teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes an edge or point that is sharp enough to cut or pierce easily.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 描述刃口或尖端锋利、容易切开或刺穿东西的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi tarf jew ponta li jaqtgħu jew itaqqbu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 锋利的，指刃口或尖端容易切开或刺穿东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li għandha tarf jew ponta li jaqtgħu jew itaqqbu faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is sharp has an edge or point that can cut or pierce things easily.

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, ivverifika li t-tarf tas-sikkina jkun misnun.
formal.en: Before use, check that the knife's edge is sharp.
formal.zh: 使用前，请检查刀刃是否锋利。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mus misnun? Mark: Iva, oqgħod attenta meta taqta' l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this pocketknife sharp? Mark: Yes, be careful when you cut the bread.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这把小折刀锋利吗？马克：锋利，切面包的时候小心。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mus misnun?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mus misnun?
messages.zh: 这把小折刀锋利吗？
messages.en: Is this pocketknife sharp?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oqgħod attenta meta taqta' l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oqgħod attenta meta taqta' l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 锋利，切面包的时候小心。
messages.en: Yes, be careful when you cut the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 misnun 和刀刃轻松切开面包的画面一起记，联想“刃口锋利”；这是情景记忆，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open public space in a town or village where people can meet or gather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄中供人们见面、聚集的公共露天广场。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju pubbliku miftuħ f'belt jew raħal fejn in-nies jistgħu jiltaqgħu jew jinġabru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄内的公共广场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju pubbliku miftuħ f'belt jew raħal, li jintuża għal-laqgħat u attivitajiet oħra tal-komunità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A town or village square is an open public area where people meet and community activities can take place.

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa pubblika se ssir fil-misraħ tar-raħal nhar il-Ħadd filgħodu.
formal.en: The public meeting will take place in the village square on Sunday morning.
formal.zh: 公众会议将于星期日上午在村庄广场举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Fil-misraħ, ħdejn il-funtana.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: In the square, next to the fountain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里见面？马克：在广场的喷泉旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-misraħ, ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-misraħ, ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.zh: 在广场的喷泉旁边。
messages.en: In the square, next to the fountain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时想象村民约在喷泉旁见面，把 misraħ 与“村里的公共广场”连成一个画面；注意标准拼写末尾是 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a hand, finger, or another part of the body against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手、手指或身体其他部位接触某人或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed idek, subgħajk jew parti oħra minn ġismek f'kuntatt ma' persuna jew ma' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触摸；使手指或身体其他部位与某人或某物接触。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel kuntatt ma' persuna jew ma' xi ħaġa b'idek, b'subgħajk jew b'parti oħra minn ġismek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you touch someone or something, you bring your hand or another part of your body into contact with them.

collocations.en: touch the surface with your finger

formal.mt: Qabel ma tmiss l-oġġett, aħsel idejk u nixxifhom sew.
formal.en: Before touching the object, wash your hands and dry them thoroughly.
formal.zh: 触摸物品前，请洗手并将双手彻底擦干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nmiss dan id-drapp? Mark: Iva, missu. Huwa artab ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I touch this fabric? Mark: Yes, touch it. It is very soft.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以摸摸这块布料吗？马克：可以，摸摸吧。它非常柔软。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nmiss dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nmiss dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 我可以摸摸这块布料吗？
messages.en: Can I touch this fabric?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, missu. Huwa artab ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, missu. Huwa artab ħafna.
messages.zh: 可以，摸摸吧。它非常柔软。
messages.en: Yes, touch it. It is very soft.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸出一根手指轻轻碰布料，同时说 miss，把词和“触摸”的动作绑定；不要套用英语同形词的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A weapon sent through the air towards a target.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发射后在空中飞向目标的武器，即导弹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma li tiġi sparata u ttir fl-arja lejn mira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 导弹；发射后飞向目标的武器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arma li tiġi sparata biex tivvjaġġa fl-arja u tolqot mira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A missile is a weapon that is launched through the air in order to strike a target.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi t-tnedija ta' missila waqt eżerċizzju militari.
formal.en: The report describes the launch of a missile during a military exercise.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一次军事演习中的导弹发射。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak il-mudell fil-vetrina? Mark: Huwa mudell ta' missila.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is that model in the display case? Mark: It is a model of a missile.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展柜里的那个模型是什么？马克：那是一个导弹模型。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-mudell fil-vetrina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-mudell fil-vetrina?
messages.zh: 展柜里的那个模型是什么？
messages.en: What is that model in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mudell ta' missila.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mudell ta' missila.
messages.zh: 那是一个导弹模型。
messages.en: It is a model of a missile.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 missila 和英语 missile 对照记忆，注意马耳他语的双写 ss 和词尾 a，再联想展柜里的导弹模型。

gloss_zh: 想念我（按所给英语词义理解）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression associated in this material with someone feeling the speaker's absence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本材料中对应英语“Miss me”的表达，涉及别人因说话者不在而想念说话者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni assoċjata f'dan il-materjal mal-kliem Ingliż 'Miss me', jiġifieri li xi ħadd iħoss in-nuqqas tal-persuna li qed titkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 想念我；因我不在而感到缺少我。此处按材料所给的英语词义解释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-materjal, il-kliem Ingliż 'Miss me' jirreferi għall-fatt li persuna oħra tħoss in-nuqqas tal-kelliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the expression concerns someone feeling the speaker's absence and wishing they were present.

collocations.zh: 想念我；感到我不在身边
一直想着我；仍然惦记我

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-entrata 'Missitni' tingħata bit-tifsira Ingliża 'Miss me', marbuta mal-idea li xi ħadd iħoss in-nuqqas tal-kelliem.
formal.en: In this exercise, the entry 'Missitni' is given the English meaning 'Miss me', associated with someone feeling the speaker's absence.
formal.zh: 在这项练习中，“Missitni”条目给出的英语词义是“Miss me”，对应别人因说话者不在而想念说话者的意思。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fuq il-karta 'Missitni' hemm 'Miss me'. X'idea rrid niftakar? Mark: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta ma tkunx hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: The 'Missitni' card says 'Miss me'. What idea should I remember? Mark: Think of someone who misses you when you are not there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“Missitni”这张卡上写着“Miss me”。我该记住什么情景？马克：想象一个人在你不在身边时想念你。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-karta 'Missitni' hemm 'Miss me'. X'idea rrid niftakar?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-karta 'Missitni' hemm 'Miss me'. X'idea rrid niftakar?
messages.zh: “Missitni”这张卡上写着“Miss me”。我该记住什么情景？
messages.en: The 'Missitni' card says 'Miss me'. What idea should I remember?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta ma tkunx hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb f'xi ħadd li jħoss in-nuqqas tiegħek meta ma tkunx hemm.
messages.zh: 想象一个人在你不在身边时想念你。
messages.en: Think of someone who misses you when you are not there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按所给英语提示记住“我离开了，你开始想念我”的画面；本条保留材料的词性标签，不据此推导马耳他语语法或词形。

gloss_zh: 使命；任务；慈善救助行动或机构

teaching_sense.en_definition: An important task or purpose that a person or organization undertakes, or an organized charitable effort to help people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或组织承担的重要任务、使命，也可指有组织地帮助他人的慈善救助行动或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompitu jew għan importanti li persuna jew organizzazzjoni tieħu fuqha, jew ħidma organizzata ta' karità biex tgħin lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使命；为实现特定目标而承担的重要任务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kompitu importanti li jingħata lil persuna jew grupp biex jintlaħaq għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mission is an important task that a person or group undertakes to achieve a particular purpose.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慈善救助行动或机构；以帮助有需要的人为目的的有组织服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħidma organizzata ta' karità, jew organizzazzjoni li twettaqha, biex tingħata għajnuna lil persuni fil-bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A charitable mission is an organized effort or organization that provides practical help to people in need.

formal.mt: Il-missjoni tat-tim hija li jqassam ikel u mediċini lill-familji fil-bżonn, b'kollaborazzjoni ma' missjoni ta' karità lokali.
formal.en: The team's mission is to distribute food and medicines to families in need, in collaboration with a local charitable mission.
formal.zh: 团队的任务是与当地一家慈善救助机构合作，向有需要的家庭分发食品和药品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-missjoni tagħna llum? Mark: Se ngħinu fil-missjoni ta' karità u nqassmu l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's our mission today? Mark: We're going to help at the charitable mission and hand out food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们今天的任务是什么？马克：去慈善救助机构帮忙，分发食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-missjoni tagħna llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-missjoni tagħna llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天的任务是什么？
messages.en: What's our mission today?

messages.speaker: Mark (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħinu fil-missjoni ta' karità u nqassmu l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħinu fil-missjoni ta' karità u nqassmu l-ikel.
messages.zh: 去慈善救助机构帮忙，分发食物。
messages.en: We're going to help at the charitable mission and hand out food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进“带着使命去帮助别人”的画面：先记重要任务，再联想到有组织的慈善救助，就能串起两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Difficult to understand or explain because relevant facts are unknown or hidden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因相关事实未知或被隐藏而显得神秘、难以理解或解释的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jistax jinftiehem jew jiġi spjegat faċilment għax il-fatti marbuta miegħu mhumiex magħrufa jew huma moħbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神秘的；由于情况不明而令人难以理解、解释或看透的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqajjem mistoqsijiet u ma jkunx faċli tifhmu jew tispjegah minħabba nuqqas ta' tagħrif ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something mysterious is difficult to understand or explain because important facts about it are unknown.

collocations.zh: 神秘的声音；来源不明的声响
神秘的信息；含义或来源不明的留言

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi ħoss misterjuż li nstema' fil-bini matul il-lejl, iżda s-sors tiegħu għadu mhux magħruf.
formal.en: The report describes a mysterious sound heard in the building during the night, but its source remains unknown.
formal.zh: 报告描述了夜间楼内传出的神秘声响，但其来源仍然不明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss misterjuż? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-kċina. Ejja naraw x'inhu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that mysterious sound? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen. Let's see what it is.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个神秘的声音了吗？马克：听到了，是从厨房传来的。我们去看看是什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt dak il-ħoss misterjuż?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt dak il-ħoss misterjuż?
messages.zh: 你听到那个神秘的声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that mysterious sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-kċina. Ejja naraw x'inhu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-kċina. Ejja naraw x'inhu.
messages.zh: 听到了，是从厨房传来的。我们去看看是什么。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the kitchen. Let's see what it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象深夜听见声音，却看不到来源：这种“知道有事，却解释不清”的感觉就是“神秘的”，不必联想到超自然现象。

gloss_zh: 谜；谜团；难以解释的事情

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something whose cause, nature, or explanation is unknown and which people may try to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原因、性质或解释尚不清楚，可能需要人们调查或思考才能理解的事情，即谜或谜团。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa jew ġrajja li l-kawża, in-natura jew it-tifsira tagħha mhix magħrufa u li n-nies jistgħu jippruvaw jifhmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谜；谜团；原因或真相尚未得到解释的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġa jew ġrajja li għadha ma ġietx spjegata u li ma nafux il-kawża jew il-verità dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mystery is something that people cannot yet understand or explain because the necessary facts are unknown.

formal.mt: Minkejja l-investigazzjoni dettaljata, l-għajbien tad-dokument għadu misteru, peress li ma nstabet ebda prova li tispjega x'ġara.
formal.en: Despite the detailed investigation, the document's disappearance remains a mystery, as no evidence explaining what happened has been found.
formal.zh: 尽管进行了详细调查，文件失踪一事仍是个谜，因为尚未找到能够解释事情经过的证据。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek ma sibtx iċ-ċwievet? Mark: Le, għadu misteru fejn qegħidthom. Kont ċert li ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you still not found the keys? Mark: No, where I put them is still a mystery. I was sure I'd left them on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还没找到钥匙吗？马克：没有，我把它们放哪儿了仍然是个谜。我本来很确定把它们留在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek ma sibtx iċ-ċwievet?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek ma sibtx iċ-ċwievet?
messages.zh: 你还没找到钥匙吗？
messages.en: Have you still not found the keys?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu misteru fejn qegħidthom. Kont ċert li ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu misteru fejn qegħidthom. Kont ċert li ħallejthom fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 没有，我把它们放哪儿了仍然是个谜。我本来很确定把它们留在桌上了。
messages.en: No, where I put them is still a mystery. I was sure I'd left them on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把找不到的钥匙想成一个等待解开的“谜团”：misteru 指谜团本身，上一词 misterjuż 则描述某事“神秘的”感觉。

gloss_zh: 神秘主义的；与直接灵性体验有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to mysticism or to a direct experience of God or spiritual reality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与神秘主义或直接体验神及灵性实在有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-mistiċiżmu jew ma' esperjenza diretta ta' Alla jew tar-realtà spiritwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神秘主义的；涉及直接灵性体验或与神直接相通的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mistika hija marbuta mal-mistiċiżmu jew ma' esperjenza spiritwali diretta u profonda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something mystical relates to mysticism or involves a direct and deeply felt spiritual experience.

formal.mt: L-awtur juża lingwaġġ mistiku biex jiddeskrivi r-rabta tiegħu ma' Alla.
formal.en: The author uses mystical language to describe his relationship with God.
formal.zh: 作者用神秘主义语言描述自己与神的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt il-poeżija? Mark: Għandha ton mistiku. Maja: Għaliex tgħid hekk? Mark: Għax titkellem dwar esperjenza profonda tal-preżenza ta' Alla.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the poem? Mark: It has a mystical tone. Maja: Why do you say that? Mark: Because it describes a profound experience of God's presence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得这首诗怎么样？Mark：它带有神秘主义的语调。Maja：你为什么这么说？Mark：因为它讲述了深切感受到神的临在的体验。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt il-poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt il-poeżija?
messages.zh: 你觉得这首诗怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the poem?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha ton mistiku.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha ton mistiku.
messages.zh: 它带有神秘主义的语调。
messages.en: It has a mystical tone.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid hekk?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么说？
messages.en: Why do you say that?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax titkellem dwar esperjenza profonda tal-preżenza ta' Alla.
messages.mt_standard: Għax titkellem dwar esperjenza profonda tal-preżenza ta' Alla.
messages.zh: 因为它讲述了深切感受到神的临在的体验。
messages.en: Because it describes a profound experience of God's presence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mistiku 放在“文本、语调、体验”旁边记忆：它负责描述事物具有神秘主义或灵性体验的性质。

gloss_zh: 神秘主义；强调直接灵性体验的思想或实践

teaching_sense.en_definition: Spiritual belief or practice that seeks direct experience of God or spiritual reality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 寻求直接体验神或灵性实在的思想或实践，常重视内在体验与沉思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin jew prattika spiritwali li tfittex esperjenza diretta ta' Alla jew tar-realtà spiritwali, spiss permezz tal-kontemplazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神秘主义，指寻求直接体验神或灵性实在的思想与实践。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mistiċiżmu huwa twemmin jew prattika li tagħti importanza lill-esperjenza diretta ta' Alla jew tar-realtà spiritwali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mysticism is spiritual belief or practice that seeks a direct experience of God or spiritual reality.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jeżamina r-rabta bejn il-mistiċiżmu u l-esperjenza spiritwali personali.
formal.en: The article examines the relationship between mysticism and personal spiritual experience.
formal.zh: 这篇文章考察神秘主义与个人灵性体验之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Ktieb dwar il-mistiċiżmu. Maja: Dwar xiex jitkellem? Mark: Dwar kif in-nies ifittxu esperjenza diretta ta' Alla.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: A book about mysticism. Maja: What does it discuss? Mark: How people seek a direct experience of God.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Mark：一本关于神秘主义的书。Maja：它讲什么？Mark：讲人们如何寻求直接体验神。

messages.mt_standard: Dwar kif in-nies ifittxu esperjenza diretta ta' Alla.
messages.zh: 讲人们如何寻求直接体验神。
messages.en: How people seek a direct experience of God.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词配上一幅静坐沉思的画面：学习时记作“追求直接灵性体验的神秘主义”，不要只联想到神秘事件。

gloss_zh: 他正躲着；他处于藏身状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: He is staying somewhere where other people cannot easily see or find him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示他正藏在某处，别人不容易看见或找到他。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li raġel jew tifel qiegħed f'post fejn ħaddieħor ma jistax jarah jew isibu faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 他正躲着，处于不容易被别人看见或找到的藏身状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Hu qiegħed f'post fejn ma jidhirx jew fejn ħaddieħor ma jistax isibu faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If he is hiding, he is somewhere other people cannot easily see or find him.

collocations.en: he is hiding behind the door
he is still hiding under the bed

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, it-tifel huwa mistoħbi wara l-purtiera waqt li sħabu jfittxuh.
formal.en: In the story, the boy is hiding behind the curtain while his friends look for him.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩正躲在窗帘后面，他的朋友们在找他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Hu mistoħbi wara l-bieb. Maja: Qed jilgħab magħna? Mark: Iva, qed jistenna li nsibuh.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is Pawlu? Mark: He is hiding behind the door. Maja: Is he playing with us? Mark: Yes, he is waiting for us to find him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 在哪里？Mark：他正躲在门后。Maja：他在跟我们玩游戏吗？Mark：是的，他正等着我们找到他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu?
messages.zh: Pawlu 在哪里？
messages.en: Where is Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu mistoħbi wara l-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Hu mistoħbi wara l-bieb.
messages.zh: 他正躲在门后。
messages.en: He is hiding behind the door.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jilgħab magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Qed jilgħab magħna?
messages.zh: 他在跟我们玩游戏吗？
messages.en: Is he playing with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jistenna li nsibuh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jistenna li nsibuh.
messages.zh: 是的，他正等着我们找到他。
messages.en: Yes, he is waiting for us to find him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象捉迷藏时一个男孩躲在门后，把 hu mistoħbi 整块记成“他正躲着”，再接地点说明他藏在哪里。

gloss_zh: 隐藏的；隐蔽的；未显露的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Kept out of sight or not readily visible, known, or noticed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被遮藏而看不见的，或不容易被发现、知晓或察觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jidhirx għax hu mgħotti jew moħbi, jew li mhuwiex magħruf jew innutat faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 隐藏的；隐蔽的；不易被看见、发现或知晓的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mistura ma tidhirx jew ma tkunx magħrufa faċilment għax tkun mgħottija jew moħbija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something hidden is kept out of sight or is not easily discovered or known.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi passaġġ mistur li jgħaqqad iż-żewġ kmamar tal-bini.
formal.en: The report describes a hidden passage connecting the building's two rooms.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一条连接该建筑内两个房间的隐蔽通道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif dħalt f'din il-kamra? Mark: Hemm passaġġ mistur wara l-armarju. Maja: Veru? Ma kontx naf bih! Mark: Ejja, nurik fejn hu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you get into this room? Mark: There is a hidden passage behind the wardrobe. Maja: Really? I didn't know about it! Mark: Come, I'll show you where it is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么进到这个房间的？Mark：衣柜后面有一条隐蔽的通道。Maja：真的？我都不知道！Mark：来，我指给你看它在哪里。

messages.mt_standard: Kif dħalt f'din il-kamra?

messages.en: How did you get into this room?

messages.en: Come, I'll show you where it is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“衣柜遮住通道”的画面记住 mistur：通道还在，只是没有显露；再联想到尚未展现的才华，理解其抽象用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mythology is a collection of traditional stories about gods, heroes, and the origins of the world.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神话是关于神祇、英雄及世界起源的传统故事，也可指这些故事组成的体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mitoloġija hija ġabra ta' stejjer tradizzjonali dwar allat, eroj u l-bidu tad-dinja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于神祇、英雄及世界起源的神话或神话体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' stejjer tradizzjonali li jirrakkontaw dwar allat, eroj u kif bdiet id-dinja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mythology consists of the traditional stories through which a culture describes its gods, heroes, and the origins of the world.

formal.mt: Dan il-ktieb jippreżenta stejjer mill-mitoloġija Griega u jispjega r-rwol tal-allat fihom.
formal.en: This book presents stories from Greek mythology and explains the role of the gods in them.
formal.zh: 本书介绍希腊神话中的故事，并解释神祇在这些故事中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Leo: Ktieb dwar il-mitoloġija Griega. Maja: Fih stejjer dwar l-allat? Leo: Iva, u dwar l-eroj ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Leo: A book about Greek mythology. Maja: Does it have stories about the gods? Leo: Yes, and about heroes too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Leo：一本关于希腊神话的书。Maja：里面有关于神祇的故事吗？Leo：有，也有关于英雄的故事。

messages.mt_standard: Ktieb dwar il-mitoloġija Griega.

messages.mt_standard: Fih stejjer dwar l-allat?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dwar l-eroj ukoll.
messages.zh: 有，也有关于英雄的故事。
messages.en: Yes, and about heroes too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mitoloġija 和一本画满神祇、英雄及创世故事的书联系起来，再用“希腊神话”这个搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 极度虚弱的；流产的；流产胎儿；极虚弱者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term describing someone as extremely weak, or a fetus whose development ended before birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述极度虚弱的状态，也可表示胎儿流产、未能继续发育的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li huwa dgħajjef ħafna, jew fetu li l-iżvilupp tiegħu waqaf qabel it-twelid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极度虚弱的；也指流产的、未能继续发育的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi stat ta' dgħufija kbira ħafna; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi fetu li ma kompliex jiżviluppa sat-twelid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as mitruħ is extremely weak; the term can also describe a fetus whose development ended before birth.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流产的胎儿；极其虚弱的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fetu li ma kompliex jiżviluppa sat-twelid, jew persuna li tkun dgħajfa ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: As a noun, mitruħ refers to an aborted fetus or to a person who is extremely weak.

collocations.en: still extremely weak after the illness

formal.mt: Wara l-marda, ir-raġel baqa' mitruħ għal diversi jiem u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
formal.en: After the illness, the man remained extremely weak for several days and needed help to walk.
formal.zh: 患病后，这名男子连续几天都极度虚弱，走路需要他人帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif qed tħossok illum? Mark: Għadni mitruħ wara l-marda. Sara: Trid inġiblek tazza ilma? Mark: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: How are you feeling today? Mark: I'm still extremely weak after the illness. Sara: Shall I bring you a glass of water? Mark: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你今天感觉怎么样？Mark：病后我还是非常虚弱。Sara：要我给你拿杯水吗？Mark：好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qed tħossok illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qed tħossok illum?
messages.zh: 你今天感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling today?

messages.speaker: Mark (病后休养者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mitruħ wara l-marda.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mitruħ wara l-marda.
messages.zh: 病后我还是非常虚弱。
messages.en: I'm still extremely weak after the illness.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid inġiblek tazza ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Trid inġiblek tazza ilma?
messages.zh: 要我给你拿杯水吗？
messages.en: Shall I bring you a glass of water?

messages.speaker: Mark (病后休养者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 mitruħ 放进“病后虚弱得需要帮助”的画面，记牢程度很重；再另设“流产”义项卡，分别记忆，避免混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: We are walking means that we are moving on foot at the time being described.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示我们在所说的时间正在步行、靠双脚前进。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aħna qed nimxu bil-mixi fil-ħin li qed nitkellmu dwaru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们正在步行；我们正走着。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aħna qed nimxu minn post għal ieħor bil-mixi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we say that we are walking, we mean that we are travelling on foot at that moment.

formal.mt: Aħna mixjin lejn il-mużew, u matul it-triq qed nosservaw il-bini storiku.
formal.en: We are walking towards the museum, and along the way we are observing the historic buildings.
formal.zh: 我们正步行前往博物馆，沿途观察历史建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn intom? Leo: Aħna mixjin lejn id-dar. Maja: Għad fadlilkom ħafna? Leo: Le, naslu dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you? Leo: We are walking home. Maja: Have you still got far to go? Leo: No, we'll arrive soon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们在哪里？Leo：我们正走回家。Maja：还要走很远吗？Leo：不用，很快就到。

messages.mt_spoken: Fejn intom?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn intom?
messages.zh: 你们在哪里？
messages.en: Where are you?

messages.speaker: Leo (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna mixjin lejn id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Aħna mixjin lejn id-dar.
messages.zh: 我们正走回家。
messages.en: We are walking home.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad fadlilkom ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Għad fadlilkom ħafna?
messages.zh: 还要走很远吗？
messages.en: Have you still got far to go?

messages.speaker: Leo (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, naslu dalwaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Le, naslu dalwaqt.
messages.zh: 不用，很快就到。
messages.en: No, we'll arrive soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己和朋友一起走回家，边走边说 Aħna mixjin lejn id-dar；用同行画面记住这里的“我们正在步行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Completely full or containing a very large amount of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某个容器或地方装得很满，或充满大量的人或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli għalkollox jew li jkun fih għadd kbir ta' nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: Full to the brim, full of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 满到边缘的；充满某种东西的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli sax-xifer jew li jkun fih ħafna minn xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a container or place is described this way, it is completely full or contains a great deal of something.

formal.mt: Waqt il-festival, il-pjazza kienet post miżgħud bin-nies.
formal.en: During the festival, the square was a place packed with people.
formal.zh: 节日期间，广场上挤满了人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm fejn noqogħdu fil-kafetterija? Mark: Le, il-post miżgħud bin-nies. Immorru xi mkien ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there somewhere for us to sit in the café? Mark: No, the place is packed with people. Let's go somewhere else.
colloquial.zh: Maja：咖啡馆里有地方坐吗？Mark：没有，里面挤满了人。我们换个地方吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm fejn noqogħdu fil-kafetterija?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm fejn noqogħdu fil-kafetterija?
messages.zh: 咖啡馆里有地方坐吗？
messages.en: Is there somewhere for us to sit in the café?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-post miżgħud bin-nies. Immorru xi mkien ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-post miżgħud bin-nies. Immorru xi mkien ieħor.
messages.zh: 没有，里面挤满了人。我们换个地方吧。
messages.en: No, the place is packed with people. Let's go somewhere else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżgħud 和节日广场挤满人的画面一起记：重点是数量多到整个空间都很满。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun referring to Mizwed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指称 Mizwed 的名词；学习时将这两个名称对应记忆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jintuża biex jirreferi għal Mizwed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Mizwed；此处为该名称的对应词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelma Mizwet tintuża biex tirreferi għal Mizwed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The noun Mizwet is used to refer to Mizwed.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kelma 'Mizwet' tintuża biex tirreferi għal Mizwed.
formal.en: In this example, the word 'Mizwet' is used to refer to Mizwed.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，“Mizwet”一词用于指称 Mizwed。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Qrajt il-kelma 'Mizwet'. Għal xiex tirreferi? Pawlu: Tirreferi għal Mizwed. Tista' tikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet flimkien fin-noti tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Lina: I read the word 'Mizwet'. What does it refer to? Pawlu: It refers to Mizwed. You can write the two names together in your notes.
colloquial.zh: Lina：我读到了“Mizwet”这个词。它指什么？Pawlu：它指 Mizwed。你可以把这两个名称一起记在笔记里。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Qrajt il-kelma 'Mizwet'. Għal xiex tirreferi?
messages.mt_standard: Qrajt il-kelma 'Mizwet'. Għal xiex tirreferi?
messages.zh: 我读到了“Mizwet”这个词。它指什么？
messages.en: I read the word 'Mizwet'. What does it refer to?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tirreferi għal Mizwed. Tista' tikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet flimkien fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Tirreferi għal Mizwed. Tista' tikteb iż-żewġ ismijiet flimkien fin-noti tiegħek.
messages.zh: 它指 Mizwed。你可以把这两个名称一起记在笔记里。
messages.en: It refers to Mizwed. You can write the two names together in your notes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张双面词卡配对记忆：正面写 Mizwet，背面写 Mizwed，先牢牢记住名称对应关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fee is an amount of money paid for a service, admission, or participation in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为获得服务、进入某处或参加某项活动而支付的一笔费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżata hija somma flus li titħallas għal servizz, għad-dħul f'post jew għall-parteċipazzjoni f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为服务、入场、报名或参加活动等支付的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma flus li persuna tħallas biex tirċievi servizz, tidħol f'post jew tieħu sehem f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fee is a sum of money that you pay to receive a service or to take part in something.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom iħallsu l-miżata ta' reġistrazzjoni qabel il-bidu tal-kors.
formal.en: Participants must pay the registration fee before the course begins.
formal.zh: 参加者须在课程开始前支付报名费。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm hi l-miżata għall-kors? Rita: Għoxrin ewro. Mark: Nista' nħallasha hawn? Rita: Iva, tista' tħallas hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much is the fee for the course? Rita: Twenty euros. Mark: Can I pay it here? Rita: Yes, you can pay here.
colloquial.zh: Mark：课程费用是多少？Rita：二十欧元。Mark：我可以在这里付款吗？Rita：可以，在这里付就行。

messages.speaker: Mark (报名者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi l-miżata għall-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi l-miżata għall-kors?
messages.zh: 课程费用是多少？
messages.en: How much is the fee for the course?

messages.speaker: Rita (课程接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro.
messages.zh: 二十欧元。
messages.en: Twenty euros.

messages.speaker: Mark (报名者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħallasha hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħallasha hawn?
messages.zh: 我可以在这里付款吗？
messages.en: Can I pay it here?

messages.speaker: Rita (课程接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tħallas hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tħallas hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，在这里付就行。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżata 写在课程报名处的收费牌上，联想“先问费用，再付报名费”，配合 tħallas il-miżata 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing seeds that have been planted, or land in which seeds have been planted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容种子已经播下，或土地已经播种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi żerriegħa li tqiegħdet fl-art biex tikber, jew art li nżergħet fiha ż-żerriegħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已播下的；已播种的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi żerriegħa li diġà tqiegħdet fl-art, jew art li diġà nżergħet fiha ż-żerriegħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Seeds that are sown have been planted in soil, and land described as sown already has seeds planted in it.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istat tar-raba' miżrugħ bil-qamħ.
formal.en: The report describes the condition of the land sown with wheat.
formal.zh: 报告描述了已播种小麦的农田的状况。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan ir-raba' diġà miżrugħ? Pawlu: Iva, żrajna l-qamħ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has this land already been sown? Pawlu: Yes, we sowed the wheat last week.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这块田已经播种了吗？保罗：是的，我们上周播了小麦。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-raba' diġà miżrugħ?
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-raba' diġà miżrugħ?
messages.zh: 这块田已经播种了吗？
messages.en: Has this land already been sown?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żrajna l-qamħ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żrajna l-qamħ il-ġimgħa li għaddiet.
messages.zh: 是的，我们上周播了小麦。
messages.en: Yes, we sowed the wheat last week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象田里已经埋好种子，把 miżrugħ 与“播种已完成”的画面相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action taken for a particular purpose, or a quantity or standard used in measuring something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个目的采取的措施，也可指测量时使用的数量、尺度或单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni li tittieħed għal għan partikolari, jew kwantità, skala jew unità li tintuża biex jitkejjel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 措施；用于衡量或测量的尺度、数量或单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura hija azzjoni maħsuba biex jintlaħaq għan, jew kwantità jew standard li jintuża fil-kejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A measure is an action intended to achieve a particular result, or a quantity or standard used to establish how much of something there is.

formal.mt: L-iskola introduċiet miżura ġdida biex ittejjeb is-sigurtà tal-istudenti.
formal.en: The school introduced a new measure to improve student safety.
formal.zh: 学校推出了一项新措施，以提高学生的安全保障。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex żammejtu dan il-bieb magħluq? Mark: Hija miżura ta' sigurtà biex it-tfal ma joħorġux waħedhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why have you kept this door closed? Mark: It is a safety measure to stop the children going out on their own.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你们为什么一直关着这扇门？马克：这是一项安全措施，防止孩子们独自出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żammejtu dan il-bieb magħluq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żammejtu dan il-bieb magħluq?
messages.zh: 你们为什么一直关着这扇门？
messages.en: Why have you kept this door closed?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija miżura ta' sigurtà biex it-tfal ma joħorġux waħedhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hija miżura ta' sigurtà biex it-tfal ma joħorġux waħedhom.
messages.zh: 这是一项安全措施，防止孩子们独自出去。
messages.en: It is a safety measure to stop the children going out on their own.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 miżura：关门保障安全是“措施”，拿尺确定长度要用“尺度”。

gloss_zh: 反补贴措施；抵消补贴影响的措施

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure intended to counteract the effects of subsidies on trade or competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为抵消补贴对贸易或竞争造成的影响而采取的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura maħsuba biex tikkontrobilanċja l-effetti tas-sussidji fuq il-kummerċ jew il-kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反补贴措施，即针对补贴所造成的贸易或竞争影响采取的措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li tittieħed kontra l-effetti tas-sussidji fuq il-kummerċ jew il-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-subsidy measure is an action taken to address the effects that subsidies have on trade or competition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵消性措施；在补贴语境中，指为抵消补贴影响而采取的反补贴措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li għandha l-għan li tikkontrobilanċja effett jew vantaġġ; fil-kuntest tas-sussidji, tintuża biex tikkontrobilanċja l-effetti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A countervailing measure is an action intended to offset an effect or advantage, particularly one arising from subsidies in a trade context.

collocations.en: the imposition of a countervailing measure
the application of a countervailing measure
the review of a countervailing measure
collocations.zh: 对一项反补贴措施的复审

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk miżura kompensatorja tistax tnaqqas l-effett tas-sussidji fuq il-kompetizzjoni.
formal.en: The report examines whether a countervailing measure could reduce the effect of subsidies on competition.
formal.zh: 报告研究了一项反补贴措施能否减轻补贴对竞争造成的影响。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura kompensatorja? David: Biex inaqqsu l-vantaġġ li xi prodotti għandhom minħabba s-sussidji.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are they proposing a countervailing measure? David: To reduce the advantage that some products have because of subsidies.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：他们为什么提议采取反补贴措施？戴维：为了减小某些产品因补贴而获得的优势。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura kompensatorja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura kompensatorja?
messages.zh: 他们为什么提议采取反补贴措施？
messages.en: Why are they proposing a countervailing measure?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inaqqsu l-vantaġġ li xi prodotti għandhom minħabba s-sussidji.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inaqqsu l-vantaġġ li xi prodotti għandhom minħabba s-sussidji.
messages.zh: 为了减小某些产品因补贴而获得的优势。
messages.en: To reduce the advantage that some products have because of subsidies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象补贴使天平一端倾斜，再用措施抵消影响，把整个短语记作“反补贴措施”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure that gives a particular person, group, product, or country more favourable treatment than others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予某个人、群体、产品或国家比其他对象更有利待遇的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tagħti lil persuna, grupp, prodott jew pajjiż partikolari trattament aktar favorevoli minn dak mogħti lil oħrajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优惠措施；使特定对象获得较有利待遇的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li permezz tagħha persuna, grupp, prodott jew pajjiż jirċievi trattament aktar favorevoli minn oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A preferential measure is an arrangement that gives a particular person, group, product, or country more favourable treatment than others receive.

collocations.en: the introduction of a preferential measure
to benefit from a preferential measure

formal.mt: Il-proposta tinkludi miżura preferenzjali li tippermetti lill-istudenti jħallsu miżata aktar baxxa.
formal.en: The proposal includes a preferential measure allowing students to pay a lower fee.
formal.zh: 该提案包含一项优惠措施，允许学生缴纳较低的费用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-istudenti jħallsu inqas għal dan il-kors? Toni: Hemm miżura preferenzjali għalihom, biex ikun aktar faċli għalihom li jattendu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why do students pay less for this course? Toni: There is a preferential measure for them to make it easier for them to attend.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么学生参加这门课程付的钱更少？托尼：有一项面向他们的优惠措施，让他们更容易参加。

messages.speaker: Sara (课程咨询者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-istudenti jħallsu inqas għal dan il-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-istudenti jħallsu inqas għal dan il-kors?
messages.zh: 为什么学生参加这门课程付的钱更少？
messages.en: Why do students pay less for this course?

messages.speaker: Toni (课程工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm miżura preferenzjali għalihom, biex ikun aktar faċli għalihom li jattendu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm miżura preferenzjali għalihom, biex ikun aktar faċli għalihom li jattendu.
messages.zh: 有一项面向他们的优惠措施，让他们更容易参加。
messages.en: There is a preferential measure for them to make it easier for them to attend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语放进“学生享较低费用”的情景，记住 miżura preferenzjali 表示给予特定对象优惠的措施。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measure that grants favourable treatment in trade through arrangements other than customs tariffs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过关税以外的安排，在贸易中给予较优惠待遇的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tagħti trattament aktar favorevoli fil-kummerċ permezz ta' arranġamenti li ma jinvolvux it-tariffi doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不以关税优惠为手段，而通过其他贸易安排给予较优惠待遇的措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura li tagħti vantaġġ jew trattament preferenzjali fil-kummerċ b'mezzi oħra għajr it-tariffi doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-tariff preferential measure gives certain traders or goods more favourable treatment through arrangements other than customs tariffs.

collocations.en: benefit from a non-tariff preferential measure
collocations.zh: 受益于非关税优惠措施

formal.mt: Il-proposta tipprevedi miżura preferenzjali nontariffarja li tissimplifika l-proċeduri amministrattivi għall-importazzjonijiet eliġibbli.
formal.en: The proposal provides for a non-tariff preferential measure that simplifies administrative procedures for eligible imports.
formal.zh: 该提案拟设立一项非关税优惠措施，为符合条件的进口货物简化行政手续。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-miżura preferenzjali nontariffarja tfisser li nħallsu inqas dazju? Pawlu: Le, f'dan il-każ tfisser li l-proċeduri jkunu aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this non-tariff preferential measure mean we pay less customs duty? Pawlu: No, in this case it means the procedures will be simpler.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这项非关税优惠措施是不是说我们要缴的关税更少？Pawlu：不是，这里是说手续会更简单。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-miżura preferenzjali nontariffarja tfisser li nħallsu inqas dazju?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-miżura preferenzjali nontariffarja tfisser li nħallsu inqas dazju?
messages.zh: 这项非关税优惠措施是不是说我们要缴的关税更少？
messages.en: Does this non-tariff preferential measure mean we pay less customs duty?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (贸易顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan il-każ tfisser li l-proċeduri jkunu aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan il-każ tfisser li l-proċeduri jkunu aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 不是，这里是说手续会更简单。
messages.en: No, in this case it means the procedures will be simpler.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记：miżura 是措施，preferenzjali 表示优惠，nontariffarja 限定为非关税；联想“手续有优惠”来记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protective action intended to prevent or limit harm, including harm to domestic producers in a trade context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止或限制损害而采取的保护性措施；在贸易语境中，可指保护国内生产者的保障措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura maħsuba biex tipprevjeni jew tillimita ħsara, fosthom ħsara lill-produtturi lokali fil-kuntest tal-kummerċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为避免或减轻损害而采取的保障措施，贸易语境中通常涉及对国内产业的保护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni protettiva li tittieħed biex jiġi evitat jew imnaqqas dannu, pereżempju lill-industrija lokali fil-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A safeguard measure is an action taken to protect people, activities, or industries from harm or serious difficulty.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina jekk hemmx bżonn ta' miżura ta' salvagwardja biex tiġi limitata l-ħsara lill-produtturi lokali.
formal.en: The report examines whether a safeguard measure is needed to limit harm to local producers.
formal.zh: 该报告研究是否需要采取保障措施，以限制本地生产者遭受的损害。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura ta' salvagwardja? Toni: Biex jipproteġu lill-produtturi lokali mill-ħsara li qed jiffaċċjaw.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why are they proposing a safeguard measure? Toni: To protect local producers from the harm they are facing.
colloquial.zh: Marija：他们为什么提出采取保障措施？Toni：为了保护本地生产者，减轻他们正面临的损害。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura ta' salvagwardja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jipproponu miżura ta' salvagwardja?
messages.zh: 他们为什么提出采取保障措施？
messages.en: Why are they proposing a safeguard measure?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jipproteġu lill-produtturi lokali mill-ħsara li qed jiffaċċjaw.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jipproteġu lill-produtturi lokali mill-ħsara li qed jiffaċċjaw.
messages.zh: 为了保护本地生产者，减轻他们正面临的损害。
messages.en: To protect local producers from the harm they are facing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成一道“防损护栏”：miżura 是措施，ta' salvagwardja 说明它用于保障和保护；用“采取保障措施”这一搭配整体记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Measures intended to protect human, animal, or plant health, especially in relation to food and agricultural trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在保护人类、动物或植物健康的措施，尤其用于食品和农产品贸易语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżuri maħsuba biex jipproteġu s-saħħa tal-bniedem, tal-annimali jew tal-pjanti, speċjalment fil-kummerċ tal-ikel u tal-prodotti agrikoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生与植物卫生措施的简称，指用于保护人类、动物或植物健康的相关措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji, magħrufa bl-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża SPS, li għandhom l-għan li jipproteġu s-saħħa tal-bniedem, tal-annimali jew tal-pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: SPS measures are sanitary and phytosanitary measures used to protect human, animal, or plant health.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卫生与植物卫生措施，涉及食品安全以及动物和植物健康方面的保护。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżuri dwar is-sikurezza tal-ikel u s-saħħa tal-annimali u tal-pjanti, maħsuba biex jipproteġu kontra riskji għas-saħħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sanitary and phytosanitary measures are actions or requirements intended to protect health through food safety and animal or plant health controls.

collocations.mt: l-applikazzjoni ta' miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji
collocations.en: the application of sanitary and phytosanitary measures
collocations.zh: 卫生与植物卫生措施的实施

collocations.en: comply with sanitary and phytosanitary measures
collocations.zh: 遵守卫生与植物卫生措施

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji applikabbli għall-importazzjoni tal-prodotti agrikoli.
formal.en: The document explains the sanitary and phytosanitary measures applicable to imports of agricultural products.
formal.zh: 该文件说明适用于农产品进口的卫生与植物卫生措施。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex iridu jiċċekkjaw dawn il-pjanti qabel jidħlu fil-pajjiż? Mark: Il-kontrolli huma parti mill-miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji biex jgħinu jipprevjenu t-tixrid tal-mard.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why do they need to check these plants before they enter the country? Mark: The checks are part of the sanitary and phytosanitary measures to help prevent the spread of disease.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些植物入境前为什么需要检查？Mark：这些检查属于卫生与植物卫生措施，有助于防止疾病传播。

messages.speaker: Nina (园艺店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex iridu jiċċekkjaw dawn il-pjanti qabel jidħlu fil-pajjiż?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex iridu jiċċekkjaw dawn il-pjanti qabel jidħlu fil-pajjiż?
messages.zh: 这些植物入境前为什么需要检查？
messages.en: Why do they need to check these plants before they enter the country?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺店店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kontrolli huma parti mill-miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji biex jgħinu jipprevjenu t-tixrid tal-mard.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kontrolli huma parti mill-miżuri sanitarji u fitosanitarji biex jgħinu jipprevjenu t-tixrid tal-mard.
messages.zh: 这些检查属于卫生与植物卫生措施，有助于防止疾病传播。
messages.en: The checks are part of the sanitary and phytosanitary measures to help prevent the spread of disease.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象食品、动物和植物一起经过健康检查：miżuri 表示多项措施，u 连接卫生与植物卫生两部分；再把整组概念与英语缩写 SPS 对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outer case in which seeds such as peas or broad beans grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 豌豆、蚕豆等植物供种子在其中生长的外壳，即豆荚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qoxra li fiha jikbru ż-żrieragħ ta' pjanti bħall-piżelli jew il-ful.

sense_translations.en_definition: pod (e.g. a pod of broad beans or peas)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 豆荚，指包裹蚕豆、豌豆等种子的荚壳。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qoxra ta' pjanta, bħal dik tal-ful jew tal-piżelli, li żżomm iż-żrieragħ ġewwa fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pod is the outer case of plants such as peas or broad beans, containing the seeds as they develop.

formal.mt: L-istudenti fetħu miżwed tal-piżelli u għaddew iż-żrieragħ li kien fih.
formal.en: The students opened a pea pod and counted the seeds inside it.
formal.zh: 学生们剥开一个豌豆荚，数了数里面的种子。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Niftaħ dan il-miżwed ukoll? Rita: Iva, iftħu u poġġi l-piżelli fl-iskutella.
colloquial.en: Lina: Shall I open this pod too? Rita: Yes, open it and put the peas in the bowl.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这个豆荚也要剥开吗？Rita：对，把它剥开，豌豆放到碗里。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Niftaħ dan il-miżwed ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Niftaħ dan il-miżwed ukoll?
messages.zh: 这个豆荚也要剥开吗？
messages.en: Shall I open this pod too?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iftħu u poġġi l-piżelli fl-iskutella.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iftħu u poġġi l-piżelli fl-iskutella.
messages.zh: 对，把它剥开，豌豆放到碗里。
messages.en: Yes, open it and put the peas in the bowl.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miżwed 想成装着一排豆子的绿色小袋：手指剥开外面的豆荚，里面才是豆粒；配合 miżwed tal-piżelli“豌豆荚”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object that is broken or damaged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指已经破裂、损坏或坏掉的物件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jkun inkiser jew li jkun ġarrab ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破损之物；处于破裂或损坏状态的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tkun miksura jew bil-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Used as a noun, this refers to something that is broken or damaged.

formal.mt: Il-mkisser għandu jissewwa jew jinbidel qabel jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The broken item should be repaired or replaced before it is used again.
formal.zh: 损坏的物件应先修理或更换，然后再使用。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema wieħed inżomm? Ġanni: Żomm dak li għadu tajjeb u warrab il-mkisser.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which one should I keep? Ġanni: Keep the one that is still in good condition and put the broken one aside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我该留下哪一个？Ġanni：留下那个还完好的，把坏的那个放到一边。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema wieħed inżomm?
messages.mt_standard: Liema wieħed inżomm?
messages.zh: 我该留下哪一个？
messages.en: Which one should I keep?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Żomm dak li għadu tajjeb u warrab il-mkisser.
messages.mt_standard: Żomm dak li għadu tajjeb u warrab il-mkisser.
messages.zh: 留下那个还完好的，把坏的那个放到一边。
messages.en: Keep the one that is still in good condition and put the broken one aside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按名词用法记成“坏的那个东西”：想象把完好的物件留下，把 il-mkisser 单独放到维修区。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Damaged, cracked, or separated into pieces.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物品已经破裂、损坏，或碎成了若干部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun ġarrbet ħsara, tkun maqsuma jew tkun saret biċċiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 破裂的；破碎的；处于损坏状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tkun miksura, bil-ħsara jew maqsuma f'biċċiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way has been damaged or broken into pieces.

formal.mt: It-tieqa mkissra fil-kuritur għandha tissewwa kemm jista' jkun malajr.
formal.en: The broken window in the corridor should be repaired as soon as possible.
formal.zh: 走廊里那扇破损的窗户应尽快修好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nuża din it-tazza? Adam: Le, dik mkissra. Ħu t-tazza l-oħra mill-armarju.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I use this cup? Adam: No, that one is broken. Take the other cup from the cupboard.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我可以用这个杯子吗？Adam：不行，那个杯子破了。拿柜子里的另一个杯子吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża din it-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża din it-tazza?
messages.zh: 我可以用这个杯子吗？
messages.en: Can I use this cup?

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dik mkissra. Ħu t-tazza l-oħra mill-armarju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dik mkissra. Ħu t-tazza l-oħra mill-armarju.
messages.zh: 不行，那个杯子破了。拿柜子里的另一个杯子吧。
messages.en: No, that one is broken. Take the other cup from the cupboard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mkissra 放进 tazza mkissra 一起读，脑中画出杯口破裂的杯子，记住它描述物品的损坏状态。

gloss_zh: 暴风雨猛烈的；风浪很大的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing weather or sea conditions with very strong winds and severe storm activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容天气暴风雨猛烈，或海面因风暴而风浪很大。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp jew baħar b'riħ qawwi ħafna u b'kundizzjonijiet ta' maltemp qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴风雨非常猛烈的；风浪非常大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi temp jew baħar meta jkun hemm maltemp qawwi ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If the weather or sea is mlangas, it is affected by very severe storm conditions.

formal.mt: Minħabba t-temp mlangas, il-vjaġġ bil-baħar ġie pospost.
formal.en: Because of the very stormy weather, the sea journey was postponed.
formal.zh: 由于暴风雨猛烈，海上行程被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se noħorġu bid-dgħajsa llum? Pawlu: Le, il-baħar mlangas wisq; aħjar nibqgħu d-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we going out in the boat today? Pawlu: No, the sea is far too stormy; we had better stay home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们今天要坐船出去吗？Pawlu：不，海上风浪太大了，我们最好待在家里。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se noħorġu bid-dgħajsa llum?
messages.mt_standard: Se noħorġu bid-dgħajsa llum?
messages.zh: 我们今天要坐船出去吗？
messages.en: Are we going out in the boat today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-baħar mlangas wisq; aħjar nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-baħar mlangas wisq; aħjar nibqgħu d-dar.
messages.zh: 不，海上风浪太大了，我们最好待在家里。
messages.en: No, the sea is far too stormy; we had better stay home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mlangas 和狂风掀起巨浪、船只推迟出航的画面绑定，记住它强调风暴非常猛烈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be held back, limited, or kept under control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到约束或限制，使行动、行为或发展被控制住。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa nżammu lura, ġew limitati jew tqiegħdu taħt kontroll.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被约束或遏制，处于受到控制的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jindika li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa ġew imrażżna jew miżmuma taħt kontroll.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is mliġġem has been held back or brought under control.

formal.mt: L-aġir aggressiv ġie mliġġem permezz ta' regoli ċari u superviżjoni regolari.
formal.en: The aggressive behaviour was restrained through clear rules and regular supervision.
formal.zh: 通过明确的规则和定期监督，攻击性行为受到了遏制。

colloquial.mt: Rita: L-aġir tiegħu fil-laqgħa kien mliġġem? Mark: Iva, din id-darba baqa' kalm u ħalla lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Was his behaviour restrained at the meeting? Mark: Yes, this time he stayed calm and let the others speak.
colloquial.zh: Rita：他在会上表现得有克制吗？Mark：是的，这次他保持冷静，也让别人发言了。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-aġir tiegħu fil-laqgħa kien mliġġem?
messages.mt_standard: L-aġir tiegħu fil-laqgħa kien mliġġem?
messages.zh: 他在会上表现得有克制吗？
messages.en: Was his behaviour restrained at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din id-darba baqa' kalm u ħalla lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din id-darba baqa' kalm u ħalla lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
messages.zh: 是的，这次他保持冷静，也让别人发言了。
messages.en: Yes, this time he stayed calm and let the others speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 mliġġem 时，想象原本要冲出去的行动被稳稳按住：核心是受到约束、被控制住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To curse someone or to take revenge for a wrong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诅咒某人，或因受到伤害、冒犯而采取报复行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu vendetta għal xi ħsara jew offiża li tkun ġarrabt.

sense_translations.en_definition: to curse or to take revenge
sense_translations.zh_definition: 诅咒某人，或为所受的伤害、冒犯而报复。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tpatti għal ħsara jew offiża billi tieħu vendetta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does this, they curse another person or take revenge for a wrong they have suffered.

collocations.en: to take revenge for an insult

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'mminditta' tista' tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu vendetta; il-kuntest jgħin biex tingħażel it-tifsira xierqa.
formal.en: The word 'mminditta' can mean to curse someone or to take revenge; the context helps determine the appropriate meaning.
formal.zh: mminditta 可以表示诅咒某人，也可以表示报复；需要结合语境判断具体含义。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'mminditta'? Marija: Tista' tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu vendetta. Aqra s-sentenza kollha biex tifhem liema tifsira għandha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'mminditta' mean? Marija: It can mean to curse someone or to take revenge. Read the whole sentence to understand which meaning it has.
colloquial.zh: Lina：mminditta 是什么意思？Marija：可以表示诅咒某人，也可以表示报复。读完整个句子，看看具体是哪一种意思。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'mminditta'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'mminditta'?
messages.zh: mminditta 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mminditta' mean?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu vendetta. Aqra s-sentenza kollha biex tifhem liema tifsira għandha.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tfisser li tisħet lil xi ħadd jew li tieħu vendetta. Aqra s-sentenza kollha biex tifhem liema tifsira għandha.
messages.zh: 可以表示诅咒某人，也可以表示报复。读完整个句子，看看具体是哪一种意思。
messages.en: It can mean to curse someone or to take revenge. Read the whole sentence to understand which meaning it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mminditta 配两张记忆卡：一张写“开口诅咒”，一张写“采取报复”；读句子时用语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of making physical contact with someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 触碰某人或某物，使身体或物体之间发生实际接触的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tmiss lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, u b'hekk isir kuntatt fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 触碰，即与某人或某物发生实际接触的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tagħmel kuntatt fiżiku ma' persuna jew ma' oġġett billi tmisshom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This refers to the act of making physical contact with a person or an object.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, it-terminu 'mmissu' jindika l-att tal-mess, bħal meta saba' jagħmel kuntatt ma' wiċċ oġġett.
formal.en: In this lesson, the term 'mmissu' denotes the act of touching, as when a finger makes contact with the surface of an object.
formal.zh: 在本课中，mmissu 表示触碰这一行为，例如手指接触到物体表面。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Xi jfisser 'mmissu' f'din il-lezzjoni? Sara: L-att li tmiss xi ħaġa, bħal meta tpoġġi subgħajk fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Ben: What does 'mmissu' mean in this lesson? Sara: The act of touching something, like when you put your finger on the table.
colloquial.zh: Ben：这课里的 mmissu 是什么意思？Sara：就是触碰某物这一行为，比如把手指放到桌面上。

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'mmissu' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'mmissu' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 这课里的 mmissu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'mmissu' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: L-att li tmiss xi ħaġa, bħal meta tpoġġi subgħajk fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: L-att li tmiss xi ħaġa, bħal meta tpoġġi subgħajk fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 就是触碰某物这一行为，比如把手指放到桌面上。
messages.en: The act of touching something, like when you put your finger on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 mmissu 时，用手指轻点桌面，把这个接触动作当作“触碰这件事”来记，帮助掌握本条的名词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used when letters, designs, or other marks have been cut into a hard surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示文字、图案或其他标记已经被刻入坚硬物体的表面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li ittri, disinji jew marki oħra ġew imnaqqxa f'wiċċ ta' materjal iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被刻入硬质表面，形成文字、图案或标记。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li saru ittri, disinji jew marki fuq wiċċ iebes billi nqata' l-materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If letters or designs are engraved, they have been cut into the surface of a hard material.

formal.mt: Id-data u l-ismijiet kienu mnaqqxa fuq pjanċa tal-metall ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: The date and the names were engraved on a metal plaque beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 日期和姓名被刻在入口旁的一块金属牌上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dawn l-ittri mnaqqxa fuq il-kaxxa! Mark: Iva, huma l-inizjali ta' nannti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at these letters engraved on the box! Mark: Yes, they are my grandmother's initials.
colloquial.zh: Lara：看盒子上刻着的这些字母！Mark：对，那是我奶奶姓名的首字母。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dawn l-ittri mnaqqxa fuq il-kaxxa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dawn l-ittri mnaqqxa fuq il-kaxxa!
messages.zh: 看盒子上刻着的这些字母！
messages.en: Look at these letters engraved on the box!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma l-inizjali ta' nannti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma l-inizjali ta' nannti.
messages.zh: 对，那是我奶奶姓名的首字母。
messages.en: Yes, they are my grandmother's initials.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用手指沿着石头上的刻字凹槽移动，把 mnaqqxa 与“已经刻进表面”的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having mould growing on its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面长有霉菌的；发霉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-moffa tikber fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因霉菌滋生而长霉的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li fuqha kibret il-moffa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is mouldy has mould growing on it.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instab ħobż mnawwar fuq waħda mill-ixkafef.
formal.en: During the inspection, mouldy bread was found on one of the shelves.
formal.zh: 检查时，在其中一个架子上发现了发霉的面包。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ħobż mnawwar? Pawlu: Iva, ara l-moffa fuq il-wiċċ. Se narmih.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this bread mouldy? Pawlu: Yes, look at the mould on the surface. I'll throw it away.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个面包发霉了吗？Pawlu：是啊，看表面上的霉。我把它扔掉。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ħobż mnawwar?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ħobż mnawwar?
messages.zh: 这个面包发霉了吗？
messages.en: Is this bread mouldy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara l-moffa fuq il-wiċċ. Se narmih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara l-moffa fuq il-wiċċ. Se narmih.
messages.zh: 是啊，看表面上的霉。我把它扔掉。
messages.en: Yes, look at the mould on the surface. I'll throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一片长着霉点的面包，再配上 ħobż mnawwar，用具体画面记住“发霉的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form whose meaning has not been established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个词义尚未确定的动词形式，暂不赋予具体动作含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' verb li t-tifsira tagħha għadha mhix stabbilita hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚未确定，无法给出具体的动词释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din il-forma verbali għadha mhix stabbilita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this verb form has not yet been established.

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'mnebbaħ' għadha trid tiġi vverifikata qabel ma tingħata definizzjoni preċiża.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'mnebbaħ' still needs to be verified before a precise definition can be given.
formal.zh: “mnebbaħ”一词的含义仍需核实，之后才能给出准确释义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mnebbaħ'? Rita: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha f'dizzjunarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'mnebbaħ' mean? Rita: I don't know yet. Let's look up its meaning in a dictionary.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“mnebbaħ”这个词是什么意思？Rita：我还不知道。我们查查词典里的解释吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mnebbaħ'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'mnebbaħ'?
messages.zh: “mnebbaħ”这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'mnebbaħ' mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha f'dizzjunarju.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Ejja nfittxu t-tifsira tagħha f'dizzjunarju.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。我们查查词典里的解释吧。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's look up its meaning in a dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mnebbaħ 写在“待查词义”卡片上，先辨认拼写，核实后再补含义；不要把 idk 当作词义背诵。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The parts of people's faces or animals' heads used for smelling and breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指多个鼻子，即人脸或动物头部用于嗅觉和呼吸的部位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-partijiet ta' wiċċ in-nies jew ta' ras l-annimali li jintużaw biex ixommu u jieħdu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻子，复数；指人或动物用于嗅闻和呼吸的部位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-partijiet tal-wiċċ jew tar-ras li bihom in-nies jew l-annimali jxommu u jieħdu n-nifs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People's or animals' noses are the parts of their faces or heads through which they smell and breathe.

formal.mt: It-tfal kellhom il-mniħrijiet ħomor wara li qagħdu fil-kesħa.
formal.en: The children had red noses after being out in the cold.
formal.zh: 孩子们在寒冷的室外待过之后，鼻子都红了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex għandkom il-mniħrijiet ħomor? Ben: Konna barra fil-kesħa. Issa se nidħlu ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are your noses red? Ben: We were outside in the cold. We're going inside now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们的鼻子怎么都红了？Ben：我们刚才在外面挨冻。现在要进屋了。

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandkom il-mniħrijiet ħomor?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandkom il-mniħrijiet ħomor?
messages.zh: 你们的鼻子怎么都红了？
messages.en: Why are your noses red?

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Konna barra fil-kesħa. Issa se nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Konna barra fil-kesħa. Issa se nidħlu ġewwa.
messages.zh: 我们刚才在外面挨冻。现在要进屋了。
messages.en: We were outside in the cold. We're going inside now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排孩子冻红的鼻子，用 mniħrijiet ħomor 配图记忆，同时提醒自己这里说的是多个鼻子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A style of clothing or appearance, especially one that is popular at a particular time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衣着或外观的风格，尤指某一时期流行的穿着方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil ta' lbies jew ta' dehra, speċjalment wieħed li jkun popolari fi żmien partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衣着或外观呈现出的特定风格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod partikolari ta' kif wieħed jilbes jew jippreżenta d-dehra tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A moda is a particular style expressed through clothing or personal appearance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某种穿着或外观样式在特定时期的流行、时兴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-popolarità li jkollu stil ta' lbies jew ta' dehra fi żmien partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moda can refer to the temporary popularity of a particular look or style.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时尚；某一时期广泛流行的衣着及外观潮流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xejriet fil-ħwejjeġ u fid-dehra li jkunu popolari f'perjodu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moda is the clothing and appearance that people consider fashionable at a particular time.

formal.mt: Il-wirja turi kif inbidlet il-moda tal-ħwejjeġ matul is-snin.
formal.en: The exhibition shows how clothing fashion has changed over the years.
formal.zh: 展览展示了服装时尚多年来的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żraben għadhom fil-moda? Lara: Iva, imma agħżel dawk li jogħġbuk u li huma komdi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these shoes still in fashion? Lara: Yes, but choose the ones you like and find comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些鞋还流行吗？Lara：流行，不过要选你喜欢而且穿着舒服的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żraben għadhom fil-moda?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żraben għadhom fil-moda?
messages.zh: 这些鞋还流行吗？
messages.en: Are these shoes still in fashion?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma agħżel dawk li jogħġbuk u li huma komdi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma agħżel dawk li jogħġbuk u li huma komdi.
messages.zh: 流行，不过要选你喜欢而且穿着舒服的。
messages.en: Yes, but choose the ones you like and find comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moda 放进穿衣场景记：fil-moda 是走在潮流里，barra mill-moda 是已经过时；用这组对照串起风格、时兴和时尚三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way in which a device, function, or system is activated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使设备、功能或系统开始工作的方式，例如手动操作或通过传感器触发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif apparat, funzjoni jew sistema tibda taħdem, pereżempju b'azzjoni manwali jew permezz ta' sensur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激活方式；使设备、系统或功能启动的具体方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod speċifiku li bih jiġi attivat apparat, sistema jew funzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The modalità ta' attivazzjoni specifies how a device, system, or function is made to start operating.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-apparat, agħżel il-modalità ta' attivazzjoni xierqa: bil-buttuna jew permezz tas-sensur.
formal.en: Before using the device, select the appropriate activation mode: by button or through the sensor.
formal.zh: 使用设备前，请选择合适的激活方式：按键启动或传感器触发。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Liema modalità ta' attivazzjoni għażilt għad-dawl? Sara: Dik bis-sensur, biex id-dawl jixgħel meta nidħol.
colloquial.en: Mark: Which activation mode did you choose for the light? Sara: The sensor mode, so the light comes on when I enter.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你给灯选了哪种启动模式？Sara：传感器模式，这样我一进来灯就会亮。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema modalità ta' attivazzjoni għażilt għad-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Liema modalità ta' attivazzjoni għażilt għad-dawl?
messages.zh: 你给灯选了哪种启动模式？
messages.en: Which activation mode did you choose for the light?

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik bis-sensur, biex id-dawl jixgħel meta nidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Dik bis-sensur, biex id-dawl jixgħel meta nidħol.
messages.zh: 传感器模式，这样我一进来灯就会亮。
messages.en: The sensor mode, so the light comes on when I enter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象设置页面上的启动选项：按按钮还是靠感应？把整组 modalità ta' attivazzjoni 与“如何启动”绑定记忆，重点记住 attivazzjoni 对应激活。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The method used to deliver goods or other items to their recipient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物或其他物品交给接收者所采用的方式，例如邮寄或快递。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-metodu li jintuża biex merkanzija jew oġġetti oħra jaslu għand min għandu jirċevihom, pereżempju bil-posta jew b'kurrier.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交付或配送方式；将物品送交接收者所采用的方法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif merkanzija jew oġġetti oħra jitwasslu għand il-persuna li għandha tirċevihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The modalità ta' kunsinna is the method by which items are delivered to their intended recipient.

formal.mt: Meta timla l-formola tal-ordni, indika l-modalità ta' kunsinna li tippreferi: bil-posta jew b'kurrier.
formal.en: When completing the order form, indicate your preferred delivery method: by post or by courier.
formal.zh: 填写订单表格时，请注明您偏好的配送方式：邮寄或快递。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema modalità ta' kunsinna nagħżel għal dan il-pakkett? Pawlu: Agħżel il-kurrier jekk trid li jasal għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which delivery method should I choose for this parcel? Pawlu: Choose the courier if you want it to arrive tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个包裹我该选哪种配送方式？Pawlu：如果你想让它明天送到，就选快递。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema modalità ta' kunsinna nagħżel għal dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: Liema modalità ta' kunsinna nagħżel għal dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个包裹我该选哪种配送方式？
messages.en: Which delivery method should I choose for this parcel?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħżel il-kurrier jekk trid li jasal għada.
messages.mt_standard: Agħżel il-kurrier jekk trid li jasal għada.
messages.zh: 如果你想让它明天送到，就选快递。
messages.en: Choose the courier if you want it to arrive tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象网购结账时选择邮寄或快递：modalità ta' kunsinna 回答“东西怎样送到”。与启动方式并排记，看到 kunsinna 就切换到包裹交付场景。

gloss_zh: 适度的；温和的；有节制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not extreme or excessive in amount, intensity, behaviour, or opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在数量、强度、行为或观点上不过分、不极端的；适度或温和的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx eċċessiv jew estrem fil-kwantità, fl-intensità, fl-imġiba jew fl-opinjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适度的；程度、数量或强度不过高的，也可指观点温和、不极端。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ta' livell jew intensità mhux għolja żżejjed, jew li jesprimi opinjonijiet li mhumiex estremi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is moderat has a limited degree or intensity, while a moderat opinion avoids extremes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有节制的；在行为、欲望或情绪表达上克制而不过分的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri rażan fl-imġiba, fix-xewqat jew fir-reazzjonijiet tiegħu u jevita l-eċċessi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person who is moderat exercises restraint in behaviour, desires, or emotional reactions.

formal.mt: Fir-risposta tiegħu għall-kritika, il-kelliem żamm ton moderat u spjega l-pożizzjoni tiegħu mingħajr kliem iebes.
formal.en: In his response to the criticism, the speaker maintained a temperate tone and explained his position without harsh language.
formal.zh: 回应批评时，发言人保持温和克制的语气，说明了自己的立场，没有使用尖刻的言辞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Illum se nimxu malajr ħafna? Mark: Le, inżommu pass moderat biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu waqt il-mixja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going to walk very fast today? Mark: No, let's keep a moderate pace so we can talk during the walk.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今天要走得很快吗？Mark：不用，保持适中的步速，这样走路时还能聊天。

messages.speaker: Lara (散步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum se nimxu malajr ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Illum se nimxu malajr ħafna?
messages.zh: 我们今天要走得很快吗？
messages.en: Are we going to walk very fast today?

messages.speaker: Mark (散步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, inżommu pass moderat biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu waqt il-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Le, inżommu pass moderat biex inkunu nistgħu nitkellmu waqt il-mixja.
messages.zh: 不用，保持适中的步速，这样走路时还能聊天。
messages.en: No, let's keep a moderate pace so we can talk during the walk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moderat 想成强度旋钮停在适中位置：步速不过快是适度，说话不激烈是温和，行为不过分是有节制；三个场景共同记住“不过度”。

gloss_zh: 现代的；具有现代风格或技术的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the present time or using contemporary ideas, styles, or technology.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 属于当代的，或采用现代观念、风格或技术的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għaż-żmien tal-lum jew juża ideat, stili jew teknoloġija tal-lum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 现代的；采用当代观念、风格或技术的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu karatteristiċi taż-żmien tal-lum fl-ideat, fl-istil jew fit-teknoloġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is modern belongs to the present time or uses contemporary ideas, styles, or technology.

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju huwa mgħammar b'tagħmir modern biex jappoġġa r-riċerka.
formal.en: The laboratory is equipped with modern equipment to support research.
formal.zh: 该实验室配备了现代化设备，以支持研究工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-bini jidher modern ħafna. Mark: Iva, speċjalment bid-disinn tal-ħġieġ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This building looks very modern. Mark: Yes, especially with its glass design.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这座建筑看起来很现代。Mark：是啊，尤其是它的玻璃设计。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-bini jidher modern ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-bini jidher modern ħafna.
messages.zh: 这座建筑看起来很现代。
messages.en: This building looks very modern.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment bid-disinn tal-ħġieġ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment bid-disinn tal-ħġieġ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 是啊，尤其是它的玻璃设计。
messages.en: Yes, especially with its glass design.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 modern 和“现代设备、现代建筑”两幅画面绑定记忆；遇到 tagħmir modern，就想到使用当代技术的设备。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not boasting about personal abilities or achievements and not trying to attract attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不夸耀自己的能力或成就，也不刻意引人注意的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jiftaħarx bil-ħiliet jew bis-suċċessi tiegħu u ma jipprovax jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦虚的；不夸耀自己的能力或成就的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiftaħarx bil-ħiliet, bil-kwalitajiet jew bis-suċċessi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is modest does not boast about their abilities, qualities, or achievements.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不张扬的；不摆架子或刻意引人注意的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod sempliċi, mingħajr pretensjonijiet u mingħajr ma jipprova jiġbed l-attenzjoni lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is unassuming behaves simply and does not try to appear important or attract attention.

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu, ir-riċerkatur baqa' modest u faħħar il-ħidma tat-tim kollu.
formal.en: Despite his success, the researcher remained modest and praised the work of the whole team.
formal.zh: 尽管取得了成功，这位研究员仍然很谦虚，并赞扬了整个团队的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt l-ewwel premju u lanqas għedtli! Mark: Kelli ħafna għajnuna mit-tim. Maja: Dejjem modest int!
colloquial.en: Maja: You won first prize and didn't even tell me! Mark: I had a lot of help from the team. Maja: You're always so modest!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你得了一等奖，居然都没告诉我！Mark：团队给了我很多帮助。Maja：你总是这么谦虚！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt l-ewwel premju u lanqas għedtli!
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt l-ewwel premju u lanqas għedtli!
messages.zh: 你得了一等奖，居然都没告诉我！
messages.en: You won first prize and didn't even tell me!

messages.speaker: Mark (获奖的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli ħafna għajnuna mit-tim.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli ħafna għajnuna mit-tim.
messages.zh: 团队给了我很多帮助。
messages.en: I had a lot of help from the team.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dejjem modest int!
messages.mt_standard: Dejjem modest int!
messages.zh: 你总是这么谦虚！
messages.en: You're always so modest!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象获奖后先感谢团队的人：谈成就时是“谦虚”，日常待人时是“不张扬”；用这两个场景区分 modest 的相近义项。

exact_key: modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett
gloss_zh: 直流连接的发电园区模块

teaching_sense.en_definition: A power park module whose electrical connection uses direct current.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用直流方式进行电气连接的发电园区模块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Modulu ta' park tal-enerġija li l-konnessjoni elettrika tiegħu tuża kurrent dirett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过直流进行电气连接的发电园区模块；DC 表示直流。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Modulu ta' park tal-enerġija li jkun konness permezz ta' kurrent dirett, imqassar bħala DC.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A DC-connected power park module is a power park module whose electrical connection uses direct current.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采用直流连接方式的发电园区模块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Modulu ta' park tal-enerġija li juża konnessjoni elettrika b'kurrent dirett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A direct current-connected power park module is a power park module connected electrically using direct current.

collocations.mt: installazzjoni ta' modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett
collocations.en: installation of a DC-connected power park module
collocations.zh: 直流连接的发电园区模块的安装

collocations.mt: spezzjoni ta' modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett
collocations.en: inspection of a DC-connected power park module
collocations.zh: 直流连接的发电园区模块的检查

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi l-konnessjoni elettrika ta' modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett.
formal.en: The technical report describes the electrical connection of a DC-connected power park module.
formal.zh: 技术报告说明了一个直流连接的发电园区模块的电气连接方式。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-modulu juża kurrent dirett? David: Iva, huwa modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett.

colloquial.zh: Lara：这个模块使用直流吗？David：是的，这是一个直流连接的发电园区模块。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-modulu juża kurrent dirett?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-modulu juża kurrent dirett?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa modulu ta' park tal-enerġija konness b'kurrent dirett.
messages.zh: 是的，这是一个直流连接的发电园区模块。
messages.en: Yes, it is a DC-connected power park module.
