teaching_sense.en_definition: A system component used to monitor and manage available capacity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于监测和管理系统可用容量的组成模块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti minn sistema li tintuża biex tissorvelja u timmaniġġja l-kapaċità disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统中用于监测和管理可用容量的模块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Modulu f'sistema li jintuża biex jissorvelja u jimmaniġġja l-kapaċità disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A capacity management module is a component that helps a system monitor and manage its available capacity.

collocations.en: operation of the capacity management module
update of the capacity management module

formal.mt: Il-modulu tal-immaniġġjar tal-kapaċità jippermetti lill-operatur jimmonitorja l-kapaċità disponibbli tas-sistema.
formal.en: The capacity management module allows the operator to monitor the system's available capacity.
formal.zh: 容量管理模块使操作人员能够监测系统的可用容量。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn nista' nara kemm fadal kapaċità? Pawlu: Iftaħ il-modulu tal-immaniġġjar tal-kapaċità; hemm issib l-informazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where can I see how much capacity is left? Pawlu: Open the capacity management module; you'll find the information there.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我在哪里能看到还剩多少容量？Pawlu：打开容量管理模块，信息就在里面。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nara kemm fadal kapaċità?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nara kemm fadal kapaċità?
messages.zh: 我在哪里能看到还剩多少容量？
messages.en: Where can I see how much capacity is left?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħ il-modulu tal-immaniġġjar tal-kapaċità; hemm issib l-informazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħ il-modulu tal-immaniġġjar tal-kapaċità; hemm issib l-informazzjoni.
messages.zh: 打开容量管理模块，信息就在里面。
messages.en: Open the capacity management module; you'll find the information there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按功能分块记忆：modulu 是模块，immaniġġjar 对应管理，kapaċità 对应容量；想象打开一个显示剩余容量的管理窗口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A power generating module that operates in synchronism with the electricity network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与电网保持同步运行的发电模块。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Modulu li jiġġenera l-enerġija elettrika u jaħdem b'mod sinkronizzat man-netwerk elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同步发电模块，即与电网同步运行的发电模块。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Modulu għall-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija elettrika li jaħdem b'mod sinkronizzat man-netwerk elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synchronous power generating module produces electrical energy while operating in synchronism with the electricity network.

collocations.mt: installazzjoni ta' modulu tal-ġenerazzjoni sinkronika tal-enerġija
collocations.en: installation of a synchronous power generating module

collocations.mt: manutenzjoni ta' modulu tal-ġenerazzjoni sinkronika tal-enerġija

formal.zh: 该报告介绍了一个同步发电模块的安装及其与电网的连接。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of equipment used to generate electrical energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于产生电能的设备单元。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' tagħmir li tintuża biex tiġġenera l-enerġija elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发电模块，即用于产生电能的设备单元。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Modulu magħmul minn tagħmir li jiġġenera l-enerġija elettrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A power generating module is a unit of equipment that produces electrical energy.

collocations.en: installation of a power generating module
maintenance of a power generating module

formal.mt: Il-pjan jinkludi l-installazzjoni ta' modulu tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija u programm ta' manutenzjoni regolari.
formal.en: The plan includes the installation of a power generating module and a regular maintenance programme.
formal.zh: 该计划包括安装一个发电模块，并制定定期维护方案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-tagħmir għal xiex jintuża? Mark: Huwa modulu tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija; jipproduċi l-elettriku. Maja: Se tinstallawh illum? Mark: Iva, it-tim se jibda wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this equipment used for? Mark: It's a power generating module; it produces electricity. Maja: Are you installing it today? Mark: Yes, the team will start this afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这套设备是做什么用的？Mark：这是一个发电模块，用来发电。Maja：你们今天安装吗？Mark：是的，团队今天下午开始安装。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)

messages.en: What is this equipment used for?

messages.mt_standard: Huwa modulu tal-ġenerazzjoni tal-enerġija; jipproduċi l-elettriku.
messages.zh: 这是一个发电模块，用来发电。
messages.en: It's a power generating module; it produces electricity.

messages.mt_spoken: Se tinstallawh illum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tinstallawh illum?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, it-tim se jibda wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 是的，团队今天下午开始安装。
messages.en: Yes, the team will start this afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆：modulu 是“模块”，ġenerazzjoni 对应“产生”，enerġija 对应“能量”；整个词组在这里表示“发电模块”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fungal growth that develops on food or other surfaces, especially in damp conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在食物或其他表面上生长的霉菌，尤其常见于潮湿环境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkabbir ta' fungi li jidher fuq l-ikel jew fuq uċuħ oħra, speċjalment f'kundizzjonijiet ta' umdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霉；在食物或其他物体表面生长的霉菌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fungi li jikbru fuq l-ikel jew fuq uċuħ oħra u li spiss jidhru bħala tikek jew saff, speċjalment fejn hemm l-umdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mould is a growth of fungi that appears on food or other surfaces, particularly when conditions are damp.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstabet moffa fuq il-ħajt ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: During the inspection, mould was found on the wall beside the window.
formal.zh: 检查时，在窗户旁边的墙上发现了霉菌。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dak l-aħdar fuq il-ħobż? Mark: Dik moffa. Ejja narmu l-ħobż.
colloquial.en: Anna: What's that green stuff on the bread? Mark: That's mould. Let's throw the bread away.
colloquial.zh: Anna：面包上那层绿色的东西是什么？Mark：那是霉。我们把面包扔掉吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-aħdar fuq il-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-aħdar fuq il-ħobż?
messages.zh: 面包上那层绿色的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that green stuff on the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik moffa. Ejja narmu l-ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Dik moffa. Ejja narmu l-ħobż.
messages.zh: 那是霉。我们把面包扔掉吧。
messages.en: That's mould. Let's throw the bread away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记 moffa：想象面包上出现一片绿色霉点，再把 moffa fuq il-ħobż 整组读出，让词语和发霉的画面联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A farm animal kept for its wool, meat, or milk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种为获取羊毛、肉或奶而饲养的家畜，即绵羊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal tar-razzett, jiġifieri nagħġa, li jitrabba għas-suf, għal-laħam jew għall-ħalib.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绵羊；通常为获取羊毛、肉或奶而饲养的家畜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nagħġa, annimal tar-razzett li jitrabba għas-suf, għal-laħam jew għall-ħalib.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sheep is a farm animal that people keep for its wool, meat, or milk.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-moghza waqt li kienet tirgħa fil-mergħa.
formal.en: The students observed the sheep while it was grazing in the pasture.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了那只正在牧场上吃草的绵羊。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hi l-moghza? Ġużeppi: Hemm ħdejn iċ-ċint, qed tiekol il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the sheep? Ġużeppi: There by the fence, eating grass.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那只绵羊在哪里？Ġużeppi：在那边的围栏旁，正吃草呢。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-moghza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-moghza?
messages.zh: 那只绵羊在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the sheep?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (农场主)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħdejn iċ-ċint, qed tiekol il-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħdejn iċ-ċint, qed tiekol il-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 在那边的围栏旁，正吃草呢。
messages.en: There by the fence, eating grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moghza 写在绵羊图片下，再配上 sheep 和「绵羊」；想象它在围栏旁吃草，用三语画面配对帮助记忆，不把拼写联想当作词源。

gloss_zh: 被充实；被赋予（原释义有疑问，须结合语境）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be filled or supplied with something; the supplied gloss is tentative, so context is needed to establish the precise meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示被某种事物充实或赋予某种特质；所给英文释义带有疑问号，具体含义须结合语境确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli jew ipprovdut b'xi ħaġa; it-tifsira mogħtija hija proviżorja u teħtieġ kuntest biex tkun aktar preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被填满或被充实（暂定释义，原文带有疑问）。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun mimli jew ipprovdut b'xi ħaġa, għalkemm il-punt interrogattiv fit-tifsira mogħtija juri li din għadha mhix ċerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is described this way, they may be filled or supplied with something, although the question mark makes the supplied meaning uncertain.

formal.mt: L-awtur huwa mogħni b'talent li jidher ċar fil-kitba tiegħu.
formal.en: The author is endowed with talent that is clearly evident in his writing.
formal.zh: 这位作者富有才华，这一点在他的作品中清晰可见。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu l-għalliem il-ġdid? Mark: Huwa mogħni bl-esperjenza u jispjega kollox ċar.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the new teacher like? Mark: He has a wealth of experience and explains everything clearly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新老师怎么样？Mark：他经验丰富，什么都解释得很清楚。

messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu l-għalliem il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu l-għalliem il-ġdid?

messages.en: What is the new teacher like?

messages.en: He has a wealth of experience and explains everything clearly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人想成装满才华或经验的容器，帮助记住“被充实、被赋予”的用法；原释义带问号，仍须看语境。

sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry is supplied with an unclear phrase as its definition, so its intended noun meaning cannot be established reliably from the packet alone.

formal.zh: 表达“mohhu jilhaqlu”需要更多语境，才能确定其准确含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young horse that is still in the early part of its life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚处于生命早期阶段的幼马，即马驹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel żgħir li għadu fil-bidu ta' ħajtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马驹，指年幼的马。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żiemel ta' età żgħira li għadu ma laħaqx il-kobor ta' żiemel adult.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foal is a young horse that has not yet grown into an adult.

formal.mt: Il-mohor baqa' ħdejn ommu waqt li kienet tirgħa fil-mergħa.
formal.en: The foal stayed beside its mother while she grazed in the pasture.
formal.zh: 母马在牧场吃草时，马驹一直待在她身边。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara l-mohor ħdejn ommu? Mark: Iva, kemm hu żgħir!
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see the foal beside its mother? Mark: Yes, it is so little!
colloquial.zh: Maja：你看见母马旁边的马驹了吗？Mark：看见了，它可真小！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara l-mohor ħdejn ommu?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara l-mohor ħdejn ommu?
messages.zh: 你看见母马旁边的马驹了吗？
messages.en: Can you see the foal beside its mother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kemm hu żgħir!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kemm hu żgħir!
messages.zh: 看见了，它可真小！
messages.en: Yes, it is so little!

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 mohor，就想象牧场上紧跟母马的小马驹，用“母马身边的幼马”这幅画面记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A molecule is a group of atoms chemically bonded together that forms a unit of a substance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分子是由原子通过化学键结合而成、构成某种物质的一个单位的粒子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Molekula hija grupp ta' atomi magħqudin b'rabtiet kimiċi li jifforma unità ta' sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分子；由原子通过化学键结合而成的粒子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Molekula hija partiċella magħmula minn atomi marbutin kimikament ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A molecule is a particle consisting of atoms held together by chemical bonds.

formal.mt: Kull molekula tal-ilma fiha żewġ atomi tal-idroġenu u atomu wieħed tal-ossiġnu.
formal.en: Each water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
formal.zh: 每个水分子含有两个氢原子和一个氧原子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-mudell juri molekula tal-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, iż-żewġ blalen iż-żgħar jirrappreżentaw l-atomi tal-idroġenu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this model show a water molecule? Pawlu: Yes, the two small balls represent the hydrogen atoms.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个模型展示的是一个水分子吗？保罗：对，两个小球代表氢原子。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mudell juri molekula tal-ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mudell juri molekula tal-ilma?
messages.zh: 这个模型展示的是一个水分子吗？
messages.en: Does this model show a water molecule?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iż-żewġ blalen iż-żgħar jirrappreżentaw l-atomi tal-idroġenu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iż-żewġ blalen iż-żgħar jirrappreżentaw l-atomi tal-idroġenu.
messages.zh: 对，两个小球代表氢原子。
messages.en: Yes, the two small balls represent the hydrogen atoms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 molekula 与水分子模型一起记：几个代表原子的小球连在一起，组成一个分子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something molecular concerns molecules, their structure, or their interactions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于描述与分子、分子结构或分子间相互作用有关的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa molekulari għandha x'taqsam mal-molekuli, mal-istruttura tagħhom jew mal-interazzjonijiet bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分子的；涉及分子结构、性质或分子层面过程的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv molekulari jiddeskrivi l-istruttura, il-proprjetajiet jew il-proċessi tal-molekuli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Molecular describes the structure, properties, or processes of molecules.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与分子有关的；用于说明某事物涉及分子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun molekulari meta jkollha x'taqsam mal-molekuli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is molecular if it relates to molecules in some way.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istruttura molekulari tas-sustanza u jispjega kif din tinfluwenza l-proprjetajiet tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes the substance's molecular structure and explains how this influences its properties.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该物质的分子结构，并解释这种结构如何影响其性质。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru? Mark: Il-bijoloġija molekulari; qed nitgħallmu dwar il-molekuli fiċ-ċelloli.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you studying this semester? Mark: Molecular biology; we're learning about the molecules in cells.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你这学期在学什么？马克：分子生物学；我们正在学习细胞中的分子。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja dan is-semestru?
messages.zh: 你这学期在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying this semester?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bijoloġija molekulari; qed nitgħallmu dwar il-molekuli fiċ-ċelloli.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bijoloġija molekulari; qed nitgħallmu dwar il-molekuli fiċ-ċelloli.
messages.zh: 分子生物学；我们正在学习细胞中的分子。
messages.en: Molecular biology; we're learning about the molecules in cells.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词组对照记忆：molekula 是一个“分子”，struttura molekulari 是“分子结构”；后者描述与分子有关的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Molestation is unwanted sexual touching or other sexually abusive behaviour towards someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指违背他人意愿的性接触或其他带有性侵犯性质的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-molestja hija mġiba sesswali abbużiva lejn persuna, bħal mess ta' natura sesswali mingħajr il-kunsens tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猥亵；对他人实施未经同意的性接触或其他性侵犯行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-molestja hija abbuż ta' natura sesswali li jista' jinvolvi mess fuq il-ġisem ta' persuna mingħajr il-kunsens tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Molestation is sexually abusive behaviour towards someone, often involving unwanted physical contact.

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-istituzzjoni tipprojbixxi kull forma ta' molestja sesswali u tispjega kif isir rapport.
formal.en: The institution's policy prohibits all forms of sexual molestation and explains how to make a report.
formal.zh: 该机构的政策禁止一切形式的性猥亵，并说明如何举报。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nixtieq nirrapporta każ ta' molestja sesswali. Rita: Nistgħu nitkellmu f'kamra privata, jekk tippreferi.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like to report a case of sexual molestation. Rita: We can speak in a private room, if you prefer.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我想举报一起性猥亵事件。丽塔：如果你愿意，我们可以到一间私密的房间谈。

messages.speaker: Anna (来访者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nirrapporta każ ta' molestja sesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nirrapporta każ ta' molestja sesswali.
messages.zh: 我想举报一起性猥亵事件。
messages.en: I'd like to report a case of sexual molestation.

messages.speaker: Rita (接待人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitkellmu f'kamra privata, jekk tippreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitkellmu f'kamra privata, jekk tippreferi.
messages.zh: 如果你愿意，我们可以到一间私密的房间谈。
messages.en: We can speak in a private room, if you prefer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 molestja sesswali 与“未经同意的性接触”这一情境对应记忆，再用 każ ta' molestja 练习表达“一起猥亵事件”。

gloss_zh: 码头；供船舶停靠装卸的岸边设施

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wharf or quay is a structure beside the water where boats can stop for people to board or goods to be loaded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 码头是水边供船舶停靠、人员上下船或货物装卸的设施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moll huwa struttura max-xatt fejn il-bastimenti jistgħu jorbtu biex jitilgħu jew jinżlu n-nies jew biex titgħabba jew tinħatt il-merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 码头；供船舶停靠及装卸货物、上下乘客的平台或设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moll huwa pjattaforma jew struttura ħdejn l-ilma fejn jorbtu l-bastimenti għat-tagħbija, għall-ħatt jew għat-tlugħ u l-inżul tal-passiġġieri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wharf is a structure beside the water where boats stop to load or unload goods or passengers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 岸壁式码头；沿水边修筑、供船舶靠泊和装卸的坚固岸边设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moll huwa struttura soda mibnija tul ix-xatt fejn il-bastimenti jorbtu u fejn tista' titgħabba jew tinħatt il-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A quay is a solid structure along the water's edge where ships can moor and load or unload.

collocations.en: a ship moored to the quay

formal.mt: Il-bastiment intrabat mal-moll qabel ma beda l-ħatt tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The ship was moored to the quay before the unloading of the cargo began.
formal.zh: 船舶系泊在码头后，才开始卸货。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu għad-dgħajsa? Toni: Fuq il-moll, ħdejn il-bank blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet to catch the boat? Toni: On the quay, beside the blue bench.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里碰面去坐船？托尼：在码头上，蓝色长椅旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu għad-dgħajsa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu għad-dgħajsa?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里碰面去坐船？
messages.en: Where shall we meet to catch the boat?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-moll, ħdejn il-bank blu.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-moll, ħdejn il-bank blu.
messages.zh: 在码头上，蓝色长椅旁边。
messages.en: On the quay, beside the blue bench.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象船靠岸、绳子系在码头的画面，把 moll 记成“码头”；再用 fuq il-moll 记住“在码头上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spring that returns to its original shape after being pressed or stretched, or a clip used to hold things in place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受压或拉伸后能恢复原状的弹簧；也指用来夹住或固定物品的夹子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa metall li terġa' tieħu l-forma tagħha wara li tingħafas jew tinġibed, jew oġġett żgħir li jżomm xi ħaġa f'postha billi jaqbadha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弹簧，受压或拉伸后能恢复原状的弹性零件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa metall elastika li terġa' tieħu l-forma tagħha wara li tingħafas jew tinġibed u li tintuża f'mekkaniżmi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spring is an elastic mechanical part that returns to its original shape after being pressed or stretched.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夹子，通过夹紧来固定头发、衣物或其他物品的小器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jaqbad u jżomm ix-xagħar, il-ħwejjeġ jew affarijiet oħra f'posthom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clip is a small device that grips something to hold it securely in place.

formal.mt: It-tekniku biddel il-molla miksura sabiex il-mekkaniżmu jerġa' jaħdem sew.
formal.en: The technician replaced the broken spring so that the mechanism would work properly again.
formal.zh: 技术员更换了断裂的弹簧，使机械装置重新正常运作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek molla tax-xagħar żejda? Maja: Iva, ħu din. Iżżomm xagħrek tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a spare hair clip? Maja: Yes, take this one. It will hold your hair well.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有多余的发夹吗？玛雅：有，拿这个吧。它能把你的头发夹牢。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek molla tax-xagħar żejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek molla tax-xagħar żejda?
messages.zh: 你有多余的发夹吗？
messages.en: Do you have a spare hair clip?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din. Iżżomm xagħrek tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din. Iżżomm xagħrek tajjeb.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个吧。它能把你的头发夹牢。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. It will hold your hair well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个义项配成两幅图来记：弹簧按下会弹回，夹子夹住不松开；遇到 tax-xagħar 就联想到发夹。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or complex where monks live as a religious community, or the cloister within such a religious building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供修士共同生活和从事宗教活动的修道院；也可指这类宗教建筑内的回廊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew grupp ta' binjiet fejn jgħixu l-patrijiet bħala komunità reliġjuża, jew il-parti ta' bini reliġjuż b'passaġġi msaqqfa madwar bitħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院，修士共同居住、祈祷并遵守宗教生活规则的建筑或建筑群。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini jew grupp ta' binjiet fejn jgħixu l-patrijiet flimkien, jitolbu u jsegwu regoli ta' ħajja reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monastery is a building or group of buildings where monks live together and follow a religious way of life.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院或教堂内围绕庭院设置的有顶回廊。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti minn monasteru jew knisja li fiha passaġġi msaqqfa jduru ma' bitħa miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cloister is a covered passage surrounding an open courtyard in a monastery or church.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-istorja tal-monasteru u l-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-patrijiet li jgħixu fih.
formal.en: The report describes the history of the monastery and the daily life of the monks who live there.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了该修道院的历史，以及住在那里的修士的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid inżuru l-monasteru għada? Sara: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-bitħa tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we visit the monastery tomorrow? Sara: Yes, I would like to see its church and courtyard.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们明天去参观修道院好吗？萨拉：好，我想看看里面的教堂和庭院。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid inżuru l-monasteru għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid inżuru l-monasteru għada?
messages.zh: 我们明天去参观修道院好吗？
messages.en: Shall we visit the monastery tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-bitħa tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara l-knisja u l-bitħa tiegħu.
messages.zh: 好，我想看看里面的教堂和庭院。
messages.en: Yes, I would like to see its church and courtyard.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用空间画面区分两个义项：远看整座修道院，走进去再看围着庭院的回廊；两个画面一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to monasteries, monks, or the religious way of life followed in a monastery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与修道院、修士或修道院中遵循的宗教生活方式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-monasteri, mal-patrijiet jew mal-mod ta' ħajja reliġjuża li jiġi segwit f'monasteru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 修道院的；修士的；与修道生活及其规则有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-monasteri, il-patrijiet jew il-ħajja ta' talb u dixxiplina reliġjuża f'komunità ta' patrijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is monastic is connected with monasteries, monks, or their religious way of life.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-ħajja monastika u r-rwol tat-talb u tax-xogħol fil-komunità.
formal.en: The study examines monastic life and the role of prayer and work in the community.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察修道生活，以及祈祷和劳动在修道团体中的作用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex qed taqra? Pawlu: Fuq il-ħajja monastika. Il-ktieb jispjega kif jgħixu l-patrijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you reading about? Pawlu: Monastic life. The book explains how monks live.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在读什么方面的内容？保罗：修道生活。这本书介绍修士怎样生活。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么方面的内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-ħajja monastika. Il-ktieb jispjega kif jgħixu l-patrijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-ħajja monastika. Il-ktieb jispjega kif jgħixu l-patrijiet.
messages.zh: 修道生活。这本书介绍修士怎样生活。
messages.en: Monastic life. The book explains how monks live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 monasteru 记成地点“修道院”，把 monastiku 放在名词旁表示“修道的”；配着 ħajja monastika 记住阴性形式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing, happening, or having an effect throughout the world, or relating to the world as a whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 存在、发生或产生影响于世界范围的；与全球整体有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti, iseħħ jew għandu effett madwar id-dinja, jew li għandu x'jaqsam mad-dinja kollha kemm hi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 世界范围的；遍及世界各地的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab jew iseħħ f'ħafna pajjiżi madwar id-dinja u għandu firxa mifruxa mad-dinja kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in many countries across the world.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全球的；涉及整个世界或从世界整体角度考虑的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda d-dinja kollha kemm hi jew li għandu effett fuqha bħala ħaġa waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is global concerns or affects the world considered as a whole.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza l-effett tat-tibdil fil-klima fuq l-ekonomija mondjali.
formal.en: The report analyses the effect of climate change on the global economy.
formal.zh: 这份报告分析气候变化对全球经济的影响。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Din il-kantanta għandha fama mondjali? David: Iva, għandha ħafna ammiraturi f'pajjiżi differenti.
colloquial.en: Elena: Does this singer have worldwide fame? David: Yes, she has many fans in different countries.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：这位女歌手在世界各地都很有名吗？戴维：是的，她在不同国家都有很多歌迷。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-kantanta għandha fama mondjali?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-kantanta għandha fama mondjali?
messages.zh: 这位女歌手在世界各地都很有名吗？
messages.en: Does this singer have worldwide fame?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandha ħafna ammiraturi f'pajjiżi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandha ħafna ammiraturi f'pajjiżi differenti.
messages.zh: 是的，她在不同国家都有很多歌迷。
messages.en: Yes, she has many fans in different countries.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地球仪：名声传遍各地是 fama mondjali，把各国经济放在一起看是 ekonomija mondjali；用“遍及”和“整体”区分两个侧重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A screen that displays information or images from a computer or another device.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于显示计算机或其他设备所输出的信息或图像的屏幕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skrin li juri informazzjoni jew stampi minn kompjuter jew minn apparat ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: monitor (of a computer or other device)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 计算机或其他设备用于显示信息、图像的显示器或监视屏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skrin imqabbad ma' kompjuter jew ma' apparat ieħor biex juri l-informazzjoni jew l-istampi li jipproduċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monitor is a screen on which information or images from a computer or another device are displayed.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda taħdem, ixgħel il-moniter u aġġusta l-luminożità tiegħu għal livell komdu.
formal.en: Before you start working, switch on the monitor and adjust its brightness to a comfortable level.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，请打开显示器，并将亮度调节至舒适的水平。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-moniter għadu iswed? Pawlu: Għadni ma xgħeltux. Issa nixegħlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the monitor still black? Pawlu: I haven't switched it on yet. I'll switch it on now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：显示器怎么还是黑的？保罗：我还没打开它。我现在就开。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-moniter għadu iswed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-moniter għadu iswed?
messages.zh: 显示器怎么还是黑的？
messages.en: Why is the monitor still black?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma xgħeltux. Issa nixegħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma xgħeltux. Issa nixegħlu.
messages.zh: 我还没打开它。我现在就开。
messages.en: I haven't switched it on yet. I'll switch it on now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moniter 和桌上显示画面的屏幕绑定记忆，再用“打开显示器、调节亮度”两个动作巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device or system used to monitor synchronous areas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于监测同步区域的设备或系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew sistema li tintuża biex tissorvelja żoni sinkroniċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于监测同步区域的监测器或监测系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat jew sistema għall-monitoraġġ ta' żoni sinkroniċi, li tipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-qagħda tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A synchronous area monitor is a device or system that provides information about the condition of synchronous areas.

collocations.en: data from the synchronous area monitor
collocations.zh: 来自同步区域监测器的数据

collocations.en: the readings of the synchronous area monitor
collocations.zh: 同步区域监测器的读数

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi d-dejta mill-monitor taż-żoni sinkroniċi u spjegazzjoni tal-qari tiegħu.
formal.en: The report includes data from the synchronous area monitor and an explanation of its readings.
formal.zh: 报告包含同步区域监测器提供的数据，以及对其读数的说明。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Waslet id-dejta mill-monitor taż-żoni sinkroniċi? Mark: Iva, qiegħda hawn. Ejja narawha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Rita: Has the data from the synchronous area monitor arrived? Mark: Yes, it's here. Let's look at it together.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：同步区域监测器的数据到了吗？马克：到了，就在这里。我们一起看看吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet id-dejta mill-monitor taż-żoni sinkroniċi?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet id-dejta mill-monitor taż-żoni sinkroniċi?
messages.zh: 同步区域监测器的数据到了吗？
messages.en: Has the data from the synchronous area monitor arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda hawn. Ejja narawha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda hawn. Ejja narawha flimkien.
messages.zh: 到了，就在这里。我们一起看看吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's here. Let's look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“监测器—区域—同步的”三块理解整个短语，想象一台持续显示同步区域数据的设备来帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Boring because there is little variety or interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因缺少变化或趣味而显得单调、令人厌倦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma tantx tqanqal interess għax fiha ftit varjetà jew tibdil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缺少变化、趣味或吸引力的；单调乏味的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tidher jew tinħass bla interess u tedjanti minħabba nuqqas ta' varjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dull fails to hold your interest because it offers little variety or excitement.

formal.mt: Lezzjoni tista' ssir monotona jekk l-għalliem jitkellem il-ħin kollu mingħajr ma jinvolvi lill-istudenti.
formal.en: A lesson can become dull if the teacher speaks throughout without involving the students.
formal.zh: 如果教师一直讲述，却不让学生参与，课堂就可能变得单调乏味。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-lezzjoni llum? Liam: Kienet monotona ħafna. Għamilna l-istess eżerċizzju l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the lesson today? Liam: It was very dull. We did the same exercise the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：今天的课怎么样？利亚姆：特别枯燥。我们一直在做同一种练习。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-lezzjoni llum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-lezzjoni llum?
messages.zh: 今天的课怎么样？
messages.en: How was the lesson today?

messages.speaker: Liam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet monotona ħafna. Għamilna l-istess eżerċizzju l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet monotona ħafna. Għamilna l-istess eżerċizzju l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 特别枯燥。我们一直在做同一种练习。
messages.en: It was very dull. We did the same exercise the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一堂不断重复同一种练习的课，把 monotona 与“没有变化，所以乏味”的感受联系起来。

gloss_zh: 空白而苍淡的（如某些现代建筑的外观）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a blank and pale appearance, as in some modern buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 外观空白、色调苍淡的，如某些现代建筑所呈现的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra vojta u kulur pallidu, bħal dak li jidher f'xi bini modern.

sense_translations.en_definition: blank and pale like in modern buildings
sense_translations.zh_definition: 像某些现代建筑那样，外观显得空白、色调显得苍淡的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher vojt u pallidu, b'dehra bħal dik ta' xi bini modern.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way has a blank, pale appearance resembling that of some modern buildings.

collocations.en: the description of a facade as blank and pale
collocations.zh: 用 monotonija 描述外墙空白而苍淡的样子

collocations.en: the word 'monotonija' in a description of a modern building
collocations.zh: 现代建筑描述中的 monotonija 一词

formal.mt: F'din id-deskrizzjoni tal-bini, il-kelma 'monotonija' tindika dehra vojta u pallida, bħal dik ta' xi bini modern.
formal.en: In this description of the building, the word 'monotonija' indicates a blank and pale appearance, like that of some modern buildings.
formal.zh: 在这段建筑描述中，monotonija 一词表示空白而苍淡的外观，如某些现代建筑所呈现的样子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi tfisser 'monotonija' f'din id-deskrizzjoni? David: Hawn tfisser li l-faċċata tidher vojta u pallida, bħal dik ta' xi bini modern.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does 'monotonija' mean in this description? David: Here it means that the facade looks blank and pale, like that of some modern buildings.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这段描述里的 monotonija 是什么意思？戴维：这里是说外墙显得空白而苍淡，就像某些现代建筑的外墙。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'monotonija' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'monotonija' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.zh: 这段描述里的 monotonija 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'monotonija' mean in this description?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li l-faċċata tidher vojta u pallida, bħal dik ta' xi bini modern.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li l-faċċata tidher vojta u pallida, bħal dik ta' xi bini modern.
messages.zh: 这里是说外墙显得空白而苍淡，就像某些现代建筑的外墙。
messages.en: Here it means that the facade looks blank and pale, like that of some modern buildings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给定的形容词义，想象一面空白、颜色苍淡的现代建筑外墙，用具体画面记住 monotonija。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant known as monstera, often grown for its decorative leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种称为龟背竹的植物，常因其具有观赏性的叶片而被栽培。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta magħrufa bħala monstera, li spiss titkabbar minħabba l-weraq dekorattiv tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 龟背竹，一种具有观赏性叶片的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-monstera hija pjanta li titkabbar għall-weraq dekorattiv tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monstera is a plant that people often grow for its decorative leaves.

formal.mt: Fl-entratura tal-bini tqiegħdet monstera f'qasrija kbira biex iżżejjen l-ispazju.
formal.en: A monstera in a large pot was placed at the building's entrance to decorate the space.
formal.zh: 大楼入口处摆放了一盆大型龟背竹，用于装饰空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-monstera tiegħek? Lara: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ. Inħobb il-weraq tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this your monstera? Lara: Yes, I bought it yesterday. I love its leaves.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这盆龟背竹是你的吗？Lara：是啊，我昨天买的。我很喜欢它的叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-monstera tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-monstera tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这盆龟背竹是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this your monstera?

messages.speaker: Lara (植物主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ. Inħobb il-weraq tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xtrajtha lbieraħ. Inħobb il-weraq tagħha.
messages.zh: 是啊，我昨天买的。我很喜欢它的叶子。
messages.en: Yes, I bought it yesterday. I love its leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 monstera 和客厅里的一盆龟背竹联系起来，再用“盆栽”和“叶片”两个搭配巩固植物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sacred vessel used to display the consecrated host for worship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于展示已祝圣圣体、供信众朝拜的礼仪器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett liturġiku li fih titqiegħed l-ostja kkonsagrata biex tintwera għall-adorazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 圣体光座，用于安置并展示已祝圣圣体，供信众朝拜的器具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-Monstrance hija oġġett liturġiku li jintuża biex tintwera l-ostja kkonsagrata waqt l-adorazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monstrance is a sacred vessel in which the consecrated host is displayed for worship.

formal.mt: Waqt l-adorazzjoni, l-ostja kkonsagrata tintwera fil-Monstrance fuq l-artal.
formal.en: During adoration, the consecrated host is displayed in the monstrance on the altar.
formal.zh: 在朝拜圣体期间，已祝圣的圣体置于祭台上的圣体光座中，供信众瞻仰。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhu dak l-oġġett fuq l-artal? Anna: Dik hija l-Monstrance. Fiha tintwera l-ostja kkonsagrata waqt l-adorazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is that object on the altar? Anna: That is the monstrance. The consecrated host is displayed in it during adoration.
colloquial.zh: Mark：祭台上那个器具是什么？Anna：那是圣体光座。朝拜圣体时，已祝圣的圣体就展示在里面。

messages.speaker: Mark (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak l-oġġett fuq l-artal?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak l-oġġett fuq l-artal?
messages.zh: 祭台上那个器具是什么？
messages.en: What is that object on the altar?

messages.speaker: Anna (教堂导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija l-Monstrance. Fiha tintwera l-ostja kkonsagrata waqt l-adorazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija l-Monstrance. Fiha tintwera l-ostja kkonsagrata waqt l-adorazzjoni.
messages.zh: 那是圣体光座。朝拜圣体时，已祝圣的圣体就展示在里面。
messages.en: That is the monstrance. The consecrated host is displayed in it during adoration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Monstrance 放进“祭台上展示圣体的器具”这个画面中记忆，并区分器具本身与其中的圣体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A market where sellers offer goods at stalls.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商贩在摊位上出售商品、顾客前来选购的集市。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Suq fejn il-bejjiegħa jbigħu diversi oġġetti minn fuq il-bankarelli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集市，商贩摆摊出售各种商品的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-monti huwa suq b'bankarelli fejn in-nies jistgħu jixtru diversi oġġetti mingħand il-bejjiegħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monti is a market where people buy goods from sellers at stalls.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jixtru ħwejjeġ u oġġetti għad-dar mill-bankarelli tal-monti.
formal.en: Visitors can buy clothes and household goods from the market stalls.
formal.zh: 访客可以在集市的摊位上购买衣物和家居用品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tiġi miegħi l-monti għada? Pawlu: Iva, għandi bżonn flokk ġdid. Niltaqgħu fid-disgħa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to come to the market with me tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, I need a new T-shirt. Shall we meet at nine?
colloquial.zh: Lara：明天想和我一起去逛集市吗？Pawlu：好啊，我需要一件新T恤。我们九点见？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi miegħi l-monti għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi miegħi l-monti għada?
messages.zh: 明天想和我一起去逛集市吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come to the market with me tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi bżonn flokk ġdid. Niltaqgħu fid-disgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi bżonn flokk ġdid. Niltaqgħu fid-disgħa?
messages.zh: 好啊，我需要一件新T恤。我们九点见？
messages.en: Yes, I need a new T-shirt. Shall we meet at nine?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 monti 时想象自己沿着一排摊位挑选衣物，并整句记住 immur il-monti，表示“我去逛集市”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure built to commemorate a person or an event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为纪念某个人或某个事件而建造的碑、雕塑或建筑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura mibnija biex tfakkar persuna jew ġrajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纪念碑或纪念建筑，为纪念人物或事件而建造的实体结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Monument huwa struttura li tinbena biex iżżomm ħajja t-tifkira ta' persuna jew ta' ġrajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monument is a structure built to preserve the memory of a person or an event.

formal.mt: Il-monument fil-pjazza nbena biex ifakkar lill-vittmi tal-gwerra.
formal.en: The monument in the square was built to commemorate the victims of the war.
formal.zh: 广场上的纪念碑是为纪念战争中的遇难者而建造的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Ħdejn il-monument fil-pjazza. Inkun hemm fil-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: By the monument in the square. I'll be there at five.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们在哪里见面？Mark：广场上的纪念碑旁边。我五点到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-monument fil-pjazza. Inkun hemm fil-ħamsa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-monument fil-pjazza. Inkun hemm fil-ħamsa.
messages.zh: 广场上的纪念碑旁边。我五点到。
messages.en: By the monument in the square. I'll be there at five.

cognitive_memory_aid: monument 与英语同形，可把两者一起配上“广场上的纪念碑”这一画面，再用碑旁见面的对话练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cleaning tool with a handle and an absorbent head, used to wash floors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有长柄和吸水拖头、用来擦洗地面的清洁工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mopp huwa għodda b'manku u ras li tassorbi l-ilma, li tintuża biex taħsel l-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拖把；用吸水拖头擦洗地面的长柄清洁工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mopp huwa għodda tat-tindif b'manku u ras li tassorbi l-ilma u li tintuża biex taħsel l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mop is a cleaning tool with a handle and an absorbent head that you use to wash floors.

collocations.en: wash the floor with a mop

formal.mt: Wara kull użu, laħlaħ il-mopp u ħallih jinxef qabel ma terġa' tużah.
formal.en: After each use, rinse the mop and let it dry before using it again.
formal.zh: 每次使用后，请冲洗拖把，并让它晾干后再使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-mopp? Waqqajt ftit ilma mal-art. Pawlu: Qiegħed ħdejn il-barmil, wara l-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the mop? I spilled some water on the floor. Pawlu: It's next to the bucket, behind the door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：拖把在哪儿？我把一点水洒到地上了。保罗：在门后，水桶旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-mopp? Waqqajt ftit ilma mal-art.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-mopp? Waqqajt ftit ilma mal-art.
messages.zh: 拖把在哪儿？我把一点水洒到地上了。
messages.en: Where's the mop? I spilled some water on the floor.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed ħdejn il-barmil, wara l-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed ħdejn il-barmil, wara l-bieb.
messages.zh: 在门后，水桶旁边。
messages.en: It's next to the bucket, behind the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mopp 和“水桶旁的拖把”画面绑定，再整句记住 bil-mopp，表示“用拖把”。

gloss_zh: 道德的；涉及是非善恶的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Concerned with principles of right and wrong behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与行为的是非善恶及人应当遵守的道德原则有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa morali għandha x'taqsam mal-prinċipji li jgħinuna nagħrfu bejn imġiba tajba u imġiba ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道德的；与判断行为对错及应如何行事的原则有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aġġettiv morali jiddeskrivi dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-prinċipji dwar x'inhu tajjeb jew ħażin fl-imġiba tal-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moral questions, values, or responsibilities concern what people believe is right or wrong in human behaviour.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddiskuta r-responsabbiltà morali tal-kumpanija li tagħti informazzjoni ċara lill-klijenti.
formal.en: The committee discussed the company's moral responsibility to provide clear information to customers.
formal.zh: 委员会讨论了公司向顾客提供清晰信息的道德责任。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Għandi neħodha għand il-pulizija? Mark: Iva, naħseb li għandek responsabbiltà morali li tipprova ssib lil sidha.
colloquial.en: Maja: I found a wallet in the street. Should I take it to the police? Mark: Yes, I think you have a moral responsibility to try to find its owner.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在街上捡到一个钱包。我该把它交给警察吗？马克：应该，我觉得你有道德责任设法找到失主。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Għandi neħodha għand il-pulizija?
messages.mt_standard: Sibt kartiera fit-triq. Għandi neħodha għand il-pulizija?
messages.zh: 我在街上捡到一个钱包。我该把它交给警察吗？
messages.en: I found a wallet in the street. Should I take it to the police?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, naħseb li għandek responsabbiltà morali li tipprova ssib lil sidha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, naħseb li għandek responsabbiltà morali li tipprova ssib lil sidha.
messages.zh: 应该，我觉得你有道德责任设法找到失主。
messages.en: Yes, I think you have a moral responsibility to try to find its owner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 valuri morali“道德价值观”：morali 在这里修饰名词，回答“哪一方面的价值观”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Principles concerning right and wrong behaviour, or the rightness or wrongness of a particular action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关于行为是非善恶的原则，也指某一行为在道德上是否正当。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moralità hija s-sett ta' prinċipji dwar imġiba tajba u ħażina, jew kemm azzjoni tkun tajba jew ħażina skont dawn il-prinċipji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道德；判断行为善恶的原则体系，也可指某个行为的道德正当性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moralità tirreferi għall-prinċipji li bihom in-nies jiġġudikaw it-tajjeb u l-ħażin fl-imġiba, kif ukoll għall-valur morali ta' azzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Morality is the set of principles used to judge right and wrong behaviour, or the moral acceptability of a particular action.

collocations.zh: 一项决定的道德正当性

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw il-moralità tad-deċiżjoni billi qiesu kemm l-intenzjonijiet kif ukoll il-konsegwenzi tagħha.
formal.en: The students analysed the morality of the decision by considering both its intentions and its consequences.
formal.zh: 学生们同时考虑了这项决定的意图与后果，以分析它在道德上是否正当。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Jekk xi ħaġa hi legali, bilfors tkun tajba? David: Mhux bilfors. Il-liġi u l-moralità mhux dejjem jaqblu.
colloquial.en: Sara: If something is legal, does that necessarily make it right? David: Not necessarily. Law and morality do not always agree.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：一件事如果合法，就一定是对的吗？戴维：不一定。法律和道德并不总是一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk xi ħaġa hi legali, bilfors tkun tajba?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk xi ħaġa hi legali, bilfors tkun tajba?
messages.zh: 一件事如果合法，就一定是对的吗？
messages.en: If something is legal, does that necessarily make it right?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors. Il-liġi u l-moralità mhux dejjem jaqblu.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors. Il-liġi u l-moralità mhux dejjem jaqblu.
messages.zh: 不一定。法律和道德并不总是一致。
messages.en: Not necessarily. Law and morality do not always agree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moralità 记成可以讨论的抽象名词“道德”：morali 修饰事物，moralità 则点出道德本身。

gloss_zh: 形态学；词法；词的内部结构

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of form and structure, especially how words are formed and how their forms change.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究形态与结构的学科；在语言学中，主要研究词的构成方式及其形式变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-morfoloġija hija l-istudju tal-għamla u l-istruttura; fil-lingwistika tistudja kif jinbnew il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形态学；研究形态和结构的学科，在语言学中研究词的构成与形式变化，在生物学中研究生物体及其部分的形态与结构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-morfoloġija hija l-istudju tal-għamla u l-istruttura, bħall-bini tal-kliem fil-lingwistika jew l-għamla u l-istruttura tal-organiżmi u tal-partijiet tagħhom fil-bijoloġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Morphology is the study of form and structure, particularly the formation of words in linguistics or the structure of organisms in biology.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词的内部结构；词由哪些组成部分构成，以及这些部分如何组合和变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-grammatika, il-morfoloġija tirreferi għall-istruttura interna tal-kliem, jiġifieri l-partijiet li jiffurmaw kelma u l-mod kif jingħaqdu u jinbidlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The morphology of a word is its internal structure, including the parts that compose it and the ways its form can change.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni dwar il-morfoloġija tal-Malti, se neżaminaw kif jinbnew il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom tiegħu.
formal.en: In this lesson on Maltese morphology, we will examine how words are formed and how their forms change.
formal.zh: 在这节马耳他语词法课中，我们将考察词如何构成，以及词的形式如何变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qed tistudja llum? Adam: Il-morfoloġija. Qed inħares lejn kif jinbnew il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are you studying today? Adam: Morphology. I'm looking at how words are formed and how their forms change.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你今天在学什么？亚当：词法。我在看词是怎样构成的，以及词的形式怎样变化。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja llum?
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-morfoloġija. Qed inħares lejn kif jinbnew il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-morfoloġija. Qed inħares lejn kif jinbnew il-kliem u kif jinbidlu l-forom tiegħu.
messages.zh: 词法。我在看词是怎样构成的，以及词的形式怎样变化。
messages.en: Morphology. I'm looking at how words are formed and how their forms change.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 morfoloġija 想成用放大镜观察词的内部构造：关注一个词怎样组成、怎样变形，就能记住“词法”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the form or structure of something, especially the structure and formation of words in language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与事物的形态或结构有关的，尤指与语言中词的内部结构和构成方式有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-forma jew mal-istruttura ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment mal-istruttura u l-formazzjoni tal-kliem fil-lingwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形态的；形态学的，尤指涉及词的结构和构成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-forma u l-istruttura, b'mod partikolari kif jinbena u jinbidel il-kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Morphological features concern the form and structure of something, especially the way words are formed and changed.

formal.mt: L-istudju morfoloġiku jeżamina kif tinbidel il-forma tal-kliem meta jinbidel in-numru.
formal.en: The morphological study examines how the form of words changes when number changes.
formal.zh: 这项形态学研究考察词的形式如何随单复数的变化而改变。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser tibdil morfoloġiku? Lara: Ifisser tibdil fil-forma tal-kelma, bħal meta kelma tinbidel mis-singular għall-plural.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does morphological change mean? Lara: It means a change in the form of a word, such as when a word changes from singular to plural.
colloquial.zh: Maja：形态变化是什么意思？Lara：就是词的形式发生变化，比如一个词从单数变成复数。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser tibdil morfoloġiku?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser tibdil morfoloġiku?
messages.zh: 形态变化是什么意思？
messages.en: What does morphological change mean?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser tibdil fil-forma tal-kelma, bħal meta kelma tinbidel mis-singular għall-plural.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser tibdil fil-forma tal-kelma, bħal meta kelma tinbidel mis-singular għall-plural.
messages.zh: 就是词的形式发生变化，比如一个词从单数变成复数。
messages.en: It means a change in the form of a word, such as when a word changes from singular to plural.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把单数词和复数词并排写下，圈出形式变化，再用 morfoloġiku 给这种观察贴上“形态学的”标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delay in making a payment, especially when money is paid after the agreed deadline.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 付款发生延误的情况，尤指未在约定期限内付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dewmien biex isir ħlas, speċjalment meta l-flus jitħallsu wara d-data miftiehma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 付款延迟；支付款项比预期或约定时间更晚的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dewmien biex jitħallas ammont ta' flus li jkun mistenni jew dovut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A delay in payment occurs when money is paid later than expected or agreed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逾期付款；在应付日期之后才付款的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir wara d-data li fiha kellu jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Late payment means that an amount owed is paid after its due date.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-morożità fil-ħlas bħala waħda mill-kawżi tal-problemi finanzjarji tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: The report identifies delays in payment as one of the causes of the company's financial problems.
formal.zh: 报告将付款延迟列为该公司财务问题的原因之一。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm ħlas żejjed fuq il-kont? Rita: Minħabba l-morożità fil-ħlas; il-flus waslu wara d-data miftiehma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there an extra charge on the bill? Rita: Because of late payment; the money arrived after the agreed date.
colloquial.zh: Mark：账单上为什么有一笔额外费用？Rita：因为逾期付款；款项在约定日期之后才到账。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm ħlas żejjed fuq il-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm ħlas żejjed fuq il-kont?
messages.zh: 账单上为什么有一笔额外费用？
messages.en: Why is there an extra charge on the bill?

messages.speaker: Rita (账务职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-morożità fil-ħlas; il-flus waslu wara d-data miftiehma.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-morożità fil-ħlas; il-flus waslu wara d-data miftiehma.
messages.zh: 因为逾期付款；款项在约定日期之后才到账。
messages.en: Because of late payment; the money arrived after the agreed date.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象日历上的付款期限已经过去，钱却还没到账；把整个短语 morożità fil-ħlas 与“付款拖延、逾期”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with two jaws that hold an object firmly while work is done on it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用两个钳口牢牢夹住物件，以便对其进行加工的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'żewġ xedaq li jżommu oġġett sod waqt li jsir xogħol fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 台钳；虎钳，用两个钳口夹紧待加工物件的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li tagħfas u żżomm biċċa materjal bejn żewġ xedaq sabiex wieħed ikun jista' jaħdem fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A vice is a tool that grips an object firmly between two jaws while you work on it.

collocations.en: hold the piece in the vice

formal.mt: Qabel ma tibda taqta' l-metall, waħħal il-biċċa fil-morsa u ċċekkja li ma tiċċaqlaqx.
formal.en: Before you start cutting the metal, secure the piece in the vice and check that it does not move.
formal.zh: 开始切割金属之前，先用台钳固定工件，并检查它是否稳固不动。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Din il-biċċa qed tiċċaqlaq waqt li naħdem fuqha. Rita: Poġġiha fil-morsa u ssikkaha sew.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: This piece keeps moving while I work on it. Rita: Put it in the vice and tighten it firmly.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我加工的时候，这块材料一直在动。Rita：把它放进台钳里，牢牢夹紧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-biċċa qed tiċċaqlaq waqt li naħdem fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-biċċa qed tiċċaqlaq waqt li naħdem fuqha.
messages.zh: 我加工的时候，这块材料一直在动。
messages.en: This piece keeps moving while I work on it.

messages.speaker: Rita (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fil-morsa u ssikkaha sew.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fil-morsa u ssikkaha sew.
messages.zh: 把它放进台钳里，牢牢夹紧。
messages.en: Put it in the vice and tighten it firmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工作台上两个钳口把木块牢牢夹住，一边做“夹紧”的手势，一边读 morsa，记住它是台钳。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or step taken in a game or situation, often to achieve a particular result.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在游戏或某种情境中采取的一步行动，常指为达到某个结果而作出的招数或举措。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni jew pass li jittieħed f'logħba jew f'sitwazzjoni, spiss biex jintlaħaq riżultat partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一步行动；招数；为应对局面或实现目标而采取的举措。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pass jew azzjoni f'logħba jew f'sitwazzjoni li tista' tbiddel dak li jiġri wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A move is an action you take in a game or situation, often to gain an advantage or achieve a result.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qieset il-ftuħ ta' ħanut ġdid bħala mossa importanti biex tilħaq aktar klijenti.
formal.en: The company regarded the opening of a new shop as an important move to reach more customers.
formal.zh: 公司认为，开设新店是接触更多顾客的一项重要举措。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tkun il-mossa li jmiss tiegħek? Mark: Se nċaqlaq iż-żiemel biex nipproteġi r-re.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will your next move be? Mark: I'll move the knight to protect the king.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你下一步打算怎么走？Mark：我要走马来保护王。

messages.speaker: Maja (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tkun il-mossa li jmiss tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tkun il-mossa li jmiss tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你下一步打算怎么走？
messages.en: What will your next move be?

messages.speaker: Mark (棋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nċaqlaq iż-żiemel biex nipproteġi r-re.
messages.mt_standard: Se nċaqlaq iż-żiemel biex nipproteġi r-re.
messages.zh: 我要走马来保护王。
messages.en: I'll move the knight to protect the king.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象棋盘上刚走出的一步，再联想到生活中为解决问题采取的一招；用 mossa 串起“一步、招数、举措”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An imaginary creature that is frightening because of its strange appearance, size, or behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因外形奇异、体型巨大或行为可怕而令人恐惧的想象中的生物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa immaġinarja li tbeżża' minħabba d-dehra stramba, id-daqs jew l-imġiba tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怪物；故事或想象中外形奇异、令人害怕的生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mostru huwa ħlejqa immaġinarja b'dehra stramba jew tal-biża', li spiss tidher fil-ħrejjef u fl-istejjer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A monster is an imaginary creature that looks strange or frightening and often appears in stories.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, mostru tal-baħar jgħasses id-daħla ta' għar u ma jħalli lil ħadd jidħol.
formal.en: In the story, a sea monster guards the entrance to a cave and allows nobody to enter.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一只海怪守着洞穴入口，不让任何人进去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film? Ben: Għax fih mostru tal-biża'! Lara: Mela nagħżlu film ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why don't you want to watch this film? Ben: Because there's a frightening monster in it! Lara: Then let's choose another film.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么不想看这部电影？本：因为里面有只可怕的怪物！拉拉：那我们选另一部吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tara dan il-film?
messages.zh: 你为什么不想看这部电影？
messages.en: Why don't you want to watch this film?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fih mostru tal-biża'!
messages.mt_standard: Għax fih mostru tal-biża'!
messages.zh: 因为里面有只可怕的怪物！
messages.en: Because there's a frightening monster in it!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nagħżlu film ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nagħżlu film ieħor.
messages.zh: 那我们选另一部吧。
messages.en: Then let's choose another film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mostru 和童话里守着洞口的怪物画面绑定；再用 mostru tal-baħar 记住“海怪”这一搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The reason that leads someone to perform an action or make a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使某人采取行动或作出决定的内在原因或动机。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-raġuni li twassal lil persuna biex tagħmel xi ħaġa jew tieħu deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动机；促使一个人做某件事的原因。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Motif huwa r-raġuni li ġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jaġixxi b'ċertu mod jew jagħżel li jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's motive is the reason that leads them to act in a particular way.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tagħha, l-investigatriċi spjegat li l-motif wara l-azzjoni kien il-qligħ finanzjarju.
formal.en: In her report, the investigator explained that the motive behind the action was financial gain.
formal.zh: 调查员在报告中解释说，该行为背后的动机是获取经济利益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex offra li jgħinna? Mark: Naħseb li l-motif tiegħu kien li jitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida. Maja: Mela nistgħu nitgħallmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he offer to help us? Mark: I think his motive was to learn something new. Maja: Then we can learn together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么主动提出帮我们？马克：我觉得他的动机是学点新东西。玛雅：那我们可以一起学。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex offra li jgħinna?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex offra li jgħinna?
messages.zh: 他为什么主动提出帮我们？
messages.en: Why did he offer to help us?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li l-motif tiegħu kien li jitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li l-motif tiegħu kien li jitgħallem xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.zh: 我觉得他的动机是学点新东西。
messages.en: I think his motive was to learn something new.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nistgħu nitgħallmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nistgħu nitgħallmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 那我们可以一起学。
messages.en: Then we can learn together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 motif 时，先想一个人做出选择，再追问“他为什么这样做”；这个行为背后的原因就是本词所指的动机。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The drive to act, the purpose an action serves, or the reasoning used to justify it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 促使人行动的动力，也可指行动所要达到的目的，或说明行动合理性的理由依据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħeġġa li twassal lil persuna biex taġixxi, l-għan ta' azzjoni, jew ir-raġunament li jiġġustifika deċiżjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动力；促使人开始行动、付出努力或坚持下去的意愿和推动力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-motivazzjoni hija l-ħeġġa jew ix-xewqa li twassal lil persuna biex tibda tagħmel xi ħaġa u tkompli taħdem għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Motivation is the desire or enthusiasm that makes you willing to act and continue making an effort.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目的；某项行动、活动或安排所希望达到的目标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-motivazzjoni ta' azzjoni tista' tkun l-għan li wieħed irid jilħaq permezz tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purpose of an action is the aim that someone intends to achieve by doing it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理由依据；用来解释或论证某项决定、行动或方案的理由和推理。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-motivazzjoni ta' deċiżjoni tista' tkun l-ispjegazzjoni tar-raġunijiet u tar-raġunament li fuqhom tkun ibbażata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The rationale for a decision is the set of reasons that explains why it was made.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta l-motivazzjoni tad-deċiżjoni li jittawlu l-ħinijiet tal-librerija: aktar studenti jkunu jistgħu jużaw is-servizz wara x-xogħol.
formal.en: The report presents the rationale for the decision to extend the library's opening hours: more students will be able to use the service after work.
formal.zh: 报告说明了延长图书馆开放时间的理由：这样能让更多学生在下班后使用这项服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Illum m'għandix motivazzjoni biex nistudja. Pawlu: Ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti biss. Sara: Tajjeb, hekk ikun aktar faċli nibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: I have no motivation to study today. Pawlu: Let's start with just ten minutes. Sara: All right, that will make it easier to get started.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我今天没有学习的动力。保罗：我们先学十分钟吧。萨拉：好，这样更容易开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum m'għandix motivazzjoni biex nistudja.
messages.mt_standard: Illum m'għandix motivazzjoni biex nistudja.
messages.zh: 我今天没有学习的动力。
messages.en: I have no motivation to study today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti biss.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nibdew b'għaxar minuti biss.
messages.zh: 我们先学十分钟吧。
messages.en: Let's start with just ten minutes.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, hekk ikun aktar faċli nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, hekk ikun aktar faċli nibda.
messages.zh: 好，这样更容易开始。
messages.en: All right, that will make it easier to get started.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个问题区分 motivazzjoni：什么推动我做，是“动力”；我想达到什么，是“目的”；为什么这样安排，是“理由依据”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short phrase used to promote an idea or express a person's or group's guiding belief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于宣传某种理念的简短口号，或表达个人、团体指导信念的格言、座右铭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frażi qasira li tintuża biex tippromwovi idea jew tesprimi prinċipju li jiggwida persuna jew grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口号；宣传活动、组织或群体用来传达主张、吸引支持的简短语句。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Motto huwa frażi qasira u faċli biex tiftakarha, użata f'kampanja jew minn grupp biex twassal messaġġ u tiġbed l-appoġġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A slogan is a short, memorable phrase used to promote an idea, campaign, or organization.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 格言；座右铭；表达个人或团体信念、并用来指导行为的简短语句。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Motto huwa frażi qasira li tesprimi twemmin jew prinċipju li persuna jew grupp jipprova jimxi fuqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A motto is a short phrase that expresses a belief or principle guiding a person or group.

formal.mt: Il-motto tal-kampanja, 'Inqas skart, aktar ħajja', jidher fuq il-posters kollha biex iħeġġeġ lin-nies inaqqsu l-iskart.
formal.en: The campaign slogan, 'Less waste, more life', appears on all the posters to encourage people to reduce waste.
formal.zh: 宣传活动的口号“少些废物，多些生机”出现在所有海报上，鼓励人们减少废物。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tibqa' tipprova meta xi ħaġa tkun diffiċli? Adam: Il-motto tiegħi hu 'Pass żgħir kuljum'. Nina: Jogħġobni! Illum nagħmel pass żgħir ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you keep trying when something is difficult? Adam: My motto is 'A small step every day'. Nina: I like that! I'll take a small step today too.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：遇到困难时，你怎么坚持尝试？亚当：我的座右铭是“每天迈一小步”。妮娜：我喜欢这句话！我今天也要迈一小步。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tibqa' tipprova meta xi ħaġa tkun diffiċli?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tibqa' tipprova meta xi ħaġa tkun diffiċli?
messages.zh: 遇到困难时，你怎么坚持尝试？
messages.en: How do you keep trying when something is difficult?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-motto tiegħi hu 'Pass żgħir kuljum'.
messages.mt_standard: Il-motto tiegħi hu 'Pass żgħir kuljum'.
messages.zh: 我的座右铭是“每天迈一小步”。
messages.en: My motto is 'A small step every day'.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jogħġobni! Illum nagħmel pass żgħir ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Jogħġobni! Illum nagħmel pass żgħir ukoll.
messages.zh: 我喜欢这句话！我今天也要迈一小步。
messages.en: I like that! I'll take a small step today too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 motto 想成写在醒目位置的一句短话：出现在宣传海报上可作“口号”，放在书桌前指导自己可作“座右铭”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A change in the position of a person, an object, or a part of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人、物体或身体某个部位的位置变化，也可指一次具体的动作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bidla fil-pożizzjoni ta' persuna, ta' oġġett jew ta' parti mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 移动；运动；人、物体或身体部位改变位置的过程或动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-azzjoni li biha persuna, oġġett jew parti mill-ġisem tibdel il-pożizzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Movement is the action or process of changing position or moving a part of the body.

formal.mt: L-għalliem talab lill-istudenti josservaw il-moviment tal-id waqt l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The teacher asked the students to observe the movement of the hand during the exercise.
formal.zh: 老师要求学生观察练习过程中的手部动作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Rajt dak il-moviment wara l-purtiera? Pawlu: Iva, il-qattus qiegħed jilgħab hemm.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you see that movement behind the curtain? Pawlu: Yes, the cat is playing there.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你看到窗帘后面刚才的动静了吗？保罗：看到了，猫正在那里玩。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt dak il-moviment wara l-purtiera?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt dak il-moviment wara l-purtiera?
messages.zh: 你看到窗帘后面刚才的动静了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that movement behind the curtain?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-qattus qiegħed jilgħab hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-qattus qiegħed jilgħab hemm.
messages.zh: 看到了，猫正在那里玩。
messages.en: Yes, the cat is playing there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moviment 和英语 movement 配对记忆，再想象抬手这个具体动作；先记住“位置发生变化”，便容易理解“移动、运动、动作”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Movement that is not prevented or unnecessarily restricted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不受阻碍或不必要限制的移动或流动；具体对象由上下文确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Moviment li jista' jsir mingħajr ostakli jew restrizzjonijiet mhux meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由移动；自由流动；能够在没有阻碍或不必要限制的情况下移动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà li persuni jew affarijiet jiċċaqilqu minn post għal ieħor mingħajr ostakli jew restrizzjonijiet mhux meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Free movement is the ability to move from place to place without obstruction or unnecessary restrictions.

formal.mt: Id-disinn tas-sala għandu jippermetti moviment liberu bejn l-imwejjed.
formal.en: The layout of the hall should allow free movement between the tables.
formal.zh: 大厅的布局应让人们能够在桌子之间自由通行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Inressqu dan is-siġġu biex ikun hemm moviment liberu fil-kamra? Mark: Iva, poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we move this chair so people can move freely around the room? Mark: Yes, put it next to the wall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们把这把椅子挪一下，让大家能在房间里自由走动，好吗？马克：好，把它放到墙边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inressqu dan is-siġġu biex ikun hemm moviment liberu fil-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Inressqu dan is-siġġu biex ikun hemm moviment liberu fil-kamra?
messages.zh: 我们把这把椅子挪一下，让大家能在房间里自由走动，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we move this chair so people can move freely around the room?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġih ħdejn il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 好，把它放到墙边。
messages.en: Yes, put it next to the wall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“moviment 移动＋liberu 自由的”分块记忆，想象把挡路的椅子移开后能够自由走动的画面；这里的“自由”不是“免费”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of goods between places or markets without unnecessary barriers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在不同地区或市场之间不受不必要障碍限制的流通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċ-ċaqliq tal-merkanzija bejn postijiet jew swieq differenti mingħajr ostakli mhux meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物自由流动；货物在不同地区或市场之间能够不受不必要障碍限制地流通。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-possibbiltà li l-merkanzija tgħaddi minn post jew suq għal ieħor mingħajr ostakli mhux meħtieġa għall-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Free movement of goods means that goods can pass between places or markets without unnecessary barriers to trade.

collocations.en: to facilitate the free movement of goods
barriers to the free movement of goods

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi miżuri biex jitnaqqsu l-ostakli għall-moviment liberu tal-merkanzija bejn is-swieq.
formal.en: The report proposes measures to reduce barriers to the free movement of goods between markets.
formal.zh: 报告提出了一些措施，以减少市场之间货物自由流动的障碍。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'ifisser moviment liberu tal-merkanzija? David: Ifisser li l-prodotti jistgħu jgħaddu minn suq għal ieħor mingħajr ostakli mhux meħtieġa.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does free movement of goods mean? David: It means that products can pass from one market to another without unnecessary barriers.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：“货物自由流动”是什么意思？戴维：意思是产品可以从一个市场流向另一个市场，而不受不必要的障碍限制。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser moviment liberu tal-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser moviment liberu tal-merkanzija?
messages.zh: “货物自由流动”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does free movement of goods mean?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-prodotti jistgħu jgħaddu minn suq għal ieħor mingħajr ostakli mhux meħtieġa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-prodotti jistgħu jgħaddu minn suq għal ieħor mingħajr ostakli mhux meħtieġa.
messages.zh: 意思是产品可以从一个市场流向另一个市场，而不受不必要的障碍限制。
messages.en: It means that products can pass from one market to another without unnecessary barriers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 moviment liberu 是“自由流动”，再把 tal-merkanzija 作为“货物的”整体接上；想象箱子在两个市场之间顺畅流通，锁定流动的对象是货物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The movement of goods through an intermediate place on their way to a final destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物前往最终目的地途中经过某个中间地区或地点的运输。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġarr ta' merkanzija minn post intermedju waqt il-vjaġġ tagħha lejn id-destinazzjoni finali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过境运输；中转运输；货物经由中间地区或地点继续运往最终目的地的运输过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moviment ta' merkanzija li tgħaddi minn pajjiż jew post intermedju biex tkompli lejn id-destinazzjoni finali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transit movement is the transport of goods through an intermediate place on the way to their final destination.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tissorvelja l-moviment ta' tranżitu tal-merkanzija mill-port sal-fruntiera.
formal.en: The company will monitor the transit movement of the goods from the port to the border.
formal.zh: 公司将监控这批货物从港口到边境的过境运输。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn? Rita: Le, dan hu moviment ta' tranżitu; għada jkomplu lejn id-destinazzjoni finali.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are these boxes staying here? Rita: No, this is a transit movement; tomorrow they will continue to their final destination.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这些箱子会留在这里吗？丽塔：不会，这是中转运输；明天它们会继续运往最终目的地。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-kaxxi se jibqgħu hawn?
messages.zh: 这些箱子会留在这里吗？
messages.en: Are these boxes staying here?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu moviment ta' tranżitu; għada jkomplu lejn id-destinazzjoni finali.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu moviment ta' tranżitu; għada jkomplu lejn id-destinazzjoni finali.
messages.zh: 不会，这是中转运输；明天它们会继续运往最终目的地。
messages.en: No, this is a transit movement; tomorrow they will continue to their final destination.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tranżitu 与英语 transit 配对记忆，画出“起点→途经地点→终点”三个位置；moviment ta' tranżitu 强调货物经过中间地点后还会继续前行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A portable telephone used to make calls and send messages through a mobile network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过移动通信网络拨打电话、发送信息的便携式电话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telefon li tista' ġġorr miegħek u tuża biex tagħmel telefonati u tibgħat messaġġi permezz ta' netwerk mobbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可随身携带、通过移动通信网络通话的电话，即手机。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mowbajl huwa telefon li ġġorr miegħek biex tagħmel telefonati u tibgħat messaġġi minn postijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mobile phone is a telephone that you can carry with you and use wherever a mobile network is available.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, itfi l-mowbajl qabel tibda l-laqgħa.
formal.en: Please switch off your mobile phone before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 请在会议开始前关闭手机。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħallejt il-mowbajl? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you leave your phone? Mark: On the table, next to the cup.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把手机放哪儿了？马克：桌子上，杯子旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ħallejt il-mowbajl?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ħallejt il-mowbajl?
messages.zh: 你把手机放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you leave your phone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazza.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazza.
messages.zh: 桌子上，杯子旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the cup.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mowbajl 和每天拿手机查看消息的动作绑定，再连读 il-mowbajl，记住它表示手机。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boat that is driven by an engine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依靠发动机提供动力行驶的船艇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajsa li timxi fuq l-ilma bis-saħħa ta' magna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以发动机为动力的船艇，常指摩托艇或小型机动艇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mowtorbowt huwa dgħajsa li tuża magna biex timxi fuq l-ilma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A motorboat is a boat that moves through the water using power from an engine.

formal.mt: Il-mowtorbowt intuża biex jittrasporta t-tagħmir mill-port sal-gżira.
formal.en: The motorboat was used to transport the equipment from the harbour to the island.
formal.zh: 这艘机动艇用于把设备从港口运往岛上。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tikri mowtorbowt għal siegħa? Pawlu: Iva, ejja nistaqsu kemm jiswa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to rent a motorboat for an hour? Pawlu: Yes, let's ask how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想租一小时摩托艇吗？保罗：想，我们去问问多少钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tikri mowtorbowt għal siegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tikri mowtorbowt għal siegħa?
messages.zh: 你想租一小时摩托艇吗？
messages.en: Do you want to rent a motorboat for an hour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nistaqsu kemm jiswa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nistaqsu kemm jiswa.
messages.zh: 想，我们去问问多少钱。
messages.en: Yes, let's ask how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象发动机响起、小艇驶离码头的画面，边看边念 mowtorbowt，把词义固定为机动艇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of barren, stony land where little vegetation grows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 土地贫瘠、石块较多，植被稀少的地面或地带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art fqira u mimlija ġebel fejn ftit li xejn jikbru pjanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫瘠而多石、难以生长茂盛植被的土地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moxa hija art għerja u mimlija ġebel li fuqha ma tantx jikbru pjanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Barren stony land is ground covered with stones where very few plants are able to grow.

collocations.en: a stretch of barren stony land
walk across the barren stony ground

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi medda moxa bi ftit veġetazzjoni u ħafna ġebel.
formal.en: The report describes a stretch of barren stony land with little vegetation and many stones.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一片植被稀少、石块众多的贫瘠土地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se naqsmu l-moxa? Toni: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta għall-ġebel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going to cross the barren stony ground? Toni: Yes, but watch out for the stones.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们要穿过这片贫瘠的石地吗？托尼：对，不过要留意脚下的石头。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Se naqsmu l-moxa?
messages.mt_standard: Se naqsmu l-moxa?
messages.zh: 我们要穿过这片贫瘠的石地吗？
messages.en: Are we going to cross the barren stony ground?

messages.speaker: Toni (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta għall-ġebel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta għall-ġebel.
messages.zh: 对，不过要留意脚下的石头。
messages.en: Yes, but watch out for the stones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 moxa 配一幅石头多、草木少的地面图，同时记住贫瘠和多石两个要点。

gloss_zh: 公共荒地；开阔的未耕地

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of open, uncultivated common land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一片未作耕种、作为公共空地的开阔土地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art komuni u miftuħa li mhix maħduma għall-biedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开阔而未耕作的公共荒地或公用空地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Moxgħa hija medda art miftuħa u komuni li ma tintużax għall-kultivazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An area of common land is open ground that people share and that is not cultivated.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi l-moxgħa u l-mogħdija li tgħaddi minnha.
formal.en: The map shows the common and the path that passes through it.
formal.zh: 地图标出了这片公共荒地以及穿过它的小路。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Immorru nimxu fil-moxgħa? David: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we go for a walk on the common? David: Yes, let's meet by the path.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们去公共荒地上走走好吗？戴维：好，我们在小路旁碰面。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru nimxu fil-moxgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru nimxu fil-moxgħa?
messages.zh: 我们去公共荒地上走走好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go for a walk on the common?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-mogħdija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-mogħdija.
messages.zh: 好，我们在小路旁碰面。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet by the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moxgħa 放进大家在开阔公共荒地散步的画面，连同 mixja fil-moxgħa 一起记忆。

exact_key: moyen mw pa pemet mw map aprann yn bagay la mw oblije kanpe koz mwayen
gloss_zh: 经济条件不允许，迫使我中断正在进行的学习（原样短语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supplied phrase expresses having to stop learning something because one's financial means are insufficient.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给短语表达：自己正在学习某样东西，却因经济条件不足而不得不中断。此处保留所给名词标签，但原文应作为整段表达理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-frażi mogħtija tesprimi li persuna tkun qed titgħallem xi ħaġa iżda jkollha tieqaf għax ma jkollhiex biżżejjed mezzi finanzjarji.

sense_translations.en_definition: moyen mw pa pemet mw map aprann yn bagay la mw oblije kanpe koz mwayen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 我的经济条件不允许；我正在学习某样东西，却不得不因为经济原因停下来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din il-frażi tfisser li l-persuna ma tistax tkompli titgħallem xi ħaġa għax il-mezzi finanzjarji tagħha ma jippermettulhiex tagħmel dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone uses this phrase, they mean that they have to interrupt their learning because they cannot afford to continue.

collocations.en: to stop learning because of the costs
collocations.zh: 因费用问题而中断学习

formal.mt: Kelli nieqaf mill-kors minħabba nuqqas ta' mezzi finanzjarji, għalkemm xtaqt inkompli nitgħallem.
formal.en: I had to withdraw from the course because of insufficient financial means, although I wanted to continue learning.
formal.zh: 尽管我希望继续学习，但由于经济条件不足，我不得不中断课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tmur għall-kors? Mark: Le, kelli nieqaf għax m'għandix biżżejjed flus biex inħallas.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still going to the course? Mark: No, I had to stop because I don't have enough money to pay for it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在上那个课程吗？Mark：没有，我不得不停下来，因为我没有足够的钱交费。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tmur għall-kors?
