messages.mt_standard: Għadek tmur għall-kors?
messages.zh: 你还在上那个课程吗？
messages.en: Are you still going to the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kelli nieqaf għax m'għandix biżżejjed flus biex inħallas.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kelli nieqaf għax m'għandix biżżejjed flus biex inħallas.
messages.zh: 没有，我不得不停下来，因为我没有足够的钱交费。
messages.en: No, I had to stop because I don't have enough money to pay for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句意思记成“想继续学，钱却不够，只能暂停”。原样文本不要当作单个马耳他语名词背诵；搭配和例句展示其意思的马耳他语表达。

gloss_zh: 马夫；照料马匹的马厩工作人员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person employed to look after horses and carry out work in a stable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在马厩中负责喂养、清洁及日常照料马匹的工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taħdem fi stalla u tieħu ħsieb iż-żwiemel, inkluż l-għalf u t-tindif tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马夫；受雇在马厩照料马匹的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mozz tal-istalla huwa ħaddiem li jieħu ħsieb iż-żwiemel u jagħmel ix-xogħol meħtieġ ta' kuljum fl-istalla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A groom is someone whose job is to look after horses and attend to their everyday needs in a stable.

formal.mt: Il-mozz tal-istalla huwa responsabbli għall-għalf taż-żwiemel u għat-tindif tal-istalla kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The groom is responsible for feeding the horses and cleaning the stable every morning.
formal.zh: 这名马夫负责每天早晨喂马并清理马厩。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min jieħu ħsieb iż-żwiemel hawn? Toni: Il-mozz tal-istalla. Jiġi kmieni biex jitmagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who looks after the horses here? Toni: The groom. He comes early to feed them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的马由谁照料？Toni：马夫。他很早就来喂它们。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jieħu ħsieb iż-żwiemel hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Min jieħu ħsieb iż-żwiemel hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的马由谁照料？
messages.en: Who looks after the horses here?

messages.speaker: Toni (马厩工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mozz tal-istalla. Jiġi kmieni biex jitmagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mozz tal-istalla. Jiġi kmieni biex jitmagħhom.
messages.zh: 马夫。他很早就来喂它们。
messages.en: The groom. He comes early to feed them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上一幅清晨马厩图：工作人员提着饲料喂马、清理马厩。这里的英语 groom 指照料马匹的人，记作“马夫”。

gloss_zh: 动议；会议上正式提出的议案

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal proposal put forward at a meeting for discussion or a decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在会议或集会上正式提出、供与会者讨论或作出决定的建议或议案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proposta formali li titressaq waqt laqgħa jew assemblea biex tiġi diskussa jew tittieħed deċiżjoni dwarha.

sense_translations.en_definition: motion (proposal made during a meeting or gathering)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 动议；在会议或集会上提出、供讨论或决定的正式建议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mozzjoni hija proposta li xi ħadd iressaq waqt laqgħa jew assemblea biex il-parteċipanti jiddiskutuha jew jiddeċiedu dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A motion is a formal proposal that someone puts forward at a meeting for the participants to discuss or decide upon.

collocations.en: to vote in favour of a motion

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, il-kumitat adotta mozzjoni biex jestendi l-ħinijiet tal-ftuħ tal-librerija.
formal.en: During the meeting, the committee adopted a motion to extend the library's opening hours.
formal.zh: 会议期间，委员会通过了一项延长图书馆开放时间的动议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara bil-mozzjoni dwar il-librerija? Pawlu: Għaddiet! Issa se tiftaħ aktar fit-tul.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to the motion about the library? Pawlu: It passed! Now the library will stay open longer.
colloquial.zh: Lara：关于图书馆的那项动议怎么样了？Pawlu：通过了！现在图书馆会延长开放时间。

messages.speaker: Lara (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġara bil-mozzjoni dwar il-librerija?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġara bil-mozzjoni dwar il-librerija?
messages.zh: 关于图书馆的那项动议怎么样了？
messages.en: What happened to the motion about the library?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaddiet! Issa se tiftaħ aktar fit-tul.
messages.mt_standard: Għaddiet! Issa se tiftaħ aktar fit-tul.
messages.zh: 通过了！现在图书馆会延长开放时间。
messages.en: It passed! Now the library will stay open longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议桌上有人举手提出建议，随后大家讨论并表决：mozzjoni 就是这项正式动议。把“提出—讨论—表决”三个动作连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's mind, especially as the place where he holds a thought, intention, or memory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 他的心思或头脑，尤其用于表示某件事在他的心里、脑海中或记忆里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-moħħ tiegħu, speċjalment bħala l-post fejn iżomm ħsieb, intenzjoni jew tifkira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在他的心里或脑海中；用于表示他所想着或记着的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-ħsieb jew fil-memorja tiegħu, meta xi ħaġa tkun qed tiġi maħsuba jew miżmuma fit-tifkira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has something in mind, he is thinking about it or keeping it in his memory.

formal.mt: L-istudent għandu jżomm f'moħħu l-istruzzjonijiet qabel jibda l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: The student should keep the instructions in mind before starting the exercise.
formal.zh: 学生开始练习之前，应把说明记在心里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għandu f'moħħu Mark għall-festa? Maja: Għandu f'moħħu ikla żgħira mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does Mark have in mind for the party? Maja: He has a small meal with friends in mind.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 对聚会有什么打算？Maja：他想和朋友们简单吃顿饭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandu f'moħħu Mark għall-festa?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandu f'moħħu Mark għall-festa?
messages.zh: Mark 对聚会有什么打算？
messages.en: What does Mark have in mind for the party?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu f'moħħu ikla żgħira mal-ħbieb.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu f'moħħu ikla żgħira mal-ħbieb.
messages.zh: 他想和朋友们简单吃顿饭。
messages.en: He has a small meal with friends in mind.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 moħħu 想成“他的脑海”，再把 f'moħħu 整块记成“在他的脑海里”，联想把提醒存进脑中的画面。

gloss_zh: 心绪不宁的；风浪大的；被翻乱或弄得乱七八糟的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Disturbed or unsettled, describing an upset person, rough water, or a place that has been thrown into disorder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示不平静或受到扰乱：可形容人心绪不宁、海面风浪大，也可形容地方被翻乱或弄得一团糟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li ma jkunx kalm, baħar b'mewġ qawwi, jew post li jkun tħarbat u ma jkunx għadu fl-ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心绪不宁的、烦乱的；也可形容海面不平静、风浪大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta jingħad għal persuna, ifisser li tkun inkwetata jew ma tkunx kalma; meta jingħad għall-baħar, ifisser li jkun hemm mewġ qawwi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is mqalleb, they feel upset or unsettled; if the sea is mqalleb, its surface is rough with waves.

sense_translations.en_definition: rough, upset, ransacked, trashed, wrecked, rough sea, messed up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不平静的、心烦意乱的；被翻箱倒柜弄乱的、被糟蹋或毁坏的、一团糟的；形容海时指风浪大的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jista' jiddeskrivi persuna li tkun imħassba, baħar b'mewġ qawwi, jew post li jkun ġie mħarbat, imqalleb bit-tfittxija jew bil-ħsara, u jkun tħalla f'diżordni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as mqalleb may be rough or disturbed, while a place may have been searched through, damaged, or left in a mess.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-baħar imqalleb, il-vjaġġ bil-lanċa ġie pospost sakemm jitjieb it-temp.
formal.en: Because of the rough sea, the ferry journey was postponed until the weather improved.
formal.zh: 由于海面风浪大，渡轮航程被推迟，等待天气好转。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk imqalleb? Mark: Sibt il-kamra kollha mqallba u ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so upset? Mark: I found the whole room in a mess, and I can't find the keys.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你怎么看起来这么心烦？Mark：我发现整个房间被弄得乱七八糟，而且找不到钥匙。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk imqalleb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk imqalleb?
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来这么心烦？
messages.en: Why do you look so upset?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt il-kamra kollha mqallba u ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt il-kamra kollha mqallba u ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 我发现整个房间被弄得乱七八糟，而且找不到钥匙。
messages.en: I found the whole room in a mess, and I can't find the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“不平静、被扰乱”串起三个画面：心里烦乱的人、波浪翻涌的海、东西被翻乱的房间。搭配 kamra 时记住阴性形式 mqallba。

gloss_zh: 顽皮的；活泼的；烤至褐色的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describes someone naughty, mischievous or lively, or food toasted until brown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人顽皮、爱恶作剧或活泼，也可形容食物烤得呈褐色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd imqareb, li jħobb jagħmel iċ-ċajt jew mimli ħajja, jew ikel mixwi sakemm jieħu kulur kannella.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容人顽皮、淘气或活泼；形容食物烤至褐色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal persuna mqarba jew mimlija ħajja, kif ukoll għal ikel li jkun inkalja jew inxtewa sakemm sar kannella.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described this way is naughty, mischievous or lively, while food described this way has been toasted until brown.

formal.mt: It-tifel mqarqaċ kien mimli enerġija, iżda segwa l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliema waqt l-attività.
formal.en: The lively, mischievous boy was full of energy, but he followed the teacher's instructions during the activity.
formal.zh: 这个活泼顽皮的男孩精力充沛，但在活动中遵守了老师的指示。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed tidħaq? Pawlu: Dak it-tifel mqarqaċ ħeba l-ballun wara s-siġġu!
colloquial.en: Marta: Why are you laughing? Pawlu: That mischievous boy hid the ball behind the chair!
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么笑？保罗：那个顽皮的男孩把球藏在椅子后面了！

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tidħaq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tidħaq?
messages.zh: 你为什么笑？
messages.en: Why are you laughing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak it-tifel mqarqaċ ħeba l-ballun wara s-siġġu!
messages.mt_standard: Dak it-tifel mqarqaċ ħeba l-ballun wara s-siġġu!
messages.zh: 那个顽皮的男孩把球藏在椅子后面了！
messages.en: That mischievous boy hid the ball behind the chair!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个画面并排记：孩子藏球是“顽皮”，面包烤褐是“烤至褐色”；看到搭配对象再判断词义。

gloss_zh: 缩短；缩短的形式；简略版本

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form referring to something made shorter in length or expressed in fewer words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指长度被缩短或文字被精简后的形式；可结合语境理解为简略版本。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tirreferi għal xi ħaġa li tkun saret iqsar fit-tul jew ġiet espressa b'inqas kliem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示缩短长度或精简内容，使之成为较短的形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li t-tul ta' xi ħaġa jitnaqqas jew li l-kontenut tagħha jiġi espress b'inqas kliem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied sense concerns making something shorter in length or expressing its content in fewer words.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mqassar jippreżenta r-riżultati ewlenin f'żewġ paġni.
formal.en: The abridged report presents the main results in two pages.
formal.zh: 这份精简报告用两页呈现主要结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu t-test kollu? Mark: Le, dan hu t-test mqassar; il-verżjoni sħiħa fiha għaxar paġni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the whole text? Mark: No, this is the shortened text; the full version has ten pages.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是全文吗？马克：不是，这是精简文本；完整版有十页。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu t-test kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu t-test kollu?
messages.zh: 这是全文吗？
messages.en: Is this the whole text?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu t-test mqassar; il-verżjoni sħiħa fiha għaxar paġni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu t-test mqassar; il-verżjoni sħiħa fiha għaxar paġni.
messages.zh: 不是，这是精简文本；完整版有十页。
messages.en: No, this is the shortened text; the full version has ten pages.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十页报告压缩成两页，保留重点、减少篇幅；用“rapport mqassar＝精简报告”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Torn, broken or tattered, with damage that leaves something split or ragged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物品被撕裂、弄破或损坏，出现裂口、破片或破烂边缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun inqattgħet, inkisret jew ġarrbet ħsara u jkollha tiċrit jew truf imħarbta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕裂的；破损的；因损坏或磨损而破烂的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jingħad għal oġġett li jkun inqatta', inkiser jew tant ġarrab ħsara li jkun mimli tiċrit u truf imħarbta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as torn, broken or tattered has damage that leaves it split, ragged or no longer intact.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb mqatta' tqiegħed f'kaxxa protettiva biex ma jġarrabx aktar ħsara.
formal.en: The tattered book was placed in a protective box to prevent further damage.
formal.zh: 这本破损的书被放进保护盒，以免进一步损坏。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nista' nuża dan id-drapp għall-borża? Nina: Dan id-drapp mqatta'; ħu l-biċċa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Can I use this fabric for the bag? Nina: This fabric is torn; take the other piece.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：我能用这块布做袋子吗？妮娜：这块布破了，拿另一块吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (缝纫学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża dan id-drapp għall-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża dan id-drapp għall-borża?
messages.zh: 我能用这块布做袋子吗？
messages.en: Can I use this fabric for the bag?

messages.speaker: Nina (缝纫老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-drapp mqatta'; ħu l-biċċa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-drapp mqatta'; ħu l-biċċa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 这块布破了，拿另一块吧。
messages.en: This fabric is torn; take the other piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词和一块撕出裂口的布绑定记忆：drapp mqatta' 是“破布料”；词尾的撇号也要一起记住。

gloss_zh: 放置好的；被摆放的（复数）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Placed or positioned somewhere, referring to more than one person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示多个人或物已经被放置、摆放或安排在某个位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika li żewġ persuni jew affarijiet jew aktar ikunu tpoġġew jew ġew irranġati f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被放置或摆放在某处的，用于多个人或物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li persuni jew affarijiet ikunu tpoġġew f'ċertu post jew ġew irranġati f'pożizzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People or things described as placed have been put or arranged in a particular location.

formal.mt: Is-siġġijiet huma mqiegħdin f'ċirku biex il-parteċipanti jkunu jistgħu jaraw lil xulxin.
formal.en: The chairs are arranged in a circle so that the participants can see one another.
formal.zh: 椅子摆成一圈，方便参与者彼此看见。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt? David: Huma mqiegħdin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where are the books I brought? David: They are on the table, next to the window.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我带来的书在哪里？戴维：它们放在桌上，就在窗边。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma l-kotba li ġibt?
messages.zh: 我带来的书在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the books I brought?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma mqiegħdin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Huma mqiegħdin fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 它们放在桌上，就在窗边。
messages.en: They are on the table, next to the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几本书已经整齐摆在桌上，用“huma mqiegħdin＝它们被放好了”连句记忆，同时留意复数对象。

gloss_zh: 穆斯林圣者；伊斯兰教灵修导师

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Muslim holy man or spiritual teacher respected within a religious community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在穆斯林社群中受到尊敬、被视为圣者或担任灵修导师的男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel Musulman meqjus bħala qaddis jew bħala għalliem spiritwali u rispettat fil-komunità reliġjuża tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林社群中被尊为圣者或灵修导师的男子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mrabit huwa raġel Musulman li jitqies bħala qaddis jew li jservi bħala għalliem spiritwali fil-komunità tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A marabout is a Muslim holy man or spiritual teacher whom members of a religious community respect.

collocations.zh: 一位知名的穆斯林圣者

collocations.en: to ask a marabout for advice
collocations.zh: 向一位穆斯林灵修导师请教

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, vjaġġatur jitlob parir mingħand mrabit qabel ikompli l-vjaġġ tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, a traveller asks a marabout for advice before continuing his journey.
formal.zh: 故事中，一位旅行者在继续旅程之前向一位穆斯林灵修导师请教。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont? Mark: Hu mrabit; in-nies imorru għandu biex jitolbuh parir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that man in the story? Mark: He is a marabout; people go to him to ask for advice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里的那个男人是谁？Mark：他是一位穆斯林灵修导师，大家会去向他请教。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel fir-rakkont?
messages.zh: 故事里的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu mrabit; in-nies imorru għandu biex jitolbuh parir.
messages.mt_standard: Hu mrabit; in-nies imorru għandu biex jitolbuh parir.
messages.zh: 他是一位穆斯林灵修导师，大家会去向他请教。
messages.en: He is a marabout; people go to him to ask for advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mrabit 放进“旅人向一位灵修导师请教”的画面中，记住它指一位受尊敬的宗教人物。

gloss_zh: 穆斯林圣者们；伊斯兰教灵修导师们

teaching_sense.en_definition: Muslim holy men or spiritual teachers respected within their religious communities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在穆斯林社群中受到尊敬、被视为圣者或担任灵修导师的多位男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Irġiel Musulmani meqjusa bħala qaddisin jew bħala għalliema spiritwali u rispettati fil-komunitajiet reliġjużi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穆斯林社群中被尊为圣者或灵修导师的多位男子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mrabitin huma rġiel Musulmani li jitqiesu bħala qaddisin jew li jservu bħala għalliema spiritwali fil-komunitajiet tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Marabouts are Muslim holy men or spiritual teachers whom members of their religious communities respect.

collocations.zh: 受到尊敬的穆斯林灵修导师们

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jiddeskrivi laqgħa bejn grupp ta' mrabitin u l-abitanti tar-raħal.
formal.en: The chapter describes a meeting between a group of marabouts and the village residents.
formal.zh: 这一章描写了一群穆斯林灵修导师与村民之间的一次会面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fir-rakkont hemm mrabit wieħed biss? Mark: Le, hemm grupp ta' mrabitin li jitkellmu man-nies tar-raħal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there only one marabout in the story? Mark: No, there is a group of marabouts who speak with the villagers.
colloquial.zh: Maja：故事里只有一位穆斯林灵修导师吗？Mark：不是，有一群灵修导师，他们与村民交谈。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fir-rakkont hemm mrabit wieħed biss?
messages.mt_standard: Fir-rakkont hemm mrabit wieħed biss?
messages.zh: 故事里只有一位穆斯林灵修导师吗？
messages.en: Is there only one marabout in the story?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hemm grupp ta' mrabitin li jitkellmu man-nies tar-raħal.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hemm grupp ta' mrabitin li jitkellmu man-nies tar-raħal.
messages.zh: 不是，有一群灵修导师，他们与村民交谈。
messages.en: No, there is a group of marabouts who speak with the villagers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mrabit 与 mrabitin 对照记忆：前者是一位导师，后者是多位导师；用“一人请教、多人会面”的画面区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Boats used for travelling on water, carrying people or goods, or fishing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于水上航行、载人、运货或捕鱼的船只，为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajjes li jintużaw biex wieħed jivvjaġġa fuq l-ilma, iġorr nies jew merkanzija, jew jistad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船只；用于水上航行的小型船舶，指多艘。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mriekeb huma dgħajjes li jintużaw għall-ivvjaġġar fuq l-ilma, għat-trasport jew għas-sajd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Boats are vessels that people use to travel on water, transport things, or catch fish.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt jidhru diversi mriekeb tas-sajd ħdejn ix-xatt.
formal.en: The photograph shows several fishing boats near the shore.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到岸边的几艘渔船。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hemm mriekeb fil-port illum? Mark: Hemm tliet mriekeb żgħar ħdejn il-moll.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many boats are in the harbour today? Mark: There are three small boats beside the quay.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天港口里有多少艘船？Mark：码头边有三艘小船。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hemm mriekeb fil-port illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hemm mriekeb fil-port illum?
messages.zh: 今天港口里有多少艘船？
messages.en: How many boats are in the harbour today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm tliet mriekeb żgħar ħdejn il-moll.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm tliet mriekeb żgħar ħdejn il-moll.
messages.zh: 码头边有三艘小船。
messages.en: There are three small boats beside the quay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象码头边并排停着三艘小船，边数边读 tliet mriekeb，把 mriekeb 与“多艘船”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be built or formed into a particular shape or structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被构建或塑造成具有某种形态、结构或特征的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun inbniet jew ingħatat għamla, struttura jew karatteristiċi partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被建成或构成；所给英文释义未完整显示。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun inbniet jew ingħatat struttura; id-definizzjoni Ingliża mogħtija mhijiex kompluta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described this way has been built or formed, although the supplied English gloss is incomplete.

collocations.zh: 由经历塑造的身份认同

collocations.en: a community formed by different people
collocations.zh: 由不同的人组成的社区

formal.mt: L-identità tal-komunità hija msawwra mill-esperjenzi komuni tal-membri tagħha.
formal.en: The community's identity is shaped by the shared experiences of its members.
formal.zh: 这个社区的身份认同由其成员的共同经历塑造。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhi msawwra l-komunità tagħkom? Pawlu: Hija msawwra minn familji li ġew minn postijiet differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is your community made up? Pawlu: It is made up of families who came from different places.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们的社区是怎样组成的？保罗：它由来自不同地方的家庭组成。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhi msawwra l-komunità tagħkom?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhi msawwra l-komunità tagħkom?
messages.zh: 你们的社区是怎样组成的？
messages.en: How is your community made up?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (社区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija msawwra minn familji li ġew minn postijiet differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Hija msawwra minn familji li ġew minn postijiet differenti.
messages.zh: 它由来自不同地方的家庭组成。
messages.en: It is made up of families who came from different places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把社区想成由许多家庭拼成的模型，用 msawwra 记住“被构建、被塑造”；所给英文释义残缺，不猜补缺失文字。

gloss_zh: 被迷住；看得或听得入迷

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be completely fascinated by something, as if held under a spell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被某人或某事深深吸引，仿佛中了魔法般完全入迷。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tkun tant affaxxinat minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa li tħossok bħallikieku taħt seħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被深深迷住；因强烈的吸引力而完全入迷，仿佛中了魔法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li tkun kompletament affaxxinat jew miġbud minn xi ħadd jew minn xi ħaġa, bħallikieku taħt seħer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are spellbound, something fascinates you so completely that it holds all your attention.

formal.mt: Waqt il-kunċert, it-tifel baqa' msaħħar bil-mużika u sema' kull nota b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: During the concert, the boy remained spellbound by the music and listened carefully to every note.
formal.zh: 音乐会期间，男孩被音乐深深迷住，专注地聆听每一个音符。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għoġbok il-kunċert? Mark: Ħafna! Bqajt msaħħar bil-vuċi tal-kantanta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you enjoy the concert? Mark: Very much! I was spellbound by the singer's voice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢这场音乐会吗？Mark：非常喜欢！女歌手的嗓音让我完全入迷。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok il-kunċert?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok il-kunċert?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这场音乐会吗？
messages.en: Did you enjoy the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħafna! Bqajt msaħħar bil-vuċi tal-kantanta.
messages.mt_standard: Ħafna! Bqajt msaħħar bil-vuċi tal-kantanta.
messages.zh: 非常喜欢！女歌手的嗓音让我完全入迷。
messages.en: Very much! I was spellbound by the singer's voice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象听到动人的歌声后整个人像被施了魔法，注意力全被吸住；用“听得入迷”的画面记住 msaħħar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Known or referred to by a particular name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以某个名字或称呼为人所知的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu isem jew li n-nies jirreferu għalih b'isem jew titlu partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被称作某个名称的；名叫某个名字的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jissejjaħ b'isem, laqam jew titlu partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something called a particular name is known or referred to by that name.

formal.mt: Il-proġett, msejjaħ 'Pont', għandu l-għan li jtejjeb il-komunikazzjoni bejn l-iskejjel.
formal.en: The project, called 'Bridge', aims to improve communication between schools.
formal.zh: 这个名为“桥梁”的项目旨在改善学校之间的沟通。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif jismu dan il-post? Mark: Huwa msejjaħ 'Il-Ġnien'. Sara: Isem sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this place called? Mark: It is called 'The Garden'. Sara: What a lovely name!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个地方叫什么？马克：它叫“花园”。萨拉：真是个好名字！

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jismu dan il-post?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jismu dan il-post?
messages.zh: 这个地方叫什么？
messages.en: What is this place called?

messages.speaker: Mark (当地居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa msejjaħ 'Il-Ġnien'.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa msejjaħ 'Il-Ġnien'.
messages.zh: 它叫“花园”。
messages.en: It is called 'The Garden'.

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Isem sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Isem sabiħ!
messages.zh: 真是个好名字！
messages.en: What a lovely name!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给人物或地点贴上名字标签，把 msejjaħ 与“名叫、被称为”一起记；再用 msejjaħ ukoll 练习“也叫”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on evidence, facts, principles, or another supporting foundation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以证据、事实、原则或其他支撑性基础为依据的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandha bħala bażi evidenza, fatti, prinċipji jew xi ħaġa oħra li ssostniha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建立在某种事实、证据或原则基础上的；有依据的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandha bażi f'fatti, evidenza jew prinċipji li jsostnuha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An idea or decision that is grounded in something has that thing as its supporting basis.

collocations.zh: 建立在信任基础上的关系

formal.mt: Il-konklużjoni tar-rapport hija msejsa fuq analiżi bir-reqqa tad-data miġbura.
formal.en: The report's conclusion is grounded in a careful analysis of the collected data.
formal.zh: 报告的结论建立在对所收集数据的细致分析之上。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għażilt din l-iskola? Nina: L-għażla tiegħi hija msejsa fuq l-esperjenza tajba ta' ħuti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you choose this school? Nina: My choice is based on my siblings' good experience.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么选这所学校？妮娜：我的选择是基于兄弟姐妹在这里的良好经历。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt din l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt din l-iskola?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这所学校？
messages.en: Why did you choose this school?

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għażla tiegħi hija msejsa fuq l-esperjenza tajba ta' ħuti.
messages.mt_standard: L-għażla tiegħi hija msejsa fuq l-esperjenza tajba ta' ħuti.
messages.zh: 我的选择是基于兄弟姐妹在这里的良好经历。
messages.en: My choice is based on my siblings' good experience.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把结论想成站在证据地基上的房子，整块记住 msejsa fuq“建立在……基础上”，随后接支持它的事实或理由。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or thing bearing a stain or dirty mark.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身上或表面带有污渍的人或物，按所给名词词性作指称理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li għandhom tebgħa jew marka ta' ħmieġ fuqhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沾有污渍的人或物；按所给名词词性理解为对带污渍者的指称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew oġġett li għandhom tebgħa jew tbajja' fuqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described as stained bears a mark left by dirt, liquid, or another substance.

formal.mt: Il-flokk mtabba' bil-kafè tqiegħed f'borża separata qabel il-ħasil.
formal.en: The shirt stained with coffee was placed in a separate bag before washing.
formal.zh: 那件沾有咖啡渍的衬衫在清洗前被放进了单独的袋子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-flokk nadif? Pawlu: Le, huwa mtabba' bil-kafè. Maja: Mela se naħslu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this shirt clean? Pawlu: No, it is stained with coffee. Maja: Then I'll wash it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这件衬衫干净吗？保罗：不，它沾上了咖啡渍。玛雅：那我把它洗了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flokk nadif?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flokk nadif?
messages.zh: 这件衬衫干净吗？
messages.en: Is this shirt clean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa mtabba' bil-kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa mtabba' bil-kafè.
messages.zh: 不，它沾上了咖啡渍。
messages.en: No, it is stained with coffee.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela se naħslu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela se naħslu.
messages.zh: 那我把它洗了。
messages.en: Then I'll wash it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象白衬衫上醒目的咖啡渍，用 flokk mtabba' 记住“带污渍的衬衫”；本包保留名词标签，例句展示它描述物品的用法。

gloss_zh: 双数；表示两个的语法形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A grammatical form used to refer to two people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中用于表示两个人或两个事物的双数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma grammatikali li tintuża biex tindika żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 双数，即表示两个对象的语法形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma tan-numru grammatikali li tindika żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The dual is a grammatical form that refers specifically to two people or things.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti jitgħallmu jagħrfu l-forma tal-mtenni u jispjegaw li tindika tnejn.
formal.en: In this lesson, students learn to identify the dual form and explain that it indicates two.
formal.zh: 在本课中，学生学习辨认双数形式，并说明它表示两个。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser il-mtenni? Pawlu: Huwa forma grammatikali li tindika tnejn. Lina: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the dual mean? Pawlu: It is a grammatical form that indicates two. Lina: So we are talking about two people or two things.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：双数是什么意思？保罗：它是表示两个的语法形式。莉娜：也就是说，我们谈的是两个人或两个事物。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser il-mtenni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser il-mtenni?
messages.zh: 双数是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the dual mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa forma grammatikali li tindika tnejn.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa forma grammatikali li tindika tnejn.
messages.zh: 它是表示两个的语法形式。
messages.en: It is a grammatical form that indicates two.

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar żewġ persuni jew żewġ affarijiet.
messages.zh: 也就是说，我们谈的是两个人或两个事物。
messages.en: So we are talking about two people or two things.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时在 mtenni 旁画两个圆，再写上“双数”；把它和“恰好两个”的语法概念一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something used as a standard or example, or a representation of an object or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作衡量标准或仿照范例的事物，也可指表现某个物体或系统的模型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li sservi bħala standard jew eżempju, jew rappreżentazzjoni ta' oġġett jew sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标准；用于衡量或评判其他事物的基准。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Livell jew eżempju stabbilit li jservi ta' kejl biex jiġu ġġudikati affarijiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A model is a standard against which other things can be judged or compared.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 范例；可供学习、参照或仿效的具体例子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżempju li wieħed jista' jsegwi jew juża bħala gwida meta jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A model is an example that you can follow when doing or making something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 模型；为展示或理解某个物体或系统而制作的表示形式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni ta' oġġett jew sistema, magħmula biex turi l-għamla tiegħu jew kif jaħdem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A model is a representation of an object or system that helps people examine or understand it.

formal.mt: L-għalliem ipprovda mudell ta' ittra biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jsegwu l-istruttura tagħha.
formal.en: The teacher provided a sample letter so that the students could follow its structure.
formal.zh: 教师提供了一封书信范例，让学生可以参照其结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek mudell ta' ittra li nista' nsegwi? Mark: Iva, tista' tuża din bħala mudell. Maja: Tajjeb, issa naf kif nibda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a sample letter I can follow? Mark: Yes, you can use this one as a model. Maja: Great, now I know how to start.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有可以让我参照的书信范例吗？马克：有，你可以把这一封当作范例。玛雅：好，现在我知道怎么开头了。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek mudell ta' ittra li nista' nsegwi?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek mudell ta' ittra li nista' nsegwi?
messages.zh: 你有可以让我参照的书信范例吗？
messages.en: Do you have a sample letter I can follow?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tuża din bħala mudell.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tuża din bħala mudell.
messages.zh: 有，你可以把这一封当作范例。
messages.en: Yes, you can use this one as a model.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, issa naf kif nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, issa naf kif nibda.
messages.zh: 好，现在我知道怎么开头了。
messages.en: Great, now I know how to start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mudell 放进三个画面：衡量质量的标准、照着写的范例、桌上的建筑模型；用场景区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A model representing a grid considered individually.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将某一个网格作为独立对象加以表示的模型。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mudell li jirrappreżenta grilja waħda meqjusa separatament minn grilji oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个体网格模型，即单独表示某一个网格的模型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni ta' grilja individwali li tittratta dik il-grilja separatament minn oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An individual grid model represents one grid considered separately from other grids.

collocations.en: to create an individual grid model
to examine an individual grid model

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta mudell ta' grilja individwali għal kull grilja eżaminata.
formal.en: The report presents an individual grid model for each grid examined.
formal.zh: 报告为每一个接受考察的网格分别呈现一个个体网格模型。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A model representing a grid shared by multiple users or cases.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示由多个使用者或多个情形共用的网格的模型。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共用网格模型，即表示共同使用的网格的模型。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rappreżentazzjoni ta' grilja li tkun komuni għal diversi utenti jew każijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A common grid model represents a grid shared by several users or cases.

collocations.en: to create a common grid model
to use a common grid model

formal.en: The document describes a common grid model that serves as a reference for all the groups.
formal.zh: 该文件描述了一个共用网格模型，供所有小组参照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The soft tissue found inside bones.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于骨骼内部的柔软组织，即骨髓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tessut artab li jinsab ġewwa l-għadam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骨髓，骨骼内部的柔软组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tessut artab li jinsab fil-parti ta' ġewwa tal-għadam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Marrow is the soft tissue found inside bones.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-mudullun ġewwa l-għadma waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The students observed the marrow inside the bone during the lesson.
formal.zh: 学生们在课堂上观察了骨头内部的骨髓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm ġewwa din l-għadma? Pawlu: Dak hu l-mudullun.

colloquial.zh: Maja：这根骨头里面是什么？Pawlu：那是骨髓。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm ġewwa din l-għadma?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm ġewwa din l-għadma?

messages.en: What's inside this bone?

messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu l-mudullun.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu l-mudullun.
messages.zh: 那是骨髓。
messages.en: That's the marrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把骨头想成外硬内软的小管，指着里面的柔软部分记 mudullun＝骨髓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An object used to lock or unlock a lock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于锁上或打开锁具的物件，即钥匙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jintuża biex jissakkar jew jinfetaħ serratura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钥匙，用于锁上或打开锁具的物件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li jidħol f'serratura u jintuża biex jissakkar jew jinfetaħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A key is an object you use to lock or unlock a lock.

formal.mt: Ir-residenti għandhom iħallu muftiħ żejjed għand persuna ta' fiduċja.
formal.en: Residents should leave a spare key with someone they trust.
formal.zh: 住户应将一把备用钥匙交给可信赖的人保管。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-muftiħ tal-bieb? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where's the door key? Mark: On the table, next to the phone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：门钥匙在哪里？Mark：在桌上，电话旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-muftiħ tal-bieb?

messages.en: Where's the door key?

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry recorded as Mughuh, without an identifiable meaning in the supplied material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给材料中标记为名词的条目 Mughuh；材料未提供可确定的词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom u miktuba 'Mughuh', li l-materjal mogħti ma jipprovdix tifsira ċara għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Mughuh；原释义仅重复这一形式，无法据此确定中文含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma miktuba 'Mughuh' li terġa' tidher bħala d-definizzjoni tagħha stess, mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira fil-materjal mogħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mughuh is listed as a noun, but its meaning is not explained in the supplied material.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Mughuh' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-materjal mogħti ma jispjegax it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The entry 'Mughuh' is marked as a noun, but the supplied material does not explain its meaning.
formal.zh: “Mughuh”这一条目标记为名词，但所给材料并未解释它的含义。

colloquial.zh: Maja：“Mughuh”这个词是什么意思？Pawlu：我不知道；这里写了这个词，却没有解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unpleasant physical feeling of hurt or discomfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体感到痛或不适的感觉，即疼痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni fiżika spjaċevoli li fiha persuna tħoss uġigħ jew skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛，身体感受到的痛楚或不适。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' uġigħ jew skumdità fil-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pain is an unpleasant physical sensation in which part of your body hurts.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent talab serħan mill-mugughha waqt il-konsultazzjoni.
formal.en: The patient asked for relief from pain during the consultation.
formal.zh: 患者在问诊时提出希望缓解疼痛。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mullet is a type of marine fish.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种生活在海中的鱼，称为鲻鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mulett huwa tip ta' ħuta li tgħix fil-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鲻鱼，一种海生鱼类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mulett huwa ħuta tal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mullet is a fish that lives in the sea.

formal.zh: 菜单上有配蔬菜的烤鲻鱼。

colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是鲻鱼吗？托尼：是的，很新鲜。你要一条吗？

teaching_sense.en_definition: A moment is a very short period of time or a particular point in time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 很短的一段时间，或某个特定的时刻。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mument huwa żmien qasir ħafna jew punt partikolari fiż-żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一瞬间，极短的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mument huwa medda ta' żmien qasira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An instant is an extremely short period of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 片刻，或某个特定的时刻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mument huwa żmien qasir jew ħin partikolari li qed issir referenza għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A moment is a brief period or a particular point in time.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Mummy is an affectionate word used for a mother, especially when speaking to her.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对母亲的亲昵称呼，相当于“妈妈”，尤其用于直接称呼母亲。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mummy hija kelma ta' mħabba li tintuża għall-omm, speċjalment meta wieħed ikellimha direttament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妈妈，对母亲的亲昵称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mummy hija kelma li biha wieħed isejjaħ lil ommu b'affezzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use mummy as an affectionate way of referring to or addressing your mother.

formal.mt: Fit-tmiem tal-ittra, it-tifla kitbet: 'Inħobbok ħafna, mummy.'
formal.en: At the end of the letter, the girl wrote: 'I love you very much, mummy.'
formal.zh: 在信的结尾，小女孩写道：“我很爱你，妈妈。”

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mummy, tista' tgħinni? Marija: Iva, x'għandek bżonn? Nina: Ma nistax insib il-ktieb tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Mummy, can you help me? Marija: Yes, what do you need? Nina: I can't find my book.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：妈妈，你能帮帮我吗？玛丽亚：可以，你需要什么？妮娜：我找不到我的书了。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Mummy, tista' tgħinni?
messages.mt_standard: Mummy, tista' tgħinni?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, x'għandek bżonn?

gloss_zh: 辱骂他人智力的歧视性称呼（冒犯语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An offensive noun used to insult someone by disparaging their intelligence or implying intellectual disability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过贬低他人智力或暗指其有智力障碍来辱骂人的冒犯性名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom offensiv u diskriminatorju li jintuża biex wieħed jinsulta persuna billi jċekken l-intelliġenza tagħha jew jissuġġerixxi li għandha diżabilità intellettwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来辱骂他人智力的歧视性称呼，含有将智力障碍作为侮辱的意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insult diskriminatorju li bih persuna tiġi mċekkna minħabba l-intelliġenza tagħha jew titqabbel b'mod dispreġġjattiv ma' persuna b'diżabilità intellettwali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone uses this noun about another person, they are insulting that person's intelligence in a discriminatory way.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有歧视和侮辱意味的人称名词，用于贬损他人的智力；不是中性的描述用语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma offensiva għal persuna, użata biex tiddisprezza l-intelliġenza tagħha u li ġġorr tifsira diskriminatorja marbuta mad-diżabilità intellettwali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is an offensive label that demeans a person by associating them with supposed intellectual inferiority.

collocations.en: to insult someone by calling them 'munglu'
collocations.zh: 用 munglu 这个歧视性称呼辱骂某人
避免使用冒犯性词语 munglu

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni dwar ir-rispett, l-għalliema spjegat li 'munglu' hija kelma offensiva u diskriminatorja li m'għandhiex tintuża biex tiddeskrivi persuna.
formal.en: In the lesson about respect, the teacher explained that 'munglu' is an offensive and discriminatory word that should not be used to describe a person.
formal.zh: 在关于尊重他人的课上，老师解释说，munglu 是一个冒犯且带有歧视的词，不应当用来称呼他人。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'munglu' f'dan id-djalogu? Daniel: Hija kelma offensiva li tintuża bħala insult; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar xi ħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'munglu' mean in this dialogue? Daniel: It is an offensive word used as an insult; it is better not to use it about anyone.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这段对话里的 munglu 是什么意思？丹尼尔：它是一个用来骂人的冒犯性词语，最好不要用它称呼任何人。

messages.speaker: Nina (语言学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'munglu' f'dan id-djalogu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'munglu' f'dan id-djalogu?
messages.zh: 这段对话里的 munglu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'munglu' mean in this dialogue?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kelma offensiva li tintuża bħala insult; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar xi ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kelma offensiva li tintuża bħala insult; aħjar ma tużahiex dwar xi ħadd.
messages.zh: 它是一个用来骂人的冒犯性词语，最好不要用它称呼任何人。
messages.en: It is an offensive word used as an insult; it is better not to use it about anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 munglu 的词卡旁画一个红色停止标志，记成“听见要识别，称人要避免”；把歧视性辱骂的语气和词义一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The proper name of the German city known in English as Munich.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 德国城市慕尼黑的专有名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' belt fil-Ġermanja magħrufa bl-Ingliż bħala Munich.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慕尼黑，德国的一座城市；此处为城市专名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Munich huwa l-isem proprju ta' belt li tinsab fil-Ġermanja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Munich is the name of a city in Germany.

formal.mt: Skont il-programm taż-żjara, il-grupp se jasal Munich nhar it-Tnejn u joqgħod hemm għal tlett ijiem.
formal.en: According to the visit programme, the group will arrive in Munich on Monday and stay there for three days.
formal.zh: 根据访问行程，团队将于星期一抵达慕尼黑，并在那里停留三天。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza? Mark: Se mmur Munich u noqgħod hemm ma' ħabib.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I am going to Munich and staying there with a friend.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你要去哪里度假？马克：我要去慕尼黑，住在那里的一个朋友家。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se tmur għall-vaganza?
messages.zh: 你要去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur Munich u noqgħod hemm ma' ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur Munich u noqgħod hemm ma' ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去慕尼黑，住在那里的一个朋友家。
messages.en: I am going to Munich and staying there with a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张写着“Munich—慕尼黑”的旅行车票，把城市名与目的地绑定记忆；在句子里使用这个专名时，记住首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mountain or opening in the Earth's surface through which lava, ash, and gases can escape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地表上能喷出熔岩、火山灰和气体的山体或开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Muntanja jew fetħa fil-wiċċ tad-Dinja li minnha jistgħu joħorġu lava, rmied u gassijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火山；能从地下喷出熔岩、火山灰和气体的地表构造。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Munġbel huwa muntanja jew fetħa fl-art li minnha jistgħu joħorġu lava, rmied u gassijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A volcano is a mountain or opening in the ground through which lava, ash, and gases can escape.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-istudenti ddeskrivew munġbel attiv u spjegaw kif joħorġu minnu lava u rmied.
formal.en: In the report, the students described an active volcano and explained how lava and ash emerge from it.
formal.zh: 学生们在报告中描述了一座活火山，并解释了熔岩和火山灰如何从中喷出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak fid-disinn tiegħek? Pawlu: Dak munġbel, u l-aħmar huwa l-lava.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that in your drawing? Pawlu: That is a volcano, and the red part is the lava.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你画里的那个是什么？保罗：那是一座火山，红色的部分是熔岩。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak fid-disinn tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak fid-disinn tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你画里的那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in your drawing?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak munġbel, u l-aħmar huwa l-lava.
messages.mt_standard: Dak munġbel, u l-aħmar huwa l-lava.
messages.zh: 那是一座火山，红色的部分是熔岩。
messages.en: That is a volcano, and the red part is the lava.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 munġbel 写在一幅火山简笔画旁，再用红线画出熔岩；用整幅图记住“火山”的意思，不必自行拆解词根。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mountain or opening in the ground from which lava, ash, and gases may be released.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够释放熔岩、火山灰和气体的山体或地表开口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Muntanja jew fetħa fl-art li minnha jistgħu joħorġu lava, rmied u gassijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火山；地表上能够喷出熔岩、火山灰和气体的山体或开口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Munġbell huwa muntanja jew fetħa fil-wiċċ tad-Dinja li tista' titfa' lava, rmied u gassijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A volcano is a mountain or opening in the Earth's surface that can release lava, ash, and gases.

formal.mt: L-istampa fil-ktieb turi munġbell u tindika l-fetħa li minnha jistgħu joħorġu lava u gassijiet.
formal.en: The picture in the book shows a volcano and marks the opening through which lava and gases can escape.
formal.zh: 书中的图片展示了一座火山，并标出了熔岩和气体可能喷出的开口。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex pinġejt duħħan fuq dik il-muntanja? Ġorġ: Għax dak munġbell li qed joħroġ irmied.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you draw smoke above that mountain? Ġorġ: Because that is a volcano releasing ash.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你为什么在那座山上方画了烟？乔治：因为那是一座正在喷出火山灰的火山。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex pinġejt duħħan fuq dik il-muntanja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex pinġejt duħħan fuq dik il-muntanja?
messages.zh: 你为什么在那座山上方画了烟？
messages.en: Why did you draw smoke above that mountain?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dak munġbell li qed joħroġ irmied.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dak munġbell li qed joħroġ irmied.
messages.zh: 因为那是一座正在喷出火山灰的火山。
messages.en: Because that is a volcano releasing ash.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 munġbell 与“火山顶、火山灰、熔岩”三幅小图配对记忆；抄写时圈出词尾双写的 ll，帮助记准本词条的拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large picture painted directly on a wall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 直接绘制在墙面上的大型图画。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pittura kbira magħmula direttament fuq wiċċ ta' ħajt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壁画，即直接画在墙面上的图画。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mural huwa pittura magħmula direttament fuq ħajt, ħafna drabi biex iżżejjen post.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A mural is a picture painted directly on a wall, often covering a large area.

formal.mt: L-artisti ħolqu mural ikkulurit fuq il-ħajt tal-iskola biex juru xeni mill-ħajja tar-raħal.
formal.en: The artists created a colourful mural on the school wall to depict scenes from village life.
formal.zh: 艺术家们在学校墙面上创作了一幅色彩鲜艳的壁画，描绘村庄生活的场景。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Rajt il-mural il-ġdid ħdejn l-iskola? Pawlu: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna kif pinġew il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Have you seen the new mural near the school? Pawlu: Yes, I really like how they painted the sea.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你看到学校旁边那幅新壁画了吗？Pawlu：看到了，我很喜欢他们画的大海。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-mural il-ġdid ħdejn l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-mural il-ġdid ħdejn l-iskola?
messages.zh: 你看到学校旁边那幅新壁画了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the new mural near the school?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna kif pinġew il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jogħġobni ħafna kif pinġew il-baħar.
messages.zh: 看到了，我很喜欢他们画的大海。
messages.en: Yes, I really like how they painted the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mural 和校园整面墙上的彩色图画一起记：画直接画在墙上，就是壁画。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Were presented or displayed so that people could see them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某些事物被展示或出示，让人们能够看见。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġew ippreżentati jew esposti sabiex in-nies setgħu jarawhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被展示了，或被出示给别人看了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi affarijiet tqiegħdu quddiem in-nies jew ġew ippreżentati lilhom biex setgħu jarawhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If things were shown, they were presented or displayed for people to see.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, ir-ritratti kienu murija fuq skrin sabiex il-parteċipanti setgħu jaraw id-dettalji.
formal.en: During the meeting, the photographs were shown on a screen so that participants could see the details.
formal.zh: 会议期间，照片被展示在屏幕上，以便与会者看清细节。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn kienu murija r-ritratti tal-vjaġġ? Mark: Fuq l-iskrin il-kbir fis-sala.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where were the trip photographs shown? Mark: On the big screen in the hall.
colloquial.zh: Lara：旅行照片是在哪里展示的？Mark：在大厅的大屏幕上。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn kienu murija r-ritratti tal-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn kienu murija r-ritratti tal-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 旅行照片是在哪里展示的？
messages.en: Where were the trip photographs shown?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-iskrin il-kbir fis-sala.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-iskrin il-kbir fis-sala.
messages.zh: 在大厅的大屏幕上。
messages.en: On the big screen in the hall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用完整短语 kienu murija 记住“被展示了”：想象几张照片已经出现在大家面前的屏幕上。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Swollen veins in or around the anus or lower rectum.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肛门周围或直肠下部静脉肿胀形成的痔疮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vini minfuħin fl-anus, madwaru jew fil-parti t'isfel tar-rektum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 痔疮，指肛门周围或直肠下部肿胀的静脉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-murliti huma vini minfuħin fl-anus jew madwaru, jew fil-parti t'isfel tar-rektum, li jistgħu jikkawżaw skumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Piles are swollen veins in or around the anus or lower rectum that may cause discomfort.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega x'inhuma l-murliti u jiddeskrivi s-sintomi li jistgħu jkunu assoċjati magħhom.
formal.en: The leaflet explains what piles are and describes the symptoms that may be associated with them.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册解释了什么是痔疮，并介绍了可能伴随出现的症状。

colloquial.mt: Rita: F'dan il-fuljett hemm informazzjoni dwar il-murliti? Anna: Iva, hemm taqsima sħiħa dwarhom.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is there information about piles in this leaflet? Anna: Yes, there is a whole section about them.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这份宣传册里有关于痔疮的信息吗？Anna：有，里面有一整节介绍痔疮。

messages.speaker: Rita (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: F'dan il-fuljett hemm informazzjoni dwar il-murliti?
messages.mt_standard: F'dan il-fuljett hemm informazzjoni dwar il-murliti?
messages.zh: 这份宣传册里有关于痔疮的信息吗？
messages.en: Is there information about piles in this leaflet?

messages.speaker: Anna (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm taqsima sħiħa dwarhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm taqsima sħiħa dwarhom.
messages.zh: 有，里面有一整节介绍痔疮。
messages.en: Yes, there is a whole section about them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 murliti 放在诊所宣传册的情景中记忆：这里的英语 piles 指痔疮，联想到肛门周围的不适。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fireworks set off to produce bright effects or loud sounds during celebrations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 庆祝活动中燃放的烟花，能够产生明亮的视觉效果或响声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti tal-logħob tan-nar li jinħarqu waqt ċelebrazzjonijiet biex jipproduċu dawl jew ħsejjes qawwija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟花、焰火，指庆祝时燃放、产生光彩或响声的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-murtali huma oġġetti tal-logħob tan-nar li jintużaw fiċ-ċelebrazzjonijiet u jipproduċu dawl jew ħsejjes qawwija meta jinħarqu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Fireworks are objects set off during celebrations to produce bright displays or loud sounds.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa jindika li l-ħruq tal-murtali jibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The festival programme states that the fireworks will be set off starting at nine in the evening.
formal.zh: 节庆活动安排写明，烟花将于晚上九点开始燃放。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Smajt il-murtali lbieraħ filgħaxija? Pawlu: Iva, u rajthom mit-tieqa wkoll!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you hear the fireworks last night? Pawlu: Yes, and I saw them from the window too!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你昨晚听到烟花声了吗？Pawlu：听到了，我还从窗户看到了烟花！

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt il-murtali lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt il-murtali lbieraħ filgħaxija?
messages.zh: 你昨晚听到烟花声了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear the fireworks last night?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u rajthom mit-tieqa wkoll!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u rajthom mit-tieqa wkoll!
messages.zh: 听到了，我还从窗户看到了烟花！
messages.en: Yes, and I saw them from the window too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 murtali 和节庆夜空连在一起记：耳边传来响声，窗外绽放烟花，同时记住听觉与视觉场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A body part made of tissue that contracts to produce movement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由能够收缩的组织构成、帮助身体或身体部位运动的肌肉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti tal-ġisem magħmula minn tessut li jinġibed biex iċaqlaq il-ġisem jew parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肌肉；能够通过收缩产生运动的身体组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Muskolu huwa parti tal-ġisem magħmula minn tessut li jista' jinġibed u b'hekk joħloq moviment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A muscle is a part of your body that contracts to help you move.

formal.mt: Dan l-eżerċizzju jsaħħaħ il-muskolu tad-driegħ li jidher fl-istampa.
formal.en: This exercise strengthens the arm muscle shown in the picture.
formal.zh: 这个练习能够增强图片中所示的手臂肌肉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ara kif jidher dan il-muskolu meta ngħawweġ driegħi! Lara: Iva, issa jidher sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Look how this muscle shows when I bend my arm! Lara: Yes, you can see it clearly now.
colloquial.zh: 马克：看，我弯起手臂时，这块肌肉就显出来了！拉拉：对，现在看得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kif jidher dan il-muskolu meta ngħawweġ driegħi!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kif jidher dan il-muskolu meta ngħawweġ driegħi!
messages.zh: 看，我弯起手臂时，这块肌肉就显出来了！
messages.en: Look how this muscle shows when I bend my arm!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jidher sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jidher sew.
messages.zh: 对，现在看得很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, you can see it clearly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 muskolu 和弯起手臂时鼓起的一块肌肉联系起来，再用 muskolu tad-driegħ 记住“手臂肌肉”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dried aromatic flower bud used as a spice in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作烹饪香料的干燥丁香花蕾，通常指完整的一粒丁香。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Blanzun imnixxef u aromatiku tal-qronfol li jintuża bħala ħwawar fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 丁香；用作香料的干燥丁香花蕾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Musmar tal-qronfol huwa blanzun imnixxef b'riħa u togħma qawwija li jintuża biex jagħti t-togħma lill-ikel u lix-xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clove is a dried flower bud used to give food or drinks a strong, aromatic flavour.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob li jiżdied musmar tal-qronfol mal-ħalib waqt li jkun qed jisħon.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a clove to be added to the milk while it is heating.
formal.zh: 食谱要求在牛奶加热时加入一粒丁香。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Inżid musmar tal-qronfol mat-te? Pawlu: Iva, wieħed biss, għax it-togħma tiegħu qawwija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall I add a clove to the tea? Pawlu: Yes, just one, because it has a strong flavour.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：要不要在茶里加一粒丁香？保罗：好，只加一粒，它的味道很浓。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Inżid musmar tal-qronfol mat-te?
messages.mt_standard: Inżid musmar tal-qronfol mat-te?
messages.zh: 要不要在茶里加一粒丁香？
messages.en: Shall I add a clove to the tea?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wieħed biss, għax it-togħma tiegħu qawwija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wieħed biss, għax it-togħma tiegħu qawwija.
messages.zh: 好，只加一粒，它的味道很浓。
messages.en: Yes, just one, because it has a strong flavour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象往热茶里放入一粒完整丁香，一边闻香一边记住整个词组 musmar tal-qronfol，避免只记其中一部分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condiment made from mustard seeds, often served with meat or in sandwiches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以芥菜籽制成的调味酱，常搭配肉类或涂在三明治中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kondiment magħmul miż-żrieragħ tal-mustarda, li spiss jittiekel mal-laħam jew jintuża fis-sandwiches.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芥末酱；以芥菜籽制成、带有辛辣风味的调味酱。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mustarda hija zalza magħmula miż-żrieragħ tal-pjanta tal-mustarda u tintuża biex tagħti togħma pikkanti lill-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mustard is a condiment made from mustard seeds that adds a sharp flavour to food.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara z-zalza, ħallat kuċċarina mustarda ma' żewġ imgħaref żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: To prepare the sauce, mix a teaspoon of mustard with two tablespoons of olive oil.
formal.zh: 制作这款酱汁时，将一茶匙芥末酱与两汤匙橄榄油混合。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid il-mustarda fis-sandwich tiegħek? Mark: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like mustard in your sandwich? Mark: Yes, but just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的三明治里要加芥末酱吗？马克：要，不过请只加一点。

messages.speaker: Anna (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid il-mustarda fis-sandwich tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Trid il-mustarda fis-sandwich tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的三明治里要加芥末酱吗？
messages.en: Would you like mustard in your sandwich?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，不过请只加一点。
messages.en: Yes, but just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mustarda 和英文 mustard 对照记忆，再想象三明治里抹上一点芥末酱，用点餐场景巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 大人物；某领域的顶尖人物或自命高手

teaching_sense.en_definition: An important or influential person, or someone who is or claims to be highly accomplished in a particular field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有地位、有影响力的大人物，也可指某个领域的顶尖人物或自称高手的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna importanti jew influwenti, jew xi ħadd li hu kapaċi ħafna f'qasam partikolari jew jippretendi li hu fost l-aqwa fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大人物；具有较高地位或较大影响力的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mustaċċun huwa persuna ta' importanza jew ta' influwenza kbira f'organizzazzjoni jew fis-soċjetà.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call someone a bigwig, you mean that they hold an important or influential position.

sense_translations.en_definition: someone who is or purports to be at the top of their game
sense_translations.zh_definition: 某领域的顶尖人物，或自称在该领域处于顶尖水平的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mustaċċun huwa xi ħadd li hu fost l-aqwa fil-qasam tiegħu, jew li jippreżenta lilu nnifsu bħallikieku hu fost l-aqwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You can use this word for someone who excels in their field or claims to do so.

collocations.en: to consider himself a leading expert

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lid-direttur bħala mustaċċun fid-dinja tan-negozju minħabba l-influwenza tiegħu.
formal.en: The report describes the director as a bigwig in the business world because of his influence.
formal.zh: 报告因这位董事的影响力而将他描述为商界大人物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark jgħid li hu mustaċċun fil-futbol. Pawlu: Mela narawh jilgħab qabel nemmnuh!
colloquial.en: Lara: Mark says he is a top football player. Pawlu: Then let's watch him play before we believe him!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克说自己是足球高手。保罗：那先看看他踢得怎么样，再相信他吧！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark jgħid li hu mustaċċun fil-futbol.
messages.mt_standard: Mark jgħid li hu mustaċċun fil-futbol.
messages.zh: 马克说自己是足球高手。
messages.en: Mark says he is a top football player.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela narawh jilgħab qabel nemmnuh!
messages.mt_standard: Mela narawh jilgħab qabel nemmnuh!
messages.zh: 那先看看他踢得怎么样，再相信他吧！
messages.en: Then let's watch him play before we believe him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 mustaċċun 配两幅记忆画面：一位有影响力的大人物，以及一位声称自己最厉害的球员；结合语境判断是实力还是自夸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A motor or engine that powers a machine or vehicle; the word can also refer to a motorbike.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为机器或车辆提供动力的马达或发动机；也可指摩托车，具体含义须结合语境判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jipprovdi l-qawwa biex taħdem magna jew timxi vettura; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għal motoċikletta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马达；将能量转化为机械运动、驱动设备运转的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jibdel l-enerġija f'moviment mekkaniku biex iħaddem tagħmir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A motor is a device that produces mechanical movement to operate equipment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发动机；为车辆或其他机器提供动力的机械装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Magna li tipproduċi l-qawwa meħtieġa biex taħdem vettura jew magna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An engine is a machine that supplies power to a vehicle or other machinery.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摩托车；由发动机驱动的两轮机动车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura b'żewġ roti li titħaddem b'magna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A motorbike is a vehicle with two wheels that is powered by an engine.

formal.mt: It-tekniku eżamina l-mutur elettriku qabel ma reġa' ħaddem it-tagħmir.
formal.en: The technician examined the electric motor before restarting the equipment.
formal.zh: 技术员检查了电动马达，然后重新启动设备。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum ġejt bil-mutur? Mark: Iva, imma ħallejt l-elmu fil-garaxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you come by motorbike today? Mark: Yes, but I left my helmet in the garage.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天骑摩托车来的？马克：是啊，不过我把头盔留在车库里了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum ġejt bil-mutur?
messages.mt_standard: Illum ġejt bil-mutur?
messages.zh: 你今天骑摩托车来的？
messages.en: Did you come by motorbike today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ħallejt l-elmu fil-garaxx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ħallejt l-elmu fil-garaxx.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过我把头盔留在车库里了。
messages.en: Yes, but I left my helmet in the garage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mutur 放进三个画面记忆：设备里的马达、汽车里的发动机、路上骑的摩托车；看到电力、汽车或头盔等语境线索，再选择对应词义。

gloss_zh: 优质借款人；信用资质上佳的借款人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A borrower regarded as having very strong creditworthiness and a reliable ability to repay a loan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信用资质和偿还贷款能力受到高度评价的优质借款人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef u titqies li għandha affidabbiltà finanzjarja għolja u kapaċità soda li tħallas lura s-self.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一流借款人；信用资质和偿债能力均处于很高水平的借款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef u għandha livell għoli ħafna ta' affidabbiltà finanzjarja u kapaċità li tħallas lura s-self.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A first class borrower is someone whose creditworthiness and repayment capacity are considered excellent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优质借款人；财务状况和还款可靠性受到良好评价的借款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef u titqies finanzjarjament soda u affidabbli fil-ħlas lura tas-self.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A high quality borrower is a person or organization considered financially sound and reliable in repaying loans.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 顶尖借款人；在信用资质方面被视为最优一类的借款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef u titqies fost l-aħjar minħabba l-affidabbiltà finanzjarja tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A premier borrower is a borrower regarded as belonging among the strongest in creditworthiness.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 优质借款人；具有很强信用资质、被认为违约风险较低的借款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef, għandha affidabbiltà finanzjarja għolja u titqies li għandha riskju baxx li ma tħallasx lura s-self.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prime borrower is someone with strong creditworthiness who is considered unlikely to default on a loan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最高等级的借款人；信用资质被评为很高等级的借款人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tissellef u tingħata klassifikazzjoni għolja ħafna għall-affidabbiltà finanzjarja tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A top grade borrower is a borrower assessed as having a very high level of creditworthiness.

collocations.en: to be regarded as a prime borrower
a loan to a prime borrower
collocations.zh: 向优质借款人发放的贷款

collocations.en: the creditworthiness of a prime borrower
collocations.zh: 优质借款人的信用资质

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lill-applikant bħala mutwatajru prim minħabba d-dħul stabbli tiegħu u r-rekord tajjeb ta' ħlas.
formal.en: The report describes the applicant as a prime borrower because of his stable income and good payment record.
formal.zh: 报告指出，申请人收入稳定、还款记录良好，因此属于优质借款人。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi jfisser mutwatajru prim? Sara: Xi ħadd li jislef il-flus ikun iqisu affidabbli ħafna biex iħallas lura s-self.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does prime borrower mean? Sara: It means someone a lender considers very reliable when it comes to repaying a loan.
colloquial.zh: 马克：优质借款人是什么意思？萨拉：就是放贷方认为还款非常可靠的人。

messages.speaker: Mark (贷款申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser mutwatajru prim?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser mutwatajru prim?
messages.zh: 优质借款人是什么意思？
messages.en: What does prime borrower mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd li jislef il-flus ikun iqisu affidabbli ħafna biex iħallas lura s-self.
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd li jislef il-flus ikun iqisu affidabbli ħafna biex iħallas lura s-self.
messages.zh: 就是放贷方认为还款非常可靠的人。
messages.en: It means someone a lender considers very reliable when it comes to repaying a loan.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成贷款档案上的“优质借款人”标签，联想稳定收入、良好还款记录和较强偿债能力；重点记住评价对象是借款人。

gloss_zh: 可向外窥看而不被看见的窗

teaching_sense.en_definition: A window that allows someone inside to look outside without being seen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种使室内的人能够向外观察，同时不被外面的人看见的窗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieqa li tippermetti lil min ikun ġewwa jħares lejn barra mingħajr ma jidher minn barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: window to peep outside without being seen
sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人在室内向外窥看、同时遮蔽自身不被外面的人看见的窗。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tieqa li minnha persuna tista' tittawwal lejn barra mingħajr ma jarawha n-nies li jkunu barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A muxrabija is a window through which someone can look outside while remaining unseen.

collocations.zh: 透过隐蔽窥望窗向外看

collocations.en: to see the street through a muxrabija
collocations.zh: 透过隐蔽窥望窗观察街道

formal.mt: Il-muxrabija tippermetti lil min ikun fil-kamra josserva t-triq mingħajr ma jidher minn barra.
formal.en: The muxrabija allows someone in the room to observe the street without being seen from outside.
formal.zh: 这扇窥望窗使房间里的人能够观察街道，同时不被外面的人看见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Minn din it-tieqa nista' nara min hemm barra mingħajr ma jarawni? Pawlu: Iva, din muxrabija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I see who is outside through this window without being seen? Pawlu: Yes, this is a muxrabija.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我能透过这扇窗看到外面的人，又不让他们看见我吗？保罗：能，这就是一种隐蔽窥望窗。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn din it-tieqa nista' nara min hemm barra mingħajr ma jarawni?
messages.mt_standard: Minn din it-tieqa nista' nara min hemm barra mingħajr ma jarawni?
messages.zh: 我能透过这扇窗看到外面的人，又不让他们看见我吗？
messages.en: Can I see who is outside through this window without being seen?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din muxrabija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din muxrabija.
messages.zh: 能，这就是一种隐蔽窥望窗。
messages.en: Yes, this is a muxrabija.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我看得到外面，外面看不到我”的窗边画面记住 muxrabija；把窗的用途与整词绑定，不必假设它的构造或词源。

gloss_zh: 迟的；延迟的；晚于预定时间的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening or occurring later than the expected or scheduled time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生或进行的时间晚于预期或预定时间的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew isir aktar tard mill-ħin mistenni jew stabbilit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟的；延迟的；发生时间晚于预期或规定时间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jseħħx fil-ħin mistenni jew stabbilit, iżda aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is late happens after the time when it was expected or scheduled.

formal.mt: Il-ħlas mwaħħar wassal għal dewmien fl-ipproċessar tal-ordni.
formal.en: The late payment caused a delay in processing the order.
formal.zh: 付款延迟导致订单处理推迟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għadna hawn? Pawlu: It-tluq illum hu mwaħħar; se nitilqu nofs siegħa wara l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we still here? Pawlu: Today's departure is late; we will leave half an hour behind schedule.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们怎么还在这里？保罗：今天出发延迟了，我们会比预定时间晚半小时走。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadna hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadna hawn?
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在这里？
messages.en: Why are we still here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tluq illum hu mwaħħar; se nitilqu nofs siegħa wara l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: It-tluq illum hu mwaħħar; se nitilqu nofs siegħa wara l-ħin.
messages.zh: 今天出发延迟了，我们会比预定时间晚半小时走。
messages.en: Today's departure is late; we will leave half an hour behind schedule.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象时间表上原定八点出发，时钟到了八点半才动身，用这段超出预定时间的空档记住 mwaħħar 表示“迟了、延迟的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small table used for placing objects or carrying out simple activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尺寸较小的桌子，可用来放置物品或进行简单活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mejda żgħira li tintuża biex jitqiegħdu affarijiet fuqha jew isiru attivitajiet sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小桌子；体积较小、可供摆放物品的桌子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mejda ta' daqs żgħir li fuqha jistgħu jitqiegħdu oġġetti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small table is a piece of furniture with a limited surface area on which you can place things.

collocations.en: a small table beside the window

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tal-qari tqiegħdet mwejda ħdejn it-tieqa biex il-qarrejja jkunu jistgħu jpoġġu l-kotba fuqha.
formal.en: A small table was placed beside the window in the reading room so that readers could put their books on it.
formal.zh: 阅览室的窗边放置了一张小桌子，供读者摆放书籍。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi t-tazza? Lara: Poġġiha fuq il-mwejda ħdejn is-sufan.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put the cup? Lara: Put it on the small table beside the sofa.
colloquial.zh: Maja：杯子放在哪里？Lara：放在沙发旁边的小桌子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi t-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi t-tazza?
messages.zh: 杯子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put the cup?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fuq il-mwejda ħdejn is-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fuq il-mwejda ħdejn is-sufan.
messages.zh: 放在沙发旁边的小桌子上。
messages.en: Put it on the small table beside the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mwejda 和沙发旁只放得下一只杯子的小桌子联系起来，用具体画面记住“小桌子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Prevented from proceeding easily or making progress because of an obstacle or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因障碍或困难而无法顺利进行或取得进展。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imfixkla minn ostaklu jew diffikultà li ma jħallihiex timxi 'l quddiem faċilment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到妨碍或阻挠，因而难以顺利行动或推进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imfixkla jew miżmuma lura minn xi ħaġa li tagħmel l-azzjoni jew il-progress aktar diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an activity is hindered, something makes it more difficult for that activity to continue or progress.

formal.mt: Il-ħidma kienet mwergħa min-nuqqas ta' materjal, u għalhekk it-tlestija tal-proġett ħadet aktar żmien.
formal.en: The work was hindered by a shortage of materials, so completing the project took longer.
formal.zh: 工作因材料短缺而受阻，因此项目的完成耗费了更长时间。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex domtu daqshekk fil-mixja? Rita: Il-mixja kienet mwergħa mit-tajn, u kellna nimxu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did your walk take so long? Rita: The walk was hindered by mud, and we had to walk slowly.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们怎么走了这么久？Rita：路上泥泞，行走受阻，我们只好慢慢走。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex domtu daqshekk fil-mixja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex domtu daqshekk fil-mixja?
messages.zh: 你们怎么走了这么久？
messages.en: Why did your walk take so long?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mixja kienet mwergħa mit-tajn, u kellna nimxu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mixja kienet mwergħa mit-tajn, u kellna nimxu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 路上泥泞，行走受阻，我们只好慢慢走。
messages.en: The walk was hindered by mud, and we had to walk slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 mwergħa 时想象前路被泥泞挡住，事情只能缓慢推进；把“有障碍、进展受阻”作为核心画面。

gloss_zh: 被承诺的；已答应给予的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Said to be something that someone will give or do, with a commitment to fulfil it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经有人作出承诺，表示将给予某物或完成某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li dwarha xi ħadd ta kelmtu li se jagħtiha jew iwettaqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被承诺给予、提供或完成。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd intrabat bil-kelma li jagħtiha, jipprovdiha jew iwettaqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something has been promised, someone has given their word that they will provide it or make it happen.

formal.mt: L-għajnuna mwiegħda għandha tasal qabel tmiem ix-xahar sabiex il-familji jkunu jistgħu jħallsu l-ispejjeż essenzjali.
formal.en: The promised assistance should arrive before the end of the month so that the families can pay their essential expenses.
formal.zh: 已承诺提供的援助应于月底前到位，以便这些家庭支付基本开支。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Waslet l-għajnuna mwiegħda? Maja: Iva, waslet dalgħodu, u issa nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the promised help arrived? Maja: Yes, it arrived this morning, and now we can start the work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：答应给我们的帮助到位了吗？Maja：到了，今天早上到的，现在我们可以开始干活了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet l-għajnuna mwiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet l-għajnuna mwiegħda?
messages.zh: 答应给我们的帮助到位了吗？
messages.en: Has the promised help arrived?

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet dalgħodu, u issa nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet dalgħodu, u issa nistgħu nibdew ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的，现在我们可以开始干活了。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning, and now we can start the work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 mwiegħda 放进“已承诺的援助”这个场景：先有人答应，再等待兑现；承诺本身不表示已经交付。

gloss_zh: 受到劝告或警告；被提醒注意

teaching_sense.en_definition: Given advice or a warning to take care, avoid danger, or act appropriately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到劝告、提醒或警告，以便谨慎行事、避免危险或采取适当行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ngħatat parir jew twissija biex toqgħod attenta, tevita periklu jew taġixxi kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到劝告或告诫，被提醒应当注意某事或避免某种行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li xi ħadd taha parir jew ġibdilha l-attenzjoni għal xi ħaġa li għandha tagħmel jew tevita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is advised or cautioned, they are given guidance about what to do or what to avoid.

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanta ġiet mwissija biex taqra l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sigurtà qabel tuża t-tagħmir.
formal.en: The participant was advised to read the safety instructions before using the equipment.
formal.zh: 这位女性参与者被告诫，在使用设备前应阅读安全说明。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod? Rita: Ġejt mwissija li l-art tiżloq, allura qed noqgħod attenta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why are you walking so slowly? Rita: I was warned that the floor is slippery, so I am being careful.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你怎么走得这么慢？Rita：有人提醒我地面很滑，所以我正小心走。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed timxi daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 你怎么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are you walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġejt mwissija li l-art tiżloq, allura qed noqgħod attenta.
messages.mt_standard: Ġejt mwissija li l-art tiżloq, allura qed noqgħod attenta.
messages.zh: 有人提醒我地面很滑，所以我正小心走。
messages.en: I was warned that the floor is slippery, so I am being careful.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“有人提醒我地滑，我便小心走”的场景记 mwissija，把收到劝告或警告与随后谨慎行动联系起来。

gloss_zh: 份额；分享（具体词性和用法未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A form associated with a share or with sharing, whose precise grammatical function is unspecified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与“份额”或“分享”相关的词形；具体语法功能尚未明确，学习时应保留这一不确定性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma marbuta ma' sehem jew mal-qsim ta' xi ħaġa, li l-funzjoni grammatikali preċiża tagħha mhijiex speċifikata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 份额；分享。此处未明确区分名词或动词用法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sehem minn xi ħaġa jew l-att li taqsam xi ħaġa ma' ħaddieħor; il-kategorija grammatikali hawnhekk mhijiex speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gloss may refer to a portion or to sharing something, but the grammatical use remains unspecified.

collocations.en: the use of 'mxerda' in a sentence

formal.mt: Meta tistudja l-forma 'mxerda', żomm separati l-kunċett ta' sehem u l-azzjoni tal-qsim sakemm il-funzjoni grammatikali tkun ċara.
formal.en: When studying the form 'mxerda', keep the concept of a share separate from the action of sharing until its grammatical function is clear.
formal.zh: 学习词形“mxerda”时，在明确其语法功能之前，应区分“份额”这一概念与“分享”这一动作。

colloquial.mt: Lina: 'Mx erda' niktibha bħala kelma waħda, 'mxerda'? Pawlu: Iva, il-forma hija 'mxerda'; iżda għad irridu niċċaraw kif tintuża.
colloquial.en: Lina: Should I write 'mx erda' as one word, 'mxerda'? Pawlu: Yes, the form is 'mxerda', but we still need to clarify how it is used.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：我应该把“mx erda”连写成一个词“mxerda”吗？保罗：是的，词形是“mxerda”，不过我们还需要明确它的用法。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Mx erda' niktibha bħala kelma waħda, 'mxerda'?
messages.mt_standard: 'Mx erda' niktibha bħala kelma waħda, 'mxerda'?
messages.zh: 我应该把“mx erda”连写成一个词“mxerda”吗？
messages.en: Should I write 'mx erda' as one word, 'mxerda'?
