messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-forma hija 'mxerda'; iżda għad irridu niċċaraw kif tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-forma hija 'mxerda'; iżda għad irridu niċċaraw kif tintuża.
messages.zh: 是的，词形是“mxerda”，不过我们还需要明确它的用法。
messages.en: Yes, the form is 'mxerda', but we still need to clarify how it is used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡分成“份额”和“分享”两格，并加上词性问号；这是帮助保留歧义的学习方法，不是构词分析。

gloss_zh: 英语（动词标签，动作义未明确）；nabbin（专名标签，所指未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb-labelled form associated with English, without a specified action meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标作动词并与“英语”对应的词形；其表示的具体动作未明确，不能据此直接解释为“说英语”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma mmarkata bħala verb u marbuta mal-Ingliż, mingħajr tifsira speċifika tal-azzjoni li tindika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英语；此义项标作动词，但未说明具体表示何种动作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-Ingliż huwa t-tifsira assoċjata ma' din il-forma mmarkata bħala verb, iżda l-azzjoni tagħha mhijiex speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb-labelled sense is associated with English, although the particular action it expresses is not specified.

sense_translations.zh_definition: nabbin；作为专名标签保留，具体所指未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju bit-tikketta 'nabbin', li l-persuna, il-post jew l-entità li jirreferi għalihom mhumiex speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This proper-name sense carries the label 'nabbin', but its particular referent has not been identified.

collocations.en: the entry for 'nabbinaw' as a proper name

formal.mt: Fl-istudju ta' 'nabbinaw', l-entrata verbali għandha tinżamm separata mill-entrata tal-isem proprju, għax dawn għandhom kategoriji grammatikali differenti.
formal.en: When studying 'nabbinaw', the verb entry should be kept separate from the proper-name entry because they belong to different grammatical categories.
formal.zh: 学习“nabbinaw”时，应将动词义项与专名义项分开，因为两者属于不同的语法类别。

colloquial.mt: Sara: 'Nabbinaw' tfisser li nitkellmu bl-Ingliż? Mark: Ma nistgħux ngħidu hekk mingħajr tifsira aktar ċara; hemm ukoll entrata separata bħala isem proprju.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does 'nabbinaw' mean that we speak English? Mark: We cannot say that without a clearer definition; there is also a separate proper-name entry.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：“nabbinaw”表示我们说英语吗？马克：没有更明确的释义，还不能这样判断；另外还有一个独立的专名义项。

messages.mt_standard: 'Nabbinaw' tfisser li nitkellmu bl-Ingliż?

messages.en: Does 'nabbinaw' mean that we speak English?

messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux ngħidu hekk mingħajr tifsira aktar ċara; hemm ukoll entrata separata bħala isem proprju.

messages.en: We cannot say that without a clearer definition; there is also a separate proper-name entry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 制作两张同形词卡：动词卡写“English，动作待明确”，专名卡写“nabbin，所指待明确”，避免混合记忆。

gloss_zh: 用铲勺舀除；用铲勺清理

teaching_sense.en_definition: To gather and remove material with a scoop or a similar utensil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用铲勺或类似工具把材料舀起并移走，以清理某处或某个容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġbor u tneħħi materjal minn post jew minn reċipjent permezz ta' sassla jew għodda simili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用铲勺等工具舀起并移除材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħolli u tneħħi materjal b'sassla, billi ddaħħalha taħtu u tiġbru fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you scoop material out of a container, you lift and remove it with a scoop or a similar utensil.

collocations.en: scoop out the contents of the bucket
collocations.zh: 用铲勺舀出桶里的东西
用铲勺清理撒出来的沙子

formal.mt: Naddaf bis-sassla r-ramel li waqa' ħdejn il-bieb, u poġġih fil-barmil.
formal.en: Scoop up the sand that fell beside the door and put it in the bucket.
formal.zh: 用铲勺把掉在门旁的沙子铲起来，放进桶里。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Kif inneħħi r-ramel kollu minn dan il-barmil? Rita: Naddaf bis-sassla, ftit ftit, u poġġi r-ramel fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Luca: How do I remove all the sand from this bucket? Rita: Scoop it out a little at a time and put the sand in the box.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：这个桶里的沙子要怎么全部弄出来？丽塔：用铲勺一点点舀出来，把沙子放进箱子里。

messages.speaker: Luca (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inneħħi r-ramel kollu minn dan il-barmil?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inneħħi r-ramel kollu minn dan il-barmil?
messages.zh: 这个桶里的沙子要怎么全部弄出来？
messages.en: How do I remove all the sand from this bucket?

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Naddaf bis-sassla, ftit ftit, u poġġi r-ramel fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Naddaf bis-sassla, ftit ftit, u poġġi r-ramel fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 用铲勺一点点舀出来，把沙子放进箱子里。
messages.en: Scoop it out a little at a time and put the sand in the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用小铲勺把桶里的沙子一勺勺清出去，将整个短语与“舀起并清除”的连续动作绑定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic plant whose leaves are used to flavour food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种叶片有清凉芳香的植物，其叶子可用于给食物和饮品调味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta b'weraq li għandu riħa friska u qawwija, u li jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel u lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄荷；叶片有清凉香气、可用于食品和饮品调味的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika msejħa nagħniegħ, li l-weraq tagħha jintuża fit-tisjir u f'xorb bħat-te.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mint is a plant with fresh-smelling leaves that people use to add flavour to food and drinks.

formal.mt: Aħsel il-weraq tan-nagħniegħ u żidu mat-te qabel ma sservih.
formal.en: Wash the mint leaves and add them to the tea before serving it.
formal.zh: 洗净薄荷叶，在上茶之前把它们加入茶中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit nagħniegħ fit-te? Toni: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Żidli żewġ werqiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some mint in your tea? Toni: Yes, please. Add two leaves for me.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你的茶里要放一点薄荷吗？托尼：要，谢谢。帮我加两片叶子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit nagħniegħ fit-te?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit nagħniegħ fit-te?
messages.zh: 你的茶里要放一点薄荷吗？

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡上的薄荷与“一杯茶、两片绿叶、清凉香气”连成画面，再配合朗读记住这个植物名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose lexical meaning has not been established.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词义尚未确定的名词词条；不能把“词义未知”当作这个词本身的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata ta' nom li t-tifsira lessikali tiegħu għadha mhijiex magħrufa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未知；这是对释义状态的说明，并非该词表示“不知道”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira tal-kelma għadha mhijiex magħrufa; dan ma jfissirx li l-kelma nnifisha tfisser li xi ħaġa mhijiex magħrufa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun has not been established, so it should not be assigned a specific lexical interpretation.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-kelma 'nagħar' għandha tibqa' mingħajr traduzzjoni speċifika sakemm tiġi ċċarata t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the word 'nagħar' should remain without a specific translation until its meaning is clarified.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，“nagħar”应暂不填写具体译义，直到其含义得到澄清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'nagħar'? Pawlu: Għadni ma nafx. Inħalli t-tifsira vojta sakemm insib spjegazzjoni ċara.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'nagħar' mean? Pawlu: I don't know yet. I'll leave the meaning blank until I find a clear explanation.
colloquial.zh: Maja：‘nagħar’是什么意思？Pawlu：我还不知道。我会先把词义留空，等找到清楚的解释再填。

messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'nagħar'?

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very large bird with a long neck and long legs that cannot fly but can run fast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鸵鸟，一种颈长、腿长、体型很大、不会飞但能快速奔跑的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir ħafna b'għonq twil u saqajn twal, li ma jistax itir iżda jista' jiġri malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸵鸟，一种体型很大、颈腿修长且不能飞翔的鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir ħafna li għandu għonq twil u saqajn twal u li jiġri minflok itir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ostrich is a very large flightless bird with a long neck and powerful legs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸵鸟，一种不会飞、长有长颈和长腿并善于奔跑的大型鸟类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur ta' daqs kbir ħafna, b'għonq twil u saqajn twal, li ma jtirx u jista' jiġri b'veloċità kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ostrich is a large bird that cannot fly but can move very quickly by running.

formal.mt: In-nagħma hija għasfur li ma jistax itir, iżda s-saqajn twal tagħha jgħinuha tiġri malajr.
formal.en: The ostrich is a bird that cannot fly, but its long legs help it run fast.
formal.zh: 鸵鸟是一种不会飞的鸟，但它的长腿有助于快速奔跑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik nagħma? Kemm għandha għonqha twil! Pawlu: Iva, u ara kemm għandha saqajha twal ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that an ostrich? What a long neck it has! Pawlu: Yes, and look how long its legs are too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那是鸵鸟吗？它的脖子好长啊！Pawlu：是啊，再看看它的腿，也很长。

messages.en: Is that an ostrich? What a long neck it has!

messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ara kemm għandha saqajha twal ukoll.

gloss_zh: 选择；词形的语法用法待核实

teaching_sense.en_definition: The idea of selecting one option from several possibilities, with the grammatical use of this headword left unverified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从多个可能项中选取一个的概念；本词条保留名词标签，但该拼写的具体语法用法尚待核实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-idea li tintgħażel ħaġa minn fost diversi possibbiltajiet; l-użu grammatikali ta' din il-forma għad irid jiġi vverifikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择，即从若干选项中选取一个；此处保留名词标签，不据此确认该词形可作普通名词使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-idea ta' għażla bejn żewġ affarijiet jew aktar, mingħajr ma jiġi kkonfermat li din il-forma tintuża bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This entry concerns selecting one option from several alternatives, while its grammatical use remains to be verified.

formal.mt: Il-karta tal-kelma 'nagħzel' turi l-idea ta' għażla bejn diversi possibbiltajiet; l-użu grammatikali tal-forma għandu jiġi vverifikat.
formal.en: The vocabulary card for 'nagħzel' illustrates the idea of choosing among several possibilities; the grammatical use of the form should be verified.
formal.zh: “nagħzel”的词汇卡展示了从多个可能项中进行选择的概念；该词形的语法用法需要核实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'niftakar meta nara 'nagħzel' fuq il-karta? Pawlu: Aħseb li qed tagħżel bejn żewġ affarijiet. Imbagħad niċċekkjaw kif tintuża l-forma.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I remember when I see 'nagħzel' on the card? Pawlu: Imagine choosing between two things. Then we'll check how the form is used.
colloquial.zh: Maja：在卡片上看到‘nagħzel’时，我该记住什么？Pawlu：想象自己正在两样东西之间做选择。然后我们再核实这个词形怎么用。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'niftakar meta nara 'nagħzel' fuq il-karta?
messages.mt_standard: X'niftakar meta nara 'nagħzel' fuq il-karta?
messages.zh: 在卡片上看到‘nagħzel’时，我该记住什么？
messages.en: What should I remember when I see 'nagħzel' on the card?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb li qed tagħżel bejn żewġ affarijiet. Imbagħad niċċekkjaw kif tintuża l-forma.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb li qed tagħżel bejn żewġ affarijiet. Imbagħad niċċekkjaw kif tintuża l-forma.
messages.zh: 想象自己正在两样东西之间做选择。然后我们再核实这个词形怎么用。
messages.en: Imagine choosing between two things. Then we'll check how the form is used.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 nagħzel 词卡旁画两个选项并给其中一个打勾，记住“选择”的概念；另加待核标记，提醒自己核实拼写和词性用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sheep considered as more than one animal, typically kept for wool, milk, or meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 绵羊的复数称呼，指多只通常为获取羊毛、奶或肉而饲养的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimali tar-razzett li għandhom is-suf u li jitrabbew għas-suf, għall-ħalib jew għal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绵羊，指多只身上长有羊毛的家畜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimali b'ġisimhom miksi bis-suf, li normalment jitrabbew fir-razzett għall-ħalib, għas-suf jew għal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Sheep are farm animals with woolly coats that are kept for their wool, milk, or meat.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara edukattiva fir-razzett, l-istudenti osservaw merħla nagħġiet jirgħu fl-għalqa.
formal.en: During the educational visit to the farm, the students observed a flock of sheep grazing in the field.
formal.zh: 在农场教学参观期间，学生们观察了一群在田里吃草的绵羊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hemm nagħġiet fl-għalqa! Pawlu: Iva, qed jirgħu. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how many sheep there are in the field! Pawlu: Yes, they're grazing. Let's watch them from here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看，田里有这么多绵羊！Pawlu：是啊，它们正在吃草。我们就在这里看吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm nagħġiet fl-għalqa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm nagħġiet fl-għalqa!
messages.zh: 看，田里有这么多绵羊！
messages.en: Look how many sheep there are in the field!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qed jirgħu. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qed jirgħu. Ejja narawhom minn hawn.
messages.zh: 是啊，它们正在吃草。我们就在这里看吧。
messages.en: Yes, they're grazing. Let's watch them from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 nagħġiet，就想象田里一群披着羊毛的绵羊；把整个词与“多只绵羊”这幅画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entertainment venue where people go at night to dance, listen to music, and have drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人们在夜间跳舞、听音乐和喝饮料的娱乐场所，即夜总会或夜店。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post ta' divertiment fejn in-nies imorru billejl biex jiżfnu, jisimgħu l-mużika u jixorbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜总会；夜店，主要在夜间提供音乐、跳舞和饮品的娱乐场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Najtklabb huwa post ta' divertiment li jiftaħ billejl u fejn in-nies jistgħu jiżfnu, jisimgħu l-mużika u jixorbu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nightclub is an entertainment venue where people gather at night to enjoy music, dancing, and drinks.

formal.mt: In-najtklabb jiftaħ fl-għaxra ta' filgħaxija u joffri mużika għaż-żfin sa tard billejl.
formal.en: The nightclub opens at ten in the evening and offers dance music until late at night.
formal.zh: 这家夜店晚上十点开门，播放舞曲直到深夜。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tmur fin-najtklabb wara l-ikel? Mark: Iva, għandi aptit niżfen ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go to the nightclub after dinner? Mark: Yes, I feel like dancing for a bit.
colloquial.zh: Lara：晚饭后想去夜店吗？Mark：想，我想跳一会儿舞。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tmur fin-najtklabb wara l-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tmur fin-najtklabb wara l-ikel?
messages.zh: 晚饭后想去夜店吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the nightclub after dinner?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi aptit niżfen ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi aptit niżfen ftit.
messages.zh: 想，我想跳一会儿舞。
messages.en: Yes, I feel like dancing for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 朗读 najtklabb 时联想英语 nightclub 的声音，再配上“夜间音乐响起、大家跳舞”的场景，记住它是场所名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something such as a door or window so that it is no longer open.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使门、窗等由打开的状态变为闭合状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tressaq bieb, tieqa jew xi ħaġa simili sabiex ma tibqax miftuħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关闭；合上，使原本打开的物体闭合。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-verb 'nalaq' ifisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa, bħal bieb jew tieqa, ma tibqax miftuħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you close something, you move it so that it is no longer open.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-vokabularju, il-frażi 'nalaq il-bieb' turi azzjoni li tagħmel il-bieb ma jibqax miftuħ.
formal.en: In the vocabulary exercise, the phrase 'nalaq il-bieb' illustrates an action that makes the door no longer open.
formal.zh: 在词汇练习中，短语 nalaq il-bieb 展示了使门由打开变为关闭的动作。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser 'nalaq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Ifisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa ma tibqax miftuħa, bħal meta tagħlaq tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'nalaq' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It means making something no longer open, as when you close a window.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这道练习里的 nalaq 是什么意思？Pawlu：就是使某样东西不再开着，比如把窗户关上。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'nalaq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'nalaq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的 nalaq 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nalaq' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa ma tibqax miftuħa, bħal meta tagħlaq tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li tagħmel xi ħaġa ma tibqax miftuħa, bħal meta tagħlaq tieqa.
messages.zh: 就是使某样东西不再开着，比如把窗户关上。
messages.en: It means making something no longer open, as when you close a window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“敞开的门慢慢合上”这个动作画面记 nalaq；把它和英语 close、中文“关闭”连在一起，突出由开到关的变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: I acknowledge that something is true or confess something I have done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我承认某事属实，或坦白自己做过的事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiena naċċetta li xi ħaġa hija vera jew nistqarr xi ħaġa li għamilt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我承认某个事实；我坦白自己的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiena ngħid li xi ħaġa hija vera, jew nistqarr dak li għamilt, anki jekk diffiċli għalija ngħidu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If I admit or confess something, I acknowledge that it is true or that I have done it.

collocations.en: I admit that I made a mistake

formal.mt: F'din id-dikjarazzjoni, nammetti li ma ċċekkjajtx id-dettalji kollha qabel bgħatt ir-rapport.
formal.en: In this statement, I admit that I did not check all the details before sending the report.
formal.zh: 在这份声明中，我承认自己在发送报告前没有核查所有细节。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Int kilt l-aħħar biċċa kejk? Mark: Iva, nammetti li kont jien. Marija: Mela d-darba li jmiss ħallili biċċa!
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you eat the last piece of cake? Mark: Yes, I admit it was me. Marija: Then leave me a piece next time!
colloquial.zh: Marija：最后一块蛋糕是你吃的吗？Mark：是的，我承认是我。Marija：那下次给我留一块！

messages.mt_standard: Int kilt l-aħħar biċċa kejk?
messages.zh: 最后一块蛋糕是你吃的吗？
messages.en: Did you eat the last piece of cake?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, nammetti li kont jien.

messages.mt_standard: Mela d-darba li jmiss ħallili biċċa!
messages.zh: 那下次给我留一块！
messages.en: Then leave me a piece next time!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nammetti li… 连同“我承认……”一起记，想象自己举手承认吃了最后一块蛋糕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic plant whose leaves are used to flavour food and drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 薄荷，一种叶片带有清凉香气、可用于食物和饮料调味的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta aromatika li l-weraq tagħha jintuża biex jagħti togħma lill-ikel u lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薄荷，叶片具有清凉香气、常用于调味的草本植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta b'weraq li għandu riħa friska u qawwija u li jintuża fit-tisjir jew fix-xorb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mint is a plant with fresh-smelling leaves that are used to flavour food and drinks.

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara din ix-xarba, żid ftit weraq tan-nanieh frisk mal-ilma sħun.
formal.en: To prepare this drink, add a few fresh mint leaves to the hot water.
formal.zh: 制作这款饮品时，在热水中加入几片新鲜薄荷叶。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid ftit nanieh fit-te? Marija: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma żid biss żewġ werqiet. Mark: Tajjeb, żewġ werqiet biss.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like some mint in your tea? Marija: Yes, please, but add only two leaves. Mark: All right, just two leaves.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你的茶里要加点薄荷吗？Marija：好的，谢谢，不过只加两片叶子。Mark：好，就两片。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit nanieh fit-te?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit nanieh fit-te?
messages.zh: 你的茶里要加点薄荷吗？
messages.en: Would you like some mint in your tea?

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma żid biss żewġ werqiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma żid biss żewġ werqiet.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过只加两片叶子。
messages.en: Yes, please, but add only two leaves.

messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, żewġ werqiet biss.
messages.zh: 好，就两片。
messages.en: All right, just two leaves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 nanieh 就想象两片薄荷叶落进热茶，把清凉香气与“薄荷”这个词义联系起来。

gloss_zh: 矮人；身材非常矮小的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very short person, or a small humanlike character in a fairy tale.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身材非常矮小的人，也指童话中身形矮小、具有人类外形的角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ta' statura baxxa ħafna, jew karattru fil-ħrejjef li jixbah bniedem żgħir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身材非常矮小的人；童话或幻想故事中的矮人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna baxxa ħafna fl-istatura, jew figura fil-ħrejjef li għandha sura ta' bniedem iżda hija żgħira ħafna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dwarf is a very short person or a small humanlike being described in fairy tales.

formal.mt: F'din il-ħrafa, nanu jgħin lit-tifel isib it-triq lura lejn id-dar.
formal.en: In this fairy tale, a dwarf helps the boy find his way back home.
formal.zh: 在这则童话中，一位矮人帮助男孩找到回家的路。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dan fil-ktieb? Pawlu: Dan nanu li jgħix fil-foresta. Lara: U għaliex għandu fanal? Pawlu: Biex jara t-triq fid-dlam.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is this in the book? Pawlu: This is a dwarf who lives in the forest. Lara: And why does he have a lantern? Pawlu: So he can see the path in the dark.
colloquial.zh: Lara：书里的这个是谁？Pawlu：这是一个住在森林里的矮人。Lara：那他为什么提着灯笼？Pawlu：这样他就能在黑暗中看清路。

messages.mt_standard: Min hu dan fil-ktieb?

messages.en: Who is this in the book?

messages.mt_standard: Dan nanu li jgħix fil-foresta.

messages.mt_standard: Biex jara t-triq fid-dlam.
messages.zh: 这样他就能在黑暗中看清路。
messages.en: So he can see the path in the dark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短短的 nanu 配上一幅童话插图：一个矮人提灯走进森林，用画面记住词义。

gloss_zh: 娜奥米（人名；条目写作 Naomi Bambin）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A personal name used here in the form Naomi Bambin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人名娜奥米，在本条目中以 Naomi Bambin 的形式出现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' persuna li f'din l-entrata jidher fil-forma Naomi Bambin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 娜奥米，人名；本条目的完整形式为 Naomi Bambin。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju ta' persuna, mogħti f'din l-entrata bħala Naomi Bambin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Naomi is a personal name, presented in this entry as Naomi Bambin.

collocations.zh: 一封写给 Naomi Bambin 的信
一条来自 Naomi Bambin 的消息

formal.mt: Din l-ittra hija indirizzata lil Naomi Bambin u għandha titwassal fl-indirizz indikat fuq l-envelop.
formal.en: This letter is addressed to Naomi Bambin and should be delivered to the address shown on the envelope.
formal.zh: 这封信的收信人是 Naomi Bambin，应送至信封上注明的地址。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lil min se tibgħat din l-ittra? Mark: Lil Naomi Bambin. Marija: Għandek l-indirizz? Mark: Iva, ktibtu fuq l-envelop.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who are you going to send this letter to? Mark: To Naomi Bambin. Marija: Do you have the address? Mark: Yes, I wrote it on the envelope.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你打算把这封信寄给谁？Mark：寄给 Naomi Bambin。Marija：你有地址吗？Mark：有，我已经写在信封上了。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象信封收信人栏写着 Naomi Bambin，把整个形式当作人名记忆，并保留两个词的首字母大写。

gloss_zh: 那不勒斯的；来自那不勒斯的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Naples or connected with the city and its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自那不勒斯的，或与这座城市及其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej minn Napli jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' din il-belt u mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 那不勒斯的；具有那不勒斯地方特色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Napli, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something Neapolitan is associated with Naples, its people, or its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Naples
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自那不勒斯的，或与那不勒斯有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina minn Napli jew li b'xi mod għandu rabta ma' din il-belt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way comes from Naples or has a connection with that city.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festival jinkludi kunċert minn kantant naplitan.
formal.en: The festival programme includes a concert by a Neapolitan singer.
formal.zh: 音乐节的节目包括一场由那不勒斯歌手演出的音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-restorant iservi ikel naplitan? Mark: Iva, trid nippruvawh illejla?
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this restaurant serve Neapolitan food? Mark: Yes, shall we try it tonight?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这家餐馆供应那不勒斯美食吗？Mark：是的，我们今晚去尝尝好吗？

messages.mt_standard: Iva, trid nippruvawh illejla?
messages.zh: 是的，我们今晚去尝尝好吗？
messages.en: Yes, shall we try it tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naplitan 和“那不勒斯风味菜单”联在一起记：看到这个形容词，就想到人的籍贯或事物的地方特色。

gloss_zh: 拿破仑的；拿破仑时代的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Napoleon or to the period associated with him.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与拿破仑本人或其所处时代有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Napuljun jew mal-perjodu marbut miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拿破仑的；与拿破仑或拿破仑时代有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda lil Napuljun, l-attivitajiet tiegħu jew iż-żmien marbut miegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something described as napoleonic is connected with Napoleon or with the period associated with him.

collocations.zh: 一幅与拿破仑有关的肖像画

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina dokumenti mill-perjodu napoleoniku.
formal.en: The study examines documents from the Napoleonic period.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察拿破仑时代的文献。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fuq xiex qed taqra? Pawlu: Fuq il-perjodu napoleoniku; għada għandi lezzjoni dwaru.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you reading about? Pawlu: The Napoleonic period; I have a lesson about it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在读哪方面的内容？Pawlu：拿破仑时代；我明天有一堂课讲这个。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读哪方面的内容？
messages.en: What are you reading about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-perjodu napoleoniku; għada għandi lezzjoni dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-perjodu napoleoniku; għada għandi lezzjoni dwaru.
messages.zh: 拿破仑时代；我明天有一堂课讲这个。
messages.en: The Napoleonic period; I have a lesson about it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 napoleoniku 贴在“拿破仑时代”这一历史课标题旁记忆，提醒自己它是描述相关人物、文献或时代的形容词。

gloss_zh: 剪彩；剪断开幕仪式上的彩带

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut a ribbon as part of an opening ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在开幕或启用仪式上剪断彩带，表示正式开放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqta' ż-żigarella waqt ċerimonja biex timmarka l-ftuħ uffiċjali ta' post jew proġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剪彩；在开幕或启用仪式上剪断彩带。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqta' żigarella f'ċerimonja li timmarka l-ftuħ uffiċjali ta' post jew il-bidu ta' attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people cut the ribbon, they ceremonially mark the official opening of a place or project.

collocations.en: we cut the ribbon during the official opening
collocations.zh: 我们在正式开幕时剪彩

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja tal-ftuħ, naqgħtaw iż-żigarella quddiem id-daħla taċ-ċentru l-ġdid.
formal.en: During the opening ceremony, we cut the ribbon in front of the entrance to the new centre.
formal.zh: 在开幕仪式上，我们在新中心的入口前剪彩。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta naqgħtaw iż-żigarella? Toni: Fl-għaxra, wara d-diskors.
colloquial.en: Lara: When do we cut the ribbon? Toni: At ten, after the speech.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们什么时候剪彩？Toni：十点，致辞结束以后。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta naqgħtaw iż-żigarella?
messages.mt_standard: Meta naqgħtaw iż-żigarella?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候剪彩？
messages.en: When do we cut the ribbon?

messages.speaker: Toni (活动同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-għaxra, wara d-diskors.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-għaxra, wara d-diskors.
messages.zh: 十点，致辞结束以后。
messages.en: At ten, after the speech.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“剪刀、彩带、开幕掌声”三幅画面记住 naqgħtaw 的剪彩义，并把它和 iż-żigarella 一起朗读。

gloss_zh: 我给你添麻烦；我打扰你

teaching_sense.en_definition: I cause you inconvenience or disturb what you are doing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我给你造成不便，或打扰你正在做的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiena nikkawżalek inkonvenjent jew niddisturbak f'dak li tkun qed tagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我给你带来不便；我打扰你。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiena nagħmillek xi inkonvenjent jew inkun ta' tfixkil għalik.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If I inconvenience you, I cause you trouble or make something less convenient for you.

collocations.en: I inconvenience you with this request
collocations.zh: 我提出这个请求给你添麻烦

collocations.en: I inconvenience you at this time

formal.mt: Jekk naqilgħek b'din it-talba, nista' nipproponi ħin ieħor għal-laqgħa.
formal.en: If I inconvenience you with this request, I can suggest another time for the meeting.
formal.zh: 如果这个请求给你带来不便，我可以另提一个开会时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Naqilgħek jekk niġi issa? Mark: Le, ejja, għandi ftit ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Will I inconvenience you if I come now? Mark: No, come over, I have a little time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我现在过来会给你添麻烦吗？Mark：不会，过来吧，我有一点时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naqilgħek jekk niġi issa?
messages.mt_standard: Naqilgħek jekk niġi issa?
messages.zh: 我现在过来会给你添麻烦吗？
messages.en: Will I inconvenience you if I come now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ejja, għandi ftit ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ejja, għandi ftit ħin.
messages.zh: 不会，过来吧，我有一点时间。
messages.en: No, come over, I have a little time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naqilgħek 放进“我现在来会打扰你吗”的门口对话中记忆，特别记清这个词表达的是“我”给“你”添麻烦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dispose of something by throwing it away; narmi is the first-person singular form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把不需要的东西扔掉或丢弃；narmi 是第一人称单数形式，表示“我扔掉”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta narmi xi ħaġa, neħles minnha billi nitfagħha mal-iskart għax ma rridhiex jew ma għandix bżonnha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扔掉；把不再需要或不想保留的东西丢弃。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tarmi xi ħaġa jfisser li teħles minnha billi titfagħha mal-iskart għax ma tridhiex iżjed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you throw something away, you get rid of it because you no longer want or need it.

formal.mt: Qabel ma narmi dokumenti qodma, niċċekkja jekk għadx għandi bżonnhom.
formal.en: Before I throw away old documents, I check whether I still need them.
formal.zh: 在扔掉旧文件之前，我会检查自己是否还需要它们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Narmi din il-kaxxa tal-kartun? Pawlu: Iva, hi vojta. Armiha fil-kontenitur tal-kartun.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall I throw away this cardboard box? Pawlu: Yes, it's empty. Put it in the cardboard recycling bin.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我要把这个纸箱扔掉吗？保罗：可以，里面是空的。把它放进纸板回收箱吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Narmi din il-kaxxa tal-kartun?
messages.mt_standard: Narmi din il-kaxxa tal-kartun?
messages.zh: 我要把这个纸箱扔掉吗？
messages.en: Shall I throw away this cardboard box?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hi vojta. Armiha fil-kontenitur tal-kartun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hi vojta. Armiha fil-kontenitur tal-kartun.
messages.zh: 可以，里面是空的。把它放进纸板回收箱吧。
messages.en: Yes, it's empty. Put it in the cardboard recycling bin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 narmi 和“我把旧纸扔进垃圾桶”的画面一起记，特别记住这个形式已经包含“我”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The person or voice that tells a story or describes events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在故事、影片或其他叙事作品中讲述事件的人或声音，即叙述者或旁白者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Narratur huwa l-persuna jew il-vuċi li tirrakkonta storja jew tiddeskrivi l-ġrajjiet f'ktieb, film jew xogħol ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叙述者；负责讲述故事或交代事件的人或声音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Narratur huwa min jirrakkonta storja u jippreżenta l-ġrajjiet lill-qarrejja jew lis-semmiegħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The narrator of a story is the person or voice that tells the audience what happens.

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rumanz, in-narratur jippreżenta l-ġrajjiet mill-perspettiva ta' tifel.
formal.en: In this novel, the narrator presents events from a boy's perspective.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，叙述者从一个男孩的视角讲述事件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu n-narratur ta' dan il-film? Mark: Hu dak li qed jirrakkonta l-istorja, imma ma narawhx fuq l-iskrin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the narrator of this film? Mark: He's the one telling the story, but we don't see him on screen.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这部电影的旁白者是谁？马克：就是正在讲故事的那个人，不过我们在屏幕上看不到他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu n-narratur ta' dan il-film?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu n-narratur ta' dan il-film?
messages.zh: 这部电影的旁白者是谁？
messages.en: Who is the narrator of this film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu dak li qed jirrakkonta l-istorja, imma ma narawhx fuq l-iskrin.
messages.mt_standard: Hu dak li qed jirrakkonta l-istorja, imma ma narawhx fuq l-iskrin.
messages.zh: 就是正在讲故事的那个人，不过我们在屏幕上看不到他。
messages.en: He's the one telling the story, but we don't see him on screen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 narratur 记成故事里的“讲述声音”：谁在告诉你发生了什么，谁就是叙述者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loquat fruit; the word can also refer to medlar fruit in another sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指枇杷这种黄色或橙色的多汁水果；另一个义项指欧楂果，学习时应结合语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naspli huwa frott li jista' jkun isfar jew oranġjo u mmerraq; f'tifsira oħra, il-kelma tirreferi għal frott kannella li jittiekel meta jkun irtab ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 枇杷；果皮通常呈黄色或橙色、果肉多汁并含有较大种子的水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-naspli huwa frott żgħir isfar jew oranġjo, b'laħam mmerraq u żrieragħ kbar ġewwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A loquat is a small yellow or orange fruit with juicy flesh and large seeds inside.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧楂果；一种通常呈褐色、充分软熟后食用的水果，与枇杷属于不同义项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'din it-tifsira, in-naspli huwa frott kannella li jitħalla jirtab ħafna qabel ma jittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A medlar is a brownish fruit that is usually eaten after its flesh has become very soft.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta tal-ġamm, agħżel naspli isfar jew oranġjo u neħħi ż-żrieragħ qabel it-tisjir.
formal.en: For this jam recipe, choose yellow or orange loquats and remove the seeds before cooking.
formal.zh: 制作这份食谱中的果酱时，请选用黄色或橙色的枇杷，并在烹煮前去除种子。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn in-naspli l-oranġjo ħelwin? Toni: Iva, huma ħelwin u mmerqin. Trid idduq wieħed?
colloquial.en: Nina: Are these orange loquats sweet? Toni: Yes, they're sweet and juicy. Would you like to try one?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些橙色的枇杷甜吗？托尼：甜，而且很多汁。你想尝一个吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn in-naspli l-oranġjo ħelwin?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn in-naspli l-oranġjo ħelwin?
messages.zh: 这些橙色的枇杷甜吗？
messages.en: Are these orange loquats sweet?

messages.speaker: Toni (水果摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma ħelwin u mmerqin. Trid idduq wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma ħelwin u mmerqin. Trid idduq wieħed?
messages.zh: 甜，而且很多汁。你想尝一个吗？
messages.en: Yes, they're sweet and juicy. Would you like to try one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 naspli 配两张水果卡：黄橙多汁的是枇杷，褐色软熟的是欧楂果；靠语境辨别两个义项。

gloss_zh: 本土的；原生的；出生地的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with the place where someone was born or where something occurs naturally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某人的出生地有关的，或指某种生物等原本自然生长、存在于某地的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nattiv jiddeskrivi persuna marbuta mal-post fejn twieldet, jew pjanta jew annimal li jinsab b'mod naturali f'post partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生于当地的；本土的；原生于某一地区的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tkun nattiva ta' post meta dik il-persuna tkun twieldet hemm jew dik il-ħaġa tkun teżisti hemm b'mod naturali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person, animal, or plant described as native comes originally from the place being discussed.

formal.mt: Wara ħafna snin barra, l-awtur reġa' lura lejn il-pajjiż nattiv tiegħu.
formal.en: After many years abroad, the author returned to his native country.
formal.zh: 在国外生活多年后，这位作家回到了自己的出生国。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-għasfur nattiv ta' hawn? David: Iva, jgħix hawn b'mod naturali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this bird native to this area? David: Yes, it lives here naturally.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这种鸟是这里的本土鸟类吗？戴维：是的，它自然栖息在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-għasfur nattiv ta' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-għasfur nattiv ta' hawn?
messages.zh: 这种鸟是这里的本土鸟类吗？
messages.en: Is this bird native to this area?

messages.speaker: David (自然导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jgħix hawn b'mod naturali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jgħix hawn b'mod naturali.
messages.zh: 是的，它自然栖息在这里。
messages.en: Yes, it lives here naturally.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nattiv 贴在“原本属于这里”的地图标记上：人联想到出生地，动植物联想到自然分布地。

gloss_zh: 座席间的通道；教堂内的走道

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aisle is a passage between rows of seats or benches, especially in a church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成排座椅或长凳之间供人行走的通道，尤指教堂内的走道。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Passaġġ bejn ringieli ta' siġġijiet jew bankijiet, speċjalment fi knisja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 座椅或长凳之间的通道，尤指教堂内的走道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nava hija passaġġ bejn ringieli ta' siġġijiet jew bankijiet li minnu jgħaddu n-nies, speċjalment fi knisja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aisle is a passage that allows people to walk between rows of seats, especially in a church.

collocations.zh: 沿着座席间的通道行走

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, in-nava tal-knisja għandha tibqa' ħielsa biex in-nies ikunu jistgħu jgħaddu.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the church aisle should remain clear so that people can pass through.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，教堂内的走道应保持畅通，以便人们通行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu? Mark: Hawn, ħdejn in-nava, biex inkunu nistgħu noħorġu faċilment.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit? Mark: Here, beside the aisle, so we can get out easily.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐哪里？马克：这里，靠走道坐，这样出去比较方便。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu?
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, ħdejn in-nava, biex inkunu nistgħu noħorġu faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, ħdejn in-nava, biex inkunu nistgħu noħorġu faċilment.
messages.zh: 这里，靠走道坐，这样出去比较方便。
messages.en: Here, beside the aisle, so we can get out easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nava 和教堂座位之间的一条走道配成画面：两边是长凳，中间留出通路，再用“靠走道坐”这个场景巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shipwreck is an accident in which a ship is destroyed or sinks at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船舶在海上遭到毁坏或沉没的事故。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inċident fuq il-baħar li fih bastiment jinqered jew jegħreq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船舶在海上失事，遭到毁坏或沉没的事故。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nawfraġju huwa inċident fuq il-baħar li fih bastiment jinqered jew jegħreq, pereżempju waqt maltempata jew wara ħabta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shipwreck is an accident in which a ship is destroyed or sinks, for example during a storm or after a collision.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi nawfraġju li seħħ waqt maltempata u l-operazzjoni biex jiġu salvati l-passiġġieri.
formal.en: The report describes a shipwreck that occurred during a storm and the operation to rescue the passengers.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一场发生于暴风雨中的海难，以及营救乘客的行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dwar xiex kien id-dokumentarju? Mark: Dwar nawfraġju. Kien hemm sajjied li salva tliet passiġġieri.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the documentary about? Mark: A shipwreck. There was a fisherman who saved three passengers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那部纪录片讲什么？马克：讲一场海难。有位渔民救了三名乘客。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar xiex kien id-dokumentarju?
messages.mt_standard: Dwar xiex kien id-dokumentarju?
messages.zh: 那部纪录片讲什么？
messages.en: What was the documentary about?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar nawfraġju. Kien hemm sajjied li salva tliet passiġġieri.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar nawfraġju. Kien hemm sajjied li salva tliet passiġġieri.
messages.zh: 讲一场海难。有位渔民救了三名乘客。
messages.en: A shipwreck. There was a fisherman who saved three passengers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“暴风雨、船舶失事、乘客获救”三幅连续画面记住 nawfraġju，并把整个事件对应为“海难”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nausea is an unpleasant feeling in your stomach that makes you feel as if you might vomit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胃部不适、觉得可能要呕吐的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni mhux pjaċevoli fl-istonku li ġġiegħlek tħoss li tista' tirremetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 胃部难受并想要呕吐的感觉；恶心感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nawsja hija sensazzjoni ta' skumdità fl-istonku li fiha tħoss li tista' tirremetti, anki jekk fil-fatt ma tirremettix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Nausea is the unpleasant feeling that you are going to vomit, even if you do not actually do so.

formal.mt: Il-pazjenta rrappurtat sensazzjoni ta' nawsja waqt il-vjaġġ, iżda ma rremettietx.
formal.en: The patient reported a feeling of nausea during the journey, but she did not vomit.
formal.zh: 这名女患者表示，旅途中曾感到恶心，但没有呕吐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ma tridx tiekol? Mark: Qed inħoss nawsja. Nippreferi nistenna ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why don't you want to eat? Mark: I'm feeling nauseous. I'd rather wait a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么不想吃东西？马克：我觉得恶心。我想先等一会儿。

gloss_zh: 民族主义的；带有民族主义倾向的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something nationalistic expresses strong support for a nation and places particular importance on its identity or interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达对某个民族或国家的强烈支持，并特别强调其认同或利益的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi appoġġ qawwi għal nazzjon u jagħti importanza speċjali lill-identità jew lill-interessi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民族主义的；强烈强调本民族或本国认同、地位或利益的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri appoġġ qawwi għal nazzjon u jenfasizza l-identità, il-pożizzjoni jew l-interessi tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is nationalistic expresses strong support for a particular nation and emphasizes its identity, position, or interests.

sense_translations.en_definition: having tendencies or views associated with nationalism
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有与民族主义相关的倾向或观点的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu jew jesprimi tendenzi jew fehmiet marbuta man-nazzjonaliżmu, bħal enfasi fuq l-identità u l-interessi tan-nazzjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is described as nationalistic, it shows tendencies or views associated with nationalism, such as emphasizing national identity and interests.

collocations.zh: 带有民族主义色彩的演讲
带有民族主义倾向的信息

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tagħha, ir-riċerkatriċi ddeskriviet id-diskors bħala nazzjonalistiku minħabba l-enfasi tiegħu fuq l-identità u l-interessi tan-nazzjon.
formal.en: In her analysis, the researcher described the speech as nationalistic because of its emphasis on national identity and interests.
formal.zh: 研究者在分析中将这篇演讲描述为带有民族主义色彩，因为它着重强调了民族认同和国家利益。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt id-diskors? Mark: Kellu ton nazzjonalistiku. Il-kelliem baqa' jenfasizza l-identità u l-interessi tan-nazzjon.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the speech? Mark: It had a nationalistic tone. The speaker kept emphasizing national identity and interests.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得那场演讲怎么样？马克：带有民族主义的语调。演讲者一直强调民族认同和国家利益。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nazzjonalistiku 放进“diskors nazzjonalistiku”一起记：想象一篇反复强调民族认同与国家利益的演讲，用具体内容记住“民族主义的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach to economic policy that gives priority to national interests and domestic production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在经济政策中优先考虑本国利益和国内生产的主张或取向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Orjentazzjoni fil-politika ekonomika li tagħti prijorità lill-interessi nazzjonali u lill-produzzjoni lokali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经济民族主义，即主张在经济政策中优先维护本国经济利益、支持国内生产的取向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-nazzjonaliżmu ekonomiku huwa approċċ li jagħti prijorità lill-interessi ekonomiċi tal-pajjiż u lill-produzzjoni lokali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Economic nationalism is an approach that prioritizes a country's own economic interests and domestic production.

collocations.zh: 关于经济民族主义的辩论

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina kif in-nazzjonaliżmu ekonomiku jista' jinfluwenza d-deċiżjonijiet dwar l-importazzjoni u l-appoġġ lill-produtturi lokali.
formal.en: The report examines how economic nationalism can influence decisions about imports and support for domestic producers.
formal.zh: 该报告探讨经济民族主义如何影响有关进口及支持国内生产者的决策。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri nazzjonaliżmu ekonomiku? Pawlu: Ifisser li fil-politika ekonomika tagħti prijorità lill-interessi ta' pajjiżek u lill-produzzjoni lokali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does economic nationalism mean? Pawlu: It means giving priority to your country's interests and domestic production in economic policy.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：经济民族主义是什么意思？保罗：就是在经济政策中优先考虑本国利益和国内生产。

messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri nazzjonaliżmu ekonomiku?
messages.zh: 经济民族主义是什么意思？
messages.en: What does economic nationalism mean?

messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li fil-politika ekonomika tagħti prijorità lill-interessi ta' pajjiżek u lill-produzzjoni lokali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li fil-politika ekonomika tagħti prijorità lill-interessi ta' pajjiżek u lill-produzzjoni lokali.
messages.zh: 就是在经济政策中优先考虑本国利益和国内生产。
messages.en: It means giving priority to your country's interests and domestic production in economic policy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组与“经济政策先考虑本国利益”的画面相连：看到进口商品与本国产品并列时，联想优先支持国内生产的政策取向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The international organization in which member states work together on peace, security, and other shared concerns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由成员国共同参与，就和平、安全及其他共同关切开展合作的国际组织，即联合国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni internazzjonali li fiha l-istati membri jaħdmu flimkien għall-paċi, għas-sigurtà u fuq kwistjonijiet oħra ta' interess komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联合国，由成员国共同参与、促进国际和平与合作的国际组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-Nazzjonijiet Uniti huma organizzazzjoni internazzjonali li tlaqqa' flimkien stati membri biex jikkooperaw għall-paċi, għas-sigurtà u fuq kwistjonijiet ta' interess komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The United Nations is an international organization through which member states cooperate on peace, security, and shared concerns.

collocations.en: the member states of the United Nations

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi r-rwol tan-Nazzjonijiet Uniti fil-promozzjoni tal-paċi u tal-kooperazzjoni bejn l-istati.
formal.en: The document describes the role of the United Nations in promoting peace and cooperation between states.
formal.zh: 该文件介绍了联合国在促进国家间和平与合作方面的作用。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni? Ġanni: Fuq in-Nazzjonijiet Uniti u kif il-pajjiżi jaħdmu flimkien fi ħdanhom.
colloquial.en: Marija: What will your presentation be about? Ġanni: The United Nations and how countries work together within it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你准备做什么主题的展示？詹尼：介绍联合国，以及各国如何在其中合作。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex se tagħmel il-preżentazzjoni?
messages.zh: 你准备做什么主题的展示？
messages.en: What will your presentation be about?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq in-Nazzjonijiet Uniti u kif il-pajjiżi jaħdmu flimkien fi ħdanhom.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq in-Nazzjonijiet Uniti u kif il-pajjiżi jaħdmu flimkien fi ħdanhom.
messages.zh: 介绍联合国，以及各国如何在其中合作。
messages.en: The United Nations and how countries work together within it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Nazzjonijiet Uniti 当作完整的组织专名记忆，联想各国代表围桌讨论和平与合作的场景；正文中的两个词均以大写字母开头。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wasp: a flying insect with a narrow waist that can sting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 黄蜂或胡蜂，一种腰部细窄、能够蜇人的飞行昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett li jtir, għandu qadd dejjaq u jista' jniggeż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄蜂；胡蜂，一种腰部细窄、能够蜇人的昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Naħla bagħlija hija insett li jtir, għandu qadd dejjaq u jista' jniggeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wasp is a flying insect with a narrow waist that can sting.

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni, l-għalliema rat naħla bagħlija ħdejn it-tieqa u talbet lit-tfal jibqgħu kalmi.
formal.en: During the lesson, the teacher saw a wasp near the window and asked the children to remain calm.
formal.zh: 上课时，老师看见窗边有一只黄蜂，便请孩子们保持镇定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hemm naħla bagħlija ħdejn il-meraq tiegħek! Lara: Rajtha. Se mmexxi t-tazza bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Maja: There's a wasp next to your juice! Lara: I saw it. I'll move the glass slowly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的果汁旁边有一只黄蜂！Lara：我看见了。我会慢慢把杯子移开。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of being on bad terms with another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人之间关系不睦、彼此不友好的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' nuqqas ta' qbil jew ħbiberija bejn persuni li ma jkunux f'relazzjoni tajba ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不和；彼此关系不好或不友好的状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Naħrawa hija qagħda li fiha żewġ persuni jew aktar ma jkunux f'relazzjoni tajba ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When people are not on good terms, their relationship is unfriendly or strained.

formal.mt: In-naħrawa bejn iż-żewġ ġirien għamlitha diffiċli biex jaslu għal ftehim dwar l-użu tal-bitħa.
formal.en: The strained relations between the two neighbours made it difficult for them to reach an agreement about using the courtyard.
formal.zh: 两位邻居关系不睦，因此很难就庭院的使用达成协议。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad hemm naħrawa bejn Pawlu u Mark? Nina: Iva, għadhom ma jitkellmux ma' xulxin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are Pawlu and Mark still on bad terms? Nina: Yes, they're still not speaking to each other.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Pawlu 和 Mark 还不和吗？Nina：是的，他们仍然互不说话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad hemm naħrawa bejn Pawlu u Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għad hemm naħrawa bejn Pawlu u Mark?
messages.zh: Pawlu 和 Mark 还不和吗？
messages.en: Are Pawlu and Mark still on bad terms?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadhom ma jitkellmux ma' xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadhom ma jitkellmux ma' xulxin.
messages.zh: 是的，他们仍然互不说话。
messages.en: Yes, they're still not speaking to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 naħrawa 想成两位邻居背对背、互不搭话的画面；按名词记住它表示“关系不和的状态”。

gloss_zh: 大小相等；范围或程度相同

teaching_sense.en_definition: Equal in size or extent when two or more things are compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于比较两个或多个事物，表示它们的大小、范围或程度相同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika li żewġ affarijiet jew aktar għandhom l-istess daqs jew l-istess firxa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在大小、范围或程度上相等。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta affarijiet ikunu ndaqs, ma jkunx hemm differenza bejniethom fid-daqs jew fil-firxa li tkun qed titqabbel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If two things are equal in size or extent, neither is larger or extends further than the other.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-attività, iċċekkja li ż-żewġ biċċiet tal-karta huma ndaqs fid-daqs.
formal.en: Before starting the activity, check that the two pieces of paper are equal in size.
formal.zh: 开始活动前，请检查两张纸是否大小相同。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dawn iż-żewġ kaxxi huma ndaqs? Mark: Iva, huma ndaqs fid-daqs, imma waħda itqal mill-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are these two boxes the same size? Mark: Yes, they are equal in size, but one is heavier than the other.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这两个箱子一样大吗？马克：是的，大小相同，不过一个比另一个重。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn iż-żewġ kaxxi huma ndaqs?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn iż-żewġ kaxxi huma ndaqs?

messages.en: Are these two boxes the same size?

messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma ndaqs fid-daqs, imma waħda itqal mill-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma ndaqs fid-daqs, imma waħda itqal mill-oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，大小相同，不过一个比另一个重。

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把两张大小相同的纸完全叠合，边缘整齐重合时说 huma ndaqs；记住比较的是指定的大小或范围，不表示所有性质都相同。

gloss_zh: 湿气；石材中的潮气或水分

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moisture or dampness, especially moisture present in stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 湿气或潮湿状态，尤指存在于石材内部的潮气或水分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Umdità jew ilma preżenti f'materjal, speċjalment fil-ġebel, li jagħmluh niedi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 湿气、潮气，尤指石材中含有的水分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: In-ndewwa hija l-umdità jew l-ilma li jkun hemm fil-ġebel u li jżommu niedi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Moisture is water present in a material such as stone, making it damp.

formal.mt: L-ispezzjoni identifikat traċċi ta' ndewwa fil-ġebel tal-ħajt; ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li jiġi investigat minn fejn ġej l-ilma.
formal.en: The inspection identified traces of moisture in the wall's stone; the report recommends investigating where the water is coming from.
formal.zh: 检查发现墙体石材中存在受潮痕迹；报告建议调查水分的来源。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex dan il-ġebel għadu niedi? Toni: Hemm ndewwa fih. Irridu naraw minn fejn ġej l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why is this stone still damp? Toni: There is moisture in it. We need to see where the water is coming from.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这块石头怎么还潮着？托尼：里面有水分。我们得看看水是从哪里来的。

messages.speaker: Rita (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-ġebel għadu niedi?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-ġebel għadu niedi?
messages.zh: 这块石头怎么还潮着？
messages.en: Why is this stone still damp?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ndewwa fih. Irridu naraw minn fejn ġej l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ndewwa fih. Irridu naraw minn fejn ġej l-ilma.
messages.zh: 里面有水分。我们得看看水是从哪里来的。
messages.en: There is moisture in it. We need to see where the water is coming from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ndewwa 与手摸石墙时感到潮湿的触觉绑定，配合 ndewwa fil-ġebel 一起记：重点是石材里含着的湿气和水分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a noun whose supplied definition mentions an English translation without specifying a precise lexical meaning.
