teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that turns liquid medicine into a fine mist so that it can be breathed in.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体药物转化为细雾，供人吸入的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jbiddel mediċina likwida fi raxx fin sabiex tkun tista' tittieħed man-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雾化器；把液体药物变成可吸入细雾的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Apparat li jikkonverti mediċina likwida fi qtar żgħir ħafna li jista' jittieħed man-nifs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nebuliser is a device that produces a fine mist of liquid medicine for someone to breathe in.

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega kif tuża n-nebulizzatur u kif tnaddaf il-partijiet tiegħu.
formal.en: The manual explains how to use the nebuliser and how to clean its parts.
formal.zh: 说明书解释了雾化器的使用方法及其部件的清洁方法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn poġġejt in-nebulizzatur? Mark: Qiegħed fil-kaxxa tiegħu, ħdejn il-maskra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the nebuliser? Mark: It's in its box, next to the mask.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把雾化器放在哪里了？Mark：在它的盒子里，就在面罩旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt in-nebulizzatur?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt in-nebulizzatur?
messages.zh: 你把雾化器放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the nebuliser?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fil-kaxxa tiegħu, ħdejn il-maskra.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fil-kaxxa tiegħu, ħdejn il-maskra.
messages.zh: 在它的盒子里，就在面罩旁边。
messages.en: It's in its box, next to the mask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台把药液变成细雾的机器，把 nebulizzatur 与“药液变细雾、吸气吸进去”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 我们找事做；我们让自己忙起来

teaching_sense.en_definition: We keep ourselves or our minds occupied by doing something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我们通过做某件事让自己或头脑保持忙碌，有事可做。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inżommu lilna nfusna jew moħħna okkupati billi nagħmlu xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们让头脑保持忙碌，或通过某项活动让自己有事可做。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nagħmlu xi attività biex inżommu moħħna jew lilna nfusna okkupati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we keep ourselves busy, we occupy our time or attention with an activity.

collocations.en: we keep ourselves occupied by reading
collocations.zh: 我们通过阅读让自己有事可做

collocations.en: we keep ourselves occupied with games
collocations.zh: 我们通过玩游戏打发时间

formal.mt: Waqt li nistennew il-bidu tal-laqgħa, nedhew naqraw id-dokumenti.
formal.en: While we wait for the meeting to begin, we keep ourselves occupied by reading the documents.
formal.zh: 等待会议开始时，我们通过阅读文件让自己有事可做。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'nagħmlu sakemm tasal ix-xarabank? Mark: Nedhew b'logħba żgħira fuq it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we do until the bus arrives? Mark: Let's keep ourselves occupied with a little game on the phone.
colloquial.zh: Maja：公交车来之前我们做什么？Mark：我们玩个手机小游戏打发一下时间吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'nagħmlu sakemm tasal ix-xarabank?
messages.mt_standard: X'nagħmlu sakemm tasal ix-xarabank?
messages.zh: 公交车来之前我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we do until the bus arrives?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nedhew b'logħba żgħira fuq it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Nedhew b'logħba żgħira fuq it-telefon.
messages.zh: 我们玩个手机小游戏打发一下时间吧。
messages.en: Let's keep ourselves occupied with a little game on the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nedhew 记成一群人在等车时一起读书或玩游戏的画面：主语是“我们”，核心是“给自己找点事做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing denial or an unfavourable judgment, or describing something harmful or undesirable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示否定或不赞同的，或描述不利、有害、令人不满意的情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ċaħda jew ġudizzju sfavorevoli, jew li jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tagħmel ħsara jew mhix mixtieqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 否定的、负面的或消极的；可形容不赞同的评价、不利的影响或缺乏积极性的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri ċaħda, nuqqas ta' approvazzjoni jew ottimiżmu, jew li għandu effett ħażin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is negative expresses denial or disapproval, shows a lack of optimism, or has an unfavourable effect.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-impatt negattiv tat-tniġġis fuq l-ambjent.
formal.en: The report describes the negative impact of pollution on the environment.
formal.zh: 报告描述了污染对环境造成的负面影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kumment tiegħu kien negattiv? Mark: Iva, qal biss x'ma għoġbux u ma semma xejn tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Was his comment negative? Mark: Yes, he only said what he didn't like and didn't mention anything good.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他的评论很负面吗？Mark：是的，他只说了不喜欢的地方，一点好的也没提。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment tiegħu kien negattiv?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment tiegħu kien negattiv?
messages.zh: 他的评论很负面吗？
messages.en: Was his comment negative?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qal biss x'ma għoġbux u ma semma xejn tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qal biss x'ma għoġbux u ma semma xejn tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是的，他只说了不喜欢的地方，一点好的也没提。
messages.en: Yes, he only said what he didn't like and didn't mention anything good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 negattiv 和英语 negative 对照记忆：看到“负面影响”或“消极态度”，就联想到这个形容词。

gloss_zh: 电子商务；电子化商业活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: Business activity conducted or managed through electronic systems and networks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子系统和网络开展或管理的商业活动，包括交易及相关业务流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività kummerċjali li titwettaq jew titmexxa permezz ta' sistemi u netwerks elettroniċi, inklużi t-tranżazzjonijiet u l-proċessi marbuta magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子商务，即利用电子系统和网络开展交易、管理及其他商业业务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività kummerċjali li tuża sistemi u netwerks elettroniċi biex twettaq tranżazzjonijiet, tmexxi x-xogħol u tikkomunika mal-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-business is the use of electronic systems and networks to conduct transactions and manage business activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子化商业活动，指通过电子系统和网络进行或管理的经营活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Negozju li l-attivitajiet tiegħu jsiru jew jiġu amministrati permezz ta' sistemi u netwerks elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic business refers to commercial activities carried out or administered through electronic systems and networks.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tinvesti fin-negozju elettroniku biex il-klijenti jkunu jistgħu jordnaw u jħallsu permezz tal-internet.
formal.en: The company is investing in e-business so that customers can order and pay online.
formal.zh: 该公司正在投资电子商务，使客户能够在线下单和付款。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħanut tiegħek issa jbigħ ukoll fuq l-internet? Mark: Iva, bdejt nuża pjattaforma għan-negozju elettroniku, u l-klijenti jistgħu jordnaw mid-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does your shop now sell online too? Mark: Yes, I started using an e-business platform, and customers can order from home.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的商店现在也在网上卖东西了吗？Mark：是的，我开始使用电子商务平台，客户在家就能下单。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut tiegħek issa jbigħ ukoll fuq l-internet?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut tiegħek issa jbigħ ukoll fuq l-internet?
messages.zh: 你的商店现在也在网上卖东西了吗？
messages.en: Does your shop now sell online too?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bdejt nuża pjattaforma għan-negozju elettroniku, u l-klijenti jistgħu jordnaw mid-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bdejt nuża pjattaforma għan-negozju elettroniku, u l-klijenti jistgħu jordnaw mid-dar.
messages.zh: 是的，我开始使用电子商务平台，客户在家就能下单。
messages.en: Yes, I started using an e-business platform, and customers can order from home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“网上接单、电子付款、系统管理”的场景相连，记住它涵盖电子化商业活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trade in which goods or services provide all or part of the payment for other goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以商品或服务抵付另一方商品或服务的全部或部分价款的贸易方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma ta' kummerċ li fiha l-ħlas kollu jew parti minnu jsir b'oġġetti jew servizzi minflok bi flus biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对销贸易，指交易双方约定以商品或服务抵付全部或部分价款的贸易安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament kummerċjali li fih parti tħallas għall-oġġetti jew għas-servizzi ta' parti oħra, kollha kemm huma jew parzjalment, billi tipprovdi oġġetti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Countertrade is a trading arrangement in which goods or services are exchanged as all or part of the payment.

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim ta' negozju kumpensatorju, ix-xerrej se jħallas parti mill-prezz tal-makkinarju billi jipprovdi prodotti agrikoli lill-bejjiegħ.
formal.en: Under the countertrade agreement, the buyer will pay part of the price of the machinery by supplying agricultural products to the seller.
formal.zh: 根据对销贸易协议，买方将向卖方提供农产品，以抵付机械设备的部分价款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kumpanija se tħallas għall-magni bil-prodotti tagħha? Pawlu: Għax għamlet ftehim ta' negozju kumpensatorju; il-prodotti se jkopru parti mill-prezz.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the company going to pay for the machines with its products? Pawlu: Because it has made a countertrade agreement; the products will cover part of the price.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这家公司为什么要用自己的产品支付机器的价款？Pawlu：因为它签了对销贸易协议，这些产品会抵付部分价款。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-kumpanija se tħallas għall-magni bil-prodotti tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-kumpanija se tħallas għall-magni bil-prodotti tagħha?
messages.zh: 这家公司为什么要用自己的产品支付机器的价款？
messages.en: Why is the company going to pay for the machines with its products?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għamlet ftehim ta' negozju kumpensatorju; il-prodotti se jkopru parti mill-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għamlet ftehim ta' negozju kumpensatorju; il-prodotti se jkopru parti mill-prezz.
messages.zh: 因为它签了对销贸易协议，这些产品会抵付部分价款。
messages.en: Because it has made a countertrade agreement; the products will cover part of the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象买机器时交出一批农产品抵账，用“商品抵付货款”的画面记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small tool with a rough surface used to smooth and shape the edges of fingernails or toenails.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面粗糙的小工具，用来锉平和修整手指甲或脚趾甲的边缘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda żgħira b'wiċċ aħrax li tintuża biex tillixxa u tagħti forma lit-truf tad-dwiefer tal-idejn jew tas-saqajn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于磨平、修整指甲边缘的指甲锉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'wiċċ aħrax li biha wieħed jirfina t-truf tad-dwiefer u jagħtihom il-forma mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nail file is a small rough tool that you use to smooth or shape your nails.

collocations.en: smooth the edges of the nails with a nail file
collocations.zh: 用指甲锉磨平指甲边缘

formal.mt: Wara li taqta' d-dwiefer, uża nejl fajl biex tillixxa t-truf tagħhom.
formal.en: After cutting your nails, use a nail file to smooth their edges.
formal.zh: 剪完指甲后，用指甲锉磨平边缘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek nejl fajl? Għandi tarf ta' difer jaqbad fil-ħwejjeġ. Nina: Iva, hawn wieħed; illixxa t-tarf bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a nail file? The edge of one of my nails keeps catching on my clothes. Nina: Yes, here's one; smooth the edge gently.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你有指甲锉吗？我有个指甲的边缘老是勾住衣服。妮娜：有，这里有一个；轻轻把边缘磨平。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek nejl fajl? Għandi tarf ta' difer jaqbad fil-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek nejl fajl? Għandi tarf ta' difer jaqbad fil-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 你有指甲锉吗？我有个指甲的边缘老是勾住衣服。
messages.en: Do you have a nail file? The edge of one of my nails keeps catching on my clothes.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed; illixxa t-tarf bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed; illixxa t-tarf bil-mod.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一个；轻轻把边缘磨平。
messages.en: Yes, here's one; smooth the edge gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nejl fajl 连着念，再想象用小锉条来回磨平指甲边缘；记住它的主要动作是“磨平、修形”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small viewing hole, usually in a front door, through which someone inside can see who is outside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常设在住宅大门上的小窥视孔，供屋内的人观察门外情况或辨认来访者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqba żgħira, ġeneralment fil-bieb ta' barra ta' dar, li minnha min ikun ġewwa jista' jara min hemm barra.

sense_translations.en_definition: spyhole (a small viewing hole, usually in the front door of a house)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常位于住宅大门上、用来从屋内查看门外的小孔，即门上的窥视孔或猫眼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fetħa żgħira fil-bieb, speċjalment fil-bieb ta' barra ta' dar, li tippermetti lil min ikun ġewwa jħares barra mingħajr ma jiftaħ il-bieb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A spyhole is a small opening in a door that lets you see who is outside without opening it.

collocations.en: a spyhole in the front door

formal.mt: Qabel tiftaħ il-bieb ta' barra, ħares min-nemmiesa biex tara min ikun wasal.
formal.en: Before opening the front door, look through the spyhole to see who has arrived.
formal.zh: 打开大门前，先从猫眼查看来访者是谁。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi ħadd ħabbat. Tista' tħares min-nemmiesa? Pawlu: Iva, huwa l-ġar tagħna; se niftaħlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Someone knocked. Can you look through the spyhole? Pawlu: Yes, it's our neighbour; I'll open the door for him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：有人敲门。你能从猫眼看看吗？保罗：好，是我们的邻居；我去给他开门。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħadd ħabbat. Tista' tħares min-nemmiesa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħadd ħabbat. Tista' tħares min-nemmiesa?
messages.zh: 有人敲门。你能从猫眼看看吗？
messages.en: Someone knocked. Can you look through the spyhole?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa l-ġar tagħna; se niftaħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa l-ġar tagħna; se niftaħlu.
messages.zh: 好，是我们的邻居；我去给他开门。
messages.en: Yes, it's our neighbour; I'll open the door for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“听见敲门，凑近小孔，先看是谁”这一连串动作，把 nemmiesa 对应到门上的猫眼。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A net used to catch fish in water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在水中捕捉鱼类的网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xibka li tintuża biex jinqabad il-ħut fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于捕鱼的网，即渔网。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xibka tas-sajd li titqiegħed jew tintefa' fl-ilma biex il-ħut jinqabad fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fish net is a net that people place or cast in water to catch fish.

collocations.en: cast the fishing net into the sea

formal.mt: Qabel ħareġ għas-sajd, is-sajjied eżamina n-nems u sewwa t-toqob li sab fih.
formal.en: Before going fishing, the fisherman inspected the fishing net and repaired the holes he found in it.
formal.zh: 出海捕鱼前，渔民检查了渔网，并修补了发现的破洞。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Fejn hu n-nems? Se noħorġu għas-sajd dalgħodu. Marija: Qiegħed fid-dgħajsa, imma fih toqba żgħira; ejja nsewwuha l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Toni: Where's the fishing net? We're going fishing this morning. Marija: It's in the boat, but it has a small hole; let's mend it first.
colloquial.zh: 托尼：渔网在哪里？我们今天早上要去捕鱼。玛丽亚：在船里，不过有个小洞；我们先把它补好吧。

messages.speaker: Toni (渔民)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu n-nems? Se noħorġu għas-sajd dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu n-nems? Se noħorġu għas-sajd dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 渔网在哪里？我们今天早上要去捕鱼。
messages.en: Where's the fishing net? We're going fishing this morning.

messages.speaker: Marija (捕鱼搭档)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fid-dgħajsa, imma fih toqba żgħira; ejja nsewwuha l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fid-dgħajsa, imma fih toqba żgħira; ejja nsewwuha l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 在船里，不过有个小洞；我们先把它补好吧。
messages.en: It's in the boat, but it has a small hole; let's mend it first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象渔民先补网、再撒网、最后收网捕鱼的三个画面，把 nems 稳稳记成这一义项的“渔网”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sandfly is a small biting insect whose female feeds on blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 白蛉是一种小型叮咬昆虫，其雌虫吸食血液。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett żgħir li l-mara tiegħu tigdem u terda' d-demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 白蛉，一种雌虫会叮咬吸血的小型昆虫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Insett żgħir li l-mara tiegħu tigdem il-bnedmin jew l-annimali biex terda' d-demm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sandfly is a small insect whose female bites people or animals to feed on their blood.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif tagħraf in-nemusa muta u kif tipproteġi ruħek mill-gdim tagħha.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how to recognise a sandfly and how to protect yourself from its bites.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册介绍如何辨认白蛉，以及如何防止被它叮咬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-insett żgħir huwa nemusa muta? Pawlu: Naħseb li iva, imma ejja nħarsu lejn l-istampa fil-fuljett biex inkunu ċerti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this little insect a sandfly? Pawlu: I think so, but let's look at the picture in the leaflet to make sure.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这只小虫是白蛉吗？Pawlu：我觉得是，不过我们看看宣传册里的图片，确认一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-insett żgħir huwa nemusa muta?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-insett żgħir huwa nemusa muta?
messages.zh: 这只小虫是白蛉吗？
messages.en: Is this little insect a sandfly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva, imma ejja nħarsu lejn l-istampa fil-fuljett biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva, imma ejja nħarsu lejn l-istampa fil-fuljett biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我觉得是，不过我们看看宣传册里的图片，确认一下。
messages.en: I think so, but let's look at the picture in the leaflet to make sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nemusa muta 整体记成“白蛉”，配一张小虫叮咬的图，再用“白蛉叮咬”这一搭配巩固；不要凭词组外形猜虫种。

gloss_zh: 裙带关系；任人唯亲；偏袒

teaching_sense.en_definition: Nepotism is the unfair use of influence to favour relatives, especially when giving jobs; the word can also refer more broadly to favouritism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指利用职权或影响力优待亲属，尤其是在职位分配中任人唯亲；也可泛指不公正的偏袒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattika li biha persuna tuża l-pożizzjoni jew l-influwenza tagħha biex tagħti vantaġġi lill-qraba tagħha, speċjalment fl-għoti tax-xogħol; il-kelma tista' tindika wkoll favoritiżmu b'mod usa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 任人唯亲；利用职权或影响力给予亲属职位或其他不公平的优待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika li biha persuna tagħti impjiegi jew vantaġġi oħra lill-qraba tagħha minħabba r-rabta familjari, aktar milli skont il-mertu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Nepotism occurs when someone uses their power to give jobs or other advantages to relatives rather than choosing people fairly.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏袒；因个人偏好而给予某些人优于他人的不公平待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba li biha xi ħadd jittratta lil ċerti persuni aħjar minn oħrajn minħabba preferenza personali, aktar milli skont kriterji ġusti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Favouritism is the unfair treatment of certain people more generously than others because of a personal preference for them.

formal.mt: Biex tevita n-nepotiżmu, l-istituzzjoni għandha tagħżel il-kandidati skont kriterji ċari u l-mertu tagħhom.
formal.en: To prevent nepotism, the institution should select candidates according to clear criteria and their merits.
formal.zh: 为防止任人唯亲，该机构应依据明确的标准及候选人的能力与资历进行选拔。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed jgħidu li kien hemm nepotiżmu fl-għażla? Mark: Għax intgħażel qarib tad-direttur, imma rridu naraw kif ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are people saying there was nepotism in the selection? Mark: Because a relative of the director was chosen, but we need to see how the decision was made.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么大家说这次选拔存在任人唯亲？Mark：因为入选的是主任的亲属，不过我们还得看看这个决定是怎么作出的。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jgħidu li kien hemm nepotiżmu fl-għażla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jgħidu li kien hemm nepotiżmu fl-għażla?
messages.zh: 为什么大家说这次选拔存在任人唯亲？
messages.en: Why are people saying there was nepotism in the selection?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax intgħażel qarib tad-direttur, imma rridu naraw kif ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Għax intgħażel qarib tad-direttur, imma rridu naraw kif ittieħdet id-deċiżjoni.
messages.zh: 因为入选的是主任的亲属，不过我们还得看看这个决定是怎么作出的。
messages.en: Because a relative of the director was chosen, but we need to see how the decision was made.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“招聘时先看亲属关系”的情景记住 nepotiżmu；核心义联想“任人唯亲”，较宽泛的义项联想“偏袒”，学习时分清两者范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Netting is the process of combining amounts owed between parties so that only the remaining balance has to be paid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指将各方之间相互应付的款项合并抵销，使最终只需支付净余额的处理过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li bih l-ammonti li l-partijiet għandhom iħallsu lil xulxin jiġu kkalkulati flimkien u paċuti, biex jitħallas biss il-bilanċ li jibqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净额结算；将相互应付的多笔款项合并计算，仅结清净余额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess finanzjarju li jgħaqqad u jpaċi l-obbligi ta' ħlas bejn il-partijiet biex jiġi stabbilit bilanċ nett wieħed jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Netting is a financial process in which payment obligations are combined and offset to establish the net amounts payable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 款项抵销；用一笔应收款抵减相应的应付款，以确定剩余金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-operazzjoni li biha ammont li għandu jitħallas jitnaqqas minn ammont dovut fid-direzzjoni opposta, biex jibqa' biss id-differenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Netting off involves deducting an amount owed in one direction from an amount owed in the opposite direction.

formal.mt: Skont il-ftehim ta' netting, il-kumpaniji għandhom jikkalkulaw l-ammonti dovuti lil xulxin u jħallsu biss il-bilanċ nett.
formal.en: Under the netting agreement, the companies must calculate the amounts they owe each other and pay only the net balance.
formal.zh: 根据净额结算协议，各公司须计算彼此应付的款项，并仅支付净余额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Aħna għandna nħallsuhom mitt ewro, u huma għandhom iħallsuna sittin. Kemm se nħallsu wara n-netting? David: Erbgħin ewro, għax innaqqsu s-sittin mill-mija.
colloquial.en: Lara: We owe them one hundred euros, and they owe us sixty. How much will we pay after netting? David: Forty euros, because we subtract sixty from one hundred.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们欠他们一百欧元，他们欠我们六十欧元。抵销后我们要付多少？David：四十欧元，因为用一百减去六十。

messages.speaker: Lara (会计助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna għandna nħallsuhom mitt ewro, u huma għandhom iħallsuna sittin. Kemm se nħallsu wara n-netting?
messages.mt_standard: Aħna għandna nħallsuhom mitt ewro, u huma għandhom iħallsuna sittin. Kemm se nħallsu wara n-netting?
messages.zh: 我们欠他们一百欧元，他们欠我们六十欧元。抵销后我们要付多少？
messages.en: We owe them one hundred euros, and they owe us sixty. How much will we pay after netting?

messages.speaker: David (会计师)
messages.mt_spoken: Erbgħin ewro, għax innaqqsu s-sittin mill-mija.
messages.mt_standard: Erbgħin ewro, għax innaqqsu s-sittin mill-mija.
messages.zh: 四十欧元，因为用一百减去六十。
messages.en: Forty euros, because we subtract sixty from one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“我欠你一百，你欠我六十，最后只付四十”的算式记住 netting：先抵销往来款，再支付净余额。这是情景记忆法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Netting is the calculation and offsetting of reciprocal payment obligations to leave a net balance for settlement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指计算并抵销双方或多方之间相互应付的款项，留下用于结算的净余额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kalkolu u t-tpaċija tal-ammonti li żewġ partijiet jew aktar għandhom iħallsu lil xulxin, biex jibqa' bilanċ nett għall-ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净额结算；合并并抵销相互付款义务，再按剩余净额结算的过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih obbligi ta' ħlas bejn il-partijiet jiġu kkalkulati u paċuti flimkien sabiex jitħallas il-bilanċ nett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Netting allows parties to combine their mutual payment obligations and settle the balance remaining after these obligations are offset.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 款项抵销；将方向相反的应收与应付款相互抵减，仅留下差额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tnaqqis ta' ammont dovut lil parti mill-ammont li dik il-parti għandha tħallas lill-parti l-oħra, biex tiġi stabbilita d-differenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Netting off is the act of offsetting reciprocal amounts so that only the difference remains to be paid.

formal.mt: Wara n-nettjar tal-ammonti dovuti bejn iż-żewġ kumpaniji, il-bilanċ li għandu jitħallas huwa ta' ħamsin ewro.
formal.en: After netting the amounts owed between the two companies, the balance payable is fifty euros.
formal.zh: 两家公司之间的应付款项相互抵销后，尚需支付的余额为五十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għandna żewġ ammonti: mitejn ewro li rridu nħallsu u mija u ħamsin li rridu nirċievu. Nagħmlu n-nettjar? Simon: Iva, hekk inħallsu biss ħamsin ewro u nniżżlu l-kalkolu fir-reġistru.
colloquial.en: Rita: We have two amounts: two hundred euros to pay and one hundred and fifty to receive. Shall we net them off? Simon: Yes, then we pay only fifty euros and enter the calculation in the register.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我们有两笔款：要付两百欧元，要收一百五十欧元。把它们抵销吗？Simon：好，这样只需付五十欧元，并把计算结果记入登记簿。

messages.speaker: Rita (财务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna żewġ ammonti: mitejn ewro li rridu nħallsu u mija u ħamsin li rridu nirċievu. Nagħmlu n-nettjar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna żewġ ammonti: mitejn ewro li rridu nħallsu u mija u ħamsin li rridu nirċievu. Nagħmlu n-nettjar?
messages.zh: 我们有两笔款：要付两百欧元，要收一百五十欧元。把它们抵销吗？
messages.en: We have two amounts: two hundred euros to pay and one hundred and fifty to receive. Shall we net them off?

messages.speaker: Simon (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk inħallsu biss ħamsin ewro u nniżżlu l-kalkolu fir-reġistru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk inħallsu biss ħamsin ewro u nniżżlu l-kalkolu fir-reġistru.
messages.zh: 好，这样只需付五十欧元，并把计算结果记入登记簿。
messages.en: Yes, then we pay only fifty euros and enter the calculation in the register.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nettjar 配上“应付二百减应收一百五十，剩五十”的账本图；再朗读 nagħmlu n-nettjar，记住“进行款项抵销”这一用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A network is a group of connected people, devices, or other elements that communicate or work together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由相互连接、能够交流或协同运作的人、设备或其他要素组成的网络。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Netwerk huwa grupp ta' persuni, apparati jew elementi oħra konnessi ma' xulxin biex jikkomunikaw jew jaħdmu flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由相互联系的人、设备或其他要素构成的网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni, apparati jew elementi oħra li huma konnessi ma' xulxin u jistgħu jikkomunikaw jew jaħdmu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A network is a set of connected people or things that exchange information or function together.

formal.mt: Il-kompjuters kollha tal-iskola huma konnessi ma' netwerk wieħed biex l-għalliema jkunu jistgħu jaqsmu r-riżorsi.
formal.en: All the school's computers are connected to one network so that teachers can share resources.
formal.zh: 学校的所有计算机都连接到同一个网络，方便教师共享资源。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kompjuter tiegħi mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk. Pawlu: Ipprova erġa' qabbdu; tiegħi qed jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Lara: My computer isn't connecting to the network. Pawlu: Try connecting it again; mine is working.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我的电脑连不上网络。Pawlu：试着重新连接一下，我的能用。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kompjuter tiegħi mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kompjuter tiegħi mhux qed jaqbad man-netwerk.
messages.zh: 我的电脑连不上网络。
messages.en: My computer isn't connecting to the network.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova erġa' qabbdu; tiegħi qed jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova erġa' qabbdu; tiegħi qed jaħdem.
messages.zh: 试着重新连接一下，我的能用。
messages.en: Try connecting it again; mine is working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 netwerk 想成一张连接图：圆点可以是电脑，也可以是人；抓住“彼此连接”就能记住“网络”的核心义。

gloss_zh: 分配网络；配送网络；配电网；分配系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distribution network is a connected system that carries electricity, goods, or other supplies to users or destinations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把电力、货物或其他供应物输送至用户或目的地的相互连接的网络；在电力语境中指配电网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni huwa sistema ta' konnessjonijiet li twassal l-elettriku, il-prodotti jew provvisti oħra lill-utenti jew lejn id-destinazzjonijiet tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 配电网；由线路和相关设备组成、向用户分配电力的电网。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' linji u tagħmir li jqassam l-elettriku u jwasslu lill-utenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution grid is a network of electrical lines and equipment that delivers electricity to users.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分配网络；将货物、电力或其他供应物送往不同用户或目的地的网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' konnessjonijiet jew rotot li permezz tagħhom jitwasslu prodotti, elettriku jew provvisti oħra lil diversi utenti jew destinazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution network is a set of connected routes or facilities through which supplies reach their users.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分配系统；配合运作以完成物资或能源分配的设施及安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' faċilitajiet u arranġamenti li jaħdmu flimkien biex iqassmu prodotti, enerġija jew provvisti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A distribution system consists of the facilities and arrangements used to deliver goods or energy to users.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi titjib fin-netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni tal-elettriku biex il-provvista lill-irħula tkun aktar affidabbli.
formal.en: The report proposes improvements to the electricity distribution network to make the supply to villages more reliable.
formal.zh: 报告建议改善配电网，使各村庄的电力供应更加可靠。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-ħanut għadu ma rċeviex l-ordni? David: Hemm dewmien fin-netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni; il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why hasn't the shop received the order yet? David: There's a delay in the distribution network; the boxes are still in the warehouse.
colloquial.zh: Marija：商店怎么还没收到订货？David：配送网络出现了延误，箱子还在仓库里。

messages.speaker: Marija (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-ħanut għadu ma rċeviex l-ordni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-ħanut għadu ma rċeviex l-ordni?
messages.zh: 商店怎么还没收到订货？
messages.en: Why hasn't the shop received the order yet?

messages.speaker: David (配送协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm dewmien fin-netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni; il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm dewmien fin-netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni; il-kaxxi għadhom fil-maħżen.
messages.zh: 配送网络出现了延误，箱子还在仓库里。
messages.en: There's a delay in the distribution network; the boxes are still in the warehouse.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“网络＋分配”分块记忆 netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni：想象从一个供应点向多个接收点画箭头；运电时是配电网，运货时是配送网络。

gloss_zh: 封闭式配电网；封闭式分配系统

teaching_sense.en_definition: A closed distribution network is a system that distributes electricity to a defined group of users within a particular area or site.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定区域或场所内，向范围明确的一组用户分配电力的封闭式网络。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq huwa sistema li tqassam l-elettriku lil grupp definit ta' utenti f'żona jew sit partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封闭式配电网；在限定区域内为特定用户群体配电的网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk li jqassam l-elettriku lil grupp speċifiku ta' utenti f'żona delimitata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closed distribution network delivers electricity to a defined group of users within a particular site or area.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 封闭式配电系统；在限定区域内为特定用户群体分配电力的设施体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema ta' linji u tagħmir li tqassam l-elettriku lil utenti speċifiċi fi ħdan żona delimitata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A closed distribution system comprises the facilities used to supply electricity to specific users within a defined area.

collocations.en: operator of a closed distribution network

collocations.mt: utenti ta' netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq
collocations.en: users of a closed distribution network

collocations.mt: netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq f'sit industrijali
collocations.en: closed distribution network at an industrial site
collocations.zh: 工业场所内的封闭式配电网

formal.mt: Il-pjan jiddeskrivi netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq li jwassal l-elettriku lill-binjiet kollha fis-sit industrijali.
formal.en: The plan describes a closed distribution network that supplies electricity to all the buildings at the industrial site.
formal.zh: 该方案描述了一个向工业场所内所有建筑供电的封闭式配电网。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dawn il-binjiet kollha jieħdu l-elettriku mill-istess netwerk? Ġorġ: Iva, għandhom netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq għas-sit kollu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do all these buildings get electricity from the same network? Ġorġ: Yes, they have a closed distribution network for the whole site.
colloquial.zh: Anna：这些建筑都从同一个网络取电吗？Ġorġ：对，整个场所共用一个封闭式配电网。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)

messages.mt_standard: Dawn il-binjiet kollha jieħdu l-elettriku mill-istess netwerk?
messages.zh: 这些建筑都从同一个网络取电吗？

messages.zh: 对，整个场所共用一个封闭式配电网。
messages.en: Yes, they have a closed distribution network for the whole site.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在“配电网络”的图外画一个场所边框，用 magħluq 提醒自己“封闭、范围限定”；这里记的是服务范围，不要把图画成环就当作词义。

exact_key: netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni
gloss_zh: 接入输电网的封闭式配电网

teaching_sense.en_definition: A transmission connected closed distribution network is a closed electricity distribution network that is connected to the transmission system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与输电系统连接，并在特定区域内向限定用户群体分配电力的封闭式配电网。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni huwa netwerk li jqassam l-elettriku lil grupp definit ta' utenti f'żona partikolari u huwa konness mas-sistema tat-trażmissjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接入输电网的封闭式配电网；与输电系统连接、为限定区域内特定用户配电的网络。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Netwerk magħluq għad-distribuzzjoni tal-elettriku lil utenti speċifiċi f'żona delimitata, li għandu konnessjoni mas-sistema tat-trażmissjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transmission connected closed distribution network supplies a defined group of electricity users and has a connection to the transmission system.

collocations.mt: operatur ta' netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni
collocations.en: operator of a transmission connected closed distribution network
collocations.zh: 接入输电网的封闭式配电网运营方

collocations.mt: punt ta' konnessjoni ta' netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni
collocations.en: connection point of a transmission connected closed distribution network
collocations.zh: 接入输电网的封闭式配电网的连接点

collocations.mt: tħaddim ta' netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni
collocations.en: operation of a transmission connected closed distribution network
collocations.zh: 接入输电网的封闭式配电网的运行

formal.mt: Id-dokument tekniku juri l-punt fejn netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni jirċievi l-elettriku biex iqassmu lill-utenti tas-sit.
formal.en: The technical document shows the point where a transmission connected closed distribution network receives electricity for distribution to the site's users.
formal.zh: 技术文件标明了接入输电网的封闭式配电网接收电力、再向场所内用户配电的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan in-netwerk tas-sit hu konness mas-sistema tat-trażmissjoni? Mark: Iva, huwa netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni; minn hawn l-elettriku jitqassam lill-binjiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this site's network connected to the transmission system? Mark: Yes, it's a transmission connected closed distribution network; electricity is distributed to the buildings from here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个场所的网络接入输电系统了吗？Mark：对，这是接入输电网的封闭式配电网，电力从这里分配到各栋建筑。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan in-netwerk tas-sit hu konness mas-sistema tat-trażmissjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Dan in-netwerk tas-sit hu konness mas-sistema tat-trażmissjoni?
messages.zh: 这个场所的网络接入输电系统了吗？
messages.en: Is this site's network connected to the transmission system?

messages.speaker: Mark (电气工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni; minn hawn l-elettriku jitqassam lill-binjiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa netwerk ta' distribuzzjoni magħluq konness mat-trażmissjoni; minn hawn l-elettriku jitqassam lill-binjiet.
messages.zh: 对，这是接入输电网的封闭式配电网，电力从这里分配到各栋建筑。
messages.en: Yes, it's a transmission connected closed distribution network; electricity is distributed to the buildings from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按四块记忆：netwerk“网络”、ta' distribuzzjoni“用于分配”、magħluq“封闭式”、konness mat-trażmissjoni“连接输电系统”。脑中画“输电网→场所内配电网→用户”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a rounded edible root, used in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种根部通常呈圆形、可作为蔬菜烹调食用的植物；也指其可食用的根，即芜菁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'għerq tond li jittiekel u li jintuża fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芜菁；一种根部通常呈圆形、可供食用的根菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li titkabbar għall-għerq tond tagħha, li jista' jittiekel jew jintuża f'diversi platti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A turnip is a vegetable grown for its rounded edible root, which can be used in soups and other dishes.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, qaxxar in-nevew, aqtagħh f'biċċiet żgħar u żidu mas-soppa.
formal.en: For this recipe, peel the turnip, cut it into small pieces and add it to the soup.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，将芜菁去皮、切成小块，再加入汤中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nżidu mas-soppa llum? Toni: Għandna nevew fil-friġġ. Nistgħu nqattgħuh u nżiduh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we add to the soup today? Toni: We have a turnip in the fridge. We can chop it up and add it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今天往汤里加点什么？托尼：冰箱里有个芜菁，我们可以把它切碎加进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nżidu mas-soppa llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nżidu mas-soppa llum?
messages.zh: 今天往汤里加点什么？
messages.en: What shall we add to the soup today?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nevew fil-friġġ. Nistgħu nqattgħuh u nżiduh.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nevew fil-friġġ. Nistgħu nqattgħuh u nżiduh.
messages.zh: 冰箱里有个芜菁，我们可以把它切碎加进去。
messages.en: We have a turnip in the fridge. We can chop it up and add it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nevew 和一颗圆圆的芜菁配成图片，再连读 soppa tan-nevew“芜菁汤”，用食材与菜名一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Excessively anxious or worried, often about relatively minor matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人容易过度焦虑、紧张，常对较小的事情也反复担忧，即神经质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jinkwieta żżejjed u jħoss tensjoni, anki dwar affarijiet żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神经质的；容易表现出过度焦虑、紧张或反复担忧的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu tendenza jinkwieta b'mod eċċessiv u jħoss ansjetà jew tensjoni, kultant anki mingħajr raġuni qawwija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is neurotic tends to become excessively anxious or worried, sometimes about matters that other people consider minor.

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-karattru ewlieni huwa deskritt bħala newrotiku għax jinkwieta kontinwament dwar kull żball żgħir.
formal.en: In the novel, the main character is described as neurotic because he constantly worries about every small mistake.
formal.zh: 在这部小说中，主人公被描写为神经质的人，因为他总是为每一个小错误忧心忡忡。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Erġajt iċċekkjajt il-biljetti. Qed insir newrotiku dwar dan il-vjaġġ! Lara: Il-biljetti qegħdin hemm. Ejja nieħdu kafè u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: I checked the tickets again. I'm getting neurotic about this trip! Lara: The tickets are there. Let's have a coffee and relax for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我又检查了一遍票。我为这次旅行都快变得神经质了！拉拉：票都在呢。我们喝杯咖啡，放松一下吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Erġajt iċċekkjajt il-biljetti. Qed insir newrotiku dwar dan il-vjaġġ!
messages.mt_standard: Erġajt iċċekkjajt il-biljetti. Qed insir newrotiku dwar dan il-vjaġġ!
messages.zh: 我又检查了一遍票。我为这次旅行都快变得神经质了！
messages.en: I checked the tickets again. I'm getting neurotic about this trip!

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-biljetti qegħdin hemm. Ejja nieħdu kafè u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Il-biljetti qegħdin hemm. Ejja nieħdu kafè u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 票都在呢。我们喝杯咖啡，放松一下吧。
messages.en: The tickets are there. Let's have a coffee and relax for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“出发前反复检查车票”的情景记 newrotiku：重点是过度担忧、神经紧绷，而不是普通的一次紧张。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Newton or to his scientific laws and theories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与牛顿本人或其科学定律、理论有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' Newton jew mal-liġijiet u t-teoriji xjentifiċi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牛顿的；与牛顿提出的科学定律或理论有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għal Newton jew li huwa marbut mal-liġijiet u t-teoriji tiegħu, speċjalment fil-fiżika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Newtonian relates to Newton or follows the scientific laws and theories associated with his work.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, nużaw mudell newtonjan biex nikkalkulaw kif tinbidel il-veloċità ta' oġġett meta taġixxi forza fuqu.
formal.en: In this exercise, we use a Newtonian model to calculate how an object's velocity changes when a force acts on it.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，我们使用牛顿理论模型，计算物体受到力的作用时速度如何变化。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal din il-problema nużaw mudell newtonjan? Pawlu: Iva, nibdew bil-forzi li jaġixxu fuq il-ballun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we use a Newtonian model for this problem? Pawlu: Yes, we start with the forces acting on the ball.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这道题要用牛顿理论模型吗？保罗：对，我们先看作用在球上的力。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din il-problema nużaw mudell newtonjan?
messages.mt_standard: Għal din il-problema nużaw mudell newtonjan?
messages.zh: 这道题要用牛顿理论模型吗？
messages.en: Do we use a Newtonian model for this problem?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nibdew bil-forzi li jaġixxu fuq il-ballun.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nibdew bil-forzi li jaġixxu fuq il-ballun.
messages.zh: 对，我们先看作用在球上的力。
messages.en: Yes, we start with the forces acting on the ball.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 newtonjan 放进“用力分析小球运动”的课堂画面，再成组记 mudell newtonjan 和 mekkanika newtonjana，分别对应牛顿模型与牛顿力学。

gloss_zh: 中立的；不偏向任何一方的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not supporting or favouring either side in a disagreement or conflict.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在分歧、争论或冲突中不支持或偏袒任何一方的，即中立的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jappoġġjax u ma jiffavorixxi ebda naħa f'tilwima jew f'kunflitt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中立的；在争论或冲突中不站在任何一方、不偏袒任何一方的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jiħux naħa f'tilwima jew f'kunflitt u ma jagħtix preferenza lil xi parti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is neutral in a disagreement or conflict, they do not support or favour either side.

formal.mt: Il-medjatur għandu jibqa' newtrali u jagħti liż-żewġ naħat l-istess opportunità biex jesprimu l-fehmiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The mediator should remain neutral and give both sides an equal opportunity to express their views.
formal.zh: 调解员应当保持中立，给予双方同等的机会表达各自的观点。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int ma' min taqbel f'din it-tilwima? David: Se nibqa' newtrali sakemm nisma' liż-żewġ naħat.
colloquial.en: Nina: Whose side are you on in this argument? David: I'll remain neutral until I've heard both sides.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这场争论你站在哪一边？戴维：在听完双方的说法之前，我会保持中立。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int ma' min taqbel f'din it-tilwima?
messages.mt_standard: Int ma' min taqbel f'din it-tilwima?
messages.zh: 这场争论你站在哪一边？
messages.en: Whose side are you on in this argument?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nibqa' newtrali sakemm nisma' liż-żewġ naħat.
messages.mt_standard: Se nibqa' newtrali sakemm nisma' liż-żewġ naħat.
messages.zh: 在听完双方的说法之前，我会保持中立。
messages.en: I'll remain neutral until I've heard both sides.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象争论双方分坐左右，你站在中间认真听取双方意见：这个“暂不站队”的画面帮助记住 newtrali“中立的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take weapons away from a person or group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拿走某人或某个群体的武器，使其解除武装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa l-armi mingħand persuna jew grupp biex dawn ma jibqgħux armati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解除某人或某个群体的武装，拿走其持有的武器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Neħħa l-armi minn idejn persuna jew grupp sabiex ma jkunux jistgħu jibqgħu jużawhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone disarms a person or group, they take away that person's or group's weapons.

formal.mt: Wara li l-aggressur ċeda, l-uffiċjal neħħa l-armi minn idejh u żgura li ħadd ma kien fil-periklu.
formal.en: After the attacker surrendered, the officer disarmed him and made sure that nobody was in danger.
formal.zh: 袭击者投降后，警官解除了他的武装，并确认没有人处于危险之中。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fil-film, min neħħa l-armi minn idejn il-ħalliel? Toni: Il-pulizija li wasal l-ewwel. Imbagħad il-ħalliel ċeda.
colloquial.en: Lara: In the film, who disarmed the thief? Toni: The police officer who arrived first. Then the thief surrendered.
colloquial.zh: Lara：电影里是谁解除了那个窃贼的武装？Toni：最先赶到的警察。后来那个窃贼就投降了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-film, min neħħa l-armi minn idejn il-ħalliel?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-film, min neħħa l-armi minn idejn il-ħalliel?
messages.zh: 电影里是谁解除了那个窃贼的武装？
messages.en: In the film, who disarmed the thief?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pulizija li wasal l-ewwel. Imbagħad il-ħalliel ċeda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pulizija li wasal l-ewwel. Imbagħad il-ħalliel ċeda.
messages.zh: 最先赶到的警察。后来那个窃贼就投降了。
messages.en: The police officer who arrived first. Then the thief surrendered.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语配上“武器被拿走，持械者空手”的画面，整块记成“解除武装”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove a mask or reveal someone's concealed identity or true character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摘下面具；也可比喻揭露某人隐藏的身份或真实面目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa maskra minn fuq wiċċ, jew kixef l-identità moħbija jew il-karattru veru ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摘去面具，或揭露某人掩藏的身份、真实面目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Neħħa maskra li kienet tgħatti wiċċ, jew wera min kienet tassew persuna jew x'kienet qed taħbi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone unmasks a person, they remove that person's mask or reveal their hidden identity or true character.

collocations.en: removed the mask from his face
collocations.zh: 摘下了自己脸上的面具

formal.mt: Ir-rapport neħħa l-maskra tal-qarrieq billi ppubblika dokumenti li kixfu l-identità vera tiegħu.
formal.en: The report unmasked the deceiver by publishing documents that revealed his true identity.
formal.zh: 这份报告公布了揭示其真实身份的文件，从而揭穿了骗子的真面目。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Meta ndunajt li kien ħuk taħt il-kostum? Ben: Meta neħħa l-maskra minn fuq wiċċu. Sa dak il-ħin ma għaraftux!
colloquial.en: Nina: When did you realize it was your brother in the costume? Ben: When he took the mask off his face. Until then, I hadn't recognized him!
colloquial.zh: Nina：你什么时候发现穿着那身装扮的是你兄弟？Ben：他摘下面具的时候。在那之前我都没认出他！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ndunajt li kien ħuk taħt il-kostum?
messages.mt_standard: Meta ndunajt li kien ħuk taħt il-kostum?
messages.zh: 你什么时候发现穿着那身装扮的是你兄弟？
messages.en: When did you realize it was your brother in the costume?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta neħħa l-maskra minn fuq wiċċu. Sa dak il-ħin ma għaraftux!
messages.mt_standard: Meta neħħa l-maskra minn fuq wiċċu. Sa dak il-ħin ma għaraftux!
messages.zh: 他摘下面具的时候。在那之前我都没认出他！
messages.en: When he took the mask off his face. Until then, I hadn't recognized him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想“摘下面具露出脸”，再联想“揭露隐藏身份”，用同一画面连接字面义和比喻义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To uncover something by removing the veil or covering over it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 移去遮盖某物的面纱或盖布，使其显露出来，尤其指为雕像或纪念物揭幕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikxef xi ħaġa billi jneħħi l-velu jew id-drapp li jkun jgħattiha, speċjalment waqt ċerimonja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揭去覆盖物，使某物显露出来；为雕像或纪念物揭幕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ineħħi l-velu jew il-kisi minn fuq oġġett biex ikun jista' jidher, ħafna drabi waqt ċerimonja uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone unveils an object, they remove its covering so that people can see it.

formal.mt: Matul iċ-ċerimonja, is-sindku neħħa l-velu minn fuq il-monument il-ġdid.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the mayor unveiled the new monument.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，市长为新纪念碑揭幕。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min neħħa l-velu minn fuq l-istatwa? Mark: Is-sindku; jien kont hemm meta kixifha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who unveiled the statue? Mark: The mayor; I was there when he uncovered it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁为雕像揭幕的？马克：市长；他揭开盖布时我就在现场。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min neħħa l-velu minn fuq l-istatwa?
messages.mt_standard: Min neħħa l-velu minn fuq l-istatwa?
messages.zh: 谁为雕像揭幕的？
messages.en: Who unveiled the statue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sindku; jien kont hemm meta kixifha.
messages.mt_standard: Is-sindku; jien kont hemm meta kixifha.
messages.zh: 市长；他揭开盖布时我就在现场。
messages.en: The mayor; I was there when he uncovered it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象揭幕仪式上盖布被拉开、雕像显露的画面，把整个短语与“揭去遮盖、正式揭幕”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 脱去衣服；使裸露，去掉覆盖物

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove someone's clothing or remove something that covers a person or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 脱去某人的衣服，或去掉人或物表面的覆盖物，使其裸露。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Neħħa l-ħwejjeġ minn fuq xi ħadd jew neħħa dak li kien jgħatti persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱去某人的衣服，使其脱衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Neħħa l-ħwejjeġ minn fuq persuna, pereżempju biex tinħasel jew tiġi eżaminata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone disrobes a person, they remove that person's clothing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去掉覆盖物，使身体部位或物体表面裸露。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Neħħa dak li kien jgħatti parti tal-ġisem jew wiċċ ta' oġġett u ħallieh mikxuf.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone bares something, they remove its covering so that it becomes exposed.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent neżża driegħu sabiex l-infermier ikun jista' jeżamina l-ferita.
formal.en: The patient bared his arm so that the nurse could examine the wound.
formal.zh: 病人露出手臂，以便护士检查伤口。

colloquial.mt: Lena: Diġà neżżajt lit-tifel għall-banju? Adam: Iva, u ħejjejt ix-xugaman ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lena: Have you already undressed the boy for his bath? Adam: Yes, and I have prepared the towel too.
colloquial.zh: 莱娜：你已经给孩子脱好衣服，准备洗澡了吗？亚当：是的，毛巾也准备好了。

messages.speaker: Lena (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà neżżajt lit-tifel għall-banju?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà neżżajt lit-tifel għall-banju?
messages.zh: 你已经给孩子脱好衣服，准备洗澡了吗？
messages.en: Have you already undressed the boy for his bath?

messages.speaker: Adam (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u ħejjejt ix-xugaman ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u ħejjejt ix-xugaman ukoll.
messages.zh: 是的，毛巾也准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, and I have prepared the towel too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面连成两步：给孩子脱衣、把手臂露出。neżża 的两个义项都围绕去掉覆盖物来记，不必另猜词源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ourselves, referring back to the people included in 'we' or 'us'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我们自己，回指包括说话者在内的复数人群，常用于反身表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pronom li jirreferi lura għalina bħala grupp li jinkludi lil min qed jitkellem, u jintuża f'espressjonijiet bħal 'lilna nfusna'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们自己；指包括说话者在内的我们自身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pronom li jfisser aħna stess u jirreferi lura għall-persuni inklużi f'aħna, bħal fl-espressjoni 'nieħdu ħsieb tagħna nfusna'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this pronoun to refer back to yourself and the other people included in 'we'.

collocations.zh: 我们自己，作动作的对象

formal.mt: Qabel nieħdu deċiżjoni, għandna nistaqsu lilna nfusna jekk għandniex biżżejjed informazzjoni.
formal.en: Before making a decision, we should ask ourselves whether we have enough information.
formal.zh: 作决定之前，我们应该问问自己是否掌握了足够的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed nitolbu wisq minna nfusna? Mark: Naħseb li iva. Ejja nieħdu pawża.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we asking too much of ourselves? Mark: I think so. Let's take a break.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们是不是对自己要求太高了？马克：我觉得是。我们休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitolbu wisq minna nfusna?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitolbu wisq minna nfusna?

messages.en: Are we asking too much of ourselves?

messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva. Ejja nieħdu pawża.
messages.zh: 我觉得是。我们休息一下吧。
messages.en: I think so. Let's take a break.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群人一起照镜子说“我们自己”。连着 lilna nfusna 和 tagħna nfusna 记；英语通常对应 ourselves，保留的 ourself 是所给释义标签。

gloss_zh: 招募入伍；聘用，雇请提供服务

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recruit someone for military service or hire someone to provide a service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 招募某人服兵役，或聘请某人提供专业或其他服务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd fis-servizz militari jew qabbad lil xi ħadd biex jagħti servizz bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招募某人加入军队服役。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħħal lil xi ħadd fil-forzi armati biex iservi bħala suldat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an organization enlists someone, it recruits that person for military service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 聘请或雇用某人，约定由其提供服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qabbad persuna jew organizzazzjoni biex twettaq xogħol jew tagħti servizz bi ħlas skont ftehim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you contract someone's services, you arrange for them to do work for you.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ngaġġa traduttur biex iħejji verżjoni Ċiniża tar-rapport.
formal.en: The committee hired a translator to prepare a Chinese version of the report.
formal.zh: 委员会聘请了一名翻译，编制报告的中文版本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jsewwi s-saqaf? Pawlu: Missieri ngaġġa bennej. Se jiġi għada filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to repair the roof? Pawlu: My father hired a builder. He is coming tomorrow morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁来修屋顶？保罗：我爸爸请了一位建筑工人。他明天早上来。

messages.speaker: Sara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jsewwi s-saqaf?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jsewwi s-saqaf?
messages.zh: 谁来修屋顶？
messages.en: Who is going to repair the roof?

messages.mt_spoken: Missieri ngaġġa bennej. Se jiġi għada filgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri ngaġġa bennej. Se jiġi għada filgħodu.
messages.zh: 我爸爸请了一位建筑工人。他明天早上来。
messages.en: My father hired a builder. He is coming tomorrow morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个招聘场景联记：军队招新兵、委员会请翻译。看到 ngaġġa 后接谁，就判断是招募服役还是聘请服务。

gloss_zh: Nghati（所给名词条目未说明具体词义）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun supplied as 'Nghati', with no further meaning specified in the packet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料中以 Nghati 形式给出的名词；材料未提供其具体含义，不能据此确定所指。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom mogħti fil-pakkett bħala 'Nghati', mingħajr spjegazzjoni tat-tifsira jew ta' dak li jirreferi għalih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Nghati；所给释义仅重复该形式，未提供可确定的中文词义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom li l-unika tifsira mogħtija għalih fil-pakkett hija l-istess forma 'Nghati'; il-pakkett ma jispeċifikax x'ifisser.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun is supplied as 'Nghati', but the packet does not explain what it denotes.

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jelenka 'Nghati' bħala nom, iżda ma jagħtix definizzjoni li tispjega t-tifsira tiegħu.
formal.en: The packet lists 'Nghati' as a noun but provides no definition explaining its meaning.
formal.zh: 材料将“Nghati”列为名词，但没有提供解释其含义的定义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Nghati' hawn? Lara: Il-pakkett ma jispjegahiex. Nafu biss li hi mniżżla bħala nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'Nghati' mean here? Lara: The packet does not explain it. We only know that it is listed as a noun.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里“Nghati”这个词是什么意思？拉拉：材料没有解释。我们只知道它被列为名词。

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'Nghati' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里“Nghati”这个词是什么意思？

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone information by speaking or writing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说话或书写，把信息告诉某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd bil-kliem jew bil-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诉某人某件事；向某人传达信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa permezz tal-kliem jew tal-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tell someone something, you give them information about it.

formal.mt: Nixtieq ngħid lill-parteċipanti li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa.
formal.en: I would like to tell the participants that the meeting starts at nine.
formal.zh: 我想告知各位参与者，会议九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tgħid lil Mark? Lara: Se ngħidlu li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What will you tell Mark? Lara: I'll tell him that the meeting starts at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你会告诉马克什么？拉拉：我会告诉他，会议九点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se tgħid lil Mark?
messages.mt_standard: X'se tgħid lil Mark?
messages.zh: 你会告诉马克什么？
messages.en: What will you tell Mark?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ngħidlu li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Se ngħidlu li l-laqgħa tibda fid-disgħa.
messages.zh: 我会告诉他，会议九点开始。
messages.en: I'll tell him that the meeting starts at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条 nghid 与例句中的 ngħid 联系起来，想象自己开口“告诉”朋友一件事，再用 ngħid il-verità 记住“我说实话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large bird with a long neck and long legs that cannot fly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种脖子和腿都很长、不能飞行的大型鸟，即鸵鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir b'għonq twil u saqajn twal li ma jistax itir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鸵鸟，一种长颈、长腿而不能飞行的大型鸟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għasfur ta' daqs kbir li għandu għonq twil u saqajn twal u ma jistax itir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ostrich is a large bird with a long neck and long legs that cannot fly.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw ngħama u ddeskrivew l-għonq twil tagħha.
formal.en: The students observed an ostrich and described its long neck.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一只鸵鸟，并描述了它长长的脖子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik ngħama? Lara: Iva, ara kemm għandha għonq twil!
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that an ostrich? Lara: Yes, look how long its neck is!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那是鸵鸟吗？拉拉：是呀，看它的脖子多长！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ngħama?
messages.mt_standard: Dik ngħama?
messages.zh: 那是鸵鸟吗？
messages.en: Is that an ostrich?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ara kemm għandha għonq twil!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ara kemm għandha għonq twil!
messages.zh: 是呀，看它的脖子多长！
messages.en: Yes, look how long its neck is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ngħama 写在一只长脖子鸵鸟的图旁，再配上 bajda ta' ngħama“鸵鸟蛋”，用动物和蛋的画面一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 词包标为 għaqad 的复数祈使形式

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form presented in the supplied entry as the plural imperative of għaqad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所给词条标为 għaqad 的复数祈使形式，用于面向多人的命令；词包未提供该动词的具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali ppreżentata fl-entrata mogħtija bħala l-imperattiv fil-plural ta' għaqad, jiġifieri kmand indirizzat lil aktar minn persuna waħda; it-tifsira tal-verb mhijiex mogħtija.

sense_translations.en_definition: Plural imperative of għaqad. The ħ is missing from the għ in parts of the conjugation.
sense_translations.zh_definition: għaqad 的复数祈使形式。原说明还称：在部分变位中，għ 中的 ħ 缺失。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-imperattiv fil-plural ta' għaqad. Skont id-deskrizzjoni mogħtija, il-ħ tonqos mill-għ f'xi partijiet tal-konjugazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied entry identifies this as the plural imperative of għaqad and states that ħ is absent from għ in some conjugated forms.

formal.mt: L-entrata tippreżenta 'ngħaqdu' bħala l-imperattiv fil-plural ta' għaqad u tinkludi nota dwar il-ħ f'xi partijiet tal-konjugazzjoni.
formal.en: The entry presents 'ngħaqdu' as the plural imperative of għaqad and includes a note about ħ in some parts of the conjugation.
formal.zh: 该词条将“ngħaqdu”列为 għaqad 的复数祈使形式，并附有关于部分变位中 ħ 的说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tikklassifika 'ngħaqdu' din l-entrata? Lara: Bħala imperattiv fil-plural, jiġifieri kmand lil aktar minn persuna waħda.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does this entry classify 'ngħaqdu'? Lara: As a plural imperative, meaning a command to more than one person.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个词条把“ngħaqdu”归为什么形式？拉拉：复数祈使形式，也就是对不止一个人发出的命令。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of giving something to another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给予他人某物的行为；本词条按名词义理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li bih persuna tagħti xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予；把某物交给他人的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tagħti xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this entry, the noun refers to the act of giving something to another person.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'ngħati' hija trattata bħala nom li jirreferi għall-att li tagħti xi ħaġa lil persuna oħra.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'ngħati' is treated as a noun referring to the act of giving something to another person.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“ngħati”按名词处理，表示把某物给予他人的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif niftakar 'ngħati' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Mark: Aħseb fl-att li tagħti rigal lil ħabib.
colloquial.en: Maja: How can I remember 'ngħati' in this exercise? Mark: Think of the act of giving a present to a friend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个练习里的“ngħati”怎么记？Mark：想一想把礼物送给朋友这个行为。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)

messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar 'ngħati' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的名词义，想象双手递出礼物，把“ngħati”与“给予这个行为”一起记忆；这只是情景助记。

gloss_zh: 所给义项尚无法释义：名词项为 Zbzl，x 类项为 Qelż

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose supplied gloss, Zbzl, does not establish an identifiable meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按所给词包归为名词的条目；其释义仅为 Zbzl，现有信息不足以确定具体词义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata kklassifikata bħala nom, iżda t-tifsira mogħtija, Zbzl, ma tipprovdix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex jiġi stabbilit xi tfisser.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义为 Zbzl；所给材料不足以确定该名词义项的含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira oriġinali hija Zbzl, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija mhijiex biżżejjed biex jiġi stabbilit is-sens ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun sense is labelled Zbzl, but the supplied information does not establish what it means.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义为 Qelż，词性标记为 x；所给材料不足以确定其含义或具体词性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din it-tifsira għandha t-tikketta Qelż u l-kategorija x, iżda l-informazzjoni mogħtija ma tistabbilixxix it-tifsira jew kategorija grammatikali speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense is labelled Qelż and assigned the category x, leaving its meaning and specific grammatical category unresolved.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'Ngħaġġibhom' tinkludi t-tikketti Zbzl u Qelż, iżda dawn ma jipprovdux biżżejjed informazzjoni biex jiġu spjegati ż-żewġ tifsiriet.

formal.zh: “Ngħaġġibhom”词条包含 Zbzl 和 Qelż 两个标签，但它们提供的信息不足以解释这两个义项。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'Ngħaġġibhom' hawn? Lara: Ma nistgħux inkunu ċerti; għandna biss it-tikketti Zbzl u Qelż.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'Ngħaġġibhom' mean here? Lara: We can't be certain; we only have the labels Zbzl and Qelż.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“Ngħaġġibhom”在这里是什么意思？拉拉：还无法确定；我们只有 Zbzl 和 Qelż 这两个标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To laugh so much that tears come to your eyes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因笑得非常厉害而流出眼泪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tidħak tant li joħroġlok id-dmugħ minn għajnejk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 笑得流眼泪；因大笑而流泪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tidħak b'tali mod li d-daħk iġiblek id-dmugħ f'għajnejk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, someone laughs so much that tears come to their eyes.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'ngħoxa' tiddeskrivi li persuna tidħak tant li joħroġ id-dmugħ minn għajnejha.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'ngħoxa' describes a person laughing so much that tears come to their eyes.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“ngħoxa”描述一个人笑得眼泪都流出来的情形。

colloquial.mt: Sara: 'Ngħoxa' hawn tfisser li tkun imdejjaq? Pawlu: Le, hawn tfisser li tidħak tant li joħroġlok id-dmugħ!

colloquial.zh: Sara：这里的“ngħoxa”是说难过吗？Pawlu：不是，这里是说笑得眼泪都出来了！

messages.en: Does 'ngħoxa' mean being sad here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser li tidħak tant li joħroġlok id-dmugħ!
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser li tidħak tant li joħroġlok id-dmugħ!
messages.zh: 不是，这里是说笑得眼泪都出来了！
messages.en: No, here it means laughing so much that tears come to your eyes!

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的意思，想象听完笑话后边笑边擦眼泪，用“开心大笑加眼泪”的画面记住“ngħoxa”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular place or geographical area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个具体的地方或地理区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post partikolari jew żona ġeografika partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地方；具有一定地理范围的地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew żona li wieħed jista' jidentifika f'kuntest ġeografiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A locality is a particular place or area that people identify or refer to.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'nhawi' tirreferi għal post jew żona ġeografika li tista' tintwera fuq mappa.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'nhawi' refers to a place or geographical area that can be shown on a map.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“nhawi”指可以在地图上标示的地方或地理区域。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'nhawi'? Ben: Immaġina mappa u dawwar ċirku ma' żona waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: How can I remember the meaning of 'nhawi'? Ben: Imagine a map and draw a circle around one area.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“nhawi”的意思怎么记？Ben：想象一张地图，再把其中一个地区圈起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'nhawi'?
messages.mt_standard: Kif niftakar it-tifsira ta' 'nhawi'?
messages.zh: “nhawi”的意思怎么记？
messages.en: How can I remember the meaning of 'nhawi'?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Immaġina mappa u dawwar ċirku ma' żona waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Immaġina mappa u dawwar ċirku ma' żona waħda.
messages.zh: 想象一张地图，再把其中一个地区圈起来。
messages.en: Imagine a map and draw a circle around one area.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“nhawi”写在想象中的地图圆圈旁，将它和“圈出的这个地方、这片地区”联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be moving or travelling towards a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某个地方移动或行进；处于前往某处的过程中。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tkun miexi jew qed tivvjaġġa lejn xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 去；前往；正在向某处行进。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tkun fil-proċess li tmur minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this sense, someone is moving or travelling from one place towards another.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'nibaghtu' tirreferi għall-azzjoni ta' persuna li tkun sejra minn post għal ieħor.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'nibaghtu' refers to the action of a person going from one place to another.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“nibaghtu”指一个人从一个地方前往另一个地方的动作。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'immaġni nuża biex niftakar 'nibaghtu' hawn? Adam: Aħseb fik innifsek miexi lejn l-iskola; int fi triqtek hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: What picture can I use to remember 'nibaghtu' here? Adam: Think of yourself walking towards school; you are on your way there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里的“nibaghtu”可以用什么画面来记？Adam：想象自己正走向学校，已经在去那里的路上。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'immaġni nuża biex niftakar 'nibaghtu' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: X'immaġni nuża biex niftakar 'nibaghtu' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“nibaghtu”可以用什么画面来记？
messages.en: What picture can I use to remember 'nibaghtu' here?

messages.speaker: Adam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb fik innifsek miexi lejn l-iskola; int fi triqtek hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb fik innifsek miexi lejn l-iskola; int fi triqtek hemm.
messages.zh: 想象自己正走向学校，已经在去那里的路上。
messages.en: Think of yourself walking towards school; you are on your way there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条给出的意思，想象脚步沿着箭头走向学校，把“nibaghtu”与“正在前往”的动态画面一起记住。

gloss_zh: 变形者；能改变外形的角色

teaching_sense.en_definition: A being in a story that can change its physical form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 故事中能够改变自身外形，变成其他人物、动物或形态的角色。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa fi storja li tista' tbiddel id-dehra tagħha u tieħu s-sura ta' persuna, annimal jew ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变形者，指故事中能够改变自身外形的角色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlejqa immaġinarja li għandha l-ħila tbiddel is-sura ta' ġisimha u tidher bħala xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shapeshifter is an imaginary being that can change its body into different physical forms.

formal.mt: Fil-ħrafa, il-karattru 'nibdel il- forhom' jieħu s-sura ta' għasfur biex jaħrab mill-kastell.
formal.en: In the tale, the shapeshifter character takes the form of a bird to escape from the castle.
formal.zh: 在这个传说中，变形者角色化身为鸟，从城堡逃走。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-karattru? Leo: Huwa 'nibdel il- forhom'; issa jidher bħala bniedem, imma wara jinbidel f'lupu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that character? Leo: He is a shapeshifter; he looks human now, but later he turns into a wolf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那个角色是谁？利奥：他是变形者；现在看起来是人，之后却会变成狼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-karattru?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-karattru?
messages.zh: 那个角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa 'nibdel il- forhom'; issa jidher bħala bniedem, imma wara jinbidel f'lupu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa 'nibdel il- forhom'; issa jidher bħala bniedem, imma wara jinbidel f'lupu.
messages.zh: 他是变形者；现在看起来是人，之后却会变成狼。
messages.en: He is a shapeshifter; he looks human now, but later he turns into a wolf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词条与“故事角色先变鸟、再变狼”的连续画面配对记忆，抓住“能改变自身外形的人物”这个名词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel afraid because something seems dangerous or frightening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因某事物令人恐惧或似乎有危险而感到害怕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħoss biża' minħabba xi ħaġa li tidher perikoluża jew li tbeżżgħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 害怕，指因感到危险或受到惊吓而产生恐惧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħoss biża' meta tiffaċċja xi ħaġa li tbeżżgħek jew taħseb li tista' tagħmillek il-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you feel scared, you experience fear because something seems threatening or frightening.

collocations.en: I am afraid of the dark

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont tiegħi ktibt: 'Meta nkun waħdi fid-dlam, nibza u nfittex id-dawl.'
formal.en: In my account I wrote: 'When I am alone in the dark, I feel afraid and look for a light.'
formal.zh: 我在自己的叙述中写道：“当我独自处于黑暗中时，我感到害怕，并寻找亮光。”

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma tridx tidħol? Mark: Nibza mill-kelb. Tista' tidħol miegħi?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why don't you want to go in? Mark: I am afraid of the dog. Can you go in with me?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么不想进去？马克：我怕那只狗。你能陪我进去吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma tridx tidħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma tridx tidħol?

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lump of dried or thick mucus in the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻腔内由鼻涕变稠或干结形成的小块分泌物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żgħira ta' mukus oħxon jew niexef li tinġabar ġewwa l-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼻屎，指鼻腔内凝结或干结成小块的鼻涕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa mukus li tkun ħxienet jew nixfet u baqgħet ġewwa l-imnieħer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A booger is a small piece of thick or dried mucus found inside the nose.

collocations.en: to remove a booger from his nose
collocations.zh: 从他的鼻子里清除一块鼻屎

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel uża maktur biex ineħħi nifel minn imnieħru qabel daħal fil-klassi.
formal.en: In the account, the boy used a handkerchief to remove a booger from his nose before entering the classroom.
formal.zh: 在这段叙述中，男孩进教室前用手帕清除了鼻子里的一块鼻屎。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Hemm xi ħaġa ma' mnieħri? Omm: Iva, hemm nifel. Ħu maktur u naddaf imnieħrek.
colloquial.en: Luca: Is there something on my nose? Mum: Yes, there is a booger. Take a handkerchief and clean your nose.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：我鼻子上有东西吗？妈妈：有，有一块鼻屎。拿块手帕擦擦鼻子。

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)

messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi ħaġa ma' mnieħri?
messages.zh: 我鼻子上有东西吗？
messages.en: Is there something on my nose?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm nifel. Ħu maktur u naddaf imnieħrek.
messages.zh: 有，有一块鼻屎。拿块手帕擦擦鼻子。

colloquial.en: Maja: 'Bigger' means greater in size, right? Mark: Yes, but we still need to clarify how 'niggo' is used and what the label 'part' means here.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To communicate information to someone, usually by speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说话等方式把信息告诉某人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħti informazzjoni lil xi ħadd, normalment billi tkellmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诉；向某人传达信息或说明事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa billi tagħtih informazzjoni jew tispjegalu x'ġara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you tell someone something, you communicate information to that person.

formal.mt: F'din l-ittra ngħidlek x'ġara waqt il-laqgħa u nispjega d-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: In this letter, I tell you what happened during the meeting and explain the final decision.
formal.zh: 在这封信中，我向你说明会议期间发生的事情，并解释最终决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf x'ġara lbieraħ? Pawlu: Le, għidli. Maja: Ngħidlek kollox wara l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know what happened yesterday? Pawlu: No, tell me. Maja: I'll tell you everything after lunch.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你知道昨天发生了什么吗？保罗：不知道，告诉我吧。玛雅：午饭后我把一切都告诉你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf x'ġara lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Taf x'ġara lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你知道昨天发生了什么吗？
messages.en: Do you know what happened yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għidli.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għidli.
messages.zh: 不知道，告诉我吧。
messages.en: No, tell me.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ngħidlek kollox wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Ngħidlek kollox wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 午饭后我把一切都告诉你。
messages.en: I'll tell you everything after lunch.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“告诉”联想到午饭后向朋友讲述昨天的事情，并搭配“真相”和“发生了什么”练习；输入键保留原样，例句使用规范形式 ngħidlek。

gloss_zh: 长大；成长；变大（所给名词标签与动词短语释义不一致）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Growth, understood as becoming larger or older; the supplied noun label conflicts with the verbal gloss 'to grow'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成长或变大的过程。资料将本条标为名词，却提供了表示“长大、成长”的动词短语释义，因此词性对应关系尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li wieħed jikber fid-daqs jew fl-età; il-pakkett jagħti t-tikketta ta' nom, iżda t-tifsira Ingliża 'to grow' hija verbali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长大；成长；变大。原资料标注为名词，但英文释义表达的是动作或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed jikber fid-daqs jew fl-età; din hija t-tifsira tal-frażi Ingliża mogħtija, għalkemm l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss describes becoming larger or older, although the entry is labelled as a noun.

formal.mt: L-entrata 'nikbar' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda tingħata t-tifsira Ingliża 'to grow'; għalhekk, ir-relazzjoni bejn it-tikketta u t-tifsira teħtieġ kjarifika.
formal.en: The entry 'nikbar' is labelled as a noun but is given the English gloss 'to grow'; the relationship between the label and the meaning therefore needs clarification.
formal.zh: 词条“nikbar”被标为名词，但其英文释义为“to grow”；因此，这一标签与释义之间的对应关系需要澄清。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'nikbar' f'din il-lista? Toni: Il-lista tagħti 'to grow', jiġifieri tikber fid-daqs jew fl-età. Lina: U għaliex hemm miktub nom? Toni: Dik it-tikketta teħtieġ kjarifika.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'nikbar' mean in this list? Toni: The list gives 'to grow', meaning to become larger or older. Lina: Then why does it say noun? Toni: That label needs clarification.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这份词表里的“nikbar”是什么意思？托尼：词表给的是“to grow”，也就是变大或长大。莉娜：那为什么写着名词？托尼：这个标签需要澄清。

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'nikbar' f'din il-lista?
messages.zh: 这份词表里的“nikbar”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nikbar' mean in this list?

messages.zh: 词表给的是“to grow”，也就是变大或长大。
messages.en: The list gives 'to grow', meaning to become larger or older.

messages.mt_standard: U għaliex hemm miktub nom?

messages.en: Then why does it say noun?

messages.mt_spoken: Dik it-tikketta teħtieġ kjarifika.
messages.mt_standard: Dik it-tikketta teħtieġ kjarifika.
messages.zh: 这个标签需要澄清。
messages.en: That label needs clarification.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“孩子一年年长大”的画面记住所给释义；另在卡片上注明“名词标签待澄清”，避免把资料中的词性矛盾记成语法规则。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a game or an activity for enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加游戏，或进行以娱乐为目的的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tieħu sehem f'logħba jew f'attività biex tieħu gost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玩；玩耍；参与游戏或娱乐活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel attività għad-divertiment jew tieħu sehem f'logħba waħdek jew ma' oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you play, you take part in a game or do something for enjoyment.

formal.mt: Kull nhar ta' Erbgħa nilgħab il-futbol mat-tim tal-iskola wara l-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: Every Wednesday, I play football with the school team after lessons.
formal.zh: 每周三放学后，我都和校队一起踢足球。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tħobb tagħmel wara l-iskola? Mark: Inħobb nilgħab il-futbol ma' sħabi. Sara: Nista' niġi magħkom illum? Mark: Żgur, niltaqgħu fil-park.
colloquial.en: Sara: What do you like doing after school? Mark: I like playing football with my friends. Sara: Can I come with you today? Mark: Of course, we'll meet in the park.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你放学后喜欢做什么？马克：我喜欢和朋友们踢足球。萨拉：今天我能和你们一起去吗？马克：当然，我们在公园见。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)

messages.mt_standard: Xi tħobb tagħmel wara l-iskola?
messages.zh: 你放学后喜欢做什么？
messages.en: What do you like doing after school?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħobb nilgħab il-futbol ma' sħabi.
messages.mt_standard: Inħobb nilgħab il-futbol ma' sħabi.
messages.zh: 我喜欢和朋友们踢足球。
messages.en: I like playing football with my friends.

messages.mt_spoken: Nista' niġi magħkom illum?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' niġi magħkom illum?
messages.zh: 今天我能和你们一起去吗？
messages.en: Can I come with you today?

messages.mt_standard: Żgur, niltaqgħu fil-park.
messages.zh: 当然，我们在公园见。
messages.en: Of course, we'll meet in the park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己放学后和朋友踢球，把 nilgħab 与“我玩、我参加游戏”连起来，再用 il-futbol 记住具体搭配；输入键保留 nilghab。

gloss_zh: 释义未明（资料仅提供标记 rGRG）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun entry whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied marker 'rGRG'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 资料标为名词的词条；其所给释义只有标记“rGRG”，无法据此确定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-marka mogħtija 'rGRG'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义无法确定；所给“rGRG”不足以支持可靠的中文词义翻译。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-marka 'rGRG' ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tkun tista' tiġi stabbilita t-tifsira ta' dan in-nom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied marker does not provide enough information to establish a meaning for this noun.

collocations.en: an example of the use of 'nillatika'

formal.mt: L-entrata 'nillatika' hija mmarkata bħala nom, iżda l-marka 'rGRG' ma tippermettix li tiġi stabbilita tifsira; hemm bżonn ta' definizzjoni ċara u eżempju tal-użu.
formal.en: The entry 'nillatika' is labelled as a noun, but the marker 'rGRG' does not establish a meaning; a clear definition and an example of use are needed.
formal.zh: 词条“nillatika”被标为名词，但标记“rGRG”无法确定其含义；需要清晰的定义和用法示例。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'nillatika'? David: Hawnhekk hemm biss il-marka 'rGRG', għalhekk it-tifsira mhijiex ċara. Nina: Nista' nagħtiha traduzzjoni? David: Aħjar tistenna definizzjoni ċara u eżempju.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'nillatika' mean? David: There is only the marker 'rGRG' here, so the meaning is unclear. Nina: Can I give it a translation? David: It is better to wait for a clear definition and an example.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“nillatika”是什么意思？戴维：这里只有标记“rGRG”，所以含义还不清楚。妮娜：我能给它写一个译义吗？戴维：最好等有了清楚的定义和例句再写。
