teaching_sense.en_definition: A fight or quarrel involving disagreement between people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人与人因意见不合而发生的争吵或争执。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlied jew tilwima bejn persuni li ma jaqblux dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 争吵；因意见不合而发生的争执。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġlied jew argument bejn persuni minħabba nuqqas ta' qbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fight is an angry disagreement in which people argue with one another.

formal.mt: Meta nillatikaw waqt laqgħa, nitilfu ħin li nistgħu nużaw biex insibu soluzzjoni.
formal.en: When we quarrel during a meeting, we lose time that we could use to find a solution.
formal.zh: 开会时争吵，会浪费本可用来寻找解决办法的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dejjem nillatikaw fuq affarijiet żgħar? Mark: Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma u nsibu soluzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we always quarrel about little things? Mark: Let's talk calmly and find a solution.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么总为小事争吵？Mark：我们平静地谈谈，找个解决办法吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dejjem nillatikaw fuq affarijiet żgħar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dejjem nillatikaw fuq affarijiet żgħar?
messages.zh: 我们为什么总为小事争吵？
messages.en: Why do we always quarrel about little things?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma u nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma u nsibu soluzzjoni.
messages.zh: 我们平静地谈谈，找个解决办法吧。
messages.en: Let's talk calmly and find a solution.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nillatikaw 放进“我们又为小事争吵”的场景中记忆，再搭配 bil-kalma“平静地”，形成争吵与平静交谈的画面对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression of longing for someone or something that is absent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达“我想念某人或某物”的说法，强调因其不在身边而产生的思念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li nħoss in-nuqqas ta' xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa li mhix miegħi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我想念某人或某物；我因其不在身边而感到缺憾。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha ngħid li nħoss in-nuqqas ta' persuna jew ħaġa u nixtieq li tkun miegħi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you say that you miss someone or something, you feel their absence and wish they were with you.

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħi lill-familja, ktibt li nimissja d-dar u l-ħin li konna nqattgħu flimkien.
formal.en: In my letter to my family, I wrote that I miss home and the time we used to spend together.
formal.zh: 在给家人的信中，我写道，我想念家，也怀念我们过去一起度过的时光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nimissja lil ħbiebi minn meta mort noqgħod hawn. Lara: Għaliex ma ċċemplilhomx illejla?
colloquial.en: Sara: I miss my friends since I moved here. Lara: Why don't you call them tonight?
colloquial.zh: Sara：搬到这里以后，我很想念朋友们。Lara：你今晚为什么不给他们打个电话呢？

messages.speaker: Sara (新邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nimissja lil ħbiebi minn meta mort noqgħod hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Nimissja lil ħbiebi minn meta mort noqgħod hawn.
messages.zh: 搬到这里以后，我很想念朋友们。
messages.en: I miss my friends since I moved here.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma ċċemplilhomx illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma ċċemplilhomx illejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚为什么不给他们打个电话呢？
messages.en: Why don't you call them tonight?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己搬到新地方，翻看朋友合照时说 nimissja lil ħbiebi。把整个短语与“我想念朋友们”的情绪一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: I produce the spoken sounds of a word or name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我把一个词或名字的语音读出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiena nlissen il-ħsejjes ta' kelma jew ta' isem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我读出某个词或名字；我发出其语音。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiena ngħid kelma jew isem billi nlissen il-ħsejjes tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When I pronounce a word, I say it using particular speech sounds.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami orali, nippronunzja kull kelma b'mod ċar sabiex l-eżaminatur jifhimni.
formal.en: During the oral examination, I pronounce every word clearly so that the examiner can understand me.
formal.zh: 口试时，我把每个词都读清楚，以便考官听懂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif nippronunzja ismek? Sean: Ismi Sean, u jingħad bħall-kelma Ingliża 'shawn'.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do I pronounce your name? Sean: My name is Sean, and it is said like the English word 'shawn'.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的名字怎么读？Sean：我叫 Sean，读起来像英语里的“shawn”。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nippronunzja ismek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nippronunzja ismek?
messages.zh: 你的名字怎么读？
messages.en: How do I pronounce your name?

messages.speaker: Sean (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ismi Sean, u jingħad bħall-kelma Ingliża 'shawn'.
messages.mt_standard: Ismi Sean, u jingħad bħall-kelma Ingliża 'shawn'.
messages.zh: 我叫 Sean，读起来像英语里的“shawn”。
messages.en: My name is Sean, and it is said like the English word 'shawn'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 nippronunzja 就想象自己指着生词开口朗读；反复练习 Kif nippronunzja…?“我该怎么读……？”，把词义和动作绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something again; this form means 'I repeat'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次说出或做出某事；这个形式表示“我重复”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nerġa' ngħid jew nagħmel xi ħaġa li diġà għedt jew għamilt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重复；再次说出或做出同一件事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tgħid jew tagħmel xi ħaġa mill-ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you repeat something, you say or do it again.

formal.mt: Biex niżgura li l-istruzzjonijiet huma ċari, nirrepeti l-punti ewlenin.
formal.en: To ensure that the instructions are clear, I repeat the main points.
formal.zh: 为了确保指示清楚，我再说一遍要点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma smajtx il-mistoqsija. Tista' tirrepetiha? Pawlu: Iva, nirrepetiha bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Lara: I didn't hear the question. Can you repeat it? Pawlu: Yes, I'll repeat it slowly.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我没听清问题，你能再说一遍吗？保罗：可以，我慢慢再说一遍。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma smajtx il-mistoqsija. Tista' tirrepetiha?
messages.mt_standard: Ma smajtx il-mistoqsija. Tista' tirrepetiha?
messages.zh: 我没听清问题，你能再说一遍吗？
messages.en: I didn't hear the question. Can you repeat it?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nirrepetiha bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nirrepetiha bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，我慢慢再说一遍。
messages.en: Yes, I'll repeat it slowly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nirrepeti 配上“我按下重播键”的画面，记住它表示“我重复”；练习时把同一句话说两遍。

gloss_zh: 我收到它们；我接收它们

teaching_sense.en_definition: I receive the previously mentioned things that are sent or given to me.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我收到或接收前面提到的多个物品，例如文件、信件或包裹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiena nieħu l-affarijiet li ssemmew qabel meta jintbagħtu jew jingħataw lili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我收到它们，指接收已经提到的多个物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiena nirċievi l-affarijiet imsemmija qabel mingħand min jibgħathom jew jagħtihomli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When I receive them, the things already mentioned are delivered or given to me.

formal.mt: Id-dokumenti jintbagħtu bil-posta elettronika, u nikkonferma li waslu hekk kif nirċevihom.
formal.en: The documents are sent by email, and I confirm their arrival as soon as I receive them.
formal.zh: 文件通过电子邮件发送，我一收到就确认收件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-pakketti jaslu għandek jew għand ommok? Mark: Nirċevihom għand ommi, għax tkun id-dar matul il-jum.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do the parcels arrive at your place or your mother's? Mark: I receive them at my mother's because she is home during the day.
colloquial.zh: Lara：包裹送到你家还是你妈妈家？Mark：我在妈妈家收，因为她白天在家。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakketti jaslu għandek jew għand ommok?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakketti jaslu għandek jew għand ommok?
messages.zh: 包裹送到你家还是你妈妈家？
messages.en: Do the parcels arrive at your place or your mother's?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nirċevihom għand ommi, għax tkun id-dar matul il-jum.
messages.mt_standard: Nirċevihom għand ommi, għax tkun id-dar matul il-jum.
messages.zh: 我在妈妈家收，因为她白天在家。
messages.en: I receive them at my mother's because she is home during the day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两份文件送到手中，说 nirċevihom“我收到它们”。记忆时同时指向那几份文件，提醒自己这个词已经包含“它们”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Adult female people; a plural noun meaning 'women'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成年女性；表示多位女性的复数名词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuni adulti tas-sess femminili; nom fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妇女；成年女性的复数称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuni adulti tas-sess femminili, imsemmija fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Women are adult female people, referred to in the plural.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-parteċipazzjoni tan-nisa fis-suq tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The report examines women's participation in the labour market.
formal.zh: 这份报告研究女性在劳动力市场中的参与情况。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jiġi għal-laqgħa? Rita: Grupp ta' nisa mill-viċinat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is coming to the meeting? Rita: A group of women from the neighbourhood.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁会来参加聚会？丽塔：附近的一群女性。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiġi għal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiġi għal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 谁会来参加聚会？
messages.en: Who is coming to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Grupp ta' nisa mill-viċinat.
messages.mt_standard: Grupp ta' nisa mill-viċinat.
messages.zh: 附近的一群女性。
messages.en: A group of women from the neighbourhood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 nisa，就想象几位成年女性一起聊天；用“几位”提醒自己这是复数，不是单独一人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pinch: a brief squeeze with the fingers, or a very small amount held between them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手指轻轻一捏，或指尖捏起的少量东西，如一撮盐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għafsa qasira bis-swaba', jew kwantità żgħira ħafna li taqbad bejn is-swaba', bħal ftit melħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一捏；也可指用指尖捏起的一撮少量东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għafsa bis-swaba', jew ammont żgħir ħafna li jista' jinqabad bejn is-swaba'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pinch is a brief squeeze with the fingers or a small amount held between them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一撮；指用指尖捏起的少量粉末或细粒物，如盐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità żgħira ħafna ta' sustanza bħal melħ jew bżar, li taqbad bejn is-swaba'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pinch of an ingredient is a very small amount that you hold between your fingertips.

formal.mt: Żid niskata melħ mat-taħlita u ħawwad sew.
formal.en: Add a pinch of salt to the mixture and stir well.
formal.zh: 往混合物中加入一撮盐，然后充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kemm melħ inżid? Anna: Żid niskata biss, imbagħad duq.
colloquial.en: Mark: How much salt should I add? Anna: Add just a pinch, then taste it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我要加多少盐？安娜：只加一撮，然后尝尝。

messages.speaker: Mark (学做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm melħ inżid?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm melħ inżid?
messages.zh: 我要加多少盐？
messages.en: How much salt should I add?

messages.speaker: Anna (教做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żid niskata biss, imbagħad duq.
messages.mt_standard: Żid niskata biss, imbagħad duq.
messages.zh: 只加一撮，然后尝尝。
messages.en: Add just a pinch, then taste it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读 niskata 时做拇指与食指捏盐的动作，把“一捏”和“一撮”连在一起，记住分量很少。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of peeping from behind a mat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从席子后面暗中窥看的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att ta' tħaris bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从席子后面偷偷窥看的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-att li tħares bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This refers to the act of peeping from behind a mat.

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-kelma 'nissajja' tindika l-att ta' tħaris bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.
formal.en: In this lesson, the word 'nissajja' denotes the act of peeping from behind a mat.
formal.zh: 在本课中，nissajja 一词表示从席子后面偷偷窥看的行为。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'nissajja' f'din il-lezzjoni? Marija: Tfisser li tħares bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'nissajja' mean in this lesson? Marija: It means peeping from behind a mat.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：本课里的 nissajja 是什么意思？玛丽亚：就是从席子后面偷偷看。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'nissajja' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'nissajja' f'din il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 本课里的 nissajja 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'nissajja' mean in this lesson?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li tħares bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li tħares bil-moħbi minn wara ħasira.
messages.zh: 就是从席子后面偷偷看。
messages.en: It means peeping from behind a mat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nissajja 写在“席子后露出一双眼睛”的想象画面旁，整幅画记作“从席子后偷看”；这是情景记忆法。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词义尚未明确的条目；暂保留名词标签，不据此推定具体含义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata b'tifsira li għadha mhix ċara u li trid tiġi ċċarata qabel l-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 含义未确定；这一释义不足以建立明确的名词义项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din l-entrata mhix stabbilita b'mod ċar, għalhekk ma jistax jingħatalha sens nominali preċiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish a clear noun meaning for this entry.

formal.en: The meaning of the word 'nistrieħ' must be clarified before a precise translation is given.

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used by a speaker to say that they study or spend time learning a subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“我学习”，用于说话人说明自己学习某个科目或花时间进行学习。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-forma tintuża meta l-kelliem jgħid li jitgħallem suġġett jew iqatta' ħin fl-istudju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我学习；表示说话人自己从事学习活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kelliem juża din il-forma biex jgħid li jagħmel xogħol ta' studju jew jitgħallem suġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say this, you mean that you spend time learning about a subject.

formal.mt: Nistudja l-Malti kuljum sabiex intejjeb il-ħiliet tiegħi fil-qari u fil-kitba.
formal.en: I study Maltese every day to improve my reading and writing skills.
formal.zh: 我每天学习马耳他语，以提高自己的阅读和写作能力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tagħmel wara x-xogħol? Pawlu: Nistudja l-Malti għal siegħa, imbagħad niekol.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you do after work? Pawlu: I study Maltese for an hour, then I eat.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你下班后做什么？保罗：我学习一个小时的马耳他语，然后吃饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tagħmel wara x-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: X'tagħmel wara x-xogħol?
messages.zh: 你下班后做什么？
messages.en: What do you do after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistudja l-Malti għal siegħa, imbagħad niekol.
messages.mt_standard: Nistudja l-Malti għal siegħa, imbagħad niekol.
messages.zh: 我学习一个小时的马耳他语，然后吃饭。
messages.en: I study Maltese for an hour, then I eat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己指着课本说“我学习”：把 nistudja 与“我坐下学习一小时”的画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cow described as blue in colour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蓝色的母牛；用于指颜色被描述为蓝色的母牛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din il-kelma tirreferi għal baqra li hija deskritta bħala ta' kulur blu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蓝色的母牛，即颜色被描述为蓝色的母牛。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija baqra li l-kulur tagħha huwa deskritt bħala blu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This refers to a cow that is described as blue in colour.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'nitilġhu' hija mqabbla ma' stampa ta' baqra blu.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'nitilġhu' is matched with a picture of a blue cow.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“nitilġhu”这个词与一张蓝色母牛的图片配对。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema stampa taqbel mal-kelma 'nitilġhu'? Pawlu: Dik tal-baqra blu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which picture matches the word 'nitilġhu'? Pawlu: The one of the blue cow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：哪张图片与“nitilġhu”这个词相配？保罗：蓝色母牛的那张。

messages.mt_spoken: Liema stampa taqbel mal-kelma 'nitilġhu'?
messages.mt_standard: Liema stampa taqbel mal-kelma 'nitilġhu'?

messages.en: Which picture matches the word 'nitilġhu'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik tal-baqra blu.
messages.mt_standard: Dik tal-baqra blu.
messages.zh: 蓝色母牛的那张。
messages.en: The one of the blue cow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一头涂成蓝色的母牛，在旁边写 nitilġhu；用颜色与动物组成的画面记住整个词。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具体意义尚未明确的动词条目；暂不推定其表示的动作、状态或参与者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din hija entrata verbali li t-tifsira speċifika tagħha għadha mhix ċara.

messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nkunu nafu xi tfisser.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 nitnieħdu 配一张带问号的动词卡：先记拼写和动词标签，等含义明确后再添加动作画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express that I dislike something or feel an aversion to it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示我不喜欢某事物，或对它有反感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nesprimi li xi ħaġa ma togħġobnix jew li nħoss stmerrija lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我不喜欢；我对某事物感到反感。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Inħoss li xi ħaġa ma togħġobnix u li nippreferi nevitaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If I do not like something, I find it unpleasant or feel an aversion to it.

collocations.en: I feel an aversion to the smell
I am disgusted by spoiled food
collocations.zh: 我对变质食物感到恶心

formal.mt: Nitqażżeż mir-riħa qawwija tal-ikel imħassar u għalhekk nevita li noqgħod qribu.
formal.en: I find the strong smell of spoiled food unpleasant, so I avoid staying near it.
formal.zh: 我对变质食物的强烈气味感到反感，因此避免待在它附近。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Trid idduq dan? Nina: Le, grazzi. Nitqażżeż mir-riħa tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Would you like to taste this? Nina: No, thanks. I can't stand its smell.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你想尝尝这个吗？妮娜：不了，谢谢。我受不了它的气味。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid idduq dan?
messages.mt_standard: Trid idduq dan?
messages.zh: 你想尝尝这个吗？
messages.en: Would you like to taste this?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, grazzi. Nitqażżeż mir-riħa tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, grazzi. Nitqażżeż mir-riħa tiegħu.
messages.zh: 不了，谢谢。我受不了它的气味。
messages.en: No, thanks. I can't stand its smell.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“别人请我尝一口，我因气味而摆手拒绝”的画面记忆，把第一人称的“不喜欢、反感”连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel strong dislike or revulsion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生强烈的厌恶、反感或恶心的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqajjem f'xi ħadd sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew ta' dardir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人感到强烈厌恶或恶心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss stmerrija qawwija lejn xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something disgusts someone, it makes them feel strong dislike or revulsion.

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni tal-ikel imħassar tqanqal stmerrija fil-qarrej.
formal.en: The description of the spoiled food arouses disgust in the reader.
formal.zh: 对变质食物的描写使读者产生厌恶感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din ir-riħa tqażżiżni. Lara: Ejja nitbiegħdu minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: This smell disgusts me. Lara: Let's move away from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这气味让我恶心。拉拉：我们离这里远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din ir-riħa tqażżiżni.
messages.mt_standard: Din ir-riħa tqażżiżni.
messages.zh: 这气味让我恶心。
messages.en: This smell disgusts me.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitbiegħdu minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitbiegħdu minn hawn.
messages.zh: 我们离这里远一点吧。
messages.en: Let's move away from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象闻到变质食物后立刻皱眉退开的场景，记住这里的情绪强于普通的“不喜欢”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To light something by starting a flame or switching on a light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过引燃火焰或打开照明设备，使某物燃烧或发光。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nagħmlu li xi ħaġa tibda taqbad jew tagħti d-dawl, bħal xemgħa jew lampa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点亮了；点燃了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd għamel li xi ħaġa bdiet taqbad jew tagħti d-dawl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone lit something, they made it burn or give out light.

formal.mt: Qabel tibda ċ-ċerimonja, nixegħlu x-xemgħat fuq il-mejda.
formal.en: Before the ceremony begins, we light the candles on the table.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，我们点燃桌上的蜡烛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn dlam. Nixegħlu d-dawl? Toni: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nistax naqra hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's dark here. Shall we turn on the light? Toni: Yes, please. I can't read like this.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里很暗。我们开灯吧？托尼：好，麻烦了。这样我没法看书。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn dlam. Nixegħlu d-dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn dlam. Nixegħlu d-dawl?
messages.zh: 这里很暗。我们开灯吧？
messages.en: It's dark here. Shall we turn on the light?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nistax naqra hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ma nistax naqra hekk.
messages.zh: 好，麻烦了。这样我没法看书。
messages.en: Yes, please. I can't read like this.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把点燃蜡烛和按下电灯开关并排想象：两种动作都让眼前亮起来，可一起记住“点亮、点燃”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something produce light or begin burning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物开始发光或燃烧，例如打开灯或点燃火。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nagħmlu li xi ħaġa tagħti d-dawl jew tibda tinħaraq, bħal lampa jew nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 点亮了；点燃了。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd xegħel dawl jew għamel li xi ħaġa bdiet tinħaraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone lit a lamp or fire, they caused it to produce light or begin burning.

formal.mt: Meta jidlam, nixegħlu l-lampi fil-kamra tal-qari biex kulħadd ikun jista' jaqra sew.
formal.en: When it gets dark, we turn on the lamps in the reading room so that everyone can read comfortably.
formal.zh: 天黑时，我们打开阅览室里的灯，让大家都能舒适地阅读。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qed nibred. Nixegħlu n-nar? Pawlu: Iva. Inġib ftit ħatab.
colloquial.en: Lara: I'm getting cold. Shall we light the fire? Pawlu: Yes. I'll get some firewood.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我开始觉得冷了。我们生火吧？保罗：好。我去拿些柴。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nibred. Nixegħlu n-nar?
messages.mt_standard: Qed nibred. Nixegħlu n-nar?
messages.zh: 我开始觉得冷了。我们生火吧？
messages.en: I'm getting cold. Shall we light the fire?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Inġib ftit ħatab.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Inġib ftit ħatab.
messages.zh: 好。我去拿些柴。
messages.en: Yes. I'll get some firewood.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住两个生活画面：天黑打开台灯，天冷点起炉火；再用例句中的完整短语反复练习“点亮、点燃”。

gloss_zh: 我想；我愿意（可用于引出邀请）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression meaning 'I would like', which can introduce a polite invitation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“我想”或“我愿意”，可用来引出“我想邀请你……”这样的礼貌邀请。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tesprimi dak li jrid il-kelliem b'mod edukat u li tista' tintuża biex tintroduċi stedina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请；在礼貌邀请中，可用 nixtieq 引出“我想邀请你……”的表达。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tistieden lil xi ħadd biex jiġi jew jieħu sehem f'xi ħaġa; nixtieq tista' tintroduċi stedina bħal 'Nixtieq nistiednek għall-ikel'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you invite someone politely, you can introduce your invitation by saying that you would like them to join you.

collocations.en: I would like to invite you
I would like you to come with us
collocations.zh: 我希望你和我们一起去

formal.mt: Nixtieq nistiednek għal-laqgħa li se ssir nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħodu.
formal.en: I would like to invite you to the meeting taking place on Friday morning.
formal.zh: 我想邀请你参加本周五上午举行的会议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nixtieq nistiednek għall-ikel għada. Tista' tiġi? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi! X'ħin?
colloquial.en: Marija: I would like to invite you for a meal tomorrow. Can you come? Pawlu: Yes, thank you! What time?
colloquial.zh: Marija：我想邀请你明天来吃饭。你能来吗？Pawlu：能，谢谢！几点？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nistiednek għall-ikel għada. Tista' tiġi?
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nistiednek għall-ikel għada. Tista' tiġi?
messages.zh: 我想邀请你明天来吃饭。你能来吗？
messages.en: I would like to invite you for a meal tomorrow. Can you come?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (受邀的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! X'ħin?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! X'ħin?
messages.zh: 能，谢谢！几点？
messages.en: Yes, thank you! What time?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixtieq 记成礼貌开场的“我想”，再把 nixtieq nistiednek 整块记成“我想邀请你”，邀请动作由后面的词表达。

gloss_zh: 喜欢；点赞（此处作为名词标签）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A label meaning 'Like', treated here as a noun naming a sign of approval.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 此处作为名词学习的“喜欢／点赞”标签，表示对某项内容的喜爱或赞同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta li hawn tintuża bħala nom għal sinjal ta' għoġba jew approvazzjoni lejn xi kontenut.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜爱或赞同的表示；此处指作为名词标签的“点赞”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinjal li juri li persuna togħġobha xi ħaġa jew tapprovaha, rappreżentat hawn bit-tikketta 'Nixtiq'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A like is a sign that someone enjoys or approves of a piece of content.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, it-tikketta 'Nixtiq' tintuża bħala nom għal sinjal ta' approvazzjoni.
formal.en: In this exercise, the label 'Nixtiq' is used as a noun for a sign of approval.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，标签“Nixtiq”用作名词，表示赞同的标记。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser it-tikketta 'Nixtiq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Ben: Tfisser sinjal ta' approvazzjoni, bħal meta tagħti 'like' lil ritratt.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the label 'Nixtiq' mean in this exercise? Ben: It means a sign of approval, like when you give a photo a like.
colloquial.zh: Lara：本练习中的“Nixtiq”标签是什么意思？Ben：表示赞同的标记，就像给照片点个赞。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser it-tikketta 'Nixtiq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser it-tikketta 'Nixtiq' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 本练习中的“Nixtiq”标签是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the label 'Nixtiq' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser sinjal ta' approvazzjoni, bħal meta tagħti 'like' lil ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser sinjal ta' approvazzjoni, bħal meta tagħti 'like' lil ritratt.
messages.zh: 表示赞同的标记，就像给照片点个赞。
messages.en: It means a sign of approval, like when you give a photo a like.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在练习卡上把 Nixtiq 放进“点赞”按钮图案中，联想一个赞同标记；此处按名词标签记忆，并留意它与 nixtieq 的拼写不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something by paying for it, expressed with the speaker as the buyer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者自己付钱取得某物，即“我买”或“我购买”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tfisser li jien nikseb xi ħaġa billi nħallas għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买；付钱取得某物，此形式表示“我买”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikseb xi ħaġa bi ħlas; il-forma nixtri tindika li l-persuna li tixtri hija l-kelliem innifsu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you buy something, you pay money to obtain it.

formal.mt: Għall-kors, nixtri l-kotba meħtieġa mill-ħanut tal-università.
formal.en: For the course, I buy the required books from the university shop.
formal.zh: 为了这门课程，我从大学书店购买所需的书籍。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Trid xi ħaġa mill-ħanut? Luqa: Iva, ħobż, jekk jogħġbok. Marta: Tajjeb, nixtri l-ħobż jien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you want anything from the shop? Luqa: Yes, bread, please. Marta: All right, I'll buy the bread.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你需要我从商店带什么吗？Luqa：需要，请买些面包。Marta：好，面包我来买。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid xi ħaġa mill-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Trid xi ħaġa mill-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你需要我从商店带什么吗？
messages.en: Do you want anything from the shop?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħobż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħobż, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 需要，请买些面包。
messages.en: Yes, bread, please.

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nixtri l-ħobż jien.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nixtri l-ħobż jien.
messages.zh: 好，面包我来买。
messages.en: All right, I'll buy the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixtri 和 jien（我）一起朗读，想象自己一个人在收银台付款；整句记住 nixtri biljett，意思是“我买一张票”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To obtain something by paying for it, expressed with the speaker and others as the buyers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示说话者与其他人付钱取得某物，即“我们买”或“我们购买”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma tal-verb li tfisser li aħna niksbu xi ħaġa billi nħallsu għaliha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 购买；付钱取得某物，此形式表示“我们买”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tikseb xi ħaġa bi ħlas; il-forma nixtru tindika li x-xiri jsir mill-kelliem flimkien ma' persuna oħra jew aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we buy something, we pay money to obtain it for ourselves or for someone else.

formal.mt: Għall-attività tal-iskola, nixtru l-materjal meħtieġ minn ħanut lokali.
formal.en: For the school activity, we buy the required materials from a local shop.
formal.zh: 为了学校的活动，我们从当地商店购买所需材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna kollox għall-ikla? Mark: Le, jonqosna l-ħobż u l-ġobon. Sara: Mela nixtru kollox qabel immorru d-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have everything for the meal? Mark: No, we still need bread and cheese. Sara: Then let's buy everything before we go home.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这顿饭需要的东西都齐了吗？Mark：没有，还缺面包和奶酪。Sara：那我们回家前把东西买齐吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna kollox għall-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna kollox għall-ikla?
messages.zh: 这顿饭需要的东西都齐了吗？
messages.en: Do we have everything for the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (一起准备饭菜的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jonqosna l-ħobż u l-ġobon.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jonqosna l-ħobż u l-ġobon.
messages.zh: 没有，还缺面包和奶酪。
messages.en: No, we still need bread and cheese.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nixtru kollox qabel immorru d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nixtru kollox qabel immorru d-dar.
messages.zh: 那我们回家前把东西买齐吧。
messages.en: Then let's buy everything before we go home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nixtru 和 aħna（我们）一起朗读，想象几个人共推一辆购物车；对照记忆 nixtri 是“我买”，nixtru 是“我们买”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something impure or unsafe by introducing dirt or harmful substances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使污物或有害物质进入某物，从而使其不洁或不安全。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iddaħħal ħmieġ jew sustanzi ta' ħsara f'xi ħaġa u b'hekk tagħmilha maħmuġa jew mhux sikura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 污染，指使某物混入污物或有害物质而变得不洁或不安全。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmel xi ħaġa maħmuġa jew mhux sikura billi ddaħħal fiha ħmieġ jew materjal li jista' jagħmel il-ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you contaminate something, you make it impure or unsafe by introducing unwanted or harmful material.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport spjegajt li, jekk nuża kuċċarina maħmuġa, nista' niġġeż l-ikel.
formal.en: In the report, I explained that if I use a dirty spoon, I may contaminate the food.
formal.zh: 我在报告中解释说，如果使用脏勺子，我可能会污染食物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tuża dik il-kuċċarina? Paul: Le, hija maħmuġa. Ma rridx niġġeż l-ikel; se nieħu waħda nadifa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to use that spoon? Paul: No, it is dirty. I don't want to contaminate the food; I'll get a clean one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要用那把勺子吗？保罗：不用，它脏了。我不想污染食物；我去拿把干净的。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tuża dik il-kuċċarina?
messages.mt_standard: Se tuża dik il-kuċċarina?
messages.zh: 你要用那把勺子吗？
messages.en: Are you going to use that spoon?

messages.speaker: Paul (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hija maħmuġa. Ma rridx niġġeż l-ikel; se nieħu waħda nadifa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hija maħmuġa. Ma rridx niġġeż l-ikel; se nieħu waħda nadifa.
messages.zh: 不用，它脏了。我不想污染食物；我去拿把干净的。
messages.en: No, it is dirty. I don't want to contaminate the food; I'll get a clean one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象脏勺子伸进一碗干净食物，污物随之进入；把 niġġeż 记成“使别的东西受到污染”这一动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to thank someone for help, kindness, or something received.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向别人提供的帮助、善意或所给予的东西表示感谢的用语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tuża biex turi gratitudni lil xi ħadd għall-għajnuna, għall-qalb tajba jew għal xi ħaġa li tak.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谢谢你；用于向对方表示感谢。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tintuża biex tirringrazzja lil persuna għal xi ħaġa li għamlet għalik jew li tatk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when you want to show someone that you are grateful.

formal.mt: Niżżikħajr tal-għajnuna tiegħek fit-tħejjija ta' dan ir-rapport.
formal.en: Thank you for your help in preparing this report.
formal.zh: 感谢你协助编写这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn il-ktieb li tlabtni. Lara: Niżżikħajr! Kont qed infittxu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here is the book you asked me for. Lara: Thank you! I was looking for it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是你向我要的那本书。拉拉：谢谢你！我正找它呢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn il-ktieb li tlabtni.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn il-ktieb li tlabtni.
messages.zh: 这是你向我要的那本书。
messages.en: Here is the book you asked me for.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Niżżikħajr! Kont qed infittxu.
messages.mt_standard: Niżżikħajr! Kont qed infittxu.
messages.zh: 谢谢你！我正找它呢。
messages.en: Thank you! I was looking for it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Niżżikħajr 与接过朋友递来的书时说“谢谢你”的画面绑定，整句记忆，再练习接上感谢的原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exchange a cheque for the money it represents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将支票兑现，领取支票所代表的款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan il-verb ifisser li ssarraf ċekk biex tirċievi l-flus li jirrappreżenta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兑现支票等付款凭证，领取相应的现金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan il-verb jintuża meta persuna ssarraf ċekk jew dokument simili u tirċievi l-flus tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone cashes a cheque, they exchange it for the money it represents.

collocations.en: cashed a cheque at the bank
collocations.zh: 在银行兑现了一张支票

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant nkaxxa ċ-ċekk fil-bank u żamm l-irċevuta bħala prova tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The representative cashed the cheque at the bank and kept the receipt as proof of payment.
formal.zh: 代表在银行兑现了支票，并保留收据作为付款凭证。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark diġà nkaxxa ċ-ċekk? Maja: Iva, dalgħodu. Il-flus qegħdin għandu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark cashed the cheque already? Maja: Yes, this morning. He has the money.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克已经把支票兑现了吗？玛雅：是的，今天早上兑现的。钱在他那里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà nkaxxa ċ-ċekk?
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà nkaxxa ċ-ċekk?
messages.zh: 马克已经把支票兑现了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark cashed the cheque already?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dalgħodu. Il-flus qegħdin għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dalgħodu. Il-flus qegħdin għandu.
messages.zh: 是的，今天早上兑现的。钱在他那里。
messages.en: Yes, this morning. He has the money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把支票递进银行柜台，再拿回现金的完整动作；用 nkaxxa ċ-ċekk 把“兑现支票”作为一个搭配记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A picture that shows a person, an object, or a scene.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现人物、物体或场景的图画，可作为陈设悬挂或摆放。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nkwatru huwa stampa jew pittura li turi persuna, oġġett jew xena u li tista' titqiegħed għall-wiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 图画；描绘人物、物体或场景的画。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nkwatru huwa stampa jew pittura li tirrappreżenta xi ħaġa, bħal persuna, pajsaġġ jew oġġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A picture is an image that shows a person, an object, or a scene.

formal.mt: In-nkwatru fil-kamra tal-laqgħat juri veduta tal-port u jagħti kulur lill-ispazju.
formal.en: The picture in the meeting room shows a view of the harbour and adds colour to the space.
formal.zh: 会议室里的画描绘了港口景色，为这个空间增添了色彩。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se ndendlu dan in-nkwatru? Mark: Fuq is-sufan. Hemm jidher sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we hang this picture? Mark: Above the sofa. It will look nice there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们把这幅画挂在哪里？马克：沙发上方吧。挂在那里会很好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se ndendlu dan in-nkwatru?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se ndendlu dan in-nkwatru?
messages.zh: 我们把这幅画挂在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we hang this picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sufan. Hemm jidher sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sufan. Hemm jidher sabiħ.
messages.zh: 沙发上方吧。挂在那里会很好看。
messages.en: Above the sofa. It will look nice there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见墙上的画就指着说 nkwatru，再加上 sabiħ 表示漂亮；把物品、位置和短语连在一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 自身；自己（通常与人称后缀连用）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reflexive pronoun usually combined with a personal suffix to refer back to the same person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常与人称后缀结合使用的反身代词，表示所指的人自身，如 nnifsi 表示“我自己”，nnifsu 表示“他自己”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dan huwa pronom riflessiv li normalment jingħaqad ma' suffiss personali biex jirreferi lura għall-istess persuna, bħal nnifsi u nnifsu.

sense_translations.en_definition: reflexive pronoun usually used with a bound personal pronoun ('nnifs-u', 'nnifs-i' etc)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 反身代词，通常与黏着人称代词结合，表示“自己”；例如 nnifsu 表示“他自己”，nnifsi 表示“我自己”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan il-pronom riflessiv normalment jintuża ma' pronom personali mehmuż biex jindika l-persuna nfisha, pereżempju nnifsu għalih u nnifsi għalija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reflexive pronoun refers back to the same person, with an attached personal form indicating who is meant.

formal.mt: L-istudent evalwa lilu nnifsu skont il-kriterji mogħtija mill-għalliem.
formal.en: The student assessed himself according to the criteria provided by the teacher.
formal.zh: 学生按照教师提供的标准对自己进行了评价。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħmel dan waħdek? Mark: Iva, nafda lili nnifsi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you do this on your own? Mark: Yes, I trust myself.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能独自完成这件事吗？马克：能，我相信自己。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħmel dan waħdek?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħmel dan waħdek?
messages.zh: 你能独自完成这件事吗？
messages.en: Can you do this on your own?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nafda lili nnifsi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nafda lili nnifsi.
messages.zh: 能，我相信自己。
messages.en: Yes, I trust myself.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nnifs 当作“自己”的记忆核心，成组练习 nnifsi“我自己”和 nnifsu“他自己”，再用“我相信我自己”体会反指关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's own self, especially when emphasizing that the person acts personally.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本人或其自身，强调所说的那个人自己；此形式用于阳性单数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-persuna stess, b'enfasi fuqha jew fuq il-fatt li tagħmel xi ħaġa personalment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己；本人，指所说的那个人自身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuna stess li tkun qed tissemma, speċjalment meta l-azzjoni tirreferi lura għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to refer to a person's own self or to emphasize their personal involvement.

formal.mt: Id-direttur innifsu ffirma l-ittra u bagħatha lill-ġenituri.
formal.en: The director himself signed the letter and sent it to the parents.
formal.zh: 主任本人签署了这封信，并寄给了家长。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan il-kejk? Mark: Pawlu nnifsu għamlu. Maja: Mela rrid nirringrazzjah!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this cake? Mark: Pawlu himself made it. Maja: Then I must thank him!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个蛋糕是谁做的？Mark：是 Pawlu 本人做的。Maja：那我得谢谢他！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għamel dan il-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: Min għamel dan il-kejk?
messages.zh: 这个蛋糕是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu nnifsu għamlu.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu nnifsu għamlu.
messages.zh: 是 Pawlu 本人做的。
messages.en: Pawlu himself made it.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid nirringrazzjah!
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid nirringrazzjah!
messages.zh: 那我得谢谢他！
messages.en: Then I must thank him!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nnifsu 和“本人亲自”一起记：看到 Pawlu nnifsu，就想象他指着自己说“是我本人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having curls or a shape that bends into rounded curves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有卷儿或呈弯曲环绕形状的，常用于描述毛发等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu nokkli jew forma li titgħawweġ f'kurvi tondi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 卷曲的；具有卷儿或弯曲形态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu nokkli, jew li jitgħawweġ u jieħu forma tonda minflok jibqa' dritt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is curly has curls or bends into rounded shapes.

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher kelb żgħir b'denb nnukkla u widnejn twal.
formal.en: The picture shows a small dog with a curly tail and long ears.
formal.zh: 图中是一只小狗，尾巴卷曲，耳朵很长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se nagħrfu lil ħuk? Nina: Għandu xagħar nnukkla u liebes ġakketta ħamra. Lara: Ara, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb!
colloquial.en: Lara: How will we recognize your brother? Nina: He has curly hair and is wearing a red jacket. Lara: Look, he is by the door!
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们怎么认出你哥哥？Nina：他留着卷发，穿着红夹克。Lara：看，他就在门旁边！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nagħrfu lil ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nagħrfu lil ħuk?
messages.zh: 我们怎么认出你哥哥？
messages.en: How will we recognize your brother?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu xagħar nnukkla u liebes ġakketta ħamra.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu xagħar nnukkla u liebes ġakketta ħamra.
messages.zh: 他留着卷发，穿着红夹克。
messages.en: He has curly hair and is wearing a red jacket.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 看，他就在门旁边！
messages.en: Look, he is by the door!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 nnukkla 时画一缕卷发和一条卷尾巴，用两个弯曲的画面固定“卷曲的”这个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing admirable moral qualities, or belonging to a family with a high hereditary social rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品格或行为高尚、值得敬重的；也指属于世袭贵族阶层的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri kwalitajiet morali tajbin u jistħoqqlu rispett, jew li jappartjeni għal familja ta' grad soċjali għoli li jintiret.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高尚的，具有值得尊敬的品格的；或贵族的，属于世袭上层社会家族的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru tajjeb u ta' min jirrispettah, jew li jagħmel parti minn familja bi status għoli li jgħaddi minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A noble person or action deserves admiration for moral qualities, while a noble family holds a high hereditary social rank.

formal.mt: Id-donazzjoni anonima kienet ġest nobbli li għen lil ħafna familji fil-bżonn.
formal.en: The anonymous donation was a noble gesture that helped many families in need.
formal.zh: 这笔匿名捐款是一个高尚的举动，帮助了许多有困难的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taf li Mark ħallas għall-kotba tat-tifel? Pawlu: Dak kien ġest nobbli ħafna. Sara: Iva, u lanqas ried li ngħidu lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you know that Mark paid for the boy's books? Pawlu: That was a very noble gesture. Sara: Yes, and he did not even want us to tell anyone.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你知道 Mark 出钱给那个男孩买书了吗？Pawlu：这个举动真高尚。Sara：是啊，他甚至不想让我们告诉别人。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf li Mark ħallas għall-kotba tat-tifel?
messages.mt_standard: Taf li Mark ħallas għall-kotba tat-tifel?
messages.zh: 你知道 Mark 出钱给那个男孩买书了吗？
messages.en: Did you know that Mark paid for the boy's books?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien ġest nobbli ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien ġest nobbli ħafna.
messages.zh: 这个举动真高尚。
messages.en: That was a very noble gesture.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u lanqas ried li ngħidu lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u lanqas ried li ngħidu lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 是啊，他甚至不想让我们告诉别人。
messages.en: Yes, and he did not even want us to tell anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nobbli 配成两幅图：帮助他人表示“品格高尚”，贵族家庭表示“社会身份”，靠搭配区分含义。

gloss_zh: 干净的那些；干净的物品（复数名词用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The clean ones, referring collectively to items that are free from dirt.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指一组物品中干净的那些；在所指物品已明确时，用来代指这些干净物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oġġetti li huma nodfa, imsemmija bħala grupp meta jkun diġà ċar għal liema oġġetti qed nirreferu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 干净的那些物品；指代已知物品中的干净者，表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-oġġetti li mhumiex maħmuġin, meta nirreferu għalihom flimkien mingħajr ma nerġgħu nsemmu x'inhuma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The clean ones are the items in a particular group that are free from dirt.

collocations.en: the clean ones and the dirty ones
collocations.zh: 干净的那些和脏的那些

formal.mt: Il-platti għandhom jinqasmu f'żewġ gruppi: in-nodof u l-maħmuġin.
formal.en: The plates should be divided into two groups: the clean ones and the dirty ones.
formal.zh: 应把盘子分成两组：干净的和脏的。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema platti nieħu? Toni: Ħu n-nodof minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which plates should I take? Toni: Take the clean ones from the shelf.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该拿哪些盘子？托尼：拿架子上干净的那些。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema platti nieħu?
messages.mt_standard: Liema platti nieħu?
messages.zh: 我该拿哪些盘子？
messages.en: Which plates should I take?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu n-nodof minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu n-nodof minn fuq l-ixkaffa.
messages.zh: 拿架子上干净的那些。
messages.en: Take the clean ones from the shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把盘子分成干净和脏的两堆；本条的 nodof 代指“干净的那些”，记得所指物品不止一个。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A node situated at the end of a path or branch in a network or diagram.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于网络、路径或图示分支末端的节点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nodu li jinsab fit-tarf ta' mogħdija jew fergħa f'netwerk jew dijagramma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 末端节点；位于某条路径或某个分支终点的节点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt f'netwerk jew dijagramma li jkun fl-aħħar ta' mogħdija jew fergħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An end node is a point at which a path or branch in a network terminates.

collocations.en: an end node in the network

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, in-nodu aħħari ta' kull fergħa huwa mmarkat b'ċirku aħmar.
formal.en: In the diagram, the end node of each branch is marked with a red circle.
formal.zh: 图中每个分支的末端节点都用红色圆圈标出。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu n-nodu aħħari ta' din il-fergħa? Mark: Hawn, fejn tieqaf il-linja.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the end node of this branch? Mark: Here, where the line stops.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个分支的末端节点在哪里？马克：在这里，就是线条结束的地方。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu n-nodu aħħari ta' din il-fergħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu n-nodu aħħari ta' din il-fergħa?
messages.zh: 这个分支的末端节点在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the end node of this branch?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn, fejn tieqaf il-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn, fejn tieqaf il-linja.
messages.zh: 在这里，就是线条结束的地方。
messages.en: Here, where the line stops.

cognitive_memory_aid: 沿着图中的一条分支走到最后，把终点圆点和 nodu aħħari 绑定记忆：分支走完，末端节点出现。

gloss_zh: 生成节点；产生输出的节点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A node in a system where an output, such as energy, is generated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系统中发生生成过程、产生某种输出的节点，例如产生能量的节点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nodu f'sistema fejn jiġi prodott xi ħaġa, bħall-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生成节点；系统中用于产生某种输出的节点，具体生成对象由上下文确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt f'sistema fejn isseħħ il-ġenerazzjoni ta' xi ħaġa, skont x'tip ta' sistema tkun.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A generation node is a point in a system at which a particular output is produced.

collocations.en: the capacity of the generation node

formal.mt: F'din id-dijagramma tas-sistema tal-enerġija, kull nodu ta' ġenerazzjoni jindika fejn tiġi prodotta l-enerġija.
formal.en: In this energy system diagram, each generation node indicates where energy is produced.
formal.zh: 在这张能源系统图中，每个生成节点都表示产生能量的位置。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu nodu ta' ġenerazzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, f'din is-sistema l-enerġija tiġi prodotta hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a generation node? Pawlu: Yes, in this system energy is produced here.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这是生成节点吗？保罗：是的，在这个系统里，能量在这里产生。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu nodu ta' ġenerazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu nodu ta' ġenerazzjoni?
messages.zh: 这是生成节点吗？
messages.en: Is this a generation node?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din is-sistema l-enerġija tiġi prodotta hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din is-sistema l-enerġija tiġi prodotta hawn.
messages.zh: 是的，在这个系统里，能量在这里产生。
messages.en: Yes, in this system energy is produced here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把系统画成许多圆点，在“产生输出”的圆点旁画一个向外的箭头，用这个画面记住生成节点；生成什么要看上下文。

gloss_zh: 半扇胴体；半副屠宰后的动物躯体

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two halves of the dressed body of a slaughtered animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 屠宰并作初步处理后的动物胴体分成两半所得的一半，常称半扇胴体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ nofsijiet tal-ġisem ta' annimal maqtul u mħejji għall-ipproċessar tal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一半；在本词组的肉类加工语境中，指整副胴体的一半。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda minn żewġ partijiet indaqs; f'dan il-kuntest, waħda miż-żewġ nofsijiet ta' karkassa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A half is one of two equal parts, here referring to one half of an animal carcass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半扇胴体；屠宰处理后的动物躯体的一半。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nofs il-ġisem ta' annimal maqtul u mħejji biex jiġi pproċessat għal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A half carcase is one of the two halves of a slaughtered animal's dressed body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半扇胴体；一副屠宰后的动物胴体分成两半所得的其中一半。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ nofsijiet ta' karkassa ta' annimal maqtul għall-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A half carcass is one half of an animal's body after slaughter and initial preparation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半扇胴体；表示动物胴体一半的肉类加工用语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nofs karkassa ta' annimal maqtul, meqjus bħala unità fil-preparazzjoni jew fil-bejgħ tal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A half-carcase is a single half of a dressed animal body handled as a unit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半扇肉；在屠宰和肉类交易语境中，指沿纵向分开的半副胴体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waħda miż-żewġ nofsijiet ta' karkassa maqsuma tul il-ġisem, fil-kuntest tal-preparazzjoni jew tal-bejgħ tal-laħam.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A side is one of the two lengthwise halves of an animal carcass prepared for meat.

collocations.en: the weight of half a carcass

formal.mt: Il-fornitur għandu jirreġistra l-piż ta' nofs karkassa qabel ma jibgħatha lill-biċċier.
formal.en: The supplier must record the weight of half a carcass before sending it to the butcher.
formal.zh: 供应商在把半扇胴体运给肉贩之前，必须记录其重量。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Illum se nirċievu nofs karkassa? Rita: Iva, ħejjejt post għaliha fil-kamra kiesħa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are we receiving half a carcass today? Rita: Yes, I've made room for it in the cold room.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们今天会收到半扇胴体吗？丽塔：会，我已经在冷藏室里给它腾好地方了。

messages.speaker: Mark (肉店店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum se nirċievu nofs karkassa?
messages.mt_standard: Illum se nirċievu nofs karkassa?
messages.zh: 我们今天会收到半扇胴体吗？
messages.en: Are we receiving half a carcass today?

messages.speaker: Rita (肉店员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħejjejt post għaliha fil-kamra kiesħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħejjejt post għaliha fil-kamra kiesħa.
messages.zh: 会，我已经在冷藏室里给它腾好地方了。
messages.en: Yes, I've made room for it in the cold room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象肉店把整副胴体沿中线分成两扇，一扇就是 nofs karkassa；遇到英语 side 时，也要结合肉类语境理解为半扇。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount equal to half the usual or original price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常价格或原价的一半。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont li jkun daqs nofs il-prezz tas-soltu jew tal-prezz oriġinali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半价，即通常价格或原价的一半。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prezz li jkun daqs nofs l-ammont li oġġett normalment jiswa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is sold at half price, it costs only half its usual or original price.

formal.mt: Matul il-bejgħ speċjali, il-ħanut se joffri l-kotba kollha b'nofs prezz.
formal.en: During the special sale, the shop will offer all its books at half price.
formal.zh: 特卖期间，这家商店的所有书籍都将以半价出售。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-ġakketta b'nofs prezz? Mark: Iva, minflok għoxrin ewro, tiswa għaxra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this jacket half price? Mark: Yes, it costs ten euros instead of twenty.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这件夹克是半价吗？Mark：对，原来二十欧元，现在十欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-ġakketta b'nofs prezz?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-ġakketta b'nofs prezz?
messages.zh: 这件夹克是半价吗？
messages.en: Is this jacket half price?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minflok għoxrin ewro, tiswa għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minflok għoxrin ewro, tiswa għaxra.
messages.zh: 对，原来二十欧元，现在十欧元。
messages.en: Yes, it costs ten euros instead of twenty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把价格标签想成二十变十：nofs prezz 就是半价；常把 b'nofs prezz 整块记作“以半价”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A quantity of six items, equal to half a dozen.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 六个物品的数量，相当于半打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' sitt oġġetti, jiġifieri nofs grupp ta' tnax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半打，即六个。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' sitta, li tkun nofs tużżana sħiħa ta' tnax.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you ask for half a dozen items, you are asking for six of them.

formal.mt: Għal kull kejk, ir-riċetta titlob nofs tużżana bajd u mitejn gramma dqiq.
formal.en: For each cake, the recipe calls for half a dozen eggs and two hundred grams of flour.
formal.zh: 每做一个蛋糕，食谱要求使用六个鸡蛋和二百克面粉。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Agħtini nofs tużżana tuffieħ, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Żgur. Tridhom ħomor jew ħodor?
colloquial.en: Anna: Give me half a dozen apples, please. Rita: Certainly. Would you like red or green ones?
colloquial.zh: Anna：请给我六个苹果。Rita：好的。你要红苹果还是青苹果？

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Agħtini nofs tużżana tuffieħ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Agħtini nofs tużżana tuffieħ, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我六个苹果。
messages.en: Give me half a dozen apples, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (水果店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Tridhom ħomor jew ħodor?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Tridhom ħomor jew ħodor?
messages.zh: 好的。你要红苹果还是青苹果？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like red or green ones?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象十二格蛋盒只装满一半，数出来正好六个：nofs tużżana 就是“半打”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The entire morning, considered as a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为一段完整时间来看的整个上午。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħin kollu ta' filgħodu, meqjus bħala perjodu wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整个上午，指上午的全部时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-perjodu kollu ta' filgħodu, mill-bidu tiegħu sa nofsinhar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you spend nofstanħar doing something, you spend the whole morning doing it.

collocations.en: I spent the whole morning studying

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti qattgħu nofstanħar jiddiskutu l-proposti u jħejju r-rapport.
formal.en: The participants spent the whole morning discussing the proposals and preparing the report.
formal.zh: 与会者整个上午都在讨论提案并编写报告。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn kont dalgħodu? Pawlu: Qattajt nofstanħar fil-librerija nistudja għall-eżami.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where were you this morning? Pawlu: I spent the whole morning at the library studying for the exam.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你今天上午去哪儿了？Pawlu：我整个上午都在图书馆复习考试。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn kont dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn kont dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你今天上午去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where were you this morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qattajt nofstanħar fil-librerija nistudja għall-eżami.
messages.mt_standard: Qattajt nofstanħar fil-librerija nistudja għall-eżami.
messages.zh: 我整个上午都在图书馆复习考试。
messages.en: I spent the whole morning at the library studying for the exam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上午的日程从开始到午饭前全部涂满，用 nofstanħar 记住“整个上午”这一完整时段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun derived from a verb.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由动词派生而来的名词，属于语法术语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li jitnissel minn verb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由动词派生而来的名词；语法上称为动词派生名词或动名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu grammatikali għal nom li jitnissel minn verb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In grammar, a verbal noun is a noun that is derived from a verb.

collocations.en: an example of a verbal noun
collocations.zh: 一个动词派生名词的例子

collocations.en: the use of a verbal noun

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-grammatika, l-istudent għandu jidentifika n-nom verbali fis-sentenza.
formal.en: In the grammar exercise, the student should identify the verbal noun in the sentence.
formal.zh: 在这道语法练习中，学生应找出句子里的动词派生名词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser nom verbali? Pawlu: Huwa nom li jitnissel minn verb. Maja: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar tip ta' nom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does verbal noun mean? Pawlu: It's a noun derived from a verb. Maja: So we're talking about a type of noun.
colloquial.zh: Maja：动词派生名词是什么意思？Pawlu：就是由动词派生出来的名词。Maja：所以我们说的是一种名词。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser nom verbali?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser nom verbali?
messages.zh: 动词派生名词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does verbal noun mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa nom li jitnissel minn verb.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa nom li jitnissel minn verb.
messages.zh: 就是由动词派生出来的名词。
messages.en: It's a noun derived from a verb.

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar tip ta' nom.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed nitkellmu dwar tip ta' nom.
messages.zh: 所以我们说的是一种名词。
messages.en: So we're talking about a type of noun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张标签辅助记忆：“来源是动词，身份是名词”；看到这个术语时先判断它属于名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing in name or title, without the full power or effect normally associated with it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅在名称或头衔上存在，缺乏通常与之相应的实际权力或作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti fl-isem jew fit-titlu, mingħajr is-setgħa jew l-effett sħiħ li normalment ikun marbut miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 名义上的，指虽有相应名称、头衔或形式，却缺少实际权力或作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun hekk fl-isem jew formalment, iżda mingħajr il-poter jew il-funzjoni reali li wieħed jistenna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nominal leader has the title of leader but exercises little or no actual authority.

formal.mt: Għalkemm baqa' l-mexxej nominali tal-organizzazzjoni, id-deċiżjonijiet kollha kienu jittieħdu mill-kumitat.
formal.en: Although he remained the nominal leader of the organization, all decisions were made by the committee.
formal.zh: 虽然他仍是该组织名义上的领导者，但所有决定都由委员会作出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Allura Mark imexxi l-grupp? Lara: Hu l-mexxej nominali, imma Rita tieħu d-deċiżjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: So does Mark run the group? Lara: He is the nominal leader, but Rita makes the decisions.
colloquial.zh: Maja：所以这个小组由 Mark 负责？Lara：他是名义上的组长，但决定都是 Rita 作的。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura Mark imexxi l-grupp?
messages.mt_standard: Allura Mark imexxi l-grupp?
messages.zh: 所以这个小组由 Mark 负责？
messages.en: So does Mark run the group?

messages.speaker: Lara (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-mexxej nominali, imma Rita tieħu d-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-mexxej nominali, imma Rita tieħu d-deċiżjonijiet.
messages.zh: 他是名义上的组长，但决定都是 Rita 作的。
messages.en: He is the nominal leader, but Rita makes the decisions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门牌上写着“领导”，实际决定却由别人作：用这幅画面记住 nominali 的“名义上的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Officially proposed as a candidate for a position or an award.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被正式提出作为某一职位或奖项候选人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Propost uffiċjalment bħala kandidat għal kariga jew premju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获正式提名为职位或奖项候选人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie propost uffiċjalment bħala kandidat għal kariga jew għal premju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is nominated has been officially proposed as a candidate for a position or an award.

formal.mt: L-attur nominat għall-premju se jattendi ċ-ċerimonja flimkien mad-direttur.
formal.en: The actor nominated for the award will attend the ceremony with the director.
formal.zh: 获该奖项提名的演员将与导演一同出席典礼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt li Mark ġie nominat għal premju? Lara: Iva! Se nċempillu biex nifraħlu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you heard that Mark has been nominated for an award? Lara: Yes! I'll call him to congratulate him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你听说Mark获得奖项提名了吗？Lara：听说了！我要打电话祝贺他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Smajt li Mark ġie nominat għal premju?
messages.mt_standard: Smajt li Mark ġie nominat għal premju?
messages.zh: 你听说Mark获得奖项提名了吗？
messages.en: Have you heard that Mark has been nominated for an award?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Se nċempillu biex nifraħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Se nċempillu biex nifraħlu.
messages.zh: 听说了！我要打电话祝贺他。
messages.en: Yes! I'll call him to congratulate him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进颁奖场景记忆：名字进入候选名单，就是“获提名的”；获提名并不表示已经获奖。

gloss_zh: 无手机恐惧；对没有手机可用的恐惧

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fear of finding yourself without a mobile phone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 害怕自己陷入没有手机可用的处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biża' li wieħed jispiċċa mingħajr mowbajl.

sense_translations.en_definition: fear of ending up without a mobile phone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对自己最终陷入没有手机可用的处境的恐惧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biża' li wieħed jispiċċa f'sitwazzjoni fejn ma jkollux mowbajl disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Nomophobia is the fear you feel at the possibility of finding yourself without a mobile phone.

collocations.zh: 与无手机恐惧有关的恐惧感
关于无手机恐惧的讨论

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi n-nomofobja bħala l-biża' li wieħed jispiċċa mingħajr mowbajl.
formal.en: The article describes nomophobia as the fear of finding oneself without a mobile phone.
formal.zh: 这篇文章将无手机恐惧描述为害怕自己陷入没有手机可用的处境。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi n-nomofobja? Mark: Hija l-biża' li tispiċċa mingħajr mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is nomophobia? Mark: It's the fear of finding yourself without a mobile phone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是无手机恐惧？Mark：就是害怕自己陷入没有手机可用的处境。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi n-nomofobja?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi n-nomofobja?
messages.zh: 什么是无手机恐惧？
messages.en: What is nomophobia?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-biża' li tispiċċa mingħajr mowbajl.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-biża' li tispiċċa mingħajr mowbajl.
messages.zh: 就是害怕自己陷入没有手机可用的处境。
messages.en: It's the fear of finding yourself without a mobile phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门摸口袋，发现没带手机便开始害怕；用这个场景记住“害怕没有手机可用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice or principle of avoiding discrimination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 避免歧视、不给予歧视性差别待遇的做法或原则。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika jew il-prinċipju li tiġi evitata d-diskriminazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 避免实施歧视或给予歧视性差别待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-evitar ta' trattament inġust jew inqas favorevoli lejn persuni minħabba karatteristiċi personali jew l-appartenenza tagħhom għal grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Avoidance of discrimination means taking care not to treat people unfairly because of personal characteristics or group membership.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不歧视，即不因个人特征或群体身份而给予不公平待遇的原则或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prinċipju jew il-prattika li persuni ma jiġux ittrattati b'mod inġust minħabba karatteristiċi personali jew l-appartenenza tagħhom għal grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-discrimination is the principle or practice of treating people fairly regardless of personal characteristics or group membership.

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-iskola hija bbażata fuq il-prinċipju ta' non-diskriminazzjoni u titlob trattament ġust għal kull student.
formal.en: The school's policy is based on the principle of non-discrimination and requires fair treatment for every student.
formal.zh: 学校的政策以不歧视原则为基础，要求公平对待每一位学生。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser non-diskriminazzjoni fil-klabb tagħna? Lara: Tfisser li nittrattaw lil kulħadd b'mod ġust, ikun minn fejn ikun.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does non-discrimination mean in our club? Lara: It means we treat everyone fairly, wherever they come from.
colloquial.zh: Mark：在我们俱乐部里，不歧视是什么意思？Lara：意思是无论大家来自哪里，我们都公平对待。

messages.speaker: Mark (俱乐部新成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser non-diskriminazzjoni fil-klabb tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser non-diskriminazzjoni fil-klabb tagħna?
messages.zh: 在我们俱乐部里，不歧视是什么意思？
messages.en: What does non-discrimination mean in our club?

messages.speaker: Lara (俱乐部负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li nittrattaw lil kulħadd b'mod ġust, ikun minn fejn ikun.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li nittrattaw lil kulħadd b'mod ġust, ikun minn fejn ikun.
messages.zh: 意思是无论大家来自哪里，我们都公平对待。
messages.en: It means we treat everyone fairly, wherever they come from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象俱乐部门口写着“人人公平相待”：不因身份区别待遇，就能记住“不歧视”的核心意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression supplied with the meaning of remaining in a place for a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示在某个地方停留一段时间或继续留在那里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni mogħtija bit-tifsira li wieħed jibqa' f'post għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停留；在某处继续待着。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li wieħed jibqa' f'post għal ċertu żmien mingħajr ma jitlaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you stay somewhere, you remain in that place for a period of time.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'noqodu' tesprimi l-idea li nibqgħu f'post għal xi żmien.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'noqodu' expresses the idea of staying in a place for some time.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“noqodu”表达在某个地方停留一段时间的意思。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'noqodu' f'dan l-eżerċizzju? Pawlu: Tfisser li nibqgħu f'post u ma nitilqux.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'noqodu' mean in this exercise? Pawlu: It means that we stay in a place and do not leave.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这道练习里的“noqodu”是什么意思？保罗：意思是我们留在某个地方，不离开。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'noqodu' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'noqodu' f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的“noqodu”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'noqodu' mean in this exercise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li nibqgħu f'post u ma nitilqux.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li nibqgħu f'post u ma nitilqux.
messages.zh: 意思是我们留在某个地方，不离开。
messages.en: It means that we stay in a place and do not leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 noqodu 和“留在原地”的画面一起记：想象自己坐在长椅上继续等候，用场景记住所给的“停留”义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression supplied with the meaning that the speaker and other people stop sleeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示包括说话人在内的“我们”从睡眠中醒来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni mogħtija bit-tifsira li aħna ma nibqgħux reqdin u nsiru mqajmin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我们醒来；我们从睡眠状态转为清醒状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aħna nieqfu norqdu u nsiru mqajmin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When we wake up, we stop sleeping and become aware of our surroundings.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'noqomsu' tesprimi l-idea li aħna nieqfu norqdu u nsiru mqajmin.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'noqomsu' expresses the idea that we stop sleeping and wake up.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“noqomsu”表达我们结束睡眠、醒过来的意思。

colloquial.mt: Sara: 'Noqomsu' tfisser li mmorru norqdu? Mark: Le, f'dan l-eżerċizzju tfisser li aħna ma nibqgħux reqdin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does 'noqomsu' mean that we go to sleep? Mark: No, in this exercise it means that we are no longer asleep.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：“noqomsu”是说我们去睡觉吗？马克：不是，在这道练习里，它表示我们醒来、不再睡着。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Noqomsu' tfisser li mmorru norqdu?
messages.mt_standard: 'Noqomsu' tfisser li mmorru norqdu?
messages.zh: “noqomsu”是说我们去睡觉吗？
messages.en: Does 'noqomsu' mean that we go to sleep?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, f'dan l-eżerċizzju tfisser li aħna ma nibqgħux reqdin.
messages.mt_standard: Le, f'dan l-eżerċizzju tfisser li aħna ma nibqgħux reqdin.
messages.zh: 不是，在这道练习里，它表示我们醒来、不再睡着。
messages.en: No, in this exercise it means that we are no longer asleep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 noqomsu 配上“闹钟响了，我们一起睁眼”的画面；记忆时完整说出“我们醒来”，同时记住人物和动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Nordic countries of northern Europe, their people, or their cultures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与欧洲北部的北欧国家、当地居民或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-pajjiżi Nordiċi fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa, man-nies tagħhom jew mal-kulturi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北欧的；与北欧国家、居民或文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-pajjiżi Nordiċi, in-nies li jgħixu fihom jew il-kulturi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Nordic relates to the Nordic countries, their people, or their cultures.

formal.mt: L-artiklu jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' kuljum f'pajjiż nordiku.
formal.en: The article describes everyday life in a Nordic country.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了一个北欧国家的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-istil nordiku jogħġbok? David: Iva, jogħġbuni l-kuluri ċari u l-għamara sempliċi f'din il-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this Nordic style? David: Yes, I like the light colours and the simple furniture in this room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这种北欧风格吗？戴维：喜欢，我喜欢这个房间里的浅色调和简洁家具。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-istil nordiku jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-istil nordiku jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 你喜欢这种北欧风格吗？
messages.en: Do you like this Nordic style?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jogħġbuni l-kuluri ċari u l-għamara sempliċi f'din il-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jogħġbuni l-kuluri ċari u l-għamara sempliċi f'din il-kamra.
messages.zh: 喜欢，我喜欢这个房间里的浅色调和简洁家具。
messages.en: Yes, I like the light colours and the simple furniture in this room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nordiku 与英文 Nordic 并排做成词卡，再配一张欧洲北部的地图；看到词就回想“北欧的”，练习搭配 pajjiż nordiku。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A standard of behaviour or practice that a group accepts, or a situation regarded as usual.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个群体认可的行为或做事标准，也可指被认为通常如此的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola jew livell ta' mġiba jew prattika aċċettat minn grupp, jew sitwazzjoni li titqies bħala tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 群体普遍接受的行为规范或标准；也指通常出现、被视为正常的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Regola jew standard li grupp jaċċetta, jew dak li normalment jiġri u jitqies bħala tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A norm is a standard that people accept or a situation that they regard as usual.

formal.mt: Li wieħed jistenna min imissu huwa norma soċjali li tgħin biex jinżamm l-ordni.
formal.en: Waiting one's turn is a social norm that helps maintain order.
formal.zh: 等候轮到自己是一项有助于维持秩序的社会规范。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Hawn kulħadd jasal ħames minuti qabel? Toni: Iva, dik hi n-norma fit-tim tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does everyone here arrive five minutes early? Toni: Yes, that is the norm in our team.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的人都提前五分钟到吗？托尼：对，在我们团队里这就是常态。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn kulħadd jasal ħames minuti qabel?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn kulħadd jasal ħames minuti qabel?
messages.zh: 这里的人都提前五分钟到吗？
messages.en: Does everyone here arrive five minutes early?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hi n-norma fit-tim tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hi n-norma fit-tim tagħna.
messages.zh: 对，在我们团队里这就是常态。
messages.en: Yes, that is the norm in our team.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 norma 和英文 norm 放在同一张词卡上：想到大家排队遵守的“规范”，再想到团队平时如此的“常态”，用两个场景区分侧重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A nostalgic feeling or quality associated with affectionate memories of the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因温情地回忆过去的人、地方或经历而产生的怀念情绪，或作品所呈现的怀旧意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' ħlewwa u xi ftit dieqa meta wieħed jiftakar nies, postijiet jew esperjenzi tal-imgħoddi, jew il-kwalità li tqanqal dan is-sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀旧的；表现出对往昔的人、地方或经历的温情眷恋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi jew iqanqal ħlewwa u xewqa għall-imgħoddi, speċjalment għal nies, postijiet jew esperjenzi li wieħed jiftakar b'għożża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something nostalgic makes you remember past people, places, or experiences with affection and often a little sadness.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratti tal-villaġġ ta' dari joħolqu atmosfera ta' nostalgia u jfakkru lill-viżitaturi fil-ħajja ta' tfulithom.
formal.en: The photographs of the village in earlier times create an atmosphere of nostalgia and remind visitors of their childhood lives.
formal.zh: 这些展现村庄旧貌的照片营造出怀旧氛围，让参观者想起童年生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed terġa' tisma' dawn il-kanzunetti qodma? Leo: Jagħtuni sens ta' nostalgia. Ifakkruni fis-sjuf li kont inqatta' għand in-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you listening to these old songs again? Leo: They give me a feeling of nostalgia. They remind me of the summers I used to spend at my grandmother's.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么又在听这些老歌？利奥：它们让我很怀旧，让我想起以前在奶奶家度过的夏天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed terġa' tisma' dawn il-kanzunetti qodma?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed terġa' tisma' dawn il-kanzunetti qodma?
messages.zh: 你怎么又在听这些老歌？
messages.en: Why are you listening to these old songs again?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jagħtuni sens ta' nostalgia. Ifakkruni fis-sjuf li kont inqatta' għand in-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Jagħtuni sens ta' nostalgia. Ifakkruni fis-sjuf li kont inqatta' għand in-nanna.
messages.zh: 它们让我很怀旧，让我想起以前在奶奶家度过的夏天。
messages.en: They give me a feeling of nostalgia. They remind me of the summers I used to spend at my grandmother's.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与老照片、童年歌曲连在一起记：心里暖暖的，又有一点回不去的惆怅，就是怀旧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short written message or record, or a symbol representing a musical sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于传达信息或帮助记忆的简短文字记录；在音乐中，也指表示一个乐音的音符。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġ jew tagħrif qasir bil-miktub biex wieħed jikkomunika jew jiftakar xi ħaġa; fil-mużika, sinjal li jirrappreżenta ħoss mużikali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 便条；为传递信息或备忘而写下的简短文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba qasira li fiha messaġġ jew tagħrif biex tgħarraf lil xi ħadd b'xi ħaġa jew biex tgħin lil min jaqraha jiftakar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A note is a short written message or record that communicates information or helps someone remember something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 音符；乐谱中表示一个乐音及其时值的符号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sinjal f'partitura li juri l-għoli ta' ħoss mużikali u kemm għandu jdum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A musical note is a written symbol that indicates the pitch and duration of a sound in music.

collocations.zh: 写一张便条；作简短记录

formal.mt: L-għalliema ħalliet nota lill-istudenti biex ifakkru ruħhom jaqraw kull nota mużikali bir-reqqa qabel idoqqu s-silta.
formal.en: The teacher left the students a note reminding them to read each musical note carefully before playing the passage.
formal.zh: 老师给学生留了一张便条，提醒他们在演奏乐段之前仔细识读每一个音符。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt in-nota li ħallejtlek fuq il-pjanu? Mark: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx naqra din in-nota mużikali. Sara: Ejja, nurik kif taqraha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see the note I left you on the piano? Mark: Yes, but I still don't know how to read this musical note. Sara: Come here, I'll show you how to read it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到我留在钢琴上的便条了吗？马克：看到了，不过我还是不认识这个音符。萨拉：来，我教你怎么认。

messages.speaker: Sara (钢琴老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt in-nota li ħallejtlek fuq il-pjanu?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt in-nota li ħallejtlek fuq il-pjanu?
messages.zh: 你看到我留在钢琴上的便条了吗？
messages.en: Did you see the note I left you on the piano?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx naqra din in-nota mużikali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx naqra din in-nota mużikali.
messages.zh: 看到了，不过我还是不认识这个音符。
messages.en: Yes, but I still don't know how to read this musical note.

messages.speaker: Sara (钢琴老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja, nurik kif taqraha.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja, nurik kif taqraha.
messages.zh: 来，我教你怎么认。
messages.en: Come here, I'll show you how to read it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象钢琴上放着一张便条，乐谱上写着一个音符：两种都可以叫 nota，靠书写或音乐场景区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business document notifying someone of an amount entered as a debit to an account.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 商业往来中用于通知某笔金额已记入某账户借方的单据，常用于说明收费或账款调整。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument kummerċjali li javża li ammont tniżżel fuq in-naħa tad-debitu ta' kont u li jispjega l-ħlas jew l-aġġustament marbut miegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借记通知单；通知交易对方某笔金额已作借方入账，并说明相关收费或调整的商业单据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li bih parti f'tranżazzjoni tgħarraf lill-parti l-oħra b'ammont irreġistrat bħala debitu f'kont, flimkien mar-raġuni għal dik ir-reġistrazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A debit note is a business document informing another party that an amount has been recorded as a debit to an account.

formal.mt: Il-fornitur ħareġ nota ta' debitu biex jitlob il-ħlas tal-ispejjeż tat-trasport li ma kinux inklużi fil-fattura oriġinali.
formal.en: The supplier issued a debit note to request payment of the transport costs that had not been included in the original invoice.
formal.zh: 供应商开具了一张借记通知单，要求支付原发票未包含的运输费用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex irċevejna din in-nota ta' debitu? Pawlu: Hi għall-ispejjeż tat-trasport li ma dehrux fil-fattura. Nina: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw l-ammont qabel inħallsu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why did we receive this debit note? Pawlu: It's for the transport costs that weren't shown on the invoice. Nina: Then let's check the amount before we pay.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们为什么收到了这张借记通知单？保罗：这是发票上没列出的运输费。妮娜：那我们付款前先核对一下金额。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irċevejna din in-nota ta' debitu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irċevejna din in-nota ta' debitu?
messages.zh: 我们为什么收到了这张借记通知单？
messages.en: Why did we receive this debit note?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Hi għall-ispejjeż tat-trasport li ma dehrux fil-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Hi għall-ispejjeż tat-trasport li ma dehrux fil-fattura.
messages.zh: 这是发票上没列出的运输费。
messages.en: It's for the transport costs that weren't shown on the invoice.

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw l-ammont qabel inħallsu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ejja niċċekkjaw l-ammont qabel inħallsu.
messages.zh: 那我们付款前先核对一下金额。
messages.en: Then let's check the amount before we pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“通知单上写明借方金额”这一画面记忆整组词；遇到它先找金额、调整原因和对应账户。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal notification concerning the export of goods that were previously imported.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 就先前进口的货物再次运出有关地区而作出的正式通知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avviż formali dwar il-ħruġ mill-ġdid ta' merkanzija minn territorju wara li dik il-merkanzija kienet iddaħħlet fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 再出口通知；向有关主管机关通报先前进口的货物将再次运出的正式通知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Avviż formali lill-awtorità rilevanti li merkanzija li kienet ġiet importata se terġa' tinħareġ mit-territorju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A re-export notification formally informs the relevant authority that previously imported goods are to be exported again.

collocations.en: the details in the re-export notification
collocations.zh: 再出口通知中的详细信息

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ssottomettiet notifika ta' riesportazzjoni lill-awtorità rilevanti dwar il-merkanzija importata li kienet se tintbagħat lura lill-fornitur.
formal.en: The company submitted a re-export notification to the relevant authority concerning the imported goods that were to be sent back to the supplier.
formal.zh: 公司向有关主管机关提交了再出口通知，说明此前进口的货物将被运回供应商。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħejjejt in-notifika ta' riesportazzjoni għal dawn il-kaxxi? David: Iva, imma għandi bżonn in-numru tal-konsenja qabel nissottomettiha. Lara: Qiegħed fuq id-dokument li bgħattlek dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you prepared the re-export notification for these boxes? David: Yes, but I need the consignment number before I submit it. Lara: It's on the document I sent you this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这些箱子的再出口通知准备好了吗？戴维：准备好了，不过提交前我还需要这批货的托运编号。拉拉：就在我今天早上发给你的文件上。

messages.speaker: Lara (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħejjejt in-notifika ta' riesportazzjoni għal dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Ħejjejt in-notifika ta' riesportazzjoni għal dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 这些箱子的再出口通知准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you prepared the re-export notification for these boxes?

messages.speaker: David (物流专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għandi bżonn in-numru tal-konsenja qabel nissottomettiha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għandi bżonn in-numru tal-konsenja qabel nissottomettiha.
messages.zh: 准备好了，不过提交前我还需要这批货的托运编号。
messages.en: Yes, but I need the consignment number before I submit it.

messages.speaker: Lara (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed fuq id-dokument li bgħattlek dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed fuq id-dokument li bgħattlek dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 就在我今天早上发给你的文件上。
messages.en: It's on the document I sent you this morning.
