cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条“货物先进入、随后再运出”的路线，再在出口处放一份通知书，用整个场景记住“再出口通知”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Occurring at night, or describing an animal that is mainly active at night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指在夜间发生或进行的，也可形容主要在夜间活动的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew isir bil-lejl, jew li jiddeskrivi annimal li jkun attiv l-aktar bil-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夜间发生或进行的；主要在夜间活动的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ matul il-lejl jew li jkun attiv l-aktar matul il-lejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is nocturnal happens at night, and a nocturnal animal is mainly active during the night.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-imġiba ta' annimal notturn li joħroġ ifittex l-ikel wara nżul ix-xemx.
formal.en: The report describes the behaviour of a nocturnal animal that comes out to look for food after sunset.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一种夜间活动动物的行为：它在日落后出来觅食。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan l-annimal joħroġ biss meta jidlam? Toni: Għax hu annimal notturn; ikun attiv l-aktar bil-lejl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this animal only come out when it gets dark? Toni: Because it is a nocturnal animal; it is mainly active at night.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么这种动物只在天黑后出来？托尼：因为它是夜间活动的动物，主要在晚上活动。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan l-annimal joħroġ biss meta jidlam?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan l-annimal joħroġ biss meta jidlam?
messages.zh: 为什么这种动物只在天黑后出来？
messages.en: Why does this animal only come out when it gets dark?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu annimal notturn; ikun attiv l-aktar bil-lejl.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu annimal notturn; ikun attiv l-aktar bil-lejl.
messages.zh: 因为它是夜间活动的动物，主要在晚上活动。
messages.en: Because it is a nocturnal animal; it is mainly active at night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 notturn 放进月亮下动物觅食的画面，再配上“夜班”场景，记住它表示夜间的或夜间活动的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short work of fiction that tells a story within a limited space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 篇幅较短的虚构叙事作品，在有限篇幅内讲述一个故事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rakkont qasir ta' finzjoni li jippreżenta storja fi spazju limitat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短篇小说；篇幅较短的虚构故事作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kitba narrattiva qasira ta' finzjoni li tirrakkonta storja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A short story is a work of fiction that tells a story in a relatively small number of pages.

formal.mt: Għall-kompetizzjoni letterarja, kull parteċipant għandu jikteb novella dwar il-ħajja f'raħal żgħir.
formal.en: For the literary competition, each participant must write a short story about life in a small village.
formal.zh: 参加文学比赛的每位选手都须写一篇关于小村庄生活的短篇小说。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qed taqra? Pawlu: Novella dwar żewġ ħbieb li jerġgħu jiltaqgħu wara ħafna snin. Lara: Meta tlestiha, nista' naqraha jien?
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you reading? Pawlu: A short story about two friends who meet again after many years. Lara: When you finish it, can I read it?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你在读什么？保罗：一篇短篇小说，讲两个朋友多年后重逢的故事。拉拉：你读完后，我可以读吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Novella dwar żewġ ħbieb li jerġgħu jiltaqgħu wara ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Novella dwar żewġ ħbieb li jerġgħu jiltaqgħu wara ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 一篇短篇小说，讲两个朋友多年后重逢的故事。
messages.en: A short story about two friends who meet again after many years.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta tlestiha, nista' naqraha jien?
messages.mt_standard: Meta tlestiha, nista' naqraha jien?
messages.zh: 你读完后，我可以读吗？
messages.en: When you finish it, can I read it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 novella 就想象几页纸讲完一个完整故事，把“篇幅短、故事完整”的画面与短篇小说一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used to hold incense before it is taken out for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放乳香、供使用时取出的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent li fih jinżamm l-inċens sakemm jittieħed biex jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于盛放或存放乳香的容器。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent li jintuża biex jinżamm fih l-inċens.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A novetta is a container in which incense is kept until it is needed.

collocations.en: to fill the incense container with incense
collocations.zh: 往乳香容器里装入乳香

formal.mt: Qabel iċ-ċerimonja, is-sagristan għandu jiċċekkja li n-novetta jkun fiha biżżejjed inċens.
formal.en: Before the ceremony, the sacristan must check that the incense container holds enough incense.
formal.zh: 仪式开始前，圣器管理员须检查乳香容器内是否装有足够的乳香。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt in-novetta? Ġużeppi: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tal-inċens. Marija: Tajjeb, se nimlieha qabel tibda ċ-ċerimonja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put the incense container? Ġużeppi: On the table, beside the bag of incense. Marija: Good, I'll fill it before the ceremony starts.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你把乳香容器放在哪里了？朱塞佩：在桌上，乳香袋旁边。玛丽亚：好，我会在仪式开始前把它装满。

messages.speaker: Marija (仪式助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt in-novetta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt in-novetta?
messages.zh: 你把乳香容器放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the incense container?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (圣器管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tal-inċens.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-borża tal-inċens.
messages.zh: 在桌上，乳香袋旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the bag of incense.

messages.speaker: Marija (仪式助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nimlieha qabel tibda ċ-ċerimonja.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nimlieha qabel tibda ċ-ċerimonja.
messages.zh: 好，我会在仪式开始前把它装满。
messages.en: Good, I'll fill it before the ceremony starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 novetta 想成桌上专门盛放乳香的容器，练习“打开、装满、取出乳香”的动作来记住用途。

gloss_zh: 新手；初学者；修会初学生

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is new to an activity and has little experience, or someone beginning training in a religious order.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刚开始从事某项活动、经验尚少的人；也指处于修会初期培育阶段的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għadha tibda attività u għandha ftit esperjenza, jew persuna fil-bidu tal-formazzjoni f'ordni reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新手；刚开始学习或从事某项活动、缺乏经验的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għadha tibda titgħallem jew tipprattika attività u għad għandha ftit esperjenza fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A novice is someone who has only recently started an activity and has little experience of it.

sense_translations.en_definition: person in the early stages of religious orders
sense_translations.zh_definition: 修会初学生；处于修会生活与培育初期阶段的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tinsab fl-ewwel stadji tal-ħajja u tal-formazzjoni f'ordni reliġjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A novice in a religious order is a person undergoing the initial stages of religious training and community life.

collocations.en: a novice in a religious order

formal.mt: In-novizz fl-ordni reliġjuż jieħu sehem f'laqgħat ta' tagħlim u fil-ħajja ta' kuljum tal-komunità.
formal.en: The novice in the religious order takes part in learning sessions and in the community's daily life.
formal.zh: 这位修会初学生参加学习活动，并参与团体的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għadni novizz fil-fotografija; tista' turini kif nuża din il-kamera? Sara: Żgur. Nibdew billi nieħdu ritratt sempliċi ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm still a novice in photography; can you show me how to use this camera? Sara: Of course. Let's start by taking a simple photo beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我还是摄影新手，你能教我怎么用这台相机吗？萨拉：当然。我们先在窗边拍一张简单的照片吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni novizz fil-fotografija; tista' turini kif nuża din il-kamera?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni novizz fil-fotografija; tista' turini kif nuża din il-kamera?
messages.zh: 我还是摄影新手，你能教我怎么用这台相机吗？
messages.en: I'm still a novice in photography; can you show me how to use this camera?

messages.speaker: Sara (摄影老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Nibdew billi nieħdu ritratt sempliċi ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Nibdew billi nieħdu ritratt sempliċi ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 当然。我们先在窗边拍一张简单的照片吧。
messages.en: Of course. Let's start by taking a simple photo beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅“刚入门”的画面记 novizz：一位摄影新手正在学操作，一位修会初学生正在接受培育；靠语境区分两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book with pages for writing notes and recording information.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来书写笔记、记录信息的本子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb b'paġni li jintużaw biex jinkitbu noti u informazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供书写笔记或记录信息使用的本子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ktieb li fih wieħed jikteb noti, ideat jew informazzjoni li jrid iżomm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A notebook is a book in which you write notes, ideas, or information you want to remember.

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jġib nowtbuk biex jikteb in-noti waqt il-lezzjoni.
formal.en: Each student should bring a notebook to take notes during the lesson.
formal.zh: 每位学生都应带一本笔记本，以便在课堂上记笔记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek nowtbuk żejjed? Irrid nikteb xi noti. Mark: Iva, ħu dan. Għadu ġdid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a spare notebook? I want to take some notes. Mark: Yes, take this one. It's still new.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有多余的笔记本吗？我想记点笔记。马克：有，拿这本吧。还是新的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek nowtbuk żejjed? Irrid nikteb xi noti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek nowtbuk żejjed? Irrid nikteb xi noti.
messages.zh: 你有多余的笔记本吗？我想记点笔记。
messages.en: Do you have a spare notebook? I want to take some notes.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan. Għadu ġdid.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan. Għadu ġdid.
messages.zh: 有，拿这本吧。还是新的。
messages.en: Yes, take this one. It's still new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nowtbuk 和“打开本子记笔记”的画面相连，再用 nowtbuk ġdid 练习“新笔记本”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aromatic spice made from a seed, used whole for grating or already ground to flavour food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肉豆蔻，一种由种子制成的芳香香料，可现磨或以粉末形式用于食物调味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħwawar aromatiċi magħmula minn żerriegħa, li tinħakk jew tintuża mitħuna biex tagħti togħma lill-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肉豆蔻，用作调味香料的芳香种子，也指由它磨成的香料粉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żerriegħa aromatika li tintuża bħala ħwawar fl-ikel, kif ukoll it-trab magħmul minnha meta titħan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Nutmeg is an aromatic seed used as a spice, often grated or ground into food.

formal.mt: Żid niskata noċemuskata maz-zalza bajda u ħawwad sew qabel isservi.
formal.en: Add a pinch of nutmeg to the white sauce and stir well before serving.
formal.zh: 在白酱中加入一小撮肉豆蔻，上桌前充分搅拌。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'żidt mal-patata? Għandha togħma tajba ħafna. Toni: Ftit noċemuskata u biċċa butir. Marija: Mela d-darba li jmiss nipprova hekk ukoll!
colloquial.en: Marija: What did you add to the potatoes? They taste really good. Toni: A little nutmeg and a piece of butter. Marija: Then I will try that next time too!
colloquial.zh: Marija：你在土豆里加了什么？味道真好。Toni：一点肉豆蔻和一块黄油。Marija：那我下次也试试这个做法！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'żidt mal-patata? Għandha togħma tajba ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: X'żidt mal-patata? Għandha togħma tajba ħafna.
messages.zh: 你在土豆里加了什么？味道真好。
messages.en: What did you add to the potatoes? They taste really good.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit noċemuskata u biċċa butir.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit noċemuskata u biċċa butir.
messages.zh: 一点肉豆蔻和一块黄油。
messages.en: A little nutmeg and a piece of butter.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela d-darba li jmiss nipprova hekk ukoll!
messages.mt_standard: Mela d-darba li jmiss nipprova hekk ukoll!
messages.zh: 那我下次也试试这个做法！
messages.en: Then I will try that next time too!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 noċemuskata 时想象给白酱撒一小撮肉豆蔻粉，把整词和香料罐、少量调味的动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fault or imperfection that makes something less complete or satisfactory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使事物不够完善或不够理想的缺陷、瑕疵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Difett jew imperfezzjoni li tagħmel xi ħaġa inqas sħiħa jew inqas sodisfaċenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物中不完善、有毛病或未达到应有标准的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karatteristika ħażina jew difett f'xi ħaġa li ma jħallihiex tkun kif suppost.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imperfection or defect is a fault that prevents something from being as good or complete as it should be.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika nqas fid-disinn li għandu jiġi kkoreġut qabel il-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The report identifies a defect in the design that should be corrected before production.
formal.zh: 报告指出了设计中的一个缺陷，应在生产前予以纠正。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, hemm nqas żgħir f'din it-tazza. Mark: Veru, aħjar nagħżlu oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, there's a small defect in this cup. Mark: You're right; we'd better choose another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，这个杯子有个小瑕疵。马克：确实，我们最好换一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, hemm nqas żgħir f'din it-tazza.
messages.mt_standard: Ara, hemm nqas żgħir f'din it-tazza.
messages.zh: 看，这个杯子有个小瑕疵。
messages.en: Look, there's a small defect in this cup.

messages.speaker: Mark (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, aħjar nagħżlu oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, aħjar nagħżlu oħra.
messages.zh: 确实，我们最好换一个。
messages.en: You're right; we'd better choose another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象检查杯子时圈出一个小瑕疵，用 nqas żgħir 把这个名词和“缺陷”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry provisionally labelled as a noun whose meaning remains unresolved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂列为名词、但尚未确定可靠词义的词条；学习时应保留疑问标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entrata mmarkata proviżorjament bħala nom li t-tifsira tagħha għadha mhix stabbilita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义未明；此处未提供可据以确定名词含义的释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira ta' din l-entrata bħala nom għadha mhix magħrufa u teħtieġ kjarifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this provisionally labelled noun remains unresolved, so no specific lexical sense can be taught confidently.

collocations.zh: “nsegwu”这个词的含义（询问待确认词义）

formal.mt: It-tifsira tal-kelma 'nsegwu' bħala nom għadha mhix stabbilita; għalhekk, l-entrata teħtieġ kjarifika qabel tintuża fit-tagħlim.
formal.en: The meaning of the word 'nsegwu' as a noun has not yet been established; the entry therefore needs clarification before it is used in teaching.
formal.zh: “nsegwu”作为名词的含义尚未确定，因此该词条需要澄清后才能用于教学。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'nsegwu' hawn? Mark: Għadni ma nafx. Inħallu mistoqsija ħdejha sakemm niċċaraw it-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'nsegwu' mean here? Mark: I don't know yet. Let's leave a question mark beside it until we clarify the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：“nsegwu”这个词在这里是什么意思？马克：我还不知道。先在旁边标个问号，等弄清词义再说。

messages.speaker: Maja (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'nsegwu' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'nsegwu' hawn?
messages.zh: “nsegwu”这个词在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'nsegwu' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma nafx. Inħallu mistoqsija ħdejha sakemm niċċaraw it-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma nafx. Inħallu mistoqsija ħdejha sakemm niċċaraw it-tifsira.
messages.zh: 我还不知道。先在旁边标个问号，等弄清词义再说。
messages.en: I don't know yet. Let's leave a question mark beside it until we clarify the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nsegwu 写在带问号的词卡上，记住“名词义待确认”；不要把 idk 当作它的实际词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be known, with information becoming available to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某事被人知道，相关信息得到知晓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun magħruf minn xi ħadd, billi l-informazzjoni dwaru tasal għand dik il-persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被人知晓；有关事实或信息为人所知。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fatt jew informazzjoni jkunu magħrufa minn persuna jew minn grupp ta' nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is known, people have information about it or are aware that it is true.

formal.mt: L-isem tar-rebbieħ ntaf wara li tħabbar ir-riżultat uffiċjali.
formal.en: The winner's name became known after the official result was announced.
formal.zh: 官方结果公布后，获胜者的姓名才为人所知。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta ntaf ir-riżultat? Mark: Ir-riżultat ntaf dalgħodu, wara t-tħabbira.
colloquial.en: Maja: When did the result become known? Mark: The result became known this morning, after the announcement.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：结果是什么时候揭晓的？马克：今天早上，公告发布后就知道了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta ntaf ir-riżultat?
messages.mt_standard: Meta ntaf ir-riżultat?
messages.zh: 结果是什么时候揭晓的？
messages.en: When did the result become known?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riżultat ntaf dalgħodu, wara t-tħabbira.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riżultat ntaf dalgħodu, wara t-tħabbira.
messages.zh: 今天早上，公告发布后就知道了。
messages.en: The result became known this morning, after the announcement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象结果公告揭开，大家终于知道答案；用 ir-riżultat ntaf 记住“结果被知晓”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A black powder left by smoke when fuel does not burn completely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃料燃烧不完全时产生、随烟附着在物体表面的黑色粉末。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trab iswed li jifforma meta fjuwil ma jinħaraqx kompletament u li jista' jeħel mal-uċuħ mad-duħħan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟炱；燃烧不完全所产生的黑色粉末，常附着于烟囱、墙面等处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trab iswed prodott minn ħruq mhux komplut, li jinġarr mad-duħħan u jinġabar fuq uċuħ bħal dawk taċ-ċmieni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Soot is the black powder that smoke leaves on surfaces when something burns incompletely.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, instab saff oħxon ta' nugrufun fuq ġewwa taċ-ċumnija.
formal.en: During the inspection, a thick layer of soot was found inside the chimney.
formal.zh: 检查时发现，烟囱内壁积有一层厚厚的烟灰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex idejk suwed? Pawlu: Naddaft iċ-ċumnija u mtlejt bin-nugrufun.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are your hands black? Pawlu: I cleaned the chimney and got covered in soot.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的手怎么黑了？保罗：我清理了烟囱，弄得满身都是烟灰。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex idejk suwed?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex idejk suwed?
messages.zh: 你的手怎么黑了？
messages.en: Why are your hands black?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naddaft iċ-ċumnija u mtlejt bin-nugrufun.
messages.mt_standard: Naddaft iċ-ċumnija u mtlejt bin-nugrufun.
messages.zh: 我清理了烟囱，弄得满身都是烟灰。
messages.en: I cleaned the chimney and got covered in soot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nugrufun 和“擦完烟囱，手变黑”的画面一起记：它指烟留下的黑色粉末。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The central part of an atom, or the structure in a cell that contains genetic material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 原子的中心部分，或细胞中含有遗传物质的结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ċentrali ta' atomu, jew l-istruttura f'ċellola li fiha jinsab il-materjal ġenetiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 核：指原子中心的原子核，或细胞中含有遗传物质的细胞核。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti li tinsab fiċ-ċentru ta' atomu, jew struttura f'ċellola li jkun fiha l-materjal ġenetiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The nucleus is the central part of an atom or the structure within a cell that contains its genetic material.

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, in-nukleu tal-atomu jidher fiċ-ċentru, filwaqt li l-elettroni jidhru madwaru.
formal.en: In the diagram, the nucleus of the atom is shown at the centre, while the electrons are shown around it.
formal.zh: 图中，原子核位于中心，电子则画在其周围。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan iċ-ċirku fid-disinn taċ-ċellola? Mark: Dak hu n-nukleu; fih jinsab il-materjal ġenetiku.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this circle in the drawing of the cell? Mark: That is the nucleus; it contains the genetic material.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：细胞图里的这个圆是什么？马克：那是细胞核，里面含有遗传物质。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan iċ-ċirku fid-disinn taċ-ċellola?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan iċ-ċirku fid-disinn taċ-ċellola?
messages.zh: 细胞图里的这个圆是什么？
messages.en: What is this circle in the drawing of the cell?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak hu n-nukleu; fih jinsab il-materjal ġenetiku.
messages.mt_standard: Dak hu n-nukleu; fih jinsab il-materjal ġenetiku.
messages.zh: 那是细胞核，里面含有遗传物质。
messages.en: That is the nucleus; it contains the genetic material.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 nukleu 配在两张科学图上记：原子图中标“原子核”，细胞图中标“细胞核”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to numbers or expressed using numbers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与数字有关的，或用数字、数值表示的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-numri jew li huwa espress permezz tan-numri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 数字的；数值的；涉及数字或以数字形式表达的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda n-numri jew li juża n-numri biex jesprimi informazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is numerical relates to numbers or presents information in the form of numbers.

formal.mt: Kull parteċipant ingħata kodiċi numeriku biex l-isem tiegħu ma jidhirx fir-riżultati.
formal.en: Each participant was assigned a numerical code so that their name would not appear in the results.
formal.zh: 每位参与者都获分配了一个数字代码，以免其姓名出现在结果中。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kodiċi fih ittri wkoll? Ben: Le, huwa kodiċi numeriku ta' sitt ċifri.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the code contain letters too? Ben: No, it is a six-digit numerical code.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：代码里也有字母吗？本：没有，这是一个六位数字代码。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kodiċi fih ittri wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kodiċi fih ittri wkoll?
messages.zh: 代码里也有字母吗？
messages.en: Does the code contain letters too?

messages.speaker: Ben (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa kodiċi numeriku ta' sitt ċifri.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa kodiċi numeriku ta' sitt ċifri.
messages.zh: 没有，这是一个六位数字代码。
messages.en: No, it is a six-digit numerical code.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 numeriku，就想到“用数字表示”：例如数字代码和数值；它描述形式，不表示数量很多。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Present in large numbers, or consisting of many people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数量很多的，或由许多人、许多事物组成的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeżisti f'għadd kbir jew li huwa magħmul minn ħafna nies jew affarijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 众多的；数量很大的；也形容群体成员很多。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun hemm ħafna minnu jew li jkollu għadd kbir ta' membri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People or things described as numerous exist in large numbers, and a numerous group has many members.

formal.mt: Grupp numeruż ta' studenti ħa sehem fiż-żjara tal-mużew.
formal.en: A large group of students took part in the museum visit.
formal.zh: 一大群学生参加了博物馆参观活动。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-grupp se jkun numeruż? Sam: Iva, se jiġu erbgħin persuna, allura rridu aktar siġġijiet.
colloquial.en: Nina: Will it be a large group? Sam: Yes, forty people are coming, so we need more chairs.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这组会有很多人吗？萨姆：会，有四十个人要来，所以我们需要更多椅子。

messages.speaker: Nina (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-grupp se jkun numeruż?
messages.mt_standard: Il-grupp se jkun numeruż?
messages.zh: 这组会有很多人吗？
messages.en: Will it be a large group?

messages.speaker: Sam (活动助手)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se jiġu erbgħin persuna, allura rridu aktar siġġijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se jiġu erbgħin persuna, allura rridu aktar siġġijiet.
messages.zh: 会，有四十个人要来，所以我们需要更多椅子。
messages.en: Yes, forty people are coming, so we need more chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 numeruż 和“人多到要加椅子”的场景一起记：重点是数量多；搭配 grupp numeruż 练习。

gloss_zh: 钱币学的；与钱币研究或收藏有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the study or collection of coins and other forms of currency.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与钱币及其他货币形式的研究或收藏有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-istudju jew il-ġbir tal-muniti u ta' forom oħra ta' flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱币学的；涉及钱币及其他货币形式的研究或收藏的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-istudju jew il-ġbir tal-muniti u ta' forom oħra ta' flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something numismatic is connected with the study or collection of coins and other forms of currency.

formal.mt: L-istudju numiżmatiku janalizza l-muniti fil-kollezzjoni tal-mużew.
formal.en: The numismatic study analyses the coins in the museum's collection.
formal.zh: 这项钱币学研究分析了博物馆馆藏中的钱币。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-munita għandha valur numiżmatiku? Pawlu: Jista' jkun, imma rridu nistaqsu lil espert.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this coin have numismatic value? Pawlu: It might, but we need to ask an expert.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这枚钱币有钱币收藏价值吗？保罗：可能有，不过我们得问问专家。

messages.speaker: Maja (钱币收藏初学者)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-munita għandha valur numiżmatiku?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-munita għandha valur numiżmatiku?
messages.zh: 这枚钱币有钱币收藏价值吗？
messages.en: Does this coin have numismatic value?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (收藏同好)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun, imma rridu nistaqsu lil espert.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun, imma rridu nistaqsu lil espert.
messages.zh: 可能有，不过我们得问问专家。
messages.en: It might, but we need to ask an expert.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 numiżmatiku 和英语 numismatic 配对记忆：想象放大镜下的一枚收藏钱币，再用 valur numiżmatiku 记住它表示与钱币研究或收藏有关的性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Numbers, numerals, or identifying numbers, considered as more than one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量的数、书写出来的数字，或用于识别事物的多个号码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' numri li juru kwantitajiet, jintużaw fil-kalkoli jew jidentifikaw persuni u affarijiet.

sense_translations.en_definition: numbers; numerals; I'm not knowledgeable, but your dictionary holds numru, numrijiet (both fem), and I read "numri" as plural (masc) for "numru" in [Camilleri: Merħba bik], as well as on https://www.publictransport.com.mt/mt/news-details/50-millionth-bus-passenger-welcomed-by-malta-public-transport
sense_translations.zh_definition: 数；数字；号码，指用于计数、表示数量或识别事物的多个数或数字符号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Valuri jew sinjali miktuba li bihom ngħoddu, nuru kwantitajiet, nagħmlu kalkoli jew nidentifikaw persuni u affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Numbers are values or written symbols used to count, express quantities, perform calculations, or identify things.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu n-numri minn wieħed sa għaxra fl-ordni t-tajba.
formal.en: Students should write the numbers from one to ten in the correct order.
formal.zh: 学生应按正确顺序写出一到十的数字。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' taqra dawn in-numri? Mark: Iva, huma tnejn, erbgħa u sitta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you read these numbers? Mark: Yes, they are two, four, and six.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能读出这些数字吗？马克：能，是二、四和六。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' taqra dawn in-numri?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' taqra dawn in-numri?
messages.zh: 你能读出这些数字吗？
messages.en: Can you read these numbers?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huma tnejn, erbgħa u sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huma tnejn, erbgħa u sitta.
messages.zh: 能，是二、四和六。
messages.en: Yes, they are two, four, and six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 numru 与 numri 成对记：一个号码用 numru，多个数字或号码用 numri；脑中摆出二、四、六三个数字，提醒自己这里表达复数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An identifying number assigned to an order for goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分配给商品或服务订单、用于识别和查询该订单的编号。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Numru mogħti lil ordni għal prodotti jew servizzi biex dik l-ordni tkun tista' tiġi identifikata u ċċekkjata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订单号；用于识别、查询或处理某笔商品或服务订单的编号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Numru li jidentifika ordni partikolari għal prodotti jew servizzi u jintuża biex wieħed jistaqsi dwarha jew isegwiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An order number is a reference assigned to a purchase so that the seller and customer can identify it.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, inkludi n-numru tal-ordni f'kull messaġġ dwar ix-xiri tiegħek.
formal.en: Please include the order number in every message about your purchase.
formal.zh: 请在每封有关此次购物的消息中注明订单号。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq inkun naf meta tasal l-ordni tiegħi. Lara: Żgur. Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like to know when my order will arrive. Lara: Of course. Can you give me the order number?
colloquial.zh: 马克：我想知道我的订单什么时候送到。拉拉：当然可以。你能提供订单号吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq inkun naf meta tasal l-ordni tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq inkun naf meta tasal l-ordni tiegħi.
messages.zh: 我想知道我的订单什么时候送到。
messages.en: I'd like to know when my order will arrive.

messages.speaker: Lara (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Tista' tagħtini n-numru tal-ordni?
messages.zh: 当然可以。你能提供订单号吗？
messages.en: Of course. Can you give me the order number?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 numru tal-ordni 当作购物邮件里的固定标签记忆：看到购买确认，就寻找订单号；用“号码对应这笔订单”的画面串起整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sequence of digits used to contact a person or organisation by telephone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电话联系个人或机构时所使用的一串数字。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ċifri li tintuża biex iċċempel lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni bit-telefown.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话号码；拨打电话联系某个人或机构时使用的号码。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' ċifri li ddaħħal fit-telefown biex iċċempel lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A phone number is a sequence of digits you use to call a particular person or organisation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话号码；用于将电话接通至特定个人或机构的数字号码。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Numru magħmul minn sensiela ta' ċifri li bih tista' tagħmel telefonata lil persuna jew organizzazzjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A telephone number identifies the person or organisation you want to reach when making a telephone call.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ikteb in-numru tat-telefown tiegħek fil-formola sabiex inkunu nistgħu nikkuntattjawk.
formal.en: Please enter your telephone number on the form so that we can contact you.
formal.zh: 请在表格中填写您的电话号码，以便我们与您联系。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tat-telefown tiegħek? Lara: Iva, niktibhulek hawn, u tista' ċċempilli għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you give me your phone number? Lara: Yes, I'll write it here for you, and you can call me tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把你的电话号码给我吗？拉拉：可以，我给你写在这里，你明天可以打给我。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tat-telefown tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħtini n-numru tat-telefown tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你能把你的电话号码给我吗？
messages.en: Can you give me your phone number?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niktibhulek hawn, u tista' ċċempilli għada.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niktibhulek hawn, u tista' ċċempilli għada.
messages.zh: 可以，我给你写在这里，你明天可以打给我。
messages.en: Yes, I'll write it here for you, and you can call me tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 telefown 就联想电话，把 numru tat-telefown 整体配上手机拨号界面的画面：先输入一串数字，再按通话键，记住意思是电话号码。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaviour or speech that shows a lack of respect for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语或行为表现出的对某人或某事的不尊重。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba jew kliem li juru li persuna ma turix rispett lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人或某事缺乏尊重，尤其体现在失礼的言语或行为中。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' konsiderazzjoni u rispett lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, li jidher fil-kliem jew fl-imġiba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone shows disrespect, they speak or behave in a way that fails to show proper regard for another person or thing.

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-iskola jiddeskrivu l-insulti lejn studenti oħra bħala nuqqas ta' rispett.
formal.en: The school regulations describe insults directed at other students as disrespect.
formal.zh: 学校规章将辱骂其他学生的行为界定为不尊重他人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt waqt li kont qed nitkellem? Mark: Skużani, ma ridtx nuri nuqqas ta' rispett.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you leave while I was speaking? Mark: Sorry, I did not mean to show disrespect.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我说话的时候，你为什么走了？马克：抱歉，我不是有意不尊重你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt waqt li kont qed nitkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt waqt li kont qed nitkellem?
messages.zh: 我说话的时候，你为什么走了？
messages.en: Why did you leave while I was speaking?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, ma ridtx nuri nuqqas ta' rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, ma ridtx nuri nuqqas ta' rispett.
messages.zh: 抱歉，我不是有意不尊重你。
messages.en: Sorry, I did not mean to show disrespect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“别人说话时转身离开”的场景联系起来，记住它表示言行上的不尊重。

gloss_zh: 石材磨平；石面或墙面的找平

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work of making stone smooth or making a stone surface or wall level.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使石材表面光滑，或使石面、墙面平整的作业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih il-ġebel isir lixx jew il-wiċċ tal-ġebel jew ta' ħajt isir livell.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将石材粗糙的表面磨平、弄光滑的作业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih titneħħa l-ħruxija minn wiċċ il-ġebel biex isir lixx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The smoothing of stone is the work of removing roughness so that its surface becomes smooth.

sense_translations.en_definition: levelling of a stone surface or wall
sense_translations.zh_definition: 消除石面或墙面的高低不平，使其达到平整的作业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li bih jitneħħew id-differenzi fl-għoli minn wiċċ tal-ġebel jew minn ħajt biex il-wiċċ isir livell.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The levelling of a stone surface or wall is the work of making it even by correcting differences in height.

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol ta' nvjar neħħa l-ħruxija mill-ġebel u għamel il-wiċċ tal-ħajt aktar livell.
formal.en: The smoothing and levelling work removed the roughness from the stone and made the wall surface more even.
formal.zh: 磨平与找平作业去除了石材表面的粗糙部分，使墙面更加平整。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-ġebel għadu aħrax. Pawlu: Iva, għad hemm bżonn ta' nvjar biex isir lixx.
colloquial.en: Lara: This stone is still rough. Pawlu: Yes, it still needs smoothing to make it smooth.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块石头还是很粗糙。保罗：是的，还需要磨平，才能变光滑。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ġebel għadu aħrax.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ġebel għadu aħrax.
messages.zh: 这块石头还是很粗糙。
messages.en: This stone is still rough.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (石匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għad hemm bżonn ta' nvjar biex isir lixx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għad hemm bżonn ta' nvjar biex isir lixx.
messages.zh: 是的，还需要磨平，才能变光滑。
messages.en: Yes, it still needs smoothing to make it smooth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想工匠处理石面的画面：手摸不再粗糙是“磨平”，表面不再高低起伏是“找平”，两种意思一起记。

gloss_zh: 我会回答你；我会回复你

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to tell someone that you will answer or respond to them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于告诉对方自己会回答其问题或作出回复的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha min jitkellem jgħid lil persuna oħra li se jagħtiha tweġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 我会对你提出的问题、话语或消息作出回应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tfisser li min jitkellem se jwieġeb lill-persuna li qed ikellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say this to someone, you tell them that you will give an answer to their question or message.

collocations.en: I will respond to you later
I will respond to you in writing
collocations.zh: 我会以书面形式回复你

formal.mt: Nwieġbek bil-miktub wara li neżamina d-dokumenti li bgħattli.
formal.en: I will respond to you in writing after I examine the documents you sent me.
formal.zh: 审阅你发给我的文件后，我会以书面形式回复你。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tgħidli jekk intix ġej għada? Mark: Nwieġbek aktar tard, meta nkun naf il-ħin tax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you tell me whether you are coming tomorrow? Mark: I will get back to you later, when I know my working hours.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你能告诉我明天来不来吗？马克：等我知道工作时间后，晚点回复你。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħidli jekk intix ġej għada?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħidli jekk intix ġej għada?
messages.zh: 你能告诉我明天来不来吗？
messages.en: Can you tell me whether you are coming tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nwieġbek aktar tard, meta nkun naf il-ħin tax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Nwieġbek aktar tard, meta nkun naf il-ħin tax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 等我知道工作时间后，晚点回复你。
messages.en: I will get back to you later, when I know my working hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词作为整句记忆：看到朋友发来问题，就联想“我会回复你”，再搭配 aktar tard 练习“稍后回复”。

gloss_zh: 分担的义务；划分承担份额的义务

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obligation divided into parts, with each person responsible for an assigned part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被划分为若干份额、由各人承担相应部分的义务。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Obbligu maqsum f'partijiet, fejn kull persuna tkun responsabbli għall-parti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在承担者之间划分各自应履行部分的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Obbligu li jinqasam bejn il-persuni li għandhom iwettquh, b'parti speċifika għal kull waħda minnhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A divided obligation is a duty split into separate parts so that each person is responsible for an assigned share.

collocations.en: an obligation divided between two people

collocations.mt: il-parti ta' kull persuna f'obbligu diviż
collocations.en: each person's share of a divided obligation
collocations.zh: 各人在分担义务中承担的部分

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi obbligu diviż u jispeċifika l-parti li għandha twettaq kull persuna.
formal.en: The agreement establishes a divided obligation and specifies the part that each person must perform.
formal.zh: 协议规定了一项分担义务，并明确了每个人应履行的部分。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Xi jfisser obbligu diviż f'dan il-ftehim? David: Ifisser li kull wieħed minna għandu parti x'jagħmel.
colloquial.en: Anna: What does a divided obligation mean in this agreement? David: It means that each of us has a part to carry out.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这份协议里的分担义务是什么意思？戴维：意思是我们每个人都有自己要履行的部分。

messages.speaker: Anna (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser obbligu diviż f'dan il-ftehim?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser obbligu diviż f'dan il-ftehim?
messages.zh: 这份协议里的分担义务是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a divided obligation mean in this agreement?

messages.speaker: David (项目成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li kull wieħed minna għandu parti x'jagħmel.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li kull wieħed minna għandu parti x'jagħmel.
messages.zh: 意思是我们每个人都有自己要履行的部分。
messages.en: It means that each of us has a part to carry out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张义务清单被分给几个人，每个人负责自己的一栏，用“义务分份、各担一份”的画面记住整个短语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A duty to act loyally and responsibly in the interests of a person whose affairs or assets have been entrusted to you.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因受托管理他人的事务或资产而承担的义务，要求忠实、负责地维护受益人的利益。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dmir li persuna taġixxi b'lealtà u responsabbiltà fl-interessi ta' min ikun fdalha l-ġestjoni tal-affarijiet jew tal-assi tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信义义务：受托人基于信任关系，为受益人的利益忠实履职的责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dmir marbut ma' relazzjoni ta' fiduċja li jitlob li min ikun fdat b'responsabbiltà jaġixxi b'lealtà fl-interessi tal-benefiċjarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fiduciary duty is a responsibility to act loyally in the interests of someone who has entrusted you with their affairs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受托义务：因承担受托职责而产生的、维护受益人利益的约束性责任。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Obbligu li jinħoloq meta persuna tingħata responsabbiltà fuq affarijiet jew assi ta' ħaddieħor u tkun meħtieġa tħares l-interessi tal-benefiċjarju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fiduciary obligation requires a trusted person to protect the beneficiary's interests when carrying out their entrusted responsibilities.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li l-persuna responsabbli mill-ġestjoni tal-assi għandha obbligu fiduċjarju lejn il-benefiċjarju.
formal.en: The report explains that the person responsible for managing the assets has a fiduciary duty towards the beneficiary.
formal.zh: 报告说明，负责管理资产的人对受益人承担信义义务。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ma jistax juża dawk il-flus għalih innifsu? Pawlu: Għax għandu obbligu fiduċjarju; irid iħares l-interessi tal-benefiċjarju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why can't he use that money for himself? Pawlu: Because he has a fiduciary duty; he must protect the beneficiary's interests.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他为什么不能把那笔钱拿来自己用？保罗：因为他承担信义义务，必须维护受益人的利益。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma jistax juża dawk il-flus għalih innifsu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma jistax juża dawk il-flus għalih innifsu?
messages.zh: 他为什么不能把那笔钱拿来自己用？
messages.en: Why can't he use that money for himself?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu obbligu fiduċjarju; irid iħares l-interessi tal-benefiċjarju.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu obbligu fiduċjarju; irid iħares l-interessi tal-benefiċjarju.
messages.zh: 因为他承担信义义务，必须维护受益人的利益。
messages.en: Because he has a fiduciary duty; he must protect the beneficiary's interests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组联想成“受人之托，忠于受益人”：管理的是别人的资产，履行的是自己的信义义务。

gloss_zh: 金融输电权义务型合约；义务型金融输电权

teaching_sense.en_definition: An obligation-type financial transmission right under which settlement can require the holder either to receive money or to make a payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种义务型金融输电权，其结算与电力输送相关的价格差额挂钩，持有人既可能获得款项，也可能承担付款责任。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni tal-elettriku li, skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet rilevanti, jista' jagħti lill-possessur ħlas jew jobbligah iħallas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: FTR 义务型合约：金融输电权的一种形式，结算既可能带来收入，也可能产生付款义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni, imsejjaħ FTR, li tista' twassal għal ħlas favur il-possessur jew għal obbligu li jħallas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An FTR obligation is a financial transmission right whose settlement may produce either a receipt or a payment for its holder.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融输电权义务型合约：持有人依据相关价格差额进行双向结算的金融输电权。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni li bih il-possessur jista' jirċievi jew iħallas ammont skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet użata għall-kalkolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A financial transmission right obligation exposes its holder to settlement amounts that can be positive or negative.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融输电权——义务型：指结算结果可能要求持有人付款的金融输电权类别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kategorija ta' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni li tinkludi kemm il-possibbiltà li l-possessur jirċievi ħlas kif ukoll ir-responsabbiltà li jħallas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This term identifies the obligation form of a financial transmission right, which can require its holder to make a payment.

collocations.mt: il-valur ta' obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: the value of an FTR obligation
collocations.zh: 义务型金融输电权的价值

collocations.mt: ir-riskju marbut ma' obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: the risk associated with an FTR obligation
collocations.zh: 义务型金融输电权涉及的风险

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega li obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni jista' jwassal għal dħul jew għal ħlas dovut mill-possessur, skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet rilevanti.
formal.en: The report explains that an FTR obligation can result in income or a payment owed by the holder, depending on the relevant price difference.
formal.zh: 报告说明，义务型金融输电权可能带来收入，也可能产生持有人应付的款项，具体取决于相关价格差额。

colloquial.mt: Lara: B'obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni, dejjem nirċievi l-flus? David: Le, skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet, jista' jkollok tħallas ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: With an FTR obligation, do I always receive money? David: No, depending on the price difference, you may also have to pay.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：持有义务型金融输电权，就一定能收钱吗？戴维：不一定，根据价格差额，你也可能需要付款。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: B'obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni, dejjem nirċievi l-flus?
messages.mt_standard: B'obbligu għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni, dejjem nirċievi l-flus?
messages.zh: 持有义务型金融输电权，就一定能收钱吗？
messages.en: With an FTR obligation, do I always receive money?

messages.speaker: David (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet, jista' jkollok tħallas ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Le, skont id-differenza fil-prezzijiet, jista' jkollok tħallas ukoll.
messages.zh: 不一定，根据价格差额，你也可能需要付款。
messages.en: No, depending on the price difference, you may also have to pay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“双向结算”记住义务型：价差结算时可能收钱，也可能付款；看到整个长词组就回想这两个方向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to tell one person to do what an authority, rule, or instruction requires.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于命令或要求一个人服从某人，或遵守规则、指示，意思是“服从”“照着做”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tordna jew titlob lil persuna waħda tagħmel dak li jgħidilha xi ħadd jew dak li titlob regola jew istruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服从；遵守。用于要求对方按照命令、规则或指示行事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tint tuża din il-kelma meta tgħid lil persuna waħda biex tagħmel dak li tkun ġiet ordnata tagħmel jew biex timxi ma' regola jew istruzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you tell someone to obey, you tell them to do what a person in authority or an instruction requires.

formal.mt: Meta tidħol fil-laboratorju, obdi l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sigurtà u uża t-tagħmir protettiv meħtieġ.
formal.en: When you enter the laboratory, follow the safety instructions and use the required protective equipment.
formal.zh: 进入实验室时，请遵守安全指示，并使用规定的防护装备。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Obdi l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem, jekk jogħġbok. Luqa: Tajjeb, se nagħmel kif qalilna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Follow the teacher's instructions, please. Luqa: All right, I'll do what he told us.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：请照老师的指示做。卢卡：好，我会按他告诉我们的去做。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Obdi l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Obdi l-istruzzjonijiet tal-għalliem, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请照老师的指示做。
messages.en: Follow the teacher's instructions, please.

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se nagħmel kif qalilna.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se nagħmel kif qalilna.
messages.zh: 好，我会按他告诉我们的去做。
messages.en: All right, I'll do what he told us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 obdi 放进“老师说一步，我照做一步”的画面，整句记忆 obdi l-istruzzjonijiet，就是“照着指示做”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on facts and evidence rather than personal feelings or preferences.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 客观的；以事实和证据为依据，不受个人情绪或偏好左右的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ibbażat fuq il-fatti u l-evidenza u ma jkunx influwenzat minn sentimenti jew preferenzi personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客观的；依据事实作出判断，不偏向个人喜好或情感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqis il-fatti b'mod imparzjali u ma jħallix sentimenti, interessi jew preferenzi personali jinfluwenzaw il-ġudizzju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is objective bases their judgement on facts rather than allowing personal feelings or preferences to influence it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目的；目标，即一项行动或计划意图达到的结果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għan li persuna jew grupp irid jilħaq permezz ta' azzjoni, attività jew pjan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The purpose of an activity is the result that someone intends to achieve by carrying it out.

formal.mt: L-objettiv tal-istudju huwa li jipprovdi rapport objettiv dwar il-kwalità tas-servizz, ibbażat fuq evidenza ċara.
formal.en: The purpose of the study is to provide an objective report on service quality, based on clear evidence.
formal.zh: 这项研究的目的是依据明确证据，就服务质量提供一份客观的报告。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-objettiv tal-laqgħa? Mark: Li naraw il-fatti u naslu għal ġudizzju objettiv.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's the purpose of the meeting? Mark: To look at the facts and reach an objective judgement.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这次会议的目的是什么？马克：看看事实，作出客观判断。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-objettiv tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-objettiv tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 这次会议的目的是什么？
messages.en: What's the purpose of the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li naraw il-fatti u naslu għal ġudizzju objettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Li naraw il-fatti u naslu għal ġudizzju objettiv.
messages.zh: 看看事实，作出客观判断。
messages.en: To look at the facts and reach an objective judgement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分含义：判断时只看事实是“客观的”，行动前先看终点是“目的、目标”；结合搭配分别记忆。

gloss_zh: 令人讨厌的；惹人反感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very unpleasant or offensive in a way that annoys other people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言行、态度或人十分令人讨厌，容易使他人恼怒或反感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdejjaq ħafna lil ħaddieħor jew iqanqal stmerrija minħabba l-imġiba jew l-attitudni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十分讨厌或冒犯他人的，使人恼怒或反感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun spjaċevoli ħafna u jdejjaq jew joffendi lil dawk ta' madwaru.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or their behaviour is obnoxious, they are extremely unpleasant and annoy or offend other people.

formal.mt: Il-kumment obnoxjuz tal-parteċipant fixkel id-diskussjoni u wassal għal ilment mill-organizzaturi.
formal.en: The participant's obnoxious comment disrupted the discussion and prompted a complaint from the organisers.
formal.zh: 这位参与者令人反感的评论扰乱了讨论，并引来了组织者的投诉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dak ir-raġel? Lara: Kien obnoxjuz; baqa' jidħak bija u ma riedx jieqaf.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you move away from that man? Lara: He was obnoxious; he kept laughing at me and refused to stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么从那个男人身边走开？拉拉：他太讨厌了，一直嘲笑我，还不肯停。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt minn ħdejn dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 你为什么从那个男人身边走开？
messages.en: Why did you move away from that man?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien obnoxjuz; baqa' jidħak bija u ma riedx jieqaf.
messages.mt_standard: Kien obnoxjuz; baqa' jidħak bija u ma riedx jieqaf.
messages.zh: 他太讨厌了，一直嘲笑我，还不肯停。
messages.en: He was obnoxious; he kept laughing at me and refused to stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 obnoxjuz 和“嘲笑别人还不肯停”的画面绑定，记住它表示言行令人强烈反感，而不只是一般的不喜欢。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or state of becoming outdated and no longer useful or commonly used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物因发展、更新或需求变化而逐渐过时、不再适用或不再普遍使用的过程或状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew l-istat li fih xi ħaġa ssir antikwata u ma tibqax utli jew tintuża ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物逐渐过时、失去实用性或退出使用的过程或状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih prodott, tagħmir jew metodu jsir antikwat u ma jibqax jaqdi l-ħtiġijiet attwali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Obsolescence is the process or state in which something becomes outdated and is no longer useful or widely used.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li l-kumpanija tqis ir-riskju ta' obsolexxenza teknoloġika qabel tixtri tagħmir ġdid.
formal.en: The report recommends that the company consider the risk of technological obsolescence before buying new equipment.
formal.zh: 报告建议公司在购买新设备之前，考虑技术性过时的风险。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kompjuter għadu jaħdem; għaliex trid tibdlu? Nina: Minħabba l-obsolexxenza: il-programmi li għandi bżonn ma jaħdmux fuqu.
colloquial.en: Mark: This computer still works; why do you want to replace it? Nina: Because of obsolescence: the programs I need do not run on it.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这台电脑还能用，你为什么想换掉它？妮娜：因为它已经过时了，我需要的软件在上面运行不了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kompjuter għadu jaħdem; għaliex trid tibdlu?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kompjuter għadu jaħdem; għaliex trid tibdlu?
messages.zh: 这台电脑还能用，你为什么想换掉它？
messages.en: This computer still works; why do you want to replace it?

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-obsolexxenza: il-programmi li għandi bżonn ma jaħdmux fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-obsolexxenza: il-programmi li għandi bżonn ma jaħdmux fuqu.
messages.zh: 因为它已经过时了，我需要的软件在上面运行不了。
messages.en: Because of obsolescence: the programs I need do not run on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一台还能开机却运行不了新软件的电脑，把 obsolexxenza 记成“功能未必损坏，但已经过时”的过程或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling of dislike or hostility towards someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事怀有的强烈厌恶或敌意，比普通的不喜欢更为强烈。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment qawwi ta' mibegħda jew ostilità lejn persuna, grupp jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某人、群体或事物的强烈憎恶、仇恨或敌对情绪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mibegħda qawwija lejn xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, li tista' tkun akkumpanjata minn ostilità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hate is a very strong feeling of dislike or hostility towards a person, group, or thing.

formal.mt: L-iskola ħejjiet programm edukattiv biex tnaqqas l-odju bejn il-gruppi u ssaħħaħ ir-rispett reċiproku.
formal.en: The school prepared an educational programme to reduce hatred between groups and strengthen mutual respect.
formal.zh: 学校制定了一项教育计划，以减少群体之间的仇恨，增进相互尊重。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek tħoss odju lejh wara dak li ġara? Pawlu: Le, għadni rrabjat, imma ma nobogħdux.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you still feel hatred towards him after what happened? Pawlu: No, I am still angry, but I do not hate him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：出了那件事以后，你还恨他吗？保罗：不恨了，我还是生气，但并不憎恨他。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tħoss odju lejh wara dak li ġara?
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tħoss odju lejh wara dak li ġara?
messages.zh: 出了那件事以后，你还恨他吗？
messages.en: Do you still feel hatred towards him after what happened?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadni rrabjat, imma ma nobogħdux.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadni rrabjat, imma ma nobogħdux.
messages.zh: 不恨了，我还是生气，但并不憎恨他。
messages.en: No, I am still angry, but I do not hate him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“生气不一定等于仇恨”来记 odju：它指心中强烈的憎恨情绪；再用 tħoss odju“感到憎恨”巩固名词用法。

gloss_zh: 不公而招人怨恨的；令人反感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unfair or unpleasant in a way that is likely to cause resentment or offence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容比较、评论或做法不公平或令人不快，容易使人感到受冒犯或产生怨恨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun inġust jew spjaċevoli u jista' jqanqal riżentiment jew iweġġa' lil xi ħadd, speċjalment meta jsir paragun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因不公平或令人不快而容易引起怨恨、反感或冒犯的，尤用于比较或区别对待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqajjem riżentiment jew joffendi għax ikun inġust jew spjaċevoli, bħal paragun li jnaqqas il-valur ta' persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An invidious comparison, remark, or action is unfair or unpleasant and is likely to make people feel offended or resentful.

collocations.zh: 不公而招人反感的比较
不公而令人反感的评论

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jevita paragun odjuż bejn studenti li kellhom opportunitajiet differenti ta' tagħlim.
formal.en: The report avoids an invidious comparison between students who had different learning opportunities.
formal.zh: 报告避免对学习机会不同的学生作出不公而容易引起反感的比较。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qal li ħuk aħjar minnek f'kollox? Lara: Iva, kien paragun odjuż; kull wieħed minna għandu l-ħiliet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did he say your brother is better than you at everything? Lara: Yes, it was an invidious comparison; each of us has our own skills.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他说你哥哥什么都比你强？拉拉：对，这种比较太不公平，也太伤人了；我们各有各的长处。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal li ħuk aħjar minnek f'kollox?
messages.mt_standard: Qal li ħuk aħjar minnek f'kollox?
messages.zh: 他说你哥哥什么都比你强？
messages.en: Did he say your brother is better than you at everything?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien paragun odjuż; kull wieħed minna għandu l-ħiliet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien paragun odjuż; kull wieħed minna għandu l-ħiliet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 对，这种比较太不公平，也太伤人了；我们各有各的长处。
messages.en: Yes, it was an invidious comparison; each of us has our own skills.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人当面说“你哥哥样样比你强”，用这幅不公比较惹人反感的画面记住 odjuż，重点记搭配 paragun odjuż。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hurt someone's feelings or cause someone to feel insulted through words or actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以言语或行为伤害某人的感情，使其感到受辱或被冒犯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħid jew jagħmel xi ħaġa li tweġġa' s-sentimenti ta' xi ħadd jew iġġiegħlu jħossu insultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以言语或行为冒犯某人，使其感到受辱、不快或感情受伤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iweġġa' s-sentimenti ta' persuna jew iġegħelha tħossha insultata minħabba dak li jgħid jew jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you offend someone, something you say or do makes them feel hurt, upset, or insulted.

formal.mt: L-awtur talab skuża għax il-kumment tiegħu offenda lil diversi qarrejja.
formal.en: The author apologized because his comment offended several readers.
formal.zh: 作者因自己的评论冒犯了数位读者而道歉。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Il-kumment tiegħi offenda lil xi ħadd? Mark: Iva, offenda lil Sara. Aħjar titlob skuża.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Did my comment offend anyone? Mark: Yes, it offended Sara. You'd better apologize.
colloquial.zh: Pawlu：我的评论冒犯谁了吗？Mark：是的，冒犯了Sara。你最好道个歉。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumment tiegħi offenda lil xi ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumment tiegħi offenda lil xi ħadd?
messages.zh: 我的评论冒犯谁了吗？
messages.en: Did my comment offend anyone?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, offenda lil Sara. Aħjar titlob skuża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, offenda lil Sara. Aħjar titlob skuża.
messages.zh: 是的，冒犯了Sara。你最好道个歉。
messages.en: Yes, it offended Sara. You'd better apologize.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把offenda放进“评论伤人后道歉”的场景来记；它表示冒犯这个动作，可连同offenda lil xi ħadd一起练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to hurt people's feelings or make them feel insulted or upset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语、行为或内容具有冒犯性，容易使人感到受辱、不快或反感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jweġġa' s-sentimenti ta' xi ħadd jew iġiegħlu jħossu insultat jew imdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有冒犯性的；会使人感到受辱、不快或反感的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li fih kliem, ideat jew imġiba li jistgħu jinsultaw lil xi ħadd jew iweġġgħu s-sentimenti tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is offensive makes people feel insulted, upset, or hurt because of its content or character.

formal.mt: L-editur neħħa l-kumment offensiv qabel ma ġie ppubblikat l-artiklu.
formal.en: The editor removed the offensive comment before the article was published.
formal.zh: 编辑在文章发表前删去了那条冒犯性的评论。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-kumment offensiv? Pawlu: Iva, jista' jweġġa' lil xi ħadd. Aħjar tibdlu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this comment offensive? Pawlu: Yes, it could hurt someone. You'd better change it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这条评论冒犯人吗？Pawlu：是的，可能会伤害别人。你最好改一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kumment offensiv?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kumment offensiv?
messages.zh: 这条评论冒犯人吗？
messages.en: Is this comment offensive?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jista' jweġġa' lil xi ħadd. Aħjar tibdlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jista' jweġġa' lil xi ħadd. Aħjar tibdlu.
messages.zh: 是的，可能会伤害别人。你最好改一下。
messages.en: Yes, it could hurt someone. You'd better change it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一句伤人的评论贴上“有冒犯性”的标签：offensiv描述性质，搭配kumment offensiv记忆更清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that submits a bid or tender to buy something or obtain a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为购买物品而出价，或为取得合同而提交投标方案的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tagħmel offerta biex tixtri xi ħaġa jew tikseb kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出价人；为购买物品或争取交易而提出报价的个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li toffri prezz biex tixtri xi ħaġa, pereżempju f'irkant.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bidder is a person or organization that offers a price for something being sold or puts forward a bid for a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标人；响应招标、为承接工程、供货或服务而提交正式投标文件的个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tissottometti offerta formali bi tweġiba għal sejħa għall-offerti għal xogħlijiet, provvisti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tenderer is a person or organization that submits a formal offer to provide goods, services, or work under a contract.

formal.mt: Kull offerent għandu jissottometti d-dokumenti meħtieġa sad-data indikata fis-sejħa għall-offerti.
formal.en: Each tenderer must submit the required documents by the date specified in the invitation to tender.
formal.zh: 每位投标人均须在招标公告指定的日期前提交所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak ir-raġel li għadu kemm għamel offerta? Mark: Hu offerent ieħor. Irid jixtri l-istess mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is that man who just made a bid? Mark: He's another bidder. He wants to buy the same table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：刚才出价的那个男人是谁？Mark：他是另一位出价人。他也想买这张桌子。

messages.speaker: Sara (拍卖参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel li għadu kemm għamel offerta?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel li għadu kemm għamel offerta?
messages.zh: 刚才出价的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man who just made a bid?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu offerent ieħor. Irid jixtri l-istess mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Hu offerent ieħor. Irid jixtri l-istess mejda.
messages.zh: 他是另一位出价人。他也想买这张桌子。
messages.en: He's another bidder. He wants to buy the same table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住offerent：拍卖时举牌的是出价人，招标时提交文件的是投标人；重点都在提出报价的一方。

gloss_zh: 中标人；获授合同的投标人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tenderer whose offer has been selected and who is awarded the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投标方案获选、并获授相关合同的投标人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerent li l-offerta tiegħu tkun intgħażlet u li jingħata l-kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中标人；其投标获选并获授合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jirnexxi fil-proċess tal-għażla u jingħata l-kuntratt abbażi tal-offerta tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A successful tenderer is a person or organization whose tender is selected and who is awarded the contract.

sense_translations.en_definition: tenderer to whom the contract is awarded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获授该合同的投标人；经评选后被确定为合同承接方的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jingħata kuntratt wara li l-offerta tiegħu tintgħażel fil-proċess tal-evalwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The tenderer to whom the contract is awarded is the bidding party selected to carry out the work or supply the required goods or services.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中标人；在投标竞争中胜出并获授合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jirbaħ il-kompetizzjoni għall-kuntratt u jintgħażel biex iwettaq ix-xogħol jew jipprovdi l-prodotti jew is-servizzi mitluba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A winning tenderer is the person or organization that wins a tender competition and receives the resulting contract.

collocations.en: the successful tenderer for the contract
the representative of the successful tenderer

formal.mt: L-offerent ammess irid jiffirma l-kuntratt fi żmien għaxart ijiem minn meta jirċievi n-notifika.
formal.en: The successful tenderer must sign the contract within ten days of receiving the notification.
formal.zh: 中标人须在收到通知后十日内签署合同。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jiffirma l-kuntratt għada? Mark: Ir-rappreżentant tal-offerent ammess se jiġi fl-għaxra biex jiffirmah.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who will sign the contract tomorrow? Mark: The successful tenderer's representative will come at ten to sign it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：明天谁来签合同？Mark：中标人的代表会在十点来签。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiffirma l-kuntratt għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiffirma l-kuntratt għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁来签合同？
messages.en: Who will sign the contract tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (合同负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rappreżentant tal-offerent ammess se jiġi fl-għaxra biex jiffirmah.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rappreżentant tal-offerent ammess se jiġi fl-għaxra biex jiffirmah.
messages.zh: 中标人的代表会在十点来签。
messages.en: The successful tenderer's representative will come at ten to sign it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条义项，把offerent ammess整组对应“中标人”，联想投标获选后收到通知、派代表签合同的连续场景。

gloss_zh: 中标人；获得合同的投标人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company whose tender is selected and who is awarded the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投标获得选定并获授合同的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li l-offerta tagħha tintgħażel u li tingħata l-kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标成功并获得合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jirnexxi fil-proċess tal-għażla u jingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A successful tenderer is a person or company whose tender is chosen for the contract.

sense_translations.en_definition: tenderer to whom the contract is awarded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 获授该合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jingħata l-kuntratt wara li tintgħażel l-offerta tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is the tenderer who receives the contract following the selection of their tender.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在招标评选中胜出并获得合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jintgħażel bħala r-rebbieħ tal-proċess tal-offerti u jingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A winning tenderer is the bidder selected to carry out the work covered by the contract.

collocations.en: the obligations of the successful tenderer

formal.mt: L-offerent li jirbaħ il-kuntratt għandu jippreżenta pjan tax-xogħol qabel tibda l-ewwel fażi tal-proġett.
formal.en: The successful tenderer must submit a work plan before the first phase of the project begins.
formal.zh: 中标人须在项目第一阶段开始前提交工作计划。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min se jagħmel ix-xogħol? Pawlu: L-offerent li jirbaħ il-kuntratt. Għadna qed nistennew ir-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who will do the work? Pawlu: The successful tenderer. We're still waiting for the result.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁来做这项工作？保罗：中标人。我们还在等结果。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jagħmel ix-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jagħmel ix-xogħol?
messages.zh: 谁来做这项工作？
messages.en: Who will do the work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: L-offerent li jirbaħ il-kuntratt. Għadna qed nistennew ir-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: L-offerent li jirbaħ il-kuntratt. Għadna qed nistennew ir-riżultat.
messages.zh: 中标人。我们还在等结果。
messages.en: The successful tenderer. We're still waiting for the result.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：offerent 是投标人，li 连接后面的说明，jirbaħ il-kuntratt 表示赢得合同；连起来就是“赢得合同的投标人”。

gloss_zh: 未被选中的投标人；未中标者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company whose tender was not selected for the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在招标评选中未被选中、未获得合同的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li ma ntgħażlitx biex tingħata l-kuntratt fil-proċess tal-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在投标评选中被淘汰、未被选中的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li l-offerta tiegħu ġiet miċħuda u li ma ntgħażilx għall-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rejected bidder is a bidder whose offer has been turned down during selection.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在招标评选中未获选定的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li ma ntgħażilx fil-proċess tal-għażla tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This describes a tenderer who was not chosen when the submitted tenders were assessed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未能中标、未获得合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li ma kisibx il-kuntratt minħabba li l-offerta tiegħu ma ntgħażlitx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsuccessful tenderer is a person or company whose tender does not secure the contract.

collocations.mt: jibgħat ittra lill-offerent li ma ntgħażilx
collocations.en: send a letter to the unsuccessful tenderer

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bagħat lill-offerent li ma ntgħażilx ittra li tispjega r-riżultat tal-evalwazzjoni.
formal.en: The committee sent the unsuccessful tenderer a letter explaining the outcome of the evaluation.
formal.zh: 委员会向未被选中的投标人发函，说明评估结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Lil min se nibagħtu din l-ittra? David: Lill-offerent li ma ntgħażilx. Irridu nispjegawlu r-riżultat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who are we sending this letter to? David: The unsuccessful tenderer. We need to explain the result to them.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这封信要寄给谁？戴维：未被选中的投标人。我们需要向对方说明结果。

messages.speaker: Sara (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se nibagħtu din l-ittra?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se nibagħtu din l-ittra?
messages.zh: 这封信要寄给谁？
messages.en: Who are we sending this letter to?

messages.speaker: David (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-offerent li ma ntgħażilx. Irridu nispjegawlu r-riżultat.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-offerent li ma ntgħażilx. Irridu nispjegawlu r-riżultat.
messages.zh: 未被选中的投标人。我们需要向对方说明结果。
messages.en: The unsuccessful tenderer. We need to explain the result to them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象评选名单上没有被圈中的投标人：把 ma ntgħażilx 整块记成“未被选中”，再接到 offerent 后面，就能记住整条表达。

gloss_zh: 未获接受的投标人；未中标者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company whose bid or tender has not been accepted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所提交的投标未被接受的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li l-offerta tagħha ma ġietx aċċettata fil-proċess tal-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其投标被拒绝的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li l-offerta tiegħu ġiet miċħuda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rejected bidder is a person or company whose bid has been turned down.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在招标过程中未获接受的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat fil-proċess tal-għażla tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This describes a tenderer who has not been accepted in the tender selection process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未能中标、未获得合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li ma rnexxilux jikseb il-kuntratt permezz tal-offerta tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsuccessful tenderer is a bidder who does not obtain the contract through their tender.

collocations.mt: jinforma lill-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat
collocations.zh: 告知未获接受的投标人

collocations.mt: talba għal spjegazzjoni mill-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat
collocations.en: a request for an explanation from the unsuccessful tenderer
collocations.zh: 未中标者提出的解释请求

formal.mt: L-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat talab spjegazzjoni bil-miktub dwar ir-raġunijiet għaċ-ċaħda tal-offerta tiegħu.
formal.en: The rejected bidder requested a written explanation of the reasons why their tender was rejected.
formal.zh: 未获接受的投标人请求以书面形式说明其投标被拒绝的原因。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Waslet it-tweġiba dwar l-offerta tagħna? Mark: Iva. Aħna l-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat. Se nitolbu spjegazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the reply about our tender arrived? Mark: Yes. We're the unsuccessful tenderer. We'll ask for an explanation.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：关于我们投标的答复到了吗？马克：到了。我们没有中标，会请求对方说明原因。

messages.speaker: Nina (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet it-tweġiba dwar l-offerta tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet it-tweġiba dwar l-offerta tagħna?
messages.zh: 关于我们投标的答复到了吗？
messages.en: Has the reply about our tender arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Aħna l-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat. Se nitolbu spjegazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Aħna l-offerent li ma ġiex aċċettat. Se nitolbu spjegazzjoni.
messages.zh: 到了。我们没有中标，会请求对方说明原因。
messages.en: Yes. We're the unsuccessful tenderer. We'll ask for an explanation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“投标人收到未接受通知”的画面记忆：offerent 指投标人，ma ġiex aċċettat 表示未获接受；整个短语指人，不指被拒绝的文件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or company that wins a tender competition and is awarded the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在招标评选中胜出并获授合同的个人或公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew kumpanija li tirbaħ fil-proċess tal-offerti u tingħata l-kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标成功、获授合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li l-offerta tiegħu tintgħażel u li jirnexxilu jikseb il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A successful tenderer is a bidder whose tender is accepted and who receives the contract.

sense_translations.en_definition: tenderer to whom the contract is awarded
sense_translations.zh_definition: 被授予该合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jingħata l-kuntratt bħala riżultat tal-għażla tal-offerta tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is the tenderer selected to receive the contract after the tenders have been assessed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在招标评选中胜出的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerent li jirbaħ il-kompetizzjoni bejn l-offerti u jingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A winning tenderer is the person or company that wins the competition for a contract.

collocations.en: sign a contract with the successful tenderer

formal.mt: L-offerent rebbieħ se jiffirma l-kuntratt nhar it-Tnejn u jibda x-xogħol ix-xahar id-dieħel.
formal.en: The winning tenderer will sign the contract on Monday and begin work next month.
formal.zh: 中标人将于星期一签署合同，并于下月开始工作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà ħabbru min rebaħ? Toni: Iva, il-kumpanija tagħna hija l-offerent rebbieħ! Lara: Mela issa nistgħu nippjanaw ix-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have they announced who won yet? Toni: Yes, our company is the winning tenderer! Lara: Then we can plan the work now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：已经公布谁中标了吗？托尼：公布了，我们公司就是中标人！拉拉：那现在可以安排工作了。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ħabbru min rebaħ?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ħabbru min rebaħ?
messages.zh: 已经公布谁中标了吗？
messages.en: Have they announced who won yet?

messages.speaker: Toni (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kumpanija tagħna hija l-offerent rebbieħ!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kumpanija tagħna hija l-offerent rebbieħ!
messages.zh: 公布了，我们公司就是中标人！
messages.en: Yes, our company is the winning tenderer!

messages.speaker: Lara (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela issa nistgħu nippjanaw ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Mela issa nistgħu nippjanaw ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 那现在可以安排工作了。
messages.en: Then we can plan the work now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offerent 记作“投标人”，把 rebbieħ 记作“胜出的”；想象投标人举起中标通知书，两词合起来就是“中标人”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organization that submits a price to buy something or to supply goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出购买价格，或提交货物、服务供应报价的个人或机构；可指竞价中的出价者或招标中的投标人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tippreżenta prezz biex tixtri xi ħaġa jew biex tipprovdi oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在竞价或拍卖中提出购买价格的个人或机构；出价者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li toffri prezz biex tixtri xi ħaġa f'irkant jew f'kompetizzjoni ma' xerrejja oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bidder is a person or organization that offers a price for something, especially at an auction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照招标要求，正式提交货物或服务供应方案及报价的个人或机构；投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tissottometti proposta formali bi prezz biex tipprovdi oġġetti jew servizzi skont il-kundizzjonijiet ta' sejħa għall-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tenderer is a person or organization that submits a formal proposal and price to supply goods or services.

formal.mt: Kull offerent ta' prezzijiet għandu jissottometti proposta li tinkludi l-ispiża totali u ż-żmien meħtieġ għat-tlestija tax-xogħol.
formal.en: Each tenderer must submit a proposal that includes the total cost and the time required to complete the work.
formal.zh: 每位投标人必须提交一份方案，列明总费用及完成工作所需的时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-ogħla offerent ta' prezzijiet s'issa? Mark: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; offra mitejn ewro.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the highest bidder so far? Mark: The man in the blue jacket; he offered two hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：目前谁出价最高？马克：穿蓝色夹克的那位男士；他出了两百欧元。

messages.speaker: Maja (拍卖会参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-ogħla offerent ta' prezzijiet s'issa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-ogħla offerent ta' prezzijiet s'issa?
messages.zh: 目前谁出价最高？
messages.en: Who is the highest bidder so far?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; offra mitejn ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-raġel bil-ġakketta blu; offra mitejn ewro.
messages.zh: 穿蓝色夹克的那位男士；他出了两百欧元。
messages.en: The man in the blue jacket; he offered two hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“举牌报价的人”这一画面绑定：拍卖时是出价者，招标时是投标人。记住它指提交价格的一方，而价格或提议本身可用 offerta 表达。

gloss_zh: 致敬礼物；奉献物；出价；提议；投标书

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something presented as a gift or tribute, or a proposal involving a price, help, goods, or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为表达敬意或奉献而献出的物品，也指给予帮助等的提议、购买出价，以及供应货物或服务的正式投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa mogħtija bħala rigal jew b'turija ta' ġieħ, jew proposta li tinvolvi prezz, għajnuna, oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为表达敬意、感激或纪念而献上的礼物或赠献。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rigal jew għotja ppreżentata biex turi ġieħ, rispett jew gratitudni lejn xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tribute is a gift presented to express respect, gratitude, or admiration for someone.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为礼物或奉献而献出的物品或款项，尤其指宗教活动中的奉献物或奉献款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew somma flus mogħtija bħala rigal jew bħala att ta' devozzjoni, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offering is something given as a gift, especially as an act of religious devotion.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为购买某物而提出的价格，尤其指拍卖或竞价中的出价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prezz propost biex tinxtara xi ħaġa, speċjalment waqt irkant jew f'kompetizzjoni ma' xerrejja oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bid is an amount of money that someone offers to pay for something, especially at an auction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向他人提出的给予、帮助、购买或提供某物的提议，可由对方接受或拒绝。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta lil xi ħadd biex tagħtih xi ħaġa, tgħinu, tixtri mingħandu jew tipprovdilu xi ħaġa, li jista' jaċċetta jew jirrifjuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offer is a proposal to give or do something that another person may accept or refuse.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照招标要求提交的正式供应提案或投标书，通常列明货物或服务的价格及条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta formali ppreżentata bi tweġiba għal sejħa għall-offerti, li tispeċifika l-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet għall-provvista ta' oġġetti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender is a formal proposal stating the price and conditions for supplying goods or carrying out work.

collocations.en: a gift presented as a tribute
collocations.zh: 为表达敬意而献上的礼物

collocations.en: to make a bid at an auction
to accept an offer of help
collocations.zh: 接受他人提供帮助的提议

collocations.en: to submit a tender for a contract
collocations.zh: 为承接合同提交投标书

formal.mt: L-offerta għall-provvista tat-tagħmir għandha tinkludi l-prezz totali, id-data tal-kunsinna u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The tender for supplying the equipment must include the total price, the delivery date, and the payment terms.
formal.zh: 设备供应投标书必须列明总价、交货日期及付款条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tridni ngħinek iġġorr dawn il-basktijiet? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi! Naċċetta l-offerta tiegħek bil-qalb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like me to help you carry these bags? Pawlu: Yes, thanks! I'd gladly accept your offer.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：要我帮你提这些袋子吗？保罗：好呀，谢谢！我很乐意接受你的提议。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni ngħinek iġġorr dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni ngħinek iġġorr dawn il-basktijiet?
messages.zh: 要我帮你提这些袋子吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to help you carry these bags?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi! Naċċetta l-offerta tiegħek bil-qalb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi! Naċċetta l-offerta tiegħek bil-qalb.
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢！我很乐意接受你的提议。
messages.en: Yes, thanks! I'd gladly accept your offer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把东西或条件递到对方面前”的画面串联词义：递上敬意是致敬礼物，献在祭坛上是奉献物，报出金额是出价，主动帮忙是提议，正式提交供应方案是投标书。

gloss_zh: 符合受理条件的投标；符合要求的标书；有效投标

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender that satisfies the applicable requirements and is eligible for consideration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 符合适用要求、具备受理或评审资格的投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti applikabbli u li tista' tiġi kkunsidrata fil-proċess tal-għażla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合受理条件、可以纳入评审的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa biex tkun tista' tiġi aċċettata għall-evalwazzjoni.
