sense_translations.en_explanation: An admissible tender meets the conditions required for it to be considered in a tendering process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实质上符合招标文件所列要求和条件的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti u l-kundizzjonijiet sostanzjali stabbiliti fid-dokumenti tas-sejħa għall-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A responsive tender satisfies the substantive requirements and conditions set out in the tender documents.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合相关有效性条件、可被视为有效的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tissodisfa l-kundizzjonijiet rilevanti biex titqies valida fil-proċess tal-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A valid bid fulfils the relevant conditions for being treated as effective within the bidding process.

collocations.zh: 提交符合受理条件的投标
评审符合受理条件的投标

formal.mt: Wara li vverifika d-dokumenti, il-kumitat ikkonferma li l-kumpanija kienet issottomettiet offerta ammissibbli.
formal.en: After checking the documents, the committee confirmed that the company had submitted an admissible tender.
formal.zh: 核查文件后，委员会确认该公司提交的投标符合受理条件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-offerta tagħna hi ammissibbli? Pawlu: Iva, tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti, iżda dan ma jfissirx li se nirbħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is our tender admissible? Pawlu: Yes, it meets the requirements, but that does not mean we will win.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们的投标符合受理条件吗？Pawlu：是的，符合要求，但这不代表我们会中标。

messages.speaker: Marija (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: L-offerta tagħna hi ammissibbli?
messages.mt_standard: L-offerta tagħna hi ammissibbli?
messages.zh: 我们的投标符合受理条件吗？
messages.en: Is our tender admissible?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti, iżda dan ma jfissirx li se nirbħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti, iżda dan ma jfissirx li se nirbħu.
messages.zh: 是的，符合要求，但这不代表我们会中标。
messages.en: Yes, it meets the requirements, but that does not mean we will win.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象标书通过资格检查、拿到评审入场券：offerta ammissibbli 表示投标可以进入考虑范围，入场券本身不保证中标。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender whose price appears unusually low for the work, supplies, or services required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于所需工程、货物或服务而言，报价显得异常偏低的投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta bi prezz li jidher ferm aktar baxx milli wieħed jistenna għax-xogħol, il-provvisti jew is-servizzi mitluba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对于投标所涉及的工程、货物或服务，报价异常偏低的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li l-prezz tagħha jidher baxx b'mod mhux tas-soltu meta jitqiesu x-xogħol, il-provvisti jew is-servizzi li jridu jiġu pprovduti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An abnormally low tender offers a price that appears unusually low in relation to the work, supplies, or services being requested.

collocations.mt: titlob spjegazzjoni għal offerta anormalment baxxa
collocations.en: request an explanation for an abnormally low tender
collocations.zh: 要求就异常低价投标作出说明

formal.mt: Il-kumitat identifika offerta anormalment baxxa u talab lill-kumpanija tispjega kif il-prezz propost ikopri l-ispejjeż tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The committee identified an abnormally low tender and asked the company to explain how the proposed price covers the costs of the work.
formal.zh: 委员会发现一份异常低价投标，并要求该公司解释所报价格如何覆盖工程成本。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din l-offerta tidher irħisa ħafna. Taħseb li hi offerta anormalment baxxa? Mark: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw kif ikkalkulaw il-prezz u jekk inkludewx l-ispejjeż kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: This tender looks very cheap. Do you think it is an abnormally low tender? Mark: It could be. Let's see how they calculated the price and whether they included all the costs.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这份投标的报价看起来很便宜。你觉得属于异常低价投标吗？Mark：有可能。我们看看他们怎么算的价格，以及是否计入了所有成本。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-offerta tidher irħisa ħafna. Taħseb li hi offerta anormalment baxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-offerta tidher irħisa ħafna. Taħseb li hi offerta anormalment baxxa?
messages.zh: 这份投标的报价看起来很便宜。你觉得属于异常低价投标吗？
messages.en: This tender looks very cheap. Do you think it is an abnormally low tender?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw kif ikkalkulaw il-prezz u jekk inkludewx l-ispejjeż kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun. Ejja naraw kif ikkalkulaw il-prezz u jekk inkludewx l-ispejjeż kollha.
messages.zh: 有可能。我们看看他们怎么算的价格，以及是否计入了所有成本。
messages.en: It could be. Let's see how they calculated the price and whether they included all the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把投标报价画成一排柱子，其中一根低得格外显眼：offerta 是投标，anormalment 是异常地，baxxa 是低的，整组记作异常低价投标。

gloss_zh: 异常低价投标；报价异常偏低的标书

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender whose proposed price is unusually low in relation to the work, goods, or services required.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于所需工程、货物或服务，报价异常偏低的投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta bi prezz li jidher baxx b'mod mhux tas-soltu meta jitqabbel max-xogħol, mal-oġġetti jew mas-servizzi meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相对于采购要求而言，报价异常偏低的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li l-prezz tagħha jkun baxx b'mod mhux tas-soltu meta jitqiesu x-xogħol, l-oġġetti jew is-servizzi li jridu jiġu pprovduti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An abnormally low tender is a bid whose price appears unusually low for the work, goods, or services being requested.

collocations.mt: titlob spjegazzjoni dwar offerta baxxa wisq
collocations.en: request an explanation concerning an abnormally low tender
collocations.zh: 要求说明异常低价投标的报价依据

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab spjegazzjoni dettaljata dwar l-ispejjeż wara li identifika offerta baxxa wisq.
formal.en: The committee requested a detailed explanation of the costs after identifying an abnormally low tender.
formal.zh: 委员会发现一份异常低价投标后，要求对其成本作出详细说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nitolbu aktar dettalji mingħand din il-kumpanija? Mark: Għax din tidher li hi offerta baxxa wisq; irridu nifhmu kif se jkopru l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we asking this company for more details? Mark: Because this looks like an abnormally low tender; we need to understand how they will cover the costs.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么要求这家公司提供更多细节？Mark：因为这份投标的报价看起来异常偏低；我们需要了解他们如何支付各项成本。

messages.speaker: Maja (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nitolbu aktar dettalji mingħand din il-kumpanija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nitolbu aktar dettalji mingħand din il-kumpanija?
messages.zh: 我们为什么要求这家公司提供更多细节？
messages.en: Why are we asking this company for more details?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax din tidher li hi offerta baxxa wisq; irridu nifhmu kif se jkopru l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Għax din tidher li hi offerta baxxa wisq; irridu nifhmu kif se jkopru l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 因为这份投标的报价看起来异常偏低；我们需要了解他们如何支付各项成本。
messages.en: Because this looks like an abnormally low tender; we need to understand how they will cover the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offerta 想成一份投标，baxxa 表示低，wisq 表示过头：价格低到需要解释成本，就是“异常低价投标”。

gloss_zh: 最低报价投标；报价最低的标书

teaching_sense.en_definition: The tender that offers the lowest price among the tenders being compared.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在所比较的各份投标中，报价最低的一份。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-offerta li jkollha l-inqas prezz fost l-offerti li jkunu qed jitqabblu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在参与比较的投标中，报价最低的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li l-prezz tagħha jkun l-inqas wieħed fost il-prezzijiet tal-offerti li jkunu qed jiġu mqabbla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The lowest tender is the bid with the smallest quoted price among those being compared.

formal.mt: Wara li qabbel il-prezzijiet tat-tliet offerti, il-kumitat identifika l-offerta bl-orħos prezz.
formal.en: After comparing the prices of the three tenders, the committee identified the lowest tender.
formal.zh: 比较三份投标的报价后，委员会确定了报价最低的一份。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema hi l-offerta bl-orħos prezz? Pawlu: It-tieni waħda: elfejn ewro. L-oħrajn jiswew aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which is the lowest tender? Pawlu: The second one: two thousand euros. The others cost more.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪一份投标的报价最低？Pawlu：第二份，两千欧元。其他几份都更贵。

messages.speaker: Lara (采购负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema hi l-offerta bl-orħos prezz?
messages.mt_standard: Liema hi l-offerta bl-orħos prezz?
messages.zh: 哪一份投标的报价最低？
messages.en: Which is the lowest tender?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tieni waħda: elfejn ewro. L-oħrajn jiswew aktar.
messages.mt_standard: It-tieni waħda: elfejn ewro. L-oħrajn jiswew aktar.
messages.zh: 第二份，两千欧元。其他几份都更贵。
messages.en: The second one: two thousand euros. The others cost more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把几份标书的价格从小到大排队：orħos 提醒你“最便宜”，prezz 提醒你“价格”，排在最前的就是最低报价投标。

gloss_zh: 平衡电能报价；平衡电能投标

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bid specifying the price and quantity of electrical energy offered to help balance electricity supply and demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为帮助平衡电力供需而提出的报价，列明可提供的平衡电能数量及其价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li tispeċifika l-prezz u l-kwantità ta' enerġija elettrika offruta biex tgħin iżżomm bilanċ bejn il-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对用于平衡电力供需的电能所提交的报价，包含所报电能数量及价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta għal kwantità ta' enerġija elettrika bi prezz speċifikat, maħsuba biex tintuża għall-ibbilanċjar tal-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A balancing energy bid states the quantity and price of electrical energy offered for balancing electricity supply and demand.

collocations.mt: il-prezz ta' offerta għall-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar
collocations.en: the price of a balancing energy bid
collocations.zh: 平衡电能报价中的价格

formal.mt: Il-fornitur issottometta offerta għall-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar li tispeċifika l-kwantità ta' enerġija offruta u l-prezz għal kull megawatt-siegħa.
formal.en: The provider submitted a balancing energy bid specifying the quantity of energy offered and the price per megawatt-hour.
formal.zh: 供应商提交了一份平衡电能报价，列明所报电能数量及每兆瓦时的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandna ninkludu fl-offerta għall-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar? David: Il-kwantità ta' enerġija li qed noffru u l-prezz għal kull megawatt-siegħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should we include in the balancing energy bid? David: The quantity of energy we are offering and the price per megawatt-hour.
colloquial.zh: Nina：平衡电能报价里应该写些什么？David：我们所报的电能数量，以及每兆瓦时的价格。

messages.speaker: Nina (电力交易助理)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandna ninkludu fl-offerta għall-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandna ninkludu fl-offerta għall-enerġija ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.zh: 平衡电能报价里应该写些什么？
messages.en: What should we include in the balancing energy bid?

messages.speaker: David (电力交易员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kwantità ta' enerġija li qed noffru u l-prezz għal kull megawatt-siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kwantità ta' enerġija li qed noffru u l-prezz għal kull megawatt-siegħa.
messages.zh: 我们所报的电能数量，以及每兆瓦时的价格。
messages.en: The quantity of energy we are offering and the price per megawatt-hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 enerġija 就联想电表记录的“电能”，把整词组记成“为供需平衡报出多少电能、什么价格”，用兆瓦时帮助记住数量维度。

gloss_zh: 平衡容量报价；平衡容量投标

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bid specifying the capacity offered to remain available for balancing electricity supply and demand, together with its price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为平衡电力供需而提出的容量报价，列明承诺在指定期间保持可调用状态的容量及其价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li tispeċifika l-kapaċità li tinżamm disponibbli matul perjodu partikolari għall-ibbilanċjar tal-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku, flimkien mal-prezz tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对保持可调用状态、用于平衡电力供需的容量所提交的报价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta bi prezz speċifikat għal kapaċità li tinżamm disponibbli sabiex tkun tista' tintuża, meta jkun hemm bżonn, biex jiġu bbilanċjati l-provvista u d-domanda għall-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A balancing capacity bid states the capacity offered to be kept available for electricity balancing and the price for that availability.

formal.mt: Il-fornitur issottometta offerta għall-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar li tindika l-kapaċità f'megawatts, il-perjodu ta' disponibbiltà u l-prezz mitlub.
formal.en: The provider submitted a balancing capacity bid indicating the capacity in megawatts, the availability period, and the requested price.
formal.zh: 供应商提交了一份平衡容量报价，列明以兆瓦计的容量、保持可调用状态的期间，以及所报价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed noffru f'din l-offerta għall-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar? Daniel: Għaxar megawatts ta' kapaċità li se nżommu disponibbli bejn is-sitta u t-tmienja ta' filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we offering in this balancing capacity bid? Daniel: Ten megawatts of capacity that we will keep available between six and eight in the evening.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份平衡容量报价中，我们报的是什么？Daniel：十兆瓦的容量，我们会在晚上六点到八点之间保持其可调用。

messages.speaker: Sara (电力调度同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed noffru f'din l-offerta għall-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed noffru f'din l-offerta għall-kapaċità ta' bbilanċjar?
messages.zh: 这份平衡容量报价中，我们报的是什么？
messages.en: What are we offering in this balancing capacity bid?

messages.speaker: Daniel (电力交易员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar megawatts ta' kapaċità li se nżommu disponibbli bejn is-sitta u t-tmienja ta' filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar megawatts ta' kapaċità li se nżommu disponibbli bejn is-sitta u t-tmienja ta' filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 十兆瓦的容量，我们会在晚上六点到八点之间保持其可调用。
messages.en: Ten megawatts of capacity that we will keep available between six and eight in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 kapaċità 就想“随时可调用的能力”：脑中画一台待命设备，旁边写上兆瓦数和待命时段，帮助记住平衡容量报价的重点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bid submitted for an integrated process that coordinates scheduling activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为统筹协调各项排程活动的综合流程而提交的投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta ppreżentata għal proċess li jgħaqqad u jikkoordina diversi attivitajiet tal-iskedar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对综合排程流程提交的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li titressaq għal proċess integrat li jikkoordina l-attivitajiet tal-iskedar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An integrated scheduling process bid is a proposal submitted for a process that brings scheduling activities together in a coordinated way.

collocations.en: prepare an integrated scheduling process bid
collocations.zh: 编制综合排程流程投标

collocations.en: evaluate an integrated scheduling process bid
collocations.zh: 评估综合排程流程投标

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jevalwa l-offerta għall-proċess integrat għall-iskedar skont il-kriterji stabbiliti fid-dokument tas-sejħa.
formal.en: The committee will evaluate the integrated scheduling process bid according to the criteria set out in the tender document.
formal.zh: 委员会将按照招标文件规定的标准，评估该综合排程流程投标。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejt l-offerta għall-proċess integrat għall-iskedar? Mark: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-aħħar paġna qabel nibgħatha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have you finished the integrated scheduling process bid? Mark: Almost. I still need to check the last page before sending it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：综合排程流程的投标准备好了吗？马克：差不多了。我还要检查最后一页，然后再发出去。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt l-offerta għall-proċess integrat għall-iskedar?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt l-offerta għall-proċess integrat għall-iskedar?
messages.zh: 综合排程流程的投标准备好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the integrated scheduling process bid?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-aħħar paġna qabel nibgħatha.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-aħħar paġna qabel nibgħatha.
messages.zh: 差不多了。我还要检查最后一页，然后再发出去。
messages.en: Almost. I still need to check the last page before sending it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语义分块记忆：offerta 是投标，proċess integrat 是综合流程，skedar 是排程；想象把多张时间表整合后，为整套流程提交投标。

gloss_zh: 不合规投标；不符合要求的标书

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender or bid that does not meet the applicable procedural or submission requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不符合适用程序规定或提交要求的投标或标书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li ma tissodisfax ir-rekwiżiti applikabbli tal-proċedura jew tal-preżentazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在提交程序、文件形式或其他规定方面存在不合规情形的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li jkollha nuqqas ta' konformità mal-proċedura, mal-forma tad-dokumenti jew ma' rekwiżit ieħor tas-sejħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An irregular tender is a tender that departs from the rules or procedures governing its submission or assessment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未满足招标文件所列适用要求的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li ma tissodisfax wieħed jew aktar mir-rekwiżiti applikabbli stabbiliti fid-dokumenti tas-sejħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-compliant bid is a bid that fails to satisfy one or more requirements specified for the tender.

collocations.zh: 识别不符合要求的投标

formal.mt: Fir-rapport ta' evalwazzjoni, il-kumitat ikklassifika l-proposta bħala offerta irregolari minħabba n-nuqqas ta' dokument obbligatorju.
formal.en: In the evaluation report, the committee classified the proposal as a non-compliant bid because a mandatory document was missing.
formal.zh: 委员会在评估报告中指出，该投标缺少一份必交文件，因此将其认定为不合规投标。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qalu li tagħna kienet offerta irregolari? Pawlu: Għax kien hemm formola obbligatorja nieqsa. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista tad-dokumenti flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did they say ours was a non-compliant bid? Pawlu: Because a mandatory form was missing. Let's check the document list together.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：他们为什么说我们的投标不合规？保罗：因为缺了一张必交表格。我们一起核对一下文件清单吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (投标负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qalu li tagħna kienet offerta irregolari?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qalu li tagħna kienet offerta irregolari?
messages.zh: 他们为什么说我们的投标不合规？
messages.en: Why did they say ours was a non-compliant bid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien hemm formola obbligatorja nieqsa. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista tad-dokumenti flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien hemm formola obbligatorja nieqsa. Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista tad-dokumenti flimkien.
messages.zh: 因为缺了一张必交表格。我们一起核对一下文件清单吧。
messages.en: Because a mandatory form was missing. Let's check the document list together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“投标文件缺一张必交表格”的画面记忆 offerta irregolari：重点是投标未满足规定要求，而不只是报价高低。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bidding in which participants secretly coordinate their bids to distort competition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 投标参与者私下协调投标安排，以扭曲竞争的串通投标行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattika ta' tfigħ ta' offerti li fiha l-parteċipanti jiftiehmu bil-moħbi biex jgħawġu l-kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原本应相互竞争的投标者私下协调报价或其他投标安排的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika li fiha offerenti li suppost jikkompetu bejniethom jiftiehmu bil-moħbi dwar il-prezzijiet jew arranġamenti oħra tal-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Collusive bidding occurs when bidders secretly coordinate their bids instead of competing independently for the same opportunity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招投标过程中，参与者通过秘密协议操纵投标安排或竞争结果的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti li fiha l-parteċipanti jużaw ftehim sigriet biex jimmanipulaw l-offerti jew ir-riżultat tal-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Collusive tendering is the practice of using secret agreements between tender participants to manipulate competition or influence the outcome.

collocations.en: investigate a case of collusive tendering
collocations.zh: 调查一起串通投标事件

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda li jiġi investigat is-suspett ta' offerta kollużiva biex jiġi stabbilit jekk l-offerenti kkoordinawx il-prezzijiet tagħhom bil-moħbi.
formal.en: The report recommends investigating the suspicion of collusive bidding to establish whether the bidders secretly coordinated their prices.
formal.zh: 报告建议调查串通投标的嫌疑，以查明投标者是否曾私下协调报价。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Żewġ kumpaniji taw eżatt l-istess prezz. Din offerta kollużiva? David: Mhux bilfors. Irridu naraw jekk kienx hemm ftehim bejniethom.
colloquial.en: Nina: Two companies quoted exactly the same price. Is this collusive bidding? David: Not necessarily. We need to see whether there was an agreement between them.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：两家公司报了完全相同的价格。这是串通投标吗？戴维：不一定。我们得看看它们之间是否有过协议。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ kumpaniji taw eżatt l-istess prezz. Din offerta kollużiva?
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ kumpaniji taw eżatt l-istess prezz. Din offerta kollużiva?
messages.zh: 两家公司报了完全相同的价格。这是串通投标吗？
messages.en: Two companies quoted exactly the same price. Is this collusive bidding?

messages.speaker: David (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors. Irridu naraw jekk kienx hemm ftehim bejniethom.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors. Irridu naraw jekk kienx hemm ftehim bejniethom.
messages.zh: 不一定。我们得看看它们之间是否有过协议。
messages.en: Not necessarily. We need to see whether there was an agreement between them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offerta kollużiva 记成“几家投标者先私下商量，再各自递交标书”的场景；记忆核心是秘密合谋，不能仅凭报价相同就判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tender chosen through a selection process, including one chosen to receive the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在遴选过程中被选中的投标，也可指最终获授合同的中标投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li tingħażel permezz ta' proċess ta' għażla, inkluża waħda magħżula biex tingħata l-kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经评选被选中的投标；是否已经最终获授合同须结合语境判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta magħżula wara proċess ta' evalwazzjoni, li l-għażla tagħha mhux dejjem tfisser li l-kuntratt ikun diġà ngħata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A selected tender is a tender chosen through an evaluation process, although the contract may not yet have been formally awarded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在招标评选中取得成功、被选定获授合同的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tirnexxi fil-proċess ta' evalwazzjoni u tintgħażel biex tingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A successful tender is a tender that succeeds in the selection process and is chosen for the contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在竞争性评选中胜出并获选承接合同的投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tirbaħ il-kompetizzjoni bejn l-offerenti u tintgħażel għall-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A winning tender is the tender that prevails over competing submissions and is chosen for the contract.

collocations.en: the price of the selected tender

formal.mt: L-offerta li tintgħażel għandha tissodisfa r-rekwiżiti tekniċi kollha u tikseb l-ogħla punteġġ skont il-kriterji ppubblikati.
formal.en: The selected tender must meet all technical requirements and obtain the highest score under the published criteria.
formal.zh: 获选投标必须满足全部技术要求，并按照已公布的评选标准取得最高分。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Meta se jħabbru l-offerta li tintgħażel? Ġorġ: Għada, skont l-aħħar messaġġ. Nispera li tagħna tirbaħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: When will they announce the winning tender? Ġorġ: Tomorrow, according to the latest message. I hope ours wins.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：他们什么时候公布中标投标？乔治：按最新消息，是明天。希望我们能中标。

messages.speaker: Marija (投标团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jħabbru l-offerta li tintgħażel?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jħabbru l-offerta li tintgħażel?
messages.zh: 他们什么时候公布中标投标？
messages.en: When will they announce the winning tender?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada, skont l-aħħar messaġġ. Nispera li tagħna tirbaħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għada, skont l-aħħar messaġġ. Nispera li tagħna tirbaħ.
messages.zh: 按最新消息，是明天。希望我们能中标。
messages.en: Tomorrow, according to the latest message. I hope ours wins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offerta li tintgħażel 拆成“投标＋被选中的”来记，想象评委从多份标书中挑出一份；英文 selected 强调获选，successful 和 winning 强调中标成功。

gloss_zh: 未共享的出价；未向其他相关方提供的报价

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bid that has not been shared with other relevant parties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未向其他相关方提供或披露的出价或报价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li ma tkunx ġiet kondiviża ma' partijiet oħra kkonċernati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未与其他相关方共享的出价或报价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li l-kontenut tagħha ma jkunx ġie kondiviż ma' partijiet oħra kkonċernati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unshared bid is a bid whose contents have not been made available to other relevant parties.

collocations.zh: 保持报价未共享的状态
审阅一份未共享的报价

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li din hija offerta mhux kondiviża u li l-kontenut tagħha għadu disponibbli biss għat-tim li ħejjieha.
formal.en: The report indicates that this is an unshared bid and that its contents are still available only to the team that prepared it.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这是一份未共享的报价，其内容目前仍仅供拟定该报价的团队查阅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din għadha offerta mhux kondiviża? Mark: Iva, għadha għand it-tim tagħna biss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this still an unshared bid? Mark: Yes, only our team has it so far.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份报价还没有共享出去吗？Mark：对，目前还只有我们团队持有。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din għadha offerta mhux kondiviża?
messages.mt_standard: Din għadha offerta mhux kondiviża?
messages.zh: 这份报价还没有共享出去吗？
messages.en: Is this still an unshared bid?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadha għand it-tim tagħna biss.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadha għand it-tim tagħna biss.
messages.zh: 对，目前还只有我们团队持有。
messages.en: Yes, only our team has it so far.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把报价想成团队内部的一份文件：offerta 是报价，mhux kondiviża 表示未共享；用“文件还没发给别人”的画面记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 已匹配的出价；已核对匹配的报价

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bid that has been checked against a corresponding bid or record and found to match.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已与对应出价或记录进行核对，并确认相匹配的出价或报价。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Offerta li tkun tqabblet ma' offerta jew rekord korrispondenti u tkun instabet taqbel magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经核对后与对应出价或记录相匹配的出价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li, wara li tkun ġiet iċċekkjata, tkun instabet taqbel ma' offerta jew rekord korrispondenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A matched bid is a bid that has been compared with a corresponding bid or record and confirmed to agree with it.

collocations.zh: 确认一份已匹配的报价
登记一份已匹配的报价

formal.mt: Wara li tqabblu l-prezz u l-kwantità mar-rekord korrispondenti, l-offerta ġiet irreġistrata bħala offerta rikonċiljata.
formal.en: After the price and quantity were compared with the corresponding record, the bid was recorded as a matched bid.
formal.zh: 将价格和数量与对应记录核对后，该出价被登记为已匹配的出价。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din issa hi offerta rikonċiljata? Pawlu: Iva, iċċekkjajt il-prezz u l-kwantità, u t-tnejn jaqblu mar-rekord.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this now a matched bid? Pawlu: Yes, I checked the price and quantity, and both match the record.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这份报价现在已经核对匹配了吗？Pawlu：是的，我查了价格和数量，两项都与记录一致。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din issa hi offerta rikonċiljata?
messages.mt_standard: Din issa hi offerta rikonċiljata?
messages.zh: 这份报价现在已经核对匹配了吗？
messages.en: Is this now a matched bid?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iċċekkjajt il-prezz u l-kwantità, u t-tnejn jaqblu mar-rekord.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iċċekkjajt il-prezz u l-kwantità, u t-tnejn jaqblu mar-rekord.
messages.zh: 是的，我查了价格和数量，两项都与记录一致。
messages.en: Yes, I checked the price and quantity, and both match the record.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报价单与对应记录并排放好，价格和数量逐项打勾；把 offerta rikonċiljata 整体记成“核对后已经匹配的报价”。

gloss_zh: 市场准入要约；市场准入条件提案

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proposal setting out the terms on which goods, services, or suppliers may enter a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提出商品、服务或供应商进入某一市场所适用条件的要约或提案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proposta li tistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet li bihom prodotti, servizzi jew fornituri jistgħu jidħlu f'suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就商品、服务或供应商进入市场的条件提出的要约或方案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Offerta li tispeċifika l-kundizzjonijiet proposti biex prodotti, servizzi jew fornituri jkollhom aċċess għal suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market access offer is a proposal describing the conditions under which goods, services, or suppliers would be allowed to enter a market.

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni ppreżentat offerta ta' aċċess għas-suq li tispeċifika l-kundizzjonijiet proposti għad-dħul ta' fornituri barranin fis-settur tas-servizzi.
formal.en: The delegation presented a market access offer specifying the proposed conditions for foreign suppliers to enter the services sector.
formal.zh: 代表团提出了一份市场准入要约，列明外国供应商进入服务业的拟议条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'hemm fl-offerta ta' aċċess għas-suq? David: Hemm il-kundizzjonijiet proposti biex fornituri barranin jidħlu fis-suq tagħna.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is in the market access offer? David: It contains the proposed conditions for foreign suppliers to enter our market.
colloquial.zh: Lara：市场准入要约里有什么内容？David：里面有外国供应商进入我们市场的拟议条件。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'hemm fl-offerta ta' aċċess għas-suq?
messages.mt_standard: X'hemm fl-offerta ta' aċċess għas-suq?
messages.zh: 市场准入要约里有什么内容？
messages.en: What is in the market access offer?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm il-kundizzjonijiet proposti biex fornituri barranin jidħlu fis-suq tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm il-kundizzjonijiet proposti biex fornituri barranin jidħlu fis-suq tagħna.
messages.zh: 里面有外国供应商进入我们市场的拟议条件。
messages.en: It contains the proposed conditions for foreign suppliers to enter our market.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把市场想成一扇门：aċċess 是进入，suq 是市场，offerta 是提出的方案；整组联想为“说明怎样进入市场的条件提案”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proposal stating the prices at which someone is willing to supply goods or services, including a bid or tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明愿意提供商品或服务的价格的提议，可用于一般报价、竞争性出价或正式投标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proposta li tindika l-prezzijiet li bihom persuna jew kumpanija tkun lesta tipprovdi prodotti jew servizzi, inkluż f'kompetizzjoni jew fi proċess ta' sejħa għall-offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为争取交易或合同而提出的竞争性报价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta ta' prezzijiet magħmula biex persuna jew kumpanija tikkompeti għal negozju jew kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bid is a proposed price or set of prices submitted in competition for a particular transaction or contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向对方提出的商品或服务价格方案，供其考虑接受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta li tagħti l-prezzijiet ta' prodotti jew servizzi sabiex il-parti l-oħra tkun tista' tikkunsidra jekk taċċettahiex.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offer is a proposal stating the prices at which goods or services can be supplied for another party to consider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 响应招标而正式提交的报价方案。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proposta formali li tinkludi l-prezzijiet għall-provvista ta' prodotti jew servizzi u li titressaq bi tweġiba għal sejħa għall-offerti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender is a formal proposal containing prices for supplying goods or services in response to an invitation to submit proposals.

formal.mt: Bi tweġiba għas-sejħa għall-offerti, il-kumpanija ssottomettiet offerta ta' prezzijiet li tinkludi l-ispiża ta' kull oġġett u tat-trasport.
formal.en: In response to the invitation to tender, the company submitted a price tender that includes the cost of each item and transport.
formal.zh: 该公司响应招标，提交了一份列明各项物品及运输费用的投标报价。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Waslet l-offerta ta' prezzijiet mingħand il-fornitur? Mark: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja jekk il-prezz jinkludix it-trasport.
colloquial.en: Nina: Has the supplier's price offer arrived? Mark: Yes, but I want to check whether the price includes transport.
colloquial.zh: Nina：供应商的报价到了吗？Mark：到了，不过我想确认价格是否包含运输费。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet l-offerta ta' prezzijiet mingħand il-fornitur?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet l-offerta ta' prezzijiet mingħand il-fornitur?
messages.zh: 供应商的报价到了吗？
messages.en: Has the supplier's price offer arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja jekk il-prezz jinkludix it-trasport.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rrid niċċekkja jekk il-prezz jinkludix it-trasport.
messages.zh: 到了，不过我想确认价格是否包含运输费。
messages.en: Yes, but I want to check whether the price includes transport.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 prezzijiet 就联想报价表上一行行价格；普通交易中是报价，竞争交易中是出价，响应正式招标时是投标报价，用场景区分三个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A remark or action that insults someone or hurts their feelings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人感到受辱、被轻视或感情受到伤害的言语或行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma jew azzjoni li tweġġa' s-sentimenti ta' persuna jew turi nuqqas ta' rispett lejha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冒犯或侮辱他人、使其感到受伤害的言语或行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma jew imġiba li biha persuna tinsulta lil xi ħadd jew tweġġagħlu s-sentimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An offense is something said or done that insults someone or hurts their feelings.

collocations.en: to take a comment as an insult

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, il-kittieb talab skuża għall-offiża u ċċara li ma kellux l-intenzjoni li jweġġa' lil ħadd.
formal.en: In his letter, the writer apologized for the offense and clarified that he had not intended to hurt anyone.
formal.zh: 写信人在信中为自己的冒犯道歉，并澄清自己无意伤害任何人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt il-kumment tiegħi bħala offiża? Mark: Iva, weġġagħni ftit. Maja: Skużani, ma ridtx inweġġgħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you take my comment as an insult? Mark: Yes, it hurt me a little. Maja: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得我那句话冒犯了你吗？马克：是的，有点伤人。玛雅：对不起，我不是有意伤害你的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt il-kumment tiegħi bħala offiża?
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt il-kumment tiegħi bħala offiża?
messages.zh: 你觉得我那句话冒犯了你吗？
messages.en: Did you take my comment as an insult?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, weġġagħni ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, weġġagħni ftit.
messages.zh: 是的，有点伤人。
messages.en: Yes, it hurt me a little.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, ma ridtx inweġġgħek.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, ma ridtx inweġġgħek.
messages.zh: 对不起，我不是有意伤害你的。
messages.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to hurt you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offiża 放进“这句话伤到我了”的场景记忆，再用 offiża personali 联想到“人身侮辱”，抓住言行造成感情伤害这一核心。

gloss_zh: 被提供的；被提出的；获提供的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made available or presented to someone for consideration or acceptance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已向某人提供或提出、供其考虑或接受的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqiegħed għad-dispożizzjoni ta' xi ħadd jew ippreżentat lilu biex jikkunsidrah jew jaċċettah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经向某人提供、提出或给予其接受机会的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie ppreżentat lil xi ħadd biex ikun jista' jaċċettah jew jagħmel użu minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is offered is made available to someone, who can choose whether to accept it.

collocations.zh: 所提出的价格；所报的价格

formal.mt: Il-kumitat eżamina s-servizz offrut mill-kumpanija qabel ma ħa d-deċiżjoni finali.
formal.en: The committee examined the service offered by the company before making its final decision.
formal.zh: 委员会在作出最终决定之前，审查了该公司所提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-prezz offrut għar-rota huwa tajjeb? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadni ma ddeċidejtx. Lara: Aħseb ftit qabel taċċetta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the price offered for the bicycle good? Pawlu: Yes, but I haven't decided yet. Lara: Think about it a little before accepting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：对方给这辆自行车开的价好吗？保罗：不错，但我还没决定。拉拉：接受之前再想一想。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prezz offrut għar-rota huwa tajjeb?
messages.mt_standard: Il-prezz offrut għar-rota huwa tajjeb?
messages.zh: 对方给这辆自行车开的价好吗？
messages.en: Is the price offered for the bicycle good?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (自行车卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni ma ddeċidejtx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni ma ddeċidejtx.
messages.zh: 不错，但我还没决定。
messages.en: Yes, but I haven't decided yet.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħseb ftit qabel taċċetta.
messages.mt_standard: Aħseb ftit qabel taċċetta.
messages.zh: 接受之前再想一想。
messages.en: Think about it a little before accepting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份报价已经摆到面前：offrut 表示“已被提供的”，并不表示已经接受。用 il-prezz offrut“所报的价格”整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Higher or better in standard, quality, or rank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在标准、质量或等级方面更高、更优的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta' standard, kwalità jew grad aħjar meta mqabbel ma' xi ħaġa oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在质量、水平或等级上更优或更高的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu kwalità, livell jew grad aħjar minn dak ta' ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is superior has a higher standard, quality, or rank than something else.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat irrakkomanda li l-prodotti jilħqu standard ogħla ta' kwalità.
formal.en: The committee recommended that the products meet a higher standard of quality.
formal.zh: 委员会建议产品达到更高的质量标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp? Rita: Għax huwa ta' kwalità ogħla u jdum aktar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose this fabric? Rita: Because it is of superior quality and lasts longer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么选这种布料？Rita：因为它质量更好，也更耐用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għażilt dan id-drapp?
messages.zh: 你为什么选这种布料？
messages.en: Why did you choose this fabric?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa ta' kwalità ogħla u jdum aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa ta' kwalità ogħla u jdum aktar.
messages.zh: 因为它质量更好，也更耐用。
messages.en: Because it is of superior quality and lasts longer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把质量比较想成向上的阶梯：kwalità ogħla 就是质量更上一层；这是语义联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Already being used by someone, or busy with an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示座位、地方等已被占用，也表示人正忙于某项活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post jew oġġett li diġà qed jintuża minn xi ħadd, jew persuna li għandha x'tagħmel u mhijiex libera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被占用的；已经有人使用而不能供别人使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li diġà qed jintuża minn xi ħadd u għalhekk mhuwiex disponibbli għal persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a seat or place is occupied, someone is already using it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忙碌的；正忙于工作或其他事务而没有空的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu xogħol jew attività x'jagħmel u għalhekk ma jkunx liberu biex jagħmel xi ħaġa oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is busy, they are doing something that takes their time and attention.

formal.mt: L-uffiċċju kien okkupat minn tim ieħor, għalhekk id-direttur ħadem f'post differenti.
formal.en: The office was occupied by another team, so the director worked in a different location.
formal.zh: 办公室已被另一个团队占用，因此主管换了一个地方办公。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tkellimni issa? Mark: Bħalissa jien okkupat bix-xogħol. Inċempillek aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you talk to me now? Mark: I'm busy with work at the moment. I'll call you later.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你现在能和我聊聊吗？马克：我这会儿正忙着工作，晚点给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tkellimni issa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tkellimni issa?
messages.zh: 你现在能和我聊聊吗？
messages.en: Can you talk to me now?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħalissa jien okkupat bix-xogħol. Inċempillek aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Bħalissa jien okkupat bix-xogħol. Inċempillek aktar tard.
messages.zh: 我这会儿正忙着工作，晚点给你打电话。
messages.en: I'm busy with work at the moment. I'll call you later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记住 okkupat：椅子上有人就是“被占用”，人手头有工作就是“忙碌”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The different jobs or types of work that people do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人们从事的不同职业或工作类型，为复数用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ix-xogħlijiet jew il-professjonijiet differenti li jagħmlu n-nies, normalment biex jaqilgħu l-għajxien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 职业；人们为谋生而从事的各类工作，表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tipi differenti ta' xogħol jew professjonijiet li n-nies jeżerċitaw biex jaqilgħu l-għajxien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People's occupations are the jobs or professions they follow to earn a living.

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ jiġbor informazzjoni dwar l-okkupazzjonijiet tar-residenti biex jidentifika l-ħtiġijiet tat-taħriġ.
formal.en: The survey collects information about residents' occupations to identify training needs.
formal.zh: 这项调查收集居民的职业信息，以确定培训需求。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għandek dik il-lista ta' okkupazzjonijiet? Toni: Qed nagħżel tliet okkupazzjonijiet għall-proġett tal-iskola.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you have that list of occupations? Toni: I'm choosing three occupations for the school project.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你拿着那份职业清单做什么？托尼：我正在为学校的专题作业挑选三种职业。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għandek dik il-lista ta' okkupazzjonijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għandek dik il-lista ta' okkupazzjonijiet?
messages.zh: 你拿着那份职业清单做什么？
messages.en: Why do you have that list of occupations?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nagħżel tliet okkupazzjonijiet għall-proġett tal-iskola.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nagħżel tliet okkupazzjonijiet għall-proġett tal-iskola.
messages.zh: 我正在为学校的专题作业挑选三种职业。
messages.en: I'm choosing three occupations for the school project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 okkupazzjonijiet 写在职业清单的标题上，下面列教师、厨师和司机，借多种工作记住它的复数意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A doctor who specializes in examining eyes and treating eye conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门检查眼睛并诊治眼部疾病的医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabib li jispeċjalizza fl-eżami tal-għajnejn u fid-dijanjożi u t-trattament tal-mard tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 眼科专科医生；专门检查眼睛并诊治眼部问题的医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tabib speċjalizzat li jeżamina l-għajnejn, jagħraf il-mard tagħhom u jipprovdi t-trattament meħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An eye specialist is a doctor who examines eyes and diagnoses and treats conditions affecting them.

collocations.en: an appointment with the eye specialist

formal.mt: Il-pazjent ġie riferut għand okulista għal eżami dettaljat tal-għajnejn.
formal.en: The patient was referred to an eye specialist for a detailed eye examination.
formal.zh: 患者被转诊至眼科医生处，接受详细的眼部检查。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni llum? Pawlu: Għandi appuntament għand l-okulista fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why are you leaving early today? Pawlu: I have an appointment with the eye specialist at three.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天为什么要提前走？保罗：我预约了三点看眼科医生。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex se titlaq kmieni llum?
messages.zh: 你今天为什么要提前走？
messages.en: Why are you leaving early today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi appuntament għand l-okulista fit-tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi appuntament għand l-okulista fit-tlieta.
messages.zh: 我预约了三点看眼科医生。
messages.en: I have an appointment with the eye specialist at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象预约单上写着 okulista，旁边画一只眼睛；把这个词和“预约眼科医生”的完整场景一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 奥林匹克的；与奥运会有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Olympic Games or to the athletes, events, and institutions associated with them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与奥林匹克运动会或其运动员、比赛项目及相关机构有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Olimpjadi jew mal-atleti, il-kompetizzjonijiet u l-istituzzjonijiet marbuta magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奥林匹克的；与奥运会有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mal-Olimpjadi, inklużi l-isport, l-atleti u l-organizzazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Olympic is connected with the Olympic Games or the sporting activities and organizations associated with them.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat olimpiku ħabbar programm ġdid biex jgħin lill-atleti fit-taħriġ tagħhom.
formal.en: The Olympic committee announced a new programme to help athletes with their training.
formal.zh: 奥林匹克委员会公布了一项帮助运动员训练的新计划。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ fil-pixxina? Toni: Dak atleta olimpiku. Qed jipprepara għall-kompetizzjoni li jmiss.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that training in the pool? Toni: He's an Olympic athlete. He's preparing for his next competition.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：泳池里正在训练的那个人是谁？托尼：他是一名奥运会运动员，正在准备下一场比赛。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ fil-pixxina?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak li qed jitħarreġ fil-pixxina?
messages.zh: 泳池里正在训练的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that training in the pool?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak atleta olimpiku. Qed jipprepara għall-kompetizzjoni li jmiss.
messages.mt_standard: Dak atleta olimpiku. Qed jipprepara għall-kompetizzjoni li jmiss.
messages.zh: 他是一名奥运会运动员，正在准备下一场比赛。
messages.en: He's an Olympic athlete. He's preparing for his next competition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 olimpiku 放在 atleta 后面，联想运动员胸前的五环标志，记住它表达“奥运会的”，是描述性质的形容词。

gloss_zh: 奥林匹克运动会；奥运会

teaching_sense.en_definition: The international sporting event in which athletes representing different countries compete in many sports.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各国运动员代表本国参加多个体育项目比赛的国际运动会，即奥林匹克运动会。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-logħob sportiv internazzjonali li fih atleti li jirrappreżentaw pajjiżi differenti jikkompetu f'diversi dixxiplini sportivi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奥林匹克运动会，简称奥运会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kompetizzjoni sportiva internazzjonali magħrufa bħala l-Logħob Olimpiku, li tiġbor flimkien atleti minn pajjiżi differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Olympics are an international sporting event in which athletes from different countries compete against one another in many sports.

collocations.en: win a medal at the Olympics

formal.mt: L-atleta stqarret li l-għan ewlieni tagħha huwa li tipparteċipa fl-Olimpjadi u tirrappreżenta lil pajjiżha.
formal.en: The athlete stated that her main goal is to participate in the Olympics and represent her country.
formal.zh: 这名女运动员表示，她的主要目标是参加奥运会并代表自己的国家出赛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tara l-Olimpjadi miegħi llejla? Ben: Iva! Nixtieq nara t-tiġrijiet tal-għawm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to watch the Olympics with me tonight? Ben: Yes! I'd like to watch the swimming races.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你今晚想和我一起看奥运会吗？本：想！我想看游泳比赛。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tara l-Olimpjadi miegħi llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tara l-Olimpjadi miegħi llejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚想和我一起看奥运会吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch the Olympics with me tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Nixtieq nara t-tiġrijiet tal-għawm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Nixtieq nara t-tiġrijiet tal-għawm.
messages.zh: 想！我想看游泳比赛。
messages.en: Yes! I'd like to watch the swimming races.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电视上写着 Olimpjadi，下面正在播放各国运动员入场；这个词指整场“奥运会”，与形容词 olimpiku 配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dark shape or area formed when a person or object blocks light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物体挡住光线时，在某个表面上形成的暗色形状或区域。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma jew żona mudlama li tidher fuq wiċċ meta persuna jew oġġett jimblokka d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人或物体遮挡光线后形成的影子或阴影。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona jew forma iktar mudlama li tinħoloq meta xi ħaġa twaqqaf id-dawl milli jilħaq wiċċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shadow is a dark shape or area that appears where a person or object prevents light from reaching a surface.

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, l-ombra tas-siġra tidher fuq il-ħajt abjad u toħloq kuntrast qawwi.
formal.en: In the photograph, the tree's shadow appears on the white wall and creates a strong contrast.
formal.zh: 照片中，树的影子映在白墙上，形成鲜明的对比。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara dik l-ombra fuq il-ħajt! Paul: Hija tal-pjanta ħdejn il-lampa. Jekk inċaqlaq il-lampa, tinbidel il-forma tagħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at that shadow on the wall! Paul: It's from the plant beside the lamp. If I move the lamp, its shape changes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看墙上的那个影子！保罗：那是灯旁边植物的影子。我把灯挪一下，影子的形状就会改变。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dik l-ombra fuq il-ħajt!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dik l-ombra fuq il-ħajt!
messages.zh: 看墙上的那个影子！
messages.en: Look at that shadow on the wall!

messages.speaker: Paul (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija tal-pjanta ħdejn il-lampa. Jekk inċaqlaq il-lampa, tinbidel il-forma tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija tal-pjanta ħdejn il-lampa. Jekk inċaqlaq il-lampa, tinbidel il-forma tagħha.
messages.zh: 那是灯旁边植物的影子。我把灯挪一下，影子的形状就会改变。
messages.en: It's from the plant beside the lamp. If I move the lamp, its shape changes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用手挡住台灯，看墙上出现 ombra；把“挡光形成暗影”的小实验与这个词绑定，记住影子会随光源移动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large umbrella used to provide shade from the sun or shelter from rain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于遮挡阳光或避雨的大伞，尤其可指海滩或户外使用的遮阳伞。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Umbrella kbira li tintuża biex tagħti kenn mix-xemx jew mix-xita, pereżempju fuq il-bajja jew barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于遮挡阳光、提供阴凉的遮阳伞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Umbrella kbira li tipprovdi dell u kenn mix-xemx lil min joqgħod taħtha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sunshade is a large umbrella that you put up to protect yourself from direct sunlight.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尺寸较大、可供人遮阳或避雨的伞。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Umbrella ta' daqs kbir li taħtha persuna jew grupp ta' nies jistgħu jsibu kenn mix-xemx jew mix-xita.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A large umbrella is a broad covering that opens above you to provide shelter from rain or sun.

collocations.en: sit or stay under the sunshade

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi jistgħu jikru ombrellun fuq il-bajja biex ikollhom kenn mix-xemx matul il-ġurnata.
formal.en: Visitors can rent a sunshade on the beach to shelter from the sun during the day.
formal.zh: 游客可以在海滩租一把遮阳伞，以便白天遮挡阳光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se noqogħdu? Ix-xemx qawwija ħafna. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu taħt l-ombrellun. Hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we sit? The sun is very strong. Mark: Let's sit under the sunshade. There are two empty chairs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们坐哪里？太阳太晒了。马克：我们坐到遮阳伞下面吧。那里有两把空椅子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu? Ix-xemx qawwija ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu? Ix-xemx qawwija ħafna.
messages.zh: 我们坐哪里？太阳太晒了。
messages.en: Where shall we sit? The sun is very strong.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu taħt l-ombrellun. Hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu taħt l-ombrellun. Hemm żewġ siġġijiet vojta.
messages.zh: 我们坐到遮阳伞下面吧。那里有两把空椅子。
messages.en: Let's sit under the sunshade. There are two empty chairs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ombrellun 记成海滩上撑开的大伞：伞下能放两把椅子，既突出“大伞”的尺寸，也帮助记住“遮阳伞”的用途。

gloss_zh: 词义无法确定；所给释义 fjj 不足以解释该词条。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An entry labelled as a verb whose meaning cannot be established from the supplied gloss 'fjj'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 材料标注为动词，但所给释义 fjj 无法提供可解释的词义，因此不能据此教授其实际用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Din l-entrata hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda t-tifsira tagħha ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-glossa mogħtija 'fjj'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原始释义为 fjj，含义不明，无法提供可靠的中文义项解释。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa 'fjj' ma tagħtix biżżejjed informazzjoni biex tiġi spjegata t-tifsira ta' din l-entrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied gloss does not establish an interpretable meaning for this entry.

collocations.en: the form 'one pieece' (a phrase for discussing the entry)
collocations.zh: “one pieece”这一形式（用于讨论词条本身的表达）

collocations.en: the unknown meaning of 'one pieece' (a phrase for discussing the entry)
collocations.zh: “one pieece”尚不明确的含义（用于讨论词条本身的表达）

formal.mt: L-entrata 'one pieece' hija mmarkata bħala verb, iżda l-glossa 'fjj' ma tippermettix li niddeterminaw it-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: The entry 'one pieece' is labelled as a verb, but the gloss 'fjj' does not allow us to determine its meaning.
formal.zh: 词条“one pieece”被标注为动词，但释义“fjj”无法让我们确定它的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'one pieece'? Pawlu: Mill-glossa 'fjj' biss ma nistgħux inkunu nafu. Lara: Allura nħalli t-tifsira mhux magħrufa għalissa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'one pieece' mean? Pawlu: We cannot tell from the gloss 'fjj' alone. Lara: Then I will leave the meaning unknown for now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：“one pieece”是什么意思？保罗：只凭“fjj”这个释义，我们无法判断。拉拉：那我暂时把词义标为未知。

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这一条记作“待核词卡”：保留原拼写和动词标签，不凭外形猜词义；以上短语只用于讨论词条本身。

gloss_zh: 正派的；诚实的；真诚的；正直的

teaching_sense.en_definition: An honest person tells the truth and behaves fairly; the adjective can also describe someone who is decent, sincere, or morally upright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人说实话、做事公正，也可表示为人正派、态度真诚或品行正直。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna onesta tgħid il-verità u taġixxi b'mod ġust; l-aġġettiv jista' jiddeskrivi wkoll persuna ta' mġiba tajba, sinċiera jew ta' prinċipji morali sodi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为人正派的；行为符合基本的道德和待人准则的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna onesta f'dan is-sens iġġib ruħha tajjeb u tittratta lill-oħrajn b'rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A decent person behaves properly and treats other people with respect.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诚实的；说实话且不欺骗他人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna onesta tgħid il-verità u ma tqarraqx b'ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is honest tells the truth and does not deliberately deceive others.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真诚的；表达真实想法或感情，而非假装的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna onesta f'dan is-sens tesprimi dak li tassew taħseb jew tħoss, mingħajr ma tippretendi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is sincere expresses what they really think or feel without pretending.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正直的；坚持道德原则、行为公正端正的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna onesta f'dan is-sens iżżomm ma' prinċipji morali sodi u taġixxi b'mod ġust.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An upright person follows strong moral principles and acts fairly towards other people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lid-direttur bħala persuna onesta li tgħid il-verità u tittratta lill-impjegati kollha b'mod ġust.
formal.en: The report describes the director as an honest person who tells the truth and treats all employees fairly.
formal.zh: 报告将这位主管描述为诚实正直的人：他说实话，也公平对待所有员工。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kun onest miegħi, għoġbok l-ikel? Mark: Iva, imma s-soppa kienet mielħa wisq. Marija: Grazzi talli għedtli.
colloquial.en: Marija: Be honest with me, did you like the food? Mark: Yes, but the soup was too salty. Marija: Thanks for telling me.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：跟我说实话，你喜欢这些菜吗？马克：喜欢，不过汤太咸了。玛丽娅：谢谢你告诉我。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友兼客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma s-soppa kienet mielħa wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma s-soppa kienet mielħa wisq.

messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għedtli.

messages.en: Thanks for telling me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友请你评价一道菜：说实话是“诚实”，表达真实感受是“真诚”，待人做事端正则是“正派、正直”。用同一场景串起四义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An onorarju is a payment for a service, such as professional work or a guest lecture, and may be an honorarium or a fee.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为提供某项服务而支付的报酬，例如专业工作的服务费或受邀讲课的酬金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Onorarju huwa ħlas mogħti għal servizz, bħal xogħol professjonali jew taħdita, u jista' jkun ħlas bħala rikonoxximent jew miżata għas-servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 酬金；为感谢某人提供讲座等服务而给予的报酬，通常并非按固定收费标准收取。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Onorarju f'dan is-sens huwa ħlas mogħti bħala rikonoxximent għal servizz, bħal taħdita, li għalih normalment ma tkunx stabbilita miżata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An honorarium is a payment given in appreciation of a service for which a fixed fee is not normally charged.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务费；为获得某项服务，尤其是专业服务，而支付的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Onorarju f'dan is-sens huwa somma flus imħallsa għal servizz, speċjalment għal xogħol professjonali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fee is an amount of money paid for a service, especially professional work.

collocations.en: to pay a fee or honorarium

formal.mt: L-università se tagħti onorarju lill-kelliema mistiedna bħala rikonoxximent għat-taħdita tagħha.
formal.en: The university will give the guest speaker an honorarium in appreciation of her talk.
formal.zh: 大学将向受邀女讲者支付酬金，以感谢她举办讲座。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Kemm hu l-onorarju tiegħek għal din il-konsultazzjoni? Pawlu: Sittin ewro. Rita: Sewwa, u meta nista' nħallas?
colloquial.en: Rita: How much is your fee for this consultation? Pawlu: Sixty euros. Rita: All right, and when can I pay?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这次咨询您的收费是多少？保罗：六十欧元。丽塔：好的，我什么时候可以付款？

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 onorarju 放在“服务完成后收到报酬”的画面里：受邀讲座可收酬金，专业咨询可收服务费，两义都围绕服务与付款。

gloss_zh: 受到尊重或表彰的；感到荣幸的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone who is onorat has been shown special respect or recognition, or feels proud and grateful because of it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人受到特别的尊重、认可或表彰，也可表示因此感到荣幸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna onorata tkun ingħatat rispett jew rikonoxximent speċjali, jew tħoss sodisfazzjon u gratitudni minħabba dan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受到尊重、认可或表彰的；因获得某种礼遇或机会而感到荣幸的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna onorata tkun irċeviet rispett jew rikonoxximent speċjali, jew tħossha grata u kburija għal stima, stedina jew opportunità li ngħatatilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you are honoured, you receive special respect or recognition, or feel proud and grateful because of how you are treated.

formal.mt: Il-professur qal li ħassu onorat li l-università għażlitu biex jagħti d-diskors tal-ftuħ.
formal.en: The professor said he felt honoured that the university had chosen him to give the opening address.
formal.zh: 教授表示，大学选他致开幕词，让他感到十分荣幸。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tkun ix-xhud fit-tieġ tagħna? Mark: Żgur! Inħossni onorat li għażiltuni. Anna: Kemm aħna ferħanin li aċċettajt!
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you be a witness at our wedding? Mark: Of course! I feel honoured that you chose me. Anna: We are so happy you accepted!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你愿意做我们婚礼的见证人吗？马克：当然！你们选我，我感到很荣幸。安娜：你答应了，我们真高兴！

messages.zh: 你答应了，我们真高兴！
messages.en: We are so happy you accepted!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己被邀请担任重要角色，手放胸前说 inħossni onorat，意为“我感到荣幸”；把受到重视与内心感激连起来记。

gloss_zh: 尊敬的；议员等民选代表的敬称

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used as a respectful title or form of address for an elected representative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于称呼或提及民选代表、表示尊敬的称谓性形容词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jintuża bħala titlu jew forma ta' indirizz biex jintwera rispett lejn rappreżentant elett.

sense_translations.en_definition: honourable (term of respect used of elected representatives)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊敬的，用作对民选代表的礼貌称谓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża ma' isem jew kariga ta' rappreżentant elett bħala sinjal ta' rispett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use honourable when formally addressing or referring to an elected representative with respect.

formal.mt: Il-membru onorevoli talab aktar informazzjoni dwar il-proposta waqt id-dibattitu.
formal.en: The honourable member requested more information about the proposal during the debate.
formal.zh: 尊敬的议员在辩论期间要求提供有关该提案的更多信息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex qalu 'onorevoli' qabel isem id-deputat? Pawlu: Għax huwa titlu ta' rispett li jintuża għar-rappreżentanti eletti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did they say 'honourable' before the representative's name? Pawlu: Because it is a respectful title used for elected representatives.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：为什么他们在那位议员的名字前加了“尊敬的”？保罗：因为这是用于民选代表的敬称。

messages.speaker: 玛丽亚 (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qalu 'onorevoli' qabel isem id-deputat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qalu 'onorevoli' qabel isem id-deputat?
messages.zh: 为什么他们在那位议员的名字前加了“尊敬的”？
messages.en: Why did they say 'honourable' before the representative's name?

messages.speaker: 保罗 (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax huwa titlu ta' rispett li jintuża għar-rappreżentanti eletti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax huwa titlu ta' rispett li jintuża għar-rappreżentanti eletti.
messages.zh: 因为这是用于民选代表的敬称。
messages.en: Because it is a respectful title used for elected representatives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象议会发言时先说“尊敬的议员”，把 onorevoli 与正式敬称绑定记忆；这里强调称呼礼节。

gloss_zh: 本体论的；有关存在本质的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to philosophical questions about existence, being, and what kinds of things exist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与哲学中关于存在、存在的本质以及有哪些存在者的问题有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' mistoqsijiet filosofiċi dwar l-eżistenza, in-natura tagħha u x'tipi ta' affarijiet jeżistu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 本体论的，涉及哲学上对存在及其基本性质或类别的研究。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda l-istudju filosofiku tal-eżistenza, tan-natura tagħha u tal-kategoriji ta' affarijiet li jeżistu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ontological question or argument concerns the nature of existence or the kinds of things that exist.

collocations.zh: 本体论地位；某事物以何种方式存在

formal.mt: L-istudju jindirizza l-istatus ontoloġiku tan-numri u jistaqsi jekk jeżistux indipendentement mill-moħħ tal-bniedem.
formal.en: The study addresses the ontological status of numbers and asks whether they exist independently of the human mind.
formal.zh: 该研究探讨数字的本体论地位，并追问数字是否独立于人类心智而存在。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'ontoloġiku' f'dan it-test? Mark: Għandu x'jaqsam ma' x'jeżisti u ma' x'tip ta' eżistenza għandu.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'ontological' mean in this text? Mark: It concerns what exists and what kind of existence it has.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这篇文章里的“本体论的”是什么意思？马克：它涉及什么东西存在，以及它以什么方式存在。

messages.speaker: 劳拉 (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'ontoloġiku' f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'ontoloġiku' f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“本体论的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'ontological' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: 马克 (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu x'jaqsam ma' x'jeżisti u ma' x'tip ta' eżistenza għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu x'jaqsam ma' x'jeżisti u ma' x'tip ta' eżistenza għandu.
messages.zh: 它涉及什么东西存在，以及它以什么方式存在。
messages.en: It concerns what exists and what kind of existence it has.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“数字究竟怎样存在”作记忆问题：看到 ontoloġiku，就想到哲学中的存在、本质与存在类别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool used to remove the cap from a bottle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于取下瓶盖、打开瓶子的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li tintuża biex jitneħħa l-għatu minn flixkun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开瓶器，用于取下瓶盖的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li biha tneħħi l-għatu ta' flixkun sabiex tkun tista' tferra' jew tixrob il-kontenut tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bottle opener is a tool that you use to remove a bottle cap.

formal.mt: Uża opener ta' flixkun biex tneħħi l-għatu tal-metall qabel isservi x-xarba.
formal.en: Use a bottle opener to remove the metal cap before serving the drink.
formal.zh: 端上饮料前，请用开瓶器取下金属瓶盖。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek opener ta' flixkun? Dan l-għatu ma nistax niftaħlu bl-idejn. David: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a bottle opener? I can't open this cap by hand. David: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the teaspoons.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有开瓶器吗？这个瓶盖我用手打不开。戴维：有，在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。

messages.speaker: 妮娜 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek opener ta' flixkun? Dan l-għatu ma nistax niftaħlu bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek opener ta' flixkun? Dan l-għatu ma nistax niftaħlu bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 你有开瓶器吗？这个瓶盖我用手打不开。
messages.en: Do you have a bottle opener? I can't open this cap by hand.

messages.speaker: 戴维 (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-kuċċarini.
messages.zh: 有，在茶匙旁边的抽屉里。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the drawer next to the teaspoons.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上“瓶盖被撬开”的画面，再练习“你有开瓶器吗”，将工具名称与日常请求一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An operating mode in which synchronous equipment provides compensation within an electrical system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 同步设备在电力系统中发挥补偿作用的一种运行方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' tħaddim li fih tagħmir sinkroniku jipprovdi kumpens f'sistema elettrika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电力系统中利用同步设备发挥补偿作用的运行方式，即同步补偿运行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħaddim ta' tagħmir sinkroniku biex jipprovdi kumpens fi ħdan sistema elettrika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Synchronous compensation operation is a mode in which synchronous equipment provides compensation within an electrical system.

collocations.en: the start of synchronous compensation operation
the monitoring of synchronous compensation operation

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi l-operat ta' kumpens sinkroniku u l-kundizzjonijiet meħtieġa għal dan il-mod ta' tħaddim.
formal.en: The technical report describes synchronous compensation operation and the conditions required for this operating mode.
formal.zh: 技术报告说明了同步补偿运行及这种运行方式所需的条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri operat ta' kumpens sinkroniku? Pawlu: Jiġifieri li t-tagħmir sinkroniku jkun qed jipprovdi kumpens fis-sistema elettrika.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does synchronous compensation operation mean? Pawlu: It means that the synchronous equipment is providing compensation in the electrical system.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：同步补偿运行是什么意思？保罗：意思是同步设备正在电力系统中发挥补偿作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri operat ta' kumpens sinkroniku?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri operat ta' kumpens sinkroniku?
messages.zh: 同步补偿运行是什么意思？
messages.en: What does synchronous compensation operation mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li t-tagħmir sinkroniku jkun qed jipprovdi kumpens fis-sistema elettrika.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li t-tagħmir sinkroniku jkun qed jipprovdi kumpens fis-sistema elettrika.
messages.zh: 意思是同步设备正在电力系统中发挥补偿作用。
messages.en: It means that the synchronous equipment is providing compensation in the electrical system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个意义块记忆：operat 是运行，kumpens 是补偿，sinkroniku 是同步的。先记“补偿运行”，再用“同步”限定它，合成“同步补偿运行”。

gloss_zh: 孤岛运行；孤岛模式运行

teaching_sense.en_definition: An operating mode in which an electrical network functions independently of the main electricity network.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 电力网络与主电网断开连接、独立运行的一种方式，称为孤岛运行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' tħaddim li fih netwerk elettriku jaħdem b'mod indipendenti, mingħajr konnessjoni man-netwerk elettriku prinċipali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孤岛模式运行：电力网络在不连接主电网的模式下独立运行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħaddim f'mod li fih netwerk elettriku jkun skonnettjat min-netwerk prinċipali u jaħdem b'mod indipendenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Island mode operation is an operating mode in which an electrical network functions independently after being disconnected from the main network.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 孤岛运行：电力网络与主电网分离时的独立运行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħaddim indipendenti ta' netwerk elettriku meta dan ikun separat min-netwerk elettriku prinċipali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Island operation occurs when an electrical network operates independently without a connection to the main electricity network.

collocations.en: the transition to island mode operation
collocations.zh: 向孤岛模式运行的切换

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tekniku jiddeskrivi l-operat ta' netwerk iżolat, li fih in-netwerk lokali jaħdem mingħajr konnessjoni man-netwerk prinċipali.
formal.en: The technical report describes island operation, in which the local network functions without a connection to the main network.
formal.zh: 技术报告说明了孤岛运行，即本地电网在不连接主电网的情况下运行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jiġifieri operat ta' netwerk iżolat? Mark: Jiġifieri li n-netwerk lokali jaħdem waħdu, mingħajr konnessjoni man-netwerk prinċipali.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does island operation mean? Mark: It means that the local network operates on its own, without a connection to the main network.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：孤岛运行是什么意思？马克：意思是本地电网独立运行，不与主电网连接。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri operat ta' netwerk iżolat?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri operat ta' netwerk iżolat?
messages.zh: 孤岛运行是什么意思？
messages.en: What does island operation mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li n-netwerk lokali jaħdem waħdu, mingħajr konnessjoni man-netwerk prinċipali.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li n-netwerk lokali jaħdem waħdu, mingħajr konnessjoni man-netwerk prinċipali.
messages.zh: 意思是本地电网独立运行，不与主电网连接。
messages.en: It means that the local network operates on its own, without a connection to the main network.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义块记忆：operat 是运行，netwerk 是网络，iżolat 是隔离的。想象本地电网像小岛一样与主网分开，仍然独立工作，就能记住“孤岛运行”。

gloss_zh: 厂用负荷运行；供给电厂内部用电需求的运行状态

teaching_sense.en_definition: Operation in which a generating unit supplies the power station's own internal electrical demand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发电机组为电厂自身内部设备的用电需求供电的运行状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' tħaddim li fih unità tal-ġenerazzjoni tipprovdi l-elettriku meħtieġ għat-tagħmir intern tal-impjant tal-enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 厂用负荷运行，指发电机组承担电厂自身内部用电负荷的运行方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mod ta' tħaddim ta' unità tal-ġenerazzjoni li fih din tforni l-ħtiġijiet interni tal-elettriku tal-impjant tal-enerġija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: House load operation occurs when a generating unit supplies the electrical power needed by the power station itself.

formal.mt: Matul it-test, l-unità nżammet f'operat tad-domanda interna biex tforni l-elettriku meħtieġ għat-tagħmir tal-impjant.
formal.en: During the test, the unit was kept in house load operation to supply the electricity needed by the station's equipment.
formal.zh: 测试期间，机组维持厂用负荷运行，为电厂设备提供所需电力。

colloquial.mt: Rita: X'jiġifieri li l-unità qiegħda f'operat tad-domanda interna? Joseph: Jiġifieri li qed tipprovdi l-elettriku li għandu bżonn l-impjant innifsu.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does it mean that the unit is in house load operation? Joseph: It means it is supplying the electricity that the station itself needs.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：说机组处于厂用负荷运行是什么意思？约瑟夫：意思是它正在供应电厂自身所需的电力。

messages.speaker: 丽塔 (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri li l-unità qiegħda f'operat tad-domanda interna?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri li l-unità qiegħda f'operat tad-domanda interna?
messages.zh: 说机组处于厂用负荷运行是什么意思？
messages.en: What does it mean that the unit is in house load operation?

messages.speaker: 约瑟夫 (值班工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li qed tipprovdi l-elettriku li għandu bżonn l-impjant innifsu.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li qed tipprovdi l-elettriku li għandu bżonn l-impjant innifsu.
messages.zh: 意思是它正在供应电厂自身所需的电力。
messages.en: It means it is supplying the electricity that the station itself needs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电厂给自己的泵和设备供电，用“电厂自己也要用电”记住整组短语；这里的 house load 对应厂内自用负荷。

gloss_zh: 操作员；运营商；在线博彩运营商

teaching_sense.en_definition: An operator is a person or organization that runs equipment, a service, or a business activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操作设备的人，或经营某项服务或业务的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Operatur huwa persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tħaddem tagħmir, tipprovdi servizz jew tmexxi attività kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 操作机器或设备的人；经营某项服务或业务的个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Operatur huwa persuna li tħaddem magna jew tagħmir, jew persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tmexxi servizz jew negozju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An operator is a person who controls equipment or a person or organization that runs a service or business.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网提供和经营博彩服务的个人或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard online huwa persuna jew organizzazzjoni li toffri u tmexxi servizzi tal-logħob tal-azzard fuq l-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online gambling operator is a person or organization that runs gambling services offered over the internet.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jħaddem il-magna, l-operatur għandu jaqra l-istruzzjonijiet tas-sigurtà.
formal.en: Before operating the machine, the operator should read the safety instructions.
formal.zh: 操作机器前，操作员应阅读安全说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-internet għadu ma jaħdimx? Mark: Le, se nċempel lill-operatur biex nara x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the internet still not working? Mark: No, I'm going to call the operator to find out what happened.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：网络还是不能用吗？马克：是啊，我打算给运营商打电话，问问出了什么问题。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-internet għadu ma jaħdimx?
messages.mt_standard: L-internet għadu ma jaħdimx?
messages.zh: 网络还是不能用吗？
messages.en: Is the internet still not working?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nċempel lill-operatur biex nara x'ġara.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nċempel lill-operatur biex nara x'ġara.
messages.zh: 是啊，我打算给运营商打电话，问问出了什么问题。
messages.en: No, I'm going to call the operator to find out what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 operatur 记成“负责让事物运作的人或机构”：机器旁是操作员，网络服务背后是运营商；遇到博彩语境，再理解为博彩运营商。

gloss_zh: 主要经济运营者；主要经营主体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A principal economic operator is the person or organization with the main role in carrying out an economic activity in a particular context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定经济活动中承担主要经营角色的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Operatur ekonomiku prinċipali huwa persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha r-rwol ewlieni fit-twettiq ta' attività ekonomika f'kuntest partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某项经济活动或特定业务安排中承担主要经营角色的个人或机构；具体职责取决于相关语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Operatur ekonomiku prinċipali huwa persuna jew organizzazzjoni li għandha r-rwol ewlieni f'attività ekonomika jew f'arranġament kummerċjali partikolari, bid-dmirijiet speċifiċi tagħha jiddependu mill-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A principal economic operator is the person or organization that has the main operating role in a particular economic activity or business arrangement.

collocations.en: the role of the principal economic operator
collocations.zh: 主要经济运营者的角色

collocations.en: the obligations of the principal economic operator
collocations.zh: 主要经济运营者的义务

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jidentifika l-operatur ekonomiku prinċipali u jiddeskrivi r-rwol tiegħu fil-proġett.
formal.en: The contract identifies the principal economic operator and describes its role in the project.
formal.zh: 合同明确了主要经济运营者，并说明了其在项目中的角色。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fid-dokument hemm miktub 'operatur ekonomiku prinċipali'. Min hu f'dan il-proġett? Pawlu: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Aħna għandna r-rwol ewlieni fit-tmexxija tal-attività kummerċjali.
colloquial.en: Sara: The document says 'principal economic operator'. Who is that in this project? Pawlu: Our company. We have the main role in running the business activity.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：文件里写着“主要经济运营者”。在这个项目中指的是谁？保罗：我们公司。我们在经营这项商业活动方面承担主要角色。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-dokument hemm miktub 'operatur ekonomiku prinċipali'. Min hu f'dan il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Fid-dokument hemm miktub 'operatur ekonomiku prinċipali'. Min hu f'dan il-proġett?
messages.zh: 文件里写着“主要经济运营者”。在这个项目中指的是谁？
messages.en: The document says 'principal economic operator'. Who is that in this project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Aħna għandna r-rwol ewlieni fit-tmexxija tal-attività kummerċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħna. Aħna għandna r-rwol ewlieni fit-tmexxija tal-attività kummerċjali.
messages.zh: 我们公司。我们在经营这项商业活动方面承担主要角色。
messages.en: Our company. We have the main role in running the business activity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个词逐步搭建含义：operatur 是运营者，ekonomiku 把范围限定为经济活动，prinċipali 表示主要的；合起来记作“经济活动中的主要经营主体”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation that runs gambling activities or provides gambling services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经营博彩活动或提供博彩服务的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tmexxi attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard jew tipprovdi servizzi f'dan il-qasam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经营博彩活动或提供博彩服务的个人或机构，即博彩运营商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni responsabbli għat-tmexxija ta' attivitajiet jew servizzi tal-logħob tal-azzard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gambling operator is a person or organisation that runs gambling activities or provides gambling services.

collocations.en: the services of a gambling operator
collocations.zh: 博彩运营商提供的服务

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi s-servizzi offruti minn kull operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard inkluż fl-istudju.
formal.en: The report describes the services offered by each gambling operator included in the study.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了研究所涵盖的每家博彩运营商提供的服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard' hawn? Mark: Il-kumpanija li tmexxi l-attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard. Maja: Mela qed jitkellmu dwar il-kumpanija, mhux dwar il-plejer.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'gambling operator' mean here? Mark: The company that runs the gambling activities. Maja: So they are talking about the company, not the player.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里的“博彩运营商”是什么意思？Mark：就是经营博彩活动的公司。Maja：所以这里说的是公司，不是玩家。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“博彩运营商”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'gambling operator' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija li tmexxi l-attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija li tmexxi l-attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard.
messages.zh: 就是经营博彩活动的公司。
messages.en: The company that runs the gambling activities.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela qed jitkellmu dwar il-kumpanija, mhux dwar il-plejer.
messages.mt_standard: Mela qed jitkellmu dwar il-kumpanija, mhux dwar il-plejer.
messages.zh: 所以这里说的是公司，不是玩家。
messages.en: So they are talking about the company, not the player.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组配上“公司经营博彩活动”的画面记忆：operatur 指经营主体，tal-logħob tal-azzard 限定其经营的是博彩活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation that provides gambling services over the internet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过互联网提供博彩服务的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tipprovdi servizzi tal-logħob tal-azzard permezz tal-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过互联网经营博彩业务的个人或机构，即在线博彩运营商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tmexxi attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard permezz tal-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An online gambling operator is a person or organisation that offers gambling services through the internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运营者或经营机构；在本词条语境中，指经营在线博彩服务的主体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tmexxi servizz jew attività; f'dan il-kuntest, tmexxi servizzi tal-logħob tal-azzard fuq l-internet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An operator is a person or organisation that runs a service or activity, here an online gambling business.

collocations.mt: il-websajt ta' operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn
collocations.en: the website of an online gambling operator
collocations.zh: 在线博彩运营商的网站

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel l-informazzjoni dwar is-servizzi ppubblikata fuq il-websajt ta' kull operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn magħżul.
formal.en: The study compares the service information published on the website of each selected online gambling operator.
formal.zh: 该研究比较了各家入选在线博彩运营商在其网站上公布的服务信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-kumpanija għandha sala tal-logħob? Pawlu: Le, hija operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn. Sara: Jiġifieri toffri s-servizzi tagħha fuq l-internet?
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this company have a gambling venue? Pawlu: No, it is an online gambling operator. Sara: So it offers its services over the internet?
colloquial.zh: Sara：这家公司有实体博彩场所吗？Pawlu：没有，它是一家在线博彩运营商。Sara：也就是说，它通过互联网提供服务？

messages.mt_standard: Din il-kumpanija għandha sala tal-logħob?

messages.mt_standard: Le, hija operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard onlajn.
