messages.en: So it offers its services over the internet?

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住词尾 onlajn 表示“在线”，给“博彩运营商”的画面加上电脑和网页，就能把整个词组与在线服务联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation that runs gambling activities at physical premises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在实体场所经营博彩活动的个人或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li tmexxi attivitajiet tal-logħob tal-azzard f'postijiet fiżiċi fejn jattendu l-plejers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在实体场所提供博彩服务的经营主体，即实体博彩运营商。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni li toffri servizzi tal-logħob tal-azzard f'postijiet fiżiċi li l-plejers iżuru personalment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A land-based gambling operator is a person or organisation that provides gambling services at physical venues.

collocations.mt: il-postijiet immexxija minn operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard tradizzjonali
collocations.en: the premises run by a land-based gambling operator
collocations.zh: 实体博彩运营商经营的场所

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti n-numru ta' postijiet fiżiċi mmexxija minn kull operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard tradizzjonali inkluż fl-istħarriġ.
formal.en: The report gives the number of physical premises run by each land-based gambling operator included in the survey.
formal.zh: 报告列出了调查所涵盖的每家实体博彩运营商经营的实体场所数量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'tradizzjonali' f'dan it-titlu? Ġanni: Hawn qed jirreferi għal operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard tradizzjonali, li jmexxi postijiet fiżiċi. Lara: Bħal kumpanija li tmexxi każinò?
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'traditional' mean in this heading? Ġanni: Here it refers to a land-based gambling operator that runs physical venues. Lara: Like a company that runs a casino?
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个标题中的“传统”是什么意思？Ġanni：这里指经营实体场所的博彩运营商。Lara：比如经营赌场的公司？

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'tradizzjonali' f'dan it-titlu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'tradizzjonali' f'dan it-titlu?
messages.zh: 这个标题中的“传统”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'traditional' mean in this heading?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed jirreferi għal operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard tradizzjonali, li jmexxi postijiet fiżiċi.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed jirreferi għal operatur tal-logħob tal-azzard tradizzjonali, li jmexxi postijiet fiżiċi.
messages.zh: 这里指经营实体场所的博彩运营商。
messages.en: Here it refers to a land-based gambling operator that runs physical venues.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħal kumpanija li tmexxi każinò?
messages.mt_standard: Bħal kumpanija li tmexxi każinò?
messages.zh: 比如经营赌场的公司？
messages.en: Like a company that runs a casino?

cognitive_memory_aid: 在本词条中，把 tradizzjonali 对应到“到实体场所参与”的画面；整组词记作“经营实体博彩场所的运营商”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organisation that operates the electricity transmission system concerned in a particular matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某一具体事项中，负责运营所涉及输电系统的机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni responsabbli għat-tħaddim tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-elettriku li tkun involuta fil-kwistjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 相关输电系统运营商；TSO 是 transmission system operator 的缩写，指具体事项所涉及的输电系统运营机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-elettriku li jkun ikkonċernat fil-każ partikolari; TSO hija l-abbrevjazzjoni Ingliża għal dan it-tip ta' operatur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The relevant TSO is the transmission system operator concerned with the particular system or matter being discussed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在所讨论的具体事项中，负责运营相关输电系统的机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-organizzazzjoni li tħaddem is-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-elettriku kkonċernata fil-kwistjoni li tkun qed tiġi diskussa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The relevant transmission system operator is the organisation responsible for operating the electricity transmission system concerned in a particular matter.

collocations.mt: il-kunsens tal-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti
collocations.en: the consent of the relevant transmission system operator
collocations.zh: 相关输电系统运营商的同意

collocations.mt: il-koordinazzjoni mal-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti
collocations.en: coordination with the relevant transmission system operator
collocations.zh: 与相关输电系统运营商的协调

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipprevedi konsultazzjoni mal-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti qabel ma tiġi stabbilita l-iskeda tax-xogħlijiet.
formal.en: The plan provides for consultation with the relevant transmission system operator before the work schedule is established.
formal.zh: 该计划安排在确定施工时间表之前，与相关输电系统运营商进行协商。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Lil min se nibagħtu l-pjan tax-xogħlijiet? David: Lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti. Marija: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji tal-kuntatt.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who are we sending the work plan to? David: To the relevant transmission system operator. Marija: All right, I will check the contact details.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们要把施工计划发给谁？David：发给相关输电系统运营商。Marija：好的，我来核对联系方式。

messages.speaker: Marija (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min se nibagħtu l-pjan tax-xogħlijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min se nibagħtu l-pjan tax-xogħlijiet?
messages.zh: 我们要把施工计划发给谁？
messages.en: Who are we sending the work plan to?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti.
messages.mt_standard: Lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni rilevanti.
messages.zh: 发给相关输电系统运营商。
messages.en: To the relevant transmission system operator.

messages.speaker: Marija (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji tal-kuntatt.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, se niċċekkja d-dettalji tal-kuntatt.
messages.zh: 好的，我来核对联系方式。
messages.en: All right, I will check the contact details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“运营商—输电系统—与当前事项相关”分块理解，想象施工计划交给负责该电网的机构，帮助记住整个长词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation responsible for operating the transmission system associated with a connection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责运行与某一连接相关的传输系统的人员或机构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni responsabbli mit-tħaddim tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni marbuta ma' konnessjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责连接传输系统运行的人员或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tieħu ħsieb it-tħaddim tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni marbuta mal-konnessjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A connection transmission system operator is a person or organisation that runs the transmission system associated with a connection.

collocations.mt: ir-responsabbiltajiet tal-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni
collocations.en: the responsibilities of the connection transmission system operator
collocations.zh: 连接传输系统运营方的职责

collocations.mt: tikkuntattja lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni
collocations.en: to contact the connection transmission system operator
collocations.zh: 联系连接传输系统运营方

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, l-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni ddeskriva l-problema u l-miżuri meħuda biex tissolva.
formal.en: In the report, the connection transmission system operator described the problem and the measures taken to resolve it.
formal.zh: 连接传输系统运营方在报告中说明了问题及为解决问题而采取的措施。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-konnessjoni reġgħet waqfet. Lil min għandna nikkuntattjaw? Pawlu: Ejja nikkuntattjaw lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni.
colloquial.en: Marta: The connection has stopped working again. Who should we contact? Pawlu: Let's contact the connection transmission system operator.
colloquial.zh: Marta：连接又中断了。我们该联系谁？Pawlu：我们联系连接传输系统运营方吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-konnessjoni reġgħet waqfet. Lil min għandna nikkuntattjaw?
messages.mt_standard: Il-konnessjoni reġgħet waqfet. Lil min għandna nikkuntattjaw?
messages.zh: 连接又中断了。我们该联系谁？
messages.en: The connection has stopped working again. Who should we contact?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nikkuntattjaw lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nikkuntattjaw lill-operatur tas-sistema ta' trażmissjoni tal-konnessjoni.
messages.zh: 我们联系连接传输系统运营方吧。
messages.en: Let's contact the connection transmission system operator.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“运营方—系统—传输—连接”四块，想象连接中断后找到负责整套传输系统的运营方。

gloss_zh: 终端运营方；场站运营方

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person or organisation responsible for operating a terminal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责终端或场站运行的人员或机构；具体所指取决于使用场景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna jew organizzazzjoni responsabbli mit-tħaddim ta' terminal u mill-attivitajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责运行终端或管理场站业务的人员或机构。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew entità li tmexxi terminal jew tieħu ħsieb it-tħaddim tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A terminal operator is a person or organisation responsible for running a terminal and managing its activities.

collocations.en: an agreement with the terminal operator
collocations.zh: 与终端运营方达成的协议

formal.mt: L-operatur tat-terminal tal-merkanzija ħabbar ħinijiet ġodda għall-ġbir tal-kontejners.
formal.en: The cargo terminal operator announced new container collection times.
formal.zh: 货运场站运营方公布了新的集装箱提取时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu niġbru l-kontejner illum? Mark: Ħa nċempel lill-operatur tat-terminal biex nistaqsi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we collect the container today? Mark: Let me call the terminal operator to ask.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今天能提取集装箱吗？Mark：我打电话问问场站运营方。

messages.speaker: Lara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu niġbru l-kontejner illum?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu niġbru l-kontejner illum?
messages.zh: 我们今天能提取集装箱吗？
messages.en: Can we collect the container today?

messages.speaker: Mark (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħa nċempel lill-operatur tat-terminal biex nistaqsi.
messages.mt_standard: Ħa nċempel lill-operatur tat-terminal biex nistaqsi.
messages.zh: 我打电话问问场站运营方。
messages.en: Let me call the terminal operator to ask.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象到货运场站提箱，先找负责运营的那一方；把 operatur 与“运营方”、tat-terminal 与“终端的”对应记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action or procedure carried out as part of processing data, materials, or other input.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在处理数据、加工材料或处理其他输入内容时执行的一项操作或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Azzjoni jew proċedura li titwettaq bħala parti mill-proċessar ta' data, materjal jew elementi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对数据、材料等进行处理或加工时执行的一项操作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni jew proċedura li biha jiġu pproċessati data, materjali jew elementi oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A processing operation is an action or procedure used to process data, materials, or other input.

collocations.en: to carry out a processing operation

formal.mt: Din l-operazzjoni ta' proċessar tneħħi r-rekords duplikati qabel ma jitħejja r-rapport.
formal.en: This processing operation removes duplicate records before the report is prepared.
formal.zh: 这项处理操作会在编制报告之前删除重复记录。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-lista għadha mhix lesta? David: Għad trid issir operazzjoni ta' proċessar biex jitneħħew ir-rekords duplikati.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why isn't the list ready yet? David: A processing operation still needs to be carried out to remove duplicate records.
colloquial.zh: Nina：名单怎么还没准备好？David：还需要执行一项处理操作，把重复记录删掉。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-lista għadha mhix lesta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-lista għadha mhix lesta?
messages.zh: 名单怎么还没准备好？
messages.en: Why isn't the list ready yet?

messages.speaker: David (数据分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad trid issir operazzjoni ta' proċessar biex jitneħħew ir-rekords duplikati.
messages.mt_standard: Għad trid issir operazzjoni ta' proċessar biex jitneħħew ir-rekords duplikati.
messages.zh: 还需要执行一项处理操作，把重复记录删掉。
messages.en: A processing operation still needs to be carried out to remove duplicate records.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清理名单时按下“删除重复项”：这一个具体步骤就是处理操作，用“一步处理”记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A usually short, light theatrical work that combines singing, music, and spoken dialogue.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常篇幅较短、风格轻松，结合歌唱、音乐与口语对白的舞台音乐戏剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali mużikali, ġeneralment qasir u ħafif, li jgħaqqad il-kant u l-mużika ma' djalogu mitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种通常较短、气氛轻松，并将歌唱与口语对白结合的音乐戏剧，即轻歌剧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' xogħol teatrali mużikali, ġeneralment qasir u ħafif, li fih il-kant jalterna ma' djalogu mitkellem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An operetta is a light musical play in which singing is combined with spoken dialogue.

collocations.zh: 一部轻歌剧的制作与演出

formal.mt: Il-programm tat-teatru jinkludi operetta li tgħaqqad kanzunetti ferrieħa ma' djalogu umoristiku.
formal.en: The theatre's programme includes an operetta that combines cheerful songs with humorous dialogue.
formal.zh: 剧院的演出安排包括一部轻歌剧，将欢快的歌曲与幽默的对白结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara operetta miegħi s-Sibt? Rita: Iva! Inħobb il-kant, u nieħu gost bid-djalogu umoristiku wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come and see an operetta with me on Saturday? Rita: Yes! I love the singing, and I enjoy the humorous dialogue too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：星期六想和我一起去看轻歌剧吗？Rita：想！我喜欢里面的歌唱，也喜欢幽默的对白。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara operetta miegħi s-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara operetta miegħi s-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六想和我一起去看轻歌剧吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and see an operetta with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Inħobb il-kant, u nieħu gost bid-djalogu umoristiku wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Inħobb il-kant, u nieħu gost bid-djalogu umoristiku wkoll.
messages.zh: 想！我喜欢里面的歌唱，也喜欢幽默的对白。
messages.en: Yes! I love the singing, and I enjoy the humorous dialogue too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 operetta 记成“唱一段、说一段，轻松看一场”的舞台画面；这是帮助记忆轻歌剧特点的联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who competes against someone or argues against their position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在比赛中与某人竞争，或在辩论中反对某人立场的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tikkompeti kontra persuna oħra jew li targumenta kontra l-pożizzjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比赛中的对手，或辩论及立场上的反对者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Opponent huwa persuna li tkun fuq in-naħa l-oħra f'kompetizzjoni jew f'dibattitu u tipprova tegħleb jew tikkonvinċi lil min ikun kontriha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your opponent is someone who competes against you or argues against the position you support.

formal.mt: Matul id-dibattitu, il-kandidat wieġeb għall-argumenti tal-opponent tiegħu b'mod ċar u rispettuż.
formal.en: During the debate, the candidate responded to his opponent's arguments clearly and respectfully.
formal.zh: 辩论期间，这位候选人清楚而有礼地回应了对手的论点。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu l-opponent tiegħek illum? Lara: Plejer tajjeb ħafna, imma jien ippreparajt sew.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is your opponent today? Lara: A very good player, but I've prepared well.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今天的对手是谁？拉拉：一位很出色的选手，不过我已经做好了准备。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-opponent tiegħek illum?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-opponent tiegħek illum?
messages.zh: 你今天的对手是谁？
messages.en: Who is your opponent today?

messages.speaker: Lara (参赛选手)
messages.mt_spoken: Plejer tajjeb ħafna, imma jien ippreparajt sew.
messages.mt_standard: Plejer tajjeb ħafna, imma jien ippreparajt sew.
messages.zh: 一位很出色的选手，不过我已经做好了准备。
messages.en: A very good player, but I've prepared well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赛场另一端站着的那个人：opponent 是与你较量的对手；换到辩论场景，就是与你持不同立场的人。

gloss_zh: 搭便车者；坐享他人成果的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who benefits from other people's work or contributions without making a fair contribution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自己不作出应有贡献，却享用他人劳动或投入所带来的好处的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgawdi mill-ħidma jew mill-kontribuzzjonijiet ta' ħaddieħor mingħajr ma tagħti s-sehem xieraq tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不承担应有的劳动、费用或责任，却享受他人付出所产生利益的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Opportunist, f'dan is-sens, huwa persuna li tieħu l-benefiċċji ta' xogħol jew sforz komuni mingħajr ma tagħmel il-parti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A free-rider benefits from work or resources provided by others without contributing a fair share.

formal.mt: F'dan il-proġett, l-opportunist ħa l-istess premju bħall-oħrajn minkejja li ma wettaq ebda xogħol.
formal.en: In this project, the free-rider received the same reward as the others despite doing no work.
formal.zh: 在这个项目中，那名搭便车者虽然没有做任何工作，却得到了与其他人相同的奖励。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Aħna għamilna x-xogħol kollu, u Pawlu jrid sehem mill-premju. Rita: Qed jaġixxi ta' opportunist; għandu jagħmel il-parti tiegħu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: We did all the work, and Pawlu wants a share of the prize. Rita: He's acting as a free-rider; he should do his part too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：工作全是我们做的，保罗却想分一份奖金。丽塔：他这是在搭便车；他也应该尽自己的一份力。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħna għamilna x-xogħol kollu, u Pawlu jrid sehem mill-premju.
messages.mt_standard: Aħna għamilna x-xogħol kollu, u Pawlu jrid sehem mill-premju.
messages.zh: 工作全是我们做的，保罗却想分一份奖金。
messages.en: We did all the work, and Pawlu wants a share of the prize.

messages.speaker: Rita (项目组员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jaġixxi ta' opportunist; għandu jagħmel il-parti tiegħu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jaġixxi ta' opportunist; għandu jagħmel il-parti tiegħu wkoll.
messages.zh: 他这是在搭便车；他也应该尽自己的一份力。
messages.en: He's acting as a free-rider; he should do his part too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用小组作业记这个指定词义：别人查资料、写报告，他只来领奖；把这个坐享成果的人记作 opportunist。

gloss_zh: 机会主义；投机取巧的处事方式

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of taking advantage of circumstances for personal gain without consistently following principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为谋取个人利益而利用时机，并随利益变化放弃或改变原则的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imġiba li biha persuna tieħu vantaġġ miċ-ċirkostanzi għall-ġid personali tagħha mingħajr ma żżomm mal-prinċipji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以眼前利益为导向，利用有利形势并随时改变立场或原则的机会主义做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-opportuniżmu huwa l-prattika li wieħed jadatta l-imġiba jew il-pożizzjoni tiegħu skont il-vantaġġ personali li jista' jikseb, anki jekk ikollu jwarrab il-prinċipji tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Opportunism is behaviour in which someone exploits favourable circumstances for personal advantage with little regard for consistent principles.

collocations.zh: 对机会主义行为的指责

formal.mt: L-artiklu kkritika l-opportuniżmu politiku tal-mexxej, li biddel il-pożizzjoni tiegħu biex jikseb aktar voti.
formal.en: The article criticised the leader's political opportunism, as he changed his position to gain more votes.
formal.zh: 这篇文章批评了该领导人的政治机会主义，指出他为了争取更多选票而改变立场。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ilbieraħ kien kontra l-pjan, u llum jappoġġah għax jista' jaqla' xi flus minnu. Mark: Dan opportuniżmu; qed jaħseb biss fil-vantaġġ tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Yesterday he was against the plan, and today he supports it because he can make some money from it. Mark: That's opportunism; he's only thinking about his own advantage.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：昨天他还反对这个计划，今天却因为能从中赚钱而支持它。马克：这就是机会主义；他只想着自己的好处。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilbieraħ kien kontra l-pjan, u llum jappoġġah għax jista' jaqla' xi flus minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Ilbieraħ kien kontra l-pjan, u llum jappoġġah għax jista' jaqla' xi flus minnu.
messages.zh: 昨天他还反对这个计划，今天却因为能从中赚钱而支持它。
messages.en: Yesterday he was against the plan, and today he supports it because he can make some money from it.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan opportuniżmu; qed jaħseb biss fil-vantaġġ tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan opportuniżmu; qed jaħseb biss fil-vantaġġ tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这就是机会主义；他只想着自己的好处。
messages.en: That's opportunism; he's only thinking about his own advantage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“利益往哪边，立场就往哪边”的画面：opportuniżmu 指这种为占便宜而随时改变原则的处事方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Completely different from, or contrary to, something else in direction, effect, or meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在方向、效果或意义上与另一事物相反或相对立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun bil-maqlub ta' xi ħaġa oħra jew kuntrarju għaliha fid-direzzjoni, fl-effett jew fit-tifsira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在方向、性质、效果或含义上与另一事物相反的；对立的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa tkun opposta għal oħra meta jkollha direzzjoni, natura, effett jew tifsira kuntrarja għal tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is opposite to something else when its direction, character, effect, or meaning is contrary to it.

formal.mt: Il-miżura kellha l-effett oppost għal dak mixtieq: minflok naqqset l-ispejjeż, żidithom.
formal.en: The measure had the opposite effect to the one intended: instead of reducing costs, it increased them.
formal.zh: 这项措施产生了与预期相反的效果：它非但没有降低成本，反而增加了成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħsibt li l-kafè kien se jgħinni nikkonċentra. Pawlu: U għenek? Maja: Le, kellu l-effett oppost; issa ma nistax noqgħod kwieta.
colloquial.en: Maja: I thought the coffee would help me concentrate. Pawlu: And did it help? Maja: No, it had the opposite effect; now I can't sit still.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我以为咖啡能帮我集中注意力。保罗：那有帮助吗？玛雅：没有，效果恰好相反；现在我坐都坐不住。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħsibt li l-kafè kien se jgħinni nikkonċentra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħsibt li l-kafè kien se jgħinni nikkonċentra.
messages.zh: 我以为咖啡能帮我集中注意力。
messages.en: I thought the coffee would help me concentrate.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: U għenek?
messages.mt_standard: U għenek?
messages.zh: 那有帮助吗？
messages.en: And did it help?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kellu l-effett oppost; issa ma nistax noqgħod kwieta.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kellu l-effett oppost; issa ma nistax noqgħod kwieta.
messages.zh: 没有，效果恰好相反；现在我坐都坐不住。
messages.en: No, it had the opposite effect; now I can't sit still.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两支朝相反方向的箭头来记 oppost，再联想“想降低成本却增加成本”：方向和效果都可以恰好相反。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Disagreement with or resistance to something; also, a political party that is not in government.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事的反对或抵制；也指不参与执政的反对党或在野党。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil ma' xi ħaġa jew reżistenza għaliha; fil-politika, partit li ma jkunx fil-gvern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某个想法、计划、行动或决定的反对或抵制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' qbil ma' idea, pjan, azzjoni jew deċiżjoni, jew reżistenza għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Opposition is disagreement with something or an effort to prevent it from happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未参与执政、对政府政策提出质疑或不同方案的政党，即反对党或在野党。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Partit politiku li ma jkunx fil-gvern u li jikkritika l-politika tal-gvern jew jipproponi alternattivi għaliha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An opposition party is a political party outside government that challenges government policies or presents alternatives.

formal.mt: Il-proposta sabet oppożizzjoni qawwija fost ir-residenti, li talbu aktar konsultazzjoni qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The proposal met with strong opposition among residents, who requested further consultation before a decision was made.
formal.zh: 这项提案遭到居民的强烈反对，他们要求在作出决定前进一步征求意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm daqshekk oppożizzjoni għal dan il-pjan? Pawlu: Għax ħafna ġirien jaħsbu li se jżid it-traffiku.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there so much opposition to this plan? Pawlu: Because many neighbours think it will increase traffic.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么大家这么反对这个计划？Pawlu：因为很多邻居觉得它会让交通更拥堵。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk oppożizzjoni għal dan il-pjan?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk oppożizzjoni għal dan il-pjan?
messages.zh: 为什么大家这么反对这个计划？
messages.en: Why is there so much opposition to this plan?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħafna ġirien jaħsbu li se jżid it-traffiku.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħafna ġirien jaħsbu li se jżid it-traffiku.
messages.zh: 因为很多邻居觉得它会让交通更拥堵。
messages.en: Because many neighbours think it will increase traffic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它放进两个场景记忆：居民对计划说“不”，是“反对”；政党处于执政阵营之外，是“在野党”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dramatic work performed through singing and music, or a creative work considered as an individual achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以歌唱和音乐演出的戏剧作品，即歌剧；也指一部独立的创作作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali li jitwassal permezz tal-kant u l-mużika; ukoll xogħol kreattiv meqjus bħala ħolqien individwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要通过歌唱、音乐和舞台表演来呈现故事的戏剧作品，即歌剧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali li fih l-istorja titwassal l-aktar permezz tal-kant, il-mużika u r-reċtar fuq il-palk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An opera is a dramatic work in which a story is presented mainly through singing and music.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一部独立的创作作品，尤其指音乐、文学或其他艺术作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol kreattiv individwali, speċjalment fil-mużika, fil-letteratura jew f'qasam ieħor tal-arti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An opus is an individual creative work, especially a musical composition or a literary or artistic work.

collocations.zh: 女歌剧演员；女歌剧歌手

formal.mt: Din l-opra letterarja teżamina r-relazzjoni bejn il-memorja personali u l-ħajja tal-komunità.
formal.en: This literary work examines the relationship between personal memory and community life.
formal.zh: 这部文学作品探讨个人记忆与社区生活之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tiġi tara opra miegħi nhar is-Sibt? Mark: Iva, imma qatt ma rajt waħda. Lara: Tinkwetax, naqraw ftit dwar l-istorja qabel immorru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to come and see an opera with me on Saturday? Mark: Yes, but I've never seen one. Lara: Don't worry, we'll read a little about the story before we go.
colloquial.zh: Lara：星期六想和我一起去看歌剧吗？Mark：想，不过我从来没看过。Lara：别担心，我们去之前先读一点故事介绍。

messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara opra miegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara opra miegħi nhar is-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六想和我一起去看歌剧吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and see an opera with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma qatt ma rajt waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma qatt ma rajt waħda.

messages.en: Yes, but I've never seen one.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)

messages.mt_standard: Tinkwetax, naqraw ftit dwar l-istorja qabel immorru.
messages.zh: 别担心，我们去之前先读一点故事介绍。
messages.en: Don't worry, we'll read a little about the story before we go.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“舞台上唱出来的作品”连接两个义项：看到歌唱舞台想到“歌剧”，看到文学或艺术语境想到“一部作品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose work involves supplying and fitting glasses or other optical aids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从事眼镜或其他视力辅助用品的供应、验配和调整工作的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tipprovdi u tadatta nuċċalijiet jew għajnuniet ottiċi oħra skont il-ħtiġijiet tal-klijent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为顾客提供、验配或调整眼镜等光学视力辅助用品的专业人员，即配镜师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna speċjalizzata li tipprovdi, tadatta jew taġġusta nuċċalijiet u għajnuniet ottiċi oħra għall-klijenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An optician is someone whose job involves supplying and fitting glasses or other optical aids.

collocations.zh: 去找配镜师；去眼镜店配镜

formal.mt: L-optixin aġġusta l-qafas tan-nuċċalijiet sabiex joqgħod sew fuq wiċċ il-klijent.
formal.en: The optician adjusted the glasses frame so that it fitted the customer's face properly.
formal.zh: 配镜师调整了眼镜架，使其适当地贴合顾客的脸部。

colloquial.mt: Nina: In-nuċċalijiet qed jiżolqu minn fuq imnieħri. David: Mur għand l-optixin; jista' jaġġustahomlek.
colloquial.en: Nina: My glasses keep slipping down my nose. David: Go to the optician; they can adjust them for you.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的眼镜老是从鼻梁上往下滑。David：去找配镜师吧，他可以帮你调一下。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nuċċalijiet qed jiżolqu minn fuq imnieħri.
messages.mt_standard: In-nuċċalijiet qed jiżolqu minn fuq imnieħri.
messages.zh: 我的眼镜老是从鼻梁上往下滑。
messages.en: My glasses keep slipping down my nose.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mur għand l-optixin; jista' jaġġustahomlek.
messages.mt_standard: Mur għand l-optixin; jista' jaġġustahomlek.
messages.zh: 去找配镜师吧，他可以帮你调一下。
messages.en: Go to the optician; they can adjust them for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象眼镜总往下滑，你走进店里请专业人员调整镜架；把这个“找人配镜、调镜”的场景与 optixin 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An option relating to a financial transmission right, also referred to as an FTR option.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与金融输电权相关的期权，也称 FTR 期权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Opzjoni marbuta ma' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni, magħrufa wkoll bħala opzjoni FTR.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融输电权期权；FTR 是 financial transmission right 的缩写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Opzjoni marbuta ma' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni; FTR hija l-abbrevjazzjoni tal-espressjoni Ingliża financial transmission right.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An FTR option is an option associated with a financial transmission right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融输电权期权，即与金融输电权相关的期权。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Opzjoni li hija marbuta ma' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni u li tissejjaħ ukoll opzjoni FTR.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A financial transmission right option is an option relating to a financial transmission right.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金融输电权期权；此写法用连字符将“金融输电权”与“期权”分隔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Opzjoni marbuta ma' dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni; f'din il-forma Ingliża, il-kelma option hija separata b'sing mill-bqija tat-terminu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A financial transmission right option is a form of option linked to a financial transmission right.

collocations.mt: il-valur tal-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: the value of the financial transmission right option
collocations.zh: 金融输电权期权的价值

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet tal-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: the terms of the financial transmission right option
collocations.zh: 金融输电权期权的条款

collocations.mt: deskrizzjoni tal-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni
collocations.en: a description of the financial transmission right option
collocations.zh: 对金融输电权期权的说明

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi deskrizzjoni tal-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni u jiġbor il-kundizzjonijiet tagħha f'tabella separata.
formal.en: The report includes a description of the financial transmission right option and summarises its terms in a separate table.
formal.zh: 报告包含对金融输电权期权的说明，并在单独的表格中概述其条款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi din l-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni? Mark: Hija opzjoni marbuta ma' dak id-dritt finanzjarju. Sara: Sew, ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet tagħha flimkien.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is this financial transmission right option? Mark: It's an option linked to that financial right. Sara: Okay, let's read its terms together.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个金融输电权期权是什么？Mark：它是与那项金融权利相关的期权。Sara：好，我们一起读一下它的条款。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din l-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din l-opzjoni għad-dritt finanzjarju ta' trażmissjoni?
messages.zh: 这个金融输电权期权是什么？
messages.en: What is this financial transmission right option?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija opzjoni marbuta ma' dak id-dritt finanzjarju.
messages.mt_standard: Hija opzjoni marbuta ma' dak id-dritt finanzjarju.
messages.zh: 它是与那项金融权利相关的期权。
messages.en: It's an option linked to that financial right.

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sew, ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet tagħha flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Sew, ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet tagħha flimkien.
messages.zh: 好，我们一起读一下它的条款。
messages.en: Okay, let's read its terms together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块朗读并配义：opzjoni 记“期权”，dritt finanzjarju 记“金融权利”，ta' trażmissjoni 记“输电的”；再合起来记完整术语“金融输电权期权”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used to tell someone to stay in the place indicated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来叫某人待在所指位置或留在原处的表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li biha tgħid lil xi ħadd biex jibqa' fil-post indikat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待在那里；用于指示对方留在所指的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża biex tgħid lil persuna tibqa' hemm fejn tkun jew fil-post li tindikalha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression to tell someone to stay in the place you indicate.

formal.mt: L-għalliem ta din l-istruzzjoni lill-istudent: "Oqgħod hemm sakemm insejjaħlek."
formal.en: The teacher gave the student this instruction: "Stay there until I call you."
formal.zh: 老师向学生作出指示：“待在那里，直到我叫你。”

colloquial.mt: Marija: Oqgħod hemm ħdejn il-bieb. Ġejja issa. Pawlu: Tajjeb, nistenniek hawn.
colloquial.en: Marija: Stay there beside the door. I'm coming now. Pawlu: Okay, I'll wait for you here.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：待在那边的门旁，我这就来。保罗：好，我在这里等你。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Oqgħod hemm ħdejn il-bieb. Ġejja issa.
messages.mt_standard: Oqgħod hemm ħdejn il-bieb. Ġejja issa.
messages.zh: 待在那边的门旁，我这就来。
messages.en: Stay there beside the door. I'm coming now.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nistenniek hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nistenniek hawn.
messages.zh: 好，我在这里等你。
messages.en: Okay, I'll wait for you here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Oqgħod hemm 整句配上“指着门旁叫人留下”的画面，记住“待在那里”的交际用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressed through speech rather than writing, as in an examination or explanation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说话而非书写进行的，例如口试或口头解释。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir bil-kliem mitkellem aktar milli bil-kitba, bħal eżami jew spjegazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口头的；以说话而非书写方式表达或进行的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jingħad jew isir bil-fomm minflok bil-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An oral examination or explanation is conducted through speech rather than writing.

formal.mt: L-eżami orali se jsir nhar it-Tnejn, u kull student se jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet bil-fomm.
formal.en: The oral examination will take place on Monday, and each student will answer the questions aloud.
formal.zh: 口试将于星期一举行，每名学生都将口头回答问题。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-eżami ta' għada huwa orali? Mark: Iva, irridu nwieġbu bil-fomm.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is tomorrow's exam oral? Mark: Yes, we have to answer aloud.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：明天的考试是口试吗？马克：是的，我们得口头作答。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-eżami ta' għada huwa orali?
messages.mt_standard: L-eżami ta' għada huwa orali?
messages.zh: 明天的考试是口试吗？
messages.en: Is tomorrow's exam oral?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irridu nwieġbu bil-fomm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irridu nwieġbu bil-fomm.
messages.zh: 是的，我们得口头作答。
messages.en: Yes, we have to answer aloud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象考试时放下笔、开口回答：把 orali 和“口头进行”的场景连起来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A schedule showing when lessons, transport services, or other planned activities take place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明课程、交通班次或其他计划活动在什么时间进行的表。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabella li turi l-ħinijiet tal-lezzjonijiet, tas-servizzi tat-trasport jew ta' attivitajiet oħra ppjanati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时间表；列出课程、交通班次等安排及其对应时间的表。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tabella jew lista li turi f'liema ħinijiet isiru lezzjonijiet, vjaġġi jew attivitajiet oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A timetable shows the times at which lessons, journeys, or other scheduled activities take place.

formal.mt: L-orarju tal-lezzjonijiet jinsab fuq il-websajt tal-iskola u juri l-ħin tal-bidu ta' kull lezzjoni.
formal.en: The class timetable is on the school's website and shows the starting time of each lesson.
formal.zh: 课程表刊登在学校网站上，列明每节课的开始时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek l-orarju tal-karozzi tal-linja? Samwel: Iva, il-karozza li jmiss titlaq fl-għaxra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have the bus timetable? Samwel: Yes, the next bus leaves at ten.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有公交车时刻表吗？萨姆韦尔：有，下一班十点发车。

messages.speaker: Nina (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek l-orarju tal-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek l-orarju tal-karozzi tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你有公交车时刻表吗？
messages.en: Do you have the bus timetable?

messages.speaker: Samwel (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-karozza li jmiss titlaq fl-għaxra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-karozza li jmiss titlaq fl-għaxra.
messages.zh: 有，下一班十点发车。
messages.en: Yes, the next bus leaves at ten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orarju 想成一张左边写活动、右边写几点的表；查课和查车都能用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arranged in a clear order or kept neat, with things in their proper places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按清楚的次序组织的，或物品各归其位而显得整齐的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imqiegħed f'ordni ċar jew miżmum pulit, bl-affarijiet fil-post xieraq tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有条理的；按照适当次序排列或组织的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun irranġat skont ordni ċar u xieraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is in order, its parts are arranged in a clear and appropriate sequence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 整齐的；物品摆放妥当、没有杂乱的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun pulit u mingħajr imbarazz, bl-affarijiet imqiegħda f'posthom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tidy place has its contents arranged neatly, with things put where they belong.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport huwa ordnat: l-informazzjoni hija maqsuma f'taqsimiet ċari li jgħinu lill-qarrej isegwi l-argument.
formal.en: The report is well organized: the information is divided into clear sections that help the reader follow the argument.
formal.zh: 这份报告条理清楚：信息划分为清晰的章节，便于读者理解论证。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-mejda tiegħek dejjem tkun hekk ordnata? Pawlu: Le, illum poġġejt kollox f'postu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is your table always this tidy? Pawlu: No, I put everything away today.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你的桌子总是这么整齐吗？保罗：不是，今天我把东西都归位了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mejda tiegħek dejjem tkun hekk ordnata?
messages.mt_standard: Il-mejda tiegħek dejjem tkun hekk ordnata?
messages.zh: 你的桌子总是这么整齐吗？
messages.en: Is your table always this tidy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum poġġejt kollox f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum poġġejt kollox f'postu.
messages.zh: 不是，今天我把东西都归位了。
messages.en: No, I put everything away today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 ordnat：报告章节顺序清楚，房间物品各归其位；分别对应“有条理”和“整齐”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An order is an arrangement in which things follow a particular sequence or occupy their proper places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物按照一定先后顺序排列，或各自处于适当位置的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ordni hija l-arranġament ta' affarijiet f'sekwenza partikolari jew fil-post xieraq tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物排列的次序或顺序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ordni hija s-sekwenza li fiha jitqiegħdu affarijiet jew isiru azzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The order of things is the sequence in which they are arranged or happen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由有权指挥的人发出的、要求他人遵从的命令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni hija struzzjoni mogħtija minn persuna li għandha l-awtorità biex titlob li ssir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An order is an instruction that someone in authority expects another person to obey.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 物品摆放妥当、不杂乱的整齐状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ordni hija l-istat ta' post fejn l-affarijiet ikunu mqiegħda sewwa u ma jkunx hemm taħwid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Order is the state of a place where things are arranged neatly and kept in their proper places.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 成员遵守共同宗教会规的修会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni reliġjuża hija komunità ta' persuni li jgħixu ħajja reliġjuża skont regola komuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A religious order is a community whose members follow a shared religious rule and way of life.

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-parteċipanti għandha tkun f'ordni alfabetiku biex ikun aktar faċli li jinstab kull isem.
formal.en: The list of participants should be in alphabetical order so that each name is easier to find.
formal.zh: 参与者名单应按字母顺序排列，以便更容易找到每个人的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn poġġejt il-kotba? Pawlu: Fuq l-ixkaffa, f'ordni alfabetiku skont l-isem tal-awtur.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did you put the books? Pawlu: On the shelf, in alphabetical order by the author's name.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你把书放在哪里了？Pawlu：在书架上，按作者姓名的字母顺序排好了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn poġġejt il-kotba?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn poġġejt il-kotba?
messages.zh: 你把书放在哪里了？
messages.en: Where did you put the books?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-ixkaffa, f'ordni alfabetiku skont l-isem tal-awtur.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-ixkaffa, f'ordni alfabetiku skont l-isem tal-awtur.
messages.zh: 在书架上，按作者姓名的字母顺序排好了。
messages.en: On the shelf, in alphabetical order by the author's name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅画面记住 ordni：名单有次序、长官下命令、房间很整齐、修士属修会；读句子时靠搭配判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electronic ordering is the process of requesting goods or services through an electronic system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子系统提交商品或服务订购需求的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ordni elettronika hija l-proċess li bih jintalbu prodotti jew servizzi permezz ta' sistema elettronika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过电子系统完成的订购或下单过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ordni elettronika hija mod kif persuna titlob li tixtri prodotti jew servizzi billi tuża sistema elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: E-ordering is the process of placing requests for goods or services through an electronic system.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用电子系统提交商品或服务订单的方式或过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ordni elettronika hija l-proċess li fih ordnijiet għal prodotti jew servizzi jintbagħtu permezz ta' sistema elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Electronic ordering allows people to submit orders for goods or services using an electronic system.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija introduċiet sistema ta' ordni elettronika biex il-klijenti jkunu jistgħu jitolbu l-prodotti permezz tas-sit tagħha.
formal.en: The company introduced an electronic ordering system so that customers can order products through its website.
formal.zh: 公司引入了电子订购系统，让客户可以通过其网站订购产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Biex nixtri, irrid inċempel? Mark: Le, tista' tuża s-sistema ta' ordni elettronika fuq is-sit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I need to call to make a purchase? Mark: No, you can use the electronic ordering system on the website.
colloquial.zh: Lara：买东西需要打电话吗？Mark：不用，你可以使用网站上的电子订购系统。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nixtri, irrid inċempel?
messages.mt_standard: Biex nixtri, irrid inċempel?
messages.zh: 买东西需要打电话吗？
messages.en: Do I need to call to make a purchase?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tista' tuża s-sistema ta' ordni elettronika fuq is-sit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tista' tuża s-sistema ta' ordni elettronika fuq is-sit.
messages.zh: 不用，你可以使用网站上的电子订购系统。
messages.en: No, you can use the electronic ordering system on the website.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ordni elettronika 连成“打开电子页面、选商品、提交订购”的画面；整个词组表示电子订购，记忆时连同 sistema ta' 一起练习。

gloss_zh: 银行定期付款指令；常设转账指令

teaching_sense.en_definition: A standing order is an instruction to a bank to pay a fixed amount to a specified recipient at regular intervals.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 账户持有人向银行发出的持续有效指令，要求银行定期向指定收款人支付固定金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni permanenti hija struzzjoni lill-bank biex iħallas ammont fiss lil riċevitur speċifikat f'intervalli regolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 客户授权银行按固定周期向指定收款人支付固定金额的指令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni permanenti hija struzzjoni li klijent jagħti lill-bank tiegħu biex jagħmel ħlas ta' ammont fiss lil riċevitur speċifikat f'intervalli regolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A banker's order is an instruction authorizing a bank to make regular payments of a fixed amount to a specified recipient.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要求银行持续按约定周期执行固定金额付款的常设指令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni permanenti hija struzzjoni li tibqa' fis-seħħ biex bank jittrasferixxi ammont fiss regolarment lil riċevitur speċifikat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standing order tells your bank to transfer a fixed sum to a specified recipient at regular intervals.

collocations.en: to set up a standing order

collocations.zh: 通过银行定期付款指令付款

formal.mt: Il-kerrej waqqaf ordni permanenti biex il-bank jittrasferixxi l-kera lis-sid fl-ewwel jum ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: The tenant set up a standing order for the bank to transfer the rent to the landlord on the first day of each month.
formal.zh: 租客设立了银行定期付款指令，让银行在每月第一天向房东转付租金。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif tiftakar tħallas il-kera kull xahar? David: Waqqaft ordni permanenti mal-bank, u l-ħlas isir awtomatikament.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do you remember to pay the rent every month? David: I set up a standing order with the bank, and the payment happens automatically.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你怎么记得每个月交房租？David：我在银行设了定期付款指令，款项会自动支付。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tiftakar tħallas il-kera kull xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tiftakar tħallas il-kera kull xahar?
messages.zh: 你怎么记得每个月交房租？
messages.en: How do you remember to pay the rent every month?

messages.speaker: David (租客)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqqaft ordni permanenti mal-bank, u l-ħlas isir awtomatikament.
messages.mt_standard: Waqqaft ordni permanenti mal-bank, u l-ħlas isir awtomatikament.
messages.zh: 我在银行设了定期付款指令，款项会自动支付。
messages.en: I set up a standing order with the bank, and the payment happens automatically.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每月日历上的同一天，银行按同一条 ordni permanenti 自动付出同样金额；用“设一次、定期付”的场景记住整个词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A postal order is a payment document bought from a post office and sent to someone who can exchange it for money.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在邮局购买、可寄给收款人并由其兑取款项的付款凭证，即邮政汇票。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni postali hija dokument ta' ħlas li jinxtara minn uffiċċju tal-posta u jista' jintbagħat lil persuna oħra biex tissarrfu fi flus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由邮局出售、用于向他人付款且可兑换为款项的邮政汇票。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni postali hija dokument maħruġ mill-posta għal ammont ta' flus, li x-xerrej jista' jibgħat lil riċevitur biex dan jissarrfu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A postal order is a document you buy at a post office and send to someone as a means of payment.

formal.mt: Fl-eżempju tal-ittra, il-klijent jikteb li qed jibgħat ordni postali biex iħallas għall-ktieb.
formal.en: In the sample letter, the customer writes that they are sending a postal order to pay for the book.
formal.zh: 在信件范例中，顾客写明自己正寄出一张邮政汇票，用于支付书款。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandek f'dak l-envelopp? Toni: Ordni postali. Se nibgħatha biex inħallas għall-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: What have you got in that envelope? Toni: A postal order. I'm going to send it to pay for the book.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你那个信封里装着什么？Toni：一张邮政汇票。我准备把它寄出去付书款。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandek f'dak l-envelopp?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandek f'dak l-envelopp?
messages.zh: 你那个信封里装着什么？
messages.en: What have you got in that envelope?

messages.speaker: Toni (购书人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ordni postali. Se nibgħatha biex inħallas għall-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ordni postali. Se nibgħatha biex inħallas għall-ktieb.
messages.zh: 一张邮政汇票。我准备把它寄出去付书款。
messages.en: A postal order. I'm going to send it to pay for the book.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ordni postali 记成信封里装着的一张付款凭证：邮局购买、寄给收款人、凭票兑钱；这三个动作串起“邮政汇票”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An order that has been checked and matched with the corresponding records.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经核对并与相应记录匹配一致的订单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni li tkun ġiet iċċekkjata u mqabbla mar-rekords korrispondenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已与相应记录核对匹配的订单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ordni li tkun ġiet iċċekkjata u li d-dettalji tagħha jaqblu mar-rekords korrispondenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A matched order is an order whose details have been checked against the corresponding records and found to agree.

collocations.en: an order matched with the invoice
collocations.zh: 已与发票核对匹配的订单

collocations.en: the details of the matched order
collocations.zh: 已核对匹配订单的详细信息

formal.mt: L-ordni rikonċiljata ġiet immarkata fis-sistema wara li d-dettalji tagħha tqabblu ma' dawk tal-fattura.
formal.en: The matched order was marked in the system after its details were checked against those on the invoice.
formal.zh: 该订单的详细信息与发票核对一致后，系统将其标记为已匹配。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din l-ordni għadha trid tiġi ċċekkjata? Pawlu: Le, din hi ordni rikonċiljata. Id-dettalji tagħha jaqblu mal-fattura.
colloquial.en: Marija: Does this order still need checking? Pawlu: No, this is a matched order. Its details agree with the invoice.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这张订单还需要核对吗？Pawlu：不用了，这是已核对匹配的订单。它的详细信息与发票一致。

messages.speaker: Marija (行政助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-ordni għadha trid tiġi ċċekkjata?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-ordni għadha trid tiġi ċċekkjata?
messages.zh: 这张订单还需要核对吗？
messages.en: Does this order still need checking?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din hi ordni rikonċiljata. Id-dettalji tagħha jaqblu mal-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din hi ordni rikonċiljata. Id-dettalji tagħha jaqblu mal-fattura.
messages.zh: 不用了，这是已核对匹配的订单。它的详细信息与发票一致。
messages.en: No, this is a matched order. Its details agree with the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把订单和对应记录并排核对，信息一致后打勾；把整个短语记作“核对匹配完成的订单”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A child whose parents have died.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 父母已经去世的孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla li l-ġenituri tagħhom ikunu mietu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 失去父母的孩子；孤儿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel jew tifla li jkunu tilfu lill-ġenituri tagħhom minħabba l-mewt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An orphan is a child whose parents have died and who therefore needs care from other people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-familja laqgħet lil orfni u offrietlu dar stabbli.
formal.en: The report describes how the family welcomed an orphan and offered him a stable home.
formal.zh: 报告描述了这个家庭如何接纳一名孤儿，并为他提供稳定的住所。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu t-tifel fil-ktieb? Luqa: Hu orfni li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu. Sara: Mela n-nanna tieħu ħsiebu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is the boy in the book? Luqa: He is an orphan who lives with his grandmother. Sara: So his grandmother looks after him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：书里的男孩是谁？Luqa：他是个孤儿，和奶奶一起生活。Sara：那就是奶奶在照顾他。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu t-tifel fil-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu t-tifel fil-ktieb?
messages.zh: 书里的男孩是谁？
messages.en: Who is the boy in the book?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu orfni li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Hu orfni li jgħix man-nanna tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他是个孤儿，和奶奶一起生活。
messages.en: He is an orphan who lives with his grandmother.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela n-nanna tieħu ħsiebu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela n-nanna tieħu ħsiebu.
messages.zh: 那就是奶奶在照顾他。
messages.en: So his grandmother looks after him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orfni 放进“失去父母、由亲人照顾的孩子”这一画面中记忆，联结中文“孤儿”，避免只背抽象释义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to living things or their products; also describing food produced by organic farming methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与生物或其产物有关的；也形容采用有机农业方式生产的食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħlejjaq ħajjin jew mal-prodotti tagħhom; jintuża wkoll għal ikel prodott b'metodi ta' biedja organika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与生物或生物来源物质有关的；用于食品时，指采用有机农业方式生产的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa marbut mal-ħlejjaq ħajjin jew ma' materjal li ġej minnhom; meta jiddeskrivi ikel, ifisser li jkun prodott b'metodi ta' biedja organika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something organic is connected with living things or comes from them; organic food is produced using organic farming methods.

formal.mt: Il-weraq li jaqa' mis-siġar iżid materjal organiku mal-ħamrija hekk kif jiddekomponi.
formal.en: Leaves that fall from trees add organic material to the soil as they decompose.
formal.zh: 树木落叶在分解过程中为土壤增加有机物质。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan l-ikel organiku? Mark: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta. Nina: Tajjeb, ħa nara l-prezz ukoll.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this food organic? Mark: Yes, that is what the label says. Nina: All right, let me check the price too.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这是有机食品吗？Mark：是的，标签上是这样写的。Nina：好，我也看看价格。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-ikel organiku?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-ikel organiku?
messages.zh: 这是有机食品吗？
messages.en: Is this food organic?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上是这样写的。
messages.en: Yes, that is what the label says.

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, ħa nara l-prezz ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, ħa nara l-prezz ukoll.
messages.zh: 好，我也看看价格。
messages.en: All right, let me check the price too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 organiku：落叶变成土壤中的有机物，食品标签写着有机生产；根据所修饰的名词判断具体含义。

gloss_zh: 有组织的；有条理的；井然有序的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Planned and arranged effectively, or kept in a clear and orderly way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过有效规划和安排的，或保持清楚、有条理状态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ippjanat u mqassam b'mod effettiv, jew miżmum b'ordni ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过规划、协调和安排的；形容人时指善于安排事务的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ippjanat u kkoordinat tajjeb; meta jiddeskrivi persuna, ifisser li taf tqassam il-ħin u x-xogħol tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An organised activity has been carefully planned, while an organised person arranges tasks and time effectively.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排列整齐、安排有条理或保持良好秩序的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun irranġat b'ordni ċar u regolari, sabiex l-affarijiet ikunu f'posthom u faċli biex jinstabu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something orderly is arranged or maintained in a clear, regular way that makes it easy to use or understand.

formal.mt: L-avveniment kien organizzat tajjeb: kull kelliem kellu ħin allokat u l-programm beda fil-ħin.
formal.en: The event was well organised: each speaker had an allocated time slot, and the programme started on time.
formal.zh: 这场活动组织周密：每位发言者都有分配好的时段，活动也准时开始。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif issib kollox daqshekk malajr? David: Inżomm l-uffiċċju organizzat. Kull ħaġa għandha postha. Anna: Mela għalhekk ma taħlix ħin tfittex!
colloquial.en: Anna: How do you find everything so quickly? David: I keep the office orderly. Everything has its place. Anna: So that is why you do not waste time searching!
colloquial.zh: Anna：你怎么什么都能这么快找到？David：我把办公室收拾得井然有序。每样东西都有固定位置。Anna：难怪你不用浪费时间找东西！

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif issib kollox daqshekk malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Kif issib kollox daqshekk malajr?
messages.zh: 你怎么什么都能这么快找到？
messages.en: How do you find everything so quickly?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Inżomm l-uffiċċju organizzat. Kull ħaġa għandha postha.
messages.mt_standard: Inżomm l-uffiċċju organizzat. Kull ħaġa għandha postha.
messages.zh: 我把办公室收拾得井然有序。每样东西都有固定位置。
messages.en: I keep the office orderly. Everything has its place.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għalhekk ma taħlix ħin tfittex!
messages.mt_standard: Mela għalhekk ma taħlix ħin tfittex!
messages.zh: 难怪你不用浪费时间找东西！
messages.en: So that is why you do not waste time searching!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 organizzat 联结到“安排得好”：活动有日程是组织周密，办公室物品各归其位是井然有序；用两个场景区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 消费者协会；消费者组织

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organisation that represents consumers and works to protect their rights and interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表消费者并致力于维护其权利和利益的组织。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda li tirrappreżenta lill-konsumaturi u taħdem biex tħares id-drittijiet u l-interessi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由消费者组成或代表消费者、维护其共同利益的协会。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' konsumaturi jew ta' rappreżentanti tagħhom li taħdem biex tħares l-interessi komuni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer association is a group that represents consumers and works to protect their shared interests.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为消费者提供支持并维护消费者权利和利益的组织。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Organizzazzjoni li tagħti appoġġ lill-konsumaturi u taħdem biex tiddefendi d-drittijiet u l-interessi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer organisation supports people who buy goods or services and works to defend their interests.

collocations.en: ask a consumer organisation for advice
collocations.zh: 向消费者组织寻求建议

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur ippubblikat gwida biex tgħin lix-xerrejja jifhmu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ.
formal.en: The consumer organisation published a guide to help buyers understand the conditions of sale.
formal.zh: 消费者组织发布了一份指南，帮助买家了解销售条款。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għandi problema b'xi ħaġa li xtrajt. Lil min nista' nitlob parir? Pawlu: Tista' titlob parir mingħand organizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur.
colloquial.en: Marta: I have a problem with something I bought. Who can I ask for advice? Pawlu: You can ask a consumer organisation for advice.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我买的东西出了问题，可以向谁咨询？Pawlu：你可以向消费者组织咨询。

messages.speaker: Marta (消费者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi problema b'xi ħaġa li xtrajt. Lil min nista' nitlob parir?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi problema b'xi ħaġa li xtrajt. Lil min nista' nitlob parir?
messages.zh: 我买的东西出了问题，可以向谁咨询？
messages.en: I have a problem with something I bought. Who can I ask for advice?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' titlob parir mingħand organizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' titlob parir mingħand organizzazzjoni tal-konsumatur.
messages.zh: 你可以向消费者组织咨询。
messages.en: You can ask a consumer organisation for advice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“购物遇到问题，找消费者组织咨询”的场景绑定，连同 titlob parir 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The peak of sexual excitement, involving an intense feeling of physical pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性兴奋达到顶峰时出现的强烈身体快感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qofol tal-eċċitament sesswali, li fih persuna tħoss pjaċir fiżiku intens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 性兴奋达到顶峰时产生强烈快感的高潮状态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat fil-qofol tal-eċċitament sesswali li jkun akkumpanjat minn sensazzjoni intensa ta' pjaċir fiżiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An orgasm is the point of greatest sexual excitement, when a person experiences intense physical pleasure.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu dwar l-edukazzjoni sesswali jispjega t-tifsira tal-kelma orgażmu b'lingwaġġ ċar u newtrali.
formal.en: The chapter on sex education explains the meaning of the word orgasm in clear, neutral language.
formal.zh: 性教育章节用清晰、中性的语言解释了“性高潮”一词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma orgażmu f'dan it-test? David: Tfisser il-qofol tal-eċċitament sesswali, meta persuna tħoss pjaċir fiżiku intens.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word orgasm mean in this text? David: It means the peak of sexual excitement, when a person feels intense physical pleasure.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这篇文章里的 orgażmu 是什么意思？David：指性兴奋达到顶峰、产生强烈身体快感的状态。

messages.speaker: Lara (成年学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma orgażmu f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma orgażmu f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 orgażmu 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word orgasm mean in this text?

messages.speaker: David (语言教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-qofol tal-eċċitament sesswali, meta persuna tħoss pjaċir fiżiku intens.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-qofol tal-eċċitament sesswali, meta persuna tħoss pjaċir fiżiku intens.
messages.zh: 指性兴奋达到顶峰、产生强烈身体快感的状态。
messages.en: It means the peak of sexual excitement, when a person feels intense physical pleasure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orgażmu 放进性教育词汇卡，与“性兴奋的顶峰”配对记忆，注意它表示性高潮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A keyboard musical instrument that produces sound through pipes or by electronic means.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过音管或电子方式发声的键盘乐器，即管风琴或电子风琴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strument mużikali bit-tastiera li jipproduċi l-ħoss permezz ta' pajpijiet jew b'mezzi elettroniċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风琴这一键盘乐器，包括以音管发声的管风琴和电子风琴。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strument mużikali li jindaqq permezz ta' tastiera u li l-ħoss tiegħu jinħoloq permezz ta' pajpijiet jew b'mod elettroniku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An organ is a keyboard instrument that produces musical sounds through pipes or an electronic system.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi tliet biċċiet għall-orgni.
formal.en: The concert programme includes three pieces for the organ.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目包括三首风琴作品。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jdoqq l-orgni fil-kunċert? Mark: Se ddoqq oħti. Trid tiġi tismagħha?
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is going to play the organ at the concert? Mark: My sister is. Would you like to come and hear her?
colloquial.zh: Anna：音乐会上谁来弹风琴？Mark：我姐姐来弹。你想来听她演奏吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jdoqq l-orgni fil-kunċert?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jdoqq l-orgni fil-kunċert?
messages.zh: 音乐会上谁来弹风琴？
messages.en: Who is going to play the organ at the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (演奏者的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Se ddoqq oħti. Trid tiġi tismagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Se ddoqq oħti. Trid tiġi tismagħha?
messages.zh: 我姐姐来弹。你想来听她演奏吗？
messages.en: My sister is. Would you like to come and hear her?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象演奏者坐在风琴键盘前，把 orgni 与 idoqq l-orgni“弹风琴”一起记，固定在音乐场景中。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The line in the distance where the sky appears to meet the land or sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 远处天空与陆地或海面看起来相接的界线。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja fil-bogħod fejn is-sema jidher li jiltaqa' mal-art jew mal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地平线；天空与陆地或海面看起来相接的远处界线。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-orizzont huwa l-linja fil-bogħod fejn is-sema jidher li jiltaqa' mal-art jew mal-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The horizon is the distant line where the sky appears to meet the land or sea.

collocations.zh: 在地平线上；在海平线上

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt, il-linja tal-orizzont tifred il-baħar mis-sema.
formal.en: In the photograph, the horizon line separates the sea from the sky.
formal.zh: 照片中，海平线将海面与天空分开。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tara dak il-vapur fuq l-orizzont? Mark: Iva, imma jidher żgħir ħafna minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you see that ship on the horizon? Mark: Yes, but it looks very small from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见海平线上那艘船了吗？马克：看见了，不过从这里看显得特别小。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara dak il-vapur fuq l-orizzont?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara dak il-vapur fuq l-orizzont?
messages.zh: 你看见海平线上那艘船了吗？
messages.en: Can you see that ship on the horizon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jidher żgħir ħafna minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jidher żgħir ħafna minn hawn.
messages.zh: 看见了，不过从这里看显得特别小。
messages.en: Yes, but it looks very small from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象站在海边，目光追到海天相接的一条线，把这个画面与 orizzont 一起记住。

gloss_zh: 原来的；原版的；有独创性的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Existing in its first form rather than as a copy, or showing new and independent ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于最初形式而非复制而来的；也指体现新颖、独立构思的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun fl-ewwel forma tiegħu u mhux kopja, jew li juri ideat ġodda u ħsieb indipendenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最初的、原版而非复制的；或具有独创性、体现新构思的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun dak li nħoloq jew kien jeżisti l-ewwel, mhux kopja; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li turi ideat ġodda u mhux imitazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something original is in its first form rather than a copy, or expresses fresh ideas developed independently.

formal.mt: Mal-applikazzjoni għandha tintbagħat kopja ċara tad-dokument oriġinali.
formal.en: A clear copy of the original document should be sent with the application.
formal.zh: 应随申请提交一份文件原件的清晰副本。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din l-idea ħriġt biha int? Luqa: Iva, hija idea oriġinali tiegħi. Sara: Tajjeb! Ejja nippruvawha.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you come up with this idea yourself? Luqa: Yes, it is an original idea of mine. Sara: Great! Let's try it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个想法是你自己想出来的吗？Luqa：是的，这是我自己的原创想法。Sara：好啊！我们试试吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din l-idea ħriġt biha int?
messages.mt_standard: Din l-idea ħriġt biha int?
messages.zh: 这个想法是你自己想出来的吗？
messages.en: Did you come up with this idea yourself?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija idea oriġinali tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija idea oriġinali tiegħi.
messages.zh: 是的，这是我自己的原创想法。
messages.en: Yes, it is an original idea of mine.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Ejja nippruvawha.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Ejja nippruvawha.
messages.zh: 好啊！我们试试吧。
messages.en: Great! Let's try it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片记 oriġinali：文件卡写“原件”，灯泡卡写“原创想法”，分别对应原版与独创两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: At the beginning, before later changes occurred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事在最初阶段或后来发生变化之前的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-bidu, qabel ma seħħew bidliet aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最初；原先，用于说明后来发生变化之前的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fil-bidu ta' xi ħaġa, qabel ma nbidlet jew żviluppat aktar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use originally to describe how something was at first, before it changed.

formal.mt: Il-bini, li oriġinarjament kien skola, illum jintuża bħala librerija pubblika.
formal.en: The building, which was originally a school, is now used as a public library.
formal.zh: 这栋建筑最初是一所学校，如今用作公共图书馆。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont se tiġi għada? Mark: Iva, oriġinarjament kont se niġi għada, imma issa nista' niġi llum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you going to come tomorrow? Mark: Yes, originally I was going to come tomorrow, but now I can come today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你本来打算明天来吗？Mark：对，我原先打算明天来，不过现在今天就能来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont se tiġi għada?
messages.mt_standard: Kont se tiġi għada?
messages.zh: 你本来打算明天来吗？
messages.en: Were you going to come tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, oriġinarjament kont se niġi għada, imma issa nista' niġi llum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, oriġinarjament kont se niġi għada, imma issa nista' niġi llum.
messages.zh: 对，我原先打算明天来，不过现在今天就能来。
messages.en: Yes, originally I was going to come tomorrow, but now I can come today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把事情想成一条时间线：oriġinarjament 指向最初的位置，再用“现在怎样”作对照，记住它是副词“最初、原先”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The beginning, source, or background from which something or someone comes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物开始或产生的源头，也可指人的出身背景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bidu jew is-sors ta' xi ħaġa, jew l-isfond li minnu ġejja persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 起源或来源，指事物产生的源头，也可指人的出身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-post, il-bidu jew l-isfond li minnu ġejja xi ħaġa jew persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The origin of something is the place, source, or situation from which it comes.

collocations.zh: 具有马耳他来源或血统的

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza l-oriġini ta' din it-tradizzjoni u l-iżvilupp tagħha matul iż-żmien.
formal.en: The study analyses the origin of this tradition and its development over time.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了这一传统的起源及其随时间的发展。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma? Mark: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know the origin of this word? Mark: No, but we can look it up in the dictionary.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道这个词的起源吗？Mark：不知道，不过我们可以查词典。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma?
messages.mt_standard: Taf l-oriġini ta' din il-kelma?
messages.zh: 你知道这个词的起源吗？
messages.en: Do you know the origin of this word?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma nistgħu nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju.
messages.zh: 不知道，不过我们可以查词典。
messages.en: No, but we can look it up in the dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 oriġini，就问“从哪里来”：词语有起源，物品有来源，人有出身；把这三个场景连起来记忆。

gloss_zh: 非优惠原产地；货物的非优惠原产地

teaching_sense.en_definition: The origin assigned to goods under rules used for trade measures other than preferential tariff treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据非优惠原产地规则确定的货物原产地，用于优惠关税待遇以外的贸易措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oriġini attribwita lill-merkanzija skont regoli użati għal miżuri kummerċjali oħra għajr it-trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非优惠原产地，指为实施非优惠贸易措施而按相应规则确定的原产地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-oriġini stabbilita skont ir-regoli applikabbli għal miżuri kummerċjali li ma jagħtux trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-preferential origin is the origin established under rules used for trade measures other than preferential tariff treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物的非优惠原产地，即根据非优惠原产地规则认定的货物所属原产国家或地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż jew it-territorju meqjus bħala l-oriġini tal-merkanzija skont ir-regoli tal-oriġini nonpreferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The non-preferential origin of goods is the country or territory assigned to them under non-preferential origin rules.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif ġiet determinata l-oriġini nonpreferenzjali tal-prodott abbażi tal-informazzjoni dwar il-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The report explains how the product's non-preferential origin was determined using information about its production.
formal.zh: 报告说明了如何根据生产信息认定该产品的非优惠原产地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser oriġini nonpreferenzjali? Mark: Hija l-oriġini stabbilita skont regoli li jintużaw għal miżuri kummerċjali oħra għajr it-trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does non-preferential origin mean? Mark: It is the origin established under rules used for trade measures other than preferential tariff treatment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：非优惠原产地是什么意思？Mark：就是按照用于优惠关税待遇以外的贸易措施的规则确定的原产地。

messages.speaker: Maja (新入职员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser oriġini nonpreferenzjali?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser oriġini nonpreferenzjali?
messages.zh: 非优惠原产地是什么意思？
messages.en: What does non-preferential origin mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (贸易业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija l-oriġini stabbilita skont regoli li jintużaw għal miżuri kummerċjali oħra għajr it-trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.
messages.mt_standard: Hija l-oriġini stabbilita skont regoli li jintużaw għal miżuri kummerċjali oħra għajr it-trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.
messages.zh: 就是按照用于优惠关税待遇以外的贸易措施的规则确定的原产地。
messages.en: It is the origin established under rules used for trade measures other than preferential tariff treatment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用贸易表格记忆：oriġini 对应“原产地”，整组 oriġini nonpreferenzjali 对应“非优惠原产地”；这里的“优惠”指贸易待遇，不是商品打折。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country or territory assigned as the origin of goods under non-preferential origin rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据非优惠原产地规则确定的货物原产国家或地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż jew it-territorju attribwit bħala l-oriġini tal-merkanzija skont ir-regoli tal-oriġini nonpreferenzjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非优惠原产地；在本词组中，明确指货物按照非优惠原产地规则确定的原产地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-oriġini tal-merkanzija stabbilita skont ir-regoli użati għal miżuri kummerċjali oħra għajr it-trattament tariffarju preferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Non-preferential origin identifies where goods originate under rules used for purposes other than preferential tariff treatment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物的非优惠原产地，即根据非优惠原产地规则认定的货物原产国家或地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż jew it-territorju li jitqies bħala l-oriġini tal-merkanzija għall-finijiet tar-regoli tal-oriġini nonpreferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The non-preferential origin of goods is their country or territory of origin as determined by non-preferential origin rules.

collocations.en: verification of the non-preferential origin of goods
collocations.zh: 货物非优惠原产地的核实

collocations.en: documents concerning the non-preferential origin of goods
collocations.zh: 有关货物非优惠原产地的文件

formal.mt: Id-dokumentazzjoni tipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-produzzjoni sabiex tkun tista' tiġi vverifikata l-oriġini nonpreferenzjali tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The documentation provides information about production so that the non-preferential origin of the goods can be verified.
formal.zh: 这些文件提供生产方面的信息，以便核实货物的非优惠原产地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn insib l-oriġini nonpreferenzjali tal-merkanzija f'dan ir-rapport? Mark: Fit-taqsima dwar l-oriġini, ħdejn id-dettalji tal-produzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I find the non-preferential origin of the goods in this report? Mark: In the section on origin, next to the production details.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这份报告里哪里能找到货物的非优惠原产地？Mark：在原产地那一节，就在生产详情旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (贸易业务助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib l-oriġini nonpreferenzjali tal-merkanzija f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib l-oriġini nonpreferenzjali tal-merkanzija f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里哪里能找到货物的非优惠原产地？
messages.en: Where can I find the non-preferential origin of the goods in this report?

messages.speaker: Mark (贸易业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fit-taqsima dwar l-oriġini, ħdejn id-dettalji tal-produzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Fit-taqsima dwar l-oriġini, ħdejn id-dettalji tal-produzzjoni.
messages.zh: 在原产地那一节，就在生产详情旁边。
messages.en: In the section on origin, next to the production details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三段理解整组词：oriġini 是“原产地”，nonpreferenzjali 是“非优惠的”，tal-merkanzija 是“货物的”；按中文顺序重组为“货物的非优惠原产地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The origin status that allows goods to qualify for preferential customs treatment under the applicable origin rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物依据适用的原产地规则获得、使其能够享受关税优惠待遇的原产地资格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istatus ta' oriġini li jippermetti li merkanzija tibbenefika minn trattament doganali preferenzjali skont ir-regoli applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使货物依适用规则有资格享受关税优惠待遇的原产地资格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-istatus li jingħata lill-merkanzija meta tissodisfa r-regoli ta' oriġini meħtieġa biex tibbenefika minn trattament doganali preferenzjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goods have preferential origin when they satisfy the origin rules required to qualify for preferential customs treatment.

formal.mt: Qabel jitlob trattament doganali preferenzjali, l-importatur għandu jivverifika l-oriġini preferenzjali tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: Before requesting preferential customs treatment, the importer should verify the preferential origin of the goods.
formal.zh: 进口商在申请关税优惠待遇前，应核实货物的优惠原产地资格。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nitolbu rata ta' dazju aktar baxxa għal din il-merkanzija? Rita: L-ewwel irridu nivverifikaw l-oriġini preferenzjali tagħha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can we request a lower duty rate for these goods? Rita: First we need to verify their preferential origin.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这批货能申请较低的关税税率吗？Rita：我们得先核实它的优惠原产地资格。

messages.speaker: Mark (进口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nitolbu rata ta' dazju aktar baxxa għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nitolbu rata ta' dazju aktar baxxa għal din il-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 这批货能申请较低的关税税率吗？
messages.en: Can we request a lower duty rate for these goods?

messages.speaker: Rita (报关代理)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nivverifikaw l-oriġini preferenzjali tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nivverifikaw l-oriġini preferenzjali tagħha.
messages.zh: 我们得先核实它的优惠原产地资格。
messages.en: First we need to verify their preferential origin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和“凭原产地资格享受关税优惠”的场景一起记：学习重点是优惠资格，而不只是产地名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country or territory identified as the place of origin of goods under the applicable origin rules.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据适用的原产地规则，被认定为货物原产地的国家或地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż jew it-territorju meqjus bħala l-post minn fejn toriġina l-merkanzija skont ir-regoli ta' oriġini applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依据原产地规则认定的货物来源国家或地区。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż jew it-territorju li minnu titqies li toriġina l-merkanzija skont ir-regoli applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The origin of goods is the country or territory from which they are considered to originate under the relevant rules.

collocations.en: declaration concerning the origin of goods
collocations.zh: 关于货物原产地的声明

collocations.en: verification of the origin of goods

formal.mt: Id-dikjarazzjoni għandha tindika b'mod ċar l-oriġini tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The declaration should clearly indicate the origin of the goods.
formal.zh: 声明应清楚注明货物的原产地。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-oriġini tal-merkanzija? Pawlu: Ħares lejn id-dokument li bagħat il-fornitur.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where can I check the origin of the goods? Pawlu: Look at the document the supplier sent.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我可以在哪里查看货物的原产地？Pawlu：看看供应商发来的那份文件。

messages.speaker: Anna (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-oriġini tal-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' niċċekkja l-oriġini tal-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里查看货物的原产地？
messages.en: Where can I check the origin of the goods?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn id-dokument li bagħat il-fornitur.
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn id-dokument li bagħat il-fornitur.
messages.zh: 看看供应商发来的那份文件。
messages.en: Look at the document the supplier sent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象查看一箱货物的产地文件，把整个短语对应为“这批货的原产地”；用货箱场景固定记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The source, place, or circumstances from which something begins or someone comes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物开始或产生的来源、地点或背景，也可指人的出身。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sors, il-post jew iċ-ċirkustanzi li minnhom tibda jew ġejja xi ħaġa, jew il-post jew l-isfond li minnu ġejja persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事物的起源或来源，亦指人的出身。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-bidu jew is-sors ta' xi ħaġa, jew il-post u l-isfond li minnhom ġejja persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The origin of something is the source or beginning from which it developed, while a person's origin concerns where they come from.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju jeżamina l-oriġni ta' din it-tradizzjoni u kif inbidlet maż-żmien.
formal.en: This study examines the origin of this tradition and how it has changed over time.
formal.zh: 本研究考察这一传统的起源及其随时间发生的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf x'inhi l-oriġni ta' din l-istorja? Lara: Le, imma nistgħu nistaqsu lin-nanna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know the origin of this story? Lara: No, but we can ask Grandma.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道这个故事的起源吗？Lara：不知道，不过我们可以问问奶奶。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf x'inhi l-oriġni ta' din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Taf x'inhi l-oriġni ta' din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 你知道这个故事的起源吗？
messages.en: Do you know the origin of this story?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, imma nistgħu nistaqsu lin-nanna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, imma nistgħu nistaqsu lin-nanna.
messages.zh: 不知道，不过我们可以问问奶奶。
messages.en: No, but we can ask Grandma.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“从哪里开始、从哪里来”串联记忆：故事有起源，问题有来源，人也有出身，核心都是追溯来处。

gloss_zh: 水平线；水平方向（名词用法）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A horizontal line or direction, used as a reference for position or angle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为位置或角度参照的水平线或水平方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja jew direzzjoni parallela mal-orizzont, li tintuża bħala referenza għal pożizzjoni jew angolu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水平线或水平方向，尤指用作测量或绘图参照者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Linja jew direzzjoni parallela mal-orizzont li tista' sservi ta' referenza fil-kejl jew fit-tpinġija.
