sense_translations.en_explanation: The horizontal is a level line or direction used as a reference when describing positions or measuring angles.

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma, il-linja tifforma angolu ta' tletin grad mal-oriżżontali.
formal.en: In the diagram, the line forms an angle of thirty degrees with the horizontal.
formal.zh: 图中，这条线与水平线成三十度角。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn nibda nkejjel l-angolu? Mark: Ibda mill-oriżżontali, imbagħad kejjel sal-linja mmejla.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where do I start measuring the angle? Mark: Start from the horizontal, then measure up to the sloping line.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我从哪里开始量这个角？Mark：从水平线开始，然后量到那条斜线。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nibda nkejjel l-angolu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nibda nkejjel l-angolu?
messages.zh: 我从哪里开始量这个角？
messages.en: Where do I start measuring the angle?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ibda mill-oriżżontali, imbagħad kejjel sal-linja mmejla.
messages.mt_standard: Ibda mill-oriżżontali, imbagħad kejjel sal-linja mmejla.
messages.zh: 从水平线开始，然后量到那条斜线。
messages.en: Start from the horizontal, then measure up to the sloping line.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量角器底边那条平平的参照线；本条按名词记作“水平线或水平方向”，再联想与它所成的角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Chemical substances produced in the body that help regulate growth and other bodily functions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由身体产生、帮助调节生长及其他身体功能的化学物质；此词为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanzi kimiċi prodotti fil-ġisem li jgħinu biex jirregolaw it-tkabbir u funzjonijiet oħra tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激素，指身体产生并参与调节生长、代谢等功能的化学物质；这里表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ormoni huma sustanzi kimiċi prodotti fil-ġisem li jġorru sinjali u jgħinu biex jirregolaw diversi funzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hormones are chemical substances produced in the body that carry signals and help regulate its functions.

formal.mt: Il-kapitlu jispjega kif l-ormoni jgħinu biex jirregolaw it-tkabbir tal-ġisem.
formal.en: The chapter explains how hormones help regulate the body's growth.
formal.zh: 这一章解释了激素如何帮助调节身体的生长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'qed tistudja llum? Pawlu: L-ormoni u kif jgħinu lill-ġisem jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are you studying today? Pawlu: Hormones and how they help the body function.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天在学什么？保罗：激素，以及它们如何帮助身体运作。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed tistudja llum?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed tistudja llum?
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ormoni u kif jgħinu lill-ġisem jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: L-ormoni u kif jgħinu lill-ġisem jaħdem.
messages.zh: 激素，以及它们如何帮助身体运作。
messages.en: Hormones and how they help the body function.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ormoni 想成身体里传递信号的一群小信使，并连同“激素的复数”一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Very unpleasant, frightening, or extremely bad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容令人非常不适、害怕，或情况极其糟糕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li hija spjaċevoli ħafna, li tqanqal il-biża', jew li hija ħażina ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可怕的；令人厌恶或极不舒服的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa orribbli tqanqal il-biża' jew sens qawwi ta' stmerrija jew skumdità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something horrible makes you feel frightened, disgusted, or very uncomfortable.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糟透的；非常差或非常令人不快的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa orribbli tkun ħażina ħafna jew spjaċevoli ħafna u tqanqal nuqqas qawwi ta' sodisfazzjon.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You describe something as awful when it is extremely bad or unpleasant.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru prinċipali jqum minn ħolma orribbli u jsib ruħu waħdu fid-dlam.
formal.en: In the story, the main character wakes from a horrible dream and finds himself alone in the dark.
formal.zh: 故事中，主人公从一个可怕的梦中醒来，发现自己独处在黑暗里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-temp illum orribbli! Ben: Veru, ejja nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
colloquial.en: Lara: The weather is awful today! Ben: It really is; let's stay home and watch a film.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今天的天气糟透了！本：真是这样，我们待在家里看电影吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-temp illum orribbli!
messages.mt_standard: It-temp illum orribbli!
messages.zh: 今天的天气糟透了！
messages.en: The weather is awful today!

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, ejja nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, ejja nibqgħu d-dar u naraw film.
messages.zh: 真是这样，我们待在家里看电影吧。
messages.en: It really is; let's stay home and watch a film.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 orribbli：噩梦让人觉得“可怕”，坏天气让人抱怨“糟透了”，共同点都是强烈负面感受。

gloss_zh: 可怕的；令人极不舒服的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Causing fear, disgust, or a very strong feeling of unpleasantness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容引起恐惧、厌恶或强烈不适的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tqanqal il-biża', l-istmerrija jew sens qawwi ta' skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可怕的；令人厌恶或极不舒服的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa orribli tkun tant spjaċevoli li tqanqal il-biża', l-istmerrija jew skumdità kbira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something horrible causes a strong feeling of fear, disgust, or discomfort.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ħoss orribli jkisser is-skiet u jbeżża' lit-tfal.
formal.en: In the story, a horrible noise breaks the silence and frightens the children.
formal.zh: 故事中，一阵可怕的声响打破寂静，吓到了孩子们。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-meraq għandu togħma orribli! Adam: Iva, ma jogħġobnix lanqas. Trid ftit ilma?
colloquial.en: Nina: This juice tastes horrible! Adam: Yes, I don't like it either. Would you like some water?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这果汁的味道太难受了！亚当：是啊，我也不喜欢。你想喝点水吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-meraq għandu togħma orribli!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-meraq għandu togħma orribli!
messages.zh: 这果汁的味道太难受了！
messages.en: This juice tastes horrible!

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma jogħġobnix lanqas. Trid ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma jogħġobnix lanqas. Trid ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 是啊，我也不喜欢。你想喝点水吗？
messages.en: Yes, I don't like it either. Would you like some water?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orribli 放进“听到可怕声响”和“喝到难受味道”两个场景，记住它表达的是强烈的不舒服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An intense feeling of fear, shock, or disgust caused by something frightening or terrible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由可怕或骇人的事物引起的强烈恐惧、震惊或厌恶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens qawwi ta' biża', xokk jew stmerrija quddiem xi ħaġa tal-biża' jew terribbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对可怕或骇人事物时产生的强烈恐惧、震惊或厌恶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-orrur huwa sens qawwi ta' biża', xokk jew stmerrija li tqanqal xi ħaġa terribbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Horror is a very strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust that something terrible causes.

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi s-sens ta' orrur li ħassew in-nies meta raw il-ħsara.
formal.en: The author describes the feeling of horror people experienced when they saw the damage.
formal.zh: 作者描写了人们看到损毁情况时产生的惊骇感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tara film tal-orrur illejla? Mark: Le, nippreferi kummiedja. Il-films tal-orrur ibeżżgħuni wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to watch a horror film tonight? Mark: No, I prefer a comedy. Horror films scare me too much.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚想看恐怖片吗？Mark：不了，我更想看喜剧。恐怖片太吓人了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tara film tal-orrur illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tara film tal-orrur illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想看恐怖片吗？
messages.en: Do you want to watch a horror film tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nippreferi kummiedja. Il-films tal-orrur ibeżżgħuni wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nippreferi kummiedja. Il-films tal-orrur ibeżżgħuni wisq.
messages.zh: 不了，我更想看喜剧。恐怖片太吓人了。
messages.en: No, I prefer a comedy. Horror films scare me too much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 orrur 和电影类别 film tal-orrur 一起记：想象恐怖片中令人惊骇的一幕，记住它表达强烈恐惧或震惊。

gloss_zh: 正畸牙医；牙齿矫正专科医生

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dentist who specializes in correcting the position of teeth and the alignment of the jaws.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门矫正牙齿位置及上下颌咬合关系的牙科医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dentist li jispeċjalizza fil-korrezzjoni tal-pożizzjoni tas-snien u tal-allinjament tax-xedaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 专门诊治牙齿排列不齐及咬合问题的正畸牙科医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Orthodontist huwa dentist speċjalizzat li jikkoreġi l-pożizzjoni tas-snien u problemi fil-mod kif jingħalqu x-xedaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An orthodontist is a dentist who treats problems with the position of teeth and the way the jaws meet.

formal.mt: Wara l-eżami, id-dentist irrakkomanda konsultazzjoni ma' orthodontist biex tiġi evalwata l-pożizzjoni tas-snien.
formal.en: After the examination, the dentist recommended a consultation with an orthodontist to assess the position of the teeth.
formal.zh: 检查后，牙医建议咨询正畸专科医生，以评估牙齿的位置。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex sejjer għand l-orthodontist għada? Pawlu: Biex jiċċekkja jekk għandix bżonn apparat biex jiddrittali snieni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you going to the orthodontist tomorrow? Pawlu: To check whether I need an appliance to straighten my teeth.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你明天为什么要去看正畸牙医？Pawlu：让医生检查一下，我是否需要戴矫治器来矫正牙齿。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjer għand l-orthodontist għada?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjer għand l-orthodontist għada?
messages.zh: 你明天为什么要去看正畸牙医？
messages.en: Why are you going to the orthodontist tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jiċċekkja jekk għandix bżonn apparat biex jiddrittali snieni.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jiċċekkja jekk għandix bżonn apparat biex jiddrittali snieni.
messages.zh: 让医生检查一下，我是否需要戴矫治器来矫正牙齿。
messages.en: To check whether I need an appliance to straighten my teeth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 orthodontist，就想象预约看牙齿矫正医生的场景；用“排齐牙齿的专科医生”记住它的职业含义。

gloss_zh: 正统的；遵循传统教义或公认观念的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Following the traditional or generally accepted beliefs, teachings, or methods of a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 遵循某个群体的传统信仰、正式教义或普遍认可的方法的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsegwi t-twemmin, it-tagħlim jew il-metodi tradizzjonali jew ġeneralment aċċettati ta' grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合传统信仰、正统教义或普遍认可的观念与方法的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa jew xi ħadd ortodoss isegwi t-twemmin, it-tagħlim jew il-prattiki tradizzjonali u aċċettati fil-qasam tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a belief, method, or person is orthodox, they follow the traditional or generally accepted ideas of their group.

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel approċċ ortodoss mat-tagħlim ma' metodu ġdid li jagħti aktar spazju lid-diskussjoni.
formal.en: The study compares an orthodox approach to teaching with a new method that allows more room for discussion.
formal.zh: 这项研究将传统的教学方法与一种给予讨论更多空间的新方法进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'taħseb dwar il-metodu tal-għalliem il-ġdid? David: Huwa pjuttost ortodoss: l-ewwel jispjega r-regola, imbagħad jagħtina l-eżerċizzji.
colloquial.en: Lara: What do you think of the new teacher's method? David: It is fairly orthodox: first he explains the rule, then he gives us exercises.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得新老师的方法怎么样？David：挺传统的：先解释规则，再让我们做练习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'taħseb dwar il-metodu tal-għalliem il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: X'taħseb dwar il-metodu tal-għalliem il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 你觉得新老师的方法怎么样？
messages.en: What do you think of the new teacher's method?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa pjuttost ortodoss: l-ewwel jispjega r-regola, imbagħad jagħtina l-eżerċizzji.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa pjuttost ortodoss: l-ewwel jispjega r-regola, imbagħad jagħtina l-eżerċizzji.
messages.zh: 挺传统的：先解释规则，再让我们做练习。
messages.en: It is fairly orthodox: first he explains the rule, then he gives us exercises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ortodoss 放进“遵循公认规则”的画面里：宗教中可指正统，方法上可指传统；结合 approċċ ortodoss 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The correct way of writing words, or the system of spelling conventions used in a language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词语的正确书写方式，或一种语言规定词语写法的拼写规则体系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod korrett kif jinkitbu l-kliem, jew is-sistema ta' regoli li tiddetermina kif jinkitbu f'lingwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词语的拼写及正确写法，也指一种语言的正字法规则体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ortografia hija l-kitba korretta tal-kliem u s-sistema ta' regoli dwar l-ittri u s-sinjali li jintużaw biex jinkiteb il-kliem ta' lingwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Orthography is the way words are correctly written and the set of spelling conventions used in a language.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiġi ppubblikat it-test, l-editur għandu jiċċekkja li l-ortografia ssegwi r-regoli tal-lingwa.
formal.en: Before the text is published, the editor should check that its spelling follows the rules of the language.
formal.zh: 文本出版之前，编辑应检查其拼写是否符合该语言的规则。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografia ta' dan il-messaġġ? Karl: Iva, hawn żball wieħed biss. Din il-kelma trid appostrofu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can you check the spelling in this message? Karl: Yes, there is only one mistake here. This word needs an apostrophe.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你能检查一下这条消息的拼写吗？Karl：可以，这里只有一个错误。这个词需要加一个撇号。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografia ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografia ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你能检查一下这条消息的拼写吗？
messages.en: Can you check the spelling in this message?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn żball wieħed biss. Din il-kelma trid appostrofu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn żball wieħed biss. Din il-kelma trid appostrofu.
messages.zh: 可以，这里只有一个错误。这个词需要加一个撇号。
messages.en: Yes, there is only one mistake here. This word needs an apostrophe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ortografia 和校对作业联系起来：逐字检查字母与撇号，就是检查拼写；整套正确书写规则则叫正字法。

gloss_zh: 正字法；拼写；文字书写体系

teaching_sense.en_definition: The rules and conventions used to write and spell a language correctly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种语言中规范书写和正确拼写所遵循的规则与惯例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-regoli u l-konvenzjonijiet li jiddeterminaw kif lingwa tinkiteb u kif il-kliem tagħha jinkiteb b'mod korrett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正字法，即一种语言规范书写的规则体系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sett ta' regoli u konvenzjonijiet li jirregolaw il-kitba korretta ta' lingwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The orthography of a language is the set of conventions that governs how its words are written.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拼写，即组成单词时字母的选择和排列方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif jintgħażlu u jitqiegħdu fl-ordni l-ittri biex tinkiteb kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The spelling of a word is the particular sequence of letters used to write it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 文字书写体系，即用书写符号及其使用规则来记录语言的系统。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sistema ta' sinjali miktuba u r-regoli għall-użu tagħhom biex lingwa tiġi rrappreżentata bil-kitba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A writing system is an organized set of written signs and conventions used to represent a language.

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, l-editur għandu jiċċekkja l-ortografija tat-test u jikkoreġi kull żball.
formal.en: Before publication, the editor should check the spelling of the text and correct every error.
formal.zh: 出版前，编辑应检查文本的拼写并改正所有错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografija ta' dan il-messaġġ? Mark: Iva, imma l-ewwel aqrah int u ara jekk issibx xi żball.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you check the spelling in this message? Mark: Yes, but read it yourself first and see whether you can find any errors.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能检查一下这条消息的拼写吗？马克：可以，不过你先自己读一遍，看看能不能找出错误。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografija ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiċċekkja l-ortografija ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你能检查一下这条消息的拼写吗？
messages.en: Can you check the spelling in this message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel aqrah int u ara jekk issibx xi żball.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel aqrah int u ara jekk issibx xi żball.
messages.zh: 可以，不过你先自己读一遍，看看能不能找出错误。
messages.en: Yes, but read it yourself first and see whether you can find any errors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ortografija 联想成写作时旁边的一本拼写规则手册：查一个词是“拼写”，查整套规则是“正字法”，看整套书写符号则是“文字体系”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The friendly and generous welcome and care offered to guests or visitors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对客人或来访者表现出的友善、热情与周到款待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kordjali u ġeneruż kif jintlaqgħu l-mistednin u tingħatalhom l-għajnuna u l-kura li jkollhom bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好客与款待，指友善地欢迎客人并周到照顾他们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ospitalità hija l-merħba kordjali u l-kura ġeneruża li jingħataw lill-mistednin jew lill-viżitaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hospitality is the friendly and generous treatment you give to people who visit your home or another place.

formal.mt: Nixtiequ nirringrazzjaw lill-familji kollha għall-ospitalità ġeneruża li wrew lill-parteċipanti matul iż-żjara.
formal.en: We would like to thank all the families for the generous hospitality they showed the participants during the visit.
formal.zh: 我们谨向所有家庭致谢，感谢他们在访问期间对参与者的慷慨款待。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Grazzi tal-ospitalità, ħassejtni d-dar! Pawlu: Ħadt gost li ġejt. Ejja erġa' żurna dalwaqt!
colloquial.en: Lina: Thank you for your hospitality; I felt at home! Pawlu: I'm glad you came. Come and visit us again soon!
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：谢谢你的热情款待，我感觉就像在自己家里！保罗：很高兴你能来。过不久再来我们家玩吧！

messages.speaker: Lina (来访的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi tal-ospitalità, ħassejtni d-dar!
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi tal-ospitalità, ħassejtni d-dar!
messages.zh: 谢谢你的热情款待，我感觉就像在自己家里！
messages.en: Thank you for your hospitality; I felt at home!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt gost li ġejt. Ejja erġa' żurna dalwaqt!
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt gost li ġejt. Ejja erġa' żurna dalwaqt!
messages.zh: 很高兴你能来。过不久再来我们家玩吧！
messages.en: I'm glad you came. Come and visit us again soon!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住感谢句 grazzi tal-ospitalità：想象做客结束时向主人道谢，把这个词与端茶、留饭、热情迎客的场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The warm welcome and generous treatment given to guests and visitors.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对客人或来访者给予的热情欢迎和慷慨款待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-merħba sabiħa u l-attenzjoni ġeneruża li jingħataw lill-mistednin biex iħossuhom komdi u milqugħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好客与热情款待，指欢迎来客并周到照料他们。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ospitalità hija l-mod kif persuna jew grupp jilqa' lill-viżitaturi b'kordjalità u jieħu ħsiebhom matul iż-żjara tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hospitality is the kindness and generous attention that make guests feel welcome and comfortable during a visit.

collocations.zh: 享受一个家庭的热情款待

formal.mt: L-ospitalità tar-residenti għenet lill-viżitaturi jħossuhom milqugħa matul il-programm kulturali.
formal.en: The residents' hospitality helped the visitors feel welcome during the cultural programme.
formal.zh: 居民们的热情款待让来访者在文化活动期间感受到宾至如归。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet iż-żjara għand il-familja ta' Marija? Ġorġ: L-ospitalità tagħhom kienet mill-aqwa. Saħansitra ħejjew kamra għalina!
colloquial.en: Sara: How was your visit to Marija's family? Ġorġ: Their hospitality was wonderful. They even prepared a room for us!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你去玛丽亚家做客怎么样？乔治：他们的款待特别周到，甚至给我们准备了一间房！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet iż-żjara għand il-familja ta' Marija?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet iż-żjara għand il-familja ta' Marija?
messages.zh: 你去玛丽亚家做客怎么样？
messages.en: How was your visit to Marija's family?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (做客归来的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ospitalità tagħhom kienet mill-aqwa. Saħansitra ħejjew kamra għalina!
messages.mt_standard: L-ospitalità tagħhom kienet mill-aqwa. Saħansitra ħejjew kamra għalina!
messages.zh: 他们的款待特别周到，甚至给我们准备了一间房！
messages.en: Their hospitality was wonderful. They even prepared a room for us!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ospitalità 放进“主人让客人感到自在”的画面：微笑迎接、准备饭菜、安排住处，三幅画面共同帮助记住“好客与款待”。

gloss_zh: 受到接待的；被招待的；获安排住宿的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Received and looked after as a guest, often with accommodation provided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为客人受到接待和照顾，通常也获提供住宿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Milqugħ u mħares bħala mistieden minn persuna, familja jew istituzzjoni, spiss b'post fejn joqgħod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被接待或招待，作为客人受到照顾，也可包括获安排住宿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd ikun ospitat, persuna jew organizzazzjoni tkun laqgħetu bħala mistieden u tkun ħadet ħsiebu, u tista' tkun ipprovdietlu wkoll fejn joqgħod.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone was hosted by a person or organization, they were welcomed and looked after as a guest.

collocations.zh: 在私人住宅中受到接待

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara ta' studju, l-istudent kien ospitat minn familja lokali li pprovdietlu l-ikel u l-akkomodazzjoni.
formal.en: During the study visit, the student was hosted by a local family that provided him with meals and accommodation.
formal.zh: 在学习访问期间，这名学生由一个当地家庭接待，该家庭为他提供了食宿。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn qgħadt meta mort Malta? David: Kont ospitat minn ħabib tiegħi għal ġimgħa. Anna: Mela kellek ukoll lil xi ħadd jurik il-post!
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did you stay when you went to Malta? David: I was hosted by a friend of mine for a week. Anna: So you also had someone to show you around!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你去马耳他时住在哪里？戴维：我在一个朋友家受到了一周的接待。安娜：那你还有人带着逛当地了！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qgħadt meta mort Malta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qgħadt meta mort Malta?
messages.zh: 你去马耳他时住在哪里？
messages.en: Where did you stay when you went to Malta?

messages.speaker: David (旅行归来的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont ospitat minn ħabib tiegħi għal ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Kont ospitat minn ħabib tiegħi għal ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我在一个朋友家受到了一周的接待。
messages.en: I was hosted by a friend of mine for a week.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela kellek ukoll lil xi ħadd jurik il-post!
messages.mt_standard: Mela kellek ukoll lil xi ħadd jurik il-post!
messages.zh: 那你还有人带着逛当地了！
messages.en: So you also had someone to show you around!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 kont ospitat minn ħabib tiegħi 整句记忆“我受到朋友接待”：把自己想成带着行李入住朋友家的客人，就容易记住这里接受接待的视角。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of welcoming guests and looking after them during a visit or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在来访或活动期间迎接宾客并照顾其需要的接待活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tilqa' lill-mistednin u tieħu ħsieb il-ħtiġijiet tagħhom waqt żjara jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对宾客等的接待与招待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha tilqa' mistednin u tipprovdilhom l-għajnuna u l-kura meħtieġa matul iż-żjara tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hosting is the activity of welcoming guests and taking care of their needs during their visit.

collocations.en: the hosting of a group from abroad

formal.mt: Il-kumitat se jieħu ħsieb l-ospitazzjoni tal-mistednin matul il-konferenza.
formal.en: The committee will take care of hosting the guests during the conference.
formal.zh: 委员会将负责会议期间的宾客接待工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-ospitazzjoni tal-mistednin għada? Pawlu: Jien u Sara. Se nilqgħuhom u nuruhom il-kmamar tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will take care of hosting the guests tomorrow? Pawlu: Sara and I will. We'll welcome them and show them their rooms.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天谁负责接待宾客？Pawlu：我和Sara。我们会迎接他们，带他们去各自的房间。

messages.speaker: Maja (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-ospitazzjoni tal-mistednin għada?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb l-ospitazzjoni tal-mistednin għada?
messages.zh: 明天谁负责接待宾客？
messages.en: Who will take care of hosting the guests tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien u Sara. Se nilqgħuhom u nuruhom il-kmamar tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Jien u Sara. Se nilqgħuhom u nuruhom il-kmamar tagħhom.
messages.zh: 我和Sara。我们会迎接他们，带他们去各自的房间。
messages.en: Sara and I will. We'll welcome them and show them their rooms.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“迎接客人、安排房间、照顾需要”三个画面连在一起，记住它表示整套接待活动。

gloss_zh: 被观察到的；被注意到的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Noticed, seen, or recorded through observation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过观察而被看到、注意到或记录下来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie nnutat, meqjus jew irreġistrat permezz tal-osservazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经被观察到、注意到或记录到的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie nnutat jew irreġistrat wara li xi ħadd ikun ħares lejh jew eżaminah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is observed has been noticed or recorded by someone watching or examining it.

formal.mt: Il-fenomenu osservat waqt l-esperiment ġie deskritt fid-dettall fir-rapport.
formal.en: The phenomenon observed during the experiment was described in detail in the report.
formal.zh: 报告详细描述了实验期间观察到的现象。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għasfur osservat ilbieraħ reġa' deher? Mark: Iva, rajtu dalgħodu fl-istess siġra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the bird observed yesterday appear again? Mark: Yes, I saw it this morning in the same tree.
colloquial.zh: Lara：昨天观察到的那只鸟又出现了吗？Mark：是的，我今天早上在同一棵树上看见它了。

messages.speaker: Lara (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għasfur osservat ilbieraħ reġa' deher?
messages.mt_standard: L-għasfur osservat ilbieraħ reġa' deher?
messages.zh: 昨天观察到的那只鸟又出现了吗？
messages.en: Did the bird observed yesterday appear again?

messages.speaker: Mark (观鸟伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, rajtu dalgħodu fl-istess siġra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, rajtu dalgħodu fl-istess siġra.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天早上在同一棵树上看见它了。
messages.en: Yes, I saw it this morning in the same tree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象观察笔记旁打了一个勾：这个现象已经被人看到并记下。用“已被观察到的”记住它的形容词意义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The name of the chemical element oxygen, which occurs as a gas in the air and is needed for human breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 化学元素氧的名称；氧以气体形式存在于空气中，是人类呼吸所必需的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku li jinsab fl-arja bħala gass u li huwa meħtieġ biex il-bniedem jieħu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氧这一化学元素的名称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-isem tal-element kimiku li jinsab fl-arja u li huwa essenzjali għan-nifs tal-bniedem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Oxygen is the name of a chemical element that occurs in the air and is essential for human breathing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 氧；空气中供人类呼吸所需的气体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Gass li jinsab fl-arja u li l-bniedem għandu bżonn biex jieħu n-nifs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Oxygen is a gas in the air that people need in order to breathe and stay alive.

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tal-elementi, l-isem Ossiġnu jidher ħdejn is-simbolu O.
formal.en: In the table of elements, the name Oxygen appears beside the symbol O.
formal.zh: 在元素表中，名称“Ossiġnu（氧）”出现在符号O旁边。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'jismu l-element bis-simbolu O? Rita: Ossiġnu. Huwa wieħed mill-gassijiet fl-arja li nieħdu n-nifs minnha.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is the element with the symbol O called? Rita: Oxygen. It is one of the gases in the air we breathe.
colloquial.zh: Nina：符号为O的元素叫什么？Rita：氧。它是我们呼吸的空气中的一种气体。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jismu l-element bis-simbolu O?
messages.mt_standard: X'jismu l-element bis-simbolu O?
messages.zh: 符号为O的元素叫什么？
messages.en: What is the element with the symbol O called?

messages.speaker: Rita (科学教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ossiġnu. Huwa wieħed mill-gassijiet fl-arja li nieħdu n-nifs minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Ossiġnu. Huwa wieħed mill-gassijiet fl-arja li nieħdu n-nifs minnha.
messages.zh: 氧。它是我们呼吸的空气中的一种气体。
messages.en: Oxygen. It is one of the gases in the air we breathe.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词卡上的Ossiġnu与元素符号O、呼吸和氧气瓶三个画面相连；分别练习“元素名称”和“氧气这种物质”两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Things or difficulties that block movement or make progress harder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 挡住通行或使事情难以推进的多个障碍物、困难或阻碍因素。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Affarijiet jew diffikultajiet li jfixklu l-moviment jew jagħmlu l-progress aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妨碍通行或阻碍进展的障碍物、困难或阻碍因素，表示复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Affarijiet li jimblukkaw it-triq jew diffikultajiet li jfixklu lil xi ħadd milli javvanza jew jilħaq għan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Obstacles are objects or difficulties that prevent movement or make it harder to achieve something.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika l-ostakli li qed idewmu l-proġett u jipproponi soluzzjonijiet biex jingħelbu.
formal.en: The report identifies the obstacles delaying the project and proposes solutions to overcome them.
formal.zh: 报告指出了导致项目延误的阻碍因素，并提出克服这些障碍的解决办法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn bir-rota? Ben: Aħjar nieħdu triq oħra. Hemm wisq ostakli fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can we cycle through here? Ben: We'd better take another road. There are too many obstacles in the road.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们能骑自行车从这里过去吗？Ben：最好换条路。这条路上的障碍物太多了。

messages.speaker: Sara (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn bir-rota?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn bir-rota?
messages.zh: 我们能骑自行车从这里过去吗？
messages.en: Can we cycle through here?

messages.speaker: Ben (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar nieħdu triq oħra. Hemm wisq ostakli fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar nieħdu triq oħra. Hemm wisq ostakli fit-triq.
messages.zh: 最好换条路。这条路上的障碍物太多了。
messages.en: We'd better take another road. There are too many obstacles in the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象前进路上摆着好几个路障，记住ostakli表示复数的“障碍”；再把画面延伸到做事时遇到的各种困难。

gloss_zh: 贸易障碍；贸易摩擦因素

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule, requirement, or difficulty that restricts trade or makes commercial exchange harder.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 限制贸易往来，或使商品和服务交易更加困难的规定、要求或其他障碍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola, rekwiżit jew diffikultà li tillimita l-kummerċ jew tagħmel l-iskambju ta' prodotti u servizzi aktar diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阻碍商品或服务贸易往来的限制或障碍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Restrizzjoni jew xkiel li jfixkel il-kummerċ ta' prodotti jew servizzi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barrier to trade is a restriction or difficulty that makes the exchange of goods or services harder.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使贸易活动难以开展或顺利进行的困难或阻碍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diffikultà jew xkiel li jagħmel l-attività kummerċjali aktar diffiċli biex titwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An obstacle to trade is something that prevents commercial exchange from taking place easily or efficiently.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限制贸易的措施或条件，例如关税或进口限制。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura jew kundizzjoni, bħal dazju jew restrizzjoni fuq l-importazzjoni, li tillimita l-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade barrier is a measure or condition that limits trade, such as a tariff or an import restriction.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在贸易伙伴之间引起不满或摩擦、但未必完全阻断贸易的问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwistjoni li tqajjem nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew tensjoni bejn sħab kummerċjali mingħajr ma neċessarjament twaqqaf il-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade irritant is an issue that causes dissatisfaction or tension between trading partners without necessarily stopping trade.

collocations.en: a barrier to trade is removed

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika r-rekwiżit ta' ċertifikazzjoni doppja bħala ostakolu għall-kummerċ u jirrakkomanda li jiġi ssimplifikat.
formal.en: The report identifies the requirement for duplicate certification as a barrier to trade and recommends simplifying it.
formal.zh: 报告指出，重复认证要求构成贸易障碍，并建议简化这一要求。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola darbtejn? Mark: Hekk titlob il-proċedura. Maja: Dan hu ostakolu għall-kummerċ; qed nitilfu ħafna ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we have to fill in the same form twice? Mark: That's what the procedure requires. Maja: This is an obstacle to trade; we're wasting a lot of time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么同一张表要填两遍？马克：流程就是这样要求的。玛雅：这构成了贸易障碍，我们浪费了很多时间。

messages.speaker: Maja (出口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola darbtejn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irridu nimlew l-istess formola darbtejn?
messages.zh: 为什么同一张表要填两遍？
messages.en: Why do we have to fill in the same form twice?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk titlob il-proċedura.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk titlob il-proċedura.
messages.zh: 流程就是这样要求的。
messages.en: That's what the procedure requires.

messages.speaker: Maja (出口商)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu ostakolu għall-kummerċ; qed nitilfu ħafna ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu ostakolu għall-kummerċ; qed nitilfu ħafna ħin.
messages.zh: 这构成了贸易障碍，我们浪费了很多时间。
messages.en: This is an obstacle to trade; we're wasting a lot of time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语想成贸易道路上的路障：看到 ostakolu 想到障碍，再把 għall-kummerċ 整体联系到贸易，串记为贸易障碍。

gloss_zh: 贸易障碍；商业阻碍；贸易摩擦因素

teaching_sense.en_definition: A restriction, requirement, or practical difficulty that hinders trade or commercial activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 妨碍贸易或商业活动开展的限制、要求或实际困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Restrizzjoni, rekwiżit jew diffikultà prattika li tfixkel il-kummerċ jew l-attività kummerċjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限制商品或服务交换、使贸易更加困难的障碍。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xkiel li jirrestrinġi l-iskambju ta' prodotti jew servizzi u jagħmel il-kummerċ aktar diffiċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A barrier to trade is something that restricts commercial exchange or makes it more difficult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 妨碍贸易正常开展或顺利推进的因素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fattur li jfixkel il-kummerċ milli jsir jew milli jimxi bla xkiel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An obstacle to trade is a factor that interferes with the smooth conduct of business between trading partners.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对贸易施加限制的政策、规定或其他条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika, regola jew kundizzjoni oħra li timponi restrizzjoni fuq il-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade barrier is a policy, rule, or other condition that places a restriction on trade.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 引起贸易伙伴不满或争议、使贸易关系不顺畅的问题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Problema li tqajjem nuqqas ta' sodisfazzjon jew tilwim bejn sħab kummerċjali u tagħmel ir-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali inqas faċli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade irritant is a problem that causes friction or disagreement in relations between trading partners.

formal.mt: L-assoċjazzjoni wissiet li r-regola l-ġdida tista' ssir ostakolu kummerċjali għall-intrapriżi żgħar.
formal.en: The association warned that the new rule could become a trade barrier for small enterprises.
formal.zh: 该协会警告说，新规定可能成为小型企业面临的贸易障碍。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-miżata żejda se tgħolli l-prezz tal-prodott. Pawlu: Iva, għalina hija ostakolu kummerċjali. Lara: Ejja naraw jekk hemmx mod kif innaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Lara: This extra fee will raise the price of the product. Pawlu: Yes, it's a trade barrier for us. Lara: Let's see whether there's a way to reduce costs.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这笔额外费用会抬高产品价格。保罗：是啊，对我们来说这是一项贸易障碍。拉拉：我们看看有没有办法降低成本。

messages.speaker: Lara (销售经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-miżata żejda se tgħolli l-prezz tal-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-miżata żejda se tgħolli l-prezz tal-prodott.
messages.zh: 这笔额外费用会抬高产品价格。
messages.en: This extra fee will raise the price of the product.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (企业主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalina hija ostakolu kummerċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalina hija ostakolu kummerċjali.
messages.zh: 是啊，对我们来说这是一项贸易障碍。
messages.en: Yes, it's a trade barrier for us.

messages.speaker: Lara (销售经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw jekk hemmx mod kif innaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw jekk hemmx mod kif innaqqsu l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 我们看看有没有办法降低成本。
messages.en: Let's see whether there's a way to reduce costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆：货物前面有一道关卡，关卡就是 ostakolu，旁边贴着商业标签 kummerċjali，合起来记作贸易障碍。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thin wafer of bread consecrated in the Eucharist and received as Holy Communion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在圣体圣事中经过祝圣、供信徒领受圣体的薄饼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ħobż irqiq li tiġi kkonsagrata fl-Ewkaristija u li l-fidili jirċievu fit-tqarbin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在圣体圣事中祝圣并供领圣体时领受的薄饼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ħobż irqiq ikkonsagrata fl-Ewkaristija li tingħata lill-fidili waqt it-tqarbin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A holy wafer is a thin piece of bread consecrated in the Eucharist and received during Holy Communion.

formal.mt: Waqt il-quddiesa, is-saċerdot għolla l-ostja kkonsagrata quddiem il-kongregazzjoni.
formal.en: During Mass, the priest raised the consecrated host before the congregation.
formal.zh: 弥撒期间，神父在会众面前举起经过祝圣的圣饼。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ħobż tonda li għolla s-saċerdot? Marija: Dik hija l-ostja kkonsagrata. Anna: Mela hija dik li n-nies jirċievu fit-tqarbin? Marija: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that round piece of bread the priest raised? Marija: That is the consecrated host. Anna: So that's what people receive at Holy Communion? Marija: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：神父举起的那片圆圆的饼是什么？玛丽娅：那是经过祝圣的圣饼。安娜：所以，人们领圣体时领受的就是它吗？玛丽娅：是的，就是它。

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ħobż tonda li għolla s-saċerdot?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-biċċa ħobż tonda li għolla s-saċerdot?
messages.zh: 神父举起的那片圆圆的饼是什么？
messages.en: What is that round piece of bread the priest raised?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija l-ostja kkonsagrata.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija l-ostja kkonsagrata.
messages.zh: 那是经过祝圣的圣饼。
messages.en: That is the consecrated host.

messages.speaker: Anna (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hija dik li n-nies jirċievu fit-tqarbin?
messages.mt_standard: Mela hija dik li n-nies jirċievu fit-tqarbin?
messages.zh: 所以，人们领圣体时领受的就是它吗？
messages.en: So that's what people receive at Holy Communion?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt.
messages.zh: 是的，就是它。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ostja 写在一张画着白色圆形薄饼的学习卡上，再配上弥撒中举起圣饼的场景，用宗教情境记住圣体薄饼这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who supplies and fits spectacles and other optical aids according to a prescription.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据验光处方提供、验配和调整眼镜等视力辅助用品的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tipprovdi u tadatta nuċċalijiet u għajnuniet ottiċi oħra skont riċetta għall-vista.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照验光处方为顾客选择、配制和调整眼镜等视力辅助用品的配镜专业人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna mħarrġa li tgħin lill-klijenti jagħżlu nuċċalijiet u għajnuniet ottiċi oħra, tipprovdihom u tadattahom skont riċetta għall-vista.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dispensing optician is a trained person who supplies and fits spectacles and other optical aids according to a prescription.

collocations.en: an appointment with the dispensing optician
the dispensing optician adjusts the frame

formal.mt: L-ottiku għen lill-klijent jagħżel frejm adattat u ordna l-lentijiet skont ir-riċetta għall-vista.
formal.en: The dispensing optician helped the customer choose a suitable frame and ordered the lenses according to the prescription.
formal.zh: 配镜师帮助顾客挑选合适的镜框，并根据验光处方订购镜片。

colloquial.mt: Mark: In-nuċċali qed jiżloqli minn fuq imnieħri. Lara: Ħudu għand l-ottiku biex jaġġustalek il-frejm. Mark: Tajjeb, immur illum.
colloquial.en: Mark: My glasses keep slipping down my nose. Lara: Take them to the dispensing optician to have the frame adjusted. Mark: All right, I'll go today.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我的眼镜老是从鼻梁上往下滑。拉拉：拿去找配镜师，让他帮你调一下镜框。马克：好，我今天就去。

messages.speaker: Mark (眼镜佩戴者)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nuċċali qed jiżloqli minn fuq imnieħri.
messages.mt_standard: In-nuċċali qed jiżloqli minn fuq imnieħri.
messages.zh: 我的眼镜老是从鼻梁上往下滑。
messages.en: My glasses keep slipping down my nose.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħudu għand l-ottiku biex jaġġustalek il-frejm.
messages.mt_standard: Ħudu għand l-ottiku biex jaġġustalek il-frejm.
messages.zh: 拿去找配镜师，让他帮你调一下镜框。
messages.en: Take them to the dispensing optician to have the frame adjusted.

messages.speaker: Mark (眼镜佩戴者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, immur illum.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, immur illum.
messages.zh: 好，我今天就去。
messages.en: All right, I'll go today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住一个具体动作：眼镜下滑时，ottiku 帮你调整镜框；把这个词与拿处方配眼镜、试戴和调镜框的人员联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An optimist is a person who expects good things to happen and looks for positive possibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对未来抱有希望、倾向于预期好结果，并看到事情积极一面的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħares lejn il-futur b'tama u tistenna li l-affarijiet imorru tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐观主义者；通常相信事情会向好的方向发展的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li normalment tara n-naħa t-tajba tal-affarijiet u tittama f'riżultat tajjeb, anki meta jkun hemm diffikultajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An optimist is someone who usually expects a situation to develop in a good way.

collocations.zh: 对未来持乐观态度的人

formal.mt: Bħala ottimista, id-direttur jemmen li t-tim jista' jegħleb id-diffikultajiet permezz ta' ppjanar tajjeb.
formal.en: As an optimist, the director believes that the team can overcome the difficulties through good planning.
formal.zh: 作为一个乐观的人，主任相信团队能够通过妥善规划克服困难。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li se nsibu post fuq il-karozza tal-linja? Pawlu: Iva, jien ottimista! Ejja nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think we'll find a seat on the bus? Pawlu: Yes, I'm an optimist! Let's wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得我们能在公交车上找到座位吗？Pawlu：能，我可是个乐观的人！我们等一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li se nsibu post fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li se nsibu post fuq il-karozza tal-linja?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们能在公交车上找到座位吗？
messages.en: Do you think we'll find a seat on the bus?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien ottimista! Ejja nistennew ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien ottimista! Ejja nistennew ftit.
messages.zh: 能，我可是个乐观的人！我们等一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, I'm an optimist! Let's wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ottimista 记成遇到困难仍说“会好起来”的那个人；本词指乐观的人，可与表示乐观心态的 ottimiżmu 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Optimism is a hopeful attitude based on expecting good things to happen or a situation to improve.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相信事情会顺利发展或情况会改善、对未来抱有希望的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attitudni ta' tama u fiduċja li l-affarijiet imorru tajjeb jew li sitwazzjoni titjieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐观；倾向于期待好结果、相信未来会更好的心态。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħarsa pożittiva lejn il-ħajja jew lejn sitwazzjoni, flimkien mat-tama li jkun hemm żvilupp jew riżultat tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Optimism is the feeling that good things will happen and that difficulties can be overcome.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jesprimi ottimiżmu kawt dwar ir-riżultati tal-proġett, iżda jenfasizza l-ħtieġa ta' aktar xogħol.
formal.en: The report expresses cautious optimism about the project's results but stresses the need for further work.
formal.zh: 报告对项目成果表示谨慎乐观，但强调仍需进一步开展工作。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għad għandek ottimiżmu dwar l-eżami? Daniel: Iva, studjajt ħafna u naħseb li se mmur tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Are you still optimistic about the exam? Daniel: Yes, I've studied a lot, and I think I'll do well.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你对考试还抱有乐观的心态吗？Daniel：是的，我复习了很多，觉得自己会考得不错。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek ottimiżmu dwar l-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek ottimiżmu dwar l-eżami?
messages.zh: 你对考试还抱有乐观的心态吗？
messages.en: Are you still optimistic about the exam?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, studjajt ħafna u naħseb li se mmur tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, studjajt ħafna u naħseb li se mmur tajjeb.
messages.zh: 是的，我复习了很多，觉得自己会考得不错。
messages.en: Yes, I've studied a lot, and I think I'll do well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ottimiżmu 想成心里那句“事情会变好”；它表示乐观心态，与指乐观之人的 ottimista 成对记忆更清楚。

gloss_zh: 奥斯曼的；与奥斯曼帝国有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something Ottoman is connected with the Ottoman Empire, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与奥斯曼帝国及其人民或文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imperu Ottoman, mal-popli tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奥斯曼的；属于奥斯曼帝国或与其人民、历史及文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni lill-Imperu Ottoman jew li huwa marbut mal-popli, mal-istorja jew mal-kultura tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Ottoman belongs to or is associated with the Ottoman Empire and its culture.

formal.mt: Dan l-istudju jeżamina l-istil ottoman fid-dekorazzjoni tal-bini.
formal.en: This study examines the Ottoman style in the decoration of buildings.
formal.zh: 本研究考察建筑装饰中的奥斯曼风格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'ottoman' f'din id-deskrizzjoni? Mark: Ifisser li l-istil għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imperu Ottoman.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'Ottoman' mean in this description? Mark: It means that the style is connected with the Ottoman Empire.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这段说明里的“奥斯曼的”是什么意思？Mark：意思是这种风格与奥斯曼帝国有关。

messages.speaker: Sara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'ottoman' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'ottoman' f'din id-deskrizzjoni?
messages.zh: 这段说明里的“奥斯曼的”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Ottoman' mean in this description?

messages.speaker: Mark (导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-istil għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imperu Ottoman.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-istil għandu x'jaqsam mal-Imperu Ottoman.
messages.zh: 意思是这种风格与奥斯曼帝国有关。
messages.en: It means that the style is connected with the Ottoman Empire.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ottoman 放进“奥斯曼风格”这张说明牌里记忆：它在这里是形容词，用来说明事物与奥斯曼帝国有关。

gloss_zh: 外包；将工作交由外部承包方完成

teaching_sense.en_definition: Outsourcing is the practice of arranging for an outside person or company to carry out particular work or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由企业或机构委托外部个人或公司完成某项工作或提供服务的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li kumpanija jew organizzazzjoni tqabbad persuna jew kumpanija esterna biex twettaq xogħol jew tipprovdi servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外包；把某项工作或服务交给外部承包方执行的安排或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' xogħol jew servizzi lil persuna jew kumpanija esterna permezz ta' ftehim biex twettaqhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Outsourcing is an arrangement in which an organization engages an outside contractor to perform particular work or services.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tapprova l-outsourcing tas-servizzi tat-tindif, il-kumpanija għandha tevalwa l-ispiża u l-kwalità tas-servizz.
formal.en: Before approving the outsourcing of cleaning services, the company should assess the cost and the quality of the service.
formal.zh: 公司在批准清洁服务外包之前，应评估费用和服务质量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindif tal-uffiċċju? David: Se nagħmlu outsourcing u nqabbdu kumpanija tat-tindif.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who will take care of cleaning the office? David: We'll outsource it and hire a cleaning company.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁来负责办公室的清洁？David：我们会把这项工作外包，聘请一家清洁公司。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindif tal-uffiċċju?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu ħsieb it-tindif tal-uffiċċju?
messages.zh: 谁来负责办公室的清洁？
messages.en: Who will take care of cleaning the office?

messages.speaker: David (办公室主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Se nagħmlu outsourcing u nqabbdu kumpanija tat-tindif.
messages.mt_standard: Se nagħmlu outsourcing u nqabbdu kumpanija tat-tindif.
messages.zh: 我们会把这项工作外包，聘请一家清洁公司。
messages.en: We'll outsource it and hire a cleaning company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公室把清洁任务交给门外的专业公司：outsourcing 就是这种外包安排；可用“工作交出去，服务请进来”帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a rounded, elongated shape resembling an egg.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形状圆润而较长，轮廓像鸡蛋的；椭圆形的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu forma tonda u tawwalija li tixbah lil bajda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 椭圆形的；轮廓圆润、长宽不等而像鸡蛋的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu forma tonda u tawwalija, simili għall-forma ta' bajda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is oval has a rounded, elongated outline resembling an egg.

formal.mt: Fid-disinn tal-kamra hemm mejda ovali fiċ-ċentru u mera ovali fuq il-ħajt.
formal.en: The room design includes an oval table in the centre and an oval mirror on the wall.
formal.zh: 房间设计中，中央放着一张椭圆形的桌子，墙上挂着一面椭圆形的镜子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema mera togħġbok? Lara: Dik ovali, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which mirror do you like? Lara: The oval one, beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你喜欢哪面镜子？Lara：门旁边那面椭圆形的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema mera togħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Liema mera togħġbok?
messages.zh: 你喜欢哪面镜子？
messages.en: Which mirror do you like?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik ovali, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Dik ovali, ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 门旁边那面椭圆形的。
messages.en: The oval one, beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ovali 和椭圆形镜子的画面连起来记：圆润又拉长，像鸡蛋的轮廓。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate that something is clear or easy to recognize.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某件事很清楚、容易看出，或说话者认为它是显而易见的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri li xi ħaġa hija ċara, faċli biex tinduna biha, jew meqjusa evidenti minn min qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显然；明显地；用于指出某事容易看出或被认为不言而喻。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod ċar jew evidenti; jintuża wkoll biex juri li min qed jitkellem iqis xi ħaġa bħala faċli biex tinftiehem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use obviously to indicate that something is clear or easily recognized.

formal.mt: Żewġ siġġijiet għal għaxar parteċipanti huma ovvjament mhux biżżejjed; għalhekk jeħtieġ li jinġiebu aktar siġġijiet.
formal.en: Two chairs for ten participants are obviously not enough; therefore, more chairs need to be brought in.
formal.zh: 十名参与者只有两把椅子，显然不够，因此需要再搬些椅子来。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tieħu umbrella? Anna: Ovvjament! Ara kemm qed tagħmel xita.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you taking an umbrella? Anna: Obviously! Look how hard it is raining.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你要带伞吗？Anna：当然啦！你看雨下得多大。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu umbrella?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu umbrella?
messages.zh: 你要带伞吗？
messages.en: Are you taking an umbrella?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ovvjament! Ara kemm qed tagħmel xita.
messages.mt_standard: Ovvjament! Ara kemm qed tagħmel xita.
messages.zh: 当然啦！你看雨下得多大。
messages.en: Obviously! Look how hard it is raining.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗外正在下大雨，有人还问是否带伞：回答 ovvjament，就是“这还用说，显然要带”。

gloss_zh: 食品；食物品项；供人食用的食品

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual food item or food product intended to be eaten by people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人食用的一种食品或一个食品品项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew prodott tal-ikel maħsub biex jittiekel mill-bnedmin, waħdu jew bħala parti minn ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人食用的食物；此处指某一种或某一件食品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tittiekel mill-bnedmin bħala ikel; f'din l-espressjoni, oġġett jew tip wieħed ta' ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food is something that people eat, and this expression refers to an individual item of it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可供食用或用来制作食物的食品或食材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott jew sustanza li tintuża bħala ikel jew fil-preparazzjoni tal-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foodstuff is a substance or product used as food or as an ingredient in preparing food.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以供人食用为用途的食品或食材。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott jew sustanza tal-ikel maħsuba biex jikkunsmawha l-bnedmin, direttament jew wara l-preparazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foodstuff for human consumption is a food product intended to be eaten by people, either directly or after preparation.

formal.mt: Kull oġġett tal-ikel għandu jinħażen skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: Each food item should be stored according to the instructions on its label.
formal.zh: 每种食品都应按照其标签上的说明存放。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan l-oġġett tal-ikel fih il-ħalib? Luqa: Iva, fih il-ħalib. Ħa nurik wieħed mingħajru.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this food item contain milk? Luqa: Yes, it contains milk. Let me show you one without it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这款食品含牛奶吗？卢卡：是的，含牛奶。我给你看一款不含牛奶的。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-oġġett tal-ikel fih il-ħalib?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-oġġett tal-ikel fih il-ħalib?
messages.zh: 这款食品含牛奶吗？
messages.en: Does this food item contain milk?

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fih il-ħalib. Ħa nurik wieħed mingħajru.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fih il-ħalib. Ħa nurik wieħed mingħajru.
messages.zh: 是的，含牛奶。我给你看一款不含牛奶的。
messages.en: Yes, it contains milk. Let me show you one without it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象购物篮里单独拿起的一件食品：oġġett 表示物品，tal-ikel 限定它属于食品。

gloss_zh: 两用设备；两用货物；两用物项

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods or equipment that can serve two purposes, including civilian and military uses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够用于两种用途的物品或设备，也可指兼具民用和军用用途的货物或物项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew tagħmir li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, fosthom għal skopijiet ċivili u militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可用于两种不同用途的设备；两用设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmir li jista' jintuża għal żewġ skopijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-purpose equipment is equipment that can be used for two different purposes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有两种用途的货物，尤其指既可用于民用目的、也可用于军用目的的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Merkanzija li tista' tintuża għal żewġ skopijiet, b'mod partikolari għal skopijiet ċivili kif ukoll militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-use goods are goods that can serve two purposes, particularly both civilian and military purposes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有两种用途的物项，尤其指兼具民用和军用用途的具体物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti individwali li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, b'mod partikolari għal skopijiet ċivili u militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-use items are individual articles that can have two uses, particularly civilian and military uses.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi oġġetti b'użu doppju u jispjega kif l-istess tagħmir jista' jintuża għal skopijiet ċivili u militari.
formal.en: The report describes dual-use items and explains how the same equipment can be used for civilian and military purposes.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了两用物项，并解释了同一设备如何用于民用和军用目的。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhuma dawn l-oġġetti b'użu doppju? David: Huma oġġetti li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, pereżempju ċivili u militari. Nina: Issa fhimt għaliex il-lista ssemmi żewġ użi.
colloquial.en: Nina: What are these dual-use items? David: They are items that can be used for two purposes, for example civilian and military purposes. Nina: Now I understand why the list mentions two uses.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这些两用物项是什么？戴维：就是可以用于两种目的的物品，例如民用和军用。妮娜：现在我明白清单为什么提到两种用途了。

messages.speaker: Nina (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma dawn l-oġġetti b'użu doppju?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma dawn l-oġġetti b'użu doppju?
messages.zh: 这些两用物项是什么？
messages.en: What are these dual-use items?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huma oġġetti li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, pereżempju ċivili u militari.
messages.mt_standard: Huma oġġetti li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, pereżempju ċivili u militari.
messages.zh: 就是可以用于两种目的的物品，例如民用和军用。
messages.en: They are items that can be used for two purposes, for example civilian and military purposes.

messages.speaker: Nina (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt għaliex il-lista ssemmi żewġ użi.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt għaliex il-lista ssemmi żewġ użi.
messages.zh: 现在我明白清单为什么提到两种用途了。
messages.en: Now I understand why the list mentions two uses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成 oġġetti“物品”、b'użu“具有用途”、doppju“双重”来记，想象同一设备旁画着两条用途箭头，即可联想到“两用物项”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods brought into a country from another country for sale or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从其他国家运入本国、供销售或使用的物品或货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jiddaħħlu f'pajjiż minn pajjiż ieħor biex jinbiegħu jew jintużaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从国外输入的物品或货物；进口品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jkunu ddaħħlu fil-pajjiż minn barra għall-bejgħ jew għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Importations are goods that have been brought into a country from abroad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由其他国家运入本国的货物；进口商品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Merkanzija jew prodotti li pajjiż jirċievi minn pajjiżi oħra għall-bejgħ jew għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A country's imports are goods that it receives from other countries for sale or use.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-prezzijiet tal-oġġetti importati mal-prezzijiet tal-prodotti lokali fl-istess perjodu.
formal.en: The report compares the prices of imported goods with the prices of local products over the same period.
formal.zh: 报告比较了同一时期进口货物与本地产品的价格。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dawn huma oġġetti importati? Toni: Iva, ġejjin mill-Italja. Sara: Għandkom ukoll prodotti lokali?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are these imported goods? Toni: Yes, they come from Italy. Sara: Do you also have local products?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些是进口商品吗？托尼：是的，来自意大利。萨拉：你们也有本地产品吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn huma oġġetti importati?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn huma oġġetti importati?
messages.zh: 这些是进口商品吗？
messages.en: Are these imported goods?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġejjin mill-Italja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġejjin mill-Italja.
messages.zh: 是的，来自意大利。
messages.en: Yes, they come from Italy.

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom ukoll prodotti lokali?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom ukoll prodotti lokali?
messages.zh: 你们也有本地产品吗？
messages.en: Do you also have local products?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货架上一批贴着外国来源标签的商品：oġġetti 是“物品”，importati 表示“进口的”。整组记为“从国外运进来的物品”。

exact_key: oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli
gloss_zh: 由农产品加工而成的货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods produced by processing agricultural products, such as flour made from grain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以农产品为原料，通过加工得到的货物，例如将谷物加工制成的面粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jinkisbu meta prodotti agrikoli jiġu pproċessati, bħad-dqiq magħmul miċ-ċereali.

sense_translations.en_definition: goods obtained by processing agricultural products
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过加工农产品而获得的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti miksuba billi prodotti agrikoli jiġu pproċessati u jinbidlu fi prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goods obtained by processing agricultural products are items made by transforming agricultural materials into other products.

sense_translations.en_definition: goods resulting from the processing of agricultural products
sense_translations.zh_definition: 农产品经过加工后所产生的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jkunu r-riżultat tal-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli, bħaż-żejt magħmul miż-żebbuġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goods resulting from the processing of agricultural products are the products created when agricultural materials undergo processing.

collocations.mt: il-produzzjoni ta' oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli
collocations.en: the production of goods obtained by processing agricultural products
collocations.zh: 农产品加工货物的生产

collocations.mt: il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli
collocations.en: the sale of goods obtained by processing agricultural products
collocations.zh: 农产品加工货物的销售

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-produzzjoni ta' oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli, fosthom id-dqiq u ż-żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: The report describes the production of goods obtained by processing agricultural products, including flour and olive oil.
formal.zh: 该报告介绍了由农产品加工而成的货物的生产情况，其中包括面粉和橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhuma oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli? Pawlu: Bħad-dqiq. Nibdew bil-qamħ u nipproċessawh biex nagħmlu d-dqiq.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are goods obtained by processing agricultural products? Pawlu: Things like flour. We start with wheat and process it to make flour.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是由农产品加工而成的货物？Pawlu：比如面粉。我们以小麦为原料，把它加工成面粉。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar ta' prodotti agrikoli?
messages.zh: 什么是由农产品加工而成的货物？
messages.en: What are goods obtained by processing agricultural products?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħad-dqiq. Nibdew bil-qamħ u nipproċessawh biex nagħmlu d-dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Bħad-dqiq. Nibdew bil-qamħ u nipproċessawh biex nagħmlu d-dqiq.
messages.zh: 比如面粉。我们以小麦为原料，把它加工成面粉。
messages.en: Things like flour. We start with wheat and process it to make flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小麦经过加工变成面粉”的画面记忆整句：oġġetti 是货物，li jirriżultaw 表示产生的，后半段说明这些货物来自农产品加工。

gloss_zh: 未经要求而寄送或提供的货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods sent or supplied to someone who has not requested or ordered them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在收货人没有提出要求或下单的情况下，向其寄送或提供的货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti mibgħuta jew ipprovduti lil persuna mingħajr ma tkun talbithom jew ordnathom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收货人未要求或未订购，却被寄送或提供给其的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li persuna tirċievi mingħajr ma tkun għamlet talba jew ordni għalihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Unsolicited goods are items sent or supplied to someone who has not asked to receive them.

collocations.zh: 寄送收件人未要求的货物

formal.mt: Il-klijent informa lill-kumpanija bil-miktub li kien irċieva oġġetti mhux mitluba u talab spjegazzjoni dwar il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The customer informed the company in writing that he had received unsolicited goods and requested an explanation about the delivery.
formal.zh: 该顾客书面通知公司，称自己收到了未订购的货物，并要求公司说明此次配送的情况。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wasalli pakkett, imma ma ordnajt xejn. Dawn huma oġġetti mhux mitluba? Mark: Jekk ma tlabthomx, iva. Ejja naraw min bagħathom.
colloquial.en: Lara: A parcel arrived for me, but I didn't order anything. Are these unsolicited goods? Mark: If you didn't ask for them, yes. Let's see who sent them.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我收到了一个包裹，可我什么也没订。这些算是未经要求寄来的货物吗？Mark：如果你没有要求寄来，那就算。我们看看是谁寄的。

messages.speaker: Lara (收件人)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasalli pakkett, imma ma ordnajt xejn. Dawn huma oġġetti mhux mitluba?
messages.mt_standard: Wasalli pakkett, imma ma ordnajt xejn. Dawn huma oġġetti mhux mitluba?
messages.zh: 我收到了一个包裹，可我什么也没订。这些算是未经要求寄来的货物吗？
messages.en: A parcel arrived for me, but I didn't order anything. Are these unsolicited goods?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk ma tlabthomx, iva. Ejja naraw min bagħathom.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk ma tlabthomx, iva. Ejja naraw min bagħathom.
messages.zh: 如果你没有要求寄来，那就算。我们看看是谁寄的。
messages.en: If you didn't ask for them, yes. Let's see who sent them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门口出现一个“我没订过”的包裹：oġġetti 是货物，mhux 表示否定，mitluba 表示被要求的；整句记作“未经要求送来的货物”。

exact_key: oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli
gloss_zh: 通过加工农产品获得的货物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods obtained through the processing of agricultural products, such as jam made from fruit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过对农产品进行加工而获得的货物，例如果实加工制成的果酱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jinkisbu permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli, bħall-ġamm magħmul mill-frott.

sense_translations.en_definition: goods obtained by processing agricultural products
sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过加工农产品而取得的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jinkisbu meta l-prodotti agrikoli jiġu pproċessati biex isiru prodotti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goods obtained by processing agricultural products are items produced by working agricultural materials into a different form.

sense_translations.en_definition: goods resulting from the processing of agricultural products
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以农产品加工过程为来源而产生的货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jirriżultaw mill-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli, bħall-ġamm magħmul mill-frott jew id-dqiq magħmul mill-qamħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Goods resulting from the processing of agricultural products are the items that emerge when agricultural materials are processed.

collocations.mt: il-ħażna ta' oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli
collocations.en: the storage of goods obtained by processing agricultural products
collocations.zh: 通过农产品加工获得的货物的储存

collocations.mt: it-trasport ta' oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli
collocations.en: the transport of goods obtained by processing agricultural products
collocations.zh: 通过农产品加工获得的货物的运输

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jippreżenta oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli, fosthom il-ġamm tal-frawli u d-dqiq tal-qamħ.
formal.en: The catalogue presents goods obtained by processing agricultural products, including strawberry jam and wheat flour.
formal.zh: 该目录展示了通过加工农产品获得的货物，其中包括草莓酱和小麦面粉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ġamm jidħol taħt oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli? Toni: Iva, għax isir mill-frott. Il-frott jiġi pproċessat biex isir ġamm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does jam count as goods obtained by processing agricultural products? Toni: Yes, because it is made from fruit. The fruit is processed to make jam.
colloquial.zh: Sara：果酱算是通过加工农产品获得的货物吗？Toni：算，因为果酱是用水果制成的。水果经过加工后就做成了果酱。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġamm jidħol taħt oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġamm jidħol taħt oġġetti miksuba permezz tal-ipproċessar tal-prodotti agrikoli?
messages.zh: 果酱算是通过加工农产品获得的货物吗？
messages.en: Does jam count as goods obtained by processing agricultural products?

messages.speaker: Toni (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax isir mill-frott. Il-frott jiġi pproċessat biex isir ġamm.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax isir mill-frott. Il-frott jiġi pproċessat biex isir ġamm.
messages.zh: 算，因为果酱是用水果制成的。水果经过加工后就做成了果酱。
messages.en: Yes, because it is made from fruit. The fruit is processed to make jam.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成“货物—获得的—通过—农产品加工”来记：miksuba 对应“获得的”，permezz 对应“通过”；再用“水果变果酱”的画面串起整句。

gloss_zh: 两用设备；两用货物；两用物项

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods or equipment that can serve two purposes, including items that can have both civilian and military uses.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够用于两种用途的货物或设备；也指既可用于民用目的、又可用于军事目的的物项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti jew tagħmir li jistgħu jintużaw għal żewġ skopijiet, inklużi dawk li jista' jkollhom użu kemm ċivili kif ukoll militari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具备两种用途或能够完成两类任务的设备。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħmir li jista' jintuża għal żewġ skopijiet jew biex iwettaq żewġ funzjonijiet differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-purpose equipment is equipment designed or suitable for carrying out two different functions or tasks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 既可用于民用目的、又可用于军事目的的两用货物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti kkummerċjati li jistgħu jintużaw kemm għal skopijiet ċivili kif ukoll għal skopijiet militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-use goods are goods that can be used for civilian purposes as well as military purposes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有民用和军事两种潜在用途的物项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti individwali li jista' jkollhom użu ċivili kif ukoll użu militari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dual-use items are individual articles that have potential applications in both civilian and military activities.

collocations.mt: l-esportazzjoni ta' oġġetti ta' użu doppju
il-klassifikazzjoni ta' oġġetti ta' użu doppju

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-użi ċivili u militari possibbli tal-oġġetti ta' użu doppju inklużi fil-katalgu.
formal.en: The report describes the possible civilian and military uses of the dual-use items included in the catalogue.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了目录中所列两用物项可能具有的民用和军事用途。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser oġġetti ta' użu doppju f'dan it-test? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser affarijiet li jistgħu jintużaw kemm għal skopijiet ċivili kif ukoll għal skopijiet militari.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'dual-use items' mean in this text? Mark: Here it means things that can be used for both civilian and military purposes.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这篇文章里的“两用物项”是什么意思？马克：这里指既能用于民用目的，也能用于军事目的的东西。

messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser oġġetti ta' użu doppju f'dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser oġġetti ta' użu doppju f'dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的“两用物项”是什么意思？

messages.zh: 这里指既能用于民用目的，也能用于军事目的的东西。
messages.en: Here it means things that can be used for both civilian and military purposes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 użu doppju 记成“用途有两个”：设备语境看两种功能，民用与军事语境看两用物项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Goods intended for people's personal or household use, such as food, clothing, and household appliances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供个人或家庭直接使用或消费的商品，例如食品、衣物和家用电器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti maħsuba għall-użu personali jew domestiku tal-konsumaturi, bħall-ikel, il-ħwejjeġ u l-apparat tad-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供消费者个人或家庭直接使用或消费的商品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li l-konsumaturi jixtru biex jużawhom jew jikkunsmawhom fil-ħajja personali jew fid-dar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer goods are products that people buy for their own personal or household use.

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ iqabbel il-prezzijiet ta' diversi oġġetti tal-konsum, inklużi l-ikel, il-ħwejjeġ u l-apparat tad-dar.
formal.en: The survey compares the prices of various consumer goods, including food, clothing, and household appliances.
formal.zh: 该调查比较了多种消费品的价格，包括食品、衣物和家用电器。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-friġġ li xtrajna għad-dar jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum? David: Iva, għax se nużawh id-dar. Il-ħwejjeġ u l-ikel ukoll huma oġġetti tal-konsum.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the fridge we bought for home count as a consumer good? David: Yes, because we'll use it at home. Clothes and food are consumer goods too.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们给家里买的冰箱算消费品吗？David：算，因为我们会在家里使用它。衣服和食品也都是消费品。

messages.speaker: Nina (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-friġġ li xtrajna għad-dar jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum?
messages.mt_standard: Il-friġġ li xtrajna għad-dar jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum?
messages.zh: 我们给家里买的冰箱算消费品吗？
messages.en: Does the fridge we bought for home count as a consumer good?

messages.speaker: David (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax se nużawh id-dar. Il-ħwejjeġ u l-ikel ukoll huma oġġetti tal-konsum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax se nużawh id-dar. Il-ħwejjeġ u l-ikel ukoll huma oġġetti tal-konsum.
messages.zh: 算，因为我们会在家里使用它。衣服和食品也都是消费品。
messages.en: Yes, because we'll use it at home. Clothes and food are consumer goods too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一家人购物，购物车里有食品、衣服，家里还有冰箱：这些供个人或家庭使用的商品都是 oġġetti tal-konsum。记住“消费品”也包括能长期使用的物品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consumer goods intended for repeated use over a relatively long period, such as furniture and household appliances.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供消费者在较长时期内反复使用的商品，例如家具和家用电器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jinxtraw għall-użu personali jew domestiku u li jistgħu jintużaw ripetutament għal żmien twil, bħal għamara u apparat tad-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可供消费者长期反复使用、通常不会在一次使用后耗尽的耐用消费品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti għall-konsum personali jew domestiku li jdumu jintużaw u li normalment ma jiġux ikkunsmati b'użu wieħed, bħal friġġijiet u għamara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer durables are goods that people buy for repeated use over a long period, such as refrigerators and furniture.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel l-infiq tal-familji fuq oġġetti tal-konsum durabbli, bħall-għamara u l-apparat tad-dar.
formal.en: The report compares household spending on consumer durables, such as furniture and household appliances.
formal.zh: 该报告比较了家庭在家具和家用电器等耐用消费品上的支出。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Il-friġġ jidħol mal-oġġetti tal-konsum durabbli? Pawlu: Iva, għax tużah għal ħafna snin.
colloquial.en: Marta: Does a fridge count as consumer durables? Pawlu: Yes, because you use it for many years.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：冰箱算耐用消费品吗？保罗：算，因为你会用它很多年。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-friġġ jidħol mal-oġġetti tal-konsum durabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Il-friġġ jidħol mal-oġġetti tal-konsum durabbli?
messages.zh: 冰箱算耐用消费品吗？
messages.en: Does a fridge count as consumer durables?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax tużah għal ħafna snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax tużah għal ħafna snin.
messages.zh: 算，因为你会用它很多年。
messages.en: Yes, because you use it for many years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与家里的冰箱、桌椅联系起来：买一次，用多年，就是耐用消费品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Consumer goods that are used up or consumed within a relatively short period, such as food and cleaning products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在较短时间内被吃掉、消耗掉或用尽的消费品，例如食品和清洁用品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti għall-użu personali jew domestiku li jiġu kkunsmati jew jispiċċaw fi żmien relattivament qasir, bħal ikel u prodotti tat-tindif.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在一次或若干次使用后，或在较短时间内便会被消耗掉的非耐用消费品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġetti li jinxtraw għall-konsum personali jew domestiku u li jiġu kkunsmati jew jispiċċaw malajr, minflok jibqgħu jintużaw għal ħafna snin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer non-durables are goods that people consume or use up relatively quickly, such as bread, soap, and detergent.

collocations.mt: il-bejgħ ta' oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli
l-infiq fuq oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli

formal.mt: Fl-istħarriġ, il-ħobż, is-sapun u d-deterġenti huma elenkati bħala oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli.
formal.en: In the survey, bread, soap, and detergents are listed as consumer non-durables.
formal.zh: 在这项调查中，面包、肥皂和洗涤剂被列为非耐用消费品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Is-sapun ukoll jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli? David: Iva, għax jispiċċa hekk kif tużah u jkollok tixtri aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does soap also count as one of the consumer non-durables? David: Yes, because it gets used up as you use it, and you have to buy more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：肥皂也算非耐用消费品吗？戴维：算，因为它会随着使用而消耗掉，你还得再买。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Is-sapun ukoll jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli?
messages.mt_standard: Is-sapun ukoll jgħodd bħala wieħed mill-oġġetti tal-konsum mhux durabbli?
messages.zh: 肥皂也算非耐用消费品吗？
messages.en: Does soap also count as one of the consumer non-durables?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax jispiċċa hekk kif tużah u jkollok tixtri aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax jispiċċa hekk kif tużah u jkollok tixtri aktar.
messages.zh: 算，因为它会随着使用而消耗掉，你还得再买。
messages.en: Yes, because it gets used up as you use it, and you have to buy more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 mhux 的否定作用，再想面包吃完、肥皂用完：短时间会消耗掉的就是非耐用消费品。

gloss_zh: 拿；取（暂定释义，尚不确定）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb provisionally understood as meaning 'to take', although its interpretation remains uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 暂理解为表示“拿、取”的动词；这一解读仍不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Verb li jista' jfisser li tieħu xi ħaġa, iżda din l-interpretazzjoni għadha mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能表示“拿、取”；此释义带有猜测性质，尚未确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Possibbilment ifisser li tieħu xi ħaġa, iżda t-tifsira mhix stabbilita b'ċertezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This verb may mean to take something, but that interpretation remains uncertain.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, 'oħod' għandu t-tifsira proviżorja ta' 'tieħu'; din l-interpretazzjoni teħtieġ konferma.
formal.en: In the exercise, 'oħod' has the provisional meaning 'to take'; this interpretation requires confirmation.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，“oħod”暂释为“拿、取”；这一解读需要确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: 'Oħod' ifisser 'tieħu'? Pawlu: Forsi, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira u l-użu tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does 'oħod' mean 'to take'? Pawlu: Perhaps, but we still need to confirm its meaning and use.
colloquial.zh: Maja：“oħod”是“拿、取”的意思吗？Pawlu：可能是，不过我们还需要确认它的含义和用法。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'Oħod' ifisser 'tieħu'?
messages.mt_standard: 'Oħod' ifisser 'tieħu'?
messages.zh: “oħod”是“拿、取”的意思吗？
messages.en: Does 'oħod' mean 'to take'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira u l-użu tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma għadna rridu nikkonfermaw it-tifsira u l-użu tiegħu.
messages.zh: 可能是，不过我们还需要确认它的含义和用法。
messages.en: Perhaps, but we still need to confirm its meaning and use.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在词卡上把 oħod 与“拿？”一起记，保留问号提醒自己：释义尚待确认，暂不套用变位或实际指令。

gloss_zh: 其他的；别的；其他人或事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to indicate additional or different people or things beyond those already mentioned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于指已经提及的人或事物之外的其他人或事物，表示“其他的、别的”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tindika persuni jew affarijiet addizzjonali jew differenti minn dawk li diġà ssemmew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其他的人或事物；与已经提及的对象不同或另有其余的对象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika persuni jew affarijiet li mhumiex dawk diġà msemmija, jew li jiżdiedu magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Others are additional or different people or things besides those already mentioned.

formal.mt: Minbarra l-istudenti tal-klassi tagħna, studenti oħrajn ħadu sehem fil-proġett.
formal.en: Besides the students in our class, other students took part in the project.
formal.zh: 除了我们班的学生，其他学生也参加了这个项目。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn huma l-kotba kollha? Rita: Le, hemm kotba oħrajn fuq l-ixkaffa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these all the books? Rita: No, there are other books on the shelf.
colloquial.zh: Maja：所有的书都在这里了吗？Rita：没有，架子上还有其他书。

teaching_sense.en_definition: My sister: a female sibling of the person speaking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话人的姐姐或妹妹；这个形式表示“我的姐妹”，本身不区分年长或年幼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oħt il-persuna li qed titkellem, kemm jekk tkun akbar minnha kif ukoll jekk tkun iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姐姐或妹妹；oħti 具体表示“我的姐姐或妹妹”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna femminili li għandha mill-inqas ġenitur wieħed komuni mal-persuna li qed titkellem; hawnhekk tfisser 'l-oħt tiegħi'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you say 'oħti', you mean your own sister, whether she is older or younger than you.

formal.mt: Nixtieq nirringrazzja lil oħti għall-għajnuna tagħha waqt l-istudji tiegħi.
formal.en: I would like to thank my sister for her help during my studies.
formal.zh: 我想感谢我的姐妹在我求学期间给予的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma' min sejjer il-belt? Pawlu: Ma' oħti. Se nixtru rigal għal ommna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who are you going to town with? Pawlu: With my sister. We are going to buy a present for our mother.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你和谁一起进城？Pawlu：和我的姐妹。我们要给妈妈买一份礼物。
