teaching_sense.en_definition: The sister of the male person being referred to.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 所指男性的姐姐或妹妹；这个词本身不区分姐姐和妹妹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-oħt tar-raġel jew tat-tifel li jkun qed jissemma, kemm jekk tkun ikbar minnu kif ukoll jekk tkun iżgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姐姐或妹妹；oħtu 具体表示“他的姐姐或妹妹”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna ta' sess femminili li għandha mill-inqas ġenitur wieħed komuni ma' persuna oħra; oħtu tindika l-oħt tar-raġel jew tat-tifel imsemmi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sister is a female sibling, and oħtu identifies her as the sister of the male person being discussed.

collocations.zh: 和他的姐姐或妹妹一起去

formal.mt: Pawlu attenda ċ-ċerimonja flimkien ma' oħtu l-kbira, li kienet mistiedna wkoll.
formal.en: Paul attended the ceremony with his older sister, who had also been invited.
formal.zh: 保罗和他的姐姐一同出席了典礼，她也受到了邀请。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min hi dik ma' Pawlu? Anna: Dik oħtu. Ġiet miegħu għall-festa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who is that with Paul? Anna: That's his sister. She came with him to the party.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：和保罗在一起的那位是谁？安娜：那是他的姐姐或妹妹。她和他一起来参加聚会。

gloss_zh: Paceville，马耳他圣朱利安斯的一处地区，也是热门娱乐场所

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area in St Julians, Malta, known as a popular entertainment spot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他圣朱利安斯的一处地区，以热门娱乐去处而为人所知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona f'San Ġiljan, Malta, magħrufa bħala post popolari għad-divertiment.

sense_translations.en_definition: Paceville, an area in St Julians in Malta, also a popoular entertainment spot
sense_translations.zh_definition: Paceville，位于马耳他圣朱利安斯的一处地区，也是热门的娱乐去处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Paceville hija żona f'San Ġiljan, Malta, li hija wkoll post popolari għad-divertiment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Paceville is an area of St Julians in Malta that is popular for entertainment.

collocations.en: to spend an evening in Paceville
collocations.zh: 在 Paceville 度过一个晚上

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi lejla f'Paceville, żona f'San Ġiljan magħrufa għad-divertiment.
formal.en: The visit programme includes an evening in Paceville, an area of St Julians known for entertainment.
formal.zh: 参观行程安排了一个晚上在 Paceville 活动；这里是圣朱利安斯以娱乐闻名的地区。

messages.en: Yes, but let's meet at eight.

gloss_zh: 连词；所给释义“p i u”含义不明，无法确定具体中文对应词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A conjunction whose supplied gloss, 'p i u', does not establish a clear meaning or usage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 词性标为连词，但所给释义“p i u”不足以确定其具体意义和连接方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Konġunzjoni li l-glossa mogħtija tagħha, 'p i u', mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex jiġu stabbiliti t-tifsira u l-użu tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 原释义为“p i u”，含义尚不明确，不能可靠译成具体的中文连词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-glossa mogħtija għal din il-konġunzjoni hija 'p i u', iżda din ma tagħtix informazzjoni biżżejjed biex tiġi spjegata t-tifsira tagħha.

collocations.zh: 连词“pachichu”（用于讨论词语本身）

collocations.en: the meaning of 'pachichu' (a phrase discussing the word itself)

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'pachichu' hija mmarkata bħala konġunzjoni, iżda l-glossa 'p i u' mhijiex biżżejjed biex nispjegaw l-użu tagħha.
formal.en: The word 'pachichu' is labelled as a conjunction, but the gloss 'p i u' is insufficient to explain its usage.
formal.zh: “pachichu”被标为连词，但释义“p i u”不足以说明它的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short pole with a broad blade, held in the hands to move and steer a small boat through water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有宽阔桨叶、用手握持并在水中划动，以推动或操纵小船的桨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u xafra wiesgħa li tinżamm bl-idejn u tintuża biex tmexxi jew iddawwar dgħajsa żgħira fl-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划小船时用手握持、以桨叶拨水来推进或转向的桨。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda b'manku u xafra wiesgħa li persuna ddaħħal fl-ilma u tiġbed biex tmexxi jew tiggwida dgħajsa żgħira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A paddle is an implement with a broad blade that you hold and move through water to propel or steer a small boat.

formal.mt: Qabel jidħol fl-ilma bil-kayak, kull parteċipant għandu jitgħallem kif iżomm u juża l-paddle.
formal.en: Before taking a kayak onto the water, each participant must learn how to hold and use the paddle.
formal.zh: 每位参与者在划皮划艇下水前，都必须学习如何握桨和用桨。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tgħaddili l-paddle? Pawlu: Iva, hawn hu. Żommu sew meta tibda taqdef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you pass me the paddle? Pawlu: Yes, here it is. Hold it firmly when you start paddling.
colloquial.zh: Maja：能把船桨递给我吗？Pawlu：可以，给你。开始划的时候要握稳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili l-paddle?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili l-paddle?

messages.en: Can you pass me the paddle?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

messages.en: Yes, here it is. Hold it firmly when you start paddling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象自己坐在小艇上，双手握着宽桨叶的船桨拨水；把 paddle 的词形与“握桨、划水、前进”三个动作连起来记。

gloss_zh: 主人；掌管者；支持或庇护他人的赞助人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has authority or control over a place, property, or people working under them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某处场所、财产或其手下工作人员具有支配权或管理权的人，即主人或掌管者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha s-setgħa jew il-kontroll fuq post, proprjetà jew nies li jaħdmu taħt it-tmexxija tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主人；对某处场所、财产或手下人员具有支配权的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-awtorità fuq post, proprjetà jew persuni oħra u li tista' tiddeċiedi kif jitmexxew l-affarijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A master is a person who has authority over a place, property, or other people and can direct what happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞助人；为某个人、团体或事业提供支持或庇护的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti appoġġ jew protezzjoni lil persuna oħra, lil grupp jew lil xi ħidma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patron is someone who supports or protects a person, group, or activity, sometimes by providing money or other help.

collocations.en: the person in charge of the shop

formal.mt: Bħala padrun tal-arti, huwa ta appoġġ finanzjarju lill-grupp biex jorganizza wirja ġdida.
formal.en: As a patron of the arts, he gave the group financial support to organise a new exhibition.
formal.zh: 作为艺术赞助人，他为该团体举办新展览提供了资金支持。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu l-padrun ta' dan il-ħanut? Pawlu: Dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb. Tista' tkellmu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the master of this shop? Pawlu: That man by the door. You can speak to him now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这家店的主人是谁？Pawlu：门旁边那位男士。你现在可以去跟他说话。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-padrun ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-padrun ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 这家店的主人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the master of this shop?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb. Tista' tkellmu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel ħdejn il-bieb. Tista' tkellmu issa.
messages.zh: 门旁边那位男士。你现在可以去跟他说话。
messages.en: That man by the door. You can speak to him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张人物卡分开记：店里作决定的是“主人”，为艺术活动提供支持的是“赞助人”；看到 padrun 时让语境帮助选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money paid regularly for work, or a fixed allowance paid during study or training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因工作而定期领取的工资或薪金，也可指学习或培训期间领取的固定津贴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Somma flus li persuna tirċievi regolarment għax-xogħol tagħha, jew bħala għajnuna finanzjarja fissa waqt l-istudju jew it-taħriġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工资，通常按工时、工作日或工作量计算的劳动报酬。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li ħaddiem jirċievi għax-xogħol tiegħu, spiss ikkalkulat skont is-sigħat jew il-ġranet li jkun ħadem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wage is money paid to someone for work, often calculated according to the hours or days worked.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 薪金，按固定周期发放的约定工作报酬，通常按月支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas regolari u fiss li impjegat jirċievi għax-xogħol tiegħu, normalment kull xahar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A salary is a fixed amount of money that an employee receives regularly, usually each month, for their work.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定期发放的固定津贴，常用于支持学习、培训或某项指定工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma fissa li tingħata regolarment biex tgħin persuna waqt l-istudju, it-taħriġ jew xogħol speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A stipend is a fixed sum paid regularly to support someone during study, training, or a particular assignment.

formal.mt: Skont il-kuntratt, il-paga titħallas fl-aħħar jum tax-xogħol ta' kull xahar.
formal.en: Under the contract, the salary is paid on the last working day of each month.
formal.zh: 根据合同，薪金于每月最后一个工作日发放。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Daħlet il-paga tiegħek illum? Pawlu: Iva, u se nwarrab ftit flus għall-kera.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did your pay come in today? Pawlu: Yes, and I'm going to set aside some money for the rent.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你今天收到工资了吗？保罗：收到了，我打算留出一些钱交房租。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħlet il-paga tiegħek illum?
messages.mt_standard: Daħlet il-paga tiegħek illum?
messages.zh: 你今天收到工资了吗？
messages.en: Did your pay come in today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u se nwarrab ftit flus għall-kera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u se nwarrab ftit flus għall-kera.
messages.zh: 收到了，我打算留出一些钱交房租。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm going to set aside some money for the rent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paga 放进“每月工资到账”的画面记忆；再按语境区分计时工资、固定薪金和学习培训津贴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The total wages of a specified group divided by the number of people in that group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将指定群体的工资总额除以该群体人数所得的平均工资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont li jinkiseb meta t-total tal-pagi ta' grupp speċifiku jinqasam bin-numru ta' persuni f'dak il-grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平均工资，指某一群体在相同统计期间内的工资总额除以人数所得的数值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-valur li jinkiseb billi t-total tal-pagi ta' grupp għall-istess perjodu jinqasam bin-numru ta' persuni fil-grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The average wage is the amount obtained by dividing a group's total wages for a given period by the number of people in that group.

collocations.en: an increase in the average wage

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-paga medja fix-xahar ta' dan il-grupp żdiedet meta mqabbla mas-sena ta' qabel.
formal.en: The report shows that this group's average monthly wage increased compared with the previous year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该群体的平均月工资较上一年有所增长。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-paga medja hi l-paga li jieħu kulħadd? Mark: Le, xi nies jaqilgħu aktar minnha u oħrajn inqas.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the average wage what everyone earns? Mark: No, some people earn more than that and others less.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：平均工资就是每个人拿到的工资吗？马克：不是，有些人挣得比这个数多，有些人挣得少。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-paga medja hi l-paga li jieħu kulħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Il-paga medja hi l-paga li jieħu kulħadd?
messages.zh: 平均工资就是每个人拿到的工资吗？
messages.en: Is the average wage what everyone earns?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, xi nies jaqilgħu aktar minnha u oħrajn inqas.
messages.mt_standard: Le, xi nies jaqilgħu aktar minnha u oħrajn inqas.
messages.zh: 不是，有些人挣得比这个数多，有些人挣得少。
messages.en: No, some people earn more than that and others less.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工资总额除以人数”的算式记住 paga medja：它是群体平均值，不代表人人都领到这个数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment arranged to be made at a later date instead of immediately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按约定在较晚日期支付，而非立即支付的款项或付款安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas li jkun miftiehem li jsir f'data aktar tard minflok minnufih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延期付款，指依照约定将款项推迟至较晚日期支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li, skont ftehim, jitħalla għal data aktar tard minflok ma jsir fil-ħin tax-xiri jew tal-provvista tas-servizz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deferred payment is a payment that an agreement allows you to make at a later date instead of immediately.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jippermetti pagament differit, u l-ammont kollu għandu jitħallas sittin jum wara l-kunsinna.
formal.en: The agreement allows deferred payment, and the full amount must be paid sixty days after delivery.
formal.zh: 协议允许延期付款，全部款项须于交货后六十天支付。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid inħallas illum stess? Toni: Le, b'dan il-pagament differit tista' tħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I have to pay today? Toni: No, with this deferred payment arrangement you can pay next month.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我必须今天就付款吗？托尼：不用，按这项延期付款安排，你可以下个月支付。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid inħallas illum stess?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid inħallas illum stess?
messages.zh: 我必须今天就付款吗？
messages.en: Do I have to pay today?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, b'dan il-pagament differit tista' tħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, b'dan il-pagament differit tista' tħallas ix-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 不用，按这项延期付款安排，你可以下个月支付。
messages.en: No, with this deferred payment arrangement you can pay next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把付款提醒移到日历上的约定日期，以此记住 pagament differit；重点是付款时间延后，不一定分期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment made electronically rather than by handing over cash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子方式完成的付款，而非直接交付现金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir b'mezz elettroniku minflok billi jingħataw flus kontanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子支付，即通过电子系统完成的付款。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jitwettaq permezz ta' sistema elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-payment is a payment that you make through an electronic system.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子付款，指使用电子方式而非交付现金完成的支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir b'mezzi elettroniċi mingħajr ma jingħataw flus kontanti direttament.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic payment transfers money electronically instead of requiring you to hand over cash.

formal.mt: Wara li tagħmel pagament elettroniku, żomm il-konferma tal-ħlas għar-rekords tiegħek.
formal.en: After making an electronic payment, keep the payment confirmation for your records.
formal.zh: 完成电子支付后，请保留付款确认凭证以备查阅。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nagħmel pagament elettroniku? Rita: Iva, tista' tħallas bil-kard.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can I make an electronic payment? Rita: Yes, you can pay by card.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我可以用电子方式付款吗？Rita：可以，你可以刷卡付款。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħmel pagament elettroniku?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħmel pagament elettroniku?
messages.zh: 我可以用电子方式付款吗？
messages.en: Can I make an electronic payment?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tħallas bil-kard.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tħallas bil-kard.
messages.zh: 可以，你可以刷卡付款。
messages.en: Yes, you can pay by card.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和刷卡付款的画面绑定记忆，再配上“进行付款”和“收到付款”两个动作练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A payment made using an electronic system, such as a card, banking app, or online service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过银行卡、银行应用或在线服务等电子系统完成的付款。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir permezz ta' sistema elettronika, bħal kard bankarja, applikazzjoni tal-bank jew servizz fuq l-internet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子支付，指借助电子设备或电子系统完成款项支付。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas li jsir bl-użu ta' apparat jew sistema elettronika biex il-flus jgħaddu minn min iħallas għal min jirċevihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An e-payment is a payment made through an electronic device or system, such as a banking app or an online payment service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子付款，指通过电子系统转移资金以支付商品、服务或其他应付款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħlas għal oġġetti, servizzi jew ammonti oħra dovuti, li jsir billi l-flus jiġu trasferiti permezz ta' sistema elettronika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An electronic payment is a transfer of money through an electronic system to pay for goods, services, or other amounts owed.

formal.mt: Wara li jsir il-pagament-e, is-sistema tibgħat konferma lill-klijent permezz tal-posta elettronika.
formal.en: After the electronic payment is made, the system sends the customer a confirmation by email.
formal.zh: 电子付款完成后，系统会通过电子邮件向客户发送确认信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nagħmel pagament-e minn fuq il-mowbajl? David: Iva, u meta tlesti tara l-konferma fuq l-iskrin.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I make an electronic payment on my phone? David: Yes, and when you finish you'll see the confirmation on the screen.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以用手机进行电子支付吗？戴维：可以，完成后你会在屏幕上看到付款确认。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nagħmel pagament-e minn fuq il-mowbajl?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nagħmel pagament-e minn fuq il-mowbajl?
messages.zh: 我可以用手机进行电子支付吗？
messages.en: Can I make an electronic payment on my phone?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u meta tlesti tara l-konferma fuq l-iskrin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u meta tlesti tara l-konferma fuq l-iskrin.
messages.zh: 可以，完成后你会在屏幕上看到付款确认。
messages.en: Yes, and when you finish you'll see the confirmation on the screen.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pagament-e 与“手机付款后出现确认画面”一起记忆；本条的两个英文义项都表示电子支付。

gloss_zh: 通过交易制造虚假交投或价格表象的市场操纵行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: Market manipulation in which trades create a misleading impression of trading activity or price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过安排交易，使市场交投活跃程度或价格呈现误导性表象的操纵行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Manipulazzjoni tas-suq li fiha jsiru tranżazzjonijiet biex tinħoloq impressjoni qarrieqa tal-attività tan-negozju jew tal-prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种市场操纵行为，通过交易制造关于交投活动或价格的误导性印象。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika ta' manipulazzjoni tas-suq li tuża tranżazzjonijiet biex tagħti stampa qarrieqa tal-attività tan-negozju jew tal-prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Painting the tape occurs when trades are used to give other market participants a misleading impression of activity or price.

collocations.en: a case of painting the tape
collocations.zh: 一起制造虚假交投表象的市场操纵案件
涉嫌通过交易制造虚假市场表象
调查制造虚假交投表象的行为

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' painting the tape li fih it-tranżazzjonijiet ħolqu impressjoni qarrieqa ta' attività fis-suq.
formal.en: The report describes a case of painting the tape in which transactions created a misleading impression of market activity.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起通过交易制造市场活跃假象的操纵案例。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu painting the tape? Karl: Huwa meta jsiru tranżazzjonijiet biex l-attività jew il-prezz fis-suq jidhru b'mod qarrieqi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is painting the tape? Karl: It is when trades are made to give a misleading impression of market activity or price.
colloquial.zh: Maja：painting the tape 是什么意思？Karl：就是通过交易，让市场活动或价格呈现误导性的表象。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu painting the tape?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu painting the tape?
messages.zh: painting the tape 是什么意思？
messages.en: What is painting the tape?

messages.speaker: Karl (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta jsiru tranżazzjonijiet biex l-attività jew il-prezz fis-suq jidhru b'mod qarrieqi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta jsiru tranżazzjonijiet biex l-attività jew il-prezz fis-suq jidhru b'mod qarrieqi.
messages.zh: 就是通过交易，让市场活动或价格呈现误导性的表象。
messages.en: It is when trades are made to give a misleading impression of market activity or price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成给交易画面涂上虚假颜色：屏幕看起来很活跃，却可能是交易刻意制造的表象。这只是记忆比喻。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country to which a person, shipment, or other item is being sent or is travelling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人员前往或货物等被运送到的国家，即目的地所在国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż li lejh tkun sejra persuna jew li lejh ikunu qed jintbagħtu oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目的地国家，即人员行程或货物运送所指向的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż li jkun id-destinazzjoni ta' vjaġġ jew ta' oġġetti li jintbagħtu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The country of destination is the country that someone is travelling to or that goods are being sent to.

collocations.en: arrive in the country of destination
the requirements of the country of destination

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok speċifika l-pajjiż destinatarju u l-indirizz sħiħ tar-riċevitur fuq il-formola.
formal.en: Please specify the country of destination and the recipient's full address on the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格上注明目的国及收件人的完整地址。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn 'pajjiż destinatarju'? Pawlu: Ikteb l-Italja, għax il-pakkett sejjer Ruma.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I write next to 'country of destination'? Pawlu: Write Italy, because the parcel is going to Rome.
colloquial.zh: Nina：“目的国”旁边应该填什么？Pawlu：填意大利，因为包裹要寄到罗马。

messages.speaker: Nina (寄件人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn 'pajjiż destinatarju'?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nikteb ħdejn 'pajjiż destinatarju'?
messages.zh: “目的国”旁边应该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write next to 'country of destination'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邮局职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb l-Italja, għax il-pakkett sejjer Ruma.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb l-Italja, għax il-pakkett sejjer Ruma.
messages.zh: 填意大利，因为包裹要寄到罗马。
messages.en: Write Italy, because the parcel is going to Rome.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条从寄件地指向收件地的箭头，把箭头终点所在的国家标成 pajjiż destinatarju，记住表格里应填国家名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country situated next to another country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于另一个国家旁边的国家，即邻国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jinsab maġenb pajjiż ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在地理位置上与另一个国家相邻的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jinsab eżatt ħdejn pajjiż ieħor u għalhekk jitqies bħala ġar tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An adjacent country is a country situated immediately next to another.

collocations.en: trade with a country next to ours

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jagħżlu pajjiż maġenb Franza u jiddeskrivu l-pożizzjoni tiegħu fuq il-mappa.
formal.en: Students should choose a country next to France and describe its position on the map.
formal.zh: 学生应选择一个与法国相邻的国家，并描述它在地图上的位置。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Wara Franza, fejn se mmorru? Karl: Nistgħu nżuru pajjiż maġenb Franza, bħall-Belġju.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where shall we go after France? Karl: We can visit a country next to France, such as Belgium.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：去完法国后，我们去哪里？卡尔：我们可以去法国的一个邻国，比如比利时。

messages.speaker: Marta (旅行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara Franza, fejn se mmorru?
messages.mt_standard: Wara Franza, fejn se mmorru?
messages.zh: 去完法国后，我们去哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we go after France?

messages.speaker: Karl (旅行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nżuru pajjiż maġenb Franza, bħall-Belġju.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nżuru pajjiż maġenb Franza, bħall-Belġju.
messages.zh: 我们可以去法国的一个邻国，比如比利时。
messages.en: We can visit a country next to France, such as Belgium.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上并排站着两个国家，把 maġenb 记成“在旁边”；后面接国家名，说明是谁的邻国。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country that cooperates with another country or organisation in an activity or agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某项活动、项目或协议中与另一国家或组织开展合作的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jaħdem flimkien ma' pajjiż ieħor jew ma' organizzazzjoni f'attività, proġett jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在特定项目、协议或合作关系中作为伙伴参与的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jieħu sehem bħala sieħeb f'relazzjoni ta' kooperazzjoni ma' pajjiż ieħor jew ma' organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A partner country is a country that works with another country or organisation towards shared aims.

collocations.en: an agreement with a partner country
a partner country in the project

formal.mt: Kull pajjiż sieħeb fil-proġett għandu jippreżenta rapport annwali dwar ir-riżultati miksuba.
formal.en: Each partner country in the project must submit an annual report on the results achieved.
formal.zh: 参与该项目的每个伙伴国都必须提交一份关于已取得成果的年度报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Minn fejn ġejjin l-istudenti li se jżuruna? Pawlu: Ġejjin minn pajjiż sieħeb fil-proġett tal-iskola tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where are the students who are coming to visit us from? Pawlu: They are coming from a partner country in our school's project.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：要来访问我们的学生来自哪里？保罗：他们来自我们学校项目的一个伙伴国。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn ġejjin l-istudenti li se jżuruna?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn ġejjin l-istudenti li se jżuruna?
messages.zh: 要来访问我们的学生来自哪里？
messages.en: Where are the students who are coming to visit us from?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġejjin minn pajjiż sieħeb fil-proġett tal-iskola tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Ġejjin minn pajjiż sieħeb fil-proġett tal-iskola tagħna.
messages.zh: 他们来自我们学校项目的一个伙伴国。
messages.en: They are coming from a partner country in our school's project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把国家想成一起完成小组作业的伙伴：pajjiż sieħeb 就是合作项目中的“伙伴国”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country from which a person, object or consignment comes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人员、物品或一批货物所来自的国家，具体所指取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż li minnu tkun ġejja persuna, oġġett jew kunsinna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某人、某物或某批货物的来源国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż minn fejn tiġi persuna jew minn fejn ikun ġej oġġett jew tkun ġejja kunsinna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The country of provenance is the country from which a person or thing comes.

collocations.en: to indicate the country of provenance
the country of provenance of the consignment

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, imla l-formola billi tindika l-pajjiż ta' provenjenza ta' kull kunsinna.
formal.en: For this exercise, complete the form by indicating the country of provenance of each consignment.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，请填写表格，注明每批货物的来源国。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandi nikteb fil-kaxxa tal-pajjiż ta' provenjenza? Mark: Ikteb minn liema pajjiż ġie dan il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should I write in the country of provenance box? Mark: Write which country this parcel came from.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：来源国这一栏我该填什么？马克：填这个包裹来自哪个国家。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nikteb fil-kaxxa tal-pajjiż ta' provenjenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nikteb fil-kaxxa tal-pajjiż ta' provenjenza?
messages.zh: 来源国这一栏我该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write in the country of provenance box?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb minn liema pajjiż ġie dan il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb minn liema pajjiż ġie dan il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 填这个包裹来自哪个国家。
messages.en: Write which country this parcel came from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象沿着包裹的来路倒着追踪到一个国家：pajjiż ta' provenjenza 回答的就是“来自哪个国家”。

gloss_zh: 第三国；欧盟以外的国家

teaching_sense.en_definition: A country outside the European Union, or outside the countries directly involved in a particular agreement or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指欧盟以外的国家，也可指某项协议或某种关系所涉及国家之外的第三国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li mhuwiex membru tal-Unjoni Ewropea, jew li mhuwiex wieħed mill-pajjiżi involuti direttament fi ftehim jew f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不属于欧盟的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż li mhuwiex membru tal-Unjoni Ewropea.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-EU country is a country that does not belong to the European Union.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非欧盟成员国；未加入欧盟的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stat li ma jagħmilx parti mill-Unjoni Ewropea.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-EU state is a state that is not a member of the European Union.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第三国，即某项协议、关系或事务所涉及国家之外的另一个国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pajjiż li mhuwiex wieħed mill-pajjiżi involuti direttament fi ftehim, f'relazzjoni jew fi kwistjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A third country is a country outside the countries directly involved in a particular agreement or situation.

collocations.en: a citizen of a third country

formal.mt: F'dan id-dokument, it-terminu 'pajjiż terz' jirreferi għal pajjiż li mhuwiex membru tal-Unjoni Ewropea.
formal.en: In this document, the term 'third country' refers to a country that is not a member of the European Union.
formal.zh: 在本文件中，“第三国”一词指不属于欧盟的国家。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jiġifieri 'pajjiż terz' fuq din il-formola? Mark: Hawnhekk ifisser pajjiż barra mill-Unjoni Ewropea.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'third country' mean on this form? Mark: Here it means a country outside the European Union.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张表上的“第三国”是什么意思？Mark：这里指欧盟以外的国家。

messages.speaker: Maja (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri 'pajjiż terz' fuq din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri 'pajjiż terz' fuq din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表上的“第三国”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'third country' mean on this form?

messages.speaker: Mark (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser pajjiż barra mill-Unjoni Ewropea.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser pajjiż barra mill-Unjoni Ewropea.
messages.zh: 这里指欧盟以外的国家。
messages.en: Here it means a country outside the European Union.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“圈外的国家”：欧盟语境中画一个成员国圆圈，圈外标上 pajjiż terz；这里的“第三”不是国家排名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The country that you belong to or regard as your own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 你所属或认同为自己国家的国家；在具体语境中可指你的祖国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż li inti tappartjeni għalih jew li tqis bħala tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 你所属或认同为自己国家的国家。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pajjiż li inti tappartjeni għalih, pereżempju għax inti ċittadin tiegħu jew għax tqisu bħala pajjiż twelidek.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your country is the country you belong to or consider your own.

formal.mt: F'dan l-esej, iddeskrivi tradizzjoni importanti f'pajjiżek u spjega għaliex għadha popolari.
formal.en: In this essay, describe an important tradition in your country and explain why it is still popular.
formal.zh: 在这篇作文中，请描述你国家的一项重要传统，并解释它为何至今仍然流行。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'ikel huwa popolari f'pajjiżek? Wei: Ir-ross huwa komuni ħafna, imma l-platti jvarjaw minn reġjun għal ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lina: What food is popular in your country? Wei: Rice is very common, but the dishes vary from region to region.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：你们国家什么食物很受欢迎？魏：米饭很常见，不过各地的菜肴各不相同。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ikel huwa popolari f'pajjiżek?
messages.mt_standard: X'ikel huwa popolari f'pajjiżek?
messages.zh: 你们国家什么食物很受欢迎？
messages.en: What food is popular in your country?

messages.speaker: Wei (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-ross huwa komuni ħafna, imma l-platti jvarjaw minn reġjun għal ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-ross huwa komuni ħafna, imma l-platti jvarjaw minn reġjun għal ieħor.
messages.zh: 米饭很常见，不过各地的菜肴各不相同。
messages.en: Rice is very common, but the dishes vary from region to region.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pajjiżek 放进“介绍你的国家”这一场景：别人指着地图问你，你就想到“你的国家”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large tropical fruit with a rough skin, a crown of stiff leaves, and sweet yellow flesh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种表皮粗糙、顶部有硬叶、果肉呈黄色且味甜的热带水果，即菠萝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali kbira b'qoxra ħarxa, b'weraq iebes fil-quċċata u b'laħam isfar u ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菠萝，亦称凤梨；一种外皮粗糙、顶部有叶冠、果肉黄色的热带水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali li għandha qoxra ħarxa, weraq iebes fil-quċċata u laħam isfar li jkun ħelu meta jimmatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pineapple is a tropical fruit with rough skin, stiff leaves at the top, and sweet yellow flesh.

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata tal-frott, qaxxar il-pajnapil u aqta' l-laħam tiegħu f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this fruit salad, peel the pineapple and cut its flesh into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道水果沙拉时，先给菠萝去皮，再把果肉切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid ftit pajnapil mal-jogurt? Ben: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like some pineapple with your yogurt? Ben: Yes, please. Cut me two pieces.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想在酸奶里加点菠萝吗？Ben：好的，谢谢。给我切两块吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit pajnapil mal-jogurt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit pajnapil mal-jogurt?
messages.zh: 你想在酸奶里加点菠萝吗？
messages.en: Would you like some pineapple with your yogurt?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli żewġ biċċiet.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。给我切两块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut me two pieces.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记忆：给一个戴着绿色叶冠的菠萝贴上 pajnapil 标签，再把切块和榨汁两个动作一起联想，巩固水果名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The visible features of an area of land, considered together as a view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某片地域中可以看到的地貌、植被等共同构成的景观或风景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Id-dehra ġenerali ta' medda art, magħmula mill-għoljiet, il-veġetazzjoni u elementi oħra li jidhru fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 景观；一片地域的地形、植被等可见要素共同形成的整体景色。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Id-dehra ta' medda art meta l-elementi viżibbli tagħha, bħall-għoljiet, is-siġar u l-bini, jitqiesu flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The landscape of an area is the overall appearance formed by its visible features, such as hills, vegetation, and buildings.

formal.mt: Ir-ritratt juri pajsaġġ rurali b'għelieqi, ħitan tas-sejjieħ u ftit djar.
formal.en: The photograph shows a rural landscape with fields, rubble walls, and a few houses.
formal.zh: 照片展现了一片乡村景观，其中有田地、干砌石墙和几栋房屋。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-pajsaġġ minn hawn! Pawlu: Veru! Ejja nieħdu ritratt qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look how beautiful the landscape is from here! Pawlu: It really is! Let's take a photo before we leave.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看，从这里望出去的风景多美啊！Pawlu：真是！咱们走之前拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-pajsaġġ minn hawn!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu sabiħ il-pajsaġġ minn hawn!
messages.zh: 你看，从这里望出去的风景多美啊！
messages.en: Look how beautiful the landscape is from here!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ejja nieħdu ritratt qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ejja nieħdu ritratt qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 真是！咱们走之前拍张照吧。
messages.en: It really is! Let's take a photo before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pajsaġġ 写在一张全景照片下：让田野、山坡和房屋一起进入画面，提醒自己这个词指它们共同构成的整体景观。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item or group of items wrapped or enclosed together, especially for sale, transport, or delivery.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包在一起或装在同一包装内的一件或多件物品，常用于出售、运输或递送。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew grupp ta' oġġetti mgeżwra jew magħluqa flimkien f'kaxxa jew f'tgeżwir, speċjalment għall-bejgħ, għat-trasport jew għall-kunsinna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包；包装件，指包装在一起以便出售、携带或运输的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew għadd ta' oġġetti magħluqa flimkien f'tgeżwir jew f'kontenitur għall-bejgħ, għall-ġarr jew għat-trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A package is an item or group of items enclosed together in wrapping or a container for sale or transport.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包裹，指包好后供邮寄或递送的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew grupp ta' oġġetti mgeżwra jew imqiegħda f'kaxxa biex jintbagħtu bil-posta jew jitwasslu lil xi ħadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A parcel is a wrapped item or box of items that is sent by post or delivered to someone.

collocations.en: to send a parcel by post

formal.mt: Qabel tibgħat il-pakkett bil-posta, ikteb l-isem u l-indirizz tar-riċevitur b'mod ċar fuq in-naħa ta' barra.
formal.en: Before sending the parcel by post, write the recipient's name and address clearly on the outside.
formal.zh: 邮寄包裹前，请在包装外侧清楚写明收件人的姓名和地址。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Wasal il-pakkett li kont qed tistenna? David: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Poġġejtu fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the parcel you were waiting for arrived? David: Yes, it arrived this morning. I put it on the table.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你一直在等的包裹到了吗？David：到了，今天早上到的。我把它放在桌上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal il-pakkett li kont qed tistenna?
messages.mt_standard: Wasal il-pakkett li kont qed tistenna?
messages.zh: 你一直在等的包裹到了吗？
messages.en: Has the parcel you were waiting for arrived?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Poġġejtu fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Poġġejtu fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。我把它放在桌上了。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. I put it on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pakkett 和“包在一起”绑定记忆：商店里的一包饼干和邮递员送来的包裹都可用它表示，再靠购物或邮寄场景区分具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A package of goods grouped together as a single unit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将若干商品组合为一个单位的商品包或成套货品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pakkett ta' prodotti miġbura flimkien bħala unità waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将商品集中包装或组合供应的商品包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pakkett li jiġbor fih għadd ta' prodotti biex jiġu pprovduti flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A goods package is a collection of products supplied together as one unit.

collocations.en: the contents of the goods package
the delivery of the goods package

formal.mt: Il-pakkett dwar il-prodotti għandu jkun fih lista ċara tal-oġġetti inklużi.
formal.en: The goods package must contain a clear list of the items included.
formal.zh: 商品包内必须附有清晰的所含物品清单。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wasal il-pakkett dwar il-prodotti? Mark: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Niftħuh flimkien?
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the goods package arrived? Mark: Yes, it arrived this morning. Shall we open it together?
colloquial.zh: Maja：商品包到了吗？Mark：到了，今天早上到的。我们一起打开看看？

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal il-pakkett dwar il-prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Wasal il-pakkett dwar il-prodotti?
messages.zh: 商品包到了吗？
messages.en: Has the goods package arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Niftħuh flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wasal dalgħodu. Niftħuh flimkien?
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。我们一起打开看看？
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. Shall we open it together?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语配上一张商品组合包图片，联想清点包内货品的场景来记忆。

exact_key: pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża
gloss_zh: 不可重复使用的包装；单次使用包装

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pack intended for a single use that cannot be used again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供单次使用、使用后不能再次使用的包装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pakkett maħsub għal użu wieħed biss li ma jkunx jista' jintuża mill-ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用一次后不能再次使用的包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pakkett li ma jistax jerġa' jintuża wara l-ewwel użu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-reusable pack cannot be used again after its initial use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使用后不再返回包装使用循环的单次使用包装。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ippakkjar maħsub għal użu wieħed biss, mingħajr ma jerġa' jidħol f'ċiklu ta' użu bħala pakkett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: One-way packaging is used once and does not return for another packaging cycle.

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża
collocations.en: the use of a non-reusable pack
collocations.zh: 不可重复使用包装的使用

collocations.mt: alternattiva għal pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża
collocations.en: an alternative to a non-reusable pack
collocations.zh: 不可重复使用包装的替代品

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tfittex alternattiva għal pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża.
formal.en: The company is seeking an alternative to a non-reusable pack.
formal.zh: 公司正在寻找不可重复使用包装的替代品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan hu pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża? Pawlu: Iva, għalhekk id-dar nuża kaxxa li nista' nuża ħafna drabi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this a non-reusable pack? Pawlu: Yes, so at home I use a box that I can use many times.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这是不能重复使用的包装吗？Pawlu：是的，所以我在家用的是可以反复使用的盒子。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu pakkett li ma jkunx jista' jerġa' jintuża?
messages.zh: 这是不能重复使用的包装吗？
messages.en: Is this a non-reusable pack?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għalhekk id-dar nuża kaxxa li nista' nuża ħafna drabi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għalhekk id-dar nuża kaxxa li nista' nuża ħafna drabi.
messages.zh: 是的，所以我在家用的是可以反复使用的盒子。
messages.en: Yes, so at home I use a box that I can use many times.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分段记成“包装／不能／再次／被使用”，再想象包装上标着只能用一次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An outer box containing several smaller packs of cigarettes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 装有若干小包香烟的外层条盒，也指这样一整条香烟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa ta' barra li fiha jkun hemm diversi pakketti iżgħar tas-sigaretti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装有多包香烟的条盒；一整条香烟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kaxxa li tiġbor fiha diversi pakketti tas-sigaretti bħala unità waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A carton is an outer box holding several individual packs of cigarettes.

collocations.en: the contents of a cigarette carton

formal.mt: Waqt il-kontroll tal-inventarju, instab pakkett sigeretti bil-kaxxa ta' barra miftuħa.
formal.en: During the inventory check, a carton of cigarettes was found with its outer box open.
formal.zh: 盘点库存时，发现一条香烟的外层条盒已经打开。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-pakkett sigeretti? Toni: Fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq, ħdejn il-kaxxi l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where should I put this carton of cigarettes? Toni: On the top shelf, next to the other boxes.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这条香烟放在哪里？Toni：放在最上层架子上，其他盒子旁边。

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-pakkett sigeretti?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-pakkett sigeretti?
messages.zh: 这条香烟放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this carton of cigarettes?

messages.speaker: Toni (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq, ħdejn il-kaxxi l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq, ħdejn il-kaxxi l-oħra.
messages.zh: 放在最上层架子上，其他盒子旁边。
messages.en: On the top shelf, next to the other boxes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本条的 carton 义记忆：想象一个长条外盒，里面排列着多包香烟。

gloss_zh: 马耳他语表达（具体含义未明确）

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression identified as Maltese whose specific meaning is not established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 标为马耳他语的表达，其具体词义和语法功能尚未明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni identifikata bħala Maltija li t-tifsira speċifika u l-funzjoni grammatikali tagħha mhumiex stabbiliti hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他语；此处用于标明该表达的语言，具体含义未明确。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikazzjoni li l-espressjoni hija bil-Malti, mingħajr ma tingħata tifsira speċifika tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The label identifies this expression as Maltese without establishing its particular meaning.

formal.mt: L-espressjoni "Pakkira dakkra" għandha tiġi spjegata f'kuntest sħiħ biex it-tifsira tagħha tkun ċara.
formal.en: The expression "Pakkira dakkra" should be explained in a full context so that its meaning is clear.
formal.zh: 应结合完整语境解释“Pakkira dakkra”这一表达，使其含义清楚明确。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser "Pakkira dakkra"? Marija: Ejja naraw is-sentenza kollha qabel nippruvaw nispjegawha.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does "Pakkira dakkra" mean? Marija: Let's look at the whole sentence before we try to explain it.
colloquial.zh: Lina：“Pakkira dakkra”是什么意思？Marija：我们先看看完整句子，再试着解释。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser "Pakkira dakkra"?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser "Pakkira dakkra"?
messages.zh: “Pakkira dakkra”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does "Pakkira dakkra" mean?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naraw is-sentenza kollha qabel nippruvaw nispjegawha.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naraw is-sentenza kollha qabel nippruvaw nispjegawha.
messages.zh: 我们先看看完整句子，再试着解释。
messages.en: Let's look at the whole sentence before we try to explain it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把这两个词作为完整表达记住，并在学习卡上标注“结合语境确认含义”，不要凭声音猜词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong metal bar used as a lever to lift, loosen, or force objects apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作杠杆、帮助抬起物件或将物件撬开、撬松的坚固金属棍。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda magħmula minn virga b'saħħitha tal-metall, li tintuża bħala lieva biex terfa' oġġetti jew taqla' affarijiet imwaħħlin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撬棍；利用杠杆作用抬起或撬动物件的金属工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Virga tal-metall b'saħħitha li tintuża bħala lieva biex jintrefgħu oġġetti jew jinqalgħu affarijiet imwaħħlin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A crowbar is a strong metal bar that you use as a lever to lift objects or prise things apart.

collocations.en: to lift a cover with a crowbar

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża palankina biex jerfa' t-tarf tal-għatu tqil.
formal.en: The worker used a crowbar to lift the edge of the heavy cover.
formal.zh: 工人用撬棍抬起了沉重盖子的边缘。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-palankina? Dan l-għatu tqil wisq. Rita: Qiegħda ħdejn il-kaxxa tal-għodda. Se ngħinek nerfgħuh.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the crowbar? This cover is too heavy. Rita: It's next to the toolbox. I'll help you lift it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：撬棍在哪里？这个盖子太重了。Rita：在工具箱旁边。我来帮你把它抬起来。

messages.speaker: Mark (工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-palankina? Dan l-għatu tqil wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-palankina? Dan l-għatu tqil wisq.
messages.zh: 撬棍在哪里？这个盖子太重了。
messages.en: Where's the crowbar? This cover is too heavy.

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda ħdejn il-kaxxa tal-għodda. Se ngħinek nerfgħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda ħdejn il-kaxxa tal-għodda. Se ngħinek nerfgħuh.
messages.zh: 在工具箱旁边。我来帮你把它抬起来。
messages.en: It's next to the toolbox. I'll help you lift it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palankina 和“长金属棍伸进盖子下面”的画面绑定，记住它靠杠杆作用把东西撬起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The upper surface inside the mouth, forming its roof.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于口腔内部上方、构成口腔顶部的部位，即腭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' fuq ġewwa l-ħalq, li tifforma s-saqaf tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 腭，即口腔内部的顶部。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' fuq tal-ħalq minn ġewwa, li tinsab fuq l-ilsien u tifforma s-saqaf tal-ħalq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your palate is the upper surface inside your mouth, above your tongue.

formal.mt: Waqt l-eżami tal-ħalq, it-tabib eżamina l-palat tal-pazjent.
formal.en: During the oral examination, the doctor examined the patient's palate.
formal.zh: 在口腔检查过程中，医生检查了患者的腭。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ħraqt il-palat bis-soppa sħuna! Nina: Ħalliha tiksaħ ftit qabel tkompli tiekol.
colloquial.en: Lara: I burnt my palate on the hot soup! Nina: Let it cool a little before you carry on eating.
colloquial.zh: Lara：热汤把我的上腭烫到了！Nina：让汤稍微凉一凉再接着喝。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħraqt il-palat bis-soppa sħuna!
messages.mt_standard: Ħraqt il-palat bis-soppa sħuna!
messages.zh: 热汤把我的上腭烫到了！
messages.en: I burnt my palate on the hot soup!

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalliha tiksaħ ftit qabel tkompli tiekol.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalliha tiksaħ ftit qabel tkompli tiekol.
messages.zh: 让汤稍微凉一凉再接着喝。
messages.en: Let it cool a little before you carry on eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读到 palat，就想象舌尖轻触口腔顶部；用“嘴里的天花板”记住腭的位置。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, grand residence, especially one used by a royal family or an important official.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模宏大、装饰华丽的住所，尤指王室或重要官员居住的宫殿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini kbir u lussuż maħsub bħala residenza, speċjalment għal familja rjali jew għal persuna b'kariga għolja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宫殿；尤指王室或重要官员居住的宏伟华丽建筑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Residenza kbira u grandjuża, ħafna drabi marbuta ma' familja rjali jew ma' persuna li għandha kariga importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A palace is a large and impressive residence, especially one occupied by a royal family or an important official.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi daħlu fil-palazz u ammiraw is-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The visitors entered the palace and admired the main hall.
formal.zh: 参观者走进宫殿，欣赏了主厅。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nidħlu naraw il-palazz? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nara l-bitħa wkoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go in and see the palace? Mark: Yes, I'd like to see the courtyard too.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们进去参观一下宫殿吧？Mark：好啊，我也想看看庭院。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nidħlu naraw il-palazz?
messages.mt_standard: Nidħlu naraw il-palazz?
messages.zh: 我们进去参观一下宫殿吧？
messages.en: Shall we go in and see the palace?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nara l-bitħa wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nara l-bitħa wkoll.
messages.zh: 好啊，我也想看看庭院。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to see the courtyard too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palazz 配上高大门厅、华丽大厅和宽阔庭院的画面，一起记成“宫殿”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small palace or a grand residence of relatively modest size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规模较小、仍具有宫殿气派的华丽住所，即小宫殿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Palazz ta' daqs żgħir, jew residenza eleganti li għandha l-karattru ta' palazz iżda mhijiex kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小宫殿；规模较小而具有宫殿气派的住所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini residenzjali żgħir u eleganti li għandu d-dehra jew il-karattru ta' palazz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A small palace is an elegant residence that has the character of a palace but is relatively small.

collocations.en: the garden of the small palace

formal.mt: Il-pjan ta' restawr jinkludi t-tiswija tas-saqaf tal-palazzin u l-ħarsien tad-dekorazzjoni oriġinali tiegħu.
formal.en: The restoration plan includes repairing the roof of the small palace and preserving its original decoration.
formal.zh: 修复计划包括修缮小宫殿的屋顶，并保护其原有装饰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhu dak il-bini wara s-siġar? Pawlu: Dak palazzin. Żgħir, imma għandu ġnien sabiħ ħafna.
colloquial.en: Sara: What's that building behind the trees? Pawlu: That's a small palace. It's small, but it has a beautiful garden.
colloquial.zh: Sara：树后面那座建筑是什么？Pawlu：那是一座小宫殿。它不大，不过花园非常漂亮。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-bini wara s-siġar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-bini wara s-siġar?
messages.zh: 树后面那座建筑是什么？
messages.en: What's that building behind the trees?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak palazzin. Żgħir, imma għandu ġnien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dak palazzin. Żgħir, imma għandu ġnien sabiħ ħafna.
messages.zh: 那是一座小宫殿。它不大，不过花园非常漂亮。
messages.en: That's a small palace. It's small, but it has a beautiful garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排画两座建筑：palazz 标“宫殿”，palazzin 标“小宫殿”；用大小对照记住两个完整词。

gloss_zh: 巴勒斯坦的；来自巴勒斯坦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone from Palestine or something connected with Palestine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某人来自巴勒斯坦，或某事物与巴勒斯坦有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Palestina jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Palestina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巴勒斯坦的；属于巴勒斯坦人或其文化的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Palestina, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Palestinian describes people or things connected with Palestine and its culture.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Palestine
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自巴勒斯坦的，或与巴勒斯坦有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Palestina jew li għandu rabta magħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something described as Palestinian comes from Palestine or has a connection with it.

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jippreżenta x-xogħol ta' artist palestinjan f'wirja dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The museum is presenting the work of a Palestinian artist in an exhibition about everyday life.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在一场以日常生活为主题的展览中展示一位巴勒斯坦艺术家的作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tipprova ikel palestinjan illejla? Mark: Iva, nixtieq nipprova xi ħaġa ġdida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to try Palestinian food tonight? Mark: Yes, I'd like to try something new.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：今晚想尝尝巴勒斯坦食物吗？马克：想，我想试点新东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova ikel palestinjan illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova ikel palestinjan illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚想尝尝巴勒斯坦食物吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try Palestinian food tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq nipprova xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq nipprova xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.zh: 想，我想试点新东西。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to try something new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palestinjan 放进 artist palestinjan 和 ikel palestinjan 两个词组中，分别联想巴勒斯坦艺术家与食物，记住它表示来源或关联。

gloss_zh: 长木柄手扇（传统上由男性使用）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hand-held fan with a long wooden handle, traditionally used by men.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带长木柄、拿在手中扇风的扇子，传统上由男性使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett li jinżamm fl-id u jitħarrek biex jagħmel ir-riħ, b'manku twil tal-injam, li tradizzjonalment jintuża mill-irġiel.

sense_translations.en_definition: hand-held fan with a long wooden handle (traditionally used by men)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有长木柄的手持扇子，传统上由男性使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' oġġett għall-idejn b'manku twil tal-injam, li jitħarrek biex jagħmel ir-riħ u li tradizzjonalment jintuża mill-irġiel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A palju is a fan with a long wooden handle that is held and moved by hand, traditionally by men.

collocations.en: the handle of the long-handled fan
to fan yourself with a long-handled fan
collocations.zh: 用长柄手扇给自己扇风

formal.mt: Il-palju espost fil-mużew għandu manku twil tal-injam u kien jintuża biex wieħed jagħmel ir-riħ.
formal.en: The long-handled fan displayed in the museum has a long wooden handle and was used for fanning oneself.
formal.zh: 博物馆中展出的这把长柄手扇有一根长木柄，过去用来给自己扇风。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'inhu dak li għandek f'idek? Nannu: Dan palju; nagħmel ir-riħ bih meta jkun is-sħana.
colloquial.en: Luca: What's that you're holding? Grandfather: This is a long-handled fan; I use it to fan myself when it's hot.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：你手里拿的是什么？爷爷：这是一把长柄手扇，天热时我用它给自己扇风。

messages.speaker: Luca (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak li għandek f'idek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak li għandek f'idek?
messages.zh: 你手里拿的是什么？
messages.en: What's that you're holding?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan palju; nagħmel ir-riħ bih meta jkun is-sħana.
messages.mt_standard: Dan palju; nagħmel ir-riħ bih meta jkun is-sħana.
messages.zh: 这是一把长柄手扇，天热时我用它给自己扇风。
messages.en: This is a long-handled fan; I use it to fan myself when it's hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位爷爷握着长木柄慢慢扇风，把 palju 与“长柄、木柄、手动扇风”三个画面绑定，避免只记成普通扇子。

gloss_zh: 托盘；装卸货物用的货盘

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat platform on which goods are placed for storage or transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于放置货物、方便储存或搬运的平坦承载平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjattaforma ċatta li fuqha jitqiegħdu l-oġġetti jew il-merkanzija biex jinħażnu jew jinġarru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物托盘；用于承放、储存或搬运货物的平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma li sservi ta' bażi għall-merkanzija waqt il-ħażna jew it-trasport tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pallet is a flat platform used to support goods while they are stored or moved.

formal.mt: Il-kaxxi tqiegħdu fuq palleta sabiex ikunu jistgħu jinġarru flimkien lejn il-maħżen.
formal.en: The boxes were placed on a pallet so that they could be moved together to the warehouse.
formal.zh: 这些箱子被放在一个货物托盘上，以便一起运往仓库。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi? Pawlu: Poġġihom fuq il-palleta ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where should I put these boxes? Pawlu: Put them on the pallet next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些箱子放在哪里？保罗：放在门旁边的托盘上。

messages.speaker: Sara (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 这些箱子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these boxes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġihom fuq il-palleta ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġihom fuq il-palleta ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 放在门旁边的托盘上。
messages.en: Put them on the pallet next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 palleta 时，想象仓库里一摞箱子下面的承载平台；配合 kaxxi fuq palleta，牢牢记住“箱子在货盘上”的位置关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little colour, especially in the face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色很淡的，尤其指脸部缺少血色、显得苍白。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit kulur, speċjalment fil-wiċċ, u jidher bajdani jew bla ħmura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍白的；尤指脸色缺少血色的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jidher b'kulur ċar jew bi ftit kulur, b'mod speċjali meta l-wiċċ ikun bla ħmura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone looks pale, their face has less colour than usual.

formal.mt: Fid-deskrizzjoni tal-personaġġ, l-awtur isemmi wiċċ pallidu u għajnejn għajjenin.
formal.en: In the description of the character, the author mentions a pale face and tired eyes.
formal.zh: 在对人物的描写中，作者提到了一张苍白的脸和一双疲惫的眼睛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int tidher pallidu llum. Tħossok sew? Mark: Iva, imma rqadt ftit wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: You look pale today. Are you feeling all right? Mark: Yes, but I got too little sleep last night.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天脸色苍白，身体还好吗？马克：还好，不过我昨晚睡得太少了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int tidher pallidu llum. Tħossok sew?
messages.mt_standard: Int tidher pallidu llum. Tħossok sew?
messages.zh: 你今天脸色苍白，身体还好吗？
messages.en: You look pale today. Are you feeling all right?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma rqadt ftit wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma rqadt ftit wisq ilbieraħ filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 还好，不过我昨晚睡得太少了。
messages.en: Yes, but I got too little sleep last night.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pallidu 与 wiċċ pallidu 一起记，想象画像中的脸几乎没有红润色彩；用“脸上血色淡”帮助记住苍白这一含义。

gloss_zh: 心悸；明显感觉到的心脏急跳或异常跳动

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noticeable heartbeat that feels unusually fast, strong, or irregular.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明显感觉到心脏跳得过快、过猛或节律不规则的现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħbita tal-qalb li tinħass b'mod qawwi jew mhux tas-soltu, bħal meta l-qalb tħabbat malajr jew b'ritmu irregolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心悸，即明显感觉到心脏急速、强烈或不规则地跳动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni ta' taħbita tal-qalb qawwija, mgħaġġla jew irregolari li l-persuna tinnota b'mod ċar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you experience a palpitation, you notice your heart beating unusually strongly, quickly, or irregularly.

formal.mt: Matul il-konsultazzjoni, il-pazjenta rrappurtat li kienet ħasset palpitazzjoni waqt li kienet bilqiegħda.
formal.en: During the consultation, the patient reported that she had felt a palpitation while sitting down.
formal.zh: 就诊时，这位女患者报告说，她坐着时曾感到一阵心悸。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex waqaft titkellem? Rita: Ħassejt palpitazzjoni għal mument. Maja: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda? Rita: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you stop talking? Rita: I felt a palpitation for a moment. Maja: Would you like to sit down? Rita: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么突然不说话了？丽塔：我刚才感到一阵心悸。玛雅：你想坐下吗？丽塔：好，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqaft titkellem?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqaft titkellem?
messages.zh: 你怎么突然不说话了？
messages.en: Why did you stop talking?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt palpitazzjoni għal mument.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt palpitazzjoni għal mument.
messages.zh: 我刚才感到一阵心悸。
messages.en: I felt a palpitation for a moment.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: Trid toqgħod bilqiegħda?
messages.zh: 你想坐下吗？
messages.en: Would you like to sit down?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi.
messages.zh: 好，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 palpitazzjoni 配上手按胸口、突然注意到心跳的画面，整句记忆 Ħassejt palpitazzjoni，表示“我感到一阵心悸”。

gloss_zh: 专家小组；评议小组；关贸总协定争端审理专家组

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group of people selected to discuss, assess, or decide a particular matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为讨论、评估或裁定某一事项而选定的一组人员，如专家组或评议小组。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' persuni magħżula biex jiddiskutu, jevalwaw jew jiddeċiedu dwar kwistjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税与贸易总协定（GATT）框架下负责审理贸易争端的专家组。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' esperti magħżula fil-qafas tal-Ftehim Ġenerali dwar it-Tariffi u l-Kummerċ, magħruf bħala GATT, biex jeżaminaw tilwima kummerċjali u jħejju rapport dwarha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A GATT Panel is a group of experts appointed to examine a trade dispute under the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为讨论、评估或裁定特定事项而组成的小组，如专家小组或评议小组。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies magħżula minħabba l-għarfien jew ir-rwol tagħhom biex jiddiskutu suġġett, jevalwaw xi ħaġa jew jagħtu deċiżjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A panel is a group of people chosen to discuss a subject, evaluate something, or make a decision.

collocations.zh: 关贸总协定专家组报告

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-kors, l-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw kif panel tal-GATT jeżamina tilwima kummerċjali u jippreżenta s-sejbiet tiegħu f'rapport.
formal.en: In the course exercise, students must explain how a GATT Panel examines a trade dispute and presents its findings in a report.
formal.zh: 在课程练习中，学生须说明关贸总协定专家组如何审理贸易争端，并以报告形式提出审理结果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min se jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet wara t-taħdita? Elena: Hemm panel ta' tliet esperti. Mark: Nista' nistaqsihom dwar il-proġett tiegħi? Elena: Iva, ikun hemm ħin għall-mistoqsijiet.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who will answer questions after the talk? Elena: There is a panel of three experts. Mark: Can I ask them about my project? Elena: Yes, there will be time for questions.
colloquial.zh: 马克：讲座结束后由谁来回答问题？埃琳娜：有一个由三位专家组成的小组。马克：我能向他们询问我的项目吗？埃琳娜：可以，会安排提问时间。

messages.speaker: Mark (参会者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet wara t-taħdita?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jwieġeb il-mistoqsijiet wara t-taħdita?
messages.zh: 讲座结束后由谁来回答问题？
messages.en: Who will answer questions after the talk?

messages.speaker: Elena (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm panel ta' tliet esperti.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm panel ta' tliet esperti.
messages.zh: 有一个由三位专家组成的小组。
messages.en: There is a panel of three experts.

messages.speaker: Mark (参会者)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nistaqsihom dwar il-proġett tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nistaqsihom dwar il-proġett tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我能向他们询问我的项目吗？
messages.en: Can I ask them about my project?

messages.speaker: Elena (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikun hemm ħin għall-mistoqsijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikun hemm ħin għall-mistoqsijiet.
messages.zh: 可以，会安排提问时间。
messages.en: Yes, there will be time for questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 panel 想成几位专家同桌讨论：普通语境是评议小组；看到 tal-GATT 时，把场景切换为审理贸易争端的专家组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat section that forms part of a door, wall, machine, or other structure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 构成门、墙壁、机器或其他结构一部分的平板状部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta li tifforma parti minn bieb, ħajt, magna jew struttura oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面板；构成某个表面或结构一部分的平板状部件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa ċatta ta' materjal li tifforma sezzjoni minn wiċċ jew struttura akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A panel is a flat piece of material that forms part of a larger surface or structure.

formal.mt: It-tekniku neħħa l-panew ta' quddiem tal-magna biex jeżamina l-partijiet ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The technician removed the machine's front panel to inspect the internal parts.
formal.zh: 技术员拆下机器的前面板，以检查内部零件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-panew tal-injam ma jidħolx hawn. Pawlu: Ipprova dawwru; naħseb li qiegħed bil-maqlub.
colloquial.en: Lara: This wooden panel won't fit here. Pawlu: Try turning it around; I think it's the wrong way round.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块木板装不进这里。保罗：试着转过来，我觉得方向反了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-panew tal-injam ma jidħolx hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-panew tal-injam ma jidħolx hawn.
messages.zh: 这块木板装不进这里。
messages.en: This wooden panel won't fit here.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipprova dawwru; naħseb li qiegħed bil-maqlub.
messages.mt_standard: Ipprova dawwru; naħseb li qiegħed bil-maqlub.
messages.zh: 试着转过来，我觉得方向反了。
messages.en: Try turning it around; I think it's the wrong way round.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 panew 和机器前面可以拆下的那块板联系起来，再用 panew tal-kontroll 记住“控制面板”这一常见搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mammal covered in hard scales that eats ants and termites.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体覆盖坚硬鳞片、以蚂蚁和白蚁为食的哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu b'ġismu miksi bi skwali iebsin, li jiekol in-nemel u t-termiti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿山甲；一种体表覆盖坚硬鳞片、以蚂蚁和白蚁为食的哺乳动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu li għandu skwali iebsin fuq ġismu u lsien twil li jużah biex jiġbor in-nemel u t-termiti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pangolin is a mammal with hard scales and a long tongue used to collect ants and termites.

formal.mt: Il-pangolin juża lsienu twil biex jiġbor in-nemel u t-termiti.
formal.en: The pangolin uses its long tongue to collect ants and termites.
formal.zh: 穿山甲用长舌头捕食蚂蚁和白蚁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dan l-annimal bl-iskwali fir-ritratt? Mark: Dak pangolin. Jiekol in-nemel u t-termiti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this animal with scales in the photo? Mark: That's a pangolin. It eats ants and termites.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：照片里这只有鳞片的动物是什么？马克：那是穿山甲。它吃蚂蚁和白蚁。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dan l-annimal bl-iskwali fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dan l-annimal bl-iskwali fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 照片里这只有鳞片的动物是什么？
messages.en: What's this animal with scales in the photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pangolin. Jiekol in-nemel u t-termiti.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pangolin. Jiekol in-nemel u t-termiti.
messages.zh: 那是穿山甲。它吃蚂蚁和白蚁。
messages.en: That's a pangolin. It eats ants and termites.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习 pangolin 时，想象一只披着鳞片、伸出长舌吃蚂蚁的穿山甲，用“鳞片加长舌”的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small individual loaf of bread, often cut open and filled with food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供一人食用的小面包，常切开后夹入食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobża żgħira għal persuna waħda, li spiss tinqasam biex timtela b'xi ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小面包；通常供一人食用、可切开夹馅的面包。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħobża żgħira li tittiekel waħedha jew tinqasam u timtela b'ingredjenti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bread roll is a small individual loaf that can be eaten plain or cut open and filled.

collocations.en: a bread roll filled with cheese

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, kull student ingħata panina bil-ġobon u biċċa frott.
formal.en: For lunch, each student was given a bread roll filled with cheese and a piece of fruit.
formal.zh: 午餐时，每名学生都领到了一个夹奶酪的小面包和一份水果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nixtieq panina bil-ġobon, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Trid ukoll ftit tadam fiha? Sara: Iva, grazzi.
colloquial.en: Sara: I'd like a bread roll with cheese, please. Rita: Would you like some tomato in it too? Sara: Yes, thank you.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：请给我一个夹奶酪的小面包。丽塔：里面也要加一点番茄吗？萨拉：要，谢谢。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq panina bil-ġobon, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq panina bil-ġobon, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一个夹奶酪的小面包。
messages.en: I'd like a bread roll with cheese, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ukoll ftit tadam fiha?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ukoll ftit tadam fiha?
messages.zh: 里面也要加一点番茄吗？
messages.en: Would you like some tomato in it too?

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。
messages.en: Yes, thank you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 panina 想成午餐袋里一人份的小面包，再想象切开夹奶酪，连同 panina bil-ġobon 一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religious talk given to a congregation to explain or reflect on matters of faith.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向会众讲述、解释或阐发信仰内容的宗教讲话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskors reliġjuż li jsir quddiem il-fidili biex jispjega jew jittratta suġġett marbut mal-fidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲道；面向会众、阐述宗教教义或信仰主题的讲话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Diskors dwar tagħlim jew suġġett reliġjuż li jingħata lil ġemgħa ta' fidili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sermon is a talk given to a congregation about religious teachings or matters of faith.

formal.mt: Fil-paniġierku tiegħu, is-saċerdot tkellem dwar l-importanza li ngħinu lil min hu fil-bżonn.
formal.en: In his sermon, the priest spoke about the importance of helping those in need.
formal.zh: 神父在讲道中谈到了帮助有需要者的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif kien il-paniġierku llum? Ġużeppi: Kien ċar ħafna. Is-saċerdot tkellem dwar kif nistgħu ngħinu lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was today's sermon like? Ġużeppi: It was very clear. The priest talked about how we can help one another.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天的讲道怎么样？朱塞佩：讲得很清楚。神父谈了我们可以怎样互相帮助。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien il-paniġierku llum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien il-paniġierku llum?
messages.zh: 今天的讲道怎么样？
messages.en: What was today's sermon like?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien ċar ħafna. Is-saċerdot tkellem dwar kif nistgħu ngħinu lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Kien ċar ħafna. Is-saċerdot tkellem dwar kif nistgħu ngħinu lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 讲得很清楚。神父谈了我们可以怎样互相帮助。
messages.en: It was very clear. The priest talked about how we can help one another.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paniġierku 放进“神父在教堂向会众讲道”的场景记忆，再配对练习“讲道”和“听讲道”两个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gathered or wavy strip of fabric attached to a woman's skirt as decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缝在女裙上作装饰的褶皱状或波浪状布边。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' drapp miġbura jew immewġa li titwaħħal ma' dublett ta' mara bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女裙上用褶皱或波浪状布条制成的装饰性荷叶边。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strixxa dekorattiva ta' drapp miġbura jew immewġa, imwaħħla ma' dublett ta' mara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flounce is a gathered or wavy strip of fabric that decorates a woman's skirt.

collocations.en: a flounce along the edge of the skirt

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata żiedet pantor mat-tarf tad-dublett biex tagħtih dehra aktar eleganti.
formal.en: The dressmaker added a flounce along the edge of the skirt to give it a more elegant appearance.
formal.zh: 女裁缝在裙子边缘加了一圈荷叶边，使裙子显得更加优雅。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid pantor ma' dan id-dublett? Lara: Iva, nixtieq pantor blu mat-tarf.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like a flounce on this skirt? Lara: Yes, I'd like a blue flounce along the edge.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这条裙子要加荷叶边吗？Lara：要，我想在裙边加一圈蓝色荷叶边。

messages.speaker: Marija (裁缝)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid pantor ma' dan id-dublett?
messages.mt_standard: Trid pantor ma' dan id-dublett?
messages.zh: 这条裙子要加荷叶边吗？
messages.en: Would you like a flounce on this skirt?

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq pantor blu mat-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq pantor blu mat-tarf.
messages.zh: 要，我想在裙边加一圈蓝色荷叶边。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like a blue flounce along the edge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pantor 和裙边波浪状的装饰布条一起记：想象裁缝给裙子加一圈荷叶边。

gloss_zh: 汽车轮胎扎破；轮胎破孔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hole or other damage in a car tyre that allows air to escape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 汽车轮胎因被刺穿或破损而出现的漏气破孔，也用于指轮胎扎破的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqba jew ħsara f'tajer ta' karozza li minnha toħroġ l-arja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽车轮胎上的扎孔或导致漏气的破损；轮胎扎破。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Toqba f'tajer ta' karozza, normalment ikkawżata minn oġġett li jaqta' jew bil-ponta, li tħalli l-arja toħroġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puncture is a hole in a car tyre that lets the air escape.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-vettura, instab panċer fit-tajer ta' wara kkawżat minn musmar.
formal.en: During the vehicle inspection, a puncture caused by a nail was found in the rear tyre.
formal.zh: 车辆检查时，发现后轮胎有一处由钉子造成的扎孔。

colloquial.mt: Mark: It-tajer qed jitlef l-arja. Għandu panċer? Pawlu: Iva, hawn musmar fih. Mark: Tista' ssewwih illum? Pawlu: Iva, nista' nsewwih dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Mark: The tyre is losing air. Does it have a puncture? Pawlu: Yes, there is a nail in it here. Mark: Can you repair it today? Pawlu: Yes, I can repair it this morning.
colloquial.zh: 马克：轮胎在漏气，是扎破了吗？保罗：是的，这里扎了一颗钉子。马克：你今天能修好吗？保罗：可以，我今天上午就能修好。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tajer qed jitlef l-arja. Għandu panċer?
messages.mt_standard: It-tajer qed jitlef l-arja. Għandu panċer?
messages.zh: 轮胎在漏气，是扎破了吗？
messages.en: The tyre is losing air. Does it have a puncture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修车师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn musmar fih.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn musmar fih.
messages.zh: 是的，这里扎了一颗钉子。
messages.en: Yes, there is a nail in it here.

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' ssewwih illum?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' ssewwih illum?
messages.zh: 你今天能修好吗？
messages.en: Can you repair it today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (修车师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nsewwih dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nsewwih dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 可以，我今天上午就能修好。
messages.en: Yes, I can repair it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 panċer 与“钉子扎进汽车轮胎、空气漏出”的画面绑定，再用 tajer b'panċer 记住“扎破的轮胎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A close-fitting garment worn around the torso to support or shape the body, especially the waist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贴身穿在躯干部位，用来支撑身体或塑造腰部线条的紧身衣物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies issikkat li jintlibes madwar it-torso biex isostni jew jagħti forma lill-ġisem, speċjalment fil-parti tal-qadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 紧身胸衣或束腰，围住躯干并用于支撑或收束腰身的贴身衣物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies li ddawwar u tissikka t-torso biex issostni l-ġisem jew tagħti forma lill-qadd.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A corset is a tightly fitting garment worn around the torso to support or shape the waist.

collocations.zh: 穿在连衣裙里面的束腰

formal.mt: Il-kostum teatrali jinkludi panċiera li tintlibes taħt il-libsa biex tagħti forma lill-qadd.
formal.en: The theatrical costume includes a corset worn under the dress to shape the waist.
formal.zh: 这套戏服包括一件穿在连衣裙里面、用于塑造腰部线条的束腰。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandi nilbes il-panċiera taħt din il-libsa? Lina: Iva, ipprovahom flimkien. Sara: Din il-panċiera ssikkata wisq. Lina: Nista' nġiblek waħda ikbar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Should I wear the corset under this dress? Lina: Yes, try them on together. Sara: This corset is too tight. Lina: I can bring you a larger one.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条裙子里面要穿束腰吗？莉娜：是的，一起试穿一下。萨拉：这件束腰太紧了。莉娜：我可以给你拿一件大一点的。

messages.speaker: Sara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nilbes il-panċiera taħt din il-libsa?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nilbes il-panċiera taħt din il-libsa?
messages.zh: 这条裙子里面要穿束腰吗？
messages.en: Should I wear the corset under this dress?

messages.speaker: Lina (服装师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ipprovahom flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ipprovahom flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，一起试穿一下。
messages.en: Yes, try them on together.

messages.speaker: Sara (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-panċiera ssikkata wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-panċiera ssikkata wisq.
messages.zh: 这件束腰太紧了。
messages.en: This corset is too tight.

messages.speaker: Lina (服装师)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nġiblek waħda ikbar.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nġiblek waħda ikbar.
messages.zh: 我可以给你拿一件大一点的。
messages.en: I can bring you a larger one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象服装师把 panċiera 穿在裙子里面收束腰身，用 nilbes panċiera“穿束腰”记忆，并注意不要与轮胎扎破 panċer 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The title of the religious leader of the Roman Catholic Church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 罗马天主教会最高宗教领袖的称号，即教宗或教皇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-titlu tal-mexxej reliġjuż tal-Knisja Kattolika Rumana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教宗，亦称教皇，指罗马天主教会的最高宗教领袖。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mexxej reliġjuż tal-Knisja Kattolika Rumana, li jissejjaħ il-Papa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The Pope is the religious leader of the Roman Catholic Church.

formal.mt: L-istudenti kitbu paragrafu dwar ir-rwol tal-Papa fil-Knisja Kattolika.
formal.en: The students wrote a paragraph about the Pope's role in the Catholic Church.
formal.zh: 学生们写了一段文字，介绍教宗在天主教会中的角色。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min hu l-Papa? Pawlu: Hu l-mexxej reliġjuż tal-Knisja Kattolika.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who is the Pope? Pawlu: He is the religious leader of the Catholic Church.
colloquial.zh: Anna：教宗是什么人？Pawlu：他是天主教会的宗教领袖。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu l-Papa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu l-Papa?
messages.zh: 教宗是什么人？
messages.en: Who is the Pope?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hu l-mexxej reliġjuż tal-Knisja Kattolika.
messages.mt_standard: Hu l-mexxej reliġjuż tal-Knisja Kattolika.
messages.zh: 他是天主教会的宗教领袖。
messages.en: He is the religious leader of the Catholic Church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 对照记忆 Papa 与 papà：本条 Papa 首字母大写、末尾没有重音符号，表示教宗；papà 表示爸爸。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A familiar and affectionate word used to refer to or address one's father.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于称呼或提及父亲的亲切日常用语，相当于“爸爸”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma familjari u affettiva li tintuża biex wieħed isejjaħ jew jitkellem dwar missieru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 父亲；本词以较亲切、日常的方式表达这一亲属身份。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-missier ta' persuna, imsemmi b'kelma familjari u affettiva.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your father is your male parent, whom you may affectionately call papà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爸爸；日常生活中对父亲的亲切称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma ta' kuljum li persuna tuża biex issejjaħ lil missierha jew titkellem dwaru b'mod familjari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Dad is an informal word you use when addressing or talking about your father.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爸爸；带有家庭亲昵色彩的父亲称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem affettiv għall-missier, użat bħala sejħa diretta jew meta wieħed jitkellem dwaru fil-familja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Papa is an affectionate name that someone uses for their father.

formal.mt: Il-papà tat-tifla attenda l-laqgħa mal-għalliema biex jiddiskuti l-progress tagħha.
formal.en: The girl's father attended the meeting with the teachers to discuss her progress.
formal.zh: 女孩的父亲参加了与老师们的会面，讨论她的学习进展。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Papà, tista' tgħinni bil-kompitu? David: Iva, ġib il-ktieb u narawh flimkien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Dad, can you help me with my homework? David: Yes, bring the book and we'll look at it together.
colloquial.zh: Nina：爸爸，你能帮我做作业吗？David：可以，把书拿来，我们一起看看。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Papà, tista' tgħinni bil-kompitu?
messages.mt_standard: Papà, tista' tgħinni bil-kompitu?
messages.zh: 爸爸，你能帮我做作业吗？
messages.en: Dad, can you help me with my homework?

messages.speaker: David (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġib il-ktieb u narawh flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġib il-ktieb u narawh flimkien.
messages.zh: 可以，把书拿来，我们一起看看。
messages.en: Yes, bring the book and we'll look at it together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 papà 放进向爸爸求助的场景中记忆，并留意末尾的 à；再与表示教宗的 Papa 对照。

gloss_zh: 范式；典范；词形变化范例

teaching_sense.en_definition: A model or framework that guides thought or practice; in grammar, an organized set of the forms of a word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指导思考或实践的典范、模型或框架；在语法中也指系统列出的某个词的变化形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mudell jew qafas li jiggwida l-ħsieb jew il-prattika; fil-grammatika, ġabra organizzata tal-forom differenti ta' kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为参照的典范、模型或思想框架；语法中也指一个词的整套变化形式或其范例。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mudell li jservi ta' eżempju jew qafas għall-ħsieb u l-prattika f'qasam partikolari; fil-grammatika, ġabra organizzata tal-forom ta' kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A paradigm is a model or framework used to understand something, or an organized set of word forms in grammar.

formal.mt: L-istudju jipproponi paradigma ġdida biex nifhmu kif l-istudenti jitgħallmu lingwa.
formal.en: The study proposes a new paradigm for understanding how students learn a language.
formal.zh: 该研究提出一种新范式，用于理解学生如何学习语言。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi tfisser paradigma ta' verb? Mark: Hija ġabra organizzata tal-forom tiegħu; ejja nħarsu lejn eżempju.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a verb paradigm mean? Mark: It is an organized set of its forms; let's look at an example.
colloquial.zh: Sara：动词的词形变化范例是什么意思？Mark：就是把它的各种形式有系统地列出来；我们看一个例子吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
