messages.mt_standard: Iva, immorru nimxu ftit mal-baħar.
messages.zh: 好啊，我们去海边走一会儿吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's walk by the sea for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 passiġġata 记成饭后沿海边走一圈的完整活动；它是名词，连同 nagħmel passiġġata 一起记，表达我去散步。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乘坐交通工具出行、但不负责驾驶或操作该交通工具的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tivvjaġġa f'vettura mingħajr ma tkun qed issuqha jew tħaddimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乘坐汽车、公共汽车、火车、船或飞机等交通工具的乘客。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun qed tivvjaġġa f'karozza, xarabank, ferrovija, vapur jew ajruplan, mingħajr ma tkun responsabbli mis-sewqan jew mit-tħaddim tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A passenger is someone who travels in a vehicle without being responsible for driving or operating it.

formal.mt: Kull passiġġier għandu jżomm il-biljett tiegħu sakemm jintemm il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: Every passenger should keep their ticket until the journey ends.
formal.zh: 每位乘客都应保留车票，直到行程结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' noqgħod hawn? Mark: Iva, il-passiġġier li kien hawn niżel fl-aħħar waqfa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I sit here? Mark: Yes, the passenger who was here got off at the last stop.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我可以坐这里吗？马克：可以，刚才坐这里的乘客在上一站下车了。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' noqgħod hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' noqgħod hawn?
messages.zh: 我可以坐这里吗？
messages.en: Can I sit here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-passiġġier li kien hawn niżel fl-aħħar waqfa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-passiġġier li kien hawn niżel fl-aħħar waqfa.
messages.zh: 可以，刚才坐这里的乘客在上一站下车了。
messages.en: Yes, the passenger who was here got off at the last stop.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 passiġġier 和车票、座位、下车三个画面一起记：坐车出行的人就是乘客。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small dried seedless grape, often used in cakes and other foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由小粒无核葡萄制成的葡萄干，常用于蛋糕等食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għenba żgħira mingħajr żerriegħa li tkun ġiet imnixxfa u li spiss tintuża fil-kejkijiet u f'ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常作烘焙配料的小粒无核葡萄干。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għenba żgħira mnixxfa mingħajr żerriegħa, li tintuża bħala ingredjent fil-kejkijiet, fil-ħobż ħelu u fi platti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A currant is a small dried seedless grape that is often added to cakes, breads, and other dishes.

collocations.en: add a currant to the mixture
collocations.zh: 往混合料中加入一粒小葡萄干

formal.mt: Għad-dekorazzjoni, poġġi passolina waħda fiċ-ċentru ta' kull gallettina qabel il-ħami.
formal.en: For decoration, place one currant in the centre of each biscuit before baking.
formal.zh: 烘烤前，在每块饼干中央放一粒小葡萄干作为装饰。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhi din il-ħaġa żgħira fil-kejk? Omm: Dik hija passolina; tagħti ftit ħlewwa lill-kejk.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's this little thing in the cake? Mum: That's a currant; it adds a little sweetness to the cake.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：蛋糕里这个小东西是什么？妈妈：那是一粒小葡萄干，能给蛋糕增加一点甜味。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-ħaġa żgħira fil-kejk?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-ħaġa żgħira fil-kejk?
messages.zh: 蛋糕里这个小东西是什么？
messages.en: What's this little thing in the cake?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik hija passolina; tagħti ftit ħlewwa lill-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Dik hija passolina; tagħti ftit ħlewwa lill-kejk.
messages.zh: 那是一粒小葡萄干，能给蛋糕增加一点甜味。
messages.en: That's a currant; it adds a little sweetness to the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象饼干中央放着一粒小葡萄干，把 passolina 和这颗小小的甜配料一起记住。

gloss_zh: （牌戏中错过出牌机会后说的）过；跳房子游戏

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression used in card games to indicate that a player has lost the opportunity to play a card.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 牌戏中表示自己已经错过出牌机会的用语，大致相当于“过”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża fil-logħob tal-karti biex tindika li plejer tilef iċ-ċans li jilgħab karta.

sense_translations.en_definition: term used in card games with the rough meaning of 'I pass', used when the chance to play a card has been lost
sense_translations.zh_definition: 牌戏用语，在已经错过出牌机会时使用，大致表示“我过”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma li jgħid plejer waqt logħba tal-karti meta jkun tilef iċ-ċans li jilgħab karta, b'tifsira qrib ta' 'ngħaddi'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In a card game, a player says 'passu' when they have lost their opportunity to play a card.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跳房子；在地上画出的格子中按规则单脚或双脚跳跃的游戏。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Logħba li fiha jitpinġew kaxxi mal-art u l-plejers jaqbżu minn kaxxa għal oħra fuq sieq waħda jew fuq iż-żewġ saqajn skont ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Hopscotch is a game in which players hop or jump through a pattern of squares marked on the ground.

collocations.en: to say 'pass' after missing the chance to play

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba tal-karti, il-plejer qal 'passu' għax kien tilef iċ-ċans li jilgħab karta.
formal.en: During the card game, the player said 'passu' because he had lost his opportunity to play a card.
formal.zh: 牌戏进行时，这名玩家说了“过”，因为他已经错过了出牌机会。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tilgħab il-passu magħna? Mark: Iva! Se nġib il-ġibs biex inpinġu l-kaxxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to play hopscotch with us? Mark: Yes! I'll get the chalk so we can draw the squares.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想和我们一起玩跳房子吗？Mark：想！我去拿粉笔，这样我们就能画格子了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tilgħab il-passu magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tilgħab il-passu magħna?
messages.zh: 你想和我们一起玩跳房子吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play hopscotch with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Se nġib il-ġibs biex inpinġu l-kaxxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Se nġib il-ġibs biex inpinġu l-kaxxi.
messages.zh: 想！我去拿粉笔，这样我们就能画格子了。
messages.en: Yes! I'll get the chalk so we can draw the squares.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅场景分开记：牌桌上错过机会，说 passu；地上画好格子，玩 il-passu。把“说”和“玩”分别连到两个词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A past-tense expression of wanting; ridt means 'I wanted'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达过去的意愿或需求；ridt 表示“我当时想要”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tesprimi xewqa jew rieda fil-passat; ridt tfisser li jien kelli dik ix-xewqa jew ir-rieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Irrid 表示“我想要”；表达“我过去想要”时可用 ridt。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Irrid tesprimi xewqa jew rieda fil-preżent; biex ngħidu li kellna dik ix-xewqa jew ir-rieda fil-passat, nużaw ridt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When you use ridt, you describe something you wanted at a time in the past.

collocations.en: I wanted to buy a book
I wanted to speak with you

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħi spjegajt li ridt aktar informazzjoni dwar il-kors qabel nirreġistra.
formal.en: In my letter, I explained that I wanted more information about the course before registering.
formal.zh: 我在信中说明，报名之前我想进一步了解这门课程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ċempiltli lbieraħ? Pawlu: Ridt nistaqsik jekk tridx tiġi magħna s-Sibt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you call me yesterday? Pawlu: I wanted to ask whether you want to come with us on Saturday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你昨天为什么打电话给我？保罗：我当时想问问你，星期六要不要和我们一起去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ċempiltli lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ċempiltli lbieraħ?
messages.zh: 你昨天为什么打电话给我？
messages.en: Why did you call me yesterday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ridt nistaqsik jekk tridx tiġi magħna s-Sibt.
messages.mt_standard: Ridt nistaqsik jekk tridx tiġi magħna s-Sibt.
messages.zh: 我当时想问问你，星期六要不要和我们一起去。
messages.en: I wanted to ask whether you want to come with us on Saturday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 irrid 配上“现在想要”，把 ridt 配上“昨天想要”，用时间画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vegetable with a compact head of usually white flower buds surrounded by green leaves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种蔬菜，通常由紧密聚集的白色花蕾形成菜球，外面有绿叶，即花椰菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxixa li għandha ras magħmula minn fjuretti magħqudin mill-qrib, ġeneralment bojod, u mdawra b'weraq ħodor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花椰菜；以紧密聚集、通常呈白色的花蕾部分供食用的蔬菜。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxixa b'ras ta' fjuretti magħqudin, ġeneralment bojod, li tittiekel nejja jew imsajra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cauliflower is a vegetable with a firm head of small, usually white flower buds that can be eaten raw or cooked.

formal.mt: Għalli l-pastarda sakemm tirtab, imbagħad qattagħha f'biċċiet żgħar u żidha mal-insalata.
formal.en: Boil the cauliflower until tender, then cut it into small pieces and add it to the salad.
formal.zh: 将花椰菜煮至软嫩，然后切成小块，加入沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se nsajru llejla? Pawlu: Għandna pastarda fil-friġġ. Nagħmluha l-forn bil-ġobon?
colloquial.en: Maja: What shall we cook tonight? Pawlu: We have cauliflower in the fridge. Shall we bake it with cheese?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们今晚做什么吃？Pawlu：冰箱里有花椰菜。我们把它加上奶酪烤着吃，好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nsajru llejla?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nsajru llejla?
messages.zh: 我们今晚做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna pastarda fil-friġġ. Nagħmluha l-forn bil-ġobon?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna pastarda fil-friġġ. Nagħmluha l-forn bil-ġobon?
messages.zh: 冰箱里有花椰菜。我们把它加上奶酪烤着吃，好吗？
messages.en: We have cauliflower in the fridge. Shall we bake it with cheese?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastarda 和“一团白色小花、外面围着绿叶”的菜花形象绑定，再用“水煮”和“烤制”两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small pastry made from dough and baked, often with a sweet filling or topping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用面团烘烤而成的小糕点，常带有甜馅或甜味配料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa għaġina żgħira moħmija, li spiss ikollha mili jew tiżjin ħelu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 糕点；用面团烘烤制成、常带有甜馅或甜味配料的小点心。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaġina żgħira moħmija li tittiekel bħala ħelwa u li jista' jkollha mili, krema jew tiżjin fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pastry is a small baked item made from dough, often containing a sweet filling or finished with a topping.

formal.mt: Il-kafetterija toffri kafè u pastina friska bil-krema bħala għażla għall-kolazzjon.
formal.en: The café offers coffee and a fresh pastry with cream as a breakfast option.
formal.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供咖啡配新鲜奶油糕点，作为一种早餐选择。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nixtieq kafè u pastina bil-krema, jekk jogħġbok. Rita: Żgur. Trid tiekolha hawn jew teħodha miegħek?
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like a coffee and a pastry with cream, please. Rita: Certainly. Would you like to eat it here or take it with you?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一杯咖啡和一个奶油糕点。Rita：好的。您想在这里吃，还是带走？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq kafè u pastina bil-krema, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq kafè u pastina bil-krema, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡和一个奶油糕点。
messages.en: I'd like a coffee and a pastry with cream, please.

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Trid tiekolha hawn jew teħodha miegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Trid tiekolha hawn jew teħodha miegħek?
messages.zh: 好的。您想在这里吃，还是带走？
messages.en: Certainly. Would you like to eat it here or take it with you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pastina 放进咖啡馆点单画面：一杯咖啡旁边摆着一个小糕点，再把 bil-krema 与糕点上的奶油一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the spiritual care and guidance that a church provides for people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与教会为人们提供的信仰关怀、灵性照顾和引导有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-kura spiritwali u l-gwida li l-Knisja tagħti lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 牧灵的；教牧的；与教会对信众的灵性照顾及信仰引导有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marbut mal-ħidma tal-Knisja biex tieħu ħsieb il-ħtiġijiet spiritwali tal-fidili u tiggwidahom fil-ħajja tal-fidi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pastoral activities involve the spiritual care, support, and guidance that a church offers to its members.

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa ħejjiet programm ta' ħidma pastorali biex toffri appoġġ spiritwali lill-familji.
formal.en: The parish prepared a programme of pastoral work to offer spiritual support to families.
formal.zh: 堂区制订了一项牧灵工作计划，为各家庭提供灵性支持。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ġej il-kappillan illum? Pawlu: Għal żjara pastorali. Se jitkellem man-nanna u jara jekk għandhiex bżonn xi għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the parish priest coming today? Pawlu: For a pastoral visit. He'll talk to Grandma and see whether she needs any help.
colloquial.zh: Lara：本堂神父今天为什么要来？Pawlu：来做牧灵探访。他会和奶奶聊聊，看看她是否需要什么帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ġej il-kappillan illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ġej il-kappillan illum?
messages.zh: 本堂神父今天为什么要来？
messages.en: Why is the parish priest coming today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal żjara pastorali. Se jitkellem man-nanna u jara jekk għandhiex bżonn xi għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Għal żjara pastorali. Se jitkellem man-nanna u jara jekk għandhiex bżonn xi għajnuna.
messages.zh: 来做牧灵探访。他会和奶奶聊聊，看看她是否需要什么帮助。
messages.en: For a pastoral visit. He'll talk to Grandma and see whether she needs any help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“神父探访家庭、关心信仰生活”的画面记 pastorali，再成组记忆 ħidma pastorali（牧灵工作）和 żjara pastorali（牧灵探访）。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose intended lexical meaning requires clarification before translation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个具体词义尚未明确的名词，需要先确认所指，才能给出可靠译法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira maħsuba tiegħu trid tiġi ċċarata qabel ma tingħata traduzzjoni preċiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此名词的目标词义尚未明确，不能据此确定中文释义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tifsira speċifika maħsuba għal dan in-nom mhijiex ċara biżżejjed biex tingħata definizzjoni lessikali preċiża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun needs a clearly identified sense before a reliable translation can be supplied.

formal.mt: Qabel ma nużaw il-kelma 'pasturi' fit-traduzzjoni, jeħtieġ li niċċaraw it-tifsira tagħha f'din is-sentenza.
formal.en: Before using the word 'pasturi' in the translation, we need to clarify its meaning in this sentence.
formal.zh: 在译文中使用“pasturi”之前，我们需要先明确它在这个句子中的意思。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'pasturi' hawn? Mark: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu t-tifsira.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'pasturi' mean here? Mark: Let's read the whole sentence to understand the meaning.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：“pasturi”在这里是什么意思？马克：我们把整个句子读一遍，理解一下它的意思。

messages.speaker: Lina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'pasturi' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'pasturi' hawn?
messages.zh: “pasturi”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'pasturi' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu t-tifsira.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw is-sentenza kollha biex nifhmu t-tifsira.
messages.zh: 我们把整个句子读一遍，理解一下它的意思。
messages.en: Let's read the whole sentence to understand the meaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“这个词是什么意思”练习提问；词义未明确时，留下待查标记，避免记错译义。

gloss_zh: 家长式干预的；父权制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing authority that decides what is best for others, or a social order in which men hold the main authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容以替他人作主的方式管理、声称为他人着想的态度；也可指男性掌握主要权力的社会秩序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi tmexxija li tiddeċiedi x'inhu l-aħjar għal ħaddieħor mingħajr ma tagħtih biżżejjed għażla, jew ordni soċjali fejn l-irġiel għandhom l-awtorità ewlenija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家长式干预的；以保护或为他人着想为由，替他人决定并限制其自主选择的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jittratta lin-nies bħallikieku ma jistgħux jiddeċiedu għalihom infushom, billi jagħmel għażliet għalihom bl-intenzjoni li jipproteġihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is paternalistic makes decisions for other people because they believe they know what is best for them.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 父权制的；指家庭或社会中的主要权力由男性掌握的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda familja jew soċjetà fejn l-irġiel għandhom l-awtorità ewlenija u l-akbar setgħa fit-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patriarchal family or society gives men the main authority over decisions and social arrangements.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkritika l-approċċ paternalistiku tal-istituzzjoni, li tiddeċiedi għan-nies mingħajr ma tikkonsultahom.
formal.en: The report criticizes the institution's paternalistic approach, which involves deciding for people without consulting them.
formal.zh: 报告批评了该机构未经咨询便替人作主的家长式做法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-maniġer jgħid li jaf x'inhu l-aħjar għalina, imma qatt ma jistaqsina. David: Dan hu atteġġjament paternalistiku; għandu jisma' l-opinjonijiet tagħkom.
colloquial.en: Sara: The manager says he knows what is best for us, but he never asks us. David: That's a paternalistic attitude; he should listen to your opinions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：经理说他知道什么对我们最好，却从来不问我们。戴维：这是家长式作主的态度；他应该听听你们的意见。

messages.speaker: Sara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maniġer jgħid li jaf x'inhu l-aħjar għalina, imma qatt ma jistaqsina.
messages.mt_standard: Il-maniġer jgħid li jaf x'inhu l-aħjar għalina, imma qatt ma jistaqsina.
messages.zh: 经理说他知道什么对我们最好，却从来不问我们。
messages.en: The manager says he knows what is best for us, but he never asks us.

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu atteġġjament paternalistiku; għandu jisma' l-opinjonijiet tagħkom.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu atteġġjament paternalistiku; għandu jisma' l-opinjonijiet tagħkom.
messages.zh: 这是家长式作主的态度；他应该听听你们的意见。
messages.en: That's a paternalistic attitude; he should listen to your opinions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分义项：“我替你决定”对应家长式干预，“男性掌握主要权力”对应父权制。

gloss_zh: 父权制的；男性掌握主要权力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a family or social system in which men hold the main authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容家庭或社会制度中男性掌握主要权力、主导重要决定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirrigwarda familja jew sistema soċjali fejn l-irġiel għandhom l-awtorità ewlenija u jiddominaw id-deċiżjonijiet importanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 父权制的；指男性在家庭或社会中占据主要权力地位的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi struttura ta' familja jew soċjetà fejn is-setgħa u l-awtorità huma prinċipalment f'idejn l-irġiel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patriarchal system places the main social or family authority in the hands of men.

formal.mt: L-istudju janalizza struttura patrijarkali li tagħti lill-irġiel aktar setgħa fit-teħid tad-deċiżjonijiet tal-familja.
formal.en: The study analyzes a patriarchal structure that gives men greater power in family decision-making.
formal.zh: 这项研究分析了一种使男性在家庭决策中拥有更大权力的父权结构。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex issejjaħ din il-familja patrijarkali? Lara: Għax l-irġiel jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet importanti, u n-nisa ftit għandhom leħen.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why do you call this family patriarchal? Lara: Because the men make the important decisions, and the women have little say.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你为什么说这个家庭是父权式的？拉拉：因为重要决定都由男性作出，女性几乎没有发言权。

messages.speaker: Anna (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħ din il-familja patrijarkali?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħ din il-familja patrijarkali?
messages.zh: 你为什么说这个家庭是父权式的？
messages.en: Why do you call this family patriarchal?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-irġiel jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet importanti, u n-nisa ftit għandhom leħen.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-irġiel jieħdu d-deċiżjonijiet importanti, u n-nisa ftit għandhom leħen.
messages.zh: 因为重要决定都由男性作出，女性几乎没有发言权。
messages.en: Because the men make the important decisions, and the women have little say.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住提问“主要权力在谁手里”：若制度让男性主导，就用 patrijarkali 描述其父权性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who loves and supports their country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 热爱并支持自己国家的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb lil pajjiżha u tappoġġjah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱国者；热爱并支持自己国家的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Patrijott huwa persuna li tħobb lil pajjiżha u turi appoġġ lejh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patriot is someone who loves their country and supports it.

collocations.en: a patriot who serves his country

formal.mt: Il-patrijott juri mħabbtu lejn pajjiżu billi jaqdi lill-komunità b'responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The patriot shows his love for his country by serving the community responsibly.
formal.zh: 这位爱国者通过尽责地服务社区，表达对国家的热爱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li nannuk huwa patrijott? Mark: Għax iħobb lil pajjiżu u dejjem jipprova jgħin lin-nies tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say your grandfather is a patriot? Mark: Because he loves his country and always tries to help its people.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说你爷爷是爱国者？Mark：因为他热爱自己的国家，也总是尽力帮助本国人民。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li nannuk huwa patrijott?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li nannuk huwa patrijott?
messages.zh: 你为什么说你爷爷是爱国者？
messages.en: Why do you say your grandfather is a patriot?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax iħobb lil pajjiżu u dejjem jipprova jgħin lin-nies tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax iħobb lil pajjiżu u dejjem jipprova jgħin lin-nies tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他热爱自己的国家，也总是尽力帮助本国人民。
messages.en: Because he loves his country and always tries to help its people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 patrijott 和“爱国者本人”配对记忆，想象一个用实际行动服务国家的人，记住它指人。

gloss_zh: 爱国的；体现爱国情感的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing love for and support of one's country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现出对自己国家的热爱与支持的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri mħabba lejn pajjiżu jew jesprimi mħabba u appoġġ lejn il-pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱国的；表达或体现对本国的热爱与支持的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa deskritta bħala patrijottika turi jew tesprimi mħabba u appoġġ lejn il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something that is patriotic shows love for and support of their country.

formal.mt: Id-diskors patrijottiku esprima mħabba lejn il-pajjiż u ħeġġeġ liċ-ċittadini biex jaħdmu għall-ġid komuni.
formal.en: The patriotic speech expressed love for the country and encouraged citizens to work for the common good.
formal.zh: 这篇爱国演讲表达了对国家的热爱，并鼓励公民为共同利益而努力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għoġbok id-diskors? Pawlu: Iva, kien patrijottiku u tkellem dwar kemm għandna nieħdu ħsieb pajjiżna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you like the speech? Pawlu: Yes, it was patriotic and talked about how much we should care for our country.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你喜欢那篇演讲吗？Pawlu：喜欢，很有爱国情怀，讲到了我们应当多么用心地爱护自己的国家。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoġbok id-diskors?
messages.mt_standard: Għoġbok id-diskors?
messages.zh: 你喜欢那篇演讲吗？
messages.en: Did you like the speech?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien patrijottiku u tkellem dwar kemm għandna nieħdu ħsieb pajjiżna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien patrijottiku u tkellem dwar kemm għandna nieħdu ħsieb pajjiżna.
messages.zh: 喜欢，很有爱国情怀，讲到了我们应当多么用心地爱护自己的国家。
messages.en: Yes, it was patriotic and talked about how much we should care for our country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“怎样的演讲？爱国的演讲”来记 patrijottiku；把它放进 diskors patrijottiku，记住它用于描述性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Love for and support of one's country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自己国家的热爱与支持，以及由此体现的爱国精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-imħabba u l-appoġġ li persuna turi lejn pajjiżha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱国主义；对本国的热爱、支持及相应的情感与态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-patrijottiżmu huwa s-sentiment ta' mħabba lejn pajjiżek u x-xewqa li tappoġġjah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Patriotism is the love people feel for their country and the support they give it.

formal.mt: Il-patrijottiżmu jista' jiġi espress permezz ta' ħidma volontarja għall-ġid tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: Patriotism can be expressed through voluntary work for the good of the country.
formal.zh: 爱国精神可以通过为国家福祉开展志愿服务来表达。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif turi l-patrijottiżmu tiegħek? David: Billi nieħu ħsieb pajjiżi u ngħin lill-komunità fejn ngħix.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do you show your patriotism? David: By caring for my country and helping the community where I live.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你怎样表达自己的爱国情怀？David：爱护自己的国家，并帮助我居住的社区。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif turi l-patrijottiżmu tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Kif turi l-patrijottiżmu tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你怎样表达自己的爱国情怀？
messages.en: How do you show your patriotism?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Billi nieħu ħsieb pajjiżi u ngħin lill-komunità fejn ngħix.
messages.mt_standard: Billi nieħu ħsieb pajjiżi u ngħin lill-komunità fejn ngħix.
messages.zh: 爱护自己的国家，并帮助我居住的社区。
messages.en: By caring for my country and helping the community where I live.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 patrijottiżmu 放在“心中的爱国情怀”这个画面里记忆；它指抽象的情感与精神，可用具体的服务行动来联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement in which the parties commit to honest, transparent conduct and the prevention of corruption.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 各方承诺诚实、透明地行事并防止腐败的协议，常用于采购或其他需要廉洁保障的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ftehim li bih il-partijiet jimpenjaw ruħhom li jaġixxu b'onestà u trasparenza u li jevitaw il-korruzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 约定参与各方遵守诚信、保持透明并防止腐败行为的廉洁协议。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ftehim bejn partijiet li jwiegħdu li jżommu mġiba onesta u trasparenti u li ma jinvolvux ruħhom fil-korruzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An integrity pact is an agreement through which participants commit to honest conduct, transparency, and the prevention of corruption.

formal.mt: Qabel ma bdiet il-proċedura tal-akkwist, il-partijiet kollha ffirmaw patt ta' integrità biex jippromwovu t-trasparenza u jipprevjenu l-korruzzjoni.
formal.en: Before the procurement procedure began, all parties signed an integrity pact to promote transparency and prevent corruption.
formal.zh: 采购程序开始前，各方签署了廉洁协议，以促进透明并防止腐败。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex irridu niffirmaw dan il-patt ta' integrità? Mark: Biex ilkoll nimpenjaw ruħna li naġixxu b'onestà u nevitaw il-korruzzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do we need to sign this integrity pact? Mark: So that we all commit to acting honestly and avoiding corruption.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们为什么需要签这份廉洁协议？Mark：为了让大家都承诺诚实行事，避免腐败。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex irridu niffirmaw dan il-patt ta' integrità?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex irridu niffirmaw dan il-patt ta' integrità?
messages.zh: 我们为什么需要签这份廉洁协议？
messages.en: Why do we need to sign this integrity pact?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex ilkoll nimpenjaw ruħna li naġixxu b'onestà u nevitaw il-korruzzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Biex ilkoll nimpenjaw ruħna li naġixxu b'onestà u nevitaw il-korruzzjoni.
messages.zh: 为了让大家都承诺诚实行事，避免腐败。
messages.en: So that we all commit to acting honestly and avoiding corruption.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个短语连同“各方签字承诺廉洁”的画面一起记：看到协议上的签名，就想到诚信、透明和反腐。

gloss_zh: 按双方共同商定的条款与条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Terms and conditions that the parties have agreed to together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有关各方共同商定并接受的条款与条件；在相应语境中表示按这些条款与条件行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-patti u l-kundizzjonijiet li l-partijiet ikunu qablu dwarhom flimkien u aċċettaw.

sense_translations.en_definition: on mutually agreed terms and conditions
sense_translations.zh_definition: 按照有关各方共同商定并接受的条款与条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din l-espressjoni tindika li xi ħaġa ssir skont patti u kundizzjonijiet li l-partijiet kollha jkunu qablu dwarhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an arrangement operates on mutually agreed terms and conditions, everyone involved has accepted the rules governing it.

collocations.mt: jaħdmu skont patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament
collocations.en: to work on mutually agreed terms and conditions
collocations.zh: 按共同商定的条款与条件开展工作

collocations.mt: jistabbilixxu patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament
collocations.en: to establish mutually agreed terms and conditions
collocations.zh: 确立各方共同认可的条款与条件

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ partijiet se jikkooperaw skont patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament.
formal.en: The two parties will cooperate on mutually agreed terms and conditions.
formal.zh: 双方将按照共同商定的条款与条件开展合作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nistgħu naħdmu skont patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament? Mark: Iva, ejja niddiskutu d-dettalji u niktbu dak li naqblu fuqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can we work on mutually agreed terms and conditions? Mark: Yes, let's discuss the details and write down what we agree on.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们可以按双方共同商定的条款与条件开展工作吗？Mark：可以，我们来讨论细节，把达成一致的内容写下来。

messages.speaker: Lara (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu naħdmu skont patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu naħdmu skont patti u kundizzjonijiet maqbula reċiprokament?
messages.zh: 我们可以按双方共同商定的条款与条件开展工作吗？
messages.en: Can we work on mutually agreed terms and conditions?

messages.speaker: Mark (合作方代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja niddiskutu d-dettalji u niktbu dak li naqblu fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja niddiskutu d-dettalji u niktbu dak li naqblu fuqu.
messages.zh: 可以，我们来讨论细节，把达成一致的内容写下来。
messages.en: Yes, let's discuss the details and write down what we agree on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“条款与条件—已经商定—双方共同认可”三个意义块记忆整句，想象双方一起核对并接受同一份约定。

gloss_zh: 悬挂在街道上方的装饰布幔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorated piece of cloth hung above a street as an ornament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬挂在街道上方、带有较多装饰的布幔，用于布置街景。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp imżejna ħafna li tiddendel fuq triq biex iżżejjinha.

sense_translations.en_definition: A piece of cloth hung above streets largley decorated
sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂于街道上方、装饰较为繁复的一幅布幔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp b'ħafna tiżjin li tkun imdendla fuq triq bħala dekorazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pavaljun is a decorated cloth suspended above a street to make the street look festive.

collocations.en: a decorative cloth hangs above the street
collocations.zh: 装饰布幔悬挂在街道上方

collocations.en: a decorative street cloth adorned for the feast
collocations.zh: 为节庆装饰的街道布幔

formal.mt: Għall-festa tar-raħal, il-voluntiera dendlu pavaljun ikkulurit fuq it-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: For the village feast, volunteers hung a colourful decorative cloth above the main street.
formal.zh: 为庆祝村里的节日，志愿者在主街上方悬挂了一幅彩色装饰布幔。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ara dak il-pavaljun fuq it-triq! Pawlu: Kemm hu sabiħ! Il-kuluri tiegħu jaqblu mat-tiżjin tal-festa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Look at that decorative cloth above the street! Pawlu: It's so beautiful! Its colours match the feast decorations.
colloquial.zh: Sara：看街道上方那幅装饰布幔！Pawlu：真漂亮！它的颜色和节日装饰很搭。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-pavaljun fuq it-triq!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-pavaljun fuq it-triq!
messages.zh: 看街道上方那幅装饰布幔！
messages.en: Look at that decorative cloth above the street!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Il-kuluri tiegħu jaqblu mat-tiżjin tal-festa.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Il-kuluri tiegħu jaqblu mat-tiżjin tal-festa.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！它的颜色和节日装饰很搭。
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Its colours match the feast decorations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为这个词单独画一张街景卡片：彩色布幔高挂在街道上方，把本条含义牢牢定位为“头顶的装饰布”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or covered structure used for exhibitions, events, or shelter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于展览、活动或遮蔽休息的建筑物或亭式有顶结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew struttura msaqqfa li tintuża għal wirjiet, attivitajiet jew kenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供展览、举办活动或遮蔽休息使用的展馆或亭式建筑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini jew struttura b'saqaf fejn jistgħu jsiru wirjiet u attivitajiet, jew fejn in-nies jistgħu jsibu kenn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pavilion is a building or covered structure where people can attend exhibitions, take part in events, or find shelter.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi d-daħliet tal-pavaljuni u r-rotta li għandhom isegwu l-viżitaturi waqt il-wirja.
formal.en: The map shows the pavilion entrances and the route visitors should follow during the exhibition.
formal.zh: 地图标明了各展馆的入口，以及参观者在展览期间应遵循的路线。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn insib il-mappa tal-pavaljuni? David: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nieħdu waħda qabel nibdew induru.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where can I find the map of the pavilions? David: Near the entrance. Let's get one before we start looking around.
colloquial.zh: Lara：哪里能找到展馆地图？David：入口附近。我们先拿一张，再开始逛吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn insib il-mappa tal-pavaljuni?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn insib il-mappa tal-pavaljuni?
messages.zh: 哪里能找到展馆地图？
messages.en: Where can I find the map of the pavilions?

messages.speaker: David (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nieħdu waħda qabel nibdew induru.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn id-daħla. Ejja nieħdu waħda qabel nibdew induru.
messages.zh: 入口附近。我们先拿一张，再开始逛吧。
messages.en: Near the entrance. Let's get one before we start looking around.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pavaljuni 写在一张展馆导览图旁，联想有屋顶、有入口、可以进去参观的建筑，用场景记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A building or roofed structure used for exhibitions, public activities, or shelter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于展览、公共活动或遮蔽休息的展馆或有顶亭阁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bini jew struttura b'saqaf li tintuża għal wirjiet, attivitajiet pubbliċi jew kenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供展览、公共活动或遮蔽休息使用的展馆或亭阁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bini jew struttura msaqqfa fejn isiru wirjiet jew attivitajiet, jew fejn in-nies jistgħu joqogħdu għall-kenn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pavilion is a building or roofed structure used for exhibitions, gatherings, or shelter in a public space.

formal.mt: Il-paviljun fil-ġnien se jintuża għal wirja ta' pitturi magħmula minn artisti lokali.
formal.en: The pavilion in the garden will be used for an exhibition of paintings by local artists.
formal.zh: 花园里的亭阁将用于举办本地艺术家的绘画展。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se niltaqgħu wara l-mixja? Mark: Ħdejn il-paviljun fil-ġnien. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we meet after the walk? Mark: By the pavilion in the garden. We can sit in the shade there.
colloquial.zh: Nina：散步后我们在哪里碰面？Mark：花园的亭阁旁边。我们可以在那里坐着乘凉。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu wara l-mixja?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu wara l-mixja?
messages.zh: 散步后我们在哪里碰面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet after the walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-paviljun fil-ġnien. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-paviljun fil-ġnien. Hemm nistgħu noqogħdu fid-dell.
messages.zh: 花园的亭阁旁边。我们可以在那里坐着乘凉。
messages.en: By the pavilion in the garden. We can sit in the shade there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象与朋友约在花园亭阁旁见面，再把 paviljun 写在亭子的屋顶上，用“有顶、可停留”的画面帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The surface inside a room or building that people stand and walk on.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 房间或建筑物内供人站立和行走的地板或地面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ ta' ġewwa ta' kamra jew bini li n-nies joqogħdu bilwieqfa jew jimxu fuqu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地板；房间或建筑物内部供人站立和行走的地面。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-wiċċ ta' ġewwa ta' kamra jew bini li fuqu jimxu n-nies u jitqiegħdu l-għamara u oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The floor of a room is the surface that you walk on and place furniture on.

formal.mt: Il-paviment tas-sala għandu jinżamm nadif u niexef biex jitnaqqas ir-riskju li xi ħadd jiżloq.
formal.en: The hall floor must be kept clean and dry to reduce the risk of someone slipping.
formal.zh: 大厅地面应保持清洁干燥，以降低有人滑倒的风险。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-paviment għadu mxarrab? Mark: Għadni kemm ħsiltu. Oqgħod attenta meta tgħaddi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the floor still wet? Mark: I've just washed it. Be careful when you walk across.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：地板怎么还湿着？马克：我刚洗过。你走过去时小心点。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-paviment għadu mxarrab?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-paviment għadu mxarrab?
messages.zh: 地板怎么还湿着？
messages.en: Why is the floor still wet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni kemm ħsiltu. Oqgħod attenta meta tgħaddi.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni kemm ħsiltu. Oqgħod attenta meta tgħaddi.
messages.zh: 我刚洗过。你走过去时小心点。
messages.en: I've just washed it. Be careful when you walk across.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paviment 和脚下的地板画面绑定，再联想木地板与清洗地板两个场景，记住它指地面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A folded part on the front of a jacket or coat, beside the collar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夹克、西装或外套前襟靠近领口、向外翻折的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' quddiem ta' ġakketta jew kowt, ħdejn l-għonq, li tintewa lura fuq is-sider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻领；西装、夹克或外套前襟靠近领口、向外翻折的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' ġakketta jew kowt ħdejn l-għonq li tkun mitwija lura u tidher fuq quddiem tas-sider.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lapel is a folded section at the front of a jacket or coat, next to the collar.

formal.mt: Għaċ-ċerimonja, kull rappreżentant għandu jwaħħal pin żgħir fuq il-pavru tal-ġakketta.
formal.en: For the ceremony, each representative should attach a small pin to the lapel of their jacket.
formal.zh: 参加典礼时，每位代表应在西装翻领上佩戴一枚小别针。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn inwaħħal dan il-pin? Toni: Fuq il-pavru tal-ġakketta, hawn ħdejn l-għonq.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I put this pin? Toni: On the lapel of your jacket, here beside the collar.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这枚别针该别在哪里？托尼：别在你的外套翻领上，就在领口旁边这里。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inwaħħal dan il-pin?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inwaħħal dan il-pin?
messages.zh: 这枚别针该别在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this pin?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-pavru tal-ġakketta, hawn ħdejn l-għonq.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-pavru tal-ġakketta, hawn ħdejn l-għonq.
messages.zh: 别在你的外套翻领上，就在领口旁边这里。
messages.en: On the lapel of your jacket, here beside the collar.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pavru 时想象把小别针别在西装胸前翻折的领片上，用这个具体位置记住“翻领”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short break between parts of a performance or other organized event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 演出或其他有组织活动的不同部分之间安排的短暂休息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Waqfa qasira bejn il-partijiet ta' spettaklu jew attività organizzata oħra, li warajha l-programm ikompli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幕间休息；演出或活动两部分之间、之后还会继续进行的休息时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħin qasir ta' mistrieħ bejn żewġ partijiet ta' spettaklu jew avveniment, qabel ma jerġa' jibda l-programm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An intermission is a short break between parts of a performance or event, after which the programme continues.

collocations.en: an intermission between the two acts

formal.mt: Bejn l-ewwel u t-tieni att se jkun hemm pawsa ta' ħmistax-il minuta.
formal.en: There will be a fifteen-minute intermission between the first and second acts.
formal.zh: 第一幕和第二幕之间将安排十五分钟的幕间休息。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Immorru nixtru xi ħaġa x'nixorbu waqt il-pawsa? Toni: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu nidħlu qabel jibda t-tieni att.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we go and buy something to drink during the intermission? Toni: Yes, but let's get back inside before the second act starts.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：幕间休息时，我们去买点喝的吧？托尼：好，不过第二幕开始前我们得回到里面。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Immorru nixtru xi ħaġa x'nixorbu waqt il-pawsa?
messages.mt_standard: Immorru nixtru xi ħaġa x'nixorbu waqt il-pawsa?
messages.zh: 幕间休息时，我们去买点喝的吧？
messages.en: Shall we go and buy something to drink during the intermission?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu nidħlu qabel jibda t-tieni att.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nerġgħu nidħlu qabel jibda t-tieni att.
messages.zh: 好，不过第二幕开始前我们得回到里面。
messages.en: Yes, but let's get back inside before the second act starts.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pawsa 放进看戏的时间线：第一幕结束、出去喝水、第二幕继续，中间那段休息就是它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bag used to carry or store small objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于携带或存放小件物品的小袋子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Borża żgħira li tintuża biex jinġarru jew jinżammu oġġetti żgħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小袋；用来装零钱、钥匙等小件物品的收纳袋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Borża żgħira li fiha wieħed jista' jżomm oġġetti bħall-flus, iċ-ċwievet jew affarijiet personali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pouch is a small bag in which you carry or keep small belongings.

formal.mt: Waqt il-vjaġġ, żomm iċ-ċwievet u l-muniti f'pawċ biż-żipp ġewwa l-bagalja.
formal.en: During the journey, keep your keys and coins in a zippered pouch inside your suitcase.
formal.zh: 旅途中，请把钥匙和硬币放在行李箱内的拉链小袋里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-pawċ tiegħi? Għandi ċ-ċwievet fih. Mark: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen my pouch? My keys are in it. Mark: Yes, it's on the table, beside the phone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看见我的小袋了吗？我的钥匙在里面。马克：看见了，在桌上，手机旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-pawċ tiegħi? Għandi ċ-ċwievet fih.
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-pawċ tiegħi? Għandi ċ-ċwievet fih.
messages.zh: 你看见我的小袋了吗？我的钥匙在里面。
messages.en: Have you seen my pouch? My keys are in it.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-telefon.
messages.zh: 看见了，在桌上，手机旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table, beside the phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pawċ 想成手掌大小的拉链袋，脑中依次放入硬币和钥匙，记住它是装小物件的小袋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vulgar slang word referring to female genitalia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指女性生殖器的粗俗俚语，使用时须注意其冒犯性语体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma vulgari tal-lingwaġġ informali li tirreferi għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性生殖器的粗俗俚语称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Din hija kelma vulgari li tintuża fil-lingwaġġ informali biex tirreferi għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Paxu is a vulgar slang term used to refer to female genitalia.

collocations.zh: 避免使用 paxu 这个词

formal.mt: F'materjal edukattiv, il-kelma 'paxu' għandha tkun immarkata bħala kelma vulgari għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili.
formal.en: In educational material, the word 'paxu' should be marked as a vulgar term for female genitalia.
formal.zh: 在教学材料中，paxu 一词应标注为指女性生殖器的粗俗用语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'paxu'? Mark: Hija kelma vulgari għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili; aħjar tevitaha f'konverżazzjoni formali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the word 'paxu' mean? Mark: It's a vulgar word for female genitalia; it's better to avoid it in formal conversation.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：paxu 这个词是什么意思？马克：它是指女性生殖器的粗俗词，正式交谈时最好避免使用。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'paxu'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'paxu'?
messages.zh: paxu 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'paxu' mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kelma vulgari għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili; aħjar tevitaha f'konverżazzjoni formali.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kelma vulgari għall-partijiet ġenitali femminili; aħjar tevitaha f'konverżazzjoni formali.
messages.zh: 它是指女性生殖器的粗俗词，正式交谈时最好避免使用。
messages.en: It's a vulgar word for female genitalia; it's better to avoid it in formal conversation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paxu 放进标着“粗俗俚语”的词汇盒，同时记住其所指为女性生殖器；识别意思时也要识别语体。

gloss_zh: 女性生殖器的俚语或贬称；骂人优柔寡断或愚蠢的称呼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slang or derogatory name for female genitalia, also used as an insult for an indecisive or silly person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指女性生殖器的俚语或贬义称呼，也可用来辱骂优柔寡断或愚蠢的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma tal-lingwaġġ familjari jew dispreġġjattiv għall-organi ġenitali femminili, li tintuża wkoll bħala insult għal persuna indeċiża jew iblah.

sense_translations.en_definition: slang or derogatory term for female genitalia
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于称呼女性生殖器的俚语或贬义用语。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma tal-lingwaġġ familjari jew dispreġġjattiv li tirreferi għall-organi ġenitali femminili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Paċoċċu is a slang or derogatory word referring to female genitalia.

sense_translations.en_definition: term of abuse for an indecisive or silly person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来辱骂优柔寡断或愚蠢之人的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma ta' insult għal persuna li ma tiddeċidix jew li ġġib ruħha b'mod iblah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone may use paċoċċu to insult a person they consider indecisive or silly.

collocations.zh: 把 paċoċċu 当作骂人的话使用

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'paċoċċu' għandha żewġ tifsiriet: terminu familjari jew dispreġġjattiv għall-organi ġenitali femminili, u insult għal persuna indeċiża jew iblah.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'paċoċċu' has two meanings: a slang or derogatory term for female genitalia, and an insult for an indecisive or silly person.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，paċoċċu 有两个义项：一是女性生殖器的俚语或贬称，二是辱骂优柔寡断或愚蠢之人的称呼。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex sejjaħtli paċoċċu? Għax għadni ma ddeċidejtx? Mark: Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you call me a paċoċċu? Because I haven't decided yet? Mark: Sorry, I shouldn't have insulted you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么用 paċoċċu 骂我？就因为我还没决定吗？Mark：对不起，我不该骂你。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex sejjaħtli paċoċċu? Għax għadni ma ddeċidejtx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex sejjaħtli paċoċċu? Għax għadni ma ddeċidejtx?
messages.zh: 你为什么用 paċoċċu 骂我？就因为我还没决定吗？
messages.en: Why did you call me a paċoċċu? Because I haven't decided yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, ma kellix ninsultak.
messages.zh: 对不起，我不该骂你。
messages.en: Sorry, I shouldn't have insulted you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张语境卡记忆 paċoċċu：身体称谓卡对应女性生殖器，争吵卡对应骂人犹豫或愚蠢；注意两义都有不礼貌的使用语境。

gloss_zh: 睡衣；供睡觉时穿着的宽松衣服。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Loose, comfortable clothing worn in bed, typically consisting of a top and trousers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉时穿的宽松舒适衣服，通常由上衣和裤子组成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies komdu u wiesa' li jintlibes waqt l-irqad u li ġeneralment ikun magħmul minn flokk jew qmis u qalziet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡衣，通常指由宽松上衣和裤子组成、供睡觉时穿着的衣服。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies għall-irqad, normalment magħmul minn parti ta' fuq u qalziet, li jħalli lil min jilbsu jħossu komdu fis-sodda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pyjama clothing is loose clothing that you wear in bed, usually consisting of a comfortable top and a pair of trousers.

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-affarijiet għall-vjaġġ tinkludi paġama komda u ħwejjeġ nodfa għal kull jum.
formal.en: The packing list includes comfortable pyjamas and clean clothes for each day.
formal.zh: 旅行物品清单包括舒适的睡衣和每天要换的干净衣服。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hi l-paġama tiegħi? Omm: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbisha u ejja ngħidulek il-lejl it-tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are my pyjamas? Mum: On the bed. Put them on, and let's say goodnight to you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我的睡衣在哪里？妈妈：在床上。穿上吧，我们来跟你道晚安。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-paġama tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-paġama tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的睡衣在哪里？
messages.en: Where are my pyjamas?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbisha u ejja ngħidulek il-lejl it-tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbisha u ejja ngħidulek il-lejl it-tajjeb.
messages.zh: 在床上。穿上吧，我们来跟你道晚安。
messages.en: On the bed. Put them on, and let's say goodnight to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 paġama 和睡前流程连起来记：洗漱后拿起宽松睡衣，穿好再上床；用“睡前穿的衣服”这一画面巩固词义。

gloss_zh: 傻乎乎的；被用来辱骂某人天真或愚蠢

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used insultingly to describe someone as naive or silly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以侮辱口吻形容某人天真、容易受骗或愚蠢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies bħala inġenwu jew iblah, meta l-kelma tintuża biex tinsulta lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.en_definition: an insult directed at someone considered naive or silly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于辱骂被认为天真或愚蠢的人的说法，带有贬损意味。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma ta' insult indirizzata lil persuna li titqies bħala inġenwa jew iblah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls you paħaħħu, they are insulting you by suggesting that you are naive or silly.

collocations.en: insult someone by calling them naive or silly
do not be so naive or silly
collocations.zh: 别那么傻；别那么天真（带贬损语气）

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'paħaħħu' tintuża bħala insult lejn persuna meqjusa inġenwa jew iblah.
formal.en: The word 'paħaħħu' is used as an insult towards someone considered naive or silly.
formal.zh: paħaħħu 一词用于辱骂被认为天真或愚蠢的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għajjarni paħaħħu? Ben: Għax emmint dik l-istorja, imma ma kellux għalfejn jinsultak.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did he call me naive like that? Ben: Because you believed that story, but he did not need to insult you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他为什么用 paħaħħu 骂我傻？Ben：因为你相信了那个故事，但他没必要侮辱你。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għajjarni paħaħħu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għajjarni paħaħħu?
messages.zh: 他为什么用 paħaħħu 骂我傻？
messages.en: Why did he call me naive like that?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax emmint dik l-istorja, imma ma kellux għalfejn jinsultak.
messages.mt_standard: Għax emmint dik l-istorja, imma ma kellux għalfejn jinsultak.
messages.zh: 因为你相信了那个故事，但他没必要侮辱你。
messages.en: Because you believed that story, but he did not need to insult you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想一个轻信故事后被人骂傻的场景：记住它带侮辱语气，不能当作中性的“天真”来使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Different from what is usual or expected, or having a particular, special character.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与通常情况或预期不同的；也可指具有特别或独特性质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun differenti mis-soltu jew minn dak li wieħed jistenna, jew li jkollu karattru partikolari jew speċjali.

sense_translations.en_definition: different to what is normal or expected; strange / particular; special.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同于正常情况或预期的，奇怪的；也可表示特别的、独特的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi xi ħaġa li tkun differenti min-normal jew minn dak mistenni, jew li tkun partikolari jew speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something peculiar differs from what you normally expect, or has a distinctive and special character.

formal.mt: Il-bini għandu karattru peculiar li jagħmlu differenti mill-binjiet l-oħra fit-triq.
formal.en: The building has a distinctive character that makes it different from the other buildings on the street.
formal.zh: 这座建筑具有独特的风格，使它有别于街上的其他建筑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss peculiar? Mark: Iva, ġej mill-fann; qatt ma smajtu jagħmel hekk qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you hear that peculiar sound? Mark: Yes, it's coming from the fan; I've never heard it make that noise before.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听见那个奇怪的声音了吗？马克：听见了，是风扇发出来的；我以前从没听过它这样响。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss peculiar?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss peculiar?
messages.zh: 你听见那个奇怪的声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that peculiar sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-fann; qatt ma smajtu jagħmel hekk qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-fann; qatt ma smajtu jagħmel hekk qabel.
messages.zh: 听见了，是风扇发出来的；我以前从没听过它这样响。
messages.en: Yes, it's coming from the fan; I've never heard it make that noise before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排相似房屋里有一座特别显眼的房子：peculiar 的核心是“与平常不同”，语境决定译成“奇怪”还是“独特”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to teaching, especially its methods and principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与教学及其方法、原则有关的；教育学的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mat-tagħlim, speċjalment mal-metodi u l-prinċipji tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 教学的；与教学方法或教育学原则有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi dak li jirrigwarda t-tagħlim u l-metodi jew il-prinċipji li jintużaw biex jgħinu lill-istudenti jitgħallmu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something pedagogical relates to teaching and to the methods or principles used to help people learn.

formal.mt: L-għan pedagoġiku ta' dan l-eżerċizzju huwa li jgħin lill-istudenti jużaw il-kliem f'kuntest.
formal.en: The pedagogical objective of this exercise is to help students use words in context.
formal.zh: 这项练习的教学目标是帮助学生在语境中使用词语。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nużaw din il-logħba fil-lezzjoni? Mark: Għandha għan pedagoġiku: tgħin lill-istudenti jipprattikaw il-kliem flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we using this game in the lesson? Mark: It has a pedagogical purpose: it helps the students practise vocabulary together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么在课上用这个游戏？马克：它有教学目的：帮助学生一起练习词汇。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nużaw din il-logħba fil-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nużaw din il-logħba fil-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 我们为什么在课上用这个游戏？
messages.en: Why are we using this game in the lesson?

messages.speaker: Mark (指导教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha għan pedagoġiku: tgħin lill-istudenti jipprattikaw il-kliem flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha għan pedagoġiku: tgħin lill-istudenti jipprattikaw il-kliem flimkien.
messages.zh: 它有教学目的：帮助学生一起练习词汇。
messages.en: It has a pedagogical purpose: it helps the students practise vocabulary together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pedagoġiku 和“教师为什么这样教”联系起来：课堂游戏有教学目标，讲解步骤有教学方法，两者都可用这个形容词描述。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part of a vehicle, machine, or instrument that you press or move with your foot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 车辆、机器或乐器上用脚踩压或推动的部件，即踏板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' vettura, magna jew strument li tagħfas jew iċċaqlaq b'sieqek biex tħaddem jew tikkontrolla xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踏板；车辆、机器或乐器上供脚踩动以操作或控制某项功能的部件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pedala hija parti li titħaddem bis-sieq biex tikkontrolla funzjoni ta' vettura, magna jew strument.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pedal is a part that you press or move with your foot to operate a vehicle, machine, or instrument.

formal.mt: Il-pedala tal-brejk tintuża biex tnaqqas il-veloċità tal-vettura jew twaqqafha.
formal.en: The brake pedal is used to reduce the vehicle's speed or bring it to a stop.
formal.zh: 制动踏板用于降低车辆速度或使车辆停下。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din il-pedala tar-rota qed tagħmel ħoss. Mark: Ejja nieqfu u niċċekkjawha qabel inkomplu.
colloquial.en: Maja: This bicycle pedal is making a noise. Mark: Let's stop and check it before we carry on.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：自行车的这个脚踏在响。马克：我们先停下来检查一下，再继续骑。

messages.speaker: Maja (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-pedala tar-rota qed tagħmel ħoss.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-pedala tar-rota qed tagħmel ħoss.
messages.zh: 自行车的这个脚踏在响。
messages.en: This bicycle pedal is making a noise.

messages.speaker: Mark (骑行伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu u niċċekkjawha qabel inkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu u niċċekkjawha qabel inkomplu.
messages.zh: 我们先停下来检查一下，再继续骑。
messages.en: Let's stop and check it before we carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pedala 时想象脚踩自行车脚踏，再联想到汽车刹车踏板：共同点都是“用脚操作的踏板”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The supporting base of a building, or the underlying basis on which something is developed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 支撑建筑物的地基，也可比喻事物赖以建立或发展的基础。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pedament huwa l-bażi li fuqha jinbena u jistrieħ bini, jew il-bażi li fuqha tiżviluppa xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物承重的地基；比喻支撑某种发展或活动的基础。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pedament huwa l-parti bażika li ssostni bini, jew dak li fuqu tinbena idea, ħidma jew relazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The foundation of something is the supporting base on which it is built or developed.

formal.mt: L-inġinier eżamina l-pedament tad-dar qabel ma beda x-xogħol ta' tiswija.
formal.en: The engineer examined the foundation of the house before the repair work began.
formal.zh: 工程师在维修工作开始前检查了房屋的地基。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex għadhom ma bnewx il-ħitan? Pawlu: Għax l-ewwel iridu jlestu l-pedament.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why haven't they built the walls yet? Pawlu: Because they need to finish the foundation first.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：他们怎么还没砌墙？保罗：因为他们得先把地基做好。

messages.speaker: Marta (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex għadhom ma bnewx il-ħitan?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex għadhom ma bnewx il-ħitan?
messages.zh: 他们怎么还没砌墙？
messages.en: Why haven't they built the walls yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax l-ewwel iridu jlestu l-pedament.
messages.mt_standard: Għax l-ewwel iridu jlestu l-pedament.
messages.zh: 因为他们得先把地基做好。
messages.en: Because they need to finish the foundation first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pedament 想成房屋最下面承重的地基，再由实物联想到学习或关系的基础。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cat, especially when referred to in an affectionate or familiar way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猫，尤其用于亲昵、熟悉的称呼，相当于“猫咪”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pejxu huwa qattus, speċjalment meta wieħed isejjaħlu b'mod ħelu jew familjari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫，一种常被当作宠物饲养的动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pejxu huwa qattus, annimal bil-pil u bid-dwiefer li ħafna nies iżommu bħala annimal domestiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cat is a small animal with fur and claws that people often keep as a pet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猫咪；对猫的亲昵称呼，并不一定指幼猫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pejxu huwa isem ħelu jew familjari għal qattus, li mhux bilfors ikun żgħir fl-età.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pussy-cat is a cat referred to in an affectionate or familiar way.

formal.mt: Fl-istorja għat-tfal, tifla ssib pejxu fil-ġnien u tagħtih l-ilma.
formal.en: In the children's story, a girl finds a cat in the garden and gives it water.
formal.zh: 在这篇儿童故事中，一个女孩在花园里发现一只猫，并给它水喝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dak il-pejxu ħelu ħdejn il-bieb! Ninu: Iva, ilu jorqod hemm minn dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that cute kitty by the door! Ninu: Yes, it's been sleeping there since this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看门边那只可爱的猫咪！尼努：是啊，它从今天早上就一直在那儿睡觉。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-pejxu ħelu ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-pejxu ħelu ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 看门边那只可爱的猫咪！
messages.en: Look at that cute kitty by the door!

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ilu jorqod hemm minn dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilu jorqod hemm minn dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 是啊，它从今天早上就一直在那儿睡觉。
messages.en: Yes, it's been sleeping there since this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pejxu 就想象自己温柔地招呼一只猫咪；亲昵称呼不代表它一定是幼猫。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who travels to a holy place for religious reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出于宗教信仰前往圣地的人，即朝圣者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pellegrin huwa persuna li tivvjaġġa lejn post qaddis għal raġunijiet reliġjużi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为表达宗教信仰、祈祷或敬拜而前往圣地的朝圣者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pellegrin huwa persuna li tmur lejn post qaddis biex titlob, turi d-devozzjoni tagħha jew tieħu sehem f'attivitajiet reliġjużi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilgrim is someone who makes a journey to a holy place for religious reasons.

collocations.en: a pilgrim walking towards the sanctuary
collocations.zh: 步行前往圣所的朝圣者

formal.mt: Il-pellegrin wasal fis-santwarju wara vjaġġ twil u waqaf jitlob fis-skiet.
formal.en: The pilgrim arrived at the sanctuary after a long journey and stopped to pray in silence.
formal.zh: 这位朝圣者经过长途跋涉抵达圣所，停下来默默祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dak ir-raġel huwa turist? Ġużeppi: Le, huwa pellegrin. Ġie hawn biex jitlob fis-santwarju.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is that man a tourist? Ġużeppi: No, he's a pilgrim. He came here to pray at the sanctuary.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：那个男人是游客吗？朱塞佩：不是，他是朝圣者。他来这里是为了在圣所祈祷。

messages.speaker: Marija (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ir-raġel huwa turist?
messages.mt_standard: Dak ir-raġel huwa turist?
messages.zh: 那个男人是游客吗？
messages.en: Is that man a tourist?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa pellegrin. Ġie hawn biex jitlob fis-santwarju.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa pellegrin. Ġie hawn biex jitlob fis-santwarju.
messages.zh: 不是，他是朝圣者。他来这里是为了在圣所祈祷。
messages.en: No, he's a pilgrim. He came here to pray at the sanctuary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pellegrin 配上一幅人走向圣地的画面，重点记住它指参加朝圣的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A journey to a holy place made for religious reasons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出于宗教信仰前往圣地的旅程或活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pellegrinaġġ huwa vjaġġ lejn post qaddis li jsir għal raġunijiet reliġjużi, bħat-talb u d-devozzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为祈祷、敬拜或表达虔诚信仰而前往圣地的朝圣旅程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pellegrinaġġ huwa vjaġġ li persuna jew grupp jagħmlu lejn post qaddis biex jitolbu jew jesprimu l-fidi u d-devozzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilgrimage is a journey that people make to a holy place as an expression of religious faith.

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa organizzat pellegrinaġġ lejn is-santwarju, u l-parteċipanti nġabru għat-talb qabel it-tluq.
formal.en: The parish organized a pilgrimage to the sanctuary, and the participants gathered for prayer before departure.
formal.zh: 堂区组织了一次前往圣所的朝圣之旅，参加者在出发前聚集祈祷。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Se tiġi magħna għall-pellegrinaġġ nhar il-Ħadd? Mark: Iva, se niġi. Minn fejn se nitilqu?
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you coming with us on the pilgrimage on Sunday? Mark: Yes, I'm coming. Where are we leaving from?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：星期日你要和我们一起去朝圣吗？马克：要，我会去。我们从哪里出发？

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tiġi magħna għall-pellegrinaġġ nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Se tiġi magħna għall-pellegrinaġġ nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 星期日你要和我们一起去朝圣吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us on the pilgrimage on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niġi. Minn fejn se nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niġi. Minn fejn se nitilqu?
messages.zh: 要，我会去。我们从哪里出发？
messages.en: Yes, I'm coming. Where are we leaving from?

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 pellegrinaġġ 想成日历上标好的整段朝圣行程；与指人的 pellegrin 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 彭布罗克（马耳他北部地区的城镇）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pembroke is a town in the Northern Region of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 彭布罗克，位于马耳他北部地区的一座城镇。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pembroke hija belt fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.

sense_translations.en_definition: Pembroke, a town in the Northern Region of Malta
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彭布罗克，马耳他北部地区的一座城镇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pembroke hija belt li tinsab fir-Reġjun tat-Tramuntana ta' Malta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pembroke is the name of a town located in Malta's Northern Region.

collocations.zh: 到彭布罗克的一次访问

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi informazzjoni dwar is-servizzi pubbliċi f'Pembroke.
formal.en: The report includes information about public services in Pembroke.
formal.zh: 这份报告包含有关彭布罗克公共服务的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn toqgħod? Mark: Noqgħod f'Pembroke. Maja: U taħdem hemm ukoll? Mark: Le, naħdem f'belt oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where do you live? Mark: I live in Pembroke. Maja: Do you work there too? Mark: No, I work in another town.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你住在哪里？马克：我住在彭布罗克。玛雅：你也在那里工作吗？马克：不，我在另一座城镇工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn toqgħod?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn toqgħod?
messages.zh: 你住在哪里？
messages.en: Where do you live?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Noqgħod f'Pembroke.
messages.mt_standard: Noqgħod f'Pembroke.
messages.zh: 我住在彭布罗克。
messages.en: I live in Pembroke.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U taħdem hemm ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: U taħdem hemm ukoll?
messages.zh: 你也在那里工作吗？
messages.en: Do you work there too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, naħdem f'belt oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, naħdem f'belt oħra.
messages.zh: 不，我在另一座城镇工作。
messages.en: No, I work in another town.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pembroke 当作地图上的专名记忆：联想马耳他北部的一枚城镇图钉，再用 f'Pembroke 练习表达“在彭布罗克”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A punishment or charge imposed for breaking a rule or failing to meet an obligation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因违反规则或未履行义务而受到的处罚，尤指罚款或违约金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Piena jew somma ta' flus imposta fuq xi ħadd talli jikser regola jew jonqos milli jwettaq obbligu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因违规或未履行义务而施加的处罚，可指罚款或违约金。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Piena li tiġi imposta minħabba ksur ta' regola jew nuqqas ta' twettiq ta' obbligu, u li tista' tkun ħlas ta' flus.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A penalty is a punishment or charge that someone receives for breaking a rule or failing to fulfil an obligation.

formal.mt: Skont il-kuntratt, il-kumpanija trid tħallas penali jekk ma tlestix ix-xogħol fil-ħin.
formal.en: Under the contract, the company must pay a penalty if it does not complete the work on time.
formal.zh: 根据合同，公司若未按时完成工作，就必须支付违约金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ħallast aktar dan ix-xahar? Mark: Kelli nħallas penali għax ħallast il-kont tard. Maja: Id-darba li jmiss, agħmel tfakkira fuq il-mowbajl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you pay more this month? Mark: I had to pay a penalty because I paid the bill late. Maja: Next time, set a reminder on your phone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你这个月怎么多付了钱？马克：因为账单付晚了，我得交一笔罚款。玛雅：下次在手机上设个提醒吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallast aktar dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallast aktar dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 你这个月怎么多付了钱？
messages.en: Why did you pay more this month?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kelli nħallas penali għax ħallast il-kont tard.
messages.mt_standard: Kelli nħallas penali għax ħallast il-kont tard.
messages.zh: 因为账单付晚了，我得交一笔罚款。
messages.en: I had to pay a penalty because I paid the bill late.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-darba li jmiss, agħmel tfakkira fuq il-mowbajl.
messages.mt_standard: Id-darba li jmiss, agħmel tfakkira fuq il-mowbajl.
messages.zh: 下次在手机上设个提醒吧。
messages.en: Next time, set a reminder on your phone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 penali 和“账单逾期后多交的一笔钱”联系起来，再记住 tħallas penali，表示缴纳罚款或违约金。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land that is almost surrounded by water but remains connected to a larger land area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 半岛，向水域伸出、几乎被水包围，但仍与较大陆地相连的一片陆地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art kważi mdawra bl-ilma li tibqa' magħquda ma' massa ta' art akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 半岛，几乎四面环水、但仍有一部分与较大陆地相连的陆地区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Peninsula hija biċċa art li tisporġi fl-ilma u tkun kważi mdawra bih, iżda tibqa' magħquda ma' art akbar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A peninsula is an area of land that is almost surrounded by water but is still connected to a larger land area.

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi peninsula dejqa li tibqa' magħquda mal-art prinċipali fin-naħa tan-Nofsinhar.
formal.en: The map shows a narrow peninsula that remains connected to the mainland on its southern side.
formal.zh: 地图显示了一座狭窄的半岛，其南侧仍与大陆相连。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din gżira fuq il-mappa? Ninu: Le, din peninsula. Ara, għadha magħquda mal-art hawn. Lara: Issa fhimt, hemm l-ilma kważi madwarha kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this an island on the map? Ninu: No, it's a peninsula. Look, it's still connected to the land here. Lara: Now I understand; there's water almost all around it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：地图上这是一座岛吗？尼努：不，这是半岛。看，这里还与陆地相连。拉拉：现在我明白了，它几乎四周都是水。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Din gżira fuq il-mappa?
messages.mt_standard: Din gżira fuq il-mappa?
messages.zh: 地图上这是一座岛吗？
messages.en: Is this an island on the map?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din peninsula. Ara, għadha magħquda mal-art hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din peninsula. Ara, għadha magħquda mal-art hawn.
messages.zh: 不，这是半岛。看，这里还与陆地相连。
messages.en: No, it's a peninsula. Look, it's still connected to the land here.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Issa fhimt, hemm l-ilma kważi madwarha kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Issa fhimt, hemm l-ilma kważi madwarha kollha.
messages.zh: 现在我明白了，它几乎四周都是水。
messages.en: Now I understand; there's water almost all around it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一块伸进海里的陆地，四周大多涂蓝色，但留一处连接大陆；把这个“仍然连着陆地”的图形与 peninsula 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An antibiotic medicine used to treat certain bacterial infections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 青霉素，一种用于治疗某些细菌感染的抗生素药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina antibijotika li tintuża biex tikkura ċerti infezzjonijiet ikkawżati mill-batterji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 青霉素，也称盘尼西林，用于治疗某些细菌感染的抗生素。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-peniċillina hija antibijotiku li jintuża għall-kura ta' ċerti infezzjonijiet batteriċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Penicillin is an antibiotic medicine that is used to treat certain infections caused by bacteria.

formal.mt: Fir-rekord mediku tal-pazjenta hemm imniżżel li għandha allerġija għall-peniċillina.
formal.en: The patient's medical record states that she is allergic to penicillin.
formal.zh: 这位女患者的病历注明，她对青霉素过敏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi allerġija għall-peniċillina. Pawlu: Grazzi talli għedtli. Se nniżżilha fir-rekord tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'm allergic to penicillin. Pawlu: Thank you for telling me. I'll note it in your record.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我对青霉素过敏。保罗：谢谢你告诉我。我会把这点记在你的病历里。

messages.speaker: Anna (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi allerġija għall-peniċillina.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi allerġija għall-peniċillina.
messages.zh: 我对青霉素过敏。
messages.en: I'm allergic to penicillin.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (医生)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi talli għedtli. Se nniżżilha fir-rekord tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi talli għedtli. Se nniżżilha fir-rekord tiegħek.
messages.zh: 谢谢你告诉我。我会把这点记在你的病历里。
messages.en: Thank you for telling me. I'll note it in your record.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借中文别名“盘尼西林”的声音联想 peniċillina，再用“青霉素过敏”这个完整场景巩固药名；这是记音方法。

gloss_zh: 寄宿旅馆；小型旅馆；养老金

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boarding house or guesthouse; also, a regular payment received after retirement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指供人住宿、有时也提供膳食的旅馆，也可指退休后定期领取的养老金；具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dar li tilqa' nies biex joqogħdu fiha bi ħlas u li tista' toffri wkoll l-ikel; il-kelma tfisser ukoll ħlas regolari li persuna tirċievi wara li tirtira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 寄宿旅馆；收费提供住宿和膳食的住所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar fejn in-nies jistgħu joqogħdu u jieklu bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A boarding house is a place where people pay for accommodation and meals.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小型旅馆；向旅客收费提供客房的住宿场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dar jew lukanda żgħira li toffri kmamar lill-vjaġġaturi bi ħlas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A guesthouse is a small establishment where travellers pay to stay in guest rooms.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 养老金；退休后定期领取的款项。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Somma flus li persuna tirċievi regolarment wara li tirtira mix-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pension is money paid regularly to someone after they retire from work.

collocations.en: a boarding house that provides meals

formal.mt: Wara li rtirat mix-xogħol, Marija bdiet tirċievi pensjoni kull xahar.
formal.en: After retiring from work, Marija began receiving a pension every month.
formal.zh: 退休后，玛丽娅开始每月领取养老金。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Mark: Sibt pensjoni żgħira ħdejn il-baħar. Maja: Toffri l-ikel ukoll? Mark: Iva, il-kolazzjon huwa inkluż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are we staying this weekend? Mark: I found a small guesthouse near the sea. Maja: Does it provide meals too? Mark: Yes, breakfast is included.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们这个周末住哪里？马克：我找到了一家海边的小旅馆。玛雅：也提供吃的吗？马克：提供，房费包含早餐。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 我们这个周末住哪里？
messages.en: Where are we staying this weekend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sibt pensjoni żgħira ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Sibt pensjoni żgħira ħdejn il-baħar.
messages.zh: 我找到了一家海边的小旅馆。
messages.en: I found a small guesthouse near the sea.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Toffri l-ikel ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Toffri l-ikel ukoll?
messages.zh: 也提供吃的吗？
messages.en: Does it provide meals too?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kolazzjon huwa inkluż.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kolazzjon huwa inkluż.
messages.zh: 提供，房费包含早餐。
messages.en: Yes, breakfast is included.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两个场景并排记：谈客房和住宿时想到旅馆，谈退休和每月领钱时想到养老金；用上下文区分同一个词。

gloss_zh: 全膳食宿；含每日三餐的住宿安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: An accommodation arrangement that includes a room and breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 住宿费用包含客房以及每日早餐、午餐和晚餐的食宿安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' akkomodazzjoni li fih il-prezz jinkludi l-kamra, il-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全膳食宿；住宿并包含每日早餐、午餐和晚餐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Servizz ta' akkomodazzjoni li jinkludi kamra u tliet ikliet kuljum: il-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Full board is an accommodation arrangement in which your room and three daily meals are included in the price.

collocations.zh: 以包含每日三餐的方式住宿

collocations.en: book a room with full board
collocations.zh: 预订包含每日三餐的客房

formal.mt: Il-pakkett jinkludi sebat iljieli b'pensjoni kompleta, bil-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija kuljum.
formal.en: The package includes seven nights with full board, providing breakfast, lunch, and dinner each day.
formal.zh: 该套餐包含七晚全膳食宿，每天提供早餐、午餐和晚餐。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Irrid nibbukkja kamra b'pensjoni kompleta. Rita: Għal kemm-il lejl? Mark: Għal tlett iljieli. It-tliet ikliet huma inklużi? Rita: Iva, il-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'd like to book a room with full board. Rita: For how many nights? Mark: For three nights. Are all three meals included? Rita: Yes, breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我想订一间包含每日三餐的客房。丽塔：住几晚？马克：三晚。三餐都包含吗？丽塔：是的，包含早餐、午餐和晚餐。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nibbukkja kamra b'pensjoni kompleta.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nibbukkja kamra b'pensjoni kompleta.
messages.zh: 我想订一间包含每日三餐的客房。
messages.en: I'd like to book a room with full board.

messages.speaker: Rita (旅馆接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal kemm-il lejl?
messages.mt_standard: Għal kemm-il lejl?
messages.zh: 住几晚？
messages.en: For how many nights?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal tlett iljieli. It-tliet ikliet huma inklużi?
messages.mt_standard: Għal tlett iljieli. It-tliet ikliet huma inklużi?
messages.zh: 三晚。三餐都包含吗？
messages.en: For three nights. Are all three meals included?

messages.speaker: Rita (旅馆接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kolazzjon, l-ikla ta' nofsinhar u l-ikla ta' filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 是的，包含早餐、午餐和晚餐。
messages.en: Yes, breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张订房清单记住整个短语：客房、早餐、午餐、晚餐四项全部打勾，就是全膳食宿。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flowering plant with delicate petals, often red, or a flower of this plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种花瓣轻薄、花色常为红色的开花植物，也可指这种植物的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bi fjuri b'petali rqaq, ħafna drabi ħomor; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għall-fjuri tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罂粟或罂粟花；花瓣轻薄、常开红花的一类植物或其花朵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel fjuri b'petali rqaq u delikati, ħafna drabi ħomor, jew fjura ta' din il-pjanta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A poppy is a plant with delicate flowers, often red, or one of the flowers that grows on it.

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw il-fjuri tal-pepprin fit-tarf tal-għalqa u ddeskrivew il-kulur u l-forma tal-petali.
formal.en: The students observed the poppy flowers at the edge of the field and described the colour and shape of the petals.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了田边的罂粟花，并描述了花瓣的颜色和形状。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dawk il-fjuri ħomor ħdejn l-għalqa! Pawlu: Dak pepprin. Maja: Nista' nieħu ritratt? Pawlu: Dażgur, minn hawn jidhru tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at those red flowers beside the field! Pawlu: Those are poppies. Maja: Can I take a photo? Pawlu: Of course, you can see them well from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看田边那些红花！保罗：那是罂粟花。玛雅：我可以拍张照吗？保罗：当然，从这里能拍得很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dawk il-fjuri ħomor ħdejn l-għalqa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dawk il-fjuri ħomor ħdejn l-għalqa!
messages.zh: 看田边那些红花！
messages.en: Look at those red flowers beside the field!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pepprin.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pepprin.
messages.zh: 那是罂粟花。
messages.en: Those are poppies.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu ritratt?
messages.zh: 我可以拍张照吗？
messages.en: Can I take a photo?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dażgur, minn hawn jidhru tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Dażgur, minn hawn jidhru tajjeb.
messages.zh: 当然，从这里能拍得很清楚。
messages.en: Of course, you can see them well from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pepprin 写在田边红色薄花瓣的图画旁，并圈出相邻的两个 p；用花朵画面记词义，用圈字母记拼写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant that produces flowers with delicate petals, often red, or a flower from this plant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种开有轻薄花瓣、花色常为红色的植物，也可指它所开的花。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel fjuri b'petali rqaq, ħafna drabi ta' lewn aħmar; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għall-fjuri ta' din il-pjanta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罂粟或罂粟花；具有轻薄花瓣、花色常为红色的植物或其花朵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta bi fjuri delikati li għandhom petali rqaq, ħafna drabi ħomor, jew fjura li tikber fuq din il-pjanta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A poppy is a flowering plant with thin, delicate petals, or a flower produced by that plant.

formal.mt: Fit-tpinġija, il-peprin aħmar jidher fost il-ħaxix aħdar, u l-petali rqaq tiegħu huma murija fid-dettall.
formal.en: In the drawing, red poppies appear among the green grass, and their thin petals are shown in detail.
formal.zh: 画中，红色罂粟花点缀在绿草之间，轻薄的花瓣得到了细致描绘。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qiegħed tpinġi? Toni: Qiegħed inpinġi l-peprin li rajna lbieraħ. Lara: Għandek bżonn l-aħmar? Toni: Iva, għaddihuli, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Lara: What are you drawing? Toni: I'm drawing the poppies we saw yesterday. Lara: Do you need the red pencil? Toni: Yes, pass it to me, please.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你在画什么？托尼：我在画我们昨天看到的罂粟花。劳拉：你需要红色铅笔吗？托尼：需要，请递给我。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qiegħed tpinġi?
messages.mt_standard: X'qiegħed tpinġi?
messages.zh: 你在画什么？
messages.en: What are you drawing?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħed inpinġi l-peprin li rajna lbieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħed inpinġi l-peprin li rajna lbieraħ.
messages.zh: 我在画我们昨天看到的罂粟花。
messages.en: I'm drawing the poppies we saw yesterday.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek bżonn l-aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek bżonn l-aħmar?
messages.zh: 你需要红色铅笔吗？
messages.en: Do you need the red pencil?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għaddihuli, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għaddihuli, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 需要，请递给我。
messages.en: Yes, pass it to me, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用红色铅笔画一朵薄花瓣的罂粟花，再在旁边写 peprin；按 p-e-p-r-i-n 逐字核对，把词义和准确拼写一起记住。

gloss_zh: 危险的；可能造成伤害的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Likely to cause harm, injury, or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有造成伤害、受伤或损失的风险的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jikkawża ħsara jew korriment, jew ipoġġi lil xi ħadd fil-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 危险的；有可能导致伤害或损失的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi riskju ta' ħsara jew korriment għal xi ħadd jew għal xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is dangerous can cause harm, injury, or damage.

formal.mt: Dan il-post huwa perikoluż minħabba l-ġebel li jista' jaqa' minn fuq.
formal.en: This place is dangerous because stones may fall from above.
formal.zh: 这个地方很危险，因为上方可能有石块掉落。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn? Pawlu: Aħjar le, dan il-pont jidher perikoluż.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we go this way? Pawlu: Better not; this bridge looks dangerous.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们能从这里过去吗？保罗：最好别，这座桥看起来很危险。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu ngħaddu minn hawn?
messages.zh: 我们能从这里过去吗？
