messages.en: Can we go this way?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar le, dan il-pont jidher perikoluż.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar le, dan il-pont jidher perikoluż.
messages.zh: 最好别，这座桥看起来很危险。
messages.en: Better not; this bridge looks dangerous.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一座摇晃的桥，看到就提醒自己 perikoluż，意思是危险的、可能让人受伤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A professional who designs buildings and prepares plans for their construction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责设计建筑物并绘制建造图纸的专业人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna professjonali li tfassal il-bini u tħejji l-pjanti għall-kostruzzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从事建筑设计、制定建筑图纸的专业人员；建筑师。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tiddisinja l-bini u tfassal il-pjanti meħtieġa biex jinbena.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An architect is a professional who designs buildings and prepares plans for their construction.

formal.mt: Il-perit ħejja l-pjanti tal-iskola l-ġdida u spjega d-disinn lill-kumitat.
formal.en: The architect prepared the plans for the new school and explained the design to the committee.
formal.zh: 建筑师绘制了新学校的图纸，并向委员会解释了设计方案。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min se jfasslilkom id-dar? David: Qabbadna perit, u għada se naraw l-ewwel pjanti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is going to design your house? David: We hired an architect, and tomorrow we will see the first plans.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁来给你们设计房子？戴维：我们请了一位建筑师，明天就看第一版图纸。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jfasslilkom id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jfasslilkom id-dar?
messages.zh: 谁来给你们设计房子？
messages.en: Who is going to design your house?

messages.speaker: David (房主)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabbadna perit, u għada se naraw l-ewwel pjanti.
messages.mt_standard: Qabbadna perit, u għada se naraw l-ewwel pjanti.
messages.zh: 我们请了一位建筑师，明天就看第一版图纸。
messages.en: We hired an architect, and tomorrow we will see the first plans.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 perit 和摊开的房屋图纸一起记：站在图纸旁设计房子的人，就是建筑师。

gloss_zh: 定期的；周期性的；偶尔发生的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Happening at regular intervals or occurring from time to time rather than continuously.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按一定间隔重复发生的，或只是时有发生而非持续进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jseħħ f'intervalli regolari jew minn żmien għal żmien, mingħajr ma jkun kontinwu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定期发生或按一定周期重复出现的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ jew jerġa' jsir f'intervalli regolari ta' żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is periodical happens or is done repeatedly at regular intervals.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偶尔发生的；间或出现而非持续或经常发生的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jseħħ xi kultant jew minn żmien għal żmien, u mhux b'mod kontinwu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is occasional happens sometimes, without being frequent or continuous.

collocations.zh: 定期进行或偶尔承接的工作

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment joħroġ rapport perjodiku kull tliet xhur dwar il-progress tal-proġett.
formal.en: The department issues a periodic report every three months on the project's progress.
formal.zh: 该部门每三个月发布一份有关项目进展的定期报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħdem hemm kuljum? Toni: Le, nagħmel xogħol perjodiku biss, meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you work there every day? Toni: No, I only do occasional work, when they need help.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你每天都在那里工作吗？托尼：不是，我只是偶尔在他们需要帮忙时做些工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħdem hemm kuljum?
messages.mt_standard: Taħdem hemm kuljum?
messages.zh: 你每天都在那里工作吗？
messages.en: Do you work there every day?

messages.speaker: Toni (兼职工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, nagħmel xogħol perjodiku biss, meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, nagħmel xogħol perjodiku biss, meta jkollhom bżonn l-għajnuna.
messages.zh: 不是，我只是偶尔在他们需要帮忙时做些工作。
messages.en: No, I only do occasional work, when they need help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上画两组圆点：等距圆点表示定期，零散圆点表示偶尔；用上下文判断 perjodiku 的具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defined length of time during which something lasts, applies, or must be completed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事持续、适用或必须完成的规定时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien stabbilita li matulha xi ħaġa ddum, tapplika jew trid titlesta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某项活动、安排或义务规定的一段期限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien stabbilita għal attività, arranġament jew obbligu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A term is a specified length of time during which an activity, arrangement, or obligation continues.

formal.mt: Il-perjodu ta' validità tal-permess huwa ta' sitt xhur mid-data tal-ħruġ.
formal.en: The permit's period of validity is six months from the date of issue.
formal.zh: 许可证的有效期为自签发之日起六个月。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm idum il-perjodu ta' prova? Mark: Xahar. Wara niddeċiedi jekk inkomplix.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long does the trial period last? Mark: One month. Then I'll decide whether to continue.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：试用期有多长？马克：一个月。之后我再决定是否继续。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum il-perjodu ta' prova?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum il-perjodu ta' prova?
messages.zh: 试用期有多长？
messages.en: How long does the trial period last?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xahar. Wara niddeċiedi jekk inkomplix.
messages.mt_standard: Xahar. Wara niddeċiedi jekk inkomplix.
messages.zh: 一个月。之后我再决定是否继续。
messages.en: One month. Then I'll decide whether to continue.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 perjodu 想成日历上框出的一段时间，再用试用期和有效期两个场景记住“期限”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defined interval over which data or values are grouped and combined into a summary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将数据或数值归为一组并合并形成汇总结果时采用的规定时间区间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intervall ta' żmien stabbilit li għalih id-data jew il-valuri jinġabru flimkien biex jiffurmaw sommarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于把某一时间区间内的数据或数值合并计算的汇总时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien li għaliha d-data jew il-valuri jiġu raggruppati u kkombinati f'riżultat wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An aggregation period is the time interval over which individual data points or values are combined into a summary.

collocations.en: an aggregation period of one hour

formal.mt: Għal dan ir-rapport, il-perjodu ta' aggregazzjoni huwa ta' ġurnata, u l-kejl kollu ta' kull ġurnata jinġabar f'sommarju wieħed.
formal.en: For this report, the aggregation period is one day, and all measurements from each day are combined into a single summary.
formal.zh: 本报告采用一天的汇总时段，将每天的全部测量数据合并为一份汇总结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex it-tabella turi total wieħed għal kull siegħa? Pawlu: Għax għażilna perjodu ta' aggregazzjoni ta' siegħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the table show one total for each hour? Pawlu: Because we chose an aggregation period of one hour.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：为什么表格每小时只显示一个总数？保罗：因为我们选择了一小时的汇总时段。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex it-tabella turi total wieħed għal kull siegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex it-tabella turi total wieħed għal kull siegħa?
messages.zh: 为什么表格每小时只显示一个总数？
messages.en: Why does the table show one total for each hour?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (数据分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għażilna perjodu ta' aggregazzjoni ta' siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għażilna perjodu ta' aggregazzjoni ta' siegħa.
messages.zh: 因为我们选择了一小时的汇总时段。
messages.en: Because we chose an aggregation period of one hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象每小时的数据小点被装进同一个盒子：盒子的时间宽度就是 perjodu ta' aggregazzjoni，即汇总时段。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defined interval during which a system, device, or function is deactivated.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 系统、设备或功能处于停用状态的一段规定时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien stabbilita li matulha sistema, apparat jew funzjoni jkunu diżattivati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 系统、设备或功能被停用而不执行其正常功能的时间区间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervall ta' żmien li matulu sistema, apparat jew funzjoni jkunu diżattivati u ma jwettqux il-funzjoni normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A deactivation period is a length of time during which a system, device, or function is switched off or disabled.

collocations.en: the end of the deactivation period

formal.mt: Matul il-perjodu ta' diżattivazzjoni, il-funzjoni ta' ħlas online ma tkunx disponibbli għall-utenti.
formal.en: During the deactivation period, the online payment function will be unavailable to users.
formal.zh: 在停用期间，用户将无法使用在线支付功能。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont? David: Il-kont jinsab f'perjodu ta' diżattivazzjoni temporanja. Għada jerġa' jkun attiv.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why can't I use the account? David: The account is in a period of temporary deactivation. It will be active again tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：为什么我用不了这个账户？戴维：账户正处于临时停用期，明天就会恢复启用。

messages.speaker: Lara (用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma nistax nuża l-kont?
messages.zh: 为什么我用不了这个账户？
messages.en: Why can't I use the account?

messages.speaker: David (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kont jinsab f'perjodu ta' diżattivazzjoni temporanja. Għada jerġa' jkun attiv.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kont jinsab f'perjodu ta' diżattivazzjoni temporanja. Għada jerġa' jkun attiv.
messages.zh: 账户正处于临时停用期，明天就会恢复启用。
messages.en: The account is in a period of temporary deactivation. It will be active again tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把账户按钮变灰到重新亮起之间的时间画成一条横线，用这段停用时间记住 perjodu ta' diżattivazzjoni。

gloss_zh: 渐变调整期；斜坡调节时段

teaching_sense.en_definition: An interval during which an operating level changes gradually from an initial value to a target value.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 运行水平从初始值逐步变化到目标值所经历的一段时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intervall ta' żmien li matulu livell ta' tħaddim jinbidel gradwalment minn valur inizjali għal valur mixtieq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使运行水平或输出量逐步变化至目标值的调节时段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien li matulha livell ta' tħaddim jew ta' produzzjoni jiġi aġġustat gradwalment sakemm jilħaq il-valur mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ramping period is an interval during which an operating level or output changes gradually until it reaches a target value.

collocations.mt: perjodu ta' kalar ta' għaxar minuti
collocations.en: a ramping period of ten minutes
the duration of the ramping period

formal.mt: Matul il-perjodu ta' kalar ta' għaxar minuti, il-qawwa tinbidel gradwalment mill-valur inizjali għall-valur mixtieq.
formal.en: During the ten-minute ramping period, the power changes gradually from its initial value to the target value.
formal.zh: 在十分钟的渐变调整期内，功率从初始值逐步变化至目标值。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-qawwa tinbidel kollha f'daqqa? Mark: Le, għandna perjodu ta' kalar ta' għaxar minuti biex tasal gradwalment għal-livell mixtieq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does the power change all at once? Mark: No, we have a ten-minute ramping period so that it reaches the target level gradually.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：功率会一下子就变过去吗？马克：不会，我们设了十分钟的渐变调整期，让它逐步达到目标水平。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qawwa tinbidel kollha f'daqqa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qawwa tinbidel kollha f'daqqa?
messages.zh: 功率会一下子就变过去吗？
messages.en: Does the power change all at once?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandna perjodu ta' kalar ta' għaxar minuti biex tasal gradwalment għal-livell mixtieq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandna perjodu ta' kalar ta' għaxar minuti biex tasal gradwalment għal-livell mixtieq.
messages.zh: 不会，我们设了十分钟的渐变调整期，让它逐步达到目标水平。
messages.en: No, we have a ten-minute ramping period so that it reaches the target level gradually.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象运行曲线沿斜坡逐步到达目标值；斜坡在时间轴上占据的那一段就是 perjodu ta' kalar。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A specified period for reconsidering a decision or withdrawing from an agreement or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人重新考虑决定，或从协议、活动中撤回或退出的一段规定时间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żmien stabbilit biex persuna terġa' tikkunsidra deċiżjoni jew tirtira minn ftehim jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冷静期，即作出决定后可重新考虑，并可按适用条件改变决定或撤回承诺的一段时间。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien wara deċiżjoni li fih persuna tista' terġa' taħsibha u, skont il-kundizzjonijiet applikabbli, tibdel id-deċiżjoni jew tirtira l-impenn tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cooling-off period is a set amount of time during which someone can reconsider a decision and withdraw their commitment under the applicable conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撤回期或退出期，即进行撤回、退出，或获准这样做的一段规定时间；具体对象由语境决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien stabbilit li matulu jsir jew ikun permess irtirar, pereżempju minn ftehim jew attività, skont il-kuntest.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A withdrawal period is a specified interval during which withdrawal takes place or is permitted, with the particular meaning depending on the context.

collocations.en: during the cooling-off or withdrawal period
the end of the cooling-off or withdrawal period
collocations.zh: 冷静期或撤回期的结束

formal.mt: Il-ftehim għandu jindika t-tul tal-perjodu ta' rtirar u l-proċedura li għandha tiġi segwita jekk il-klijent jiddeċiedi li jirtira.
formal.en: The agreement should state the length of the withdrawal period and the procedure to follow if the customer decides to withdraw.
formal.zh: 协议应注明撤回期的长度，以及客户决定撤回时应遵循的程序。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni mhux ċerta jekk irridx inkompli bil-ftehim. Mark: Ara jekk hemmx perjodu ta' rtirar u aqra l-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm still not sure whether I want to go ahead with the agreement. Mark: Check whether there is a cooling-off period and read its conditions.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我还不确定要不要继续履行这份协议。马克：看看有没有冷静期，再读一下相关条件。

messages.speaker: Maja (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni mhux ċerta jekk irridx inkompli bil-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni mhux ċerta jekk irridx inkompli bil-ftehim.
messages.zh: 我还不确定要不要继续履行这份协议。
messages.en: I'm still not sure whether I want to go ahead with the agreement.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara jekk hemmx perjodu ta' rtirar u aqra l-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Ara jekk hemmx perjodu ta' rtirar u aqra l-kundizzjonijiet tiegħu.
messages.zh: 看看有没有冷静期，再读一下相关条件。
messages.en: Check whether there is a cooling-off period and read its conditions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组想成日历上圈出的一段“可以再想想、可以撤回”的时间；偏重重新考虑时记作冷静期，偏重撤回动作时记作撤回期。

gloss_zh: 有功功率爬坡时段；有功功率渐变期

teaching_sense.en_definition: The interval during which active power is progressively increased or decreased from one level to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有功功率从一个水平逐步增加或降低至另一个水平所经历的时间段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intervall li matulu l-potenza attiva tiżdied jew tonqos gradwalment minn livell għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爬坡时段，即有功功率从原有水平逐步调整到目标水平的一段时间，可包括上调或下调。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żmien li matulu l-potenza attiva tinbidel gradwalment mil-livell inizjali għal dak mixtieq, kemm jekk tiżdied kif ukoll jekk tonqos.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ramping period is the time over which active power is gradually raised or lowered from an initial level to a target level.

collocations.mt: it-tul tal-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva
collocations.en: the duration of the active-power ramping period
collocations.zh: 有功功率爬坡时段的长度

collocations.mt: matul il-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva
collocations.zh: 在有功功率爬坡时段内

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri kif il-potenza attiva tiżdied gradwalment matul il-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva sakemm jintlaħaq il-livell mixtieq.
formal.en: The report shows how active power increases gradually during the ramping period until the target level is reached.
formal.zh: 报告展示了有功功率如何在爬坡时段内逐步增加，直至达到目标水平。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-potenza għadha ma laħqitx il-livell mixtieq? Pawlu: Għadna fil-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva; il-potenza qed tiżdied ftit ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why hasn't the power reached the target level yet? Pawlu: We're still in the active-power ramping period; the power is increasing little by little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：功率为什么还没有达到目标水平？保罗：现在还处于有功功率爬坡时段，功率正在一点点增加。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-potenza għadha ma laħqitx il-livell mixtieq?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-potenza għadha ma laħqitx il-livell mixtieq?
messages.zh: 功率为什么还没有达到目标水平？
messages.en: Why hasn't the power reached the target level yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna fil-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva; il-potenza qed tiżdied ftit ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna fil-perjodu ta' varjazzjoni tal-potenza attiva; il-potenza qed tiżdied ftit ftit.
messages.zh: 现在还处于有功功率爬坡时段，功率正在一点点增加。
messages.en: We're still in the active-power ramping period; the power is increasing little by little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象功率曲线上连接两个水平的一段斜坡：走完斜坡所需的时间就是这个词组。斜坡可以向上，也可以向下，不要只记成功率增加。

gloss_zh: 市场时段；市场时间区间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A defined interval used to organize or describe activity in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于组织或描述市场活动的一个明确时间区间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Intervall ta' żmien definit li jintuża biex tiġi organizzata jew deskritta l-attività f'suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 市场时段，即市场活动或相关数据所对应的一个规定时间区间，具体长度取决于所讨论的市场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Intervall ta' żmien stabbilit li għalih jirreferu l-attività tas-suq jew id-data relatata magħha, bit-tul tiegħu jiddependi mis-suq inkwistjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A market time period is a defined interval to which market activity or related data refers, and its length depends on the market concerned.

collocations.mt: għal kull perjodu ta' żmien tas-suq

collocations.en: the start of the market time period

formal.mt: It-tabella tippreżenta l-prezz u l-volum tal-kummerċ għal kull perjodu ta' żmien tas-suq, bil-ħin tal-bidu u tat-tmiem indikati b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The table presents the price and trading volume for each market time period, with the start and end times clearly indicated.
formal.zh: 表格列出了每个市场时段的价格和交易量，并清楚标明了开始与结束时间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-prezz japplika għall-ġurnata kollha? David: Le, japplika biss għal dan il-perjodu ta' żmien tas-suq; ara l-ħinijiet fit-tabella.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this price apply to the whole day? David: No, it only applies to this market time period; look at the times in the table.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个价格适用于一整天吗？戴维：不，只适用于这个市场时段；看看表格里的时间。

messages.speaker: Nina (新入职分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prezz japplika għall-ġurnata kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prezz japplika għall-ġurnata kollha?
messages.zh: 这个价格适用于一整天吗？
messages.en: Does this price apply to the whole day?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, japplika biss għal dan il-perjodu ta' żmien tas-suq; ara l-ħinijiet fit-tabella.
messages.mt_standard: Le, japplika biss għal dan il-perjodu ta' żmien tas-suq; ara l-ħinijiet fit-tabella.
messages.zh: 不，只适用于这个市场时段；看看表格里的时间。
messages.en: No, it only applies to this market time period; look at the times in the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把市场数据表想成一格格时间盒子，每个盒子都有起止时间，装着对应的价格和交易量；整个词组就指其中一个市场时段。

gloss_zh: 工作附带福利；额外好处、有利条件

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extra benefits associated with a job, or advantages gained from a situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作除基本报酬之外附带的福利，或某种处境带来的好处和有利条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Benefiċċji żejda marbuta ma' impjieg, jew vantaġġi li persuna tikseb minn sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作附带福利，即除基本工资之外，因担任某份工作而获得的额外待遇或便利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Benefiċċji jew faċilitajiet addizzjonali li persuna tirċievi minħabba l-impjieg tagħha, apparti l-paga bażika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The perks associated with a job are the extra benefits or conveniences an employee receives in addition to their basic pay.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好处或有利条件，即某种安排、选择或处境带来的便利与收益，不限于工作福利。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Aspetti favorevoli ta' arranġament, għażla jew sitwazzjoni li jagħtu benefiċċju jew jagħmlu xi ħaġa aktar konvenjenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Advantages are features of a situation or choice that provide benefits or make things easier for someone.

collocations.en: to enjoy the perks or advantages

formal.mt: Minbarra l-paga, il-perkaċċi tal-impjieg jinkludu ikla bla ħlas u l-użu tal-faċilitajiet sportivi tal-kumpanija.
formal.en: In addition to pay, the perks of the job include a free meal and use of the company's sports facilities.
formal.zh: 除工资外，这份工作的附带福利还包括免费餐食和使用公司的运动设施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhuma l-perkaċċi tax-xogħol il-ġdid tiegħek? Ben: Għandi parkeġġ bla ħlas u nista' nagħżel x'ħin nibda.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are the perks of your new job? Ben: I get free parking and can choose what time I start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的新工作有哪些附带福利？本：我可以免费停车，还能选择几点开始上班。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhuma l-perkaċċi tax-xogħol il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhuma l-perkaċċi tax-xogħol il-ġdid tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你的新工作有哪些附带福利？
messages.en: What are the perks of your new job?

messages.speaker: Ben (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi parkeġġ bla ħlas u nista' nagħżel x'ħin nibda.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi parkeġġ bla ħlas u nista' nagħżel x'ħin nibda.
messages.zh: 我可以免费停车，还能选择几点开始上班。
messages.en: I get free parking and can choose what time I start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象工资旁边另放一个装着免费餐食、停车便利的小礼盒，用它记住工作附带福利；把礼盒放到其他生活场景，又能记住更广义的好处。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Musical instruments played by striking or shaking them, considered collectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 打击乐：通过敲击或摇动来发声的乐器的统称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' strumenti mużikali li jindaqqu billi jintlaqtu jew jitħawwdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打击乐；通过敲击或摇动发声的乐器的统称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Strumenti mużikali, bħat-tnabar, li jipproduċu l-ħoss meta jintlaqtu jew jitħawwdu, meqjusa bħala grupp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Percussion consists of musical instruments that produce sound when they are struck or shaken.

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi biċċa għall-istrumenti tal-perkussjoni.
formal.en: The concert programme includes a piece for percussion instruments.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目中包含一首打击乐器作品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int se ddoqq il-kitarra fil-kunċert? Mark: Le, jien se ndoqq fit-taqsima tal-perkussjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to play the guitar at the concert? Mark: No, I'm going to play in the percussion section.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要在音乐会上弹吉他吗？马克：不，我要在打击乐声部演奏。

messages.speaker: Maja (乐队朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int se ddoqq il-kitarra fil-kunċert?
messages.mt_standard: Int se ddoqq il-kitarra fil-kunċert?
messages.zh: 你要在音乐会上弹吉他吗？
messages.en: Are you going to play the guitar at the concert?

messages.speaker: Mark (乐队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien se ndoqq fit-taqsima tal-perkussjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien se ndoqq fit-taqsima tal-perkussjoni.
messages.zh: 不，我要在打击乐声部演奏。
messages.en: No, I'm going to play in the percussion section.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 perkussjoni 与鼓、沙锤和敲击节奏的画面一起记，看到 strumenti tal-perkussjoni 就想到一组打击乐器。

gloss_zh: 珀拉（女性人名，对应英语 Pearl）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A female given name corresponding to the English name Pearl.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珀拉：女性名字，所对应的英语名字为 Pearl。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem personali femminili li jikkorrispondi għall-isem Ingliż Pearl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 珀拉，女性人名，对应英语人名 Pearl。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem mogħti lil persuna femminili, li bl-Ingliż jikkorrispondi għal Pearl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Perla is a female given name corresponding to Pearl in English.

formal.mt: Perla se tippreżenta r-riżultati tal-proġett waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Perla will present the project results at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: 珀拉将在明天的会议上介绍项目成果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif jisimha t-tifla l-ġdida fil-klassi? Mark: Jisimha Perla. Għada se nistudja magħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's the name of the new girl in class? Mark: Her name is Perla. I'm going to study with her tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：班上新来的女孩叫什么名字？马克：她叫珀拉。明天我要和她一起学习。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jisimha t-tifla l-ġdida fil-klassi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jisimha t-tifla l-ġdida fil-klassi?
messages.zh: 班上新来的女孩叫什么名字？
messages.en: What's the name of the new girl in class?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Jisimha Perla. Għada se nistudja magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Jisimha Perla. Għada se nistudja magħha.
messages.zh: 她叫珀拉。明天我要和她一起学习。
messages.en: Her name is Perla. I'm going to study with her tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把大写 Perla 想成点名册上的女孩名字，用整句 Jisimha Perla（她叫珀拉）来记，并与英语名字 Pearl 配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document authorizing someone to carry out a particular activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 许可证或执照：由有关机构签发、准许持有人从事某项活动的正式文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali maħruġ minn awtorità li jawtorizza persuna tagħmel attività partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 许可证；执照；正式准许持有人从事特定活动的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jagħti lid-detentur tiegħu l-awtorizzazzjoni biex iwettaq attività speċifika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A licence is an official document allowing its holder to carry out a particular activity.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija għandha tippreżenta kopja tal-permess validu mal-applikazzjoni.
formal.en: The company must submit a copy of the valid licence with the application.
formal.zh: 公司必须随申请提交有效许可证的副本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek il-permess għas-suq? Mark: Iva, imma jiskadi dalwaqt. Irrid inġeddu din il-ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still have your market licence? Mark: Yes, but it expires soon. I need to renew it this week.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还留着在市场经营的许可证吗？马克：留着，不过快到期了。我这周得续办。

messages.speaker: Maja (摊主朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad għandek il-permess għas-suq?
messages.mt_standard: Għad għandek il-permess għas-suq?
messages.zh: 你还留着在市场经营的许可证吗？
messages.en: Do you still have your market licence?

messages.speaker: Mark (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jiskadi dalwaqt. Irrid inġeddu din il-ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jiskadi dalwaqt. Irrid inġeddu din il-ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 留着，不过快到期了。我这周得续办。
messages.en: Yes, but it expires soon. I need to renew it this week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手里拿着一张写有 permess 的许可证，再用「有效、到期、续办」三个动作串起它的实际用法。

gloss_zh: 进口许可证；进口证明书

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official document authorizing or certifying the importation of goods into a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有关机构签发、准许货物进口或证明进口事项的正式文件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jawtorizza jew jiċċertifika l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija f'pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书；正式证明货物进口事项的文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jiċċertifika l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija f'pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of import is an official document certifying the importation of goods into a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明书；就货物进口行为出具的正式证明文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat uffiċjali li jagħti prova tal-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija f'pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A certificate of importation provides official confirmation that goods have been imported into a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口证明；用于证明货物进口相关事项的正式证书。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ċertifikat maħruġ minn awtorità li jikkonferma fatti dwar l-importazzjoni ta' merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import certificate is an official document confirming details concerning the importation of goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可证；准许持有人进口特定货物的正式证件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument uffiċjali li jagħti lid-detentur tiegħu l-awtorizzazzjoni biex jimporta merkanzija speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import licence authorizes its holder to bring specified goods into a country.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进口许可文件；由有关机构签发、准许货物进口的正式文件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Permess uffiċjali maħruġ minn awtorità biex merkanzija tkun tista' tiddaħħal f'pajjiż minn barra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An import permit is an official document granting permission to bring goods into a country.

collocations.en: an application for an import permit
the issuing of an import permit

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, l-importatur għandu jippreżenta permess ta' importazzjoni validu qabel ma tasal il-merkanzija.
formal.en: In this example, the importer must present a valid import permit before the goods arrive.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，进口商必须在货物抵达前出示有效的进口许可证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wasal il-permess ta' importazzjoni? Mark: Iva, irċevejtu dalgħodu. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the import permit arrived? Mark: Yes, I received it this morning. I'll send you a copy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：进口许可证到了吗？马克：到了，我今天早上收到了。我会给你发一份副本。

messages.speaker: Maja (进口业务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Wasal il-permess ta' importazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Wasal il-permess ta' importazzjoni?
messages.zh: 进口许可证到了吗？
messages.en: Has the import permit arrived?

messages.speaker: Mark (进口业务经办人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, irċevejtu dalgħodu. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, irċevejtu dalgħodu. Se nibgħatlek kopja.
messages.zh: 到了，我今天早上收到了。我会给你发一份副本。
messages.en: Yes, I received it this morning. I'll send you a copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分块记忆：permess 是许可文件，ta' 连接后面的内容，importazzjoni 是进口；想象货物旁附着一张进口许可证。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Through a particular means, effort, or cause, usually in the expression permezz ta'.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示通过某种方式、凭借某种努力，或由于某种原因，通常用于 permezz ta' 结构。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża, ġeneralment fl-espressjoni permezz ta', biex turi l-mezz, l-isforz jew il-kawża li jwasslu għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凭借；依靠某种努力、能力或持续行动而实现
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li xi ħaġa tinkiseb bis-saħħa ta' sforz, ħila jew ħidma kontinwa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you achieve something by dint of effort or skill, you achieve it because you use that effort or skill.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为……的结果；因某事而产生
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi li xi ħaġa sseħħ bħala riżultat ta' azzjoni, ġrajja jew kundizzjoni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens as a result of an action or event, that action or event brings it about.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由于；归因于某种原因或因素
sense_translations.mt_definition: Turi l-kawża jew il-fattur li minħabba fih isseħħ xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is due to a particular factor, that factor is the reason why it happens.

formal.mt: L-istudenti tejbu l-ħiliet tagħhom permezz ta' taħriġ regolari u appoġġ mill-għalliema.
formal.en: The students improved their skills through regular training and support from their teachers.
formal.zh: 学生们通过定期训练和教师的支持提高了技能。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tgħallimt tant kliem ġdid? Mark: Permezz ta' stejjer qosra. Naqra waħda kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did you learn so many new words? Mark: Through short stories. I read one every day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你是怎么学会这么多新词的？Mark：通过短篇故事。我每天读一篇。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif tgħallimt tant kliem ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif tgħallimt tant kliem ġdid?
messages.zh: 你是怎么学会这么多新词的？
messages.en: How did you learn so many new words?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Permezz ta' stejjer qosra. Naqra waħda kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Permezz ta' stejjer qosra. Naqra waħda kuljum.
messages.zh: 通过短篇故事。我每天读一篇。
messages.en: Through short stories. I read one every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 permezz ta' 当作连接目标与途径的桥：学会新词是目标，阅读故事是途径，整组记成“通过……”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cruel or unfair treatment directed at people, especially because of their beliefs, identity, or group membership.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对个人或群体的残酷或不公正待遇，尤其因其信仰、身份或所属群体而实施的迫害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament krudili jew inġust kontra persuna jew grupp, speċjalment minħabba t-twemmin, l-identità jew il-grupp li jagħmlu parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迫害；尤其指因信仰、身份或群体归属而遭受的持续性残酷或不公正待遇
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament krudili jew inġust li persuna jew grupp isofru ripetutament, ħafna drabi minħabba r-reliġjon, l-opinjonijiet jew l-identità tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Persecution is cruel or unfair treatment that people suffer, especially because of their beliefs, identity, or membership of a particular group.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-persekuzzjoni li sofriet il-komunità minħabba t-twemmin reliġjuż tagħha.
formal.en: The report describes the persecution that the community suffered because of its religious beliefs.
formal.zh: 报告描述了该群体因其宗教信仰而遭受的迫害。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex kellha titlaq dik il-familja? Pawlu: Minħabba l-persekuzzjoni. Kienu jhedduhom minħabba t-twemmin tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did that family have to leave? Pawlu: Because of persecution. They were being threatened because of their beliefs.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那家人为什么不得不离开？Pawlu：因为遭到迫害。他们因自己的信仰而受到威胁。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex kellha titlaq dik il-familja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex kellha titlaq dik il-familja?
messages.zh: 那家人为什么不得不离开？
messages.en: Why did that family have to leave?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-persekuzzjoni. Kienu jhedduhom minħabba t-twemmin tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-persekuzzjoni. Kienu jhedduhom minħabba t-twemmin tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为遭到迫害。他们因自己的信仰而受到威胁。
messages.en: Because of persecution. They were being threatened because of their beliefs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“因信仰而反复受到威胁”的情境记住 persekuzzjoni：它表示迫害，语义比普通争执或一次批评严重。

gloss_zh: 百叶窗；遮光百叶帘；窗板

teaching_sense.en_definition: A window covering, often made with slats, used to control light, airflow, or privacy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在窗户处、常由条片组成的遮挡装置，用于调节光线、通风或保护隐私，可指百叶窗、百叶帘或窗板。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata għal tieqa, spiss magħmula minn strixxi, li tintuża biex tirregola d-dawl u l-arja jew biex tipprovdi privatezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百叶窗；由间隔排列的斜条片构成、能通风并遮挡直射光线的窗体或装置
sense_translations.mt_definition: Struttura bi strixxi mqiegħda b'mod inklinat li jħallu l-arja tgħaddi filwaqt li jnaqqsu d-dawl dirett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A louvre is a structure with sloping slats that allow air to pass while limiting direct light.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗用遮光帘；用于遮挡光线或视线的百叶帘等窗帘装置
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata ta' tieqa li tista' tinfetaħ, tingħalaq jew tiġi aġġustata biex tikkontrolla d-dawl u l-veduta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A window blind is a covering that you adjust to control the light or view through a window.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗板；可开合以遮蔽或保护窗户的板状装置，也可带有百叶条片
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata riġida ta' tieqa, b'paletti jew mingħajrhom, li tingħalaq biex tgħatti jew tipproteġi t-tieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shutter is a rigid cover that you close over a window to provide shade, privacy, or protection.

formal.mt: Il-persjana tal-injam tnaqqas id-dawl dirett tax-xemx u tipprovdi privatezza fil-kamra.
formal.en: The wooden shutter reduces direct sunlight and provides privacy in the room.
formal.zh: 木制百叶窗减少阳光直射，并为房间提供隐私遮挡。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-persjana ftit? Luqa: Iva, nagħlaqha ftit biex jibqa' dieħel id-dawl.
colloquial.en: Nina: The sun is shining in my eyes. Can you close the blind a little? Luqa: Yes, I'll close it a little so that some light still comes in.
colloquial.zh: Nina：阳光照得我睁不开眼。你能把百叶帘关上一点吗？Luqa：可以，我关上一点，让光线还能透进来。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-persjana ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-persjana ftit?
messages.zh: 阳光照得我睁不开眼。你能把百叶帘关上一点吗？
messages.en: The sun is shining in my eyes. Can you close the blind a little?

messages.speaker: Luqa (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħlaqha ftit biex jibqa' dieħel id-dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħlaqha ftit biex jibqa' dieħel id-dawl.
messages.zh: 可以，我关上一点，让光线还能透进来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll close it a little so that some light still comes in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗前一排条片挡住刺眼阳光，把 persjana 与“开合条片、调节光线”一起记；具体译成百叶窗、百叶帘还是窗板，要看实物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a particular person's own life, views, possessions, or direct involvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某个人自己的生活、观点、物品或直接参与有关的；个人的、私人的或亲自进行的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ħajja, l-opinjonijiet jew l-affarijiet ta' persuna partikolari, jew mal-involviment dirett tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 个人的；私人的；属于或涉及特定个人，也可表示由本人亲自参与的
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni jew jirreferi għal persuna partikolari, għall-ħajja privata tagħha jew għal xi ħaġa li tagħmel hi stess.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something personal relates to a particular individual, their private life, or their own direct involvement in an activity.

formal.mt: Din hija l-opinjoni personali tiegħi u ma tirrappreżentax il-pożizzjoni uffiċjali tal-organizzazzjoni.
formal.en: This is my personal opinion and does not represent the organisation's official position.
formal.zh: 这是我的个人意见，并不代表该组织的官方立场。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan il-kompjuter tax-xogħol? Ġanni: Le, dan il-kompjuter personali tiegħi. Nużah id-dar.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this the work computer? Ġanni: No, this is my personal computer. I use it at home.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这是工作用的电脑吗？Ġanni：不是，这是我的私人电脑。我在家用它。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kompjuter tax-xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kompjuter tax-xogħol?
messages.zh: 这是工作用的电脑吗？
messages.en: Is this the work computer?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan il-kompjuter personali tiegħi. Nużah id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan il-kompjuter personali tiegħi. Nużah id-dar.
messages.zh: 不是，这是我的私人电脑。我在家用它。
messages.en: No, this is my personal computer. I use it at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 借英语 personal 联想 personali，再用“个人意见、个人信息、个人经历”三组搭配巩固；核心是与某个具体的人有关。

gloss_zh: 个人集权；个人崇拜倾向

teaching_sense.en_definition: The concentration of authority around one individual, or an attitude that encourages excessive admiration of a particular personality.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 权力围绕某一个人集中，或倾向于过度推崇某个个人的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-konċentrazzjoni tal-awtorità madwar individwu wieħed, jew attitudni li tħeġġeġ ammirazzjoni eċċessiva lejn persuna partikolari.

sense_translations.en_definition: authority revolving around a single individual or personality
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以某一个人为中心、围绕其个人意志运作的权力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Awtorità li tkun iċċentrata fuq individwu wieħed u li tiddependi ħafna mir-rieda u l-influwenza personali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Personalism is a form of authority in which power centres on one individual and depends heavily on that person's influence.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倾向于将某个人物理想化并对其形成个人崇拜的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni li twassal biex persuna tiġi idealizzata u ssir l-oġġett ta' ammirazzjoni eċċessiva u mhux kritika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Personalism is an attitude that encourages people to idealize a particular person and admire that person without sufficient criticism.

collocations.zh: 个人集权或个人崇拜的危险
个人集权或个人崇拜的倾向

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iwissi li l-personaliżmu jista' jdgħajjef l-istituzzjonijiet meta d-deċiżjonijiet kollha jiddependu minn mexxej wieħed.
formal.en: The report warns that personalism can weaken institutions when all decisions depend on a single leader.
formal.zh: 报告警告说，当所有决定都取决于一名领导者时，个人集权可能削弱制度。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iridu jfaħħru lill-mexxej il-ħin kollu? Mark: Dan hu personaliżmu; għandna niddiskutu l-ideat ukoll.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do they want to praise the leader all the time? Mark: That's personalism; we should discuss the ideas too.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么总要赞扬那位领导者？马克：这就是个人崇拜倾向；我们也应该讨论理念。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex iridu jfaħħru lill-mexxej il-ħin kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex iridu jfaħħru lill-mexxej il-ħin kollu?
messages.zh: 他们为什么总要赞扬那位领导者？
messages.en: Why do they want to praise the leader all the time?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu personaliżmu; għandna niddiskutu l-ideat ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu personaliżmu; għandna niddiskutu l-ideat ukoll.
messages.zh: 这就是个人崇拜倾向；我们也应该讨论理念。
messages.en: That's personalism; we should discuss the ideas too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象所有权力和赞美都围着一个人转：权力方面记“个人集权”，态度方面记“个人崇拜倾向”。这是情景联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: By the person concerned directly, or from that person's own point of view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示由有关的人亲自做某事，或表示从说话者个人的角度来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: B'mod dirett mill-persuna nnifisha, jew skont il-fehma personali ta' min ikun qed jitkellem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲自，表示本人直接参与；就个人而言，表示个人的观点或感受。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mill-persuna nnifisha mingħajr ma tagħmel dan xi ħadd ieħor f'isimha, jew skont l-opinjoni u s-sentimenti tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you do something personally, you do it yourself; if you speak personally, you express your own opinion or feelings.

formal.mt: Id-direttriċi rringrazzjat personalment lil kull voluntier għall-għajnuna tiegħu.
formal.en: The director personally thanked each volunteer for their help.
formal.zh: 主任亲自向每位志愿者致谢，感谢他们的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tippreferi niltaqgħu filgħodu jew wara nofsinhar? Pawlu: Personalment, nippreferi filgħodu, imma nista' niġi wara nofsinhar ukoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you rather we meet in the morning or in the afternoon? Pawlu: Personally, I prefer the morning, but I can come in the afternoon too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你更愿意上午见面，还是下午见面？保罗：我个人更喜欢上午，不过下午我也能来。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tippreferi niltaqgħu filgħodu jew wara nofsinhar?
messages.mt_standard: Tippreferi niltaqgħu filgħodu jew wara nofsinhar?
messages.zh: 你更愿意上午见面，还是下午见面？
messages.en: Would you rather we meet in the morning or in the afternoon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Personalment, nippreferi filgħodu, imma nista' niġi wara nofsinhar ukoll.
messages.mt_standard: Personalment, nippreferi filgħodu, imma nista' niġi wara nofsinhar ukoll.
messages.zh: 我个人更喜欢上午，不过下午我也能来。
messages.en: Personally, I prefer the morning, but I can come in the afternoon too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“我本人”放进句子：本人去做，就是“亲自”；本人表达看法，就是“就我个人而言”。用这两个场景记住副词的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An individual human being, especially when distinguished from a company or another legal entity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为独立个体的人，尤其指与公司等法律实体相区别的自然人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bniedem individwali, speċjalment meta jkun distint minn kumpanija jew minn entità ġuridika oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为独立个体的一个人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bniedem wieħed meqjus bħala individwu separat minn grupp jew organizzazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A persuna fiżika is a single human being considered as an individual rather than as a group or organization.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自然人，即实际存在的人，与公司等法律实体相区别。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Bniedem meqjus bħala persuna fil-kuntest legali, b'distinzjoni minn kumpanija jew minn entità ġuridika oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A natural person is a human being considered in a legal context, as distinct from a company or another legal entity.

collocations.en: the rights of a natural person

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob lill-applikant jindika jekk huwiex persuna fiżika jew kumpanija.
formal.en: The form asks the applicant to indicate whether they are an individual or a company.
formal.zh: 表格要求申请人注明其身份是自然人还是公司。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hawn fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'persuna fiżika'. Xi tfisser? Rita: Tfisser individwu, bħalek jew bħali, u mhux kumpanija.
colloquial.en: Mark: It says 'natural person' here on the form. What does that mean? Rita: It means an individual, like you or me, rather than a company.
colloquial.zh: 马克：表格这里写着“自然人”。这是什么意思？丽塔：就是像你我这样的个人，而不是公司。

messages.speaker: Mark (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'persuna fiżika'. Xi tfisser?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fuq il-formola hemm miktub 'persuna fiżika'. Xi tfisser?
messages.zh: 表格这里写着“自然人”。这是什么意思？
messages.en: It says 'natural person' here on the form. What does that mean?

messages.speaker: Rita (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser individwu, bħalek jew bħali, u mhux kumpanija.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser individwu, bħalek jew bħali, u mhux kumpanija.
messages.zh: 就是像你我这样的个人，而不是公司。
messages.en: It means an individual, like you or me, rather than a company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写申请表时，在“个人”和“公司”之间选择：一个实际的人就是这里的“自然人”。用表格场景记整组词，避免误解成身体状况的描述。

exact_key: persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata
gloss_zh: 其投标将接受审查的投标人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person submitting a tender that is to be examined.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提交投标且其投标将接受审查的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tressaq offerta li ser tiġi eżaminata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 待审查的投标人，即其提交的投标将接受审查的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun tefgħet offerta li ser tkun suġġetta għal eżami.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tenderer to be examined is someone whose submitted tender is due to undergo examination.

collocations.mt: id-dokumenti tal-persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata
collocations.en: the documents of the tenderer whose tender is to be examined
collocations.zh: 其投标将接受审查的投标人所提交的文件

collocations.mt: talba għal kjarifika lill-persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata
collocations.en: a request for clarification addressed to the tenderer whose tender is to be examined
collocations.zh: 向其投标将接受审查的投标人提出的澄清请求

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bagħat talba għal kjarifika lill-persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata.
formal.en: The committee sent a request for clarification to the tenderer whose tender is to be examined.
formal.zh: 委员会向其投标将接受审查的投标人发出了澄清请求。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser hawn 'persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata'? Mark: Tfisser il-persuna li tibgħat l-offerta li se jeżamina l-kumitat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'a person submitting the tender that is to be examined' mean here? Mark: It means the person who sends in the tender that the committee will examine.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这里“提交将接受审查的投标的人”是什么意思？马克：就是提交投标、而那份投标将由委员会审查的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser hawn 'persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser hawn 'persuna li titfa' l-offerta li ser tkun eżaminata'?
messages.zh: 这里“提交将接受审查的投标的人”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'a person submitting the tender that is to be examined' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser il-persuna li tibgħat l-offerta li se jeżamina l-kumitat.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser il-persuna li tibgħat l-offerta li se jeżamina l-kumitat.
messages.zh: 就是提交投标、而那份投标将由委员会审查的人。
messages.en: It means the person who sends in the tender that the committee will examine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“人→提交投标→该投标将被审查”的顺序画三格图，两个 li 分别连接后面的说明；抓住“待审查”这个状态来记整条表达。

exact_key: persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet
gloss_zh: 投标被拒者；未中标的投标人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who submits a tender but does not succeed in obtaining the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提交了投标但未能获得合同的人，包括投标被拒绝或最终未中标的投标人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tressaq offerta iżda ma tirnexxix tikseb il-kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投标遭到拒绝的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ressqet offerta li tkun ġiet miċħuda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rejected bidder is someone whose bid has been refused during a bidding process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其投标被拒绝的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ippreżentat offerta f'sejħa għall-offerti u li l-offerta tagħha tkun ġiet miċħuda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tenderer rejected in a procurement process is a participant whose tender has not been accepted.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加投标但最终未获授合同的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ħadet sehem f'sejħa għall-offerti iżda ma tkunx ingħatat il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An unsuccessful tenderer is someone who submits a tender but is not awarded the contract.

collocations.mt: notifika lill-persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet
collocations.zh: 向未中标投标人发出的通知

collocations.mt: talba għal spjegazzjoni mill-persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet
collocations.en: a request for an explanation from the unsuccessful tenderer
collocations.zh: 未中标投标人提出的说明请求

formal.mt: Il-persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet tista' titlob spjegazzjoni dwar ir-riżultat tal-proċess.
formal.en: A person who submits a tender and is unsuccessful may request an explanation of the outcome of the process.
formal.zh: 提交投标但未中标的人可以请求对程序结果作出说明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fil-formola hemm 'persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet'. Dan ifisser li ma ħadniex il-kuntratt? Toni: Iva, ifisser li tefgħajna offerta imma ma rbaħniex il-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Sara: The form says 'a person who submits a tender and is unsuccessful'. Does that mean we did not get the contract? Toni: Yes, it means we submitted a tender but did not win the contract.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：表格上写着“提交投标但未成功的人”。这意味着我们没拿到合同吗？托尼：对，意思是我们提交了投标，但没有中标。

messages.speaker: Sara (投标团队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-formola hemm 'persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet'. Dan ifisser li ma ħadniex il-kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Fil-formola hemm 'persuna li tixħet offerta u ma tkunx irnexxiet'. Dan ifisser li ma ħadniex il-kuntratt?
messages.zh: 表格上写着“提交投标但未成功的人”。这意味着我们没拿到合同吗？
messages.en: The form says 'a person who submits a tender and is unsuccessful'. Does that mean we did not get the contract?

messages.speaker: Toni (投标团队负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ifisser li tefgħajna offerta imma ma rbaħniex il-kuntratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ifisser li tefgħajna offerta imma ma rbaħniex il-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 对，意思是我们提交了投标，但没有中标。
messages.en: Yes, it means we submitted a tender but did not win the contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把表达记成“人＋提交投标＋没有成功”的小故事：投标已经交出，合同却未获得。再区分英语 rejected 强调被拒，unsuccessful 强调最终未中标。

exact_key: persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet
gloss_zh: 提交中标报价的人；待审查的投标人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has submitted the successful tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提交了获选投标方案或中标报价的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ressqet offerta li ntgħażlet bħala dik rebbieħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 其投标材料有待审查的投标人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun ressqet offerta u li l-offerta tagħha tkun għad trid tiġi eżaminata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tenderer to be examined is someone whose submitted tender is awaiting examination.

collocations.mt: id-dokumenti tal-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet
collocations.en: the documents of the person who submitted the successful tender
collocations.zh: 提交中标报价者的文件

collocations.mt: tinnotifika lill-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet
collocations.en: to notify the person who submitted the successful tender
collocations.zh: 通知提交中标报价的人

formal.mt: Il-kumitat talab dokumenti addizzjonali mingħand il-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet.
formal.en: The committee requested additional documents from the person who submitted the successful tender.
formal.zh: 委员会要求提交中标报价的人补交文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min għandu jibgħat id-dokumenti? Pawlu: Il-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet għandha tibgħathom.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who needs to send the documents? Pawlu: The person who submitted the successful tender needs to send them.
colloquial.zh: Marija：谁需要寄送文件？Pawlu：提交中标报价的人需要寄送。

messages.speaker: Marija (行政同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għandu jibgħat id-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Min għandu jibgħat id-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 谁需要寄送文件？
messages.en: Who needs to send the documents?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet għandha tibgħathom.
messages.mt_standard: Il-persuna li tkun xeħtet l-offerta li rnexxiet għandha tibgħathom.
messages.zh: 提交中标报价的人需要寄送。
messages.en: The person who submitted the successful tender needs to send them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长短语分成“人—提交报价—报价获选”三段记忆；原短语指向中标者，另将所给义项“待审查的投标人”作为审查阶段的表达单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 神秘的人；令人捉摸不透的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a person whose identity, intentions, or behaviour is difficult to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人的身份、意图或行为不易了解，给人神秘莫测的感觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li l-identità, l-intenzjonijiet jew l-imġiba tagħha jkunu diffiċli biex tifhimhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容身份、意图或行为令人难以理解的神秘人物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tiddeskrivi persuna li ftit ikun magħruf dwarha jew li l-imġiba tagħha tqajjem mistoqsijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described as a mysterious person, little is known about them or their behaviour is difficult to explain.

collocations.en: the identity of a mysterious person

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, persuna mysterjuża tibgħat ittri mingħajr firma lill-familja.
formal.en: In the novel, a mysterious person sends unsigned letters to the family.
formal.zh: 小说中，一个神秘人物给这家人寄送没有署名的信。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min kien ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Ma nafx, kienet persuna mysterjuża li telqet mingħajr ma qalet kelma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who was by the door? Mark: I don't know; it was a mysterious person who left without saying a word.
colloquial.zh: Lara：刚才门边是谁？Mark：我不知道，是个神秘的人，一句话也没说就走了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 刚才门边是谁？
messages.en: Who was by the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx, kienet persuna mysterjuża li telqet mingħajr ma qalet kelma.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx, kienet persuna mysterjuża li telqet mingħajr ma qalet kelma.
messages.zh: 我不知道，是个神秘的人，一句话也没说就走了。
messages.en: I don't know; it was a mysterious person who left without saying a word.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小说里一位不留姓名、只留下信封的人，把整个短语与“神秘人物”的画面联系起来；神秘并不一定表示危险。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A legal entity that is under the control of another person or entity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受另一自然人或实体控制、具有独立法律人格的实体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Entità li għandha personalità ġuridika u li tkun taħt il-kontroll ta' persuna jew entità oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受另一自然人或实体控制的法人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna ġuridika li tkun taħt il-kontroll ta' persuna jew entità oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A controlled legal person is a legal entity over which another person or entity exercises control.

collocations.en: the activities of a controlled legal person

collocations.mt: ir-relazzjoni bejn il-persuna ġuridika kkontrollata u l-entità li tikkontrollaha
collocations.en: the relationship between the controlled legal person and its controlling entity
collocations.zh: 受控制法人与控制实体之间的关系

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-attivitajiet tal-persuna ġuridika kkontrollata u r-relazzjoni tagħha mal-entità li tikkontrollaha.
formal.en: The report describes the activities of the controlled legal person and its relationship with the entity that controls it.
formal.zh: 报告说明了该受控制法人的活动及其与控制实体之间的关系。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi persuna ġuridika kkontrollata? Pawlu: Hija entità b'personalità ġuridika li tkun taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor, bħal kumpanija kkontrollata minn kumpanija oħra.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a controlled legal person? Pawlu: It is an entity with legal personality that is under someone else's control, such as a company controlled by another company.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是受控制的法人？保罗：就是具有法律人格、受他人控制的实体，例如受另一家公司控制的公司。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi persuna ġuridika kkontrollata?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi persuna ġuridika kkontrollata?
messages.zh: 什么是受控制的法人？
messages.en: What is a controlled legal person?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija entità b'personalità ġuridika li tkun taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor, bħal kumpanija kkontrollata minn kumpanija oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Hija entità b'personalità ġuridika li tkun taħt il-kontroll ta' ħaddieħor, bħal kumpanija kkontrollata minn kumpanija oħra.
messages.zh: 就是具有法律人格、受他人控制的实体，例如受另一家公司控制的公司。
messages.en: It is an entity with legal personality that is under someone else's control, such as a company controlled by another company.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组短语对应到“法人＋受控制”两层意思，想象组织关系图中一家公司受到另一家公司控制；这里的“人”指法律主体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The people who work for an organization, considered as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某个机构或组织工作的人员的统称，指全体员工或工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies li jaħdmu għal organizzazzjoni jew istituzzjoni, meqjusa bħala grupp wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某机构或单位的全体员工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħaddiema kollha ta' organizzazzjoni jew post tax-xogħol, meqjusa flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The staff of an organization are the people who work for it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某组织所属或承担特定工作的人员，常用于正式的人事或工作语境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-persuni impjegati minn organizzazzjoni jew assenjati għal xogħol partikolari, speċjalment f'kuntest formali jew amministrattiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Personnel are the people employed by an organization or assigned to a particular activity.

formal.mt: Il-persunal amministrattiv se jirċievi taħriġ dwar is-sistema l-ġdida qabel ma tibda tintuża.
formal.en: The administrative staff will receive training on the new system before it comes into use.
formal.zh: 行政人员将在新系统投入使用前接受相关培训。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex qed nistennew daqshekk? Ġorġ: Illum għandna nuqqas ta' persunal, imma dalwaqt imisskom.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why have we been waiting so long? Ġorġ: We are short of staff today, but it will be your turn soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们怎么等了这么久？乔治：今天我们人手不足，不过很快就轮到你们了。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nistennew daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nistennew daqshekk?
messages.zh: 我们怎么等了这么久？
messages.en: Why have we been waiting so long?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (服务人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandna nuqqas ta' persunal, imma dalwaqt imisskom.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandna nuqqas ta' persunal, imma dalwaqt imisskom.
messages.zh: 今天我们人手不足，不过很快就轮到你们了。
messages.en: We are short of staff today, but it will be your turn soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 persunal 就想象一张全体员工合照：它把工作人员作为一个整体来称呼，再用“行政人员、员工培训、人员短缺”三个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is important, distinguished, or widely respected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有重要地位、成就突出或广受尊重的人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha importanza jew pożizzjoni prominenti, li tkun kisbet suċċessi notevoli jew li tgawdi rispett kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有显著地位、突出成就或较高声望的重要人物、杰出人士。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna magħrufa għall-importanza, għall-kisbiet jew għall-pożizzjoni prominenti tagħha fis-soċjetà jew f'qasam partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A personage is someone regarded as important or distinguished because of their position, achievements, or reputation.

collocations.en: a prominent figure in public life
collocations.zh: 公共生活中的一位显要人物

formal.mt: Il-mistieden tal-unur huwa persunaġġ prominenti fil-qasam tal-edukazzjoni, magħruf għall-ħidma tiegħu favur l-istudenti.
formal.en: The guest of honour is a prominent figure in education, known for his work in support of students.
formal.zh: 这位贵宾是教育界的一位杰出人士，以支持学生的工作而闻名。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hu dak ir-raġel li kulħadd qed isellem? Ġużi: Huwa persunaġġ importanti fir-raħal; għamel ħafna ġid lill-komunità.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is that man everyone is greeting? Ġużi: He's an important figure in the village; he's done a lot of good for the community.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：大家都在打招呼的那个男人是谁？朱齐：他是村里的一位重要人物，为社区做了很多好事。

messages.speaker: Nina (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak ir-raġel li kulħadd qed isellem?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak ir-raġel li kulħadd qed isellem?
messages.zh: 大家都在打招呼的那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that man everyone is greeting?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (村民)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa persunaġġ importanti fir-raħal; għamel ħafna ġid lill-komunità.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa persunaġġ importanti fir-raħal; għamel ħafna ġid lill-komunità.
messages.zh: 他是村里的一位重要人物，为社区做了很多好事。
messages.en: He's an important figure in the village; he's done a lot of good for the community.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象典礼上被郑重介绍、受到大家尊敬的贵宾，把这个词与“重要人物、杰出人士”联系起来。本条练习重点是人物的地位与声望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Directly connected with the subject or situation being considered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与正在讨论的主题或处理的情况直接相关，能够切合当前问题的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu rabta diretta mas-suġġett li jkun qed jiġi diskuss jew mas-sitwazzjoni li tkun qed tiġi kkunsidrata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切合当前问题或讨论要点的；切题的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jolqot direttament il-punt jew il-kwistjoni li tkun qed tiġi diskussa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A remark or question is pertinent when it directly addresses the matter being discussed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与所讨论的主题、所处理的事情或特定用途有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mas-suġġett, mal-każ jew mal-għan li jkun qed jiġi kkunsidrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something is relevant when it is connected with the subject or purpose under consideration.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jinkludi biss informazzjoni pertinenti għall-għan tal-istudju.
formal.en: The report should include only information relevant to the purpose of the study.
formal.zh: 报告应只纳入与研究目的相关的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nista' nistaqsi kemm se jiswa l-proġett? David: Iva, dik mistoqsija pertinenti għad-diskussjoni tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can I ask how much the project will cost? David: Yes, that's a pertinent question for our discussion.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以问一下这个项目要花多少钱吗？David：可以，这个问题很切合我们正在讨论的内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nistaqsi kemm se jiswa l-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nistaqsi kemm se jiswa l-proġett?
messages.zh: 我可以问一下这个项目要花多少钱吗？
messages.en: Can I ask how much the project will cost?

messages.speaker: David (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik mistoqsija pertinenti għad-diskussjoni tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik mistoqsija pertinenti għad-diskussjoni tagħna.
messages.zh: 可以，这个问题很切合我们正在讨论的内容。
messages.en: Yes, that's a pertinent question for our discussion.

cognitive_memory_aid: 设想讨论项目预算时有人问价格，这个问题就很 pertinenti；记成“紧扣眼前主题”，同时联系“切题”和“相关”两个用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quality of being directly connected with a particular subject, question, or purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项内容与特定主题、问题或目的相联系、相切合的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa li jkollha rabta diretta ma' suġġett, mistoqsija jew għan partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言论、问题或内容切合当前讨论要点的性质；切题性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li kumment, mistoqsija jew informazzjoni jolqtu direttament il-punt li jkun qed jiġi diskuss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The pertinence of a comment is the extent to which it directly addresses the matter being discussed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某事物与特定主题、情况或目的之间的关联程度；相关性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt jew il-grad li fih xi ħaġa jkollha x'taqsam ma' suġġett, sitwazzjoni jew għan partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The relevance of something is its connection with the subject, situation, or purpose being considered.

collocations.en: to assess the relevance of the information

formal.mt: Qabel ma tinkludi sors fir-rapport, għandek tevalwa l-pertinenza tiegħu għall-mistoqsija tar-riċerka.
formal.en: Before including a source in the report, you should assess its relevance to the research question.
formal.zh: 在把某项资料纳入报告之前，应评估它与研究问题的相关性。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ħallejt barra dak l-artiklu? Luqa: Għax ma rajtx il-pertinenza tiegħu għas-suġġett tagħna.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave out that article? Luqa: Because I couldn't see its relevance to our topic.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么没有采用那篇文章？Luqa：因为我看不出它与我们主题的相关性。

messages.speaker: Sara (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ħallejt barra dak l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ħallejt barra dak l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 你为什么没有采用那篇文章？
messages.en: Why did you leave out that article?

messages.speaker: Luqa (学习伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ma rajtx il-pertinenza tiegħu għas-suġġett tagħna.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ma rajtx il-pertinenza tiegħu għas-suġġett tagħna.
messages.zh: 因为我看不出它与我们主题的相关性。
messages.en: Because I couldn't see its relevance to our topic.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pertinenti 记作“这条信息是相关的”，把 pertinenza 记作“这条信息的相关性”；前者描述事物，后者把这种性质当作讨论对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Coming from Peru or relating to its people, culture, or other features.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自秘鲁的，或与秘鲁及其人民、文化等有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Perù jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Perù, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-kultura tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 秘鲁的；属于秘鲁或与秘鲁有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Perù jew ma' xi ħaġa li ġejja minn dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Peruvian comes from Peru or is associated with that country.

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Peru
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自秘鲁的，或涉及秘鲁的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joriġina mill-Perù jew li jirrigwarda lil dan il-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person or thing described this way originates in Peru or has a connection with it.

formal.mt: Il-mużew organizza wirja dwar l-arti u l-wirt kulturali peruvjan.
formal.en: The museum organized an exhibition about Peruvian art and cultural heritage.
formal.zh: 博物馆举办了一场关于秘鲁艺术与文化遗产的展览。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid nippruvaw dak ir-ristorant peruvjan illejla? Ben: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ikel peruvjan.
colloquial.en: Lara: Shall we try that Peruvian restaurant tonight? Ben: Yes, I'd like to taste some Peruvian food.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：今晚我们去试试那家秘鲁餐馆吧？本：好啊，我想尝尝秘鲁食物。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nippruvaw dak ir-ristorant peruvjan illejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid nippruvaw dak ir-ristorant peruvjan illejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们去试试那家秘鲁餐馆吧？
messages.en: Shall we try that Peruvian restaurant tonight?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ikel peruvjan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nixtieq induq xi ikel peruvjan.
messages.zh: 好啊，我想尝尝秘鲁食物。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to taste some Peruvian food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peruvjan 写在秘鲁地图旁，再联想秘鲁餐馆和秘鲁食物，记住它表示来源或关联。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proportion expressed as a number out of one hundred.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把整体看作一百份时，某一部分所占的比例。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proporzjon li juri kemm parti tirrappreżenta minn total ta' mija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以一百为基数表示的比例或比率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proporzjon espress bħala numru minn kull mija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A percentage is a proportion expressed as a number out of one hundred.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-perċentwali ta' studenti li għaddew mill-eżami.
formal.en: The report shows the percentage of students who passed the examination.
formal.zh: 报告显示了通过考试的学生所占的百分比。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif nikkalkula l-perċentwali ta' tweġibiet tajbin? Mark: Aqsam in-numru ta' tweġibiet tajbin bin-numru totali ta' mistoqsijiet, imbagħad immultiplika b'mija.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I calculate the percentage of correct answers? Mark: Divide the number of correct answers by the total number of questions, then multiply by one hundred.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：答对题目的百分比怎么算？马克：用答对的题数除以总题数，再乘以一百。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nikkalkula l-perċentwali ta' tweġibiet tajbin?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nikkalkula l-perċentwali ta' tweġibiet tajbin?
messages.zh: 答对题目的百分比怎么算？
messages.en: How do I calculate the percentage of correct answers?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqsam in-numru ta' tweġibiet tajbin bin-numru totali ta' mistoqsijiet, imbagħad immultiplika b'mija.
messages.mt_standard: Aqsam in-numru ta' tweġibiet tajbin bin-numru totali ta' mistoqsijiet, imbagħad immultiplika b'mija.
messages.zh: 用答对的题数除以总题数，再乘以一百。
messages.en: Divide the number of correct answers by the total number of questions, then multiply by one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整体想成一百格，涂色部分占多少格，就是 perċentwali；配合百分号一起记。

gloss_zh: 男性生殖器的口语粗称；微小而无足轻重的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A colloquial, coarse term for male genitalia, also used for something small and trifling.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男性生殖器的口语粗俗称呼；也指微小、无足轻重的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma kollokjali u vulgari għall-partijiet ġenitali tar-raġel; tintuża wkoll għal xi ħaġa żgħira u ta' ftit importanza.

sense_translations.en_definition: colloquial term for male genitalia (equivalent to 'pecker' or 'prick')
sense_translations.zh_definition: 男性生殖器的口语粗俗称呼，语气类似英语 pecker 或 prick。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kelma kollokjali u vulgari li tintuża biex tirreferi għall-partijiet ġenitali tar-raġel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: People use this coarse, informal word to refer to male genitalia.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微小且无足轻重的东西；不值一提的小物件或小事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa żgħira li għandha ftit valur jew li mhijiex importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls something a pesisa, they regard it as small and of little importance.

formal.mt: F'dan il-kuntest, il-kelma 'pesisa' tirreferi għal ħaġa żgħira u ta' ftit importanza, mhux għall-partijiet ġenitali.
formal.en: In this context, the word 'pesisa' refers to a small, insignificant thing, rather than to genitalia.
formal.zh: 在这一语境中，pesisa 指微小而无足轻重的东西，而非生殖器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi din il-pesisa fuq il-mejda? Toni: Biċċa plastik biss; tista' tarmiha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's this little thing on the table? Toni: Just a piece of plastic; you can throw it away.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：桌上这个小玩意儿是什么？托尼：就是一小块塑料，你可以扔掉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi din il-pesisa fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi din il-pesisa fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上这个小玩意儿是什么？
messages.en: What's this little thing on the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biċċa plastik biss; tista' tarmiha.
messages.mt_standard: Biċċa plastik biss; tista' tarmiha.
messages.zh: 就是一小块塑料，你可以扔掉。
messages.en: Just a piece of plastic; you can throw it away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 pesisa 做一张双面词卡：一面标注身体部位的粗俗称呼，另一面画不起眼的小物件；靠语境区分两义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A severe infectious disease that can spread among many people and cause many deaths.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼠疫；可在人群中传播并造成大量死亡的严重传染病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda infettiva serja li tista' tinfirex fost ħafna nies u tikkawża ħafna mwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鼠疫；瘟疫，即传播广泛、可造成大量死亡的严重传染病。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li tittieħed u li tista' tinfirex ħafna u tikkawża l-mewt ta' għadd kbir ta' nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Plague is a serious infectious disease that can spread widely and kill many people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-pesta affettwat il-ħajja ta' kuljum fil-belt.
formal.en: The report describes how the plague affected everyday life in the city.
formal.zh: 报告描述了鼠疫如何影响城里的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fuq xiex inhu dak il-ktieb? Mark: Fuq il-pesta u kif kienet tbiddel il-ħajja tan-nies.
colloquial.en: Nina: What's that book about? Mark: It's about plague and how it used to change people's lives.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：那本书讲什么？马克：讲鼠疫，以及它过去怎样改变人们的生活。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq xiex inhu dak il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Fuq xiex inhu dak il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 那本书讲什么？
messages.en: What's that book about?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-pesta u kif kienet tbiddel il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-pesta u kif kienet tbiddel il-ħajja tan-nies.
messages.zh: 讲鼠疫，以及它过去怎样改变人们的生活。
messages.en: It's about plague and how it used to change people's lives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pesta 与历史书里的瘟疫章节配成一组，再用“疫情”和“传播”两个搭配巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An animal kept for companionship and cared for by its owner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为陪伴而饲养、由主人照料的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal li persuna żżomm għall-kumpanija u li tieħu ħsiebu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宠物；人们为陪伴而饲养和照料的动物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Annimal li jinżamm għall-kumpanija jew għall-pjaċir u li s-sid jieħu ħsiebu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pet is an animal that someone keeps and cares for as a companion.

formal.mt: Min jadotta pet għandu jippjana kif se jipprovdi l-ikel, il-kura u l-attenzjoni meħtieġa.
formal.en: Anyone adopting a pet should plan how to provide the necessary food, care, and attention.
formal.zh: 领养宠物的人应规划如何提供它所需的食物、照料和关爱。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek xi pet id-dar? Liam: Iva, għandi qattus jismu Leo. Trid tara ritratt tiegħu?
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have a pet at home? Liam: Yes, I have a cat called Leo. Would you like to see a photo of him?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你家养宠物吗？利亚姆：养啊，我有只猫叫利奥。想看看它的照片吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi pet id-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi pet id-dar?
messages.zh: 你家养宠物吗？
messages.en: Do you have a pet at home?

messages.speaker: Liam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi qattus jismu Leo. Trid tara ritratt tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi qattus jismu Leo. Trid tara ritratt tiegħu?
messages.zh: 养啊，我有只猫叫利奥。想看看它的照片吗？
messages.en: Yes, I have a cat called Leo. Would you like to see a photo of him?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pet 与自家或朋友家的宠物照片放在一起，边看边练“领养宠物”和“照料宠物”两个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal written request addressed to an authority, sometimes supported by several people's signatures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向有关机构或有权处理事务的人提出的正式书面请求，有时附有多人签名。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Talba formali bil-miktub indirizzata lil awtorità, xi drabi appoġġata bil-firem ta' diversi persuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请求；正式向有关方面提出的要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba formali li persuna tagħmel lil xi ħadd li jista' jiddeċiedi dwarha jew jieħu azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A petizzjoni is a formal request asking someone to take action or consider a particular matter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 请愿书；请求有关机构采取行动的正式文件，常附有支持者签名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument b'talba formali lil awtorità, li spiss ikollu l-firem ta' persuni li jappoġġaw it-talba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A petition is a written request to an authority, often signed by people who support its purpose.

collocations.en: a petition to the local council

formal.mt: Ir-residenti ppreżentaw petizzjoni lill-kunsill lokali biex jitolbu aktar spazji ħodor fil-lokalità.
formal.en: The residents submitted a petition to the local council requesting more green spaces in the area.
formal.zh: 居民向地方议会提交了一份请愿书，要求在该地区增加绿地。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiffirma din il-petizzjoni biex il-park jibqa' miftuħ? Mark: Iva, żgur. Fejn għandi niffirma?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to sign this petition to keep the park open? Mark: Yes, of course. Where should I sign?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你愿意在这份请愿书上签名，让公园继续开放吗？马克：当然愿意。我该在哪里签名？

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiffirma din il-petizzjoni biex il-park jibqa' miftuħ?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiffirma din il-petizzjoni biex il-park jibqa' miftuħ?
messages.zh: 你愿意在这份请愿书上签名，让公园继续开放吗？
messages.en: Would you like to sign this petition to keep the park open?

messages.speaker: Mark (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żgur. Fejn għandi niffirma?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żgur. Fejn għandi niffirma?
messages.zh: 当然愿意。我该在哪里签名？
messages.en: Yes, of course. Where should I sign?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 petizzjoni 与“一张写明诉求、下面留着签名栏的纸”联系起来，同时记住“正式请求”和“请愿书”两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A liquid fuel used in many cars and other engines, called gasoline in American English.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于许多汽车及其他发动机的液体燃料，即汽油；美式英语称 gasoline。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Karburant likwidu li jintuża f'ħafna karozzi u magni oħra biex dawn jaħdmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽油；美式英语 gasoline 所指的汽车等使用的液体燃料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karburant likwidu użat f'ħafna magni tal-karozzi, li bl-Ingliż Amerikan jissejjaħ gasoline.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gasoline is the liquid fuel used in many cars and other vehicles with suitable engines.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 汽油；英式英语 petrol 所指的发动机燃料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karburant likwidu li jitqiegħed fit-tank ta' vettura b'magna adattata u jintuża biex iħaddimha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Petrol is a liquid fuel that powers many cars and is called gasoline in American English.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 燃料；此词条中指用于驱动发动机的汽油。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Karburant li jinħaraq biex jipprovdi l-enerġija meħtieġa għal magna; f'dan il-każ, il-petrol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: As a fuel, petrol supplies energy when it burns inside an engine designed to use it.

collocations.en: to fill the tank with petrol
a car that runs on petrol

formal.mt: Qabel il-vjaġġ, is-sewwieq iċċekkja jekk kienx hemm biżżejjed petrol fit-tank.
formal.en: Before the journey, the driver checked whether there was enough petrol in the tank.
formal.zh: 出发前，司机检查了油箱里的汽油是否充足。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna biżżejjed petrol biex naslu d-dar? Pawlu: Iva, imma aħjar nimlew it-tank qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have we got enough petrol to get home? Pawlu: Yes, but we'd better fill the tank before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们的汽油够开回家吗？保罗：够，不过最好在出发前把油箱加满。

messages.speaker: Lara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed petrol biex naslu d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed petrol biex naslu d-dar?
messages.zh: 我们的汽油够开回家吗？
messages.en: Have we got enough petrol to get home?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aħjar nimlew it-tank qabel nitilqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aħjar nimlew it-tank qabel nitilqu.
messages.zh: 够，不过最好在出发前把油箱加满。
messages.en: Yes, but we'd better fill the tank before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 petrol 放进“汽车油箱”的画面里记忆：对应汽油，英式英语也写 petrol，美式英语常说 gasoline。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The bottom part of a shoe that touches the ground when you stand or walk.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鞋子最下面、站立或行走时与地面接触的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' taħt ta' żarbuna li tmiss mal-art meta persuna tkun bilwieqfa jew timxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞋底；鞋子底部与地面接触的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti t'isfel ta' żarbuna li fuqha tistrieħ is-sieq u li tmiss mal-art waqt il-mixi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The sole of a shoe is its bottom part, which makes contact with the ground.

collocations.en: to replace the sole of a shoe

formal.mt: Il-pett taż-żarbuna kien mikul, għalhekk is-sid ħadha għand żarbun biex ibiddlu.
formal.en: The sole of the shoe was worn, so the owner took it to a cobbler to have the sole replaced.
formal.zh: 这只鞋的鞋底磨损了，因此鞋主把鞋送到修鞋匠那里更换鞋底。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tibdel il-pett ta' din iż-żarbuna? Ġużeppi: Iva, nista' nagħmillek wieħed ġdid tal-gomma.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you replace the sole of this shoe? Ġużeppi: Yes, I can fit a new rubber one for you.
colloquial.zh: 马克：您能给这只鞋换个鞋底吗？朱塞佩：可以，我能给你装一个新的橡胶鞋底。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibdel il-pett ta' din iż-żarbuna?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibdel il-pett ta' din iż-żarbuna?
messages.zh: 您能给这只鞋换个鞋底吗？
messages.en: Can you replace the sole of this shoe?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (修鞋匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nista' nagħmillek wieħed ġdid tal-gomma.
