messages.mt_standard: Iva, nista' nagħmillek wieħed ġdid tal-gomma.
messages.zh: 可以，我能给你装一个新的橡胶鞋底。
messages.en: Yes, I can fit a new rubber one for you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pett 时想象把鞋翻过来，看到紧贴地面的那一层；将“鞋底”与 pett tal-gomma“橡胶鞋底”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a row of teeth used to untangle, smooth, or arrange hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有一排梳齿、用来梳开打结的头发或整理发型的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'ringiela ta' snien li tintuża biex tħoll l-għoqod tax-xagħar jew tirranġah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 梳子；用梳齿梳理、解开或整理头发的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda bi snien li tgħaddiha minn ġox-xagħar biex tħoll l-għoqod u tirranġa x-xagħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A comb is a tool with teeth that you draw through your hair to untangle or arrange it.

collocations.en: to arrange your hair with a comb

formal.mt: Il-parrukkiera użat pettne bi snien wesgħin biex tħoll l-għoqod tax-xagħar bil-mod.
formal.en: The hairdresser used a wide-toothed comb to gently untangle the hair.
formal.zh: 理发师用一把宽齿梳轻轻梳开打结的头发。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek pettne? Irrid nirranġa xagħri. Sara: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you got a comb? I want to tidy my hair. Sara: Yes, there's one in the drawer next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有梳子吗？我想整理一下头发。萨拉：有，镜子旁边的抽屉里有一把。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek pettne? Irrid nirranġa xagħri.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek pettne? Irrid nirranġa xagħri.
messages.zh: 你有梳子吗？我想整理一下头发。
messages.en: Have you got a comb? I want to tidy my hair.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-kexxun ħdejn il-mera.
messages.zh: 有，镜子旁边的抽屉里有一把。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the drawer next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pettne 与“镜子旁一排梳齿穿过头发”的画面绑定；搭配 snien“齿”一起记，帮助牢牢记住“梳子”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A naughty child who misbehaves or causes mischief.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为淘气、常做恶作剧或不听话的孩子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel imqareb li ma jġibx ruħu sew jew jagħmel xi praspura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气、不听话或爱恶作剧的孩子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifel li jkun imqareb u jagħmel affarijiet li ma għandux jagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you call a child a pexpux, you mean that the child is naughty or mischievous.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-pexpux jaħbi ż-żraben ta' ħuh u mbagħad jitlob skuża.
formal.en: In the story, the naughty child hides his brother's shoes and then apologizes.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个淘气孩子藏起哥哥或弟弟的鞋，随后道了歉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn huma ż-żraben tiegħi? Pawlu: Dak il-pexpux ħbiehom wara l-bieb!
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are my shoes? Pawlu: That little rascal hid them behind the door!
colloquial.zh: Marija：我的鞋在哪儿？Pawlu：那个小捣蛋把鞋藏到门后了！

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn huma ż-żraben tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn huma ż-żraben tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的鞋在哪儿？
messages.en: Where are my shoes?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-pexpux ħbiehom wara l-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-pexpux ħbiehom wara l-bieb!
messages.zh: 那个小捣蛋把鞋藏到门后了！
messages.en: That little rascal hid them behind the door!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pexpux 和“藏鞋的小捣蛋”画面一起记，重点记住它指淘气的孩子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of fabric used for sewing, covering, or another purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可用于缝纫、遮盖等用途的一块布料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tista' tintuża għall-ħjata, biex tgħatti xi ħaġa jew għal skop ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块布料或织物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa minn materjal minsuġ li tista' tintuża waħedha jew bħala parti minn xi ħaġa meħjuta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pezza is a piece of fabric that you can use for sewing or other purposes.

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju tal-ħjata, kull student għandu jġib pezza tal-qoton u labra.
formal.en: For this sewing exercise, each student should bring a piece of cotton fabric and a needle.
formal.zh: 进行这项缝纫练习时，每位学生应带一块棉布和一根针。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek pezza drapp biex nagħmel but żgħir? Rita: Iva, ħu din il-pezza blu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have a piece of fabric so I can make a small pocket? Rita: Yes, take this blue piece.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你有一块布吗？我想做个小口袋。Rita：有，拿这块蓝布吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek pezza drapp biex nagħmel but żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek pezza drapp biex nagħmel but żgħir?
messages.zh: 你有一块布吗？我想做个小口袋。
messages.en: Do you have a piece of fabric so I can make a small pocket?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu din il-pezza blu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu din il-pezza blu.
messages.zh: 有，拿这块蓝布吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this blue piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拿起一块蓝布缝口袋，把 pezza 与“一块布”的具体形状一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 爱争辩的人；惹是生非的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is inclined to argue or cause trouble.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜欢与人争辩，或经常挑起事端、制造麻烦的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tħobb targumenta mal-oħrajn jew taqla' l-inkwiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱争辩、动辄与人争论的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ta' spiss tmeri lil ħaddieħor u tħobb tidħol f'argumenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you describe someone as a pezza kustjoni, you mean that they are always ready to argue.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经常惹是生非、挑起事端或给别人制造麻烦的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taqla' l-inkwiet jew toħloq problemi għall-oħrajn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pezza kustjoni is someone who causes trouble or creates problems for other people.

collocations.en: to be an argumentative person or troublemaker
collocations.zh: 是个爱争辩或惹事的人

collocations.en: to work with an argumentative person or troublemaker
collocations.zh: 与爱争辩或惹事的人共事

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, is-surmast iqis lil Toni bħala pezza kustjoni għax spiss iqajjem argumenti bejn l-istudenti.
formal.en: In the story, the headteacher regards Toni as a troublemaker because he often starts arguments among the students.
formal.zh: 故事里，校长认为 Toni 是个惹事的人，因为他经常挑起学生之间的争吵。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' Toni? Luqa: Diffiċli! Huwa pezza kustjoni; kellu xi jgħid kontra kull proposta.
colloquial.en: Marta: How did the meeting with Toni go? Luqa: It was difficult! He's so argumentative; he had something to say against every proposal.
colloquial.zh: Marta：和 Toni 的会议开得怎么样？Luqa：很费劲！他太爱争辩了，每个提议他都有意见。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' Toni?
messages.mt_standard: Kif marret il-laqgħa ma' Toni?
messages.zh: 和 Toni 的会议开得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the meeting with Toni go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Diffiċli! Huwa pezza kustjoni; kellu xi jgħid kontra kull proposta.
messages.mt_standard: Diffiċli! Huwa pezza kustjoni; kellu xi jgħid kontra kull proposta.
messages.zh: 很费劲！他太爱争辩了，每个提议他都有意见。
messages.en: It was difficult! He's so argumentative; he had something to say against every proposal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pezza kustjoni 整组记成“开会总抬杠、相处常惹事的人”，用两个场景区分爱争辩与制造麻烦。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A line or fold in fabric where it has been bent or pressed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料因折叠、受压等形成的一道褶痕或折痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Linja jew tinja fid-drapp li tifforma meta dan jintlewa jew jingħafas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布料或衣物上因折叠、挤压形成的褶痕。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marka jew tinja li tibqa' fid-drapp wara li jkun intewa jew ingħafas.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pieg is a line in fabric that forms when the material is folded or pressed.

collocations.en: to remove a crease with an iron

formal.mt: Qabel il-wirja, il-ħajjata neħħiet pieg mill-libsa bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija.
formal.en: Before the show, the dressmaker removed a crease from the dress with an iron.
formal.zh: 演出前，裁缝用熨斗熨平了连衣裙上的一道褶痕。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandi pieg fil-qmis. Jidher ħafna? Adam: Ftit. Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: There's a crease in my shirt. Is it very noticeable? Adam: A little. Iron it before you go out.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我的衬衫上有道褶痕，很明显吗？Adam：有一点。出门前熨一下吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi pieg fil-qmis. Jidher ħafna?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi pieg fil-qmis. Jidher ħafna?
messages.zh: 我的衬衫上有道褶痕，很明显吗？
messages.en: There's a crease in my shirt. Is it very noticeable?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit. Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit. Għaddiha bil-ħadida tal-mogħdija qabel toħroġ.
messages.zh: 有一点。出门前熨一下吧。
messages.en: A little. Iron it before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衬衫折好后留下一道线，再用熨斗压平；把这道褶痕与 pieg 对应起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is among the first to explore a place or develop a new activity, method, or field.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 最早探索某个地方，或率先开展某项活动、发展某种方法或开拓某个领域的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun fost l-ewwel li tesplora post jew tiżviluppa attività, metodu jew qasam ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先驱；开拓者，指率先探索某地或开创某种活动、方法或领域的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li twitti t-triq għal oħrajn billi tkun fost l-ewwel li tesplora post jew tibda taħdem f'qasam ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pioneer is someone who is among the first to explore a place or develop a new area of activity.

collocations.en: to be a pioneer in a new field

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi lir-riċerkatur bħala pijunier fl-iżvilupp ta' metodi ġodda għat-tisfija tal-ilma.
formal.en: The report describes the researcher as a pioneer in developing new methods of water purification.
formal.zh: 报告将这名研究人员描述为开发新型净水方法的先驱。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex issejjaħlu pijunier? Mark: Għax kien fost l-ewwel li ppruvaw dan il-metodu, u ħafna oħrajn segwewh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you call him a pioneer? Mark: Because he was among the first to try this method, and many others followed his example.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么称他为先驱？马克：因为他是最早尝试这种方法的人之一，后来很多人都效仿了他。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex issejjaħlu pijunier?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex issejjaħlu pijunier?
messages.zh: 你为什么称他为先驱？
messages.en: Why do you call him a pioneer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax kien fost l-ewwel li ppruvaw dan il-metodu, u ħafna oħrajn segwewh.
messages.mt_standard: Għax kien fost l-ewwel li ppruvaw dan il-metodu, u ħafna oħrajn segwewh.
messages.zh: 因为他是最早尝试这种方法的人之一，后来很多人都效仿了他。
messages.en: Because he was among the first to try this method, and many others followed his example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一人先走进未知领域，其他人沿着他的脚步前进：这位带头开路的人就是 pijunier。搭配 fil-mediċina 一起记，可表达“医学领域的先驱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a spicy taste that can produce a burning sensation in the mouth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道辛辣的，能在口中产生辣或灼热感觉的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma qawwija ta' ħwawar, bħall-bżar jaħraq, u jista' jagħti sensazzjoni ta' ħruq fil-ħalq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辛辣的；带有辣味香料所产生的刺激性味道的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma qawwija u tingiż fil-ħalq minħabba ħwawar bħall-bżar jaħraq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is spicy has a strong, pungent flavour from ingredients such as chillies or pepper.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辣的；形容食物入口后产生灼辣感，此处指辣度而非温度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti sensazzjoni ta' ħruq fil-ħalq minħabba t-togħma tiegħu, mhux minħabba t-temperatura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food that is hot produces a burning sensation in your mouth because of ingredients such as chillies.

formal.mt: Il-menu jindika li din iz-zalza hija pikkanti ħafna u għandha tiġi servuta fi kwantitajiet żgħar.
formal.en: The menu indicates that this sauce is very spicy and should be served in small quantities.
formal.zh: 菜单注明，这款酱汁很辣，宜少量供应。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din iz-zalza pikkanti? Pawlu: Iva, ftit. Jekk ma tħobbx il-pikkanti, ħu l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this sauce spicy? Pawlu: Yes, a little. If you don't like spicy food, have the other one.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这款酱汁辣吗？保罗：是的，有一点。你要是不喜欢吃辣，就选另一款。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din iz-zalza pikkanti?
messages.mt_standard: Din iz-zalza pikkanti?
messages.zh: 这款酱汁辣吗？
messages.en: Is this sauce spicy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftit. Jekk ma tħobbx il-pikkanti, ħu l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftit. Jekk ma tħobbx il-pikkanti, ħu l-oħra.
messages.zh: 是的，有一点。你要是不喜欢吃辣，就选另一款。
messages.en: Yes, a little. If you don't like spicy food, have the other one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pikkanti 记成舌尖受到辣味刺激的感觉，搭配 zalza pikkanti“辣味酱汁”反复练习。这里英语 hot 说的是吃起来辣，不能据此理解成温度高。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An informal meal eaten outdoors, often during an outing with food brought from home.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在户外享用的便餐，常指外出时携带食物一起吃的野餐活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla informali li tittiekel fil-beraħ waqt ħarġa, ħafna drabi b'ikel miġjub mid-dar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野餐；通常指外出时携带食物在户外享用的一餐或相应活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikla li ssir barra, pereżempju f'park jew fil-kampanja, fejn in-nies iġibu magħhom l-ikel biex jiekluh flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A picnic is an informal meal eaten outdoors, usually with food that you have brought with you.

formal.mt: Wara l-mixja, il-parteċipanti se jagħmlu piknik fil-park; kull persuna għandha ġġib l-ikel u l-ilma tagħha.
formal.en: After the walk, the participants will have a picnic in the park; each person should bring their own food and water.
formal.zh: 步行活动结束后，参加者将在公园野餐；每人应自备食物和饮用水。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nagħmlu piknik nhar il-Ħadd? Luqa: Iva! Jien inġib il-ħobż u l-ġobon, u inti ġib il-frott.
colloquial.en: Sara: Shall we have a picnic on Sunday? Luqa: Yes! I'll bring the bread and cheese, and you bring the fruit.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们星期天去野餐好吗？卢卡：好啊！我带面包和奶酪，你带水果。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nagħmlu piknik nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.mt_standard: Nagħmlu piknik nhar il-Ħadd?
messages.zh: 我们星期天去野餐好吗？
messages.en: Shall we have a picnic on Sunday?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Jien inġib il-ħobż u l-ġobon, u inti ġib il-frott.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Jien inġib il-ħobż u l-ġobon, u inti ġib il-frott.
messages.zh: 好啊！我带面包和奶酪，你带水果。
messages.en: Yes! I'll bring the bread and cheese, and you bring the fruit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 利用 piknik 与英语 picnic 的拼写相似性建立记忆，再想象提着野餐篮到草地上吃午餐。整句记住 Nagħmlu piknik?“我们去野餐好吗？”便于直接开口。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure or solid shape with a polygonal base and triangular sides that meet at one point above it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有多边形底面、各三角形侧面在顶部汇聚于一点的建筑或立体形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pilandra hija struttura jew forma solida b'bażi poligonali u b'uċuħ trijangulari li jiltaqgħu f'punt wieħed fil-quċċata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 金字塔；底面为多边形、侧面为三角形且共同汇聚于一个顶点的角锥体。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pilandra hija struttura jew forma ġeometrika b'bażi poligonali u b'uċuħ trijangulari li jiltaqgħu f'punt wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pyramid is a structure or solid shape whose triangular sides rise from a polygonal base to a single point.

formal.mt: Għall-proġett tal-iskola, l-istudenta bniet pilandra tal-kartun b'bażi kwadra u erba' uċuħ trijangulari.
formal.en: For the school project, the student built a cardboard pyramid with a square base and four triangular faces.
formal.zh: 为完成学校的项目，这名女生用硬纸板制作了一个底面为正方形、具有四个三角形侧面的角锥体。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'se nibnu b'dawn il-biċċiet? Ben: Ejja nibnu pilandra. Lara: Sewwa, nibdew mill-bażi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What shall we build with these pieces? Ben: Let's build a pyramid. Lara: All right, let's start with the base.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们用这些零件搭什么？本：搭一个金字塔吧。拉拉：好，我们从底部开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nibnu b'dawn il-biċċiet?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nibnu b'dawn il-biċċiet?
messages.zh: 我们用这些零件搭什么？
messages.en: What shall we build with these pieces?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nibnu pilandra.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nibnu pilandra.
messages.zh: 搭一个金字塔吧。
messages.en: Let's build a pyramid.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nibdew mill-bażi.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nibdew mill-bażi.
messages.zh: 好，我们从底部开始。
messages.en: All right, let's start with the base.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pilandra 写在角锥体图旁，沿着三角形侧面向上画到同一顶点，用“底面宽、顶部尖”的图像记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Upright structural supports that carry the weight of a roof or another part of a building.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 竖直设立、承托屋顶或建筑其他部分重量的柱子；pilastri 是复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pilastri huma strutturi wieqfa u sodi li jġorru l-piż ta' saqaf jew ta' parti oħra minn bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柱；支柱，指承托建筑结构的直立构件；pilastri 为复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pilastru huwa struttura wieqfa u soda li ssostni saqaf jew parti oħra minn bini; pilastri hija l-forma fil-plural.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pillar is a strong upright support for part of a building; pilastri refers to more than one such support.

formal.mt: L-erba' pilastri tal-ġebel isostnu s-saqaf tas-sala u għandhom jiġu spezzjonati regolarment.
formal.en: The four stone pillars support the hall's roof and should be inspected regularly.
formal.zh: 四根石柱支撑着大厅的屋顶，应当定期接受检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nistennew lil Pawlu? Mark: Ħdejn il-pilastri tad-daħla. Nina: Tajjeb, nistennuh hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where shall we wait for Pawlu? Mark: By the pillars at the entrance. Nina: All right, we'll wait for him there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们在哪里等保罗？马克：在入口的柱子旁边。妮娜：好，我们在那里等他。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nistennew lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nistennew lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 我们在哪里等保罗？
messages.en: Where shall we wait for Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-pilastri tad-daħla.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-pilastri tad-daħla.
messages.zh: 在入口的柱子旁边。
messages.en: By the pillars at the entrance.

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nistennuh hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nistennuh hemm.
messages.zh: 好，我们在那里等他。
messages.en: All right, we'll wait for him there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pilastri 标在一排承托屋顶的柱子下，记住它表示多根柱子；背词时同时想象柱子把屋顶稳稳撑住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small solid dose of medicine, usually taken by swallowing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小块固体剂型的药物，通常通过吞服使用，可指药片或药丸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pillola hija doża żgħira u solida ta' mediċina li normalment tittieħed billi tinbela'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药片；将药物压制成的小块固体制剂。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pillola hija biċċa żgħira u solida ta' mediċina magħmula billi sustanzi mediċinali jiġu ppressati f'forma li tista' tittieħed faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tablet is a small solid dose of medicine made by pressing medicinal ingredients into a compact shape.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 药丸；通常需要吞服的小粒固体药物，也可泛指药片。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pillola hija biċċa żgħira ta' mediċina solida li normalment tinbela' biex tittieħed doża tal-mediċina.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pill is a small solid piece of medicine that you usually swallow as a dose.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega kif għandha tittieħed il-pillola u kif għandha tinħażen il-mediċina.
formal.en: The leaflet explains how the tablet should be taken and how the medicine should be stored.
formal.zh: 说明书解释了该药片的服用方法以及药物的储存方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħadt il-pillola tiegħek? Toni: Għadni le. Tista' ġġibli tazza ilma? Sara: Iva, hawn l-ilma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you taken your pill? Toni: Not yet. Can you bring me a glass of water? Sara: Yes, here's the water.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你吃药了吗？托尼：还没有。你能给我拿杯水吗？萨拉：好，水来了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadt il-pillola tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Ħadt il-pillola tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你吃药了吗？
messages.en: Have you taken your pill?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. Tista' ġġibli tazza ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. Tista' ġġibli tazza ilma?
messages.zh: 还没有。你能给我拿杯水吗？
messages.en: Not yet. Can you bring me a glass of water?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn l-ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn l-ilma.
messages.zh: 好，水来了。
messages.en: Yes, here's the water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 pill 帮助联想 pillola，脑中配上一粒药和一杯水的画面；这里只作词形联想，不把它当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who operates and controls an aircraft.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 操纵和驾驶飞机等航空器的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pilota huwa persuna li tmexxi u tikkontrolla ajruplan jew inġenju ieħor tal-ajru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 飞行员；负责操纵和驾驶航空器的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pilota huwa persuna mħarrġa biex tmexxi u tikkontrolla ajruplan jew inġenju ieħor tal-ajru waqt it-titjira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot is a person trained to operate and control an aircraft during flight.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, il-pilota informa lill-passiġġieri dwar it-tul tat-titjira u l-kundizzjonijiet tat-temp.
formal.en: Before departure, the pilot informed the passengers about the flight duration and the weather conditions.
formal.zh: 起飞前，飞行员向乘客介绍了飞行时长和天气状况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk? Leo: Huwa pilota u jsuq ajruplani tal-passiġġieri. Maja: Kemm ilu jaħdem bħala pilota? Leo: Ilu ħames snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does your brother do? Leo: He's a pilot and flies passenger planes. Maja: How long has he worked as a pilot? Leo: For five years.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你兄弟做什么工作？利奥：他是飞行员，驾驶客机。玛雅：他当飞行员多久了？利奥：五年了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk?
messages.mt_standard: X'xogħol jagħmel ħuk?
messages.zh: 你兄弟做什么工作？
messages.en: What does your brother do?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa pilota u jsuq ajruplani tal-passiġġieri.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa pilota u jsuq ajruplani tal-passiġġieri.
messages.zh: 他是飞行员，驾驶客机。
messages.en: He's a pilot and flies passenger planes.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm ilu jaħdem bħala pilota?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm ilu jaħdem bħala pilota?
messages.zh: 他当飞行员多久了？
messages.en: How long has he worked as a pilot?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ilu ħames snin.
messages.mt_standard: Ilu ħames snin.
messages.zh: 五年了。
messages.en: For five years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pilota 时联想英语 pilot，再想象驾驶舱里操纵飞机的人；把完整拼写和“飞行员”的人物画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The degree to which a surface or route slopes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面或路线倾斜的程度，即坡度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-grad ta' inklinazzjoni ta' wiċċ jew ta' triq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表面或路线的坡度，即其倾斜程度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grad li bih wiċċ jew triq ikun inklinat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gradient of a surface or route is the degree to which it slopes.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li din it-triq għandha pindil qawwi u għalhekk teħtieġ attenzjoni waqt is-sewqan.
formal.en: The report indicates that this road has a steep gradient and therefore requires care when driving.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这条道路坡度较陡，因此驾车时需要小心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed nimxu daqshekk bil-mod? Pawlu: Din it-triq għandha pindil qawwi. Ejja nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are we walking so slowly? Pawlu: This road has a steep gradient. Let's rest for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们为什么走得这么慢？保罗：这条路坡度很陡。我们休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nimxu daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nimxu daqshekk bil-mod?
messages.zh: 我们为什么走得这么慢？
messages.en: Why are we walking so slowly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-triq għandha pindil qawwi. Ejja nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Din it-triq għandha pindil qawwi. Ejja nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 这条路坡度很陡。我们休息一下吧。
messages.en: This road has a steep gradient. Let's rest for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pindil 配上一幅斜坡图来记：坡越陡，倾斜程度越大；同时记住 qawwi 表示这里的坡度较陡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instruction requesting that a ping be sent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 要求发送一次 ping 的指令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Istruzzjoni li titlob li jintbagħat ping.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要求发送 ping 的指令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Istruzzjoni biex jintbagħat ping.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ping order is an instruction requesting that a ping be sent.

collocations.zh: 发出发送 ping 的指令

collocations.en: to carry out a ping order
collocations.zh: 执行发送 ping 的指令

formal.mt: Il-proċedura titlob li l-operatur joħroġ ping order u jikkonferma meta jintbagħat il-ping.
formal.en: The procedure requires the operator to issue a ping order and confirm when the ping is sent.
formal.zh: 该流程要求操作员发出发送 ping 的指令，并在 ping 发出时予以确认。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ħriġt il-ping order? David: Iva, u diġà ntbagħat il-ping.
colloquial.en: Marta: Have you issued the ping order? David: Yes, and the ping has already been sent.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你发出发送 ping 的指令了吗？戴维：发出了，而且 ping 已经发送了。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħriġt il-ping order?
messages.mt_standard: Ħriġt il-ping order?
messages.zh: 你发出发送 ping 的指令了吗？
messages.en: Have you issued the ping order?

messages.speaker: David (操作员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà ntbagħat il-ping.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà ntbagħat il-ping.
messages.zh: 发出了，而且 ping 已经发送了。
messages.en: Yes, and the ping has already been sent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“先下指令，再发 ping”的两步画面记住 ping order：整个短语指要求发送的指令。

gloss_zh: 预先填充、可直接使用的笔

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pen that is supplied already filled and ready for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供应时已预先填充好内容物、可直接使用的笔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pinna li tiġi diġà mimlija bil-kontenut tagħha u tkun lesta għall-użu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预填充笔，即使用前已由供应方填充好内容物的笔。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pinna li l-kontenut tagħha jkun tqiegħed fiha minn qabel u li tkun lesta biex tintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pre-filled pen is supplied with its contents already inside, ready for use.

collocations.en: the instructions for the pre-filled pen

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-pinna mimlija lesta, aqra l-istruzzjonijiet li jiġu magħha.
formal.en: Before using the pre-filled pen, read the instructions supplied with it.
formal.zh: 使用预填充笔之前，请阅读随附的使用说明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irrid nimla din il-pinna qabel nużaha? Mark: Le, din hija pinna mimlija lesta. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do I need to fill this pen before using it? Mark: No, this is a pre-filled pen. Read the instructions first.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我使用这支笔之前需要先填充吗？马克：不用，这是预填充笔。先读一下说明。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nimla din il-pinna qabel nużaha?
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nimla din il-pinna qabel nużaha?
messages.zh: 我使用这支笔之前需要先填充吗？
messages.en: Do I need to fill this pen before using it?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, din hija pinna mimlija lesta. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Le, din hija pinna mimlija lesta. Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 不用，这是预填充笔。先读一下说明。
messages.en: No, this is a pre-filled pen. Read the instructions first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语顺序记成“笔—已装满—已就绪”：pinna 是笔，mimlija 表示已填满，lesta 表示准备好了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wind-direction indicator shaped like a cock that turns with the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种呈公鸡形状、随风转动以显示风向的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat f'għamla ta' serduk li jdur mar-riħ biex juri d-direzzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公鸡形风向标，通过随风转动显示风向。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Indikatur tad-direzzjoni tar-riħ, magħmul f'għamla ta' serduk, li jdur skont ir-riħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A weather cock is a cock-shaped device that turns in the wind to indicate its direction.

collocations.en: a weather cock on the roof
collocations.zh: 屋顶上的公鸡形风向标

formal.mt: Il-pinnur fuq il-bejt idur mar-riħ u juri d-direzzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The weather cock on the roof turns with the wind and indicates its direction.
formal.zh: 屋顶上的公鸡形风向标随风转动，显示风向。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed idur dak is-serduk fuq il-bejt? Ġużeppi: Dak pinnur. Iġiegħlu jdur ir-riħ, u hekk jurina d-direzzjoni tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is that cock on the roof turning? Ġużeppi: That's a weather cock. The wind makes it turn, and that shows us the wind's direction.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：屋顶上那只公鸡为什么在转？朱塞佩：那是公鸡形风向标。风使它转动，这样就能向我们显示风向。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed idur dak is-serduk fuq il-bejt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed idur dak is-serduk fuq il-bejt?
messages.zh: 屋顶上那只公鸡为什么在转？
messages.en: Why is that cock on the roof turning?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pinnur. Iġiegħlu jdur ir-riħ, u hekk jurina d-direzzjoni tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pinnur. Iġiegħlu jdur ir-riħ, u hekk jurina d-direzzjoni tiegħu.
messages.zh: 那是公鸡形风向标。风使它转动，这样就能向我们显示风向。
messages.en: That's a weather cock. The wind makes it turn, and that shows us the wind's direction.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinnur 与“屋顶公鸡随风转”的画面绑定：看到公鸡形装置转动，就想到它在显示风向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pint is a unit used to measure the volume of liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品脱是一种用于计量液体体积的容量单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pinta hija unità ta' kejl għall-volum tal-likwidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 品脱，一种液体容量单位，也可指一品脱的量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pinta hija unità ta' kejl għall-volum tal-likwidi, jew kwantità ta' likwidu li timla dan il-kejl.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pint is a unit of liquid volume, or an amount of liquid measured in that unit.

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob pinta ħalib, li għandha titkejjel qabel tibda t-taħlita.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a pint of milk, which should be measured before preparing the mixture.
formal.zh: 食谱要求使用一品脱牛奶，应在准备混合物之前量好。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kemm ħalib għandna bżonn? Pawlu: Pinta ħalib tkun biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Marta: How much milk do we need? Pawlu: A pint of milk will be enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：我们需要多少牛奶？保罗：一品脱牛奶就够了。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm ħalib għandna bżonn?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm ħalib għandna bżonn?
messages.zh: 我们需要多少牛奶？
messages.en: How much milk do we need?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pinta ħalib tkun biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Pinta ħalib tkun biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 一品脱牛奶就够了。
messages.en: A pint of milk will be enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pinta 和“一品脱牛奶”的量杯画面一起记；看到 pinta ħalib，就想到量杯里的一品脱牛奶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tweezers are a small tool with two narrow arms used to grip and remove tiny objects or hairs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 镊子是一种有两个细长夹臂的小工具，用来夹取细小物体或拔除毛发。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pinzetta hija għodda żgħira b'żewġ dirgħajn irqaq li jintużaw biex jaqbdu oġġetti żgħar jew ineħħu x-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镊子，用两个细长夹臂夹取小物体或拔除毛发的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pinzetta hija għodda b'żewġ dirgħajn irqaq li tagħfashom flimkien biex taqbad xi ħaġa żgħira jew taqla' xagħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tweezers are a small tool whose two narrow arms close together to grip tiny objects or pull out hairs.

formal.mt: L-istudenta użat pinzetta biex taqbad iż-żerriegħa żgħira u tpoġġiha fil-kontenitur.
formal.en: The student used tweezers to pick up the small seed and place it in the container.
formal.zh: 这名学生用镊子夹起小种子，并把它放进容器里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tgħaddili l-pinzetta? Nina: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you pass me the tweezers? Nina: Yes, they're next to the mirror.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：能把镊子递给我吗？妮娜：可以，就在镜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (姐姐)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tgħaddili l-pinzetta?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tgħaddili l-pinzetta?
messages.zh: 能把镊子递给我吗？
messages.en: Can you pass me the tweezers?

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda ħdejn il-mera.
messages.zh: 可以，就在镜子旁边。
messages.en: Yes, they're next to the mirror.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象 pinzetta 的两个细尖夹臂夹起一根眉毛；马耳他语用一个名词，英语对应 tweezers。

gloss_zh: 尿液；尿尿（儿童用语或口语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pee is an informal or children's word for urine, the liquid waste passed out of the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指身体排出的尿液，是儿童用语或日常口语中对尿液的称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pipì hija l-awrina li toħroġ mill-ġisem; din il-kelma tintuża l-aktar mat-tfal jew f'taħdit informali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尿液，即身体经泌尿系统排出的液体废物；本词的语体较口语化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pipì hija l-awrina, jiġifieri l-likwidu ta' skart li jipproduċu l-kliewi u li joħroġ mill-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Urine is the liquid waste produced by the kidneys and passed out of the body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尿、尿尿，儿童用语或非正式口语中对尿液的称呼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pipì hija kelma informali għall-awrina, u tintuża ta' spiss mit-tfal jew meta wieħed jitkellem magħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pee is an informal word for urine, often used by children or when speaking to them.

formal.mt: Fil-ktieb għat-tfal, il-kelma 'pipì' tintuża biex tirreferi għall-awrina.
formal.en: In the children's book, the word 'pipì' is used to refer to urine.
formal.zh: 在这本儿童读物中，使用“pipì”这个词来指尿液。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għandi bżonn nagħmel pipì. Sara: Ejja, il-kamra tal-banju qiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Ben: I need to have a pee. Sara: Come on, the bathroom is here.
colloquial.zh: 本：我要尿尿。萨拉：来，卫生间在这里。

messages.speaker: Ben (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi bżonn nagħmel pipì.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi bżonn nagħmel pipì.
messages.zh: 我要尿尿。
messages.en: I need to have a pee.

messages.speaker: Sara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja, il-kamra tal-banju qiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja, il-kamra tal-banju qiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 来，卫生间在这里。
messages.en: Come on, the bathroom is here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pipì 放进孩子说“我要尿尿”的场景里记，并整句练习 nagħmel pipì；注意词尾 ì 的重音符号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period is the phase of a woman's menstrual cycle when blood and tissue from the lining of the uterus leave the body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 月经或经期，指女性月经周期中子宫内膜组织随血液排出体外的阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pirjid huwa ż-żmien fiċ-ċiklu mestrwali ta' mara meta demm u tessut mill-kisja tal-utru joħorġu mill-ġisem.

sense_translations.en_definition: period (phase of a woman's menstrual cycle)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 月经；女性月经周期中出现经血排出的阶段，即经期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pirjid huwa l-fażi taċ-ċiklu mestrwali ta' mara li fiha l-kisja tal-utru titneħħa u toħroġ mill-ġisem flimkien mad-demm.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A period is the part of a woman's menstrual cycle during which blood and tissue from the uterus pass out of the body.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega li l-pirjid huwa fażi taċ-ċiklu mestrwali.
formal.en: The leaflet explains that a period is a phase of the menstrual cycle.
formal.zh: 这份宣传册解释说，经期是月经周期中的一个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Illum għandi uġigħ tal-pirjid u nippreferi nibqa' d-dar. Anna: Sewwa, nistgħu niltaqgħu ġurnata oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: I have period pain today and would rather stay home. Anna: Okay, we can meet another day.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我今天经痛，想待在家里。安娜：好，我们可以改天见。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum għandi uġigħ tal-pirjid u nippreferi nibqa' d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Illum għandi uġigħ tal-pirjid u nippreferi nibqa' d-dar.
messages.zh: 我今天经痛，想待在家里。
messages.en: I have period pain today and would rather stay home.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nistgħu niltaqgħu ġurnata oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nistgħu niltaqgħu ġurnata oħra.
messages.zh: 好，我们可以改天见。
messages.en: Okay, we can meet another day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在月历上圈出经期，把 pirjid 与这个具体阶段联系起来；再用 waqt il-pirjid 记住“在经期”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A priest referred to as Pirjol in these teaching examples.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 神父，即主持宗教礼仪并为信众提供宗教指导的人；本条教学例句按所给词性将 Pirjol 作为专名使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qassis li jmexxi ċerimonji reliġjużi u jagħti gwida lill-fidili; f'dawn l-eżempji jissejjaħ Pirjol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 神父，主持宗教礼仪并给予信众宗教指导的人；本条词性标为专名。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qassis huwa persuna li tmexxi ċerimonji reliġjużi u tagħti gwida spiritwali lill-fidili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A priest is a religious minister who conducts services and provides spiritual guidance.

collocations.en: the advice of Pirjol, the priest

formal.mt: Wara l-quddiesa, Pirjol iltaqa' mal-familji biex joffrilhom gwida spiritwali.
formal.en: After Mass, Pirjol, the priest, met with the families to offer them spiritual guidance.
formal.zh: 弥撒结束后，Pirjol 神父与各个家庭会面，为他们提供灵性指导。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Taf fejn hu Pirjol? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fil-knisja. Trid tkellmu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you know where Pirjol, the priest, is? Pawlu: Yes, he is in the church. Do you want to speak to him?
colloquial.zh: Marija：你知道 Pirjol 神父在哪里吗？Pawlu：知道，他在教堂里。你想找他谈谈吗？

messages.speaker: Marija (教区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf fejn hu Pirjol?
messages.mt_standard: Taf fejn hu Pirjol?
messages.zh: 你知道 Pirjol 神父在哪里吗？
messages.en: Do you know where Pirjol, the priest, is?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教区居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fil-knisja. Trid tkellmu?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fil-knisja. Trid tkellmu?
messages.zh: 知道，他在教堂里。你想找他谈谈吗？
messages.en: Yes, he is in the church. Do you want to speak to him?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pirjol 放进“向神父请教”的教堂场景记忆；本条按专名练习，不由拼写推测词根或身分来历。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small firearm with a rotating cylinder that holds its cartridges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 左轮手枪，一种用旋转弹巢容纳枪弹的短枪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arma tan-nar qasira b'ċilindru li jdur u li jżomm l-iskrataċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 左轮手枪，具有旋转弹巢的短枪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pistola hija arma tan-nar qasira li żżomm l-iskrataċ f'ċilindru li jdur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A revolver is a small firearm whose cartridges are held in a rotating cylinder.

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi pistola antika f'vetrina magħluqa.
formal.en: The museum displays an antique revolver in a closed display case.
formal.zh: 博物馆在封闭的展柜中陈列着一把古董左轮手枪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik fil-vetrina? Mark: Dik pistola antika. Ara ċ-ċilindru tagħha.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that in the display case? Mark: That is an antique revolver. Look at its cylinder.
colloquial.zh: Lara：展柜里的那个是什么？Mark：那是一把古董左轮手枪。你看它的弹巢。

messages.speaker: Lara (博物馆访客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik fil-vetrina?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik fil-vetrina?
messages.zh: 展柜里的那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that in the display case?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik pistola antika. Ara ċ-ċilindru tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Dik pistola antika. Ara ċ-ċilindru tagħha.
messages.zh: 那是一把古董左轮手枪。你看它的弹巢。
messages.en: That is an antique revolver. Look at its cylinder.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pistola 与展柜中带旋转弹巢的短枪图像绑定；本条用“左轮手枪”的具体形状帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A book of pages used by a student for written exercises and schoolwork.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 练习本或作业本，学生用来完成书面练习及课堂作业的本子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb ta' paġni li student juża biex jikteb l-eżerċizzji u x-xogħol tal-iskola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 练习本，供学生书写练习、答案或学校作业的本子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pitazz huwa ktieb li fih student jikteb l-eżerċizzji, it-tweġibiet u xogħol ieħor tal-iskola.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An exercise book is a book in which students write their exercises and schoolwork.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jiktbu t-tweġibiet fil-pitazz u jindikaw in-numru ta' kull eżerċizzju.
formal.en: Students should write their answers in the exercise book and indicate the number of each exercise.
formal.zh: 学生应将答案写在练习本上，并标明每道练习的题号。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-pitazz tal-matematika tiegħi? Ben: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapes tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is my mathematics exercise book? Ben: On the table, beside your pencil.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我的数学练习本在哪里？Ben：在桌子上，就在你的铅笔旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-pitazz tal-matematika tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-pitazz tal-matematika tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的数学练习本在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my mathematics exercise book?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapes tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn il-lapes tiegħek.
messages.zh: 在桌子上，就在你的铅笔旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside your pencil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象打开 pitazz 写数学题：把“练习本、铅笔、作业”三个画面连起来，再用 fil-pitazz 练习“在本子上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird recognizable by its orange-red face and breast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 知更鸟，一种体形较小、面部和胸部呈橙红色的鸟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li jingħaraf minn wiċċu u sidru ta' lewn oranġjo fl-aħmar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 知更鸟，面部和胸部带有橙红色的小型鸟类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pitiross huwa għasfur żgħir b'wiċċ u sider ta' lewn oranġjo fl-aħmar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A robin is a small bird with a distinctive orange-red face and breast.

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni fil-ġnien, l-istudenti raw pitiross fuq fergħa u nnutaw il-kulur ta' sidru.
formal.en: During their observation in the garden, the students saw a robin on a branch and noted the colour of its breast.
formal.zh: 在花园观察时，学生们看见一只知更鸟停在树枝上，并记录了它胸部的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa! Toni: Dak pitiross. Qed tara sidru oranġjo fl-aħmar?
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that bird on the branch! Toni: That is a robin. Can you see its orange-red breast?
colloquial.zh: Maja：看树枝上的那只鸟！Toni：那是知更鸟。你看见它橙红色的胸部了吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak l-għasfur fuq il-fergħa!
messages.zh: 看树枝上的那只鸟！
messages.en: Look at that bird on the branch!

messages.speaker: Toni (观鸟朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pitiross. Qed tara sidru oranġjo fl-aħmar?
messages.mt_standard: Dak pitiross. Qed tara sidru oranġjo fl-aħmar?
messages.zh: 那是知更鸟。你看见它橙红色的胸部了吗？
messages.en: That is a robin. Can you see its orange-red breast?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pitiross 记成树枝上胸前带橙红色的小鸟；看图时同时说出“pitiross、知更鸟、robin”，建立三语对应。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where vegetables are sold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出售蔬菜的市场或场所。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn jinbiegħ il-ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出售蔬菜的市场或场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn in-nies ibigħu u jixtru l-ħaxix.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pitkalija is a place where vegetables are sold.

collocations.en: to go to the vegetable market
to buy vegetables from the vegetable market

formal.mt: Ir-ristorant jixtri l-ħaxix frisk mill-pitkalija kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The restaurant buys fresh vegetables from the vegetable market every morning.
formal.zh: 这家餐馆每天早上从蔬菜市场购买新鲜蔬菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur il-pitkalija dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri ftit ħaxix għall-ikla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to the vegetable market this morning? Mark: Yes, I need to buy some vegetables for the meal.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天早上要去蔬菜市场吗？Mark：是的，我需要买点菜做饭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur il-pitkalija dalgħodu?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur il-pitkalija dalgħodu?
messages.zh: 你今天早上要去蔬菜市场吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the vegetable market this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri ftit ħaxix għall-ikla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi bżonn nixtri ftit ħaxix għall-ikla.
messages.zh: 是的，我需要买点菜做饭。
messages.en: Yes, I need to buy some vegetables for the meal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pitkalija 放进“早上提篮去买菜”的画面中，整词对应蔬菜市场，并连记 mill-pitkalija“从蔬菜市场”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In two days' time, counting from today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以今天为起点，两天之后，也就是后天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jindika żmien jumejn wara llum, jiġifieri wara għada.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从今天算起的两天后，即后天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jindika li xi ħaġa se sseħħ jumejn wara llum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens pitpitgħada, it happens two days from today.

collocations.en: in the morning two days from now
to meet in two days' time

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa mal-ġenituri se ssir pitpitgħada fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The meeting with the parents will take place in two days' time at ten in the morning.
formal.zh: 与家长的会议将于后天上午十点举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Meta se niltaqgħu biex nistudjaw? Pawlu: Pitpitgħada filgħodu, jekk tista'.
colloquial.en: Lara: When shall we meet to study? Pawlu: The morning after tomorrow, if you can.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们什么时候碰面学习？Pawlu：后天早上吧，如果你有空的话。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se niltaqgħu biex nistudjaw?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se niltaqgħu biex nistudjaw?
messages.zh: 我们什么时候碰面学习？
messages.en: When shall we meet to study?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Pitpitgħada filgħodu, jekk tista'.
messages.mt_standard: Pitpitgħada filgħodu, jekk tista'.
messages.zh: 后天早上吧，如果你有空的话。
messages.en: The morning after tomorrow, if you can.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历上从今天向后移动两格，把 pitpitgħada 整词写在第二格，记住它表示后天；这是场景记忆，不是词源拆解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beet, a vegetable grown for its edible root, often dark red.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 甜菜，一种根部可食用、常呈深红色的蔬菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix b'għerq li jittiekel u li spiss ikun ta' kulur aħmar skur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 甜菜，尤其指作为蔬菜食用的甜菜根。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaxix li jitkabbar għall-għerq tiegħu, li jista' jittiekel nej jew imsajjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Beet is a vegetable with an edible root that is often dark red.

formal.mt: Għal din l-insalata, għalli l-pitravi, ħallihom jiksħu u qattagħhom f'biċċiet żgħar.
formal.en: For this salad, boil the beets, let them cool, and cut them into small pieces.
formal.zh: 制作这道沙拉时，先将甜菜煮熟，放凉后切成小块。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se nżidu mal-insalata? Toni: Għandna ftit pitravi mgħollija; nistgħu nużawhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: What shall we add to the salad? Toni: We have some boiled beets; we can use them.
colloquial.zh: Sara：沙拉里加点什么呢？Toni：我们有一些煮熟的甜菜，可以用上。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nżidu mal-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nżidu mal-insalata?
messages.zh: 沙拉里加点什么呢？
messages.en: What shall we add to the salad?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ftit pitravi mgħollija; nistgħu nużawhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ftit pitravi mgħollija; nistgħu nużawhom.
messages.zh: 我们有一些煮熟的甜菜，可以用上。
messages.en: We have some boiled beets; we can use them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象切甜菜后砧板染上深红色，把 pitravi 与这幅厨房画面绑定，再用 insalata tal-pitravi“甜菜沙拉”巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 极挑剔的人；完美主义者；令人厌烦的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who is very particular, demands perfection, or becomes tiresome through their behaviour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指非常挑剔、追求尽善尽美，或因行为令人厌烦的人，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tkun diffiċli biex togħġobha, li trid kollox perfett, jew li ddejjaq lil ħaddieħor bl-imġiba tagħha, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 极其挑剔、很难满意的人，尤其对细小之处也有许多要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna diffiċli ħafna biex togħġobha u li ssib x'tikkritika anki f'dettalji żgħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A finicky person is very difficult to please and objects to small details.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完美主义者，要求自己所做的事情或成果毫无瑕疵的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li trid li dak li tagħmel ikun perfett u ma tkunx sodisfatta jekk ikun fih xi difett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A perfectionist wants everything they do to be completely free from faults.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 令人厌烦的人，其言行使他人感到烦躁或疲惫。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li ddejjaq jew tgħejja lil ħaddieħor b'dak li tgħid jew tagħmel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tiresome person makes other people feel annoyed or weary through their behaviour.

collocations.en: a person who is very fussy about food
a tiresome person who is always complaining
collocations.zh: 总在抱怨、令人厌烦的人

formal.mt: Ir-reviżur huwa pittma fix-xogħol tiegħu: jerġa' jaqra kull paġna sakemm ikun ċert li ma fiha ebda żball.
formal.en: The reviewer is a perfectionist in his work: he rereads every page until he is certain that it contains no errors.
formal.zh: 这位审校者在工作中是个完美主义者：他会反复阅读每一页，直到确定没有任何错误。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek tirranġa dak ir-rapport? Int pittma fix-xogħol! Mark: Naf, imma rrid niċċekkja kull dettall qabel nibagħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still working on that report? You're such a perfectionist at work! Mark: I know, but I want to check every detail before I send it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你还在修改那份报告吗？你工作起来真是个完美主义者！Mark：我知道，不过我想把每个细节都检查一遍再发出去。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadek tirranġa dak ir-rapport? Int pittma fix-xogħol!
messages.mt_standard: Għadek tirranġa dak ir-rapport? Int pittma fix-xogħol!
messages.zh: 你还在修改那份报告吗？你工作起来真是个完美主义者！
messages.en: Are you still working on that report? You're such a perfectionist at work!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Naf, imma rrid niċċekkja kull dettall qabel nibagħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Naf, imma rrid niċċekkja kull dettall qabel nibagħtu.
messages.zh: 我知道，不过我想把每个细节都检查一遍再发出去。
messages.en: I know, but I want to check every detail before I send it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅人物画面记 pittma：点菜处处挑剔、改稿追求完美、反复抱怨惹人烦；这是三个语境义，使用时需分别判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure filled with water where people swim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人游泳的人工蓄水池。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post mibni apposta u mimli bl-ilma fejn in-nies jistgħu jgħumu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游泳池；专门建造并蓄水以供游泳的设施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post mibni apposta li jinżamm mimli bl-ilma biex in-nies jgħumu fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swimming pool is a structure filled with water that people use for swimming.

collocations.en: to swim in the swimming pool

formal.mt: Għal raġunijiet ta' sigurtà, it-tfal għandhom ikunu akkumpanjati minn adult meta jużaw il-pixxina.
formal.en: For safety reasons, children must be accompanied by an adult when using the swimming pool.
formal.zh: 出于安全考虑，儿童使用游泳池时必须有成人陪同。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tgħum fil-pixxina llum? Lara: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib il-malja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come swimming in the pool today? Lara: Yes, but first I need to find my swimsuit.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今天想一起来游泳池游泳吗？Lara：想，不过我得先找到泳衣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tgħum fil-pixxina llum?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tgħum fil-pixxina llum?
messages.zh: 今天想一起来游泳池游泳吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come swimming in the pool today?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib il-malja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel irrid insib il-malja.
messages.zh: 想，不过我得先找到泳衣。
messages.en: Yes, but first I need to find my swimsuit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pixxina 和泳衣、池水的画面一起记，再整句练习 tgħum fil-pixxina（在游泳池里游泳）。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large sea fish with a long, pointed upper jaw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种上颌细长、尖锐，形似剑的海鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħuta kbira tal-baħar li għandha x-xedaq ta' fuq twil u ppuntat bħal xabla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剑鱼；上颌向前延伸、形似长剑的大型海鱼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħuta kbira tal-baħar magħrufa għax-xedaq ta' fuq tagħha, li huwa twil u ppuntat bħal xabla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A swordfish is a large sea fish whose upper jaw extends into a long, pointed shape resembling a sword.

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi pixxispad mixwi servut bil-ħaxix u l-lumi.
formal.en: The menu includes grilled swordfish served with vegetables and lemon.
formal.zh: 菜单上有配蔬菜和柠檬的烤剑鱼。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek pixxispad frisk illum? Pawlu: Iva. Kemm trid? Mark: Żewġ porzjonijiet, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have fresh swordfish today? Pawlu: Yes. How much would you like? Mark: Two portions, please.
colloquial.zh: Mark：今天有新鲜剑鱼吗？Pawlu：有。你要多少？Mark：请给我两份。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek pixxispad frisk illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek pixxispad frisk illum?
messages.zh: 今天有新鲜剑鱼吗？
messages.en: Do you have fresh swordfish today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Kemm trid?
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Kemm trid?
messages.zh: 有。你要多少？
messages.en: Yes. How much would you like?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Żewġ porzjonijiet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Żewġ porzjonijiet, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请给我两份。
messages.en: Two portions, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pixxispad 就想象一条上颌像长剑的鱼，再用 pixxispad frisk（新鲜剑鱼）巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A restaurant that specializes in making and serving pizzas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门制作和供应比萨饼的餐馆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ristorant li jispeċjalizza fit-tħejjija u s-servizz tal-pizza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要制作和供应比萨饼的餐馆。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ristorant fejn il-pizza hija l-ikel ewlieni li jitħejja u jiġi servut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pizzeria is a restaurant that specializes in preparing and serving pizzas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供应比萨饼、供顾客用餐的比萨店。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn jinbiegħu l-pizez u fejn il-klijenti jistgħu joqogħdu jieklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pizza parlour is a place where people can buy and eat pizzas.

collocations.en: book a table at the pizzeria

formal.mt: Il-grupp ibbukkja mejda fil-pizzerija għal nhar il-Ġimgħa filgħaxija.
formal.en: The group booked a table at the pizzeria for Friday evening.
formal.zh: 这个团体在比萨店预订了星期五晚上的餐位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid immorru nieklu fil-pizzerija llejla? Mark: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go and eat at the pizzeria tonight? Mark: Yes, but let's book a table first.
colloquial.zh: Maja：今晚我们去比萨店吃饭好吗？Mark：好，不过我们先订个位吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid immorru nieklu fil-pizzerija llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid immorru nieklu fil-pizzerija llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们去比萨店吃饭好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go and eat at the pizzeria tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nibbukkjaw mejda qabel.
messages.zh: 好，不过我们先订个位吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's book a table first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pizzerija 与比萨店的菜单、餐桌和烤炉一起记；用整句“nieklu f'pizzerija（在比萨店吃饭）”巩固它表示场所。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clothes worn for sleeping, usually consisting of a top and trousers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 睡觉时穿的衣服，通常由上衣和裤子组成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes għall-irqad u li ġeneralment ikun magħmul minn flokk u qalziet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡衣，通常指由上衣和裤子组成的一套睡衣；此处英语采用美式拼写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies għall-irqad li ġeneralment jikkonsisti fi flokk u qalziet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pajamas are clothes that you wear in bed, usually consisting of a top and trousers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 睡衣，通常指由上衣和裤子组成的一套睡衣；此处英语采用英式拼写。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes fis-sodda għall-irqad, ġeneralment magħmul minn flokk u qalziet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pyjamas are a set of clothes worn for sleeping, typically comprising a top and trousers.

formal.mt: Għall-waqfa ta' billejl, kull student għandu jġib piġama nadifa u par papoċċi.
formal.en: For the overnight stay, each student should bring clean pajamas and a pair of slippers.
formal.zh: 参加过夜活动时，每名学生应携带干净的睡衣和一双拖鞋。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn hi l-piġama tiegħi? Omm: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbes il-piġama u ejja naqraw storja.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where are my pajamas? Mum: On the bed. Put your pajamas on and let's read a story.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我的睡衣在哪里？妈妈：在床上。穿上睡衣，我们一起读个故事吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-piġama tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-piġama tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的睡衣在哪里？
messages.en: Where are my pajamas?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbes il-piġama u ejja naqraw storja.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sodda. Ilbes il-piġama u ejja naqraw storja.
messages.zh: 在床上。穿上睡衣，我们一起读个故事吧。
messages.en: On the bed. Put your pajamas on and let's read a story.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 piġama 和睡前换衣服的画面绑定，连读 ilbes il-piġama“穿上睡衣”。英语 pajamas、pyjamas 在这两条释义中只是拼写不同，都对应同一种睡衣。

gloss_zh: 授权称重员；获授权的香蕉称重员

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person officially permitted to weigh goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获正式授权为货物称重的人员；在特定语境中指获授权的香蕉称重员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha permess uffiċjali biex tiżen merkanzija; f'kuntest speċifiku tista' tkun awtorizzata biex tiżen il-banana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 授权称重员；获正式许可执行货物称重工作的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-awtorizzazzjoni uffiċjali biex tiżen merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorised weigher is a person who has official permission to weigh goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 获授权的香蕉称重员；获正式许可对香蕉进行称重的人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-awtorizzazzjoni uffiċjali biex tiżen il-banana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An authorized banana weigher is a person who has official permission to weigh bananas.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li piżatur awtorizzat tal-banana kejjel il-piż tal-kunsinna u rreġistra r-riżultat.
formal.en: The report indicates that an authorized banana weigher measured the weight of the consignment and recorded the result.
formal.zh: 报告指出，一名获授权的香蕉称重员称量了该批货物，并记录了结果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jiżen il-kaxxi tal-banana? Ġużeppi: Piżatur awtorizzat. Se jiġi dalgħodu. Sara: Tajjeb, inħalli l-kaxxi hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is going to weigh the boxes of bananas? Ġużeppi: An authorised weigher. He is coming this morning. Sara: All right, I will leave the boxes here.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁来称这些装香蕉的箱子？Ġużeppi：一名授权称重员。他今天上午过来。Sara：好，那我把箱子放在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jiżen il-kaxxi tal-banana?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jiżen il-kaxxi tal-banana?
messages.zh: 谁来称这些装香蕉的箱子？
messages.en: Who is going to weigh the boxes of bananas?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Piżatur awtorizzat. Se jiġi dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Piżatur awtorizzat. Se jiġi dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 一名授权称重员。他今天上午过来。
messages.en: An authorised weigher. He is coming this morning.

messages.speaker: Sara (仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inħalli l-kaxxi hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inħalli l-kaxxi hawn.
messages.zh: 好，那我把箱子放在这里。
messages.en: All right, I will leave the boxes here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“拿着授权证明站在秤旁的人”；出现香蕉语境时，再对应到获授权的香蕉称重员。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, round, usually green seed eaten as a vegetable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 豌豆的一粒种子，通常呈绿色、圆形，可作蔬菜食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żerriegħa żgħira, tonda u ġeneralment ħadra li tikber f'miżwed u tittiekel bħala ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豌豆；豆荚内一粒通常为绿色、圆形的可食种子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żerriegħa żgħira u tonda, ġeneralment ħadra, li tikber f'miżwed u tintuża bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pea is a small, round seed that grows in a pod and is eaten as a vegetable.

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-osservazzjoni, kull student għandu jpinġi piżella u jiddeskrivi l-kulur u l-għamla tagħha.
formal.en: In the observation exercise, each student should draw a pea and describe its colour and shape.
formal.zh: 在观察练习中，每位学生应画一粒豌豆，并描述它的颜色和形状。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Waqgħet piżella taħt il-mejda. Omm: Tista' tiġborha, jekk jogħġbok? Lina: Iva, sibtha ħdejn is-siġġu.
colloquial.en: Lina: A pea fell under the table. Mum: Can you pick it up, please? Lina: Yes, I found it next to the chair.
colloquial.zh: Lina：一粒豌豆掉到桌子底下了。妈妈：请把它捡起来，好吗？Lina：好，我在椅子旁边找到它了。

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Waqgħet piżella taħt il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Waqgħet piżella taħt il-mejda.
messages.zh: 一粒豌豆掉到桌子底下了。
messages.en: A pea fell under the table.

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiġborha, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiġborha, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请把它捡起来，好吗？
messages.en: Can you pick it up, please?

messages.speaker: Lina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, sibtha ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, sibtha ħdejn is-siġġu.
messages.zh: 好，我在椅子旁边找到它了。
messages.en: Yes, I found it next to the chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象指尖捏着一粒圆圆的青豌豆，读出 piżella；再用 daqs piżella 记住“豌豆大小”的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A serious disease or widespread affliction that causes great suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成重大痛苦的严重疫病，或广泛肆虐的祸患。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda serja li tinfirex, jew ħażen mifrux li jġib tbatija kbira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 广泛传播、造成严重苦难的瘟疫；也可比喻肆虐成灾的祸患。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda li tinfirex fost ħafna nies u ġġib tbatija kbira; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal ħażen mifrux li jagħmel ħafna ħsara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plague is a disease that spreads widely and causes severe suffering, or a widespread problem that brings great harm.

formal.mt: L-awtur juża l-kelma 'pjaga' biex jenfasizza l-ħsara kbira li l-faqar jagħmel lis-soċjetà.
formal.en: The author uses the word 'plague' to emphasize the great harm that poverty does to society.
formal.zh: 作者使用“瘟疫”一词，比喻贫困给社会造成的巨大危害。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-artiklu jsejjaħ il-faqar pjaga? Toni: Għax jagħmel ħafna ħsara u jġib tbatija lil ħafna nies.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why does the article call poverty a plague? Toni: Because it causes great harm and brings suffering to many people.
colloquial.zh: Lara：文章为什么把贫困称作瘟疫？Toni：因为它危害很大，让许多人受苦。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-artiklu jsejjaħ il-faqar pjaga?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-artiklu jsejjaħ il-faqar pjaga?
messages.zh: 文章为什么把贫困称作瘟疫？
messages.en: Why does the article call poverty a plague?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jagħmel ħafna ħsara u jġib tbatija lil ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jagħmel ħafna ħsara u jġib tbatija lil ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 因为它危害很大，让许多人受苦。
messages.en: Because it causes great harm and brings suffering to many people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“蔓延、危害、苦难”三个画面记 pjaga；读到“il-pjaga tal-faqar”时，把贫困理解为肆虐社会的祸患。

gloss_zh: 可用性计划；可用时间或资源安排表

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plan showing when people, resources, or services are available for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 列明人员、资源或服务在何时可以使用或提供的计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan li juri meta persuni, riżorsi jew servizzi jkunu disponibbli għall-użu jew għax-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可用性计划；说明人员、资源或服务可用时段及相关安排的计划。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan li jistabbilixxi l-ħinijiet u l-arranġamenti li fihom persuni, riżorsi jew servizzi jkunu disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An availability plan sets out when people, resources, or services can be used or provided.

formal.mt: Il-pjan tad-disponibilità tal-persunal għandu jindika min jista' jaħdem kull filgħodu matul il-ġimgħa.
formal.en: The staff availability plan should indicate who can work each morning during the week.
formal.zh: 人员可用时间安排表应注明本周每天上午哪些人可以工作。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Aġġornajt il-pjan tad-disponibilità għal din il-ġimgħa? Sara: Iva, ktibt li nista' naħdem it-Tlieta u l-Ħamis.
colloquial.en: Mark: Have you updated the availability plan for this week? Sara: Yes, I wrote that I can work on Tuesday and Thursday.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你更新这周的可用时间安排表了吗？萨拉：更新了，我写了星期二和星期四可以工作。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Aġġornajt il-pjan tad-disponibilità għal din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Aġġornajt il-pjan tad-disponibilità għal din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你更新这周的可用时间安排表了吗？
messages.en: Have you updated the availability plan for this week?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ktibt li nista' naħdem it-Tlieta u l-Ħamis.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ktibt li nista' naħdem it-Tlieta u l-Ħamis.
messages.zh: 更新了，我写了星期二和星期四可以工作。
messages.en: Yes, I wrote that I can work on Tuesday and Thursday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成一张标有姓名和空闲时段的表格：看到 pjan tad-disponibilità，就想到“谁或什么在何时可用”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A living plant, a plan showing a layout, or a shrub, depending on the context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指有生命的植物、显示空间布局的平面图，或灌木，具体含义由上下文决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa ħajja li tikber fil-ħamrija, tpinġija li turi t-tqassim ta' post, jew arbuxxell, skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 植物，通常具有根、茎、叶等部分的生物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġa ħajja li ġeneralment għandha għeruq, zokk u weraq u tikber fil-ħamrija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plant is a living thing that usually has roots, a stem, and leaves.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平面图；以图示方式表示建筑物或其他场所的布局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tpinġija li turi t-tqassim ta' bini jew ta' post ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plan is a drawing that shows how a building or another space is arranged.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌木；通常比乔木矮，并从近地面处分出多条木质枝干的植物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-injam li ġeneralment tkun iżgħar minn siġra u jkollha diversi friegħi qrib l-art.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A shrub is a woody plant that usually has several branches growing near the ground.

collocations.en: the floor plan of the house

formal.mt: Il-pjanta tal-bini turi fejn jinsabu l-entratura, it-taraġ u l-kmamar.
formal.en: The building plan shows where the entrance, the stairs, and the rooms are located.
formal.zh: 建筑平面图标明了入口、楼梯和各房间的位置。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta? Lara: Poġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa, fejn hemm aktar dawl.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put this plant? Lara: Put it beside the window, where there is more light.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这盆植物放在哪里？拉拉：放在窗边吧，那里光线更充足。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi din il-pjanta?
messages.zh: 这盆植物放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put this plant?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa, fejn hemm aktar dawl.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha ħdejn it-tieqa, fejn hemm aktar dawl.
messages.zh: 放在窗边吧，那里光线更充足。
messages.en: Put it beside the window, where there is more light.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pjanta 配上三张学习图片：盆里的植物、房屋平面图、低矮灌木；读句子时先找花盆、房屋或枝叶等语境线索。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A police officer who carries out duties such as keeping order and helping the public.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 执行维持秩序、协助公众等职责的警员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal tal-pulizija li jwettaq dmirijiet bħaż-żamma tal-ordni u l-għajnuna lill-pubbliku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 警察；履行维持公共秩序和执行法律等职责的男性警员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Raġel li jaħdem fil-korp tal-pulizija u jwettaq dmirijiet bħaż-żamma tal-ordni pubbliku u l-infurzar tal-liġi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A policeman is a male police officer whose duties include maintaining public order and enforcing the law.

collocations.en: a policeman on guard at the door
to ask a policeman for help

formal.mt: Il-pjantun li kien għassa mal-entratura għen lill-viżitaturi jsibu l-uffiċċju t-tajjeb.
formal.en: The policeman on guard at the entrance helped visitors find the correct office.
formal.zh: 在入口站岗的警员帮助访客找到了相应的办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nafx minn fejn ngħaddu. Mark: Ejja nistaqsu lill-pjantun ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: I don't know which way we should go. Mark: Let's ask the policeman beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我不知道该往哪边走。马克：我们去问问门旁的警员吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx minn fejn ngħaddu.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx minn fejn ngħaddu.
messages.zh: 我不知道该往哪边走。
messages.en: I don't know which way we should go.

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nistaqsu lill-pjantun ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nistaqsu lill-pjantun ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 我们去问问门旁的警员吧。
messages.en: Let's ask the policeman beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“门口有警员，可以去问路”的画面记住 pjantun；反复朗读 lill-pjantun，并把它与向警员求助的动作联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A broad area of land, especially a flat plain, considered as part of the landscape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一片广阔的土地，尤指作为地貌景观组成部分的平坦原野。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda wiesgħa ta' art, speċjalment art ċatta, li tifforma parti mill-pajsaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地貌景观；从整体上观看的一片土地及其自然面貌。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda ta' art meqjusa fid-dehra ġenerali tagħha u fil-karatteristiċi naturali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A landscape is an area of land considered in terms of its overall appearance and natural features.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平原；地势平坦或起伏很小的广阔土地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda wiesgħa ta' art ċatta jew bi ftit li xejn għoljiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plain is a large area of land that is flat or has very few changes in height.

formal.mt: Il-pjanura fertili bejn ix-xmara u l-għoljiet tintuża għat-tkabbir tal-qamħ.
formal.en: The fertile plain between the river and the hills is used for growing wheat.
formal.zh: 河流与丘陵之间的肥沃平原用于种植小麦。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kemm hi wiesgħa din il-pjanura! Pawlu: Iva, minn hawn fuq nistgħu naraw l-għelieqi kollha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how broad this plain is! Pawlu: Yes, from up here we can see all the fields.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，这片平原多宽阔啊！保罗：是啊，从这上面能看到所有的田地。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hi wiesgħa din il-pjanura!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hi wiesgħa din il-pjanura!
messages.zh: 看，这片平原多宽阔啊！
messages.en: Look how broad this plain is!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hawn fuq nistgħu naraw l-għelieqi kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hawn fuq nistgħu naraw l-għelieqi kollha.
messages.zh: 是啊，从这上面能看到所有的田地。
messages.en: Yes, from up here we can see all the fields.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pjanura 放进一幅远眺图：前方是一大片平坦田野；关注地势时记“平原”，关注整片土地的面貌时联系“地貌景观”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat sheet of metal, or a flat plaque bearing an inscription.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 扁平的金属板，或带有铭文的铭牌、纪念牌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa metall ċatta, jew plakka ċatta bi kliem miktub jew imnaqqax fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于加工、制作或覆盖物体的金属薄板。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa metall ċatta u rqiqa li tista' tinqata', titgħawweġ jew tintuża biex tgħatti xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A metal sheet is a thin, flat piece of metal used for making or covering things.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有文字、通常固定在墙上或建筑物上的铭牌，常用于纪念人物或事件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Plakka ċatta bi kliem miktub jew imnaqqax fuqha, li normalment titwaħħal ma' ħajt jew bini biex tfakkar persuna jew ġrajja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plaque is a flat object bearing an inscription, often attached to a building to commemorate a person or event.

formal.mt: Fuq il-faċċata tal-bini twaħħlet pjanċa kommemorattiva bl-isem tal-fundatur.
formal.en: A commemorative plaque bearing the founder's name was attached to the front of the building.
formal.zh: 建筑物正面安装了一块刻有创办人姓名的纪念牌。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-pjanċa tal-metall hija kbira biżżejjed? Ġużeppi: Iva, nistgħu naqtgħuha biex nagħmlu l-għatu tal-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this sheet of metal big enough? Ġużeppi: Yes, we can cut it to make the lid for the box.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这块金属板够大吗？Ġużeppi：够，我们可以把它裁成箱盖。

messages.speaker: Nina (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-pjanċa tal-metall hija kbira biżżejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-pjanċa tal-metall hija kbira biżżejjed?
messages.zh: 这块金属板够大吗？
messages.en: Is this sheet of metal big enough?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (工匠)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nistgħu naqtgħuha biex nagħmlu l-għatu tal-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nistgħu naqtgħuha biex nagħmlu l-għatu tal-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 够，我们可以把它裁成箱盖。
messages.en: Yes, we can cut it to make the lid for the box.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pjanċa 记成两幅扁平物体的画面：工作台上的金属薄板，以及墙上刻字的纪念牌；再用后面的修饰语区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system through which available resources are assigned to users or purposes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于将可用资源分配给使用者或特定用途的系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema li permezz tagħha r-riżorsi disponibbli jitqassmu lil utenti jew għal skopijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于组织和执行资源分配的平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma li tintuża biex jiġi organizzat u jitwettaq it-tqassim tar-riżorsi disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allocation platform is a system used to assign available resources to particular users or purposes.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni tuża pjattaforma ta' allokazzjoni biex tqassam ir-riżorsi skont il-ħtiġijiet ta' kull dipartiment.
formal.en: The organisation uses an allocation platform to distribute resources according to each department's needs.
formal.zh: 该组织使用分配平台，根据各部门的需要分配资源。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn nista' nitlob ir-riżorsi għall-proġett? Mark: Uża l-pjattaforma ta' allokazzjoni; hemm tista' tibgħat it-talba tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where can I request resources for the project? Mark: Use the allocation platform; you can submit your request there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我可以在哪里申请项目所需的资源？Mark：用分配平台，你可以在那里提交申请。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nitlob ir-riżorsi għall-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nitlob ir-riżorsi għall-proġett?
messages.zh: 我可以在哪里申请项目所需的资源？
messages.en: Where can I request resources for the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża l-pjattaforma ta' allokazzjoni; hemm tista' tibgħat it-talba tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Uża l-pjattaforma ta' allokazzjoni; hemm tista' tibgħat it-talba tiegħek.
messages.zh: 用分配平台，你可以在那里提交申请。
messages.en: Use the allocation platform; you can submit your request there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成一个“分资源的服务窗口”：pjattaforma 对应平台，ta' allokazzjoni 说明平台的分配用途。

gloss_zh: 单一分配平台；统一分配平台

teaching_sense.en_definition: One platform through which all allocation within a specified scope is handled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在指定范围内统一办理所有分配事务的单一平台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjattaforma waħda li permezz tagħha jsir it-tqassim kollu tar-riżorsi f'qasam jew f'sistema partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某一范围内集中办理分配事务的单一平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma waħda li tiġbor fiha l-proċess tal-allokazzjoni f'qasam partikolari, minflok ma dan isir fuq diversi pjattaformi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single allocation platform brings allocation activities within a particular scope together on one platform.

collocations.mt: tgħaddi għal pjattaforma unika ta' allokazzjoni
collocations.en: switch to a single allocation platform

formal.mt: L-istituzzjoni se tintroduċi pjattaforma unika ta' allokazzjoni biex it-talbiet kollha għar-riżorsi jiġu pproċessati fl-istess sistema.
formal.en: The institution will introduce a single allocation platform so that all resource requests are processed in the same system.
formal.zh: 该机构将引入统一分配平台，使所有资源申请都在同一个系统中处理。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għad irrid nuża żewġ siti biex nitlob ir-riżorsi? Pawlu: Le, issa għandna pjattaforma unika ta' allokazzjoni. Tista' tagħmel kollox hemm.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do I still need to use two websites to request resources? Pawlu: No, we now have a single allocation platform. You can do everything there.
colloquial.zh: Sara：申请资源还需要用两个网站吗？Pawlu：不用，我们现在有统一分配平台了。你可以在那里办理所有事项。

messages.speaker: Sara (工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irrid nuża żewġ siti biex nitlob ir-riżorsi?
messages.mt_standard: Għad irrid nuża żewġ siti biex nitlob ir-riżorsi?
messages.zh: 申请资源还需要用两个网站吗？
messages.en: Do I still need to use two websites to request resources?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa għandna pjattaforma unika ta' allokazzjoni. Tista' tagħmel kollox hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa għandna pjattaforma unika ta' allokazzjoni. Tista' tagħmel kollox hemm.
messages.zh: 不用，我们现在有统一分配平台了。你可以在那里办理所有事项。
messages.en: No, we now have a single allocation platform. You can do everything there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象多个分配窗口合成一个：在“分配平台”短语中加入 unika，就突出“单一、统一”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An open public space in a town or village, usually surrounded by buildings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄中供公众使用的开阔场地，通常周围有建筑物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju miftuħ għall-pubbliku f'belt jew f'raħal, ġeneralment imdawwar bil-bini.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 城镇或村庄中的公共广场。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post miftuħ f'belt jew f'raħal fejn in-nies jistgħu jiltaqgħu u fejn jistgħu jsiru attivitajiet pubbliċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A square is an open public area in a town or village where people can gather.

formal.mt: Il-kunsill lokali se jorganizza attività kulturali fil-pjazza tar-raħal nhar il-Ħadd.
formal.en: The local council will organise a cultural event in the village square on Sunday.
formal.zh: 地方议会将于星期日在村庄广场举办文化活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla? Toni: Fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-funtana. Lara: Tajjeb, narak hemm fis-sebgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are we meeting tonight? Toni: In the square, beside the fountain. Lara: All right, see you there at seven.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今晚在哪里见面？Toni：在广场上，喷泉旁边。Lara：好，七点在那里见。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se niltaqgħu llejla?
messages.zh: 我们今晚在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where are we meeting tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-funtana.
messages.zh: 在广场上，喷泉旁边。
messages.en: In the square, beside the fountain.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, narak hemm fis-sebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, narak hemm fis-sebgħa.
messages.zh: 好，七点在那里见。
messages.en: All right, see you there at seven.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pjazza 和“广场喷泉旁等朋友”的画面绑定，再连着记 fil-pjazza，意思就是“在广场上”。

gloss_zh: 令人愉快的；舒适宜人的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Giving pleasure or making someone feel comfortable and happy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能带来乐趣，或使人感到舒适、愉快的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti gost jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu komdu u kuntent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人享受其中、感到有乐趣的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħti gost lil min jieħu sehem fih jew jesperjenzah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An enjoyable activity or experience gives you pleasure while you take part in it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人感到舒适、愉悦或印象良好的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu komdu jew kuntent, jew li jħalli impressjoni tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something pleasant makes you feel comfortable, happy, or pleased.

formal.mt: L-attività offriet esperjenza pjaċevoli lill-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: The activity offered an enjoyable experience to all the participants.
formal.zh: 这项活动为所有参与者带来了愉快的体验。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-mixja? Pawlu: Kienet pjaċevoli ħafna; ma kienx hemm ħafna nies u t-temp kien sabiħ.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the walk? Pawlu: It was very pleasant; there weren't many people and the weather was lovely.
colloquial.zh: Sara：散步感觉怎么样？Pawlu：非常惬意，人不多，天气也很好。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-mixja?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-mixja?
messages.zh: 散步感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How was the walk?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet pjaċevoli ħafna; ma kienx hemm ħafna nies u t-temp kien sabiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet pjaċevoli ħafna; ma kienx hemm ħafna nies u t-temp kien sabiħ.
messages.zh: 非常惬意，人不多，天气也很好。
messages.en: It was very pleasant; there weren't many people and the weather was lovely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象散步后微笑着说“pjaċevoli ħafna（非常愉快）”；把活动带来的乐趣和环境带来的舒适感一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fold made in fabric and held in place to give a garment shape or decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布料经过折叠并固定后形成的褶裥，用于塑造或装饰衣物。
