teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinja magħmula fid-drapp u miżmuma f'postha biex tagħti forma jew tiżjin lil ilbies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在衣物或布料上有意折出并固定的褶裥。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tinja fid-drapp li ssir apposta u tinżamm f'postha bil-ħjata jew bil-mogħdija biex tagħti forma jew tiżjin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pleat is a fold deliberately made in fabric and held in place to shape or decorate it.

collocations.en: make a pleat in the fabric
press a pleat with an iron

formal.mt: Biex tagħmel il-pjieg, itwi d-drapp mal-linja mmarkata u għaddih bil-ħadida qabel ma tħitu.
formal.en: To make the pleat, fold the fabric along the marked line and press it with an iron before sewing it.
formal.zh: 制作褶裥时，沿标记线折叠布料，并在缝合之前用熨斗熨压。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pjieg fil-falda ma baqax f'postu. Rita: Ġib il-ħadida u ngħadduh. Nina: Tajjeb, inġibha issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: This pleat in the skirt has lost its shape. Rita: Bring the iron and we'll press it. Nina: All right, I'll get it now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：裙子上的这个褶裥走形了。Rita：把熨斗拿来，我们把它熨好。Nina：好，我现在去拿。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pjieg fil-falda ma baqax f'postu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pjieg fil-falda ma baqax f'postu.
messages.zh: 裙子上的这个褶裥走形了。
messages.en: This pleat in the skirt has lost its shape.

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġib il-ħadida u ngħadduh.
messages.mt_standard: Ġib il-ħadida u ngħadduh.
messages.zh: 把熨斗拿来，我们把它熨好。
messages.en: Bring the iron and we'll press it.

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, inġibha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, inġibha issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在去拿。
messages.en: All right, I'll get it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象裙子上被熨斗压得整齐的一道褶裥，用“折好、压平、固定”的动作画面记住 pjieg。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plug is a device attached to an electrical cable that connects an appliance to a socket.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接在电线上、插入插座以接通电器电源的部件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa mwaħħla ma' kejbil tal-elettriku li tidħol f'sokit biex tqabbad apparat mal-provvista tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电线末端用来插入插座、连接电源的插头。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa fit-tarf ta' kejbil tal-elettriku li ddaħħal f'sokit biex apparat ikun jista' jirċievi l-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plug is the part at the end of an electrical cable that you insert into a socket to supply power.

collocations.en: remove the plug from the socket

formal.mt: Qabel tnaddaf l-apparat, neħħi l-plagg mis-sokit.
formal.en: Before cleaning the appliance, remove the plug from the socket.
formal.zh: 清洁电器之前，请把插头从插座中拔出。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex il-lampa ma tixgħelx? Pawlu: Il-plagg mhux fis-sokit; se ndaħħlu issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why won't the lamp turn on? Pawlu: The plug isn't in the socket; I'll plug it in now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：灯为什么不亮？Pawlu：插头没插在插座里；我现在把它插上。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex il-lampa ma tixgħelx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex il-lampa ma tixgħelx?
messages.zh: 灯为什么不亮？
messages.en: Why won't the lamp turn on?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-plagg mhux fis-sokit; se ndaħħlu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-plagg mhux fis-sokit; se ndaħħlu issa.
messages.zh: 插头没插在插座里；我现在把它插上。
messages.en: The plug isn't in the socket; I'll plug it in now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plagg 和“插头插入插座”的动作一起记；搭配 l-plagg 与 is-sokit，分别对应插头和插座。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A beach or stretch of land beside the sea where people may walk, relax, or swim.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 海边供人散步、休息或下海游泳的海滨或海滩地带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art ħdejn il-baħar fejn in-nies jistgħu jimxu, jistrieħu jew jidħlu jgħumu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海滨，即紧邻海洋的沿岸地带，常作为散步或休闲的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ħdejn il-baħar fejn in-nies jistgħu jmorru biex jimxu, jistrieħu jew igawdu l-baħar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The seaside is an area beside the sea where people often go to relax or enjoy the coast.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海滩，指沿着海水边缘延伸的一片岸地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Medda art max-xatt tal-baħar li tista' tkun miksija bir-ramel jew biċ-ċagħaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A strand is a stretch of shore along the edge of the sea, often covered with sand or pebbles.

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jżommu l-plajja nadifa.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to keep the beach clean.
formal.zh: 请游客保持海滩清洁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid immorru l-plajja wara nofsinhar? Mark: Iva, nieħdu xugaman u mmorru ngħumu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go to the beach this afternoon? Mark: Yes, let's take a towel and go swimming.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天下午想去海滩吗？Mark：好，我们带条毛巾去游泳吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid immorru l-plajja wara nofsinhar?
messages.mt_standard: Trid immorru l-plajja wara nofsinhar?
messages.zh: 今天下午想去海滩吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go to the beach this afternoon?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nieħdu xugaman u mmorru ngħumu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nieħdu xugaman u mmorru ngħumu.
messages.zh: 好，我们带条毛巾去游泳吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's take a towel and go swimming.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plajja 放进“沙滩、毛巾、游泳”的画面里记；看到 plajja ramlija，就联想到脚下有沙的海滩。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large raised platform on which a musical band performs, especially during a feast.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供乐队演奏的大型高台，尤其用于节庆活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjattaforma kbira u għolja li fuqha ddoqq banda, speċjalment waqt festa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 乐队演奏台，供乐队登台进行音乐表演的平台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma li fuqha joqogħdu l-mużiċisti ta' banda biex idoqqu quddiem in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bandstand is a raised platform where a musical band performs for an audience.

sense_translations.en_definition: a big stand used for a musical band in feasts
sense_translations.zh_definition: 节庆活动中供乐队演奏使用的大型高台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjattaforma kbira li tintrama għall-banda biex tkun tista' ddoqq waqt il-festi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: At a feast, this is the large raised stand on which the band gathers to perform.

formal.mt: Il-banda se ddoqq fuq il-planċier waqt il-festa.
formal.en: The band will perform on the bandstand during the feast.
formal.zh: 乐队将在节庆期间登上乐台演奏。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn se ddoqq il-banda llejla? Ġanni: Fuq il-planċier fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where will the band play tonight? Ġanni: On the bandstand in the square, beside the church.
colloquial.zh: Anna：乐队今晚在哪里演奏？Ġanni：在广场的乐台上，就在教堂旁边。

messages.speaker: Anna (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se ddoqq il-banda llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se ddoqq il-banda llejla?
messages.zh: 乐队今晚在哪里演奏？
messages.en: Where will the band play tonight?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq il-planċier fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq il-planċier fil-pjazza, ħdejn il-knisja.
messages.zh: 在广场的乐台上，就在教堂旁边。
messages.en: On the bandstand in the square, beside the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 planċier 记成节庆广场上供乐队演奏的高台；联记 banda 是乐队，planċier 是乐队站着演奏的地方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A material that can be shaped into many forms and is used to make objects such as bottles, bags, and containers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够加工成多种形状、常用于制造瓶子、袋子和容器等物品的材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal li jista' jingħata diversi forom u li jintuża biex isiru oġġetti bħal fliexken, boroż u kontenituri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 塑料，一类可加工成型、用于制造各种日常用品的材料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal li jista' jiġi ffurmat f'ħafna għamliet u jintuża fil-manifattura ta' bosta oġġetti ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Plastic is a material that can be shaped into many different objects, including bottles, bags, and household containers.

formal.mt: Il-kontenituri huma magħmula mill-plastik u għandhom għatu li jingħalaq sew.
formal.en: The containers are made of plastic and have a lid that closes securely.
formal.zh: 这些容器由塑料制成，并配有能够盖紧的盖子。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dan il-flixkun tal-ħġieġ jew tal-plastik? Toni: Tal-plastik. Huwa ħafif u faċli biex iġġorru.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this bottle made of glass or plastic? Toni: Plastic. It's light and easy to carry.
colloquial.zh: Rita：这个瓶子是玻璃的还是塑料的？Toni：塑料的。它很轻，拿着也方便。

messages.speaker: Rita (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flixkun tal-ħġieġ jew tal-plastik?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flixkun tal-ħġieġ jew tal-plastik?
messages.zh: 这个瓶子是玻璃的还是塑料的？
messages.en: Is this bottle made of glass or plastic?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tal-plastik. Huwa ħafif u faċli biex iġġorru.
messages.mt_standard: Tal-plastik. Huwa ħafif u faċli biex iġġorru.
messages.zh: 塑料的。它很轻，拿着也方便。
messages.en: Plastic. It's light and easy to carry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plastik 与英语 plastic 对照记忆，再联记 flixkun tal-plastik：整个短语表示塑料瓶，plastik 本身表示材料。

gloss_zh: 塑料制的；可弯曲塑形的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Made of plastic, or capable of being bent or shaped.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指物品由塑料制成，或指材料具有可弯曲、可塑形的性质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magħmul mill-plastik, jew li jista' jitgħawweġ jew jingħata forma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由塑料制成的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li huwa magħmul mill-plastik bħala l-materjal tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An object that is plastiku is made from plastic.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有柔韧性、能够弯曲或塑形的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jista' jitgħawweġ jew jibdel il-forma tiegħu mingħajr ma jinkiser faċilment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A material that is plastiku can bend or change shape without easily breaking.

formal.mt: Il-kontenitur plastiku għandu jingħalaq sew qabel ma jiġi ttrasportat.
formal.en: The plastic container must be closed securely before it is transported.
formal.zh: 塑料容器在运输前必须盖紧。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan it-tafal hu plastiku biżżejjed biex nagħmel figura żgħira? Toni: Iva, tista' tagħtih forma faċilment b'idejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this clay pliable enough to make a small figure? Toni: Yes, you can easily shape it with your hands.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这块黏土够柔软可塑，能做个小人偶吗？托尼：可以，你用手就能轻松塑形。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-tafal hu plastiku biżżejjed biex nagħmel figura żgħira?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-tafal hu plastiku biżżejjed biex nagħmel figura żgħira?
messages.zh: 这块黏土够柔软可塑，能做个小人偶吗？
messages.en: Is this clay pliable enough to make a small figure?

messages.speaker: Toni (美术老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' tagħtih forma faċilment b'idejk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' tagħtih forma faċilment b'idejk.
messages.zh: 可以，你用手就能轻松塑形。
messages.en: Yes, you can easily shape it with your hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把塑料容器与可塑黏土并排想象：前者提示材料，后者提示可弯曲塑形，帮助区分两个义项。

gloss_zh: 柏拉图式的；指不含性关系的精神恋爱或情感关系

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an affectionate relationship that does not involve sexual activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容以情感或精神联系为主、不涉及性行为的关系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi relazzjoni ta' affezzjoni jew rabta emozzjonali mingħajr relazzjoni sesswali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柏拉图式的，指有情感联系但不涉及性关系的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinvolvi affezzjoni jew qrubija emozzjonali bejn persuni mingħajr rabta sesswali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A platonic relationship involves affection or emotional closeness without a sexual relationship.

collocations.zh: 柏拉图式的爱情；精神之爱

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, ir-rapport bejn iż-żewġ protagonisti jibqa' platoniku minkejja l-affezzjoni profonda tagħhom.
formal.en: In the novel, the relationship between the two protagonists remains platonic despite their deep affection.
formal.zh: 小说中，两位主人公虽然感情深厚，彼此的关系仍停留在柏拉图式的情感联系上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int u Daniel qegħdin flimkien? Sara: Le, ir-rapport tagħna hu platoniku; aħna qrib ħafna, imma m'hemmx relazzjoni sesswali bejnietna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you and Daniel together? Sara: No, our relationship is platonic; we are very close, but there is no sexual relationship between us.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你和丹尼尔在一起了吗？萨拉：没有，我们是柏拉图式的关系；我们很亲近，但没有性关系。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int u Daniel qegħdin flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Int u Daniel qegħdin flimkien?
messages.zh: 你和丹尼尔在一起了吗？
messages.en: Are you and Daniel together?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ir-rapport tagħna hu platoniku; aħna qrib ħafna, imma m'hemmx relazzjoni sesswali bejnietna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ir-rapport tagħna hu platoniku; aħna qrib ħafna, imma m'hemmx relazzjoni sesswali bejnietna.
messages.zh: 没有，我们是柏拉图式的关系；我们很亲近，但没有性关系。
messages.en: No, our relationship is platonic; we are very close, but there is no sexual relationship between us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人深入谈心、感情亲近，却没有性关系，用这个场景记住 platoniku 的关系含义。

gloss_zh: 长毛绒；表面有柔软绒毛的织物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft fabric with a dense raised pile on its surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种表面覆有浓密柔软绒毛的织物，可用来制作玩具或覆盖物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp artab b'pil dens fuq il-wiċċ tiegħu, li jintuża biex isiru ġugarelli jew biex jinksew oġġetti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 长毛绒，一种表面有浓密柔软绒毛的织物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' drapp li għandu wiċċ miksi b'pil dens u artab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Plush is a fabric with a thick, soft pile that gives its surface a furry feel.

formal.mt: Il-ġugarell huwa magħmul mill-plaxx u għandu jinħasel skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: The toy is made of plush and should be washed according to the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 这个玩具由长毛绒制成，应按照标签上的说明清洗。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn hu l-ors tal-plaxx tiegħi? Marija: Fuq is-sodda, ħdejn l-imħadda; għadni kif poġġejtu hemm.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where is my plush teddy bear? Marija: On the bed, beside the pillow; I have just put it there.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我的毛绒玩具熊在哪里？玛丽亚：在床上，枕头旁边；我刚把它放在那里。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ors tal-plaxx tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ors tal-plaxx tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我的毛绒玩具熊在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my plush teddy bear?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-sodda, ħdejn l-imħadda; għadni kif poġġejtu hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-sodda, ħdejn l-imħadda; għadni kif poġġejtu hemm.
messages.zh: 在床上，枕头旁边；我刚把它放在那里。
messages.en: On the bed, beside the pillow; I have just put it there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手掌摸过毛绒熊柔软浓密的绒毛，把触感与 plaxx 联系起来，再整组记住 ors tal-plaxx。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who takes part in a game or sport, especially as a member of a team.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参加游戏或体育比赛的人，尤指队中的选手或球员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu sehem f'logħba jew fi sport, speċjalment bħala membru ta' tim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 参加游戏或体育比赛的人；选手或球员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tipparteċipa f'logħba jew f'attività sportiva, waħedha jew bħala parti minn tim.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, either individually or as a member of a team.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 踢足球的人，尤指足球队的球员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tilgħab il-futbol, speċjalment bħala membru ta' tim tal-futbol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A footballer is a person who plays football, especially as a member of an organized team.

formal.mt: Kull plejer għandu jasal għat-taħriġ fil-ħin u jirrispetta r-regoli tat-tim.
formal.en: Every player must arrive for training on time and respect the team's rules.
formal.zh: 每名球员都必须准时到场训练，并遵守球队的规定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ? Mark: Dak ħija. Illum se jilgħab għall-ewwel darba mat-tim.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is that player next to the coach? Mark: That's my brother. Today he'll play for the team for the first time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：教练旁边那个球员是谁？马克：那是我兄弟。他今天将第一次代表这支球队上场。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-plejer ħdejn il-kowċ?
messages.zh: 教练旁边那个球员是谁？
messages.en: Who is that player next to the coach?

messages.speaker: Mark (球员的兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ħija. Illum se jilgħab għall-ewwel darba mat-tim.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ħija. Illum se jilgħab għall-ewwel darba mat-tim.
messages.zh: 那是我兄弟。他今天将第一次代表这支球队上场。
messages.en: That's my brother. Today he'll play for the team for the first time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 plejer 放进球队合照来记：指着其中一人说“球员”，再用 plejer tal-futbol 明确表示“足球运动员”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Security given to ensure that an obligation is fulfilled, including security associated with bail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为确保履行义务而提供的担保或质押物，也指与保释有关的担保。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Garanzija mogħtija biex jiġi żgurat li jitwettaq obbligu, inkluża garanzija marbuta mal-ħelsien mill-arrest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为保证偿还债务或履行义务而交付的担保或质押物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Garanzija jew oġġett mogħti bħala sigurtà biex jiġi żgurat il-ħlas ta' dejn jew it-twettiq ta' obbligu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pledge is something given as security to ensure that a debt is paid or an obligation is fulfilled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 保释担保，即为获准暂时离开羁押而提供、用以保证遵守相关条件的担保。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Garanzija marbuta mal-ħelsien mill-arrest, biex jiġi żgurat li l-persuna tħares il-kundizzjonijiet imposti mill-qorti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bail is security associated with a person's release from custody, intended to ensure compliance with the court's conditions.

collocations.en: to give an item as a pledge

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jispeċifika li l-arloġġ jingħata bħala pleġġ biex jiggarantixxi l-ħlas tad-dejn.
formal.en: The agreement specifies that the watch is given as a pledge to secure repayment of the debt.
formal.zh: 协议规定，将该手表作为质押物，以担保债务的偿还。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-qorti tatu l-ħelsien mill-arrest bi pleġġ? Rita: Iva, imma jrid iħares il-kundizzjonijiet kollha li imponiet il-qorti.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the court grant him release on bail? Rita: Yes, but he must comply with all the conditions imposed by the court.
colloquial.zh: 马克：法院准许他保释了吗？丽塔：准许了，但他必须遵守法院规定的所有条件。

messages.speaker: Mark (家属)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-qorti tatu l-ħelsien mill-arrest bi pleġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Il-qorti tatu l-ħelsien mill-arrest bi pleġġ?
messages.zh: 法院准许他保释了吗？
messages.en: Did the court grant him release on bail?

messages.speaker: Rita (律师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma jrid iħares il-kundizzjonijiet kollha li imponiet il-qorti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma jrid iħares il-kundizzjonijiet kollha li imponiet il-qorti.
messages.zh: 准许了，但他必须遵守法院规定的所有条件。
messages.en: Yes, but he must comply with all the conditions imposed by the court.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记忆担保概念：借款时交出手表作质押，获准保释时承担担保与条件；分别搭配 bħala pleġġ 和 bi pleġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of land considered as a separate unit, often intended for building or another particular use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作为独立单位划分的一块土地，常用于建筑或其他特定用途。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art meqjusa bħala unità separata, spiss maħsuba għall-bini jew għal użu partikolari ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 划分出来的一块土地，通常有明确边界，并可供建筑等特定用途。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Biċċa art b'konfini definiti li tista' tintuża għall-bini jew għal skop ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A plot is a piece of land with defined boundaries that is treated as a separate unit for a particular use.

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi l-konfini tal-plott u l-aċċess tiegħu mit-triq prinċipali.
formal.en: The plan shows the boundaries of the plot and its access from the main road.
formal.zh: 平面图标明了该地块的边界，以及从主路进入该地块的通道。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt il-plott li hemm għall-bejgħ ħdejn id-dar tagħna? Pawlu: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx kemm jiswa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Have you seen the plot for sale next to our house? Pawlu: Yes, but I still don't know how much it costs.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到我们家旁边那块待售的土地了吗？保罗：看到了，不过我还不知道它卖多少钱。

messages.speaker: Sara (妻子)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-plott li hemm għall-bejgħ ħdejn id-dar tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-plott li hemm għall-bejgħ ħdejn id-dar tagħna?
messages.zh: 你看到我们家旁边那块待售的土地了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen the plot for sale next to our house?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx kemm jiswa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma għadni ma nafx kemm jiswa.
messages.zh: 看到了，不过我还不知道它卖多少钱。
messages.en: Yes, but I still don't know how much it costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上用线框出的一块土地，框内写着 plott；把“独立地块”的画面与这个词一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The principle or practice of allowing different beliefs, groups, or ways of life to coexist within a society.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容许不同信仰、群体或生活方式在同一社会中共同存在的原则或实践。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prinċipju jew prattika li tippermetti lil twemmin, gruppi jew modi ta' ħajja differenti jeżistu flimkien fl-istess soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承认并容许不同观点、信仰或社会群体共同存在的原则或社会实践。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prinċipju jew prattika li tagħraf u taċċetta l-eżistenza flimkien ta' fehmiet, twemmin jew gruppi soċjali differenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pluralism is the principle or practice of accepting that different beliefs, opinions, and social groups can coexist within the same society.

formal.mt: Il-pluraliżmu jippermetti li gruppi b'fehmiet differenti jieħdu sehem fid-diskussjoni pubblika.
formal.en: Pluralism allows groups with different views to take part in public discussion.
formal.zh: 多元主义容许持有不同观点的群体参与公共讨论。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex stidintu nies b'opinjonijiet daqshekk differenti? David: Għax nemmnu fil-pluraliżmu. Irridu nisimgħu aktar minn perspettiva waħda.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you invite people with such different opinions? David: Because we believe in pluralism. We want to hear more than one perspective.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你们为什么邀请观点差异这么大的人？戴维：因为我们认同多元主义。我们想听到不止一种视角。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动参加者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex stidintu nies b'opinjonijiet daqshekk differenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex stidintu nies b'opinjonijiet daqshekk differenti?
messages.zh: 你们为什么邀请观点差异这么大的人？
messages.en: Why did you invite people with such different opinions?

messages.speaker: David (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax nemmnu fil-pluraliżmu. Irridu nisimgħu aktar minn perspettiva waħda.
messages.mt_standard: Għax nemmnu fil-pluraliżmu. Irridu nisimgħu aktar minn perspettiva waħda.
messages.zh: 因为我们认同多元主义。我们想听到不止一种视角。
messages.en: Because we believe in pluralism. We want to hear more than one perspective.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pluraliżmu 想成一张圆桌：不同观点的人都有座位，也都有发言机会，用这个画面记住“多元共存”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An illness in which lung tissue becomes inflamed, usually because of an infection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 肺部组织发生炎症的疾病，通常由感染引起。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marda li fiha t-tessut tal-pulmuni jinfjamma, ġeneralment minħabba infezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常由感染引起的肺部炎症性疾病，可累及一侧或两侧肺。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Marda, ġeneralment ikkawżata minn infezzjoni, li tinvolvi infjammazzjoni f'pulmun wieħed jew fit-tnejn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pneumonia is an illness, usually caused by an infection, in which tissue in one or both lungs becomes inflamed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport mediku jindika li l-pazjent qed jirkupra mill-pnewmonja u għandu appuntament ieħor il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
formal.en: The medical report indicates that the patient is recovering from pneumonia and has another appointment next week.
formal.zh: 医疗报告显示，该患者正在从肺炎中康复，并已安排下周再次就诊。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif inhu missierek illum? Ġużeppi: Aħjar, grazzi. Qed jirkupra mill-pnewmonja, imma għadu jgħejja malajr.
colloquial.en: Nina: How is your father today? Ġużeppi: Better, thanks. He's recovering from pneumonia, but he still gets tired quickly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你父亲今天怎么样？朱塞佩：好些了，谢谢。他正在从肺炎中康复，不过还是很容易累。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu missierek illum?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu missierek illum?
messages.zh: 你父亲今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is your father today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (患者的儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar, grazzi. Qed jirkupra mill-pnewmonja, imma għadu jgħejja malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar, grazzi. Qed jirkupra mill-pnewmonja, imma għadu jgħejja malajr.
messages.zh: 好些了，谢谢。他正在从肺炎中康复，不过还是很容易累。
messages.en: Better, thanks. He's recovering from pneumonia, but he still gets tired quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡片上画一对肺，并把 pnewmonja 与“肺炎”并排写下；再用“从肺炎中康复”的短语巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun written as Pnnghap whose specific meaning is not established here.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 写作 Pnnghap 的名词，其具体所指尚不明确。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom miktub Pnnghap li t-tifsira speċifika tiegħu mhijiex ċara hawn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: Pnnghap，具体所指尚不明确的名词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Nom bil-forma Pnnghap li t-tifsira preċiża tiegħu għadha mhijiex ċara hawn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pnnghap is a noun whose specific referent cannot be identified here.

formal.mt: Qabel tuża l-kelma Pnnghap f'test, ivverifika t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: Before using the word Pnnghap in a text, verify its meaning.
formal.zh: 在文章中使用 Pnnghap 这个词之前，请核实其含义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser Pnnghap? Mark: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does Pnnghap mean? Mark: I don't know; let's check its meaning before using it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pnnghap 是什么意思？Mark：我不知道；我们先查清含义再用吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser Pnnghap?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser Pnnghap?
messages.zh: Pnnghap 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does Pnnghap mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; ejja niċċekkjaw it-tifsira qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 我不知道；我们先查清含义再用吧。
messages.en: I don't know; let's check its meaning before using it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Pnnghap 记为一张待核义词卡：先认准字母顺序，再确认所指，不凭外形猜词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long poem that develops its subject over many lines.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 篇幅较长、用许多诗行展开内容的诗作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Poeżija twila li tiżviluppa s-suġġett tagħha fuq ħafna versi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 篇幅较长的诗，通常以较多诗行展开主题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Poeżija ta' tul konsiderevoli li fiha s-suġġett jiġi żviluppat fuq ħafna versi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A poema is a long poem in which a subject is developed over many lines.

formal.mt: F'din il-poema, l-awtriċi tiżviluppa t-tema tal-memorja permezz ta' sensiela ta' xeni mill-ħajja tal-familja.
formal.en: In this long poem, the author develops the theme of memory through a series of scenes from family life.
formal.zh: 在这首长诗中，作者通过一系列家庭生活场景展开记忆这一主题。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed taqra? Mark: Poema dwar il-baħar. Maja: Se tispiċċaha llum? Mark: Le, se naqra ftit minnha kuljum.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you reading? Mark: A long poem about the sea. Maja: Will you finish it today? Mark: No, I'll read a little of it each day.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你在读什么？Mark：一首关于大海的长诗。Maja：你今天会读完吗？Mark：不会，我打算每天读一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qed taqra?
messages.mt_standard: X'qed taqra?
messages.zh: 你在读什么？
messages.en: What are you reading?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Poema dwar il-baħar.
messages.mt_standard: Poema dwar il-baħar.
messages.zh: 一首关于大海的长诗。
messages.en: A long poem about the sea.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tispiċċaha llum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tispiċċaha llum?
messages.zh: 你今天会读完吗？
messages.en: Will you finish it today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se naqra ftit minnha kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se naqra ftit minnha kuljum.
messages.zh: 不会，我打算每天读一点。
messages.en: No, I'll read a little of it each day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 poema，可借英语 poem 联想诗歌，再想象每天读几页的长篇诗作，记牢本词义为长诗。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small case or pouch used to hold pencils, pens, and other small writing supplies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于收纳铅笔、钢笔及其他小型书写用品的盒子或袋子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kaxxa żgħira jew borża li tintuża biex jinżammu lapsijiet, pinen u oġġetti żgħar oħra għall-kitba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装铅笔、笔和其他小型文具的文具盒或笔袋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kontenitur żgħir għall-lapsijiet, il-pinen u affarijiet oħra tal-kitba, li jista' jkun kaxxa jew borża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pokit is a small case in which you keep pencils, pens, and other writing supplies.

collocations.en: a pencil case full of pens

formal.mt: Qabel tibda l-lezzjoni, poġġi l-pokit fuq il-mejda u oħroġ lapes u gomma.
formal.en: Before the lesson begins, put your pencil case on the desk and take out a pencil and an eraser.
formal.zh: 上课前，把文具盒放在桌上，并拿出一支铅笔和一块橡皮。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek lapes żejjed? Mark: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-pokit tiegħi. Maja: Nista' nieħdu? Mark: Żgur, ħudu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a spare pencil? Mark: Yes, there's one in my pencil case. Maja: Can I take it? Mark: Sure, take it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有多余的铅笔吗？Mark：有，我的文具盒里有一支。Maja：我可以拿来用吗？Mark：当然，拿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek lapes żejjed?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek lapes żejjed?
messages.zh: 你有多余的铅笔吗？
messages.en: Do you have a spare pencil?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-pokit tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm wieħed fil-pokit tiegħi.
messages.zh: 有，我的文具盒里有一支。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in my pencil case.

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħdu?
messages.zh: 我可以拿来用吗？
messages.en: Can I take it?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħudu.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħudu.
messages.zh: 当然，拿吧。
messages.en: Sure, take it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pokit 和课桌上的文具盒绑定记忆：打开它，拿出铅笔和橡皮，再用 fil-pokit 练习表达在文具盒里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A polar bear is a large bear with white fur that lives in Arctic regions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 北极熊，生活在北极地区、具有白色皮毛的大型熊类。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ors polari huwa ors kbir b'pil abjad li jgħix fir-reġjuni tal-Artiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 北极熊，生活在北极地区的白色大型熊类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ors polari huwa annimal kbir tal-familja tal-orsijiet, b'pil abjad, li jgħix fl-Artiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A polar bear is a large white bear that lives in the Arctic.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-ħabitat tal-ors polari u l-ħtieġa li dan jiġi protett.
formal.en: The report describes the polar bear's habitat and the need to protect it.
formal.zh: 报告描述了北极熊的栖息地及保护这一栖息地的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'annimal hemm f'dan ir-ritratt? Mark: Huwa ors polari. Ara kemm hu kbir!
colloquial.en: Maja: What animal is in this photo? Mark: It's a polar bear. Look how big it is!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张照片里是什么动物？Mark：是北极熊。你看它多大！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'annimal hemm f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'annimal hemm f'dan ir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 这张照片里是什么动物？
messages.en: What animal is in this photo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa ors polari. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.mt_standard: Huwa ors polari. Ara kemm hu kbir!
messages.zh: 是北极熊。你看它多大！
messages.en: It's a polar bear. Look how big it is!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词条 Polarbear 与冰雪中的白熊图像配对，再记马耳他语表达 ors polari，形成图像、中文和马耳他语的联系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A commercial or trade policy is a set of principles and measures governing business activity or trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指导商业活动或贸易往来的原则和措施；在企业语境中可指商业经营政策，在政府语境中可指贸易政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Politika kummerċjali hija sett ta' prinċipji u miżuri li jiggwidaw l-attività kummerċjali ta' negozju jew ir-regoli dwar il-kummerċ ta' pajjiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业政策，指导企业或机构开展商业活动的原则与措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika kummerċjali hija sett ta' prinċipji u regoli li jiggwidaw kif negozju jew organizzazzjoni jmexxu l-attivitajiet kummerċjali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An organization's commercial policy sets out the principles that guide its business activities.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易政策，政府管理进出口及其他贸易往来的原则与措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika kummerċjali hija sett ta' prinċipji u miżuri li bihom gvern jirregola l-importazzjoni, l-esportazzjoni u r-relazzjonijiet kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A government's trade policy determines how it regulates trade with other countries.

collocations.mt: politika kummerċjali dwar l-importazzjoni u l-esportazzjoni
collocations.en: a trade policy on imports and exports
collocations.zh: 关于进出口的贸易政策

formal.mt: Il-gvern ippubblika politika kummerċjali ġdida li tistabbilixxi l-prijoritajiet tiegħu għall-importazzjoni u l-esportazzjoni.
formal.en: The government published a new trade policy setting out its priorities for imports and exports.
formal.zh: 政府公布了一项新的贸易政策，明确其进出口方面的优先事项。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex biddiltu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ? Pawlu: Għax il-kumpanija għandha politika kummerċjali ġdida. Nispjegalek x'inbidel.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why have you changed the terms of sale? Pawlu: Because the company has a new commercial policy. I'll explain what has changed.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们为什么修改销售条款？Pawlu：因为公司有了新的商业政策。我来解释一下有哪些变化。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex biddiltu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex biddiltu l-kundizzjonijiet tal-bejgħ?
messages.zh: 你们为什么修改销售条款？
messages.en: Why have you changed the terms of sale?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (销售人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kumpanija għandha politika kummerċjali ġdida. Nispjegalek x'inbidel.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kumpanija għandha politika kummerċjali ġdida. Nispjegalek x'inbidel.
messages.zh: 因为公司有了新的商业政策。我来解释一下有哪些变化。
messages.en: Because the company has a new commercial policy. I'll explain what has changed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记同一词组：公司制定销售规则时想到“商业政策”，政府管理进出口时想到“贸易政策”。

gloss_zh: 配套政策；辅助支持政策

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supporting policy is a policy introduced alongside a main measure to help it work effectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与主要政策或措施同时推行、帮助其有效落实或处理相关影响的配套支持政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Politika ta' appoġġ hija politika li titħaddem flimkien ma' miżura ewlenija biex tgħinha tirnexxi jew biex tindirizza l-effetti marbuta magħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伴随主要政策或措施一同实施、为其提供支持的配套政策。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika ta' appoġġ hija politika li takkumpanja politika jew miżura ewlenija u tipprovdi l-għajnuna meħtieġa biex din titwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An accompanying policy is introduced alongside a main policy to support its implementation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辅助性配套政策，用于支持主要改革或措施，并处理其实施过程中产生的相关影响。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika ta' appoġġ hija politika komplementari li ssaħħaħ miżura ewlenija u tgħin biex jiġu indirizzati d-diffikultajiet jew l-effetti li joħorġu mill-implimentazzjoni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A flanking policy supports a main measure and helps address difficulties or effects arising from it.

collocations.en: a supporting policy for the reform
the implementation of an accompanying policy

formal.mt: Il-pjan jipproponi politika ta' appoġġ għar-riforma, b'taħriġ għall-ħaddiema li se jkollhom bżonn ħiliet ġodda.
formal.en: The plan proposes an accompanying policy for the reform, with training for workers who will need new skills.
formal.zh: 该计划提出了一项改革配套政策，为需要掌握新技能的劳动者提供培训。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Jekk tinbidel is-sistema, min se jgħinna nitgħallmu nużawha? Ġużeppi: Hemm politika ta' appoġġ li tinkludi taħriġ għalina.
colloquial.en: Marija: If the system changes, who will help us learn to use it? Ġużeppi: There's an accompanying policy that includes training for us.
colloquial.zh: Marija：如果系统变了，谁来帮助我们学习使用它？Ġużeppi：有一项配套政策，其中包括给我们的培训。

messages.speaker: Marija (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk tinbidel is-sistema, min se jgħinna nitgħallmu nużawha?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk tinbidel is-sistema, min se jgħinna nitgħallmu nużawha?
messages.zh: 如果系统变了，谁来帮助我们学习使用它？
messages.en: If the system changes, who will help us learn to use it?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm politika ta' appoġġ li tinkludi taħriġ għalina.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm politika ta' appoġġ li tinkludi taħriġ għalina.
messages.zh: 有一项配套政策，其中包括给我们的培训。
messages.en: There's an accompanying policy that includes training for us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象主要改革旁边放着一套培训和帮助措施：politika ta' appoġġ 就是让主要措施顺利实施的“配套支持政策”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of principles and measures for maintaining environmental, social, and economic well-being over the long term.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为长期维持环境、社会与经济福祉而制定的一套原则与措施，即可持续发展政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' prinċipji u miżuri biex jitħarsu l-ambjent u l-benesseri soċjali u ekonomiku fit-tul.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指导资源使用、环境保护及社会经济长期发展的可持续发展政策。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika li tiggwida l-użu tar-riżorsi, il-ħarsien tal-ambjent u l-iżvilupp soċjali u ekonomiku sabiex dawn ikunu jistgħu jinżammu fit-tul.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sustainability policy sets out how an organization or community intends to support environmental, social, and economic well-being over time.

formal.mt: L-iskola adottat politika ta' sostenibbiltà li tinkludi miżuri biex jitnaqqas l-iskart u jintużaw ir-riżorsi b'mod responsabbli.
formal.en: The school adopted a sustainability policy that includes measures to reduce waste and use resources responsibly.
formal.zh: 学校采用了一项可持续发展政策，其中包括减少废弃物和负责任地使用资源的措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex l-uffiċċju għandu politika ta' sostenibbiltà ġdida? Pawlu: Biex naħlu inqas ilma u elettriku u naħsbu aktar fil-futur.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why does the office have a new sustainability policy? Pawlu: So that we waste less water and electricity and think more about the future.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：办公室为什么制定了新的可持续发展政策？保罗：为了让我们少浪费水电，也多为未来着想。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-uffiċċju għandu politika ta' sostenibbiltà ġdida?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-uffiċċju għandu politika ta' sostenibbiltà ġdida?
messages.zh: 办公室为什么制定了新的可持续发展政策？
messages.en: Why does the office have a new sustainability policy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex naħlu inqas ilma u elettriku u naħsbu aktar fil-futur.
messages.mt_standard: Biex naħlu inqas ilma u elettriku u naħsbu aktar fil-futur.
messages.zh: 为了让我们少浪费水电，也多为未来着想。
messages.en: So that we waste less water and electricity and think more about the future.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“今天节约资源，明天仍能使用”的画面记住整个短语；把节水、节电和长期规划一起归入“可持续发展政策”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of principles and measures intended to protect consumers and guide matters affecting their interests.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保护消费者权益并指导涉及消费者利益的事务而制定的一套原则与措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sett ta' prinċipji u miżuri maħsuba biex iħarsu d-drittijiet tal-konsumaturi u jiggwidaw kwistjonijiet li jolqtu l-interessi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对消费者权益保护及相关事务制定的政策。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika li tistabbilixxi prinċipji u miżuri dwar il-ħarsien tal-konsumaturi u l-interessi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer policy consists of principles and measures that guide how consumers and their interests are protected.

formal.mt: Il-politika tal-konsumatur għandha tippromwovi informazzjoni ċara dwar il-prezzijiet u proċeduri aċċessibbli għall-ilmenti.
formal.en: Consumer policy should promote clear information about prices and accessible complaints procedures.
formal.zh: 消费者政策应促进价格信息清晰透明，并使投诉程序便于使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jirrevedu l-politika tal-konsumatur? Mark: Biex min jixtri jkollu informazzjoni aktar ċara u jkun jaf kif jilmenta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they reviewing consumer policy? Mark: So that people buying things have clearer information and know how to complain.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他们为什么要修订消费者政策？马克：为了让买东西的人获得更清楚的信息，并知道如何投诉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jirrevedu l-politika tal-konsumatur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jirrevedu l-politika tal-konsumatur?
messages.zh: 他们为什么要修订消费者政策？
messages.en: Why are they reviewing consumer policy?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex min jixtri jkollu informazzjoni aktar ċara u jkun jaf kif jilmenta.
messages.mt_standard: Biex min jixtri jkollu informazzjoni aktar ċara u jkun jaf kif jilmenta.
messages.zh: 为了让买东西的人获得更清楚的信息，并知道如何投诉。
messages.en: So that people buying things have clearer information and know how to complain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“购物后需要维权”的场景记忆：看到价格说明、消费者权益和投诉程序，就联想到“消费者政策”。

gloss_zh: 在政治上；从政治角度看

teaching_sense.en_definition: Politically means in relation to politics or when considered from a political point of view.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某种情况涉及政治，或某项判断是从政治角度作出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Politikament tfisser f'dak li għandu x'jaqsam mal-politika jew meta xi ħaġa titqies mill-perspettiva politika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在政治方面；就政治立场、活动或影响而言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politikament tfisser fir-rigward tal-politika, tal-pożizzjonijiet politiċi jew tal-effetti politiċi ta' xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is described politically, it is considered in terms of politics or political effects.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega għaliex din id-deċiżjoni hija politikament sensittiva u teħtieġ diskussjoni pubblika.
formal.en: The report explains why this decision is politically sensitive and requires public discussion.
formal.zh: 报告解释了为什么这项决定在政治上较为敏感，并需要公众讨论。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int u ħuk taqblu fuq kollox? David: Le, politikament ma naqblux, imma xorta nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you and your brother agree on everything? David: No, we disagree politically, but we still talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你和你哥哥什么事都意见一致吗？David：不，我们在政治上意见不同，但还是能平静地交谈。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int u ħuk taqblu fuq kollox?
messages.mt_standard: Int u ħuk taqblu fuq kollox?
messages.zh: 你和你哥哥什么事都意见一致吗？
messages.en: Do you and your brother agree on everything?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, politikament ma naqblux, imma xorta nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Le, politikament ma naqblux, imma xorta nitkellmu bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 不，我们在政治上意见不同，但还是能平静地交谈。
messages.en: No, we disagree politically, but we still talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 politikament 当作“从政治角度看”的提示牌：看到它，就把后面的判断放到政治这一角度理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event in which winning tickets or numbers are selected by chance to award prizes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过随机抽出票券或号码来决定获奖者的活动，可指抽奖或彩票开奖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Avveniment li fih jintgħażlu bil-polza biljetti jew numri rebbieħa biex jingħataw premjijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通常通过出售有编号的票券并随机抽出中奖票来颁发奖品的抽奖活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività li fiha normalment jinbiegħu biljetti nnumerati u jintgħażel biljett jew aktar bix-xorti biex jingħataw premjijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A raffle is an event in which people usually buy numbered tickets and prizes are awarded to tickets selected by chance.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在彩票活动中随机抽取中奖号码或中奖票的开奖过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċess f'lotterija li fih jintgħażlu bix-xorti n-numri jew il-biljetti rebbieħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lottery draw is the occasion when winning numbers or tickets are selected by chance in a lottery.

collocations.en: to take part in a raffle
the results of the lottery draw

formal.mt: L-assoċjazzjoni se torganizza polza biex tiġbor fondi għall-attivitajiet tagħha; il-biljetti rebbieħa jitħabbru fi tmiem is-serata.
formal.en: The association will organize a raffle to raise funds for its activities; the winning tickets will be announced at the end of the evening.
formal.zh: 协会将组织抽奖，为其活动筹集资金；中奖票号将在晚会结束时公布。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Diġà ħarġu r-riżultati tal-polza? Ninu: Iva, iżda n-numru tiegħi ma rebaħx. Lara: Tajjeb, niċċekkja l-biljett tiegħi wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are the lottery draw results out yet? Ninu: Yes, but my number didn't win. Lara: All right, I'll check my ticket too.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：彩票开奖结果出来了吗？尼努：出来了，不过我的号码没中奖。拉拉：好，我也查一下我的彩票。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà ħarġu r-riżultati tal-polza?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà ħarġu r-riżultati tal-polza?
messages.zh: 彩票开奖结果出来了吗？
messages.en: Are the lottery draw results out yet?

messages.speaker: Ninu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda n-numru tiegħi ma rebaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda n-numru tiegħi ma rebaħx.
messages.zh: 出来了，不过我的号码没中奖。
messages.en: Yes, but my number didn't win.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, niċċekkja l-biljett tiegħi wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, niċċekkja l-biljett tiegħi wkoll.
messages.zh: 好，我也查一下我的彩票。
messages.en: All right, I'll check my ticket too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一只箱子装满号码，主持人随机抽出中奖号码：筹款活动中想到“抽奖”，彩票语境中想到“开奖”，用场景区分两个义项。

exact_key: polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi

teaching_sense.en_definition: A non-negotiable bill of lading that names the specific consignee to whom the goods are to be delivered.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明确指定货物应交付给哪一位收货人的不可转让提单，即记名提单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument tat-trasport tal-merkanzija li jsemmi d-destinatarju speċifiku li għandu jirċeviha u li mhuwiex negozjabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记名提单；指定具体收货人的不可转让货运提单，此处为 straight bill of lading 的简称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem imqassar għal dokument tat-trasport tal-merkanzija li jispeċifika d-destinatarju li għandu jirċieviha u li mhuwiex negozjabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A straight bill is a shortened name for a non-negotiable bill of lading that specifies the consignee who is to receive the goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记名提单；载明特定收货人、不能通过背书转让给他人的提单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Polza ta' kargu li ssemmi destinatarju speċifiku għall-kunsinna tal-merkanzija u li ma tistax tiġi ttrasferita lil ħaddieħor permezz ta' endorsjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A straight bill of lading names a specific consignee and cannot be transferred to another party by endorsement.

collocations.mt: toħroġ polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi
collocations.en: to issue a straight bill of lading

collocations.mt: tivverifika polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi
collocations.en: to verify a straight bill of lading

collocations.mt: id-dettalji fuq il-polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi
collocations.en: the details on the straight bill of lading
collocations.zh: 记名提单上的详细信息

formal.mt: Qabel il-kunsinna, l-aġent ivverifika li l-isem tad-destinatarju fuq il-polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi kien jaqbel mad-dettalji fl-ordni.
formal.en: Before delivery, the agent verified that the consignee's name on the straight bill of lading matched the details in the order.
formal.zh: 交货前，代理人核实了记名提单上的收货人姓名与订单资料一致。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Din hi polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi? Toni: Iva, il-kumpanija tiegħek hi msemmija bħala d-destinatarju. Rita: Mela niċċekkja li d-dettalji kollha huma tajbin.
colloquial.en: Rita: Is this a straight bill of lading? Toni: Yes, your company is named as the consignee. Rita: Then I'll check that all the details are correct.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这是记名提单吗？托尼：是的，上面列明你们公司是收货人。丽塔：那我核对一下所有资料是否正确。

messages.speaker: Rita (进口商职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din hi polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi?
messages.mt_standard: Din hi polza ta' kargu għal destinatarju msemmi?
messages.zh: 这是记名提单吗？
messages.en: Is this a straight bill of lading?

messages.speaker: Toni (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kumpanija tiegħek hi msemmija bħala d-destinatarju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kumpanija tiegħek hi msemmija bħala d-destinatarju.
messages.zh: 是的，上面列明你们公司是收货人。
messages.en: Yes, your company is named as the consignee.

messages.speaker: Rita (进口商职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niċċekkja li d-dettalji kollha huma tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niċċekkja li d-dettalji kollha huma tajbin.
messages.zh: 那我核对一下所有资料是否正确。
messages.en: Then I'll check that all the details are correct.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长短语想成一张已经填写收货人姓名的货运单：记住“货物交给单上指名的人”，再对应中文术语“记名提单”。

exact_key: polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier
gloss_zh: 货运代理人签发的提单；货代提单

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bill of lading issued by a freight forwarder for goods arranged for transport.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由货运代理人就其安排运输的货物签发的提单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument tat-trasport li spedizjonier joħroġ għall-merkanzija li jkun organizza t-trasport tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货运代理人针对其安排运输的货物签发的提单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Polza ta' kargu li tinħareġ minn spedizjonier għall-merkanzija li jkun organizza t-trasport tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forwarder's bill of lading is a transport document issued by the freight forwarder who arranges the shipment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货代提单，指由货运代理人以自身名义向托运人签发的提单。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Polza ta' kargu li spedizjonier joħroġ f'ismu stess lill-persuna jew lill-kumpanija li tibgħat il-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A house bill of lading is a bill issued in a freight forwarder's own name to the shipper.

collocations.mt: kopja tal-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier
collocations.en: a copy of the forwarder's bill of lading

collocations.mt: in-numru tal-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier
collocations.en: the number of the forwarder's bill of lading

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ibgħat kopja tal-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier sabiex inkunu nistgħu niċċekkjaw id-dettalji tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: Please send a copy of the forwarder's bill of lading so that we can check the details of the goods.
formal.zh: 请发送货代提单的副本，以便我们核对货物详情。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Waslet il-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier? Pawlu: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Nibgħatlek kopja issa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Has the forwarder's bill of lading arrived? Pawlu: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll send you a copy now.
colloquial.zh: Marta：货代提单到了吗？Pawlu：到了，今天早上到的。我现在发一份副本给你。

messages.speaker: Marta (物流协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Waslet il-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier?
messages.mt_standard: Waslet il-polza ta' kargu maħruġa minn spedizjonier?
messages.zh: 货代提单到了吗？
messages.en: Has the forwarder's bill of lading arrived?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (货运代理人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Nibgħatlek kopja issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, waslet dalgħodu. Nibgħatlek kopja issa.
messages.zh: 到了，今天早上到的。我现在发一份副本给你。
messages.en: Yes, it arrived this morning. I'll send you a copy now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语分成“提单”和“由货运代理人签发的”两块来记；看到末尾的 spedizjonier，就联想负责安排运输并签发这份提单的货代。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A document recording how goods have been accounted for so that the relevant obligations can be discharged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记载货物如何得到交代、供核查相关义务是否已履行并办理核销的单据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument li juri kif tkun ġiet ikkontabilizzata l-merkanzija sabiex jiġi vverifikat jekk l-obbligi marbuta magħha twettqux u tkun tista' tingħalaq il-proċedura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 核销单，用于列明货物的处置或去向，以核查并核销相关程序下的义务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti rendikont ta' kif intużat jew fejn marret il-merkanzija sabiex jiġu vverifikati l-obbligi tal-proċedura u tkun tista' tingħalaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bill of discharge is a document accounting for goods so that obligations under the relevant procedure can be checked and discharged.

collocations.en: to submit a bill of discharge
to prepare a bill of discharge

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħejjiet il-polza ta' verifika u ġabret id-dokumenti meħtieġa biex turi fejn marret il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The company prepared the bill of discharge and collected the documents needed to show where the goods had gone.
formal.zh: 公司编制了核销单，并收集了证明货物去向所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lestejt il-polza ta' verifika? Ġorġ: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-kwantitajiet mad-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you finished the bill of discharge? Ġorġ: Almost. I still need to check the quantities against the documents.
colloquial.zh: Nina：核销单做好了吗？Ġorġ：快了。我还得对照文件核查数量。

messages.speaker: Nina (业务主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejt il-polza ta' verifika?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejt il-polza ta' verifika?
messages.zh: 核销单做好了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished the bill of discharge?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (单证员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-kwantitajiet mad-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi. Għad irrid niċċekkja l-kwantitajiet mad-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 快了。我还得对照文件核查数量。
messages.en: Almost. I still need to check the quantities against the documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“核查货物去向，再办理核销”连成一个记忆场景；polza ta' verifika 就是这个场景中用来交代货物情况的核销单。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bill of discharge accounting for goods in connection with their re-exportation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与货物再出口有关、用于交代货物情况并办理相关义务核销的单据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Polza ta' verifika li tagħti rendikont tal-merkanzija b'rabta mar-riesportazzjoni tagħha sabiex jiġu vverifikati l-obbligi u tkun tista' tingħalaq il-proċedura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 再出口核销单，在本词组中指用于核查货物再出口情况并核销相关义务的单据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jagħti rendikont tal-merkanzija li tkun ġiet riesportata, biex jiġi vverifikat jekk twettqux l-obbligi marbuta mal-proċedura u din tkun tista' tingħalaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this phrase, a bill of discharge is a document accounting for re-exported goods so that the relevant obligations can be checked and discharged.

collocations.mt: tħejji polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni
collocations.en: to prepare a bill of discharge relating to re-exportation

collocations.mt: tippreżenta polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni
collocations.en: to submit a bill of discharge relating to re-exportation

formal.mt: Id-dettalji fil-polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni għandhom jaqblu mad-dokumenti li juru li l-merkanzija ġiet riesportata.
formal.en: The details in the bill of discharge relating to re-exportation should match the documents showing that the goods were re-exported.
formal.zh: 再出口核销单中的详情应与证明货物已再出口的文件一致。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna l-polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni lesta? David: Iva. Qabbilt id-dettalji mad-dokumenti tar-riesportazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have the bill of discharge relating to re-exportation ready? David: Yes. I checked the details against the re-export documents.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们的再出口核销单准备好了吗？David：好了。我已经对照再出口文件核查了详情。

messages.speaker: Lara (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna l-polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni lesta?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna l-polza ta' verifika dwar ir-riesportazzjoni lesta?
messages.zh: 我们的再出口核销单准备好了吗？
messages.en: Do we have the bill of discharge relating to re-exportation ready?

messages.speaker: David (单证员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva. Qabbilt id-dettalji mad-dokumenti tar-riesportazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva. Qabbilt id-dettalji mad-dokumenti tar-riesportazzjoni.
messages.zh: 好了。我已经对照再出口文件核查了详情。
messages.en: Yes. I checked the details against the re-export documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 polza ta' verifika 是“核销单”，再把 dwar ir-riesportazzjoni 整块记成“关于再出口”；想象核对货物再次出境的文件，就能记住完整词组。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A transport document recording the goods being sent and the details of their shipment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 记载所运货物及其运输详情的单据。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dokument tat-trasport li jagħti d-dettalji tal-merkanzija li tkun qed tintbagħat u tal-vjeġġ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 运单，记载货物、发货人、收货人及运输安排等信息的运输单据。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument li jakkumpanja vjeġġ u jagħti informazzjoni dwar il-merkanzija, min jibgħatha, min jirċeviha u l-arranġamenti tat-trasport.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A waybill is a document that gives details of goods being transported, including their sender, recipient, and destination.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintbagħat il-merkanzija, ivverifika li l-indirizz tar-riċevitur fuq il-polza tal-vjeġġ huwa korrett.
formal.en: Before the goods are sent, verify that the recipient's address on the waybill is correct.
formal.zh: 货物发出前，请核实运单上的收货人地址是否正确。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu n-numru tal-polza tal-vjeġġ? Mark: Fuq nett, ħdejn id-data. Nużah biex infittex id-dettalji tal-vjeġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the waybill number? Mark: At the top, next to the date. I use it to look up the shipment details.
colloquial.zh: Sara：运单号码在哪里？Mark：在最上面，日期旁边。我用它来查询这批货的运输详情。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu n-numru tal-polza tal-vjeġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu n-numru tal-polza tal-vjeġġ?
messages.zh: 运单号码在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the waybill number?

messages.speaker: Mark (货运职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq nett, ħdejn id-data. Nużah biex infittex id-dettalji tal-vjeġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq nett, ħdejn id-data. Nużah biex infittex id-dettalji tal-vjeġġ.
messages.zh: 在最上面，日期旁边。我用它来查询这批货的运输详情。
messages.en: At the top, next to the date. I use it to look up the shipment details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物出发，运单随行”的画面记忆：把 polza tal-vjeġġ 想成写有收货地址和运输详情的那张单据，整体对应“运单”。

gloss_zh: 泵；抽送液体或气体的装置

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device used to move liquids or gases from one place to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将液体或气体从一处输送到另一处的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jintuża biex imexxi likwidi jew gassijiet minn post għal ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泵；用于抽送液体或气体的装置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pompa hija apparat li jiġbed jew jimbotta likwidi jew gassijiet biex imexxihom minn post għal ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pump is a device that moves liquids or gases from one place to another.

formal.mt: It-tekniku installa pompa ġdida biex jittrasferixxi l-ilma mit-tank għall-ġnien.
formal.en: The technician installed a new pump to transfer water from the tank to the garden.
formal.zh: 技术员安装了一台新水泵，将水从水箱输送到花园。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pompa biex nonfoħ it-tajer tar-rota? Mark: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx. Inġibhielek issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a pump so I can inflate the bicycle tyre? Mark: Yes, it's in the garage. I'll get it for you now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你有打气筒吗？我想给自行车轮胎打气。Mark：有，在车库里。我现在拿给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek pompa biex nonfoħ it-tajer tar-rota?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek pompa biex nonfoħ it-tajer tar-rota?
messages.zh: 你有打气筒吗？我想给自行车轮胎打气。
messages.en: Do you have a pump so I can inflate the bicycle tyre?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx. Inġibhielek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħda fil-garaxx. Inġibhielek issa.
messages.zh: 有，在车库里。我现在拿给你。
messages.en: Yes, it's in the garage. I'll get it for you now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pompa 和给自行车打气的动作一起记：它可以送气，也可以抽水，核心都是用泵输送。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pump that delivers measured quantities of liquid at a controlled rate.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以受控速率输送规定量液体的泵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pompa li twassal kwantitajiet imkejla ta' likwidu b'rata kkontrollata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 计量泵；能够按设定量或受控流量输送液体的泵。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pompa tal-kejl hija apparat li jippompja likwidu fi kwantitajiet imkejla u b'rata li tista' tiġi kkontrollata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A metering pump delivers measured amounts of liquid at a controlled rate.

collocations.en: the flow rate of the metering pump

formal.mt: Il-pompa tal-kejl ġiet aġġustata biex iżżid għaxar millilitri ta' soluzzjoni kull minuta.
formal.en: The metering pump was adjusted to add ten millilitres of solution per minute.
formal.zh: 计量泵经过调节，每分钟添加十毫升溶液。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tuża pompa tal-kejl? Pawlu: Biex inżid l-istess ammont ta' likwidu kull minuta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you using a metering pump? Pawlu: To add the same amount of liquid every minute.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么用计量泵？Pawlu：为了每分钟都加入相同量的液体。

messages.speaker: Sara (实验室同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tuża pompa tal-kejl?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tuża pompa tal-kejl?
messages.zh: 你为什么用计量泵？
messages.en: Why are you using a metering pump?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (实验室技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex inżid l-istess ammont ta' likwidu kull minuta.
messages.mt_standard: Biex inżid l-istess ammont ta' likwidu kull minuta.
messages.zh: 为了每分钟都加入相同量的液体。
messages.en: To add the same amount of liquid every minute.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把计量泵想成会按刻度送液体的泵：看到 pompa tal-kejl，就联想每分钟准确加入固定毫升数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place where drivers buy fuel for their vehicles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 驾驶员为车辆购买并加注燃油的场所，即加油站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fejn is-sewwieqa jixtru l-fjuwil u jimlew it-tankijiet tal-vetturi tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加油站；供驾驶员给车辆加注燃油的场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pompa tal-petrol hija post fejn jinbiegħ il-fjuwil u fejn is-sewwieqa jistgħu jimlew it-tankijiet tal-vetturi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A gas station is a place where drivers can buy fuel for their vehicles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车辆加油站；提供车辆燃油加注服务的营业场所。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pompa tal-petrol hija post li jipprovdi l-fjuwil biex is-sewwieqa jkunu jistgħu jimlew it-tankijiet tal-vetturi tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A filling station is a place where vehicles can be supplied with fuel.

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq waqaf fil-pompa tal-petrol biex jimla t-tank qabel il-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The driver stopped at the filling station to fill the tank before the journey.
formal.zh: 司机出发前在加油站停车，把油箱加满。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-eqreb pompa tal-petrol? Maja: Hemm waħda ftit aktar 'il quddiem, fuq ix-xellug.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where is the nearest gas station? Maja: There's one a little further ahead, on the left.
colloquial.zh: Mark：最近的加油站在哪里？Maja：再往前一点，左边就有一家。

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hi l-eqreb pompa tal-petrol?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hi l-eqreb pompa tal-petrol?
messages.zh: 最近的加油站在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the nearest gas station?

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm waħda ftit aktar 'il quddiem, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm waħda ftit aktar 'il quddiem, fuq ix-xellug.
messages.zh: 再往前一点，左边就有一家。
messages.en: There's one a little further ahead, on the left.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组连同公路边加油站的画面一起记；问路时说 l-eqreb pompa tal-petrol，就是问最近的加油站。

gloss_zh: 自命不凡的；浮夸做作的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Showing an exaggerated sense of importance, especially through overly grand or formal behaviour or language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得过分庄重或夸大自身重要性，尤指言谈举止自命不凡、浮夸做作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri sens esaġerat tal-importanza tiegħu nnifsu jew li juża kliem u mġiba grandjużi żżejjed biex jimpressjona.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自命不凡的；言语或举止过分庄重、浮夸，显得刻意抬高自身重要性的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna jew diskors ikun pompuż meta juri importanza esaġerata jew juża formalità u kliem grandjuż żżejjed biex jimpressjona lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is pompous behaves or speaks as though they are more important than other people.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża stil pompuż li jagħmel ideat sempliċi diffiċli biex jinftiehmu.
formal.en: The report uses a pompous style that makes simple ideas difficult to understand.
formal.zh: 这份报告采用浮夸的文风，把简单的意思写得难以理解。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sibt id-diskors? Mark: Kien pompuż wisq; seta' qal l-istess ħaġa bi kliem aktar sempliċi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did you think of the speech? Mark: It was too pompous; he could have said the same thing in simpler words.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你觉得这场演说怎么样？Mark：太浮夸了；他完全可以用更简单的话表达同样的意思。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sibt id-diskors?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sibt id-diskors?
messages.zh: 你觉得这场演说怎么样？
messages.en: What did you think of the speech?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien pompuż wisq; seta' qal l-istess ħaġa bi kliem aktar sempliċi.
messages.mt_standard: Kien pompuż wisq; seta' qal l-istess ħaġa bi kliem aktar sempliċi.
messages.zh: 太浮夸了；他完全可以用更简单的话表达同样的意思。
messages.en: It was too pompous; he could have said the same thing in simpler words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人把简单的话说得像盛大典礼上的致辞，还显得自己特别重要；用这个画面记住 pompuż 的浮夸和自命不凡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having people living in a place or area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指某个地方或区域有人居住；可搭配程度词说明居民的密集程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih jgħixu n-nies, bi kliem ieħor li għandu abitanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有人居住的；有居民定居的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi post jew territorju li fih jgħixu n-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A populated place is one where people live.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi dan ir-reġjun bħala post densament popolat.
formal.en: The study describes this region as a densely populated place.
formal.zh: 该研究将这一地区描述为人口密集的地方。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan ir-raħal jidher kwiet ħafna. Mark: Iva, iżda huwa popolat; in-nies ikunu aktar barra filgħaxija.
colloquial.en: Maja: This village seems very quiet. Mark: Yes, but people do live here; they are out more in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个村庄看起来很安静。马克：是啊，不过这里有人住；大家晚上更常出来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan ir-raħal jidher kwiet ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan ir-raħal jidher kwiet ħafna.
messages.zh: 这个村庄看起来很安静。
messages.en: This village seems very quiet.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iżda huwa popolat; in-nies ikunu aktar barra filgħaxija.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, iżda huwa popolat; in-nies ikunu aktar barra filgħaxija.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过这里有人住；大家晚上更常出来。
messages.en: Yes, but people do live here; they are out more in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 popolat 配上一幅亮着住户灯光的村庄图，记住它描述的是地方有人居住；是否拥挤还要看程度词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: All the people living in a particular place, or their total number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 居住在某一地方的全体居民，或这些居民的总人数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-nies kollha li jgħixu f'post partikolari, jew l-għadd totali tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某个国家、城市或地区的全体居民，或其人口总数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ġabra tan-nies li jgħixu f'pajjiż, belt jew żona, jew in-numru totali ta' dawn in-nies.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The population of a place consists of all the people who live there.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport iqabbel il-popolazzjoni ta' tliet bliet u jiddeskrivi l-bidliet matul għaxar snin.
formal.en: The report compares the populations of three cities and describes the changes over ten years.
formal.zh: 该报告比较了三座城市的人口，并描述了十年间的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hi l-popolazzjoni ta' dan ir-raħal? Pawlu: Ma nafx eżatt, imma nistgħu niċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is the population of this village? Pawlu: I don't know exactly, but we can check the figures.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个村庄有多少人口？保罗：我不清楚确切人数，不过我们可以查一下数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi l-popolazzjoni ta' dan ir-raħal?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi l-popolazzjoni ta' dan ir-raħal?
messages.zh: 这个村庄有多少人口？
messages.en: What is the population of this village?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx eżatt, imma nistgħu niċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx eżatt, imma nistgħu niċċekkjaw iċ-ċifri.
messages.zh: 我不清楚确切人数，不过我们可以查一下数据。
messages.en: I don't know exactly, but we can check the figures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 populazzjoni 就想象统计员数一座城市的居民：既能指这群居民，也能指统计出来的人口总数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medicine that helps a person empty their bowels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 帮助排便、促进肠道内容物排出的药物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina li tgħin lil persuna tbattal l-imsaren.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泻药；用于帮助排便的药物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mediċina li tiffaċilita t-tbattil tal-imsaren u tintuża kontra l-istitikezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A laxative is a medicine that helps you empty your bowels.

formal.mt: Il-fuljett jispjega li porga hija mediċina li tiffaċilita t-tbattil tal-imsaren.
formal.en: The leaflet explains that a laxative is a medicine that makes it easier to empty the bowels.
formal.zh: 说明书解释说，泻药是一种帮助肠道排便的药物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Xi tfisser il-kelma porga? Sara: Hija mediċina li tgħin biex tbattal l-imsaren.
colloquial.en: Mark: What does the word porga mean? Sara: It is a medicine that helps you empty your bowels.
colloquial.zh: 马克：porga 这个词是什么意思？萨拉：它指帮助排便的药物。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma porga?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma porga?
messages.zh: porga 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word porga mean?

messages.speaker: Sara (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija mediċina li tgħin biex tbattal l-imsaren.
messages.mt_standard: Hija mediċina li tgħin biex tbattal l-imsaren.
messages.zh: 它指帮助排便的药物。
messages.en: It is a medicine that helps you empty your bowels.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 porga 配一张写着“帮助排便”的药盒图，再用 tieħu porga 练习“服用泻药”这一搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small personal holder used for carrying money and cards.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随身携带、用来存放钱和卡片的小型物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li persuna ġġorr magħha biex iżżomm fih il-flus u l-karti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱包；用于随身存放钱和卡片的小型夹袋。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett żgħir li jintuża biex jinżammu fih flus u karti u li jista' jinġarr fil-but jew f'borża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wallet is a small holder in which you carry money and cards.

formal.mt: Jekk issib portafoll fil-librerija, jekk jogħġbok agħtih lill-persuna responsabbli.
formal.en: If you find a wallet in the library, please give it to the person in charge.
formal.zh: 如果你在图书馆捡到钱包，请交给负责人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt il-portafoll tiegħi? Mark: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you seen my wallet? Mark: Yes, it's on the table next to the keys.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到我的钱包了吗？马克：看到了，在桌上，钥匙旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-portafoll tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-portafoll tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你看到我的钱包了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my wallet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda ħdejn iċ-ċwievet.
messages.zh: 看到了，在桌上，钥匙旁边。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table next to the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 portafoll 和出门前检查钱包的动作连起来记：摸摸口袋，确认钱和卡都在。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to carry luggage for other people, especially at a hotel or station.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 专门为他人搬运行李的工作人员，常见于酒店或车站。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li ġġorr il-bagalji għal nies oħra, speċjalment f'lukanda jew fi stazzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行李搬运员；在酒店或车站等场所为旅客搬运行李的工作人员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaddiem li jgħin lill-klijenti jew lill-vjaġġaturi billi jġorr il-bagalji tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A porter is someone employed to carry people's luggage, especially in a hotel or at a station.

collocations.en: to ask for the porter's help

formal.mt: Il-porter tal-lukanda għen lill-klijenti jġorru l-bagalji tagħhom sal-kamra.
formal.en: The hotel porter helped the guests carry their luggage to their room.
formal.zh: 酒店的行李搬运员帮助客人把行李搬到房间。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-bagalja tqila wisq għalija. Pawlu: Nistaqsu lill-porter jekk jistax jgħinna?
colloquial.en: Anna: This suitcase is too heavy for me. Pawlu: Shall we ask the porter if he can help us?
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个行李箱对我来说太重了。保罗：我们问问行李搬运员能不能帮忙，好吗？

messages.speaker: Anna (酒店住客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-bagalja tqila wisq għalija.
messages.mt_standard: Din il-bagalja tqila wisq għalija.
messages.zh: 这个行李箱对我来说太重了。
messages.en: This suitcase is too heavy for me.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistaqsu lill-porter jekk jistax jgħinna?
messages.mt_standard: Nistaqsu lill-porter jekk jistax jgħinna?
messages.zh: 我们问问行李搬运员能不能帮忙，好吗？
messages.en: Shall we ask the porter if he can help us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象酒店门口有人接过沉重的行李箱，把 porter 与“帮旅客搬行李的人”一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An explosive powder used in firearms and fireworks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于枪械和烟火的粉末状爆炸性物质。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' sustanzi f'forma ta' trab li tintuża bħala materjal splussiv fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火药；用于枪械和烟火的粉末状爆炸性物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' sustanzi f'forma ta' trab li tinħaraq malajr u tintuża bħala materjal splussiv fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gunpowder is an explosive substance in powder form that is used in firearms and fireworks.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火药；可快速燃烧、用于枪械和烟火的爆炸性粉末。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Materjal splussiv magħmul minn taħlita ta' sustanzi f'forma ta' trab, użat fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Gunpowder is a powder that burns rapidly and is used as an explosive in firearms and fireworks.

formal.mt: It-test tal-wirja jispjega l-użu tal-porvli fl-armi tan-nar.
formal.en: The exhibition text explains the use of gunpowder in firearms.
formal.zh: 展览说明文字介绍了火药在枪械中的用途。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser 'porvli' f'din is-sentenza? Luka: Huwa trab splussiv li jintuża fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does 'porvli' mean in this sentence? Luka: It's an explosive powder used in firearms and fireworks.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这句话里的“porvli”是什么意思？卢卡：是一种用于枪械和烟火的爆炸性粉末，也就是火药。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'porvli' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'porvli' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的“porvli”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'porvli' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa trab splussiv li jintuża fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa trab splussiv li jintuża fl-armi tan-nar u fil-logħob tan-nar.
messages.zh: 是一种用于枪械和烟火的爆炸性粉末，也就是火药。
messages.en: It's an explosive powder used in firearms and fireworks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 porvli 写在烟火图片旁，联想烟火所用的火药；这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An amount forming part of a larger whole, especially food served to one person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体中分出的一部分，尤指供一个人食用的一份食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ammont li jagħmel parti minn ħaġa akbar, speċjalment ammont ta' ikel mogħti lil persuna waħda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一部分；一份，尤指分给一个人食用的食物量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti jew ammont minn ħaġa sħiħa, speċjalment il-kwantità ta' ikel li tingħata lil persuna waħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A portion is a part of something larger, especially an amount of food served to one person.

formal.mt: Il-prezz tal-ikla jinkludi porzjon għaġin u tazza ilma.
formal.en: The price of the meal includes a portion of pasta and a glass of water.
formal.zh: 餐费包含一份意面和一杯水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tixtieq porzjon ieħor? Mark: Iva, imma porzjon żgħir, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like another portion? Mark: Yes, but a small portion, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想再来一份吗？马克：想，不过请给我一小份。

messages.speaker: Maja (招待朋友的主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Tixtieq porzjon ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Tixtieq porzjon ieħor?
messages.zh: 你想再来一份吗？
messages.en: Would you like another portion?

messages.speaker: Mark (做客的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma porzjon żgħir, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma porzjon żgħir, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 想，不过请给我一小份。
messages.en: Yes, but a small portion, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象从一大锅意面里盛出一盘：锅里是整体，盘里的一份就是 porzjon。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Amounts or parts of something divided or allocated separately, especially servings of food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从整体中分出或分别分配的若干份，尤指食物供每人食用的份量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Partijiet jew kwantitajiet separati minn ħaġa sħiħa, speċjalment ammonti ta' ikel maħsuba biex jittieklu minn persuni differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分出的若干份或部分，尤指分别供应的食物份量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ammonti jew partijiet li jinqasmu minn ħaġa akbar, bħal ikel li jitqassam bejn diversi persuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Portions are separate amounts of something, especially food divided into servings for different people.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tal-grupp, il-kċina se tipprepara għoxrin porzjon ta' għaġin u tqassamhom f'porzjonijiet indaqs.
formal.en: For the group meal, the kitchen will prepare twenty servings of pasta and divide them into equal portions.
formal.zh: 厨房将为团体用餐准备二十份意面，并按相同份量分装。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm għandna bżonn porzjonijiet ta' soppa? Mark: Tlieta, jekk jogħġbok, u agħmilhom żgħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many portions of soup do we need? Mark: Three, please, and make them small.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们需要几份汤？Mark：三份，谢谢，都要小份的。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandna bżonn porzjonijiet ta' soppa?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandna bżonn porzjonijiet ta' soppa?
messages.zh: 我们需要几份汤？
messages.en: How many portions of soup do we need?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tlieta, jekk jogħġbok, u agħmilhom żgħar.
messages.mt_standard: Tlieta, jekk jogħġbok, u agħmilhom żgħar.
messages.zh: 三份，谢谢，都要小份的。
messages.en: Three, please, and make them small.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一锅汤分进几个碗：每碗是一份，几个碗合起来就是 porzjonijiet；搭配 żgħar 记“小份量”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hard, fine ceramic material used to make objects such as cups, plates, and ornaments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种质地细密、坚硬的陶瓷材料，常用于制作杯盘和装饰品；也可指用这种材料制成的瓷器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal taċ-ċeramika fin u iebes li jintuża biex isiru tazzi, platti u oġġetti dekorattivi, jew l-oġġetti magħmula minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓷，一种坚硬细密的陶瓷材料；也指用瓷制成的器物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' ċeramika fina u iebsa li minnha jsiru oġġetti bħal tazzi u platti, kif ukoll dawn l-oġġetti nfushom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Porcelain is a hard, fine ceramic material used for making tableware and decorative objects.

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri kollezzjoni ta' oġġetti tal-porċellana, fosthom tazzi u platti mżejna.
formal.en: The museum displays a collection of porcelain objects, including decorated cups and plates.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一批瓷器藏品，其中包括带有装饰的瓷杯和瓷盘。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din it-tazza tal-porċellana sabiħa ħafna! Rita: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta biha għax tinkiser faċilment.
colloquial.en: Anna: This porcelain cup is beautiful! Rita: Yes, but be careful with it because it breaks easily.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个瓷杯真漂亮！丽塔：是啊，不过拿的时候小心，它很容易摔坏。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Din it-tazza tal-porċellana sabiħa ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Din it-tazza tal-porċellana sabiħa ħafna!
messages.zh: 这个瓷杯真漂亮！
messages.en: This porcelain cup is beautiful!

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta biha għax tinkiser faċilment.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma oqgħod attenta biha għax tinkiser faċilment.
messages.zh: 是啊，不过拿的时候小心，它很容易摔坏。
messages.en: Yes, but be careful with it because it breaks easily.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 porċellana 和白色瓷杯、彩绘瓷盘放在同一张记忆卡上，用材质和器物一起记住“瓷、瓷器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing approval, optimism, or a favourable opinion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示赞同、乐观态度或有利评价的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi approvazzjoni, ottimiżmu jew opinjoni favorevoli dwar xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 积极、肯定或正面的，表示赞同、信心或有利评价。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li juri approvazzjoni jew fiduċja, jew li jagħti valutazzjoni favorevoli ta' persuna, ħaġa jew sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A positive attitude or response expresses optimism, approval, or a favourable view of something.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-valutazzjoni ġiet immarkata 'positive' għax il-parteċipanti esprimew opinjonijiet favorevoli dwar l-attività.
