formal.en: In the report, the assessment was marked 'positive' because the participants expressed favourable opinions about the activity.
formal.zh: 报告将该评价标注为“正面”，因为参与者对这项活动表达了肯定意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser 'positive' ħdejn dan il-kumment? Leon: Hawn tfisser li l-kumment huwa favorevoli u juri approvazzjoni.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'positive' mean next to this comment? Leon: Here it means that the comment is favourable and expresses approval.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这条评论旁边的 positive 是什么意思？Leon：这里表示评论是正面的，表达了赞同。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser 'positive' ħdejn dan il-kumment?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser 'positive' ħdejn dan il-kumment?
messages.zh: 这条评论旁边的 positive 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'positive' mean next to this comment?

messages.speaker: Leon (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser li l-kumment huwa favorevoli u juri approvazzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser li l-kumment huwa favorevoli u juri approvazzjoni.
messages.zh: 这里表示评论是正面的，表达了赞同。
messages.en: Here it means that the comment is favourable and expresses approval.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 positive 标签与“赞同的评论、乐观的态度”两个画面配对，并用马耳他语 favorevoli 辅助理解“正面、肯定”。

gloss_zh: 地方；座位；场址；所处位置；活动场地

teaching_sense.en_definition: A place or position where someone or something is located, sits, or takes part in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物所在的位置，也可指供人坐下的座位、建筑场址或活动场地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju jew lok fejn jinsab xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, fejn wieħed jista' joqgħod bilqiegħda, jew fejn issir attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地方；某人或某物所在或可前往的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lok jew spazju fejn jinsab xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa, jew fejn wieħed jista' jmur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A place is a particular location where someone or something is or where an activity happens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 座位；供一个人坐下的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Spazju maħsub biex persuna toqgħod bilqiegħda, pereżempju f'teatru jew fuq tal-linja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A seat is a place provided for one person to sit, for example in a theatre or on a bus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 场址；建筑、工程或其他设施所在或拟建的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Art jew lok fejn hemm bini jew faċilità, jew fejn ikun ippjanat li jsir proġett.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A site is an area of land where a building or other facility stands or is planned.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 所处位置；某物相对于周围环境的位置或地理条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pożizzjoni ta' xi ħaġa fir-rigward tal-inħawi ta' madwarha u tal-karatteristiċi ta' dawk l-inħawi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The situation of a building or place is its position in relation to the surrounding area.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 活动场地；举行会议、演出或其他活动的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Lok fejn issir laqgħa, wirja, kunċert jew attività oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A venue is the place where an organised event, such as a meeting or concert, takes place.

collocations.en: a site for building a school

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel post għall-konferenza qrib l-istazzjon, b'post għal kull parteċipant fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The committee selected a conference venue near the station, with a seat for every participant in the main hall.
formal.zh: 委员会选定了车站附近的一处会议场地，主厅内为每位参与者都安排了座位。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm post ħdejk? Pawlu: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a seat next to you? Pawlu: Yes, you can sit here by the window.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你旁边有座位吗？Pawlu：有，你可以坐在这里，靠窗的位置。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm post ħdejk?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm post ħdejk?
messages.zh: 你旁边有座位吗？
messages.en: Is there a seat next to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, tista' toqgħod hawn ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 有，你可以坐在这里，靠窗的位置。
messages.en: Yes, you can sit here by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“位置”串联 post 的几个义项：地图上是地方，车厢里是座位，建筑规划中是场址，活动安排中是场地；具体译法看上下文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place where an obligation to pay customs duties arises.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产生缴纳关税义务的地点，即关税债务发生的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post li fih jinħoloq l-obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.

sense_translations.en_definition: place where the customs debt is incurred
sense_translations.zh_definition: 关税债务发生的地点，即缴纳关税的义务产生之地。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa l-post fejn tinħoloq responsabbiltà għall-ħlas ta' dazji doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The place where the customs debt is incurred is the location where an obligation to pay customs duties arises.

collocations.mt: jiddetermina l-post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali
collocations.en: determine the place where a customs debt is incurred

collocations.mt: jindika l-post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali
collocations.en: indicate the place where a customs debt is incurred

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jindika l-post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali.
formal.en: The report should indicate the place where a customs debt is incurred.
formal.zh: 报告应注明关税债务发生地。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi jfisser 'post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali'? David: Ifisser il-post fejn jinħoloq l-obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'place where the customs debt is incurred' mean? David: It means the place where the obligation to pay customs duties arises.
colloquial.zh: Lara：“关税债务发生地”是什么意思？David：就是产生缴纳关税义务的地点。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'post fejn jinħoloq dejn doganali'?
messages.zh: “关税债务发生地”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'place where the customs debt is incurred' mean?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser il-post fejn jinħoloq l-obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser il-post fejn jinħoloq l-obbligu li jitħallsu dazji doganali.
messages.zh: 就是产生缴纳关税义务的地点。
messages.en: It means the place where the obligation to pay customs duties arises.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“地点 post—在那里 fejn—产生 jinħoloq—关税债务 dejn doganali”的顺序分块理解，再把整句收拢成中文术语“关税债务发生地”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The location where a person was born.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人出生的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post fejn persuna twieldet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出生地点，指某人出生时所在的地方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-post tat-twelid huwa l-lokalità jew il-post fejn persuna twieldet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your place of birth is the location where you were born.

collocations.en: write down the place of birth

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ikteb id-data u l-post tat-twelid tiegħek fuq il-formola.
formal.en: Please write your date and place of birth on the form.
formal.zh: 请在表格上填写你的出生日期和出生地。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'post tat-twelid'? Ġanni: Ikteb fejn twelidt. Jien ktibt 'Ir-Rabat'.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I write under 'place of birth'? Ġanni: Write where you were born. I wrote 'Rabat'.
colloquial.zh: Sara：“出生地”这一栏该填什么？Ġanni：填你出生的地方。我填了“拉巴特”。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'post tat-twelid'?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'post tat-twelid'?
messages.zh: “出生地”这一栏该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write under 'place of birth'?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb fejn twelidt. Jien ktibt 'Ir-Rabat'.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb fejn twelidt. Jien ktibt 'Ir-Rabat'.
messages.zh: 填你出生的地方。我填了“拉巴特”。
messages.en: Write where you were born. I wrote 'Rabat'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象填写个人资料表，把 post tat-twelid 对应到需要写地名的“出生地”一栏，再与需要写年月日的“出生日期”一栏配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Letters and parcels sent or delivered by the postal service, or the office that handles them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过邮政寄送或投递的信件和包裹，也指办理相关业务的邮局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ittri u pakketti mibgħuta jew imqassma mis-servizz postali, jew l-uffiċċju fejn jintbagħtu u jiġu ttrattati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮件；通过邮政寄送或投递的信件和包裹。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ittri u l-pakketti li jintbagħtu jew jitwasslu permezz tas-servizz postali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Mail consists of letters and parcels that are sent or delivered through the postal service.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮局；办理寄信、寄包裹及其他邮政业务的营业处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċċju fejn wieħed jista' jibgħat ittri u pakketti, jixtri bolol u juża servizzi postali oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A post office is a place where you can send letters and parcels and obtain other postal services.

collocations.en: to go to the post office

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, ibgħat id-dokumenti oriġinali bil-posta u żomm l-irċevuta li tingħatalek mill-uffiċċju tal-posta.
formal.en: Please send the original documents by mail and keep the receipt issued to you by the post office.
formal.zh: 请将文件原件通过邮政寄出，并保留邮局开具的收据。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Se tmur il-posta llum? David: Iva, għandi pakkett x'nibgħat. Nina: Tista' tibgħat din l-ittra wkoll? David: Żgur, ħalliha ħdejn il-pakkett.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you going to the post office today? David: Yes, I have a parcel to send. Nina: Can you send this letter too? David: Of course, leave it next to the parcel.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今天要去邮局吗？David：是的，我有个包裹要寄。Nina：也能帮我寄这封信吗？David：当然，把它放在包裹旁边吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur il-posta llum?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur il-posta llum?
messages.zh: 你今天要去邮局吗？
messages.en: Are you going to the post office today?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi pakkett x'nibgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi pakkett x'nibgħat.
messages.zh: 是的，我有个包裹要寄。
messages.en: Yes, I have a parcel to send.

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibgħat din l-ittra wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibgħat din l-ittra wkoll?
messages.zh: 也能帮我寄这封信吗？
messages.en: Can you send this letter too?

messages.speaker: David (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħalliha ħdejn il-pakkett.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħalliha ħdejn il-pakkett.
messages.zh: 当然，把它放在包裹旁边吧。
messages.en: Of course, leave it next to the parcel.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 posta 放进“去邮局、寄邮件”的连续画面中：tmur il-posta 是去的地点，tibgħat bil-posta 是寄送的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Messages sent and received electronically, or the system used to exchange them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过电子方式发送和接收的邮件，也指交换这些邮件的通信系统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Messaġġi li jintbagħtu u jaslu b'mod elettroniku, jew is-sistema użata biex jiġu skambjati dawn il-messaġġi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电子邮件；用于发送和接收电子邮件的通信方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-posta elettronika hija mezz ta' komunikazzjoni li bih jintbagħtu u jaslu messaġġi elettroniċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Email is a way of exchanging electronic messages, or the messages exchanged in this way.

collocations.zh: 通过电子邮件发送文件

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ibgħat il-formola mimlija bil-posta elettronika.
formal.en: Please send the completed form by email.
formal.zh: 请通过电子邮件发送填好的表格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tibgħatli r-ritratti bil-posta elettronika? Mark: Iva, ibgħatli l-indirizz tiegħek u nibgħathomlok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you send me the photos by email? Mark: Yes, send me your email address and I'll send them to you.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能通过电子邮件把照片发给我吗？Mark：可以，把你的邮箱地址发给我，我就把照片发给你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tibgħatli r-ritratti bil-posta elettronika?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tibgħatli r-ritratti bil-posta elettronika?
messages.zh: 你能通过电子邮件把照片发给我吗？
messages.en: Can you send me the photos by email?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ibgħatli l-indirizz tiegħek u nibgħathomlok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ibgħatli l-indirizz tiegħek u nibgħathomlok.
messages.zh: 可以，把你的邮箱地址发给我，我就把照片发给你。
messages.en: Yes, send me your email address and I'll send them to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词与“在屏幕上写信、点击发送”的画面绑定，再搭配记住 indirizz tal-posta elettronika，表示电子邮箱地址。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A postal service that records the posting of an item, or mail sent using that service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邮政机构对邮件交寄进行登记的邮寄服务，也指通过这种服务寄送的邮件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Servizz postali li fih jiġi rreġistrat li oġġett intbagħat, jew il-posta mibgħuta permezz ta' dan is-servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 交寄时由邮政机构登记的邮件，或采用这种登记方式的挂号邮寄服务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-posta reġistrata hija posta li tintbagħat permezz ta' servizz postali li jżomm rekord ta' meta tintbagħat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Registered mail is mail sent using a postal service that keeps a record of its posting.

collocations.en: send a letter by registered mail
receive a parcel by registered mail
collocations.zh: 收到通过挂号邮寄的包裹

formal.mt: Il-kopja ffirmata tal-ftehim intbagħtet bil-posta reġistrata.
formal.en: The signed copy of the agreement was sent by registered mail.
formal.zh: 已签署的协议副本通过挂号邮件寄出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Irrid nibgħat din l-ittra bil-posta reġistrata. Pawlu: Tajjeb, poġġiha fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: I'd like to send this letter by registered mail. Pawlu: Certainly, please put it on the scales.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我想把这封信挂号寄出。Pawlu：好的，请把信放到秤上。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid nibgħat din l-ittra bil-posta reġistrata.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid nibgħat din l-ittra bil-posta reġistrata.
messages.zh: 我想把这封信挂号寄出。
messages.en: I'd like to send this letter by registered mail.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邮局职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, poġġiha fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, poġġiha fuq il-miżien, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好的，请把信放到秤上。
messages.en: Certainly, please put it on the scales.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在邮局交寄信件时，职员先把交寄信息登记下来；用“登记交寄”这个画面记住整组词表示挂号邮件。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The average electrical power that transfers energy to a load for conversion into work, heat, or other forms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向负载实际传递能量，使其转化为机械功、热或其他形式的平均电功率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-potenza elettrika medja li tittrasferixxi l-enerġija lejn tagħbija biex tinbidel f'xogħol, sħana jew forom oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有功功率，即电路中实际用于能量转换的平均电功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-potenza elettrika medja li tagħbija tuża biex tikkonverti l-enerġija f'xogħol, sħana jew forom oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Active power is the average electrical power transferred to a load and converted into work, heat, or other forms of energy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实际功率，即有功功率，指实际传递给负载并用于能量转换的平均电功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-potenza attiva, jiġifieri l-potenza medja li tittrasferixxi l-enerġija lejn tagħbija għal konverżjoni f'forom oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Real power is another name for the average electrical power that a load converts into other forms of energy.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实功率，即有功功率，指以瓦特计量、实际用于能量转换的平均电功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu ieħor għall-potenza attiva, imkejla f'watts, li tirrappreżenta r-rata medja tal-konverżjoni tal-enerġija elettrika f'forom oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: True power refers to active power, measured in watts, which represents the average rate of electrical energy conversion.

collocations.en: the active power of the load

formal.mt: Ir-rapport tal-laboratorju juri li l-potenza attiva tat-tagħbija hija ta' 500 watt; dan il-valur jirrappreżenta r-rata medja li biha l-enerġija elettrika tinbidel f'forom oħra.
formal.en: The laboratory report shows that the active power of the load is 500 watts; this value represents the average rate at which electrical energy is converted into other forms.
formal.zh: 实验室报告显示，负载的有功功率为500瓦；这一数值表示电能转化为其他形式能量的平均速率。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-miter juri l-potenza attiva? Pawlu: Iva, jurik kemm hi f'watts. Lara: Mela dan hu l-valur li nuża biex nikkalkula l-enerġija għal siegħa, jekk jibqa' l-istess? Pawlu: Eżatt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this meter show active power? Pawlu: Yes, it shows you the value in watts. Lara: So this is the value I use to calculate the energy for one hour, if it stays the same? Pawlu: Exactly.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个表显示的是有功功率吗？Pawlu：对，它显示以瓦特为单位的数值。Lara：那么，如果数值不变，我就用这个值计算一小时的电能吗？Pawlu：没错。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-miter juri l-potenza attiva?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-miter juri l-potenza attiva?
messages.zh: 这个表显示的是有功功率吗？
messages.en: Does this meter show active power?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jurik kemm hi f'watts.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jurik kemm hi f'watts.
messages.zh: 对，它显示以瓦特为单位的数值。
messages.en: Yes, it shows you the value in watts.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela dan hu l-valur li nuża biex nikkalkula l-enerġija għal siegħa, jekk jibqa' l-istess?
messages.mt_standard: Mela dan hu l-valur li nuża biex nikkalkula l-enerġija għal siegħa, jekk jibqa' l-istess?
messages.zh: 那么，如果数值不变，我就用这个值计算一小时的电能吗？
messages.en: So this is the value I use to calculate the energy for one hour, if it stays the same?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Eżatt.
messages.zh: 没错。
messages.en: Exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 attiva 联想到“实际干活”：电能变成热、光或机械功时，记住有功功率用瓦特表示。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reactive electrical power associated with energy exchanged back and forth between a source and electric or magnetic fields in an alternating-current circuit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交流电路中，与电源和电场或磁场之间往返交换的能量有关的无功功率；这种交换本身不产生净能量消耗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-potenza reattiva marbuta mal-enerġija li f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti tgħaddi bejn is-sors u l-kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi u terġa' lura, mingħajr konsum nett minn dan l-iskambju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无功功率，表示交流电路中与电场或磁场储能和释能有关的能量往返交换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-potenza li tirrappreżenta l-iskambju tal-enerġija bejn is-sors u l-kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reactive power describes the electrical power associated with energy stored temporarily in electric or magnetic fields and then returned.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无瓦功率，即无功功率，强调这种功率不代表以瓦特计量的平均净能量转换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-potenza reattiva, li ma tirrappreżentax konverżjoni medja netta tal-enerġija u titkejjel f'var minflok f'watts.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wattless power is another term for reactive power, whose energy exchange produces no net energy conversion over a complete cycle.

formal.mt: Fit-tabella tar-riżultati, il-potenza bla watts tingħata f'var u l-potenza attiva tingħata f'watts, sabiex iż-żewġ kwantitajiet ikunu distinti b'mod ċar.
formal.en: In the results table, wattless power is given in var and active power is given in watts, so that the two quantities are clearly distinguished.
formal.zh: 结果表中，无功功率以var表示，有功功率以瓦特表示，以便明确区分这两个量。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hawn miktub potenza bla watts. Jiġifieri m'hemmx enerġija għaddejja? David: Le, l-enerġija tgħaddi u terġa' lura; dan l-iskambju ma jagħtix konsum nett fuq ċiklu sħiħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: It says wattless power here. Does that mean no energy is flowing? David: No, energy flows out and returns; this exchange gives no net consumption over a complete cycle.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里写着无瓦功率。是不是说没有能量流动？David：不是，能量会流出再返回；这种交换在一个完整周期内没有净消耗。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub potenza bla watts. Jiġifieri m'hemmx enerġija għaddejja?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub potenza bla watts. Jiġifieri m'hemmx enerġija għaddejja?
messages.zh: 这里写着无瓦功率。是不是说没有能量流动？
messages.en: It says wattless power here. Does that mean no energy is flowing?

messages.speaker: David (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-enerġija tgħaddi u terġa' lura; dan l-iskambju ma jagħtix konsum nett fuq ċiklu sħiħ.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-enerġija tgħaddi u terġa' lura; dan l-iskambju ma jagħtix konsum nett fuq ċiklu sħiħ.
messages.zh: 不是，能量会流出再返回；这种交换在一个完整周期内没有净消耗。
messages.en: No, energy flows out and returns; this exchange gives no net consumption over a complete cycle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bla watts 当作“无瓦”的字面记忆提示：能量仍可往返交换，只是不形成平均净做功；无功功率看var。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Reactive power in an alternating-current circuit, associated with the temporary storage and return of energy in electric or magnetic fields.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交流电路中的无功功率，与电场或磁场暂时储存并随后返还能量的过程有关。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-potenza reattiva f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti, marbuta mal-ħażna temporanja tal-enerġija f'kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi u mar-ritorn tagħha lejn is-sors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无功功率，指交流电路中与电场或磁场的周期性储能和释能有关的功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-potenza marbuta mal-enerġija li tinħażen temporanjament f'kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi u mbagħad terġa' tingħata lura f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reactive power is associated with the repeated storage and return of energy in the electric or magnetic fields of an alternating-current circuit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无瓦功率，即无功功率；其所对应的能量交换在完整周期内不产生净能量转换。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu ieħor għall-potenza reattiva, li l-iskambju tal-enerġija tagħha ma jipproduċix konverżjoni netta fuq ċiklu sħiħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wattless power refers to reactive power, for which the exchanged energy does not produce net energy conversion over a full cycle.

collocations.en: the reactive power of a motor

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju, il-potenza passiva tal-mutur għandha tiġi identifikata separatament mill-potenza attiva, għax tirrappreżenta l-iskambju tal-enerġija marbut mal-kamp manjetiku.
formal.en: In the exercise, the motor's reactive power should be identified separately from its active power because it represents the energy exchange associated with the magnetic field.
formal.zh: 练习中应将电动机的无功功率与有功功率分别标明，因为无功功率表示与磁场有关的能量交换。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-potenza passiva tfisser li l-mutur huwa mitfi? Rita: Le, hawn tfisser potenza reattiva. Il-mutur jista' jkun qed jaħdem u jkollu kemm potenza attiva kif ukoll potenza passiva.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does passive power mean the motor is switched off? Rita: No, here it means reactive power. The motor can be running and have both active power and reactive power.
colloquial.zh: Mark：被动功率是不是指电动机关闭了？Rita：不是，这里指无功功率。电动机运行时可以同时具有有功功率和无功功率。

messages.speaker: Mark (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-potenza passiva tfisser li l-mutur huwa mitfi?
messages.mt_standard: Il-potenza passiva tfisser li l-mutur huwa mitfi?
messages.zh: 被动功率是不是指电动机关闭了？
messages.en: Does passive power mean the motor is switched off?

messages.speaker: Rita (电工)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn tfisser potenza reattiva. Il-mutur jista' jkun qed jaħdem u jkollu kemm potenza attiva kif ukoll potenza passiva.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn tfisser potenza reattiva. Il-mutur jista' jkun qed jaħdem u jkollu kemm potenza attiva kif ukoll potenza passiva.
messages.zh: 不是，这里指无功功率。电动机运行时可以同时具有有功功率和无功功率。
messages.en: No, here it means reactive power. The motor can be running and have both active power and reactive power.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习本词条时，把 passiva 记成“储能再返还”的提示画面；整词对应无功功率，不要误记成停机或待机功率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Electrical power associated with energy that moves back and forth between a source and electric or magnetic fields in an alternating-current circuit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 交流电路中，与电源和电场或磁场之间往返交换的能量有关的电功率，通常以var表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-potenza elettrika marbuta mal-enerġija li tgħaddi bejn is-sors u l-kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi u terġa' lura f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti, normalment imkejla f'var.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无功功率，指交流电路中与电场或磁场储存并返还能量有关的功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-potenza f'ċirkwit ta' kurrent alternanti li hija marbuta mal-ħażna tal-enerġija f'kampi elettriċi jew manjetiċi u mar-ritorn tagħha lejn is-sors.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Reactive power represents the power associated with energy exchanged between the source and electric or magnetic fields in an alternating-current circuit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无瓦功率，即无功功率，表示完整周期内不造成净能量转换的往返能量交换所对应的功率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem ieħor għall-potenza reattiva, li tirrappreżenta skambju tal-enerġija mingħajr konverżjoni netta fuq ċiklu sħiħ u titkejjel f'var.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wattless power is a name for reactive power, measured in var, which involves energy exchange without net conversion over a complete cycle.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw kif il-kumpens tal-potenza reattiva jista' jnaqqas il-potenza reattiva li tittieħed mis-sors, filwaqt li t-tagħbija tibqa' tirċievi l-istess potenza attiva.
formal.en: Students should explain how reactive power compensation can reduce the reactive power drawn from the source while the load continues to receive the same active power.
formal.zh: 学生应说明，无功功率补偿如何在负载继续获得相同有功功率的同时，减少从电源取得的无功功率。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex poġġejtu dan il-kapaċitatur ħdejn il-mutur? Toni: Biex jgħin fil-kumpens tal-potenza reattiva. Sara: Jiġifieri l-mutur jibqa' jagħmel l-istess xogħol? Toni: Iva, l-għan hu li nnaqqsu l-potenza reattiva mis-sors.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you put this capacitor beside the motor? Toni: To help compensate for reactive power. Sara: So the motor keeps doing the same work? Toni: Yes, the aim is to reduce the reactive power drawn from the source.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你们为什么在电动机旁边装这个电容器？Toni：用来帮助补偿无功功率。Sara：也就是说，电动机仍然做同样的功？Toni：对，目的是减少从电源取得的无功功率。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejtu dan il-kapaċitatur ħdejn il-mutur?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejtu dan il-kapaċitatur ħdejn il-mutur?
messages.zh: 你们为什么在电动机旁边装这个电容器？
messages.en: Why did you put this capacitor beside the motor?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jgħin fil-kumpens tal-potenza reattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jgħin fil-kumpens tal-potenza reattiva.
messages.zh: 用来帮助补偿无功功率。
messages.en: To help compensate for reactive power.

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-mutur jibqa' jagħmel l-istess xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-mutur jibqa' jagħmel l-istess xogħol?
messages.zh: 也就是说，电动机仍然做同样的功？
messages.en: So the motor keeps doing the same work?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-għan hu li nnaqqsu l-potenza reattiva mis-sors.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-għan hu li nnaqqsu l-potenza reattiva mis-sors.
messages.zh: 对，目的是减少从电源取得的无功功率。
messages.en: Yes, the aim is to reduce the reactive power drawn from the source.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 reattiva 配上来回箭头来记：能量在电源与电场或磁场之间往返，整词就是无功功率，常用var表示。

gloss_zh: 适销性；产品吸引买家并售出的潜力

teaching_sense.en_definition: The capacity of a product to attract buyers and sell successfully in a market.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 产品吸引买家并在市场上成功售出的能力或潜力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħila ta' prodott li jattira xerrejja u jinbiegħ b'suċċess fis-suq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 适销性，即产品对潜在买家的吸引力以及在市场上售出的可能性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grad li fih prodott ikun attraenti għal xerrejja potenzjali u jkun jista' jinbiegħ fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The marketability of a product is its ability to attract customers and be sold successfully.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tniedi l-prodott, il-kumpanija għandha tevalwa l-potenzjal tal-bejgħ tiegħu permezz ta' riċerka tas-suq.
formal.en: Before launching the product, the company should assess its marketability through market research.
formal.zh: 推出产品前，公司应通过市场调研评估其适销性。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Taħseb li din il-borża għandha potenzjal tal-bejgħ? Pawlu: Iva, hija prattika u l-prezz tajjeb. Naħseb li ħafna nies jixtruha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Do you think this bag has sales potential? Pawlu: Yes, it is practical and reasonably priced. I think many people would buy it.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你觉得这款包有销售潜力吗？Pawlu：有，它很实用，价格也合适。我觉得很多人会买。

messages.speaker: Marta (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li din il-borża għandha potenzjal tal-bejgħ?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li din il-borża għandha potenzjal tal-bejgħ?
messages.zh: 你觉得这款包有销售潜力吗？
messages.en: Do you think this bag has sales potential?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija prattika u l-prezz tajjeb. Naħseb li ħafna nies jixtruha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija prattika u l-prezz tajjeb. Naħseb li ħafna nies jixtruha.
messages.zh: 有，它很实用，价格也合适。我觉得很多人会买。
messages.en: Yes, it is practical and reasonably priced. I think many people would buy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词组联系到新品上架前的提问：“有人想买吗，卖得出去吗？”用买家的兴趣来记住“适销性、销售潜力”。

gloss_zh: 权力；支配或影响他人的力量

teaching_sense.en_definition: The authority or ability to control decisions, influence people, or direct events.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 控制决策、影响他人或主导事态发展的权力或能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-awtorità jew il-ħila li wieħed jikkontrolla deċiżjonijiet, jinfluwenza lin-nies jew imexxi l-ġrajjiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权力或支配力，指控制他人、决定事务或影响结果的能力与权限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-awtorità jew il-kapaċità li persuna jew istituzzjoni għandha biex tikkontrolla lil ħaddieħor, tieħu deċiżjonijiet jew tinfluwenza r-riżultati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone has power, they have the authority or ability to control people, make decisions, or influence what happens.

formal.mt: L-istituzzjonijiet pubbliċi għandhom jużaw il-poter tagħhom b'responsabbiltà u fl-interess taċ-ċittadini.
formal.en: Public institutions should exercise their power responsibly and in the interests of citizens.
formal.zh: 公共机构应负责任地行使权力，并以公民利益为依归。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għandu l-poter li jbiddel din ir-regola? Mark: Id-direttur. Aħna nistgħu nagħmlulu proposta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who has the power to change this rule? Mark: The director. We can make a proposal to him.
colloquial.zh: Sara：谁有权修改这条规定？Mark：主任。我们可以向他提出建议。

messages.speaker: Sara (员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għandu l-poter li jbiddel din ir-regola?
messages.mt_standard: Min għandu l-poter li jbiddel din ir-regola?
messages.zh: 谁有权修改这条规定？
messages.en: Who has the power to change this rule?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-direttur. Aħna nistgħu nagħmlulu proposta.
messages.mt_standard: Id-direttur. Aħna nistgħu nagħmlulu proposta.
messages.zh: 主任。我们可以向他提出建议。
messages.en: The director. We can make a proposal to him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象会议中能最终拍板的人，把 poter 和“谁有决定权”一起记；再用“掌权”和“滥权”两个场景巩固。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Living with a partner as a couple without being married to that partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与伴侣以夫妻般的关系共同生活，但彼此没有结婚的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħix ma' sieħeb jew sieħba bħala koppja mingħajr ma jkunu miżżewġin lil xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与伴侣共同生活、但彼此并未结婚的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħix fl-istess dar ma' sieħeb jew sieħba f'relazzjoni ta' koppja mingħajr żwieġ bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is poġġut lives with a partner as a couple without being married to that partner.

collocations.en: a man cohabiting with a partner
collocations.zh: 与伴侣未婚同居的男子

collocations.en: to live with a partner without being married

collocations.zh: 与他的女性伴侣未婚同居的

formal.mt: Il-karattru prinċipali tar-rumanz huwa raġel poġġut li jaqsam dar mas-sieħba tiegħu.
formal.en: The novel's main character is a cohabiting man who shares a home with his partner.
formal.zh: 这部小说的主人公是一名与伴侣未婚同居、共同居住的男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk miżżewweġ? Mark: Le, jgħix poġġut mas-sieħba tiegħu. Maja: Ilhom jgħixu flimkien? Mark: Iva, ilhom tliet snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother married? Mark: No, he lives with his partner without being married. Maja: Have they been living together long? Mark: Yes, for three years.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥结婚了吗？Mark：没有，他和伴侣未婚同居。Maja：他们一起住很久了吗？Mark：是的，已经三年了。

messages.mt_standard: Le, jgħix poġġut mas-sieħba tiegħu.
messages.zh: 没有，他和伴侣未婚同居。
messages.en: No, he lives with his partner without being married.

messages.mt_standard: Ilhom jgħixu flimkien?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, ilhom tliet snin.

messages.en: Yes, for three years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一幅生活画面记 poġġut：两位伴侣共住一个家、彼此未结婚；整块记住 jgħix poġġut，表示未婚同居。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A position in which someone holds their body, or the calm and graceful way they carry themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体保持的姿势，也可指一个人从容、稳重而优雅的仪态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pożizzjoni li fiha persuna żżomm ġisimha, jew il-mod kalm, bilanċjat u eleganti kif iġġib ruħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 姿势，尤指为拍照、绘画或展示而有意保持的身体位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pożizzjoni tal-ġisem li persuna tieħu u żżomm, speċjalment biex tiġi fotografata, impinġija jew murija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pose is a particular position in which someone holds their body, especially for a photograph or painting.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从容优雅的仪态，表现为身体姿态稳当、举止自然且有自信。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kwalità li persuna żżomm ġisimha u ġġib ruħha b'bilanċ, kalma, eleganza u kunfidenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Poise is the calm confidence and graceful control that someone shows in their posture and behaviour.

collocations.en: to strike a pose for a photograph
an elegant pose or graceful bearing

formal.mt: Il-kritiċi faħħru l-poża eleganti taż-żeffiena u l-kontroll li wriet f'kull moviment.
formal.en: The critics praised the dancer's graceful poise and the control she showed in every movement.
formal.zh: 评论家赞扬了这位女舞者优雅的仪态，以及她在每个动作中展现的控制力。

colloquial.mt: Ninu: Tista' tieħu poża ħdejn it-tieqa? Lara: Hekk tajjeb, jew indur ftit? Ninu: Hekk tajjeb. Żomm rasek dritta u ħares lejja.
colloquial.en: Ninu: Can you strike a pose by the window? Lara: Is this all right, or should I turn a little? Ninu: That is good. Keep your head straight and look at me.
colloquial.zh: Ninu：你能在窗边摆个姿势吗？Lara：这样可以吗，还是稍微转一下身？Ninu：这样很好。头保持端正，看着我。

messages.speaker: Ninu (摄影师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tieħu poża ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tieħu poża ħdejn it-tieqa?
messages.zh: 你能在窗边摆个姿势吗？
messages.en: Can you strike a pose by the window?

messages.speaker: Lara (模特)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk tajjeb, jew indur ftit?
messages.mt_standard: Hekk tajjeb, jew indur ftit?
messages.zh: 这样可以吗，还是稍微转一下身？
messages.en: Is this all right, or should I turn a little?

messages.speaker: Ninu (摄影师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hekk tajjeb. Żomm rasek dritta u ħares lejja.
messages.mt_standard: Hekk tajjeb. Żomm rasek dritta u ħares lejja.
messages.zh: 这样很好。头保持端正，看着我。
messages.en: That is good. Keep your head straight and look at me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分：镜头前定格的身体位置是“姿势”，舞台上自然稳重的整体风度是“仪态”；poża 可用于这两种意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container or stand used to hold umbrellas upright, usually near an entrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于竖放雨伞的容器或架子，通常放在入口附近。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent jew struttura fejn jitqiegħdu l-umbrelel wieqfa, normalment ħdejn id-daħla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 雨伞架或雨伞桶，指放在门口等处、供竖立收放雨伞的用具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Reċipjent jew struttura li żżomm l-umbrelel wieqfa u miġbura f'post wieħed, spiss fid-daħla ta' bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An umbrella stand is a container or frame in which umbrellas are stored upright, usually near a building's entrance.

collocations.en: an umbrella stand beside the door
to put an umbrella in the umbrella stand

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi huma mitluba jħallu l-umbrelel imxarrbin fil-pożambrella ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: Visitors are asked to leave wet umbrellas in the umbrella stand beside the entrance.
formal.zh: 请访客将湿雨伞放在入口旁的雨伞架内。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inpoġġi l-umbrella? Għadha mxarrba. Rita: Poġġiha fil-pożambrella ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where should I put my umbrella? It is still wet. Rita: Put it in the umbrella stand beside the door, please.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我的雨伞放哪儿？它还湿着。Rita：请把它放在门旁的雨伞架里。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi l-umbrella? Għadha mxarrba.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi l-umbrella? Għadha mxarrba.
messages.zh: 我的雨伞放哪儿？它还湿着。
messages.en: Where should I put my umbrella? It is still wet.

messages.speaker: Rita (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġiha fil-pożambrella ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġiha fil-pożambrella ħdejn il-bieb, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请把它放在门旁的雨伞架里。
messages.en: Put it in the umbrella stand beside the door, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pożambrella 配上“门口几把雨伞竖着排队”的画面，再练习“把伞放进去”，就能记住它是收放雨伞的架子或桶。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing an attitude, response, or result that expresses optimism, approval, or a favourable outcome.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容态度积极乐观、回应表示赞同，或结果良好、有利。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ottimiżmu jew approvazzjoni, jew li jindika riżultat tajjeb jew favorevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 积极的、正面的；表示肯定或赞同的；形容结果时指良好或有利的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jesprimi ottimiżmu, kunsens jew approvazzjoni, jew li juri li xi ħaġa kellha riżultat tajjeb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An attitude, response, or result that is positive shows optimism, expresses approval, or indicates a favourable outcome.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-proġett kellu effett pożittiv fuq il-komunità.
formal.en: The report shows that the project had a positive effect on the community.
formal.zh: 报告显示，该项目对社区产生了积极影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejjer il-kors il-ġdid? Mark: Għadu diffiċli, imma qed inżomm atteġġjament pożittiv.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the new course going? Mark: It is still difficult, but I am keeping a positive attitude.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新课程学得怎么样？马克：还是挺难的，不过我保持着积极的态度。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer il-kors il-ġdid?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer il-kors il-ġdid?
messages.zh: 新课程学得怎么样？
messages.en: How is the new course going?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu diffiċli, imma qed inżomm atteġġjament pożittiv.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu diffiċli, imma qed inżomm atteġġjament pożittiv.
messages.zh: 还是挺难的，不过我保持着积极的态度。
messages.en: It is still difficult, but I am keeping a positive attitude.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pożittiv 和“积极态度、正面评价、良好结果”三幅画面一起记，遇到具体搭配再确定中文意思。

gloss_zh: 被放置在某位置的；已定位的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Placed or arranged in a particular location or orientation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被安放或安排在某个具体位置，或朝向某个方向的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Imqiegħed jew irranġat f'post partikolari jew b'orjentazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已被放置、安排或定位在某个位置或方向的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'ċertu post jew iħares f'ċerta direzzjoni minħabba l-mod kif tqiegħed jew ġie rranġat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is positioned in a particular place has been put or arranged there.

formal.mt: Il-monitor għandu jkun pożizzjonat quddiem l-utent, bl-iskrin fil-livell tal-għajnejn.
formal.en: The monitor should be positioned in front of the user, with the screen at eye level.
formal.zh: 显示器应放置在使用者面前，屏幕与视线齐平。

colloquial.mt: Sara: It-televixin jidher sew minn hemm? Pawlu: Iva, issa pożizzjonat sew u nista' narah mis-sufan.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you see the television clearly from there? Pawlu: Yes, it is well positioned now, and I can see it from the sofa.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：从那里看电视清楚吗？保罗：清楚，现在位置摆好了，我坐在沙发上就能看见。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-televixin jidher sew minn hemm?
messages.mt_standard: It-televixin jidher sew minn hemm?
messages.zh: 从那里看电视清楚吗？
messages.en: Can you see the television clearly from there?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa pożizzjonat sew u nista' narah mis-sufan.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa pożizzjonat sew u nista' narah mis-sufan.
messages.zh: 清楚，现在位置摆好了，我坐在沙发上就能看见。
messages.en: Yes, it is well positioned now, and I can see it from the sofa.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把显示器摆好后贴上“位置已定”的标签，用 pożizzjonat 描述摆放完成后的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The balance remaining after related opposing amounts, such as assets and liabilities, have been offset.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将相互对应的金额抵销后剩余的净额状况，例如资产减去负债后的余额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-bilanċ li jibqa' wara li jitnaqqsu ammonti korrispondenti minn xulxin, bħal meta jitnaqqsu l-obbligazzjonijiet mill-assi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净头寸，指将相关的相反金额相互抵销后所剩的余额或财务状况，例如资产扣除负债后的净额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda finanzjarja li tirriżulta wara li jitnaqqsu ammonti opposti jew korrispondenti minn xulxin, bħall-valur tal-assi wara t-tnaqqis tal-obbligazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A net position is the balance left after related opposing amounts, such as assets and liabilities, have been offset.

collocations.en: the calculation of the net position

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, assi ta' għaxart elef ewro u obbligazzjonijiet ta' sitt elef ewro jagħtu pożizzjoni netta ta' erbat elef ewro.
formal.en: In this example, assets of ten thousand euros and liabilities of six thousand euros give a net position of four thousand euros.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，一万欧元的资产减去六千欧元的负债，得到四千欧元的净头寸。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għandna elfejn ewro fil-kont u ħames mitt ewro x'nagħtu. Kemm hi l-pożizzjoni netta tagħna? Toni: Jekk ngħoddu dawn biss, il-pożizzjoni netta hi elf u ħames mitt ewro.
colloquial.en: Marija: We have two thousand euros in the account and owe five hundred euros. What is our net position? Toni: If we count only those amounts, our net position is one thousand five hundred euros.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们账户里有两千欧元，还欠五百欧元。我们的净头寸是多少？托尼：如果只算这两笔金额，净头寸就是一千五百欧元。

messages.speaker: Marija (社团财务负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna elfejn ewro fil-kont u ħames mitt ewro x'nagħtu. Kemm hi l-pożizzjoni netta tagħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna elfejn ewro fil-kont u ħames mitt ewro x'nagħtu. Kemm hi l-pożizzjoni netta tagħna?
messages.zh: 我们账户里有两千欧元，还欠五百欧元。我们的净头寸是多少？
messages.en: We have two thousand euros in the account and owe five hundred euros. What is our net position?

messages.speaker: Toni (社团成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk ngħoddu dawn biss, il-pożizzjoni netta hi elf u ħames mitt ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk ngħoddu dawn biss, il-pożizzjoni netta hi elf u ħames mitt ewro.
messages.zh: 如果只算这两笔金额，净头寸就是一千五百欧元。
messages.en: If we count only those amounts, our net position is one thousand five hundred euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两千减五百，净剩一千五”的小账本记 pożizzjoni netta，重点是抵销后的净额状况。

gloss_zh: 拍照时噘嘴；模仿鸭嘴噘起嘴唇

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push one's lips forward while posing for a photograph or to imitate a duck's beak.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拍照摆姿势时将嘴唇向前噘起，或通过噘嘴模仿鸭嘴的样子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ xufftejh 'il barra waqt li jippoża għal ritratt jew biex jimita l-munqar ta' papra.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pout while posing for a picture
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为拍照摆姿势时噘起嘴唇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ xufftejh 'il quddiem bħala parti mill-poża tiegħu meta jkun qed jittieħed ritratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does this while posing for a picture, they push their lips forward as part of their pose.

sense_translations.en_definition: to pout one's lips in imitation to a duck
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将嘴唇向前噘起，模仿鸭嘴的形状。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Joħroġ xufftejh 'il barra u jagħtihom għamla li tixbah il-munqar ta' papra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone does this to imitate a duck, they push their lips outward to resemble its beak.

collocations.mt: ppapra waqt li ppoża għal ritratt
collocations.en: pouted while posing for a photograph
pouted like a duck in front of the mirror
collocations.zh: 对着镜子噘嘴模仿鸭嘴

collocations.en: pouted his lips to imitate a duck

formal.mt: Waqt il-lezzjoni tal-fotografija, il-mudell ppapra għal ritratt u mbagħad tbissem għar-ritratt li jmiss.
formal.en: During the photography lesson, the model pouted for one photograph and then smiled for the next.
formal.zh: 在摄影课上，模特拍一张照片时噘起了嘴，拍下一张时则露出了微笑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex Mark ppapra fir-ritratt? Lara: Ried jimita papra u jdaħħakna!
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark pout in the photograph? Lara: He wanted to imitate a duck and make us laugh!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么在照片里噘着嘴？拉拉：他想模仿鸭子，逗我们笑！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex Mark ppapra fir-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex Mark ppapra fir-ritratt?
messages.zh: 马克为什么在照片里噘着嘴？
messages.en: Why did Mark pout in the photograph?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ried jimita papra u jdaħħakna!
messages.mt_standard: Ried jimita papra u jdaħħakna!
messages.zh: 他想模仿鸭子，逗我们笑！
messages.en: He wanted to imitate a duck and make us laugh!

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时做一次“嘴唇前伸成鸭嘴”的动作，再想象镜头拍下这一刻，把模仿鸭嘴和拍照噘嘴两个义项一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To leave a vehicle stationary in a place for a period of time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把车辆停放在某处，使其暂时保持不动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħalla vettura wieqfa f'post għal xi żmien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 停车；把车辆停放在某处。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħalla karozza jew vettura oħra wieqfa f'post għal xi żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone parks a vehicle, they leave it stationary somewhere for a period of time.

formal.mt: Is-sewwieq ipparkja l-karozza fil-post indikat u daħal fl-uffiċċju.
formal.en: The driver parked the car in the designated space and entered the office.
formal.zh: 司机把汽车停在指定车位，然后走进办公室。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ipparkja Mark? Lara: Ipparkja ħdejn il-ħanut. Ġej hawn bil-mixi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark park? Lara: He parked near the shop. He's walking here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把车停哪儿了？拉拉：他停在商店附近，正走过来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn ipparkja Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn ipparkja Mark?
messages.zh: 马克把车停哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark park?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ipparkja ħdejn il-ħanut. Ġej hawn bil-mixi.
messages.mt_standard: Ipparkja ħdejn il-ħanut. Ġej hawn bil-mixi.
messages.zh: 他停在商店附近，正走过来。
messages.en: He parked near the shop. He's walking here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词与“汽车进入车位后停稳”的画面绑定，搭配 l-karozza 一起记忆，明确表示停放车辆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To collect someone, usually in a vehicle, and take them somewhere.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常指开车到约定地点接上某人，再载其前往别处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mar għal xi ħadd, ġeneralment b'vettura, biex jieħdu miegħu lejn post ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 接某人；通常指开车去接上某人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mar jiġbor lil xi ħadd minn post, ġeneralment b'vettura, biex iwasslu xi mkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone picks a person up, they collect that person, usually in a vehicle, and take them somewhere.

collocations.en: picked up his sister from the airport

formal.mt: Mark ippikkja lill-mistieden mill-ajruport u wasslu fil-lukanda qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: Mark picked up the guest from the airport and took him to the hotel before the meeting.
formal.zh: 马克到机场接上客人，并在会议前把他送到了酒店。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Mark diġà ppikkja lil Pawlu? Maja: Iva, ppikkjah minn quddiem id-dar. Qegħdin fi triqthom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has Mark picked up Pawlu yet? Maja: Yes, he picked him up outside the house. They're on their way.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克已经接上保罗了吗？玛雅：接上了，就在家门口接的。他们正在路上。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà ppikkja lil Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà ppikkja lil Pawlu?
messages.zh: 马克已经接上保罗了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark picked up Pawlu yet?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ppikkjah minn quddiem id-dar. Qegħdin fi triqthom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ppikkjah minn quddiem id-dar. Qegħdin fi triqthom.
messages.zh: 接上了，就在家门口接的。他们正在路上。
messages.en: Yes, he picked him up outside the house. They're on their way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友在门口等车，你开车到达后让他上车；把整个“去接人”的动作与这个词一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put a seed or plant into the soil so that it can grow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把种子或植物放入土壤中，使其能够生长。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed żerriegħa jew xitla fil-ħamrija biex tikber.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 种植；把种子或植物种入土壤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Daħħal żerriegħa jew l-għeruq ta' xitla fil-ħamrija biex tkun tista' tikber.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone plants a seed or a plant, they put it into the soil so that it can grow.

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ippjanta siġra fil-bitħa tal-iskola u saqqa l-ħamrija ta' madwarha.
formal.en: The gardener planted a tree in the school courtyard and watered the soil around it.
formal.zh: 园丁在学校庭院里栽了一棵树，并给周围的土壤浇了水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel in-nannu fil-ġnien illum? Lara: Ippjanta żewġ siġriet. Ejja nsaqquhom!
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Grandpa do in the garden today? Lara: He planted two trees. Let's water them!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：爷爷今天在花园里做了什么？拉拉：他栽了两棵树。我们去给它们浇水吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għamel in-nannu fil-ġnien illum?
messages.mt_standard: X'għamel in-nannu fil-ġnien illum?
messages.zh: 爷爷今天在花园里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do in the garden today?

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Ippjanta żewġ siġriet. Ejja nsaqquhom!
messages.mt_standard: Ippjanta żewġ siġriet. Ejja nsaqquhom!
messages.zh: 他栽了两棵树。我们去给它们浇水吧！
messages.en: He planted two trees. Let's water them!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“挖坑、放入树苗、覆土”的连续画面记忆这个词，再联想 siġra（树），记住栽种的动作。

gloss_zh: 被附身的；被邪灵控制的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Described as being controlled by an evil spirit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容被认为受到邪灵控制、仿佛无法自主行动的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jitqies bħala persuna taħt il-kontroll ta' spirtu ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被附身的；被认为受到邪灵控制的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jingħad li jinsab taħt il-kontroll ta' spirtu ħażin li daħal fih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone described as possessed is believed to be controlled by an evil spirit.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, ir-raġel huwa deskritt bħala pposedut minn spirtu ħażin, u l-karattri l-oħra jibżgħu minnu.
formal.en: In the story, the man is described as possessed by an evil spirit, and the other characters are afraid of him.
formal.zh: 在故事中，这个男人被描写为遭邪灵附身，其他人物都害怕他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-film qed jitkellem hekk? Lara: Fl-istorja huwa pposedut minn spirtu ħażin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the man in the film talking like that? Lara: In the story, he's possessed by an evil spirit.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：电影里的那个男人为什么那样说话？拉拉：按照故事情节，他被邪灵附身了。

messages.speaker: Maja (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-film qed jitkellem hekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-raġel fil-film qed jitkellem hekk?
messages.zh: 电影里的那个男人为什么那样说话？
messages.en: Why is the man in the film talking like that?

messages.speaker: Lara (观影的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-istorja huwa pposedut minn spirtu ħażin.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-istorja huwa pposedut minn spirtu ħażin.
messages.zh: 按照故事情节，他被邪灵附身了。
messages.en: In the story, he's possessed by an evil spirit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 联想恐怖故事里人物被邪灵操控的情节，把这个词记作描述人物状态的形容词：“被附身的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat a meal, especially the midday meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进餐，尤其指吃午餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kiel ikla, speċjalment l-ikla ta' nofsinhar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用餐，尤指吃午餐。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kiel ikla, normalment f'nofsinhar, waħdu jew ma' nies oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone dines, they eat a meal, often in company or at a restaurant.

formal.mt: Wara ż-żjara uffiċjali, id-direttur ppranza mal-membri tal-kumitat.
formal.en: After the official visit, the director had lunch with the committee members.
formal.zh: 正式访问结束后，主任与委员会成员共进了午餐。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà ppranza? Lara: Iva, ppranza magħna f'nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark had lunch already? Lara: Yes, he had lunch with us at noon.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark已经吃过午饭了吗？Lara：是的，他中午和我们一起吃了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà ppranza?
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà ppranza?
messages.zh: Mark已经吃过午饭了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark had lunch already?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ppranza magħna f'nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ppranza magħna f'nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 是的，他中午和我们一起吃了。
messages.en: Yes, he had lunch with us at noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ppranza 放进“中午与家人围桌吃饭”的画面里；用“他吃了午餐”这一整句来记，比只记“吃”更准确。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To recognize or anticipate that something will happen before it actually happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在事情发生之前，预先看出或预料它会发生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ra jew fehem minn qabel li xi ħaġa kienet se tiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预见；事先预料到某事会发生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Induna minn qabel b'dak li seta' jiġri jew b'kif setgħet tiżviluppa sitwazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone foresees an event or difficulty, they recognize that it is likely to happen before it occurs.

formal.mt: L-ekonomista ppreveda żieda fid-domanda u rrakkomanda li l-produzzjoni tiżdied.
formal.en: The economist foresaw an increase in demand and recommended increasing production.
formal.zh: 这位经济学家预见到需求将增长，并建议提高产量。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif wasal daqshekk kmieni Mark? Maja: Ppreveda t-traffiku u telaq qabel.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark arrive so early? Maja: He foresaw the traffic and left earlier.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark怎么这么早就到了？Maja：他预料到会堵车，所以提前出发了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif wasal daqshekk kmieni Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Kif wasal daqshekk kmieni Mark?
messages.zh: Mark怎么这么早就到了？
messages.en: How did Mark arrive so early?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ppreveda t-traffiku u telaq qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Ppreveda t-traffiku u telaq qabel.
messages.zh: 他预料到会堵车，所以提前出发了。
messages.en: He foresaw the traffic and left earlier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前先在脑海里看见堵车，于是提前出发；把 ppreveda 与“事情未发生，已经预料到”绑定记忆。

gloss_zh: 企业内部定价；转让定价

teaching_sense.en_definition: The setting of prices for goods, services, or other items transferred between units of a company or related companies.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为同一企业内部单位或关联企业之间转移的商品、服务或其他项目确定价格的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-iffissar tal-prezzijiet għal oġġetti, servizzi jew elementi oħra li jiġu ttrasferiti bejn unitajiet tal-istess kumpanija jew bejn kumpaniji relatati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 企业内部定价，即为同一企业不同部门或单位之间提供的商品、服务等确定内部价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iffissar ta' prezzijiet interni għall-oġġetti, għas-servizzi jew għal elementi oħra li jgħaddu bejn dipartimenti jew unitajiet tal-istess kumpanija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Intra-company pricing is the process of setting prices for goods or services exchanged between units within the same company.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 转让定价，即为关联企业之间转让商品、提供服务或转移其他项目所确定的交易价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iffissar tal-prezzijiet għal tranżazzjonijiet li jinvolvu oġġetti, servizzi jew elementi oħra bejn kumpaniji relatati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Transfer pricing is the practice of determining the prices charged in transactions between related companies.

collocations.zh: 部门之间的企业内部定价

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega l-politika ta' pprezzar tat-trasferimenti għas-servizzi pprovduti bejn il-kumpaniji tal-grupp.
formal.en: The report explains the transfer pricing policy for services provided between the companies in the group.
formal.zh: 该报告说明了集团内各公司之间提供服务时采用的转让定价政策。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex id-dipartiment tagħna jħallas lid-dipartiment tal-produzzjoni? Lara: Minħabba l-ipprezzar tat-trasferimenti; hekk kull dipartiment jista' jara l-ispejjeż tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why does our department pay the production department? Lara: Because of intra-company pricing; that way each department can see its own costs.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们部门为什么要向生产部门付费？Lara：这是企业内部定价的安排，这样每个部门都能看清自己的成本。

messages.speaker: Mark (部门员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dipartiment tagħna jħallas lid-dipartiment tal-produzzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dipartiment tagħna jħallas lid-dipartiment tal-produzzjoni?
messages.zh: 我们部门为什么要向生产部门付费？
messages.en: Why does our department pay the production department?

messages.speaker: Lara (财务同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Minħabba l-ipprezzar tat-trasferimenti; hekk kull dipartiment jista' jara l-ispejjeż tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Minħabba l-ipprezzar tat-trasferimenti; hekk kull dipartiment jista' jara l-ispejjeż tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这是企业内部定价的安排，这样每个部门都能看清自己的成本。
messages.en: Because of intra-company pricing; that way each department can see its own costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象商品从甲部门或甲公司流向乙部门或关联公司，箭头上贴着一个价格标签；用“内部流转也要定价”的画面记住这个术语。

gloss_zh: 被呈交给的；被介绍给的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Formally shown or submitted to someone, or made known to someone through an introduction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被正式展示或提交给某人的；也指经介绍而与某人相识的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ntwera jew tressaq formalment quddiem xi ħadd, jew li ġie mlaqqa' ma' xi ħadd permezz ta' introduzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被呈交、提交或正式展示给某人的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ngħata, intwera jew tressaq formalment lil persuna jew lil grupp biex jiġi eżaminat jew ikkunsidrat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something presented to a person or group has been formally shown or submitted for their attention.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被介绍给某人的；经人引见而与某人相识的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie mlaqqa' ma' persuna oħra permezz ta' xi ħadd li għamel l-introduzzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone introduced to another person has been made known to them through a social or formal introduction.

collocations.en: a report presented to the committee
a guest introduced to the president

formal.mt: Ir-rapport ippreżentat lill-kumitat jinkludi l-konklużjonijiet tal-istudju.
formal.en: The report presented to the committee includes the study's conclusions.
formal.zh: 提交给委员会的报告包含该研究的结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà jaf lid-direttur? Lara: Iva, ġie ppreżentat lilu waqt il-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does Mark already know the director? Lara: Yes, he was introduced to him at yesterday's meeting.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark已经认识主任了吗？Lara：是的，昨天开会时有人把他介绍给了主任。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark diġà jaf lid-direttur?
messages.mt_standard: Mark diġà jaf lid-direttur?
messages.zh: Mark已经认识主任了吗？
messages.en: Does Mark already know the director?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġie ppreżentat lilu waqt il-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġie ppreżentat lilu waqt il-laqgħa tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 是的，昨天开会时有人把他介绍给了主任。
messages.en: Yes, he was introduced to him at yesterday's meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画区分义项：报告递到委员手里，是“被呈交”；来宾由主持人引见，是“被介绍”。都记住动作有明确的接收对象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To produce a paper copy of text or an image using a printer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用打印机将文字或图像印在纸上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tipproduċi kopja fuq il-karta ta' test jew stampa billi tuża printer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将文字、图像或文件打印出来。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tipproduċi kopja stampata ta' dokument, test jew stampa billi tuża printer.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you print something, you use a printer to produce a copy of it on paper.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, pprintja kopja tar-rapport u ehmeż magħha l-formola ffirmata.
formal.en: Please print a copy of the report and attach the signed form to it.
formal.zh: 请打印一份报告，并将签署好的表格附在后面。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tipprintjali dan il-biljett? Mark: Iva, pprintja kopja oħra int ukoll, biex ikollna waħda żejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you print this ticket for me? Mark: Yes, print another copy yourself too, so we have a spare.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能帮我打印这张票吗？马克：可以，你也再打印一份吧，这样我们就有备用的了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tipprintjali dan il-biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tipprintjali dan il-biljett?
messages.zh: 你能帮我打印这张票吗？
messages.en: Can you print this ticket for me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, pprintja kopja oħra int ukoll, biex ikollna waħda żejda.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, pprintja kopja oħra int ukoll, biex ikollna waħda żejda.
messages.zh: 可以，你也再打印一份吧，这样我们就有备用的了。
messages.en: Yes, print another copy yourself too, so we have a spare.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pprintja 与打印机吐出纸张的画面绑定，连着 pprintja dokument 一起记，就是“打印文件”；这是场景记忆，不是词源分析。

gloss_zh: 已证实的；经验证有效的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Shown by evidence or experience to be true, reliable, or effective.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已由证据或实际经验确认真实、可靠或有效的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ntwera bi provi jew bl-esperjenza li huwa veru, affidabbli jew effettiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经证实的；经过实践验证为可靠或有效的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie kkonfermat bi provi jew bl-esperjenza bħala veru, affidabbli jew effettiv.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is proven has been shown by evidence or experience to be true, reliable, or effective.

collocations.zh: 经验证有效的补救办法

formal.mt: L-iskola adottat metodu ppruvat biex tgħin lill-istudenti jtejbu l-ħiliet tal-qari.
formal.en: The school adopted a proven method to help students improve their reading skills.
formal.zh: 学校采用了一种经验证有效的方法，帮助学生提高阅读能力。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-metodu jaħdem tassew? Pawlu: Iva, huwa metodu ppruvat; użajnieh is-sena l-oħra u tana riżultati tajbin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this method really work? Pawlu: Yes, it is a proven method; we used it last year and got good results.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个方法真的有效吗？保罗：有效，这是经过验证的方法；我们去年用过，效果很好。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-metodu jaħdem tassew?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-metodu jaħdem tassew?
messages.zh: 这个方法真的有效吗？
messages.en: Does this method really work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa metodu ppruvat; użajnieh is-sena l-oħra u tana riżultati tajbin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa metodu ppruvat; użajnieh is-sena l-oħra u tana riżultati tajbin.
messages.zh: 有效，这是经过验证的方法；我们去年用过，效果很好。
messages.en: Yes, it is a proven method; we used it last year and got good results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个方法旁边盖着“验证通过”的印章，把 metodu ppruvat 整体记成“经验证有效的方法”，突出证据或经验已经支持它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An approach that judges ideas and decisions by their practical results and usefulness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据实际效果和实用价值判断观念、选择或行动的思考方式与态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' ħsieb jew ta' azzjoni li jqis l-ideat u d-deċiżjonijiet skont ir-riżultati prattiċi u l-utilità tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实用主义；重视实际条件、可行办法及实际效果的务实态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni jew mod ta' ħsieb li jagħti importanza lill-kundizzjonijiet reali, lis-soluzzjonijiet fattibbli u lir-riżultati prattiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pragmatism is an approach in which you judge ideas and choices mainly by how useful they are and how well they work in practice.

collocations.zh: 政治实用主义；政治上的务实态度

formal.mt: Il-kumitat wera pragmatiżmu billi għażel soluzzjoni li setgħet titwettaq bir-riżorsi disponibbli.
formal.en: The committee showed pragmatism by choosing a solution that could be implemented with the available resources.
formal.zh: 委员会选择了一个能够利用现有资源实施的方案，表现出务实态度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: M'għandniex ħin biex nibdlu l-pjan kollu. Mark: Ejja nuru ftit pragmatiżmu u nirranġaw l-aktar ħaġa urġenti l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Lara: We don't have time to change the whole plan. Mark: Let's show a little pragmatism and fix the most urgent thing first.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们没有时间修改整个计划了。马克：我们务实一点，先处理最紧急的问题吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: M'għandniex ħin biex nibdlu l-pjan kollu.
messages.mt_standard: M'għandniex ħin biex nibdlu l-pjan kollu.
messages.zh: 我们没有时间修改整个计划了。
messages.en: We don't have time to change the whole plan.

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nuru ftit pragmatiżmu u nirranġaw l-aktar ħaġa urġenti l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nuru ftit pragmatiżmu u nirranġaw l-aktar ħaġa urġenti l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我们务实一点，先处理最紧急的问题吧。
messages.en: Let's show a little pragmatism and fix the most urgent thing first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pragmatiżmu 对应到“先看能否落实，再看实际效果”的决策画面；记住 juri pragmatiżmu，就是“表现出务实态度”。

gloss_zh: 务实的；注重实际效果的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Focused on practical results and what can realistically be done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 着重实际情况、可行办法和具体效果的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti importanza lil dak li jista' jsir fil-prattika u lir-riżultati konkreti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 务实的；根据实际条件和可行效果作出判断的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jqis iċ-ċirkostanzi reali u jagħżel soluzzjonijiet li jistgħu jaħdmu fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is pragmatic chooses workable solutions based on actual circumstances and likely results.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jirrakkomanda approċċ prammatiku li jqis il-baġit u l-ħin disponibbli.
formal.en: The report recommends a pragmatic approach that takes account of the budget and the time available.
formal.zh: 报告建议采用务实的方法，将预算和可用时间纳入考虑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ma nistgħux nagħmlu kollox illum. Pawlu: Ejja nieħdu approċċ prammatiku u nibdew bl-aktar ħaġa importanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: We can't do everything today. Pawlu: Let's take a pragmatic approach and start with the most important thing.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们今天做不完所有事情。Pawlu：我们务实一点，先从最重要的事情开始。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistgħux nagħmlu kollox illum.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistgħux nagħmlu kollox illum.
messages.zh: 我们今天做不完所有事情。
messages.en: We can't do everything today.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieħdu approċċ prammatiku u nibdew bl-aktar ħaġa importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieħdu approċċ prammatiku u nibdew bl-aktar ħaġa importanti.
messages.zh: 我们务实一点，先从最重要的事情开始。
messages.en: Let's take a pragmatic approach and start with the most important thing.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 approċċ prammatiku 联想成“先看条件，再选做得到的办法”，用具体行动记住“务实的”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Repeated activity used to improve a skill, or the actual use of knowledge and methods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为提高技能而反复进行的练习，也指将知识或方法用于实际，以及惯常采用的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħriġ ripetut biex titjieb ħila, l-użu ta' għarfien f'sitwazzjonijiet reali, jew mod kif normalment issir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 练习；知识或方法的实际运用；惯常采用的做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività ripetuta biex wieħed itejjeb ħila, it-twettiq ta' dak li jkun tgħallem, jew mod abitwali kif issir xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Practice is repeated activity that develops a skill, the actual application of knowledge, or an established way of doing something.

collocations.zh: 在实际操作中；在实践中

formal.mt: Il-kors jgħaqqad it-teorija mal-prattika permezz ta' eżerċizzji f'sitwazzjonijiet reali.
formal.en: The course combines theory with practice through exercises in real situations.
formal.zh: 这门课程通过真实情境中的练习，将理论与实践结合起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni nitħawwad meta nitkellem bil-Malti. Sara: Bi ftit prattika kuljum, tibda titkellem b'aktar kunfidenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: I still get confused when I speak Maltese. Sara: With a little practice every day, you'll start speaking more confidently.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我说马耳他语时还是会弄混。Sara：每天练习一点，你就会开始说得更有信心。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nitħawwad meta nitkellem bil-Malti.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nitħawwad meta nitkellem bil-Malti.
messages.zh: 我说马耳他语时还是会弄混。
messages.en: I still get confused when I speak Maltese.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bi ftit prattika kuljum, tibda titkellem b'aktar kunfidenza.
messages.mt_standard: Bi ftit prattika kuljum, tibda titkellem b'aktar kunfidenza.
messages.zh: 每天练习一点，你就会开始说得更有信心。
messages.en: With a little practice every day, you'll start speaking more confidently.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“每天练一点，再放到实际中使用”的画面记住 prattika；看到 prattika komuni 时则理解为“常见做法”。

gloss_zh: 几乎；实际上；从实际效果看

teaching_sense.en_definition: Almost completely, or in terms of what happens in actual practice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度上几乎完全如此，或表示从实际情况和效果来看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kważi għalkollox, jew meta wieħed iqis dak li jiġri fil-prattika u r-riżultati reali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 几乎；差不多；从实际情况或效果来看。
sense_translations.mt_definition: B'mod li jkun kważi sħiħ jew totali, jew skont kif l-affarijiet iseħħu fil-prattika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use practically to mean almost completely or to describe something in terms of its actual effects.

formal.mt: Mingħajr id-dokumenti meħtieġa, huwa prattikament impossibbli li titlesta l-proċedura fil-ħin.
formal.en: Without the required documents, it is practically impossible to complete the procedure on time.
formal.zh: 没有所需文件，几乎不可能按时完成这项程序。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lest biex noħorġu? Nina: Prattikament lesta; għad irrid nilbes iż-żraben.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you ready to go out? Nina: Practically ready; I just need to put my shoes on.
colloquial.zh: Mark：准备好出门了吗？Nina：差不多好了，就差穿鞋。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lest biex noħorġu?
messages.mt_standard: Lest biex noħorġu?
messages.zh: 准备好出门了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready to go out?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Prattikament lesta; għad irrid nilbes iż-żraben.
messages.mt_standard: Prattikament lesta; għad irrid nilbes iż-żraben.
messages.zh: 差不多好了，就差穿鞋。
messages.en: Practically ready; I just need to put my shoes on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prattikament lesta 记成“已经站在门口，只差穿鞋”，理解为“几乎好了”；也可按语境理解为“从实际效果看”。

gloss_zh: 掠夺性行为或做法；掠夺性定价；低于对手报价

teaching_sense.en_definition: Business practices intended to exploit others or weaken competitors, especially through aggressive pricing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在利用他人或削弱竞争对手的商业做法，尤其指通过激进定价排挤对手的做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prattiki kummerċjali maħsuba biex jieħdu vantaġġ minn ħaddieħor jew idgħajfu lill-kompetituri, speċjalment permezz tal-prezzijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性行为；以利用他人或损害竞争对手为目的的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba li tfittex li tieħu vantaġġ minn ħaddieħor jew tagħmel ħsara lill-kompetituri għall-benefiċċju ta' min iwettaqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Predatory behaviour involves exploiting other people or deliberately weakening competitors for one's own advantage.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性做法；为利用他人或排挤竞争对手而采用的经营手段。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Metodi ta' negozju użati biex wieħed jieħu vantaġġ minn ħaddieħor jew iwarrab lill-kompetituri mis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Predatory practices are business methods used to exploit others or drive competitors out of a market.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性定价；为排挤竞争对手而将价格压至成本以下的定价行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-iffissar ta' prezzijiet taħt l-ispiża bil-għan li l-kompetituri jitwarrbu mis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Predatory pricing involves setting prices below cost with the aim of forcing competitors out of the market.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性定价策略；将低于成本的价格作为排挤竞争对手手段的定价方针。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika ta' negozju li tadotta prezzijiet taħt l-ispiża bħala mezz biex twarrab lill-kompetituri mis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A predatory pricing policy is a business strategy of using below-cost prices to eliminate competitors.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掠夺性定价做法；实际采用低于成本的价格来排挤竞争对手的经营行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika kummerċjali li fiha jiġu applikati prezzijiet taħt l-ispiża biex jitwarrbu l-kompetituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A predatory pricing practice is the use of below-cost selling prices to push competitors out of business.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低于对手报价；为争取订单或合同而报出比竞争对手更低的价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' kwotazzjoni bi prezz aktar baxx minn dak ta' kompetitur sabiex jinkiseb ordni jew kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Underquoting means offering a lower price than a competitor in order to win an order or contract.

collocations.zh: 关于掠夺性做法的指控

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi kif prattiki predatorji, bħall-bejgħ taħt l-ispiża biex jitwarrbu l-kompetituri, jistgħu jdgħajfu l-kompetizzjoni fis-suq.
formal.en: The study describes how predatory practices, such as selling below cost to drive out competitors, can weaken competition in the market.
formal.zh: 这项研究说明，掠夺性做法，例如为排挤竞争对手而低于成本销售，可能削弱市场竞争。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Jekk ħanut ibigħ irħas mill-oħrajn, dawn huma prattiki predatorji? David: Mhux bilfors; prezz baxx waħdu ma jurix li l-għan hu li jitwarrbu l-kompetituri.
colloquial.en: Marija: If a shop sells more cheaply than the others, is that predatory practice? David: Not necessarily; a low price alone doesn't show that the aim is to drive competitors out.
colloquial.zh: Marija：如果一家商店卖得比其他店便宜，这就是掠夺性做法吗？David：不一定；仅凭价格低，不能说明它的目的是排挤竞争对手。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk ħanut ibigħ irħas mill-oħrajn, dawn huma prattiki predatorji?
messages.mt_standard: Jekk ħanut ibigħ irħas mill-oħrajn, dawn huma prattiki predatorji?
messages.zh: 如果一家商店卖得比其他店便宜，这就是掠夺性做法吗？
messages.en: If a shop sells more cheaply than the others, is that predatory practice?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Mhux bilfors; prezz baxx waħdu ma jurix li l-għan hu li jitwarrbu l-kompetituri.
messages.mt_standard: Mhux bilfors; prezz baxx waħdu ma jurix li l-għan hu li jitwarrbu l-kompetituri.
messages.zh: 不一定；仅凭价格低，不能说明它的目的是排挤竞争对手。
messages.en: Not necessarily; a low price alone doesn't show that the aim is to drive competitors out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“压低价格、挤走对手”的商业场景记住掠夺性做法；另将 underquoting 单独记成“报价比对手低”，不要仅凭低价就判断有掠夺目的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Useful in real situations or concerned with doing things through direct experience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能在实际生活中发挥作用的，或重视亲自操作和实际经验的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun utli f'sitwazzjonijiet reali jew li jinvolvi t-twettiq ta' ħidma u l-esperjenza diretta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实用的，能够解决实际问题的；涉及实际操作而非仅限于理论的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jgħin biex jiġu solvuti problemi reali jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' xogħol li jsir fil-prattika, mhux biss mat-teorija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something practical is useful in real situations or involves learning by actually doing things.

formal.mt: Il-kors jinkludi taħriġ prattiku biex l-istudenti jkunu jistgħu jużaw dak li jitgħallmu.
formal.en: The course includes practical training so that students can use what they learn.
formal.zh: 本课程包含实际操作培训，使学生能够运用所学知识。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek xi parir prattiku biex niffranka l-ħin fil-kċina? Toni: Iva, aħsel u qatta' l-ħaxix minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have any practical advice for saving time in the kitchen? Toni: Yes, wash and chop the vegetables beforehand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你有什么在厨房里节省时间的实用建议吗？托尼：有，提前把蔬菜洗好、切好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek xi parir prattiku biex niffranka l-ħin fil-kċina?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek xi parir prattiku biex niffranka l-ħin fil-kċina?
messages.zh: 你有什么在厨房里节省时间的实用建议吗？
messages.en: Do you have any practical advice for saving time in the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, aħsel u qatta' l-ħaxix minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, aħsel u qatta' l-ħaxix minn qabel.
messages.zh: 有，提前把蔬菜洗好、切好。
messages.en: Yes, wash and chop the vegetables beforehand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prattiku 和“学完马上能用”连在一起记：建议能解决问题是实用，培训让你动手做是实践。

gloss_zh: 初领圣体；首次领圣体礼

teaching_sense.en_definition: The occasion when a Catholic receives Holy Communion for the first time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 天主教徒首次领受圣体的宗教礼仪或场合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-okkażjoni li fiha persuna Kattolika tirċievi t-Tqarbin Imqaddes għall-ewwel darba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 初领圣体，即天主教徒第一次领受圣体的礼仪。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Iċ-ċelebrazzjoni reliġjuża li fiha persuna Kattolika tirċievi t-Tqarbin Imqaddes għall-ewwel darba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A person's First Holy Communion is the occasion when they receive Holy Communion for the first time in the Catholic Church.

collocations.en: the day of First Holy Communion

formal.mt: Il-parroċċa se torganizza laqgħa għall-ġenituri tat-tfal li se jagħmlu l-Praċett din is-sena.
formal.en: The parish will organise a meeting for the parents of children who will receive their First Holy Communion this year.
formal.zh: 堂区将为今年初领圣体的儿童家长举行一次会议。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Meta se jagħmel il-Praċett ibnek? Anna: Nhar il-Ħadd; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu mal-familja.
colloquial.en: Rita: When will your son receive his First Holy Communion? Anna: On Sunday; after the ceremony we will have a meal with the family.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你儿子什么时候初领圣体？安娜：星期日；仪式结束后，我们会和家人一起吃饭。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta se jagħmel il-Praċett ibnek?
messages.mt_standard: Meta se jagħmel il-Praċett ibnek?
messages.zh: 你儿子什么时候初领圣体？
messages.en: When will your son receive his First Holy Communion?

messages.speaker: Anna (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ħadd; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu mal-familja.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ħadd; wara ċ-ċerimonja se nieklu mal-familja.
messages.zh: 星期日；仪式结束后，我们会和家人一起吃饭。
messages.en: On Sunday; after the ceremony we will have a meal with the family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“第一次领受圣体”的仪式画面记住 Praċett，并把 jagħmel il-Praċett 整体理解为“初领圣体”，不要逐字翻译这个搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who held a particular position before someone else.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在现任者之前担任某一职位或职务的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li kellha kariga jew pożizzjoni qabel il-persuna li għandha dik il-kariga jew pożizzjoni bħalissa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先于另一人担任某一职位或职务的前任者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li okkupat kariga jew pożizzjoni qabel persuna oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone's predecessor is the person who held their job or position before them.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport annwali, id-direttur il-ġdid irringrazzja lill-predeċessur tiegħu għax-xogħol li wettaq.
formal.en: In the annual report, the new director thanked his predecessor for the work he had done.
formal.zh: 在年度报告中，新任主任感谢了前任所做的工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min beda dan il-proġett? Pawlu: Il-predeċessur tiegħi. Jien qed inkompli x-xogħol tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who started this project? Pawlu: My predecessor. I'm continuing his work.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这个项目是谁发起的？Pawlu：我的前任。我正在继续他的工作。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min beda dan il-proġett?
messages.mt_standard: Min beda dan il-proġett?
messages.zh: 这个项目是谁发起的？
messages.en: Who started this project?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-predeċessur tiegħi. Jien qed inkompli x-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-predeċessur tiegħi. Jien qed inkompli x-xogħol tiegħu.
messages.zh: 我的前任。我正在继续他的工作。
messages.en: My predecessor. I'm continuing his work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一把办公椅先后换人坐：现在坐的是你，之前坐的人就是你的 predeċessur。用“我的前任”整块记住 il-predeċessur tiegħi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An introductory section at the beginning of a book or publication that presents its purpose or background.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于书籍或其他出版物开头，用于介绍写作目的、背景或内容的前言或序言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima introduttorja fil-bidu ta' ktieb jew pubblikazzjoni li tippreżenta l-għan, l-isfond jew il-kontenut tax-xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: foreward (beginning section of a book or other publication)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 书籍或其他出版物开头的序言，用于引介该作品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima fil-bidu ta' ktieb jew pubblikazzjoni oħra li tintroduċi x-xogħol lill-qarrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foreword is an introductory section that presents a book or another publication to its readers.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书前的前言，通常说明作者的写作目的、背景或编写方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima introduttorja ta' ktieb li fiha l-awtur normalment jispjega l-għan tal-kitba, l-isfond tagħha jew kif ħejja x-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A preface is an opening section in which an author usually explains the purpose or background of a book.
