formal.mt: Fil-prefazjoni tal-ktieb, l-awtriċi tispjega l-għan tal-istudju u tirringrazzja lil dawk li għenuha.
formal.en: In the book's preface, the author explains the purpose of the study and thanks those who helped her.
formal.zh: 在这本书的前言中，作者说明了研究目的，并感谢帮助过她的人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex l-awtriċi kitbet dan il-ktieb? David: Tispjegah fil-prefazjoni. Aqraha qabel tibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the author write this book? David: She explains it in the preface. Read it before you start the first chapter.
colloquial.zh: Lara：作者为什么写这本书？David：她在前言里解释了。开始读第一章之前，先读一下前言。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex l-awtriċi kitbet dan il-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex l-awtriċi kitbet dan il-ktieb?
messages.zh: 作者为什么写这本书？
messages.en: Why did the author write this book?

messages.speaker: David (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tispjegah fil-prefazjoni. Aqraha qabel tibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Tispjegah fil-prefazjoni. Aqraha qabel tibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
messages.zh: 她在前言里解释了。开始读第一章之前，先读一下前言。
messages.en: She explains it in the preface. Read it before you start the first chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prefazjoni 想成正文前的一次开场介绍：先说为什么写，再进入第一章。搭配 prefazjoni qasira 记忆，并用 qasira 的形式提示它是阴性名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An introductory section placed before the main text of a book or publication.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 置于书籍或出版物正文之前，介绍作品及其写作背景的前言或序言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima introduttorja li titqiegħed qabel it-test ewlieni ta' ktieb jew pubblikazzjoni u tagħti tagħrif dwar ix-xogħol jew l-isfond tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: foreward (beginning section of a book or other publication)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 位于书籍或其他出版物开头、向读者介绍作品的序言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima fil-bidu ta' ktieb jew pubblikazzjoni oħra li tagħti introduzzjoni għax-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foreword introduces a book or another publication before the reader reaches its main text.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 书前的前言，通常由作者说明作品的目的、背景或形成过程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqsima qabel it-test ewlieni ta' ktieb li fiha l-awtur normalment jispjega l-għan tax-xogħol, l-isfond tiegħu jew kif żviluppah.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A preface gives readers introductory information about why a book was written or how it developed.

formal.mt: Il-prefazju ta' din l-edizzjoni jispjega l-bidliet li saru fit-test u l-għażla tal-materjal il-ġdid.
formal.en: The preface to this edition explains the changes made to the text and the selection of the new material.
formal.zh: 本版前言说明了正文所作的修改以及新增材料的选取。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Bdejt taqra l-ktieb? Mark: Iva, qrajt il-prefazju. Issa se nibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you started reading the book? Mark: Yes, I've read the preface. Now I'm going to start the first chapter.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你开始读这本书了吗？Mark：开始了，我读完了前言。现在准备读第一章。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bdejt taqra l-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: Bdejt taqra l-ktieb?
messages.zh: 你开始读这本书了吗？
messages.en: Have you started reading the book?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qrajt il-prefazju. Issa se nibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qrajt il-prefazju. Issa se nibda l-ewwel kapitlu.
messages.zh: 开始了，我读完了前言。现在准备读第一章。
messages.en: Yes, I've read the preface. Now I'm going to start the first chapter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prefazju 放在阅读顺序中记：封面之后、正文之前的介绍页。用 prefazju qasir 整块背诵，qasir 提示它是阳性名词，与 prefazjoni qasira 对照。

gloss_zh: 商业优惠待遇；贸易优惠

teaching_sense.en_definition: More favourable treatment given to a trading partner or its goods in commercial exchanges.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在商业或贸易往来中给予某一贸易伙伴或其商品的较优惠待遇，例如较低的进口关税。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trattament aktar favorevoli mogħti lil sieħeb kummerċjali jew lill-prodotti tiegħu fil-kummerċ, bħal dazju aktar baxx fuq l-importazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业往来中给予某一伙伴或其商品、优于一般条件的优惠待遇。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament aktar favorevoli minn dak ġenerali mogħti lil sieħeb jew lill-prodotti tiegħu fi skambji kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commercial preference gives a particular business partner or its goods more favourable treatment in commercial exchanges.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予特定贸易伙伴或其商品的贸易优惠，例如降低进口关税。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vantaġġ fil-kundizzjonijiet tal-kummerċ mogħti lil pajjiż jew lill-prodotti tiegħu, pereżempju permezz ta' dazji aktar baxxi fuq l-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade preference allows goods from a particular trading partner to receive favourable treatment, such as lower import duties.

collocations.en: to be granted a trade preference
to benefit from a trade preference
an agreement on a trade preference

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-ftehim jagħti preferenza kummerċjali lil ċerti prodotti billi jnaqqas id-dazju fuq l-importazzjoni tagħhom.
formal.en: In this example, the agreement grants a trade preference to certain products by reducing the duty on their importation.
formal.zh: 在这个例子中，协议通过降低某些商品的进口关税，给予这些商品贸易优惠待遇。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex id-dazju fuq dawn il-prodotti huwa aktar baxx? Ġorġ: Għax jibbenefikaw minn preferenza kummerċjali skont dan il-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the duty on these products lower? Ġorġ: Because they benefit from a trade preference under this agreement.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这些商品的关税比较低？Ġorġ：因为根据这份协议，它们享有贸易优惠待遇。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex id-dazju fuq dawn il-prodotti huwa aktar baxx?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex id-dazju fuq dawn il-prodotti huwa aktar baxx?
messages.zh: 为什么这些商品的关税比较低？
messages.en: Why is the duty on these products lower?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (贸易顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jibbenefikaw minn preferenza kummerċjali skont dan il-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jibbenefikaw minn preferenza kummerċjali skont dan il-ftehim.
messages.zh: 因为根据这份协议，它们享有贸易优惠待遇。
messages.en: Because they benefit from a trade preference under this agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两批进口商品，其中一批凭协议享受较低关税；把这份贸易上的优待标成 preferenza kummerċjali。用“贸易伙伴获得优惠”这一场景记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 商业优先待遇；贸易优惠

teaching_sense.en_definition: Arrangements that give certain businesses, trading partners, or goods more favourable treatment in commercial dealings or international trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在商业往来或国际贸易中给予某些企业、贸易伙伴或商品的优先待遇或优惠条件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġamenti li jagħtu lil ċerti negozji, sħab kummerċjali jew prodotti trattament jew kundizzjonijiet aktar favorevoli f'attivitajiet kummerċjali jew fil-kummerċ internazzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 商业优先待遇，指在商业交易中给予某些企业、供应商或商品的较有利条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Trattament aktar favorevoli mogħti lil ċerti negozji, fornituri jew prodotti fi tranżazzjonijiet kummerċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commercial preference is an advantage given to a particular business, supplier, or product in commercial dealings.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易优惠，指给予某些国家或其商品的较低关税、较便利市场准入等有利贸易条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vantaġġ fil-kummerċ mogħti lil ċerti pajjiżi jew lill-prodotti tagħhom, bħal tariffi aktar baxxi jew aċċess aktar faċli għas-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade preference is a favourable trading condition, such as a lower tariff, granted to particular countries or their goods.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jagħti preferenzi ta' kummerċ lil ċerti prodotti, fosthom tariffi aktar baxxi meta jiġu importati.
formal.en: The agreement grants trade preferences to certain products, including lower tariffs when they are imported.
formal.zh: 该协议给予某些商品贸易优惠，包括进口时适用较低关税。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex dan il-prodott għandu tariffa aktar baxxa? Mark: Għax jibbenefika minn preferenzi ta' kummerċ skont il-ftehim.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does this product have a lower tariff? Mark: Because it benefits from trade preferences under the agreement.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么这种商品的关税较低？Mark：因为按照协议，它享有贸易优惠。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-prodott għandu tariffa aktar baxxa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-prodott għandu tariffa aktar baxxa?
messages.zh: 为什么这种商品的关税较低？
messages.en: Why does this product have a lower tariff?

messages.speaker: Mark (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jibbenefika minn preferenzi ta' kummerċ skont il-ftehim.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jibbenefika minn preferenzi ta' kummerċ skont il-ftehim.
messages.zh: 因为按照协议，它享有贸易优惠。
messages.en: Because it benefits from trade preferences under the agreement.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语放进“协议让某些商品少交关税”的画面中记忆；遇到商业交易语境联想优先待遇，遇到进出口语境联想贸易优惠。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Liked or chosen more than other available people, things, or possibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与其他可选的人、事物或方案相比，更受喜爱或更愿意被选择的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun jogħġob aktar minn oħrajn jew li jintgħażel qabel persuni, affarijiet jew għażliet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 较受喜爱的；在多个选择中更愿意选择的；首选的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun aktar mixtieq jew li jintgħażel qabel alternattivi oħra minħabba togħma personali jew ħtieġa partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your preferred option is the one you like or would choose more than the alternatives.

collocations.en: the preferred time for the meeting

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok indika l-metodu preferit ta' ħlas meta timla l-formola.
formal.en: Please indicate your preferred payment method when completing the form.
formal.zh: 填写表格时，请注明您首选的付款方式。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema kulur trid għat-tazza? Pawlu: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Dak hu l-kulur preferit tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which colour would you like for the mug? Pawlu: Blue, please. That's my favourite colour.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你想要什么颜色的杯子？Pawlu：请给我蓝色的。那是我最喜欢的颜色。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema kulur trid għat-tazza?
messages.mt_standard: Liema kulur trid għat-tazza?
messages.zh: 你想要什么颜色的杯子？
messages.en: Which colour would you like for the mug?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Dak hu l-kulur preferit tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Il-blu, jekk jogħġbok. Dak hu l-kulur preferit tiegħi.
messages.zh: 请给我蓝色的。那是我最喜欢的颜色。
messages.en: Blue, please. That's my favourite colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象表格中“首选”一栏被打上勾，把 preferit 与“多个选项里更想选的那个”联系起来；谈颜色时也可理解为最喜欢的。

gloss_zh: 前缀；电话区号或拨号代码

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word element placed before a base to affect its meaning, or a telephone code dialled before the rest of a number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 加在词基前、影响词义的构词成分；也指拨打电话号码时加在其余号码之前的区号或拨号代码。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Element li jitqiegħed qabel il-bażi ta' kelma biex jinfluwenza t-tifsira tagħha, jew kodiċi tat-telefon li jiġi ċċempel qabel il-bqija tan-numru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 前缀，即置于词基之前、用来影响词义的构词成分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Element li jiżdied fil-bidu ta' kelma jew qabel il-bażi tagħha biex ibiddel jew jispeċifika t-tifsira tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prefix is a word element added before a base to change or specify its meaning.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 电话拨号代码，如拨打某个国家、地区或城市的电话号码时须先拨的国家代码或区号。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kodiċi li jiġi ċċempel qabel il-bqija ta' numru tat-telefon biex is-sejħa tasal fil-pajjiż jew fiż-żona t-tajba.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A dialling code is a set of digits used before a telephone number to reach a particular country or area.

collocations.en: add a prefix to a word

formal.mt: Fl-eżerċizzju tal-lingwa, l-istudenti għandhom jidentifikaw il-prefiss ta' kull kelma u jispjegaw kif jinfluwenza t-tifsira tagħha.
formal.en: In the language exercise, students should identify the prefix of each word and explain how it affects its meaning.
formal.zh: 在这项语言练习中，学生应辨认每个词的前缀，并解释它如何影响词义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-numru ma jaħdimx. X'jonqos? Mark: Daħħalt il-prefiss internazzjonali qabel in-numru? Maja: Le, issa nżidu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The number isn't working. What's missing? Mark: Did you enter the international dialling code before the number? Maja: No, I'll add it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个号码打不通。少了什么？Mark：你在号码前输入国际电话拨号代码了吗？Maja：没有，我现在加上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-numru ma jaħdimx. X'jonqos?
messages.mt_standard: In-numru ma jaħdimx. X'jonqos?
messages.zh: 这个号码打不通。少了什么？
messages.en: The number isn't working. What's missing?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Daħħalt il-prefiss internazzjonali qabel in-numru?
messages.mt_standard: Daħħalt il-prefiss internazzjonali qabel in-numru?
messages.zh: 你在号码前输入国际电话拨号代码了吗？
messages.en: Did you enter the international dialling code before the number?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, issa nżidu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, issa nżidu.
messages.zh: 没有，我现在加上。
messages.en: No, I'll add it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“放在前面”串联两个义项：单词前面放的是前缀，电话号码前面加的是拨号代码。这是学习联想，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the period before written records of human history.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人类历史出现文字记录之前的时期有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam maż-żmien ta' qabel ma bdiet tinkiteb l-istorja tal-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 史前的；属于或涉及人类历史有文字记录之前的时期的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jappartjeni għaż-żmien ta' qabel ir-rekords miktuba tal-istorja tal-bniedem, jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dak iż-żmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something prehistoric belongs to the period before people began keeping written historical records.

formal.mt: L-istudju jiddeskrivi sit preistoriku u l-oġġetti li nstabu fih.
formal.en: The study describes a prehistoric site and the objects found there.
formal.zh: 这项研究介绍了一处史前遗址及其中出土的物品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'juri dan il-mudell? Mark: Juri raħal preistoriku u kif kienu jgħixu n-nies fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this model show? Mark: It shows a prehistoric village and how its people lived.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个模型展示的是什么？Mark：它展示了一个史前村落，以及村里的人当时怎样生活。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'juri dan il-mudell?
messages.mt_standard: X'juri dan il-mudell?
messages.zh: 这个模型展示的是什么？
messages.en: What does this model show?

messages.speaker: Mark (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri raħal preistoriku u kif kienu jgħixu n-nies fih.
messages.mt_standard: Juri raħal preistoriku u kif kienu jgħixu n-nies fih.
messages.zh: 它展示了一个史前村落，以及村里的人当时怎样生活。
messages.en: It shows a prehistoric village and how its people lived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 preistoriku 和博物馆里的史前村落模型一起记：画面发生在文字记史以前，便能联想到“史前的”。

gloss_zh: 就业与生计缺乏保障的劳动者群体

teaching_sense.en_definition: A term for people whose insecure employment leaves their income and livelihood uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指由于工作缺乏稳定保障，收入和生计处于不确定状态的劳动者群体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terminu li jirreferi għal nies li, minħabba xogħol mingħajr stabbiltà jew sigurtà, jgħixu b'inċertezza dwar id-dħul u l-għajxien tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不稳定就业群体；因工作缺乏保障而面临收入和生计不确定性的劳动者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-grupp ta' ħaddiema li x-xogħol tagħhom ma joffrix stabbiltà jew sigurtà biżżejjed u li għalhekk jiffaċċjaw inċertezza fl-għajxien tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The precariat consists of workers whose insecure employment makes their income and future livelihood uncertain.

collocations.en: the conditions experienced by the precariat
collocations.zh: 不稳定就业群体所处的境况
不稳定就业群体的权利

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-kundizzjonijiet tal-prekarjat u jipproponi miżuri biex titjieb is-sigurtà tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The report examines the conditions experienced by the precariat and proposes measures to improve job security.
formal.zh: 这份报告考察了不稳定就业群体所处的境况，并提出改善就业保障的措施。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser prekarjat f'dan l-artiklu? Mark: Qed jitkellem fuq nies b'xogħol bla stabbiltà, li ma jafux kemm se jaqilgħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does precariat mean in this article? Mark: It means people with insecure jobs who do not know how much they will earn next month.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 prekarjat 是什么意思？Mark：指工作不稳定的人，他们连下个月能挣多少钱都不知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser prekarjat f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser prekarjat f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 prekarjat 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does precariat mean in this article?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jitkellem fuq nies b'xogħol bla stabbiltà, li ma jafux kemm se jaqilgħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jitkellem fuq nies b'xogħol bla stabbiltà, li ma jafux kemm se jaqilgħu x-xahar id-dieħel.
messages.zh: 指工作不稳定的人，他们连下个月能挣多少钱都不知道。
messages.en: It means people with insecure jobs who do not know how much they will earn next month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prekarjat 放进“下个月还有没有工作和收入”的情境来记，联想到一群就业与生计缺乏保障的劳动者。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An action taken in advance to prevent possible harm, danger, or difficulty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为防止可能发生的伤害、危险或困难而事先采取的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Miżura li tittieħed minn qabel biex jiġu evitati ħsara, periklu jew diffikultà li jistgħu jinqalgħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预防措施；为避免可能出现的危险、损害或问题而事先采取的行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Azzjoni jew miżura li persuna tieħu minn qabel biex tnaqqas ir-riskju ta' periklu, ħsara jew problema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A precaution is something you do beforehand to reduce the risk of harm or trouble.

collocations.zh: 作为预防措施；以防万一

formal.mt: Bħala prekawzjoni, il-persunal għandu jiċċekkja li t-tagħmir ikun mitfi qabel ma jibda t-tindif.
formal.en: As a precaution, staff must check that the equipment is switched off before cleaning begins.
formal.zh: 作为预防措施，工作人员必须在开始清洁前检查设备是否已经关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tieħu umbrella? Mark: Bħala prekawzjoni, għax jista' jagħmel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you taking an umbrella? Mark: As a precaution, because it might rain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么带伞？Mark：以防万一，因为可能会下雨。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tieħu umbrella?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tieħu umbrella?
messages.zh: 你为什么带伞？
messages.en: Why are you taking an umbrella?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala prekawzjoni, għax jista' jagħmel ix-xita.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala prekawzjoni, għax jista' jagħmel ix-xita.
messages.zh: 以防万一，因为可能会下雨。
messages.en: As a precaution, because it might rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“天还没下雨，先把伞带上”来记 prekawzjoni：关键是提前行动，防止可能发生的问题。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A preliminary process that checks eligibility or selects candidates before a later stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在后续正式程序之前，检查参与资格或初步筛选候选者的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess preliminari li bih jiġu vverifikati r-rekwiżiti għall-parteċipazzjoni jew jintgħażlu kandidati għal stadju sussegwenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 资格预审；在允许申请者进入后续程序之前，预先核查其是否符合规定条件。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Verifika minn qabel li tistabbilixxi jekk applikant jissodisfax ir-rekwiżiti meħtieġa biex ikun jista' jieħu sehem fl-istadju li jmiss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prequalification is a preliminary check that applicants meet the requirements for taking part in a later process.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预选；在最终选定之前，从候选者或选项中进行初步筛选。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għażla preliminari ta' kandidati jew għażliet minn grupp akbar, li ssir qabel l-għażla finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preselection is the process of choosing an initial group of candidates or options before making a final choice.

formal.mt: Il-kumpaniji għandhom jippreżentaw id-dokumenti meħtieġa għall-prekwalifikazzjoni qabel ma jiġu mistiedna jressqu offerta.
formal.en: Companies must submit the documents required for prequalification before they are invited to submit a bid.
formal.zh: 各公司必须先提交资格预审所需的文件，之后才会获邀投标。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Diġà għażluk għall-kors? Mark: Għad le. Għaddejt mill-prekwalifikazzjoni, imma l-għażla finali ssir il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you already been selected for the course? Mark: Not yet. I passed the preliminary selection, but the final selection takes place next week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你已经被这个课程录取了吗？Mark：还没有。我通过了预选，不过最终选拔要到下周才进行。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Diġà għażluk għall-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Diġà għażluk għall-kors?
messages.zh: 你已经被这个课程录取了吗？
messages.en: Have you already been selected for the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (课程申请者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad le. Għaddejt mill-prekwalifikazzjoni, imma l-għażla finali ssir il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.mt_standard: Għad le. Għaddejt mill-prekwalifikazzjoni, imma l-għażla finali ssir il-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
messages.zh: 还没有。我通过了预选，不过最终选拔要到下周才进行。
messages.en: Not yet. I passed the preliminary selection, but the final selection takes place next week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prekwalifikazzjoni 想成正式入场前的一道关：检查是否符合条件时是“资格预审”，先筛出部分候选者时是“预选”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small wheeled carriage in which a baby can lie while someone pushes it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供婴儿躺卧、由人推着行走的小型轮式车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura żgħira bir-roti li fiha tarbija tista' timtedd waqt li xi ħadd jimbuttaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 婴儿车；供婴儿躺卧并由成人推行的小车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura żgħira bir-roti li tintuża biex tinġarr tarbija mimduda waqt li persuna timbottaha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pram is a small wheeled carriage that you push to take a baby from one place to another.

formal.mt: Il-ġenituri għandhom jiżguraw li l-brejk tal-prem ikun mixgħul qabel ma jħallu l-manku.
formal.en: Parents should ensure that the pram's brake is engaged before letting go of the handle.
formal.zh: 父母应确保婴儿车的刹车已锁定，再松开扶手。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tarbija għadha rieqda fil-prem? Mark: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma nqajmuhiex.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the baby still asleep in the pram? Mark: Yes, let's walk slowly so we don't wake her.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：宝宝还在婴儿车里睡觉吗？马克：是啊，我们慢慢走，免得把她吵醒。

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tarbija għadha rieqda fil-prem?
messages.mt_standard: It-tarbija għadha rieqda fil-prem?
messages.zh: 宝宝还在婴儿车里睡觉吗？
messages.en: Is the baby still asleep in the pram?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma nqajmuhiex.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nimxu bil-mod biex ma nqajmuhiex.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们慢慢走，免得把她吵醒。
messages.en: Yes, let's walk slowly so we don't wake her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prem 和“推着熟睡宝宝散步”的画面绑定，连同 tarbija fil-prem（婴儿车里的宝宝）一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something given to someone for winning, achieving something, or doing something deserving recognition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因获胜、取得成就或做出值得肯定的行为而获得的奖品、奖项或奖赏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna għax tkun rebħet, kisbet suċċess jew għamlet xi ħaġa li jistħoqqilha rikonoxximent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奖品；在比赛或竞赛中因获胜而得到的物品、奖金等奖励。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett, flus jew xi ħaġa oħra li tingħata lil min jirbaħ kompetizzjoni jew tellieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prize is something that you receive because you have won a competition or contest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奖项；由机构等正式授予、用于表彰成就或贡献的荣誉或奖励。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unur jew rikonoxximent li jingħata formalment lil persuna jew grupp għal kisba jew kontribut importanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An award is an honour that an organization formally gives someone to recognize an achievement or contribution.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奖赏；为肯定某人的努力、良好行为或帮助而给予的回报。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tingħata lil persuna bħala rikonoxximent għall-isforz, għall-imġiba tajba jew għall-għajnuna tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reward is something that you are given in return for your effort, good behaviour, or help.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ta premju lir-riċerkatriċi bħala rikonoxximent għall-kontribut tagħha fix-xjenza.
formal.en: The committee gave the researcher an award in recognition of her contribution to science.
formal.zh: 委员会向这位女性研究人员颁奖，以表彰她对科学的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'irbaħt fil-kompetizzjoni? Pawlu: Irbaħt ktieb bħala premju. Se nibda naqrah illejla!
colloquial.en: Nina: What did you win in the competition? Pawlu: I won a book as a prize. I'll start reading it tonight!
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你在比赛中赢了什么？保罗：我赢了一本书作为奖品。今晚我就开始读！

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'irbaħt fil-kompetizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'irbaħt fil-kompetizzjoni?
messages.zh: 你在比赛中赢了什么？
messages.en: What did you win in the competition?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (参赛者)
messages.mt_spoken: Irbaħt ktieb bħala premju. Se nibda naqrah illejla!
messages.mt_standard: Irbaħt ktieb bħala premju. Se nibda naqrah illejla!
messages.zh: 我赢了一本书作为奖品。今晚我就开始读！
messages.en: I won a book as a prize. I'll start reading it tonight!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个领奖场景记 premju：比赛赢奖品、典礼获奖项、努力得奖赏；同一个词随语境对应三种中文表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state of hurry in which someone feels a need to act or move quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因觉得必须赶快行动或赶路而产生的匆忙、急迫状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat ta' għaġla li fih persuna tħoss il-ħtieġa li taġixxi jew timxi malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 匆忙；急切地加快行动的状态，有时会因此疏忽细节。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għaġla biex isir xi ħaġa malajr, xi drabi b'inqas attenzjoni għad-dettalji.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Haste is a state of hurry in which you do something quickly, sometimes without enough care.

formal.mt: Minħabba l-premura, l-applikant nesa jiffirma d-dokument qabel ma bagħtu.
formal.en: Because of his haste, the applicant forgot to sign the document before sending it.
formal.zh: 由于匆忙，申请人在寄出文件前忘了签名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tgħaġġel daqshekk? David: Għandi premura għax il-karozza tal-linja se titlaq.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you rushing so much? David: I'm in a hurry because the bus is about to leave.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为什么这么匆忙？戴维：我赶时间，因为公交车马上要开了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tgħaġġel daqshekk?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tgħaġġel daqshekk?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么匆忙？
messages.en: Why are you rushing so much?

messages.speaker: David (赶车的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi premura għax il-karozza tal-linja se titlaq.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi premura għax il-karozza tal-linja se titlaq.
messages.zh: 我赶时间，因为公交车马上要开了。
messages.en: I'm in a hurry because the bus is about to leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交车即将开走，你边跑边说 Għandi premura（我赶时间）；用赶车的急迫感记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arrangement made in advance to keep a room, table, seat, or similar service available for someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先安排保留房间、餐桌、座位或类似服务的预订。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament li jsir minn qabel biex kamra, mejda, siġġu jew servizz simili jinżamm disponibbli għal xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预订；提前请商家或服务机构为某人保留房间、餐桌、座位等的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament minn qabel li bih lukanda, restorant jew fornitur ieħor ta' servizz iżomm post jew servizz għal persuna.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reservation is an arrangement that you make in advance so that a room, table, or seat is kept for you.

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok ikkonferma l-prenotazzjoni tiegħek għal kamra doppja għal żewġt iljieli.
formal.en: Please confirm your reservation for a double room for two nights.
formal.zh: 请确认您预订的双人房，入住两晚。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek prenotazzjoni? Mark: Iva, għal żewġ persuni fis-sebgħa, f'isem Mark.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a reservation? Mark: Yes, for two people at seven, under the name Mark.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：您有预订吗？马克：有，七点，两位，预订人是马克。

messages.speaker: Anna (餐厅服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek prenotazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek prenotazzjoni?
messages.zh: 您有预订吗？
messages.en: Do you have a reservation?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal żewġ persuni fis-sebgħa, f'isem Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal żewġ persuni fis-sebgħa, f'isem Mark.
messages.zh: 有，七点，两位，预订人是马克。
messages.en: Yes, for two people at seven, under the name Mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prenotazzjoni 放进餐厅迎宾场景：听到 Għandek prenotazzjoni?，就想到“您有预订吗”，再练习回答人数和时间。

gloss_zh: 心事；忧虑；萦绕心头的事

teaching_sense.en_definition: A matter that occupies your thoughts, or the anxiety you feel about something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续占据心思的事情，或因某件事而产生的忧虑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tokkupalek il-ħsieb għal ħafna ħin, jew tħassib li tħoss dwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续占据注意力和心思的事情；萦绕心头的事。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ħaġa li tokkupa l-ħsieb u l-attenzjoni ta' persuna għal ħafna ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A preoccupation is something that occupies your thoughts and attention for a long time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因问题、困难或可能发生的不利情况而产生的担忧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tħassib jew ansjetà li persuna tħoss minħabba problema jew xi ħaġa li tista' tiġri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Worry is a feeling of anxiety about a problem or something that might happen.

formal.mt: Il-preokkupazzjoni ewlenija tal-kumitat hija s-sigurtà tat-tfal waqt l-attivitajiet.
formal.en: The committee's main concern is the children's safety during the activities.
formal.zh: 委员会首要关切的是儿童在活动期间的安全。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher inkwetat? Mark: Għandi preokkupazzjoni dwar ix-xogħol. Maja: Trid titkellem dwarha?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look worried? Mark: I have a worry about work. Maja: Do you want to talk about it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你怎么看起来很担心？马克：我有件工作上的烦心事。玛雅：你想聊聊吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher inkwetat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher inkwetat?
messages.zh: 你怎么看起来很担心？
messages.en: Why do you look worried?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi preokkupazzjoni dwar ix-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi preokkupazzjoni dwar ix-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我有件工作上的烦心事。
messages.en: I have a worry about work.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid titkellem dwarha?
messages.mt_standard: Trid titkellem dwarha?
messages.zh: 你想聊聊吗？
messages.en: Do you want to talk about it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一件事一直占据脑海：它既可能是萦绕心头的事，也可能是让你发愁的忧虑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The work or process of getting someone or something ready for an activity or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为使人或事物能够应对某项活动或事件而进行的准备过程或工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ix-xogħol li jsir biex persuna jew ħaġa tkun lesta għal attività jew avveniment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某项活动、任务或事件预先做好安排、备齐所需事物的过程或工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li jsir minn qabel biex kollox ikun lest għal attività, biċċa xogħol jew avveniment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preparation is the work you do beforehand to make someone or something ready for a particular purpose.

formal.mt: Il-preparament tal-materjal għandu jitlesta qabel il-bidu tal-kors.
formal.en: The preparation of the material must be completed before the course begins.
formal.zh: 材料的准备工作必须在课程开始前完成。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejjer il-preparament għall-eżami? Pawlu: Tajjeb, qed nirrevedi ftit kuljum. Lara: Nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is your preparation for the exam going? Pawlu: Well, I'm doing a little revision every day. Lara: We can study together tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你备考准备得怎么样？保罗：挺好的，我每天都复习一点。劳拉：我们明天可以一起学习。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejjer il-preparament għall-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejjer il-preparament għall-eżami?
messages.zh: 你备考准备得怎么样？
messages.en: How is your preparation for the exam going?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, qed nirrevedi ftit kuljum.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, qed nirrevedi ftit kuljum.
messages.zh: 挺好的，我每天都复习一点。
messages.en: Well, I'm doing a little revision every day.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien għada.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nistudjaw flimkien għada.
messages.zh: 我们明天可以一起学习。
messages.en: We can study together tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个名词和考前复习、课前备料连起来记：活动开始之前做的工作就是准备。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ready for an activity or situation because the necessary work or arrangements have been completed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因已经完成必要的工作或安排，而能够应对某项活动或情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lest għal attività jew sitwazzjoni għax ikun sar ix-xogħol meħtieġ minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事先已做好必要准备的；能够应对即将进行的活动或出现的情况的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun lest biex jagħmel xi ħaġa jew jiffaċċja sitwazzjoni wara li jkun ħa l-passi meħtieġa minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is prepared, they are ready for an activity or situation because they have made the necessary arrangements.

formal.mt: Il-kandidat kien preparat tajjeb għall-intervista u wieġeb il-mistoqsijiet b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The candidate was well prepared for the interview and answered the questions clearly.
formal.zh: 这位候选人为面试做了充分准备，并清楚地回答了问题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int preparat għall-preżentazzjoni ta' għada? Mark: Iva, ipprattikajt darbtejn illum. Sara: Tajjeb! Jekk trid, nista' nisma' l-bidu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you prepared for tomorrow's presentation? Mark: Yes, I practised twice today. Sara: Great! If you like, I can listen to the beginning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你为明天的展示做好准备了吗？马克：是的，我今天练习了两遍。萨拉：好啊！你愿意的话，我可以听听开头。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Int preparat għall-preżentazzjoni ta' għada?
messages.mt_standard: Int preparat għall-preżentazzjoni ta' għada?
messages.zh: 你为明天的展示做好准备了吗？
messages.en: Are you prepared for tomorrow's presentation?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ipprattikajt darbtejn illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ipprattikajt darbtejn illum.
messages.zh: 是的，我今天练习了两遍。
messages.en: Yes, I practised twice today.

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Jekk trid, nista' nisma' l-bidu.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Jekk trid, nista' nisma' l-bidu.
messages.zh: 好啊！你愿意的话，我可以听听开头。
messages.en: Great! If you like, I can listen to the beginning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象上台前已经练习完毕的自己：preparat 描述的是此刻已经准备好的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process or work of making yourself or something ready for a future activity, task, or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为将来的活动、任务或事件，使自己或某事物达到就绪状态的过程或工作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ix-xogħol li tagħmel biex inti jew xi ħaġa tkun lesta għal attività, biċċa xogħol jew avveniment fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为即将进行的事情预先学习、安排或备齐所需物品的准备过程与工作。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ix-xogħol li jsir minn qabel, bħall-istudju jew l-arranġamenti meħtieġa, biex persuna jew ħaġa tkun lesta għal dak li jkun se jsir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Preparation is the process of getting ready for something by studying, planning, or arranging what you will need.

formal.mt: Il-preparazzjoni għall-konferenza tinkludi l-għażla tal-kelliema u t-tqassim tal-programm lill-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Preparation for the conference includes selecting the speakers and distributing the programme to participants.
formal.zh: 会议的筹备工作包括选定发言人，并向与会者分发日程。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif sejra l-preparazzjoni għall-vjaġġ? David: Kważi kollox lest; għad irrid nippakkja l-ħwejjeġ. Anna: Tinsiex iċ-ċarġer!
colloquial.en: Anna: How is the preparation for the trip going? David: Almost everything is ready; I still need to pack my clothes. Anna: Don't forget the charger!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：旅行准备得怎么样了？戴维：差不多都准备好了，我还得把衣服装进行李。安娜：别忘了充电器！

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra l-preparazzjoni għall-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra l-preparazzjoni għall-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 旅行准备得怎么样了？
messages.en: How is the preparation for the trip going?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kważi kollox lest; għad irrid nippakkja l-ħwejjeġ.
messages.mt_standard: Kważi kollox lest; għad irrid nippakkja l-ħwejjeġ.
messages.zh: 差不多都准备好了，我还得把衣服装进行李。
messages.en: Almost everything is ready; I still need to pack my clothes.

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinsiex iċ-ċarġer!
messages.mt_standard: Tinsiex iċ-ċarġer!
messages.zh: 别忘了充电器！
messages.en: Don't forget the charger!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用出发前的清单帮助记忆：订行程、收衣服、带充电器，这一整套准备工作就是 preparazzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A word that relates a noun or pronoun to another part of a sentence, often expressing place, time, or another relationship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把名词或代词与句中其他成分联系起来，常表示地点、时间或其他关系的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li torbot nom jew pronom ma' parti oħra tas-sentenza u spiss turi relazzjoni ta' post, żmien jew tip ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 介词：表示名词或代词与句中其他成分之间关系的一类词。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Parti mid-diskors li turi r-relazzjoni bejn nom jew pronom u kliem ieħor fis-sentenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A preposition is a word that connects a noun or pronoun with another part of a sentence and indicates a relationship between them.

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Il-ktieb qiegħed fuq il-mejda', il-kelma 'fuq' hija prepożizzjoni li turi relazzjoni ta' post.
formal.en: In the sentence 'The book is on the table', the word 'on' is a preposition indicating a spatial relationship.
formal.zh: 在“书在桌子上”这个句子中，马耳他语的 fuq 是表示位置关系的介词。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tip ta' kelma hi 'fuq' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Hija prepożizzjoni; turina fejn qiegħed il-ktieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: What kind of word is 'fuq' in this sentence? Pawlu: It's a preposition; it tells us where the book is.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个句子里的 fuq 是什么词？Pawlu：是介词，它告诉我们书在哪里。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tip ta' kelma hi 'fuq' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: X'tip ta' kelma hi 'fuq' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 fuq 是什么词？
messages.en: What kind of word is 'fuq' in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija prepożizzjoni; turina fejn qiegħed il-ktieb.
messages.mt_standard: Hija prepożizzjoni; turina fejn qiegħed il-ktieb.
messages.zh: 是介词，它告诉我们书在哪里。
messages.en: It's a preposition; it tells us where the book is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把介词想成句中的关系路标：看到 prepożizzjoni，就找它怎样说明人或物的位置、时间等关系。

gloss_zh: 被主持的；由某人主持的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used of a body, meeting, or event that is led by someone acting as its presiding officer or chairperson.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容某个机构、会议或活动由担任主席或主持人的人主持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi korp, laqgħa jew attività li tkun taħt it-tmexxija ta' persuna li taqdi r-rwol ta' president jew tmexxi x-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由某人主持或担任主席的，强调处于该人的主持之下。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun taħt it-tmexxija ta' persuna li taqdi r-rwol ta' president f'korp jew f'attività.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If a body or event is presided over, someone leads it in an official capacity.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于会议等，表示由某人担任主席并主持议程或讨论的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkollu persuna tmexxi l-laqgħa jew id-diskussjoni u tiggwida x-xogħol skont l-aġenda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A meeting chaired by someone has that person directing its discussion and managing its proceedings.

formal.mt: Il-bord, presedut minn Marija Borg, eżamina l-proposti u approva l-aġenda tal-laqgħa li jmiss.
formal.en: The board, chaired by Marija Borg, examined the proposals and approved the agenda for the next meeting.
formal.zh: 由 Marija Borg 主持的董事会审议了各项提案，并批准了下次会议的议程。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jmexxi d-dibattitu llejla? Mark: Se jkun presedut minn Anna; hi se tagħti l-kelma lill-parteċipanti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who's going to lead the debate tonight? Mark: It'll be chaired by Anna; she'll give the participants their turns to speak.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚的辩论由谁主持？Mark：由 Anna 主持，她会安排参与者依次发言。

messages.speaker: Lara (参与者)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmexxi d-dibattitu llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmexxi d-dibattitu llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚的辩论由谁主持？
messages.en: Who's going to lead the debate tonight?

messages.speaker: Mark (组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Se jkun presedut minn Anna; hi se tagħti l-kelma lill-parteċipanti.
messages.mt_standard: Se jkun presedut minn Anna; hi se tagħti l-kelma lill-parteċipanti.
messages.zh: 由 Anna 主持，她会安排参与者依次发言。
messages.en: It'll be chaired by Anna; she'll give the participants their turns to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“会议由谁主持”来记 presedut，搭配 minn 时，把后面的人名理解为主持者。

gloss_zh: 专名，对应 afarjeit；具体所指未说明

teaching_sense.en_definition: A proper name associated with the supplied designation 'afarjeit'; its specific referent is not identified.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个与所给名称 afarjeit 对应的专名；所给资料没有说明它具体指谁或什么。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem proprju marbut mad-denominazzjoni mogħtija 'afarjeit'; it-tagħrif mogħti ma jispeċifikax għal min jew għal xiex jirreferi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对应 afarjeit 的专名；具体指称未在所给资料中说明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem proprju li jingħata d-denominazzjoni 'afarjeit', mingħajr tagħrif li jidentifika r-referent tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The proper name 'presents' is associated here with 'afarjeit', although the supplied information does not identify its referent.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'presents' huwa isem proprju marbut mad-denominazzjoni 'afarjeit', iżda r-referent tiegħu mhuwiex speċifikat.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'presents' is a proper name associated with the designation 'afarjeit', but its referent is not specified.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，presents 是与名称 afarjeit 对应的专名，但其具体所指并未说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif għandna nittrattaw 'presents' hawn? Pawlu: Bħala isem proprju marbut ma' 'afarjeit'; ma nafux għal min jew għal xiex jirreferi.
colloquial.en: Maja: How should we treat 'presents' here? Pawlu: As a proper name associated with 'afarjeit'; we don't know who or what it refers to.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这里应该怎样理解 presents？Pawlu：把它当作与 afarjeit 对应的专名；我们不知道它具体指谁或什么。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif għandna nittrattaw 'presents' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Kif għandna nittrattaw 'presents' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里应该怎样理解 presents？
messages.en: How should we treat 'presents' here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħala isem proprju marbut ma' 'afarjeit'; ma nafux għal min jew għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.mt_standard: Bħala isem proprju marbut ma' 'afarjeit'; ma nafux għal min jew għal xiex jirreferi.
messages.zh: 把它当作与 afarjeit 对应的专名；我们不知道它具体指谁或什么。
messages.en: As a proper name associated with 'afarjeit'; we don't know who or what it refers to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 presents 与 afarjeit 配成一张专名卡片，只记已给的对应关系，具体所指留待资料补充。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who holds the leading office in a country or organization, or who chairs a committee or meeting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任一国总统、某组织主席，或主持委员会及会议的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tokkupa l-ogħla kariga fi stat jew f'organizzazzjoni, jew li tmexxi kumitat jew laqgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总统；会长或主席，指担任国家或组织相应最高领导职务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tokkupa l-kariga ta' kap ta' stat jew li tkun il-kap ta' organizzazzjoni jew għaqda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A president is the head of a country or the person holding the leading office in an organization.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主席；主持人，指主持委员会或会议并引导讨论的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tmexxi kumitat jew laqgħa, tiggwida d-diskussjoni u tagħti l-kelma lill-parteċipanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chairperson leads a committee or meeting and makes sure that its discussion and proceedings are properly organized.

collocations.en: to elect a president or chairperson

formal.mt: Il-president tar-repubblika indirizza lill-parteċipanti waqt il-ftuħ tal-konferenza.
formal.en: The president of the republic addressed the participants at the opening of the conference.
formal.zh: 共和国总统在会议开幕时向与会者致辞。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min se jmexxi l-laqgħa tal-kumitat illum? David: Il-president tal-kumitat; l-ewwel se jgħaddi magħna l-aġenda.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's going to lead the committee meeting today? David: The committee chairperson; first he'll go through the agenda with us.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天的委员会会议由谁主持？David：委员会主席，他会先和我们一起过一遍议程。

messages.speaker: Sara (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jmexxi l-laqgħa tal-kumitat illum?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jmexxi l-laqgħa tal-kumitat illum?
messages.zh: 今天的委员会会议由谁主持？
messages.en: Who's going to lead the committee meeting today?

messages.speaker: David (委员会秘书)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-president tal-kumitat; l-ewwel se jgħaddi magħna l-aġenda.
messages.mt_standard: Il-president tal-kumitat; l-ewwel se jgħaddi magħna l-aġenda.
messages.zh: 委员会主席，他会先和我们一起过一遍议程。
messages.en: The committee chairperson; first he'll go through the agenda with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 president 放进两个画面记忆：国家场合是总统，委员会开会时是主席；根据所领导的对象判断中文译法。

gloss_zh: 总统或主席的职务、任期

teaching_sense.en_definition: The office, responsibilities, or term of a president or chairperson.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 总统或主席所担任的职务、承担的职责，或其在任的时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kariga, ir-responsabbiltajiet jew il-perjodu fil-kariga ta' president jew ta' persuna li tmexxi kumitat jew organizzazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总统或主席的职位、职责或任期。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kariga u d-dmirijiet ta' president, jew iż-żmien li fih persuna tokkupa din il-kariga.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The presidency is the office held by a president, or the period during which someone holds that office.

collocations.zh: 在她担任总统或主席期间

formal.mt: Matul il-presidenza tagħha, il-kumitat introduċa regoli ġodda biex itejjeb it-trasparenza.
formal.en: During her chairmanship, the committee introduced new rules to improve transparency.
formal.zh: 在她担任主席期间，委员会引入了新规则，以提高透明度。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min se jieħu l-presidenza tal-klabb din is-sena? Pawlu: Anna. Ilbieraħ ivvutajna għaliha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Who will take over as president of the club this year? Pawlu: Anna. We voted for her yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Marija：今年谁来担任俱乐部主席？Pawlu：Anna。我们昨天投票选了她。

messages.mt_standard: Min se jieħu l-presidenza tal-klabb din is-sena?
messages.zh: 今年谁来担任俱乐部主席？
messages.en: Who will take over as president of the club this year?

messages.mt_standard: Anna. Ilbieraħ ivvutajna għaliha.

messages.en: Anna. We voted for her yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 presidenza 想成主席席位旁的一本任期日历：席位提示职务，日历提示在任时期。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physical force acting on a surface, or demands and influence that make someone feel compelled to act.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体表面受到的压力或压强；也指要求、影响或处境给人造成的心理压力或行动上的逼迫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forza li taġixxi fuq wiċċ, jew l-effett ta' talbiet, influwenza jew ċirkostanzi li jġiegħlu lil persuna tħossha mġiegħla taġixxi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作用在物体表面上的压力或压强；也指促使某人行动的外在压力或心理负担。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forza eżerċitata fuq wiċċ, jew talbiet u influwenzi li joħolqu tensjoni jew iġiegħlu lil xi ħadd jagħmel xi ħaġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Pressure is force acting on a surface, or the demands and influence that make someone feel obliged to act.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri li l-impjegati qed jaħdmu taħt pressjoni kbira minħabba n-nuqqas ta' ħin.
formal.en: The report shows that employees are working under considerable pressure because of a lack of time.
formal.zh: 报告显示，由于时间不足，员工正承受着很大的工作压力。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex int daqshekk inkwetat? Mark: Għandi ħafna pressjoni fuq ix-xogħol. Irrid inlesti kollox sal-Ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you so worried? Mark: I'm under a lot of pressure at work. I have to finish everything by Friday.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你为什么这么担心？Mark：我的工作压力很大。我得在星期五之前把所有事情做完。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex int daqshekk inkwetat?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex int daqshekk inkwetat?
messages.zh: 你为什么这么担心？
messages.en: Why are you so worried?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ħafna pressjoni fuq ix-xogħol. Irrid inlesti kollox sal-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ħafna pressjoni fuq ix-xogħol. Irrid inlesti kollox sal-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 我的工作压力很大。我得在星期五之前把所有事情做完。
messages.en: I'm under a lot of pressure at work. I have to finish everything by Friday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pressjoni 时想象一只手往下压：压在物体上是物理压力，压在心头上是心理压力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The pressure exerted by circulating blood against the walls of blood vessels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 循环中的血液对血管壁产生的压力，日常测量通常指动脉血压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-pressjoni li d-demm jiċċirkola biha kontra l-ħitan tal-vini u tal-arterji, u li normalment titkejjel fl-arterji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 血液在循环时对血管壁施加的压力，通常用来指动脉血压。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-forza li d-demm jeżerċita fuq il-ħitan tal-vini u tal-arterji waqt li jiċċirkola fil-ġisem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Your blood pressure is the pressure that your circulating blood exerts against the walls of your blood vessels.

formal.mt: Matul iż-żjara fil-klinika, l-infermiera kejlet il-pressjoni tad-demm tal-pazjent u rreġistrat ir-riżultat.
formal.en: During the clinic visit, the nurse measured the patient's blood pressure and recorded the result.
formal.zh: 在这次门诊就诊中，护士测量了患者的血压，并记录了结果。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Tista' tkejjel il-pressjoni tad-demm tiegħi, jekk jogħġbok? Elena: Iva, poġġi bilqiegħda hawn.
colloquial.en: Rita: Could you measure my blood pressure, please? Elena: Yes, have a seat here.
colloquial.zh: Rita：请帮我量一下血压，好吗？Elena：可以，请坐在这里。

messages.speaker: Rita (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tkejjel il-pressjoni tad-demm tiegħi, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tkejjel il-pressjoni tad-demm tiegħi, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请帮我量一下血压，好吗？
messages.en: Could you measure my blood pressure, please?

messages.speaker: Elena (护士)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, poġġi bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, poġġi bilqiegħda hawn.
messages.zh: 可以，请坐在这里。
messages.en: Yes, have a seat here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上量血压的袖带画面：pressjoni 提示压力，tad-demm 限定为血液的压力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: How well someone or something performs a task, a public artistic presentation, or an impressive achievement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物完成任务时的表现；面向观众的艺术演出；也可指需要能力或努力才能完成的非凡成就。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna jew ħaġa twettaq kompitu, wirja artistika quddiem udjenza, jew kisba notevoli li teħtieġ ħila jew sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完成任务或参与活动时的表现；也指面向观众进行的一场表演或演出。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna jew ħaġa twettaq xogħol jew attività, jew wirja ta' reċtar, mużika jew arti oħra quddiem udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A performance is how well someone or something carries out an activity, or an artistic presentation given to an audience.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要出色的技能、力量、勇气或努力才能完成的壮举或非凡成就。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kisba notevoli li teħtieġ ħila, saħħa, kuraġġ jew sforz kbir biex titwettaq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A feat is an impressive achievement that requires considerable skill, strength, courage, or effort to accomplish.

formal.mt: Li temmet it-tellieqa minkejja l-kundizzjonijiet diffiċli kienet prestazzjoni straordinarja ta' reżistenza.
formal.en: Finishing the race despite the difficult conditions was an extraordinary feat of endurance.
formal.zh: 尽管条件艰苦，她仍完成了比赛，这是一项展现非凡耐力的壮举。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif kienet il-prestazzjoni ta' Sara lbieraħ? David: Kienet mill-aqwa! Kantat tant tajjeb li kulħadd qam iċapċap.
colloquial.en: Marta: How was Sara's performance yesterday? David: It was excellent! She sang so well that everyone stood up to applaud.
colloquial.zh: Marta：Sara昨天的演出怎么样？David：棒极了！她唱得非常好，大家都站起来鼓掌。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kienet il-prestazzjoni ta' Sara lbieraħ?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kienet il-prestazzjoni ta' Sara lbieraħ?
messages.zh: Sara昨天的演出怎么样？
messages.en: How was Sara's performance yesterday?

messages.speaker: David (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet mill-aqwa! Kantat tant tajjeb li kulħadd qam iċapċap.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet mill-aqwa! Kantat tant tajjeb li kulħadd qam iċapċap.
messages.zh: 棒极了！她唱得非常好，大家都站起来鼓掌。
messages.en: It was excellent! She sang so well that everyone stood up to applaud.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画记 prestazzjoni：工作评分表对应表现，舞台对应演出，艰难冲线对应非凡成就；靠语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The results achieved by an organisation, activity, or product in managing its effects on the environment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织、活动或产品在管理其对环境的影响方面所取得的实际成效。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-riżultati li organizzazzjoni, attività jew prodott jikseb fil-ġestjoni tal-effetti tiegħu fuq l-ambjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 环境绩效，指组织、活动或产品在控制环境影响、减少污染及节约资源等方面的实际表现。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' suċċess ta' organizzazzjoni, attività jew prodott fit-tnaqqis tal-ħsara lill-ambjent u fl-użu responsabbli tar-riżorsi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The environmental performance of an organisation, activity, or product is how well it manages its effects on the environment.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali jevalwa l-prestazzjoni ambjentali tal-kumpanija abbażi tal-konsum tal-ilma, l-użu tal-enerġija u l-ammont ta' skart.
formal.en: The annual report assesses the company's environmental performance on the basis of water consumption, energy use, and the amount of waste.
formal.zh: 年度报告根据用水量、能源使用情况和废弃物数量评估公司的环境绩效。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif sejra l-prestazzjoni ambjentali tal-lukanda? Pawlu: Aħjar minn qabel. Qed nużaw inqas ilma u nipproduċu inqas skart.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is the hotel's environmental performance? Pawlu: Better than before. We're using less water and producing less waste.
colloquial.zh: Lara：酒店的环保表现怎么样？Pawlu：比以前好了。我们现在用水更少，产生的垃圾也更少。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif sejra l-prestazzjoni ambjentali tal-lukanda?
messages.mt_standard: Kif sejra l-prestazzjoni ambjentali tal-lukanda?
messages.zh: 酒店的环保表现怎么样？
messages.en: How is the hotel's environmental performance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (酒店经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar minn qabel. Qed nużaw inqas ilma u nipproduċu inqas skart.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar minn qabel. Qed nużaw inqas ilma u nipproduċu inqas skart.
messages.zh: 比以前好了。我们现在用水更少，产生的垃圾也更少。
messages.en: Better than before. We're using less water and producing less waste.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词组记成企业的“环保成绩单”：看节水、节能和减废的实际成绩，就想到 prestazzjoni ambjentali。

gloss_zh: 享有盛誉的；声望很高的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Widely respected and admired because of recognised quality, achievement, or status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因公认的品质、成就或地位而广受尊重和推崇的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgawdi rispett u ammirazzjoni kbira minħabba l-kwalità, il-kisbiet jew il-pożizzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 享有很高声望的；因卓越品质、成就或地位而备受推崇的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu reputazzjoni għolja u huwa meqjus b'ħafna rispett minħabba l-kwalità, is-suċċess jew l-importanza tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is prestigious is highly respected and admired because people recognise its quality, achievements, or importance.

formal.mt: Il-kittieb ingħata premju prestiġjuż bħala rikonoxximent tal-kontribut tiegħu għal-letteratura.
formal.en: The writer received a prestigious award in recognition of his contribution to literature.
formal.zh: 这位作家获颁一个享有盛誉的奖项，以表彰他对文学的贡献。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Taf li ħija rebaħ premju prestiġjuż? David: Tassew? Prosit! Għal liema xogħol rebħu?
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you know my brother won a prestigious award? David: Really? Congratulations! Which work did he win it for?
colloquial.zh: Marija：你知道吗，我哥哥获得了一个很有声望的奖项。David：真的吗？恭喜！他是凭哪部作品获奖的？

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf li ħija rebaħ premju prestiġjuż?
messages.mt_standard: Taf li ħija rebaħ premju prestiġjuż?
messages.zh: 你知道吗，我哥哥获得了一个很有声望的奖项。
messages.en: Did you know my brother won a prestigious award?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tassew? Prosit! Għal liema xogħol rebħu?
messages.mt_standard: Tassew? Prosit! Għal liema xogħol rebħu?
messages.zh: 真的吗？恭喜！他是凭哪部作品获奖的？
messages.en: Really? Congratulations! Which work did he win it for?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人人敬重的文学大奖，用 premju prestiġjuż 整组记忆；搭配阴性名词时可见 prestiġjuża。

gloss_zh: 自命不凡；自负的姿态；权利主张；索求

teaching_sense.en_definition: An attempt to appear more important or capable than one is, or an assertion that one is entitled to something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表现得比实际更重要或更有能力的姿态；也指声称自己有权获得某物的主张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb jew l-attitudni li wieħed huwa aktar importanti jew kapaċi milli hu tassew, jew talba bbażata fuq dritt li wieħed jgħid li għandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自命不凡或自负的姿态，指自认为具有超出实际的重要性、才干或地位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attitudni li biha wieħed jippreżenta ruħu bħala aktar importanti, kapaċi jew ta' livell ogħla milli hu fil-fatt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pretension is an attempt to appear more important, knowledgeable, or accomplished than you really are.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 权利主张或索求，指声称自己对某物享有权利或应当获得某种补偿。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Talba li fiha persuna ssostni li għandha dritt għal xi ħaġa, bħal proprjetà, ħlas jew kumpens.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A claim is an assertion that you have a right to something or should receive something.

collocations.zh: 自以为什么都懂的姿态

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, is-sid ressaq pretensjoni għal kumpens u spjega l-ħsara li kienet saret lill-proprjetà.
formal.en: In his letter, the owner put forward a claim for compensation and explained the damage that had been done to the property.
formal.zh: 业主在信中提出了索赔主张，并说明了房产所遭受的损坏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex idejqek daqshekk dak ir-raġel? Karl: Għandu l-pretensjoni li jaf kollox, u qatt ma jisma' lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why does that man annoy you so much? Karl: He acts as though he knows everything, and he never listens to anyone.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那个人为什么让你这么烦？Karl：他自以为什么都懂，而且从来不听别人的话。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex idejqek daqshekk dak ir-raġel?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex idejqek daqshekk dak ir-raġel?
messages.zh: 那个人为什么让你这么烦？
messages.en: Why does that man annoy you so much?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandu l-pretensjoni li jaf kollox, u qatt ma jisma' lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għandu l-pretensjoni li jaf kollox, u qatt ma jisma' lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 他自以为什么都懂，而且从来不听别人的话。
messages.en: He acts as though he knows everything, and he never listens to anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面区分义项：昂头说“我什么都懂”记自负，递上赔偿要求记权利主张；两者都可用 pretensjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reason given to justify an action while concealing the real reason.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某个行为提出、用来掩盖真实动机的表面理由。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġuni li tingħata biex tiġġustifika azzjoni u taħbi r-raġuni vera tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 借口或托词，指为掩饰真实原因或动机而提出的表面理由。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skuża jew raġuni apparenti li persuna tagħti għal dak li tagħmel, waqt li taħbi l-motiv veru tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pretext is a reason someone gives for doing something in order to hide their real reason.

collocations.en: look for a pretext to leave

formal.mt: Il-maniġer evita l-laqgħa taħt il-pretest li kellu impenn ieħor, iżda r-raġuni vera kienet li ma riedx jiddiskuti l-ilmenti.
formal.en: The manager avoided the meeting on the pretext that he had another commitment, but the real reason was that he did not want to discuss the complaints.
formal.zh: 经理以另有安排为借口避开了会议，但真正的原因是他不想讨论那些投诉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex tlaqt daqshekk kmieni mill-festa? Luqa: Użajt ix-xogħol bħala pretest. Fil-verità, kont iddejjaqt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you leave the party so early? Luqa: I used work as a pretext. The truth is, I was bored.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么那么早就离开聚会了？Luqa：我拿工作当借口。其实，我觉得很无聊。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tlaqt daqshekk kmieni mill-festa?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tlaqt daqshekk kmieni mill-festa?
messages.zh: 你为什么那么早就离开聚会了？
messages.en: Why did you leave the party so early?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Użajt ix-xogħol bħala pretest. Fil-verità, kont iddejjaqt.
messages.mt_standard: Użajt ix-xogħol bħala pretest. Fil-verità, kont iddejjaqt.
messages.zh: 我拿工作当借口。其实，我觉得很无聊。
messages.en: I used work as a pretext. The truth is, I was bored.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象聚会上有人说“有工作先走”，心里却只是觉得无聊；说出口的掩饰理由就是 pretest，可连同 bħala pretest 一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Action taken beforehand to stop something harmful or unwanted from happening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事先采取措施，防止有害或不希望发生的事情出现。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħidma jew il-miżuri li jittieħdu minn qabel biex xi ħaġa ta' ħsara jew mhux mixtieqa ma sseħħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预防；通过事先采取措施，阻止有害或不希望发生的事情。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-teħid ta' miżuri minn qabel biex jiġi evitat li sseħħ xi ħaġa ta' ħsara jew mhux mixtieqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prevention is the action you take to stop something harmful or unwanted from happening.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预先考虑；在事情发生之前，对可能出现的情况作出预想。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kunsiderazzjoni minn qabel ta' dak li jista' jiġri, qabel ma dan iseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Anticipation is the act of considering what may happen before it actually occurs.

formal.mt: Il-programm jagħti importanza lill-prevenzjoni tal-inċidenti permezz ta' taħriġ regolari.
formal.en: The programme gives importance to accident prevention through regular training.
formal.zh: 该项目重视通过定期培训预防事故。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw il-brejkijiet qabel nitilqu? Mark: Għall-prevenzjoni tal-inċidenti. Aħjar insibu problema issa milli fit-triq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we checking the brakes before we leave? Mark: To prevent accidents. It is better to find a problem now than on the road.
colloquial.zh: Maja：为什么出发前要检查刹车？Mark：为了预防事故。现在发现问题，总比在路上发现好。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw il-brejkijiet qabel nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed niċċekkjaw il-brejkijiet qabel nitilqu?
messages.zh: 为什么出发前要检查刹车？
messages.en: Why are we checking the brakes before we leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-prevenzjoni tal-inċidenti. Aħjar insibu problema issa milli fit-triq.
messages.mt_standard: Għall-prevenzjoni tal-inċidenti. Aħjar insibu problema issa milli fit-triq.
messages.zh: 为了预防事故。现在发现问题，总比在路上发现好。
messages.en: To prevent accidents. It is better to find a problem now than on the road.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和出发前检查刹车的画面绑定：先采取措施，再避免事故，就能记住“预防”；另一义则侧重事情发生前的预先考虑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expected to happen on the basis of a prediction or an assessment made beforehand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据事先的预测或判断，预计会发生的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun mistenni li jseħħ skont tbassir jew stima magħmula minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测的；根据已有信息或事先判断而预计会发生的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun intqal jew ġie stmat minn qabel li se jseħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is predicted is expected to happen according to an earlier assessment or forecast.

formal.mt: It-tkabbir previst fil-bejgħ huwa bbażat fuq id-data tal-aħħar sitt xhur.
formal.en: The predicted growth in sales is based on data from the last six months.
formal.zh: 预计的销售增长以过去六个月的数据为依据。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ir-riżultat kien sorpriża għalik? Pawlu: Le, kien ir-riżultat previst. It-tim l-ieħor kien aktar b'saħħtu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the result a surprise to you? Pawlu: No, it was the predicted result. The other team was stronger.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这个结果让你意外吗？Pawlu：不，这是预料中的结果。另一支队伍实力更强。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-riżultat kien sorpriża għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Ir-riżultat kien sorpriża għalik?
messages.zh: 这个结果让你意外吗？
messages.en: Was the result a surprise to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, kien ir-riżultat previst. It-tim l-ieħor kien aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, kien ir-riżultat previst. It-tim l-ieħor kien aktar b'saħħtu.
messages.zh: 不，这是预料中的结果。另一支队伍实力更强。
messages.en: No, it was the predicted result. The other team was stronger.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象赛前在纸上写下比分，赛后说“这是预料中的结果”。把 previst 放进 ir-riżultat previst 一起记，突出“事先预测的”这个性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement or estimate of what is likely to happen in the future.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对未来可能发生的事情所作的判断、估计或预测结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew stima dwar dak li x'aktarx se jiġri fil-futur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预测；根据现有信息，对未来情况所作的估计或判断。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stima ta' dak li x'aktarx se jiġri fil-futur, magħmula fuq il-bażi tal-informazzjoni disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A forecast is a statement about what is likely to happen in the future, based on available information.

formal.mt: Il-previżjoni tal-bejgħ għas-sena d-dieħla tindika żieda moderata fid-domanda.
formal.en: The sales forecast for next year indicates a moderate increase in demand.
formal.zh: 明年的销售预测显示，需求将温和增长。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm taħseb li se nbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel? Mark: Skont il-previżjoni, ftit aktar minn dan ix-xahar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much do you think we will sell next month? Mark: According to the forecast, a little more than this month.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得我们下个月能卖出多少？Mark：按照预测，会比这个月多一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm taħseb li se nbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm taħseb li se nbigħu x-xahar id-dieħel?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们下个月能卖出多少？
messages.en: How much do you think we will sell next month?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-previżjoni, ftit aktar minn dan ix-xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-previżjoni, ftit aktar minn dan ix-xahar.
messages.zh: 按照预测，会比这个月多一点。
messages.en: According to the forecast, a little more than this month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 previżjoni 想成一张写着“下个月预计销量”的表：它是名词“预测”。再与 previst“预测的”对照，用“预测表”和“预测的结果”区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A report predicting the weather for a particular place and period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 预测某个地区在某段时间内天气状况的报告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rapport li jbassar kif x'aktarx se jkun it-temp f'post partikolari matul perjodu speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 天气预报；对特定地区未来一段时间的天气状况所作的预测报告。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Rapport dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tat-temp li huma mistennija f'post u fi żmien partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A weather forecast is a report describing what the weather is likely to be in a particular place and period.

formal.mt: Skont il-previżjoni tat-temp għal għada, hemm ċans ta' xita filgħodu.
formal.en: According to tomorrow's weather forecast, there is a chance of rain in the morning.
formal.zh: 根据明天的天气预报，上午可能有雨。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nieħdu umbrella magħna? Ġużeppi: Iva, il-previżjoni tat-temp tgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita wara nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Shall we take an umbrella with us? Ġużeppi: Yes, the weather forecast says it will rain in the afternoon.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们带把伞吗？Ġużeppi：带吧，天气预报说下午会下雨。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nieħdu umbrella magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Nieħdu umbrella magħna?
messages.zh: 我们带把伞吗？
messages.en: Shall we take an umbrella with us?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-previżjoni tat-temp tgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita wara nofsinhar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-previżjoni tat-temp tgħid li se tagħmel ix-xita wara nofsinhar.
messages.zh: 带吧，天气预报说下午会下雨。
messages.en: Yes, the weather forecast says it will rain in the afternoon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语和出门前查看雨云图的动作绑定：previżjoni 表示“预测”，tat-temp 把范围限定到天气，合起来就是决定要不要带伞时看的“天气预报”。

exact_key: prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas

teaching_sense.en_definition: The price that a buyer has actually paid or is obliged to pay for goods or services.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 买方为货物或服务实际已经支付或负有支付义务的价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prezz li xerrej ikun verament ħallas jew li jkun obbligat iħallas għal oġġetti jew servizzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实际已付或应付的价格，既包括已经支付的价格，也包括尚未支付但应当支付的价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prezz li jkun tħallas fil-fatt jew li għad irid jitħallas skont l-obbligu tax-xerrej.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The price actually paid or payable is the price a buyer has already paid or has an obligation to pay.

collocations.mt: jiddikjara l-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas
collocations.en: to declare the price actually paid or payable

collocations.mt: jivverifika l-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas
collocations.en: to verify the price actually paid or payable

formal.mt: Ix-xerrej għandu jindika fid-dokument il-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas għall-oġġetti.
formal.en: The buyer must indicate in the document the price actually paid or payable for the goods.
formal.zh: 买方须在文件中注明货物的实付或应付价格。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn qed jitolbu l-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas. Xi nikteb jekk għadni ma ħallastx? Pawlu: Ikteb il-prezz li int obbligata tħallas, anki jekk għadek ma ħallastux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Here they're asking for the price actually paid or payable. What should I write if I haven't paid yet? Pawlu: Write the price you're obliged to pay, even if you haven't paid it yet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里要求填写实付或应付价格。如果我还没付款，该填什么？保罗：填你有义务支付的价格，即使你还没付。

messages.speaker: Maja (买方)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn qed jitolbu l-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas. Xi nikteb jekk għadni ma ħallastx?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn qed jitolbu l-prezz effettivament imħallas jew li għandu jitħallas. Xi nikteb jekk għadni ma ħallastx?
messages.zh: 这里要求填写实付或应付价格。如果我还没付款，该填什么？
messages.en: Here they're asking for the price actually paid or payable. What should I write if I haven't paid yet?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会计)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb il-prezz li int obbligata tħallas, anki jekk għadek ma ħallastux.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb il-prezz li int obbligata tħallas, anki jekk għadek ma ħallastux.
messages.zh: 填你有义务支付的价格，即使你还没付。
messages.en: Write the price you're obliged to pay, even if you haven't paid it yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“价格＋实际已付＋或＋应当支付”来记：一边是已经付款，另一边是尚未付款但负有付款义务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The highest price permitted for a particular product or service under a rule or agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据规定或协议，某种商品或服务所允许收取的最高价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ogħla prezz li jista' jintalab għal prodott jew servizz skont regola jew ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由规定或协议设定、收费不得超过的价格上限。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prezz stabbilit bħala l-ogħla ammont permess għal prodott jew servizz, li l-bejjiegħ ma jistax jaqbeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ceiling price is the highest amount sellers are permitted to charge.

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi prezz limitu ta' għoxrin ewro għal kull biljett, u l-organizzatur ma jistax jitlob aktar minn hekk.
formal.en: The agreement sets a ceiling price of twenty euros per ticket, and the organiser cannot charge more than that.
formal.zh: 协议规定每张票的最高限价为二十欧元，主办方不得收取更高的价格。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Jistgħu jitolbu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro għall-biljett? Pawlu: Le, il-prezz limitu huwa għoxrin ewro.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can they charge twenty-five euros for the ticket? Pawlu: No, the ceiling price is twenty euros.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：他们可以收二十五欧元一张票吗？保罗：不可以，最高限价是二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Jistgħu jitolbu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro għall-biljett?
messages.mt_standard: Jistgħu jitolbu ħamsa u għoxrin ewro għall-biljett?
messages.zh: 他们可以收二十五欧元一张票吗？
messages.en: Can they charge twenty-five euros for the ticket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezz limitu huwa għoxrin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezz limitu huwa għoxrin ewro.
messages.zh: 不可以，最高限价是二十欧元。
messages.en: No, the ceiling price is twenty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把价格想成向上移动的数字，头顶有一条不可越过的横线；这条线就是“价格上限”。

gloss_zh: 最高限价；允许收取的最高价格

teaching_sense.en_definition: The maximum amount that may be charged for a product or service under an established limit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在既定限额下，某种商品或服务可以收取的最高金额。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-akbar ammont li jista' jintalab għal prodott jew servizz skont limitu stabbilit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按规定或协议允许收取的最高价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ogħla prezz permess għal prodott jew servizz skont regola jew ftehim, li ma jistax jinqabeż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ceiling price sets the maximum permitted charge for a particular product or service.

formal.mt: Skont ir-regoli tal-fiera, il-prezz massimu għal flixkun ilma huwa żewġ ewro, u kull bejjiegħ għandu josserva dan il-limitu.
formal.en: Under the fair's rules, the ceiling price for a bottle of water is two euros, and every seller must observe this limit.
formal.zh: 根据集市规定，每瓶水的最高限价为两欧元，每位商贩都必须遵守这一限额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-flixkun ilma jiswa tliet ewro? Ġanni: Le, hawn il-prezz massimu huwa żewġ ewro.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does this bottle of water cost three euros? Ġanni: No, the ceiling price here is two euros.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这瓶水要三欧元吗？詹尼：不用，这里的最高限价是两欧元。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-flixkun ilma jiswa tliet ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-flixkun ilma jiswa tliet ewro?
messages.zh: 这瓶水要三欧元吗？
messages.en: Does this bottle of water cost three euros?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (摊主)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hawn il-prezz massimu huwa żewġ ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hawn il-prezz massimu huwa żewġ ewro.
messages.zh: 不用，这里的最高限价是两欧元。
messages.en: No, the ceiling price here is two euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水摊挂着“每瓶最多两欧元”的牌子，把整个短语与“最多能收多少”连起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lowest price permitted, required, or accepted in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在特定情况下获准、要求或愿意接受的最低价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inqas prezz li jkun permess, meħtieġ jew aċċettat f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格下限；由规则、政策或协议规定，不得低于的价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Limitu t'isfel għall-prezz, stabbilit b'regola, politika jew ftehim, li ma jistax jinqabeż lejn isfel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A floor price is a price limit below which something may not be sold under a particular rule or agreement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最低价格；某项商品、服务或交易所规定或接受的最低金额。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-inqas ammont ta' flus stabbilit jew aċċettat għal prodott, servizz jew tranżazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The minimum price is the lowest amount specified or accepted for a particular product, service, or transaction.

collocations.en: be sold below the minimum price
collocations.zh: 以低于最低价格的价格出售

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi prezz minimu ta' għoxrin ewro għal kull unità.
formal.en: The agreement sets a minimum price of twenty euros per unit.
formal.zh: 协议规定，每件商品的最低价格为二十欧元。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tbigħhieli bi ħmistax-il ewro? Lara: Le, il-prezz minimu li nista' naċċetta huwa għoxrin ewro.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you sell it to me for fifteen euros? Lara: No, the minimum price I can accept is twenty euros.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你能以十五欧元卖给我吗？拉拉：不行，我能接受的最低价格是二十欧元。

messages.speaker: Mark (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tbigħhieli bi ħmistax-il ewro?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tbigħhieli bi ħmistax-il ewro?
messages.zh: 你能以十五欧元卖给我吗？
messages.en: Can you sell it to me for fifteen euros?

messages.speaker: Lara (卖家)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezz minimu li nista' naċċetta huwa għoxrin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezz minimu li nista' naċċetta huwa għoxrin ewro.
messages.zh: 不行，我能接受的最低价格是二十欧元。
messages.en: No, the minimum price I can accept is twenty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prezz 想成价签，把 minimu 和最低刻度联系起来：价签降到这条线，就到了最低价或价格下限。

gloss_zh: 净价；债券不含应计利息的报价

teaching_sense.en_definition: The quoted price of a bond excluding interest accrued since its last interest payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 债券的报价，不包括自上次付息以来累计的应计利息。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prezz ikkwotat ta' bond li ma jinkludix l-imgħax akkumulat mill-aħħar ħlas tal-imgħax.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 净价；债券报价中不包含自上次付息日起累计的应计利息的价格。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-prezz ta' bond ikkwotat mingħajr l-imgħax li jkun akkumula minn meta sar l-aħħar ħlas tal-imgħax.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The clean price of a bond is its quoted price before any accrued interest is added.

collocations.en: the clean price of the bond

formal.mt: It-tabella turi l-prezz nadif tal-bond; l-imgħax akkumulat huwa elenkat separatament.
formal.en: The table shows the bond's clean price; accrued interest is listed separately.
formal.zh: 表格列出该债券的净价，应计利息另行列示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prezz tal-bond jinkludi l-imgħax akkumulat? Pawlu: Le, dan huwa l-prezz nadif. L-imgħax akkumulat jiżdied separatament.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this bond price include accrued interest? Pawlu: No, this is the clean price. Accrued interest is added separately.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个债券价格包括应计利息吗？保罗：不包括，这是净价。应计利息需要另外加上。

messages.speaker: Maja (金融课程学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prezz tal-bond jinkludi l-imgħax akkumulat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prezz tal-bond jinkludi l-imgħax akkumulat?
messages.zh: 这个债券价格包括应计利息吗？
messages.en: Does this bond price include accrued interest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (金融课程教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan huwa l-prezz nadif. L-imgħax akkumulat jiżdied separatament.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan huwa l-prezz nadif. L-imgħax akkumulat jiżdied separatament.
messages.zh: 不包括，这是净价。应计利息需要另外加上。
messages.en: No, this is the clean price. Accrued interest is added separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“干净的价签”作学习联想：prezz nadif 的债券价签上没有附带应计利息，记住净价之外还要另加这部分利息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The minimum price that a seller is willing to accept for an item at auction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 卖方愿意在拍卖中接受的最低成交价格。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-inqas prezz li bejjiegħ ikun lest jaċċetta għal oġġett f'irkant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍卖前设定的最低可接受售价，出价须达到该价格才符合卖方的最低价格要求。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prezz minimu stabbilit għal oġġett f'irkant li offerta trid tilħaq biex tissodisfa l-kundizzjoni tal-bejjiegħ dwar il-prezz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserve price is the lowest amount a seller has set as acceptable for an item offered at auction.

formal.mt: L-ogħla offerta ma laħqitx il-prezz ta' riżerva, u għalhekk il-pittura ma nbiegħetx.
formal.en: The highest bid did not reach the reserve price, so the painting was not sold.
formal.zh: 最高出价未达到拍卖保留价，因此这幅画没有售出。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Offrewli mitejn ewro għar-rota fl-irkant. Toni: U se tbigħha? Nina: Le, il-prezz ta' riżerva huwa mitejn u ħamsin ewro.
colloquial.en: Nina: They offered me two hundred euros for the bicycle at the auction. Toni: So are you going to sell it? Nina: No, the reserve price is two hundred and fifty euros.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：拍卖时有人为我的自行车出价两百欧元。托尼：那你要卖吗？妮娜：不卖，拍卖保留价是两百五十欧元。

messages.speaker: Nina (卖方)
messages.mt_spoken: Offrewli mitejn ewro għar-rota fl-irkant.
messages.mt_standard: Offrewli mitejn ewro għar-rota fl-irkant.
messages.zh: 拍卖时有人为我的自行车出价两百欧元。
messages.en: They offered me two hundred euros for the bicycle at the auction.

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: U se tbigħha?
messages.mt_standard: U se tbigħha?
messages.zh: 那你要卖吗？
messages.en: So are you going to sell it?

messages.speaker: Nina (卖方)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, il-prezz ta' riżerva huwa mitejn u ħamsin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, il-prezz ta' riżerva huwa mitejn u ħamsin ewro.
messages.zh: 不卖，拍卖保留价是两百五十欧元。
messages.en: No, the reserve price is two hundred and fifty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象卖方心里画了一条最低价格线：出价不到这条线就不接受。用“守住最低成交价”的画面记住这个拍卖词组。

gloss_zh: 日前价格；日前电价；日平均价格

teaching_sense.en_definition: A price agreed or established one day before delivery, especially for electricity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在交付前一天商定或确定的价格，尤其指电力的日前价格。
