messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott alimentari fih ħalib? Jien ma nistax nieħu ħalib.
messages.zh: 这种食品含牛奶吗？我不能喝牛奶。
messages.en: Does this food product contain milk? I can't have milk.

messages.speaker: Mark (食品店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw il-lista tal-ingredjenti fuq it-tikketta biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw il-lista tal-ingredjenti fuq it-tikketta biex inkunu ċerti.
messages.zh: 我们看看标签上的配料表，确认一下。
messages.en: Let's read the ingredient list on the label to make sure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prodott 想成货架上的“产品”，把 alimentari 与食品区的画面一起记：一袋面粉、一盒饼干都能帮助联想“食品产品”。三个英文释义彼此重叠，不必硬分成三类实物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product alleged to have been sold in a foreign market through dumping, without the allegation being treated as an established fact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被指涉嫌在外国市场以倾销方式销售、但该指控尚不能视为既定事实的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li dwaru hemm allegazzjoni li nbiegħ f'suq barrani bi prattika ta' dumping, mingħajr ma l-allegazzjoni titqies bħala fatt stabbilit.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被指涉嫌以倾销方式销售的产品；这一称谓本身不表示指控已经成立。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li allegatament kien soġġett għal prattika ta' dumping fil-bejgħ tiegħu f'suq barrani.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An allegedly dumped product is a product that is claimed to have been sold in a foreign market through dumping, although the claim has not necessarily been established.

collocations.mt: investigazzjoni dwar prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping
collocations.en: an investigation into an allegedly dumped product
collocations.zh: 针对涉嫌被倾销产品的调查

collocations.mt: l-importazzjoni ta' prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping
collocations.en: the importation of an allegedly dumped product
collocations.zh: 涉嫌被倾销产品的进口

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping u jagħmilha ċara li l-allegazzjoni għadha qed tiġi eżaminata.
formal.en: The report describes the allegedly dumped product and makes clear that the allegation is still being examined.
formal.zh: 报告描述了涉嫌被倾销的产品，并明确指出有关指控仍在审查中。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ir-rapport jgħid 'prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping'? Pawlu: Għax hemm allegazzjoni ta' dumping, iżda għadhom qed jeżaminawha.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why does the report say 'allegedly dumped product'? Pawlu: Because there is an allegation of dumping, but they are still examining it.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：为什么报告说“涉嫌被倾销的产品”？保罗：因为存在倾销指控，但他们还在审查。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-rapport jgħid 'prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping'?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-rapport jgħid 'prodott allegatament oġġett ta' dumping'?
messages.zh: 为什么报告说“涉嫌被倾销的产品”？
messages.en: Why does the report say 'allegedly dumped product'?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm allegazzjoni ta' dumping, iżda għadhom qed jeżaminawha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm allegazzjoni ta' dumping, iżda għadhom qed jeżaminawha.
messages.zh: 因为存在倾销指控，但他们还在审查。
messages.en: Because there is an allegation of dumping, but they are still examining it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成报告上的“涉嫌倾销产品”标签；特别圈出 allegatament，提醒自己“有人指称”不等于“已经证实”。

gloss_zh: 类别界定不明的产品；边界产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product whose classification is unclear because it lies near the boundary between two or more categories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于两个或多个类别的边界、难以明确归入其中一类的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li l-klassifikazzjoni tiegħu mhijiex ċara għax jinsab bejn żewġ kategoriji jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有不同类别特征、归类边界不清的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li għandu karatteristiċi ta' kategoriji differenti u għalhekk ma jkunx ċar f'liema kategorija għandu jidħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A borderline product is a product that cannot easily be assigned to a single category because its characteristics place it near the boundary between categories.

collocations.en: the classification of a borderline product
the assessment of a borderline product
collocations.zh: 对类别界定不明产品的评估

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiġi kklassifikat il-prodott ambigwu, għandhom jiġu eżaminati l-karatteristiċi u l-użu maħsub tiegħu.
formal.en: Before the borderline product is classified, its characteristics and intended use should be examined.
formal.zh: 在对该边界产品进行分类之前，应考察其特征及预期用途。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-prodott f'liema kategorija jidħol? Mark: Għadu mhux ċar; hu prodott ambigwu u rridu neżaminaw il-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which category does this product belong to? Mark: It is still unclear; it is a borderline product, and we need to examine its characteristics.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个产品属于哪一类？马克：还不清楚；这是个边界产品，我们需要考察它的特征。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott f'liema kategorija jidħol?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott f'liema kategorija jidħol?
messages.zh: 这个产品属于哪一类？
messages.en: Which category does this product belong to?

messages.speaker: Mark (产品专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mhux ċar; hu prodott ambigwu u rridu neżaminaw il-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mhux ċar; hu prodott ambigwu u rridu neżaminaw il-karatteristiċi tiegħu.
messages.zh: 还不清楚；这是个边界产品，我们需要考察它的特征。
messages.en: It is still unclear; it is a borderline product, and we need to examine its characteristics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个产品放在两个分类盒子的交界线上：prodott ambigwu 强调“归哪一类不清楚”，不要直接理解成质量有问题。

gloss_zh: 基本产品；大宗商品；初级产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A basic product used to meet an essential need or to provide the starting point for further production.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 满足基本需要，或作为后续生产起点的基础性产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jintuża biex jissodisfa ħtieġa essenzjali jew biex iservi bħala bażi għal aktar produzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于满足基本需要或提供基础用途的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jaqdi ħtieġa fundamentali jew li jintuża għal skop bażiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A basic product is a product that meets a fundamental need or provides a simple foundation for a particular use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为市场交易对象的基础商品，常为原材料或农产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott kummerċjali, ħafna drabi materja prima jew prodott agrikolu, li jinxtara u jinbiegħ fis-suq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A commodity is a product, often a raw material or an agricultural good, that is bought and sold in a market.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接从自然资源中取得、未经加工或仅经过少量加工的初级产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott miksub direttament minn riżorsi naturali li jkun għadda minn ftit jew ebda proċessar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A primary product is a product obtained directly from natural resources that has undergone little or no processing.

collocations.en: the production of a basic product
the export of a primary product

formal.mt: Il-qamħ huwa prodott bażiku li jinbiegħ fis-suq u jintuża fil-produzzjoni tad-dqiq.
formal.en: Wheat is a commodity that is sold in the market and used in the production of flour.
formal.zh: 小麦是一种在市场上交易、用于生产面粉的基础商品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri 'prodott bażiku' hawnhekk? Toni: Hawnhekk ifisser prodott li jinxtara u jinbiegħ fis-suq, bħall-qamħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'prodott bażiku' mean here? Toni: Here it means a product bought and sold in the market, such as wheat.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里的 prodott bażiku 是什么意思？托尼：这里指在市场上买卖的基础商品，比如小麦。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri 'prodott bażiku' hawnhekk?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri 'prodott bażiku' hawnhekk?
messages.zh: 这里的 prodott bażiku 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'prodott bażiku' mean here?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawnhekk ifisser prodott li jinxtara u jinbiegħ fis-suq, bħall-qamħ.
messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk ifisser prodott li jinxtara u jinbiegħ fis-suq, bħall-qamħ.
messages.zh: 这里指在市场上买卖的基础商品，比如小麦。
messages.en: Here it means a product bought and sold in the market, such as wheat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个观察角度记忆：看基本用途是“基本产品”，看市场买卖是“大宗商品”，看来自自然且少加工是“初级产品”；根据上下文选择义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product created, supplied, or used in digital form, such as an electronic book or downloadable software.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以数字形式制作、提供或使用的产品，例如电子书或可下载的软件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott maħluq, ipprovdut jew użat f'forma diġitali, bħal ktieb elettroniku jew programm li jista' jitniżżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以数字数据形式提供和使用的产品，例如电子书、软件或数字内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jiġi pprovdut u użat f'forma ta' data diġitali, bħal ktieb elettroniku, programm jew kontenut diġitali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A digital product is a product supplied or used in digital form, such as an electronic book, a software program, or downloadable content.

formal.mt: Il-ktieb elettroniku huwa prodott diġitali li x-xerrej jista' jniżżel wara li jħallas.
formal.en: The electronic book is a digital product that the buyer can download after paying.
formal.zh: 这本电子书是一种数字产品，买家付款后即可下载。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-ktieb jasal bil-posta? David: Le, huwa prodott diġitali. Wara li tħallas, tista' tniżżlu u taqrah fuq it-tablet.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will this book arrive by post? David: No, it is a digital product. After paying, you can download it and read it on your tablet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这本书会邮寄过来吗？戴维：不会，它是数字产品。付款后，你可以下载到平板电脑上阅读。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb jasal bil-posta?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb jasal bil-posta?
messages.zh: 这本书会邮寄过来吗？
messages.en: Will this book arrive by post?

messages.speaker: David (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa prodott diġitali. Wara li tħallas, tista' tniżżlu u taqrah fuq it-tablet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa prodott diġitali. Wara li tħallas, tista' tniżżlu u taqrah fuq it-tablet.
messages.zh: 不会，它是数字产品。付款后，你可以下载到平板电脑上阅读。
messages.en: No, it is a digital product. After paying, you can download it and read it on your tablet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象付款后屏幕上出现“下载”按钮：把 prodott diġitali 与电子书、软件等数字形式的产品联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product made at a later stage of a production chain, using materials or products from earlier stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于生产链较后阶段、使用前面阶段提供的材料或产品制成的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott magħmul fi stadju aktar tard fil-katina tal-produzzjoni, bl-użu ta' materjali jew prodotti minn stadji preċedenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 利用生产链上游的材料或产品，在后续生产阶段制成的下游产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jsir fi stadju aktar tard tal-produzzjoni minn materjali jew prodotti miksuba fi stadji preċedenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A downstream product is a product made at a later stage of a production chain using outputs from earlier stages.

collocations.en: the production of a downstream product

formal.mt: Ir-rapport janalizza kif iż-żieda fil-prezz tal-materja prima taffettwa l-ispiża ta' prodott downstream.
formal.en: The report analyses how an increase in the price of raw materials affects the cost of a downstream product.
formal.zh: 报告分析了原材料涨价如何影响下游产品的成本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-kontenitur tal-plastik huwa prodott downstream? Mark: Iva, għax isir mill-plastik prodott fi stadju preċedenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this plastic container a downstream product? Mark: Yes, because it is made from plastic produced at an earlier stage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个塑料容器是下游产品吗？Mark：是的，因为它使用前一阶段生产的塑料制成。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kontenitur tal-plastik huwa prodott downstream?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kontenitur tal-plastik huwa prodott downstream?
messages.zh: 这个塑料容器是下游产品吗？
messages.en: Is this plastic container a downstream product?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax isir mill-plastik prodott fi stadju preċedenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax isir mill-plastik prodott fi stadju preċedenti.
messages.zh: 是的，因为它使用前一阶段生产的塑料制成。
messages.en: Yes, because it is made from plastic produced at an earlier stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把生产链想成一条河：材料先经过上游加工，再成为下游产品；将 prodott downstream 整体记作“下游产品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product prepared for use as a medicine to prevent, diagnose, or treat disease.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为预防、诊断或治疗疾病而制备、供药用的医药产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott imħejji biex jintuża bħala mediċina għall-prevenzjoni, id-dijanjożi jew il-kura tal-mard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为预防、诊断或治疗疾病而制备的药用产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott ippreparat għall-użu bħala mediċina sabiex jipprevjeni, jgħin fid-dijanjożi jew jittratta l-mard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pharmaceutical product is a preparation intended for medical use in preventing, diagnosing, or treating disease.

collocations.en: the quality of a pharmaceutical product
the storage of a pharmaceutical product

formal.mt: It-tikketta ta' kull prodott farmaċewtiku għandha tindika l-kundizzjonijiet xierqa għall-ħażna tiegħu.
formal.en: The label of each pharmaceutical product should indicate its appropriate storage conditions.
formal.zh: 每种医药产品的标签都应标明其适宜的储存条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn għandi nżomm dan il-prodott farmaċewtiku? Pawlu: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet tal-ħażna fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where should I keep this pharmaceutical product? Pawlu: Let's read the storage instructions on the label.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这种医药产品应该存放在哪里？Pawlu：我们看看标签上的储存说明吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn għandi nżomm dan il-prodott farmaċewtiku?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn għandi nżomm dan il-prodott farmaċewtiku?
messages.zh: 这种医药产品应该存放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I keep this pharmaceutical product?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (药剂师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet tal-ħażna fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw l-istruzzjonijiet tal-ħażna fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 我们看看标签上的储存说明吧。
messages.en: Let's read the storage instructions on the label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象药盒上的名称和储存标签，把 prodott farmaċewtiku 作为一个整体记成“医药产品”，再用药盒场景回忆。

gloss_zh: 消费品；面向消费者的产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product intended for purchase and personal or household use by consumers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供消费者购买并用于个人或家庭生活的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott maħsub biex jinxtara mill-konsumatur għall-użu personali jew domestiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供最终消费者用于个人或家庭生活的消费品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett maħsub għall-użu personali jew domestiku tal-konsumatur finali, aktar milli għall-produzzjoni ta' oġġetti oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer good is an item bought by an individual for personal or household use rather than for producing other goods.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以个人或家庭消费者为销售和使用对象的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott maħsub biex jinbiegħ lil individwi jew familji għall-użu tagħhom ta' kuljum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A consumer product is a product designed and offered for sale to people for their personal or household use.

collocations.en: the safety of a consumer product
the price of a consumer good

formal.mt: L-istħarriġ jeżamina jekk il-prezz ta' prodott għall-konsumatur jinfluwenzax id-deċiżjoni tax-xiri.
formal.en: The survey examines whether the price of a consumer product influences the purchasing decision.
formal.zh: 这项调查研究消费品的价格是否影响购买决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Friġġ għad-dar jitqies bħala prodott għall-konsumatur? David: Iva, għax il-familja tixtrih biex tużah id-dar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is a refrigerator for the home considered a consumer product? David: Yes, because the family buys it to use at home.
colloquial.zh: Sara：家用冰箱算消费品吗？David：算，因为家庭购买它是为了在家中使用。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Friġġ għad-dar jitqies bħala prodott għall-konsumatur?
messages.mt_standard: Friġġ għad-dar jitqies bħala prodott għall-konsumatur?
messages.zh: 家用冰箱算消费品吗？
messages.en: Is a refrigerator for the home considered a consumer product?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax il-familja tixtrih biex tużah id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax il-familja tixtrih biex tużah id-dar.
messages.zh: 算，因为家庭购买它是为了在家中使用。
messages.en: Yes, because the family buys it to use at home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁买来自己用”帮助记忆：想到家庭购买冰箱，就把 prodott għall-konsumatur 与“面向消费者的产品”联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product made through industrial manufacturing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过工业生产或制造过程制成的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott magħmul permezz ta' proċess ta' produzzjoni industrijali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业品，即通过工业生产制成的物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett magħmul permezz ta' produzzjoni industrijali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An industrial good is an item produced through industrial manufacturing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工业产品，即工业制造过程所生产的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jirriżulta minn proċess ta' manifattura industrijali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An industrial product is something made through an industrial manufacturing process.

collocations.en: the production of an industrial product
the quality of an industrial product

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċess tal-manifattura ta' dan il-prodott industrijali.
formal.en: The report describes the manufacturing process for this industrial product.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了这种工业产品的制造过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-prodott industrijali jsir hawn? Mark: Iva, jagħmluh fil-fabbrika ħdejn il-port.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this industrial product made here? Mark: Yes, they make it in the factory near the port.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种工业产品是在这里制造的吗？马克：是的，在港口附近的工厂制造。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott industrijali jsir hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott industrijali jsir hawn?
messages.zh: 这种工业产品是在这里制造的吗？
messages.en: Is this industrial product made here?

messages.speaker: Mark (工厂员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jagħmluh fil-fabbrika ħdejn il-port.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jagħmluh fil-fabbrika ħdejn il-port.
messages.zh: 是的，在港口附近的工厂制造。
messages.en: Yes, they make it in the factory near the port.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prodott 记作“产品”，把 industrijali 与“工业的”配对，想象工厂流水线上完成的产品来记住整个词组。

gloss_zh: 加工产品；经加工的产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product that has undergone processing to change its form or properties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过加工处理，形态或性质发生改变的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun għadda minn proċess li jbiddel il-forma jew il-proprjetajiet tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加工产品，即经过处理而改变原有形态或性质的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun ġie ttrattat jew mibdul permezz ta' proċess ta' pproċessar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A processed product is a product that has undergone treatment to change its original form or properties.

collocations.en: a processed product ready for sale
the packaging of a processed product

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-materja prima tinbidel fi prodott ipproċessat lest għall-bejgħ.
formal.en: The report explains how the raw material is transformed into a processed product ready for sale.
formal.zh: 报告说明了原材料如何转变为可供销售的加工产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-meraq huwa prodott ipproċessat? Pawlu: Iva, il-frott jingħasar u l-meraq jiġi ppasturizzat.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this juice a processed product? Pawlu: Yes, the fruit is squeezed and the juice is pasteurized.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这种果汁属于加工产品吗？保罗：是的，水果经过榨汁，果汁再经过巴氏杀菌。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-meraq huwa prodott ipproċessat?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-meraq huwa prodott ipproċessat?
messages.zh: 这种果汁属于加工产品吗？
messages.en: Is this juice a processed product?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-frott jingħasar u l-meraq jiġi ppasturizzat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-frott jingħasar u l-meraq jiġi ppasturizzat.
messages.zh: 是的，水果经过榨汁，果汁再经过巴氏杀菌。
messages.en: Yes, the fruit is squeezed and the juice is pasteurized.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“原材料经过处理成为产品”的画面记忆：prodott 是产品，ipproċessat 提醒你它已经经过加工。

gloss_zh: 补偿产品（加工所得产品）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product obtained from processing or manufacturing goods under a processing arrangement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在加工安排下，由货物经过加工或制造而得到的产品，称为补偿产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott miksub mill-ipproċessar jew mill-manifattura ta' oġġetti taħt arranġament ta' pproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 补偿产品，指加工安排下由投入货物经加工或制造后得到的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jirriżulta mill-ipproċessar jew mill-manifattura tal-oġġetti koperti minn arranġament ta' pproċessar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A compensating product is a product obtained when goods undergo processing or manufacturing under a processing arrangement.

collocations.en: the quantity of the compensating product
the description of the compensating product

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika d-drapp bħala l-materja prima u l-qomos bħala l-prodott kumpensatur miksub mill-ipproċessar tiegħu.
formal.en: The report identifies the fabric as the raw material and the shirts as the compensating product obtained from processing it.
formal.zh: 报告将布料列为原材料，将衬衫列为加工该布料所得的补偿产品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'prodott kumpensatur' f'dan l-eżempju? David: Ikteb 'qomos', għax huma l-prodott li ksibna wara li pproċessajna d-drapp.
colloquial.en: Sara: What should I write under 'compensating product' in this example? David: Write 'shirts', because they are the product we obtained after processing the fabric.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个例子中，“补偿产品”一栏应该填什么？戴维：填“衬衫”，因为这是我们加工布料后得到的产品。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'prodott kumpensatur' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandi nikteb taħt 'prodott kumpensatur' f'dan l-eżempju?
messages.zh: 这个例子中，“补偿产品”一栏应该填什么？
messages.en: What should I write under 'compensating product' in this example?

messages.speaker: David (培训教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ikteb 'qomos', għax huma l-prodott li ksibna wara li pproċessajna d-drapp.
messages.mt_standard: Ikteb 'qomos', għax huma l-prodott li ksibna wara li pproċessajna d-drapp.
messages.zh: 填“衬衫”，因为这是我们加工布料后得到的产品。
messages.en: Write 'shirts', because they are the product we obtained after processing the fabric.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“投入布料，产出衬衫”的加工流程记忆这个术语，把 prodott kumpensatur 对应到流程末端得到的补偿产品。

gloss_zh: 非食品产品；非食品类商品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product that is not intended to be eaten as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不作为食物供人食用的产品，例如清洁用品或文具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li mhuwiex maħsub biex jittiekel bħala ikel, bħal deterġent jew oġġett tal-kartolerija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非食品产品，即不属于供人食用的食品类别的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li ma jaqax fil-kategorija tal-ikel u li mhuwiex maħsub għall-konsum bħala ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-food product is an item intended for a purpose other than being eaten as food.

collocations.en: the sale of a non-food product
the label of a non-food product

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jikklassifika d-deterġent bħala prodott mhux tal-ikel.
formal.en: The catalogue classifies the detergent as a non-food product.
formal.zh: 目录将这种洗涤剂归类为非食品产品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan is-sapun jidħol fil-kategorija tal-ikel? Toni: Le, huwa prodott mhux tal-ikel. Qiegħdu mal-prodotti tal-indafa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this soap go in the food category? Toni: No, it is a non-food product. Put it with the cleaning and hygiene products.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这种肥皂归入食品类吗？托尼：不，它是非食品产品。把它放在清洁卫生用品那边。

messages.speaker: Nina (新店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan is-sapun jidħol fil-kategorija tal-ikel?
messages.mt_standard: Dan is-sapun jidħol fil-kategorija tal-ikel?
messages.zh: 这种肥皂归入食品类吗？
messages.en: Does this soap go in the food category?

messages.speaker: Toni (店长)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa prodott mhux tal-ikel. Qiegħdu mal-prodotti tal-indafa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa prodott mhux tal-ikel. Qiegħdu mal-prodotti tal-indafa.
messages.zh: 不，它是非食品产品。把它放在清洁卫生用品那边。
messages.en: No, it is a non-food product. Put it with the cleaning and hygiene products.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组分块记忆：prodott 是“产品”，mhux 表示否定，tal-ikel 表示“食品的”；想象肥皂和文具所在的非食品货架。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product obtained entirely within one country or territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 全部在同一国家或地区获得的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż jew territorju wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 完全在某一国家或地区获得的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb kompletament f'pajjiż jew territorju wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wholly obtained product is a product obtained entirely in a single country or territory.

collocations.en: a product wholly obtained in the country
collocations.zh: 完全在该国获得的产品

collocations.en: to identify a wholly obtained product

formal.mt: Id-dokument jidentifika dan l-oġġett bħala prodott miksub b'mod sħiħ fil-pajjiż indikat.
formal.en: The document identifies this item as a product wholly obtained in the specified country.
formal.zh: 该文件将此物品认定为完全在指定国家获得的产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser 'prodott miksub b'mod sħiħ'? Toni: Ifisser prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'wholly obtained product' mean? Toni: It means a product obtained entirely in one country.
colloquial.zh: Maja：‘完全获得产品’是什么意思？Toni：指完全在同一个国家获得的产品。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'prodott miksub b'mod sħiħ'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'prodott miksub b'mod sħiħ'?
messages.zh: ‘完全获得产品’是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'wholly obtained product' mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
messages.zh: 指完全在同一个国家获得的产品。
messages.en: It means a product obtained entirely in one country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按语块记忆：prodott 是产品，miksub 表示获得的，b'mod sħiħ 表示完全地；把整句联想成产品的全部来源都落在同一国家或地区。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product obtained wholly within a single country or territory.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完全在同一国家或地区获得的产品，表达与 prodott miksub b'mod sħiħ 相同的基本概念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż jew territorju wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 全部在某一国家或地区获得的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb għalkollox f'pajjiż jew territorju wieħed.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A wholly obtained product is one obtained completely within a particular country or territory.

collocations.en: a product wholly obtained in one territory
collocations.zh: 完全在同一地区获得的产品

collocations.en: to describe a wholly obtained product

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża l-espressjoni 'prodott miksub għalkollox' għal prodott li jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'territorju wieħed.
formal.en: The report uses the expression 'wholly obtained product' for a product obtained entirely in one territory.
formal.zh: 该报告使用‘完全获得产品’这一表述，指全部在同一地区获得的产品。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hawn miktub 'prodott miksub għalkollox'. Għalkollox tfisser kompletament? Mark: Iva, hawn tfisser li l-prodott jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
colloquial.en: Sara: It says 'wholly obtained product' here. Does għalkollox mean completely? Mark: Yes, here it means that the product is obtained entirely in one country.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这里写着‘完全获得产品’。għalkollox 是‘完全地’的意思吗？Mark：是的，这里表示产品完全在同一个国家获得。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn miktub 'prodott miksub għalkollox'. Għalkollox tfisser kompletament?
messages.mt_standard: Hawn miktub 'prodott miksub għalkollox'. Għalkollox tfisser kompletament?
messages.zh: 这里写着‘完全获得产品’。għalkollox 是‘完全地’的意思吗？
messages.en: It says 'wholly obtained product' here. Does għalkollox mean completely?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn tfisser li l-prodott jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn tfisser li l-prodott jinkiseb kollu kemm hu f'pajjiż wieħed.
messages.zh: 是的，这里表示产品完全在同一个国家获得。
messages.en: Yes, here it means that the product is obtained entirely in one country.

cognitive_memory_aid: 将 għalkollox 单独记作‘完全地’，再与 miksub‘获得的’连读；可和 b'mod sħiħ 对照记忆，两种表达在本词条中都强调全部获得。

gloss_zh: 利基产品；面向特定小众市场的产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product designed for a particular, narrowly defined group of customers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面向需求明确、范围较窄的特定顾客群体的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott maħsub għal grupp speċifiku u limitat ta' klijenti bi bżonnijiet partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对某个细分市场中特定顾客需求的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jissodisfa l-bżonnijiet partikolari ta' grupp limitat ta' klijenti f'suq speċjalizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A niche product is designed to meet the particular needs of a narrowly defined group of customers.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija żviluppat prodott niċċa għal fotografi li għandhom bżonn tagħmir ħafif għall-mixi fil-muntanji.
formal.en: The company developed a niche product for photographers who need lightweight equipment for hiking in the mountains.
formal.zh: 该公司为需要轻便登山徒步器材的摄影师开发了一款利基产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex dan il-prodott hu biss għal fotografi li jimxu fil-muntanji? Pawlu: Għax hu prodott niċċa, maħsub għal dak il-grupp ta' klijenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is this product only for photographers who hike in the mountains? Pawlu: Because it's a niche product, designed for that group of customers.
colloquial.zh: Lara：为什么这款产品只面向登山徒步的摄影师？Pawlu：因为它是利基产品，专门为那一类顾客设计。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex dan il-prodott hu biss għal fotografi li jimxu fil-muntanji?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex dan il-prodott hu biss għal fotografi li jimxu fil-muntanji?
messages.zh: 为什么这款产品只面向登山徒步的摄影师？
messages.en: Why is this product only for photographers who hike in the mountains?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu prodott niċċa, maħsub għal dak il-grupp ta' klijenti.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu prodott niċċa, maħsub għal dak il-grupp ta' klijenti.
messages.zh: 因为它是利基产品，专门为那一类顾客设计。
messages.en: Because it's a niche product, designed for that group of customers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货架上专门留给某一类顾客的一小格：prodott niċċa 就是服务这类特定需求的产品。重点记‘顾客群体细分’，不要只记‘销量少’。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product recognized as originating in a particular country or territory under the applicable rules of origin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 依据适用的原产地规则，被认定原产于某一国家或地区的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott meqjus li joriġina minn pajjiż jew territorju partikolari skont ir-regoli tal-oriġini applikabbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 符合相关原产地规则、具有某一国家或地区原产资格的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jitqies bħala li għandu l-oriġini tiegħu f'pajjiż jew territorju partikolari skont ir-regoli tal-oriġini rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An originating product is one that qualifies as originating in a particular country or territory under the relevant rules of origin.

collocations.en: to be considered an originating product

formal.mt: Biex il-prodott jitqies bħala prodott oriġinarju, għandu jissodisfa r-regoli tal-oriġini applikabbli.
formal.en: To be considered an originating product, the product must satisfy the applicable rules of origin.
formal.zh: 该产品须符合适用的原产地规则，才能被认定为原产产品。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan jista' jitqies bħala prodott oriġinarju? David: Irridu l-ewwel niċċekkjaw jekk jissodisfax ir-regoli tal-oriġini.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can this be considered an originating product? David: We first need to check whether it meets the rules of origin.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个能被认定为原产产品吗？David：我们得先核查它是否符合原产地规则。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jista' jitqies bħala prodott oriġinarju?
messages.mt_standard: Dan jista' jitqies bħala prodott oriġinarju?
messages.zh: 这个能被认定为原产产品吗？
messages.en: Can this be considered an originating product?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Irridu l-ewwel niċċekkjaw jekk jissodisfax ir-regoli tal-oriġini.
messages.mt_standard: Irridu l-ewwel niċċekkjaw jekk jissodisfax ir-regoli tal-oriġini.
messages.zh: 我们得先核查它是否符合原产地规则。
messages.en: We first need to check whether it meets the rules of origin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prodott oriġinarju 想成贴着‘原产地资格’标签的产品：本词条的重点是依据规则认定来源，不要把它误记为‘原创产品’。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A secondary product that has undergone processing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在生产中处于次要地位，并已经过加工处理的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li għandu rwol sekondarju fil-produzzjoni u li jkun għadda minn proċess ta' pproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经过加工处理的次级产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott sekondarju li jkun ġie pproċessat sabiex ikun jista' jintuża jew jinbiegħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A secondary processed product is a secondary output of production that has undergone processing.

collocations.en: the sale of a secondary processed product
collocations.zh: 经加工次级产品的销售

collocations.en: the quality of the secondary processed product
collocations.zh: 经加工次级产品的质量

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif il-prodott sekondarju pproċessat jiġi ppakkjat u mibjugħ separatament mill-prodott ewlieni.
formal.en: The report describes how the secondary processed product is packaged and sold separately from the main product.
formal.zh: 报告说明了经加工的次级产品如何单独包装，并与主要产品分开销售。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan hu l-prodott ewlieni? Pawlu: Le, dan hu prodott sekondarju pproċessat. Il-prodott ewlieni qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this the main product? Pawlu: No, this is a secondary processed product. The main product is on the other shelf.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这是主要产品吗？Pawlu：不是，这是经加工的次级产品。主要产品在另一个货架上。

messages.speaker: Marta (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-prodott ewlieni?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-prodott ewlieni?
messages.zh: 这是主要产品吗？
messages.en: Is this the main product?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, dan hu prodott sekondarju pproċessat. Il-prodott ewlieni qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Le, dan hu prodott sekondarju pproċessat. Il-prodott ewlieni qiegħed fuq l-ixkaffa l-oħra.
messages.zh: 不是，这是经加工的次级产品。主要产品在另一个货架上。
messages.en: No, this is a secondary processed product. The main product is on the other shelf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按三个信息块记忆：prodott 是产品，sekondarju 表示次级，pproċessat 表示已经加工；想象主产品旁边另放着一包加工好的次级产品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An item or product that requires special care or control because of its nature or use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因自身性质或用途而需要特别小心处理或采取专门管控的物品或产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew prodott li jeħtieġ attenzjoni jew kontroll speċjali minħabba n-natura jew l-użu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因性质或用途而需要特别谨慎处理或管控的敏感物品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett li, minħabba n-natura jew l-użu tiegħu, għandu jiġi mmaniġġjat b'attenzjoni jew taħt kontroll speċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sensitive item is an object that requires particular care or control because of its nature or use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因产品特性或用途而需要特别保护、谨慎处理或管控的敏感产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jeħtieġ protezzjoni, immaniġġjar bir-reqqa jew kontroll speċjali minħabba l-karatteristiċi jew l-użu tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sensitive product is a product whose characteristics or use require special protection, handling, or control.

collocations.en: the transport of a sensitive product

formal.mt: Dan il-prodott sensittiv għas-sħana għandu jinħażen skont l-istruzzjonijiet fuq it-tikketta.
formal.en: This heat-sensitive product must be stored according to the instructions on the label.
formal.zh: 这种对热敏感的产品必须按照标签上的说明储存。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nħalli din il-kaxxa fix-xemx? David: Le, fiha prodott sensittiv għas-sħana. Poġġiha fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I leave this box in the sun? David: No, it contains a heat-sensitive product. Put it in the shade.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我能把这个箱子放在太阳下吗？David：不能，里面有对热敏感的产品。把它放到阴凉处。

messages.speaker: Lara (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nħalli din il-kaxxa fix-xemx?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nħalli din il-kaxxa fix-xemx?
messages.zh: 我能把这个箱子放在太阳下吗？
messages.en: Can I leave this box in the sun?

messages.speaker: David (仓库同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fiha prodott sensittiv għas-sħana. Poġġiha fid-dell.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fiha prodott sensittiv għas-sħana. Poġġiha fid-dell.
messages.zh: 不能，里面有对热敏感的产品。把它放到阴凉处。
messages.en: No, it contains a heat-sensitive product. Put it in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prodott sensittiv 与贴着特别处理标签的产品联系起来：核心是需要特别注意；后接 għas-sħana 时，就具体记成对热敏感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product used or supplied in place of another product.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来代替另一种产品使用或供应的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jintuża jew jiġi pprovdut minflok prodott ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于替换原有产品或代替另一产品的替代产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jieħu post prodott ieħor, pereżempju meta dak oriġinali ma jkunx disponibbli jew ma jkunx jista' jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A replacement product is supplied or used in place of another product.

formal.mt: Jekk il-prodott ordnat ma jkunx disponibbli, il-fornitur għandu jipproponi prodott sostitut u jitlob il-kunsens tal-klijent.
formal.en: If the ordered product is unavailable, the supplier should propose a replacement product and seek the customer's consent.
formal.zh: 如果订购的产品缺货，供应商应提出替代产品，并征求客户同意。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandkom l-istess sapun li xtrajt il-ġimgħa l-oħra? Mark: Bħalissa m'għandniex, imma nista' nurik prodott sostitut.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have the same soap I bought last week? Mark: We don't have it at the moment, but I can show you a replacement product.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你们有我上周买的那款肥皂吗？Mark：我们现在没有，不过我可以给你看看一款替代产品。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandkom l-istess sapun li xtrajt il-ġimgħa l-oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Għandkom l-istess sapun li xtrajt il-ġimgħa l-oħra?
messages.zh: 你们有我上周买的那款肥皂吗？
messages.en: Do you have the same soap I bought last week?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Bħalissa m'għandniex, imma nista' nurik prodott sostitut.
messages.mt_standard: Bħalissa m'għandniex, imma nista' nurik prodott sostitut.
messages.zh: 我们现在没有，不过我可以给你看看一款替代产品。
messages.en: We don't have it at the moment, but I can show you a replacement product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象常买的商品缺货，店员拿出另一款顶替：prodott 是产品，sostitut 提醒你它承担替代作用，整组记成替代产品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product made or supplied to the usual specifications rather than individual requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按通常规格制造或供应，而非按照个别要求专门定制的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott magħmul jew ipprovdut skont l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet tas-soltu, aktar milli skont rekwiżiti individwali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按通常规格制造或供应的标准产品、常规产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodotti magħmula jew ipprovduti skont speċifikazzjonijiet tas-soltu, mingħajr tibdil apposta għal klijent partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Standard products are made or supplied to usual specifications rather than customized for individual customers.

collocations.en: the price of the standard product

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi prodott standard b'qisien fissi; kwalunkwe bidla fil-qisien teħtieġ ordni speċjali.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a standard product with fixed dimensions; any change in dimensions requires a special order.
formal.zh: 目录介绍了一款尺寸固定的标准产品；任何尺寸变更都需要特别订购。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dan il-mejda tista' tagħmluh idjaq? Toni: Dan huwa prodott standard. Għal mejda idjaq, trid tagħmel ordni speċjali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you make this table narrower? Toni: This is a standard product. For a narrower table, you need to place a special order.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这张桌子能做窄一点吗？Toni：这是标准产品。要更窄的桌子，需要特别订购。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-mejda tista' tagħmluh idjaq?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-mejda tista' tagħmluh idjaq?
messages.zh: 这张桌子能做窄一点吗？
messages.en: Can you make this table narrower?

messages.speaker: Toni (家具店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa prodott standard. Għal mejda idjaq, trid tagħmel ordni speċjali.
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa prodott standard. Għal mejda idjaq, trid tagħmel ordni speċjali.
messages.zh: 这是标准产品。要更窄的桌子，需要特别订购。
messages.en: This is a standard product. For a narrower table, you need to place a special order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prodott standard 想成目录里规格固定、可以直接订购的常规款；词条是单数，表示多件标准产品时可记 prodotti standard。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product on which enough work has been carried out for the purpose or stage concerned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经接受足够加工，达到相关用途或阶段所需程度的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun sar biżżejjed xogħol fuqu għall-iskop jew għall-istadju kkonċernat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加工已达到相关用途或阶段所需程度的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun inħadem biżżejjed biex jilħaq il-livell meħtieġ għall-iskop jew għall-istadju kkonċernat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sufficiently worked product is one that has undergone enough work to meet the needs of the purpose or stage concerned.

collocations.en: inspection of a sufficiently worked product
collocations.zh: 对经过充分加工的产品进行检验

collocations.en: the quality of a sufficiently worked product
collocations.zh: 经过充分加工的产品的质量

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-oġġett bħala prodott suffiċjentement maħdum għall-istadju li jmiss.
formal.en: The report describes the item as a sufficiently worked product for the next stage.
formal.zh: 报告将该物品描述为加工已足够充分、可以进入下一阶段的产品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan diġà huwa prodott suffiċjentement maħdum? Mark: Iva, għal dan l-istadju sar biżżejjed xogħol fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this already a sufficiently worked product? Mark: Yes, enough work has been done on it for this stage.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个产品已经加工得足够充分了吗？Mark：是的，就这个阶段而言，已经做了足够的加工。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan diġà huwa prodott suffiċjentement maħdum?
messages.mt_standard: Dan diġà huwa prodott suffiċjentement maħdum?
messages.zh: 这个产品已经加工得足够充分了吗？
messages.en: Is this already a sufficiently worked product?

messages.speaker: Mark (导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal dan l-istadju sar biżżejjed xogħol fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal dan l-istadju sar biżżejjed xogħol fuqu.
messages.zh: 是的，就这个阶段而言，已经做了足够的加工。
messages.en: Yes, enough work has been done on it for this stage.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词组分块记忆：prodott 是“产品”，suffiċjentement 是“充分地”，maħdum 表示“经过加工的”。想象产品旁写着“这个阶段已加工到位”，帮助记住“充分”针对所需程度，并不必然表示所有工序都已结束。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product that has undergone enough processing for the purpose or stage concerned.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经经过足够处理，达到相关用途或阶段所需程度的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun għadda minn biżżejjed proċessar għall-iskop jew għall-istadju kkonċernat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处理程度已达到相关用途或阶段要求的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun ġie proċessat biżżejjed biex jilħaq il-livell meħtieġ għall-iskop jew għall-istadju kkonċernat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sufficiently processed product is one that has undergone enough processing to meet the needs of the purpose or stage concerned.

collocations.en: the assessment of a sufficiently processed product
collocations.zh: 对经过充分处理的产品的评估

collocations.en: a sample of a sufficiently processed product
collocations.zh: 经过充分处理的产品的样品

formal.mt: Il-valutazzjoni għandha tistabbilixxi jekk dan huwiex prodott suffiċjentement proċessat għall-użu maħsub.
formal.en: The assessment should establish whether this is a sufficiently processed product for its intended use.
formal.zh: 评估应确定该产品是否已经得到充分处理，能够满足预定用途。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan huwa prodott suffiċjentement proċessat għall-pass li jmiss? Pawlu: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-kampjun qabel ngħidu iva.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this a sufficiently processed product for the next step? Pawlu: We still need to check the sample before we can say yes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个产品的处理程度已经足以进入下一步了吗？Pawlu：我们还得检查样品，才能说是。

messages.speaker: Lara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan huwa prodott suffiċjentement proċessat għall-pass li jmiss?
messages.mt_standard: Dan huwa prodott suffiċjentement proċessat għall-pass li jmiss?
messages.zh: 这个产品的处理程度已经足以进入下一步了吗？
messages.en: Is this a sufficiently processed product for the next step?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-kampjun qabel ngħidu iva.
messages.mt_standard: Għad irridu niċċekkjaw il-kampjun qabel ngħidu iva.
messages.zh: 我们还得检查样品，才能说是。
messages.en: We still need to check the sample before we can say yes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组记成“产品＋充分地＋处理过的”：prodott 对应产品，suffiċjentement 对应充分程度，proċessat 对应处理过程。用“检查样品，确认处理到位”的画面记忆，不要把“充分处理”直接理解为采用了某种特定工艺。

gloss_zh: 食品；食物制品；供人食用的食品

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food product or foodstuff intended to be eaten, particularly by people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供食用的食品或食物制品，尤其指供人食用的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott li jintuża bħala ikel, b'mod partikolari għall-konsum mill-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食物；供食用的东西。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tittiekel biex tipprovdi nutriment.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Food is something that people or animals eat to obtain nourishment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 食品；用作食物或用于制备食物的物品或物质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew sustanza li tintuża bħala ikel jew fit-tħejjija tal-ikel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foodstuff is an item or substance used as food or in preparing food.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供人食用的食品；预定由人食用的食物或食品原料。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Oġġett jew sustanza tal-ikel maħsuba biex tittiekel mill-bnedmin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A foodstuff for human consumption is an item or substance intended to be eaten by people.

collocations.en: the label of a food product

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ta' kull prodott tal-ikel f'dan il-katalgu tinkludi l-ingredjenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The description of each food product in this catalogue includes its ingredients.
formal.zh: 本目录中每种食品的说明都列有其配料。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-prodott tal-ikel fih ġewż? Rita: Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'ingredjenti fih.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this food product contain nuts? Rita: Let's read the label to see what ingredients it contains.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这种食品含有坚果吗？Rita：我们读一下标签，看看里面有哪些配料。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott tal-ikel fih ġewż?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott tal-ikel fih ġewż?
messages.zh: 这种食品含有坚果吗？
messages.en: Does this food product contain nuts?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'ingredjenti fih.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw it-tikketta biex naraw x'ingredjenti fih.
messages.zh: 我们读一下标签，看看里面有哪些配料。
messages.en: Let's read the label to see what ingredients it contains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用食品包装作记忆画面：prodott 是“产品”，ikel 是“食物”，合起来记作“食品”。三个英语义项依次关注普通食物、作为物品或原料的食品、明确供人食用的食品，中文翻译随语境选择。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product relating to a period within the same day whose specifications differ from a standard form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与同一天内某一时段相关、规格不同于标准形式的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott marbut ma' perjodu fl-istess ġurnata li l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet tiegħu jvarjaw mill-forma standard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 非标准日内产品；与同一天内的时段相关、采用非标准规格的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jirrigwarda perjodu fl-istess ġurnata u li ma jsegwix l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet tal-forma standard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A non-standard intraday product relates to a period within the same day and has specifications that differ from the standard form.

collocations.mt: l-ispeċifikazzjonijiet ta' prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard
collocations.en: the specifications of a non-standard intraday product
collocations.zh: 非标准日内产品的规格

collocations.mt: it-tul tal-perjodu kopert minn prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard
collocations.en: the duration of the period covered by a non-standard intraday product
collocations.zh: 非标准日内产品所涵盖时段的长度

formal.mt: Id-deskrizzjoni ta' prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard għandha tispeċifika l-perjodu kopert u d-differenzi mill-forma standard.
formal.en: The description of a non-standard intraday product should specify the period covered and the differences from the standard form.
formal.zh: 非标准日内产品的说明应明确其涵盖的时段，以及它与标准形式的差异。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Xi jfisser prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard? David: Huwa prodott għal perjodu fl-istess ġurnata, bi speċifikazzjonijiet differenti minn dawk standard.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does a non-standard intraday product mean? David: It is a product for a period within the same day, with specifications that differ from the standard ones.
colloquial.zh: Sara：非标准日内产品是什么意思？David：就是针对同一天内某一时段、规格与标准规格不同的产品。

messages.speaker: Sara (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser prodott tal-istess ġurnata mhux standard?
messages.zh: 非标准日内产品是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a non-standard intraday product mean?

messages.speaker: David (导师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa prodott għal perjodu fl-istess ġurnata, bi speċifikazzjonijiet differenti minn dawk standard.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa prodott għal perjodu fl-istess ġurnata, bi speċifikazzjonijiet differenti minn dawk standard.
messages.zh: 就是针对同一天内某一时段、规格与标准规格不同的产品。
messages.en: It is a product for a period within the same day, with specifications that differ from the standard ones.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成三块：prodott“产品”、tal-istess ġurnata“同一天内的”、mhux standard“非标准的”。想象一张当天时间表，某个时段旁标着“规格另列”；“非标准”说明规格有差异，不等于质量不合格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product with standard conditions that relates to activity within a single day.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采用标准条件、涉及同一日内活动的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott b'kundizzjonijiet standard li jirrigwarda attività fi ħdan l-istess ġurnata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采用标准条件、涉及同一日内活动的标准日内产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott b'kundizzjonijiet standard marbut ma' attività li ssir fi ħdan l-istess ġurnata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A standard intraday product is a product with standard conditions relating to activity within a single day.

collocations.mt: il-kundizzjonijiet ta' prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard
collocations.en: the conditions of a standard intraday product

collocations.mt: il-prezz ta' prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard
collocations.en: the price of a standard intraday product

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-kundizzjonijiet u l-prezz ta' prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard.
formal.en: The document describes the conditions and price of a standard intraday product.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了一项标准日内产品的条件和价格。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'inhu prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard? David: Huwa prodott b'kundizzjonijiet standard li jirrigwarda attività fl-istess ġurnata. Marta: Mela rrid inħares ukoll lejn il-ġurnata li għaliha japplika. David: Iva, dik hija informazzjoni importanti.
colloquial.en: Marta: What is a standard intraday product? David: It is a product with standard conditions relating to activity within the same day. Marta: So I also need to check which day it applies to. David: Yes, that is important information.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：什么是标准日内产品？戴维：就是采用标准条件、涉及同一天内活动的产品。玛尔塔：那么我还得查看它适用于哪一天。戴维：对，那是重要信息。

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu prodott tal-istess ġurnata standard?
messages.zh: 什么是标准日内产品？
messages.en: What is a standard intraday product?

messages.speaker: David (讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa prodott b'kundizzjonijiet standard li jirrigwarda attività fl-istess ġurnata.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa prodott b'kundizzjonijiet standard li jirrigwarda attività fl-istess ġurnata.
messages.zh: 就是采用标准条件、涉及同一天内活动的产品。
messages.en: It is a product with standard conditions relating to activity within the same day.

messages.speaker: Marta (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela rrid inħares ukoll lejn il-ġurnata li għaliha japplika.
messages.mt_standard: Mela rrid inħares ukoll lejn il-ġurnata li għaliha japplika.
messages.zh: 那么我还得查看它适用于哪一天。
messages.en: So I also need to check which day it applies to.

messages.speaker: David (讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dik hija informazzjoni importanti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dik hija informazzjoni importanti.
messages.zh: 对，那是重要信息。
messages.en: Yes, that is important information.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语想成一张产品卡：产品名称旁标着“同一天内”，下方列着“标准条件”，合起来记作“标准日内产品”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A product obtained through fishing, such as fish caught for sale or consumption.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过捕捞获得的产品，例如供出售或食用的鱼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott miksub mis-sajd, bħal ħut maqbud biex jinbiegħ jew jittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渔业产品，即通过捕捞获得的鱼类等产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jinkiseb mill-attività tas-sajd, bħal ħut jew annimali akkwatiċi oħra maqbuda mis-sajjieda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fisheries product is something obtained through fishing, such as fish caught for food or sale.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕捞所得的渔业产品，例如供食用或销售的鱼类。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott miksub permezz tas-sajd, bħall-ħut li jinqabad għall-ikel jew għall-bejgħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fishery product is a product resulting from fishing activities and intended for use or sale.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 渔业活动所产出的产品；捕捞所得的产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott li jkun ir-riżultat tal-attività tas-sajd, bħall-ħut maqbud mis-sajjieda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A product of fisheries is something produced by fishing activities, including fish caught by fishers.

collocations.en: the sale of a fishery product

formal.mt: It-tikketta tindika minn fejn ġie l-prodott tas-sajd u kif għandu jinżamm.
formal.en: The label indicates where the fishery product came from and how it should be stored.
formal.zh: 标签注明了该渔业产品的来源及储存方式。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dan il-prodott tas-sajd frisk? Pawlu: Iva, il-ħut wasal dalgħodu. Lina: Tajjeb, nieħu nofs kilo.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is this fishery product fresh? Pawlu: Yes, the fish arrived this morning. Lina: Good, I'll take half a kilo.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个渔业产品新鲜吗？保罗：新鲜，鱼是今天早上送到的。莉娜：好，我买半公斤。

messages.speaker: Lina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-prodott tas-sajd frisk?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-prodott tas-sajd frisk?
messages.zh: 这个渔业产品新鲜吗？
messages.en: Is this fishery product fresh?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (鱼贩)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħut wasal dalgħodu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħut wasal dalgħodu.
messages.zh: 新鲜，鱼是今天早上送到的。
messages.en: Yes, the fish arrived this morning.

messages.speaker: Lina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, nieħu nofs kilo.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, nieħu nofs kilo.
messages.zh: 好，我买半公斤。
messages.en: Good, I'll take half a kilo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鱼摊上的一条鱼，标签写着“捕捞所得的产品”；把 prodott tas-sajd 整体与“渔业产品”配对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One product considered on its own, rather than several different products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 单独考虑的一种产品，而非多种不同产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prodott wieħed meqjus waħdu, minflok diversi prodotti differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单一产品；相对于多种产品而言的一种产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prodott wieħed biss, meqjus separatament jew bħala l-uniku prodott f'għażla jew offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A single product is one product considered individually, rather than a range or combination of different products.

collocations.en: an offer of a single product
the sale of a single product

formal.mt: L-analiżi tiffoka fuq il-bejgħ ta' prodott uniku matul is-sena.
formal.en: The analysis focuses on sales of a single product during the year.
formal.zh: 该分析聚焦于一种产品在这一年中的销售情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għall-proġett, nagħżlu prodott uniku jew diversi prodotti? Mark: Prodott uniku, biex inkunu nistgħu nistudjawh fid-dettall. Sara: Tajjeb, imbagħad niġbru l-informazzjoni dwaru.
colloquial.en: Sara: For the project, shall we choose a single product or several products? Mark: A single product, so we can study it in detail. Sara: Good, then we'll collect information about it.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个项目选一种产品还是几种产品？马克：选一种，这样我们就能详细研究它。萨拉：好，那我们就收集它的资料。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目组同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għall-proġett, nagħżlu prodott uniku jew diversi prodotti?
messages.mt_standard: Għall-proġett, nagħżlu prodott uniku jew diversi prodotti?
messages.zh: 这个项目选一种产品还是几种产品？
messages.en: For the project, shall we choose a single product or several products?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目组同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Prodott uniku, biex inkunu nistgħu nistudjawh fid-dettall.
messages.mt_standard: Prodott uniku, biex inkunu nistgħu nistudjawh fid-dettall.
messages.zh: 选一种，这样我们就能详细研究它。
messages.en: A single product, so we can study it in detail.

messages.speaker: Sara (项目组同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, imbagħad niġbru l-informazzjoni dwaru.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, imbagħad niġbru l-informazzjoni dwaru.
messages.zh: 好，那我们就收集它的资料。
messages.en: Good, then we'll collect information about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个只放一种产品的展示格，旁边写 prodott uniku；本词条用“一种产品”的画面帮助记住 single product 这一义项。

gloss_zh: 产品覆盖范围；所涵盖的产品

teaching_sense.en_definition: The range of products included within the scope of a particular rule, agreement, or scheme.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某项规则、协议或计划所涵盖的产品范围；该短语以复数形式指范围内的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-firxa ta' prodotti li jaqgħu fil-kamp ta' applikazzjoni ta' regola, ftehim jew skema partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某项规则、协议或计划所覆盖的产品范围，即其所涵盖的各类产品。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-firxa ta' prodotti inklużi fil-kamp ta' applikazzjoni ta' regola, ftehim jew skema, li tiddetermina liema prodotti huma koperti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Product coverage is the range of products to which a particular rule, agreement, or scheme applies.

collocations.en: the products covered by the agreement

formal.mt: L-anness jelenka l-prodotti koperti mill-ftehim u jispeċifika l-kategorija ta' kull prodott.
formal.en: The annex lists the products covered by the agreement and specifies the category of each product.
formal.zh: 附件列出了协议所涵盖的产品，并注明了每种产品的类别。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn nista' nara l-prodotti koperti mill-ftehim? Mark: Hemm lista fl-anness; ejja niċċekkjaw jekk dan il-mudell hux fiha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where can I see the products covered by the agreement? Mark: There is a list in the annex; let's check whether this model is on it.
colloquial.zh: Nina：在哪里可以查看协议所涵盖的产品？Mark：附件里有清单；我们查查这个型号是否在里面吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn nista' nara l-prodotti koperti mill-ftehim?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn nista' nara l-prodotti koperti mill-ftehim?
messages.zh: 在哪里可以查看协议所涵盖的产品？
messages.en: Where can I see the products covered by the agreement?

messages.speaker: Mark (供应商代表)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm lista fl-anness; ejja niċċekkjaw jekk dan il-mudell hux fiha.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm lista fl-anness; ejja niċċekkjaw jekk dan il-mudell hux fiha.
messages.zh: 附件里有清单；我们查查这个型号是否在里面吧。
messages.en: There is a list in the annex; let's check whether this model is on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象协议附件中圈定的一组产品：圈内就是 prodotti koperti。记住它是复数短语，用“所涵盖的产品”理解产品覆盖范围。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The amount of useful output produced in relation to the time, work, or resources used.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 相对于所投入的时间、劳动或资源而言的有效产出水平。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-livell ta' produzzjoni jew ta' xogħol utli miksub meta jitqabbel mal-ħin, max-xogħol jew mar-riżorsi użati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生产率，即单位时间、劳动或其他资源投入所带来的产出水平；也可指工作中的有效产出能力。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kejl ta' kemm jiġu prodotti oġġetti jew jitwettaq xogħol utli meta mqabbel mal-ħin, mal-isforz jew mar-riżorsi meħtieġa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Productivity is the rate at which useful work or goods are produced in relation to the resources used.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri żieda fil-produttività: it-tim ipproduċa aktar fl-istess numru ta' sigħat.
formal.en: The report shows an increase in productivity: the team produced more in the same number of hours.
formal.zh: 报告显示生产率有所提高：团队在相同工时内实现了更多产出。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Illum lestejna aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin. Ġużepp: Iva, il-produttività tagħna tjiebet. Anna: Għenna ħafna li ħejjejna kollox minn qabel.
colloquial.en: Anna: Today we completed more work in the same amount of time. Ġużepp: Yes, our productivity improved. Anna: Preparing everything beforehand helped us a lot.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：今天我们在相同时间内完成了更多工作。约瑟夫：对，我们的工作效率提高了。安娜：提前把一切准备好帮了我们很大的忙。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum lestejna aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Illum lestejna aktar xogħol fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 今天我们在相同时间内完成了更多工作。
messages.en: Today we completed more work in the same amount of time.

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-produttività tagħna tjiebet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-produttività tagħna tjiebet.
messages.zh: 对，我们的工作效率提高了。
messages.en: Yes, our productivity improved.

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għenna ħafna li ħejjejna kollox minn qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Għenna ħafna li ħejjejna kollox minn qabel.
messages.zh: 提前把一切准备好帮了我们很大的忙。
messages.en: Preparing everything beforehand helped us a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个同样长的一小时：第一小时做十件，第二小时做十二件；用“相同投入、更多产出”的画面记住生产率。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Connected with a profession, or showing the skill and standards expected in that profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与某种职业有关的，或体现该职业应有的技能与工作水准的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' professjoni, jew li juri l-ħila u l-livell ta' xogħol mistennija f'dik il-professjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与职业有关的；具有专业技能或符合专业工作水准的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' professjoni jew li juri l-ħila u s-serjetà mistennija fix-xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something professional shows the skills and standards expected in a particular kind of work.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tipprovdi taħriġ professjonali biex l-impjegati jtejbu l-ħiliet tagħhom.
formal.en: The company provides professional training so that employees can improve their skills.
formal.zh: 公司提供专业培训，以便员工提升技能。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien is-servizz? Daniel: Kien professjonali ħafna, u spjegawli kollox ċar.
colloquial.en: Maja: How was the service? Daniel: It was very professional, and they explained everything clearly to me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：服务怎么样？Daniel：很专业，而且他们把一切都给我解释清楚了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif kien is-servizz?
messages.mt_standard: Kif kien is-servizz?
messages.zh: 服务怎么样？
messages.en: How was the service?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien professjonali ħafna, u spjegawli kollox ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Kien professjonali ħafna, u spjegawli kollox ċar.
messages.zh: 很专业，而且他们把一切都给我解释清楚了。
messages.en: It was very professional, and they explained everything clearly to me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 professjonali 和“做事有专业水准”的画面绑定，连记 servizz professjonali“专业服务”，记住它描述性质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A type of work that a person does as an occupation, especially one requiring particular knowledge or training.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人所从事的职业，尤其指需要专门知识或培训的职业。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' xogħol li persuna tagħmel bħala l-okkupazzjoni tagħha, speċjalment xogħol li jeħtieġ għarfien jew taħriġ speċifiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 职业，尤指需要专门知识、技能或培训的职业。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Xogħol li persuna teżerċita bħala l-okkupazzjoni tagħha, ħafna drabi wara studju jew taħriġ speċifiku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A profession is a type of work that people do, often after gaining particular knowledge or training.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom ifittxu informazzjoni dwar it-taħriġ meħtieġ qabel jagħżlu professjoni.
formal.en: Students should seek information about the training required before choosing a profession.
formal.zh: 学生在选择职业之前，应了解该职业所需的培训。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi l-professjoni tiegħek? Mark: Jien għalliem. U inti? Lara: Jien perit.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is your profession? Mark: I'm a teacher. And you? Lara: I'm an architect.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你从事什么职业？Mark：我是教师。你呢？Lara：我是建筑师。

messages.speaker: Lara (新认识的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-professjoni tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-professjoni tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你从事什么职业？
messages.en: What is your profession?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għalliem. U inti?
messages.mt_standard: Jien għalliem. U inti?
messages.zh: 我是教师。你呢？
messages.en: I'm a teacher. And you?

messages.speaker: Lara (建筑师)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien perit.
messages.mt_standard: Jien perit.
messages.zh: 我是建筑师。
messages.en: I'm an architect.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 professjoni 放进“你从事什么职业？”这句问话中记忆：它指职业本身，可联想教师、建筑师等职业名称。

gloss_zh: 职业的；以某项活动为职业的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing someone who does a particular activity as a profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容一个人以某项活动为职业、从事该领域专业工作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi persuna li tagħmel attività partikolari bħala l-professjoni tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 职业的；形容以某项活动为职业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jagħmel attività bħala xogħol u bħala l-professjoni tiegħu, u mhux biss bħala passatemp.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A professional player or performer does that activity as a profession rather than simply as a hobby.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who is professionally engaged in sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 形容专门从事某项工作、以该项活动为职业的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiddeskrivi lil xi ħadd li jeżerċita attività jew jaħdem f'qasam partikolari bħala l-professjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is professionally engaged in an activity, they do it as part of their occupation.

formal.mt: Il-klabb offra kuntratt ġdid lil plejer professjonist li għandu ħafna esperjenza.
formal.en: The club offered a new contract to a professional player who has extensive experience.
formal.zh: 俱乐部向一名经验丰富的职业球员提供了新合同。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk idoqq biss bħala passatemp? Pawlu: Le, huwa mużiċist professjonist. Dak hu xogħlu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does your brother play music only as a hobby? Pawlu: No, he's a professional musician. That's his job.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你哥哥演奏音乐只是出于爱好吗？Pawlu：不是，他是职业音乐人。那就是他的工作。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħuk idoqq biss bħala passatemp?
messages.mt_standard: Ħuk idoqq biss bħala passatemp?
messages.zh: 你哥哥演奏音乐只是出于爱好吗？
messages.en: Does your brother play music only as a hobby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (音乐人的弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa mużiċist professjonist. Dak hu xogħlu.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa mużiċist professjonist. Dak hu xogħlu.
messages.zh: 不是，他是职业音乐人。那就是他的工作。
messages.en: No, he's a professional musician. That's his job.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 plejer professjonist“职业球员”建立画面：球员把踢球当职业。此处记作修饰人的形容词，突出“以此为业”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person believed to receive and communicate messages from God.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被认为能够领受并传达上帝旨意或信息的人，即先知。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li titqies li tirċievi messaġġi mingħand Alla u twassalhom lin-nies.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先知；在宗教信仰中被认为领受并向人们传达神意的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li, skont twemmin reliġjuż, tirċievi messaġġ mingħand Alla u twasslu lil ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prophet is someone who is believed to receive messages from God and communicate them to other people.

formal.mt: Fit-test reliġjuż, il-profeta jwassal lill-poplu messaġġ mingħand Alla.
formal.en: In the religious text, the prophet conveys a message from God to the people.
formal.zh: 在这篇宗教文本中，先知向民众传达来自上帝的信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser il-kelma profeta f'din l-istorja? Marija: Hija persuna li n-nies jemmnu li twassal messaġġ mingħand Alla.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the word prophet mean in this story? Marija: It is a person whom people believe conveys a message from God.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个故事里的“先知”是什么意思？Marija：指人们相信能够传达上帝信息的人。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma profeta f'din l-istorja?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma profeta f'din l-istorja?
messages.zh: 这个故事里的“先知”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word prophet mean in this story?

messages.speaker: Marija (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija persuna li n-nies jemmnu li twassal messaġġ mingħand Alla.
messages.mt_standard: Hija persuna li n-nies jemmnu li twassal messaġġ mingħand Alla.
messages.zh: 指人们相信能够传达上帝信息的人。
messages.en: It is a person whom people believe conveys a message from God.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 profeta 与宗教故事中“传达神意的人”联系起来，再连记 il-kliem tal-profeta“先知的话语”，通过人物与话语一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing words, warnings, or visions that predict future events or seem to anticipate them accurately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容话语、警告或异象具有预言性质，或后来显得准确预见了未来事件。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jbassar ġrajjiet futuri jew li jidher li kien bassarhom b'mod preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 预言性的；能够或仿佛能够预见未来事件的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' tbassir tal-futur, jew li jidher li jantiċipa dak li jiġri wara.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Words or warnings are prophetic if they predict future events or later appear to have anticipated them accurately.

formal.mt: Il-kliem tal-kittieb deher profetiku meta l-ġrajjiet li kien bassar seħħew snin wara.
formal.en: The writer's words seemed prophetic when the events he had predicted occurred years later.
formal.zh: 当这位作家预言的事件在多年后发生时，他的话显得极有预见性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tiftakar x'qal Pawlu dwar il-ħanut? Mark: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu kien profetiku. Il-ħanut għalaq eżatt kif kien qal.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you remember what Pawlu said about the shop? Mark: Yes, his words were prophetic. The shop closed exactly as he had said.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你记得 Pawlu 当时怎么说那家店的吗？Mark：记得，他的话真有预见性。那家店果然像他说的那样关门了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tiftakar x'qal Pawlu dwar il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Tiftakar x'qal Pawlu dwar il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你记得 Pawlu 当时怎么说那家店的吗？
messages.en: Do you remember what Pawlu said about the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu kien profetiku. Il-ħanut għalaq eżatt kif kien qal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kliem tiegħu kien profetiku. Il-ħanut għalaq eżatt kif kien qal.
messages.zh: 记得，他的话真有预见性。那家店果然像他说的那样关门了。
messages.en: Yes, his words were prophetic. The shop closed exactly as he had said.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一句话先被写下，多年后事情果然发生；用 profetiku 描述这句话的“预言性”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement about what will happen in the future, especially one believed to come from divine inspiration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 关于未来将发生之事的预言，尤指被认为来自神圣启示的预言。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni dwar dak li se jiġri fil-futur, speċjalment waħda li titqies li ġejja minn ispirazzjoni divina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对未来事件所作的预言，尤指被认为源于神圣启示的预言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tbassir espress fi kliem dwar ġrajjiet futuri, speċjalment meta jitqies bħala messaġġ ispirat minn Alla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prophecy is a statement about future events, especially one that people believe has been inspired by a divine power.

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tar-rumanz, l-istudenta spjegat kif il-profezija antika tinfluwenza d-deċiżjonijiet tal-karattri.
formal.en: In her analysis of the novel, the student explained how the ancient prophecy influences the characters' decisions.
formal.zh: 这名学生在小说分析中解释了那则古老的预言如何影响人物的决定。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Taħseb li l-profezija fl-istorja se sseħħ? Luka: Naħseb li iva, imma rrid naqra l-aħħar kapitlu biex inkun naf.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you think the prophecy in the story will come true? Luka: I think so, but I need to read the last chapter to find out.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你觉得故事里的预言会应验吗？Luka：我觉得会，不过我要读完最后一章才能知道。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li l-profezija fl-istorja se sseħħ?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li l-profezija fl-istorja se sseħħ?
messages.zh: 你觉得故事里的预言会应验吗？
messages.en: Do you think the prophecy in the story will come true?

messages.speaker: Luka (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li iva, imma rrid naqra l-aħħar kapitlu biex inkun naf.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li iva, imma rrid naqra l-aħħar kapitlu biex inkun naf.
messages.zh: 我觉得会，不过我要读完最后一章才能知道。
messages.en: I think so, but I need to read the last chapter to find out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 profezija 想成故事卷轴上写着的“一则预言”；它是预言本身，适合搭配“应验”。

gloss_zh: 简介；特征概况；侧面轮廓

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of the main characteristics of a person, group, or organization, or the outline of a face seen from the side.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对个人、群体或组织主要特征的概述，也可指从侧面看到的脸部轮廓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni tal-karatteristiċi ewlenin ta' persuna, grupp jew organizzazzjoni, jew il-kontorn ta' wiċċ meta jidher mill-ġenb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 概述个人、群体或组织主要特征的简介或资料；也指脸部的侧面轮廓。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħrif li jippreżenta l-karatteristiċi prinċipali ta' persuna, grupp jew organizzazzjoni; jista' jfisser ukoll il-linja ta' wiċċ li jidher mill-ġenb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A profile is an account of someone's or something's main characteristics, or the outline of a person's face viewed from the side.

formal.mt: Il-profil professjonali tal-kandidata jinkludi l-esperjenza tagħha fit-tagħlim u l-kwalifiki rilevanti għall-kariga.
formal.en: The candidate's professional profile includes her teaching experience and the qualifications relevant to the position.
formal.zh: 这位应聘者的职业简介包括她的教学经验及与该职位相关的资历。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Rajt il-profil il-ġdid tiegħi? Adam: Iva, imma żid xi ħaġa dwar il-passatempi tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you seen my new profile? Adam: Yes, but add something about your hobbies.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你看过我的新个人简介了吗？Adam：看过，不过再加一点你的兴趣爱好吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajt il-profil il-ġdid tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Rajt il-profil il-ġdid tiegħi?
messages.zh: 你看过我的新个人简介了吗？
messages.en: Have you seen my new profile?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma żid xi ħaġa dwar il-passatempi tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma żid xi ħaġa dwar il-passatempi tiegħek.
messages.zh: 看过，不过再加一点你的兴趣爱好吧。
messages.en: Yes, but add something about your hobbies.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张人物卡：文字展示主要特征，旁边画着侧脸；用这两个画面记住 profil 的常见含义。

gloss_zh: 买家画像；购买者特征概况

teaching_sense.en_definition: A description of the main characteristics, needs, and purchasing habits of a buyer or a type of buyer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某位买家或某类买家的主要特征、需求及购买习惯所作的概述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deskrizzjoni tal-karatteristiċi ewlenin, il-ħtiġijiet u d-drawwiet tax-xiri ta' xerrej jew ta' tip ta' xerrej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 买家画像，即对某位或某类购买者的特征、需求和购买行为的概括描述。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġabra ta' tagħrif dwar il-karatteristiċi, il-ħtiġijiet u l-imġiba fix-xiri ta' persuna li tixtri jew ta' grupp ta' xerrejja simili.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A buyer profile describes the characteristics, needs, and purchasing habits of a particular buyer or a category of buyers.

formal.mt: It-tim ħoloq profil tax-xerrej abbażi ta' stħarriġ dwar il-ħtiġijiet tal-klijenti u d-drawwiet tax-xiri tagħhom.
formal.en: The team created a buyer profile based on a survey of customers' needs and purchasing habits.
formal.zh: 团队根据一项有关顾客需求及购买习惯的调查，建立了买家画像。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se ninkludu fil-profil tax-xerrej? David: Il-baġit, x'għandu bżonn u kemm-il darba jixtri mingħandna.
colloquial.en: Marija: What shall we include in the buyer profile? David: The budget, what the buyer needs, and how often they buy from us.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们要在买家画像中加入哪些内容？David：预算、买家的需求，以及他们多久向我们买一次东西。

messages.speaker: Marija (营销同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se ninkludu fil-profil tax-xerrej?
messages.mt_standard: X'se ninkludu fil-profil tax-xerrej?
messages.zh: 我们要在买家画像中加入哪些内容？
messages.en: What shall we include in the buyer profile?

messages.speaker: David (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-baġit, x'għandu bżonn u kemm-il darba jixtri mingħandna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-baġit, x'għandu bżonn u kemm-il darba jixtri mingħandna.
messages.zh: 预算、买家的需求，以及他们多久向我们买一次东西。
messages.en: The budget, what the buyer needs, and how often they buy from us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 profil tax-xerrej 想成一张“买家资料卡”，依次填写需求、预算和购买习惯，就能记住“买家画像”。

gloss_zh: 已实现利润；已实现收益

teaching_sense.en_definition: Profit actually obtained from a completed transaction, rather than an increase in value that has not yet been converted into a gain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过已经完成的交易实际取得的利润，区别于资产尚未出售时仅在账面上增加的价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Profitt miksub minn tranżazzjoni li tkun tlestiet, aktar milli sempliċi żieda fil-valur ta' assi li jkun għadu ma nbiegħx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过完成交易实际取得的利润，而非尚未兑现的账面增值。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qligħ li jkun inkiseb meta titlesta tranżazzjoni, bħall-bejgħ ta' assi, wara li jitnaqqsu l-ispejjeż rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Realised profit is the gain you actually obtain when a transaction is completed, after the relevant costs have been deducted.

collocations.zh: 出售所得的已实现利润

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju juri profitt realizzat ta' elfejn ewro mill-bejgħ tal-ishma, wara li tnaqqsu l-ispejjeż kollha.
formal.en: The financial report shows a realised profit of two thousand euros from the sale of the shares, after all costs were deducted.
formal.zh: 财务报告显示，扣除全部费用后，出售股票取得了两千欧元的已实现利润。

colloquial.mt: Marija: L-ishma tiegħi għolew fil-valur. Dan diġà hu profitt realizzat? Pawlu: Le, għadek ma begħthomx. Meta tbigħhom, tkun tista' tikkalkula l-profitt realizzat wara li tnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
colloquial.en: Marija: My shares have gone up in value. Is that already realised profit? Pawlu: No, you haven't sold them yet. When you sell them, you can calculate the realised profit after deducting the costs.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我的股票升值了。这已经算已实现利润了吗？Pawlu：还不算，你还没有卖掉。等卖出后，扣除费用，就能计算已实现利润了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ishma tiegħi għolew fil-valur. Dan diġà hu profitt realizzat?
messages.mt_standard: L-ishma tiegħi għolew fil-valur. Dan diġà hu profitt realizzat?
messages.zh: 我的股票升值了。这已经算已实现利润了吗？
messages.en: My shares have gone up in value. Is that already realised profit?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadek ma begħthomx. Meta tbigħhom, tkun tista' tikkalkula l-profitt realizzat wara li tnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadek ma begħthomx. Meta tbigħhom, tkun tista' tikkalkula l-profitt realizzat wara li tnaqqas l-ispejjeż.
messages.zh: 还不算，你还没有卖掉。等卖出后，扣除费用，就能计算已实现利润了。
messages.en: No, you haven't sold them yet. When you sell them, you can calculate the realised profit after deducting the costs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“卖出成交，利润兑现”的画面记忆：profitt realizzat 强调交易完成后实际取得的收益，不能只看账面升值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organised plan or sequence of activities, a radio or television broadcast, or a set of instructions that a computer follows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织的活动计划或安排，也可指广播、电视节目，或供计算机执行的一组指令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjan jew sensiela organizzata ta' attivitajiet, xandira fuq ir-radju jew it-televiżjoni, jew ġabra ta' struzzjonijiet li jwettaq kompjuter.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按一定目标组织的活动计划或安排；也指广播、电视节目，或让计算机完成特定任务的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjan organizzat ta' attivitajiet għal għan partikolari; il-kelma tintuża wkoll għal xandira fuq ir-radju jew it-televiżjoni u għal sett ta' struzzjonijiet li kompjuter iwettaq biex jagħmel xogħol partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A program is an organised plan of activities, a radio or television broadcast, or a set of instructions that tells a computer how to perform a task.

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ jinkludi sitt sessjonijiet prattiċi u valutazzjoni finali tal-ħiliet miksuba.
formal.en: The training program includes six practical sessions and a final assessment of the skills acquired.
formal.zh: 该培训计划包括六次实践课程，以及一次对所学技能的最终评估。
