colloquial.mt: Nina: Liema programm tuża biex teditja r-ritratti? Ġanni: Nuża programm b'xejn. Hu faċli biex tużah u tista' taqta' r-ritratti u tbiddel il-kuluri.
colloquial.en: Nina: Which program do you use to edit photos? Ġanni: I use a free program. It's easy to use, and you can crop photos and change the colours.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你用哪个程序编辑照片？Ġanni：我用一个免费程序。它用起来很简单，可以裁剪照片、调整颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema programm tuża biex teditja r-ritratti?
messages.mt_standard: Liema programm tuża biex teditja r-ritratti?
messages.zh: 你用哪个程序编辑照片？
messages.en: Which program do you use to edit photos?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nuża programm b'xejn. Hu faċli biex tużah u tista' taqta' r-ritratti u tbiddel il-kuluri.
messages.mt_standard: Nuża programm b'xejn. Hu faċli biex tużah u tista' taqta' r-ritratti u tbiddel il-kuluri.
messages.zh: 我用一个免费程序。它用起来很简单，可以裁剪照片、调整颜色。
messages.en: I use a free program. It's easy to use, and you can crop photos and change the colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景记住 programm：培训表上是“计划”，电视屏幕上是“节目”，电脑里执行任务的是“程序”；结合搭配判断含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized set of measures intended to simplify and improve procedures involved in trade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 旨在简化和改善贸易相关手续、使贸易更顺畅的一套有组织的措施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Programm ta' miżuri maħsuba biex jissimplifikaw u jtejbu l-proċeduri marbuta mal-kummerċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易便利化计划，即通过简化贸易手续、改善相关流程来促进贸易的一套措施。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett organizzat ta' miżuri li għandhom l-għan li jagħmlu l-proċeduri tal-kummerċ aktar sempliċi u effiċjenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trade facilitation programme is a coordinated set of measures designed to make trading procedures simpler and more efficient.

formal.mt: Il-ministeru ħabbar programm ta' faċilitazzjoni tal-kummerċ biex inaqqas id-dewmien fl-ipproċessar tad-dokumenti.
formal.en: The ministry announced a trade facilitation programme to reduce delays in processing documents.
formal.zh: 该部宣布了一项贸易便利化计划，以减少文件处理方面的延误。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-programm ta' faċilitazzjoni tal-kummerċ kif se jgħinna? David: L-għan hu li jagħmel il-proċeduri aktar sempliċi, biex inqattgħu inqas ħin fuq il-burokrazija.
colloquial.en: Marta: How will this trade facilitation programme help us? David: The aim is to make the procedures simpler, so we spend less time on bureaucracy.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这项贸易便利化计划会怎样帮助我们？戴维：目的是简化手续，让我们少花些时间处理繁文缛节。

messages.speaker: Marta (商户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-programm ta' faċilitazzjoni tal-kummerċ kif se jgħinna?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-programm ta' faċilitazzjoni tal-kummerċ kif se jgħinna?
messages.zh: 这项贸易便利化计划会怎样帮助我们？
messages.en: How will this trade facilitation programme help us?

messages.speaker: David (贸易顾问)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għan hu li jagħmel il-proċeduri aktar sempliċi, biex inqattgħu inqas ħin fuq il-burokrazija.
messages.mt_standard: L-għan hu li jagħmel il-proċeduri aktar sempliċi, biex inqattgħu inqas ħin fuq il-burokrazija.
messages.zh: 目的是简化手续，让我们少花些时间处理繁文缛节。
messages.en: The aim is to make the procedures simpler, so we spend less time on bureaucracy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意义分成三块记忆：programm 是“计划”，faċilitazzjoni 是“便利化”，kummerċ 是“贸易”；合起来就是贸易便利化计划。

gloss_zh: 纲领性的；按既定计划组织的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on a defined programme of aims, principles, or planned actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以明确的纲领、目标或行动计划为基础，并按其组织实施的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ibbażat fuq programm ċar ta' għanijiet, prinċipji jew azzjonijiet ippjanati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以一套明确的纲领、原则或行动计划为依据的；纲领性的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jsegwi jew jesprimi programm definit ta' prinċipji, għanijiet u azzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A programmatic approach follows a defined programme of principles, objectives, or planned actions.

collocations.zh: 按明确纲领展开的方法

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi approċċ programmatiku li jgħaqqad l-għanijiet tal-proġett ma' azzjonijiet konkreti.
formal.en: The report proposes a programmatic approach that links the project's objectives to concrete actions.
formal.zh: 报告提出一种按明确计划展开的方法，将项目目标与具体行动联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'jiġifieri approċċ programmatiku? Pawlu: Jiġifieri li nimxu skont programm ċar, b'għanijiet u passi definiti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a programmatic approach mean? Pawlu: It means following a clear programme, with defined goals and steps.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：按明确纲领展开的方法是什么意思？保罗：就是按照清晰的计划来做，有明确的目标和步骤。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri approċċ programmatiku?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri approċċ programmatiku?
messages.zh: 按明确纲领展开的方法是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a programmatic approach mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri li nimxu skont programm ċar, b'għanijiet u passi definiti.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri li nimxu skont programm ċar, b'għanijiet u passi definiti.
messages.zh: 就是按照清晰的计划来做，有明确的目标和步骤。
messages.en: It means following a clear programme, with defined goals and steps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词与“先定纲领，再排步骤”的画面联系起来；看到 approċċ programmatiku，就想到有明确计划的方法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Developing gradually through successive stages, or favouring social change and improvement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分阶段逐步发展的；也指支持社会变革与改善的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jiżviluppa jew iseħħ gradwalment fi stadji suċċessivi, jew li jappoġġja bidla u titjib fis-soċjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 逐步发展或推进的；在社会观念或政策方面支持变革与进步的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jimxi 'l quddiem jew jiżviluppa pass pass; jista' wkoll jiddeskrivi ideat jew politika li jappoġġjaw bidla u titjib soċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something progressive develops in stages, while progressive ideas or policies favour social change and improvement.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri titjib progressiv fil-kwalità tas-servizz matul is-sena.
formal.en: The report shows progressive improvement in service quality over the year.
formal.zh: 报告显示，服务质量在这一年中逐步改善。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tara xi titjib fil-qari tiegħek bil-Malti? Toni: Iva, titjib progressiv. Kull ġimgħa nifhem ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you seeing any improvement in your reading in Maltese? Toni: Yes, progressive improvement. Every week I understand a little more.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你的马耳他语阅读有进步吗？托尼：有，是逐步进步的。每周我都能多懂一点。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed tara xi titjib fil-qari tiegħek bil-Malti?
messages.mt_standard: Qed tara xi titjib fil-qari tiegħek bil-Malti?
messages.zh: 你的马耳他语阅读有进步吗？
messages.en: Are you seeing any improvement in your reading in Maltese?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, titjib progressiv. Kull ġimgħa nifhem ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, titjib progressiv. Kull ġimgħa nifhem ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 有，是逐步进步的。每周我都能多懂一点。
messages.en: Yes, progressive improvement. Every week I understand a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一步一步向前走：描述变化时记“渐进”，描述社会思想时记“进步”；结合搭配判断具体含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official who acts on behalf of an inquisitor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表宗教裁判官履行职务的官员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li jaġixxi f'isem inkwiżitur u jwettaq dmirijiet bħala r-rappreżentant tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宗教裁判官代理，即代表宗教裁判官履行相关职务的官员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Uffiċjal li jirrappreżenta lill-inkwiżitur u jaġixxi f'ismu fit-twettiq ta' dmirijiet marbuta mal-kariga.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A proinquisitor is an official who carries out duties on behalf of an inquisitor.

collocations.zh: 宗教裁判官代理的职位

formal.mt: Fit-test tal-eżerċizzju, il-proinkwiżitur huwa deskritt bħala uffiċjal li jaġixxi f'isem l-inkwiżitur.
formal.en: In the exercise text, the proinquisitor is described as an official acting on behalf of the inquisitor.
formal.zh: 在练习文本中，宗教裁判官代理被描述为代表宗教裁判官行事的官员。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser proinkwiżitur f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Uffiċjal li jaġixxi f'isem l-inkwiżitur.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does proinquisitor mean in this sentence? Mark: An official who acts on behalf of the inquisitor.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这句话里的 proinkwiżitur 是什么意思？马克：就是代表宗教裁判官行事的官员。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser proinkwiżitur f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser proinkwiżitur f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 proinkwiżitur 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does proinquisitor mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Uffiċjal li jaġixxi f'isem l-inkwiżitur.
messages.mt_standard: Uffiċjal li jaġixxi f'isem l-inkwiżitur.
messages.zh: 就是代表宗教裁判官行事的官员。
messages.en: An official who acts on behalf of the inquisitor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个职位记成“替宗教裁判官履职的人”，并联记 f'isem“代表、以……的名义”，帮助抓住代理职责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not permitted by a rule, law, or instruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因规则、法律或明确指示而不被允许的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhux permess skont regola, liġi jew ordni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被规则、法律或命令禁止的；不允许的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ma jistax isir għax regola, liġi jew ordni ma tippermettihx.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something is forbidden, a rule or authority does not allow you to do it.

formal.mt: Id-dħul f'din iż-żona huwa projbit mingħajr permess.
formal.en: Entry into this area is forbidden without permission.
formal.zh: 未经许可，禁止进入此区域。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nistgħu nipparkjaw hawn? Mark: Le, ara t-tabella: parkeġġ projbit.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can we park here? Mark: No, look at the sign: parking prohibited.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们可以在这里停车吗？Mark：不行，看那个牌子：禁止停车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nipparkjaw hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nipparkjaw hawn?
messages.zh: 我们可以在这里停车吗？
messages.en: Can we park here?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ara t-tabella: parkeġġ projbit.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ara t-tabella: parkeġġ projbit.
messages.zh: 不行，看那个牌子：禁止停车。
messages.en: No, look at the sign: parking prohibited.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 projbit 和红色禁令牌一起记：看到 dħul projbit，就想到门口写着“禁止入内”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To officially ban something or tell someone that an action is not allowed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 正式禁止某事，或明确告诉某人不准做某个行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma ppermettiex xi ħaġa, b'deċiżjoni uffiċjali jew billi qal lil xi ħadd li ma jistax jagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以正式规定或权威决定禁止某种活动、物品或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Waqqaf uffiċjalment attività, l-użu ta' xi ħaġa jew prattika billi ma baqax jippermettiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If an authority bans something, it officially decides that people must not do or use it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确不准某人做某事；禁止某个行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qal lil xi ħadd li ma jistax jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew ma ppermettiex li jsir ċertu att.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone forbids an action, they tell another person that the action is not allowed.

collocations.en: banned the use of mobile phones

formal.mt: Il-kunsill projbixxa l-ipparkjar quddiem id-daħla tal-iskola biex itejjeb is-sigurtà tat-tfal.
formal.en: The council banned parking in front of the school entrance to improve children's safety.
formal.zh: 议会禁止在学校入口前停车，以提高儿童的安全保障。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nuża l-mowbajl waqt il-lezzjoni? Pawlu: Le, l-għalliem projbixxa l-użu tal-mowbajls fil-klassi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I use my phone during the lesson? Pawlu: No, the teacher banned the use of mobile phones in class.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我上课时可以用手机吗？Pawlu：不行，老师禁止了在课堂上使用手机。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nuża l-mowbajl waqt il-lezzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nuża l-mowbajl waqt il-lezzjoni?
messages.zh: 我上课时可以用手机吗？
messages.en: Can I use my phone during the lesson?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-għalliem projbixxa l-użu tal-mowbajls fil-klassi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-għalliem projbixxa l-użu tal-mowbajls fil-klassi.
messages.zh: 不行，老师禁止了在课堂上使用手机。
messages.en: No, the teacher banned the use of mobile phones in class.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“谁禁止了什么”来记 projbixxa：把老师、手机和禁止手势连成一幅课堂画面，突出禁止这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rule or order that does not allow a particular action or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定某种行为或活动不被允许的规则、命令或禁令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Regola jew ordni li ma tippermettix li ssir ċerta azzjoni jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某种行为或活动的禁止，或作出这种禁止的规定、禁令。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħaġa ma tkunx permessa, jew ir-regola jew l-ordni li twaqqafha milli ssir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prohibition is a rule or order that prevents people from doing a particular thing.

collocations.en: a ban on the use of plastic

formal.mt: Il-projbizzjoni tat-tipjip tapplika għall-kmamar kollha tal-bini.
formal.en: The smoking ban applies to all rooms in the building.
formal.zh: 禁烟令适用于这栋建筑内的所有房间。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm projbizzjoni tat-tipjip hawn? Luka: Iva, ma tistax tpejjep ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a smoking ban here? Luka: Yes, you cannot smoke indoors.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里有禁烟规定吗？Luka：有，室内不能吸烟。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm projbizzjoni tat-tipjip hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm projbizzjoni tat-tipjip hawn?
messages.zh: 这里有禁烟规定吗？
messages.en: Is there a smoking ban here?

messages.speaker: Luka (服务员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma tistax tpejjep ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma tistax tpejjep ġewwa.
messages.zh: 有，室内不能吸烟。
messages.en: Yes, you cannot smoke indoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 projbizzjoni 想成墙上那一条正式禁令：它是可以张贴、说明适用范围的“禁止规定”，用名词画面来记。

gloss_zh: 已宣布的；被正式宣告的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Announced publicly or officially, especially as having a particular status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已被公开或正式宣布的，尤指被宣告具有某种身份或地位的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tħabbar pubblikament jew uffiċjalment, speċjalment bħala li għandu ċertu status jew kariga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被公开宣布或正式宣告的；被正式宣布具有某种身份的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġie ddikjarat jew imħabbar b'mod pubbliku jew uffiċjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is proclaimed, their status or existence has been announced publicly or officially.

formal.mt: Wara li ngħaddu l-voti kollha, il-kandidat ġie proklamat rebbieħ tal-elezzjoni.
formal.en: After all the votes were counted, the candidate was proclaimed the winner of the election.
formal.zh: 全部选票清点完毕后，这位候选人被正式宣布为选举获胜者。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min ġie proklamat rebbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni? Ben: Ġanni! Għadu kemm ħabbar ismu l-preżentatur.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who was proclaimed the winner of the competition? Ben: Ġanni! The presenter has just announced his name.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁被宣布为比赛获胜者了？Ben：Ġanni！主持人刚刚宣布了他的名字。

messages.speaker: Anna (观众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min ġie proklamat rebbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Min ġie proklamat rebbieħ tal-kompetizzjoni?
messages.zh: 谁被宣布为比赛获胜者了？
messages.en: Who was proclaimed the winner of the competition?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġanni! Għadu kemm ħabbar ismu l-preżentatur.
messages.mt_standard: Ġanni! Għadu kemm ħabbar ismu l-preżentatur.
messages.zh: Ġanni！主持人刚刚宣布了他的名字。
messages.en: Ġanni! The presenter has just announced his name.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proklamat 配上主持人拿麦克风宣布冠军的画面：名字已被公开宣告，记住“被正式宣布的”这一状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who acts on behalf of another person in legal matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在法律事务中代表他人行事的代理人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi f'isem persuna oħra fi kwistjonijiet legali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律代理人；在法律事务中代表他人行事的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prokuratur huwa persuna li tirrappreżenta lil persuna oħra fi kwistjonijiet legali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurator is someone who represents another person in legal matters.

formal.mt: Il-klijent talab lill-prokuratur jirrevedi d-dokumenti qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The client asked the procurator to review the documents before the meeting.
formal.zh: 客户请法律代理人在会议前审阅文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tkellimt mal-prokuratur dwar id-dokumenti? Pawlu: Iva, qalli nġibhom miegħi għal-laqgħa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did you speak to the procurator about the documents? Pawlu: Yes, he told me to bring them to the meeting.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你跟法律代理人谈过那些文件了吗？保罗：谈过了，他叫我开会时带上。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tkellimt mal-prokuratur dwar id-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Tkellimt mal-prokuratur dwar id-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 你跟法律代理人谈过那些文件了吗？
messages.en: Did you speak to the procurator about the documents?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qalli nġibhom miegħi għal-laqgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qalli nġibhom miegħi għal-laqgħa.
messages.zh: 谈过了，他叫我开会时带上。
messages.en: Yes, he told me to bring them to the meeting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prokuratur 放进“委任代理人、带齐法律文件”的画面中记忆，重点记住他代表他人处理法律事务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A legal procurator who represents another person in legal matters.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在法律事务中代表他人行事的法律代理人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Prokuratur legali huwa persuna li tirrappreżenta lil ħaddieħor fi kwistjonijiet legali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法律事务代理人；代表他人处理法律事务的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi bħala rappreżentant ta' persuna oħra fi kwistjonijiet legali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A legal procurator is a person who acts for someone else in legal matters.

collocations.en: a meeting with a legal procurator
collocations.zh: 与法律事务代理人的会面

formal.mt: Il-prokuratur legali eżamina d-dokumenti u ddiskuta l-każ mal-klijent.
formal.en: The legal procurator examined the documents and discussed the case with the client.
formal.zh: 法律事务代理人审阅了文件，并与客户讨论了案情。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandek laqgħa mal-prokuratur legali llum? Mark: Iva, fit-tlieta. Se nieħu d-dokumenti kollha miegħi.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you have a meeting with the legal procurator today? Mark: Yes, at three. I'll take all the documents with me.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你今天要跟法律事务代理人见面吗？马克：是的，三点。我会把所有文件都带上。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek laqgħa mal-prokuratur legali llum?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek laqgħa mal-prokuratur legali llum?
messages.zh: 你今天要跟法律事务代理人见面吗？
messages.en: Do you have a meeting with the legal procurator today?

messages.speaker: Mark (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fit-tlieta. Se nieħu d-dokumenti kollha miegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fit-tlieta. Se nieħu d-dokumenti kollha miegħi.
messages.zh: 是的，三点。我会把所有文件都带上。
messages.en: Yes, at three. I'll take all the documents with me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prokuratur legali 整体记成“法律事务代理人”，联想预约会面、携带文件的场景来巩固这个职务名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Producing a large amount of work, especially writing or other creative work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作品或成果产出很多的，尤其用于形容写作或其他创作活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jipproduċi ħafna xogħol jew ħafna xogħlijiet, speċjalment fil-kitba jew f'attivitajiet kreattivi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多产的；能创作大量作品或产生大量成果的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joħloq jew jipproduċi għadd kbir ta' xogħlijiet jew riżultati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is prolific produces a large number of works or results.

formal.mt: Dan il-kittieb prolifiku ppubblika għaxar rumanzi f'ħames snin.
formal.en: This prolific writer published ten novels in five years.
formal.zh: 这位多产的作家在五年内出版了十部小说。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kittieb ħareġ ktieb ieħor? Ġorġ: Iva! Hu prolifiku ħafna; din is-sena diġà ħareġ tliet kotba.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has this writer brought out another book? Ġorġ: Yes! He's very prolific; he's already brought out three books this year.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：这位作家又出新书了？乔治：是啊！他特别多产，今年已经出了三本书。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-kittieb ħareġ ktieb ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-kittieb ħareġ ktieb ieħor?
messages.zh: 这位作家又出新书了？
messages.en: Has this writer brought out another book?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Hu prolifiku ħafna; din is-sena diġà ħareġ tliet kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Hu prolifiku ħafna; din is-sena diġà ħareġ tliet kotba.
messages.zh: 是啊！他特别多产，今年已经出了三本书。
messages.en: Yes! He's very prolific; he's already brought out three books this year.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象作家的书架每个月都添一本新书，用“作品一本接一本”记住 prolifiku，核心是产出数量多。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Important or well known, or easy to notice because of position or appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 重要或知名的；也指因位置或外观而显眼、突出的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa importanti jew magħruf sew, jew li jispikka minħabba l-pożizzjoni jew id-dehra tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显著、突出或知名；可形容容易引人注意的事物或具有较高知名度的人物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġbed l-attenzjoni għax jispikka, jew li huwa importanti u magħruf sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone or something prominent attracts attention through visibility, importance, or public recognition.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显眼的；突出的；用于人物时也可指重要的、知名的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jispikka u jidher faċilment, jew li għandu importanza jew huwa magħruf sew.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prominent person is well known, while a prominent feature is easily noticed.

formal.mt: L-avviż għandu jitqiegħed f'post prominenti ħdejn id-daħla biex il-viżitaturi jarawh faċilment.
formal.en: The notice should be placed in a prominent position near the entrance so that visitors can see it easily.
formal.zh: 通知应放在入口附近的显眼位置，以便访客容易看到。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Fejn inpoġġi l-avviż? David: Poġġih f'post prominenti ħdejn il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
colloquial.en: Rita: Where should I put the notice? David: Put it in a prominent position by the door so everyone can see it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：通知放在哪里好？戴维：放在门边显眼的位置，让大家都看得到。

messages.speaker: Rita (活动工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi l-avviż?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi l-avviż?
messages.zh: 通知放在哪里好？
messages.en: Where should I put the notice?

messages.speaker: David (活动负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Poġġih f'post prominenti ħdejn il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
messages.mt_standard: Poġġih f'post prominenti ħdejn il-bieb, biex kulħadd jarah.
messages.zh: 放在门边显眼的位置，让大家都看得到。
messages.en: Put it in a prominent position by the door so everyone can see it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“门口显眼的通知”和“大家熟知的人物”两幅画面记 prominenti：事物突出易见，人物重要知名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The importance or attention given to someone or something that makes them stand out.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人或某事物因重要、受到关注或被突出呈现而具有的显著地位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-importanza jew l-attenzjoni li tingħata lil persuna jew lil ħaġa u li tagħmilha tispikka.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 显著或突出的状态；受到重视或广泛关注的地位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qagħda ta' persuna jew ħaġa li tispikka jew li tingħata importanza u attenzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something has prominence, they stand out because they are important, noticeable, or given particular attention.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti prominenza lill-ħtieġa li jittejjeb it-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The report gives prominence to the need to improve public transport.
formal.zh: 该报告着重强调改善公共交通的必要性。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex poġġejt din l-aħbar fil-bidu? Pawlu: Biex nagħtiha aktar prominenza; taffettwa ħafna nies.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did you put this news story first? Pawlu: To give it more prominence; it affects many people.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你为什么把这条新闻放在最前面？保罗：为了让它更突出；它影响很多人。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex poġġejt din l-aħbar fil-bidu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex poġġejt din l-aħbar fil-bidu?
messages.zh: 你为什么把这条新闻放在最前面？
messages.en: Why did you put this news story first?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (编辑)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħtiha aktar prominenza; taffettwa ħafna nies.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħtiha aktar prominenza; taffettwa ħafna nies.
messages.zh: 为了让它更突出；它影响很多人。
messages.en: To give it more prominence; it affects many people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象报纸把一条新闻放大置顶：它获得更多关注，就有了 prominenza；连同“给予突出地位”这个搭配一起记。

gloss_zh: 与不同对象发生随意性关系的行为

teaching_sense.en_definition: The practice of having casual sexual relationships with different people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与不同对象发生随意性关系的行为或生活方式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prattika li persuna jkollha relazzjonijiet sesswali każwali ma' persuni differenti.

sense_translations.en_definition: randon sexual relations with different people
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与不同的人发生随意性关系的行为。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Imġiba li fiha persuna jkollha relazzjonijiet sesswali każwali ma' diversi persuni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Promiscuity is the practice of having casual sexual relationships with a number of different people.

collocations.zh: 关于随意性关系行为的讨论
对随意性关系行为的态度

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-attitudnijiet lejn il-promiscuity fost gruppi ta' etajiet differenti.
formal.en: The study examines attitudes towards promiscuity among different age groups.
formal.zh: 该研究考察不同年龄群体对与不同对象发生随意性关系这一行为的态度。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'promiscuity' f'dan l-artiklu? David: Tfisser li persuna jkollha relazzjonijiet sesswali każwali ma' persuni differenti.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does the word 'promiscuity' mean in this article? David: It means having casual sexual relationships with different people.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文章里的 promiscuity 是什么意思？戴维：指一个人与不同对象发生随意性关系。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'promiscuity' f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'promiscuity' f'dan l-artiklu?
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 promiscuity 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'promiscuity' mean in this article?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li persuna jkollha relazzjonijiet sesswali każwali ma' persuni differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li persuna jkollha relazzjonijiet sesswali każwali ma' persuni differenti.
messages.zh: 指一个人与不同对象发生随意性关系。
messages.en: It means having casual sexual relationships with different people.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“不同对象＋随意性关系”两个要点记住 promiscuity；重点在关系行为，不要只记成一般的社交活跃。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ready to do something, or quick to act or respond.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经准备好做某事的，或行动、回应迅速的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun lest biex jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew li jaġixxi jew iwieġeb malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行动或回应迅速的；及时作出反应的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi jew iwieġeb malajr u mingħajr dewmien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is prompt acts or responds quickly, without making others wait unnecessarily.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经准备好的；处于可以开始行动或使用的状态的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun lest u jkollu t-tħejjijiet meħtieġa biex jibda jew biex jintuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is ready, the necessary preparations have been completed and action can begin.

formal.mt: It-tim kien pront biex iwieġeb għat-talba, u r-rapport kien pront qabel il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The team was quick to respond to the request, and the report was ready before the meeting.
formal.zh: 团队迅速回应了请求，报告也在会议开始前准备好了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int pront biex nitilqu? Mark: Iva, kollox pront. Ħa nieħu ċ-ċwievet u niġi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you ready for us to leave? Mark: Yes, everything's ready. Let me get the keys and I'll come.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你准备好出发了吗？马克：好了，一切都准备好了。我拿上钥匙就来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Int pront biex nitilqu?
messages.mt_standard: Int pront biex nitilqu?
messages.zh: 你准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Are you ready for us to leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kollox pront. Ħa nieħu ċ-ċwievet u niġi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kollox pront. Ħa nieħu ċ-ċwievet u niġi.
messages.zh: 好了，一切都准备好了。我拿上钥匙就来。
messages.en: Yes, everything's ready. Let me get the keys and I'll come.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pront 放进出门场景：行李收好是“准备好了”，有人一叫就回应是“反应迅速”；用同一场景连接两个义项。

gloss_zh: 宣传；旨在影响观点的宣传信息

teaching_sense.en_definition: Information or messages spread to influence people's opinions in support of a particular cause or viewpoint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为支持某种立场、主张或事业而传播、旨在影响公众观点的信息或宣传活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Informazzjoni jew messaġġi mxerrda biex jinfluwenzaw l-opinjonijiet tan-nies favur kawża jew perspettiva partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 旨在影响人们观点、使其支持某种立场或主张的宣传，常带有选择性或偏向性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Informazzjoni jew messaġġi, spiss magħżula jew ippreżentati b'mod preġudikat, li jinxterdu biex in-nies jappoġġjaw kawża jew opinjoni partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Propaganda is information spread to influence people's opinions, often by presenting a selective or biased account.

formal.mt: L-istudenti analizzaw il-lingwa u l-immaġnijiet użati f'kampanja ta' propaganda politika.
formal.en: The students analysed the language and images used in a political propaganda campaign.
formal.zh: 学生们分析了一场政治宣传活动所使用的语言和图像。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dan il-filmat jagħti biss naħa waħda tal-istorja. Ġużepp: Iva, jidher aktar bħal propaganda milli bħal rapport ibbilanċjat.
colloquial.en: Anna: This video only gives one side of the story. Ġużepp: Yes, it looks more like propaganda than a balanced report.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这个视频只讲了事情的一面。朱塞佩：是啊，看起来更像宣传，而不是平衡的报道。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-filmat jagħti biss naħa waħda tal-istorja.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-filmat jagħti biss naħa waħda tal-istorja.
messages.zh: 这个视频只讲了事情的一面。
messages.en: This video only gives one side of the story.

messages.speaker: Ġużepp (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jidher aktar bħal propaganda milli bħal rapport ibbilanċjat.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jidher aktar bħal propaganda milli bħal rapport ibbilanċjat.
messages.zh: 是啊，看起来更像宣传，而不是平衡的报道。
messages.en: Yes, it looks more like propaganda than a balanced report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张反复强调同一立场的宣传海报：propaganda 的记忆重点是“传播信息以影响观点”，并留意信息的选择和偏向。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to make a statement more precise or to explain what is actually true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于严格界定某种说法，或说明实际情况，表示“严格说来”或“实际上”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jintuża biex jagħmel stqarrija aktar preċiża jew biex jiċċara x'inhu veru fil-fatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格说来；按照准确的定义或严格的标准而言。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta wieħed jitkellem b'mod preċiż u skont it-tifsira stretta tal-kliem jew ir-regoli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use propjament when you want to describe something in a precise and strictly accurate way.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实际上；用于说明真实情况，尤其是澄清与先前说法或表面印象不同的事实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri x'ġara jew x'inhu veru fir-realtà, speċjalment meta dan ikun differenti minn dak li wieħed jaħseb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use propjament to introduce the actual situation, especially when it differs from what someone believes.

collocations.en: strictly speaking, it is not a mistake
in actual fact, it did not happen that way
collocations.zh: 实际上，事情并不是那样发生的

formal.mt: Propjament, din il-laqgħa hija konsultazzjoni u mhux votazzjoni, għaliex il-parteċipanti qed jagħtu l-opinjonijiet tagħhom biss.
formal.en: Strictly speaking, this meeting is a consultation rather than a vote, because the participants are only giving their opinions.
formal.zh: 严格说来，这次会议是征询意见，而非表决，因为与会者只是在发表自己的看法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int kont hemm meta waslet l-aħbar? Pawlu: Propjament, kont diġà tlaqt. Maja: Allura min qallek? Pawlu: Ċempilli ħija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were you there when the news arrived? Pawlu: Actually, I had already left. Maja: Then who told you? Pawlu: My brother called me.
colloquial.zh: Maja：消息传来时你在那里吗？Pawlu：实际上，我已经走了。Maja：那是谁告诉你的？Pawlu：我哥哥给我打了电话。

messages.mt_standard: Ċempilli ħija.

messages.en: My brother called me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它想成说话时的“精确校准键”：校准定义是“严格说来”，校准事实是“实际上”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: In banking, total eligible regulatory capital divided by risk-weighted assets, usually expressed as a percentage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银行符合监管要求的资本总额与风险加权资产之比，通常以百分比表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-banek, il-kapital totali li jikkwalifika skont ir-regoli regolatorji diviż bl-assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju, normalment espress bħala perċentwal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总资本充足率；银行合格监管资本总额除以风险加权资产所得的比率。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proporzjon bankarju li jqabbel il-kapital regolatorju totali eliġibbli mal-assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A bank's total capital ratio measures its eligible regulatory capital in relation to its risk-weighted assets.

collocations.en: the calculation of the total capital ratio
an increase in the total capital ratio

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-bank għandu kapital regolatorju totali eliġibbli ta' tmintax-il miljun ewro u assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju ta' mitt miljun ewro; għalhekk, il-proporzjon kapitali totali huwa ta' tmintax fil-mija.
formal.en: In this example, the bank has eighteen million euros in total eligible regulatory capital and one hundred million euros in risk-weighted assets; its total capital ratio is therefore eighteen percent.
formal.zh: 在本例中，该银行的合格监管资本总额为一千八百万欧元，风险加权资产为一亿欧元，因此总资本充足率为百分之十八。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif insib il-proporzjon kapitali totali f'dan l-eżerċizzju? David: Aqsam il-kapital regolatorju totali eliġibbli bl-assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju. Lara: U biex nagħtih bħala perċentwal? David: Immultiplika r-riżultat b'mija.
colloquial.en: Lara: How do I find the total capital ratio in this exercise? David: Divide total eligible regulatory capital by risk-weighted assets. Lara: And to express it as a percentage? David: Multiply the result by one hundred.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这道练习里的总资本充足率怎么算？David：用合格监管资本总额除以风险加权资产。Lara：那要表示成百分比呢？David：把结果乘以一百。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib il-proporzjon kapitali totali f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib il-proporzjon kapitali totali f'dan l-eżerċizzju?
messages.zh: 这道练习里的总资本充足率怎么算？
messages.en: How do I find the total capital ratio in this exercise?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqsam il-kapital regolatorju totali eliġibbli bl-assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju.
messages.mt_standard: Aqsam il-kapital regolatorju totali eliġibbli bl-assi ppeżati skont ir-riskju.
messages.zh: 用合格监管资本总额除以风险加权资产。
messages.en: Divide total eligible regulatory capital by risk-weighted assets.

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: U biex nagħtih bħala perċentwal?
messages.mt_standard: U biex nagħtih bħala perċentwal?
messages.zh: 那要表示成百分比呢？
messages.en: And to express it as a percentage?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Immultiplika r-riżultat b'mija.
messages.mt_standard: Immultiplika r-riżultat b'mija.
messages.zh: 把结果乘以一百。
messages.en: Multiply the result by one hundred.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用分数图记忆：上方放合格监管资本总额，下方放风险加权资产；十八除以一百就是百分之十八。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial ratio calculated by dividing a company's debt by its shareholders' equity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将公司的债务金额除以股东权益金额所得的财务比率，用于比较债务与权益的相对规模。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proporzjon finanzjarju kkalkulat billi d-dejn ta' kumpanija jinqasam bl-ekwità tal-azzjonisti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务权益比率；公司债务与股东权益之比，表示每单位股东权益对应多少债务。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon bejn id-dejn ta' kumpanija u l-ekwità tal-azzjonisti tagħha, li juri kemm hemm dejn għal kull unità ta' ekwità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company's debt-equity ratio shows how much debt it has for each unit of shareholders' equity.

collocations.en: a reduction in the debt-equity ratio

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżempju, il-kumpanija għandha dejn ta' mitejn elf ewro u ekwità tal-azzjonisti ta' mitt elf ewro; il-proporzjon ta' dejn-ekwità huwa għalhekk ta' tnejn għal wieħed.
formal.en: In this example, the company has two hundred thousand euros in debt and one hundred thousand euros in shareholders' equity; its debt-equity ratio is therefore two to one.
formal.zh: 在本例中，该公司的债务为二十万欧元，股东权益为十万欧元，因此债务权益比率为二比一。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser proporzjon ta' dejn-ekwità ta' tnejn għal wieħed? Karl: Ifisser żewġ ewro ta' dejn għal kull ewro ta' ekwità tal-azzjonisti. Nina: Mela d-dejn huwa d-doppju tal-ekwità? Karl: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a debt-equity ratio of two to one mean? Karl: It means two euros of debt for every euro of shareholders' equity. Nina: So the debt is twice the equity? Karl: Yes, in this example.
colloquial.zh: Nina：债务权益比率为二比一是什么意思？Karl：意思是每一欧元股东权益对应两欧元债务。Nina：那债务就是权益的两倍？Karl：对，在这个例子里是这样。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser proporzjon ta' dejn-ekwità ta' tnejn għal wieħed?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser proporzjon ta' dejn-ekwità ta' tnejn għal wieħed?
messages.zh: 债务权益比率为二比一是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a debt-equity ratio of two to one mean?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser żewġ ewro ta' dejn għal kull ewro ta' ekwità tal-azzjonisti.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser żewġ ewro ta' dejn għal kull ewro ta' ekwità tal-azzjonisti.
messages.zh: 意思是每一欧元股东权益对应两欧元债务。
messages.en: It means two euros of debt for every euro of shareholders' equity.

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela d-dejn huwa d-doppju tal-ekwità?
messages.mt_standard: Mela d-dejn huwa d-doppju tal-ekwità?
messages.zh: 那债务就是权益的两倍？
messages.en: So the debt is twice the equity?

messages.speaker: Karl (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'dan l-eżempju.
messages.zh: 对，在这个例子里是这样。
messages.en: Yes, in this example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按词序记分数：dejn 是债务，放分子；ekwità 是权益，放分母。二比一就是每一份权益对应两份债务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A financial ratio comparing a company's debt with its equity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衡量公司债务相对于其所有者权益规模的财务比率。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proporzjon finanzjarju li jqabbel id-dejn ta' kumpanija mal-kapital proprju tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公司债务与其所有者权益之比。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proporzjon bejn id-dejn ta' kumpanija u l-kapital proprju tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A company's debt-equity ratio shows how much debt it has in relation to its equity.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport annwali juri li l-proporzjon ta' ingranaġġ tal-kumpanija naqas minħabba tnaqqis fid-dejn.
formal.en: The annual report shows that the company's debt-equity ratio fell because its debt decreased.
formal.zh: 年度报告显示，由于债务减少，该公司的债务权益比率有所下降。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'juri l-proporzjon ta' ingranaġġ? Mark: Juri kemm għandha dejn il-kumpanija meta mqabbel mal-kapital proprju tagħha.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does the debt-equity ratio show? Mark: It shows how much debt the company has compared with its equity.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：债务权益比率说明什么？马克：它说明公司的债务相对于其所有者权益有多少。

messages.speaker: Maja (商科学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'juri l-proporzjon ta' ingranaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: X'juri l-proporzjon ta' ingranaġġ?
messages.zh: 债务权益比率说明什么？
messages.en: What does the debt-equity ratio show?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Juri kemm għandha dejn il-kumpanija meta mqabbel mal-kapital proprju tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Juri kemm għandha dejn il-kumpanija meta mqabbel mal-kapital proprju tagħha.
messages.zh: 它说明公司的债务相对于其所有者权益有多少。
messages.en: It shows how much debt the company has compared with its equity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“债务÷所有者权益”的分式记忆本条金融义：上面放债务，下面放权益，看到整个短语就想到两者的比值。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The relationship between an amount and a whole, or between two amounts, expressed by their relative sizes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一数量相对于整体或另一数量的大小关系，可用分数、百分比或比值表示。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-relazzjoni fid-daqs jew fil-kwantità bejn parti u t-total, jew bejn żewġ ammonti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 比例；部分在整体中所占的份额，或两个数量之间的相对大小关系。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sehem li parti għandha f'total, jew ir-relazzjoni bejn żewġ kwantitajiet meta jitqabblu ma' xulxin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The proportion of something is its amount compared with the whole or with another amount.

formal.mt: Il-proporzjoni ta' studenti li jużaw it-trasport pubbliku hija ta' sittin fil-mija, jiġifieri sitt studenti minn kull għaxra.
formal.en: The proportion of students who use public transport is sixty percent, meaning six students out of every ten.
formal.zh: 使用公共交通的学生占百分之六十，也就是每十名学生中有六名。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi l-proporzjoni ta' meraq u ilma f'din ix-xarba? Mark: Parti meraq għal kull żewġ partijiet ilma. Sara: Mela għal tazza meraq inżid żewġ tazzi ilma? Mark: Iva, eżatt.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the proportion of juice to water in this drink? Mark: One part juice to two parts water. Sara: So for one glass of juice, I add two glasses of water? Mark: Yes, exactly.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这杯饮料里果汁和水的比例是多少？Mark：一份果汁配两份水。Sara：那一杯果汁就加两杯水？Mark：对，正是这样。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-proporzjoni ta' meraq u ilma f'din ix-xarba?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-proporzjoni ta' meraq u ilma f'din ix-xarba?
messages.zh: 这杯饮料里果汁和水的比例是多少？
messages.en: What is the proportion of juice to water in this drink?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Parti meraq għal kull żewġ partijiet ilma.
messages.mt_standard: Parti meraq għal kull żewġ partijiet ilma.
messages.zh: 一份果汁配两份水。
messages.en: One part juice to two parts water.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għal tazza meraq inżid żewġ tazzi ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Mela għal tazza meraq inżid żewġ tazzi ilma?
messages.zh: 那一杯果汁就加两杯水？
messages.en: So for one glass of juice, I add two glasses of water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, eżatt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, eżatt.
messages.zh: 对，正是这样。
messages.en: Yes, exactly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象量杯中的一份果汁与两份水：看到 proporzjoni，就先问“多少比多少，或占整体多少”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An idea put forward for other people to consider.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向他人提出、供其考虑的想法或做法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idea jew mod ta' kif issir xi ħaġa li jitressaq biex ħaddieħor jikkunsidrah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出供他人考虑的想法、建议或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Idea li xi ħadd iressaq quddiem ħaddieħor biex tiġi kkunsidrata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A suggestion is an idea that someone puts forward for other people to consider.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iddiskuta l-proposta li l-librerija tibqa' miftuħa sa aktar tard.
formal.en: The committee discussed the suggestion that the library should stay open later.
formal.zh: 委员会讨论了延长图书馆开放时间的建议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi proposta: immorru nimxu wara l-ikel. Pawlu: Idea tajba! Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-park?
colloquial.en: Lara: I have a suggestion: let's go for a walk after lunch. Pawlu: Good idea! Shall we meet near the park?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我有个建议：午饭后去散步吧。保罗：好主意！我们在公园附近见面，好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi proposta: immorru nimxu wara l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi proposta: immorru nimxu wara l-ikel.
messages.zh: 我有个建议：午饭后去散步吧。
messages.en: I have a suggestion: let's go for a walk after lunch.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Idea tajba! Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-park?
messages.mt_standard: Idea tajba! Niltaqgħu ħdejn il-park?
messages.zh: 好主意！我们在公园附近见面，好吗？
messages.en: Good idea! Shall we meet near the park?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proposta 放进 Għandi proposta“我有个建议”整句记忆：想象自己举手提出散步的想法，别人接着考虑是否接受。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who owns something, such as an object, building, or business.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有某件物品、某栋建筑或某家企业等财产的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha xi ħaġa tagħha, bħal oġġett, bini jew negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某物拥有所有权的人；物主。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li lilha tappartjeni xi ħaġa, bħal dar, karozza jew ħanut.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

formal.mt: Il-proprjetarju tal-bini informa lill-inkwilini li t-tiswijiet se jibdew nhar it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The owner of the building informed the tenants that repairs would begin on Monday.
formal.zh: 楼宇所有者通知租户，维修将于星期一开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Int il-proprjetarju ta' dan il-ħanut? Ġużeppi: Iva, il-ħanut tiegħi. Kif nista' ngħinek?
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you the owner of this shop? Ġużeppi: Yes, the shop is mine. How can I help you?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你是这家店的所有者吗？朱塞佩：是的，这家店是我的。有什么可以帮你？

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Int il-proprjetarju ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Int il-proprjetarju ta' dan il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 你是这家店的所有者吗？
messages.en: Are you the owner of this shop?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-ħanut tiegħi. Kif nista' ngħinek?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-ħanut tiegħi. Kif nista' ngħinek?
messages.zh: 是的，这家店是我的。有什么可以帮你？
messages.en: Yes, the shop is mine. How can I help you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象店主指着店铺说“这是我的”：proprjetarju 指拥有东西的那个人；把“谁拥有它”与“所有者”一起记住。

gloss_zh: 共同所有人；部分产权所有人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who owns part of something, with the remaining ownership belonging to others.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拥有某项财产的一部分所有权，而其余所有权属于他人的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha parti mill-proprjetà ta' xi ħaġa, filwaqt li l-bqija tkun ta' persuni oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与其他人共同拥有同一项财产的人；共同所有人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha xi ħaġa bħala proprjetà flimkien ma' persuna oħra jew ma' diversi persuni oħra.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A joint owner is someone who owns something together with one or more other people.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 只拥有某项财产部分所有权的人；部分产权所有人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha sehem fil-proprjetà ta' xi ħaġa, iżda ma tkunx il-proprjetarju waħdieni tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A part owner is someone who owns a share of something rather than the whole of it.

collocations.zh: 一栋房屋的部分产权所有人
一家企业的部分所有人

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika lil Mark bħala proprjetarju parzjali tal-bini u jindika s-sehem tiegħu.
formal.en: The report identifies Mark as a part owner of the building and indicates his share.
formal.zh: 报告将马克列为该建筑的部分产权所有人，并注明了他的份额。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din id-dar kollha tiegħek? Mark: Le, jien proprjetarju parzjali; il-bqija hija ta' oħti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you own this whole house? Mark: No, I'm a part owner; my sister owns the rest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这整栋房子都是你的吗？马克：不是，我只拥有部分产权；其余部分归我姐姐所有。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din id-dar kollha tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Din id-dar kollha tiegħek?
messages.zh: 这整栋房子都是你的吗？
messages.en: Do you own this whole house?

messages.speaker: Mark (房屋共同所有人)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien proprjetarju parzjali; il-bqija hija ta' oħti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien proprjetarju parzjali; il-bqija hija ta' oħti.
messages.zh: 不是，我只拥有部分产权；其余部分归我姐姐所有。
messages.en: No, I'm a part owner; my sister owns the rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象房屋产权被分成几份：这个词组指拥有其中一份的人。joint owner 强调与他人共有，part owner 强调自己只占一部分。

exact_key: proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt
gloss_zh: 通过继承取得的个人财产

teaching_sense.en_definition: Personal property that a person receives through inheritance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人通过继承而获得的个人财产。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proprjetà personali li persuna tkun kisbet permezz ta' wirt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过继承取得的个人财产。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proprjetà personali li tkun għaddiet għand persuna bħala wirt mingħand persuna li mietet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Personal property acquired by inheritance consists of belongings that a person receives from someone who has died.

collocations.mt: lista ta' proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt
collocations.en: a list of personal property acquired by inheritance
collocations.zh: 通过继承取得的个人财产清单

collocations.mt: il-valur tal-proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt
collocations.en: the value of personal property acquired by inheritance
collocations.zh: 通过继承取得的个人财产的价值

formal.mt: Il-lista tal-proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt tinkludi arloġġ, ġojjellerija u għamara.
formal.en: The list of personal property acquired by inheritance includes a watch, jewellery, and furniture.
formal.zh: 通过继承取得的个人财产清单包括一块手表、珠宝和家具。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt'? David: Affarijiet personali li tirċievi bħala wirt, bħall-arloġġ li ħallielek in-nannu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'personal property acquired by inheritance' mean? David: Personal belongings you receive as an inheritance, like the watch your grandfather left you.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：“通过继承取得的个人财产”是什么意思？戴维：就是你继承得到的个人物品，比如爷爷留给你的手表。

messages.speaker: Nina (妹妹)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt'?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'proprjetà personali akkwistata permezz ta' wirt'?
messages.zh: “通过继承取得的个人财产”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'personal property acquired by inheritance' mean?

messages.speaker: David (哥哥)
messages.mt_spoken: Affarijiet personali li tirċievi bħala wirt, bħall-arloġġ li ħallielek in-nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Affarijiet personali li tirċievi bħala wirt, bħall-arloġġ li ħallielek in-nannu.
messages.zh: 就是你继承得到的个人物品，比如爷爷留给你的手表。
messages.en: Personal belongings you receive as an inheritance, like the watch your grandfather left you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记：proprjetà personali 是个人财产，akkwistata 是取得的，permezz ta' wirt 是通过继承；用“继承爷爷的手表”串起全句。

gloss_zh: 本义的；确切的；实际上；事实上；确实

teaching_sense.en_definition: Exact or strictly correct, especially when describing the meaning or use of a word.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 确切而严格符合本义的，尤用于说明词语的含义或用法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li huwa eżatt u korrett, speċjalment meta jirreferi għat-tifsira jew għall-użu ta' kelma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严格符合本义或确切含义的；本义的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaqbel mat-tifsira eżatta jew mal-użu korrett ta' xi ħaġa, speċjalment ta' kelma.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The proper meaning of a word is its exact meaning in the context being discussed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 实际上；用于指出真实情况，尤其在它与原先的印象或预期不同时。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex juri x'inhi s-sitwazzjoni fir-realtà, speċjalment meta tkun differenti minn dak li wieħed jaħseb.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use actually to indicate what is really true, especially when correcting an impression or expectation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 事实上；用于补充或纠正信息，并突出所述情况属实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex iżid jew jikkoreġi informazzjoni u jenfasizza li dak li jingħad huwa fatt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use as a matter of fact when adding a true detail or correcting something previously suggested.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 确实；的确；用于加强肯定或确认前面提到的情况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jintuża biex isaħħaħ stqarrija jew jikkonferma li xi ħaġa hija tassew hekk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use indeed to emphasize a statement or confirm that something is true.

collocations.en: in the proper sense of the word

formal.mt: F'dan it-test, il-kelma tintuża fis-sens proprju tagħha, mingħajr ebda tifsira figurattiva.
formal.en: In this text, the word is used in its proper sense, without any figurative meaning.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，该词按其本义使用，不含任何比喻义。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Allura l-laqgħa hi llum, mhux għada? Pawlu: Proprju hekk! Tibda fit-tlieta.
colloquial.en: Maja: So the meeting is today, not tomorrow? Pawlu: Exactly! It starts at three.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：所以会议是今天，不是明天？保罗：正是这样！三点开始。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Allura l-laqgħa hi llum, mhux għada?
messages.mt_standard: Allura l-laqgħa hi llum, mhux għada?
messages.zh: 所以会议是今天，不是明天？
messages.en: So the meeting is today, not tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Proprju hekk! Tibda fit-tlieta.
messages.mt_standard: Proprju hekk! Tibda fit-tlieta.
messages.zh: 正是这样！三点开始。
messages.en: Exactly! It starts at three.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“确切”串联记忆：修饰词义时表示“本义、确切的”，强调一句话时表示“实际上、确实”。遇到它先判断是形容词还是副词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of bringing a criminal case against someone, or the side that presents the case against the accused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人提起并进行刑事指控的过程，也可指在案件中提出指控的控方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih titressaq u titmexxa akkuża kriminali kontra persuna, jew in-naħa li tippreżenta l-każ kontra l-akkużat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 刑事检控，即对被告提出并推进刑事指控的程序；也指承担指控一方职责的控方。
sense_translations.mt_definition: It-tressiq u t-tmexxija ta' każ kriminali kontra persuna quddiem il-qorti, jew in-naħa li tressaq l-akkużi u tippreżenta l-provi kontriha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prosecution is the process of pursuing a criminal case against someone, and the word can also refer to the side presenting that case.

formal.mt: Waqt is-seduta, il-prosekuzzjoni ppreżentat dokumenti ġodda u sejħet xhud biex jixhed.
formal.en: During the hearing, the prosecution presented new documents and called a witness to testify.
formal.zh: 庭审期间，控方提交了新文件，并传唤了一名证人作证。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min se jressaq il-provi kontra l-akkużat? Toni: Il-prosekuzzjoni. Id-difiża mbagħad twieġeb.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who will present the evidence against the accused? Toni: The prosecution. The defence will then respond.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：谁来提交指控被告的证据？托尼：控方。然后辩方会作出回应。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jressaq il-provi kontra l-akkużat?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jressaq il-provi kontra l-akkużat?
messages.zh: 谁来提交指控被告的证据？
messages.en: Who will present the evidence against the accused?

messages.speaker: Toni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-prosekuzzjoni. Id-difiża mbagħad twieġeb.
messages.mt_standard: Il-prosekuzzjoni. Id-difiża mbagħad twieġeb.
messages.zh: 控方。然后辩方会作出回应。
messages.en: The prosecution. The defence will then respond.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象法庭上提交指控证据的一方，把 prosekuzzjoni 与“控方”连在一起；描述整个追诉过程时，则理解为“刑事检控”。

gloss_zh: 提供有偿性服务的女性；妓女

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman who provides sexual services in exchange for payment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以提供性服务来换取报酬的女性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li tipprovdi servizzi sesswali bi ħlas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以金钱或其他报酬为交换提供性服务的女性；妓女。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mara li toffri servizzi sesswali lil persuni oħra bi skambju għal flus jew ħlas ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prostitute is a person who provides sexual services for payment; this Maltese noun refers to a woman.

collocations.zh: 一名提供有偿性服务的女性的生活

formal.mt: L-artiklu jirrakkonta l-esperjenzi ta' prostituta u jagħti spazju lill-perspettiva tagħha stess.
formal.en: The article recounts a prostitute's experiences and gives space to her own perspective.
formal.zh: 这篇文章讲述了一名提供有偿性服务的女性的经历，并呈现了她本人的看法。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min hi l-mara fir-rumanz? Adam: Hija prostituta, u l-istorja tirrakkonta ħajjitha.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who is the woman in the novel? Adam: She is a prostitute, and the story recounts her life.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：小说里的那个女人是谁？亚当：她是一名提供有偿性服务的女性，故事讲述了她的一生。

messages.speaker: Nina (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hi l-mara fir-rumanz?
messages.mt_standard: Min hi l-mara fir-rumanz?
messages.zh: 小说里的那个女人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the woman in the novel?

messages.speaker: Adam (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija prostituta, u l-istorja tirrakkonta ħajjitha.
messages.mt_standard: Hija prostituta, u l-istorja tirrakkonta ħajjitha.
messages.zh: 她是一名提供有偿性服务的女性，故事讲述了她的一生。
messages.en: She is a prostitute, and the story recounts her life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prostituta 放进“taħdem bħala prostituta”整句记忆，抓住“女性、性服务、报酬”三个语义要点，并用尊重当事人的语气理解和使用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protest is an expression of strong disagreement with a decision, action, or situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某项决定、行为或状况表示强烈反对的言语、书面声明或行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dikjarazzjoni jew azzjoni li biha persuna jew grupp jesprimu nuqqas ta' qbil qawwi ma' deċiżjoni, azzjoni jew sitwazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 抗议；为表达反对或提出异议而作出的声明或行动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni ta' oppożizzjoni jew nuqqas ta' qbil, li tista' ssir bil-kliem, bil-kitba jew permezz ta' azzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A protest is something people say or do to express strong disagreement or opposition.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat bagħat protest bil-miktub biex jesprimi n-nuqqas ta' qbil tiegħu mad-deċiżjoni.
formal.en: The committee sent a written protest to express its disagreement with the decision.
formal.zh: 委员会提交了书面抗议，表达其对该决定的反对。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se taċċettaw id-deċiżjoni? Mark: Le, se nibagħtu protest bil-miktub. Maja: Sewwa, spjegaw għaliex ma taqblux.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to accept the decision? Mark: No, we're going to send a written protest. Maja: All right, explain why you disagree.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你们打算接受这个决定吗？Mark：不，我们会提交书面抗议。Maja：好，把你们反对的理由说清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se taċċettaw id-deċiżjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Se taċċettaw id-deċiżjoni?
messages.zh: 你们打算接受这个决定吗？
messages.en: Are you going to accept the decision?

messages.speaker: Mark (委员会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, se nibagħtu protest bil-miktub.
messages.mt_standard: Le, se nibagħtu protest bil-miktub.
messages.zh: 不，我们会提交书面抗议。
messages.en: No, we're going to send a written protest.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, spjegaw għaliex ma taqblux.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, spjegaw għaliex ma taqblux.
messages.zh: 好，把你们反对的理由说清楚。
messages.en: All right, explain why you disagree.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 protest 联想到一封明确写着“我反对”的信，搭配 bil-miktub 一起记，就是“书面抗议”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Protestant is a Christian who belongs to one of the Protestant churches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 信奉基督教新教、属于某一新教教会的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna Nisranija li tappartjeni għal waħda mill-knejjes Protestanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新教徒；信奉基督教新教的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li tħaddan il-fidi Nisranija kif tiġi mgħallma f'waħda mill-knejjes Protestanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Protestant is a person whose Christian faith is associated with one of the Protestant churches.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 新教徒；属于基督教新教教会的信徒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Membru ta' knisja Protestanta li jħaddan it-tagħlim reliġjuż tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A Protestant is a Christian who is a member of a Protestant church.

collocations.zh: 积极实践信仰的新教徒

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, Protestant spjega kif il-komunità tiegħu torganizza attivitajiet ta' għajnuna.
formal.en: During the meeting, a Protestant explained how his community organises activities to help others.
formal.zh: 会议期间，一位新教徒介绍了他的社群如何组织助人活动。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Paul hu Protestant? David: Iva, hu membru ta' knisja Protestanta. Lara: Nista' nistaqsih dwar il-fidi tiegħu? David: Iva, jieħu gost jitkellem dwarha.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is Paul a Protestant? David: Yes, he's a member of a Protestant church. Lara: Can I ask him about his faith? David: Yes, he enjoys talking about it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Paul 是新教徒吗？David：是的，他属于一所新教教会。Lara：我可以问问他的信仰吗？David：可以，他很乐意谈这个。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Paul hu Protestant?
messages.mt_standard: Paul hu Protestant?
messages.zh: Paul 是新教徒吗？
messages.en: Is Paul a Protestant?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu membru ta' knisja Protestanta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu membru ta' knisja Protestanta.
messages.zh: 是的，他属于一所新教教会。
messages.en: Yes, he's a member of a Protestant church.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nistaqsih dwar il-fidi tiegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nistaqsih dwar il-fidi tiegħu?
messages.zh: 我可以问问他的信仰吗？
messages.en: Can I ask him about his faith?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jieħu gost jitkellem dwarha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jieħu gost jitkellem dwarha.
messages.zh: 可以，他很乐意谈这个。
messages.en: Yes, he enjoys talking about it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Protestant 放进“他属于哪所教会”的问答场景中记忆：这里指新教徒，记住它表示人的宗教身份。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Someone or something that is protected is kept safe from harm, damage, or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 得到保护，从而免受伤害、损坏或危险的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun imħares minn ħsara, periklu jew theddid permezz ta' kura jew miżuri ta' protezzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受保护的；有措施或照护使其免受伤害、损坏或危险的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun taħt protezzjoni sabiex ma jġarrabx ħsara jew ma jkunx espost għall-periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone or something is protected, measures are taken to keep them safe from harm.

formal.mt: Dan is-sit huwa protett, u l-viżitaturi għandhom jimxu biss fil-mogħdijiet immarkati.
formal.en: This site is protected, and visitors should walk only on the marked paths.
formal.zh: 该地点受到保护，游客应当只沿标示的步道行走。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nersaq lejn dak l-annimal? Sam: Aħjar tibqa' ftit 'il bogħod; huwa annimal protett. Nina: Tajjeb, narah minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I go closer to that animal? Sam: It's better to keep some distance; it's a protected animal. Nina: All right, I'll watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我能走近那只动物吗？Sam：最好保持一点距离，它是受保护的动物。Nina：好，我就在这里看。

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nersaq lejn dak l-annimal?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nersaq lejn dak l-annimal?
messages.zh: 我能走近那只动物吗？
messages.en: Can I go closer to that animal?

messages.speaker: Sam (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Aħjar tibqa' ftit 'il bogħod; huwa annimal protett.
messages.mt_standard: Aħjar tibqa' ftit 'il bogħod; huwa annimal protett.
messages.zh: 最好保持一点距离，它是受保护的动物。
messages.en: It's better to keep some distance; it's a protected animal.

messages.speaker: Nina (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, narah minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, narah minn hawn.
messages.zh: 好，我就在这里看。
messages.en: All right, I'll watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象动物旁有一块“受到保护”的牌子，把 annimal protett 连起来记；protett 描写被保护对象的状态。

gloss_zh: 保护性的；起防护作用的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something protective is intended to keep a person or thing safe from harm or damage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于保护人或物，使其免受伤害或损坏的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jservi biex jipproteġi lil persuna jew lil xi ħaġa minn ħsara jew periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受保护的；受到照护或防护而免受伤害、损坏或危险的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun imħares minn ħsara jew periklu permezz ta' protezzjoni jew kura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is protected is kept safe through care or measures that prevent harm.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom jilbsu l-ilbies protettiv qabel jidħlu fiż-żona tax-xogħol.
formal.en: Workers should put on protective clothing before entering the work area.
formal.zh: 工作人员进入作业区前应穿上防护服装。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Nista' nibda npinġi issa? Toni: Iva, imma l-ewwel ilbes l-ilbies protettiv. Marta: Fejn qiegħed? Toni: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Marta: Can I start painting now? Toni: Yes, but put on the protective clothing first. Marta: Where is it? Toni: In the box beside the door.
colloquial.zh: Marta：我现在可以开始刷漆了吗？Toni：可以，不过先穿上防护服装。Marta：放在哪里？Toni：在门旁边的箱子里。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nibda npinġi issa?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nibda npinġi issa?
messages.zh: 我现在可以开始刷漆了吗？
messages.en: Can I start painting now?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-ewwel ilbes l-ilbies protettiv.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-ewwel ilbes l-ilbies protettiv.
messages.zh: 可以，不过先穿上防护服装。
messages.en: Yes, but put on the protective clothing first.

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qiegħed?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qiegħed?
messages.zh: 放在哪里？
messages.en: Where is it?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-kaxxa ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 在门旁边的箱子里。
messages.en: In the box beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用防护服的画面记住 ilbies protettiv：衣服提供防护。对照记忆，protett 表示受到保护，protettiv 表示起保护作用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The protection of people who buy goods or services against unfair practices and unsafe products.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过规则、措施和援助，保护商品或服务购买者免受不公平交易及不安全产品的损害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien ta' min jixtri prodotti jew servizzi minn prattiki kummerċjali inġusti u minn prodotti li jistgħu jagħmlu ħsara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消费者保护；维护商品或服务购买者的权益，使其免受不公平交易和不安全产品的损害。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-liġijiet, il-miżuri u l-għajnuna li jħarsu l-interessi ta' min jixtri prodotti jew servizzi, speċjalment kontra prattiki inġusti u prodotti mhux sikuri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Consumer protection consists of laws and measures intended to defend buyers against unfair trading practices and unsafe products.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-importanza tal-protezzjoni tal-konsumatur fil-bejgħ fuq l-internet.
formal.en: The report stresses the importance of consumer protection in online sales.
formal.zh: 报告强调了消费者保护在网络销售中的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħanut ma jridx jisma' l-ilment tiegħi dwar il-prodott difettuż. Mark: Tista' titlob għajnuna mingħand uffiċċju tal-protezzjoni tal-konsumatur.
colloquial.en: Lara: The shop refuses to listen to my complaint about the faulty product. Mark: You can ask a consumer protection office for help.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：商店不肯听我投诉这件有质量问题的商品。马克：你可以向消费者保护机构求助。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħanut ma jridx jisma' l-ilment tiegħi dwar il-prodott difettuż.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħanut ma jridx jisma' l-ilment tiegħi dwar il-prodott difettuż.
messages.zh: 商店不肯听我投诉这件有质量问题的商品。
messages.en: The shop refuses to listen to my complaint about the faulty product.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' titlob għajnuna mingħand uffiċċju tal-protezzjoni tal-konsumatur.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' titlob għajnuna mingħand uffiċċju tal-protezzjoni tal-konsumatur.
messages.zh: 你可以向消费者保护机构求助。
messages.en: You can ask a consumer protection office for help.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“买到问题商品后向保护消费者的机构求助”的画面联系起来，记住它表示消费者保护。

gloss_zh: 保护主义；贸易保护主义

teaching_sense.en_definition: An economic policy of protecting domestic businesses by restricting competition from foreign goods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过限制外国商品进入或增加其成本，保护本国产业免受外国竞争的经济政策。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Politika ekonomika li tipproteġi lin-negozji u lill-industriji tal-pajjiż mill-kompetizzjoni barranija permezz ta' tariffi jew restrizzjonijiet fuq l-importazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贸易保护主义；以关税、进口限制等措施保护本国产业，使其减少受到外国商品竞争的政策。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Politika li tillimita l-kompetizzjoni minn prodotti barranin billi timponi tariffi, kwoti jew restrizzjonijiet oħra fuq l-importazzjoni biex tħares il-produzzjoni lokali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Protectionism is a policy of helping domestic industries by taxing foreign goods or limiting their importation.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-effetti tal-protezzjoniżmu fuq il-prezzijiet tal-prodotti importati u fuq il-produzzjoni lokali.
formal.en: The study examines the effects of protectionism on the prices of imported products and on domestic production.
formal.zh: 该研究考察保护主义对进口产品价格及本国生产的影响。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu l-protezzjoniżmu? Pawlu: Huwa meta pajjiż jipproteġi lin-negozji tiegħu, pereżempju billi jimponi taxxi fuq prodotti minn barra.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is protectionism? Pawlu: It is when a country protects its businesses, for example by imposing taxes on products from abroad.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：什么是保护主义？保罗：就是一个国家保护本国企业，例如对外国商品征税。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu l-protezzjoniżmu?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu l-protezzjoniżmu?
messages.zh: 什么是保护主义？
messages.en: What is protectionism?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta pajjiż jipproteġi lin-negozji tiegħu, pereżempju billi jimponi taxxi fuq prodotti minn barra.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta pajjiż jipproteġi lin-negozji tiegħu, pereżempju billi jimponi taxxi fuq prodotti minn barra.
messages.zh: 就是一个国家保护本国企业，例如对外国商品征税。
messages.en: It is when a country protects its businesses, for example by imposing taxes on products from abroad.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进口商品在国境处遇到关税门槛，本国企业因此受到保护；用这个画面记住贸易保护主义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A test of something, a difficult experience that tests someone, or a practice session before a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可指检验事物的试验、考验人的艰难经历，或正式演出前的排练，具体含义取决于语境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Test biex wieħed jara kif taħdem xi ħaġa, esperjenza diffiċli li ġġarrab lil persuna, jew taħriġ qabel wirja jew kunċert.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 试验；试用；通过实际尝试检验某事物的效果、性能或适用性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Test jew tentattiv li jsir biex jiġi evalwat kif taħdem xi ħaġa jew jekk hijiex adattata għal skop partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A trial is a test in which something is used or attempted to find out how well it works.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 严峻考验；令人痛苦或难以承受、需要坚忍度过的经历。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Esperjenza iebsa jew ta' tbatija li titlob ħafna paċenzja, kuraġġ jew saħħa mingħand min jgħaddi minnha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An ordeal is a very difficult or distressing experience that requires considerable endurance from the person facing it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 排练；为正式演出而进行的预先练习。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sessjoni li fiha l-parteċipanti jipprattikaw dramm, mużika jew wirja oħra qabel il-preżentazzjoni quddiem udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A rehearsal is a practice session in which performers prepare for a play, concert, or other public performance.

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija offriet perjodu ta' prova ta' xahar biex il-klijenti jkunu jistgħu jevalwaw is-servizz.
formal.en: The company offered a one-month trial period so that customers could evaluate the service.
formal.zh: 公司提供了一个月的试用期，让客户能够评估这项服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandna prova llejla? Toni: Iva, fit-teatru fis-sebgħa. Sara: Mela niltaqgħu hemm qabel nibdew.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do we have a rehearsal tonight? Toni: Yes, at the theatre at seven. Sara: Then let's meet there before we start.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今晚有排练吗？托尼：有，七点在剧院。萨拉：那我们开始前在那里碰面。

messages.speaker: Sara (剧团演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna prova llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna prova llejla?
messages.zh: 我们今晚有排练吗？
messages.en: Do we have a rehearsal tonight?

messages.speaker: Toni (剧团演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fit-teatru fis-sebgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fit-teatru fis-sebgħa.
messages.zh: 有，七点在剧院。
messages.en: Yes, at the theatre at seven.

messages.speaker: Sara (剧团演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela niltaqgħu hemm qabel nibdew.
messages.mt_standard: Mela niltaqgħu hemm qabel nibdew.
messages.zh: 那我们开始前在那里碰面。
messages.en: Then let's meet there before we start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个场景区分同一个词：产品先试用，人生经考验，演员做排练；看到上下文再选择对应义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Evidence or documentation showing where something comes from or was produced.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说明某物来自何处或在何处生产的证据或文件，在贸易语境中常指原产地证明。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Evidenza jew dokumentazzjoni li turi minn fejn ġejja xi ħaġa jew f'liema pajjiż ġiet prodotta merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来源证据；有助于判断某物来自何处或在何处生产的材料或信息。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tagħrif, dokumenti jew materjal ieħor li jgħin biex jiġi stabbilit minn fejn ġej oġġett jew fejn ġie prodott.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Evidence of origin is information or material that helps establish where an item comes from or was produced.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 来源证明；用以证实某物来源或生产地的材料，贸易语境中指原产地证明。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dokument jew evidenza li tistabbilixxi minn fejn ġejja xi ħaġa jew il-pajjiż li fih ġiet prodotta merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Proof of origin is documentation or other evidence used to establish the source or place of production of an item.

collocations.en: proof of the origin of the goods

formal.mt: L-importatur ippreżenta prova tal-oriġini tal-merkanzija flimkien mad-dokumenti l-oħra tal-konsenja.
formal.en: The importer submitted proof of the origin of the goods together with the other shipment documents.
formal.zh: 进口商提交了货物的原产地证明及其他运输文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-fornitur bagħat prova tal-oriġini? David: Iva, bagħat dokument li juri fejn ġew prodotti l-oġġetti. Marija: Tajjeb, żommu mal-fattura.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the supplier send proof of origin? David: Yes, he sent a document showing where the items were produced. Marija: Good, keep it with the invoice.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：供应商寄来原产地证明了吗？戴维：寄来了，他发了一份说明这些物品生产地的文件。玛丽娅：好，把它和发票放在一起。

messages.speaker: Marija (采购经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fornitur bagħat prova tal-oriġini?
messages.mt_standard: Il-fornitur bagħat prova tal-oriġini?
messages.zh: 供应商寄来原产地证明了吗？
messages.en: Did the supplier send proof of origin?

messages.speaker: David (采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, bagħat dokument li juri fejn ġew prodotti l-oġġetti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, bagħat dokument li juri fejn ġew prodotti l-oġġetti.
messages.zh: 寄来了，他发了一份说明这些物品生产地的文件。
messages.en: Yes, he sent a document showing where the items were produced.

messages.speaker: Marija (采购经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, żommu mal-fattura.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, żommu mal-fattura.
messages.zh: 好，把它和发票放在一起。
messages.en: Good, keep it with the invoice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物旁边附着一份回答“从哪里来、在哪里生产”的文件，将整个短语记作来源或原产地证明。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Supplied or made available for someone to use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经供应或交给某人使用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun ingħata jew tqiegħed għad-dispożizzjoni ta' xi ħadd biex jintuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已提供的；已供应给人使用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jkun ġie mogħti jew fornut lil xi ħadd għal użu jew ħtieġa partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is provided has been supplied or made available for someone to use.

formal.mt: Il-materjal provdut għandu jintuża biss waqt il-kors.
formal.en: The material provided must be used only during the course.
formal.zh: 所提供的材料只能在课程期间使用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna nġibu l-ikel magħna? Ben: Le, l-ikel provdut mill-iskola huwa biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: Should we bring food with us? Ben: No, the food provided by the school is enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们要自己带食物吗？本：不用，学校提供的食物够大家吃。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna nġibu l-ikel magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna nġibu l-ikel magħna?
messages.zh: 我们要自己带食物吗？
messages.en: Should we bring food with us?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, l-ikel provdut mill-iskola huwa biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Le, l-ikel provdut mill-iskola huwa biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 不用，学校提供的食物够大家吃。
messages.en: No, the food provided by the school is enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 provdut 放在材料或食物后面记忆：看到它，就想到东西已经有人提供好了。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A short, familiar saying that expresses practical advice or a general observation about life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 广为流传的简短说法，用来表达生活经验、一般道理或实用劝告。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qawl qasir u magħruf li jesprimi parir prattiku jew osservazzjoni ġenerali dwar il-ħajja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谚语，指流传较广、概括生活经验或表达劝诫的简短语句。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frażi qasira magħrufa fost in-nies li tiġbor fiha esperjenza tal-ħajja, tagħlima jew parir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A proverb is a short, widely known saying that expresses advice or an observation about life.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jispjegaw it-tifsira tal-proverbju u jagħtu eżempju ta' meta jista' jintuża.
formal.en: Students should explain the meaning of the proverb and give an example of when it can be used.
formal.zh: 学生应解释这则谚语的含义，并举例说明可以在什么情况下使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ifisser dan il-proverbju? Pawlu: Ifisser li għandek taħseb sew qabel taġixxi.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this proverb mean? Pawlu: It means that you should think carefully before you act.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这则谚语是什么意思？保罗：意思是行动之前应该仔细考虑。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ifisser dan il-proverbju?
messages.mt_standard: X'ifisser dan il-proverbju?
messages.zh: 这则谚语是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this proverb mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li għandek taħseb sew qabel taġixxi.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li għandek taħseb sew qabel taġixxi.
messages.zh: 意思是行动之前应该仔细考虑。
messages.en: It means that you should think carefully before you act.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proverbju 和“一句话装进生活经验”的画面联系起来：句子虽短，却能提醒人一个道理。

gloss_zh: 提供反馈；语境为询问网站上是否找不到该链接

teaching_sense.en_definition: A website action label inviting users to submit comments, used here in a question about whether its link is missing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 网站上邀请用户提交意见的操作文字；本例用于询问该操作链接是否在整个网站上都找不到。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tikketta fuq sit li tistieden lill-utent jibgħat kummenti jew suġġerimenti, u li hawn tissemma f'mistoqsija dwar jekk il-link tagħha hix nieqsa mis-sit kollu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Your 'provide feedback' link is not available anywhere on the site?
sense_translations.zh_definition: 你们网站上的“提供反馈”链接，在整个网站上都找不到吗？
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mistoqsija li tistaqsi jekk il-link tagħkom bit-tikketta 'provide feedback' hijiex nieqsa minn kull paġna tas-sit.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The speaker is asking whether the website offers any accessible link for submitting feedback.

formal.mt: Fir-rapport dwar is-sit, l-utent staqsa jekk il-link bit-tikketta 'Provide feedback' kinitx disponibbli fuq xi paġna.
formal.en: In the report about the website, the user asked whether the link labelled 'Provide feedback' was available on any page.
formal.zh: 在有关该网站的报告中，用户询问是否有任何页面提供标为“提供反馈”的链接。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma nistax insib il-link 'Provide feedback'. Fejn qiegħda? Mark: Qiegħda fil-qiegħ tal-paġna ewlenija.
colloquial.en: Nina: I can't find the 'Provide feedback' link. Where is it? Mark: It's at the bottom of the home page.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我找不到“提供反馈”的链接。它在哪里？马克：它在首页底部。

messages.speaker: Nina (网站用户)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax insib il-link 'Provide feedback'. Fejn qiegħda?
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax insib il-link 'Provide feedback'. Fejn qiegħda?
messages.zh: 我找不到“提供反馈”的链接。它在哪里？
messages.en: I can't find the 'Provide feedback' link. Where is it?

messages.speaker: Mark (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Qiegħda fil-qiegħ tal-paġna ewlenija.
messages.mt_standard: Qiegħda fil-qiegħ tal-paġna ewlenija.
messages.zh: 它在首页底部。
messages.en: It's at the bottom of the home page.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Provide feedback 当作网站按钮上的整块文字来记：点击之后，把使用感受和建议反馈给网站。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A territorial division of a country that is administered as a distinct region.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个国家划分出的、作为独立行政区域管理的省级地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diviżjoni territorjali ta' pajjiż li tiġi amministrata bħala reġjun distint.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 省，指一个国家内部划分出的行政区域。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Żona ta' pajjiż li tifforma diviżjoni amministrattiva b'isem u fruntieri partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A province is one of the administrative regions into which a country is divided.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-popolazzjoni, l-ekonomija u s-servizzi pubbliċi tal-provinċja.
formal.en: The report describes the population, economy and public services of the province.
formal.zh: 这份报告介绍了该省的人口、经济和公共服务。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-lukanda tinsab fl-istess provinċja bħall-ajruport? Leo: Iva, imma l-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu sagħtejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is the hotel in the same province as the airport? Leo: Yes, but the drive takes two hours.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：酒店和机场在同一个省吗？莱奥：是的，不过开车要两个小时。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-lukanda tinsab fl-istess provinċja bħall-ajruport?
messages.mt_standard: Il-lukanda tinsab fl-istess provinċja bħall-ajruport?
messages.zh: 酒店和机场在同一个省吗？
messages.en: Is the hotel in the same province as the airport?
