messages.speaker: Leo (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu sagħtejn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-vjaġġ bil-karozza jieħu sagħtejn.
messages.zh: 是的，不过开车要两个小时。
messages.en: Yes, but the drive takes two hours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上一个国家被划成若干省区，每块写着 provinċja；再把省会记作 il-kapitali tal-provinċja。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A supply of food or other necessities kept or provided for use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为满足需要而提供或预先备好的食物及其他必需物资。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel jew oġġetti oħra meħtieġa li jinżammu jew jiġu pprovduti biex jintużaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可供使用的一批食物或其他必需物资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwantità ta' ikel jew oġġetti oħra meħtieġa li tkun disponibbli għall-użu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A supply is an amount of food or other necessities available for people to use.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为满足某种需要，尤其为将来使用而备办的必需物资。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikel jew affarijiet meħtieġa li jitħejjew biex jissodisfaw ħtieġa, speċjalment għal użu aktar tard.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Provision refers here to necessities prepared or supplied to meet an expected need.

formal.mt: Qabel it-tluq, l-organizzaturi għandhom jiżguraw proviżjon ta' ikel u ilma għall-parteċipanti kollha.
formal.en: Before departure, the organisers should ensure a supply of food and water for all participants.
formal.zh: 出发前，组织者应确保为所有参加者备好食物和饮用水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna biżżejjed proviżjon għall-vjaġġ? Mark: Iva, ħadt ikel u ilma għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do we have enough provisions for the journey? Mark: Yes, I brought food and water for everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为旅途准备的物资够吗？马克：够，我给大家带了食物和水。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna biżżejjed proviżjon għall-vjaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna biżżejjed proviżjon għall-vjaġġ?
messages.zh: 我们为旅途准备的物资够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough provisions for the journey?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħadt ikel u ilma għal kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħadt ikel u ilma għal kulħadd.
messages.zh: 够，我给大家带了食物和水。
messages.en: Yes, I brought food and water for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proviżjon 和出发前装满食物、水的物资箱联系起来，记住它指供给或备好的必需品。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lasting for a limited time or accepted for now until a final arrangement is made.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 只在有限时间内使用的，或在最终安排确定之前暂时采用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdum għal żmien limitat jew jiġi aċċettat għalissa sakemm isir arranġament finali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临时的；只持续或使用一段有限时间的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jdum jew jintuża għal żmien limitat biss.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited period of time.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暂定的；目前可以采用，但仍可能在最终确认之前更改的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġi aċċettat għalissa iżda jista' jinbidel qabel ma jiġi kkonfermat b'mod finali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An arrangement that is provisional is accepted for now but may change before final confirmation.

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva ftehim proviżorju li jibqa' fis-seħħ sakemm jiġi ffirmat il-ftehim finali.
formal.en: The committee approved a provisional agreement that will remain in force until the final agreement is signed.
formal.zh: 委员会批准了一份暂定协议，该协议将持续有效，直至最终协议签署。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan hu l-ħin finali tal-laqgħa? Pawlu: Le, għadu proviżorju. Nikkonfermah għada.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this the final meeting time? Pawlu: No, it is still provisional. I'll confirm it tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：会议时间最终定下来了吗？保罗：没有，目前还是暂定的。我明天确认。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu l-ħin finali tal-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu l-ħin finali tal-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会议时间最终定下来了吗？
messages.en: Is this the final meeting time?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (会议组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għadu proviżorju. Nikkonfermah għada.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għadu proviżorju. Nikkonfermah għada.
messages.zh: 没有，目前还是暂定的。我明天确认。
messages.en: No, it is still provisional. I'll confirm it tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张可以擦改的会议时间便条：proviżorju 表示先这样安排，可能只是临时使用，也可能尚待最终确认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity or arrangement of making services available to people or organisations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向个人或机构提供服务，使其能够获得和使用这些服务的活动或安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività jew l-arranġament li bih servizzi jsiru disponibbli għal persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务的提供；为满足个人或机构需要而安排并提供服务的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha jiġu organizzati u offruti servizzi biex jintlaħqu l-ħtiġijiet ta' persuni jew organizzazzjonijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The provision of services is the activity of arranging and delivering services to people or organisations.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 服务的供应；由服务提供方向使用者提供所需服务的活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-attività li biha fornitur jagħmel is-servizzi tiegħu disponibbli għal dawk li jeħtiġuhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supply of services occurs when a provider makes services available to those who need them.

collocations.en: a contract for the supply of services

formal.mt: Il-kuntratt jistabbilixxi l-kundizzjonijiet għall-provvista ta' servizzi ta' tindif fl-iskejjel.
formal.en: The contract sets out the conditions for the provision of cleaning services in schools.
formal.zh: 合同规定了向学校提供清洁服务的条件。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'tinkludi l-provvista ta' servizzi f'dan il-pakkett? David: Tinkludi t-tindif u l-manutenzjoni ta' kull xahar.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does the provision of services in this package include? David: It includes cleaning and monthly maintenance.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个套餐提供哪些服务？戴维：包括清洁和每月维护。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tinkludi l-provvista ta' servizzi f'dan il-pakkett?
messages.mt_standard: X'tinkludi l-provvista ta' servizzi f'dan il-pakkett?
messages.zh: 这个套餐提供哪些服务？
messages.en: What does the provision of services in this package include?

messages.speaker: David (客服人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tinkludi t-tindif u l-manutenzjoni ta' kull xahar.
messages.mt_standard: Tinkludi t-tindif u l-manutenzjoni ta' kull xahar.
messages.zh: 包括清洁和每月维护。
messages.en: It includes cleaning and monthly maintenance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语联想成服务窗口：provvista 对应提供，ta' 连接后面的 servizzi，合起来记作向使用者提供服务。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The front part of a boat or ship.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 船只最前面的部分，即船首或船头。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem ta' dgħajsa jew bastiment.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船首；船只前端的部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem ta' dgħajsa jew bastiment, li tkun fuq quddiem meta dan jimxi 'l quddiem.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The prow of a boat or ship is its front part.

formal.mt: Matul l-ispezzjoni, l-ekwipaġġ eżamina l-prowa tal-bastiment għal sinjali ta' ħsara.
formal.en: During the inspection, the crew examined the ship's prow for signs of damage.
formal.zh: 检查期间，船员查看了船首是否有损坏迹象。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn se noqogħdu biex naraw il-port? Toni: Ejja lejn il-prowa; minn hemm naraw aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where shall we stand to see the harbour? Toni: Come towards the prow; we can see better from there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们站在哪里看港口呢？托尼：来船头这边吧，从那里看得更清楚。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘船游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se noqogħdu biex naraw il-port?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se noqogħdu biex naraw il-port?
messages.zh: 我们站在哪里看港口呢？
messages.en: Where shall we stand to see the harbour?

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja lejn il-prowa; minn hemm naraw aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja lejn il-prowa; minn hemm naraw aħjar.
messages.zh: 来船头这边吧，从那里看得更清楚。
messages.en: Come towards the prow; we can see better from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一艘向前航行的小船，把 prowa 标在最前端；再用 lejn il-prowa 练习表达朝船头走。

gloss_zh: 反倾销程序；反倾销案件程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal process for examining suspected dumping in trade and deciding whether action against it is warranted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审查贸易中涉嫌倾销的行为，并判断是否需要采取反倾销措施的正式程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess formali biex jiġi eżaminat bejgħ suspettat ta' dumping fil-kummerċ u jiġi deċiż jekk hemmx bażi għal miżuri kontrih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反倾销程序，指审查涉嫌倾销行为及是否需要采取相应措施的正式处理流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess formali li jistabbilixxi l-passi għall-eżami ta' dumping suspettat u għall-kunsiderazzjoni ta' miżuri kontrih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-dumping procedure is a formal process used to examine suspected dumping and consider measures against it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反倾销案件程序，指针对某项涉嫌倾销行为开展的正式调查和审查程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess formali dwar każ partikolari ta' dumping suspettat, li fih jiġu investigati l-fatti u eżaminata l-informazzjoni rilevanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-dumping proceeding is a formal case in which suspected dumping is investigated and the relevant evidence is examined.

collocations.en: the initiation of an anti-dumping proceeding

collocations.zh: 在反倾销程序进行期间

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-informazzjoni eżaminata matul il-proċediment antidumping dwar il-prodott importat.
formal.en: The report describes the information examined during the anti-dumping proceeding concerning the imported product.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了针对该进口产品的反倾销程序中所审查的信息。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi jfisser proċediment antidumping f'dan ir-rapport? David: Huwa proċess formali biex jiġi eżaminat jekk kienx hemm dumping fil-bejgħ tal-prodott.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does an anti-dumping proceeding mean in this report? David: It is a formal process to examine whether dumping occurred in the sale of the product.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这份报告里的反倾销程序是什么意思？戴维：这是审查该产品的销售是否存在倾销行为的正式程序。

messages.speaker: Nina (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser proċediment antidumping f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser proċediment antidumping f'dan ir-rapport?
messages.zh: 这份报告里的反倾销程序是什么意思？
messages.en: What does an anti-dumping proceeding mean in this report?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa proċess formali biex jiġi eżaminat jekk kienx hemm dumping fil-bejgħ tal-prodott.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa proċess formali biex jiġi eżaminat jekk kienx hemm dumping fil-bejgħ tal-prodott.
messages.zh: 这是审查该产品的销售是否存在倾销行为的正式程序。
messages.en: It is a formal process to examine whether dumping occurred in the sale of the product.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词联想成一份“反倾销案件档案”：从启动程序到审查材料，记住它指处理过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal proceeding that examines subsidies affecting imported goods and whether measures against their effects are warranted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 审查进口商品所获补贴及其影响，并判断是否需要采取相应措施的正式程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċediment formali li jeżamina s-sussidji mogħtija lil prodotti importati u l-effetti tagħhom, biex jiġi deċiż jekk hemmx bżonn ta' miżuri kontrihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 针对进口商品所获补贴及其影响展开调查和审查的反补贴程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċediment li fih jiġu investigati s-sussidji mogħtija lil prodotti importati u jiġu eżaminati l-effetti tagħhom fuq il-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-subsidy proceeding is a formal process for investigating subsidies on imported goods and considering measures to address their effects.

collocations.en: the initiation of an anti-subsidy proceeding
the conclusion of an anti-subsidy proceeding

formal.mt: L-awtorità fetħet proċediment antisussidji biex teżamina s-sussidji mogħtija lill-produtturi barranin u l-effetti tagħhom fuq is-suq lokali.
formal.en: The authority initiated an anti-subsidy proceeding to examine subsidies granted to foreign producers and their effects on the local market.
formal.zh: 主管机关启动了反补贴程序，审查向外国生产商提供的补贴及其对本地市场的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed jitolbuna dawn id-dokumenti? Mark: Għax infetaħ proċediment antisussidji, u jridu jeżaminaw l-għajnuna finanzjarja li rċieva l-produttur.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are they asking us for these documents? Mark: Because an anti-subsidy proceeding has been opened, and they want to examine the financial assistance the producer received.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他们为什么要求我们提供这些文件？Mark：因为已经启动了反补贴程序，他们想审查生产商获得的资助。

messages.speaker: Maja (进口公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jitolbuna dawn id-dokumenti?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jitolbuna dawn id-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 他们为什么要求我们提供这些文件？
messages.en: Why are they asking us for these documents?

messages.speaker: Mark (进口公司同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax infetaħ proċediment antisussidji, u jridu jeżaminaw l-għajnuna finanzjarja li rċieva l-produttur.
messages.mt_standard: Għax infetaħ proċediment antisussidji, u jridu jeżaminaw l-għajnuna finanzjarja li rċieva l-produttur.
messages.zh: 因为已经启动了反补贴程序，他们想审查生产商获得的资助。
messages.en: Because an anti-subsidy proceeding has been opened, and they want to examine the financial assistance the producer received.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语与“查补贴、看影响”的场景绑定记忆：看到进口商品补贴受审查，就联想反补贴程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal procedure for investigating whether imported goods are being dumped and considering appropriate measures.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 调查进口商品是否存在倾销，并考虑相应措施的正式程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura formali biex jiġi investigat jekk prodotti importati humiex qed jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom u biex jiġu kkunsidrati miżuri xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为调查和处理进口商品倾销问题而采用的正式程序及步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' passi formali li jintużaw biex jiġu investigati u ttrattati każijiet fejn prodotti importati jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-dumping procedure is the formal set of steps used to investigate dumping of imported goods and consider an appropriate response.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 就涉嫌进口商品倾销而启动并开展的正式调查和审查程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċediment formali dwar allegazzjoni li prodotti importati qed jinbiegħu bi prezz inqas mill-valur normali tagħhom, li fih jiġu eżaminati l-evidenza u l-effetti fuq il-produtturi lokali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An anti-dumping proceeding is a formal investigation into alleged dumping of imported goods, including examination of the evidence and effects on domestic producers.

collocations.en: the initiation of an anti-dumping proceeding

formal.mt: Matul il-proċedura antidumping, l-awtorità qabblet il-prezzijiet tal-esportazzjoni mal-valur normali tal-prodotti u eżaminat l-effetti fuq il-produtturi lokali.
formal.en: During the anti-dumping proceeding, the authority compared export prices with the normal value of the products and examined the effects on local producers.
formal.zh: 在反倾销程序中，主管机关将出口价格与产品正常价值进行比较，并审查了对本地生产商的影响。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti importati? David: Għax hemm proċedura antidumping għaddejja. Qed jaraw jekk il-prezzijiet humiex taħt il-valur normali tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are they checking the prices of these imported products? David: Because an anti-dumping proceeding is under way. They are checking whether the prices are below their normal value.
colloquial.zh: Lara：他们为什么在核查这些进口产品的价格？David：因为反倾销程序正在进行。他们在核查价格是否低于产品的正常价值。

messages.speaker: Lara (进口公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti importati?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed jiċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet ta' dawn il-prodotti importati?
messages.zh: 他们为什么在核查这些进口产品的价格？
messages.en: Why are they checking the prices of these imported products?

messages.speaker: David (进口公司同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hemm proċedura antidumping għaddejja. Qed jaraw jekk il-prezzijiet humiex taħt il-valur normali tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hemm proċedura antidumping għaddejja. Qed jaraw jekk il-prezzijiet humiex taħt il-valur normali tagħhom.
messages.zh: 因为反倾销程序正在进行。他们在核查价格是否低于产品的正常价值。
messages.en: Because an anti-dumping proceeding is under way. They are checking whether the prices are below their normal value.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“进口价与正常价值作比较”的画面记忆反倾销；两个英语释义分别突出程序步骤和具体调查程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure in which a contract is awarded automatically according to criteria established in advance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照预先确定的标准自动作出合同授予决定的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha kuntratt jingħata awtomatikament skont kriterji stabbiliti minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 依照预设标准自动授予合同或确定中标者。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-għoti awtomatiku ta' kuntratt jew l-għażla awtomatika tal-offerent rebbieħ skont kriterji stabbiliti minn qabel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An automatic award occurs when a contract is assigned to the successful bidder automatically according to criteria established in advance.

collocations.mt: l-użu ta' proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni
collocations.en: the use of an automatic award procedure

collocations.mt: il-kriterji għal proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni
collocations.en: the criteria for an automatic award procedure

formal.mt: Id-dokument tas-sejħa għall-offerti jiddeskrivi l-proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni u l-kriterji li jiddeterminaw liema offerent jirbaħ il-kuntratt.
formal.en: The tender document describes the automatic award procedure and the criteria that determine which bidder wins the contract.
formal.zh: 招标文件说明了自动授标程序，以及决定哪位投标人获得合同的标准。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif se jintgħażel min jirbaħ il-kuntratt? Ġorġ: Se tintuża proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni. Ir-rebbieħ jintgħażel awtomatikament skont il-kriterji mħabbra.
colloquial.en: Nina: How will the winner of the contract be chosen? Ġorġ: An automatic award procedure will be used. The winner will be selected automatically according to the published criteria.
colloquial.zh: Nina：会怎样选出获得合同的投标人？Ġorġ：会采用自动授标程序，按照已公布的标准自动选出中标者。

messages.speaker: Nina (投标公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se jintgħażel min jirbaħ il-kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se jintgħażel min jirbaħ il-kuntratt?
messages.zh: 会怎样选出获得合同的投标人？
messages.en: How will the winner of the contract be chosen?

messages.speaker: Ġorġ (投标公司同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tintuża proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni. Ir-rebbieħ jintgħażel awtomatikament skont il-kriterji mħabbra.
messages.mt_standard: Se tintuża proċedura awtomatika ta' aġġudikazzjoni. Ir-rebbieħ jintgħażel awtomatikament skont il-kriterji mħabbra.
messages.zh: 会采用自动授标程序，按照已公布的标准自动选出中标者。
messages.en: An automatic award procedure will be used. The winner will be selected automatically according to the published criteria.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序—自动—授标”三块记忆，想象系统依据预设标准确定中标者；这里的 award 对应授标。

gloss_zh: 加速程序；快速办理程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure designed to reach a decision or complete a process more quickly than the usual procedure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为比通常程序更快作出决定或完成办理而设置的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura mfassla biex twassal għal deċiżjoni jew biex jitlesta proċess aktar malajr milli bil-proċedura tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过缩短办理时间等安排，加快审理、审批或其他处理过程的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li tippermetti li każ, applikazzjoni jew proċess ieħor jiġi ttrattat fi żmien iqsar minn dak tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An accelerated procedure is a way of handling a case or application that allows it to be completed more quickly than usual.

collocations.en: a request for an accelerated procedure
the application of an accelerated procedure

formal.mt: Minħabba l-urġenza tal-każ, il-kumitat approva t-talba biex l-applikazzjoni tiġi eżaminata permezz ta' proċedura aċċellerata.
formal.en: Because of the urgency of the case, the committee approved the request for the application to be examined under an accelerated procedure.
formal.zh: 鉴于案件的紧迫性，委员会批准了采用加速程序审查该申请的请求。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi mod kif l-applikazzjoni tiegħi tiġi eżaminata aktar malajr? Pawlu: Tista' titlob proċedura aċċellerata, imma trid tispjega għaliex il-każ huwa urġenti.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any way my application can be examined more quickly? Pawlu: You can request an accelerated procedure, but you need to explain why the case is urgent.
colloquial.zh: Sara：有什么办法能让我的申请更快得到审查吗？Pawlu：你可以申请采用加速程序，但需要说明事情为什么紧急。

messages.speaker: Sara (申请人)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm xi mod kif l-applikazzjoni tiegħi tiġi eżaminata aktar malajr?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm xi mod kif l-applikazzjoni tiegħi tiġi eżaminata aktar malajr?
messages.zh: 有什么办法能让我的申请更快得到审查吗？
messages.en: Is there any way my application can be examined more quickly?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (办事员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' titlob proċedura aċċellerata, imma trid tispjega għaliex il-każ huwa urġenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' titlob proċedura aċċellerata, imma trid tispjega għaliex il-każ huwa urġenti.
messages.zh: 你可以申请采用加速程序，但需要说明事情为什么紧急。
messages.en: You can request an accelerated procedure, but you need to explain why the case is urgent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象申请文件进入“加速办理通道”：短语整体表示办理更快，不表示申请必定获批。

gloss_zh: 事先发布竞争公告的采购程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure in which a call for competition is issued before the subsequent selection steps.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在后续遴选步骤开始之前，先发布公告邀请经营者参与竞争的采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha ssir sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni qabel ma jitwettqu l-passi sussegwenti tal-għażla.

sense_translations.en_definition: procedure with a prior call for competition
sense_translations.zh_definition: 事先发布竞争公告，邀请经营者参与竞争的采购程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li tinkludi sejħa minn qabel biex l-operaturi interessati jkunu jistgħu jipparteċipaw fil-kompetizzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procedure with a prior call for competition is a procurement process that announces an opportunity to compete before proceeding with selection.

collocations.mt: tapplika proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni
collocations.en: apply a procedure with a prior call for competition
collocations.zh: 采用事先发布竞争公告的采购程序

collocations.mt: tiddeskrivi proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni
collocations.en: describe a procedure with a prior call for competition
collocations.zh: 说明事先发布竞争公告的采购程序

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni u jispjega kif l-operaturi interessati jistgħu jipparteċipaw.
formal.en: The report describes a procedure with a prior call for competition and explains how interested operators can participate.
formal.zh: 报告说明了一种事先发布竞争公告的采购程序，并解释了有意参与的经营者如何参加。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni? Pawlu: Jiġifieri l-ewwel issir sejħa biex min ikun interessat ikun jista' jipparteċipa fil-kompetizzjoni.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does a procedure with a prior call for competition mean? Pawlu: It means a call is issued first so that anyone interested can take part in the competition.
colloquial.zh: Lara：事先发布竞争公告的采购程序是什么意思？Pawlu：就是说，先发布公告，让有意参加的人能够参与竞争。

messages.speaker: Lara (新入职采购助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser proċedura b'sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni?
messages.zh: 事先发布竞争公告的采购程序是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a procedure with a prior call for competition mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jiġifieri l-ewwel issir sejħa biex min ikun interessat ikun jista' jipparteċipa fil-kompetizzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Jiġifieri l-ewwel issir sejħa biex min ikun interessat ikun jista' jipparteċipa fil-kompetizzjoni.
messages.zh: 就是说，先发布公告，让有意参加的人能够参与竞争。
messages.en: It means a call is issued first so that anyone interested can take part in the competition.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组按意义分块：proċedura 是“程序”，b'sejħa 是“带有公告或征集”，minn qabel 是“事先”，għall-kompetizzjoni 是“为竞争”。记住“先公告，再竞争”的顺序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An administrative process or set of arrangements for dealing with goods under customs control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为处理受海关监管的货物而设置的行政程序或相关手续安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess amministrattiv jew sett ta' arranġamenti għat-trattament ta' merkanzija taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为办理货物海关事务而作出的手续安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġamenti amministrattivi li jsiru biex jiġu ttrattati l-affarijiet tad-dwana relatati mal-merkanzija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs arrangements are the administrative provisions made for handling goods in relation to customs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处理受海关监管货物时所采用的规定程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess stabbilit li jiġi segwit meta tiġi ttrattata merkanzija taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs procedure is an established process followed when goods are dealt with by customs.

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega l-proċedura doganali għall-importazzjoni tal-merkanzija u telenka d-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: The guide explains the customs procedure for importing goods and lists the required documents.
formal.zh: 该指南解释了货物进口的海关程序，并列出了所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-pakkett tiegħi għadu għand id-dwana. X'għandi nagħmel? Ġużeppi: Staqsi lid-dwana liema proċedura doganali trid issegwi u liema dokumenti għandek tibgħat.
colloquial.en: Marija: My parcel is still at customs. What should I do? Ġużeppi: Ask customs which customs procedure you need to follow and which documents you should send.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我的包裹还在海关。我该怎么办？Ġużeppi：问问海关，你需要办理哪种海关手续，以及应当提交哪些文件。

messages.speaker: Marija (包裹收件人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pakkett tiegħi għadu għand id-dwana. X'għandi nagħmel?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pakkett tiegħi għadu għand id-dwana. X'għandi nagħmel?
messages.zh: 我的包裹还在海关。我该怎么办？
messages.en: My parcel is still at customs. What should I do?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lid-dwana liema proċedura doganali trid issegwi u liema dokumenti għandek tibgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lid-dwana liema proċedura doganali trid issegwi u liema dokumenti għandek tibgħat.
messages.zh: 问问海关，你需要办理哪种海关手续，以及应当提交哪些文件。
messages.en: Ask customs which customs procedure you need to follow and which documents you should send.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proċedura doganali 联想成“货物到海关，手续按步办”：proċedura 表示程序，doganali 限定为海关相关。阅读时可依语境理解为整套手续安排或具体海关程序。

gloss_zh: 合同授予程序；采购招标程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structured process used to assess offers, select a supplier or contractor, and award a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于评估报价或投标、选择供应商或承包商并授予合同的一套规定步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi stabbiliti biex jiġu evalwati l-offerti, jintgħażel fornitur jew kuntrattur, u jingħata kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予程序，即评估候选方的报价或投标并决定将合同授予谁的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li permezz tiegħu jiġu evalwati l-offerti u jiġi deċiż lil min għandu jingħata kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract award procedure is the process used to evaluate offers and decide which supplier or contractor receives a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购程序，即为取得货物、服务或工程而组织采购、评估报价并选择供应方的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess organizzat għax-xiri ta' oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet, li jinkludi l-evalwazzjoni tal-offerti u l-għażla ta' fornitur jew kuntrattur.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurement procedure is an organized process through which an organization obtains goods, services, or works from a supplier or contractor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购程序，即公共机构为采购货物、服务或工程而采用的规定程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li juża korp pubbliku biex jixtri oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet skont passi u regoli stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public procurement procedure is a process that a public body follows when purchasing goods, services, or works.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标程序，即征集正式投标、评估投标并选择合同承接方的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih jintalbu offerti formali, jiġu evalwati dawk li jitressqu, u jintgħażel min se jingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender procedure is a process in which formal offers are invited and assessed before a contract is awarded.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招投标程序，侧重征集、提交和评估正式投标直至确定合同承接方的各项步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi għat-talba, is-sottomissjoni u l-evalwazzjoni ta' offerti formali sabiex jintgħażel min se jingħata kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tendering procedure consists of the steps used to invite, receive, and evaluate formal offers for a contract.

collocations.mt: tipparteċipa fi proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt
collocations.en: participate in a contract award procedure
the rules of the contract award procedure

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għandu jiddokumenta kull stadju tal-proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt u jispjega r-raġunijiet għall-għażla finali.
formal.en: The committee should document every stage of the contract award procedure and explain the reasons for the final selection.
formal.zh: 委员会应记录合同授予程序的每个阶段，并说明最终选择的理由。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kumpanija tagħna tista' tipparteċipa f'din il-proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt? Mark: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet l-ewwel u naraw x'dokumenti rridu nibagħtu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can our company take part in this contract award procedure? Mark: Let's read the conditions first and see which documents we need to send.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们公司可以参加这次合同授予程序吗？Mark：我们先读一下条件，看看需要提交哪些文件。

messages.speaker: Maja (公司职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kumpanija tagħna tista' tipparteċipa f'din il-proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kumpanija tagħna tista' tipparteċipa f'din il-proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt?
messages.zh: 我们公司可以参加这次合同授予程序吗？
messages.en: Can our company take part in this contract award procedure?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet l-ewwel u naraw x'dokumenti rridu nibagħtu.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja naqraw il-kundizzjonijiet l-ewwel u naraw x'dokumenti rridu nibagħtu.
messages.zh: 我们先读一下条件，看看需要提交哪些文件。
messages.en: Let's read the conditions first and see which documents we need to send.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按短语分块记：proċedura 是“程序”，għall-għoti 是“用于授予”，ta' kuntratt 是“合同的”。联想“收投标、做评估、定承接方”这条流程，就能记住整个短语。

gloss_zh: 竞争性谈判程序；通过谈判进行的竞争性采购程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure that combines competition between suppliers or contractors with negotiation over their offers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将供应商或承包商之间的竞争与针对其报价或投标内容的谈判相结合的采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li tgħaqqad il-kompetizzjoni bejn fornituri jew kuntratturi ma' negozjar dwar l-offerti tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 竞争性谈判程序，即在供应商或承包商相互竞争的框架内，通过谈判讨论其报价或投标内容的采购程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha fornituri jew kuntratturi jikkompetu ma' xulxin u jsir negozjar dwar l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A competitive negotiated procedure is a procurement process in which suppliers or contractors compete and their offers are discussed through negotiation.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包含谈判环节的竞争性采购程序，即在竞争性选择过程中就报价或投标内容与参与方进行谈判的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura kompetittiva ta' akkwist li tinkludi negozjar mal-parteċipanti dwar l-offerti tagħhom bħala parti mill-proċess tal-għażla.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A competitive procedure with negotiation is a procurement process that includes negotiations with participants about their offers as part of a competitive selection.

collocations.en: launch a competitive procedure with negotiation

collocations.mt: tipparteċipa fi proċedura kompetittiva permezz tan-negozjar
collocations.en: participate in a competitive procedure with negotiation
the stages of the competitive procedure with negotiation
collocations.zh: 竞争性谈判程序的各个阶段

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-istadji tal-proċedura kompetittiva permezz tan-negozjar u jispjega kif se jsir in-negozjar dwar l-offerti.
formal.en: The document describes the stages of the competitive procedure with negotiation and explains how negotiations concerning the offers will be conducted.
formal.zh: 该文件描述了竞争性谈判程序的各个阶段，并说明将如何就各项报价进行谈判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi proċedura kompetittiva permezz tan-negozjar? Mark: Il-fornituri jikkompetu, u jsir ukoll negozjar dwar l-offerti tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is a competitive procedure with negotiation? Mark: Suppliers compete, and negotiations also take place over their offers.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是竞争性谈判程序？Mark：供应商相互竞争，同时还会就他们的报价进行谈判。

messages.speaker: Maja (新入职采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi proċedura kompetittiva permezz tan-negozjar?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi proċedura kompetittiva permezz tan-negozjar?
messages.zh: 什么是竞争性谈判程序？
messages.en: What is a competitive procedure with negotiation?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-fornituri jikkompetu, u jsir ukoll negozjar dwar l-offerti tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Il-fornituri jikkompetu, u jsir ukoll negozjar dwar l-offerti tagħhom.
messages.zh: 供应商相互竞争，同时还会就他们的报价进行谈判。
messages.en: Suppliers compete, and negotiations also take place over their offers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 分三块记忆：proċedura 是“程序”，kompetittiva 是“竞争性的”，permezz tan-negozjar 是“通过谈判”。想象几家供应商参加竞争，再围桌商谈报价，把“竞争”和“谈判”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shared customs procedure for moving goods in transit between participating territories.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与地区之间依据共同安排办理货物过境的海关程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali komuni li tintuża għat-trasport ta' merkanzija fi tranżitu bejn territorji parteċipanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同过境；依据参与地区共同采用的海关安排进行的货物过境。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tranżitu ta' merkanzija li jsir skont arranġamenti doganali komuni bejn territorji parteċipanti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Common transit is the movement of goods under customs arrangements shared by participating territories.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同过境程序；办理共同过境货物所采用的一套海关手续。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' formalitajiet doganali li jintużaw biex merkanzija titmexxa taħt arranġamenti komuni ta' tranżitu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A common transit procedure is the set of customs formalities used to move goods under shared transit arrangements.

collocations.en: documents for the common transit procedure
collocations.zh: 共同过境程序所需的文件

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura komuni ta' tranżitu u d-dokumenti meħtieġa għall-ġarr tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The report describes the common transit procedure and the documents required for transporting the goods.
formal.zh: 报告说明了共同过境程序以及运输该批货物所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Din il-merkanzija se tgħaddi bil-proċedura komuni ta' tranżitu? Pawlu: Iva, u diġà ħejjejt id-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Marija: Will these goods move under the common transit procedure? Pawlu: Yes, and I've already prepared the documents.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这批货物要按共同过境程序办理吗？Pawlu：对，我已经准备好文件了。

messages.speaker: Marija (物流同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Din il-merkanzija se tgħaddi bil-proċedura komuni ta' tranżitu?
messages.mt_standard: Din il-merkanzija se tgħaddi bil-proċedura komuni ta' tranżitu?
messages.zh: 这批货物要按共同过境程序办理吗？
messages.en: Will these goods move under the common transit procedure?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (物流专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u diġà ħejjejt id-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u diġà ħejjejt id-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 对，我已经准备好文件了。
messages.en: Yes, and I've already prepared the documents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词联想成“程序＋共同的＋过境”：想象货车经过参与地区，沿途使用共同安排办理过境手续。

exact_key: proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract tendering procedure in which participation is limited to selected or invited suppliers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 提交合同投标的参与范围限于经选定或受邀请供应商的招标程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt li fiha l-parteċipazzjoni fl-offerti tkun limitata għal fornituri magħżula jew mistiedna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有限招标程序；将投标参与范围限定于经选定或受邀请供应商的采购程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha fornituri magħżula jew mistiedna biss jipparteċipaw billi jressqu offerti għal kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A limited tendering procedure is a procurement process in which only selected or invited suppliers submit bids for a contract.

collocations.mt: tagħżel proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt
collocations.en: choose a limited tendering procedure for a contract
collocations.zh: 为合同选择有限招标程序

collocations.mt: stedina għall-parteċipazzjoni fi proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt
collocations.en: an invitation to participate in a limited tendering procedure for a contract
collocations.zh: 参与合同有限招标程序的邀请

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega kif intgħażlu l-fornituri mistiedna jipparteċipaw fil-proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt.
formal.en: The document explains how the suppliers invited to participate in the limited tendering procedure for a contract were selected.
formal.zh: 文件说明了受邀参与合同有限招标程序的供应商是如何选定的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kulħadd jista' jibgħat offerta għal dan il-kuntratt? Mark: Le, din hi proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt; se jieħdu sehem il-fornituri mistiedna biss.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can anyone submit a bid for this contract? Mark: No, this is a limited tendering procedure for a contract; only the invited suppliers will take part.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谁都可以为这份合同投标吗？Mark：不可以，这是合同有限招标程序，只有受邀供应商会参加。

messages.mt_standard: Le, din hi proċedura limitata ta' offerti ta' kuntratt; se jieħdu sehem il-fornituri mistiedna biss.
messages.zh: 不可以，这是合同有限招标程序，只有受邀供应商会参加。
messages.en: No, this is a limited tendering procedure for a contract; only the invited suppliers will take part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“程序、有限、投标、合同”四块，想象采购员按受邀名单收取合同投标，记住限制的是参与范围。

gloss_zh: 公开程序；公开招标程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure in which any interested supplier may submit a tender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 允许任何有意参与的供应商提交投标的公开采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha kull fornitur interessat jista' jressaq offerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开招标；面向所有有意参与的供应商征集投标。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sejħa pubblika li tistieden lil kull fornitur interessat iressaq offerta għal kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An open call for tenders is a public invitation for any interested supplier to submit a bid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开程序；在采购语境中，指任何有意参与的供应商均可提交投标的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li, fil-kuntest tal-akkwist, tippermetti lil kull fornitur interessat iressaq offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An open procedure is a procurement process that allows any interested supplier to submit a tender.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公开招标程序；公开征集供应商投标的采购流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li biha jintalbu offerti pubblikament u kull fornitur interessat jista' jipparteċipa billi jressaq offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An open tendering procedure is a purchasing process that publicly invites bids from interested suppliers.

collocations.mt: tagħti kuntratt permezz ta' proċedura miftuħa
collocations.en: award a contract through an open procedure
collocations.zh: 通过公开程序授予合同

collocations.en: participate in an open tendering procedure

formal.en: The notice states that the contract will be awarded through an open procedure and specifies the deadline for tenders.
formal.zh: 公告说明合同将通过公开程序授予，并列明投标截止日期。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu nibagħtu offerta aħna wkoll? David: Iva, din hi proċedura miftuħa. Ejja naqraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel nibdew.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we submit a bid too? David: Yes, this is an open procedure. Let's read the requirements before we start.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我们也可以投标吗？David：可以，这是公开程序。我们开始前先看看要求吧。

messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nibagħtu offerta aħna wkoll?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, din hi proċedura miftuħa. Ejja naqraw ir-rekwiżiti qabel nibdew.
messages.zh: 可以，这是公开程序。我们开始前先看看要求吧。
messages.en: Yes, this is an open procedure. Let's read the requirements before we start.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 miftuħa 联系到“开放的”，想象招标窗口向有意参与的供应商敞开；整组词就记成“开放的程序”。

exact_key: proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni
gloss_zh: 不事先发布竞争性征集公告的程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure conducted without a prior public invitation to compete for the contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在开展采购前，不先公开邀请供应商参与合同竞争的采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li ssir mingħajr ma tkun ġiet ippubblikata minn qabel sejħa li tistieden lill-fornituri jikkompetu għall-kuntratt.

sense_translations.en_definition: procedure without prior call for competition
sense_translations.zh_definition: 无事先竞争性征集公告的程序；在采购前未先发布邀请供应商参与竞争的公告所采用的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha l-akkwist isir mingħajr sejħa pubblika minn qabel li tistieden lill-fornituri jipparteċipaw fil-kompetizzjoni għall-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procedure without prior call for competition is a procurement process conducted without first publishing an invitation for suppliers to compete.

collocations.mt: tuża proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni
collocations.en: use a procedure without prior call for competition
collocations.zh: 采用不事先发布竞争性征集公告的程序

collocations.mt: ir-raġunijiet għall-użu ta' proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni
collocations.en: the reasons for using a procedure without prior call for competition
collocations.zh: 采用不事先发布竞争性征集公告程序的理由

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega r-raġunijiet għall-użu ta' proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni f'dan l-akkwist.
formal.en: The report explains the reasons for using a procedure without prior call for competition in this procurement.
formal.zh: 报告说明了此次采购采用不事先发布竞争性征集公告程序的理由。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex ma rajtx sejħa pubblika għal dan il-kuntratt? Ġorġ: Hawnhekk intużat proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni. Ir-raġuni hi spjegata fir-rapport.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why didn't I see a public call for this contract? Ġorġ: A procedure without prior call for competition was used here. The reason is explained in the report.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我怎么没看到这份合同的公开征集公告？Ġorġ：这里采用了不事先发布竞争性征集公告的程序。报告里解释了原因。

messages.mt_standard: Hawnhekk intużat proċedura mingħajr sejħa minn qabel għall-kompetizzjoni. Ir-raġuni hi spjegata fir-rapport.

messages.en: A procedure without prior call for competition was used here. The reason is explained in the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序／没有／征集公告／事先／供竞争”分块理解；把“事先发布竞争邀请”这一步画上叉，帮助记住整组词的限定关系。

exact_key: proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt
gloss_zh: 事先发布合同公告的谈判程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A contract procurement procedure in which a contract notice is published before negotiations take place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在开展谈判之前先发布合同公告的合同采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-akkwist ta' kuntratt li fiha jiġi ppubblikat avviż dwar il-kuntratt qabel ma jsiru n-negozjati.

sense_translations.en_definition: negotiated procedure after prior publication of a contract notice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在事先发布合同公告后进行的谈判程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha jsiru negozjati wara li jkun ġie ppubblikat avviż dwar il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is a procurement procedure in which negotiations follow the prior publication of a contract notice.

sense_translations.en_definition: negotiated procedure with prior call for competition
sense_translations.zh_definition: 事先发出竞争邀请的谈判程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha ssir sejħa għall-kompetizzjoni qabel ma jsiru n-negozjati dwar il-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This procedure involves negotiations preceded by a call inviting competition for the contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 包含事先公告环节的谈判程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li tinkludi l-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż qabel ma jibdew in-negozjati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is a negotiated procurement procedure that includes publication before negotiations begin.

sense_translations.en_definition: negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 事先发布合同公告的谈判程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li fiha avviż dwar il-kuntratt jiġi ppubblikat qabel l-istadju tan-negozjati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This procedure combines prior publication of a contract notice with a subsequent negotiation stage.

collocations.mt: tniedi proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt
collocations.en: launch a negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice
collocations.zh: 启动事先发布合同公告的谈判程序

collocations.mt: tagħżel proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt
collocations.en: choose a negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice
collocations.zh: 选择事先发布合同公告的谈判程序

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipproponi proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt u jispjega li l-avviż jiġi ppubblikat qabel in-negozjati.
formal.en: The report proposes a negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice and explains that the notice is published before negotiations.
formal.zh: 报告建议采用事先发布合同公告的谈判程序，并说明公告会在谈判之前发布。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'tfisser proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt? Mark: Ifisser li l-ewwel jiġi ppubblikat l-avviż dwar il-kuntratt, u mbagħad isiru n-negozjati.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does a negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice mean? Mark: It means the contract notice is published first, and negotiations take place afterwards.
colloquial.zh: Maja：事先发布合同公告的谈判程序是什么意思？Mark：意思是先发布合同公告，然后再进行谈判。

messages.speaker: Maja (新入职采购员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'tfisser proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt?
messages.mt_standard: X'tfisser proċedura negozjata bil-pubblikazzjoni ta' avviż dwar kuntratt?
messages.zh: 事先发布合同公告的谈判程序是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a negotiated procedure with prior publication of a contract notice mean?

messages.speaker: Mark (采购同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-ewwel jiġi ppubblikat l-avviż dwar il-kuntratt, u mbagħad isiru n-negozjati.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-ewwel jiġi ppubblikat l-avviż dwar il-kuntratt, u mbagħad isiru n-negozjati.
messages.zh: 意思是先发布合同公告，然后再进行谈判。
messages.en: It means the contract notice is published first, and negotiations take place afterwards.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把长词组分成“谈判程序＋发布＋合同公告”三块，脑中排出“先公告、后谈判”的顺序来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure in which the terms of a contract are discussed through negotiations.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过谈判商讨合同条件的采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha l-kundizzjonijiet ta' kuntratt jiġu diskussi permezz ta' negozjati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过与参与方谈判来商讨合同条件的采购程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-akkwist ta' kuntratt li fiha jsiru negozjati mal-parteċipanti dwar il-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A negotiated procedure is a procurement process involving discussions with participants about the terms of a contract.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi proċedura nnegozjata li fiha jiġu diskussi l-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt.
formal.en: The document describes a negotiated procedure in which the price and the terms of the contract are discussed.
formal.zh: 文件描述了一项谈判程序，其中会商讨价格和合同条件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi proċedura nnegozjata? Pawlu: Hija proċedura li fiha jiġu diskussi l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt permezz ta' negozjati.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is a negotiated procedure? Pawlu: It is a procedure in which the terms of the contract are discussed through negotiations.
colloquial.zh: Lara：什么是谈判程序？Pawlu：就是通过谈判来商讨合同条件的程序。

messages.speaker: Lara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi proċedura nnegozjata?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi proċedura nnegozjata?
messages.zh: 什么是谈判程序？
messages.en: What is a negotiated procedure?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (采购主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċedura li fiha jiġu diskussi l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt permezz ta' negozjati.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċedura li fiha jiġu diskussi l-kundizzjonijiet tal-kuntratt permezz ta' negozjati.
messages.zh: 就是通过谈判来商讨合同条件的程序。
messages.en: It is a procedure in which the terms of the contract are discussed through negotiations.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proċedura 联想到“办事程序”，再用双方坐下来商谈合同的画面记住整个词组的“谈判程序”含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procurement procedure in which only selected candidates are invited to submit tenders.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仅邀请经过筛选的候选人提交投标书的采购程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' akkwist li fiha kandidati magħżula biss jiġu mistiedna jissottomettu offerti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 限制投标邀请范围、仅邀请经过筛选的候选人提交投标书的采购程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-akkwist ta' kuntratt li fiha l-istedina biex jiġu sottomessi offerti tkun limitata għal kandidati magħżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A restricted procedure is a procurement process in which only selected candidates are invited to submit tenders.

formal.mt: Fil-proċedura ristretta deskritta fil-gwida, il-kandidati magħżula biss jirċievu stedina biex jissottomettu offerta.
formal.en: In the restricted procedure described in the guide, only selected candidates receive an invitation to submit a tender.
formal.zh: 在指南所描述的限制性程序中，只有经过筛选的候选人才会收到提交投标书的邀请。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex din tissejjaħ proċedura ristretta? David: Għax il-kandidati magħżula biss jiġu mistiedna jissottomettu offerta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is this called a restricted procedure? David: Because only selected candidates are invited to submit a tender.
colloquial.zh: Sara：为什么这叫限制性程序？David：因为只有经过筛选的候选人才会被邀请提交投标书。

messages.speaker: Sara (采购学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex din tissejjaħ proċedura ristretta?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex din tissejjaħ proċedura ristretta?
messages.zh: 为什么这叫限制性程序？
messages.en: Why is this called a restricted procedure?

messages.speaker: David (培训讲师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-kandidati magħżula biss jiġu mistiedna jissottomettu offerta.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-kandidati magħżula biss jiġu mistiedna jissottomettu offerta.
messages.zh: 因为只有经过筛选的候选人才会被邀请提交投标书。
messages.en: Because only selected candidates are invited to submit a tender.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象投标邀请名单旁画着一个圈：圈内是经过筛选的人，用“邀请范围有限”记住限制性程序。

exact_key: proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tendering procedure in which selected suppliers or contractors are invited to submit offers for a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 选择供应商或承包商并邀请其就某项合同提交投标书的招标程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' sejħa għall-offerti li fiha fornituri jew kuntratturi magħżula jiġu mistiedna jissottomettu offerti għal kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邀请选定的供应商或承包商参与合同投标的选择性招标程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-għoti ta' kuntratt li fiha tintgħażel grupp ta' fornituri jew kuntratturi u dawn jiġu mistiedna jippreżentaw l-offerti tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A selective tendering procedure invites a chosen group of suppliers or contractors to submit offers for a contract.

collocations.mt: torganizza proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt
collocations.zh: 组织合同选择性招标程序

collocations.mt: tieħu sehem fi proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt
collocations.en: take part in a selective tendering procedure
collocations.zh: 参与合同选择性招标程序

formal.mt: Il-pjan jiddeskrivi proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt li fiha grupp magħżul ta' fornituri jiġi mistieden jippreżenta offerti.
formal.en: The plan describes a selective tendering procedure in which a chosen group of suppliers is invited to submit offers.
formal.zh: 计划描述了一项合同选择性招标程序，其中会邀请一组选定的供应商提交投标书。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt? Ġanni: Ifisser li jintgħażel grupp ta' fornituri u dawn jiġu mistiedna jagħmlu offerta għall-kuntratt.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does a selective tendering procedure mean? Ġanni: It means a group of suppliers is selected and invited to make an offer for the contract.
colloquial.zh: Nina：合同选择性招标程序是什么意思？Ġanni：意思是选出一组供应商，再邀请他们就这项合同投标。

messages.speaker: Nina (供应商代表)

messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser proċedura selettiva ta' offerti ta' kuntratt?
messages.zh: 合同选择性招标程序是什么意思？
messages.en: What does a selective tendering procedure mean?

messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li jintgħażel grupp ta' fornituri u dawn jiġu mistiedna jagħmlu offerta għall-kuntratt.
messages.zh: 意思是选出一组供应商，再邀请他们就这项合同投标。
messages.en: It means a group of suppliers is selected and invited to make an offer for the contract.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序＋选择性＋投标＋合同”拆分理解，想象先圈出供应商名单，再向名单上的人发出投标邀请。

gloss_zh: 特别程序；特殊办理流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure designed for a particular situation that requires different steps from the usual process.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对某种特定情况而设立、办理步骤不同于通常流程的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura maħsuba għal sitwazzjoni partikolari li teħtieġ passi differenti minn dawk tas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为处理特定情况而设置的特别程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi stabbiliti biex tiġi ttrattata sitwazzjoni partikolari b'mod differenti mill-proċess tas-soltu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A special procedure is a set of steps used to deal with a particular situation differently from the usual process.

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi proċedura speċjali għall-ipproċessar ta' talbiet urġenti.
formal.en: The guide describes a special procedure for processing urgent requests.
formal.zh: 该指南说明了处理紧急申请的特别程序。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' nibgħat din it-talba bħas-soltu? Mark: Le, għal din trid issegwi proċedura speċjali. Lara: Tista' turini l-passi?
colloquial.en: Lara: Can I send this request as usual? Mark: No, for this one you need to follow a special procedure. Lara: Can you show me the steps?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这份申请可以照常提交吗？马克：不行，这份申请要走特别程序。拉拉：你能给我看看具体步骤吗？

messages.zh: 不行，这份申请要走特别程序。
messages.en: No, for this one you need to follow a special procedure.

messages.zh: 你能给我看看具体步骤吗？
messages.en: Can you show me the steps?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它记成办事窗口上的“特别流程”：proċedura 表示程序，speċjali 提醒你这次要按特殊步骤办理。

gloss_zh: 采购程序；合同授予程序；招标程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized process for obtaining goods, services, or works, which may include inviting bids and awarding a contract.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为取得货物、服务或工程而安排的采购流程，可包括邀请投标、评选供应商及授予合同。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess organizzat biex jinkisbu oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet, li jista' jinkludi sejħa għall-offerti, l-għażla ta' fornitur u l-għoti ta' kuntratt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予程序，即评选承包方并决定将合同授予谁的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li bih jiġu evalwati l-offerti u jintgħażel il-fornitur jew il-kuntrattur li jingħata l-kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract award procedure is the process used to evaluate offers and select the supplier or contractor who receives a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购程序，即机构为取得所需货物、服务或工程而采用的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi li organizzazzjoni ssegwi biex tikseb l-oġġetti, is-servizzi jew ix-xogħlijiet li teħtieġ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurement procedure is the process an organization follows to obtain the goods, services, or works it needs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购程序，即公共机构采购货物、服务或工程所采用的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li awtorità jew entità pubblika ssegwi biex tikseb oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public procurement procedure is the process a public authority or body follows when obtaining goods, services, or works.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标程序，即邀请供应商提交正式报价或方案，并对其进行评选的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li fih il-fornituri jiġu mistiedna jippreżentaw offerti formali li mbagħad jiġu evalwati biex tintgħażel offerta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender procedure is a process in which suppliers submit formal offers that are evaluated before an offer is selected.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招投标程序，即组织招标、接收投标文件并开展评审的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi għall-organizzazzjoni ta' sejħa għall-offerti, għar-riċeviment tal-offerti u għall-evalwazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tendering procedure is the series of steps used to invite, receive, and assess formal bids for a contract.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni se tniedi proċedura ta' akkwist biex tagħżel fornitur għat-tagħmir il-ġdid.
formal.en: The organization will launch a procurement procedure to select a supplier for the new equipment.
formal.zh: 该机构将启动采购程序，为新设备选定供应商。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu nordnaw il-kompjuters illum? Pawlu: L-ewwel irridu nibdew il-proċedura ta' akkwist. Nina: Sewwa, mela nipprepara l-lista ta' dak li għandna bżonn.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we order the computers today? Pawlu: First we need to start the procurement procedure. Nina: Okay, then I'll prepare the list of what we need.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们今天能订购电脑吗？保罗：我们得先启动采购程序。妮娜：好，那我来准备需求清单。

gloss_zh: 出口程序；出口办理流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: The organized steps followed when sending goods out of a country for sale or delivery abroad.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将货物运往国外销售或交付时所遵循的一系列办理步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi li jiġu segwiti meta oġġetti jintbagħtu barra mill-pajjiż biex jinbiegħu jew jitwasslu lil min jirċevihom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出口程序，即将货物运出本国时涉及的文件准备、申报及相关办理流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess għat-tħejjija tad-dokumenti, id-dikjarazzjoni tal-oġġetti u l-passi l-oħra marbuta mal-ħruġ tagħhom mill-pajjiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An export procedure is the set of steps involved in preparing and arranging for goods to leave a country.

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega l-proċedura ta' esportazzjoni u jelenka d-dokumenti meħtieġa għal din il-kunsinna.
formal.en: The manual explains the export procedure and lists the documents required for this shipment.
formal.zh: 该手册说明了出口程序，并列出这批货物所需的文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-kaxxi lesti biex jintbagħtu barra? David: Iva, imma għad irridu nlestu l-proċedura ta' esportazzjoni. Sara: Tajjeb, niċċekkja d-dokumenti issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are the boxes ready to be sent abroad? David: Yes, but we still need to complete the export procedure. Sara: All right, I'll check the documents now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些箱子准备好运到国外了吗？戴维：准备好了，不过我们还得完成出口手续。萨拉：好，我现在就检查文件。

messages.zh: 好，我现在就检查文件。
messages.en: All right, I'll check the documents now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句配成“货物出国前先办手续”的画面：proċedura 是程序，esportazzjoni 是出口，两部分合起来记成出口办理流程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure for completing customs clearance at an approved local location.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在获准的当地地点办理货物清关手续的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura biex jitlestew il-formalitajiet doganali għall-merkanzija f'post lokali approvat għal dan il-għan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 当地清关程序；在获准的当地地点完成货物清关手续的办理程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura li tippermetti li l-formalitajiet tal-ikklerjar tal-merkanzija mid-dwana jitlestew f'post lokali approvat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A local clearance procedure is a process that allows customs clearance formalities for goods to be completed at an approved local location.

collocations.en: the requirements of the local clearance procedure

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' kklerjar lokali u jispeċifika d-dokumenti li għandhom jiġu ppreżentati.
formal.en: The manual describes the local clearance procedure and specifies the documents to be submitted.
formal.zh: 手册说明了当地清关程序，并列明应提交的文件。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għal din il-kunsinna se nużaw il-proċedura ta' kklerjar lokali? David: Iva, u d-dokumenti diġà huma lesti. Sara: Tajjeb, niċċekkja l-indirizz tal-post approvat.
colloquial.en: Sara: Will we use the local clearance procedure for this consignment? David: Yes, and the documents are already ready. Sara: All right, I'll check the address of the approved location.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这批货我们会使用当地清关程序吗？David：会，而且文件已经准备好了。Sara：好，我来核对获准地点的地址。

messages.mt_standard: Għal din il-kunsinna se nużaw il-proċedura ta' kklerjar lokali?
messages.zh: 这批货我们会使用当地清关程序吗？
messages.en: Will we use the local clearance procedure for this consignment?

messages.speaker: David (清关经办员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u d-dokumenti diġà huma lesti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u d-dokumenti diġà huma lesti.
messages.zh: 会，而且文件已经准备好了。
messages.en: Yes, and the documents are already ready.
