messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, niċċekkja l-indirizz tal-post approvat.
messages.zh: 好，我来核对获准地点的地址。
messages.en: All right, I'll check the address of the approved location.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 kklerjar 记作这里的「清关」，把 lokali 记作「当地的」，联想在获准的当地地点办理手续；连起来就是「当地清关程序」。

gloss_zh: 进境加工退税程序；进境加工退税制度

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure in which import duties paid on goods brought in for processing can be refunded when the resulting products are re-exported.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种进境加工海关程序：加工用货物进口时先缴纳进口关税，在加工产品复出口时可按相应条件申请退还。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li biha d-dazji mħallsa fuq merkanzija importata għall-ipproċessar jistgħu jitħallsu lura meta l-prodotti li jirriżultaw jiġu esportati mill-ġdid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进境加工退税程序，指加工用货物进口时先缴纳进口关税，并在加工产品复出口时按条件退还相关关税的办理程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali għall-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija importata, li tippermetti r-rifużjoni tad-dazji mħallsa meta l-prodotti li jirriżultaw jiġu esportati mill-ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inward processing drawback procedure allows import duties paid on goods for processing to be refunded when the resulting products are re-exported.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进境加工退税制度，指加工用货物进口时先征收进口关税，再依据加工产品复出口情况按条件退还相关关税的制度安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema doganali li taħtha jitħallsu d-dazji fuq merkanzija importata għall-ipproċessar u dawn jistgħu jiġu rifużi meta l-prodotti li jirriżultaw jiġu esportati mill-ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The inward processing drawback system provides for the repayment of import duties after imported goods have been processed and the resulting products re-exported.

sense_translations.en_definition: inward processing procedure in the form of the drawback system
sense_translations.zh_definition: 采用退税制度形式的进境加工程序，即通过先缴纳进口关税、再按加工产品复出口情况申请退还的方式实施的进境加工程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv imwettqa permezz ta' sistema li tipprevedi l-ħlas tad-dazji mal-importazzjoni u r-rifużjoni tagħhom meta l-prodotti li jirriżultaw jiġu esportati mill-ġdid.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This is an inward processing procedure operated through a drawback system, with import duties paid initially and refunded upon qualifying re-export.

collocations.mt: tapplika l-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni
collocations.en: apply the inward processing drawback procedure
collocations.zh: 适用进境加工退税程序

collocations.mt: id-dokumenti għall-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni
collocations.en: the documents for the inward processing drawback procedure
collocations.zh: 进境加工退税程序所需的文件

formal.mt: L-eżempju fit-taħriġ juri kif il-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni tista' tippermetti r-rifużjoni tad-dazji wara li l-prodotti miksuba mill-ipproċessar jiġu esportati mill-ġdid.
formal.en: The training example shows how the inward processing drawback procedure can allow duties to be refunded after the products obtained from processing are re-exported.
formal.zh: 培训示例说明，进境加工退税程序如何允许在加工所得产品复出口后退还关税。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Bil-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni, inħallsu d-dazji l-ewwel? David: Iva, u mbagħad nistgħu nitolbu r-rifużjoni meta l-prodotti jiġu esportati mill-ġdid, jekk jintlaħqu l-kundizzjonijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Under the inward processing drawback procedure, do we pay the duties first? David: Yes, and then we can request a refund when the products are re-exported, if the conditions are met.
colloquial.zh: Lara：采用进境加工退税程序时，我们要先缴纳关税吗？David：是的，之后产品复出口时，如果符合条件，我们就可以申请退还。

messages.speaker: Lara (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni, inħallsu d-dazji l-ewwel?
messages.mt_standard: Bil-proċedura ta' pproċessar attiv bir-rifużjoni, inħallsu d-dazji l-ewwel?
messages.zh: 采用进境加工退税程序时，我们要先缴纳关税吗？
messages.en: Under the inward processing drawback procedure, do we pay the duties first?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u mbagħad nistgħu nitolbu r-rifużjoni meta l-prodotti jiġu esportati mill-ġdid, jekk jintlaħqu l-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u mbagħad nistgħu nitolbu r-rifużjoni meta l-prodotti jiġu esportati mill-ġdid, jekk jintlaħqu l-kundizzjonijiet.
messages.zh: 是的，之后产品复出口时，如果符合条件，我们就可以申请退还。
messages.en: Yes, and then we can request a refund when the products are re-exported, if the conditions are met.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用流程图来记：进口先缴税→境内加工→产品复出口→符合条件后退税。把 bir-rifużjoni 与最后的“退还”环节联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An established sequence of steps for handling or transforming materials, information, or other inputs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为处理信息、加工材料或处理其他输入对象而规定的一套操作步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela stabbilita ta' passi biex jiġu ttrattati jew trasformati materjali, informazzjoni jew elementi oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 处理程序或加工程序，指对材料、信息等对象进行处理或加工时遵循的一套步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' passi li jiġu segwiti biex jiġu pproċessati materjali, informazzjoni jew elementi oħra b'mod organizzat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A processing procedure is an established series of steps used to handle or transform materials, information, or other inputs.

formal.mt: Il-manwal jiddeskrivi proċedura ta' proċessar għall-materja prima, mill-wasla tagħha sal-kontroll tal-kwalità tal-prodott.
formal.en: The manual describes a processing procedure for raw materials, from their arrival to the quality inspection of the product.
formal.zh: 手册介绍了原材料从到货到产品质量检验的加工程序。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm proċedura ta' proċessar għal din l-informazzjoni? Toni: Iva, l-ewwel niċċekkjawha u mbagħad indaħħluha fis-sistema.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a processing procedure for this information? Toni: Yes, first we check it and then we enter it into the system.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这些信息有相应的处理程序吗？Toni：有，我们先核查，然后把它们录入系统。

messages.speaker: Nina (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm proċedura ta' proċessar għal din l-informazzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm proċedura ta' proċessar għal din l-informazzjoni?
messages.zh: 这些信息有相应的处理程序吗？
messages.en: Is there a processing procedure for this information?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, l-ewwel niċċekkjawha u mbagħad indaħħluha fis-sistema.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, l-ewwel niċċekkjawha u mbagħad indaħħluha fis-sistema.
messages.zh: 有，我们先核查，然后把它们录入系统。
messages.en: Yes, first we check it and then we enter it into the system.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proċedura 想成有顺序的操作清单，把 proċessar 联系到“处理或加工”；合起来就是处理某个对象时要走的步骤。

exact_key: proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv
gloss_zh: 内向加工暂缓征税程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure under which imported goods are processed while the relevant import duties are suspended.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种海关程序，允许进口货物在相关进口税暂缓征收的安排下进行加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tippermetti l-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija importata filwaqt li l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti fuq l-importazzjoni jkun sospiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内向加工暂缓征税程序，即进口货物进行加工时暂缓征收相关进口税的海关程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali għall-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija importata li matulha l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti fuq l-importazzjoni jkun sospiż.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inward processing suspension procedure allows imported goods to be processed while the relevant import duties remain suspended.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内向加工暂缓征税制度，即对用于加工的进口货物暂缓征收相关进口税的制度安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sistema doganali li taħtha merkanzija importata tista' tiġi pproċessata bis-sospensjoni tal-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti fuq l-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inward processing suspension system provides an arrangement for processing imported goods with the relevant import duties suspended.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内向加工程序（暂缓征税安排），指在相关进口税暂缓征收的条件下加工进口货物的海关程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija importata taħt arranġament li jissospendi l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti fuq l-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This inward-processing procedure operates through an arrangement that suspends the relevant import duties while imported goods are processed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加工暂缓征税程序；在本词条中，指进口货物加工期间暂缓征收相关进口税的海关程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-kuntest, proċedura doganali għall-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija importata bis-sospensjoni tal-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti fuq l-importazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this context, a processing suspension procedure permits imported goods to undergo processing with the relevant import duties suspended.

collocations.mt: tapplika l-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv
collocations.en: apply the inward processing suspension procedure
collocations.zh: 适用内向加工暂缓征税程序

collocations.mt: merkanzija taħt il-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv
collocations.en: goods under the inward processing suspension procedure
collocations.zh: 处于内向加工暂缓征税程序下的货物

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv u jispjega s-sospensjoni tal-ħlas tad-dazji fuq il-merkanzija importata għall-ipproċessar.
formal.en: The report describes the inward processing suspension procedure and explains the suspension of duty payments on goods imported for processing.
formal.zh: 报告介绍了内向加工暂缓征税程序，并说明了对进口加工货物暂缓征收税款的安排。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Xi tfisser il-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv? Pawlu: Tfisser li l-merkanzija importata tiġi pproċessata waqt li l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti jkun sospiż.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does the inward processing suspension procedure mean? Pawlu: It means that imported goods are processed while payment of the relevant duties is suspended.
colloquial.zh: Marta：内向加工暂缓征税程序是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是进口货物进行加工时，相关税款暂缓缴纳。

messages.speaker: Marta (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser il-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser il-proċedura ta' sospensjoni ta' proċessar attiv?
messages.zh: 内向加工暂缓征税程序是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the inward processing suspension procedure mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (报关员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li l-merkanzija importata tiġi pproċessata waqt li l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti jkun sospiż.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li l-merkanzija importata tiġi pproċessata waqt li l-ħlas tad-dazji rilevanti jkun sospiż.
messages.zh: 意思是进口货物进行加工时，相关税款暂缓缴纳。
messages.en: It means that imported goods are processed while payment of the relevant duties is suspended.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条术语配成“进口货物进厂加工，税款先按暂停键”的画面；这里暂停的是征税安排，不是加工活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure governing the movement of goods under customs control between designated points.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 管理货物在海关监管下于指定地点之间运输的海关程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tirregola l-moviment tal-merkanzija taħt kontroll doganali bejn punti magħżula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过境；本词条中特指货物在海关监管下于指定地点之间运输的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: F'dan il-kuntest, l-arranġament doganali għall-moviment tal-merkanzija taħt kontroll doganali bejn punti magħżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: In this context, transit refers to an arrangement for moving goods between designated points under customs control.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过境程序，即管理货物在海关监管下于指定地点之间运输的手续与安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura li tistabbilixxi l-formalitajiet u l-arranġamenti għall-moviment tal-merkanzija taħt kontroll doganali bejn punti magħżula.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A transit procedure sets out how goods move between designated points while remaining under customs control.

formal.mt: Id-dokument jispjega l-proċedura ta' tranżitu għall-ġarr tal-merkanzija mill-uffiċċju doganali tat-tluq sal-uffiċċju doganali tad-destinazzjoni.
formal.en: The document explains the transit procedure for transporting goods from the customs office of departure to the customs office of destination.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了货物从启运海关运至目的地海关的过境程序。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn nibda bil-proċedura ta' tranżitu? Mark: L-ewwel iċċekkja d-dokumenti tal-merkanzija mal-aġent doganali.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where do I start with the transit procedure? Mark: First, check the goods documents with the customs agent.
colloquial.zh: Lara：过境程序该从哪里开始办？Mark：先跟报关代理核对货物单证。

messages.speaker: Lara (运输协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Minn fejn nibda bil-proċedura ta' tranżitu?
messages.mt_standard: Minn fejn nibda bil-proċedura ta' tranżitu?
messages.zh: 过境程序该从哪里开始办？
messages.en: Where do I start with the transit procedure?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel iċċekkja d-dokumenti tal-merkanzija mal-aġent doganali.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel iċċekkja d-dokumenti tal-merkanzija mal-aġent doganali.
messages.zh: 先跟报关代理核对货物单证。
messages.en: First, check the goods documents with the customs agent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象货物沿着一条受海关监管的运输路线前进：tranżitu 提醒你记“过境”，proċedura 提醒你记“办理程序”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs transit procedure generally used to move goods without the customs status of the territory through which they are transported.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常用于运输不具有所经关境内部海关地位货物的一类海关过境程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' tranżitu doganali li ġeneralment tintuża għat-trasport ta' merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali intern tat-territorju li tgħaddi minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外部过境，通常指不具有所经关境内部海关地位的货物在海关监管下运输的安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' tranżitu li ġeneralment jippermetti t-trasport taħt kontroll doganali ta' merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali intern tat-territorju kkonċernat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: External transit generally allows goods without the territory's internal customs status to move under customs control.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外部过境程序，即管理通常不具有所经关境内部海关地位的货物在海关监管下运输的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tirregola t-trasport taħt kontroll doganali ta' merkanzija li ġeneralment ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali intern tat-territorju kkonċernat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An external transit procedure governs the controlled movement of goods generally lacking the territory's internal customs status.

collocations.mt: merkanzija taħt il-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern
collocations.en: goods under the external transit procedure
collocations.zh: 处于外部过境程序下的货物

formal.mt: Il-manwal jispjega meta tintuża l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern u liema dokumenti jakkumpanjaw il-merkanzija.
formal.en: The manual explains when the external transit procedure is used and which documents accompany the goods.
formal.zh: 手册说明了何时使用外部过境程序，以及货物随附哪些单证。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għal din il-merkanzija nużaw il-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern? David: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatus doganali tagħha mal-aġent l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we use the external transit procedure for these goods? David: Let's check their customs status with the agent first.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这批货用外部过境程序吗？David：我们先跟代理核实一下它们的海关地位。

messages.speaker: Nina (物流助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal din il-merkanzija nużaw il-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern?
messages.mt_standard: Għal din il-merkanzija nużaw il-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern?
messages.zh: 这批货用外部过境程序吗？
messages.en: Do we use the external transit procedure for these goods?

messages.speaker: David (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatus doganali tagħha mal-aġent l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw l-istatus doganali tagħha mal-aġent l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 我们先跟代理核实一下它们的海关地位。
messages.en: Let's check their customs status with the agent first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 estern 想成货物档案上的“外部”标签，再接上“过境程序”；记忆重点放在海关地位，不能只凭运输地点判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An external customs transit procedure within the Union framework, generally used for goods without Union customs status.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 联盟海关框架下的一种外部过境程序，通常用于运输不具有联盟海关地位的货物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' tranżitu doganali estern fil-qafas tal-Unjoni, li ġeneralment tintuża għal merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同体外部过境程序，指共同体海关框架下通常适用于非共同体货物的外部过境程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura ta' tranżitu doganali estern fil-qafas tal-Komunità, li ġeneralment tintuża għal merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Komunità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An external Community transit procedure governs customs transit generally involving goods without Community customs status.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联盟外部过境，指联盟海关框架下通常针对非联盟货物的海关监管运输安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' tranżitu doganali estern tal-Unjoni li ġeneralment jintuża għat-trasport taħt kontroll doganali ta' merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: External Union transit generally enables goods without Union customs status to move under customs control.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联盟外部过境程序，即联盟海关框架下管理通常不具有联盟海关地位的货物过境运输的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura fil-qafas doganali tal-Unjoni li tirregola t-tranżitu estern ta' merkanzija li ġeneralment ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An external Union transit procedure regulates customs transit generally involving goods that lack Union customs status.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 共同体外部过境，指共同体海关框架下通常针对非共同体货物的海关监管运输安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Arranġament ta' tranżitu doganali estern fil-qafas tal-Komunità għat-trasport taħt kontroll doganali ta' merkanzija li ġeneralment ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Komunità.
sense_translations.en_explanation: External community transit generally concerns the movement of goods without Community customs status under customs control.

collocations.mt: tapplika l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni
collocations.en: apply the external Union transit procedure
collocations.zh: 适用联盟外部过境程序

collocations.mt: merkanzija taħt il-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni
collocations.en: goods under the external Union transit procedure
collocations.zh: 处于联盟外部过境程序下的货物

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni u tispjega r-rwol tal-istatus doganali tal-merkanzija fl-għażla tal-proċedura.
formal.en: The guide describes the external Union transit procedure and explains the role of the goods' customs status in selecting the procedure.
formal.zh: 指南介绍了联盟外部过境程序，并说明货物的海关地位如何影响程序的选择。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni? Joseph: Hija proċedura doganali li ġeneralment tintuża għal merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the external Union transit procedure? Joseph: It is a customs procedure generally used for goods that do not have Union customs status.
colloquial.zh: Sara：什么是联盟外部过境程序？Joseph：这是一种通常用于不具有联盟海关地位货物的海关程序。

messages.speaker: Sara (新入职职员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-proċedura ta' tranżitu estern tal-Unjoni?
messages.zh: 什么是联盟外部过境程序？
messages.en: What is the external Union transit procedure?

messages.speaker: Joseph (报关培训员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċedura doganali li ġeneralment tintuża għal merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċedura doganali li ġeneralment tintuża għal merkanzija li ma jkollhiex l-istatus doganali ta' merkanzija tal-Unjoni.
messages.zh: 这是一种通常用于不具有联盟海关地位货物的海关程序。
messages.en: It is a customs procedure generally used for goods that do not have Union customs status.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序—过境—外部—联盟的”四块顺序记忆，再整理成中文“联盟外部过境程序”；tal-Unjoni 帮你锁定所属框架。

gloss_zh: 内部转运程序；内部过境手续

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure governing the movement of goods under internal transit arrangements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规范货物按内部转运安排运输时应遵守的海关程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tirregola l-moviment tal-merkanzija taħt arranġamenti ta' tranżitu intern.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部转运，指货物在内部转运安排下接受海关监管的运输。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-moviment tal-merkanzija taħt sorveljanza doganali skont arranġamenti ta' tranżitu intern.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Internal transit is the movement of goods under customs supervision according to internal transit arrangements.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内部转运程序，指货物进行内部转运时须遵循的海关手续与步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sett ta' passi u formalitajiet doganali li għandhom jiġu segwiti meta l-merkanzija tiċċaqlaq taħt arranġamenti ta' tranżitu intern.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An internal transit procedure is the set of customs steps and formalities followed when goods move under internal transit arrangements.

collocations.en: the requirements of the internal transit procedure
documents for the internal transit procedure
collocations.zh: 办理内部转运程序所需的文件

formal.mt: Qabel ma tibda t-trasport, il-kumpanija għandha tivverifika li d-dokumenti meħtieġa għall-proċedura ta' tranżitu intern huma kompluti.
formal.en: Before beginning transport, the company should verify that the documents required for the internal transit procedure are complete.
formal.zh: 开始运输前，公司应核实内部转运程序所需的文件是否齐全。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dawn huma d-dokumenti kollha għall-proċedura ta' tranżitu intern? Rita: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista flimkien qabel nibagħtu l-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are these all the documents for the internal transit procedure? Rita: Let's check the list together before we send the goods.
colloquial.zh: 马克：内部转运程序要用的文件都在这里了吗？丽塔：我们发货前一起核对一下清单吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (物流职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawn huma d-dokumenti kollha għall-proċedura ta' tranżitu intern?
messages.mt_standard: Dawn huma d-dokumenti kollha għall-proċedura ta' tranżitu intern?
messages.zh: 内部转运程序要用的文件都在这里了吗？
messages.en: Are these all the documents for the internal transit procedure?

messages.speaker: Rita (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista flimkien qabel nibagħtu l-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja niċċekkjaw il-lista flimkien qabel nibagħtu l-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 我们发货前一起核对一下清单吧。
messages.en: Let's check the list together before we send the goods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“货物内部转运，先核对手续”这个场景记忆：proċedura 对应程序，tranżitu intern 对应内部转运，把整个词组与发货前核对文件联系起来。

gloss_zh: 合格评定程序；符合性评估程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure used to determine whether specified requirements have been fulfilled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于确定产品、服务或其他评定对象是否满足规定要求的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura li tintuża biex jiġi ddeterminat jekk prodott, servizz jew oġġett ieħor ta' valutazzjoni jissodisfax rekwiżiti speċifikati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合格评定程序，即按照规定步骤确定评定对象是否符合指定要求的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sett ta' passi stabbiliti li jintużaw biex jiġi ddeterminat jekk dak li jkun qed jiġi vvalutat jissodisfax ir-rekwiżiti speċifikati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A conformity assessment procedure is a set of steps used to determine whether something meets specified requirements.

collocations.en: carry out a conformity assessment procedure

collocations.mt: tagħżel il-proċedura ta' valutazzjoni tal-konformità xierqa
collocations.en: choose the appropriate conformity assessment procedure
collocations.zh: 选择适当的合格评定程序

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' valutazzjoni tal-konformità u jippreżenta r-riżultati tal-verifiki mwettqa.
formal.en: The report describes the conformity assessment procedure and presents the results of the checks carried out.
formal.zh: 报告说明了合格评定程序，并列出了已完成核查的结果。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lestejna l-proċedura ta' valutazzjoni tal-konformità għal dan il-prodott? Pawlu: Għadna le. Irridu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultati tat-testijiet u nlestu r-rapport.
colloquial.en: Lara: Have we completed the conformity assessment procedure for this product? Pawlu: Not yet. We need to check the test results and finish the report.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个产品的合格评定程序完成了吗？保罗：还没有。我们得核查测试结果，再完成报告。

messages.speaker: Lara (产品经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Lestejna l-proċedura ta' valutazzjoni tal-konformità għal dan il-prodott?
messages.mt_standard: Lestejna l-proċedura ta' valutazzjoni tal-konformità għal dan il-prodott?
messages.zh: 这个产品的合格评定程序完成了吗？
messages.en: Have we completed the conformity assessment procedure for this product?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (质量专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna le. Irridu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultati tat-testijiet u nlestu r-rapport.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna le. Irridu niċċekkjaw ir-riżultati tat-testijiet u nlestu r-rapport.
messages.zh: 还没有。我们得核查测试结果，再完成报告。
messages.en: Not yet. We need to check the test results and finish the report.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序—评估—符合要求”三层意思记忆：proċedura 是程序，valutazzjoni 是评估，konformità 是符合性；联想拿着要求清单逐项核查产品。

gloss_zh: 储存程序；存放操作流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A set of steps for placing and keeping goods or materials in suitable storage conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为将货物或材料妥善存放，并使其保持在适当储存条件下而规定的操作步骤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi għat-tqegħid u ż-żamma ta' oġġetti jew materjali f'post u f'kundizzjonijiet adattati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 储存程序，即对物品的放置、保管及储存条件作出安排的操作流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li jistabbilixxi kif l-oġġetti għandhom jitqiegħdu u jinżammu, inklużi l-post u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħażna tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A storage procedure is a set of instructions explaining where and how items should be kept in suitable conditions.

formal.mt: Il-proċedura ta' ħażna tistipula li dawn il-materjali għandhom jinżammu f'post niexef u 'l bogħod mid-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: The storage procedure specifies that these materials should be kept in a dry place away from sunlight.
formal.zh: 该储存程序规定，这些材料应存放在干燥且避免日光照射的地方。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi? Ġanni: Skont il-proċedura ta' ħażna, fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq. Marta: Sewwa, inpoġġihom hemm u niċċekkja t-tikketti.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where should I put these boxes? Ġanni: According to the storage procedure, on the top shelf. Marta: Okay, I'll put them there and check the labels.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：这些箱子放在哪里？詹尼：按照储存流程，放在最上层架子上。玛尔塔：好，我把它们放到那里，再检查一下标签。

messages.speaker: Marta (新入职仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inpoġġi dawn il-kaxxi?
messages.zh: 这些箱子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these boxes?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (仓库主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Skont il-proċedura ta' ħażna, fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq.
messages.mt_standard: Skont il-proċedura ta' ħażna, fuq l-ixkaffa ta' fuq.
messages.zh: 按照储存流程，放在最上层架子上。
messages.en: According to the storage procedure, on the top shelf.

messages.speaker: Marta (新入职仓库员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, inpoġġihom hemm u niċċekkja t-tikketti.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, inpoġġihom hemm u niċċekkja t-tikketti.
messages.zh: 好，我把它们放到那里，再检查一下标签。
messages.en: Okay, I'll put them there and check the labels.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“放哪里、怎么放、怎样保管”三个问题记住 ħażna 的储存含义；整句 proċedura ta' ħażna 就是回答这些问题的操作流程。

gloss_zh: 海关仓储程序；保税仓储安排

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure governing the storage of goods under customs supervision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 规定货物如何在海关监管下存放的仓储程序，也可指相关的保税仓储安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura li tirregola kif tinħażen il-merkanzija taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关监管仓储；将货物存放于海关监管之下的仓储方式。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażna ta' merkanzija taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana skont il-proċedura applikabbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs warehousing is the storage of goods under customs supervision according to an applicable customs procedure.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关仓储安排；为海关监管下的货物存放所作的程序性安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-arranġamenti li jistabbilixxu kif il-merkanzija għandha tinħażen taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Customs warehousing arrangements are the provisions that organize how goods are stored under customs supervision.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关仓储程序；办理货物在海关监管下存放所遵循的正式程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura formali li tiġi segwita biex merkanzija titqiegħed u tinżamm f'ħażna taħt is-superviżjoni tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A customs warehousing procedure is the formal process followed when placing and keeping goods in storage under customs supervision.

collocations.mt: merkanzija taħt il-proċedura ta' ħażna doganali
collocations.en: goods under the customs warehousing procedure
collocations.zh: 处于海关仓储程序下的货物

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċedura ta' ħażna doganali u l-mod kif għandha tiġi rreġistrata l-merkanzija maħżuna.
formal.en: The report describes the customs warehousing procedure and how the stored goods should be recorded.
formal.zh: 报告说明了海关仓储程序，以及应如何登记所存放的货物。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-kaxxi se jibqgħu fil-maħżen għalissa? Lara: Iva, se nużaw il-proċedura ta' ħażna doganali. Mark: Tajjeb, mela nħejji l-lista tal-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are the boxes staying in the warehouse for now? Lara: Yes, we'll use the customs warehousing procedure. Mark: All right, then I'll prepare the goods list.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这些箱子暂时会留在仓库里吗？Lara：会，我们会采用海关仓储程序。Mark：好，那我来准备货物清单。

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kaxxi se jibqgħu fil-maħżen għalissa?
messages.mt_standard: Il-kaxxi se jibqgħu fil-maħżen għalissa?
messages.zh: 这些箱子暂时会留在仓库里吗？
messages.en: Are the boxes staying in the warehouse for now?

messages.speaker: Lara (物流主管)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nużaw il-proċedura ta' ħażna doganali.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nużaw il-proċedura ta' ħażna doganali.
messages.zh: 会，我们会采用海关仓储程序。
messages.en: Yes, we'll use the customs warehousing procedure.

messages.speaker: Mark (仓库职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, mela nħejji l-lista tal-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, mela nħejji l-lista tal-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 好，那我来准备货物清单。
messages.en: All right, then I'll prepare the goods list.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语分成 proċedura「程序」、ħażna「仓储」、doganali「海关的」三块记忆，联想货物入库后仍处于海关监管中的场景。

gloss_zh: 临时存储程序；暂存程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure for keeping goods in temporary storage while awaiting the next customs step.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物等待下一步海关处理期间，办理临时存放所遵循的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura għall-ħażna temporanja tal-merkanzija waqt li tkun qed tistenna l-pass li jmiss fil-proċess doganali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临时存储；在等待后续处理期间对货物进行的暂时存放。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħażna tal-merkanzija għal żmien limitat waqt li tkun qed tistenna aktar ipproċessar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Temporary storage is the keeping of goods for a limited period while they await further processing.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 临时存储程序；安排和办理货物暂时存放的正式程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura formali li tirregola kif il-merkanzija titqiegħed u tinżamm f'ħażna temporanja.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A temporary storage procedure is the formal process governing how goods are placed and kept in temporary storage.

collocations.en: the documents for the temporary storage procedure
collocations.zh: 办理临时存储程序所需的文件

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet jispjegaw il-proċedura ta' ħażna temporanja għall-merkanzija li tkun qed tistenna aktar ipproċessar mid-dwana.
formal.en: The instructions explain the temporary storage procedure for goods awaiting further customs processing.
formal.zh: 该说明解释了等待海关进一步处理的货物所适用的临时存储程序。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se nżommu l-merkanzija sakemm ikunu lesti d-dokumenti? Pawlu: Se nsegwu l-proċedura ta' ħażna temporanja. Nina: Sewwa, allura niċċekkja d-dokumenti li għandna.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where will we keep the goods until the documents are ready? Pawlu: We'll follow the temporary storage procedure. Nina: Right, then I'll check the documents we have.
colloquial.zh: Nina：文件准备好之前，我们把货物存放在哪里？Pawlu：我们会按临时存储程序办理。Nina：好，那我检查一下现有的文件。

messages.mt_standard: Fejn se nżommu l-merkanzija sakemm ikunu lesti d-dokumenti?
messages.zh: 文件准备好之前，我们把货物存放在哪里？

messages.mt_standard: Se nsegwu l-proċedura ta' ħażna temporanja.

messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, allura niċċekkja d-dokumenti li għandna.
messages.zh: 好，那我检查一下现有的文件。
messages.en: Right, then I'll check the documents we have.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 temporanja「临时的」，想象货物贴着「等待下一步处理」的便签；整组短语表示办理暂存的程序，记忆重点是临时等待。

gloss_zh: 自由区程序；自由区海关手续

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure governing goods placed in a free zone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 适用于置于自由区内的货物、规范其海关管理方式的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tirregola t-trattament tal-merkanzija mqiegħda f'żona libera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自由区程序，即规范货物在自由区内接受海关管理时所适用的手续与安排。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sett ta' formalitajiet u arranġamenti doganali li japplikaw għall-merkanzija mqiegħda f'żona libera.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A free zone procedure is a customs arrangement that governs how goods placed in a free zone are handled.

collocations.en: the conditions of the free zone procedure
collocations.zh: 自由区程序的适用条件

collocations.en: the formalities of the free zone procedure
collocations.zh: 自由区程序的相关手续

formal.mt: Il-gwida tispjega l-kundizzjonijiet tal-proċedura ta' żona libera u l-formalitajiet relatati mal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The guide explains the conditions of the free zone procedure and the formalities relating to the goods.
formal.zh: 指南解释了自由区程序的适用条件，以及与货物有关的手续。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għandna niċċekkjaw qabel napplikaw il-proċedura ta' żona libera? David: L-ewwel naraw il-kundizzjonijiet, imbagħad niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti tal-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Nina: What should we check before applying the free zone procedure? David: First we'll look at the conditions, then check the documents for the goods.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：适用自由区程序前，我们该核查什么？戴维：先看适用条件，再核查货物的文件。

messages.speaker: Nina (仓储职员)
messages.mt_spoken: X'għandna niċċekkjaw qabel napplikaw il-proċedura ta' żona libera?
messages.mt_standard: X'għandna niċċekkjaw qabel napplikaw il-proċedura ta' żona libera?
messages.zh: 适用自由区程序前，我们该核查什么？
messages.en: What should we check before applying the free zone procedure?

messages.speaker: David (报关专员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel naraw il-kundizzjonijiet, imbagħad niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti tal-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel naraw il-kundizzjonijiet, imbagħad niċċekkjaw id-dokumenti tal-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 先看适用条件，再核查货物的文件。
messages.en: First we'll look at the conditions, then check the documents for the goods.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把词组想成“货物进入自由区时对应的一套手续”：żona libera 帮你锁定自由区场景，proċedura 提醒你关注程序和文件。

gloss_zh: 招投标程序；采购及合同授予程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A formal process for inviting and assessing bids and selecting a supplier or contractor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 征集和评审投标，并选择供应商或承包商的正式程序；在不同语境下也指采购或合同授予程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess formali biex jintalbu u jiġu evalwati offerti u jintgħażel fornitur jew kuntrattur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 合同授予程序；评估相关投标并决定将合同授予哪一方的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura għall-evalwazzjoni tal-offerti rilevanti u għad-deċiżjoni dwar lil min għandu jingħata kuntratt.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A contract award procedure is the process used to assess relevant bids and decide which bidder will receive a contract.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 采购程序；为取得货物、服务或工程而组织采购并选择供应方的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura li tintuża biex jinkisbu oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet u jintgħażel min jipprovdihom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procurement procedure is the process an organization follows to obtain goods, services, or works and select a provider.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 公共采购程序；公共机构采购货物、服务或工程所遵循的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura li ssegwi awtorità pubblika biex takkwista oġġetti, servizzi jew xogħlijiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A public procurement procedure is the process a public authority follows when purchasing goods, services, or works.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招标程序；征集、接收和评审正式投标所遵循的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-proċedura li tistabbilixxi kif jintalbu, jintlaqgħu u jiġu evalwati offerti formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tender procedure is the organized process through which formal bids are invited, received, and assessed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招投标程序；组织招标、提交投标及开展评审所遵循的一整套步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Is-sensiela ta' passi li tirregola s-sejħa għall-offerti, is-sottomissjoni tagħhom u l-evalwazzjoni tagħhom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A tendering procedure is the sequence of steps governing the invitation, submission, and evaluation of competitive bids.

formal.mt: L-awtorità pubblika ppubblikat dokument li jispjega l-proċedura tal-offerti u l-kriterji għall-evalwazzjoni tal-proposti.
formal.en: The public authority published a document explaining the tendering procedure and the criteria for evaluating proposals.
formal.zh: 该公共机构公布了一份文件，说明招投标程序及评审提案的标准。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-proċedura tal-offerti diġà bdiet? Toni: Iva, u rridu nibagħtu l-proposta sal-Ġimgħa. Maja: Mela llum niċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has the tendering procedure started yet? Toni: Yes, and we need to send the proposal by Friday. Maja: Then let's check the prices and documents today.
colloquial.zh: Maja：招投标程序已经开始了吗？Toni：开始了，我们需要在周五之前提交提案。Maja：那我们今天核对一下价格和文件。

messages.speaker: Maja (投标专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċedura tal-offerti diġà bdiet?
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċedura tal-offerti diġà bdiet?
messages.zh: 招投标程序已经开始了吗？
messages.en: Has the tendering procedure started yet?

messages.speaker: Toni (项目经理)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u rridu nibagħtu l-proposta sal-Ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u rridu nibagħtu l-proposta sal-Ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 开始了，我们需要在周五之前提交提案。
messages.en: Yes, and we need to send the proposal by Friday.

messages.speaker: Maja (投标专员)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela llum niċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
messages.mt_standard: Mela llum niċċekkjaw il-prezzijiet u d-dokumenti.
messages.zh: 那我们今天核对一下价格和文件。
messages.en: Then let's check the prices and documents today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 offerti 在这里记成「投标、报价」，想象一排供应商递交报价后接受评审。整组短语可覆盖招投标、采购和合同授予，具体译法看上下文。

gloss_zh: 最终用途程序；特定用途海关程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure under which goods are handled according to their specified final use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按照货物指定的最终用途确定其海关处理方式的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li biha t-trattament tal-merkanzija jiddependi mill-użu aħħari speċifikat tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最终用途程序，指依据货物指定的最终用途对其进行海关处理的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tirregola t-trattament tal-merkanzija skont l-użu aħħari speċifikat tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An end-use procedure is a customs procedure in which the treatment of goods depends on their specified final use.

collocations.en: the conditions of the end-use procedure

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-proċedura tal-użu aħħari torbot it-trattament doganali mal-użu speċifikat tal-merkanzija.
formal.en: The report explains how the end-use procedure links customs treatment to the specified use of the goods.
formal.zh: 报告说明了最终用途程序如何将海关处理方式与货物的指定用途联系起来。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhi l-proċedura tal-użu aħħari? Pawlu: Hija proċedura doganali fejn jgħodd għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the end-use procedure? Pawlu: It is a customs procedure where what the goods will be used for matters.
colloquial.zh: Maja：什么是最终用途程序？Pawlu：这是一种海关程序，货物将用于什么用途是其中的重要依据。

messages.speaker: Maja (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-proċedura tal-użu aħħari?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-proċedura tal-użu aħħari?
messages.zh: 什么是最终用途程序？
messages.en: What is the end-use procedure?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija proċedura doganali fejn jgħodd għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija.
messages.mt_standard: Hija proċedura doganali fejn jgħodd għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija.
messages.zh: 这是一种海关程序，货物将用于什么用途是其中的重要依据。
messages.en: It is a customs procedure where what the goods will be used for matters.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语记成“程序＋最终用途”：看到 aħħari，就联想货物最后用来做什么，再理解相应的海关程序。

gloss_zh: 最终用途程序；特定用途海关程序

teaching_sense.en_definition: A customs procedure that makes the specified final use of goods relevant to their customs treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以货物指定的最终用途作为海关处理依据的程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li tqis l-użu finali speċifikat tal-merkanzija biex jiġi stabbilit it-trattament doganali tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 最终用途程序，指根据货物指定的最终用途确定其海关处理方式的程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċedura doganali li biha l-użu finali speċifikat tal-merkanzija jiddetermina t-trattament doganali tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An end-use procedure governs the customs treatment of goods by reference to the final use specified for them.

collocations.en: the requirements of the end-use procedure

formal.mt: Il-gwida tiddeskrivi l-proċedura tal-użu finali u tenfasizza l-ħtieġa li l-użu tal-merkanzija jkun speċifikat b'mod ċar.
formal.en: The guide describes the end-use procedure and stresses the need for the use of the goods to be clearly specified.
formal.zh: 指南介绍了最终用途程序，并强调需要明确说明货物的用途。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tistaqsini għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija? Mark: Għax qed inħejji d-dokumenti għall-proċedura tal-użu finali.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you asking me what the goods will be used for? Mark: Because I am preparing the documents for the end-use procedure.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么问我这些货物将用于什么用途？Mark：因为我正在准备最终用途程序的文件。

messages.speaker: Sara (客户)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tistaqsini għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tistaqsini għal xiex se tintuża l-merkanzija?
messages.zh: 你为什么问我这些货物将用于什么用途？
messages.en: Why are you asking me what the goods will be used for?

messages.speaker: Mark (货运代理)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed inħejji d-dokumenti għall-proċedura tal-użu finali.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed inħejji d-dokumenti għall-proċedura tal-użu finali.
messages.zh: 因为我正在准备最终用途程序的文件。
messages.en: Because I am preparing the documents for the end-use procedure.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按“程序—用途—最终”分块记忆：finali 提醒你关注货物最后的用途，整个短语对应最终用途海关程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A series of connected actions or changes through which something develops or a result is achieved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事发展或取得某种结果时，所经历的一系列相互关联的行动、阶段或变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' azzjonijiet, stadji jew bidliet marbuta ma' xulxin li permezz tagħhom xi ħaġa tiżviluppa jew jinkiseb riżultat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 过程或流程，指促成某种发展或结果的一系列相互关联的步骤或变化。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi jew bidliet relatati li jwasslu għall-iżvilupp ta' xi ħaġa jew għal riżultat partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A process is a series of connected actions or changes that leads to a particular development or result.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina kif il-proċess ta' tagħlim jinbidel meta l-istudenti jirċievu kummenti regolari dwar xogħolhom.
formal.en: The study examines how the learning process changes when students receive regular feedback on their work.
formal.zh: 该研究考察学生定期获得作业反馈时，学习过程会发生怎样的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm idum il-proċess biex nirreġistra għall-kors? Toni: Jekk għandek id-dokumenti lesti, tista' tlestih f'madwar għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How long does the process of registering for the course take? Toni: If you have the documents ready, you can finish it in about ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：报名这个课程的流程要花多久？托尼：如果文件准备好了，大约十分钟就能办完。

messages.speaker: Maja (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm idum il-proċess biex nirreġistra għall-kors?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm idum il-proċess biex nirreġistra għall-kors?
messages.zh: 报名这个课程的流程要花多久？
messages.en: How long does the process of registering for the course take?

messages.speaker: Toni (课程管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk għandek id-dokumenti lesti, tista' tlestih f'madwar għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk għandek id-dokumenti lesti, tista' tlestih f'madwar għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 如果文件准备好了，大约十分钟就能办完。
messages.en: If you have the documents ready, you can finish it in about ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proċess 和英语 process 配对记忆，再画“开始→几个步骤→结果”的箭头图；看到它就想到事情逐步展开的过程或流程。

gloss_zh: 专利工艺；获得专利的工艺流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A method or sequence of operations that is protected by a patent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到专利保护的操作方法或工艺流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metodu jew sekwenza ta' operazzjonijiet li jkunu protetti bi privattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已获得专利保护的方法或工艺流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li għalih tkun ingħatat privattiva li tipproteġi l-metodu jew is-sekwenza ta' operazzjonijiet tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A patented process is a method of doing or producing something that is protected by a patent.

collocations.zh: 开发出获得专利的工艺

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija tuża proċess bi privattiva biex tnaqqas il-konsum tal-enerġija waqt il-produzzjoni.
formal.en: The company uses a patented process to reduce energy consumption during production.
formal.zh: 该公司采用一项专利工艺，以降低生产过程中的能源消耗。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif jagħmlu dan il-prodott? Mark: Jużaw proċess bi privattiva; il-gwida spjegatilna l-istadji tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How do they make this product? Mark: They use a patented process; the guide explained its stages to us.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他们怎样制造这个产品？Mark：他们使用一项专利工艺；导览员向我们解释过它的各个阶段。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif jagħmlu dan il-prodott?
messages.mt_standard: Kif jagħmlu dan il-prodott?
messages.zh: 他们怎样制造这个产品？
messages.en: How do they make this product?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jużaw proċess bi privattiva; il-gwida spjegatilna l-istadji tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Jużaw proċess bi privattiva; il-gwida spjegatilna l-istadji tiegħu.
messages.zh: 他们使用一项专利工艺；导览员向我们解释过它的各个阶段。
messages.en: They use a patented process; the guide explained its stages to us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张工艺流程图旁边放着专利证书；把“流程”和“专利保护”连在一起记忆。

gloss_zh: 不平衡量净额抵销流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process that offsets opposing imbalances against one another to determine the remaining net imbalance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将方向相反的不平衡量相互抵销，以确定剩余净不平衡量的流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li fih żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti jitpaċew ma' xulxin sabiex jiġi stabbilit l-iżbilanċ nett li jibqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过相互抵销方向相反的不平衡量，计算净不平衡量的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li jiġbor flimkien żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti u jpaċihom ma' xulxin biex jiddetermina l-ammont nett li jibqa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An imbalance netting process offsets imbalances in opposite directions so that only the remaining net imbalance is left.

collocations.zh: 应用不平衡量净额抵销流程

collocations.en: the results of the imbalance netting process
collocations.zh: 不平衡量净额抵销流程的结果

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif il-proċess għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi jpaċi żbilanċi f'direzzjonijiet opposti u jidentifika l-iżbilanċ nett li jibqa'.
formal.en: The report explains how the imbalance netting process offsets imbalances in opposite directions and identifies the remaining net imbalance.
formal.zh: 报告解释了不平衡量净额抵销流程如何抵销方向相反的不平衡量，并确定剩余的净不平衡量。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'jagħmel il-proċess għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi? Leon: Jekk għandna żbilanċ ta' għaxar unitajiet u ieħor ta' sitt unitajiet fid-direzzjoni opposta, jifdal żbilanċ nett ta' erba' unitajiet.
colloquial.en: Sara: What does the imbalance netting process do? Leon: If we have an imbalance of ten units and another of six units in the opposite direction, a net imbalance of four units remains.
colloquial.zh: Sara：不平衡量净额抵销流程有什么作用？Leon：如果一个方向有十个单位的不平衡量，相反方向有六个单位，抵销后就剩下四个单位的净不平衡量。

messages.speaker: Sara (实习生)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jagħmel il-proċess għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi?
messages.mt_standard: X'jagħmel il-proċess għan-nettjar tal-iżbilanċi?
messages.zh: 不平衡量净额抵销流程有什么作用？
messages.en: What does the imbalance netting process do?

messages.speaker: Leon (分析员)
messages.mt_spoken: Jekk għandna żbilanċ ta' għaxar unitajiet u ieħor ta' sitt unitajiet fid-direzzjoni opposta, jifdal żbilanċ nett ta' erba' unitajiet.
messages.mt_standard: Jekk għandna żbilanċ ta' għaxar unitajiet u ieħor ta' sitt unitajiet fid-direzzjoni opposta, jifdal żbilanċ nett ta' erba' unitajiet.
messages.zh: 如果一个方向有十个单位的不平衡量，相反方向有六个单位，抵销后就剩下四个单位的净不平衡量。
messages.en: If we have an imbalance of ten units and another of six units in the opposite direction, a net imbalance of four units remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两支方向相反的箭头，一支标十、一支标六，抵销后剩四；用“相反量抵销，只看净剩余”记住整组词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coordinated process for scheduling related activities while considering their timing, resources, and dependencies together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将相关活动的时间、资源和相互依赖关系统一考虑并协调安排的排程流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li jikkoordina l-iskedar ta' attivitajiet relatati billi jqis flimkien il-ħinijiet, ir-riżorsi u d-dipendenzi bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将相关任务或活动纳入统一安排、综合协调其时间与资源的排程流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li jiġbor l-iskedar ta' kompiti jew attivitajiet relatati f'arranġament wieħed sabiex il-ħinijiet u r-riżorsi jiġu kkoordinati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An integrated scheduling process coordinates related activities within a shared plan, taking account of their timing and resource requirements.

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni adottat proċess integrat għall-iskedar sabiex tikkoordina l-attivitajiet tat-timijiet u tevita kunflitti bejn il-ħinijiet tagħhom.
formal.en: The organisation adopted an integrated scheduling process to coordinate team activities and avoid scheduling conflicts.
formal.zh: 该机构采用了一体化排程流程，以协调各团队的活动并避免时间冲突。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nippjanaw ix-xogħol kollu flimkien? Mark: Għax qed nużaw proċess integrat għall-iskedar, biex żewġ timijiet ma jibbukkjawx l-istess tagħmir fl-istess ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we planning all the work together? Mark: Because we're using an integrated scheduling process so that two teams don't book the same equipment at the same time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：为什么我们要把所有工作放在一起安排？马克：因为我们正在使用一体化排程流程，避免两个团队同时预订同一台设备。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed nippjanaw ix-xogħol kollu flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed nippjanaw ix-xogħol kollu flimkien?
messages.zh: 为什么我们要把所有工作放在一起安排？
messages.en: Why are we planning all the work together?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax qed nużaw proċess integrat għall-iskedar, biex żewġ timijiet ma jibbukkjawx l-istess tagħmir fl-istess ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għax qed nużaw proċess integrat għall-iskedar, biex żewġ timijiet ma jibbukkjawx l-istess tagħmir fl-istess ħin.
messages.zh: 因为我们正在使用一体化排程流程，避免两个团队同时预订同一台设备。
messages.en: Because we're using an integrated scheduling process so that two teams don't book the same equipment at the same time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把各团队的时间表拼成一张总表：用“统一协调、一起排程”的画面记住整个短语。

gloss_zh: 容量计算；容量计算流程

teaching_sense.en_definition: A calculation, or a sequence of calculations, used to determine how much a system, facility, or resource can accommodate or handle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过计算确定某个系统、设施或资源能够容纳或处理多少的运算，也指完成这一运算的流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kalkolu, jew sensiela ta' kalkoli, li jiddetermina kemm sistema, faċilità jew riżorsa tista' takkomoda jew timmaniġġja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过运算确定系统、设施或资源能够容纳或处理的数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kalkolu li jiddetermina l-kwantità li sistema, faċilità jew riżorsa tista' takkomoda jew timmaniġġja taħt kundizzjonijiet speċifiċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A capacity calculation establishes how much a system, facility, or resource can accommodate or handle under specified conditions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为确定容量而收集必要数据、开展计算并得出结果的一套步骤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sensiela ta' passi li tinkludi l-ġbir tad-data meħtieġa u t-twettiq tal-kalkoli sabiex tiġi ddeterminata l-kapaċità ta' sistema, faċilità jew riżorsa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A capacity calculation process is the sequence of steps used to gather relevant data and determine the capacity available.

collocations.mt: id-data meħtieġa għall-proċess ta' kalkolu tal-kapaċità
collocations.en: the data required for the capacity calculation process
collocations.zh: 容量计算流程所需的数据

formal.mt: Il-proċess ta' kalkolu tal-kapaċità jibda bil-ġbir tad-data dwar ir-riżorsi disponibbli u l-limitazzjonijiet operattivi.
formal.en: The capacity calculation process begins with collecting data on available resources and operational constraints.
formal.zh: 容量计算流程首先收集有关可用资源和运行限制的数据。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nistgħu naċċettaw aktar ordnijiet din il-ġimgħa? Toni: L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-proċess ta' kalkolu tal-kapaċità biex naraw kemm nistgħu nipproduċu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can we accept more orders this week? Toni: First we need to complete the capacity calculation process to see how much we can produce.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这周我们还能多接一些订单吗？托尼：我们得先完成容量计算流程，看看能生产多少。

messages.speaker: Nina (销售同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu naċċettaw aktar ordnijiet din il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu naċċettaw aktar ordnijiet din il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 这周我们还能多接一些订单吗？
messages.en: Can we accept more orders this week?

messages.speaker: Toni (生产主管)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-proċess ta' kalkolu tal-kapaċità biex naraw kemm nistgħu nipproduċu.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu nlestu l-proċess ta' kalkolu tal-kapaċità biex naraw kemm nistgħu nipproduċu.
messages.zh: 我们得先完成容量计算流程，看看能生产多少。
messages.en: First we need to complete the capacity calculation process to see how much we can produce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“到底能装多少、能处理多少”记住容量计算；再想象收数据、做计算、出结果，记住流程这一义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized procedure for coordinating periods when equipment, facilities, or services are unavailable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 协调设备、设施或服务停运时段的有组织流程，以便各相关方安排工作并减少相互影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura organizzata li biha l-partijiet involuti jikkoordinaw il-perjodi meta tagħmir, faċilitajiet jew servizzi ma jkunux disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协调设备、设施或服务停运安排的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa proċess li jikkoordina l-ħinijiet u l-arranġamenti tal-waqfien ta' tagħmir, faċilitajiet jew servizzi bejn il-partijiet involuti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An outage coordination process is a procedure through which the parties involved arrange and coordinate periods when equipment or services will be unavailable.

collocations.en: a review of the outage coordination process
collocations.zh: 对停运协调流程的审查

formal.mt: Il-proċess ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità għandu jiżgura li l-manutenzjoni ppjanata ma tikkoinċidix ma' waqfiet oħra li jistgħu jaffettwaw l-istess servizz.
formal.en: The outage coordination process should ensure that planned maintenance does not coincide with other outages that could affect the same service.
formal.zh: 停运协调流程应确保计划维护不与可能影响同一服务的其他停运安排重叠。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Nistgħu nwaqqfu l-magna għada għall-manutenzjoni? Pawlu: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-proċess ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità biex naraw jekk hemmx waqfiet oħra ppjanati.
colloquial.en: Marija: Can we shut down the machine tomorrow for maintenance? Pawlu: First we need to go through the outage coordination process to see whether any other shutdowns are planned.
colloquial.zh: Marija：我们明天可以停机维护吗？Pawlu：我们得先走停运协调流程，看看是否还有其他计划停机。

messages.speaker: Marija (维护技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nwaqqfu l-magna għada għall-manutenzjoni?
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nwaqqfu l-magna għada għall-manutenzjoni?
messages.zh: 我们明天可以停机维护吗？
messages.en: Can we shut down the machine tomorrow for maintenance?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (运行协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-proċess ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità biex naraw jekk hemmx waqfiet oħra ppjanati.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel irridu ngħaddu mill-proċess ta' koordinazzjoni tal-indisponibilità biex naraw jekk hemmx waqfiet oħra ppjanati.
messages.zh: 我们得先走停运协调流程，看看是否还有其他计划停机。
messages.en: First we need to go through the outage coordination process to see whether any other shutdowns are planned.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把短语联想成一张停机时间表：proċess 提示“流程”，koordinazzjoni 提示“协调”，indisponibilità 提示“不可用状态”；合起来记成“协调何时停运的流程”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A process for determining the amount or capacity of reserves needed to meet specified requirements.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据规定需求，确定需要保留多少备用资源或备用容量的流程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċess li jiddetermina l-ammont jew il-kapaċità tar-riservi meħtieġa biex jiġu ssodisfati rekwiżiti speċifiċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 评估备用需求并确定所需备用资源数量或容量规模的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proċess li bih jiġu evalwati l-ħtiġijiet u jiġi stabbilit kemm għandu jinżamm bħala riserva sabiex dawn il-ħtiġijiet ikunu jistgħu jiġu ssodisfati.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A reserve dimensioning process determines how much reserve is required to satisfy defined needs under the conditions being considered.

collocations.en: carry out the reserve dimensioning process
collocations.zh: 执行备用量规模确定流程

collocations.en: the results of the reserve dimensioning process
collocations.zh: 备用量规模确定流程的结果

formal.mt: Il-proċess tad-dimensjonar tar-riservi għandu jqis il-ħtiġijiet mistennija u l-varjazzjonijiet possibbli fid-domanda.
formal.en: The reserve dimensioning process should take account of expected needs and possible variations in demand.
formal.zh: 备用量规模确定流程应考虑预计需求以及需求可能出现的变化。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif se nkunu nafu kemm irridu nżommu bħala riserva? David: Il-proċess tad-dimensjonar tar-riservi jgħinna nistabbilixxu l-ammont meħtieġ.
colloquial.en: Lara: How will we know how much we need to keep in reserve? David: The reserve dimensioning process helps us determine the amount required.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们怎么知道需要保留多少备用量？戴维：备用量规模确定流程能帮助我们确定所需的数量。

messages.speaker: Lara (规划助理)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se nkunu nafu kemm irridu nżommu bħala riserva?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se nkunu nafu kemm irridu nżommu bħala riserva?
messages.zh: 我们怎么知道需要保留多少备用量？
messages.en: How will we know how much we need to keep in reserve?

messages.speaker: David (规划负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-proċess tad-dimensjonar tar-riservi jgħinna nistabbilixxu l-ammont meħtieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-proċess tad-dimensjonar tar-riservi jgħinna nistabbilixxu l-ammont meħtieġ.
messages.zh: 备用量规模确定流程能帮助我们确定所需的数量。
messages.en: The reserve dimensioning process helps us determine the amount required.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“备用要留多少”这句话提示自己：先估需求，再定备用规模，最后把整套步骤连成一个流程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The sequence of procedures used to organize and conduct an auction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 组织和进行拍卖所遵循的一系列程序，包括安排竞价并按规则确定成交结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sekwenza ta' passi u proċeduri li jintużaw biex jiġi organizzat u jitmexxa rkant, sal-għażla tal-offerta rebbieħa skont ir-regoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从组织竞价到按规则确定成交结果的拍卖程序。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa l-proċess li bih jiġi organizzat irkant, jintlaqgħu l-offerti u jiġi deċiż ir-riżultat skont ir-regoli stabbiliti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The auction process consists of the steps by which an auction is arranged, bids are received, and the outcome is determined under its rules.

collocations.en: the rules of the auction process

formal.mt: Qabel jibda l-proċess tal-irkant, l-organizzatur għandu jispjega r-regoli tal-parteċipazzjoni u kif se tintgħażel l-offerta rebbieħa.
formal.en: Before the auction process begins, the organizer should explain the participation rules and how the winning bid will be selected.
formal.zh: 拍卖流程开始之前，组织者应说明参与规则以及如何选出中标报价。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qatt ma ħadt sehem f'irkant. Kif jaħdem il-proċess tal-irkant? Mark: L-ewwel tirreġistra, imbagħad tagħmel l-offerti tiegħek skont ir-regoli.
colloquial.en: Lara: I've never taken part in an auction. How does the auction process work? Mark: First you register, then you place your bids according to the rules.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我从没参加过拍卖。拍卖流程是怎样的？Mark：你先登记，然后按照规则出价。

messages.speaker: Lara (首次参加拍卖的顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Qatt ma ħadt sehem f'irkant. Kif jaħdem il-proċess tal-irkant?
messages.mt_standard: Qatt ma ħadt sehem f'irkant. Kif jaħdem il-proċess tal-irkant?
messages.zh: 我从没参加过拍卖。拍卖流程是怎样的？
messages.en: I've never taken part in an auction. How does the auction process work?

messages.speaker: Mark (拍卖工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ewwel tirreġistra, imbagħad tagħmel l-offerti tiegħek skont ir-regoli.
messages.mt_standard: L-ewwel tirreġistra, imbagħad tagħmel l-offerti tiegħek skont ir-regoli.
messages.zh: 你先登记，然后按照规则出价。
messages.en: First you register, then you place your bids according to the rules.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍卖现场的顺序：登记、出价、确定成交。用 proċess 记“流程”，用 irkant 记“拍卖”，整组短语就对应这条拍卖步骤线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A procedure for monitoring and regulating the time taken by an activity or its stages.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 监测并调节一项活动或各个阶段所用时间的流程，以使其符合规定的时间安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċedura biex jitkejjel, jiġi mmonitorjat u jiġi rregolat il-ħin li tieħu attività jew kull fażi tagħha, skont il-limiti stabbiliti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对活动或工作阶段的用时进行监测和调节的流程。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Huwa proċess li bih jiġi segwit u kkontrollat il-ħin meħtieġ għal attività jew għall-fażijiet tagħha sabiex jiġu rispettati l-limiti tal-ħin.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A time control process is a procedure used to monitor how long activities take and regulate their duration against established time limits.

formal.mt: Il-proċess tal-kontroll tal-ħin jeħtieġ li jiġi rreġistrat it-tul ta' kull fażi u li jittieħdu miżuri korrettivi meta jinqabżu l-limiti stabbiliti.
formal.en: The time control process requires the duration of each stage to be recorded and corrective measures to be taken when established limits are exceeded.
formal.zh: 时间控制流程要求记录每个阶段的用时，并在超出规定时限时采取纠正措施。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tikteb meta tibda u tispiċċa kull biċċa xogħol? David: Dan jagħmel parti mill-proċess tal-kontroll tal-ħin. B'hekk naraw fejn qed nitilfu l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you writing down when each task starts and finishes? David: It's part of the time control process. That way we can see where we're losing time.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么要记下每项工作的开始和结束时间？David：这是时间控制流程的一部分。这样我们就能看出时间耗在哪里。

messages.speaker: Sara (项目组同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tikteb meta tibda u tispiċċa kull biċċa xogħol?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tikteb meta tibda u tispiċċa kull biċċa xogħol?
messages.zh: 你为什么要记下每项工作的开始和结束时间？
messages.en: Why are you writing down when each task starts and finishes?

messages.speaker: David (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan jagħmel parti mill-proċess tal-kontroll tal-ħin. B'hekk naraw fejn qed nitilfu l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Dan jagħmel parti mill-proċess tal-kontroll tal-ħin. B'hekk naraw fejn qed nitilfu l-ħin.
messages.zh: 这是时间控制流程的一部分。这样我们就能看出时间耗在哪里。
messages.en: It's part of the time control process. That way we can see where we're losing time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 脑中画一个秒表和任务清单：proċess 对应“流程”，kontroll 对应“控制”，ħin 对应“时间”。按“记录用时、检查时限、调整安排”三个动作记住整组表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The processing of goods while they remain subject to customs control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物在海关监管下进行加工的活动或程序。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ipproċessar ta' merkanzija waqt li din tibqa' soġġetta għall-kontrolli tad-dwana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在海关监管下对货物进行的加工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attività li fiha l-merkanzija tiġi pproċessata waqt li tkun soġġetta għall-kontrolli tad-dwana.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Processing under customs control is the processing of goods while customs authorities continue to supervise them.

collocations.en: goods for processing under customs control
collocations.zh: 用于海关监管下加工的货物

collocations.en: a procedure for processing under customs control
collocations.zh: 海关监管下的加工程序

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-proċessar bil-kontrolli doganali tal-merkanzija u jelenka l-istadji tal-ipproċessar.
formal.en: The report describes the processing of the goods under customs control and lists the processing stages.
formal.zh: 报告说明了这批货物在海关监管下的加工情况，并列出了加工阶段。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'jiġifieri proċessar bil-kontrolli doganali? Pawlu: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tiġi pproċessata waqt li tibqa' taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.
colloquial.en: Marta: What does processing under customs control mean? Pawlu: It means the goods are processed while they remain under customs control.
colloquial.zh: Marta：海关监管下的加工是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是货物在加工期间仍然受到海关监管。

messages.speaker: Marta (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: X'jiġifieri proċessar bil-kontrolli doganali?
messages.mt_standard: X'jiġifieri proċessar bil-kontrolli doganali?
messages.zh: 海关监管下的加工是什么意思？
messages.en: What does processing under customs control mean?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tiġi pproċessata waqt li tibqa' taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.
messages.mt_standard: Ifisser li l-merkanzija tiġi pproċessata waqt li tibqa' taħt il-kontroll tad-dwana.
messages.zh: 意思是货物在加工期间仍然受到海关监管。
messages.en: It means the goods are processed while they remain under customs control.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词配上“货物正在加工，海关仍在监管”的画面；记忆重点是加工与监管同时进行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Additional processing carried out after an earlier processing stage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在已有加工阶段之后，为继续处理或改变材料、产品而进行的后续加工。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ipproċessar addizzjonali li jsir fuq materjal jew prodott wara stadju preċedenti ta' pproċessar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在先前处理的基础上继续进行的加工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ipproċessar ieħor li jsir wara li materjal jew prodott ikun diġà għadda minn stadju ta' pproċessar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Further processing is additional work done on a material or product after an earlier processing stage.

collocations.zh: 用于进一步加工的材料

formal.mt: Wara l-ewwel stadju, il-materjal jintbagħat għal proċessar ulterjuri sabiex jinkiseb il-prodott finali.
formal.en: After the first stage, the material is sent for further processing to obtain the final product.
formal.zh: 第一阶段结束后，材料被送去进一步加工，以制成最终产品。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-materjal lest biex jintuża? David: Għadu mhux lest; jeħtieġ proċessar ulterjuri qabel nużawh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this material ready to use? David: It is not ready yet; it needs further processing before we use it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这批材料可以使用了吗？David：还不行；使用之前还需要进一步加工。

messages.speaker: Lara (学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-materjal lest biex jintuża?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-materjal lest biex jintuża?
messages.zh: 这批材料可以使用了吗？
messages.en: Is this material ready to use?

messages.speaker: David (师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu mhux lest; jeħtieġ proċessar ulterjuri qabel nużawh.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu mhux lest; jeħtieġ proċessar ulterjuri qabel nużawh.
messages.zh: 还不行；使用之前还需要进一步加工。
messages.en: It is not ready yet; it needs further processing before we use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象材料完成第一道工序后，还要沿传送带继续加工；用“已经加工，还要继续”记住整组词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organised group of people moving together, especially as part of a religious ceremony or formal occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有组织地一同行进的一队人，尤指参加宗教仪式或正式活动的行进队伍，也可指这种游行活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jimxu flimkien b'mod organizzat, speċjalment bħala parti minn ċerimonja reliġjuża jew okkażjoni formali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 按一定秩序共同前行的队伍，尤指宗教或正式仪式中的游行队伍或行进活动。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Mixja organizzata ta' grupp ta' nies, jew il-grupp innifsu waqt il-mixja, speċjalment waqt ċerimonja reliġjuża jew formali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procession is a group of people moving together in an organised way, usually during a ceremony or public event.

formal.mt: Il-proċessjoni għaddiet mit-toroq ewlenin tar-raħal u ntemmet fil-pjazza quddiem il-knisja.
formal.en: The procession passed through the village's main streets and ended in the square in front of the church.
formal.zh: 游行队伍经过村里的主要街道，最后在教堂前的广场结束行进。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-knisja? Pawlu: Qed jistennew il-proċessjoni. Trid nibqgħu narawha?
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are there so many people near the church? Pawlu: They're waiting for the procession. Shall we stay and watch it?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：教堂旁边怎么有这么多人？保罗：他们在等游行队伍。我们留下来看看，好吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-knisja?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm tant nies ħdejn il-knisja?
messages.zh: 教堂旁边怎么有这么多人？
messages.en: Why are there so many people near the church?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jistennew il-proċessjoni. Trid nibqgħu narawha?
messages.mt_standard: Qed jistennew il-proċessjoni. Trid nibqgħu narawha?
messages.zh: 他们在等游行队伍。我们留下来看看，好吗？
messages.en: They're waiting for the procession. Shall we stay and watch it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“人们排成队、沿街缓缓前行”的画面绑定，记住它表示有秩序行进的队伍或游行。

gloss_zh: 试点项目；试行计划；试点演练

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small initial project or trial used to test an approach before introducing it more widely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在较小范围内先行开展的项目或试验，用于检验某种做法，再决定是否扩大实施。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proġett jew prova fuq skala żgħira biex jiġi ttestjat metodu qabel ma jitħaddem fuq skala akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 为检验方法、程序或安排是否可行而先进行的小规模试验或演练。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Eżerċizzju ta' prova fuq skala żgħira biex jiġi vverifikat jekk metodu, proċedura jew arranġament jaħdimx kif mixtieq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot exercise is a limited trial carried out to check whether a method or procedure works before it is used more widely.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在有限范围内先行实施、用来评估做法和结果的试点项目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proġett li jitwettaq l-ewwel fuq skala limitata biex jiġu evalwati l-mod kif jaħdem u r-riżultati tiegħu qabel ma jitwessa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot project is a small initial project that allows people to assess an approach and its results before expanding it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先在部分地区或人群中试行、经评估后再决定是否推广的计划。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skema li tiġi ppruvata l-ewwel f'żona limitata jew ma' grupp żgħir ta' nies biex tiġi evalwata qabel ma titwessa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot scheme is an arrangement introduced for a limited group or area so that its effectiveness can be assessed before wider adoption.

collocations.en: evaluate the results of the pilot project

formal.mt: Il-kunsill se jniedi proġett pilota f'żewġ toroq biex jevalwa sistema ġdida ta' ġbir tal-iskart qabel ma jintroduċiha fil-lokalità kollha.
formal.en: The council will launch a pilot project in two streets to evaluate a new waste collection system before introducing it throughout the locality.
formal.zh: 地方议会将在两条街道启动试点项目，评估新的垃圾收集系统，然后再在整个辖区推广。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ġbir il-ġdid tal-iskart se jibda kullimkien? Mark: Għalissa le. Se jibdew bi proġett pilota f'żewġ toroq u jaraw kif imur.
colloquial.en: Lara: Will the new waste collection service start everywhere? Mark: Not yet. They'll start with a pilot project in two streets and see how it goes.
colloquial.zh: Lara：新的垃圾收集服务会在所有地方同时开始吗？Mark：暂时不会。他们会先在两条街道开展试点项目，看看效果。

messages.speaker: Lara (居民)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġbir il-ġdid tal-iskart se jibda kullimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġbir il-ġdid tal-iskart se jibda kullimkien?
messages.zh: 新的垃圾收集服务会在所有地方同时开始吗？
messages.en: Will the new waste collection service start everywhere?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għalissa le. Se jibdew bi proġett pilota f'żewġ toroq u jaraw kif imur.
messages.mt_standard: Għalissa le. Se jibdew bi proġett pilota f'żewġ toroq u jaraw kif imur.
messages.zh: 暂时不会。他们会先在两条街道开展试点项目，看看效果。
messages.en: Not yet. They'll start with a pilot project in two streets and see how it goes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proġett pilota 和“先选两条街试一试”的场景一起记：先小范围检验，再考虑扩大，就是试点项目。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An initial project conducted on a limited scale to test an idea before wider implementation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为检验某个想法或方案而先在有限范围内实施的项目，其结果可用于决定是否扩大推行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proġett inizjali fuq skala limitata biex tiġi ttestjata idea jew proposta qabel ma titwettaq fuq skala akbar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先在小范围内开展、用于检验方案可行性及实施效果的试点项目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Proġett ta' prova li jsir fuq skala żgħira biex jiġi evalwat jekk proposta taħdimx u tagħtix ir-riżultati mixtieqa qabel ma titwessa'.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pilot project is an initial trial on a small scale that helps people judge whether an idea should be implemented more widely.

collocations.zh: 扩大试点项目的实施范围

formal.mt: L-iskola se twettaq proġett-pilota f'żewġ klassijiet biex tevalwa l-użu tat-tablets fit-tagħlim qabel ma tiddeċiedi jekk twessgħux.
formal.en: The school will conduct a pilot project in two classes to evaluate the use of tablets in teaching before deciding whether to expand it.
formal.zh: 学校将在两个班级开展试点项目，评估平板电脑在教学中的使用效果，再决定是否扩大实施范围。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex żewġ klassijiet biss se jużaw it-tablets? David: Għax dan hu proġett-pilota. L-ewwel se jaraw jekk it-tablets jgħinux fit-tagħlim.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why will only two classes use the tablets? David: Because this is a pilot project. First they'll see whether the tablets help with learning.
colloquial.zh: Anna：为什么只有两个班会使用平板电脑？David：因为这是个试点项目。他们会先看看平板电脑是否有助于学习。

messages.speaker: Anna (家长)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex żewġ klassijiet biss se jużaw it-tablets?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex żewġ klassijiet biss se jużaw it-tablets?
messages.zh: 为什么只有两个班会使用平板电脑？
messages.en: Why will only two classes use the tablets?

messages.speaker: David (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax dan hu proġett-pilota. L-ewwel se jaraw jekk it-tablets jgħinux fit-tagħlim.
messages.mt_standard: Għax dan hu proġett-pilota. L-ewwel se jaraw jekk it-tablets jgħinux fit-tagħlim.
messages.zh: 因为这是个试点项目。他们会先看看平板电脑是否有助于学习。
messages.en: Because this is a pilot project. First they'll see whether the tablets help with learning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把带连字符的 proġett-pilota 整体记成“试点项目”：想象两个班先试用新设备，评估之后再决定是否推广。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Ordinary written language arranged in sentences and paragraphs rather than verse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以句子和段落组织、而非以诗行组织的文字形式，包括小说、文章等。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kitba magħmula minn sentenzi u paragrafi aktar milli minn versi, bħal dik ta' rumanz jew artiklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 散文体；以通常的句子和段落写成、区别于诗体的文字。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Forma ta' kitba li tuża sentenzi u paragrafi minflok versi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Prose is written language organised into sentences and paragraphs rather than lines of verse.

collocations.zh: 文学散文；文学性散文体文字

formal.mt: F'dan il-kors, l-istudenti jqabblu l-proża mal-poeżija u janalizzaw kif jiġu organizzati s-sentenzi u l-versi.
formal.en: In this course, students compare prose with poetry and analyse how sentences and lines of verse are organised.
formal.zh: 在本课程中，学生比较散文体与诗歌，并分析句子和诗行的组织方式。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Dan it-test hu poeżija? Pawlu: Le, hu miktub bil-proża. Ara kif is-sentenzi jiffurmaw paragrafi.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is this text poetry? Pawlu: No, it is written in prose. Look at how the sentences form paragraphs.
colloquial.zh: Marija：这篇文字是诗歌吗？Pawlu：不是，是散文体。你看，句子组成了段落。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan it-test hu poeżija?
messages.mt_standard: Dan it-test hu poeżija?
messages.zh: 这篇文字是诗歌吗？
messages.en: Is this text poetry?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, hu miktub bil-proża. Ara kif is-sentenzi jiffurmaw paragrafi.
messages.mt_standard: Le, hu miktub bil-proża. Ara kif is-sentenzi jiffurmaw paragrafi.
messages.zh: 不是，是散文体。你看，句子组成了段落。
messages.en: No, it is written in prose. Look at how the sentences form paragraphs.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 proża 记成一页连贯的段落：看到句子组成段落，就联想到散文体；这里不只指中文文学分类中的抒情散文。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Careful in judging risks and consequences, or tactful about keeping sensitive information private.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做事会考虑风险与后果的；也指处理敏感事情时有分寸、能保守秘密的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaħseb fir-riskji u fil-konsegwenzi qabel jaġixxi, jew li juri għaqal u ma jiżvelax tagħrif sensittiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 审慎的；行动或决定之前会考虑风险及后果的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaħseb sew qabel jaġixxi jew jiddeċiedi sabiex jevita riskji bla bżonn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is prudent considers possible risks and consequences before deciding what to do.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 言行谨慎、有分寸的；尤其指不会泄露秘密或敏感信息的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li joqgħod attent għal dak li jgħid jew jagħmel u jżomm tagħrif privat għalih.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is discreet handles private matters carefully and avoids revealing sensitive information.

formal.mt: Il-membri tal-kumitat għandhom ikunu prudenti fid-deċiżjonijiet tagħhom u ma jiżvelawx tagħrif kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: Committee members should be prudent in their decisions and should not reveal confidential information.
formal.zh: 委员会成员应审慎作出决定，并且不应泄露机密信息。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nista' ngħidlek xi ħaġa privata? Mark: Żgur. Inkun prudenti u ma ngħid lil ħadd.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can I tell you something private? Mark: Of course. I'll be discreet and won't tell anyone.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我能告诉你一件私事吗？Mark：当然。我会谨慎守密，不告诉任何人。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħidlek xi ħaġa privata?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħidlek xi ħaġa privata?
messages.zh: 我能告诉你一件私事吗？
messages.en: Can I tell you something private?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Inkun prudenti u ma ngħid lil ħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Inkun prudenti u ma ngħid lil ħadd.
messages.zh: 当然。我会谨慎守密，不告诉任何人。
messages.en: Of course. I'll be discreet and won't tell anyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 prudenti 配两个画面：做决定前先想后果，说私事前先管住嘴；分别帮助记住“审慎”和“谨慎守密”两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Care taken to avoid danger, unnecessary risk, or an unwise decision.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为避免危险、不必要的风险或不明智的决定而表现出的谨慎。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attenzjoni u għaqal fl-imġiba jew fid-deċiżjonijiet sabiex jiġu evitati perikli, riskji bla bżonn jew żbalji.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谨慎；为避免危险、风险或错误而保持小心的态度或做法。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Attenzjoni li wieħed juri qabel jew waqt azzjoni sabiex jevita periklu jew żball.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Caution is the care you take to avoid danger, mistakes, or unnecessary risks.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema għandhom jaġixxu bi prudenza meta jużaw tagħmir li ma jkunux familjari miegħu.
formal.en: Workers should act with caution when using equipment they are unfamiliar with.
formal.zh: 工作人员使用不熟悉的设备时，应谨慎操作。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-art għadha mxarrba? Ġanni: Iva, imxi bi prudenza biex ma tiżloqx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the floor still wet? Ġanni: Yes, walk with caution so you don't slip.
colloquial.zh: Lara：地板还湿着吗？Ġanni：是的，小心走，免得滑倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: L-art għadha mxarrba?
messages.mt_standard: L-art għadha mxarrba?
messages.zh: 地板还湿着吗？
messages.en: Is the floor still wet?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imxi bi prudenza biex ma tiżloqx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imxi bi prudenza biex ma tiżloqx.
messages.zh: 是的，小心走，免得滑倒。
messages.en: Yes, walk with caution so you don't slip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prudenza 放进固定短语 bi prudenza 一起记：想象走过湿地板时放慢脚步，就能记住“谨慎地”以及名词“谨慎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dried plum eaten as fruit or used as an ingredient in cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经过干燥处理的李子，常指西梅干，可直接食用或用于烹饪。
