teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għanbaqra mnixxfa li tittiekel waħedha jew tintuża bħala ingredjent fit-tisjir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 西梅干；由李子干燥制成、可直接食用或入菜的果干。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta tal-għanbaqar li tkun ġiet imnixxfa biex tittiekel jew tintuża fit-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A prune is a dried plum that people eat on its own or use in cooking.

formal.mt: Għal dan id-deżert, qatta' pruna bla għadma f'biċċiet żgħar u ħallatha mal-jogurt.
formal.en: For this dessert, cut a pitted prune into small pieces and mix it with the yoghurt.
formal.zh: 制作这份甜点时，将一颗去核西梅干切成小块，再拌入酸奶。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Trid pruna mal-kolazzjon? David: Iva, agħtini waħda bla għadma, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Rita: Would you like a prune with breakfast? David: Yes, give me a pitted one, please.
colloquial.zh: Rita：早餐要配一颗西梅干吗？David：要，请给我一颗去核的。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid pruna mal-kolazzjon?
messages.mt_standard: Trid pruna mal-kolazzjon?
messages.zh: 早餐要配一颗西梅干吗？
messages.en: Would you like a prune with breakfast?

messages.speaker: David (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, agħtini waħda bla għadma, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, agħtini waħda bla għadma, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，请给我一颗去核的。
messages.en: Yes, give me a pitted one, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面记 pruna：早餐碗旁放着一颗有褶皱的西梅干；再配上 bla għadma“去核”，把食物名称和实用搭配一起记住。

gloss_zh: 普鲁士的；与普鲁士有关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to Prussia, its people, or its culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与普鲁士、普鲁士人或其文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Prussja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 普鲁士的；与普鲁士人或普鲁士文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Prussja jew li għandu rabta mal-Prussja, man-nies tagħha jew mal-kultura tagħha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Prussian comes from Prussia or is associated with its people or culture.

formal.mt: Fil-katalgu tal-mużew, dan l-elmu huwa deskritt bħala elmu prussjan.
formal.en: In the museum catalogue, this helmet is described as a Prussian helmet.
formal.zh: 在博物馆目录中，这顶头盔被描述为普鲁士头盔。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-elmu huwa prussjan? Mark: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this helmet Prussian? Mark: Yes, that's what the label says.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这顶头盔是普鲁士的吗？马克：是的，标签上是这么写的。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-elmu huwa prussjan?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-elmu huwa prussjan?
messages.zh: 这顶头盔是普鲁士的吗？
messages.en: Is this helmet Prussian?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hekk hemm miktub fuq it-tikketta.
messages.zh: 是的，标签上是这么写的。
messages.en: Yes, that's what the label says.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prussjan 放在博物馆头盔标签的画面里，连着 elmu prussjan 记成“普鲁士头盔”；这里表示地域或文化归属。

gloss_zh: 自以为是的人；冒昧越分的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who assumes rights or privileges without sufficient permission or justification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 未经充分许可或缺乏正当理由，却自以为有权行事的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu fuqu aktar milli jmissha u taġixxi bħallikieku għandha drittijiet jew permessi li fil-fatt ma ngħatawl cheha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自以为有权而冒昧行事的人；言行越分、不尊重他人意愿的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li taġixxi mingħajr il-permess meħtieġ jew tiddeċiedi għal ħaddieħor bħallikieku għandha dritt tagħmel dan.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A presumptuous person assumes that they may act or decide for others without having been given permission.

collocations.en: to behave like a presumptuous person
collocations.zh: 表现得像个自以为是的人

collocations.en: to speak like a presumptuous person
collocations.zh: 说话像个冒昧越分的人

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-pruzuntuz jiddeċiedi għal kulħadd mingħajr ma jitlob il-kunsens ta' ħadd.
formal.en: In the story, the presumptuous person decides for everyone without asking for anyone's consent.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个自以为是的人没有征求任何人的同意，就替所有人作了决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Karl għażel il-menu għalina mingħajr ma staqsiena. Mark: Qed iġib ruħu ta' pruzuntuz! Ngħidulu li rridu nagħżlu aħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Karl chose the menu for us without asking us. Mark: He's behaving like a presumptuous person! Let's tell him we want to choose for ourselves.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：卡尔没问我们就替我们选好了菜单。马克：他真像个自以为是的人！我们告诉他，我们想自己选。

messages.speaker: Maja (聚餐朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Karl għażel il-menu għalina mingħajr ma staqsiena.
messages.mt_standard: Karl għażel il-menu għalina mingħajr ma staqsiena.
messages.zh: 卡尔没问我们就替我们选好了菜单。
messages.en: Karl chose the menu for us without asking us.

messages.speaker: Mark (聚餐朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed iġib ruħu ta' pruzuntuz! Ngħidulu li rridu nagħżlu aħna.
messages.mt_standard: Qed iġib ruħu ta' pruzuntuz! Ngħidulu li rridu nagħżlu aħna.
messages.zh: 他真像个自以为是的人！我们告诉他，我们想自己选。
messages.en: He's behaving like a presumptuous person! Let's tell him we want to choose for ourselves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的名词用法记住 pruzuntuz 指“那种人”：没问同伴就擅自替大家点菜的人；用具体人物帮助记住越分的含义。

gloss_zh: 自以为是的；冒昧放肆的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Acting as though one has a right to do something without sufficient permission or justification.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在没有充分许可或理由时，自以为有权行事而显得冒昧放肆的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi bħallikieku għandu dritt jagħmel xi ħaġa mingħajr permess jew raġuni biżżejjed, u b'hekk jonqos mir-rispett lejn ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 自以为有权而越分的；对他人冒昧、不够尊重的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jieħu fuqu aktar milli jmissu jew jaġixxi mingħajr il-permess meħtieġ, bħallikieku għandu dritt jiddeċiedi għal ħaddieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Someone who is presumptuous behaves as if they have a right to do something when they have not been given that right.

formal.mt: Ikun prużuntuż min-naħa tiegħi jekk niddeċiedi f'isem il-grupp mingħajr ma nikkonsulta lill-membri.
formal.en: It would be presumptuous of me to decide on behalf of the group without consulting its members.
formal.zh: 如果不征询成员意见就代表小组作决定，我就太冒昧了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu qal li se jiddeċiedi għalina lkoll. Mark: Kemm hu prużuntuż! Għandu jistaqsina l-ewwel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu said he would decide for all of us. Mark: How presumptuous of him! He should ask us first.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗说他会替我们所有人作决定。马克：他也太自以为是了！他应该先问问我们。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu qal li se jiddeċiedi għalina lkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu qal li se jiddeċiedi għalina lkoll.
messages.zh: 保罗说他会替我们所有人作决定。
messages.en: Pawlu said he would decide for all of us.

messages.speaker: Mark (小组成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu prużuntuż! Għandu jistaqsina l-ewwel.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu prużuntuż! Għandu jistaqsina l-ewwel.
messages.zh: 他也太自以为是了！他应该先问问我们。
messages.en: How presumptuous of him! He should ask us first.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象有人没问大家就宣布“我替你们决定”，用 prużuntuż 评价这种越分态度；重点记住“自以为有权”的语气。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The boldness or courage to attempt something difficult or risky.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 敢于尝试困难或有风险之事的胆量与大胆精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kuraġġ jew il-ħila li wieħed jissogra jagħmel xi ħaġa diffiċli jew li tinvolvi riskju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 大胆；面对困难或风险仍敢于行动的胆量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kuraġġ li bih wieħed jiffaċċja diffikultà jew periklu u jissogra jagħmel xi ħaġa li oħrajn jistgħu jibżgħu jagħmlu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Daring is the courage or boldness that allows someone to attempt something difficult, unusual, or risky.

collocations.en: daring in the face of danger

formal.mt: L-esploratur wera prużuntużi meta għażel li jkompli l-vjaġġ minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The explorer showed daring when he chose to continue the journey despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 这位探险者选择克服困难继续旅程，表现出了胆量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lara kienet l-ewwel waħda li ppruvat ir-rotta l-ġdida. Mark: Uriet prużuntużi, iżda ħejjiet ruħha sew qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Lara was the first to try the new route. Mark: She showed daring, but she prepared well beforehand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：劳拉是第一个尝试这条新路线的人。马克：她很有胆量，不过事先也做好了充分准备。

messages.speaker: Maja (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Lara kienet l-ewwel waħda li ppruvat ir-rotta l-ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Lara kienet l-ewwel waħda li ppruvat ir-rotta l-ġdida.
messages.zh: 劳拉是第一个尝试这条新路线的人。
messages.en: Lara was the first to try the new route.

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Uriet prużuntużi, iżda ħejjiet ruħha sew qabel.
messages.mt_standard: Uriet prużuntużi, iżda ħejjiet ruħha sew qabel.
messages.zh: 她很有胆量，不过事先也做好了充分准备。
messages.en: She showed daring, but she prepared well beforehand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按本词条的名词义，把 prużuntużi 记成可以“表现出来”的胆量，搭配 juri 一起记；画面是做好准备后勇敢尝试新路线。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A medical doctor who diagnoses and treats mental health conditions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 诊断和治疗精神健康问题的专科医生。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabib speċjalizzat fid-dijanjosi u fit-trattament ta' problemi tas-saħħa mentali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 精神科医生，即专门诊断和治疗精神健康问题的医生。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Psikjatra huwa tabib li jispeċjalizza fid-dijanjosi u fit-trattament ta' problemi tas-saħħa mentali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A psychiatrist is a medical doctor who specializes in diagnosing and treating mental health conditions.

formal.mt: It-tabib tal-familja rrakkomanda li l-pazjent jikkonsulta psikjatra għal valutazzjoni aktar dettaljata.
formal.en: The family doctor recommended that the patient consult a psychiatrist for a more detailed assessment.
formal.zh: 家庭医生建议患者咨询精神科医生，接受更详细的评估。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi appuntament ma' psikjatra għada u qed inħossni ftit nervuża. Mark: Tridni niġi miegħek u nistenniek barra?
colloquial.en: Maja: I have an appointment with a psychiatrist tomorrow, and I'm feeling a little nervous. Mark: Would you like me to come with you and wait outside?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我明天约了精神科医生，现在有点紧张。Mark：要我陪你去，在外面等你吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi appuntament ma' psikjatra għada u qed inħossni ftit nervuża.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi appuntament ma' psikjatra għada u qed inħossni ftit nervuża.
messages.zh: 我明天约了精神科医生，现在有点紧张。
messages.en: I have an appointment with a psychiatrist tomorrow, and I'm feeling a little nervous.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tridni niġi miegħek u nistenniek barra?
messages.mt_standard: Tridni niġi miegħek u nistenniek barra?
messages.zh: 要我陪你去，在外面等你吗？
messages.en: Would you like me to come with you and wait outside?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 psikjatra 放进“预约精神科医生”的场景，连同 appuntament ma' psikjatra 整块记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A noun whose meaning cannot be established from the information provided.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 现有信息未能确定具体含义的名词，暂不赋予实义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nom li t-tifsira tiegħu ma tistax tiġi stabbilita mill-informazzjoni mogħtija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词义尚未明确，无法据此确定该名词所指的事物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa nom li t-tifsira tiegħu għadha mhix ikkonfermata mill-informazzjoni disponibbli.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The meaning of this noun remains unspecified and cannot be reliably explained from the information available.

formal.mt: Qabel ma tintuża l-kelma 'pucpiec' f'eżerċizzju, jeħtieġ li jiġu kkonfermati t-tifsira u l-użu tagħha.
formal.en: Before the word 'pucpiec' is used in an exercise, its meaning and usage need to be confirmed.
formal.zh: 在练习中使用“pucpiec”这个词之前，需要先确认其含义和用法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taf xi tfisser il-kelma 'pucpiec'? Mark: Le, ma nafx. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema qabel nużawha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you know what the word 'pucpiec' means? Mark: No, I don't. Let's ask the teacher before we use it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你知道“pucpiec”这个词是什么意思吗？Mark：不知道。我们先问问老师，再使用它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf xi tfisser il-kelma 'pucpiec'?
messages.mt_standard: Taf xi tfisser il-kelma 'pucpiec'?
messages.zh: 你知道“pucpiec”这个词是什么意思吗？
messages.en: Do you know what the word 'pucpiec' means?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma nafx. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema qabel nużawha.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma nafx. Ejja nistaqsu lill-għalliema qabel nużawha.
messages.zh: 不知道。我们先问问老师，再使用它吧。
messages.en: No, I don't. Let's ask the teacher before we use it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 pucpiec 配上问号卡片，提醒自己词义待确认；先记拼写，避免用猜测编造含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dog of a breed with a curly coat, called a poodle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 贵宾犬，一种具有卷曲被毛的犬种。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelb ta' razza magħrufa għall-pil kaboċċi tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贵宾犬，具有卷曲被毛的犬种。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pudil huwa kelb ta' razza li għandha pil kaboċċi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A poodle is a dog belonging to a breed known for its curly coat.

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara, il-veterinarju eżamina l-ġilda u l-pil tal-pudil.
formal.en: During the visit, the veterinarian examined the poodle's skin and coat.
formal.zh: 就诊时，兽医检查了这只贵宾犬的皮肤和被毛。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-pudil tiegħek? Għandu pil sabiħ! Mark: Iva, jismu Toby. Trid tiġi timxi magħna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this your poodle? He has a lovely coat! Mark: Yes, his name is Toby. Would you like to come for a walk with us?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这是你的贵宾犬吗？它的毛真漂亮！Mark：是的，它叫 Toby。你想和我们一起散步吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pudil tiegħek? Għandu pil sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pudil tiegħek? Għandu pil sabiħ!
messages.zh: 这是你的贵宾犬吗？它的毛真漂亮！
messages.en: Is this your poodle? He has a lovely coat!

messages.speaker: Mark (狗主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jismu Toby. Trid tiġi timxi magħna?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jismu Toby. Trid tiġi timxi magħna?
messages.zh: 是的，它叫 Toby。你想和我们一起散步吗？
messages.en: Yes, his name is Toby. Would you like to come for a walk with us?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pudil 与英文 poodle 并排写在卷毛贵宾犬的图片旁，借助相似字形和画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet dish called pudding, usually eaten as a dessert.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 布丁，一种通常作为餐后甜点食用的甜食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deżerta ħelwa li tista' ssir b'ingredjenti differenti u li ġeneralment tittiekel wara l-ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布丁，通常作为餐后甜点食用、可用不同食材制作的甜食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pudina hija deżerta ħelwa li ssir b'ingredjenti differenti skont ir-riċetta.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pudding is a sweet dish made with various ingredients and often served at the end of a meal.

formal.mt: Għall-ikla tal-Ħadd, il-familja ħejjiet pudina biex isserviha bħala deżerta.
formal.en: For Sunday lunch, the family prepared a pudding to serve as dessert.
formal.zh: 为了星期日的午餐，这家人做了一份布丁，准备作为餐后甜点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid biċċa pudina wara l-ikla? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira. Diġà kilt ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a piece of pudding after the meal? Mark: Yes, please, but just a small piece. I've already eaten a lot.
colloquial.zh: Maja：饭后你想吃一块布丁吗？Mark：好的，谢谢，不过来一小块就行。我已经吃了很多。

messages.speaker: Maja (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid biċċa pudina wara l-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid biċċa pudina wara l-ikla?
messages.zh: 饭后你想吃一块布丁吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of pudding after the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira. Diġà kilt ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, imma biċċa żgħira. Diġà kilt ħafna.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，不过来一小块就行。我已经吃了很多。
messages.en: Yes, please, but just a small piece. I've already eaten a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pudina 和英文 pudding 配对，再想象饭后端上一块布丁，连同 biċċa pudina 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet dish made with bread, milk, eggs, and other ingredients, usually baked.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以面包、牛奶、鸡蛋等为原料，通常经过烘烤制成的甜点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Deżerta ħelwa magħmula bil-ħobż, il-ħalib, il-bajd u ingredjenti oħra, li normalment tinħema fil-forn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包布丁；以面包为主要原料制成的布丁甜点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Deżerta li ssir billi jitħallat il-ħobż ma' ħalib, bajd u ingredjenti oħra u t-taħlita tinħema fil-forn.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Bread pudding is a sweet dish made by baking bread with milk, eggs, and other ingredients.

formal.mt: Għad-deżerta, il-mistednin ġew offruti pudina tal-ħobż biż-żbib.
formal.en: For dessert, the guests were offered bread pudding with raisins.
formal.zh: 甜点时间，客人们获享了葡萄干面包布丁。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid biċċa pudina tal-ħobż? Pawlu: Iva, grazzi. Għamiltha inti? Lara: Iva, u żidt ftit żbib.
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like a piece of bread pudding? Pawlu: Yes, thanks. Did you make it yourself? Lara: Yes, and I added some raisins.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想来一块面包布丁吗？Pawlu：好呀，谢谢。是你自己做的吗？Lara：是的，我还加了一些葡萄干。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid biċċa pudina tal-ħobż?
messages.mt_standard: Trid biċċa pudina tal-ħobż?
messages.zh: 你想来一块面包布丁吗？
messages.en: Would you like a piece of bread pudding?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għamiltha inti?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għamiltha inti?
messages.zh: 好呀，谢谢。是你自己做的吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Did you make it yourself?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u żidt ftit żbib.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u żidt ftit żbib.
messages.zh: 是的，我还加了一些葡萄干。
messages.en: Yes, and I added some raisins.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词配上一块面包布丁的图片来记：pudina 是布丁，tal-ħobż 表示面包的，合起来就是面包布丁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Modesty in behaviour or a feeling of shame about something improper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 言行中的谦逊、羞谨，或面对不当行为时产生的羞耻感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kwalità ta' persuna li ġġib ruħha b'mod modest u xieraq, jew sentiment ta' mistħija quddiem xi ħaġa mhux xierqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谦逊；言行中不自我夸耀、保持适当分寸的态度。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kwalità ta' persuna li ma tiftaħarx biha nnifisha u żżomm imġiba modesta u xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Modesty is the quality of behaving without boasting and with a proper sense of personal restraint.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羞耻感；因自己的行为不当或有失体面而感到羞愧。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' mistħija li persuna tħoss meta tqis li għamlet xi ħaġa ħażina jew mhux xierqa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shame is an uncomfortable feeling you have when you believe your behaviour has been wrong or improper.

collocations.en: a sense of shame or propriety
collocations.zh: 羞耻感；知羞守礼的意识

formal.mt: Minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu, l-awtur tkellem bil-pudur u faħħar il-ħidma tal-kollegi tiegħu.
formal.en: Despite his success, the author spoke modestly and praised the work of his colleagues.
formal.zh: 尽管取得了成功，这位作者发言时仍十分谦逊，并赞扬了同事们的工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex ma ridtx tammetti l-iżball? Toni: Ħassejt pudur meta fhimt x'kont għamilt. Marija: Tista' tiskuża ruħek issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why didn't you want to admit the mistake? Toni: I felt ashamed when I realised what I had done. Marija: You can apologise now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你为什么不愿承认错误？Toni：当我明白自己做了什么时，我感到很羞愧。Marija：你现在可以道歉。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ma ridtx tammetti l-iżball?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ma ridtx tammetti l-iżball?
messages.zh: 你为什么不愿承认错误？
messages.en: Why didn't you want to admit the mistake?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt pudur meta fhimt x'kont għamilt.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt pudur meta fhimt x'kont għamilt.
messages.zh: 当我明白自己做了什么时，我感到很羞愧。
messages.en: I felt ashamed when I realised what I had done.

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiskuża ruħek issa.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiskuża ruħek issa.
messages.zh: 你现在可以道歉。
messages.en: You can apologise now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景区分 pudur：受表扬时不夸耀是谦逊，发现自己做错事而脸红是羞耻感；依上下文选择中文义项。

gloss_zh: 对男同性恋者的粗俗蔑称

teaching_sense.en_definition: An offensive colloquial word used to refer to a gay man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 口语中用来贬低或辱骂男同性恋者的冒犯性称呼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma kollo kwjali offensiva li tintuża biex tirreferi b'disprezz għal raġel omosesswali.

sense_translations.en_definition: a male homosexual (derogatory; colloquial), this term is the rough equivalent of 'faggot' or 'poofter'
sense_translations.zh_definition: 男同性恋者的粗俗蔑称，带有明显侮辱意味，语气大致相当于英语中的相关恐同辱称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Terminu kollo kwjali u dispreġġjattiv għal raġel omosesswali, li jintuża bħala insult minħabba l-orjentazzjoni sesswali tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone calls a gay man this word, they are using an offensive insult rather than a neutral description.

collocations.en: to insult someone by calling them 'pufta'

formal.mt: Fl-analiżi tad-diskors, il-kelma 'pufta' hija identifikata bħala terminu offensiv li jesprimi disprezz lejn irġiel omosesswali.
formal.en: In the discourse analysis, the word 'pufta' is identified as an offensive term expressing contempt towards gay men.
formal.zh: 在这项话语分析中，“pufta”被认定为表达对男同性恋者蔑视的冒犯性词语。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser 'pufta' f'dan il-filmat? Mark: Hija kelma offensiva għal raġel omosesswali. Nina: Mela mhix kelma newtrali. Mark: Le, tintuża bħala insult.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does 'pufta' mean in this video? Mark: It's an offensive word for a gay man. Nina: So it isn't a neutral word. Mark: No, it's used as an insult.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个视频里的“pufta”是什么意思？Mark：这是对男同性恋者的冒犯性称呼。Nina：所以它不是中性词。Mark：对，它是用来辱骂人的。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'pufta' f'dan il-filmat?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'pufta' f'dan il-filmat?
messages.zh: 这个视频里的“pufta”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'pufta' mean in this video?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija kelma offensiva għal raġel omosesswali.
messages.mt_standard: Hija kelma offensiva għal raġel omosesswali.
messages.zh: 这是对男同性恋者的冒犯性称呼。
messages.en: It's an offensive word for a gay man.

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela mhix kelma newtrali.
messages.mt_standard: Mela mhix kelma newtrali.
messages.zh: 所以它不是中性词。
messages.en: So it isn't a neutral word.

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, tintuża bħala insult.
messages.mt_standard: Le, tintuża bħala insult.
messages.zh: 对，它是用来辱骂人的。
messages.en: No, it's used as an insult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 pufta 的词卡加上“口语、侮辱性”标签，连同语气一起记忆；理解影视对白时识别它，平常描述则用中性的 raġel omosesswali。

gloss_zh: 船首雕像；另有一个释义未明的义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: A figure or sculpture attached to the bow of a ship as decoration.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在船头、用作装饰的人像或其他雕像。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura jew skultura mwaħħla mal-pruwa ta' bastiment bħala tiżjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 此义项的释义未明确，所给材料不足以确定其具体含义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Dan huwa sens li t-tifsira tiegħu mhijiex ċara fil-materjal mogħti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The supplied material does not identify a clear meaning for this sense.

sense_translations.en_definition: a nautical figurehead fitted on a ships' bow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 安装在船舶船头的装饰性雕像。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Figura skolpita mwaħħla mal-pruwa ta' bastiment bħala dekorazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A figurehead is a carved figure attached to the front of a ship as decoration.

formal.mt: Il-mużew qed jirrestawra pulena tal-injam li kienet imwaħħla mal-pruwa ta' bastiment.
formal.en: The museum is restoring a wooden figurehead that was attached to the bow of a ship.
formal.zh: 博物馆正在修复一尊曾安装在船头的木制船首雕像。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-figura fuq quddiem tal-bastiment? Pawlu: Dik pulena. Tintuża biex iżżejjen il-pruwa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that figure at the front of the ship? Pawlu: That is a figurehead. It is used to decorate the bow.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：船前面那尊雕像是什么？保罗：那是船首雕像，用来装饰船头。

messages.speaker: Lara (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-figura fuq quddiem tal-bastiment?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-figura fuq quddiem tal-bastiment?
messages.zh: 船前面那尊雕像是什么？
messages.en: What is that figure at the front of the ship?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik pulena. Tintuża biex iżżejjen il-pruwa.
messages.mt_standard: Dik pulena. Tintuża biex iżżejjen il-pruwa.
messages.zh: 那是船首雕像，用来装饰船头。
messages.en: That is a figurehead. It is used to decorate the bow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pulena 与船头迎风的雕像画面绑定记忆；未明确的另一义项先保留，不猜测含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large, comfortable bus used to carry passengers on trips or longer journeys.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于旅游或较长途旅行、通常较为舒适的大型客车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vettura kbira u komda li ġġorr gruppi ta' passiġġieri fuq ħarġiet jew vjaġġi twal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 供团体出游或长途载客使用的大型舒适客车。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Vettura kbira għall-ġarr tal-passiġġieri, normalment użata għal ħarġiet fi grupp jew għal vjaġġi twal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A coach is a large bus used to take passengers on excursions or longer journeys.

formal.mt: Il-pullman għall-ħarġa tal-iskola jitlaq mill-pjazza fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The coach for the school outing leaves the square at eight in the morning.
formal.zh: 学校出游的大巴将于早上八点从广场出发。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif se mmorru għall-ħarġa? Ġanni: Bil-pullman. Niltaqgħu fil-pjazza fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Marija: How are we getting to the outing? Ġanni: By coach. We are meeting in the square at eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：我们怎么去参加这次出游？詹尼：坐大巴。我们八点在广场集合。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif se mmorru għall-ħarġa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif se mmorru għall-ħarġa?
messages.zh: 我们怎么去参加这次出游？
messages.en: How are we getting to the outing?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Bil-pullman. Niltaqgħu fil-pjazza fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Bil-pullman. Niltaqgħu fil-pjazza fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 坐大巴。我们八点在广场集合。
messages.en: By coach. We are meeting in the square at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象全班同学排队登上旅游大巴，把 pullman 和集体出游的场景一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: One of the two organs in the chest used for breathing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胸腔内负责呼吸的两个器官之一，即一侧肺。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wieħed miż-żewġ organi fis-sider li jintużaw biex nieħdu n-nifs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肺，指胸腔内成对呼吸器官中的一个。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Wieħed minn żewġ organi fis-sider li bihom il-ġisem jieħu l-ossiġnu mill-arja u joħroġ id-diossidu tal-karbonju.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A lung is one of the two organs in your chest that enable you to breathe.

formal.mt: Fid-dijagramma tal-ġisem tal-bniedem, il-pulmun tal-lemin jidher fuq in-naħa tax-xellug tal-paġna.
formal.en: In the diagram of the human body, the right lung appears on the left side of the page.
formal.zh: 在这幅人体示意图中，右肺显示在页面左侧。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-pulmun tal-lemin? Mark: Iva, u dak l-ieħor huwa l-pulmun tax-xellug.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is this the right lung? Mark: Yes, and the other one is the left lung.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这是右肺吗？马克：是的，另一个是左肺。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-pulmun tal-lemin?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-pulmun tal-lemin?
messages.zh: 这是右肺吗？
messages.en: Is this the right lung?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u dak l-ieħor huwa l-pulmun tax-xellug.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u dak l-ieħor huwa l-pulmun tax-xellug.
messages.zh: 是的，另一个是左肺。
messages.en: Yes, and the other one is the left lung.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pulmun 时想象胸腔中的一侧肺随呼吸起伏，再用左右肺搭配巩固单数含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A warm knitted garment for the upper body that you put on by pulling it over your head.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿着时从头部套入、用于上半身保暖的针织衣物，即套头毛衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies maħdum bis-suf jew b'ħajt ieħor għall-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem, li jintlibes minn fuq ir-ras biex iżommok sħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 从头部套入穿着的毛衣或针织上衣。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ilbies maħdum għan-naħa ta' fuq tal-ġisem li jintlibes billi ddaħħal rasek mill-għonq tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pullover is a knitted garment that you wear on your upper body and pull over your head.

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi dan il-pulowver tas-suf bħala lbies adattat għal ġranet kesħin.
formal.en: The catalogue describes this woollen pullover as suitable clothing for cold days.
formal.zh: 商品目录将这件羊毛套头毛衣描述为适合寒冷天气穿着的衣物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hu l-pulowver tiegħi? Omm: Fuq is-siġġu. Ilbsu qabel toħroġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: I feel cold. Where is my pullover? Mum: On the chair. Put it on before you go out.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我觉得冷。我的套头毛衣在哪里？妈妈：在椅子上。出门前穿上。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hu l-pulowver tiegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard. Fejn hu l-pulowver tiegħi?
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。我的套头毛衣在哪里？
messages.en: I feel cold. Where is my pullover?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-siġġu. Ilbsu qabel toħroġ.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-siġġu. Ilbsu qabel toħroġ.
messages.zh: 在椅子上。出门前穿上。
messages.en: On the chair. Put it on before you go out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pulowver 与双手举起毛衣、从头套下的动作联想，再想象穿好后暖和的感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small ball of minced meat prepared for cooking or eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用碎肉捏成、供烹调或食用的小丸子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Boċċa żgħira magħmula minn laħam ikkapuljat li titħejja biex tissajjar u tittiekel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肉丸；用碎肉做成的小球状食物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Boċċa żgħira ta' laħam ikkapuljat li tissajjar biex tittiekel.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A meatball is a small ball of minced meat that is cooked and served as food.

formal.mt: Poġġi pulpetta fuq kull platt u żid ftit zalza qabel isservi.
formal.en: Place a meatball on each plate and add a little sauce before serving.
formal.zh: 在每个盘子里放一个肉丸，上菜前加少许酱汁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid pulpetta oħra? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit zalza magħha.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like another meatball? Pawlu: Yes, please, and a little sauce with it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你还要一个肉丸吗？Pawlu：要，谢谢，再配一点酱汁。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid pulpetta oħra?
messages.mt_standard: Trid pulpetta oħra?
messages.zh: 你还要一个肉丸吗？
messages.en: Would you like another meatball?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit zalza magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, u ftit zalza magħha.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢，再配一点酱汁。
messages.en: Yes, please, and a little sauce with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pulpetta 和盘中一颗圆圆的肉丸一起记忆，再用“还要一个肉丸吗”练习点餐对话。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A raised platform in a church from which someone delivers a sermon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 教堂内供讲道者站立并向会众讲道的高台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post għoli fi knisja minn fejn min jipprietka jagħmel priedka lill-kongregazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讲道台；教堂内用于向会众讲道的高台。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post merfugħ fi knisja li jintuża biex issir priedka lill-kongregazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pulpit is a raised place in a church where a preacher stands to address the congregation.

formal.mt: Il-qassis tela' fuq il-pulptu biex jagħmel il-priedka lill-kongregazzjoni.
formal.en: The priest went up into the pulpit to deliver the sermon to the congregation.
formal.zh: 神父走上讲道台，向会众讲道。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'inhu dak il-post għoli ħdejn il-ħajt? Mark: Dak pulptu; minn hemm issir il-priedka.
colloquial.en: Anna: What is that raised place beside the wall? Mark: That is a pulpit; the sermon is delivered from there.
colloquial.zh: Anna：墙边那个高台是什么？Mark：那是讲道台，讲道就是在那里进行的。

messages.speaker: Anna (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu dak il-post għoli ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu dak il-post għoli ħdejn il-ħajt?
messages.zh: 墙边那个高台是什么？
messages.en: What is that raised place beside the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak pulptu; minn hemm issir il-priedka.
messages.mt_standard: Dak pulptu; minn hemm issir il-priedka.
messages.zh: 那是讲道台，讲道就是在那里进行的。
messages.en: That is a pulpit; the sermon is delivered from there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pulptu 时想象教堂里高出的讲道台，台上有人讲道，台下会众聆听，用场景锁定词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chair with supports on both sides for resting your arms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两侧设有扶手、可供坐者搁放手臂的椅子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Siġġu b'appoġġ fuq kull naħa fejn min joqgħod bilqiegħda jista' jserraħ dirgħajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扶手椅；两侧有供手臂倚靠的扶手的椅子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Siġġu li għandu appoġġi fil-ġnub biex wieħed iserraħ dirgħajh waqt li jkun bilqiegħda.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An armchair is a chair with a support on each side where you can rest your arms.

formal.mt: Fil-kamra tal-qari hemm pultruna komda ħdejn it-tieqa.
formal.en: There is a comfortable armchair beside the window in the reading room.
formal.zh: 阅览室的窗边有一把舒适的扶手椅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Nista' noqgħod f'din il-pultruna? Ġanni: Żgur, oqgħod; hija komda ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: May I sit in this armchair? Ġanni: Of course, have a seat; it is very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我可以坐这把扶手椅吗？Ġanni：当然，请坐，很舒服的。

messages.speaker: Lara (客人)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' noqgħod f'din il-pultruna?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' noqgħod f'din il-pultruna?
messages.zh: 我可以坐这把扶手椅吗？
messages.en: May I sit in this armchair?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, oqgħod; hija komda ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, oqgħod; hija komda ħafna.
messages.zh: 当然，请坐，很舒服的。
messages.en: Of course, have a seat; it is very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 pultruna 时想象自己坐进窗边的扶手椅，两条手臂各靠一边，把动作和词义连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit used to measure length or distance in the imperial system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 英制中的长度单位，用来表示物体的长度或距离。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' tul fis-sistema imperjali li tintuża biex jitkejlu tulijiet u distanzi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英寸；英制长度单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Unità ta' kejl tat-tul li tagħmel parti mis-sistema imperjali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An inch is a unit of length used in the imperial system of measurement.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 英寸；用于测量长度或距离的英制单位。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Miżura ta' tul fis-sistema imperjali li tintuża biex jiġi espress it-tul ta' oġġett jew ta' distanza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use an inch as a unit when expressing a length or distance in imperial measurements.

formal.mt: Skont l-istruzzjonijiet, għandha titħalla distanza ta' pulzier wieħed bejn iż-żewġ biċċiet.
formal.en: According to the instructions, a distance of one inch should be left between the two pieces.
formal.zh: 按照说明，两块材料之间应留出一英寸的距离。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm għandi nqassar iż-żigarella? Toni: Aqta' pulzier wieħed mit-tarf.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much should I shorten the ribbon? Toni: Cut one inch off the end.
colloquial.zh: Sara：这条丝带要剪短多少？Toni：从末端剪掉一英寸。

messages.speaker: Sara (手工课学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm għandi nqassar iż-żigarella?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm għandi nqassar iż-żigarella?
messages.zh: 这条丝带要剪短多少？
messages.en: How much should I shorten the ribbon?

messages.speaker: Toni (手工课老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqta' pulzier wieħed mit-tarf.
messages.mt_standard: Aqta' pulzier wieħed mit-tarf.
messages.zh: 从末端剪掉一英寸。
messages.en: Cut one inch off the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pulzier 写在尺子的英寸刻度旁，再想象从丝带末端量出一英寸，借测量动作记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The end section of a shirt sleeve that fits around the wrist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 衬衫袖子末端围住手腕的部分，通常带有纽扣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti fit-tarf tal-komma ta' qmis li ddur mal-polz u ġeneralment tingħalaq b'buttuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 衬衫袖子末端围住手腕的袖口部分。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-parti fit-tarf tal-komma ta' qmis li ddur mal-polz.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A cuff is the end part of a shirt sleeve that fits around your wrist.

collocations.en: the button on the shirt cuff

formal.mt: Qabel taħsel il-qmis, iċċekkja jekk hemmx tbajja' fuq il-pulzier.
formal.en: Before washing the shirt, check whether there are any stains on the cuff.
formal.zh: 清洗衬衫之前，检查袖口上是否有污渍。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-pulzier tal-qmis tiegħek għadu miftuħ. Pawlu: Grazzi, se nagħlaq il-buttuna issa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Your shirt cuff is still undone. Pawlu: Thanks, I'll fasten the button now.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你的衬衫袖口还没扣好。Pawlu：谢谢，我现在就把纽扣扣上。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pulzier tal-qmis tiegħek għadu miftuħ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-pulzier tal-qmis tiegħek għadu miftuħ.
messages.zh: 你的衬衫袖口还没扣好。
messages.en: Your shirt cuff is still undone.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, se nagħlaq il-buttuna issa.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, se nagħlaq il-buttuna issa.
messages.zh: 谢谢，我现在就把纽扣扣上。
messages.en: Thanks, I'll fasten the button now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整组词和衬衫手腕处的一圈袖口联系起来，想象出门前扣上袖口纽扣的动作来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A comic performer who makes people laugh, or a puppet moved by a performer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过滑稽装扮或动作逗人发笑的小丑，也可指由表演者操纵的木偶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tilbes jew taġixxi b'mod komiku biex iddaħħaq lin-nies, jew pupazz li jitħarrek minn persuna waqt spettaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小丑；通过滑稽服装、动作或表演逗观众发笑的演员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Artista li jilbes ħwejjeġ komiċi u jagħmel ċajt jew movimenti tad-daħk biex jiddeverti lill-udjenza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A clown is a performer who entertains people with funny clothes, jokes, or amusing actions.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木偶；由人操纵、在表演中扮演角色的偶人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pupazz li jirrappreżenta karattru u li persuna ċċaqlaq, pereżempju b'idejha jew bil-ħjut, waqt spettaklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puppet is a figure that a performer moves to represent a character in a show.

formal.mt: Il-pulċinell tal-injam jintuża fl-ispettaklu biex jirrakkonta storja lit-tfal.
formal.en: The wooden puppet is used in the show to tell a story to the children.
formal.zh: 演出中使用这个木偶来给孩子们讲故事。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dak bil-kappell ikkulurit? Ġużeppi: Dak il-pulċinell tal-ispettaklu. Sara: X'se jagħmel? Ġużeppi: Dalwaqt jibda jdaħħaq lit-tfal.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who's that wearing the colourful hat? Ġużeppi: That's the clown in the show. Sara: What is he going to do? Ġużeppi: He'll start making the children laugh soon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：那个戴彩色帽子的人是谁？Ġużeppi：那是演出里的小丑。Sara：他要做什么？Ġużeppi：他马上就要开始逗孩子们笑了。

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak bil-kappell ikkulurit?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak bil-kappell ikkulurit?
messages.zh: 那个戴彩色帽子的人是谁？
messages.en: Who's that wearing the colourful hat?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-pulċinell tal-ispettaklu.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-pulċinell tal-ispettaklu.
messages.zh: 那是演出里的小丑。
messages.en: That's the clown in the show.

messages.speaker: Sara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se jagħmel?
messages.mt_standard: X'se jagħmel?
messages.zh: 他要做什么？
messages.en: What is he going to do?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Dalwaqt jibda jdaħħaq lit-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Dalwaqt jibda jdaħħaq lit-tfal.
messages.zh: 他马上就要开始逗孩子们笑了。
messages.en: He'll start making the children laugh soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一舞台上的两个角色：真人戴彩帽逗笑是小丑，表演者操纵的偶人是木偶；两幅画面都配上 pulċinell，再靠上下文辨义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small rounded handle or control that you hold, pull, or turn.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人握住、拉动或转动的小型圆形把手或控制旋钮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Manku jew kontroll żgħir u tond li taqbad, tiġbed jew iddawwar biex tiftaħ xi ħaġa jew tibdel issettjar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门或抽屉等物体上的圆形把手，或设备上用来调节设置的旋钮。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Manku tond fuq bieb jew kexxun, jew kontroll tond fuq apparat li ddawwar biex tibdel issettjar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A knob is a small rounded handle or control that you pull or turn to operate something.

formal.mt: Biex iżżid il-volum tar-radju, dawwar il-pum lejn il-lemin.
formal.en: To increase the radio's volume, turn the knob to the right.
formal.zh: 要调高收音机的音量，请向右转动旋钮。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-bieb ma jinfetaħx. Mark: Dawwar il-pum u mbagħad imbotta.
colloquial.en: Sara: The door won't open. Mark: Turn the knob and then push.
colloquial.zh: Sara：门打不开。Mark：转一下门把手，然后推门。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb ma jinfetaħx.
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb ma jinfetaħx.
messages.zh: 门打不开。
messages.en: The door won't open.

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Dawwar il-pum u mbagħad imbotta.
messages.mt_standard: Dawwar il-pum u mbagħad imbotta.
messages.zh: 转一下门把手，然后推门。
messages.en: Turn the knob and then push.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 pum 配上一个圆圆的门把手，再做一次握住并转动的动作，把词形和用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tropical fruit with a knobbly green skin, sweet pale flesh, and dark seeds, also called a sugar apple.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种热带水果，果皮绿色且呈块状凸起，果肉浅色而甜，内有深色种子，也称释迦果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali b'qoxra ħadra u mħarbta, polpa ċara u ħelwa, u żerriegħa skura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 番荔枝，又称释迦果，一种果皮呈块状凸起、果肉香甜且含深色种子的热带水果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta tropikali b'qoxra ħadra magħmula minn partijiet imqabbża u b'polpa ħelwa li fiha żerriegħa skura.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A sweetsop is a tropical fruit with knobbly green skin and sweet pale flesh containing dark seeds.

formal.mt: Qabel isservi biċċiet ta' pumakannella, neħħi ż-żerriegħa mill-polpa.
formal.en: Before serving pieces of sweetsop, remove the seeds from the flesh.
formal.zh: 端上切好的番荔枝之前，先去掉果肉中的种子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid idduq ftit pumakannella? David: Iva, grazzi. Neħħejt iż-żerriegħa?
colloquial.en: Lara: Would you like to try some sweetsop? David: Yes, thanks. Have you removed the seeds?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你想尝一点番荔枝吗？David：好啊，谢谢。你把种子去掉了吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid idduq ftit pumakannella?
messages.mt_standard: Trid idduq ftit pumakannella?
messages.zh: 你想尝一点番荔枝吗？
messages.en: Would you like to try some sweetsop?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Neħħejt iż-żerriegħa?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Neħħejt iż-żerriegħa?
messages.zh: 好啊，谢谢。你把种子去掉了吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Have you removed the seeds?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词配上一幅释迦果剖面图：外皮一块块凸起，里面是浅色甜果肉和深色种子，用画面记忆词义。

gloss_zh: 炒高出货；拉高价格后抛售的操纵骗局

teaching_sense.en_definition: A scheme in which people use misleading promotion to raise an asset's price and then sell their holdings at the inflated price.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种通过误导性宣传推高资产价格，再以虚高价格卖出所持资产获利的操纵骗局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skema li fiha persuni jużaw promozzjoni qarrieqa biex jgħollu l-prezz ta' assi u mbagħad ibigħu dak li għandhom bi prezz minfuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 先以夸大或误导性宣传制造热度、推高资产价格，再抛售所持资产获利的骗局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skema li fiha tinħoloq eċċitazzjoni permezz ta' promozzjoni esaġerata jew qarrieqa biex jogħla l-prezz ta' assi, u mbagħad jinbiegħ dak li għandhom l-organizzaturi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A hype and dump is a scheme in which promoters create misleading excitement about an asset before selling their holdings at an inflated price.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 通过误导性炒作人为拉高资产价格，随后卖出所持资产获利的操纵行为或骗局。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Prattika qarrieqa li fiha persuni jgħollu artifiċjalment il-prezz ta' assi permezz ta' promozzjoni u mbagħad ibigħu dak li għandhom biex jagħmlu qligħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pump and dump is a scheme in which people artificially raise an asset's price through misleading promotion and then sell their holdings for a profit.

collocations.en: a victim of a pump-and-dump scheme
collocations.zh: 拉高出货骗局的受害者

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi skema ta' pump and dump li fiha l-organizzaturi xerrdu informazzjoni qarrieqa biex jgħollu l-prezz tal-ishma qabel ibigħuhom.
formal.en: The report describes a pump-and-dump scheme in which the organisers spread misleading information to raise the share price before selling their shares.
formal.zh: 该报告描述了一起拉高出货骗局，组织者先散布误导性信息推高股价，随后卖出所持股票。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'inhu pump and dump? Luqa: Huwa meta xi ħadd ixerred informazzjoni qarrieqa biex jgħolli l-prezz ta' assi u mbagħad ibigħ dak li għandu.
colloquial.en: Nina: What is a pump and dump? Luqa: It's when someone spreads misleading information to raise an asset's price and then sells their holdings.
colloquial.zh: Nina：什么是拉高出货？Luqa：就是有人散布误导性信息推高资产价格，然后卖掉自己持有的资产。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu pump and dump?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu pump and dump?
messages.zh: 什么是拉高出货？
messages.en: What is a pump and dump?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa meta xi ħadd ixerred informazzjoni qarrieqa biex jgħolli l-prezz ta' assi u mbagħad ibigħ dak li għandu.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa meta xi ħadd ixerred informazzjoni qarrieqa biex jgħolli l-prezz ta' assi u mbagħad ibigħ dak li għandu.
messages.zh: 就是有人散布误导性信息推高资产价格，然后卖掉自己持有的资产。
messages.en: It's when someone spreads misleading information to raise an asset's price and then sells their holdings.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个表达记成两格漫画：第一格用夸大宣传把价格吹高，第二格趁高价卖出；连起来就是炒高出货。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the Punic language or culture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与布匿语或布匿文化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ilsien puniku jew mal-kultura punika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布匿的；与布匿语或布匿文化有关的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jirreferi għall-ilsien puniku jew għal xi aspett tal-kultura punika.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something that is Punic is connected with the Punic language or culture.

formal.mt: L-istudju jeżamina l-użu tal-ilsien puniku fit-test magħżul.
formal.en: The study examines the use of the Punic language in the selected text.
formal.zh: 这项研究考察所选文本中布匿语的使用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-ktieb? Pawlu: L-ilsien puniku. Maja: Mela hu ktieb dwar il-lingwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the book about? Pawlu: The Punic language. Maja: So it's a book about the language.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这本书讲什么？Pawlu：布匿语。Maja：那就是一本介绍这门语言的书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-ktieb?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhu s-suġġett tal-ktieb?
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is the book about?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilsien puniku.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilsien puniku.
messages.zh: 布匿语。
messages.en: The Punic language.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela hu ktieb dwar il-lingwa.
messages.mt_standard: Mela hu ktieb dwar il-lingwa.
messages.zh: 那就是一本介绍这门语言的书。
messages.en: So it's a book about the language.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 puniku 和英语 Punic 配对记忆，再用 l-ilsien puniku“布匿语”这个短语巩固形容词的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The central idea or most important point of a text, discussion, or message.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 文章、讨论或信息中的核心意思或最重要的要点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-idea ċentrali jew l-aktar punt importanti f'test, diskussjoni jew messaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 要旨；一段话、文章或讨论所表达的核心意思。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-ħsieb ċentrali ta' diskors jew test, mifhum mingħajr id-dettalji kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The gist of a text or conversation is its central meaning, without all the details.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 主要要点；文章、讨论或陈述中最重要的内容。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-aktar ideat jew tagħrif importanti f'test, diskors jew diskussjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The main points are the most important ideas or pieces of information in something.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标题；以简短文字突出新闻或文章主要内容的题目。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Titlu qasir u prominenti li jiġbor il-kontenut ewlieni ta' aħbar jew artiklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A headline is a short, prominent title that presents the main subject of a news story or article.

collocations.en: the main point of the discussion

formal.mt: Il-punt ewlieni tar-rapport huwa li s-servizz għandu jsir aktar aċċessibbli għall-pubbliku.
formal.en: The main point of the report is that the service should become more accessible to the public.
formal.zh: 报告的核心观点是，应让公众更方便地使用这项服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma fhimtx kollox. X'inhu l-punt ewlieni? Daniel: Li rridu nibdew aktar kmieni għada. Maja: Sewwa, mela niltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: I didn't understand everything. What's the main point? Daniel: That we need to start earlier tomorrow. Maja: All right, then let's meet at eight.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我没全部听懂。重点是什么？Daniel：我们明天得早点开始。Maja：好，那我们八点见。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma fhimtx kollox. X'inhu l-punt ewlieni?
messages.mt_standard: Ma fhimtx kollox. X'inhu l-punt ewlieni?
messages.zh: 我没全部听懂。重点是什么？
messages.en: I didn't understand everything. What's the main point?

messages.speaker: Daniel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Li rridu nibdew aktar kmieni għada.
messages.mt_standard: Li rridu nibdew aktar kmieni għada.
messages.zh: 我们明天得早点开始。
messages.en: That we need to start earlier tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, mela niltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, mela niltaqgħu fit-tmienja.
messages.zh: 好，那我们八点见。
messages.en: All right, then let's meet at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读完长文后只圈出最重要的一句话，并问 X'inhu l-punt ewlieni? 用“核心一句话”记住要旨和主要要点，再联系概括内容的标题义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A point at which two systems or components meet and exchange information or interact.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个系统或组成部分相接，并交换信息或相互作用的位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Punt fejn żewġ sistemi jew komponenti jiltaqgħu u jiskambjaw informazzjoni jew jaħdmu ma' xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个系统、设备或组成部分之间用于交互或交换信息的接口位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt ta' kuntatt bejn żewġ sistemi, apparati jew komponenti li jippermetti l-interazzjoni jew l-iskambju ta' informazzjoni bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An interface point is a location where two systems or components meet so that they can interact or exchange information.

collocations.mt: punt ta' interfaċċja bejn żewġ sistemi
collocations.en: an interface point between two systems
collocations.zh: 两个系统之间的接口点

formal.mt: Id-dokument jiddeskrivi l-punt ta' interfaċċja bejn iż-żewġ sistemi u jispeċifika liema data tiġi skambjata.
formal.en: The document describes the interface point between the two systems and specifies which data is exchanged.
formal.zh: 该文件说明了两个系统之间的接口点，并明确规定了所交换的数据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-punt ta' interfaċċja bejn dawn iż-żewġ sistemi? Mark: Hawn fid-dijagramma; minn hawn jgħaddu d-data lil xulxin.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the interface point between these two systems? Mark: Here in the diagram; this is where they pass data to each other.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这两个系统之间的接口点在哪里？马克：在图上的这里；它们通过这里相互传递数据。

messages.speaker: Lara (新同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-punt ta' interfaċċja bejn dawn iż-żewġ sistemi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-punt ta' interfaċċja bejn dawn iż-żewġ sistemi?
messages.zh: 这两个系统之间的接口点在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the interface point between these two systems?

messages.speaker: Mark (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fid-dijagramma; minn hawn jgħaddu d-data lil xulxin.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fid-dijagramma; minn hawn jgħaddu d-data lil xulxin.
messages.zh: 在图上的这里；它们通过这里相互传递数据。
messages.en: Here in the diagram; this is where they pass data to each other.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个系统在同一个小圆点交换资料，把这个圆点记作“接口点”；用“交互发生在哪里”帮助回忆整条短语。

exact_key: punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art

teaching_sense.en_definition: A location on land where an electrical network or installation connects with an electricity grid.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位于陆地上、供电力网络或电力设施与电网互联的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post fuq l-art fejn netwerk jew installazzjoni tal-elettriku jingħaqad mal-grilja tal-elettriku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设在陆地上、使电力网络或电力设施与电网相互连接的具体位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt li jinsab fuq l-art u li fih netwerk jew installazzjoni tal-elettriku jiġi konness mal-grilja tal-elettriku.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An onshore grid interconnection point is a location on land where an electrical network or installation is connected to an electricity grid.

collocations.mt: il-post tal-punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art
collocations.en: the location of the onshore grid interconnection point
collocations.zh: 陆上电网互联点的位置

collocations.mt: l-għażla ta' punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art
collocations.en: the selection of an onshore grid interconnection point
collocations.zh: 陆上电网互联点的选址

formal.mt: Il-pjan tal-proġett jidentifika l-punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art u r-rotta tal-kejbil li jwassal għalih.
formal.en: The project plan identifies the onshore grid interconnection point and the route of the cable leading to it.
formal.zh: 项目规划标明了陆上电网互联点，以及通往该点的电缆线路。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn se jkun il-punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art? David: Hawn fuq il-mappa, ħdejn is-substazzjon.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where will the onshore grid interconnection point be? David: Here on the map, beside the substation.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：陆上电网互联点将设在哪里？戴维：在地图上的这里，变电站旁边。

messages.speaker: Nina (项目协调员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn se jkun il-punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn se jkun il-punt ta' interkonnessjoni tal-grilja fuq l-art?
messages.zh: 陆上电网互联点将设在哪里？
messages.en: Where will the onshore grid interconnection point be?

messages.speaker: David (工程师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn fuq il-mappa, ħdejn is-substazzjon.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn fuq il-mappa, ħdejn is-substazzjon.
messages.zh: 在地图上的这里，变电站旁边。
messages.en: Here on the map, beside the substation.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按意思分块记忆：punt 是“点”，interkonnessjoni 提示“互联”，grilja 提示“电网”，fuq l-art 提示“在陆上”；把它们合成一幅陆上电网接线图。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A particular location where one object, device, or system is joined to another.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个物体、设备或系统与另一个相连接的具体位置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post speċifiku fejn oġġett, apparat jew sistema jingħaqad ma' oġġett, apparat jew sistema oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 两个物体、设备或系统相接，或其中一个接入另一个的位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt fejn żewġ oġġetti, apparati jew sistemi jingħaqdu, jew fejn wieħed jiġi konness mal-ieħor.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A connection point is a particular place where two objects, devices, or systems are joined together.

collocations.en: a connection point to the grid

formal.mt: Il-manwal juri l-punt ta' konnessjoni tal-kejbil fuq l-apparat u jispjega kif għandu jitwaħħal il-kejbil.
formal.en: The manual shows the cable connection point on the device and explains how the cable should be attached.
formal.zh: 手册标出了设备上的电缆连接点，并说明了电缆的安装方法。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Fejn hu l-punt ta' konnessjoni ta' dan il-kejbil? Toni: Fuq wara tal-apparat, ħdejn it-tikketta l-blu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Where is the connection point for this cable? Toni: On the back of the device, beside the blue label.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这根电缆的连接点在哪里？托尼：在设备背面，蓝色标签旁边。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-punt ta' konnessjoni ta' dan il-kejbil?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-punt ta' konnessjoni ta' dan il-kejbil?
messages.zh: 这根电缆的连接点在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the connection point for this cable?

messages.speaker: Toni (技术员)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq wara tal-apparat, ħdejn it-tikketta l-blu.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq wara tal-apparat, ħdejn it-tikketta l-blu.
messages.zh: 在设备背面，蓝色标签旁边。
messages.en: On the back of the device, beside the blue label.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根电缆插入设备，插头与设备相接的位置就是“连接点”；把整条短语和这个具体动作一起记住。

gloss_zh: 边境检查站；边境通行口岸

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official place where people or vehicles cross a border and undergo checks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供人员或车辆跨越国境并接受证件等检查的正式地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post uffiċjali fejn persuni jew vetturi jgħaddu minn pajjiż għal ieħor u jsiru l-kontrolli meħtieġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设在国境通行地点、负责检查出入境人员或车辆的边境检查站。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post uffiċjali fuq il-fruntiera fejn jiġu ċċekkjati l-persuni jew il-vetturi li jkunu deħlin f'pajjiż jew ħerġin minnu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A border post is an official place where people or vehicles are checked when crossing between countries.

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġaturi għandhom jippreżentaw id-dokumenti tagħhom fil-punt ta' qsim tal-fruntiera.
formal.en: Travellers must present their documents at the border post.
formal.zh: 旅客须在边境检查站出示证件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna 'l bogħod mill-punt ta' qsim tal-fruntiera? Mark: Le, għaxar minuti oħra. Żomm il-passaport lest.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still far from the border post? Mark: No, another ten minutes. Keep your passport ready.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们离边境检查站还远吗？Mark：不远了，再过十分钟就到。把护照准备好。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna 'l bogħod mill-punt ta' qsim tal-fruntiera?
messages.mt_standard: Għadna 'l bogħod mill-punt ta' qsim tal-fruntiera?
messages.zh: 我们离边境检查站还远吗？
messages.en: Are we still far from the border post?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għaxar minuti oħra. Żomm il-passaport lest.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għaxar minuti oħra. Żomm il-passaport lest.
messages.zh: 不远了，再过十分钟就到。把护照准备好。
messages.en: No, another ten minutes. Keep your passport ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整句分成三个意义块来记：punt 是地点，qsim 是跨越，fruntiera 是边境；联想车辆排队过境并出示护照的检查站。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A location through which people, goods, or other things enter a place or system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人员、货物或其他事物进入某个地方或系统所经过的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post li minnu persuni, merkanzija jew affarijiet oħra jidħlu f'post jew f'sistema.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入某个地方或系统的入口或位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post li minnu wieħed jidħol f'post jew f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: An entry point is a location through which someone or something enters a place or system.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某物引入某个地方或环境的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn xi ħaġa tiddaħħal f'post jew f'ambjent partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A place of introduction is the location where something is brought into a particular place or environment.

sense_translations.en_definition: place of introduction into the customs territory
sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物进入某一关境的地点。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post fejn il-merkanzija tidħol fit-territorju doganali.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A place of introduction into the customs territory is the location where goods enter that customs territory.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人员或物品进入某一区域的地点或通道。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Post jew passaġġ li minnu persuni jew oġġetti jidħlu f'żona.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A point of entry is a place or passage through which people or objects enter an area.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物被引入某个区域或系统的具体位置。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Punt speċifiku fejn xi ħaġa tiddaħħal f'żona jew f'sistema.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A point of introduction is the particular position at which something is brought into an area or system.

collocations.en: checks at the point of entry
collocations.zh: 在入境地点进行的检查

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi kollha għandhom jirreġistraw fil-punt tad-dħul prinċipali qabel jidħlu fil-bini.
formal.en: All visitors must register at the main entry point before entering the building.
formal.zh: 所有访客进入大楼前，均须在主要入口登记。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Fejn hu l-punt tad-dħul għall-viżitaturi? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb il-kbir; hemmhekk tista' tirreġistra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Where is the entry point for visitors? Pawlu: Beside the large door; you can register there.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：访客入口在哪里？保罗：在那扇大门旁边；你可以在那里登记。

messages.speaker: Marta (访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-punt tad-dħul għall-viżitaturi?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-punt tad-dħul għall-viżitaturi?
messages.zh: 访客入口在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the entry point for visitors?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb il-kbir; hemmhekk tista' tirreġistra.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb il-kbir; hemmhekk tista' tirreġistra.
messages.zh: 在那扇大门旁边；你可以在那里登记。
messages.en: Beside the large door; you can register there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整条短语想成地图上标出的一个入口点；看到人流或货物流入的箭头，就联想“进入点、入口”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool held against a nail head and struck with a hammer to sink the head below the surrounding surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种抵住钉头并用锤子敲击，使钉头沉入材料表面以下的工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda li titqiegħed fuq ras musmar u tintlaqat b'martell biex iddaħħal ir-ras taħt il-wiċċ tal-materjal.

sense_translations.en_definition: Tool placed on nail that is hit with a hammer to drive the head of the nail under the surface.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 沉钉冲；抵住钉头后承受锤击，将钉头打入材料表面以下的工具。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għodda li wieħed iżomm fuq ras musmar u jolqot b'martell sabiex ir-ras tinżel taħt il-wiċċ tal-materjal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A nail set is a tool that you strike with a hammer to drive a nail head below the surface.

collocations.en: to strike the nail set with a hammer
to place the nail set on the nail head

formal.mt: Il-mastrudaxxa uża puntell biex idaħħal ras il-musmar taħt il-wiċċ tal-injam.
formal.en: The carpenter used a nail set to sink the nail head below the surface of the wood.
formal.zh: 木匠用沉钉冲将钉头打入木材表面以下。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Ras il-musmar għadha ħierġa. Rita: Ħu l-puntell u qiegħdu fuqha. Luca: Imbagħad nolqtu bil-martell? Rita: Iva, b'daqqiet ħfief.
colloquial.en: Luca: The nail head is still sticking out. Rita: Take the nail set and place it on the head. Luca: Then do I hit it with the hammer? Rita: Yes, with light taps.
colloquial.zh: Luca：钉头还露在外面。Rita：拿沉钉冲抵住钉头。Luca：然后用锤子敲它吗？Rita：对，轻轻敲。

messages.speaker: Luca (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Ras il-musmar għadha ħierġa.
messages.mt_standard: Ras il-musmar għadha ħierġa.
messages.zh: 钉头还露在外面。
messages.en: The nail head is still sticking out.

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu l-puntell u qiegħdu fuqha.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu l-puntell u qiegħdu fuqha.
messages.zh: 拿沉钉冲抵住钉头。
messages.en: Take the nail set and place it on the head.

messages.speaker: Luca (木工学徒)
messages.mt_spoken: Imbagħad nolqtu bil-martell?
messages.mt_standard: Imbagħad nolqtu bil-martell?
messages.zh: 然后用锤子敲它吗？
messages.en: Then do I hit it with the hammer?

messages.speaker: Rita (木工师傅)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, b'daqqiet ħfief.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, b'daqqiet ħfief.
messages.zh: 对，轻轻敲。
messages.en: Yes, with light taps.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作链记 puntell：工具抵住钉头，锤子敲击工具，钉头沉到表面以下；把三步画成小图帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The marks used in writing to separate sentences and clarify their structure, or the use of those marks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 书写中用来划分句子、表示停顿和明确结构的标点符号，或这些符号的使用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sinjali li jintużaw fil-kitba biex jifirdu s-sentenzi u jiċċaraw l-istruttura tagħhom, jew l-użu ta' dawn is-sinjali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 标点；用于划分句子和明确书面表达结构的符号及其使用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-użu ta' sinjali bħal punt, virgola u marka ta' mistoqsija biex il-kitba tkun ċara u organizzata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Punctuation consists of written marks that separate sentences and help readers understand their structure.

formal.mt: Qabel ma jiġi ppubblikat it-test, għandhom jiġu kkoreġuti l-iżbalji fil-punteġġatura.
formal.en: Before the text is published, its punctuation errors should be corrected.
formal.zh: 文本发表之前，应改正其中的标点使用错误。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Tista' tiċċekkja l-punteġġatura ta' dan il-messaġġ? Mark: Iva, hawn bżonn virgola wara l-isem. Sara: Grazzi, issa naqrah aħjar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you check the punctuation in this message? Mark: Yes, you need a comma after the name here. Sara: Thanks, it's easier for me to read now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你能检查一下这条消息的标点吗？Mark：可以，这里名字后面需要一个逗号。Sara：谢谢，现在读起来更顺了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tiċċekkja l-punteġġatura ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tiċċekkja l-punteġġatura ta' dan il-messaġġ?
messages.zh: 你能检查一下这条消息的标点吗？
messages.en: Can you check the punctuation in this message?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn bżonn virgola wara l-isem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn bżonn virgola wara l-isem.
messages.zh: 可以，这里名字后面需要一个逗号。
messages.en: Yes, you need a comma after the name here.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Grazzi, issa naqrah aħjar.
messages.mt_standard: Grazzi, issa naqrah aħjar.
messages.zh: 谢谢，现在读起来更顺了。
messages.en: Thanks, it's easier for me to read now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给一段没有停顿的文字补上句号和逗号：这项整理工作就是 punteġġatura，把词和修改标点的动作一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A stroke, a sudden medical condition caused by an interruption of blood flow to the brain or bleeding in the brain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 中风，即脑部血流中断或脑内出血引起的突发性疾病。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni medika f'daqqa kkawżata minn waqfien tal-fluss tad-demm lejn il-moħħ jew minn fsada fil-moħħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中风；指因脑部血流中断或脑内出血而突然发病的状况。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li sseħħ f'daqqa meta l-fluss tad-demm lejn parti mill-moħħ jieqaf jew ikun hemm fsada fil-moħħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Apoplexy is an older medical term for a stroke, which can suddenly impair movement, speech, or consciousness.

formal.mt: Il-pazjent qed jirċievi kura ta' riabilitazzjoni wara li sofra puplesija.
formal.en: The patient is receiving rehabilitation care after suffering a stroke.
formal.zh: 患者中风后正在接受康复治疗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu n-nannu wara l-puplesija? Pawlu: Qed jirkupra bil-mod, u llum tkellimna ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is Grandpa after the stroke? Pawlu: He is recovering slowly, and today we talked a little.
colloquial.zh: Lara：爷爷中风后情况怎么样？Pawlu：他正在慢慢康复，今天我们还聊了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif inhu n-nannu wara l-puplesija?
messages.mt_standard: Kif inhu n-nannu wara l-puplesija?
messages.zh: 爷爷中风后情况怎么样？
messages.en: How is Grandpa after the stroke?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jirkupra bil-mod, u llum tkellimna ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jirkupra bil-mod, u llum tkellimna ftit.
messages.zh: 他正在慢慢康复，今天我们还聊了一会儿。
messages.en: He is recovering slowly, and today we talked a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 puplesija 和 sofra puplesija 一起记成“发生中风”，再配上 jirkupra minn puplesija“中风后康复”，用发病与康复两个场景巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A figure of a person or animal that someone moves to make it appear alive, especially in a performance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由人操纵、使其看起来能活动的人形或动物形偶，尤其用于表演。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Figura ta' persuna jew ta' annimal li xi ħadd iċaqlaq biex tidher ħajja, speċjalment waqt spettaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木偶；由人用手、线或杆等操纵来进行表演的偶。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Figura li titħaddem bl-idejn, bil-ħjut jew bil-vireg biex tagħmel movimenti waqt rappreżentazzjoni.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A puppet is a model of a person or animal that a performer moves to tell a story.

formal.mt: Waqt ir-rappreżentazzjoni, l-attur uża pupu tal-injam biex jirrakkonta l-istorja lit-tfal.
formal.en: During the performance, the actor used a wooden puppet to tell the children the story.
formal.zh: 演出期间，演员用一个木偶给孩子们讲故事。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Nista' nċaqlaq il-pupu jien? Rita: Iva, daħħal idek ġewwa u ċaqlaq rasu bil-mod.
colloquial.en: Nina: Can I move the puppet myself? Rita: Yes, put your hand inside and move its head gently.
colloquial.zh: Nina：我可以自己操纵这个木偶吗？Rita：可以，把手伸进去，轻轻地动它的头。

messages.speaker: Nina (孩子)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nċaqlaq il-pupu jien?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nċaqlaq il-pupu jien?
messages.zh: 我可以自己操纵这个木偶吗？
messages.en: Can I move the puppet myself?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, daħħal idek ġewwa u ċaqlaq rasu bil-mod.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, daħħal idek ġewwa u ċaqlaq rasu bil-mod.
messages.zh: 可以，把手伸进去，轻轻地动它的头。
messages.en: Yes, put your hand inside and move its head gently.

cognitive_memory_aid: pupu 和英语 puppet 的开头字母相同，可把两词并排记忆，再想象手中的小偶点头说话；这只是拼写联想，不表示词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Helping the bowels empty by making it easier to pass solid waste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有促进排便、帮助肠道排空作用的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħin lill-imsaren jitbattlu billi jagħmilha aktar faċli li wieħed jipporga.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 能促进排便、具有通便或泻下作用的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiffaċilita l-ħruġ tal-ippurgar mill-imsaren.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A laxative substance helps you pass solid waste from your body more easily.

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-kelma 'purganti' tiddeskrivi mediċina li tgħin lill-imsaren jitbattlu.
formal.en: In the text, the word 'purganti' describes a medicine that helps the bowels empty.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，purganti 一词描述的是一种帮助肠道排空的药物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi tfisser 'purganti' f'din is-sentenza? Pawlu: Tfisser li għandu effett li jgħinek tipporga.
colloquial.en: Lara: What does 'purganti' mean in this sentence? Pawlu: It means that it has an effect that helps you pass stools.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这句话里的 purganti 是什么意思？Pawlu：意思是它具有帮助排便的作用。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'purganti' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'purganti' f'din is-sentenza?
messages.zh: 这句话里的 purganti 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'purganti' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser li għandu effett li jgħinek tipporga.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser li għandu effett li jgħinek tipporga.
messages.zh: 意思是它具有帮助排便的作用。
messages.en: It means that it has an effect that helps you pass stools.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 effett purganti“通便作用”整组记忆：看到 purganti，就想到它在说明某种东西具有帮助排便的性质，本条按形容词学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick covering used on a bed or wrapped around someone to keep them warm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铺盖在床上或裹在身上、用于保暖的毯子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata ħoxna li titqiegħed fuq sodda jew titgeżwer madwar persuna biex iżżommha sħuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于盖身或铺在床上保暖的毯子。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata li tintuża fuq is-sodda jew madwar il-ġisem biex tipproteġi mill-kesħa.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A blanket is a covering that you put over yourself or on a bed to keep warm.

collocations.en: to cover yourself with the blanket

formal.mt: Fuq kull sodda tqiegħed purkan oħxon biex il-mistednin ikunu jistgħu jżommu sħan matul il-lejl.
formal.en: A thick blanket was placed on each bed so that the guests could keep warm during the night.
formal.zh: 每张床上都放了一条厚毯子，供客人在夜间保暖。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-purkan, jekk jogħġbok? Adam: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid ieħor ukoll?
colloquial.en: Nina: I'm feeling cold. Could you pass me the blanket, please? Adam: Of course, here it is. Would you like another one too?
colloquial.zh: Nina：我觉得冷。请把毯子递给我好吗？Adam：当然，给你。还要再来一条吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-purkan, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Qed inħoss il-bard. Tgħaddili l-purkan, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 我觉得冷。请把毯子递给我好吗？
messages.en: I'm feeling cold. Could you pass me the blanket, please?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid ieħor ukoll?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, hawn hu. Trid ieħor ukoll?
messages.zh: 当然，给你。还要再来一条吗？
messages.en: Of course, here it is. Would you like another one too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purkan 放进“冷了就盖毯子”的生活画面里，再读 purkan oħxon“厚毯子”，用物品和触感共同帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Panels fitted to a window that can be closed to block light or provide protection and privacy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安装在窗户上、可以合拢以遮光、防护或保护隐私的窗板或百叶窗，为复数形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pannelli mwaħħlin ma' tieqa li jistgħu jingħalqu biex iżommu d-dawl barra, jipproteġu t-tieqa jew jagħtu privatezza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 窗户上可开合的遮光、防护窗板或百叶窗，指复数。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Għata tat-twieqi magħmula minn pannelli li jinfetħu u jingħalqu biex jikkontrollaw id-dawl u jagħtu protezzjoni jew privatezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Shutters are panels attached to windows that you can close to keep out light or protect the windows.

formal.mt: Il-purtelli tal-injam għandhom jingħalqu filgħaxija biex jipprovdu privatezza lill-kamra.
formal.en: The wooden shutters should be closed in the evening to provide privacy in the room.
formal.zh: 木制窗板应在晚间关上，以保护房间内的隐私。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-purtelli? Ben: Iva, nagħlaqhom issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: The sun is shining straight into my eyes. Can you close the shutters? Ben: Yes, I'll close them now.
colloquial.zh: Sara：阳光正直射我的眼睛。你能关上窗板吗？Ben：可以，我现在就关。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-purtelli?
messages.mt_standard: Ix-xemx qed tidħol dritt f'għajnejja. Tista' tagħlaq il-purtelli?
messages.zh: 阳光正直射我的眼睛。你能关上窗板吗？
messages.en: The sun is shining straight into my eyes. Can you close the shutters?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħlaqhom issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħlaqhom issa.
messages.zh: 可以，我现在就关。
messages.en: Yes, I'll close them now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象阳光刺眼时把窗板合上的动作，用 tagħlaq il-purtelli“关上窗板”整句记忆；本条 purtelli 按复数名词掌握。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hanging piece of fabric used to cover a window or doorway.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬挂在窗户或门口，用来遮光、保护隐私或作装饰的布帘。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa drapp li tiddendel quddiem tieqa jew bieb biex tgħatti, tnaqqas id-dawl jew iżżejjen.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂在窗户或门口的帘子，用于遮挡视线、调节光线或装饰。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Purtiera hija biċċa drapp imdendla quddiem tieqa jew bieb biex tgħatti l-ftuħ, tnaqqas id-dawl jew tagħti aktar privatezza.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A curtain is a piece of fabric that hangs across a window or doorway to provide privacy or control light.

formal.mt: Il-purtiera ħoxna tnaqqas id-dawl tax-xemx li jidħol fil-kamra.
formal.en: The thick curtain reduces the sunlight entering the room.
formal.zh: 厚窗帘减少了照进房间的阳光。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tista' tagħlaq il-purtiera? Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja. Lara: Iva, nagħlaqha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Can you close the curtain? The sun is shining in my eyes. Lara: Yes, I'll close it now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你能把窗帘拉上吗？阳光照得我睁不开眼。拉拉：好，我现在就拉上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tista' tagħlaq il-purtiera? Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja.
messages.mt_standard: Tista' tagħlaq il-purtiera? Ix-xemx qed tidħol f'għajnejja.
messages.zh: 你能把窗帘拉上吗？阳光照得我睁不开眼。
messages.en: Can you close the curtain? The sun is shining in my eyes.

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nagħlaqha issa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nagħlaqha issa.
messages.zh: 好，我现在就拉上。
messages.en: Yes, I'll close it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purtiera 和拉窗帘的动作一起记：阳光刺眼时，伸手把布帘拉上；用画面连接词义。

gloss_zh: 杂务工；门房；看门人；清洁工

teaching_sense.en_definition: A worker who looks after an entrance or carries out practical maintenance and cleaning duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责看守入口、搬运、日常维修或清洁等事务的工作人员，具体职责依场所而定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tieħu ħsieb id-daħla ta' bini jew tagħmel xogħol ta' manutenzjoni, ġarr jew tindif, skont il-post fejn taħdem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 承担杂务维修、搬运、看门或清洁工作的人员；可按具体职责译为杂务工、门房、看门人或清洁工。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Purtinar huwa ħaddiem li, skont id-dmirijiet tiegħu, jagħmel tiswijiet żgħar, jgħin fil-ġarr, jieħu ħsieb id-daħla jew inaddaf il-bini.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A purtinar is a worker whose duties may include small repairs, carrying things, looking after an entrance, or cleaning a building.

collocations.en: to ask the caretaker for help
collocations.zh: 向楼宇杂务管理员求助

formal.mt: Il-purtinar tal-iskola jiftaħ il-bieb prinċipali kull filgħodu u jieħu ħsieb tiswijiet żgħar fil-bini.
formal.en: The school caretaker opens the main door every morning and handles small repairs in the building.
formal.zh: 学校的校务杂工每天早晨打开大门，并负责楼内的小修小补。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min jista' jiftaħ din il-kamra? Anna: Staqsi lill-purtinar; għandu ċ-ċavetta.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who can open this room? Anna: Ask the caretaker; he has the key.
colloquial.zh: 马克：谁能打开这个房间？安娜：问问管理员吧，他有钥匙。

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Min jista' jiftaħ din il-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Min jista' jiftaħ din il-kamra?
messages.zh: 谁能打开这个房间？
messages.en: Who can open this room?

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsi lill-purtinar; għandu ċ-ċavetta.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsi lill-purtinar; għandu ċ-ċavetta.
messages.zh: 问问管理员吧，他有钥匙。
messages.en: Ask the caretaker; he has the key.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 purtinar 时想象一位拿钥匙、会小修小补的楼宇工作人员；再按语境判断他负责看门、搬运还是清洁。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Behaving in a foolish or ridiculous way that shows poor judgment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人行为愚蠢、可笑，表现出缺乏判断力；带贬义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jġib ruħu b'mod iblah jew redikolu u juri nuqqas ta' ġudizzju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愚蠢可笑的；形容人举止像傻瓜，带贬义。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jaġixxi b'mod iblah u bla ġudizzju, b'tali mod li jidher redikolu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone is described this way, they behave foolishly and show a lack of good judgment.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-karattru jidher purċinell meta jiftaħar b'affarijiet li ma jifhimx.
formal.en: In the story, the character looks foolish when he boasts about things he does not understand.
formal.zh: 故事中，这个人物夸耀自己不懂的事情时，显得愚蠢可笑。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ma rridx nidher purċinell quddiem kulħadd. Lara: Mela staqsi jekk ma tifhimx; m'hemm xejn ħażin f'hekk.
colloquial.en: Mark: I don't want to look foolish in front of everyone. Lara: Then ask if you don't understand; there's nothing wrong with that.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我不想在大家面前显得像个傻瓜。Lara：那不懂就问啊，这没什么不好的。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma rridx nidher purċinell quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Ma rridx nidher purċinell quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我不想在大家面前显得像个傻瓜。
messages.en: I don't want to look foolish in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela staqsi jekk ma tifhimx; m'hemm xejn ħażin f'hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Mela staqsi jekk ma tifhimx; m'hemm xejn ħażin f'hekk.
messages.zh: 那不懂就问啊，这没什么不好的。
messages.en: Then ask if you don't understand; there's nothing wrong with that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用 jidher purċinell“显得愚蠢可笑”整块记忆，想象一个人不懂却夸口的场景；本条按形容词学习，并记住它带有贬义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized group of people moving together as part of a ceremony, especially a religious ceremony.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一群人按一定秩序共同前进的仪式性队伍或游行，尤指宗教游行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mixja organizzata ta' grupp ta' nies bħala parti minn ċerimonja, speċjalment waħda reliġjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作为仪式一部分、有秩序地共同前进的队伍或游行，尤指宗教游行。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Grupp ta' nies li jimxu flimkien f'ordni bħala parti minn ċerimonja, ħafna drabi reliġjuża.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A procession is a group of people walking together in an organized way as part of a ceremony.

collocations.en: to take part in the procession

formal.mt: Il-purċissjoni reliġjuża se tibda quddiem il-knisja u tgħaddi mit-toroq tar-raħal.
formal.en: The religious procession will begin in front of the church and pass through the village streets.
formal.zh: 宗教游行将从教堂前出发，经过村里的街道。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tieħu sehem fil-purċissjoni llejla? Mark: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-familja quddiem il-knisja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you taking part in the procession tonight? Mark: Yes, I'm meeting my family in front of the church.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今晚要参加游行吗？Mark：要，我会在教堂前和家人碰面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fil-purċissjoni llejla?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fil-purċissjoni llejla?
messages.zh: 你今晚要参加游行吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in the procession tonight?
