messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-familja quddiem il-knisja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se niltaqa' mal-familja quddiem il-knisja.
messages.zh: 要，我会在教堂前和家人碰面。
messages.en: Yes, I'm meeting my family in front of the church.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purċissjoni 和教堂前整齐前进的队伍联系起来，记住它表示仪式性的游行；再用 tieħu sehem fil-purċissjoni 练习表达“参加游行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The money charged for sending a letter or parcel by post.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过邮政寄送信件或包裹所需支付的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ammont ta' flus li jitħallas biex tintbagħat ittra jew pakkett bil-posta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邮政部门为寄送信件、包裹等邮件而收取的费用。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pustaġġ huwa l-ħlas meħtieġ biex il-posta twassal ittra, pakkett jew oġġett ieħor lid-destinazzjoni tiegħu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Postage is the money you pay to have a letter, parcel, or other item delivered by the postal service.

formal.mt: Il-prezz indikat ma jinkludix il-pustaġġ, li jitħallas separatament.
formal.en: The stated price does not include postage, which is paid separately.
formal.zh: 所标价格不含邮费，邮费须另行支付。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-pustaġġ hu inkluż fil-prezz? Pawlu: Le, trid tħallsu separatament.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is postage included in the price? Pawlu: No, you need to pay it separately.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：价格里包含邮费吗？保罗：不包含，你需要另外支付。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-pustaġġ hu inkluż fil-prezz?
messages.mt_standard: Il-pustaġġ hu inkluż fil-prezz?
messages.zh: 价格里包含邮费吗？
messages.en: Is postage included in the price?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, trid tħallsu separatament.
messages.mt_standard: Le, trid tħallsu separatament.
messages.zh: 不包含，你需要另外支付。
messages.en: No, you need to pay it separately.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pustaġġ 放进寄信付款的画面：信封交到柜台后，要付的那笔邮费就是这个词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A postal worker who delivers letters and other mail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责把信件及其他邮件投递给收件人的邮政工作人员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaddiem tal-posta li jqassam l-ittri u oġġetti postali oħra lir-riċevituri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责投递信件等邮件的邮递员，通常指男性。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pustier huwa raġel li jaħdem mal-posta u jwassal l-ittri u oġġetti postali oħra fl-indirizzi tar-riċevituri.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A postman is a man whose job is to deliver letters and other mail to homes and businesses.

formal.mt: Il-pustier iwassal l-ittri fl-indirizzi miktuba fuq l-envelops.
formal.en: The postman delivers the letters to the addresses written on the envelopes.
formal.zh: 邮递员按照信封上写明的地址投递信件。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadda l-pustier illum? Mark: Iva, ħalla ittra għalik fil-kaxxa tal-ittri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the postman been today? Mark: Yes, he left a letter for you in the letterbox.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：邮递员今天来过了吗？马克：来过了，他在信箱里给你留了一封信。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadda l-pustier illum?
messages.mt_standard: Għadda l-pustier illum?
messages.zh: 邮递员今天来过了吗？
messages.en: Has the postman been today?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalla ittra għalik fil-kaxxa tal-ittri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalla ittra għalik fil-kaxxa tal-ittri.
messages.zh: 来过了，他在信箱里给你留了一封信。
messages.en: Yes, he left a letter for you in the letterbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pustier 和背着邮袋投递信件的人联系起来；与 pustaġġ 成对记忆：一个指邮递员，一个指邮费。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A woman whose job is to deliver letters and parcels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以投递信件和包裹为工作的女性邮递员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mara li xogħolha hu li twassal l-ittri u l-pakketti lir-riċevituri tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 负责投递信件和包裹的女邮递员。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pustiera hija mara li twassal l-ittri u l-pakketti bħala xogħol.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A postwoman is a woman whose job involves delivering letters and parcels to people's homes or workplaces.

formal.mt: Il-pustiera wasslet l-ittra rreġistrata u talbet lir-riċevitur jiffirma.
formal.en: The postwoman delivered the registered letter and asked the recipient to sign.
formal.zh: 女邮递员送来了挂号信，并请收件人签字。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ġiet il-pustiera llum? Toni: Iva, ħalliet żewġ ittri fil-kaxxa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the postwoman come today? Toni: Yes, she left two letters in the letterbox.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：女邮递员今天来了吗？托尼：来了，她在信箱里放了两封信。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ġiet il-pustiera llum?
messages.mt_standard: Ġiet il-pustiera llum?
messages.zh: 女邮递员今天来了吗？
messages.en: Did the postwoman come today?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħalliet żewġ ittri fil-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħalliet żewġ ittri fil-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 来了，她在信箱里放了两封信。
messages.en: Yes, she left two letters in the letterbox.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pustiera 放进“女邮递员把两封信投入信箱”的画面中，连同 twassal l-ittri（投递信件）一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Games or problems that require thought, reasoning, or arranging pieces to find a solution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要动脑、推理或排列拼块才能解决的游戏或题目。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Logħob jew problemi li jeħtieġu l-ħsieb, ir-raġunament jew it-tqegħid ta' biċċiet flimkien biex tinstab soluzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 需要思考和寻找答案的益智谜题，也可指需要把碎片拼合起来的拼图题。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-pużżuli huma logħob jew problemi li wieħed isolvi billi jaħseb, isib rabtiet jew iqiegħed biċċiet flimkien.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Puzzles are games or problems that you solve by thinking carefully, working out relationships, or fitting pieces together.

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel ma jippruvaw isolvu l-pużżuli.
formal.en: Students should read the instructions before attempting to solve the puzzles.
formal.zh: 学生应先阅读说明，再尝试解答这些益智谜题。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid tipprova dawn il-pużżuli miegħi? Mark: Iva, ejja nibdew b'dak li jidher l-aktar faċli.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you want to try these puzzles with me? Mark: Yes, let's start with the one that looks easiest.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你想和我一起试试这些益智谜题吗？马克：想，我们先从看起来最容易的那道开始吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tipprova dawn il-pużżuli miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tipprova dawn il-pużżuli miegħi?
messages.zh: 你想和我一起试试这些益智谜题吗？
messages.en: Do you want to try these puzzles with me?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nibdew b'dak li jidher l-aktar faċli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nibdew b'dak li jidher l-aktar faċli.
messages.zh: 想，我们先从看起来最容易的那道开始吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's start with the one that looks easiest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pużżuli，就想象桌上摆着几道谜题和一盒拼图；把“动脑找答案”的共同画面与这个词一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To catch an animal or another target by using a trap.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用陷阱或捕捉装置捉住动物或其他目标。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqbad annimal jew xi ħaġa oħra permezz ta' nassa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用罗网、套索或其他陷阱捕获。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Taqbad annimal jew xi ħaġa oħra billi tuża nassa li żżommha milli taħrab.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone snares an animal, they catch it using a trap or a device that prevents it from escaping.

collocations.en: caught a mouse in a trap
collocations.zh: 用捕鼠器捉住了一只老鼠

collocations.en: caught a rabbit in a trap
collocations.zh: 用陷阱捉住了一只兔子

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jgħid li l-ħaddiem qabad ġurdien b'nassa fil-maħżen mingħajr ma weġġgħu.
formal.en: The report states that the worker caught a mouse in a trap in the storeroom without injuring it.
formal.zh: 报告称，工作人员在储藏室用捕鼠器捉住了一只老鼠，没有使它受伤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qabad il-ġurdien Pawlu? Nina: Qabdu b'nassa, u mbagħad ħelsu barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Pawlu catch the mouse? Nina: He caught it in a trap and then released it outside.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗是怎么捉住那只老鼠的？妮娜：他用捕鼠器捉住了它，然后把它放到了外面。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif qabad il-ġurdien Pawlu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif qabad il-ġurdien Pawlu?
messages.zh: 保罗是怎么捉住那只老鼠的？
messages.en: How did Pawlu catch the mouse?

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Qabdu b'nassa, u mbagħad ħelsu barra.
messages.mt_standard: Qabdu b'nassa, u mbagħad ħelsu barra.
messages.zh: 他用捕鼠器捉住了它，然后把它放到了外面。
messages.en: He caught it in a trap and then released it outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 按动作和工具分块记：qabad 表示“捉住了”，b'nassa 表示“用陷阱”；想象捕鼠器成功捉住老鼠的画面。

gloss_zh: 过早；未到适当时候；不合时宜

teaching_sense.en_definition: Before the proper, expected, or appointed time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在适当、预期或规定的时间到来之前，常含发生得过早的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabel ma jasal iż-żmien xieraq, mistenni jew stabbilit biex jiġri jew isir xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发生得过早或发生在不适当时候的；不合时宜的。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Li jiġri jew isir qabel iż-żmien xieraq jew f'mument li ma jkunx adattat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Something untimely happens too early or at a moment when it is inappropriate or unwelcome.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某事应当发生的时间到来之前；还没到时候就提前。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qabel ma jasal il-mument li fih xi ħaġa suppost tiġri jew issir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something happens before its time, it happens earlier than it should or earlier than expected.

formal.mt: Il-pubblikazzjoni tar-riżultati qabel il-waqt tista' toħloq konfużjoni fost il-parteċipanti.
formal.en: Publishing the results prematurely may cause confusion among the participants.
formal.zh: 过早公布结果可能使参与者产生困惑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niftħu r-rigali issa? Omm: Le, ma niftħuhomx qabel il-waqt; nistennew sakemm jaslu n-nanniet.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we open the presents now? Mum: No, let's not open them before it's time; we'll wait until your grandparents arrive.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们现在拆礼物好吗？妈妈：不，时候还没到，先别拆；等爷爷奶奶来了再说。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Niftħu r-rigali issa?
messages.mt_standard: Niftħu r-rigali issa?
messages.zh: 我们现在拆礼物好吗？
messages.en: Shall we open the presents now?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ma niftħuhomx qabel il-waqt; nistennew sakemm jaslu n-nanniet.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ma niftħuhomx qabel il-waqt; nistennew sakemm jaslu n-nanniet.
messages.zh: 不，时候还没到，先别拆；等爷爷奶奶来了再说。
messages.en: No, let's not open them before it's time; we'll wait until your grandparents arrive.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qabel 记作“在……之前”，il-waqt 记作“时候”；想象约定拆礼物的时间还没到，便能记住“过早、未到时候”。

gloss_zh: 明天；另有未明确释义的名词义项

teaching_sense.en_definition: In this entry, the symbol denotes tomorrow, the day after today.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 本词条中的符号表示“明天”，即今天之后的那一天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'din l-entrata, is-simbolu jindika għada, jiġifieri l-jum ta' wara llum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明天，即今天之后的那一天。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-jum li jiġi wara llum.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Tomorrow is the day that comes immediately after today.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未明确释义的名词义项，具体含义未定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tifsira bħala nom li mhijiex speċifikata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This noun sense does not have a specified meaning.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, is-simbolu 'Qaghda' jindika l-jum ta' wara llum.
formal.en: In this exercise, the symbol 'Qaghda' denotes the day after today.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，符号“Qaghda”表示今天之后的那一天。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi jfisser 'Qaghda' hawn? Mark: Hawn ifisser għada, il-jum ta' wara llum.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'Qaghda' mean here? Mark: Here it means tomorrow, the day after today.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这里的“Qaghda”是什么意思？马克：这里表示明天，也就是今天之后的那一天。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi jfisser 'Qaghda' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi jfisser 'Qaghda' hawn?
messages.zh: 这里的“Qaghda”是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Qaghda' mean here?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn ifisser għada, il-jum ta' wara llum.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn ifisser għada, il-jum ta' wara llum.
messages.zh: 这里表示明天，也就是今天之后的那一天。
messages.en: Here it means tomorrow, the day after today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本条符号义对应到日历上今天之后的一格，记作“明天”；另列的名词义未明确，分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who has experienced a sudden fright.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 受到突然惊吓的人，所指是人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li ħadet qatgħa, jiġifieri li beżgħet f'daqqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 受过惊吓的人。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna li beżgħet f'daqqa minħabba xi ħaġa li ħasditha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: This sense refers to a person who has experienced a sudden fright.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, il-kelma 'qaghta' tirreferi għal persuna li ħadet qatgħa.
formal.en: In this exercise, the word 'qaghta' refers to a person who has had a fright.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“qaghta”一词指受到惊吓的人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: 'qaghta' hawn tfisser persuna jew ġrajja? Pawlu: Persuna li ħadet qatgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Does 'qaghta' mean a person or an event here? Pawlu: A person who has had a fright.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里的“qaghta”指人还是事件？保罗：指受到惊吓的人。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: 'qaghta' hawn tfisser persuna jew ġrajja?
messages.mt_standard: 'qaghta' hawn tfisser persuna jew ġrajja?
messages.zh: 这里的“qaghta”指人还是事件？
messages.en: Does 'qaghta' mean a person or an event here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Persuna li ħadet qatgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Persuna li ħadet qatgħa.
messages.zh: 指受到惊吓的人。
messages.en: A person who has had a fright.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个突然听见巨响而吓了一跳的人，用这个人物画面记住本条名词义，避免把人和惊吓事件混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To stand with the body upright and supported by the feet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体保持直立，由双脚支撑，即站立。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun wieqaf, b'ġismu dritt u bil-piż tiegħu fuq saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 站立，身体直立并由双脚支撑。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ikun f'pożizzjoni wieqfa, b'ġismu dritt fuq saqajh.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone stands, their body is upright and their weight rests on their feet.

collocations.en: he stood in front of the class

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, ir-rappreżentant qagħad arbulat ħdejn il-bandiera.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the representative stood beside the flag.
formal.zh: 仪式期间，代表站在旗帜旁边。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn qagħad Mark għar-ritratt? David: Qagħad arbulat ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where did Mark stand for the photo? David: He stood beside the door.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克拍照时站在哪里？戴维：他站在门旁。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qagħad Mark għar-ritratt?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qagħad Mark għar-ritratt?
messages.zh: 马克拍照时站在哪里？
messages.en: Where did Mark stand for the photo?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qagħad arbulat ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Qagħad arbulat ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 他站在门旁。
messages.en: He stood beside the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上一幅“人站在门边、身体直立”的画面；与表示坐下的短语对照，记住身体姿势的区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move into a sitting position on a chair or another supporting surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 采取坐姿，坐到椅子或其他可支撑身体的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni bilqiegħda fuq siġġu jew fuq wiċċ ieħor li jsostnih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 坐下，使身体进入坐着的姿势。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jieħu pożizzjoni bilqiegħda, pereżempju billi joqgħod fuq siġġu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When someone sits down, they move into a sitting position on a seat or another surface.

collocations.en: he sat down on a chair
he sat down beside the window

formal.mt: Qabel bdiet il-laqgħa, id-direttur qagħad bilqiegħda ħdejn is-segretarja.
formal.en: Before the meeting began, the director sat down beside the secretary.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，主任在秘书旁边坐下。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn qagħad bilqiegħda Mark? Luqa: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did Mark sit down? Luqa: On the chair beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克在哪里坐下了？卢卡：在窗边的椅子上。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn qagħad bilqiegħda Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn qagħad bilqiegħda Mark?
messages.zh: 马克在哪里坐下了？
messages.en: Where did Mark sit down?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn it-tieqa.
messages.zh: 在窗边的椅子上。
messages.en: On the chair beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人走到窗边的椅子前，然后屈膝坐下；把整个短语和这个动作绑定，再与站立的画面对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cake or sweet pastry shaped like a ring.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做成圆环形、中央有孔的糕饼或甜点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kejk jew għaġina ħelwa magħmula f'għamla ta' ċurkett, b'toqba fin-nofs.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 中央有孔、形状像圆环的糕饼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Kejk jew għaġina ħelwa li għandha għamla tonda u toqba fin-nofs.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A ring cake is a cake or sweet pastry made in a circular shape with a hole in the middle.

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, kull mistieden ingħata qagħqa żgħira mat-te.
formal.en: During the meeting, each guest was given a small ring cake with their tea.
formal.zh: 会议期间，每位来宾都获赠了一块小环形糕饼配茶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid qagħqa mat-te? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Naqsmuha bejnietna?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a ring cake with your tea? Mark: Yes, please. Shall we share it?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想要一块环形糕饼配茶吗？马克：好的，谢谢。我们一起分着吃吧？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid qagħqa mat-te?
messages.mt_standard: Trid qagħqa mat-te?
messages.zh: 你想要一块环形糕饼配茶吗？
messages.en: Would you like a ring cake with your tea?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Naqsmuha bejnietna?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Naqsmuha bejnietna?
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我们一起分着吃吧？
messages.en: Yes, please. Shall we share it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qagħqa 配上一张中间有洞的圆环糕饼图片，记住“环形糕饼”；再用“qagħqa mat-te”联想配茶的点心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To arouse or increase someone's desire or interest in something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人产生或增强对某事物的欲望、兴趣或期待。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqajjem jew iżid ix-xewqa jew l-interess ta' xi ħadd għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 激起或增强某人的欲望、兴趣或期待。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jagħmel lil xi ħadd jixtieq xi ħaġa jew isir aktar interessat fiha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If something whets your interest or desire, it makes you want to discover, experience, or obtain more.

formal.mt: Il-proġett qajjem xewqa għall-qari fost l-istudenti.
formal.en: The project aroused a desire to read among the students.
formal.zh: 这个项目激起了学生们阅读的愿望。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dak il-filmat qajjem xewqa li nsiefer. Pawlu: Lili wkoll! Fejn tixtieq tmur?
colloquial.en: Lara: That video made me want to travel. Pawlu: Me too! Where would you like to go?
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那段视频让我想去旅行了。保罗：我也是！你想去哪里？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-filmat qajjem xewqa li nsiefer.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-filmat qajjem xewqa li nsiefer.
messages.zh: 那段视频让我想去旅行了。
messages.en: That video made me want to travel.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Lili wkoll! Fejn tixtieq tmur?
messages.mt_standard: Lili wkoll! Fejn tixtieq tmur?
messages.zh: 我也是！你想去哪里？
messages.en: Me too! Where would you like to go?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“看完旅行视频，突然很想出发”的场景记住 qajjem xewqa：某件事把心里的愿望激发出来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express a fact, opinion, or decision clearly in words.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用清楚明确的话表达事实、意见或决定；该短语形式表示已经明确说出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Esprima fatt, opinjoni jew deċiżjoni bi kliem ċar li jinftiehem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 以言语明确陈述事实、意见或决定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Jgħid fatt, opinjoni jew deċiżjoni b'mod ċar u espliċitu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you state something, you express a fact, opinion, or decision clearly in spoken or written words.

collocations.zh: 清楚说明了他想要什么

formal.mt: Id-direttur qal ċar li l-proposta kienet teħtieġ aktar diskussjoni.
formal.en: The director clearly stated that the proposal required further discussion.
formal.zh: 主任明确表示，这项提案需要进一步讨论。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'qal Mark dwar il-laqgħa? Toni: Qal ċar li ma jistax jiġi għada.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did Mark say about the meeting? Toni: He clearly stated that he cannot come tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克对这次会议怎么说？托尼：他明确说了，他明天来不了。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qal Mark dwar il-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: X'qal Mark dwar il-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 马克对这次会议怎么说？
messages.en: What did Mark say about the meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Qal ċar li ma jistax jiġi għada.
messages.mt_standard: Qal ċar li ma jistax jiġi għada.
messages.zh: 他明确说了，他明天来不了。
messages.en: He clearly stated that he cannot come tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qal ċar 和会议上明确表态的画面连起来，整组记成“说清楚了”；练习接 li，再补充明确说出的内容。

gloss_zh: 她告诉了她；她对她说了

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese form meaning that she told something to her.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“她告诉了她”或“她对她说了”的马耳他语形式，指过去发生的言语行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali li tfisser li hi qalet xi ħaġa lilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 告诉了；在 qaltilha 这一形式中，表示“她告诉了她”。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tindika li xi ħadd qal xi ħaġa fil-passat; fil-forma qaltilha, hi qalet xi ħaġa lilha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If someone told another person something, they communicated information to that person; qaltilha specifically means that she told her.

formal.mt: L-għalliema kellmet lil Sara u qaltilha li l-eżami kien se jsir it-Tnejn.
formal.en: The teacher spoke to Sara and told her that the examination would take place on Monday.
formal.zh: 女教师与萨拉交谈，并告诉她考试将在星期一举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Anna kellmet lil Lara? Mark: Iva, qaltilha biex tistenna hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Anna speak to Lara? Mark: Yes, she told her to wait here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：安娜跟拉拉说话了吗？马克：说了，她叫拉拉在这里等。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Anna kellmet lil Lara?
messages.mt_standard: Anna kellmet lil Lara?
messages.zh: 安娜跟拉拉说话了吗？
messages.en: Did Anna speak to Lara?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qaltilha biex tistenna hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qaltilha biex tistenna hawn.
messages.zh: 说了，她叫拉拉在这里等。
messages.en: Yes, she told her to wait here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出安娜向拉拉传话的箭头，在旁边写 qaltilha＝“她告诉了她”；同时记住说话者和接收者都是女性。

gloss_zh: 她对你说了；她告诉了你

teaching_sense.en_definition: A verb form expressing that she said something to you or gave you information in the past.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示“她曾对你说某事或告诉你某事”的动词形式，其中接受话语的人是单数的“你”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma verbali li tfisser li hi qalet xi ħaġa lilek fil-passat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 她曾告诉你某事；她曾对你说。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tfisser li hi tkellmet miegħek u qalet xi ħaġa lilek fil-passat.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If she told you something, she communicated that information directly to you.

formal.mt: Is-segretarja qaltlek li l-laqgħa se tibda fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu.
formal.en: The secretary told you that the meeting would begin at nine in the morning.
formal.zh: 秘书告诉了你，会议将在上午九点开始。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qaltlek Sara? Mark: Qaltlek biex tistenna hawn, hux? Maja: Iva, se nistenna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Sara tell you? Mark: She told you to wait here, didn't she? Maja: Yes, I'll wait.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉跟你说了什么？马克：她叫你在这里等，对吧？玛雅：对，我会等。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'qaltlek Sara?
messages.mt_standard: X'qaltlek Sara?
messages.zh: 萨拉跟你说了什么？
messages.en: What did Sara tell you?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qaltlek biex tistenna hawn, hux?
messages.mt_standard: Qaltlek biex tistenna hawn, hux?
messages.zh: 她叫你在这里等，对吧？
messages.en: She told you to wait here, didn't she?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nistenna.
messages.zh: 对，我会等。
messages.en: Yes, I'll wait.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个词记成一个对话小场景：“她已经告诉你了”。复习时同时指出“她、过去、你”三个信息点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Underwear worn over the lower part of the body beneath outer clothing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在裤子、裙子等外衣里面，覆盖下身私密部位的贴身衣物；可泛指内裤，也可指贴身短款内裤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies ta' ġewwa li jintlibes fuq il-parti t'isfel tal-ġisem taħt il-ħwejjeġ ta' barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贴合身体、裤腿很短或没有裤腿的短内裤。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tip ta' qalziet ta' ġewwa qasir li joqgħod qrib il-ġisem u jgħatti l-partijiet intimi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Briefs are short, close-fitting underwear worn over the lower part of the body.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 内裤；穿在外衣里面、覆盖下身私密部位的衣物的统称。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qalziet ta' ġewwa li jintlibes taħt il-ħwejjeġ ta' barra biex jgħatti l-partijiet intimi.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Underpants are garments worn next to the skin beneath trousers, skirts, or other outer clothing.

formal.mt: Għall-vjaġġ, kull parteċipant għandu jġib qalziet ta' taħt nadif għal kull jum.
formal.en: For the trip, each participant should bring clean underpants for every day.
formal.zh: 每位参加者都应为这次旅行准备每天更换的干净内裤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn hu l-qalziet ta' taħt nadif? Omm: Fl-ewwel kexxun, ħdejn il-kalzetti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are the clean underpants? Mum: In the first drawer, next to the socks.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：干净的内裤在哪里？妈妈：在第一个抽屉里，袜子旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-qalziet ta' taħt nadif?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-qalziet ta' taħt nadif?
messages.zh: 干净的内裤在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the clean underpants?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-ewwel kexxun, ħdejn il-kalzetti.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-ewwel kexxun, ħdejn il-kalzetti.
messages.zh: 在第一个抽屉里，袜子旁边。
messages.en: In the first drawer, next to the socks.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用穿衣顺序帮助记忆：先穿内裤，再穿外裤。把这个完整短语和“穿在外衣下面”的画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The Moon at the phase when its visible face appears fully illuminated from Earth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从地球上看，月球朝向我们的可见部分呈完整明亮圆盘的月相，即满月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qamar fil-fażi meta l-wiċċ tiegħu li jidher mid-Dinja jkun jidher kollu mdawwal u tond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 满月；月面从地球上看呈完整明亮圆盘的月相。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Fażi tal-qamar li fiha l-wiċċ li naraw mid-Dinja jidher tond u kollu mdawwal.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A full moon occurs when the Moon's visible face appears completely illuminated from Earth.

collocations.en: a night with a full moon
the light of the full moon

formal.mt: Matul il-lejl ta' qamar kwinta, l-istudenti osservaw il-qamar u ddeskrivew il-forma tonda tiegħu.
formal.en: On the night of the full moon, the students observed the Moon and described its round shape.
formal.zh: 在满月之夜，学生们观察了月亮，并描述了它的圆形外观。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ħares lejn il-qamar! Kemm hu tond illejla! Pawlu: Iva, illejla hemm qamar kwinta.
colloquial.en: Nina: Look at the Moon! It's so round tonight! Pawlu: Yes, there's a full moon tonight.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：看月亮！今晚真圆啊！保罗：是啊，今晚是满月。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħares lejn il-qamar! Kemm hu tond illejla!
messages.mt_standard: Ħares lejn il-qamar! Kemm hu tond illejla!
messages.zh: 看月亮！今晚真圆啊！
messages.en: Look at the Moon! It's so round tonight!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illejla hemm qamar kwinta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illejla hemm qamar kwinta.
messages.zh: 是啊，今晚是满月。
messages.en: Yes, there's a full moon tonight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个完整明亮的圆盘，并在旁边写下整个短语；每次看到圆月，就连同“满月”一起回忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant grown for its edible seeds, or the seeds themselves, which can be cooked or ground into flour.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 荞麦，一种以可食用种子为主要收获物的植物；也指其种子，可煮食或磨粉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta kkultivata għaż-żrieragħ li jittieklu tagħha, jew iż-żrieragħ infushom, li jistgħu jissajru jew jintaħnu biex isir id-dqiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荞麦；其种子可作食物，也可磨成荞麦粉。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħti żrieragħ tajbin għall-ikel u għat-tħin, kif ukoll iż-żrieragħ tagħha użati fit-tisjir.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Buckwheat is a plant whose edible seeds can be cooked whole or ground into flour.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, għalli l-qamh saracin fl-ilma sakemm jirtab, imbagħad ħalltu mal-ħaxix.
formal.en: For this recipe, boil the buckwheat in water until tender, then mix it with the vegetables.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，先将荞麦放入水中煮软，再与蔬菜拌匀。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'se nsajru għall-ikla? Mark: Għandna qamh saracin; nistgħu nsajruh mal-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Sara: What shall we cook for our meal? Mark: We have buckwheat; we can cook it with vegetables.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这顿饭我们做什么？马克：我们有荞麦，可以配蔬菜一起煮。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nsajru għall-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nsajru għall-ikla?
messages.zh: 这顿饭我们做什么？
messages.en: What shall we cook for our meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna qamh saracin; nistgħu nsajruh mal-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna qamh saracin; nistgħu nsajruh mal-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 我们有荞麦，可以配蔬菜一起煮。
messages.en: We have buckwheat; we can cook it with vegetables.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用厨房画面记住整个词组：一边是一碗煮好的荞麦，一边是一袋荞麦粉，把食材和词语同时记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wheat is a cereal plant whose grain is used to make flour and other foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小麦，一种谷类作物，其籽粒可用于磨制面粉和制作食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qamħa hija pjanta taċ-ċereali li l-ħbub tagħha jintużaw biex isir id-dqiq u biex jitħejja l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小麦，一种籽粒可供食用、磨粉的谷类作物。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qamħa hija pjanta taċ-ċereali li titkabbar għall-ħbub tagħha, li jistgħu jintaħnu biex isir id-dqiq.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Wheat is a cereal crop grown for its grain, which can be ground into flour.

formal.mt: Il-qamħa titkabbar għall-ħbub tagħha, li jintużaw fil-produzzjoni tad-dqiq.
formal.en: Wheat is grown for its grain, which is used in flour production.
formal.zh: 种植小麦是为了收获其籽粒，用于生产面粉。

colloquial.mt: Lina: X'inhi dik il-pjanta fl-għalqa? Pawlu: Dik qamħa. Meta timmatura, issir kulur id-deheb.
colloquial.en: Lina: What's that plant in the field? Pawlu: That's wheat. When it ripens, it turns golden.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：田里那是什么植物？保罗：那是小麦。成熟后会变成金黄色。

messages.speaker: Lina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-pjanta fl-għalqa?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-pjanta fl-għalqa?
messages.zh: 田里那是什么植物？
messages.en: What's that plant in the field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik qamħa. Meta timmatura, issir kulur id-deheb.
messages.mt_standard: Dik qamħa. Meta timmatura, issir kulur id-deheb.
messages.zh: 那是小麦。成熟后会变成金黄色。
messages.en: That's wheat. When it ripens, it turns golden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qamħa 配上金色麦田的画面，再联想到磨面粉，建立“小麦—麦粒—面粉”的记忆链。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Maize, also called corn, is a cereal plant that produces large ears bearing rows of kernels.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 玉米，一种谷类作物，其果穗上排列着一行行籽粒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qamħirrun huwa pjanta taċ-ċereali li tagħmel bsaten b'ringieli ta' ħbub li jintużaw bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玉米，果穗上密集排列籽粒的一种谷类作物，也可指供食用的玉米。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qamħirrun huwa pjanta taċ-ċereali li titkabbar għall-ħbub tagħha, li jikbru f'ringieli fuq bsaten.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Maize, or corn, is a cereal plant whose kernels grow in rows on large ears.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, għalli l-qamħirrun fl-ilma sakemm il-ħbub jirtabu.
formal.en: For this recipe, boil the corn in water until the kernels soften.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，将玉米放入水中煮至籽粒变软。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Trid ftit qamħirrun mal-ikla? Ġanni: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferih mgħolli.
colloquial.en: Marta: Would you like some corn with your meal? Ġanni: Yes, please. I prefer it boiled.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：吃饭时要配点玉米吗？詹尼：好的，谢谢。我比较喜欢水煮的。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit qamħirrun mal-ikla?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit qamħirrun mal-ikla?
messages.zh: 吃饭时要配点玉米吗？
messages.en: Would you like some corn with your meal?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferih mgħolli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Nippreferih mgħolli.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。我比较喜欢水煮的。
messages.en: Yes, please. I prefer it boiled.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到较长的 qamħirrun，就想象一根长玉米棒，上面排满黄色籽粒；用整幅画面记住“玉米”。

gloss_zh: 用芦苇秆制成的挡风屏障

teaching_sense.en_definition: A qanneċ is a screen made of cane that provides shelter from the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用芦苇秆制成、用于遮挡风的屏障或围挡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanneċ huwa lqugħ magħmul mill-qasab li jintuża biex jilqa' r-riħ u jipproteġi post minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芦苇秆制成的挡风屏障，用来减弱风对某处的吹袭。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qanneċ huwa lqugħ tal-qasab li jitqiegħed biex inaqqas il-qawwa tar-riħ f'post partikolari.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qanneċ is a cane screen placed around or beside an area to shelter it from wind.

collocations.zh: 竖起一道芦苇挡风屏障

formal.mt: Tqiegħed qanneċ ħdejn il-pjanti żgħar biex inaqqas l-effett tar-riħ fuqhom.
formal.en: A cane windbreak was placed beside the young plants to reduce the effect of the wind on them.
formal.zh: 幼苗旁设置了一道芦苇挡风屏障，以减轻风对它们的影响。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex waqqaft qanneċ hawn? Toni: Biex jilqa' r-riħ. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda warajh.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you put up a cane windbreak here? Toni: To block the wind. We can sit behind it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么在这里竖起芦苇挡风屏障？托尼：为了挡风。我们可以坐在它后面。

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex waqqaft qanneċ hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex waqqaft qanneċ hawn?
messages.zh: 你为什么在这里竖起芦苇挡风屏障？
messages.en: Why did you put up a cane windbreak here?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jilqa' r-riħ. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda warajh.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jilqa' r-riħ. Nistgħu noqogħdu bilqiegħda warajh.
messages.zh: 为了挡风。我们可以坐在它后面。
messages.en: To block the wind. We can sit behind it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qanneċ 想成花园里竖起的一排芦苇秆，风被挡住，人坐在后面；同时记住材料和用途。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To browse a text is to read through it lightly without examining every detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 浏览或粗略阅读文字，只了解大致内容，而不逐一细看所有细节。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqra test fuq fuq ifisser li tgħaddi minn fuqu biex tieħu idea ġenerali mingħajr ma teżamina kull dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 浏览，指粗略地阅读文字以了解大意，不深入细读。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Meta xi ħadd jaqra test fuq fuq, jaqrah b'mod ħafif biex jara x'fih mingħajr ma jidħol fid-dettalji kollha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you browse a text, you read through it casually to get a general idea of its contents.

formal.mt: L-istudent qara fuq fuq ir-rapport biex jieħu idea ġenerali, imbagħad reġa' qrah bir-reqqa.
formal.en: The student browsed through the report to get a general idea, then read it again carefully.
formal.zh: 学生先粗略阅读报告以了解大意，然后又仔细读了一遍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Mark qara l-artiklu kollu? Nina: Qara fuq fuq biss. Għadu ma qarax id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did Mark read the whole article? Nina: He only browsed through it. He hasn't read the details yet.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克把整篇文章都读了吗？妮娜：他只是粗略浏览了一下，还没读细节。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark qara l-artiklu kollu?
messages.mt_standard: Mark qara l-artiklu kollu?
messages.zh: 马克把整篇文章都读了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark read the whole article?

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Qara fuq fuq biss. Għadu ma qarax id-dettalji.
messages.mt_standard: Qara fuq fuq biss. Għadu ma qarax id-dettalji.
messages.zh: 他只是粗略浏览了一下，还没读细节。
messages.en: He only browsed through it. He hasn't read the details yet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qara fuq fuq 想成目光在文字表面轻轻掠过：抓住大意就继续往下看，用这个动作记住“粗略浏览”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pumpkin is a large, round fruit with a thick skin and firm flesh, commonly cooked as a vegetable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 南瓜，一种通常呈圆形、外皮较厚、果肉结实，常作为蔬菜烹调的果实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Frotta kbira u tonda b'qoxra ħoxna u laħam sod, li normalment tissajjar bħala ħaxixa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 南瓜，外皮较厚、果肉可供烹调食用的瓜类果实。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Frotta kbira b'qoxra ħoxna u laħam sod li jintuża fit-tisjir, pereżempju biex isiru sopop u torti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A pumpkin is a large fruit with a thick skin whose flesh is often used in soups, pies, and other cooked dishes.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, aqta' l-qargħa ħamra f'biċċiet żgħar u sajjarha sakemm tirtab.
formal.en: For this recipe, cut the pumpkin into small pieces and cook it until it softens.
formal.zh: 按照这份食谱，把南瓜切成小块，煮至变软。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'se nsajru llejla? Pawlu: Għandna qargħa ħamra; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
colloquial.en: Marija: What shall we cook tonight? Pawlu: We have a pumpkin; we can make soup with it.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今晚我们做什么吃？保罗：我们有一个南瓜，可以用它煮汤。

messages.speaker: Marija (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nsajru llejla?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nsajru llejla?
messages.zh: 今晚我们做什么吃？
messages.en: What shall we cook tonight?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna qargħa ħamra; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna qargħa ħamra; nistgħu nagħmlu soppa biha.
messages.zh: 我们有一个南瓜，可以用它煮汤。
messages.en: We have a pumpkin; we can make soup with it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qargħa ħamra 整体记成厨房里的南瓜，再用 soppa tal-qargħa ħamra“南瓜汤”建立食物联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A qarħa is a wound that forms when the skin is scratched.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因抓挠或刮擦使皮肤破损而形成的伤口。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferita li tinħoloq meta l-ġilda tinqala' jew tinkiser minħabba li xi ħadd jobroxha.

sense_translations.en_definition: a wound caused by scratching the skin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抓挠或刮破皮肤所造成的伤口。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ferita fil-ġilda li tkun ikkawżata minn grif jew brix fuqha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qarħa is a wound on the skin that has been caused by scratching it.

collocations.en: a small wound caused by scratching
collocations.zh: 一处抓破皮肤的小伤口

collocations.en: a scratch wound on the arm

formal.mt: It-tifel baqa' jobrox il-ġilda fuq driegħu sakemm għamel qarħa żgħira.
formal.en: The boy kept scratching the skin on his arm until he made a small wound.
formal.zh: 男孩不停地抓挠手臂上的皮肤，直到抓出了一处小伤口。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġaralek f'idek? Mark: Kont qed nobrox il-ġilda u għamilt qarħa.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to your hand? Mark: I was scratching my skin and made a wound.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你的手怎么了？马克：我刚才抓挠皮肤，抓出了一个伤口。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'ġaralek f'idek?
messages.mt_standard: X'ġaralek f'idek?
messages.zh: 你的手怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to your hand?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kont qed nobrox il-ġilda u għamilt qarħa.
messages.mt_standard: Kont qed nobrox il-ġilda u għamilt qarħa.
messages.zh: 我刚才抓挠皮肤，抓出了一个伤口。
messages.en: I was scratching my skin and made a wound.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手臂被抓破后留下的小伤口，用 qarħa żgħira“小抓伤”把词形与具体画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chestnut is an edible nut with a shiny brown shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 栗子，一种具有光滑棕色硬壳、内部种仁可食用的坚果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġewża li tittiekel u li għandha qoxra kannella, iebsa u tleqq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 栗子，包在棕色硬壳中的可食用坚果。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Ġewża b'qoxra kannella u iebsa, li l-parti ta' ġewwa tagħha tittiekel, spiss wara li tkun inkaljat jew għallietha.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A chestnut is an edible nut with a smooth brown shell, often eaten after roasting or boiling.

formal.mt: Wara li nkaljat il-qastna, neħħi l-qoxra qabel ma tiekolha.
formal.en: After roasting the chestnut, remove the shell before eating it.
formal.zh: 烤好栗子后，先去掉外壳再食用。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid qastna mixwija? David: Iva, grazzi. Għadha sħuna?
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like a roasted chestnut? David: Yes, thanks. Is it still hot?
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你要吃一颗烤栗子吗？戴维：要，谢谢。它还烫吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid qastna mixwija?
messages.mt_standard: Trid qastna mixwija?
messages.zh: 你要吃一颗烤栗子吗？
messages.en: Would you like a roasted chestnut?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Għadha sħuna?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Għadha sħuna?
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。它还烫吗？
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Is it still hot?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qastna 想成掌心里一颗棕色栗子，再联想剥开 il-qoxra tal-qastna“栗子壳”的动作来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To subtract means to take one number or amount away from another to find what remains.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从一个数或总量中减去另一个数或数量，求出剩余的数值或数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tnaqqas numru jew ammont minn numru jew ammont ieħor biex issib kemm jibqa'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 减去；从某个数或总量中扣除另一个数或数量。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tneħħi valur numeriku minn valur ieħor permezz ta' kalkolu biex issib id-differenza bejniethom.
sense_translations.en_explanation: If you subtract one number from another, you take it away to calculate the amount that remains.

collocations.en: subtracted the expenses from the total

formal.mt: L-istudent qata' barra sebgħa minn għoxrin u kiteb tlettax bħala t-tweġiba.
formal.en: The student subtracted seven from twenty and wrote thirteen as the answer.
formal.zh: 学生从二十中减去七，并写下答案十三。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif insib kemm jibqa' minn għoxrin jekk inneħħi ħamsa? Ġanni: Aqta' barra ħamsa minn għoxrin u jibqgħu ħmistax.
colloquial.en: Sara: How do I work out what is left of twenty if I take away five? Ġanni: Subtract five from twenty, and fifteen remains.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：二十去掉五以后还剩多少，要怎么算？詹尼：从二十中减去五，就剩十五。

messages.speaker: Sara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif insib kemm jibqa' minn għoxrin jekk inneħħi ħamsa?
messages.mt_standard: Kif insib kemm jibqa' minn għoxrin jekk inneħħi ħamsa?
messages.zh: 二十去掉五以后还剩多少，要怎么算？
messages.en: How do I work out what is left of twenty if I take away five?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Aqta' barra ħamsa minn għoxrin u jibqgħu ħmistax.
messages.mt_standard: Aqta' barra ħamsa minn għoxrin u jibqgħu ħmistax.
messages.zh: 从二十中减去五，就剩十五。
messages.en: Subtract five from twenty, and fifteen remains.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 qata' barra 与算式二十减五等于十五一起记；在例句中，minn 后面的 għoxrin 是被减数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The destruction of goods, whether caused by an accident or carried out deliberately.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 货物因事故或人为处置而被毁坏、销毁的过程或结果。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess jew ir-riżultat li fih oġġetti għall-bejgħ jinqerdu, b'mod aċċidentali jew apposta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 货物遭到毁坏或被销毁。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-qerda ta' oġġetti maħsuba għall-bejgħ jew għall-kummerċ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The destruction of goods occurs when products are ruined or deliberately destroyed.

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-qerda ta' merkanzija kkawżata min-nar fil-maħżen.
formal.en: The report describes the destruction of goods caused by the fire in the warehouse.
formal.zh: 报告描述了仓库火灾造成的货物毁坏。

colloquial.mt: Mark: In-nar għamel ħafna ħsara fil-maħżen? Rita: Iva, ikkawża qerda ta' merkanzija, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the fire cause much damage in the warehouse? Rita: Yes, it caused the destruction of goods, but nobody was hurt.
colloquial.zh: 马克：火灾给仓库造成了很大损失吗？丽塔：是的，造成了货物毁坏，不过没有人受伤。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nar għamel ħafna ħsara fil-maħżen?
messages.mt_standard: In-nar għamel ħafna ħsara fil-maħżen?
messages.zh: 火灾给仓库造成了很大损失吗？
messages.en: Did the fire cause much damage in the warehouse?

messages.speaker: Rita (仓库管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ikkawża qerda ta' merkanzija, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ikkawża qerda ta' merkanzija, imma ħadd ma weġġa'.
messages.zh: 是的，造成了货物毁坏，不过没有人受伤。
messages.en: Yes, it caused the destruction of goods, but nobody was hurt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把整个短语配上仓库货物被烧毁的画面，联记“货物毁坏”；再用过期商品被销毁的画面记住主动销毁这一用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cereal plant that produces large ears of yellow or pale grains, or the grains themselves.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种结有棒状果穗的谷类作物，也指其黄色或浅色籽粒，即玉米。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta taċ-ċereali li tagħmel bsaten b'ħafna żrieragħ sofor jew ċari, jew iż-żrieragħ tagħha li jintużaw bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 玉米；也指用作食物的玉米粒。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel bsaten mimlijin żrieragħ, ġeneralment sofor, jew iż-żrieragħ tagħha li jittieklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Corn is a cereal crop whose grains grow in rows on large ears.

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, żid iż-żrieragħ tal-qimħirrum mas-soppa u kompli sajjar għal ħames minuti.
formal.en: For this recipe, add the corn kernels to the soup and continue cooking for five minutes.
formal.zh: 按照这份食谱，将玉米粒加入汤中，再煮五分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit qimħirrum mal-insalata? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, jogħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some corn with the salad? Pawlu: Yes, please, I like it very much.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：沙拉里要加点玉米吗？保罗：好的，谢谢，我很喜欢。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid ftit qimħirrum mal-insalata?
messages.mt_standard: Trid ftit qimħirrum mal-insalata?
messages.zh: 沙拉里要加点玉米吗？
messages.en: Would you like some corn with the salad?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, jogħġobni ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok, jogħġobni ħafna.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢，我很喜欢。
messages.en: Yes, please, I like it very much.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 qimħirrum 就想象一根排列着黄色籽粒的玉米棒，再把“煮玉米”和“玉米粒”两个搭配一起朗读记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An occasion when you eat food, or the food eaten on that occasion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次进餐，或在这次进餐中吃的食物，即一餐、一顿饭。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikla li tittiekel f'ħin partikolari, jew l-ikel li jittiekel f'dik l-okkażjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一餐；一次进餐时所吃的饭食。
sense_translations.mt_definition: L-ikel li persuna tiekol f'okkażjoni waħda, bħal waqt l-ikla ta' nofsinhar jew ta' filgħaxija.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A meal is the food you eat on a particular occasion during the day.

formal.mt: Wara l-vjaġġ, il-grupp ingħata qirew sħun fis-sala tal-ikel.
formal.en: After the journey, the group was served a hot meal in the dining hall.
formal.zh: 旅途结束后，这个团体在餐厅吃到了一顿热饭。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'se nieklu meta naslu d-dar? David: Inħejji qirew sempliċi, forsi soppa u ftit ħobż.
colloquial.en: Anna: What will we eat when we get home? David: I'll prepare a simple meal, perhaps soup and some bread.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：到家后我们吃什么？戴维：我做顿简单的饭，或许喝点汤，再吃点面包。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: X'se nieklu meta naslu d-dar?
messages.mt_standard: X'se nieklu meta naslu d-dar?
messages.zh: 到家后我们吃什么？
messages.en: What will we eat when we get home?

messages.speaker: David (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Inħejji qirew sempliċi, forsi soppa u ftit ħobż.
messages.mt_standard: Inħejji qirew sempliċi, forsi soppa u ftit ħobż.
messages.zh: 我做顿简单的饭，或许喝点汤，再吃点面包。
messages.en: I'll prepare a simple meal, perhaps soup and some bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“旅途结束，坐下吃一顿热饭”的完整场景记 qirew；把它和一餐的食物联系起来，而不是只记某一种菜。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small lie that someone tells, often about an everyday matter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某人说的小谎，通常涉及日常小事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Gidba żgħira li persuna tgħid, ħafna drabi dwar xi ħaġa ta' kuljum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小谎；通常关于小事的一句假话。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Stqarrija qasira li mhijiex vera u li tingħad bħala gidba żgħira.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A fib is a small lie that someone tells about something.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel jgħid qliegħa dwar ix-xogħol tal-iskola, iżda wara jistqarr il-verità.
formal.en: In the story, the boy tells a fib about his schoolwork but later admits the truth.
formal.zh: 故事中，男孩就自己的功课说了个小谎，但后来承认了事实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għedt li kont diġà tlaqt, imma kont għadni d-dar. Rita: Dik kienet qliegħa! Għaliex ma għedtx li kont se tittardja?
colloquial.en: Maja: I said I had already left, but I was still at home. Rita: That was a fib! Why didn't you say you were going to be late?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我说自己已经出门了，其实还在家。丽塔：那是说了个小谎呀！你为什么不说自己会迟到呢？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għedt li kont diġà tlaqt, imma kont għadni d-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għedt li kont diġà tlaqt, imma kont għadni d-dar.
messages.zh: 我说自己已经出门了，其实还在家。
messages.en: I said I had already left, but I was still at home.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik kienet qliegħa! Għaliex ma għedtx li kont se tittardja?
messages.mt_standard: Dik kienet qliegħa! Għaliex ma għedtx li kont se tittardja?
messages.zh: 那是说了个小谎呀！你为什么不说自己会迟到呢？
messages.en: That was a fib! Why didn't you say you were going to be late?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象人还在家里，却说“我已经出门了”，用这个日常小谎记住 qliegħa，再联记 tgħid qliegħa“说个小谎”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The courage to face fear, difficulty, or danger.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面对恐惧、困难或危险时表现出的勇气与英勇精神。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kuraġġ li persuna turi meta tiffaċċja l-biża', id-diffikultajiet jew il-periklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面对恐惧或困难而仍愿意采取行动的勇气。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kuraġġ li jippermetti lil persuna taġixxi minkejja l-biża' jew id-diffikultajiet.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Courage is the ability to face fear or difficulty and act despite it.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在危险处境中表现出的英勇，尤指勇敢行动所体现的品质。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Il-kuraġġ kbir li jintwera permezz ta' għemil qalbieni f'sitwazzjoni ta' periklu.
sense_translations.en_explanation: Valour is great bravery shown through actions in a dangerous situation.

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema tas-salvataġġ urew qlubija kbira meta daħlu fil-bini biex isalvaw lin-nies.
formal.en: The rescue workers showed great courage when they entered the building to save people.
formal.zh: 救援人员进入大楼救人时，表现出了极大的勇气。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Bżajt nitkellem quddiem kulħadd, imma xorta tkellimt. Lara: Urejt qlubija; mhux faċli titkellem meta tkun beżgħana.
colloquial.en: Maja: I was afraid to speak in front of everyone, but I spoke anyway. Lara: You showed courage; speaking when you are afraid is not easy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我害怕在大家面前发言，但还是开口了。拉拉：你表现出了勇气；害怕的时候还能发言并不容易。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Bżajt nitkellem quddiem kulħadd, imma xorta tkellimt.
messages.mt_standard: Bżajt nitkellem quddiem kulħadd, imma xorta tkellimt.
messages.zh: 我害怕在大家面前发言，但还是开口了。
messages.en: I was afraid to speak in front of everyone, but I spoke anyway.

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Urejt qlubija; mhux faċli titkellem meta tkun beżgħana.
messages.mt_standard: Urejt qlubija; mhux faċli titkellem meta tkun beżgħana.
messages.zh: 你表现出了勇气；害怕的时候还能发言并不容易。
messages.en: You showed courage; speaking when you are afraid is not easy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和“虽然害怕，仍然行动”的画面绑定：日常困难中是勇气，危险行动中可译为英勇。

gloss_zh: 芦苇制挡风屏；苇秆挡风篱

teaching_sense.en_definition: Screens or barriers made of cane and used to reduce the force of the wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用苇秆制成、用于遮挡风力的屏障或篱笆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skrins jew ċnut magħmulin mill-qasab li jintużaw biex inaqqsu l-qawwa tar-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 由苇秆制成的挡风屏障。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Skrins jew ċnut tal-qasab li jitqiegħdu bħala lqugħ kontra r-riħ.
sense_translations.en_explanation: These are barriers made from cane that provide shelter by reducing the force of the wind.

formal.mt: Tqiegħdu qnieneċ madwar iż-żona tat-tħawwil biex jipproteġu l-pjanti żgħar mir-riħ.
formal.en: Cane windbreaks were placed around the planting area to protect the young plants from the wind.
formal.zh: 种植区周围设置了苇秆挡风屏，以保护幼苗免受风吹。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn inqiegħdu s-siġġijiet? Rita: Wara l-qnieneċ, għax hemm inkunu aktar protetti mir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where shall we put the chairs? Rita: Behind the cane windbreaks, because we will be more sheltered from the wind there.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们把椅子放在哪里？丽塔：放在苇秆挡风屏后面，那边比较避风。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn inqiegħdu s-siġġijiet?
messages.mt_standard: Fejn inqiegħdu s-siġġijiet?
messages.zh: 我们把椅子放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we put the chairs?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara l-qnieneċ, għax hemm inkunu aktar protetti mir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Wara l-qnieneċ, għax hemm inkunu aktar protetti mir-riħ.
messages.zh: 放在苇秆挡风屏后面，那边比较避风。
messages.en: Behind the cane windbreaks, because we will be more sheltered from the wind there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一排苇秆编成的屏障，风吹过后明显减弱；把这个词记成“苇秆做的挡风屏”。

gloss_zh: 否；表示拒绝或不同意的答复

teaching_sense.en_definition: A negative answer expressing refusal or disagreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示拒绝或不同意的否定答复，相当于“不”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġiba negattiva li tesprimi rifjut jew nuqqas ta' qbil u li tfisser 'le'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示“不”或“否”的否定答复。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Tweġiba li tfisser 'le' u li tintuża biex tesprimi rifjut jew nuqqas ta' qbil.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A no is a negative answer that expresses refusal or disagreement.

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, 'Qorqa' għandha t-tifsira ta' tweġiba negattiva, jiġifieri 'le'.
formal.en: In this exercise, 'Qorqa' has the meaning of a negative answer, namely 'no'.
formal.zh: 在本练习中，“Qorqa”表示否定答复，即“不”。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser 'Qorqa' hawn? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser 'le', jiġifieri tweġiba negattiva.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does 'Qorqa' mean here? Pawlu: Here it means 'no', that is, a negative answer.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：“Qorqa”在这里是什么意思？保罗：这里表示“不”，也就是否定答复。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi tfisser 'Qorqa' hawn?
messages.mt_standard: Xi tfisser 'Qorqa' hawn?
messages.zh: “Qorqa”在这里是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'Qorqa' mean here?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser 'le', jiġifieri tweġiba negattiva.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser 'le', jiġifieri tweġiba negattiva.
messages.zh: 这里表示“不”，也就是否定答复。
messages.en: Here it means 'no', that is, a negative answer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为本词条画一张写着“不”的回答卡，看到 Qorqa 就联想“一个否定答复”，按名词义记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An expression reacting to something as ridiculous or laughable.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某件事情荒唐或可笑时使用的表达，相当于“真是个笑话”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Espressjoni li turi li xi ħaġa titqies redikola jew tad-daħk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 真是个笑话；用于表达某事荒唐可笑的反应。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Espressjoni li tintuża bħala reazzjoni għal xi ħaġa li tidher redikola jew tad-daħk.
sense_translations.en_explanation: You use this expression when you consider something ridiculous or laughable.

collocations.en: what a joke, this cannot be serious!
collocations.zh: 真是个笑话，这不可能是认真的！

formal.mt: F'djalogu miktub, 'qqqa' tista' tesprimi r-reazzjoni ta' persuna għal proposta li tqisha redikola.
formal.en: In a written dialogue, 'qqqa' can express a person's reaction to a proposal they consider ridiculous.
formal.zh: 在书面对话中，“qqqa”可以表达一个人对其认为荒唐的提议所作的反应。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Iridu li nlestu dan ix-xogħol kollu f'ħames minuti. Mark: qqqa, dan mhux serju! Għandna bżonn ħafna aktar ħin.

gloss_zh: 淘气的小男孩；小捣蛋鬼

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young male person who is mischievous and naughty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指年纪小、爱恶作剧或行为淘气的男性，通常可理解为“小捣蛋鬼”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel jew żagħżugħ li jħobb jagħmel il-praspar u jġib ruħu b'mod imqareb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 淘气、顽皮的男孩或年轻男性；小捣蛋鬼。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Persuna żgħira ta' sess maskili li tkun imqarrba u tħobb tagħmel il-praspar.
sense_translations.en_explanation: A qrejqeċ is a young male person who behaves naughtily and enjoys making mischief.

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-qrejqeċ jaħbi l-lapsijiet ta' sħabu u mbagħad jitlob skuża għall-imġiba tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, the mischievous boy hides his classmates' pencils and then apologizes for his behaviour.
formal.zh: 故事里，那个淘气的小男孩藏起同学们的铅笔，随后为自己的行为道歉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ħeba l-ballun taħt is-sodda? Mark: Dak il-qrejqeċ ta' ħija! Dejjem jagħmel il-praspar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who hid the ball under the bed? Mark: That little rascal of a brother of mine! He's always getting up to mischief.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把球藏到床底下了？Mark：我弟弟那个小捣蛋鬼！他总爱搞恶作剧。

gloss_zh: 一种植物名，可能指 Lotus edulis

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant name that may refer to Lotus edulis, although the identification is uncertain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植物的名称，可能指学名为 Lotus edulis 的植物，但这一对应关系尚不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ta' pjanta li jista' jirreferi għal Lotus edulis, għalkemm din l-identifikazzjoni mhijiex ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可能指 Lotus edulis；具体植物身份尚未确定。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Isem li possibbilment jindika l-pjanta Lotus edulis, iżda r-rabta ma' din l-ispeċi mhijiex ikkonfermata.
sense_translations.en_explanation: The name qrempuċ may denote Lotus edulis, but its identification with that species remains uncertain.

collocations.en: the identification of the plant called qrempuċ
collocations.zh: 对名为 qrempuċ 的植物的鉴定

formal.mt: L-isem 'qrempuċ' jista' jirreferi għal Lotus edulis, iżda din l-identifikazzjoni teħtieġ konferma.
formal.en: The name 'qrempuċ' may refer to Lotus edulis, but this identification requires confirmation.
formal.zh: “qrempuċ”这一名称可能指 Lotus edulis，但这一鉴定仍需确认。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-qrempuċ huwa Lotus edulis? Mark: Jista' jkun, imma l-identifikazzjoni għadha mhijiex ċerta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is qrempuċ Lotus edulis? Mark: It could be, but the identification is still uncertain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：qrempuċ 就是 Lotus edulis 吗？Mark：有可能，不过目前还不能确定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Processing or presentation that occurs shortly after events happen, with only a small delay.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事件发生后仅有较短延迟便进行处理或呈现的状态，即接近实时。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Proċessar jew preżentazzjoni ta' informazzjoni li jseħħu ftit wara l-avvenimenti, b'dewmien qasir biss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 近实时；指处理或呈现与实际事件发生之间只有较短延迟。
sense_translations.mt_definition: Qagħda li fiha l-informazzjoni tiġi pproċessata jew murija b'dewmien qasir biss wara li jseħħu l-avvenimenti.
sense_translations.en_explanation: When information is processed close to real-time, it becomes available shortly after the relevant events occur.

formal.mt: Is-sistema tipprovdi aġġornamenti qrib il-ħin reali sabiex l-operaturi jkunu jistgħu jsegwu l-bidliet b'dewmien qasir.
formal.en: The system provides near-real-time updates so that operators can follow changes with only a short delay.
formal.zh: 该系统提供近实时更新，使操作人员只需等待较短时间就能掌握变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-mappa turi fejn tinsab il-karozza tal-linja bħalissa? Mark: Tagħti aġġornamenti qrib il-ħin reali, allura jista' jkun hemm dewmien żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does the map show where the bus is right now? Mark: It provides near-real-time updates, so there may be a slight delay.
colloquial.zh: Maja：地图显示的是公交车现在的位置吗？Mark：它提供近实时更新，所以可能有一点延迟。
